papers.title: AutoDex: An Automated Real-World System for Dexterous Grasping Data Collection
papers.abstract_en: Learning robust dexterous grasping requires real-world data that records the physical outcomes of grasp attempts. Such data is hard to obtain at scale: teleoperation yields valid physical outcomes but is slow and operator-biased, while simulation-based generation is cheap and scalable but cannot certify contact validity. A natural solution is to generate candidate grasps and verify them on real hardware, but this scales only if the entire collection loop (perception, execution, labeling, and reset) runs without human intervention. We present AutoDex, an automated real-world data-collection system that closes this loop: for each candidate from a replaceable generator, it localizes the object under severe hand-object occlusion with dense 20-camera perception, executes collision-monitored robot motions, labels lift-and-hold success or failure, and actively resets the object between trials to expose additional candidates across stable poses. The result is a reusable database of physically labeled grasp trials that downstream systems can query by retrieval and feasibility filtering. Using AutoDex, we collect 3,593 grasp trials across Allegro and Inspire hands on 100 diverse objects, with synchronized multi-view observations and robot-state logs. For a matched 500-trajectory collection, AutoDex requires 10.3 h versus 49.4 h for teleoperation, yielding a 4.8x throughput improvement, and grasps retrieved from the AutoDex-validated database succeed 76% versus 34% for simulation-only validation. Code and data will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoDex 是一个自动化真实世界灵巧抓取数据收集系统，它通过密集相机感知、碰撞监控、主动重置物体等模块，闭环地生成候选抓取、执行并物理标记成功或失败，从而构建可复用的抓取轨迹数据库。使用 AutoDex 在 100 个物体上收集了 3,593 次抓取试验，相比遥操作实现 4.8 倍吞吐量提升，且基于 AutoDex 验证数据库的检索抓取成功率为 76%，远高于纯仿真验证的 34%。
Motivation: 现有灵巧抓取数据获取存在两难：遥操作费时且带有操作者偏差，仿真生成无法保证真实物理接触有效性。需要一种无需人工干预的自动闭环数据收集系统，以规模化获取真实物理标记的抓取数据。
Method: AutoDex 包含四个自动环节：使用可替换的抓取生成器产生候选，通过 20 个密集相机在多视角下对严重手-物遮挡进行物体定位，执行碰撞监控的机器人运动，标记抬举-保持成功与否，并在试验间主动重置物体以暴露更多稳定位姿下的候选抓取。
Result: 在 100 个物体上收集 3,593 次抓取试验；对于匹配的 500 次轨迹收集，AutoDex 耗时 10.3 小时，而遥操作需 49.4 小时（4.8 倍吞吐量提升）；从 AutoDex 验证数据库检索的抓取成功率为 76%，纯仿真验证仅为 34%。
Conclusion: 论文展示了通过自动化闭环系统可以高效收集真实物理验证的灵巧抓取数据，显著提升数据收集效率和下游系统性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lift4D: Harmonizing Single-View 3D Estimation for 4D Reconstruction In-the-Wild
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing dynamic non-rigid objects from monocular video requires integrating visual cues from direct observations with data-driven priors over geometry and appearance. Prior approaches either learn to directly predict 4D representations from visual input or initialize a 3D representation that is subsequently deformed and refined based on video evidence. However, the former are constrained by the scarcity of 4D training data, while the latter leverage priors only for the initial reconstruction and rely solely on video supervision thereafter; neither handles complex in-the-wild scenarios with large deformations and occlusions well. We present Lift4D, a test-time optimization framework that addresses both limitations. First, we adapt an existing single-view 3D reconstruction model to yield temporally consistent per-frame predictions via causal latent conditioning, providing a coherent initialization for a deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting representation. We then ``sculpt'' this representation to match the input video through an occlusion-aware optimization that faithfully recovers visible surface details while completing unobserved regions using a view-conditioned diffusion prior. We demonstrate that Lift4D clearly improves over prior 4D reconstruction methods, particularly on challenging in-the-wild sequences with severe occlusions and non-rigid motion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Lift4D，一种测试时优化框架，用于从单目视频重建动态非刚性物体的 4D 表示。该方法首先通过因果潜在条件适配单视图 3D 重建模型，生成时间一致的逐帧预测，作为可变形 3D 高斯泼溅表示的初始化；然后通过遮挡感知优化，利用视图条件扩散先验恢复可见表面细节并补全未观察区域。实验表明，Lift4D 在具有严重遮挡和非刚性运动的野外序列上显著优于先前方法。
Motivation: 现有 4D 重建方法要么因 4D 训练数据稀缺而受限，要么仅利用先验进行初始重建、后续仅依赖视频监督，难以处理大变形和遮挡的复杂野外场景。
Method: Lift4D 包含两步：1）通过因果潜在条件使单视图 3D 重建模型生成时间一致的多帧预测，作为可变形 3D 高斯泼溅的初始化；2）通过遮挡感知优化，结合视图条件扩散先验，恢复可见表面细节并补全未观察区域。
Result: 在具有严重遮挡和非刚性运动的野外序列上，Lift4D 显著优于先前 4D 重建方法。
Conclusion: Lift4D 通过测试时优化结合单视图先验和视频约束，有效解决了野外动态非刚性物体的 4D 重建问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Keep The Essentials: Efficient Reference Conditioned Generation via Token Dropping
papers.abstract_en: Reference-based diffusion models enable highly controllable image generation by leveraging elements from input images to guide prompt-driven synthesis. However, these models are computationally expensive in runtime, and their cost scales severely with the number of input references. While the efficiency of diffusion models has been extensively studied in the context of prompt-driven generation, it remains largely under-explored in the realm of reference-based models. This setting presents unique challenges not addressed by methods focusing solely on generation. In particular, the wasteful representation of references as dense token grids offers significant opportunities for improvement. In this work, we present Sparse Context, a method for constructing sparse reference representations by retaining only a reduced subset of reference tokens. We observe that even without modifying the model, dropping a significant portion of reference tokens at inference time largely preserves its generation capabilities. To fully realize this potential, we fine-tune the model with random token dropping at varying ratios, encouraging robustness to partial reference representations. Crucially, this training strategy decouples the model from any specific token selection rule, allowing flexible control at inference time. At inference time, instead of random dropping, we apply task-aware token selection strategies that prioritize the most informative regions of the reference images, adapting the token budget to the input and task requirements. Extensive experiments show our method achieves a 4x increase in inference speed for multi-reference generation and an 2x for single reference generation. Importantly, this efficiency is achieved without compromising visual quality across both spatially-aligned editing and subject-driven generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Sparse Context 方法，通过丢弃参考图像中的大量 token 来加速参考条件扩散模型。实验表明，在微调模型使其对随机 token 丢弃鲁棒后，推理时采用任务感知的 token 选择策略，可在多参考生成中实现 4 倍加速、单参考生成中实现 2 倍加速，且不损失视觉质量。
Motivation: 参考条件扩散模型的计算成本随参考图像数量急剧增加，而现有效率提升方法主要针对纯文本驱动生成，未充分探索参考条件场景下的优化机会。
Method: 提出 Sparse Context：首先在训练时以随机比例丢弃参考 token 微调模型，使其对部分表示鲁棒；推理时则采用任务感知的 token 选择策略，优先保留参考图像中最具信息量的区域，自适应调整 token 预算。
Result: 在多参考生成任务上推理速度提升 4 倍，单参考生成任务提升 2 倍，且视觉质量与原有方法相当。
Conclusion: 通过构建稀疏参考表示，可在不牺牲生成质量的前提下显著提升参考条件扩散模型的推理效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoorDex: Coordinating Body and Hand Priors for Continuous Dexterous Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid loco-manipulation is often simplified into a stop-and-go process: walking to an object, stopping to manipulate it, and then resuming locomotion. It also commonly relies on low degree-of-freedom (DoF) end effectors that behave like an open-close grasp primitive. We introduce CoorDex, a learning pipeline that converts high-dimensional body and dexterous hand control into coordinated latent residual control, enabling high-DoF dexterous loco-manipulation on the move. Starting from simulated whole-body and hand demonstrations, CoorDex trains privileged motion tracking teachers for the humanoid body and dexterous hand, distills them into proprioception-conditioned latent priors, and uses the frozen priors as the action space for downstream residual reinforcement learning. A coordinated latent residual policy composes these priors through shared task context and separate body-hand residual heads, preserving natural whole-body motion while improving finger-level contact reliability. CoorDex enables a Unitree G1 humanoid with a 20-DoF WUJI hand to execute dexterous manipulation while in motion, including non-stop bottle grasping and carrying, fridge door opening on the move, and cube pick-and-turn. Ablations on the walk-grasp-carry task show that joint-space PPO, joint-space hand control, and monolithic latent prediction all fail under the same reward budget, while the latent-prior interface and coordinated residual structure make high-dimensional contact-rich loco-manipulation trainable. Project Page: https://skevinci.github.io/coordex/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoorDex 学习流水线，将人体全身和灵巧手的高维控制转换为协调的潜在残差控制，使 Unitree G1 人形机器人配备 20-DoF WUJI 手能够执行非停止的灵巧操作（如抓取瓶子、开门、翻转方块）。该方法通过从演示训练特权运动跟踪教师，蒸馏为基于本体感觉的潜在先验，并冻结作为残差强化学习的动作空间，协调的潜在残差策略通过共享任务上下文和分离的身体-手残差头部组合这些先验。消融实验表明，在行走-抓取-携带任务中，关节空间 PPO、关节空间手控制和单块潜在预测均失败，而潜在先验接口和协调残差结构使高维接触丰富的灵巧操作可训练。
Motivation: 现有类人机器人操作通常简化为止-走过程，依赖低自由度末端执行器，无法实现连续的灵巧操作。
Method: CoorDex 流水线：从模拟演示训练全身和手的特权运动跟踪教师，蒸馏为基于本体感觉的潜在先验，冻结后作为残差强化学习的动作空间，并通过协调的潜在残差策略（共享任务上下文+分离的身体/手残差头部）组合先验。
Result: 在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上实现非停止的瓶抓取与携带、行走中开门、立方体拾取翻转。消融实验显示其他方法（关节空间 PPO、关节空间手控制、单块潜在预测）均失败。
Conclusion: 潜在先验接口和协调残差结构使得高维、接触丰富的灵巧操作可训练，为连续人形操作提供了可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Semantic Browsing: Controllable Diversity for Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Modern text-to-image models excel in visual fidelity and prompt adherence. However, this strict adherence comes at the cost of diversity: generated samples tend to collapse into a single visual interpretation. Existing methods to improve diversity produce outputs driven by incidental variations rather than meaningful design choices. This motivates a new variant of the diversity task where structure is enforced on the generated samples. We introduce a method for controlled diversity that enables Semantic Browsing, where users can navigate structured image galleries and experience creative exploration through a systematic traversal of meaningful, interpretable axes of variation. Achieving this level of semantic control requires a deep understanding of the scene. We exploit the fact that recent text-to-image models are trained on elaborated captions, effectively decoupling semantic decision-making from pixel generation. This enables a paradigm shift: instead of relying on stochastic variation within the text-to-image model, we induce diversity directly at the text level. By leveraging rich textual representations, we allow a Vision Language Model (VLM) to operate on the full scene context. To overcome the generic outputs typical of standard VLMs, we employ an agentic workflow that explicitly enforces structured variation attuned to the original prompt. We demonstrate that our method produces diverse and navigable design spaces where every variation corresponds to a specific, user-understandable semantic decision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到图像模型生成样本多样性不足的问题，提出可控多样性方法实现语义浏览（Semantic Browsing），让用户通过有意义的、可解释的变异轴系统遍历结构化图像画廊。方法利用文本到图像模型在精细描述上训练的特性，将语义决策与像素生成解耦，在文本层面直接引发多样性，并通过视觉语言模型（VLM）结合智能体工作流强制执行结构化变异。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像模型严格遵循提示导致视觉多样性不足，且提升多样性的方法产生偶然变化而非有意义的设计选择，需要一种在生成样本上施加结构可控多样性的新任务。
Method: 利用现代文本到图像模型在精细描述上训练的特点，将语义决策与像素生成解耦，在文本层面直接引发多样性。采用视觉语言模型（VLM）在完整场景上下文中操作，并通过智能体工作流（agentic workflow）强制执行与原始提示相适应的结构化变异。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，仅声称方法产生多样且可导航的设计空间，其中每个变异对应一个具体、用户可理解的语义决策。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确总结局限性或范围，但强调该方法实现了从随机变化到文本层面直接控制多样性的范式转变，并通过智能体工作流克服标准VLM的通用输出问题。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要未明确总结局限性或范围，但强调该方法实现了从随机变化到文本层面直接控制多样性的范式转变，并通过智能体工作流克服标准VLM的通用输出问题。

papers.title: AIR: Adaptive Interleaved Reasoning with Code in MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Following the paradigm shift initiated by OpenAI o3, interleaved reasoning with code to enhance multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has become a pivotal research frontier. The existing literature focuses primarily on tool-use within vision-perception tasks. However, such approaches typically rely on predefined heuristics for visual manipulation and are inherently incapable of addressing numerical computation problems due to their exclusive focus on visual operations. This paper empowers MLLMs with adaptive interleaved reasoning capabilities through extended reinforcement learning training on code-augmented complex numerical computation tasks. To this end, we propose a comprehensive three-component solution consisting of: a two-stage cold-start data construction pipeline, data filtering strategies for RL dataset curation, and an adaptive tool-invocation strategy leveraging a group-constrained reward function for interleaved reasoning trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that after Reinforcement Learning training with the group-constrained reward function, performance improves by an average of 6.1 percentage points (pp) on evaluation benchmarks. Specifically, the accuracy for interleaved reasoning samples increases by 9.9 pp, and the overall success rate of tool-use exceeds 95%. Our data and code are available at: https://github.com/CongHan0808/AIR.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AIR框架，通过扩展强化学习训练使多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）具备自适应交错推理能力，特别针对代码增强的复杂数值计算任务。方法包括两阶段冷启动数据构建、RL数据集的过滤策略以及基于组约束奖励函数的自适应工具调用策略。实验表明，在评估基准上平均性能提升6.1个百分点，交错推理样本准确率提升9.9个百分点，工具使用成功率超过95%。
Motivation: 现有交错推理方法主要依赖预定义启发式规则处理视觉感知任务，无法应对需要数值计算的问题，且缺乏自适应能力。
Method: 提出三部分解决方案：两阶段冷启动数据构建流程、用于RL数据集筛选的数据过滤策略、以及利用组约束奖励函数的自适应工具调用策略，以生成交错推理轨迹。
Result: 经过组约束奖励函数的强化学习训练后，评估基准平均性能提升6.1个百分点；交错推理样本准确率提升9.9个百分点；工具使用整体成功率超过95%。
Conclusion: 论文通过强化学习训练赋予MLLMs自适应交错推理能力，在数值计算任务上取得显著提升，并开源数据和代码。

papers.title: Open Problem: Is AdamW Effective Under Heavy-Tailed Noise?
papers.abstract_en: AdamW is the de facto optimizer for training large language models (LLMs), yet the theory behind it still lives mostly in finite-variance regimes. This is increasingly unsatisfying, as empirical evidence indicates that stochastic gradient noise in LLM pretraining is typically heavy-tailed. Recent work shows that sign-based optimizers such as Lion and Muon achieve sharp heavy-tailed rates, and that AdaGrad can also converge under heavy-tailed noise. However, no rigorous convergence theory for AdamW has yet been established in this regime. Can AdamW converge under the same heavy-tailed assumptions, or does its second-moment accumulator create a genuine obstruction? We formulate this as an open problem, prove a positive weighted-metric benchmark, and give a corridor lower-bound mechanism showing how denominator memory can hide large gradients.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个开放问题：AdamW优化器在重尾噪声下是否能够收敛。作者证明了一个正加权度量基准，并给出走廊下界机制，说明分母记忆可能隐藏大梯度，从而阻碍收敛理论。研究背景是LLM训练中的随机梯度噪声通常呈重尾分布，但AdamW的理论分析仍局限于有限方差假设。
Motivation: 现有AdamW理论主要适用于有限方差噪声，而实际LLM预训练中面临的随机梯度噪声通常是重尾的，缺乏理论保证。
Method: 通过正加权度量基准和走廊下界机制，从理论上分析AdamW在重尾噪声下的收敛性问题，并与Lion、Muon、AdaGrad等优化器进行对比。
Result: 未给出具体数值结果，但指出重尾噪声下AdamW的收敛性尚无严格证明，并揭示了分母记忆可能隐藏大梯度的障碍。
Conclusion: 强调AdamW在重尾噪声下的收敛性仍是一个开放问题，需要进一步研究，同时为未来理论分析提供了基准和下界思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IMAGIN-4D: Image-Guided Controllable Interaction Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating human-object interactions (HOI) is central to character animation, robotics, AR/VR, and embodied AI. Recent HOI generation methods synthesize motion from text, object geometry, and sparse waypoints, controlling action semantics and object trajectories. However, these signals underspecify interaction: the same prompt and trajectory can produce different grasps, approach directions, body poses, object poses, contacts, and body-object layouts. We address this ambiguity with a reference image as a visual specification of the desired interaction snapshot. However, a single global image representation conflates distinct cues and conditions all frames on identical visual evidence. We therefore introduce IMAGIN-4D, a diffusion-based HOI generator that decomposes image conditioning spatio-temporally. For spatial conditioning, IMAGIN-4D extracts supervised interaction-state tokens for body pose, object pose, body-object contact, and spatial relationships at the depicted frame. For temporal conditioning, it computes frame-aware tokens by querying image patches per generated frame, allowing sequence segments to attend to different visual cues from the same image. To balance image, text, and waypoint cues, IMAGIN-4D uses role-aware conditioning: text, waypoints, and interaction-state tokens use separate AdaLN streams, while frame-aware visual tokens cross-attend with motion tokens. Since HOI motion datasets lack paired images, we build a synthetic motion-to-image rendering pipeline from FullBodyManipulation (FBM) and introduce an image-adherence metric to evaluate whether generated motions match the reference snapshot. Experiments on FBM and BEHAVE show that IMAGIN-4D improves fine-grained interaction control over single-token and uniformly image-conditioned baselines while preserving waypoint-following and motion quality. Code and models will be released at https://imagin4d.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IMAGIN-4D，一种基于扩散模型的人-物交互（HOI）生成方法，使用参考图像作为交互快照的视觉规范，通过时空分解的图像条件处理解决文本和轨迹等信号对交互细节描述不足的歧义。在FBM和BEHAVE数据集上实验表明，该方法改善了细粒度交互控制，同时保持了轨迹遵循和运动质量。
Motivation: 现有HOI生成方法仅使用文本、物体几何和稀疏轨迹，但这些信号对交互的细节（如抓取方式、接近方向、身体姿势等）描述不足，存在歧义。
Method: 提出IMAGIN-4D，一种扩散模型，对图像条件进行时空分解：空间条件提取监督交互状态令牌（身体姿势、物体姿势、接触、空间关系）；时间条件计算帧感知令牌，允许序列段关注同一图像的不同视觉线索。使用角色感知条件：文本、轨迹和交互状态令牌使用单独的AdaLN流，帧感知视觉令牌与运动令牌交叉注意。还构建了合成运动到图像渲染管线，并引入图像遵循度指标。
Result: 在FBM和BEHAVE数据集上，IMAGIN-4D相对于单令牌和均匀图像条件基线改善了细粒度交互控制，同时保持了轨迹遵循和运动质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调使用参考图像作为视觉规范可以解决交互歧义，IMAGIN-4D的时空分解条件方法有效提高了控制精度，代码和模型将开源。

papers.title: PsyBridge: A Hybrid Intelligent Framework for Multi-Dimensional Mental Health Assessment and Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: Mental health assessment commonly relies on isolated screening instruments or data-driven models that often lack interpretability and multi-dimensional integration. Existing approaches frequently focus on individual indicators such as depression or anxiety while providing limited support for comprehensive and explainable decision-making. To address this limitation, this study proposes PsyBridge, a hybrid intelligent decision-support framework designed for multi-dimensional mental health assessment through the integration of clinically validated screening tools, cognitive evaluation, and personality profiling within a unified architecture. The proposed framework incorporates PHQ-9 and GAD-7 assessments alongside cognitive and behavioural indicators using a modular design and a weighted aggregation mechanism to generate interpretable mental health risk classifications and recommendations. To evaluate the framework, a semi-synthetic dataset consisting of 500 patient profiles representing varying severity levels was constructed based on clinically grounded score distributions. Experimental results demonstrate that PsyBridge achieves an overall accuracy of 0.84, outperforming standalone PHQ-9 and GAD-7 assessments while improving precision, recall, and F1-score. Sensitivity analysis and ablation studies further indicate that integrating cognitive and personality components contributes to more stable classification performance and reduces inconsistencies in moderate-risk prediction. The findings suggest that PsyBridge provides a scalable and interpretable approach for AI-assisted mental health decision support, particularly within digital healthcare and telehealth environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PsyBridge，一种用于多维度心理健康评估的混合智能决策支持框架，整合了临床验证的筛查工具（PHQ-9、GAD-7）、认知评估和个性特征，通过加权聚合机制生成可解释的风险分类和推荐。在半合成数据集上，总体准确率达到 0.84，优于单独使用 PHQ-9 或 GAD-7。
Motivation: 现有心理健康评估方法多依赖孤立工具或缺乏可解释性，且常针对单一指标（如抑郁或焦虑），缺乏全面的、可解释的决策支持。
Method: 构建了混合框架 PsyBridge，采用模块化设计，将 PHQ-9、GAD-7 等临床筛查与认知、行为指标结合，通过加权聚合机制生成心理健康风险分类和推荐。
Result: 在 500 个半合成患者数据集上，总体准确率 0.84，精确率、召回率和 F1 分数均有提升；敏感度分析和消融研究表明整合认知与个性成分提高了分类稳定性，减少了中度风险预测的不一致性。
Conclusion: PsyBridge 为 AI 辅助心理健康决策支持提供了可扩展且可解释的方法，尤其适用于数字医疗和远程健康环境。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Teaching LLMs String Matching, Backtracking, and Error Recovery to Deduce Bases and Truth Tables for the Combinatorially Exploding Bit Manipulation Puzzles
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents our algorithmic innovations for the NVIDIA Nemotron Model Reasoning Challenge, focusing on Bit Manipulation Puzzles. In this task, the objective is to discover a hidden logical rule transforming input binary strings to outputs, then apply it to unseen inputs. Large Language Models (LLMs) notoriously struggle here; traditional methods force them to simulate complex boolean logic and arithmetic, leading to hallucinations. Furthermore, the search space of bitwise operations (combinations of shifts, rotations, and logic gates) suffers from a severe combinatorial explosion. To overcome this computational intractability, we present a novel approach that abandons arithmetic logic entirely in favor of string similarity, structured search, and autonomous error recovery. Our core contributions are: 1. Bases and Truth Table Formulation: We reframe logic-gate deduction into a base-selection task, leveraging string similarity (minimal bit flips) to isolate primitive transformations ("bases") and deduce truth tables without complex arithmetic. 2. Backtracking DFS and Error Recovery: We formalize a search process that tests candidate bases, detects logical collisions across examples, and backtracks upon failure to perform robust error recovery. 3. Bit Tokenization and Interactive Reasoning SFT: We force the tokenizer to encode binary strings as individual single-bit tokens. We use dynamic masking to simulate external oracle feedback, training the model to hypothesize, self-evaluate, and backtrack natively. Evaluated on bit manipulation puzzles, our approach achieved over 96% validation accuracy. This represents the highest performance in this category, driving our 7th Place overall finish in the contest.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. 7th Place Solution for the NVIDIA Nemotron Model Reasoning Challenge (Kaggle)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对位操作谜题（Bit Manipulation Puzzles）提出一种新的方法，放弃算术逻辑，转而采用字符串相似性、结构化搜索和自主错误恢复。核心包括：将逻辑门推导转化为基选择任务，利用字符串相似性隔离原始变换并推导真值表；使用回溯DFS和错误恢复机制测试候选基并处理冲突；通过位分词和交互式推理SFT训练模型假设、自我评估和回溯。在位操作谜题上达到超过96%验证准确率，为该类别最高性能，并最终获得竞赛总排名第7。
Motivation: 大型语言模型在解决位操作谜题时，传统方法迫使模型模拟复杂布尔逻辑和算术，导致幻觉；且按位运算的搜索空间面临严重组合爆炸。需要一种避免组合爆炸、减少幻觉的新方法。
Method: 提出三种创新：1) 基与真值表公式化：通过最小位翻转的字符串相似性将逻辑门推导转化为基选择任务，导出真值表而无需复杂算术。2) 回溯DFS与错误恢复：形式化搜索过程，测试候选基，检测逻辑冲突并回溯进行鲁棒错误恢复。3) 位分词与交互式推理SFT：强制分词器将二进制字符串编码为单比特token，使用动态掩码模拟外部oracle反馈，训练模型假设、自评估和回溯。
Result: 在位操作谜题上验证准确率超过96%，为该类别最高性能，驱动最终在竞赛中获得第7名。
Conclusion: 该方法通过放弃算术逻辑转向字符串相似性和结构化搜索，有效解决了位操作谜题中的组合爆炸和LLM幻觉问题，取得了竞赛中的最高类别性能。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法通过放弃算术逻辑转向字符串相似性和结构化搜索，有效解决了位操作谜题中的组合爆炸和LLM幻觉问题，取得了竞赛中的最高类别性能。

papers.title: Tapered Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern language models, including transformer, recurrent, and memory-based variants, share a common chassis: a stack of identical layers in which parameters are allocated uniformly across depth. This is a default inherited from the original transformer and largely unchanged since, yet a growing body of evidence suggests that layers contribute non-uniformly to the final output, with later layers refining the residual stream rather than transforming it. We ask whether parameter capacity should reflect this asymmetry. Our controlled experiment shows that, under a fixed budget, allocating more capacity to earlier layers and less to later layers improves perplexity over a uniform-width baseline, while the reverse allocation hurts. Building on this result, we introduce Tapered Language Models (TLMs), an architectural principle in which a parameter-bearing component is monotonically tapered across depth under a fixed total budget. MLPs are the natural site for this instantiation: they dominate parameter count across all modern LM families and expose width as a single, clean axis of variation. Across three model scales and four architectures (Transformer, Gated Attention, Hope-attention, and Titans), tapering MLP width via a smooth cosine schedule consistently improves perplexity and downstream benchmark performance over uniform baselines, at no additional parameter or compute cost. These findings establish depth-aware capacity allocation as a simple, architecture-agnostic axis of language model design, a free lever hidden in plain sight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出锥形语言模型（Tapered Language Models, TLMs），在固定参数预算下将MLP宽度按深度单调递减，通过平滑余弦调度分配更多容量给早期层、更少给后期层。在三种模型规模和四种架构（Transformer, Gated Attention, Hope-attention, Titans）上，该方法在困惑度和下游基准性能上一致优于均匀宽度基线，且不增加参数或计算成本。
Motivation: 现有语言模型默认所有层参数均匀分配，但研究表明各层对最终输出的贡献非均匀，后期层主要细化残差流而非变换。本文质疑参数容量是否应反映这种不对称性。
Method: 提出TLM架构原则，在固定总参数预算下，将参数承载组件（如MLP）的宽度按深度单调递减，并采用平滑余弦调度实现锥形分配。
Result: 在三种模型尺度和四种架构上，锥形MLP宽度一致提高了困惑度并改善下游基准性能，与均匀基线相比无额外参数或计算开销。
Conclusion: 深度感知容量分配是一种简单、架构无关的语言模型设计维度，是一个免费杠杆。

papers.title: GeoFidelity-Bench: Evaluating Segment-Level Geographic Fidelity in Text-to-Image Street-View Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image models can generate visually plausible city streets, but whether their outputs correspond to a requested road segment rather than a generic city prior remains unclear. We introduce GeoFidelity-Bench, a reference-panel benchmark for segment-conditioned geographic fidelity in street-view generation. It contains 7,117 curated Mapillary images covering 109 named OpenStreetMap road segments in 25 cities across six continents. For each generated panel, the benchmark ranks the target reference panel against panels from the nearest segment in the same city, other segments in the same city, and segments from other cities, making local discrimination rather than absolute target similarity the primary test. We evaluate six open-weight text-to-image generators under city-only, street-and-neighborhood, and GPS-augmented prompts. Adding street and neighborhood names is associated with an increase of 5.5 percentage points in top-1 retrieval accuracy over city-only prompts, with a 95% confidence interval from 3.4 to 7.7 percentage points. However, the similarity margin between the target and the nearest segment in the same city remains near zero, indicating that local names improve broad local plausibility more than exact segment identity. Prompts that keep the city fixed but use incorrect street or neighborhood names further show that only part of the gain depends on the correct local names, while appending raw GPS coordinates as ordinary text yields no statistically clear additional benefit. Held-out real-image queries successfully recover segment identity, showing that the curated references contain usable segment-level signal. GeoFidelity-Bench thus reveals a persistent gap between city- or neighborhood-plausible street-view generation and faithful generation for a specific road segment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoFidelity-Bench 是一个用于评估文本到图像模型在街景生成中地理保真度的基准，包含 7,117 张来自 25 个城市 109 条道路段的图像。通过比较目标段与同城最近段、同城其他段、其他城市段的检索准确率，发现添加街道和社区名称仅将 top-1 检索准确率提升 5.5 个百分点，但目标段与最近段的相似度接近零，表明模型更擅长生成局部合理而非特定段精确的图像。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像模型能生成视觉合理的城市街景，但输出是否对应特定请求的道路段（而非一般城市先验）尚不明确。
Method: 构建包含多城市、多道路段的参考面板基准，通过比较生成图像与真实图像的检索排名来评估段级地理保真度。在不同提示条件下（仅城市、城市+街道+社区、GPS增强）测试六个开源生成器。
Result: 添加街道和社区名称后，top-1 检索准确率提升 5.5 个百分点（95% CI: 3.4-7.7），但目标段与同城最近段的相似度接近零；GPS 坐标作为文本无明显额外收益；真实图像查询能正确识别段身份。
Conclusion: 该基准揭示了当前模型在生成特定道路段街景方面仍存在显著不足，模型更擅长生成城市或街区的合理图像。

papers.title: On the Limits of Prompt-Conditioned Language Models as General-Purpose Learners
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are frequently portrayed as general-purpose solvers capable of solving arbitrary tasks. We argue that this view overlooks a fundamental constraint: language is a compressed and capacity-limited interface for conveying task information. Modelling User--System interaction as a bilevel \emph{cheap-talk} game, we analyse how latent tasks are encoded into prompts and reinterpreted under alignment and safety constraints. We introduce a conceptual decomposition separating task inference from execution and derive PAC-Bayes bounds that distinguish finite-sample estimation error from irreducible structural limitations. Our first main result establishes an \emph{expressivity floor}: language acts as a capacity-limited communication channel, and whenever the informational complexity of a task family exceeds the capacity of that channel, distinct tasks become unavoidably indistinguishable to the Solver, inducing a strictly positive error floor that cannot be eliminated by additional data, optimisation, or model scaling alone. We then establish an \emph{objective-misalignment floor}: when alignment constraints restrict the admissible output set, the User-ideal distribution may lie outside the feasible class, inducing an irreducible distortion. Together, these results yield a formal negative conclusion: prompt-conditioned LLMs are not universal problem solvers through prompting alone, as there exist task families for which correct behaviour is provably unattainable even in the infinite-data regime. More broadly, our analysis shows the limits of prompt-based generalisation arise from information-constrained communication and alignment-constrained objectives. This suggests that interfaces beyond natural language, including multimodal observations and, external memory, may reduce the inherent LLM limitations by increasing the task-relevant information available to the System.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过廉价谈话博弈论框架分析prompt-conditioned LLMs的局限性，证明语言作为任务信息通道存在容量限制，且对齐约束导致不可消除的误差下界，指出prompt-only方法无法实现通用问题求解。
Motivation: 现有观点认为LLMs是通用求解器，但忽视了语言是容量有限的压缩接口这一根本约束。
Method: 将用户-系统交互建模为双层廉价谈话博弈，引入任务推理与执行的分解，并推导PAC-Bayes界区分有限样本误差和不可约的结构限制。
Result: 建立了表达性下限：当任务族的信息复杂度超过语言通道容量时，不同任务不可区分，产生严格正误差下界；还建立了目标错位下限：对齐约束使理想分布不可达，导致不可约失真。
Conclusion: 提示条件LLMs无法仅通过提示成为通用求解器，存在不可达的正确行为。建议多模态和外部记忆等接口可能缓解这些限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PHAST-Net: Attention-Guided, Physics-Informed Network for Unified Estimation of Ideal Time-Frequency Representations
papers.abstract_en: We introduce PHAST-Net, an attention-guided, physics-informed network for unified estimation of Ideal Time-Frequency Representations (ITFRs), spanning spectral, tempo-based, metrical, and harmonic representations such as Spectrograms, Tempograms, and Metrograms. PHAST-Net learns an application-general mapping from a constellation of wavelet transforms, the proposed Continuous Log-frequency Adaptive Wavelet Transform (CLAWT), to high-resolution, cross-term-suppressed time-frequency (T-F) representations. The proposed constellation of CLAWTs is selected through Cohen's class kernel analysis to maximise curvature coverage in a logarithmic-frequency T-F plane tailored to harmonic signal structure. PHAST-Net further incorporates a proposed physics-informed auxiliary reprojection loss designed to reconstruct the idealised observed CLAWT constellation from the predicted ITFR and the corresponding Cohen's class kernels during training. This auxiliary objective promotes transform consistency and energy conservation, mitigates pathological target sparsity, and enhances optimisation stability. Attention layers further promote effective cross-term suppression across the input constellation. The log-frequency formulation also enables Harmonic PHAST-Net, which estimates a Harmonic ITFR that isolates fundamental structure, supporting robust fundamental-only representations for speech and music, such as derived fundamental Tempograms and Metrograms. We further introduce Spline-PHAST-Net, which parameterises detected and associated T-F ridges as continuous spline trajectories, enabling arbitrary-grid re-rendering and signal reconstruction. Trained on an effectively unbounded procedurally generated dataset, PHAST-Net demonstrates improved accuracy over established approaches, providing a unified framework for high-resolution, cross-term-robust analysis of speech, music, and broader nonstationary signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PHAST-Net 是一种基于注意力机制且融入物理信息的神经网络，用于统一估计多种理想时频表示（ITFRs），如频谱图、音高图等。它通过学习从连续对数频率自适应小波变换（CLAWT）星座图到高分辨率、无交叉项的时频表示的映射，并引入物理信息辅助重投影损失以保持变换一致性和能量守恒。在程序生成的数据集上训练后，该方法在语音、音乐及非平稳信号分析中显示出优于现有技术的准确度。
Motivation: 现有时频表示估计方法在分辨率、交叉项抑制和统一框架方面存在不足，尤其缺乏能同时处理谱、节奏、节拍等多类表示的通用方法。
Method: 提出基于CLAWT星座图的注意力引导网络，利用Cohen类核分析优化对数频率时频平面上的曲率覆盖，并引入物理信息辅助重投影损失函数以增强变换一致性和训练稳定性，同时通过注意力层实现交叉项抑制。
Result: 在程序生成的无限数据集上训练后，PHAST-Net在语音、音乐及非平稳信号分析中相比现有方法取得了更高的准确度，并支持任意网格重渲染与信号重建（Spline-PHAST-Net）。
Conclusion: PHAST-Net 提供了一个统一的、高分辨率且鲁棒的时频分析框架，可广泛应用于语音、音乐及其他非平稳信号的处理。

papers.title: MAS-PromptBench: When Does Prompt Optimization Improve Multi-Agent LLM Systems?
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) offer a scalable path forward for agentic AI, comprising multiple LLM-based agents, each assigned a system prompt and a position within a workflow that governs inter-agent coordination and output aggregation. System prompts thus form a critical and accessible optimization surface: they specify agents' roles and behaviors, enabling system-level improvements without model finetuning. Although prompt optimization has shown substantial potential for single LLMs, extending it to MAS poses distinct challenges, notably an exponentially growing search space. It remains unclear whether, when, and by how much prompt optimization improves MAS performance, and how sensitive such gains are to system configuration. In this work, we systematically study system-prompt optimization across a broad range of MAS setups varying in task, workflow, communication protocol, and team size, benchmarking two prompt optimizers that naturally extend state-of-the-art single-agent methods. The results reveal its potential to unlock significant gains while exposing open challenges, characterizing when and how much prompt optimization helps across diverse MAS settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究多智能体LLM系统中系统提示优化的效果，针对不同任务、工作流、通信协议和团队规模的MAS设置，评估两种单智能体提示优化方法的多智能体扩展。结果表明提示优化能带来显著性能提升，但也暴露了搜索空间指数增长等挑战。
Motivation: 单智能体提示优化已取得显著成效，但扩展到多智能体系统面临搜索空间指数增长的挑战，且提示优化在MAS中的有效性、时机和幅度尚不明确。
Method: 设计了MAS-PromptBench基准，包含多种MAS设置（任务、工作流、通信协议、团队规模），并自然扩展了两种最先进的单智能体提示优化方法进行系统评估。
Result: 揭示提示优化在MAS中可解锁显著性能增益，同时暴露了开放挑战，并刻画了不同MAS设置下提示优化何时及多大程度上有帮助。
Conclusion: 提示优化对MAS性能有提升潜力，但效果依赖于系统配置，仍面临搜索空间等挑战。

papers.title: Action-BED: Task-Driven Bayesian Experimental Design with Singly Intractable Objectives
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian experimental design (BED) has traditionally been based on maximising expected uncertainty reductions from prior to posterior. A major shortfall of this approach is that it leads to doubly intractable objectives that are difficult to optimise, while customising them to particular downstream tasks of interest can also be difficult. Following first principles decision theory, we demonstrate that BED can alternatively be formulated in terms of an expected future loss (EFL) on downstream actions, providing a simple and naturally task-driven framework. Critically, we then show that all such EFLs can be rearranged into singly intractable objectives that can be jointly optimised with respect to both the design policy and a downstream action policy using stochastic gradients, an approach we refer to as ACTION-BED. This formulation further sidesteps the need for any explicit posterior or marginal likelihood estimation and is naturally implicit, requiring only the ability to sample from the joint model over model parameters and data, and evaluate the downstream loss function. It thus allows design policies to be learned more effectively, efficiently, and simply than existing methods, while providing easy customisation to different downstream tasks and losses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从第一性原理决策理论出发，将贝叶斯实验设计重新表述为基于下游行动期望未来损失（EFL）的任务驱动框架，并证明所有EFL可转化为单重难解目标，通过随机梯度联合优化设计策略和行动策略，无需显式的后验或边际似然估计。
Motivation: 传统贝叶斯实验设计基于期望不确定性减少，导致双重难解目标且难以针对特定下游任务定制，计算和优化困难。
Method: 提出ACTION-BED框架，将实验设计目标转化为单重难解的目标函数（EFL），并采用随机梯度方法联合优化设计策略和下游行动策略，仅需从联合模型采样并评估下游损失函数。
Result: 该方法相比现有方法更有效、高效且简单，能够学习更好的设计策略，同时便于适应不同下游任务和损失函数。
Conclusion: ACTION-BED提供了一种自然、任务驱动的贝叶斯实验设计新范式，避免了双重难解性和显式后验估计，具有广泛适用性。

papers.title: The Dataset Friction Framework: measuring user-facing friction as a complement to FAIR
papers.abstract_en: Open research data services have matured to the point where the cost of sustaining them at scale has become a primary design constraint, driving providers to make deliberate choices that may reduce user convenience to keep the service viable. The FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reuseable) principles describe whether a dataset is well stewarded, and FAIR compliance is often treated as a proxy for usability. FAIR does not capture the cost to a user of finding, accessing, interpreting, and applying a dataset. We introduce the Dataset Friction Framework (DFF) as a complement to FAIR, directly addressing usability. DFF measures user-facing friction across six dimensions, distinguishing engineered friction (deliberate data provider design choices that sustain a service) from accidental friction (defects that require remediation). The framework is validated against 18,556 support tickets from the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (January 2024 to May 2026), which serves 280,000 registered users. Restricting the analysis to tickets raised by external reporters reduces the corpus by 12.3%, but every dimension's internal-staff share falls below this baseline -- confirming that the reported friction signals are genuinely user-facing. We then assess three real datasets across three providers and show that FAIR compliance and DFF friction can disagree in both directions: a 92% FAIR-compliant dataset can still carry substantial friction, and a 42% FAIR score can be an artefact of anti-scraping policy rather than poor stewardship. The two measures are non-redundant and jointly informative: FAIR compliance does not predict DFF friction in either direction. This constitutes the first large-scale empirical application of the framework; cross-institutional validation is identified as the immediate next step.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出数据集摩擦框架（DFF），作为FAIR原则的补充，旨在衡量用户在使用数据集时面临的摩擦。DFF从六个维度区分工程设计摩擦和意外摩擦，并基于欧洲中期天气预报中心的18,556张支持工单进行验证。结果显示FAIR合规性与DFF摩擦不相关，两者可提供互补信息。
Motivation: FAIR原则虽衡量数据集的可发现性、可访问性等，但未捕捉用户实际使用时的成本（摩擦）。随着数据服务规模化，提供商可能为了可持续性而牺牲用户便利性，因此需要直接衡量用户面临摩擦的工具。
Method: 引入数据集摩擦框架（DFF），定义六个摩擦维度，并通过分析欧洲中期天气预报中心（ECMWF）的18,556张支持工单（2024年1月至2026年5月）进行验证。通过对比内部员工和外部用户工单比例，确认摩擦信号面向用户，并评估三个实际数据集。
Result: FAIR合规性与DFF摩擦无预测关系：一个92% FAIR合规的数据集仍可能具有高摩擦，而42% FAIR得分可能是反爬虫政策的产物而非低管理质量。该框架首次大规模实证应用，但需跨机构验证。
Conclusion: DFF作为FAIR的补充，能有效测量用户面临的数据集摩擦。FAIR和DFF非冗余且联合信息丰富，下一步需进行跨机构验证。

papers.title: Dynamic estimation of slowly varying sequences
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of sequentially approximating functions of each element in a slowly-varying sequence, i.e. one where the magnitude $α_i$ of the difference between the elements at positions $i$ and $i-1$ is small. Recent work on implicit trace estimation shows that when $α_t$ is small, reusing queries to past sequence elements can reduce the overall cost [Dharangutte \& Musco, NeurIPS~2021; Woodruff et al., NeurIPS~2022]. We introduce a framework generalizing this to a variety of linear and nonlinear functions on diverse vector spaces, obtaining novel sequential estimation results for matrix powers, spectral densities, Monte Carlo integration, and a boundary value problem from partial differential equations~(PDEs). Furthermore, we develop a novel algorithm for use with this framework that locally scales the estimation budget with $α_t$, obtaining sharper path-length-style variation bounds of form $\mathcal O(\sum_{i=1}^mα_i)$ on the cost of estimating a sequence of length $m$. This improves upon the previous implicit trace estimation bound of $\mathcal O(m\cdot\max_iα_i)$ [Dharangutte \& Musco, NeurIPS~2021], which is achieved by fixing the query budget using the worst-case $α_i$ and is thus inefficient for stable sequences with rare bursts. Lastly, while all past work assumes a known bound on $α_i$, we show in certain cases how the changes can be estimated on-the-fly with (nearly) no added cost. In summary, our framework makes the sequential approximation toolkit general-purpose and adaptive while improving upon state-of-the-art-guarantees for dynamic trace estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究缓慢变化序列中逐元素函数的顺序近似问题，提出一个通用框架，适用于多种线性与非线性函数，包括矩阵幂、谱密度、蒙特卡洛积分和偏微分方程边值问题。开发了一种根据局部变化幅度自适应调整估计预算的新算法，获得了更优的路径长度界，并展示了在部分情况下可无额外成本实时估计变化量。
Motivation: 现有工作仅针对隐式迹估计且预算固定为最差情况变化幅度，导致稳定序列中有突发变化时效率低下。本文目标是将顺序估计方法推广到更多函数并实现自适应预算。
Method: 引入一个统一框架，将隐式迹估计的查询复用思想推广到线性与非线性函数；开发新算法根据局部变化幅度α_i缩放估计预算，而非使用全局最大α_i。
Result: 获得了形式为O(Σα_i)的路径长度变化界，改进之前O(m·max α_i)的界；并在某些情况下实现实时估计变化量，几乎无额外成本。
Conclusion: 本文框架使顺序近似工具包变得通用和自适应，同时改进了动态迹估计的现有最优保证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Lightweight Neural Framework for Robust 3D Volume and Surface Estimation from Multi-View Images
papers.abstract_en: Accurate volume and surface area estimation is critical for diverse applications, from marine ecology to medical diagnostics. However, existing methods often suffer from high computational costs and poor performance with sparse and noisy data. We propose a fully feed-forward framework that regresses scale-normalized volume and surface area and their associated uncertainties directly from multi-view images. By fusing 3D point cloud reconstructions with view-aligned 2D features through a graph-based decoder, our model bypasses iterative optimization, ensuring exceptional scalability and rapid inference. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly when operating with a low number of input images. Validated across coral monitoring, dietary analysis, and anthropometry, our proposed framework provides a robust, adaptable solution for quantitative shape analysis. This architecture provides a high-speed, scalable alternative for precise geometric estimation from visual data, maintaining high performance even in resource-constrained or sparse-view scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级全前馈神经网络框架，直接从多视图图像回归尺度归一化的体积和表面积及其不确定性。通过图解码器融合3D点云重建与视图对齐的2D特征，绕过迭代优化，实现快速推理。实验表明，该方法在输入图像数量较少时优于现有方法，并在珊瑚监测、饮食分析和人体测量等任务中验证了其鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有体积和表面积估计方法计算成本高，且在处理稀疏、噪声数据时性能不佳。
Method: 提出全前馈框架，利用图解码器融合多视图图像的3D点云重建与视图对齐的2D特征，直接回归尺度归一化的体积、表面积及不确定性。
Result: 在少量输入图像条件下，该方法在多个基准上超越现有技术，并在珊瑚监测、饮食分析、人体测量中表现鲁棒。
Conclusion: 该架构为快速、可扩展的几何估计提供了替代方案，尤其适用于资源受限或稀疏视图场景。

papers.title: TailorMind: Towards Preference-Aligned Multimodal Content Generation
papers.abstract_en: Personalized content systems depend on available UGC and struggle when suitable content is absent, delayed, or costly to create. Although multimodal generators can synthesize content on demand, how to translate behavioral traces into generation-ready preferences remains underexplored. We study personalized multimodal content generation: creating user-tailored multimodal content without existing item pools or waiting for matching UGC. We propose TailorMind, linking collaborative preference modeling with controllable multimodal generation. TailorMind enriches sparse user histories via hypergraph collaborative filtering and optimizes textual profiles with ranking-error feedback and textual gradient descent. Retrieval-augmented style control grounds outputs in authentic UGC patterns, while cross-modal cohesion reflection reduces semantic drift. We construct TailorBench, a benchmark from three mainstream platforms evaluated along five dimensions: coherence, novelty, aesthetic, hallucination, profiling. Experiments show that TailorMind achieves competitive or stronger coherence, improves novelty and aesthetic quality over representative generation baselines and ground-truth UGC, demonstrating advantages over retrieving available content or comparable UGC, while achieving up to 29% Recall gains in reranking. Our code is released at: https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/TailorMind.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables. Code available at https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/TailorMind
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究个性化多模态内容生成，即在没有现有物品池或等待用户生成内容（UGC）的情况下，为用户生成定制化的多模态内容。提出TailorMind框架，结合超图协同过滤与可控生成：通过超图协同过滤丰富稀疏用户历史，利用排序错误反馈和文本梯度下降优化用户文本画像，并使用检索增强风格控制与跨模态一致性反射减少语义漂移。构建TailorBench基准（来自三个主流平台，评估五个维度），实验显示TailorMind在连贯性、新颖性、美学质量上优于代表性生成基线和真实UGC，重排序中Recall提升达29%。代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有个性化内容系统依赖现有UGC，当合适内容缺失、延迟或成本高时表现不佳。虽然多模态生成器可按需合成内容，但如何将用户行为痕迹转化为生成就绪的偏好尚未充分探索。本文旨在填补这一空白，实现无需现有物品池或等待匹配UGC的个性化多模态内容生成。
Method: 提出TailorMind框架：1）超图协同过滤（hypergraph collaborative filtering）丰富稀疏用户历史；2）利用排序错误反馈和文本梯度下降优化用户文本画像；3）检索增强风格控制（retrieval-augmented style control）使输出贴合真实UGC模式；4）跨模态一致性反射（cross-modal cohesion reflection）减少语义漂移。
Result: 在TailorBench基准上，TailorMind在连贯性、新颖性、美学质量上优于代表性生成基线和真实UGC，重排序任务中获得最高29%的Recall提升。
Conclusion: TailorMind无需现有内容池或等待UGC即可生成个性化多模态内容，实验验证其有效性，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Process Rewards via Success Visitation Matching for Efficient RL
papers.abstract_en: In many modern applications of reinforcement learning (RL), the natural reward for a task of interest is inherently sparse: a reward of 0 is given everywhere except when the task is completed, when a reward of +1 is given. Training a policy to maximize such a sparse reward requires solving a challenging credit assignment problem, leading to slow or ineffective RL improvement. We propose a simple approach to transform a sparse outcome reward into a dense process reward. Our approach relies on training a discriminator to distinguish between previous successful and unsuccessful episodes, and using this discriminator to incentivize the RL-learned policy to match the state-action visitations of successful episodes, while avoiding those of unsuccessful episodes. By incentivizing the policy to match the visitations over all states, not just those that correspond to task success, this reward provides dense feedback on whether progress is being made towards task completion, and, we show, provably achieves this without changing the optimal policy. Focusing on finetuning of robotic control policies, we demonstrate that our approach leads to significantly faster RL finetuning performance on both simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, as compared to simply maximizing the sparse outcome reward.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习中稀疏奖励导致的信用分配问题，提出通过成功访问匹配（Success Visitation Matching）学习过程奖励的方法。训练一个判别器区分成功与不成功的轨迹，然后激励策略匹配成功轨迹的状态-动作访问，同时避免不成功的访问，从而提供密集的过程奖励，并且理论证明不改变最优策略。在模拟和真实机器人操作任务上，微调效果显著快于直接优化稀疏奖励。
Motivation: 许多RL任务的自然奖励是稀疏的（只有任务完成时+1，其余0），这导致信用分配困难，训练缓慢无效。
Method: 提出将稀疏结果奖励转化为密集过程奖励的简单方法。训练一个判别器区分成功和不成功的episode，然后使用该判别器激励RL策略匹配成功episode的状态-动作访问，避免不成功episode的访问。通过匹配所有状态的访问，提供密集反馈，且理论保证不改变最优策略。
Result: 在模拟和真实世界的机器人操作任务微调中，该方法比单纯最大化稀疏结果奖励显著加快RL微调速度。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种有效的将稀疏奖励转化为密集奖励的方法，并证明了其理论性质和实际效果，尤其适用于机器人策略微调。

papers.title: Muown Implicitly Performs Angular Step-size Decay
papers.abstract_en: Matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon and Muown have recently shown strong empirical performance for pre-training Transformers. In particular, Muown separates each weight matrix into row magnitudes and an un-normalized direction variable, updating the former with Adam and the latter with Muon. We show that the directional update of Muown is equivalent to a Riemannian step on the normalized directions, while the magnitude of the un-normalized parameterization only modulates the angular step size. This explains the step-size stability of Muown and suggests making the angular step size explicit. The resulting method, AngularMuown, optimizes directly over the normalized directions and uses a schedulable angular multiplier decoupled from the radial magnitude update. AngularMuown improves over Muown and, at the time of writing, a preliminary version is leading the per-optimizer category of the modded nanoGPT speedrunning competition. Further experiments on Qwen2-0.5B, and 1.1B parameter mixture-of-experts models confirm the algorithm scales beyond small models. An implementation of the algorithm is available at https://github.com/fhueb/angular-muown
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了 Muown 优化器的更新机制，证明其方向更新等价于归一化方向上的黎曼步长，而幅度参数仅调节角度步长。基于此发现提出 AngularMuown，将角度步长显式化并与径向幅度更新解耦，在 Transformer 预训练中取得优于 Muown 的性能。
Motivation: Muown 等矩阵感知优化器在 Transformer 预训练中表现优异，但其步长稳定性的原因未得到理论解释。
Method: 通过数学推导揭示 Muown 的方向更新是黎曼梯度步长，幅度参数仅缩放角度步长；进而提出 AngularMuown，直接优化归一化方向并使用可调度的角度乘子。
Result: AngularMuown 在 modded nanoGPT 速度竞赛中领先，并在 Qwen2-0.5B 及 1.1B 参数 MoE 模型上验证了可扩展性。
Conclusion: 显式解耦角度步长与径向幅度更新可提升优化器性能，该分析为设计更稳定的优化器提供了新视角。

papers.title: Pose Anything Anywhere:Model-free Object Poses from Arbitrary References
papers.abstract_en: Estimating the 6D pose of unseen objects is a fundamental yet challenging problem for open-world robotics and embodied perception. Model-based methods are accurate but depend on CAD assets or heavy onboarding, while most model-free approaches are still limited to pairwise single-anchor matching and thus fail under occlusion and large viewpoint changes with low query-reference overlap. Therefore, we present PANY, a unified model-free framework that seamlessly supports both RGB and RGB-D inputs, operates on one or sparse pose-free reference views, and generalizes effectively to novel objects. Built on a multi-view transformer geometry backbone, PANY moves beyond pairwise matching by learning view-consistent geometry and cross-view alignment cues that remain stable under wide baselines and limited overlap. When additional unposed assist views are available, PANY aggregates them via pose-graph canonical registration to increase geometric coverage and reinforce the final pose. Extensive experiments show that PANY achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks, substantially outperforming existing model-free methods, improving pose accuracy by +12% on YCB-V and over +20% on LM-O. Furthermore, PANY consistently performs well under both single-reference and sparse-reference settings, demonstrating strong robustness in real-world environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PANY，一种无模型框架，用于任意参考视图下的6D物体姿态估计，支持RGB和RGB-D输入。该框架基于多视图Transformer几何骨干网络，学习视图一致几何和跨视图对齐线索，并利用辅助视图进行位姿图规范注册以提高几何覆盖。在YCB-V和LM-O等基准上，PANY分别提升+12%和+20%的位姿精度，且在单参考和稀疏参考设置下均表现鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有无模型6D姿态估计方法多局限于成对单锚匹配，在遮挡和大视角变化下因查询-参考重叠低而失效；而有模型方法依赖CAD模型或繁重的初始化。
Method: PANY采用多视图Transformer几何骨干，学习视图一致的几何和跨视图对齐线索，突破成对匹配限制；当存在多个无位姿辅助视图时，通过位姿图规范注册聚合它们以增强几何覆盖，最终输出位姿。
Result: 在YCB-V上位姿精度提升12%，在LM-O上提升超过20%；在单参考和稀疏参考设置下均达到当前最优，且对真实环境具有强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: PANY作为一种统一的无模型框架，无需CAD模型即可有效处理新颖物体，展现出在开放世界机器人和具身感知中的应用潜力。

papers.title: AI Exposure Scores: what they measure, what they miss, and what comes next
papers.abstract_en: A set of exposure scores calculated in 2023 has become a central empirical input to the future of work debate. Produced by Eloundou et al. (2023) and referred to here as the GPTs are GPTs scores, they define exposure as the share of occupational tasks a large language model can assist with. This work is a genuine methodological contribution, but as the scores travel from the time and place they were produced, the limitations the authors named do not always travel with them. Two gaps have widened as a result. The first is structural, between what static exposure scores measure and what policy questions actually require. Taking the diffusion of these scores as a case study, we show how their temporal, geographic, and ontological limitations compound in policy-facing analyses, and we survey five families of research responding to these limits: dynamic and benchmark-based measures, ensemble methods, task-framework extensions, worker-centered metrics, and adoption and usage data. The second gap is the one we argue needs more attention: the coordination between researchers and policymakers. The policy-relevant work which ask who is harmed, who benefits, how, and when, continues to reference the static GPTs are GPTs scores without engagement with the methodological updates that would let these questions be answered more reliably. We then ask what additional steps towards navigating uncertainty remain: ex-post frameworks and the deliberate, political work of reimagining what futures are worthy of building towards are. Closing the research-policy gap is a shared task: policymakers must widen their evidence base, engage workers as epistemic partners, and shift from prediction to preparedness; researchers must build data infrastructure, adopt participatory methods, and write with policymakers in mind. Better measurement matters, but it will not close the second gap alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对2023年Eloundou等人提出的GPTs暴露分数（GPTs are GPTs scores）进行了批判性审视。这些分数用于衡量大语言模型对职业任务的辅助程度，但在政策传播中其原始局限（时间、地理、本体论）被忽略。论文通过案例研究揭示了静态分数在政策分析中的结构性不足，并调查了五类改进方法（动态与基准测度、集成方法、任务框架扩展、以工人为中心的指标、采纳与使用数据），最终强调研究者与政策制定者之间的协调差距需要更多关注。
Motivation: AI暴露分数在政策辩论中被广泛引用，但其原始局限性未随分数传播，导致政策分析不准确；同时，研究者与政策制定者之间的协调差距被忽视，限制了政策问题的可靠回答。
Method: 采用案例研究追踪GPTs暴露分数的扩散，系统梳理五类回应方法（动态与基准测度、集成方法、任务框架扩展、以工人为中心的指标、采纳与使用数据），并提出弥合研究-政策差距的步骤。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验数字，但指出静态暴露分数在时间、地理、本体论上的局限性在政策分析中固化，且研究-政策协调不足。
Conclusion: 更好的测量重要但不足以弥合研究-政策差距；政策制定者需拓宽证据基础、将工人作为认识论伙伴并转向准备而非预测，研究者需建设数据基础设施、采用参与式方法并面向政策制定者写作。

papers.title: AI-driven Optimisation of Quality of Recovery (QoR) in Remote Patient Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Remote patient monitoring depends on patient-reported data to capture the subjective dimension of recovery that devices cannot measure. The Quality of Recovery (QoR-15) survey is the gold-standard instrument for this purpose. It was designed and validated for occasional in-hospital assessment, yet remote monitoring now administers it to patients daily. In our own post-surgical deployment, only 55% of patients submitted the survey more than 14 days of 30 monitoring days. We developed QoR-compact, a five-item daily input for the RPM prediction pathway. Setting a deployment-driven target of one-third of the daily items, we exhaustively evaluated all 3,003 five-question subsets of the QoR-15 and tested whether the best of them matches the full instrument in predicting near-term postoperative recovery severity. QoR-compact achieves a mean AUC-ROC of 0.968 (95% CI 0.915-0.988), statistically comparable to the 0.964 baseline obtained with one-third of the items. Patient-level backtesting indicates that it tracks readmission events as faithfully as the full form. Its five items span the physical and psychological axes of recovery: Q3 (feeling rested), Q9 (feeling comfortable and in control), Q10 (general well-being), Q12 (severe pain), and Q14 (feeling worried or anxious). The QoR-15 remains the gold-standard measure of recovery; QoR-compact complements it as a shorter daily input designed for prediction. This parity provides the basis for a prospective study of whether a lighter daily input is, in turn, completed more consistently. External validation on larger cohorts is required before clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对远程患者监测中QoR-15问卷提交率低的问题，提出了QoR-compact，一个仅包含5个问题的每日输入版本。通过穷举所有3003个五问题子集，发现最优子集在预测术后恢复严重程度方面与完整问卷性能相当，AUC-ROC达到0.968，与完整问卷的0.964无显著差异。该工作为减轻患者负担并提高数据完整性提供了基础。
Motivation: 远程监测中QoR-15问卷每日提交率低（仅55%），需要更短的版本以提高依从性，同时保持预测性能。
Method: 从QoR-15的15个问题中穷举所有5问题子集（共3003个），通过AUC-ROC评估每个子集预测术后恢复严重程度的能力，选择最优子集作为QoR-compact。
Result: QoR-compact的AUC-ROC为0.968（95% CI 0.915-0.988），与完整QoR-15的0.964相当；患者层面回测显示其跟踪再入院事件的能力与完整表单一致。
Conclusion: QoR-compact作为更短的每日输入，有望提高完成率，但需前瞻性研究和外部验证才能用于临床。

papers.title: Diffusion Models Adapt to Low-Dimensional Structure Under Flexible Coefficient Choices
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are known to exploit unknown low-dimensional structure to accelerate sampling. However, existing convergence theory under low-dimensional data structure has largely focused on update rules with narrowly prescribed coefficient choices. This raises a fundamental question: is adaptation to low-dimensional structure sensitive to the precise choice of update coefficients? In this paper, we show that such adaptation is a robust property of diffusion models. For a broad class of update coefficients, we prove that $\widetilde{O}(k/\varepsilon)$ iterations suffice to generate an $\varepsilon$-accurate sample in total variation (TV) distance, independently of the ambient dimension. Our framework substantially broadens the class of diffusion samplers known to enjoy low dimensional adaptation and applies to several commonly used methods in practice. These results provide a theoretical justification for the empirical effectiveness of diffusion samplers across different coefficient choices when applied to structured, high-dimensional data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明，对于一大类灵活的系数选择，扩散模型能够自适应数据中的低维结构，在总变差距离下达到ε精度所需的迭代次数为Õ(k/ε)，与环境维度无关。该结果适用于多种常用采样器，为其实际效果提供了理论支撑。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在低维数据下的收敛理论大多局限于特定的系数选择，不清楚这种低维适应是否依赖于系数的精确选取。
Method: 基于扩散模型的通用框架，通过理论分析证明对于一类广泛的更新系数，采样迭代次数仅取决于数据本质维度k，而非环境维度。
Result: 理论上证明，在灵活系数选择下，扩散模型生成ε精确样本的迭代次数为Õ(k/ε)，与整体维度无关。
Conclusion: 扩散模型对低维结构的适应是一种稳健性质，不依赖于特定的系数选择，这解释了其在结构化高维数据上的实际有效性。

papers.title: DiT-Reward: Generative Representations for Text-to-Image Reward Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Can representations learned for image generation also support the evaluation of generated images? We study text-to-image reward prediction as a downstream task of generative representation learning. To this end, we introduce DiT-Reward, which converts a pretrained text-to-image Diffusion Transformer into a reward model by processing near-clean image latents and aggregating text-conditioned image representations across transformer layers. Under the same training data mixture as HPSv3, DiT-Reward outperforms HPSv3 on all four evaluated preference benchmarks, reaching 85.6% on HPDv2 and 77.6% on HPDv3. When the generative backbone is frozen, a lightweight learned head can still extract meaningful preference predictions from its representations. Probing across depth further reveals that downstream reward performance is strongest in the middle-to-late layers and benefits from combining representations across different stages. We also observe consistent positive scaling with generative backbone capacity. Finally, when used to optimize Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large with Flow-GRPO, DiT-Reward outperforms HPSv3 along the matched training trajectory, with particularly clear gains in realism. Direct latent scoring also achieves a 1.65x inference speedup over HPSv3 with comparable peak memory. These results show that pretrained generative DiTs provide transferable representations for reward modeling and policy optimization.

TL;DR: 本文提出DiT-Reward，将预训练的文本到图像扩散Transformer（DiT）转换为奖励模型，用于评估生成图像的质量。通过处理近干净图像潜变量并聚合跨层的文本条件表示，在多个偏好基准上超越现有方法HPSv3，并用于优化扩散模型生成。
Motivation: 探索用于图像生成的表示是否也能有效支持生成图像的评估，即文本到图像奖励预测作为生成表示学习的下游任务。
Method: 基于预训练的文本到图像Diffusion Transformer，提取近干净图像潜变量，跨层聚合文本条件图像表示，训练轻量级预测头来实现奖励建模。
Result: 在HPDv2和HPDv3基准上分别达到85.6%和77.6%的准确率，超越HPSv3。用于优化Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large时，在匹配训练轨迹上优于HPSv3，尤其在真实性方面提升明显，且直接潜变量评分实现1.65倍推理加速。
Conclusion: 预训练生成式DiT能够为奖励建模提供可迁移的表征，并有效用于策略优化。

papers.title: RECALL: Recovery Experience Collection for Active Lifelong Learning in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are commonly fine-tuned through passive imitation learning, where additional demonstrations are collected for tasks where the policy performs poorly. This approach incurs several downsides: it requires the robot to fail before data collection is triggered, provides little guidance about which states require supervision, and wastes demonstrator effort on redundant parts of the task where the policy already performs well. In this paper, we propose an active, continual learning paradigm for VLAs. We demonstrate that active, uncertainty-guided data collection leads to more efficient fine-tuning than when using passively-collected demonstrations. However, we also find that fine-tuning only on actively-collected recovery data leads to catastrophic forgetting. We evaluate techniques for continual learning, including replay-based data mixing and elastic weight consolidation, and identify tradeoffs between plasticity to uncertainty-guided recovery data and retention of previously learned behaviors. Overall, our work contributes an empirical study of active continual learning for autoregressive VLAs, establishing that uncertainty-guided recovery demonstrations can improve adaptation efficiency while also revealing open challenges when targeted new data is incorporated into large robot policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的被动模仿学习缺陷，提出主动持续学习范式：通过不确定性引导的数据收集更高效地进行微调。研究发现仅微调主动收集的恢复数据会导致灾难性遗忘，因此评估了基于回放的数据混合和弹性权重巩固等持续学习技术，揭示了可塑性与保留性之间的权衡。
Motivation: 被动模仿学习要求机器人失败后才收集数据，且缺乏对需要监督的状态的指导，浪费演示者在策略已擅长部分的精力。
Method: 提出主动不确定性引导的恢复数据收集，并结合回放数据混合和弹性权重巩固等持续学习技术，实现VLA模型的增量微调。
Result: 主动不确定性引导的数据收集比被动收集的微调效率更高；但仅使用主动恢复数据会导致灾难性遗忘，不同持续学习方法在适应新数据和保留旧行为之间表现出不同权衡。
Conclusion: 本文为自回归VLA模型提供了主动持续学习的实证研究，表明不确定性引导的恢复演示能提高适应效率，同时揭示了将针对性新数据融入大型机器人策略的开放挑战。

papers.title: Hedgementation = Hedgerow Segmentation: A Remote Sensing Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: We propose Hedgementation: a new benchmark to evaluate machine learning models for hedgerow mapping from remote sensing data at country scale and 10m$^2$ spatial resolution. We combine and harmonize multiple remote sensing data products and ground truth labels sourced from a hedgerow inventory in France. We measure the ability of three baseline models to generalize across spatial distance, and across climatic zones, a more explicitly challenging task. Our benchmark tests both supervised and self-supervised learning approaches for remote sensing, applied to tracking fine-scale features of high agricultural importance. The code to reproduce the benchmark and baselines results is available at https://github.com/hedgementation/hedgementation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了Hedgementation基准，用于评估机器学习模型在基于遥感数据绘制树篱（hedgerow）地图方面的性能，覆盖全国尺度、10m²分辨率。组合多种遥感数据和法国树篱清单的标签，测试三个基线模型在空间距离和气候区上的泛化能力。基准支持监督和自监督学习方法，代码公开。
Motivation: 树篱对农业生态有重要意义，但缺乏大规模、高精度的遥感评估基准。本文旨在提供标准化的benchmark来评估模型在树篱映射上的性能。
Method: 整合多种遥感数据产品和法国树篱清单标签，构建基准数据集。测试三个基线模型，包括监督和自监督学习方法，评估跨空间距离和跨气候区的泛化能力。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但报告了基线模型的表现。
Conclusion: 基准为树篱映射提供了标准化评估，有助于推动遥感在农业精细特征追踪中的应用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Data Selection Through Iterative Self-Filtering for Vision-Language Settings
papers.abstract_en: The availability of large amounts of clean data is paramount to training neural networks. However, at large scales, manual oversight is impractical, resulting in sizeable datasets that can be very noisy. Attempts to mitigate this obstacle to producing performant vision-language models have so far involved heuristics, curated reference datasets, and using pre-trained models. Here we propose a novel, bootstrapped method in which a CLIP model is trained on an evolving, self-selected dataset. This evolving dataset constitutes a balance of filtered, highly probable clean samples as well as diverse samples from the entire distribution. Our proposed Self-Filtering method iterates between training the model and selecting a subsequently improved data mixture. Training on vision-language datasets filtered by the proposed approach improves downstream performance without the need for additional data or pre-trained models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自举式数据选择方法 Self-Filtering，用于视觉-语言任务。该方法迭代地训练 CLIP 模型并自动筛选出高质量、多样化的训练子集，无需额外数据或预训练模型。实验表明，使用该方法过滤后的数据集训练模型可提升下游任务性能。
Motivation: 大规模视觉-语言数据集的噪声问题难以通过人工监督解决，现有过滤方法依赖启发式规则、参考数据集或预训练模型，成本高且泛化性有限。
Method: 提出 Self-Filtering 方法：在每次迭代中，用当前 CLIP 模型对训练样本进行打分，保留高置信度干净样本，同时纳入一定比例的多样本（覆盖整个分布），形成新的训练集，再继续训练模型。
Result: 摘要报告使用 Self-Filtering 过滤的视觉-语言数据集训练模型，可提升下游任务性能，且无需额外数据或预训练模型。
Conclusion: Self-Filtering 是一种无需人工标注或外部模型的数据清洗方法，通过自举迭代实现训练集优化，适用于大规模视觉-语言场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Vera: A Layered Diffusion Model for Content-Preserving Video Editing
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion models have enabled remarkable progress in video generation and editing. However, content preservation remains a core challenge: existing methods regenerate every pixel and often alter elements that should remain unchanged, such as characters or background scenes. We introduce Vera, a layered diffusion framework for content-preserving video editing. Instead of regenerating the entire video, Vera generates an edit layer along with an alpha matte for compositing with the source video, separating creative editing from content preservation by design. To encourage coherent composition with the source video, we extend the text-to-video DiT into a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture, with separate DiTs for each layer that interact through joint self-attention. To support the training of Vera, we further construct a high-quality layered dataset with accurate alpha mattes, diverse scenes and dynamics, and visual effects. Across our quantitative benchmark and human preference study, Vera outperforms leading open-source video editing models in content preservation while remaining competitive in edit quality, using 486K frames of layered training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Vera 是一种分层扩散框架，用于内容保留的视频编辑。它生成一个编辑层和 alpha 遮罩，与源视频合成，通过 Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) 架构实现分层交互，并在 486K 帧的分层数据集上训练，优于现有开源视频编辑模型在内容保留方面的表现。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型在编辑时难以保留原始内容（如角色或背景），因为每帧像素都被重新生成，导致非目标元素被意外改变。
Method: 提出分层扩散框架 Vera，生成编辑层和 alpha 遮罩，通过 MoT 架构（每层使用独立 DiT，并通过联合自注意力交互）实现与源视频的连贯合成。
Result: 在定量基准和人工偏好研究中，Vera 在内容保留方面优于领先的开源视频编辑模型，同时在编辑质量上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: Vera 通过将编辑与内容保留分离，有效解决了视频编辑中的内容保留问题，但依赖高质量分层训练数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Discovering Latent Groups for Robust Classification
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models exploit spurious correlations, achieving high average accuracy but failing disproportionately on underrepresented subgroups. Existing methods address this by adjusting network parameters, guided either by subgroup annotations or inferred pseudo-group labels. Yet at inference, these methods produce only a class prediction, with no insight into a sample's latent subgroup. We propose neural classification trees (NCT), a framework that achieves robustness by encoding subgroup structure in its tree-shaped architecture. By routing each sample to an "easy" or "hard" node of this tree -- based on prediction correctness -- and reusing these routes as pseudo-labels for the next iteration, NCT disentangles conflicting subgroups, without requiring subgroup supervision. We evaluate NCT on five benchmarks spanning binary and multi-class spurious correlations. Our experiments show that the learned tree topology provides strong interpretability by consistently isolating minority subgroups, which provides a transparent mapping between the model architecture and the data's latent group structure, while yielding competitive robustness with state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经分类树（NCT），通过树形架构编码样本的子组结构，基于预测正确性将样本路由到‘易’或‘难’节点，并重复使用路由作为伪标签来迭代解耦冲突子组，无需子组监督。在五个虚假相关性基准上，NCT在保持竞争性鲁棒性的同时，通过持续隔离少数子组提供了强可解释性。
Motivation: 机器学习模型常利用虚假相关性，在高平均准确率下对少数子组表现不佳；现有方法需要子组标注或推断伪标签，且推理时仅输出类别预测，无法揭示样本的潜在子组。
Method: 提出NCT，一种树形结构的框架，通过将样本路由到代表‘易’或‘难’的节点，基于预测正确性生成伪标签，并迭代更新树结构以解耦冲突子组，整个过程无需子组监督。
Result: 在五个涵盖二分类和多类虚假相关性的基准上，NCT的可解释树拓扑持续将少数子组隔离到单独节点，同时鲁棒性达到与最先进方法竞争的水平。
Conclusion: NCT通过学习树形架构透明地映射模型与数据的潜在子组结构，在提供强可解释性的同时实现了竞争性的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Causal Discovery in the Era of Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recent attempts to combine large language models (LLMs) with causal discovery ask models to infer pairwise directions, propose graph structures, or inject language-model outputs as priors and constraints. These approaches promise faster analysis, but they also obscure whether a causal evidence is supported by data and assumptions or by textual associations, prompt artifacts and hallucinated mechanisms. We argue for a different role for agents in causal discovery. Agents should inspect data, retrieve context, explain method assumptions and clarify graph outputs, but they should not supply edges, orientations, priors, constraints or causal conclusions. We propose the principle that agents assist the workflow, while causal claims remain grounded in data, explicit assumptions, formal algorithms, diagnostics and user or domain-expert decisions. We instantiate this principle in causal-learn+, an online platform that coordinates data analysis, preprocessing, method recommendation, expert-knowledge incorporation, formal discovery and interpretation around the algorithmic ecosystem of causal-learn. A case study on Big Five personality data illustrates agent-assisted pipeline of causal discovery without turning language-model unreliability into causal evidence. The platform is available at causallearn.com.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨大型语言模型在因果发现中的合理角色，指出当前方法可能将文本关联、提示伪影等误用为因果证据，主张agent应辅助工作流而非提供因果结论。提出causal-learn+平台整合数据分析、预处理、方法推荐等环节，以因果学习算法为核心，并通过大五人格数据案例展示agent辅助流程。
Motivation: 现有结合LLM与因果发现的方法存在风险：模型可能依赖文本关联或幻觉机制提供因果证据，而非基于数据和严格假设。需要明确agent的合理角色，确保因果发现的可信性。
Method: 提出agent辅助因果发现的原则：agent负责检查数据、检索上下文、解释方法假设和澄清图表输出，但不提供边、方向、先验、约束或因果结论。基于该原则构建causal-learn+在线平台，围绕因果学习算法生态协调数据分析、预处理、方法推荐、专家知识纳入、形式化发现和解释。
Result: 通过大五人格数据的案例研究展示了agent辅助的因果发现流程，并强调不将语言模型不可靠性转为因果证据。平台已在causallearn.com上线。
Conclusion: 论文建议因果发现中agent应限辅助角色，因果主张需基于数据、明确假设、正式算法、诊断以及用户或领域专家决策。

papers.title: Scaling Linear Mode Connectivity and Merging to Billion Parameter Pretrained Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Linear mode connectivity (LMC) provides a promising foundation for understanding and merging independently trained neural networks, but existing methods typically optimize the interpolation path from only one model endpoint, limiting their scalability and effectiveness for large pretrained transformers. We propose a novel and scalable framework for enabling LMC-based model merging to {\em billion-parameter pretrained transformers}. Our method applies properly parameterized functionality-preserving weight transformations to align functionally equivalent solutions, and introduces a dual learning procedure in which both models jointly learn their corresponding transformations toward a shared linear interpolation path. This bidirectional optimization substantially reduces interpolation barriers and enables more reliable merging across large-scale architectures. Empirically, we show that our approach achieves near-zero loss barriers on WikiText for language models with medium-sized parameters, representing, to our knowledge, the first demonstration of near-barrier-free linear connectivity at this scale. In the vision domain, ViT-L maintains above 69\% ImageNet top-1 accuracy throughout the interpolation path, while modern billion-parameter LLMs exhibit only small loss barriers. These results suggest that properly resolving parameter symmetries enables large pretrained Transformers to be connected and merged through simple linear paths with substantially improved interpolation performance. Code: https://github.com/VILA-Lab/Dual-Learned-Matching .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可扩展的框架，使十亿参数预训练Transformer能够实现线性模式连接（LMC）和模型合并。该方法通过参数化的功能保持权重变换和对齐，并引入双向学习过程，让两个模型联合学习朝向共享线性插值路径的变换，从而大幅降低插值障碍。实验表明，中等规模语言模型在WikiText上达到近零损失屏障；视觉领域ViT-L在插值路径上保持ImageNet Top-1准确率超过69%；十亿参数LLM仅表现出较小的损失屏障。
Motivation: 现有LMC方法通常只从单一模型端点优化插值路径，限制了其在大型预训练Transformer上的可扩展性和有效性。
Method: 提出一个框架，应用恰当参数化的功能保持权重变换来对齐功能等价的解，并引入双向学习过程，使两个模型联合学习各自的变换，朝向共享的线性插值路径。
Result: 在语言模型上实现近零损失屏障（WikiText）；ViT-L在插值路径上保持ImageNet Top-1准确率>69%；十亿参数LLM仅出现小损失屏障。
Conclusion: 正确解决参数对称性使得大型预训练Transformer可以通过简单的线性路径实现连接和合并，显著提升插值性能。

papers.title: Autonomous Subsea Cable Search and Tracking with Graph-Optimised Priors and Visual Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Global communications rely on subsea cable infrastructure that remains vulnerable to damage from natural hazards and human activity. Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) offer an efficient means to inspect long sections of exposed cable, but uncertainty in cable route maps, small cable diameters and partial burial makes continuous tracking a challenge. This paper presents a novel cable search and tracking method that leverages uncertain prior cable route maps. Graph-based optimisation continuously update the cable route to remain consistent with visual observations. Route uncertainty is constrained as a function of distance from observations using physics-based catenary models that account for cable parameters (i.e., lay depth, diameter, and density), bounding the search space to physically feasible regions and improving search efficiency. Cable detection is performed using a semi-supervised classifier running in real-time on-board a camera-equipped AUV. These detections both update the graph-based optimisation and enable visual cable tracking. When tracking is lost due to misclassification, burial or imperfect control, the bounded search space enables efficient recovery. The approach was demonstrated in field trials using the University of Southampton's Smarty200 AUV. The system successfully located the cable despite deliberate errors in it initial cable route map, updating this to be consistent with observations and using visual tracking to inspect up to 59% of a 120m test cable, with successful recovered after tracking loss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自主水下机器人（AUV）搜索与跟踪海底电缆的方法，利用图优化融合不确定的先验路由图与视觉观测，并结合物理悬链线模型约束搜索空间。在现场试验中，系统成功定位并跟踪了120米测试电缆的59%，且在跟踪丢失后能有效恢复。
Motivation: 海底电缆易受自然和人为损害，但现有路由图存在不确定性，电缆直径小且部分掩埋，导致连续跟踪困难。
Method: 基于图优化持续更新电缆路由以匹配视觉观测，使用物理悬链线模型（考虑埋深、直径、密度）约束与观测距离相关的路由不确定性，缩小搜索空间；采用半监督分类器进行实时电缆检测，检测结果同时更新图优化和支持视觉跟踪。
Result: 使用Smarty200 AUV的现场试验中，尽管初始路由图存在故意误差，系统仍成功定位电缆，并将路由图更新至与观测一致；视觉跟踪覆盖了120米测试电缆的59%，并在跟踪丢失后成功恢复。
Conclusion: 该方法通过结合图优化、物理模型和实时视觉检测，实现了对不确定路由图下的电缆搜索与鲁棒跟踪，具备实际部署潜力。

papers.title: Polycepta: Object-Centric Appearance Estimation for Multi-Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: The tracking-by-detection paradigm in multi-object tracking (MOT) typically relies on static appearance descriptors to complement motion estimation. However, these descriptors are frame-independent, limiting their robustness as visual cues. Since such descriptors are often obtained from computationally intensive pretrained backbones, real-time MOT systems frequently abandon appearance cues altogether and rely solely on motion prediction and geometric association. In this work, we introduce Polycepta, an object-centric appearance state estimation framework that reformulates appearance modeling as a recursive estimation problem rather than a frame-wise matching task. Polycepta constructs and continuously updates an independent appearance state for each tracked object, enabling future appearance representations to be estimated from accumulated observations. Polycepta is encouraged to learn the appearance-state construction of object-specific representations rather than memorize them through a proposed learning strategy, enabling appearance estimation for unseen classes. A key property of Polycepta is that the quality of appearance estimation improves as object states evolve during inference. While conventional appearance descriptors remain static or degrade over time, Polycepta progressively refines appearance estimates as additional observations are accumulated. Extensive experiments on KITTI, the Waymo Open Dataset, and MOT17 demonstrate consistent reductions in identity switches and improvements in tracking performance when integrated into the tracking-by-detection pipelines. Polycepta operates at 90.57 Hz and delivers state-of-the-art performance on the KITTI benchmark when integrated into the RobMOT framework, achieving a MOTA of 92.27\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Polycepta，一种以对象为中心的外观状态估计框架，将外观建模重新定义为递归估计问题而非逐帧匹配。Polycepta 为每个跟踪对象构建并持续更新独立的外观状态，利用观测积累逐步改进外观估计，对未见过的类别也具有泛化能力。在 KITTI、Waymo Open Dataset 和 MOT17 上，集成到检测-跟踪流程中一致地减少了身份切换次数并提升了跟踪性能，在 KITTI 基准上结合 RobMOT 达到 92.27% MOTA，运行速度 90.57 Hz。
Motivation: 现有的基于检测-跟踪的多目标跟踪方法通常使用静态外观描述子来辅助运动估计，但这些描述子是帧无关的，鲁棒性有限；且由于来自计算密集的预训练骨干网络，实时系统常放弃外观信息仅依赖运动预测和几何关联。需要一种更鲁棒且高效的外观建模方法。
Method: 提出 Polycepta，一种对象中心的外观状态估计框架。它为每个跟踪对象构建并递归更新一个独立的外观状态（appearance state），将未来外观表示从累积观测中估计出来。通过一种学习策略鼓励模型学习对象特定表示的外观状态构建过程而非记忆，从而能对未见类别进行外观估计。
Result: 在 KITTI、Waymo Open Dataset 和 MOT17 上，Polycepta 一致地减少了身份切换次数并提升了跟踪性能。在 KITTI 上结合 RobMOT 框架达到 92.27% MOTA，运行频率 90.57 Hz，实现最先进性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Polycepta 的关键性质是随着推理过程中对象状态演变，外观估计质量逐步提高；而传统外观描述子静态或随时间退化。该方法能有效集成到检测-跟踪流程中。

papers.title: MORL-A2C: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Reranker for Optimizing Healthiness in MOPI-HFRS
papers.abstract_en: Unhealthy dietary behavior continues to be a persistent public health issue in the United States, exacerbated by recommendation systems that prioritize user preference without considering nutritional health. The Multi-Objective Personalized Interpretable Health-aware Food Recommendation System (MOPI-HFRS), from which this work extends, addresses this by jointly optimizing preference, health, and diversity through Pareto-based optimization. However, this approach relies on static, per-step tradeoff solutions that fail to capture the sequential nature of dietary decision-making. We introduce MORL-A2C, a sequential decision-making extension to MOPI-HFRS targeting the health-preference axis. Leveraging frozen GNN embeddings, MORL-A2C formulates recommendation as a K-step reranking problem using an Advantage Actor-Critic algorithm with a scalarized relevance/health reward. The policy is warm-started via behavior cloning against a dot-product ranker derived from frozen embeddings. We also identify and correct a non-trivial bug in the MOPI-HFRS evaluation pipeline that understated baseline performance; all results are reported against the corrected baseline. On the macro-nutrient benchmark, MORL-A2C achieves a modest reduction in ranking quality (Recall@20: 25.64% to 23.61%, NDCG@20: 23.52% to 20.64%) in exchange for a substantial improvement in health alignment (H-Score@20: 46.05% to 69.57%), with consistent trends on the full-nutrient benchmark. These findings validate that policy-driven sequential optimization can effectively navigate the health-preference trade-off in multi-objective food recommendation.
papers.comment: Accepted at the International Workshop on Resource-Efficient Learning for Knowledge Discovery (RelKD) at ACM SIGKDD 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MORL-A2C 扩展了 MOPI-HFRS 食品推荐系统，使用优势演员-评论家算法进行序贯重新排序，以优化健康与偏好的权衡。在宏营养素基准上，召回率从 25.64% 降至 23.61%，但健康分数从 46.05% 提升至 69.57%。

Method: 将推荐建模为 K 步重排序问题，使用冻结 GNN 嵌入和优势演员-评论家算法，通过行为克隆进行暖启动。
Result: 在宏营养素基准上，Recall@20 从 25.64% 降至 23.61%，NDCG@20 从 23.52% 降至 20.64%，但 H-Score@20 从 46.05% 提升至 69.57%。
Conclusion: 策略驱动的序贯优化能有效导航多目标食品推荐中的健康-偏好权衡。

papers.title: Neural Networks as Linear Regression: An Introduction for Statisticians
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks are a commonly used prediction tool in computer science and statistics. However, the barrier to entry of this interesting field remains high, particularly for classical statisticians trained in a frequentist perspective. In this letter, we demystify neural networks by describing networks that approximate a linear regression and describe common customizations that provide a foundation for further study.
