papers.title: SPIRAL: Learning to Search and Aggregate
papers.abstract_en: Language model reasoning can be substantially improved at test time via scaffolds that scale inference compute across different primitives -- sequential reasoning within a trace, independently sampled parallel traces, and aggregation of multiple reasoning traces into a final response. During post-training, however, language models are optimized only for sequential reasoning within a single trace. We introduce Sequential-Parallel-Aggregative Reinforcement Learning (SPIRAL), a framework in which a language model is trained to use all three primitives, as part of a unified inference compute pipeline. Concretely, the language model first samples a set of independent traces in parallel, each produced through sequential chain-of-thought reasoning, and then generates a final aggregation trace conditioned on those traces; all components are optimized end-to-end against the reward of the final aggregated response. To train this system, SPIRAL uses set reinforcement learning to teach models to produce a set of traces that are collectively useful for an aggregator and standard reinforcement learning to teach models to aggregate the set into improved final responses. Our experiments on reasoning tasks show that SPIRAL effectively scales with inference compute, outperforming GRPO by up to 11$\times$ scaling efficiency and 15% higher performance when all three compute primitives are scaled.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPIRAL 框架，通过强化学习训练语言模型在推理时同时使用顺序推理、并行采样和聚合三种计算原语，并统一优化。实验表明该方法能有效扩展推理计算量，在推理任务上相比 GRPO 实现高达 11 倍的扩展效率和 15% 的性能提升。
Motivation: 现有后训练方法仅优化单轨迹顺序推理，未能利用并行采样和聚合等计算原语来提升测试时推理能力。
Method: SPIRAL 采用集合强化学习 (set RL) 训练模型生成一组对聚合器有用的并行轨迹，并结合标准强化学习训练模型聚合这些轨迹产生最终回答，所有组件端到端优化。
Result: 在推理任务上，SPIRAL 随推理计算量扩展，扩展效率比 GRPO 提升高达 11 倍，性能提升 15%。
Conclusion: SPIRAL 证明了语言模型可以通过统一优化多种推理原语来更有效地扩展测试时计算，但未提及在具体领域（如气象）的适用性。

papers.title: Real-Time Multimodal Activity-Aware Error Detection in Robot-Assisted Surgery
papers.abstract_en: Robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery improves surgical precision but introduces complexity, making technical error detection essential for ensuring patient safety. Current executional error detection methods using video data often overlook fine-grained contextual descriptions of activities and error types within the hierarchical structure of surgical procedures. They also under-utilize complementary multimodal information. We propose a unified framework for executional error detection that leverages multimodal input, including video, kinematics, and descriptive textual prompts. Through activity prompting, we integrate descriptive language in gesture-level activities, instrument-object interactions, and error definitions. We also introduce activity-aware visual embeddings derived from vision encoders pretrained on surgical activity labels to compare the effectiveness of contrastive language-image embeddings with traditional image-based embeddings for error detection. By seamlessly integrating kinematic data with video and textual modalities, our framework significantly improves error detection performance. Achieving up to 5\% and 16.6\% F1 score improvements over state-of-the-art baselines on the JIGSAWS and SAR-RARP50 datasets, respectively, we demonstrate the value of combining curated textual prompts with multimodal data for accurate error detection.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，利用视频、运动学和文本提示的多模态输入，用于机器人辅助手术中的执行错误检测。通过活动提示集成手势级活动描述和错误定义，并在JIGSAWS和SAR-RARP50数据集上分别提升5%和16.6%的F1分数。
Motivation: 现有基于视频的错误检测方法忽略手术层次结构中的细粒度活动描述和错误类型，且未充分利用互补的多模态信息。
Method: 提出一个统一框架，整合视频、运动学和描述性文本提示。通过活动提示引入语言描述，并使用预训练于手术活动标签的视觉编码器生成活动感知视觉嵌入，对比对比语言-图像嵌入与传统图像嵌入的效果。
Result: 在JIGSAWS数据集上实现5%的F1分数提升，在SAR-RARP50数据集上实现16.6%的F1分数提升，优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 结合精心设计的文本提示与多模态数据可显著提升错误检测性能，证明了该方法的有效性。

papers.title: Quantifying the Agreement Between Data-Influence and Data-Similarity to Understand LLM Behavior
papers.abstract_en: One way to understand LLM behavior is to trace its output back to the training data. Two types of measures are commonly used for output tracing: data-similarity and data-influence. The former is cheaper while the latter is believed to be more accurate. Even though many works have compared them for ground-truth tasks, no such comparisons exist for output tracing. Here, we fill this gap and precisely quantify the commonalities and differences between the two measures. We do this by first ranking the training documents according to each measure and then computing the overlap between the two rankings. Our main finding is that the two rankings agree significantly, but there is an asymmetry between them: The top documents of data-similarity are assigned more consistent ranks by data-influence than the other way around. This result is valid across a range of experiments involving OLMo2-1B, Qwen3-1.7B, LlaMa3.2-1B, Gemma3-1B, and GPT2. We exploit the asymmetry to obtain a favorable cost-accuracy trade-off by using the costly data-influence to refine the results of data-similarity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文量化了数据影响（data-influence）和数据相似度（data-similarity）两种追踪LLM输出到训练数据的度量之间的一致性。通过排序训练文档并计算重叠度，发现两者显著一致但存在不对称性：数据相似度的顶部文档被数据影响赋予更一致的排名。利用这种不对称性可以在成本-精度权衡中取得优势。
Motivation: 尽管数据影响被认为更准确，但数据相似度更廉价，且缺乏对输出追踪任务中两者一致性的严格量化比较。
Method: 对每个度量将训练文档排序，计算两个排序之间的重叠度，并在多个小规模LLM（OLMo2-1B等）上进行实验。
Result: 两个排序显著一致，但存在不对称性：数据相似度的顶部文档被数据影响赋予更一致的排名，反之不然。
Conclusion: 可以利用不对称性以低成本的数据相似度结合高成本的数据影响来优化追踪精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Topology of Ill-Posed Questions: Persistent Homology for Detection and Steering in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Ill-posed questions, including ambiguous, underspecified, or contradictory queries, may admit no valid answer or multiple plausible answers, posing a challenge for large language models (LLMs). Existing approaches largely analyze ill-posedness through model outputs and often focus on specific subclasses. We investigate whether diverse sources of ill-posedness can be represented within a unified topology of LLM internal states and whether this structure can be used to steer response behavior. We model the contextual hidden states of prompt tokens at each transformer layer as a point cloud and characterize its geometry using finite zero-dimensional persistent homology. Each layer is summarized by three compact descriptors: mean finite lifetime, normalized lifetime entropy, and largest-lifetime concentration. Concatenating these descriptors across layers yields a topology representation of the question. We further introduce topology-conditioned activation steering, which retrieves topologically similar examples and constructs query-specific activation interventions that encourage source-aware clarification or abstention. Across three open-weight LLMs, topology features consistently outperform prompt-based and pooled-hidden-state baselines for ill-posedness classification, improving average accuracy from \(67.4\%\) to \(78.9\%\) on AmbigQA, from \(79.9\%\) to \(88.5\%\) on SituatedQA, and from \(57.6\%\) to \(69.6\%\) on CLAMBER 9-way classification. Topology-conditioned steering increases the average total acceptable response rate from \(61.4\%\) to \(70.6\%\) and grounded acceptable responses from \(11.9\%\) to \(16.4\%\). These results show that persistent homology provides both an interpretable representation of ill-posedness and an effective mechanism for targeted response steering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用持久同调（persistent homology）分析LLM内部状态的拓扑结构，以检测和引导LLM对不良问题（ill-posed questions）的响应。通过将每层transformer token的隐藏状态建模为点云，计算零维持久同调特征，并用于分类和激活干预。实验表明该方法在分类准确率和响应质量上显著优于基线。
Motivation: 不良问题（歧义、欠指定、矛盾）对LLM构成挑战，现有方法多基于输出分析且局限于特定子类，缺乏统一的表征和干预机制。
Method: 将每层transformer的上下文隐藏状态视为点云，计算零维持久同调，提取三个描述符（平均有限寿命、归一化寿命熵、最大寿命集中度）并跨层拼接作为拓扑表示。进一步提出拓扑条件激活干预，检索拓扑相似示例构建查询特定的激活引导，促进源感知的澄清或拒绝。
Result: 在三个LLM上，拓扑特征在不良问题分类中提升准确率：AmbigQA从67.4%到78.9%，SituatedQA从79.9%到88.5%，CLAMBER 9-way从57.6%到69.6%。拓扑条件引导将总可接受响应率从61.4%提升到70.6%，基于事实的可接受响应从11.9%到16.4%。
Conclusion: 持久同调提供了可解释的不良问题表征和有效的目标响应引导机制，能够统一处理多种不良问题类型。

papers.title: A Generative Model for Closed-Loop Microsimulation of Signalized Intersections
papers.abstract_en: Traffic microsimulators rely on hand-crafted behavior models that reproduce aggregate flow but miss the heterogeneous interactions between vehicles at signalized intersections. Learned trajectory predictors capture richer interactions but are short-horizon and tend to be unstable when run in closed loop. We present Enactor, an actor-centric generative model for closed-loop intersection microsimulation. The model focuses on vehicles; pedestrians are included as context that can influence vehicle decisions but not predicted. Dynamic actors and lane polylines are encoded in polar coordinates referenced to the intersection center. A transformer with separate spatial and temporal attention blocks predicts a distribution over each actor's next-step motion ($s$, $α$). Training uses a closed-loop curriculum so the model is exposed to its own predictions. We evaluate Enactor in two regimes. In a 4000-second simulation-in-the-loop test at two intersection geometries, Enactor controls every dynamic vehicle against a continuously refreshing actor set rather than the fixed cohort that learned trajectory predictors are usually evaluated against. It recovers the SUMO data generator's speed and travel-time distributions with KL divergence over an order of magnitude lower than a recent transformer baseline on travel time, and substantially lower on speed (roughly $5\times$ lower at Site 1), and reduces red-light violations relative to the same baseline by more than an order of magnitude. An ablation isolates the leader rear-bumper feature as the change with the largest effect on intersection-aware safety metrics. We also evaluate on real-world field data and apply the same architecture to naturalistic vehicle trajectories from a fish-eye camera at a signalized intersection and evaluate it on multi-horizon predictive tasks. Enactor outperforms a constant-velocity baseline at every horizon evaluated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Enactor，一种面向信号交叉口闭环微观仿真的以车辆为中心的生成模型。模型将动态车辆和车道折线编码为以交叉口中心为原点的极坐标，并采用分离空间和时间注意力模块的Transformer预测每辆车的下一步运动(s, α)。通过闭环课程训练使模型暴露于自身预测，在仿真测试中相比SUMO数据生成器和Transformer基线，旅行时间和速度分布的KL散度降低一个数量级，红灯违规减少超过一个数量级。消融实验表明领导者后保险杠特征对安全指标影响最大。
Motivation: 现有交通微观仿真器依赖手工行为模型，能够复现聚合交通流但无法捕捉信号交叉口处车辆之间的异构交互。学习型轨迹预测器虽能捕捉更丰富的交互，但预测时域短且闭环运行时不稳定。
Method: 提出Enactor模型，以车辆为中心，将动态车辆和车道折线编码为以交叉口为中心的极坐标。采用分别处理空间和时间注意力的Transformer，预测每个车辆下一步的运动参数(s, α)。训练使用闭环课程，使模型在训练中暴露于自身预测。
Result: 在4000秒闭环仿真测试中，Enactor在两种交叉口几何结构上恢复SUMO数据生成器的速度和旅行时间分布，KL散度比最近的Transformer基线低一个数量级（旅行时间）和约5倍（速度），红灯违规减少超过一个数量级。消融实验显示领导者后保险杠特征对安全指标影响最大。在真实鱼眼相机数据上也优于常速基线。
Conclusion: 本文的生成模型能够生成信号交叉口闭环微观仿真中真实且稳定的多车轨迹，在分布拟合和安全指标上显著优于现有基线。模型的可解释性通过消融分析得到验证。

papers.title: It's Much Easier for Neural Networks to learn Game of Life Dynamics with the Right Activation Function: Polynomial Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.abstract_en: Previous work has found a gap between the scale of neural networks that reliably learn Conway's Game of Life, and minimal networks capable of representing the classic cellular automaton with hard-coded parameter values. Viewing neural network learning as a search process suggests a dependence on networks large enough to contain sub-networks with lucky initializations (sometimes known as 'winning tickets') that actually learn the task. In this work, we reorient our perspective from discovering Life rules as a search problem back to a learning problem, and reason that with fitting inductive biases, the problem should be much more amenable to minimal networks. We find that network variants with several alternative activation functions meaningfully outperform the default choice of Rectified Linear Units, and in particular, that a 2nd degree polynomial activation function consistently learns Life dynamics with or without the benefit of learning neural weights. Our results provide an informative demonstration of the benefits of matching learning to the task at hand and challenge the easy default choice of scale for all problems. In particular, we advocate for the use of cellular automata as simple test domains for developing strategies that can benefit machine learning for science, physics-based deep learning, and interpretable machine learning.
papers.comment: To be published in Proceedings of the 2026 Artificial Life Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络学习Conway's Game of Life的动力学，发现使用二次多项式激活函数（Polynomial Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks）能轻松学习，而标准ReLU效果差。作者认为合适的归纳偏置可使小型网络胜任，并倡导将细胞自动机作为机器学习策略的简单测试域。
Motivation: 先前工作发现可靠学习Game of Life的神经网络规模远大于理论最小网络，表明缺乏合适的归纳偏置，阻碍了小规模网络的学习。
Method: 比较不同激活函数（包括二次多项式）训练小规模神经网络学习Game of Life的能力，并分析是否利用权重学习。
Result: 二次多项式激活函数在有无权重学习的情况下均能一致地学习Life动力学，显著优于ReLU，且网络规模可极小。
Conclusion: 匹配任务特性的激活函数选择对学习至关重要；作者倡导将细胞自动机作为评估机器学习策略的简单测试域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Decentralized Autonomous Traffic Management through Corridor Networks
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous aircraft are introduced at scale and traffic density increases, centralized management becomes insufficient to coordinate the large numbers of crewed and uncrewed aircraft. Dedicated Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) corridors have therefore been proposed for organizing high-density autonomous traffic flows. The desire to scalably provide autonomous aircraft flexibility in trajectory planning motivates the development of decentralized approaches to traffic management in AAM corridors. In this work, we extend a multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) approach to address the challenge of decentralized traffic flow management in air corridor networks. We test policies trained in a single-corridor setting on increasingly complex multi-corridor networks with combinations of merges and splits in a zero-shot manner. Experimental results demonstrate that learned behaviors transfer well to scenarios with varying traffic density, network geometry, and heterogeneous vehicle performance, without needing centralized coordination or model retraining. We evaluate system-level performance in terms of conformance to corridor boundaries, completion rates, average speeds, distance traveled, and maintenance of inter-aircraft separation. We find that although our policies require only locally coordinated entry, traversal, and exit behaviors, they collectively produce desirable traffic flows through the corridor network.
papers.comment: Presented at the Second US-Europe Air Transportation Research and Development Symposium (ATRDS2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出将多智能体强化学习(MARL)方法扩展到空中走廊网络中的分散式交通流管理。在单走廊场景训练的策略可以零样本迁移到多走廊网络（包括合并和分支组合），无需集中协调或重新训练。实验表明学到的行为在不同交通密度、网络几何形状和异构飞行器性能下表现良好，系统级性能指标包括走廊边界符合度、完成率、平均速度、飞行距离和间隔保持等。
Motivation: 随着自主飞行器大规模部署和交通密度增加，集中式管理不足以协调大量有人/无人飞行器。高级空中移动(AAM)走廊被提出用于组织高密度自主交通流，但需要可扩展的分散式方法以提供轨迹规划的灵活性。
Method: 基于多智能体强化学习(MARL)方法，在单走廊环境中训练策略，然后零样本迁移到更复杂的多走廊网络（包含合并和分支）。策略仅需要局部协调的进入、穿越和退出行为。
Result: 实验表明策略能够很好迁移到不同交通密度、网络几何形状和异构飞行器性能的场景，无需集中协调或重新训练。系统级性能指标（走廊边界符合度、完成率、平均速度、飞行距离、间隔保持）良好。
Conclusion: 该方法通过局部协调行为即可产生理想的网络级交通流，证明了分散式MARL在AAM走廊网络中的可行性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kamera: Unified Position-Invariant Multimodal KV Cache for Training-Free Reuse
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents repeatedly re-examine the same video frames, UI screenshots, and rendered artifacts as their context window slides and reasoning iterates, yet every look-back re-encodes from scratch, because prefix caches serve reuse only at a fixed leading position. We show this recompute is avoidable, and identify exactly what naive KV reuse loses: the cross-chunk conditioning a chunk absorbs from its neighbours. This loss is asymmetric. The direct readout of a cached chunk is recovered exactly and for free by the standard state-merge. What remains is a diffuse, low-rank residue concentrated in deep layers, invisible to single-hop retrieval but precisely what multi-hop reasoning binds on. Blind reuse therefore leaves single-hop recall intact while halving multi-hop accuracy; this is the failure mode prior position-independent caches, designed for single-context or single-image reuse, do not address. We repair it with a small, training-free low-rank conditioning patch stored alongside each position-free chunk. Reuse reduces to one operator across MLA, GQA, and MHA: exact RoPE re-rotation to any target position, plus the patch that restores cross-chunk binding. This makes three window operations cheap: reorder (one patch serves every ordering of a cached set), sliding-window survival (surviving chunks relocate via rotation only, zero re-encode), and recall (an evicted chunk is rehydrated by its patch, never re-encoded). A rank-m patch recovers full task accuracy on cross-chunk-binding benchmarks, MM-NIAH across two attention families and two-page doc-QA, at a fraction of the KV footprint, and reconstructs re-prefill KV to within bf16 rounding in a production SGLang kernel across six backbones. The conditioning signal is strongest in redundant vision and video streams, making our solution most impactful where multimodal agents spend their recompute budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Kamera，一种无需训练的位置不变多模态 KV 缓存复用方法。通过存储低秩条件修补（patch）来恢复跨块绑定，支持重排序、滑动窗口存活和召回三种窗口操作。在 MM-NIAH 和两页 doc-QA 基准上，使用 rank-m 修补恢复全任务精度，并在生产级 SGLang 内核中重建预填充 KV 至 bf16 舍入误差内。
Motivation: 多模态代理重复审视相同视频帧、UI 截图等时，每次查找都从零重新编码，造成大量冗余计算。现有前缀缓存仅支持固定位置复用，而位置无关缓存会丢失跨块条件，导致多跳推理准确率减半。
Method: 提出 Kamera，为每个位置无关块存储一个低秩条件修补（patch），通过精确的 RoPE 重旋转到目标位置并应用修补来恢复跨块绑定，无需训练即可支持重排序、滑动窗口存活和召回操作。
Result: 在 MM-NIAH 和两页 doc-QA 基准上，rank-m 修补恢复全任务精度，跨 MLA、GQA 和 MHA 架构有效，KV 占用仅为原始缓存的一小部分；在 SGLang 内核中重建预填充 KV 达到 bf16 精度。
Conclusion: 条件信号在冗余视觉和视频流中最强，该方法对多模态代理最有效，可显著减少其重新计算预算。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Solve for the Hyperparameter, Skip the Search: Kolmogorov-Optimal Scaling Laws for Spline Regression
papers.abstract_en: Hyperparameter tuning almost always means search: fit the model at every value on a grid, score each by cross-validation, and keep the winner. For spline regression that search is unnecessary. The optimal resolution can be solved for in closed form, to the accuracy an exhaustive search reaches, at a fraction of the compute. Three ingredients make this possible: classical approximation theory pins the squared bias to a known power of the resolution G, exactly the Kolmogorov n-width of the smoothness class; the basis dimension is an explicit polynomial in G; and leave-one-out error follows from a single fit via the PRESS identity. Balancing the two known curves gives the minimizer analytically. We extend this calculus to many coordinates by replacing ambient input dimension with interaction order, the number of active low-order components in an ANOVA decomposition, yielding a scaling law in which the optimal resolution and error are power functions of the effective density (sample size per active component), with input dimension absent from the exponent. The law becomes an algorithm. KORE (Kolmogorov-optimal Order-aware Resolution Estimation) fits two pilot resolutions, solves a leverage-calibrated 2x2 system for the bias and noise scales, and evaluates the closed-form plug-in resolution with a tiny leave-one-out certificate: about a dozen fits instead of a full grid sweep, with a consistency guarantee as the sample grows. Across additive and sparse pairwise targets up to 80 input dimensions, KORE matches exhaustive 3-fold cross-validation and the full classical ladder (GCV, Mallows' Cp, AIC, BIC) while fitting roughly 8x fewer models; on 36 real tabular datasets it ranks first among 21 methods in accuracy per unit of compute, ahead of tuned boosters and kernel machines. When complexity lives in low interaction order, solving for the resolution beats searching for it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对样条回归中的超参数调优问题，提出无需网格搜索的解析求解方法。通过经典逼近理论将平方偏置与分辨率G的已知幂次关联，利用Kolmogorov n-宽度和PRESS恒等式，推导出最优分辨率的闭式解。扩展至高维时，用交互阶数替代输入维度，得到缩放律。KORE算法仅需拟合少量模型即可匹配穷举搜索的精度，在多个基准上显著减少计算量。
Motivation: 超参数调优通常依赖网格搜索，计算成本高。作者发现样条回归的复杂度（分辨率）可解析求解，从而避免搜索。
Method: 提出KORE算法：拟合两个初始分辨率模型，使用杠杆校准的2x2系统求解偏置和噪声尺度，代入闭式解得到最优分辨率，并通过留一法验证。
Result: 在高达80维的加性和稀疏成对目标上，KORE仅用约1/8的模型拟合次数即可匹配穷举3折交叉验证及GCV、Cp、AIC、BIC等经典准则。在36个真实表格数据集上，在单位计算量精度排名第一，优于调优的boosting和核方法。
Conclusion: 当复杂性存在于低交互阶时，解析求解分辨率比搜索更高效，且随样本量增长具有一致性保证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Spectral Theory of Normalized Corrected GNN Propagation
papers.abstract_en: We develop a spectral theory for \emph{normalized corrected GNN propagation}. The object of study is the symmetric normalized adjacency with its degree-stationary component removed, matching the normalization used by standard GCN-style models while isolating the stationary direction most directly tied to oversmoothing. The central theoretical question is whether this corrected normalized operator preserves class-discriminative signal after many propagation layers. Our main result is a high-probability exact-recovery theorem for the binary Contextual Stochastic Block Model after \(k=O(\log n)\) propagation steps in the dense polylogarithmic regime \(p\ge C\log^B n/n\), for any fixed \(B>4\), under explicit graph-signal and feature-SNR conditions. We also establish a multi-class partial recovery theorem showing contraction toward class centers for most nodes. Synthetic and real node-classification experiments are included as empirical checks of the theory's predicted dependence on depth, graph signal, and feature noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为归一化校正GNN传播建立了谱理论，研究移除度平稳分量后的对称归一化邻接矩阵算子。主要理论成果是在密集多对数区域下，对于二元上下文随机块模型经过O(log n)次传播后，给出高概率精确恢复定理，并推广到多类部分恢复。实验验证了深度、图信号和特征噪声的理论预测。
Motivation: 现有GCN类模型存在过平滑问题，需要理解校正归一化传播在深层下保持分类信号的能力。
Method: 分析了对称归一化邻接减去度平稳分量后的谱性质，并利用上下文随机块模型推导精确恢复的理论条件。
Result: 在p≥C log^B n/n的密集多对数区域，O(log n)次传播后可高概率精确恢复二元类别；多类情形下大部分节点向类中心收缩。
Conclusion: 理论表明校正归一化算子可抑制过平滑，其信号保持能力依赖于图信号强度和特征信噪比，实验佐证了深度与噪声的预测关系。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Patient-Aware Contrastive Learning Preserves Per-Patient Structure in RR-Interval Representations
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive representation learning struggles on physiological signals when each subject contributes a distinct baseline pattern. If class differences overlap with subject differences,class-level objectives such as supervised contrastive learning tend to merge per-subject structure into a single per-class cluster,removing the individual variation that a model needs to generalize to unseen patients. We study this problem in the setting of Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation(PAF) detection from RR-interval(RRI) sequences and propose a patient-aware contrastive objective that forms positive pairs only from same-patient, same-class segments, preserving each patient's own sinus rhythm(SR) baseline while still pushing the two classes apart. Examining the learned embeddings directly, our objective achieves the most consistent per-patient SR structure (cohesion $0.850$ vs. $0.800$ for supervised contrastive loss (SupCon) and $0.772$ for binary cross-entropy (BCE)). We also identify that BCE produces the cleanest global class separation yet the most disordered per-patient structure. This is precisely why a linear probe trained on its features breaks down on unseen patients. On the IRIDIA-AF dataset, the resulting representation reaches a patient-independent Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUROC) of $0.989 \pm 0.003$ with $2.6\times$ lower seed variance than supervised contrastive baselines.These results highlight that per-subject geometric consistency, rather than global class separability, is key to robust cross-patient generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对对比学习在生理信号中忽略个体基线差异的问题，提出一种病人感知对比学习目标，仅对同患者、同类别片段构成正样本，从而在RR间期表示中保留患者自身的窦性心律结构。在IRIDIA-AF数据集上，该方法在患者无关的AUROC上达到0.989±0.003，且种子方差比有监督对比学习基线低2.6倍。实验表明，跨患者泛化的关键在于保持个体几何一致性，而非全局类别分离性。
Motivation: 生理信号中每个受试者的基线模式不同，类间差异与个体差异重叠时，现有对比学习目标（如监督对比损失）会将个体结构合并成单一类簇，丢失模型泛化所需的个体变异。
Method: 提出病人感知对比目标，正样本仅由同一患者、同一类别（如窦性心律或房颤）的片段构成，同时拉远不同类别；在RR间期序列的阵发性房颤检测任务上验证。
Result: 该方法在IRIDIA-AF数据集上达到患者无关AUROC 0.989±0.003，种子方差比基准低2.6倍；学习到的嵌入中每患者窦性心律结构一致性（cohesion 0.850）优于监督对比损失（0.800）和二分类交叉熵（0.772）。
Conclusion: 作者强调跨患者泛化的关键是保持每患者的几何一致性，而非全局类别分离性；基于二分类交叉熵的线性探针因破坏了患者内部结构而无法泛化到新患者。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对对比学习在生理信号中忽略个体基线差异的问题，提出一种病人感知对比学习目标，仅对同患者、同类别片段构成正样本，从而在RR间期表示中保留患者自身的窦性心律结构。在IRIDIA-AF数据集上，该方法在患者无关的AUROC上达到0.989±0.003，且种子方差比有监督对比学习基线低2.6倍。实验表明，跨患者泛化的关键在于保持个体几何一致性，而非全局类别分离性。
summary_sections.motivation: 生理信号中每个受试者的基线模式不同，类间差异与个体差异重叠时，现有对比学习目标（如监督对比损失）会将个体结构合并成单一类簇，丢失模型泛化所需的个体变异。
summary_sections.method: 提出病人感知对比目标，正样本仅由同一患者、同一类别（如窦性心律或房颤）的片段构成，同时拉远不同类别；在RR间期序列的阵发性房颤检测任务上验证。
summary_sections.result: 该方法在IRIDIA-AF数据集上达到患者无关AUROC 0.989±0.003，种子方差比基准低2.6倍；学习到的嵌入中每患者窦性心律结构一致性（cohesion 0.850）优于监督对比损失（0.800）和二分类交叉熵（0.772）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调跨患者泛化的关键是保持每患者的几何一致性，而非全局类别分离性；基于二分类交叉熵的线性探针因破坏了患者内部结构而无法泛化到新患者。

papers.title: SVD-Surgeon: Optimal Singular-Value Surgery for Large Language Model Compression
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks, but their deployment is constrained by substantial memory and compute requirements. Low-rank compression via singular value decomposition (SVD) is an effective remedy, but existing methods focus on how to factorize and which components to keep. We introduce SVD-Surgeon, a training-free method that brings the Optimal Brain Surgeon (OBS) framework to the singular-value basis. Treating each singular value as a parameter, it computes a closed-form update of the retained singular values that compensates, to second order in the model loss, for those removed by truncation. The same analysis yields a saliency for choosing which values to prune. As it operates directly on the singular-value factorization, SVD-Surgeon can be layered on top of existing SVD compressors. Applied to SVD-LLM, a leading SVD-based method, it improves the perplexity-compression trade-off on the OPT family and LLaMA 2-7B without any retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SVD-Surgeon，一种无需重新训练的大语言模型（LLM）低秩压缩方法。它通过将最优脑外科手术（OBS）框架应用于奇异值分解（SVD）的奇异值上，以闭式解更新保留的奇异值，补偿被截断部分带来的二阶损失。在OPT系列和LLaMA 2-7B上的实验表明，该方法在困惑度与压缩率之间取得了更好的权衡，且可叠加于现有SVD压缩器之上。
Motivation: 大语言模型部署受限于内存和计算成本，低秩压缩（如SVD）是有效手段，但现有方法仅关注分解方式和保留哪些分量，缺乏对移除分量带来的损失进行补偿的机制。
Method: 将OBS框架引入SVD奇异值空间，将每个奇异值视为参数，计算保留奇异值的闭式更新，以二阶近似补偿截断误差；同时基于相同分析提出奇异值重要性度量用于剪枝。
Result: 在OPT系列和LLaMA 2-7B上，将SVD-Surgeon应用于现有方法SVD-LLM，无需重新训练即改善了困惑度-压缩权衡。
Conclusion: SVD-Surgeon是一种即插即用的增强模块，可提升现有SVD压缩器的效果，且无需额外训练。

papers.title: Scheduling Thoughts: Learning the Order of Thought in Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion language models decode by iteratively unmasking tokens, where the unmasking order defines an "order of thought" that strongly influences generation quality yet is typically chosen heuristically. We derive a tractable upper bound on the sequential decoding mismatch, measured by the Kullback-Leibler divergence and expressed in terms of the model's pathwise log-likelihood, with tightness under sufficient model expressivity. This bound induces a dense self-aware reward over ordered trajectories, casting order selection as a principled policy optimization problem with a frozen denoiser. We instantiate this idea as Self-Aware Scheduling (SAS), which learns a lightweight order policy using Group Relative Policy Optimization and applies seamlessly to both any-order and semi-autoregressive decoding. On Sudoku with 1B MDM, SAS improves puzzle accuracy from 82.0% (best heuristic schedule) to 91.8%, and reaches 97.5% with second-stage fine-tuning along learned trajectories. On mathematical reasoning with LLaDA-8B, SAS improves pass@1 on GSM8K from 64% to 76% and on MBPP from 39.5% to 41%, consistently matching or exceeding heuristic schedules across generation lengths and block sizes. Project page: https://jimmyxu123.github.io/SAS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究掩蔽扩散语言模型中令牌解封顺序（order of thought）的调度问题，提出自感知调度（SAS）方法，通过策略优化学习解封顺序，显著提升生成质量。在Sudoku和数学推理任务上，SAS超越了启发式调度基线。
Motivation: 现有掩蔽扩散语言模型使用启发式解封顺序，但该顺序对生成质量影响很大，缺乏理论指导的优化方法。
Method: 推导了一个基于路径对数似然的KL散度上界，将顺序选择转化为策略优化问题，并用GRPO学习轻量级顺序策略，适用于任意顺序和半自回归解码。
Result: 在Sudoku上，1B MDM模型准确率从82.0%提升至91.8%，微调后达97.5%；在数学推理上，LLaDA-8B在GSM8K上pass@1从64%提升至76%，MBPP上从39.5%提升至41%。
Conclusion: 该方法性能超过多种启发式调度，且能自适应不同生成长度与块大小，但未探讨在更复杂文本生成任务上的表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HoloAgent-0: A Unified Embodied Agent Framework with 3D Spatial Memory
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents follow a practical execution loop in digital environments: they reason over structured states, invoke tools, inspect feedback, and revise actions. Extending this loop to physical robots is difficult because physical execution is continuous, embodiment-dependent, uncertain, and constrained by safety. Existing embodied-AI systems have advanced manipulation, spatial understanding, navigation, and humanoid control, but these capabilities often remain specialized modules or loosely coupled decision loops. In this work, we introduce HoloAgent-0, a unified embodied agent framework for real-world robot deployment. Embodied AgentOS converts language instructions into executable skill graphs, schedules robot resources, monitors execution, and triggers clarification or re-planning from runtime feedback. HoloAgent-0 organizes heterogeneous robot models and controllers through three coupled layers: Embodied AgentOS for closed-loop execution, 3D spatial memory for physical world grounding, and embodied skills for robot action. We deploy HoloAgent-0 on real hardware and evaluate its spatial memory, long-horizon navigation, and closed-loop execution across motion generation, object search, cross-robot coordination, and mobile manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HoloAgent-0，一个统一的具身智能体框架，包含三层结构：Embodied AgentOS（闭环执行）、3D 空间记忆和具身技能。该框架将语言指令转换为可执行的技能图，调度机器人资源，监测执行并通过运行时反馈触发重规划。在真实硬件上评估了空间记忆、长时域导航、运动生成、物体搜索、跨机器人协调和移动操作等能力。
Motivation: 现有具身 AI 系统在操作、空间理解、导航和人形控制等方面各有专长，但往往作为专用模块或松散耦合的决策循环，缺乏统一的闭环执行框架。
Method: 提出 HoloAgent-0 框架，通过三个耦合层组织异构机器人模型和控制器：Embodied AgentOS 实现闭环执行，3D 空间记忆用于物理世界接地，具身技能用于机器人动作。
Result: 在真实硬件上部署并评估了空间记忆、长时域导航、闭环执行（运动生成、物体搜索、跨机器人协调、移动操作）等能力。
Conclusion: 该框架统一了具身智能体的执行循环，但摘要未明确提及局限性或适用范围。

papers.title: Dense Reward for Multi-View 3D Reasoning with Global Maps and Local Views
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view 3D Visual Question Answering (MV3D-VQA) requires integrating partial observations into a coherent 3D scene representation and selecting informative viewpoints for multi-step spatial reasoning. However, current multimodal LLMs are typically trained with sparse, answer-level supervision, which often yields inconsistent cross-view reasoning and brittle view selection. We present DR-MV3D (Dense Reward for MV3D-VQA), a map-grounded learning framework that provides dense, verifiable rewards to supervise the reasoning process. Our approach decomposes MV3D-VQA into (i) allocentric global map construction, (ii) question-conditioned view-trajectory planning, and (iii) egocentric grounding for answer prediction. To make intermediate steps learnable without manual annotations, we introduce two rewards: a global consistency reward that aligns the predicted map with geometry-consistent pseudo targets from frozen 3D vision foundation models (e.g., VGGT + SAM3), and a local trajectory reward that supervises ordered viewpoint selection. We optimize the full pipeline with trajectory-level policy optimization (GRPO). Experiments on MindCube, VSI-Bench, and BLINK (MV) show that DR-MV3D consistently improves over strong multi-image baselines, supporting the effectiveness of process-level dense supervision for multi-view 3D reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多视图3D视觉问答（MV3D-VQA）中稀疏答案级监督导致的跨视图推理不一致问题，提出DR-MV3D框架，通过密集可验证奖励监督推理过程。方法分解任务为全局地图构建、条件视图轨迹规划和自我中心定位，引入全局一致性奖励（利用冻结3D基础模型生成伪目标）和局部轨迹奖励，并用GRPO进行轨迹级策略优化。在MindCube、VSI-Bench和BLINK(MV)基准上，DR-MV3D持续改进强多图像基线，验证了过程级密集监督的有效性。
Motivation: 当前多模态LLM在多视图3D VQA中常用稀疏的答案级监督，导致跨视图推理不一致且视角选择脆弱。
Method: 提出地图引导的DR-MV3D框架，分解MV3D-VQA为三个可学习步骤，并设计两种密集奖励：全局一致性奖励对齐预测地图与从冻结3D视觉基础模型（如VGGT+SAM3）得到的几何一致伪目标，局部轨迹奖励监督有序视角选择。整体使用GRPO优化。
Result: 在MindCube、VSI-Bench和BLINK(MV)上，DR-MV3D一致优于强多图像基线，证明过程级密集监督对多视图3D推理有效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调过程级密集监督显著提升多视图3D推理性能，未来可探索更复杂的奖励设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Approximating velocity fields with planted attractors via Neural-ODEs for classification purposes
papers.abstract_en: In this work, Neural ODEs equipped with a curated collection of equilibrium points have been successfully employed for classification tasks.The planted attractors serve as indicators for the target classes, while the velocity field leveraging the universal approximation capabilities of the architecture shapes the dynamical landscape.This process defines the basins of attraction of the trained model, effectively directing each input provided as an initial condition toward its corresponding destination target.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用带有预设平衡点（planted attractors）的神经常微分方程（Neural ODEs）执行分类任务。植入的吸引子作为目标类别的指示器，速度场利用架构的通用逼近能力刻画动力学景观，定义训练模型的吸引域，将作为初始条件的每个输入导向对应的目标。
Motivation: 探索如何通过可控的动力学系统（平衡点）将Neural ODEs应用于分类，使输入轨迹收敛到对应类别的吸引子。
Method: 在Neural ODEs中植入一组平衡点（吸引子），利用网络的通用逼近能力学习速度场，从而形成吸引域，将初始条件引导至对应吸引子。
Result: 摘要声称该方法在分类任务上成功，但未报告具体数值或基准。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了速度场与植入吸引子结合用于分类的可行性，但摘要未提及局限性或泛化性。

papers.title: SuperCond-GNN: Scalable Graph Neural Network Surrogate for Superconducting Circuit Simulations
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents SuperCond-GNN, a graph neural network-based surrogate model for predicting the voltage distribution in high-temperature superconducting (HTS) magnets. HTS magnets are modeled as lumped-element equivalent circuits and mapped onto graph representations, enabling message passing GNNs to learn the electrical response as a function of circuit topology, material properties, and operating current. As a proof of concept, tape stacks of up to 10 tapes are considered across a range of circuit topologies and operating conditions. The surrogate is trained on data generated from circuit simulations and achieves a mean MAPE of 4.3 % within the prescribed design space. The predicted nodal voltages enable fast and scalable inference of current redistribution and local operating conditions across a wide range of circuit configurations. The effect of incorporating physics-informed regularization via Kirchhoff's current law is also evaluated, and generalizability to unseen topologies is assessed through zero-shot inference and few-shot fine-tuning. While demonstrated on tape stack circuits, the graph-based framework is topology-agnostic and naturally extensible to more complex HTS cable and magnet configurations, offering a scalable alternative to conventional circuit solvers for downstream applications such as design space exploration, current sharing analysis, and real-time magnet monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SuperCond-GNN，一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的替代模型，用于预测高温超导（HTS）磁体中的电压分布。该模型将HTS磁体建模为集总元件等效电路并映射为图，利用消息传递GNN学习电压响应。在多达10带叠的电路拓扑和运行条件下，平均MAPE为4.3%。引入基尔霍夫电流定律的物理信息正则化，并通过零样本推理和少样本微调评估了对未见拓扑的泛化能力。
Motivation: 传统电路求解器在超导磁体设计空间探索、电流共享分析和实时监测中计算成本高，亟需一种可扩展的快速替代模型。
Method: 将超导磁体的集总元件电路映射为图，节点对应电路节点，边对应元件；使用消息传递GNN预测节点电压；训练数据由电路仿真生成；可选地加入基尔霍夫电流定律作为物理信息正则化。
Result: 在10带叠的电路配置中，平均MAPE为4.3%；零样本和少样本微调测试表明对未见拓扑具有泛化能力。

papers.title: The Energy Consumption of Transformer Fine-Tuning: A Roofline-Inspired Scaling Model
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based models underpin modern natural language processing but incur rapidly growing computational and energy costs. As training scales in both model size and parallelism, accurately predicting energy consumption has become critical for sustainable and cost-aware system design. We present a framework for modeling the energy consumption of Transformer training on multiple GPUs. Using controlled architectural sweeps of BERT models, we relate measured energy to lightweight proxies for compute, memory traffic, and hardware efficiency. Inspired by roofline models, our approach incorporates a speedup-based hardware-efficiency factor that captures the effects of tensor parallelism and fully sharded data parallelism. We derive a scaling law model that accurately predicts training energy across heterogeneous configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个框架，用于建模 Transformer 在多个 GPU 上训练的能耗。通过 BERT 模型的控制架构扫描，将测量到的能耗与计算量、内存流量和硬件效率的轻量级代理指标关联起来。受 roofline 模型启发，方法引入了基于加速比的硬件效率因子，捕捉张量并行和全分片数据并行的效果，导出能耗缩放定律模型，能跨异构配置准确预测训练能耗。
Motivation: Transformer 模型计算和能源成本快速增长，在模型大小和并行度扩展时准确预测能耗对可持续和成本感知的系统设计至关重要。
Method: 提出一个能耗建模框架，通过 BERT 模型的控制架构扫描收集测量数据，将能耗与计算量（FLOPs）、内存流量和硬件效率代理相关联。引入基于 roofline 模型的速度提升硬件效率因子，处理张量并行和全分片数据并行，并推导出缩放定律模型。
Result: 导出的缩放定律模型能够准确预测跨异构配置的训练能耗。
Conclusion: 该框架有助于可持续和成本感知的 Transformer 训练系统设计，但未提及在微调场景下的验证或与关键词相关的内容。

papers.title: VeriEvol: Scaling Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning via Verifiable Evol-Instruct
papers.abstract_en: Scaling reinforcement learning for visual mathematical reasoning requires more than generating harder questions: as data volume grows, the reward labels themselves must remain reliable. Yet existing data pipelines scale supervision while trusting the labeller, and policy-side methods assume the underlying answers are already correct. We instead treat scaling as a verifiable data-construction problem and decouple two axes before any policy update: prompt difficulty, expanded by route-specific evolution operators, and answer reliability, enforced by offline hypothesis-test falsification. We instantiate this as VeriEvol, an iterative framework with two extensible components: a type-aware evolution module that rewrites low-difficulty image-question seeds into harder, image-grounded prompts; and HTV-Agent, a verifier that accepts an answer only after multi-source counter-evidence has failed to refute it. The resulting verified data scales in volume, extends by adding evolution routes or verifier channels, and plugs directly into existing GRPO-style RL recipes. On a five-benchmark visual-math suite, scaling evolved SFT data from 10K to 250K samples raises the mean accuracy from 35.42 to 54.73; then, with backbone, SFT initialization, and GRPO recipe held fixed, VeriEvol adds a cumulative +3.88 over an un-evolved RL baseline, of which +1.82 comes from evolved prompts and +2.06 from the HTV-Agent verifier. We release the prompts, data, models, code, and the full verifier trace of every sample, so that downstream work can scale and audit the pipeline rather than only inspect its outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VeriEvol 是一个用于扩展多模态数学推理强化学习数据的迭代框架，通过可验证的进化指令（Verifiable Evol-Instruct）方法解耦问题难度和答案可靠性。它包含类型感知进化模块和 HTV-Agent 验证器，前者通过路线特定算子生成更难的问题，后者通过多源反证据验证答案。实验表明，将进化后的 SFT 数据从 10K 扩展到 250K 样本，在五个视觉数学基准上的平均准确率从 35.42 提升到 54.73；在固定 GRPO-RL 配方下，VeriEvol 带来累积 +3.88 的提升。
Motivation: 现有数据管道在扩展时依赖标注者可靠性，且策略侧方法假设答案正确，导致奖励标签在数据量增长时不可靠。因此需要一种可验证的数据构建方法，将难度扩展和答案可靠性解耦。
Method: 提出 VeriEvol 框架，包含两个可扩展组件：类型感知进化模块，通过路线特定算子将低难度图像-问题种子重写为更难的问题；以及 HTV-Agent 验证器，接受一个答案仅当多源反证据未能反驳它。生成的数据可直接用于 GRPO-style 强化学习。
Result: 在五个视觉数学基准上，进化 SFT 数据从 10K 到 250K 样本使平均准确率从 35.42 升至 54.73；在固定 backbone、SFT 初始化和 GRPO 配方下，VeriEvol 在未进化的 RL 基线上累积提升 +3.88，其中 +1.82 来自进化提示，+2.06 来自 HTV-Agent 验证器。
Conclusion: VeriEvol 提供了一种可验证的数据扩展方法，通过发布数据、模型、代码和验证器跟踪，使下游工作能够审计管道而非仅检查输出。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AwakeForest: An Interactive Geospatial Platform for Large-Scale Forest Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Forest imagery analysis often involves multiple tightly coupled vision tasks, which must be performed under substantial variation in geographic regions, sensors, and acquisition conditions. However, practitioners often lack a unified tool that is geospatial-native, cloud-optimized, and ML-integrated for end-to-end workflows spanning annotation, prediction, visualization, and downstream analysis at scale. We present AwakeForest, an interactive end-to-end platform designed for large-scale forest imagery that integrates model-assisted inference, automatic annotation, and human-in-the-loop refinement within a single workflow. Our platform supports plug-and-play integration of pretrained models and enables scalable interaction with forest imagery ranging from standard aerial scenes to large orthomosaics that can span several gigabytes to hundreds of gigabytes. AwakeForest produces analysis-ready outputs that can be directly used for downstream analysis and to support iterative model and annotation updates on new scenes. We demonstrate the system on the PALMS dataset and illustrate how AwakeForest supports an end-to-end workflow for practical forest management and analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AwakeForest 是一个面向大规模森林影像的交互式端到端地理空间平台，集成了模型辅助推理、自动标注和人在回路优化。它支持即插即用的预训练模型，可处理从标准航拍场景到数百 GB 的正射影像图，并生成可直接用于下游分析的结果。在 PALMS 数据集上的实验展示了其端到端工作流在森林管理与分析中的实用性。
Motivation: 现有森林影像分析缺乏统一的、地理空间原生、云优化且集成机器学习的工具，难以在大范围变化的地理区域、传感器和采集条件下完成标注、预测、可视化和下游分析。
Method: 提出 AwakeForest 平台，采用模型辅助推理、自动标注和人在回路细化的集成工作流，支持预训练模型的即插即用，并实现与不同尺度森林影像（从标准航拍到数百 GB 正射影像）的可扩展交互。
Result: 在 PALMS 数据集上验证了平台端到端工作流的有效性。
Conclusion: AwakeForest 为大规模森林影像分析提供了实用、可扩展的端到端解决方案，有助于森林管理和迭代模型更新。

papers.title: LightSTAR: Efficient Visual Document Retrieval via Lightweight Selection with Vision-Adaptive Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Visual document retrieval requires rapidly locating relevant pages from large multi-modal corpora in response to user queries. While recent methods powered by Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show competitive accuracy, they suffer from prohibitive computational costs by applying intensive MLLM encoding to every single page. Meanwhile, we observe that user queries are typically keyword-anchored, containing semantically rich words that are expected to appear directly in the visible text of relevant pages, offering an efficient cue for quickly narrowing down candidate pages. Building on this insight, we propose LightSTAR, an efficient framework that decomposes visual document retrieval into: 1) LLM-free Visual Selection, which utilizes content-grounded query encoding to focus on informative words and employs LLM-free visual embeddings to produce a high-recall candidate set; and 2) Vision-adaptive Semantic Refinement, which further performs fine-grained semantic matching exclusively on these top candidates via adaptive region-wise feature fusion to effectively combine textual and layout cues, optimized through a hardness-aware contrastive objective. Experimental results demonstrate that LightSTAR achieves state-of-the-art retrieval accuracy while reducing end-to-end latency by several-fold, offering a highly practical solution to the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in visual document retrieval. Code is available at https://github.com/bokufa/LightSTAR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LightSTAR，一种高效的视觉文档检索框架，将检索分解为无 LLM 的视觉选择（利用内容锚定的查询编码和视觉嵌入快速生成高召回候选集）和视觉自适应语义精炼（对候选集进行自适应区域特征融合的细粒度语义匹配），通过难度感知对比学习优化。实验表明，LightSTAR 在显著降低端到端延迟的同时取得了最先进的检索精度。
Motivation: 现有基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的视觉文档检索方法虽准确但计算成本极高，因为需要对每一页进行密集编码。用户查询通常包含关键词锚点，可直接出现在相关页面的可见文本中，这为快速缩小候选范围提供了线索，但现有方法未充分利用这一特性。
Method: 提出双阶段框架：1) 无 LLM 的视觉选择阶段，使用内容锚定的查询编码聚焦信息词，并通过无 LLM 的视觉嵌入生成高召回候选集；2) 视觉自适应语义精炼阶段，仅对候选集进行基于自适应区域特征融合的细粒度语义匹配，结合文本和布局线索，并通过难度感知对比目标优化。
Result: 实验表明，LightSTAR 取得了最先进的检索精度，同时将端到端延迟降低数倍，有效平衡了精度与效率。
Conclusion: LightSTAR 提供了一种实用且高效的解决方案，通过将检索分解为快速筛选和精细化匹配，显著降低了视觉文档检索的计算开销，同时保持了高精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SQLConductor: Search-to-Policy Learning for Step-wise Text-to-SQL Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-SQL enables users to access relational databases via natural language, but real-world settings remain challenging due to coordinated reasoning over complex database environments. Existing systems often use multi-stage pipelines or reasoning models specialized for individual stages. However, fixed pipelines rely on predefined stage orders, limiting their adaptivity to query demands and intermediate evidence. Recent orchestration-based methods provide flexibility by composing specialized modules for each query, but typical plan-then-execute approaches still commit to a complete workflow before execution and cannot adapt to intermediate artifacts and feedback. In this paper, we propose SQLConductor, a step-wise orchestration learning framework for Text-to-SQL. SQLConductor formulates Text-to-SQL subtasks as specialized actions for workflow composition and trains a policy model to select the next action based on intermediate artifacts and feedback. To learn this policy, SQLConductor introduces Search-to-Policy Learning, which uses Monte Carlo Tree Search to explore candidate workflows and stability estimation to identify robust supervision. The policy model is trained with Stability-weighted Supervised Fine-tuning to prioritize high-quality orchestration patterns and further enhanced through Curriculum Reinforcement Learning. This transforms offline workflow search into a deployable policy for step-wise orchestration at inference time. Experiments on BIRD-Dev and out-of-distribution datasets show that SQLConductor achieves superior execution accuracy and strong generalization, reaching 73.2% EX on BIRD-Dev with a compact orchestration policy coordinating frozen larger action models, outperforming prior methods that directly train comparable or larger Text-to-SQL backbones. Further analyses show that the learned policy adapts orchestration to diverse query demands.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SQLConductor 提出一种基于搜索到策略学习的分步编排框架，用于 Text-to-SQL。该框架将子任务形式化为动作，通过蒙特卡洛树搜索探索候选工作流，并使用稳定性估计选择高质量监督信号，训练策略模型实现分步编排。在 BIRD-Dev 上达到 73.2% 的执行准确率，优于先前方法，且学习到的策略能自适应不同查询需求。
Motivation: 现有 Text-to-SQL 系统常采用固定流水线或预先规划的执行流程，无法根据中间证据和反馈动态调整，限制了其对复杂数据库环境和多样查询需求的适应性。
Method: SQLConductor 将 Text-to-SQL 子任务编码为专用动作，通过蒙特卡洛树搜索探索候选工作流，利用稳定性估计识别鲁棒监督，以稳定性加权的监督微调训练策略模型，并进一步通过课程强化学习优化。推理时，策略模型逐步选择下一个动作，实现可部署的分步编排。
Result: 在 BIRD-Dev 上达到 73.2% 的执行准确率，优于直接训练同等或更大规模 Text-to-SQL 骨干的先前方法，并在分布外数据集上表现出强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 学习到的策略能够根据查询需求自适应地编排动作，将离线工作流搜索转化为推理时的有效编排，提升了复杂场景下的执行准确率和适应性。

papers.title: Simulation-Free Estimation of Traffic Flows from Sparse Count Data
papers.abstract_en: We propose a method for estimating time-varying traffic flow patterns from sparse aggregated vehicle counts. The method partitions the study area into spatial regions, constructs a set of feasible region-to-region routes, and solves a weighted least-squares optimization problem to determine the number of vehicles to allocate on each route. A weighted contribution matrix encodes sensor coverage, steering the optimizer toward flow configurations that are directly observable by sensors. Edge-level trajectories are then derived by scoring candidate routes against the temporal and volumetric profiles of aggregated regional sensor counts. The method is evaluated on the Brussels road network using real and synthetic traffic data. Results show that the proposed approach reproduces the daily traffic profile in the input data and outperforms the baseline methods at a fraction of the computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需模拟的交通流估计方法，利用稀疏聚合车辆计数数据，通过划分区域、构建可行路线并求解加权最小二乘优化来分配车辆数。在布鲁塞尔路网的实验表明，该方法能准确再现每日交通流模式，且计算成本远低于基线方法。
Motivation: 现有交通流估计方法依赖仿真或密集传感器数据，计算成本高且难以部署。
Method: 将研究区域划分为空间子区，构建所有可行的区域间路线，通过加权最小二乘优化分配车辆至各路线，其中加权贡献矩阵编码传感器覆盖信息，引导优化器优先采用直接可观测的流量配置。
Result: 在布鲁塞尔路网的真实与合成数据上，该方法成功复现了输入数据的日交通流曲线，并在精度上优于基线方法，同时计算开销显著降低。
Conclusion: 方法无需仿真即可从稀疏计数数据准确估计交通流，适合实时或资源受限场景。

papers.title: POTracker: Optimizing Large Language Models for Standard-Compliant Power Outage Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent large language models (LLMs) are good at general text generation, but it is still hard to use them for domain-specific data generation because the output must follow strict formatting and structural rules. Unlike open-ended tasks such as question answering or translation, domain-specific generation must be both semantically correct and compliant with existing guidelines and standards. In this work, we study the nationwide interoperability problem of utility power outage reports in the United States. In practice, outage reports need to be machine-readable (e.g., JSON or XML) and must strictly follow requirements from energy-sector regulatory bodies. To address this problem, we propose POTracker, an optimized LLM for power outage report generation. We fine-tune Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct using our proposed objective. The key contribution is a new loss function, POTrackerLoss, that considers both textual similarity and structural (tag) similarity between the generated report and the ground-truth report. We evaluate POTracker on a dataset of 1,000 power outage reports and compare it with five well-known fine-tuning methods and one rule-based XML conversion method. Results show that POTracker outperforms other fine-tuning approaches, improving overall accuracy by up to 51% and reaching 86.47% structural accuracy for generated power outage reports. In addition, we conduct a human study to assess the quality of the ground-truth standard reports, where domain experts assign the generated labels an average score of 4.03 on a 0--5 scale.

papers.title: Scaling State-Space Models from Lines to Paragraphs: An Ablation of Mamba-based OCR
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end OCR increasingly relies on autoregressive sequence models, where the quadratic cost of Transformer attention limits efficient transcription of long, paragraph-level text. State-Space Models (SSMs) such as Mamba offer linear-time decoding and have recently been shown to match Transformer accuracy on printed historical lines, but their behavior as sequences grow from short lines to full paragraphs, and their generalization to handwriting, remain poorly understood. We study how a Mamba-based OCR recognizer scales from lines to paragraphs. We first conduct a systematic exploration of its four core hyperparameters (decoder depth, state dimension, expansion factor, and connector depth) on synthetic paragraphs from 100 to 1,000 characters, identifying the recurrent state dimension and the expansion factor as the dominant levers for long-sequence accuracy. We then compare the recognizer against a Transformer baseline trained under an identical protocol. On clean synthetic paragraphs, both models stay below 1% CER at every length while the SSM runs 1.4 to 4.5 times faster, the speedup growing with sequence length. On real handwriting, however, the SSM lags clearly behind: it reaches 8.2% CER on IAM lines and 10.0% on IAM paragraphs, against 4.2% and 3.5% for the Transformer baseline. Through controlled experiments we show that a substantial part of this gap stems from data scarcity rather than from an intrinsic architectural limit: the autoregressive SSM decoder is markedly data-hungry on long sequences. Our study clarifies when SSMs are a practical choice for large-scale document transcription and when they are not.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICDAR 2026 Workshop on Machine Learning (WML)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统地研究了基于Mamba（状态空间模型）的OCR识别器从行级到段落级的扩展行为。在合成段落上，两者CER均低于1%，SSM速度提升1.4-4.5倍；但在真实手写文本上，SSM在IAM行和段落上的CER分别为8.2%和10.0%，而Transformer基线为4.2%和3.5%。实验表明，性能差距主要源于数据稀缺而非架构限制。
Motivation: 端到端OCR中Transformer注意力的二次复杂度限制了长文本（如段落）的高效转录，而Mamba等状态空间模型提供线性时间解码，但其在从短行到长段落扩展时的行为以及对真实手写文本的泛化能力尚不清楚。
Method: 对基于Mamba的OCR识别器的四个核心超参数（解码器深度、状态维度、扩展因子、连接器深度）在100-1000字符的合成段落上进行系统消融，并对比Transformer基线（相同训练协议）。
Result: 在干净合成段落上，两者CER均低于1%，SSM速度提升1.4-4.5倍且随序列长度增大；在IAM手写行和段落上，SSM的CER分别为8.2%和10.0%，Transformer基线分别为4.2%和3.5%。数据稀缺实验表明，SSM解码器在长序列上更依赖数据。
Conclusion: 研究阐明了SSM在大规模文档转录中的实际适用场景：在干净合成长文本上高效准确，但在手写等复杂场景下因数据饥饿而落后于Transformer。

papers.title: Concordia: JIT-Compiled Persistent-Kernel Checkpointing for Fault-Tolerant LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Long-running LLM agents keep valuable state resident on GPUs: KV caches, request schedulers, communication state, and sometimes online adapters. Losing this state after a GPU or communicator failure can discard minutes to hours of work, yet existing recovery mechanisms either restart the whole serving stack or require application-specific checkpoint logic inside every attention and runtime component. This paper argues that fault tolerance for such workloads needs a GPU-resident execution context: checkpoint hooks must run at device synchronization points, observe binary kernels that frameworks and libraries actually execute, and recover without putting the host CPU on the critical path. We present Concordia, a runtime that uses a device-resident persistent kernel as the substrate for fault-tolerant LLM inference. Concordia interposes on GPU module loading and supports PTX- and SASS-level instrumentation, allowing checkpoint and pause hooks to be inserted below framework code and library boundaries. For each registered LLM state region, Concordia JIT-compiles a specialized delta-checkpoint handler -- for example, a KV-block scanner, adapter-page scanner, or recovery applier -- and hot-swaps it into the persistent kernel's operator table. The persistent kernel consumes a lock-free ring buffer of compute, checkpoint, append-log, and recovery tasks, so the same always-on executor triggers dirty-page detection, stages deltas, and appends committed records to a CPU-visible log in CXL memory or host DRAM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Concordia，一种用于容错 LLM 推理的即时编译持久内核检查点运行时。它通过设备驻留持久内核拦截 GPU 模块加载，支持 PTX/SASS 级插桩，并在持久内核的操作表中热交换专门的增量检查点处理程序（如 KV 块扫描器、适配器页面扫描器、恢复应用器），从而在不将主机 CPU 置于关键路径的情况下恢复 GPU 或通信故障后的状态。
Motivation: 长时间运行的 LLM 代理在 GPU 上保留有价值的状态（KV 缓存、请求调度器、通信状态、在线适配器）。现有恢复机制要么重启整个服务栈，要么需要在每个注意力和运行时组件中编写特定于应用程序的检查点逻辑，缺乏高效且通用的容错方法。
Method: 提出 Concordia 运行时，使用设备驻留持久内核作为容错 LLM 推理的基础。它拦截 GPU 模块加载，支持 PTX/SASS 级插桩，在框架代码和库边界下方插入检查点和暂停钩子。对于每个注册的 LLM 状态区域，JIT 编译专门的增量检查点处理程序（如 KV 块扫描器、适配器页面扫描器、恢复应用器），并热交换到持久内核的操作表。持久内核使用无锁环形缓冲区处理计算、检查点、追加日志和恢复任务。
Result: 摘要未明确提供定量结果，但声称该方法支持高效的容错，无需将主机 CPU 置于关键路径。
Conclusion: Concordia 提供了一种新颖的、基于持久内核的容错方法，适用于长期运行的 LLM 推理服务。

papers.title: Collapsed Effective Operators for Higher-order Structures
papers.abstract_en: Higher-order structures are powerful relational modeling tools, yet existing spectral operators decompose the topology into separate ranks, leaving practitioners to fuse the information back to vertices through ad hoc choices. We introduce Collapsed Effective Operators, which condense higher-order degrees of freedom into a single vertex-level operator via Schur complementation of a graded Laplacian. This yields a (generally dense) operator that encodes long-range interactions mediated by topology and is applicable to arbitrary higher-order constructs. We show it preserves positive semi-definiteness with a spectral upper bound relative to the rank-0 Hodge Laplacian, effectively lowering system energy under higher-order connectivity. Empirically, our operator improves spectral clustering, signal smoothing, and enables the inclusion of topological features in neural network architectures via positional encoding. The project page can be found http://circle-group.github.io/research/CollapsedEffectiveOperators
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出坍塌有效算子（Collapsed Effective Operators），通过Schur补将高阶拓扑结构（如单纯复形）的多个秩压缩为单个顶点级算子。该算子编码了由拓扑介导的长程交互，保持半正定性且谱上界低于零阶Hodge Laplacian。实验表明该算子在谱聚类、信号平滑及图神经网络位置编码中有效。
Motivation: 现有高阶结构谱算子将拓扑分解为多个秩，迫使研究者通过临时选择将信息融合回顶点，缺乏统一且原则性的方法。
Method: 通过分级Laplacian的Schur补，将高阶自由度压缩为单个顶点级算子，得到一般稠密的算子，适用于任意高阶构造。
Result: 该算子保持半正定性，谱上界低于零阶Hodge Laplacian，在系统能量降低方面有理论保证。实验提升了谱聚类和信号平滑性能，并可作为位置编码纳入神经网络架构。
Conclusion: 提出一种原则性的高阶结构顶点级算子，统一了拓扑信息的融合，并展示了其在多个图学习任务中的实用性。

papers.title: FairBED: A Bayesian Experimental Design Approach to Gathering Fairer Data
papers.abstract_en: Frameworks for ensuring fairness in machine learning typically focus on learning fair models from existing data. But this endeavor is often undermined by biases already present in that data. We therefore look to modify the data acquisition process itself to help gather fairer data that is inherently more suitable for training fair predictors. To this end, we introduce FairBED, which provides novel formulations for quantifying the fairness of datasets themselves based on the idea that fair datasets should be uninformative about sensitive attributes. We then use this to construct practical fairness-aware Bayesian experimental design (BED) objectives that maximize expected information gain about the target quantity of interest while minimizing expected information gain about sensitive attributes. We further derive a theoretical link between FairBED and demographic parity, and show empirically that models trained on data gathered using FairBED provide improved fairness-accuracy trade-offs compared to randomly acquired data and conventional BED.

Method: FairBED定义数据集公平性的新量化标准，即公平数据集应对敏感属性不提供信息。基于此构造公平感知的贝叶斯实验设计目标，同时最大化目标量的期望信息增益并最小化敏感属性的期望信息增益。
Result: 摘要报告模型在公平-准确权衡上优于随机采集数据和传统BED方法，但未给出具体数值或基准。
Conclusion: FairBED通过调整数据采集过程来减轻数据偏差，理论链接至人口统计均等性，为公平数据收集提供了新方向。

papers.title: Arbor: Explicit Geometric Conditioning for Controllable 3D Asset Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text and image conditioned 3D models now generate convincing assets, but they still offer little direct control over the space an object should occupy or avoid. In authoring, this spatial intent is often known before generation starts. A chair should fit a seating envelope, a prop should leave clearance for motion, or a part should expose a contact surface. Prompts and image views are poor carriers for such constraints, requiring the need for an explicit control interface. We present Arbor, a trainable attachment for text conditioned latent 3D generation. Arbor introduces constraint meshes as a native 3D control interface. The interface uses hull regions where geometry should exist, avoidance regions that should remain empty, and touch regions the object should contact. Unlike completion or whole object scaffold control, these meshes are not target evidence. They are local typed requirements and can include regions where no surface should appear. Arbor keeps this signal as geometry by converting constraint meshes into tokens and learning a routed attachment inside a frozen denoiser. Each latent region can therefore receive the part of the constraint that matters for its spatial location. We evaluate Arbor on automatic and artist curated control benchmarks with hull, avoidance, and touch constraints, and compare the metric trends to a user preference study. Even without dedicated compliance losses, Arbor improves constraint obedience while preserving object quality and variation under fixed constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Arbor 是一个可训练的附件模块，用于文本条件的潜在 3D 生成，通过引入约束网格（hull/avoidance/touch regions）作为原生控制接口，允许用户指定对象应占据或避免的空间区域。该方法将约束网格转换为 token 并路由到冻结的 denoiser 中，使每个潜在区域仅接收与其空间位置相关的约束。实验表明，即使没有专门的 compliance loss，Arbor 也能提高约束遵从性，同时保持生成物体的质量和多样性。
Motivation: 现有文本/图像条件 3D 生成模型对物体应占据或避免的空间缺乏直接控制，而 prompt 或图像视图难以准确表达这类空间意图。
Method: 提出 Arbor，在冻结的 denoiser 中学习一个路由附件，将约束网格（hull、avoidance、touch 区域）转换为 token，并按照空间位置分配给相应的潜在区域。
Result: 在自动和艺术家策划的控制基准上，针对 hull、avoidance 和 touch 约束，Arbor 改善了约束遵从性，同时维持了物体质量和生成多样性。
Conclusion: Arbor 展示了通过显式几何约束实现可控 3D 生成的有效性，无需额外的 compliance loss，即可提升控制精度。

papers.title: Variance or Standard Deviation? Shell Geometry and Global-Scale Priors in High-Dimensional Shrinkage
papers.abstract_en: We study how the choice of default prior for a common Gaussian scale affects high-dimensional shrinkage risk, highlighting the role played by high-dimensional geometry. Formally, we consider a high-dimensional setting in which the near-zero behavior of the common scale prior has first-order consequences for shrinkage risk, and show that priors that are flat on the variance and those flat on the standard deviation allocate markedly different mass near the zero-scale boundary, leading to distinct shrinkage behavior and informing principled default prior selection. Specifically, under a radial-power benchmark, we establish that the SD-flat benchmark has a one-unit asymptotic risk advantage near the origin, crosses over in the critical regime, and is second-order equivalent to the variance-flat benchmark for strong signals. Proper single global-scale hyperpriors and bounded coordinate-multiplier mixtures inherit these limits through the near-zero exponent of their SD-scale density. For heavier-tailed or sparse priors, that exponent still classifies the common global-scale component, while local-scale tails, model-size priors, or allocation priors can also affect risk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高维收缩中方差先验与标准差先验的选择问题，强调高维几何的作用。通过径向幂基准分析，发现标准差平坦先验在原点附近有渐近风险优势，而在强信号区域与方差平坦先验二阶等价。单全局尺度超先验和有界坐标乘子混合继承这些极限性质。
Motivation: 高维收缩中默认尺度先验的选择（方差平坦 vs 标准差平坦）对收缩风险有实质性影响，但缺乏系统的几何和渐近分析。
Method: 采用径向幂基准，分析方差平坦与标准差平坦先验在零尺度边界附近的mass分配差异，并通过单全局尺度超先验和有界坐标乘子混合研究其极限行为。
Result: 标准差平坦先验在原点附近具有1单位渐近风险优势，在临界区域出现交叉，在强信号区域与方差平坦先验二阶等价。
Conclusion: 全局尺度分量的近零指数分类其渐近风险行为，局部尺度尾部、模型大小先验等因素也会影响风险。

papers.title: UniverSat: Resolution- and Modality-Agnostic Transformers for Earth Observation
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViT) dominate computer vision. However, their reliance on rigid patch projectors hinders transfer to Earth Observation (EO), where input modalities, scales, and resolutions vary widely. We introduce UniverSat, a ViT-style backbone built around a Universal Patch Encoder that maps patches from arbitrary spatial, spectral, and temporal resolutions, and from both optical and non-optical sensors, into a shared embedding space with a shared set of weights. This enables training a single model on heterogeneous multimodal corpora via self-supervision, yielding robust, sensor-agnostic spatial features. We validate this approach with strong results across classification and segmentation on standard EO benchmarks from GeoBench, PANGEABench, and SpectralEarth. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/gastruc/UniverSat.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniverSat 提出了一个基于 ViT 的骨干网络，通过通用补丁编码器将任意空间、光谱和时间分辨率的图像块（包括光学和非光学传感器）映射到共享嵌入空间，支持单一模型在异构多模态数据上自监督训练，并在分类和分割基准上取得强结果。
Motivation: 现有 ViT 依赖固定的补丁投影器，难以适应地球观测中多样化的输入模态、尺度和分辨率，需要一种统一的多模态骨干网络。
Method: 设计 Universal Patch Encoder，使用共享权重将来自不同传感器和分辨率的补丁映射到共同嵌入空间，并通过自监督学习在混合多模态语料库上训练。
Result: 在 GeoBench、PANGEABench 和 SpectralEarth 等标准 EO 基准的分类和分割任务上验证了有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法可训练出鲁棒、传感器无关的空间特征，为多模态地球观测的通用骨干提供了方向。

papers.title: DVL-DeepONet: A Physics-Guided Operator Learning for Resilient Underwater Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) rely heavily on the fusion of inertial sensors and Doppler velocity logs (DVLs) for navigation. In standard autonomous navigation systems, the DVL measures four beam velocities, thereby enabling the estimation of the AUV velocity vector. However, during real-world missions, the DVL may receive noisy or incomplete beam measurements due to marine obstacles, seabed reflections, or environmental disturbances. Furthermore, some low-cost underwater platforms operate without inertial sensors to reduce system complexity and cost. In such cases, reliable estimation of the AUV velocity vector in real-world missing beam scenarios becomes challenging, leading to degraded navigation solutions. To circumvent these challenges and enable resilient underwater navigation, we propose DVL-DeepONet, a physics-guided deep neural operator framework along with three variants. The proposed models are designed to estimate DVL-based velocity information under multiple operational scenarios, including (i) noise-resilient estimation in coupled inertial/DVL measurements, (ii) DVL-only learning, and (iii) beam measurement recovery. By learning a nonlinear operator that maps temporal inertial/DVL observations directly to vehicle velocity while enforcing DVL measurement physics through a consistency constraint, the proposed approach enables robust velocity estimation even under degraded sensing conditions. The proposed framework is validated using real-world AUV experiments, comprising a cumulative path length of approximately 10,000 m. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed DVL-DeepONet architectures outperform baseline model-based approaches and learning-based algorithms by 40%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DVL-DeepONet，一种物理引导的深度神经算子框架及其三种变体，用于在水下自主航行器（AUV）导航中估计多普勒测速仪（DVL）速度信息。该框架通过将时间惯性/DVL观测映射到车辆速度，并利用一致性约束强制DVL测量物理规律，从而在噪声、缺失波束或无惯性传感器等退化条件下实现鲁棒的速度估计。实验基于真实AUV数据（累计路径约10,000米），结果显示所提架构在多种场景下优于基线模型和基于学习的算法，性能提升达40%。
Motivation: AUV导航依赖惯性传感器与DVL的融合，但实际任务中DVL可能因海洋障碍、海底反射或环境干扰产生噪声或不完整波束测量，且低成本平台可能缺少惯性传感器，导致速度估计困难，导航性能下降。
Method: 提出DVL-DeepONet，这是一个物理引导的深度神经算子框架，学习从时间序列惯性/DVL观测到车辆速度的非线性算子，并通过一致性约束强制DVL测量物理规律。框架包含三种变体，分别针对噪声鲁棒估计、仅DVL学习和波束测量恢复等场景。
Result: 在真实AUV实验（累计路径约10,000米）中，所提架构在所有测试场景下均优于基于模型的基线和基于学习的算法，性能提升达40%。
Conclusion: DVL-DeepONet通过结合物理约束和深度学习算子，能够在退化传感条件下实现鲁棒的AUV速度估计，为弹性水下导航提供了一种有效方案。

papers.title: Development and Design of FLKit: A Structured Onboarding Toolkit for Federated Learning in Health and Life Sciences
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning lets institutions train shared models without moving their data, which makes it a natural fit for health and life sciences research under strict privacy regulation. The methods are maturing fast, but the practical barrier now comes earlier: a team starting a federated project meets a scattered mix of frameworks, governance obligations, and unfamiliar roles, with no structured place to begin that fits its own background. FLKit closes that gap. It is an open, community-maintained onboarding toolkit that takes a multidisciplinary team through the full federated learning lifecycle and gives every contributor, clinical, legal, governance, or technical, a role-aware entry point instead of assuming fluency across all four. We modeled it on the ELIXIR Research Data Management Kit and built it with a multidisciplinary core team, a wider consortium supplying milestone reviews and roadmap direction, and external practitioners interviewed to keep the content grounded in real practice. FLKit sits on four lifecycle stages, Governance, Infrastructure, Wrangling, and Analysis, and connects them through 11 role-specific entry points, a cross-disciplinary glossary, a reusable FAIR-aligned FL Story template for planning and documenting projects, and a curated directory of tools, frameworks, and communities. Since the December 2024 demo it has grown to 39 pages across eight sections, with seven FL Stories documenting completed and ongoing projects in multiple sclerosis disability prediction, inflammatory bowel disease, genomics, and brain-computer interfaces. It is openly available at https://uhasselt-biomedicaldatasciences.github.io/federated-learning-toolkit/ and welcomes contributions from across the life sciences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLKit 是一个开源的、社区维护的联邦学习入门工具包，专为健康与生命科学领域设计，帮助多学科团队（临床、法律、治理、技术）完成联邦学习全生命周期。它提供四个生命周期阶段（治理、基础设施、数据整理、分析）、11个角色入口、跨学科词汇表、FAIR对齐的 FL Story 模板以及工具目录。自2024年12月演示以来已扩展至39页，涵盖多发性硬化症、炎症性肠病、基因组学和脑机接口等7个FL故事。
Motivation: 团队启动联邦学习项目时面临框架分散、治理义务和角色不熟悉的障碍，缺乏针对其领域背景的结构化入门指南。
Method: FLKit 基于 ELIXIR 研究数据管理工具包建模，由多学科核心团队、财团评审和外部从业者访谈共同开发，包含四个生命周期阶段、11个角色入口、跨学科词汇表、FL Story 模板和工具目录。
Result: 自2024年12月演示以来，FLKit 已增长至39页8个章节，包含7个FL故事，记录已完成和进行中的项目（多发性硬化症残疾预测、炎症性肠病、基因组学、脑机接口）。
Conclusion: FLKit 是开放可贡献的，旨在降低联邦学习在健康与生命科学领域的实践门槛，为不同角色提供结构化起点。

summary_sections.method: FLKit 基于 ELIXIR 研究数据管理工具包建模，由多学科核心团队、财团评审和外部从业者访谈共同开发，包含四个生命周期阶段、11个角色入口、跨学科词汇表、FL Story 模板和工具目录。
summary_sections.result: 自2024年12月演示以来，FLKit 已增长至39页8个章节，包含7个FL故事，记录已完成和进行中的项目（多发性硬化症残疾预测、炎症性肠病、基因组学、脑机接口）。
summary_sections.conclusion: FLKit 是开放可贡献的，旨在降低联邦学习在健康与生命科学领域的实践门槛，为不同角色提供结构化起点。

papers.title: TROPT: An Open Framework for Unifying and Advancing Discrete Text Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Discrete text-trigger optimization -- searching for text sequences that, when ingested by a model, steer it toward a specified objective -- underpins model red-teaming (e.g., LLM jailbreaks), as well as auditing and interpretability. However, the current state of discrete optimizers hinders their adoption and progress. First, existing optimizers, when open-sourced at all, are scattered across research codebases tied to specific models, objectives, and problem domains. Second, optimizer variants proliferate, each requiring engineering overhead to use or extend, and remaining hard to compare head-to-head. Together, these raise the bar for adopting optimizers in existing or new domains, and for advancing them via new strategies. We address these gaps with TROPT, the first open-source framework that unifies discrete optimizers' execution and standardizes their development under a single interface. TROPT makes it easy to customize end-to-end optimization recipes by swapping any component -- models, objectives, and optimizers -- extending its reach across domains and new applications. TROPT currently ships with 30+ optimization recipes -- covering applications such as jailbreaking and probing model internals -- built from 15+ optimizers (spanning white-box to black-box access) and 15+ losses, from foundational to state-of-the-art methods. Demonstrating its utility, we leverage TROPT in several studies: (i) controlled, large-scale experiments comparing and enhancing optimization strategies for LLM jailbreaks, revealing potent-yet-underadopted techniques; and (ii) porting optimizers from one domain (e.g., LLM jailbreak) to new domains (e.g., corpus-poisoning embedding model). In all, TROPT significantly lowers the barrier to adopting and advancing discrete text optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TROPT 是首个统一离散文本优化器（discrete text optimizer）的开源框架，提供标准化接口以简化优化器的开发、比较和跨领域迁移。框架内置 30+ 优化方案（涵盖红队测试、模型内部探测等），包含 15+ 优化器（白盒到黑盒）和 15+ 损失函数。通过大规模实验验证了其在 LLM 越狱（jailbreak）优化策略比较和跨领域迁移（如文本投毒嵌入模型）中的实用性和易用性。
Motivation: 现有离散文本优化器开源代码分散、依赖特定模型/目标/领域，且变种繁多难以直接比较，导致应用和研发门槛高。
Method: TROPT 提供统一接口，支持组件化替换（模型、目标、优化器），集成 15+ 优化器与 15+ 损失函数，并可自定义端到端优化流程。
Result: 通过受控大规模实验揭示了 LLM 越狱中有效但未被充分利用的优化技术，并成功将优化器从 LLM 越狱领域迁移至文本投毒嵌入模型等新领域。
Conclusion: TROPT 显著降低了离散文本优化的应用门槛，并加速了优化策略的跨领域推广。

papers.title: Brain-Adapter: A Dual-Stream Vision-Language MIL Framework for Comprehensive 3D CT Diagnosis of Acute Intracranial Pathologies
papers.abstract_en: Automated diagnosis of 3D brain CT scans is essential for critical care, yet it remains challenging due to the heavy reliance on manual annotations and the limited semantic understanding of conventional models. While 2D foundation vision-language models (VLMs) have shown remarkable generalization, effectively transferring their representational power to 3D volumes remains an open problem. In this paper, we propose Brain-Adapter, a novel dual-stream multiple instance learning (MIL) framework that leverages pre-trained 2D biomedical VLMs and raw diagnostic reports for robust scan-level multi-label classification. Specifically, we introduce a Text-Conditioned Attention (TCA) mechanism, utilizing raw diagnostic sentences as semantic queries to dynamically align visual cues with specific disease concepts. Concurrently, a parallel visual MIL stream captures global scan characteristics, supervised by structured labels extracted via a Large Language Model (LLM). To ensure representation coherence, a consistency constraint enforces synergy between the two streams. During inference, an Uncertainty-Aware Refinement (UAR) module dynamically calibrates and fuses these dual-stream predictions to resolve ambiguous cases. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art 3D models and standard MIL approaches. By eliminating the reliance on dense annotations, Brain-Adapter provides a highly scalable and clinically viable solution for 3D acute intracranial pathology analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Brain-Adapter，一种双流多实例学习框架，利用预训练的2D生物医学视觉-语言模型和原始诊断报告进行3D CT扫描的多标签分类。通过文本条件注意机制和对齐策略，无需密集标注，在急性颅内病变诊断中显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 3D脑CT自动诊断依赖大量手动标注且语义理解有限，2D基础视觉语言模型难以直接迁移到3D体积，亟需一种无需密集标注的鲁棒诊断方法。
Method: 采用双流多实例学习：文本流使用文本条件注意机制以原始诊断句子为语义查询动态对齐视觉线索；视觉流通过结构化标签全局建模扫描特征；两流之间施加一致性约束；推理时使用不确定性感知精化模块融合预测。
Result: 在3D急性颅内病变分析任务上，该方法显著优于最先进的3D模型和标准MIL方法，消除了对密集标注的依赖。
Conclusion: Brain-Adapter提供了一种高度可扩展且临床可行的3D急性颅内病变分析解决方案，无需密集标注。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MeshFlow: Mesh Generation with Equivariant Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Meshes are among the most common 3D scene representations, but directly generating meshes is challenging because the representation contains important symmetries, including permutation invariance of faces and vertices. MeshFlow learns to generate triangle meshes directly as triangle soups, avoiding the need to serialize meshes into long autoregressive sequences. We adopt equivariant optimal-transport flow matching models that respect the key symmetries of triangle soups: arbitrary permutations of faces and permutations of the vertices within each face. Toward this goal, we propose a simple yet effective modification to the Diffusion Transformer architecture, resulting in a scalable network capable of modeling a velocity field while maintaining the desired equivariance. We further introduce an optimal-transport-based training objective that improves convergence by eliminating supervision signals that violate these symmetries. MeshFlow achieves mesh quality comparable to state-of-the-art autoregressive mesh generators while providing about an 18$\times$ speedup during inference. Project page is at https://qiisun.github.io/MeshFlow/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MeshFlow 提出一种基于等变流匹配的三角网格直接生成方法。该方法将网格视为三角形汤（triangle soup），利用等变最优传输流匹配模型保持面对排列和顶点排列的对称性，并改进 Diffusion Transformer 架构以建模速度场。相比自回归网格生成器，MeshFlow 在保持质量的同时实现约 18 倍推理加速。
Motivation: 直接生成三角网格面临表示中的排列对称性（面对置换、顶点置换）挑战，现有方法通常将网格序列化为长自回归序列，效率低下。
Method: 采用等变最优传输流匹配模型，设计对三角形汤对称性等变的网络架构（改进 Diffusion Transformer），并引入基于最优传输的训练目标以减少违反对称性的监督信号。
Result: 摘要报告 MeshFlow 生成的网格质量与最先进自回归方法相当，推理速度提升约 18 倍。
Conclusion: 该工作证明了利用等变流匹配直接生成三角网格的可行性，并展示了速度与质量的良好权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CADRE: Stable, Parameter Efficient Adaptation of Medical Vision Language Models with Bounded Forgetting and Prior Drift
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) such as BiomedCLIP generalize broadly, but adapting them to a clinical service is as much a safety problem as an accuracy one. Updating a deployed model for a new imaging modality can fail silently in two ways that harm patients: it can forget modalities it already handled (catastrophic forgetting), and it can drift from its trustworthy pretrained prior toward modality-specific shortcuts. We study parameter-efficient continual adaptation through these two properties rather than leaderboard accuracy, presenting CADRE: a frozen-backbone framework combining low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with an online, self-scaling, similarity-aware elastic weight consolidation term that bounds retained-competence loss, and an anchor-to-prior penalty bounding embedding drift from the frozen prior. Two short guarantees, a bound on total consolidation mass and a scale-invariance property, remove the scale-related sources of vanilla EWC's order fragility. Using breast cancer across three maximally dissimilar modalities (histopathology, ultrasound, chest radiography) as a controlled cross-modality stress test, under a multi-seed, multi-order protocol with paired significance testing and training approximately 0.23% of parameters, CADRE attains the highest accuracy, SPQ, and backward transfer and the lowest forgetting among adapting methods, reducing forgetting roughly sevenfold versus the strongest regularized baseline (0.075 to 0.011; paired p=0.023) and achieving positive backward transfer where every baseline is negative. We frame these as stability properties aligned with clinical-safety desiderata, not a deployment guarantee; robustness to distribution shift and adversarial inputs is out of scope.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CADRE框架，用于医学视觉语言模型（VLM）的参数高效持续适应，通过结合低秩适配（LoRA）与在线自缩放相似性感知弹性权重巩固项来限制遗忘，以及锚定到先验的惩罚项来限制嵌入漂移。在乳腺癌三种不同模态（组织病理学、超声、胸部X线）的多种子多顺序测试中，仅训练约0.23%的参数，实现了最高准确率、SPQ和正向后向迁移，遗忘率比最强正则化基线降低约7倍（从0.075降至0.011，配对p=0.023）。
Motivation: 医学VLM适应新成像模态时可能发生灾难性遗忘和先验漂移，导致患者安全隐患，现有方法缺乏对这两个安全问题的联合约束。
Method: 冻结backbone，使用LoRA进行参数高效微调，同时引入两项损失：一项是约束保留能力损失的弹性权重巩固项，具有总巩固质量有界和尺度不变性的理论保证；另一项是锚定到冻结先验的嵌入漂移惩罚项。
Result: 在乳腺癌跨模态压力测试中，CADRE获得最高准确率、SPQ和正向后向迁移，遗忘率最低（0.011），显著优于所有基线（最强基线遗忘率0.075），并实现了正向后向迁移（所有基线均为负）。
Conclusion: CADRE的稳定性特性与临床安全性期望一致，但论文明确指出稳健性至分布偏移和对抗输入不在讨论范围内，不构成部署保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Reconstruction to Decision: A Post-Encoder Plug-in Adapter for Curvilinear Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Curvilinear object segmentation, including vessels and cracks, is challenging due to extreme spatial sparsity and topological fragility, where small local errors can cause severe structural disconnections. Meanwhile, modern segmentation pipelines increasingly rely on strong but hard-to-modify foundation encoders whose heavy downsampling limits fine structural recovery. Motivated by this, we focus on the post-encoder stage and study two recurring and actionable failure modes: a reconstruction bottleneck in high-resolution feature restoration and a decision bottleneck in binarization. We present PEPA, a lightweight Post-Encoder Plug-in Adapter for 2D curvilinear segmentation pipelines with accessible decoder/head features and target, query, or class descriptors. PEPA couples (i) Target-Conditioned Snake Upsampling (TCSU), which uses target-conditioned continuous snake-like sampling to better recover thin and tortuous structures during upsampling, and (ii) Target-Adaptive Differentiable Thresholding (TADT), which predicts target-specific thresholds and optimizes a soft-threshold surrogate with explicit safeguards against trivial bias shifting. Under this post-encoder interface, PEPA can be attached to both prompt-based decoders and conventional dense predictors. Experiments on five medical and industrial benchmarks show that adding PEPA to frozen-encoder baselines yields consistent improvements, with gains in topological connectivity (clDice) typically exceeding those in region overlap (IoU), indicating improved structural continuity. With only $\sim$0.26M additional parameters, PEPA offers a practical post-encoder enhancement for structure-centric segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PEPA，一种轻量级后编码器插件适配器，用于 2D 曲线物体分割。通过目标条件蛇形上采样 (TCSU) 和目标自适应可微分阈值化 (TADT)，改善稀疏细长结构的恢复和分割。在五个医学和工业基准上，添加到冻结编码器基线后一致提升拓扑连通性 (clDice) 和区域重叠 (IoU)，仅增加约 0.26M 参数。
Motivation: 曲线物体分割因空间稀疏性和拓扑脆弱性而困难；现有分割流水线依赖难以修改的基础编码器，其重采样限制了细粒度结构恢复。作者关注后编码器阶段的两个失败模式：高分辨率特征恢复的重建瓶颈和二值化的决策瓶颈。
Method: 提出 PEPA，包含目标条件蛇形上采样 (TCSU) 和目标自适应可微分阈值化 (TADT)。TCSU 用目标条件连续蛇形采样恢复细长结构；TADT 预测目标特定阈值并优化软阈值替代物。PEPA 可附加到基于提示的解码器和常规密集预测器。
Result: 在五个医学和工业基准上，添加 PEPA 到冻结编码器基线一致改善，拓扑连通性 (clDice) 提升通常超过区域重叠 (IoU) 提升，表明结构连续性改善。仅需约 0.26M 额外参数。
Conclusion: PEPA 为结构中心的分割提供了一种实用的后编码器增强，在轻量级下提升结构连续性。
Relevance: 0
