summary_sections.conclusion: PEPA 为结构中心的分割提供了一种实用的后编码器增强，在轻量级下提升结构连续性。

papers.title: Sublinearly Structured Deep Neural Networks Achieve Feature Learning Consistency for Compositional Functions
papers.abstract_en: Over the past decade, deep neural networks (DNNs) have achieved remarkable success on complex machine-learning tasks, yet the theoretical foundations of their performance remain incomplete. From a statistical viewpoint, a natural question is: can DNNs attain feature-learning and prediction consistency comparable to that of classical models? While a full characterization is open, we provide positive results for a broad subclass. We establish feature-learning consistency guarantees for sublinearly structured DNNs-architectures whose input/output dimensions and number of hidden neurons grow sublinearly with the sample size-when learning hierarchically compositional target functions. Importantly, this consistency still holds even in the conventional "over-parameterized" regime where the total number of parameters exceeds the number of training samples. Empirically, sublinearly structured DNNs match or surpass wide DNNs in prediction. A structural audit further indicates that widely used convolutional neural networks (CNNs), including AlexNet, VGGNet, ResNet, GoogLeNet, are sublinearly structured on their image classification benchmarks. We further prove that the sublinearly structured DNNs achieve universal approximation for hierarchically compositional functions in the large-sample limit. Moreover, images exhibit an inherent hierarchical, compositional structure. Taken together, these results explain, through a statistical lens, why many large-scale deep learning models succeed after adequate training on massive image datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从统计角度证明了次线性结构深度神经网络（sublinearly structured DNNs）在学习层次组合目标函数时能够达到特征学习一致性（feature-learning consistency），即使在过参数化情况下也成立。实证表明次线性结构DNN与宽DNN性能相当，且常用CNN如AlexNet、VGGNet等均属于次线性结构。进一步证明了该类网络在样本量趋于无穷时对层次组合函数具有通用逼近性，从而从统计视角解释了大规模深度学习模型在图像数据上成功的原因。
Motivation: 深度神经网络在复杂任务中表现出色，但其理论基础仍不完整。一个自然的问题是：DNN能否像经典统计模型一样实现特征学习和预测的一致性？本文针对层次组合函数这一广泛子类给出肯定回答。
Method: 定义了输入/输出维度与隐藏神经元数量随样本量次线性增长的次线性结构DNN，并建立其层次组合函数下的特征学习一致性保证。通过理论证明和实证审计（如对AlexNet、VGGNet等结构的分析）验证该结构的普遍性，并进一步证明了其在大样本极限下的通用逼近性。
Result: 证明次线性结构DNN在层次组合函数上具有特征学习一致性；实证显示其预测性能匹配或超越宽DNN；对常用CNN的结构审计表明它们均属于次线性结构。
Conclusion: 本文从统计学习视角解释了大规模深度学习模型在图像数据集上训练成功的内在原因，为DNN的理论基础提供了正向结果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: C^2GR: Coupled Comprehensive Generative Replay for a Continually Learnable Universal Segmentation Model
papers.abstract_en: Universal segmentation models exhibit significant potential for diverse tasks involving different imaging modalities and segmentation objectives. Task-Incremental Learning provides a privacy-preserving approach to continually evolve a universal model on tasks from sequentially-arriving medical departments. However, training the model solely on the incoming task induces forgetting on past tasks, since consecutive tasks exhibit concurrent shifts in image appearance and segmentation objective. To address this problem, we propose a novel Coupled Comprehensive Generative Replay (C^2GR) framework that simultaneously synthesizes image-mask pairs of previous tasks to mitigate forgetting under concurrent appearance and objective shifts. This requires preserving image-mask correspondence for structure-realistic generation and bridging asynchronous optimization of the generator and segmentor for segmentation-oriented generation. Specifically, we propose a Bayesian Joint Diffusion (BJD) method that formulates the correspondence as conditional distributions optimized via conditional denoising. Furthermore, we develop a Relation-aware Unified Prompt Synchronization (RUPS) scheme to simultaneously modulate the generator and segmentor via a shared task-relation-aware prompt for synchronizing their optimization. Experiments on 20 tasks spanning diverse modalities and objectives demonstrate that C^2GR exhibits only a 2.44% drop in overall performance compared to joint training with all task data, effectively alleviating forgetting from the concurrent shifts. Our code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/mar-cry/C2GR.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出C^2GR框架，用于在任务增量学习场景下持续训练通用分割模型，缓解因成像模态和分割目标同时变化导致的灾难性遗忘。核心方法包括贝叶斯联合扩散（BJD）保持图像-掩码对应关系，以及关系感知统一提示同步（RUPS）协调生成器和分割器的优化。在20个跨模态任务上，C^2GR相比联合训练仅下降2.44%的性能。
Motivation: 现有通用分割模型在顺序到达的医学任务上训练时，由于新任务同时改变图像外观和分割目标，仅学习新任务会导致灾难性遗忘旧任务。
Method: 提出耦合综合生成回放（C^2GR）框架，包含贝叶斯联合扩散（BJD）以条件扩散建模图像-掩码对应关系，以及关系感知统一提示同步（RUPS）通过共享任务相关提示同步优化生成器和分割器。
Result: 在20个不同模态和分割目标的任务上，C^2GR相比联合训练仅下降2.44%的整体性能，有效缓解了并发移位下的遗忘。
Conclusion: C^2GR框架通过同步生成和分割的优化以及结构真实的回放样本，为持续学习通用分割模型提供了一种隐私保护且有效的方法。

papers.title: Time Series Classification through Diffeomorphic Time Warping (DiffTW)
papers.abstract_en: Time series classification involves learning a mapping from a continuous, temporally ordered sequence of real-valued observations to a discrete response variable, like class labels. This task is fundamental in domains, including health monitoring, where the temporal structure of data is critical for accurate prediction. Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) is a standard technique for measuring similarity between sequences varying in time or speed. However, DTW is restricted to discrete point matching. To move beyond pairwise alignment, we propose a theoretical framework that learns mappings between real-valued functions. These mappings approximate the flow associated with the characteristic curves of a linear transport equation with a space-dependent velocity field, providing a diffeomorphic transformation between two time series. Using the method of characteristics, we transform this partial differential equation into ordinary differential equations (ODEs) modeling system dynamics. The objective function used to learn these ODEs derives from the fundamental theorem of calculus. To enable flexible, expressive representations of the velocity field, we utilize reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces and optimal control methods. Our method, Diffeomorphic Time Warping (DiffTW), provides a theoretically grounded dissimilarity measure. Using a 1-nearest neighbor classifier, DiffTW outperforms DTW on 60 of 86 datasets.
papers.comment: 38 pages including appendix and references, 8 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的时间序列分类方法——微分同胚时间扭曲（DiffTW），通过学习可微变换将两个时间序列对齐，并基于此定义差异度量。在86个数据集的1-近邻分类实验中，DiffTW在60个数据集上优于动态时间规整（DTW）。
Motivation: 动态时间规整（DTW）虽广泛用于时间序列相似度度量，但其仅支持离散点匹配，缺乏对连续函数映射的建模能力。
Method: 利用线性输运方程的特征曲线对应的微分同胚映射，将偏微分方程转化为常微分方程（ODEs），通过再生核希尔伯特空间和最优控制方法学习速度场，从而得到可微的时间扭曲变换。
Result: 以1-近邻分类器测试，DiffTW在86个数据集中有60个优于DTW。
Conclusion: DiffTW提供了一个理论上有基础的时间序列差异度量，在分类任务上表现优于DTW。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: War in the Abstract: The Rise and Consequences of Militarized Language in Scientific Communication
papers.abstract_en: Scientists do not, by profession, wage war. Yet warfare's vocabulary consistently appears in their abstracts. To quantify the extent to which warfare's vocabulary pervades scientific abstracts, we analyze 21.4 million papers (2010-2025; OpenAlex, PubMed). We additionally run a within-subject war-framing experiment (N = 801; 32,040 trials) designed to provide causal insight into the effects of militaristic language on persuasion. Between 2010 and 2025, the presence of militaristic terms in scientific abstracts rose 48% in OpenAlex and 32% in PubMed, with the rise accelerating sharply after 2019 (cross-database r = 0.96, p < 10^-8). The prevalence of militaristic language is conflict-aligned at both country and annual scales (Uppsala Conflict Data Program; r = 0.77-0.84), with the abstracts from the Global South displaying the fastest rise in militaristic language. Among disciplines, social sciences leads in level of such language while engineering and computer science lead in growth. The COVID and post-2022 large-language-model eras also saw the rise and narrowed the language gap between native-English and non-English authors. In our follow-up experiment, we found that war framing reduced credibility (mean shift -0.18 Likert units, 95% CI [-0.21, -0.14]; d_z = -0.28, p < 10^-20), funding willingness (d_z = -0.12) and policy support (d_z = -0.08), with a trend-level increase in sense of urgency (d_z = +0.07). Collectively, findings reveal that while scientific abstracts drift toward warfare, the use of militaristic language may erode credibility, funding willingness, and policy support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了2010-2025年间2140万篇科学摘要中军事化语言的使用趋势，发现2019年后军事术语出现频率在OpenAlex中上升48%、在PubMed中上升32%，且与社会冲突指数高度相关（r=0.77-0.84）。进一步通过被试内实验（N=801，32040次试验）表明，战争框架会降低科学传播的可信度、资助意愿和政策支持，但轻微增加紧迫感。
Motivation: 科学家本不该使用战争语言，但军事词汇在科学摘要中普遍存在。作者希望量化这种语言的使用程度及其对受众说服力的因果影响。
Method: 对2140万篇论文（2010-2025年，来自OpenAlex和PubMed）进行军事术语频率的时间序列分析，并开展被试内战争框架实验（N=801，32040次试验），测量可信度、资助意愿、政策支持和紧迫感。
Result: 2010-2025年间军事术语使用率上升48%（OpenAlex）和32%（PubMed），2019年后加速；与全球冲突数据相关r=0.77-0.84；社会科学领域使用最多，工程和计算机科学增长最快。实验发现战争框架使可信度降低0.18 Likert单位（d_z=-0.28），资助意愿和政策支持也显著下降，紧迫感略有增加（d_z=+0.07，趋势水平）。
Conclusion: 科学摘要正日益军事化，但这种语言可能削弱科学家在公众中的可信度、资助意愿和政策支持，对科学传播产生负面后果。

papers.title: Phase-mixing of acoustic waves with applications to solar tachocline
papers.abstract_en: We adapt the \textit{magnetohydrodynamic} wave phase-mixing paradigm [Tsiklauri et al. (2003)] to investigate \textit{acoustic} wave propagation and damping in media where transverse sound speed gradients exist. Using an analytical model, we recover previous harmonic wave and Gaussian pulse evolution solutions now controlled by the spatial gradient of the local \textit{sound speed}. We discover a scaling law governing a Harris current sheet-like pulse evolution: under developed-stage phase-mixing, the peak envelope of such pulse amplitude scales with propagation distance as a new power-law $\max(P_1) \propto x^{-9/2}$. Applying our model to the solar tachocline directly resolves the 26-year-old helioseismic mystery of low-$\ell$ global $p$-mode linewidth anomalies observed by BiSON above $ν\approx 3000\,μ\text{Hz}$. We demonstrate that the sound speed gradient forces rapid, non-turbulent energy damping directly in the shear zone, providing the exact high-efficiency bulk dissipation needed to account for the missing energy sink deep within the solar tacholine. Our model provides the exact damping rates that classical, homogeneous models severely underestimated in the past. Finally, our results provide actionable design strategies for engineering compact stealth coatings or meshes to achieve enhanced acoustic signature suppression from moving bodies immersed in a fluid.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文改编了磁流体动力学波混合范式，将其应用于声波在存在横向声速梯度的介质中的传播与阻尼。通过解析模型，发现了Harris电流片状脉冲在相混合成熟阶段的峰值包络随传播距离呈幂律衰减（∝ x^{-9/2}）。将该模型应用于太阳差转层，成功解释了BiSON观测到的低阶全局p模线宽异常，为26年前的太阳地震学谜题提供了非湍流能量耗散机制。此外，结果还指向工程应用，如设计紧凑型隐身涂层以抑制流体中运动体的声学特征。
Motivation: 经典均匀模型严重低估了太阳差转层中声波的阻尼率，导致无法解释BiSON观测到的低阶p模线宽异常，需要一种高效的非湍流体耗散机制来解释缺失的能量汇。
Method: 采用解析模型，改编已有的磁流体动力学波混合范式，用声速梯度替代Alfvén速度梯度，研究谐波和高斯脉冲在横向声速梯度介质中的演化，并推导Harris电流片状脉冲的标度律。
Result: 发现相混合成熟阶段，脉冲振幅峰值包络满足新幂律∝ x^{-9/2}；模型精确提供了太阳差转层中所需的阻尼率，与观测的线宽异常一致，且无需湍流假设。
Conclusion: 该模型成功解决了太阳地震学中长期存在的p模线宽谜题，表明声速梯度可直接在剪切层内实现快速非湍流能量阻尼，并为工程隐身涂层设计提供了理论依据。

papers.title: MeGAS: Thermomechanical Dynamic Gaussian Splatting for Thermophysical Scene Editing
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances integrate physically grounded Newtonian dynamics with neural rendering frameworks, narrowing the gap between photorealistic scene reconstruction and physics-based animation. However, existing approaches focus on mechanically driven dynamics while neglecting temperature, a fundamental yet invisible physical factor underlying phenomena such as melting, solidification, and other thermomechanical processes. In this paper, we propose MeGAS, a novel framework that incorporates thermomechanical phase-change dynamics into 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). Specifically, we propose a new thermomechanical dynamic Gaussian Splatting representation that augments 3DGS with temperature attributes and employs a heat advection-diffusion solver with MPM dynamics incorporating phase transitions, enabling physically plausible and visually realistic synthesis of thermophysical phenomena. Furthermore, a new topology-adaptive Gaussian rendering strategy is proposed to mitigate cracking and floaters under extreme deformation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MeGAS produces physically consistent thermomechanical behavior while maintaining high-fidelity photorealistic rendering, advancing toward physics-integrated world models.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026. Project page: http://zju3dv.github.io/MeGAS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MeGAS，将热机械相变动力学融入 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）框架，通过为高斯表示附加温度属性、结合热对流-扩散求解器与 MPM 动力学实现相变，并设计拓扑自适应渲染策略处理极端变形下的裂缝与漂浮物。实验表明该方法能生成物理一致的热机械行为并保持高保真渲染。
Motivation: 现有基于物理的神经渲染方法仅关注机械动力学，忽略了温度这一关键物理因素，无法模拟熔化、凝固等热机械过程。
Method: 提出热机械动态高斯泼溅表示，为 3DGS 增加温度属性，采用热对流-扩散求解器与 MPM 动力学耦合相变；同时提出拓扑自适应高斯渲染策略以缓解极端变形下的渲染伪影。
Result: 在多个热物理场景上实现了物理一致的热机械行为，同时保持高保真照片级渲染质量。
Conclusion: MeGAS 向物理集成的世界模型迈进一步，但当前工作聚焦于场景编辑，未来可扩展至更复杂的耦合现象。

papers.title: Do Location Encoders Capture Spatial Effects? A GeoShapley Benchmark Across Scales
papers.abstract_en: Location encoders transform geographic coordinates into high dimensional embeddings for downstream machine learning, but it is unclear how well these representations capture interpretable spatial effects. We benchmark whether GeoShapley, a game-theoretic explainer that treats all location features as a single joint player, can recover spatially varying coefficients from models built on location-encoder embeddings. Eleven encoders from the TorchSpatial framework are evaluated against a synthetic process with known coefficients, across three scales (grid, county, global), with and without raw coordinates alongside the embedding, and under untrained and contrastively trained conditions. Measuring recovery as the correlation between estimated and true coefficients, we report how it varies with scale and encoder architecture and compare the embeddings against a raw-coordinate baseline. Recovery of the primary coefficient is consistently high across encoders, whereas recovery of a secondary coefficient is more scale-dependent, differing most at the global scale; the raw-coordinate baseline remains competitive throughout.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, Submitted to SIGSPATIAL '26 short papers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文利用GeoShapley解释器评估11种位置编码器能否捕捉可解释的空间效应，在网格、县、全球三种尺度下进行基准测试。结果表明主要系数恢复度高，次要系数恢复依赖尺度，原始坐标基线表现具有竞争力。
Motivation: 位置编码器将地理坐标转换为嵌入用于机器学习，但其能否捕捉可解释的空间效应尚不清楚。
Method: 使用GeoShapley将位置特征视为联合玩家，从位置编码嵌入模型中恢复空间变化系数，在三种尺度、多种条件下对比原始坐标基线。
Result: 主要系数恢复在所有编码器中一致高，次要系数恢复更依赖尺度，在全球尺度上差异最大；原始坐标基线始终有竞争力。
Conclusion: 基准测试揭示了位置编码器在不同尺度上捕捉空间效应的能力差异，GeoShapley可有效评估其可解释性。

papers.title: AOHP: An Open-Source OS-Level Agent Harness for Personalized, Efficient and Secure Interaction
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are driving a new software paradigm, with the ability to autonomously call tools, extract information, manage memory, and complete tasks that span applications and data sources. Most existing end-user operating systems, however, are designed for application-centric workflows and offer little native support for AI agents. This mismatch limits the wider adoption of agents and leads to execution overhead and safety risks when running agents on conventional systems. While the concept of agent-native operating systems is emerging, the research community lacks an open testbed to explore the architectural primitives desired for agent-mediated interaction. We present AOHP (Android Open Harness Project), an OS-level agent harness built on the Android Open Source Project (AOSP). The core design principle of AOHP is to treat agents as first-class OS actors, enabling adaptive user interfaces and agent-friendly runtime environments. AOHP preserves the mature Android software and hardware ecosystem while introducing three agent-oriented system mechanisms: personalized service composition, efficient agent interfaces, and secure information flow. Based on preliminary experiments on challenging tasks covering key capabilities of OS agents, AOHP shows clear advantages in task completion (+21.12% completion rate), execution cost (-51.55% token cost), and security-policy compliance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AOHP，一个基于Android开源项目(AOSP)的操作系统级AI代理工具(agent harness)，将代理视为操作系统的一等公民(OS actors)，支持自适应用户界面和代理友好运行时环境。AOHP引入三种系统级机制：个性化服务组合、高效代理接口和安全信息流。初步实验表明，在操作系统代理关键能力任务上，AOHP相比现有系统显著提升任务完成率(+21.12%)、降低执行成本(-51.55% token成本)并提高安全策略合规性。
Motivation: 现有操作系统缺乏对AI代理的原生支持，导致代理在常规系统上运行时存在执行开销和安全风险，限制了代理的广泛应用。
Method: 构建基于AOSP的OS级代理工具AOHP，将代理作为一等OS角色，设计了三项系统机制：个性化服务组合、高效代理接口和安全信息流。
Result: 初步实验显示，在挑战性任务上任务完成率提高21.12%，token成本降低51.55%，安全策略合规性提升。
Conclusion: AOHP为研究社区提供了一个探索代理操作系统的开放测试平台，验证了将代理作为一等OS角色的设计原则在效率和安全方面的优势。

papers.title: Selective Time Series Forecasting via Metalearning
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning methods have achieved state-of-the-art in time series forecasting, yet their accuracy varies considerably across samples, as some instances remain inherently difficult to predict. Reject option mechanisms, which allow models to abstain from high-risk predictions, are well established in classification and regression but underexplored in forecasting. Existing abstention strategies typically rely on proxies, such as the width of the prediction interval or learned confidence scores derived from forecasts. However, these approaches are inherently tied to the training domain, limiting their ability to generalize. We propose a selective forecasting framework that addresses this limitation by modeling the empirical percentile of forecasting errors, that is, a scale-invariant statistic, based on structural characteristics extracted from recent lags via metalearning. By decoupling the rejection decision from the forecast itself and grounding it in domain-agnostic features, the framework enables effective abstention transfer across heterogeneous time series. Experiments in both in-domain and transfer learning settings show that rejecting samples predicted as challenging consistently improves forecasting accuracy across coverage levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于元学习的框架，通过学习时间序列的结构特征来预测预测误差的经验百分位数，从而实现跨异构时间序列的选择性拒绝（即让模型放弃高风险的预测）。实验表明，该方法在域内和迁移学习设置下均能提升预测精度。
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测方法在不同样本上的准确性差异大，而拒绝选项机制在分类和回归中已成熟，但在预测中尚未充分探索。已有的放弃策略依赖于训练域内的代理指标，泛化能力有限。
Method: 通过元学习从最近的时间滞后中提取结构特征，建模预测误差的经验百分位数（一种尺度不变统计量），从而将拒绝决策与预测本身解耦，并基于域无关特征实现跨异构时间序列的拒绝转移。
Result: 在域内和迁移学习实验中，拒绝被预测为有挑战的样本能够一致地提高不同覆盖率下的预测精度。
Conclusion: 该框架通过元学习建模误差百分位数，实现了有效的放弃决策迁移，但摘要未明确讨论局限性或适用范围。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: SkyJEPA: Learning Long-Horizon World Models for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Control of Quadrotors
papers.abstract_en: Accurate dynamics models are critical for informed decision-making in robotic systems, particularly for agile aerial vehicles operating under uncertainty. Neural network dynamics models are attractive for capturing complex nonlinear effects, but existing predictive approaches struggle with long-horizon forecasting because their autoregressive rollout mechanism amplifies errors over time. Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) offer a compelling alternative by modeling dynamics in latent space, yet prior JEPA-style methods for robot navigation have been studied primarily for kinematic-level planning, with limited investigation in high-frequency control. In this work, we introduce the JEPA-style model for real-time quadrotor control. The proposed approach combines a latent dynamics model with a novel physics-inspired prober that maps frozen latents to interpretable state, enabling physically grounded long-horizon prediction. Additionally, we combine the learned model with a sampling-based optimal control solution to take advantage of its predictive capabilities for real-time control on embedded hardware. Finally, to reduce the dependence on expensive and unsafe real-world data collection, we develop a structured pipeline for automated dataset generation. Extensive open-loop and outdoor closed-loop experiments demonstrate accurate prediction, robust zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, and strong generalization across diverse operating conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkyJEPA，一种基于联合嵌入预测架构 (JEPA) 的潜在空间动力学模型，用于四旋翼飞行器的长时域预测与零样本 sim-to-real 控制。方法结合物理学启发的探针 (prober) 将潜在变量映射到可解释状态，并与采样最优控制结合实现嵌入式实时控制。通过自动化数据集生成管道减少真实数据依赖。开放环和室外闭环实验证明了准确预测、鲁棒零样本迁移及强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有神经网络动力学模型在长时域预测中因自回归误差累积而表现不佳；JEPA 方法此前主要应用于运动规划层面，缺乏在高频实时控制中的研究。
Method: 提出 JEPA 风格的潜在动力学模型，结合物理学启发的探针从冻结潜在变量中映射出可解释状态，并与基于采样的最优控制结合用于实时控制；同时开发了自动数据集生成管道。
Result: 开放环与室外闭环实验显示该方法实现了准确预测、鲁棒零样本 sim-to-real 迁移以及在不同操作条件下的强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法在长时域预测与实机控制上的有效性，并指出其减少真实数据依赖的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Does a Chemical Language Model Know About Molecules?
papers.abstract_en: Chemical language models (cLMs) are widely assumed to learn surface-level syntactic patterns rather than learning meaningful molecular semantics. Here, we apply sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to MolFormer, an encoder-only cLM, to mechanistically examine how molecular representations are built across layers. We discover that early layers rely on position-tracking latents to parse molecular grammar, while later layers encode atom-in-substructure and pharmacologically relevant features. Additionally, we show that non-canonical SMILES produce more disruptive representation shifts than invalid SMILES, driven by position-latent disruption propagating across layers. To support further exploration, we develop InterMol, an interactive visualizer for SAE activations on molecular strings and structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）机制性地分析化学语言模型MolFormer的分子表征构建过程。研究发现早期层依赖位置追踪潜在变量解析分子语法，而后期层编码原子-子结构和药理学相关特征。此外，非规范SMILES比无效SMILES导致更显著的表征偏移，并开发了交互式可视化工具InterMol。
Motivation: 化学语言模型通常被认为仅学习表面句法模式而非分子语义，本文旨在通过机制性检验揭示模型如何构建有意义的分子表征。
Method: 对编码器型化学语言模型MolFormer应用稀疏自编码器（SAE），逐层分析潜在表示，并构建交互式可视化工具InterMol。
Result: 早期层使用位置追踪潜在变量解析分子语法，后期层编码原子-子结构和药理学特征；非规范SMILES通过跨层传播的位置潜在扰动导致更严重的表征偏移。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了化学语言模型内部表征的层间演化机制，并提供了可交互的分析工具，有助于理解模型学习到的分子语义。

papers.title: Cross-Architectural Mixture-of-Experts with Adaptive Soft Routing for Plant Leaf Disease Classification
papers.abstract_en: Plant leaf disease classification is crucial for crop protection and precision agriculture but remains challenging under complex backgrounds, illumination variations, and severe class imbalance. Moreover, single-architecture models often fail to effectively capture both local and global representations. To address these challenges, this study proposes an adaptive soft Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework with cross-architectural routing that integrates EfficientNet-B0, DenseNet-121, and Swin-Tiny to exploit complementary multi-scale, local, and global features. A soft gating mechanism dynamically assigns input-dependent expert weights, while a two-stage refinement training strategy improves optimization stability and generalization. Experiments on a highly imbalanced potato leaf disease dataset achieve 91.68% recall and 92.62% F1-score, surpassing the strongest individual expert by 5.91% and 5.03%, respectively. Additional evaluations on durian and sesame leaf disease datasets yield F1-scores of 94.03% and 97.04%, demonstrating robust cross-dataset generalization and the potential of the proposed framework for reliable real-world crop health monitoring

papers.title: Rethinking Object-Centric Representations for Video Dynamics Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised video object tracking aims to decompose dynamic scenes into persistent, object-centric entities without manual annotations. Many recent approaches rely on slot-based representations, where a fixed set of latent variables ("slots") represent individual objects across frames. To preserve object identity, these models enforce temporal consistency on slot embeddings. However, when appearance and pose are entangled, this consistency objective conflicts with object motion and viewpoint changes. As a result, slots tend to lock onto static regions (e.g., background) to satisfy the consistency objective, while foreground objects become fragmented across multiple slots or frequently swap identities. To address these limitations, we propose STAITUS, a unified framework that explicitly disentangles each slot into appearance and geometric pose (position/scale). Leveraging this disentanglement, STAITUS enforces within-frame spatial separation and applies temporal alignment only in appearance space, yielding sharper masks and more persistent identities under motion, occlusion, and object entry/exit. Furthermore, to mitigate over-segmentation, we introduce an adaptive gating mechanism that dynamically adjusts the number of active slots to match scene complexity. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that STAITUS substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in segmentation quality and tracking stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STAITUS框架，通过解耦每个槽位（slot）为外观和几何姿态（位置/尺度），解决现有无监督视频对象跟踪中由于外观与姿态纠缠导致的静态区域锁定和前景碎片化问题。引入自适应门控机制动态调整活跃槽位数，在合成和真实基准上显著提升分割质量和跟踪稳定性。
Motivation: 现有基于槽位的表示方法在视频对象跟踪中，由于将外观与姿态纠缠，时域一致性约束与运动冲突，导致槽位锁定静态背景，前景对象碎片化或身份频繁交换。
Method: 提出STAITUS框架：显式解耦每个槽位为外观和几何姿态表示，仅在外观空间实施时域对齐，并引入帧内空间分离损失；同时采用自适应门控机制动态调整活跃槽位数以匹配场景复杂度。
Result: 在合成和真实视频基准上，STAITUS在分割质量和跟踪稳定性上显著超越当前最先进基线。
Conclusion: 外观与姿态的解耦以及自适应槽位数调节是提升无监督视频对象跟踪中对象持久性和口罩清晰度的有效途径。

papers.title: Interpretable Kolmogorov-Arnold Network with Feature-Isolated Temporal Attention Mechanism for Electricity Load Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate electricity load forecasting is a crucial prerequisite for stable power system operations. While prevalent deep learning models present competitive performance, they often operate as black boxes and lack interpretability. While the Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) has emerged as a promising alternative because of its learnable activation function design, its direct application to time-series forecasting faces challenges in modeling complex temporal data patterns. Also, simple integration into existing architectures, such as serving as replacement of neural modules, cannot fully leverage KAN's interpretability strengths. To address these gaps, this study develops LoadKAN, a novel hybrid and interpretable framework for load forecasting that synergistically combines a specifically-designed feature-isolated temporal attention mechanism with a KAN module. The attention stage aims to extract temporal dynamics from each input feature independently, such as historical load and human mobility, providing distilled feature representations to the KAN module for interpretable predictions. When evaluated on datasets from three representative U.S. electricity markets, our LoadKAN remains highly competitive when compared to extensively-tuned, state-of-the-art, black-box deep learning benchmarks. More importantly, LoadKAN's interpretability enables a granular analysis of the learned non-linear relationships between six distinct mobility patterns and electricity load. Through KAN-learned activation functions, our quantitative sensitivity analyses on mobility features reveal complex and market-specific dependencies. These findings further demonstrate the ability of our LoadKAN to generate insights often obscured by opaque black-box neural forecasting models.
papers.journal_ref: Applied Energy, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对电力负荷预测中深度学习模型缺乏可解释性的问题，提出混合可解释框架LoadKAN，将特征隔离的时间注意力机制与Kolmogorov-Arnold网络(KAN)结合。注意力模块独立提取各输入特征（如历史负荷、人类移动性）的时间动态，再交由KAN模块进行可解释预测。在三个美国电力市场数据集上，LoadKAN与调优后的SOTA黑盒模型性能相当，并通过KAN学习的激活函数定量分析了六种移动模式与负荷之间的非线性关系，揭示了市场特定的依赖模式。
Motivation: 现有深度学习模型在电力负荷预测中性能优异但缺乏可解释性；KAN虽具有可学习激活函数的可解释潜力，但直接用于时间序列预测难以建模复杂时序模式，且简单替换神经网络模块无法充分发挥其可解释优势。
Method: 提出LoadKAN框架，包含两个阶段：(1) 特征隔离的时间注意力机制，对每个输入特征独立提取时间动态，得到蒸馏特征表示；(2) KAN模块，利用可学习的激活函数对特征表示进行可解释预测。
Result: 在三个代表性美国电力市场数据集上，LoadKAN与经过大量调优的SOTA黑盒深度学习基准模型相比保持高度竞争力。通过KAN学习到的激活函数进行定量敏感性分析，揭示了六种移动模式与电力负荷之间复杂且市场特定的依赖关系。
Conclusion: LoadKAN在保持预测性能的同时提供了可解释性，能够发现被黑盒神经网络模型掩盖的机理洞察，适用于需要可解释性的电力负荷预测场景。

papers.title: GRINQH: Graded Input-based Quantization Hierarchy for Efficient LLM Generation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive decoding with LLMs is primarily bottlenecked by GPU memory bandwidth, especially in edge-computing settings. While quantization is essential for mitigating this bottleneck, most existing methods treat inference as a uniform process and fail to account for the asymmetry between the compute-bound prefill stage and the memory-bound decoding stage. We propose GRINQH (GRaded INput-based Quantization Hierarchy), a weight-only post-training quantization framework that accelerates decoding by unifying quantization and sparsification. GRINQH leverages activation magnitudes as a proxy for computational importance to dynamically assign weight channels to different precision levels, enabling flexible average bit widths during decoding. Evaluated on Llama3 and Qwen3 models, GRINQH outperforms state-of-the-art fixed- and mixed-precision baselines at comparable 3- and 4-bit settings, even enabling effective 2-bit generation. We experimentally verify theoretical speedups by leveraging a hierarchical nested memory layout for multi-precision storage in a custom GPU kernel. Ultimately, GRINQH establishes a new state-of-the-art Pareto frontier for LLM generation, enabling a dynamic trade-off between generation quality and inference speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRINQH 是一种针对大语言模型自回归解码的权重量化框架，利用激活幅值将权重通道动态分配到不同精度级别，在解码阶段实现灵活的平均位宽。在 Llama3 和 Qwen3 上，GRINQH 在 3-bit 和 4-bit 设置下优于现有基线，甚至支持有效的 2-bit 生成，并通过自定义 GPU 内核的多精度存储验证了理论加速。
Motivation: LLM 自回归解码受限于 GPU 内存带宽，尤其边缘计算场景。现有量化方法未区分计算密集的预填充阶段和内存密集的解码阶段，导致统一处理效率低。
Method: 提出基于激活幅值的分级输入量化层次（GRINQH），通过激活值大小作为计算重要性的代理，动态将权重通道分配至不同精度级别，并采用分层嵌套内存布局实现多精度存储的 GPU 内核。
Result: 在 Llama3 和 Qwen3 模型上，3-bit 和 4-bit 设置下优于固定精度和混合精度基线，支持 2-bit 生成，并实验验证了理论加速，建立了新的帕累托前沿。
Conclusion: GRINQH 实现了生成质量与推理速度的动态权衡，为 LLM 解码提供了新的量化优化方向。

papers.title: Digital Humanism and Evolutionary Design
papers.abstract_en: This paper examines the two concepts of digital humanism and evolutionary design. The aim is to identify and highlight potential common structures, synergies, and challenges. How should and can technical systems be designed, and what implications does this have for the design of our environment? In light of the current debate surrounding artificial intelligence, this paper aims to serve as a preliminary study to help better understand the two concepts of digital humanism and evolutionary design within the context of human-centered technological development. Following a brief introduction, the two concepts of Digital Humanism and Evolutionary Design are presented and graphically visualized. The terms of freedom and responsibility in human decision-making, conviviality, and subjectivity are discussed, along with examples illustrating the distinction between human and artificial intelligence (Turing Test and Chinese Room). The various concepts of evolutionary design (e.g., co-evolutionary or sustainable software development, clean code, or green IT) and Gilbert Simondon's concept of the "open machine" are introduced. The interdependencies between functional specialization and open technology development are highlighted. Both concepts share similar structures. In joint cooperation, they can lead to positive effects and mutual synergies. Significant differences lie in the areas of autonomy and determination in decision-making, as well as in genuine and simulated subjectivity. Open technology development is also currently suffering from the functional specialization of software and AI applications due to a purely market- and consumer-oriented approach. Even optimizations for energy efficiency in sustainable software development lead to greater specialization and thus also have a detrimental effect on open and quality-oriented technology development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨数字人文主义 (Digital Humanism) 和进化设计 (Evolutionary Design) 两个概念，旨在找出它们的共同结构、协同效应和挑战。通过分析人类决策中的自由与责任、共处性、主体性，以及人与人工智能的区别（图灵测试、中文屋），并引入进化设计的不同概念（如协同进化软件开发、清洁代码、绿色IT）和 Simondon 的“开放机器”概念，指出二者具有相似结构，但主要区别在于决策的自主性与确定性，以及真实与模拟主体性。论文认为开放技术发展受到市场导向的功能专业化的损害。
Motivation: 当前围绕人工智能的辩论中，需要更好地理解数字人文主义和进化设计在以人为本的技术发展背景下的意义，并识别它们之间的协同与挑战。
Conclusion: 数字人文主义和进化设计具有相似结构，联合协作可产生积极效应，但存在自主性、确定性、主体性等方面的差异。开放技术发展因市场导向的功能专业化而受到损害。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Detecting Malicious Agent Skills in the Wild using Attention
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly load skills, file-based packages of natural-language instructions written by third parties and distributed through marketplaces, that execute with the user's privileges. A single malicious skill can exfiltrate data, hijack the agent, or persist as a supply-chain foothold, which turns the skill marketplace into a new attack surface for agentic systems. Prompt-injection defenses do not carry over to this setting. They rely on a boundary between trusted instructions and untrusted data, whereas a skill is itself a body of instructions, so an injected command sits among many legitimate ones and inherits their authority. We present Locate-and-Judge, a two-stage detector designed for this regime. A lightweight locator scores the structural spans of a skill by the instruction-following attention each span draws and retains only the top-K. A judge then examines the retained spans in detail. Concentrating the costly judgment on a few high-attention spans lets the detector audit an entire marketplace instead of a sample. Compared to direct LLM-based scanning, this approach offers an order-of-magnitude cost reduction, dramatically increasing its scalability at a small cost to recall, and it dominates keyword and regex baselines at comparable expense. Deployed at marketplace scale and at negligible cost, Locate-and-Judge flags skills with high precision, the majority of which we manually confirmed as malicious, surfacing dozens of live malicious skills, including several disguised as benign functionality and many that SkillSpector and Cisco Skill Scanner fail to detect. We release the resulting labeled dataset.

papers.title: Leveraging Similarities in Multi-Armed Bandits
papers.abstract_en: In many online learning and bandit problems, the actions we consider possess inherent similarities--for instance because they share latent traits, tags, or hierarchical structure. We study online learning with a similarity-structured action set, encoded by a rooted tree whose leaves are the actions and whose levels quantify how closely two actions are related. The loss sequence is assumed tree-compatible: losses of similar actions are constrained to be close. We establish an impossibility result showing that usual one-point bandit feedback cannot, in general, leverage range or tree-induced similarity, even under very strong similarity constraints. We then provide a unified set of algorithms which adapt to a wide range of richer feedback models, from semi-bandit feedback down to multi-point bandit protocols, including the minimal two-point feedback setting. We show these algorithms exhibit best-of-both-worlds guarantees and provably exploit action similarities by replacing the number of actions $K$ by a similarity-aware effective number of actions $K_{\mathrm{eff}}$ in the regret bounds. As an application, we show that under two-point feedback, it is possible to achieve $\sqrt{T}$ regret in Lipschitz bandits when $d \leq 2$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究具有相似性结构的动作集在线学习问题，动作相似性由有根树的叶子和层次编码。假设损失序列是树兼容的，即相似动作的损失相近。作者证明单点 bandit 反馈通常无法利用树诱导的相似性，但提出了统一算法族适应更丰富的反馈模型（如半 bandit 到两点 bandit），实现了最佳权衡保证，并利用相似性将动作数 K 替换为有效动作数 K_eff 以改进遗憾界。作为应用，在两点反馈下，当维度 d ≤ 2 时，Lipschitz bandit 可实现 √T 遗憾。
Motivation: 许多在线学习中动作具有内在相似性（如共享潜在特征、标签或层次结构），但传统 bandit 算法未能充分利用这种结构。
Method: 建立树结构动作相似性模型，提出一系列算法适应不同反馈模型（半 bandit、两点 bandit 等），并证明遗憾界中动作数 K 可替换为相似性感知的有效动作数 K_eff。
Result: 单点 bandit 反馈无法利用树相似性；在更丰富反馈下，算法实现最佳权衡保证，且两点反馈下 Lipschitz bandit 在 d≤2 时达到 √T 遗憾。
Conclusion: 动作相似性可被有效利用，但依赖于反馈信息量；两点反馈是折衷下限。

papers.title: UnBias-Plus: Detect, Explain, and Rewrite Bias
papers.abstract_en: Bias in natural language remains a persistent challenge in both human-written and AI-generated content, affecting domains such as journalism, education, and AI research. Most existing detection methods identify only the presence of bias, with limited support for granular detection, interpretable explanations, neutral rewriting, and openly available trained models. We present UnBias-Plus, an open-source toolkit unifying (1) segment-level multi-class bias classification, (2) biased span localization, (3) neutral text rewriting, and (4) reasoning for each decision. Available via Python, CLI, REST API, and web interfaces, UnBias-Plus supports accessible bias analysis. The toolkit, source code, models, datasets, and documentation are publicly available.

papers.title: Quantum Convolutional Neural Networks for Groundwater Heat Plume Prediction: A Surrogate Modeling Approach
papers.abstract_en: Quantum machine learning methods are increasingly explored for modeling complex environmental systems, including groundwater heat plume dynamics. In this work, we explore a Quantum Convolutional Neural Network (QCNN) as a surrogate model for predicting temperature variations in groundwater induced by geothermal heat pumps in the city of Munich. To comply with the scalability constraints of current quantum hardware, the original high-dimensional simulation output is reduced to a compact set of representative parameters that serve as training targets for the surrogate. The proposed QCNN architecture consists of a quantum convolutional layer, a quantum pooling layer, and a fully connected quantum readout stage. Convolution and pooling operations are realized via parameterized quantum circuits based on rotational gates and measurement-driven decoding, while a Hamiltonian-inspired feature-encoding scheme is used to prepare informative input states on the quantum device. We evaluate the QCNN across multiple execution backends, including an ideal statevector simulator, a noisy simulator, IBM's 127-qubit Kyiv quantum processor, and the same hardware augmented with advanced error-mitigation techniques. Realistic noise models are employed to approximate device behavior and to assess the impact of mitigation strategies. Model performance is benchmarked using mean squared error (MSE) on both training and testing sets. The results show that, although classical neural networks still achieve the highest predictive accuracy, the QCNN attains competitive and consistent performance on simulators and exhibits noticeable improvement under error-mitigated hardware conditions. These findings indicate that quantum-enhanced surrogate modeling is a promising direction for future groundwater temperature prediction as quantum hardware and error-mitigation techniques continue to mature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索了量子卷积神经网络（QCNN）作为替代模型用于预测慕尼黑地区地热热泵引起的地下水温度变化。为适应当前量子硬件的可扩展性限制，原始高维模拟输出被降维为紧凑的参数集作为训练目标。QCNN架构包括量子卷积层、量子池化层和全连接量子读出阶段，通过参数化量子电路实现卷积和池化操作，并使用哈密顿量启发的特征编码方案制备输入态。模型在理想状态向量模拟器、噪声模拟器、IBM的127量子比特Kyiv量子处理器以及经误差缓解增强的硬件上进行了评估。结果表明，尽管经典神经网络仍具有最高预测精度，QCNN在模拟器上表现出竞争性且一致的性能，并在误差缓解硬件条件下有显著改进。
Motivation: 地下水热泵引起的热羽流预测对于城市能源管理至关重要，但传统模拟方法计算成本高。量子机器学习有望提供更高效的替代模型，但受限于当前量子硬件的噪声和规模。
Method: 提出使用QCNN作为替代模型：先通过主成分分析（PCA）将高维模拟输出降维为少量参数作为训练目标；QCNN包含量子卷积层（旋转门参数化电路）、量子池化层（测量驱动解码）和全连接量子读出层；采用哈密顿量启发的特征编码将输入数据映射到量子态；在多种后端（理想模拟器、噪声模拟器、真实量子处理器、误差缓解硬件）上评估。
Result: 在测试集上，经典神经网络预测精度最高，但QCNN在模拟器上达到竞争性性能（MSE接近），在IBM Kyiv量子处理器上经误差缓解后性能明显提升，表明量子替代模型有潜力。
Conclusion: 尽管当前量子硬件性能不及经典方法，但QCNN作为替代模型在地下水温度预测中展现了可行性，未来随着量子硬件和误差缓解技术成熟，量子增强替代建模值得进一步探索。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Differential Spectral Damping Gap Adaptive Regularization for Ill-Conditioned Kernel Methods
papers.abstract_en: Kernel methods requiring matrix inversion -- particularly Least-Squares Twin Support Vector Machines (LSTSVM) -- suffer from exponential eigenvalue decay in their system matrices, producing severely ill-conditioned problems where standard Tikhonov regularization applies uniform damping regardless of eigenvector reliability. We propose Differential Spectral Damping (DSD), a regularization formula that adapts its penalty to localized eigengap structure: preserving eigenvectors with large spectral gaps (reliable per Davis-Kahan perturbation theory) while aggressively suppressing those with small gaps (directionally corrupted beyond recovery). We motivate DSD through a principled design procedure grounded in the Davis-Kahan $\sin(Θ)$ theorem, systematically deriving the requirements for a reliability-aware damping function and selecting the exponential form for its smoothness, differentiability, and natural saturation properties. Through rigorous paired testing with fairly optimized baselines (including gradient-optimized Tikhonov receiving equal optimization opportunity), we demonstrate that DSD improves LSTSVM classification accuracy by +4.8 percentage points on real-world GINA ($d=970$, Cohen's $d = 4.49$, $p < 0.0001$), +10.4 percentage points at $d=200$, and +2.6 percentage points on Madelon ($d=500$) -- all using only principled spectral initialization while Tikhonov receives grid search. For pre-image reconstruction on manifold data, DSD ties Tikhonov at high perturbation noise ($p=0.99$) but slightly underperforms at lower noise levels; both reduce naive inversion error by $66\times$. We characterize the precise operating regime ($d \geq 100$, condition number $> 10^3$) and document where simpler methods suffice, providing practitioners with clear deployment guidance.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 tables, 1 figure. Complete source code and experiments are available at https://github.com/Praveg432/dsd-regularization
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对核方法矩阵求逆中的病态问题（特征值指数衰减），提出 Differential Spectral Damping (DSD) 正则化。该方法基于 Davis-Kahan 定理，根据局部特征间隙自适应调整惩罚：保留大间隙特征向量（可靠），抑制小间隙特征向量（不可靠）。实验表明，DSD 在 LSTSVM 分类任务上相比 Tikhonov 正则化提升 +4.8 至 +10.4 个百分点，在预图像重建中与 Tikhonov 性能相当（高噪声下持平，低噪声略差）。
Motivation: 标准 Tikhonov 正则化对所有特征向量施加均匀阻尼，无视特征向量可靠性差异，导致病态核方法（如 LSTSVM）中不可靠方向被保留而可靠方向被过度惩罚。
Method: 提出 DSD 正则化公式，通过指数形式的阻尼函数，根据特征间隙大小（Davis-Kahan 扰动界）自适应调整惩罚强度：大间隙特征向量几乎不受影响，小间隙特征向量被强烈抑制。
Result: 在 GINA (d=970) 上分类准确率提升 +4.8 个百分点（Cohen's d=4.49, p<0.0001），在 d=200 子集提升 +10.4 个百分点，在 Madelon (d=500) 提升 +2.6 个百分点；预图像重建中高噪声下性能持平，低噪声略差，两者均比朴素逆减少了 66 倍误差。
Conclusion: DSD 在条件数 >10^3 且 d≥100 的病态问题中显著优于 Tikhonov，但在小规模或良态问题上不一定必要，论文提供了清晰的适用条件指南。

papers.title: HyperQuant: A Rate-Distortion-Optimal Quantization Pipeline for Large Language and Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: We present HyperQuant (Hadamard, optimallY Packing, Entropy Rice-coding), a unified post-training quantization pipeline for the weights and the KV cache of large language and diffusion transformers. Across a suite of self-contained experiments (Table 1), HyperQuant outperforms the recent HIGGS scheme at every operating point from 3 to 5 bits per scalar (bps) on weights, and beats both TurboQuant and OCTOPUS on KV quantization down to 1.7 bps. Beyond the LLM setting, HyperQuant quantizes the 19B-parameter LTX-2 DiT video model with no observable per-frame artifacts. End-to-end on an H100 at 4 bps, HyperQuant compresses the linear weights ~3.9x and the KV cache ~3.79x at near-lossless quality. HyperQuant combines four known ideas into a single construction: (i) a per-tile Randomized Hadamard Transform that makes the per-coordinate distribution of weights and activations approximately Gaussian; (ii) quantization to a low-dimensional optimal lattice (E8, D4, A2, or Z); (iii) lossless bit-stripping and near-entropy-optimal variable-length Rice coding of the lattice indices; and (iv) bias-correction methods for the KV cache that keep the reconstruction unbiased under inner products, preserving attention semantics. We further integrate the pipeline with 8-bit and 4-bit Tensor-Core MMA paths (fp8-e4m3, int8, nvfp4, mxfp4), and find that int8 beats fp8 on the post-RHT lattice output. Project page: https://moonmath.ai/hyperquant/
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 提出四部分组合：每块随机 Hadamard 变换使分布近似高斯；低维最优格（E8, D4, A2, Z）量化；无损位剥离和近熵最优的 Rice 编码；针对 KV 缓存的偏差校正方法以保持注意力语义。
Result: 在权重上 3-5 bps 下优于 HIGGS；KV 量化在 1.7 bps 下优于 TurboQuant 和 OCTOPUS；19B 视频模型无伪影；4 bps 下线性权重压缩 3.9 倍，KV 缓存压缩 3.79 倍。
Conclusion: HyperQuant 在多个模型和数据集上展示了优于现有方案的率失真性能，且集成到 Tensor-Core 路径中。

papers.title: ReasoningLens: Hierarchical Visualization and Diagnostic Auditing for Large Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of Large Reasoning Models has introduced exceptionally long Chain-of-Thought traces, creating a transparency burden where critical logic is often buried under massive procedural text. To address this, we present ReasoningLens, an open-source framework designed for the hierarchical visualization and diagnostic auditing of complex reasoning chains. ReasoningLens addresses information necropsy by: (1) structuring traces into interactive hierarchies that separate high-level strategy from low-level execution; (2) leveraging an agentic auditor for automated error detection and tool-augmented verification; and (3) synthesizing systemic reasoning profiles to reveal model-specific blind spots. By transforming unstructured walls of text into actionable insights, ReasoningLens provides a modular foundation for interpreting, debugging, and optimizing the next generation of reasoning-centric AI.
papers.comment: Our project is available at https://github.com/icip-cas/ReasoningLens
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReasoningLens 是一个开源框架，旨在通过分层可视化和诊断审计来解决大型推理模型（Large Reasoning Models）中长思维链（Chain-of-Thought）的透明性难题。该框架将推理轨迹组织成交互式层次结构，分离高层策略与低层执行，并利用智能审计器进行自动错误检测和工具增强验证，最终综合出系统推理画像以揭示模型特定盲点。
Motivation: 大型推理模型产生异常长的思维链，关键逻辑常被大量程序化文本淹没，导致透明性不足。
Method: ReasoningLens 通过三个机制解决信息坏死问题：(1) 将轨迹结构化为交互式层次，区分高层策略与低层执行；(2) 采用智能审计器进行自动错误检测和工具增强验证；(3) 综合系统推理画像以揭示模型特定盲点。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果或量化数据。
Conclusion: ReasoningLens 将非结构化的文本墙转化为可操作洞察，为解释、调试和优化下一代推理中心AI提供模块化基础。

papers.title: Litmus: Zero-Label, Code-Driven Metric Specification for Evaluating AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: As agentic LLM systems move from prototypes to deployment across increasingly diverse domains, evaluating them has become both more important and more difficult. The challenge is not only that individual metrics may be unreliable, but that evaluation goals are often left implicit. Without a clear account of what a system is expected to do, how it can fail, and which failures matter, metric choices become difficult to justify, interpret, or validate. We present Litmus, a zero-label system that designs evaluation and monitoring metrics for AI pipelines by eliciting evaluation intent from source code and targeted interrogation. Instead of assuming that the evaluation target is already known, Litmus first identifies what must be measured and why, then converts those answers into constraints for constructing a justified, per-stage metric portfolio. We evaluate Litmus on three real, code-defined AI pipelines - financial account grouping, scientific QA, and inherent risk assessment - against AutoMetrics and three DynamicRubric baselines. Litmus achieves the broadest or tied-broadest concern coverage, spans more pipeline stages, produces a near-zero-redundancy portfolio, and ranks first in validity against per-row quality labels on all three pipelines - decisively on scientific QA (Spearman $ρ=0.72$ vs. less than $0.47$ for every baseline), and within overlapping confidence intervals in relation to two components of the audit framework despite using no labels during metric design. Our results support a shift from automatic metric implementation to automatic metric specification: before asking which metric to compute, evaluation systems should ask what must be measured and why.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Litmus，一个零标签系统，通过从源代码和定向询问中引出评估意图，为AI流水线设计评估和监测指标。在三个真实代码定义的AI流水线（金融账户分组、科学QA、固有风险评估）上的实验显示，与AutoMetrics和DynamicRubric基线相比，Litmus取得了最广或并列最广的关注覆盖、跨越更多流水线阶段、产生近零冗余的指标组合，并在有效性排名中位列第一（科学QA上Spearman ρ=0.72，基线均低于0.47）。结果支持评估系统应先问“必须测量什么以及为什么”，再问“计算哪个指标”。
Motivation: AI系统评估中，指标选择往往隐含，缺乏明确目标说明系统应做什么、如何失败以及哪些失败重要。现有方法假设评估目标已知，但实际中需要先识别测量目标。
Method: Litmus通过从源代码和定向询问中引出评估意图，识别必须测量什么以及为什么，然后将其转化为约束，构建合理的、每个阶段的指标组合。
Result: 在金融账户分组、科学QA和固有风险评估三个真实AI流水线上，Litmus在关注覆盖、阶段跨度、冗余度、有效性方面优于AutoMetrics和DynamicRubric基线；在科学QA上Spearman ρ=0.72，显著高于基线（小于0.47）。
Conclusion: 摘要支持从自动度量实现转向自动度量规范：在决定计算哪个指标之前，应先确定必须测量什么以及为什么。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Modeling for Wood Thermal Analysis and Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Wood materials exhibit complex, spatially varying thermal properties that challenge traditional architectural assumptions of material homogeneity. Although data-driven approaches can directly map wood RGB images to their corresponding thermal responses, they operate as uninterpretable black boxes that prioritize statistical correlation and may absorb experimental noise rather than thermodynamic plausibility. To address these limitations, we present physics-informed deep learning frameworks that integrate partial differential equations (PDEs) to predict pixel-level thermal responses of spatially heterogeneous wood materials using wood RGB images and testbed temperature maps. Specifically, we investigate two distinct approaches to enforcing a normalized 2D steady-state heat transfer equation derived from the general heat transfer equation: Physics-Informed Convolutional Neural Networks (PICNNs), which embed physics as a soft penalty term in the loss function, and Physics-Integrated Convolutional Neural Networks (PInteCNNs), which hard-code an analytical approximator-predictor-corrector solver directly into convolutional neural networks. To validate our proposed approaches, we collect three real-world multimodal datasets of Poplar, Grandis Cross-Cut (Grandis-CC), and Grandis Radial-Cut (Grandis-RC) wood samples. We further demonstrate that embedding physical inductive biases successfully balances predictive accuracy, physical interpretability, and intra-species diversity, outperforming data-driven approaches in handling complex wood material heterogeneity and enabling the extraction of interpretable physical parameters. Project: https://zekifayes.github.io/pim
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出两种物理信息深度学习框架（PICNN和PInteCNN），将稳态热传导偏微分方程嵌入卷积神经网络，利用木材RGB图像和温度图预测像素级热响应。在三种实木数据集上验证，表明物理归纳偏置提升了预测精度、可解释性和对异质性材料的泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动方法直接映射RGB图像到热响应，但缺乏物理解释性且易吸收噪声；传统建筑假设木材均匀性不成立。需要一种能结合物理规律与数据的学习范式。
Method: 构建两种方法：PICNN在损失函数中加入热传导方程软约束；PInteCNN将解析近似-预测-校正求解器硬编码到CNN中。两者均基于归一化的二维稳态热传导方程。
Result: 在Poplar、Grandis-CC和Grandis-RC三个真实数据集上，物理信息方法在预测精度、可解释性和处理种内多样性方面优于纯数据驱动方法。
Conclusion: 物理归纳偏置能有效平衡准确性、可解释性与异质性材料处理能力，并支持提取有意义的物理参数。

papers.title: Automated Semantic Fault Localization in SysML v2: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework Using Knowledge-Graph Augmented LLMs
papers.abstract_en: SysML v2's textual syntax enables compiler-based validation of model structure and language conformance. However, semantic mistakes that preserve syntactic validity but violate domain rules cannot be detected through compilers. These errors can propagate through the design process and surface late as costly integration failures. This paper presents a human-in-the-loop framework for identifying and repairing such errors automatically. It combines a fine-tuned Small Language Model (SLM) with a domain knowledge graph encoding physical compatibility rules between system elements. The knowledge graph also guides the generation of synthetic training data by systematically introducing plausible domain violations, and augments the model at inference time to ground repair suggestions in valid engineering constraints. We demonstrate the framework using the vehicle systems domain, where the knowledge graph captures the relationships between the mechanical, electrical, fluid, and signal interfaces. Two SLMs, Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B and DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B, are fine-tuned to output unified diff patches that localize faults and present candidate repairs for engineer review, preserving human judgment in the design process. Evaluation of 1,184 test samples shows that fine-tuning improves semantic fault repair from less than 3% to more than 91%, with patch-based output reducing token length by over 60%. The framework offers a practical path toward AI-assisted model verification that complements existing MBSE tools.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. Presented at INCOSE International Symposium 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种人机协同框架，用于自动定位和修复SysML v2模型中的语义错误。该框架结合了微调的小语言模型（SLM）和领域知识图谱，知识图谱编码了系统元素间的物理兼容性规则，并用于生成合成训练数据及在推理时增强模型。在车辆系统领域，使用Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B和DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B进行微调，输出统一差异补丁（unified diff patches），在1184个测试样本上，语义故障修复率从不到3%提升至91%以上，补丁输出减少了60%以上的令牌长度。
Motivation: SysML v2的文本语法允许编译器验证模型结构和语言符合性，但语义错误（语法正确但违反领域规则）无法被编译器检测，这些错误可能在设计过程中传播并导致后期昂贵的集成失败。
Method: 提出一个人机协同框架，使用微调的小语言模型（SLM）和领域知识图谱。知识图谱编码物理兼容性规则，指导合成训练数据的生成（通过系统性地引入合理的领域违规），并在推理时增强模型以将修复建议约束在有效的工程约束内。模型输出统一差异补丁，定位故障并提供候选修复供工程师审查。
Result: 在1184个测试样本上评估，微调将语义故障修复率从低于3%提高到超过91%，补丁输出将令牌长度减少超过60%。
Conclusion: 该框架为AI辅助模型验证提供了一条实用路径，补充了现有的基于模型的系统工程（MBSE）工具，强调保留人在设计过程中的判断。

papers.title: Distribution-Aware Diffusion-LLM for Robust Ultra-Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting is a fundamental machine learning task. Recent work has explored Large Language Models (LLMs) for this purpose due to their strong generalization, pattern recognition, and zero-shot or few-shot capabilities. Despite their suitability for long-context learning, LLMs face challenges in multimodal settings: they lack calibrated probabilistic modeling for non-text data and struggle to align heterogeneous representations. To address these issues, we propose a new framework Diffusion-LLM that integrates a conditional diffusion model into an LLM-based forecasting pipeline. This joint design enables learning the conditional distribution of future data while improving semantic alignment in a shared latent space. We evaluate Diffusion-LLM on six long-term forecasting benchmarks, including ETT, Weather, and ECL. Our method consistently outperforms existing LLM-based baseline, achieving notable gains in ultra-long-term and few-shot forecasting and demonstrating the value of distribution-aware regularization for enhancing robustness and generalization in time series LLMs.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Accepted at 35th International Conference on Artificial Neural Networks (ICANN 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Diffusion-LLM 框架，将条件扩散模型集成到基于 LLM 的时间序列预测管道中，以解决 LLM 在多模态设置下缺乏校准概率建模和异质表征对齐的问题。在 ETT、Weather、ECL 等六个长期预测基准上，该方法在超长期和少样本预测中持续优于现有 LLM 基线，验证了分布感知正则化对鲁棒性和泛化性的提升。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 在时间序列预测中虽具长上下文学习能力，但缺乏对非文本数据的校准概率建模，且难以对齐异质表征，限制了其在多模态场景下的性能。
Method: 设计条件扩散模型与 LLM 的联合架构，通过共享隐空间学习未来数据的条件分布并改善语义对齐，实现分布感知正则化。
Result: 在 ETT、Weather、ECL 等六个基准上，Diffusion-LLM 一致超越现有 LLM 基线，尤其在超长期和少样本预测中取得显著提升。
Conclusion: 分布感知正则化能有效增强时间序列 LLM 的鲁棒性与泛化能力，但方法依赖扩散模型训练，可能增加计算开销。
Relevance: 70

papers.title: Near-Lipschitz stability of the Kim--Milman flow map
papers.abstract_en: We prove that the Kim--Milman flow map enjoys favorable stability properties with respect to variations in the target measure, provided that one of the target measures is sufficiently regular. Our results include stability in relative entropy, and more notably, Lipschitz stability in the $2$-Wasserstein distance up to a logarithmic factor. We complement our results with a general existence theorem for these maps for any target measure with finite second moment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了Kim-Milman流映射相对于目标测度变化具有近Lipschitz稳定性，前提是其中一个目标测度足够正则。结果包括相对熵稳定性和2-Wasserstein距离上的Lipschitz稳定性（对数因子内），并补充了一般存在性定理。
Motivation: 研究Kim-Milman流映射的稳定性性质和存在性，为最优传输理论提供基础。
Method: 利用测度正则性条件，建立稳定性估计。
Result: 证明了相对熵稳定性以及2-Wasserstein距离上至多对数因子的Lipschitz稳定性，并对任意有限二阶矩的目标测度证明了映射的存在性。
Conclusion: 本文为Kim-Milman流映射的稳定性提供了定量结果，并推广了存在性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Energy-Based Transformers as Predictors of Reading Difficulty
papers.abstract_en: Transformer language models have become established tools for modeling human sentence processing, with measures such as surprisal and attention entropy serving as effective predictors of reading difficulty that together capture complementary aspects of processing load. Here, we explore a related class of transformer models: energy-based transformers, which provide a principled formal link to associative memory models, bringing processing research into direct contact with the broader literature on Hopfield networks and dense associative memory. To our knowledge, this is the first exploration of an energy-based transformer measure in computational psycholinguistics. Across reading-time corpora (Natural Stories, UCL eye-tracking, UCL self-paced reading), the energy measure is a robust predictor of reading times, providing significant fit beyond surprisal in all three. In a controlled experiment on relative clause processing, energy at a single layer captures the well-known object/subject asymmetry. We find evidence that it subsumes effects attributable to both attention entropy and surprisal, suggesting that energy may serve as a single unified predictor where multiple complementary measures have previously been required.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次探索能量基Transformer（energy-based transformers）在计算心理语言学中的应用，提出能量度量作为阅读难度的预测因子。在多个阅读时间语料库（Natural Stories、UCL眼动追踪、UCL自定步速阅读）上，能量度量显著预测阅读时间，超越信息量（surprisal）。在关系从句处理的受控实验中，单层能量捕获了主/宾语不对称性，并吸收了注意力熵和信息量的效应，暗示能量可能成为统一的预测因子。
Motivation: 现有Transformer语言模型使用信息量和注意力熵等预测阅读难度，但这些都是互补的独立指标。能量基Transformer与关联记忆模型有形式联系，可能提供统一框架。
Method: 使用能量基Transformer模型，提取能量度量（energy measure）作为处理负荷的指标，并与信息量和注意力熵进行对比。
Result: 在三个阅读时间语料库上，能量度量是阅读时间的稳健预测因子，在所有三个语料库中显著优于仅使用信息量的模型。在关系从句处理中，单层能量捕捉了主/宾语不对称性。
Conclusion: 能量度量可能统一了先前需要多个互补指标才能捕捉的处理负荷效应。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measuring & Mitigating Over-Alignment for LLMs in Multilingual Criminal Law Courts
papers.abstract_en: While the wider applicability of LLMs in the legal field is currently debated due to their reliability and the gravity of any errors, narrow uses with well-understood and mitigated risks have emerged. Notably the Swiss Federal Supreme Court uses small on-premises models for tentative translations and short-passage summarization across the four official languages. However, such usage is challenging in the context of Criminal Law. Since rulings and cases employees work on routinely can contain detailed descriptions of violent and sexual offenses, their legitimate work is compromised by refusals and disclaimers due to the activation of model guardrails (over-alignment). To measure this phenomenon, we introduce TF-RefusalBench, a multilingual benchmark for criminal-law translation and summarization derived from public Swiss Supreme Court rulings. TF-RefusalBench contains 5,200 total prompts across French, German, Italian, and English, corresponding to common task prompts and passages likely to trigger refusal. We then use TF-RefusalBench to show that over-alignment is a multifaceted phenomenon, influenced by the model and the prompt and text languages being processed, and that its impact cannot be evaluated solely from an over-refusal perspective, given the disclaimer's impact on task faithfulness. Finally, we evaluate approaches to enable on-premises LLMs for Criminal Law Tasks, demonstrating that while prompting can be effective, abliteration (refusal directions ablation) eliminates refusal with minimal impact on task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多语言刑事法庭场景中LLM因安全护栏导致过度对齐（over-alignment）的问题，提出了TF-RefusalBench基准（包含5200个提示，涵盖法语、德语、意大利语、英语），评测了不同模型和语言的拒绝行为。实验表明过度对齐是多方面的，受模型和语言影响，且不仅表现为过度拒绝，还影响任务忠实度。最后评估了两种缓解方法：提示工程和abliteration（拒绝方向消融），后者能消除拒绝且对任务性能影响很小。
Motivation: 在瑞士联邦最高法院等刑事法庭场景中，员工经常处理包含暴力、性犯罪描述的案件，模型安全护栏会触发拒绝和免责声明，影响合法工作，导致过度对齐问题。
Method: 构建多语言基准TF-RefusalBench，包含从公开瑞士最高法院判决中抽取的翻译和摘要任务提示；使用该基准测量不同模型和语言下的拒绝行为；评估提示工程和abliteration两种缓解方法。
Result: 过度对齐是多方面现象，受模型和提示语言影响，且不能仅从过度拒绝角度评估，因为免责声明损害任务忠实度；abliteration几乎完全消除拒绝，且对任务性能影响最小。
Conclusion: 对于刑事法庭任务，abliteration是有效的缓解措施，但需注意其他对齐方面。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Polynomial Dice Loss for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Medical image segmentation is a fundamental task for medical image processing and computer-assisted intervention, yet data imbalance and small lesion detection pose significant challenges. Dice Loss, which measures the overlap between predicted and ground truth regions, is widely used to mitigate these issues. To further emphasize its properties, we propose Polynomial Dice Loss, a polynomial extension of Dice Loss. Specifically, by leveraging the geometric characteristics of Dice Loss and formulating the loss function as a polynomial representation via Taylor expansion, we enable the adjustment of the contribution of higher-order components to the loss function. In our experiments, we evaluate the proposed method against loss functions derived from conventional Dice and Tversky coefficients. Experimental results and further analysis show that the polynomial formulation provides a simple way to control the loss shape and achieves competitive performance across multiple segmentation settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多项式Dice损失（Polynomial Dice Loss），通过泰勒展开将Dice损失表示为多项式形式，以调整高阶分量对损失函数的贡献，用于医学图像分割中缓解数据不平衡和小病变检测问题。实验表明该方法能简单控制损失形状，并在多个分割场景中取得有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 医学图像分割中存在数据不平衡和小病变检测困难，Dice损失虽广泛使用但仍需进一步改进，以更灵活地控制损失函数形状。
Method: 基于Dice损失的几何特性，利用泰勒展开将其表示为多项式，通过调整多项式系数控制高阶分量的贡献，从而提出Polynomial Dice Loss。
Result: 实验与传统的Dice和Tversky损失对比，多项式形式能简单控制损失形状，并在多个分割设置中取得有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 多项式扩展为Dice损失提供了一种简单有效的改进方式，能灵活适应不同分割任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlexServe: A Fast and Secure LLM Serving System for Mobile Devices with Flexible Resource Isolation
papers.abstract_en: Device-side Large Language Models (LLMs) have grown explosively, offering stronger privacy and higher availability than their cloud-side counterparts. During LLM inference, both the model weights and the user data are valuable, and attackers may compromise the OS kernel to steal them. ARM TrustZone is the de facto hardware-based isolation technology on mobile devices, used to protect sensitive applications from a compromised OS. However, protecting LLM inference with TrustZone incurs significant overhead to both the secure inference and the normal aplications, due to two challenges: the inflexible resource isolation and the inefficient secure resource management. To address these challenges, this paper presents FlexServe, a fast and secure LLM inference system for mobile devices. The key idea is to decouple the access permission from the management permission of secure resources, so that the normal-world OS cannot access them but can still manage them as usual. First, FlexServe introduces a Recallable Resource Isolation mechanism to construct Recallable Secure Memory (Flex-Mem) and a Recallable Secure NPU (Flex-NPU). They can only be accessed by the secure world, but can be efficiently allocated and reclaimed by the normal-world OS. Based on them, FlexServe further introduces a FlexServe Framework to run secure LLM inference in the secure world. It works together with the normal-world OS to perform cooperative secure memory management. We implement a prototype of FlexServe and compare it with two TrustZone-based strawman designs. The results show that FlexServe achieves average TTFT speedups of 10.05X over the strawman and 2.44X over an optimized strawman.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlexServe，一种针对移动设备上大型语言模型（LLM）推理的快速、安全系统。FlexServe利用ARM TrustZone实现硬件隔离，通过解耦安全资源的访问权限与管理权限，实现可回收的安全内存和安全NPU，从而在保护模型权重和用户数据的同时，减少对正常应用的影响。实验显示，与简单的TrustZone方案相比，FlexServe在TTFT（首次令牌生成时间）上平均加速10.05倍，与优化方案相比加速2.44倍。
Motivation: 移动设备上的LLM推理面临安全威胁，攻击者可能通过攻陷操作系统内核来窃取模型权重和用户数据。ARM TrustZone虽能提供硬件隔离，但直接用于LLM推理会导致严重的性能开销，主要源于资源隔离僵化和安全资源管理低效。
Method: FlexServe提出可回收资源隔离机制，构建可回收安全内存（Flex-Mem）和可回收安全NPU（Flex-NPU）。这些资源仅安全世界可访问，但正常世界操作系统可像普通资源一样分配和回收。基于此，设计FlexServe框架，在安全世界运行安全LLM推理，并与正常世界操作系统协同进行安全内存管理。
Result: 与两种基于TrustZone的基线方案相比，FlexServe平均TTFT加速分别为10.05倍和2.44倍。
Conclusion: FlexServe通过灵活的资源隔离机制，在保证安全性的同时显著提升LLM推理性能，适用于移动设备场景。

papers.title: Convergence of Gradient Descent for General Neural Network Architectures Beyond the NTK Regime
papers.abstract_en: Training dynamics is central to understanding neural networks, yet its theoretical analysis remains difficult even for simple architectures and becomes substantially more challenging for general modern architectures. In this paper, we propose a convergence framework for analyzing gradient descent (GD) dynamics under a broad family of neural network architectures and datasets beyond the neural tangent kernel (NTK) regime. The framework is formulated at the level of network blocks and covers architectures including pre-normalized multi-layer transformers. More precisely, under mild assumptions, we prove that for almost all initializations, GD with regular learning rates converges to the neighbourhood of a stationary point. This is mainly proved by establishing an iterate-dependent PL-type inequality through analyticity and measure-zero arguments, and by proving Lipschitz smoothness along the GD trajectory through polynomial generalized smoothness and a local relaxed dissipative condition. We further interpret the theorem under Xavier initialization and practical architectural scaling, showing that the learning rate scale depends on the depth and effective bottleneck dimensions rather than the largest width. Finally, we derive structural nondegeneracy implications for residual connections and function composition, and provide a generic characterization of global minimizers within our framework.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个适用于广泛神经网络架构（包括预归一化多层Transformer）的梯度下降收敛性分析框架，该框架超越了神经正切核（NTK）机制。在温和假设下，证明对于几乎所有初始化，使用常规学习率的梯度下降会收敛到驻点邻域。主要证明方法是通过解析性和零测集论证建立迭代相关的PL型不等式，并通过多项式广义光滑性和局部松弛耗散条件证明沿GD轨迹的Lipschitz光滑性。
Motivation: 训练动力学理论分析对于简单架构已很困难，对于一般现代架构则更具挑战性。现有NTK机制难以覆盖更广泛的神经网络结构和学习率范围。
Method: 提出一个在模块级别（network block）上分析梯度下降收敛性的框架。通过解析性和测度零论证建立迭代相关的PL型不等式（iterate-dependent PL-type inequality），并通过多项式广义光滑性和局部松弛耗散条件证明沿GD轨迹的Lipschitz光滑性。
Result: 证明对于几乎所有初始化，具有常规学习率的梯度下降收敛到驻点邻域。在Xavier初始化和实际架构缩放下，学习率尺度取决于深度和有效瓶颈维度（effective bottleneck dimensions），而非最大宽度。
Conclusion: 推导了残差连接和函数组合的结构非退化含义，并提供了该框架下全局最小化器（global minimizers）的通用刻画。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TooBad: Backdoor Diffusion Models with Ultra-Low Poison Rate and Imperceptible Trigger
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models (DMs), despite their impressive capabilities across a wide range of generative tasks, have been shown to be vulnerable to backdoor attacks. However, existing backdoor methods face critical trade-offs among key factors: attack performance, stealthiness, time complexity, and required poison rates. For example, achieving high attack performance typically demands a high poison rate and prolonged training, which undermines stealthiness, making the attack more detectable by backdoor defenses. This paper proposes TooBad (trigger optimization for backdoor diffusion models), a backdoor framework which introduces a novel DM-tailored trigger optimization technique to dramatically enhance the performance of backdoor attacks on DMs. Experiments on representative benchmarks such as CIFAR-10 show that TooBad can achieve high ASRs ($> 85$%) at only 0.5% poison rate, significantly lower than the 10% typically required by prior work on the same datasets. At 5% poison rate, TooBad reaches nearly 100% ASR within just 3-5 backdoor injection epochs, whereas existing methods need at least 30-50 epochs at double the poison rate for comparable results. Despite its potency, TooBad easily evades SOTA defenses and maintains high utility. These results reveal a critical threat on DMs and highlight the need for more robust defenses against such stealthy yet efficient attacks.
papers.journal_ref: ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TooBad，一种针对扩散模型 (DMs) 的后门攻击框架，通过专门的触发器优化技术，在极低投毒率 (0.5%) 下达到高攻击成功率 (>85%)，且仅需 3-5 个后门注入轮次即可接近 100% ASR（5% 投毒率）。该方法能轻易绕过现有防御，保持高实用性，揭示了扩散模型面临的新型威胁。
Motivation: 现有后门攻击方法在攻击性能、隐蔽性、时间复杂度和所需投毒率之间存在根本性权衡，高投毒率和长训练时间会损害隐蔽性，使攻击更易被检测。
Method: 提出 TooBad 框架，核心是一种面向扩散模型的触发器优化技术，用于增强后门攻击的效果和效率。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 上，0.5% 投毒率下攻击成功率 (ASR) 超过 85%；5% 投毒率下只需 3-5 个 epoch 即可达到近 100% ASR，而现有方法需要 30-50 个 epoch 且投毒率翻倍。该方法能避开最先进的防御检测，并保持高生成质量。
Conclusion: 该工作揭示了扩散模型在面对这种隐蔽且高效的后门攻击时的严重脆弱性，强调了开发更鲁棒防御机制的必要性。

papers.title: Rethinking Molecular Graph Backdoors under Chemistry-aware Admission
papers.abstract_en: Backdoor attacks on molecular graph neural networks (GNNs) are typically evaluated as abstract graph edits, but real molecular learning pipelines do not train on arbitrary graphs. Molecular records must first survive parsing, sanitization, canonicalization, and graph-string consistency checks. We formalize this overlooked admission stage as ChemGuard, an operational protocol for testing whether a submitted molecular record can enter a realistic learning pipeline, while complementing existing defenses. ChemGuard admits a record only when its molecular string is sanitizable and the graph reconstructed from that string matches the submitted molecular graph. Under this operational view, many existing graph-based backdoors lose much of their apparent efficacy because their poisons are chemically invalid or representation-inconsistent. We then show that admission checks alone are insufficient to rule out molecular backdoors. We propose ChemBack, an admission-aware molecular backdoor attack that constructs chemically feasible motif-anchor attachments and ranks admitted candidates by fingerprint-based Tanimoto similarity to clean target-class molecules. ChemBack is model-free during trigger selection, using molecular structures, target labels, fingerprints, and public validity checks, but no victim model, surrogate GNN, learned embedding, gradient, logit, or training-code access. Across molecular benchmarks, validators, architectures, and defenses, \textbf{ChemBack} achieves high attack success with fully admitted poisons while preserving clean accuracy. Our results reveal a two-sided lesson, chemistry-aware admission suppresses many graph-only backdoors, yet chemically valid and target-aligned molecular backdoors remain a practical threat.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视分子图神经网络的后门攻击，指出现有攻击常忽略分子必须经过解析、清洗、标准化等化学有效性检查。作者形式化了 ChemGuard 协议，该协议要求分子字符串可清洗且重建图与提交图一致，使许多现存的图后门失效。然而，仅靠 admission 检查不足以防御，作者进一步提出 ChemBack 攻击，通过构建化学可行的基序-锚点附件，并基于指纹 Tanimoto 相似性排序候选毒害样本，实现高攻击成功率且不依赖模型。结果表明，化学感知的 admission 能抑制许多图后门，但化学有效且目标对齐的分子后门仍是实际威胁。
Motivation: 现有分子图后门攻击通常假设任意图编辑，但真实分子学习流程要求分子记录经过严格的化学有效性检查，这一阶段被忽视。
Method: 提出 ChemGuard 协议作为操作化检查，要求分子字符串可清洗且图匹配；并在此基础上提出 ChemBack 攻击，使用化学可行的基序-锚点附件和指纹相似性排序生成可通过 admission 的毒害样本，无需模型访问。
Result: ChemBack 在多项分子基准、验证器、架构和防御下实现高攻击成功率，且毒害样本完全通过 admission，同时保持干净精度。
Conclusion: 化学感知的 admission 能消除许多图后门，但化学有效且目标对齐的分子后门仍是实用威胁，需进一步防御。

papers.title: Adaptive Hard-Soft Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Robust Boundary-Constrained PDE Solving
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide an effective way to solve partial differential equations (PDEs) by embedding physical principles into the learning process. However, the conventional PINN formulation, in which all constraints are imposed as soft penalty terms within a composite loss, often exhibits slow convergence, sensitivity to loss weight scaling, and inaccurate boundary enforcement due to poor conditioning of the optimization landscape. To address these limitations, this study proposes a unified hard--soft physics--informed neural network (HSPINN) with adaptive loss weighting. In this framework, Dirichlet and periodic boundary conditions are enforced exactly by construction through analytical or polynomial lifting, masking functions, and periodic feature mappings, while the governing PDE residuals, Neumann fluxes, and initial conditions are treated as soft constraints. An inverse-share softmax strategy dynamically balances the relative importance of individual loss components during training, eliminating manual penalty tuning and improving gradient stability. This formulation ensures boundary admissibility throughout optimization and enhances convergence efficiency and numerical robustness. Applications to representative elliptic (Poisson), parabolic (Burgers), and hyperbolic (convection with periodic boundaries) problems demonstrate that HSPINN consistently achieves faster convergence, higher accuracy, and greater stability than conventional PINNs, establishing a general and scalable foundation for physics-constrained deep learning across science and technology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应硬-软物理信息神经网络（HSPINN）用于求解带边界约束的偏微分方程（PDE），通过强制满足Dirichlet和周期边界条件（硬约束），同时将PDE残差、Neumann通量和初始条件作为软约束，并采用逆共享softmax动态平衡损失权重。在椭圆型（Poisson）、抛物型（Burgers）和双曲型（周期边界对流）问题上的实验表明，HSPINN相比传统PINN收敛更快、精度更高、稳定性更强。
Motivation: 传统PINN将所有约束作为软惩罚项，导致收敛慢、对损失权重敏感、边界条件不精确，优化条件差。
Method: 提出统一硬-软PINN框架：通过解析或多项式提升、掩码函数和周期特征映射精确强制Dirichlet和周期边界条件（硬约束），将PDE残差、Neumann通量和初始条件作为软约束，并使用逆共享softmax策略动态调整损失权重，消除手动调参。
Result: 在Poisson、Burgers和周期边界对流问题中，HSPINN比传统PINN收敛更快、精度更高、数值稳定性更强。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种通用且可扩展的物理约束深度学习方法，能确保边界可接受性并提升收敛效率和数值鲁棒性。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: SOAP-Bubbles: Structured Weight Uncertainty for Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Structured weight-uncertainty can improve many aspects of deep learning, but it remains costly to estimate and difficult to implement. Here, we show that these issues can be addressed by adapting the SOAP optimizer. Our key idea is to run IVON, an existing diagonal-covariance variational method, in the eigenspace of SOAP's preconditioner and then use the preconditioner to transform the diagonal estimate into a non-diagonal covariance. The resulting method has costs similar to those of SOAP and requires no drastic changes to training pipelines. We call the posteriors obtained in this way SOAP-Bubbles and our new optimizer Eigenspace-VON (EVON). We show that, for logistic regression, EVON recovers the exact Gaussian covariance and that, for language model pretraining, it yields significantly better results than existing diagonal-covariance methods. Our work makes it easier to estimate more expressive posterior distributions for deep learning at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为EVON的新优化器，通过在SOAP预条件子的特征空间中运行IVON（一种对角协方差变分方法），并将对角估计转换为非对角协方差，从而高效地估计神经网络的结构化权重不确定性。该方法在逻辑回归上能恢复精确高斯协方差，在语言模型预训练上显著优于现有对角协方差方法，且计算成本与SOAP相当。
Motivation: 结构化权重不确定性可改善深度学习的多方面性能，但现有估计方法成本高、实现复杂，本文旨在解决这些难题。
Method: 核心思想是借用SOAP优化器的预条件子，在其特征空间中应用IVON，然后通过预条件子将对角协方差变换为非对角形式，得到SOAP-Bubbles后验分布。新优化器命名为Eigenspace-VON (EVON)。
Result: 在逻辑回归任务上，EVON恢复了精确的高斯协方差；在语言模型预训练上，取得了比现有对角协方差方法显著更优的结果。
Conclusion: 这项工作使得在大规模深度学习中估计更具表达性的后验分布变得更加简便易行。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Changing Modalities: Adapting Remote Sensing Models to New Satellites and Sensors
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models for remote sensing are trained and deployed on a static set of modalities. However, as we equip newer satellites with novel sensors and retire old ones, practitioners may wish to deploy an existing model on a substitution, superset, or subset of modalities with minimal retraining given data availability or practical computational constraints. We study the setting of updating existing models to changing modalities and identify three main scenarios: Modality Transfer (substitution), Addition (superset), and Peeking (subset). We propose DeluluNet, an architecture with modular components for all three changing modality scenarios. DeluluNet is trained end-to-end, learning a multi-modal model from a unimodal teacher and unlabeled multimodal data via modality hallucination--predicting missing modality representations from those that are present. As a result, DeluluNet can keep predicting even when input modalities change, providing a practical alternative to re-labeling and re-training in a changing world.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感模型在卫星和传感器变化时的部署问题，提出了三种场景：模态转移（替换）、模态增加（超集）和模态窥视（子集）。作者设计了DeluluNet架构，通过从单模态教师和未标注多模态数据中学习模态幻觉，实现端到端训练，使模型能够适应输入模态的变化，从而避免重新标注和重新训练。
Motivation: 遥感模型通常针对静态模态训练，但卫星更新和退役导致模态变化，现有模型无法直接使用。重新训练成本高，且数据获取受限。
Method: 提出DeluluNet，一种模块化架构，通过模态幻觉（从现有模态预测缺失模态表示）来适应三种模态变化场景。模型端到端训练，使用单模态教师蒸馏和未标注多模态数据。
Result: 未在摘要中给出具体量化结果，但声称该方法能够使模型在输入模态变化时保持预测能力，提供了一种实用的替代方案。
Conclusion: DeluluNet为遥感模型在不同卫星和传感器间的迁移提供了一种无需重新标注的解决方案，具有实际应用价值。

papers.title: Faithful Grounded Visual Reasoning via Learned Proxy-Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in Visual Question Answering (VQA), yet their "black-box" nature hinders deployment in critical domains. Grounded Visual Reasoning (GVR) approaches attempt to improve interpretability by explicitly couple textual rationales with visual grounding information, which are typically textual coordinates. This mechanism lacks a learnable semantic link to the visual features, often resulting in a semantic-spatial gap where the model hallucinates coordinates that do not correspond to image evidences. In this work, we introduce Composer, a MLLM that leverages a novel visual grounding mechanism based on learned proxy-tokens to promote faithful interpretability. These discrete symbolic pointers explicitly index the image latent space, allowing the model to manipulate visual regions as addressable, semantically manipulable sets. To rigorously validate our novel grounding mechanism, we constructed ComposerGCoT, a dataset synthesized to enable holistic assessment of reasoning consistency and grounding accuracy. Experimental results indicate that Composer achieves performance parity with its coordinate-based counterpart in final answer accuracy, while improving visual grounding accuracy by +9.0 points. By demonstrating that discrete proxy-tokens capture spatial semantics more effectively than typical textual coordinates, we establish that visual grounding mechanisms with learnable semantic links represent a promising path toward trustworthy and reliable MLLMs.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICIP 2026. Code, model and data available at: https://github.com/CEA-LIST/Composer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Composer，一种多模态大语言模型 (MLLM)，通过可学习的代理令牌 (proxy-tokens) 实现忠实视觉推理。代理令牌作为离散符号指针显式索引图像潜在空间，替代传统文本坐标，弥合语义-空间鸿沟。实验表明，Composer 在保持最终答案准确率的同时，将视觉定位准确率提升 9.0 个百分点，证明了可学习语义链接在视觉定位中的有效性。
Motivation: 现有基于文本坐标的视觉定位机制缺乏可学习的语义链接，导致模型产生与图像证据不符的坐标幻觉，且可解释性不足。
Method: 提出基于可学习代理令牌的视觉定位机制，通过离散符号指针显式索引图像潜在空间，使模型能够将视觉区域作为可寻址、可语义操作的集合进行推理。
Result: 在合成的 ComposerGCoT 数据集上，Composer 在最终答案准确率上与基于坐标的基线持平，而视觉定位准确率提升 9.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: 可学习语义链接的视觉定位机制比传统文本坐标更有效地捕获空间语义，是实现可信赖 MLLM 的有前景路径。
