papers.title: Unmasking LAION-5B: Age, Gender, Race, and Emotion Biases in Large-Scale Image Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale image-text datasets, such as LAION-5B, are foundational to modern AI systems, yet their vast scale and uncurated nature raise significant concerns about demographic and stereotypical biases. This study presents a comprehensive analysis of the demographic composition and representational, stereotypical, and intersectional biases in LAION-2B-en and LAION-2B-multi, the two main components of the LAION-5B dataset. Using state-of-the-art models -- FairFace, DeepFace, and Emo-AffectNet -- we analyze faces detected in the dataset to identify biases across age, gender, race, and expressed emotion. Our findings reveal substantial overrepresentation of young adults (20--39), White individuals, and males, alongside consistent underrepresentation of minority racial groups and middle-aged or older women across both dataset components. We also observe stereotypical associations between demographic attributes and emotions, such as ``Anger'' being predominantly linked to males and ``Happiness'' to females, pointing to systemic imbalances in the data. The consistency of these patterns across two demographic models and both components of LAION-5B demonstrates that these biases are deeply embedded in one of the most widely-used training datasets. Given the scale at which LAION-5B is used to train generative models, these demographic imbalances could shape the behavior and outputs of numerous downstream AI systems.
papers.comment: Published as a paper at 3rd DATA-FM workshop @ ICLR 2026, Brazil
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对LAION-5B数据集（LAION-2B-en和LAION-2B-multi）进行了人口统计和偏见分析，使用FairFace、DeepFace和Emo-AffectNet模型检测面部，发现年龄、性别、种族和情感表达方面的显著偏见。结果显示年轻人、白人和男性过度代表，少数族裔和中年以上女性代表不足，并且存在刻板联想（如“愤怒”与男性、“快乐”与女性）。这些偏见在数据集两个部分和两种模型间一致，表明偏见根深蒂固，可能影响下游生成模型。
Motivation: 大规模图像-文本数据集如LAION-5B虽广泛用于AI系统，但其未经策划的特性可能引入人口统计和刻板偏见，目前缺乏全面的偏见分析。
Method: 使用FairFace、DeepFace和Emo-AffectNet三个预训练模型，对LAION-2B-en和LAION-2B-multi数据集中检测到的人脸进行年龄、性别、种族和情感属性分析，通过统计分布比较人口组成和偏见。
Result: 发现年轻人（20-39岁）、白人和男性过度代表；少数种族和中年以上女性代表不足；情感与性别存在刻板关联，如“愤怒”主要与男性、“快乐”与女性关联。这些模式在两个数据子集和两个人口统计模型间一致。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了LAION-5B中根深蒂固的偏见，鉴于其广泛用于训练生成模型，这些偏见可能影响大量下游AI系统的行为和输出。

papers.title: NGPS: Structure-Preserving Self-Supervised Denoising via Neighbor-Guided Patch Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Neighboring-slice self-supervised denoising is attractive for volumetric medical imaging, yet inter-slice misalignment breaks anatomical correspondence and often yields ghosting and blurred margins when adjacent slices are used naively as targets. We propose Neighbor-Guided Patch Sampling (NGPS), a lightweight framework that constructs neighboring supervision under local inter-slice misalignment without explicit registration. To avoid learning from misleading targets, prior methods commonly mask discrepant regions, but this stabilizes training at the cost of leaving a non-trivial portion of neighboring evidence unexploited, particularly around high-frequency anatomical boundaries. NGPS addresses this by decoupling structure matching from signal retrieval: for each masked location, it searches a local neighborhood for structurally similar candidate patches using a simple guide image (e.g., fast bilateral filtering), while retrieving the supervision signal directly from the raw noisy neighbor at the matched coordinates. By matching on a noise-attenuated guide while retrieving raw values from neighboring slices, NGPS constructs local pseudo targets without a learned registration module. Across the evaluated CT and synthetic-Rician MRI settings, NGPS improves fidelity and structure-sensitive metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/cv-cho/NGPS .
papers.comment: The 19th European Conference on Computer Vision: ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出邻域引导补丁采样（NGPS），一种轻量级的自监督去噪框架，用于处理体素医学图像中相邻切片间的错位问题。通过解耦结构匹配与信号检索，NGPS 在无需显式配准或学习模块的情况下，利用去噪引导图进行局部结构匹配，并从原始噪声切片中获取监督信号，从而避免了传统方法因掩蔽不一致区域导致的高频边界信息丢失。在 CT 和合成 Rician MRI 数据集上，该方法在保真度和结构敏感指标上均有提升。
Motivation: 相邻切片自监督去噪在医学体素成像中很有吸引力，但层间错位会破坏解剖对应关系，导致伪影和模糊边缘。现有方法通过掩蔽不一致区域来稳定训练，但牺牲了相邻切片中的大量证据，尤其在高频解剖边界处。
Method: 提出 Neighbor-Guided Patch Sampling (NGPS)：对于每个被掩蔽的位置，利用快速双边滤波等简单引导图像在局部邻域搜索结构相似的候选补丁，同时从原始噪声相邻切片中在匹配坐标处直接检索监督信号。无需学习配准模块。
Result: 在 CT 和合成 Rician MRI 设置下，NGPS 在保真度和结构敏感指标上优于现有方法。
Conclusion: NGPS 通过解耦结构匹配与信号检索，在不依赖显式配准或学习模块的情况下，有效处理了层间错位，为医学图像自监督去噪提供了轻量级解决方案。代码已开源。

papers.title: Bridge the Gaps: Heterogeneous Attributed Graph Clustering via Quaternion Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Attributed graph clustering partitions nodes by jointly exploiting node attributes and graph topology. It remains challenging due to attribute heterogeneity and representation degradation during graph learning. Real-world datasets often contain heterogeneous attributes, i.e., numerical and categorical attributes, complicating unified representation learning. This challenge becomes more complex in attributed graphs, where constructing a clustering-friendly graph structure from attributes and topology remains difficult. Under deep graph architectures, repeated graph propagation causes node embeddings to become overly similar, leading to the over-smoothing (OS) effect. Meanwhile, graph representation learning amplifies topological influence, making discriminative attribute information harder to exploit for clustering, an effect we refer to as over-dominating (OD). To bridge these gaps, an end-to-end framework, Any-type attributed Graph REpresentation lEarning (AGREE), is proposed. It unifies attributed graphs and any-type attributed data through multi-level alignment and similarity-based graph construction. Quaternion-based graph convolution strengthens attribute interaction to alleviate OD, while shallow graph architectures help relieve OS. The learned embeddings are jointly optimized for graph reconstruction and clustering, without requiring a predefined number of clusters during training. Experiments on diverse benchmarks show that AGREE achieves strong overall performance in accuracy, robustness, and adaptability.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Emerging Topics in Computational Intelligence. Author-accepted manuscript
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AGREE框架，用于异质属性图聚类，解决属性异构性和图学习中的表示退化问题。通过多级对齐和基于相似度的图构造统一任意类型属性数据，使用四元数图卷积增强属性交互以缓解过主导效应，并采用浅层图架构缓解过平滑。实验表明该方法在准确率、鲁棒性和适应性上表现优异。
Motivation: 现实属性图常包含数值和类别型异构属性，现有方法难以统一表示；深层图传播导致过平滑和过主导效应，使判别性属性信息难以用于聚类。
Method: 提出端到端框架AGREE，包含多级对齐和相似度图构造以统一任意类型属性数据，使用四元数图卷积增强属性交互，并联合优化图重建与聚类目标，无需预定义聚类数。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，AGREE在准确率、鲁棒性和适应性方面均取得优异性能。
Conclusion: 通过多级对齐和四元数图卷积可以有效弥合属性异构和图学习中的表示退化问题，实现鲁棒的属性图聚类。

papers.title: Incremental Learning in Mirror Flows
papers.abstract_en: We study mirror flows generated by a convex quadratic loss and a general convex lower semicontinuous mirror potential. We show that, when initialized near the boundary of the domain of the mirror potential, their rescaled trajectories converge to a limiting mirror flow whose potential is the indicator function of the domain. In this limit, the primal variable minimizes the loss over a time-dependent hypothesis set: the subdifferential of the support function of the domain, evaluated at the dual variable. This characterization provides a general mechanism for incremental learning in mirror flows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究凸二次损失与一般凸下半连续镜像势生成的镜像流。当初始化在镜像势定义域的边界附近时，其缩放轨迹收敛到以定义域指示函数为势的极限镜像流。极限下，原始变量在随时间变化的假设集上最小化损失，该假设集由定义域支撑函数的次微分在对偶变量处给出。该刻画为镜像流中的增量学习提供了通用机制。
Motivation: 理解镜像流中增量学习的通用机制，特别是当初始点靠近定义域边界时的极限行为。
Method: 通过理论分析，研究凸二次损失和一般凸下半连续镜像势生成的镜像流，证明其缩放轨迹的收敛性，并刻画极限过程的特征。
Result: 缩放后的轨迹收敛到以定义域指示函数为势的镜像流；原始变量在由支撑函数次微分定义的时变假设集上最小化损失。
Conclusion: 该刻画为镜像流中的增量学习提供了通用理论解释。

papers.title: When Does Intrinsic Self-Correction Help? A Task-Sensitive Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Intrinsic self-correction (SC) aims to improve large language model outputs by prompting a model to revisit its own initial answer without external feedback. Recent studies have questioned the reliability of this approach, showing that models often struggle to judge whether their initial responses are correct. In this work, we take a task-sensitive view of SC. Rather than asking whether it works in general, we examine settings where SC may operate through different mechanisms: verifying explicit constraints, revisiting a complex reasoning process, or providing a second opinion over competing strategies in word-game tasks. Across multiple benchmarks and models, we find that SC can yield consistent performance gains when the underlying task structure facilitates these modes of revision. These results suggest that SC is best understood as a task-dependent inference-time strategy whose usefulness depends on the role the revision stage can play in a given task, rather than as a uniformly reliable method for improving initial model outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究内在自校正（intrinsic self-correction）在大型语言模型中的适用性，提出任务敏感性分析，发现自校正在验证显式约束、重新审视复杂推理、提供竞争策略的第二意见等任务结构下可以带来一致性能提升，而非普遍有效的改进策略。
Motivation: 近年来研究表明语言模型的自校正往往不可靠，模型难以判断自己初始回答是否正确。本文旨在揭示自校正有效的条件，而非泛泛询问是否有效。
Method: 采用任务敏感视角，分类考察自校正可能通过不同机制发挥作用的场景：验证显式约束、重新审视复杂推理过程、在文字游戏任务中对竞争策略提供第二意见。在多个基准和模型上进行实验。
Result: 摘要表明，当底层任务结构有利于上述修订模式时，自校正可以带来一致性能提升。具体数值未在摘要中提及。
Conclusion: 自校正应被理解为任务依赖的推理时策略，其有用性取决于修订阶段在给定任务中能够扮演的角色，而非统一的可靠性改进方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Memory Contagion: Cross-Temporal Propagation of Evaluator Bias via Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on memory systems to maintain long-term coherence. Recent work shows that agent memories degrade during continuous consolidation. However, existing research assumes memories are derived from unbiased experiences. In this work, we identify and formalize a novel phenomenon: Memory Contagion -- the cross-temporal propagation of evaluator bias through agent memory. We show that when agents are trained or guided by biased evaluators, their experiences become biased; when these trajectories are stored and consolidated into memory, the bias propagates to future agents retrieving from the same memory store, even when consolidation is perfect (oracle). Across two bias types (length preference, authority bias) and four experimental phases, we demonstrate: (1) Memory Contagion occurs even with perfect consolidation (oracle condition), proving that biased input is a sufficient cause of contagion; (2) Consolidation has opposite effects depending on bias type -- robustly attenuating length bias while preliminarily amplifying authority bias (single-run estimate), suggesting a bias-type-dependent interaction; (3) No observed safe threshold: bias propagation is detected at contamination rates as low as p=0.2. Our findings expose a critical vulnerability in current agent memory designs and provide formal tools for measuring cross-temporal bias propagation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文识别并形式化了记忆传染现象——评估者偏差通过智能体记忆进行跨时间传播。实验表明即使完美整合也会发生偏差传播，且没有安全阈值，在污染率低至0.2时仍可检测到。这暴露了当前智能体记忆设计的漏洞。
Motivation: 现有研究假设智能体的记忆来自无偏经验，但忽略了对有偏评估者导致偏差传播的问题。本文旨在证明这种偏差传播的普遍性和危害。
Method: 通过两阶段偏差（长度偏好和权威偏差）的系统实验，设计完美整合条件来隔离输入偏差的影响，并测量不同污染率下的传播效果。
Result: 1) 即使在完美整合条件下记忆传染依然发生；2) 整合对偏差类型有相反作用；3) 未观察到安全阈值，低至0.2的污染率即可传播。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了当前agent记忆设计的关键漏洞，并提供了形式化工具来测量跨时间偏差传播。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Capable but Careless: Do Computer-Use Agents Follow Contextual Integrity?
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) now act on a user's behalf across personal applications such as email, calendars, and to-do lists. This cross-application access is useful, but it also creates a privacy risk that has been largely overlooked: when an agent works in one context, it can pull in information from another that is inappropriate in that context. Hence, we introduce AgentCIBench, an evaluation harness that turns this risk into executable, deterministically scored scenarios. We target three common failure modes in CUAs: visual co-location, where the agent pulls in prohibited items that sit next to the task target in the UI; task-ambiguity overshare, where the agent dumps dense personal state in response to an under-specified prompt; and recipient misalignment, where the agent sends content to an addressee for whom it is inappropriate. We evaluate 15 frontier agents and find a surprisingly high failure rate: 11 of 15 leak on more than 50% of scenarios, with an average leakage of 67.9%, and the same failures persist when agents act end-to-end in the environment to complete the task. We release AgentCIBench to encourage the development of safer computer-use agents and position contextual disclosure testing as a pre-deployment safety check.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文引入AgentCIBench评估框架，针对计算机使用代理（CUA）跨应用操作时的隐私风险，测试了三种常见失败模式：视觉共置、任务模糊过度分享和收件人错位。在15个前沿代理上的实验发现，11个代理在超过50%的场景中泄露信息，平均泄露率为67.9%。作者呼吁将上下文披露测试作为部署前的安全检查。
Motivation: 现有计算机使用代理跨应用访问用户数据时，可能在不适当的上下文中泄露信息，这一隐私风险被广泛忽视。
Method: 提出AgentCIBench，一种可执行且确定性得分的评估工具，针对视觉共置、任务模糊过度分享、收件人错位三种失败模式设计场景。
Result: 15个前沿代理中，11个在超过50%的场景中泄露信息，平均泄露率为67.9%，且在端到端任务中同样存在。
Conclusion: 当前计算机使用代理存在严重的隐私风险，需要开发更安全的代理，并将上下文披露测试作为部署前的安全检验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stage-dependent integer-binary encoding in factorization-machine black-box optimization
papers.abstract_en: Black-box optimization (BBO) deals with problems where objective functions lack explicit analytical forms and are expensive to evaluate. Factorization machine with quadratic-optimization annealing (FMQA) constructs a surrogate model using a factorization machine (FM) and optimizes it with an Ising machine. Conventional FMQA applies a single integer-binary encoding throughout the optimization process, although the encoding best suited to surrogate learning may differ from the one best suited to Ising-machine solution search. We propose a stage-dependent FMQA framework and derive conversion formulas between one-hot and domain-wall QUBO matrices that preserve the surrogate objective over feasible integer states up to an additive constant. We evaluate the OhDw variant, which employs one-hot encoding for learning and domain-wall encoding for search, on the Rastrigin function with input dimensions N = 2 and 5 and discretization levels q = 61 and 301. Across all conditions, the dominant factor governing optimization performance is the encoding used in the learning stage, with one-hot encoding consistently yielding lower residual errors than domain-wall or binary encoding. The additional benefit of switching to domain-wall encoding for solution search is condition-dependent. For N = 5 and q = 301, OhDw achieves a lower residual error and solutions closer to the global optimum than one-hot-only FMQA, whereas for N = 5 and q = 61 the latter achieves a lower residual error. These results indicate that one-hot encoding in the learning stage is the primary performance driver and that stage-dependent encoding can provide further improvement under finer discretization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对黑盒优化（BBO）中因子分解机与伊辛机协同优化（FMQA）的编码策略问题，提出阶段依赖的整数-二进制编码框架。标准FMQA全程使用单一编码，而本文认为学习阶段和搜索阶段的最佳编码可能不同。作者推导了one-hot编码与domain-wall编码之间的QUBO矩阵转换公式，使得代理目标函数在可行整数状态上保持（相差一个加法常数）。在Rastrigin函数（维度N=2,5，离散化等级q=61,301）上评估了OhDw变体（学习用one-hot，搜索用domain-wall）。结果表明学习阶段使用one-hot是主导因素，同样搜索阶段切换为domain-wall的效果取决于条件：在N=5, q=301时OhDw优于全程one-hot，但在N=5, q=61时则相反。
Motivation: 标准FMQA在优化过程中使用单一整数-二进制编码，忽略了代理模型学习与伊辛机搜索对编码的不同偏好，可能导致次优性能。
Method: 提出阶段依赖FMQA框架，为学习阶段和搜索阶段分别设计不同编码（如OhDw：学习用one-hot，搜索用domain-wall），并推导了两种编码QUBO矩阵之间的转换公式，保持代理目标函数在可行整数状态上不变（加法常数）。
Result: 在Rastrigin函数上，学习阶段使用one-hot编码始终优于其他编码（domain-wall或二进制），是性能主导因素。切换搜索编码的增益依赖条件：N=5, q=301时OhDw残差更低且更接近全局最优，而N=5, q=61时全程one-hot表现更好。
Conclusion: 学习阶段采用one-hot编码是FMQA性能的主要驱动因素；在精细离散化条件下，阶段依赖编码（OhDw）可进一步改善优化结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StreamPPG: Low-Latency rPPG Estimation via Consistent Privileged Learning
papers.abstract_en: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) estimates the blood volume pulse (BVP) signal from facial videos, enabling contact-free health monitoring. Conventional clip-wise approaches, which use video clips as input, require capturing over one hundred frames before inference, thus introducing several seconds of delay and hindering real-time use. Meanwhile, frame-wise approaches struggle to capture long-range temporal and periodic features of physiological rhythms, and therefore lead to reduced estimation accuracy. To overcome these issues, we propose StreamPPG, a unified architecture that enables low-latency frame-wise physiological signal estimation while achieving competitive accuracy compared with clip-wise approaches. StreamPPG is trained under a consistent privileged learning (CPL) strategy, which leverages ground-truth rPPG signals as privileged information to enhance the model's representation capability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that StreamPPG achieves state-of-the-art accuracy across multiple datasets while maintaining real-time throughput on edge devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StreamPPG，一种低延迟的远程光电容积描记法 (rPPG) 框架，通过一致特权学习 (CPL) 策略实现帧级生理信号估计，在保持实时吞吐量的同时达到与片级方法相当的精度。
Motivation: 现有 rPPG 方法中，片级方法延迟高（需捕获上百帧），帧级方法难以捕捉长时序与周期性特征，精度较低。需要同时实现低延迟和高精度。
Method: 提出 StreamPPG 统一架构，训练时采用一致特权学习 (CPL) 策略，利用真实 rPPG 信号作为特权信息增强模型表示能力。
Result: 在多个数据集上达到最先进精度，同时在边缘设备上保持实时吞吐量。
Conclusion: 该框架统一了帧级低延迟和片级高精度，适用于实时健康监测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DART: Draft-Agreement Routing for Training-Free Adaptive Thinking Budgets in Hybrid Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid reasoning models can answer directly or spend extra tokens on extended thinking. A practical router should choose between these modes for each query, so easy problems avoid unnecessary reasoning and hard problems receive enough budget to finish the answer. Existing routers move in this direction, but they typically require labeled training data or fix thinking budgets up front, ignoring answer-level evidence from the model itself. We introduce DART, a training-free routing framework that samples two cheap no-think drafts, accepts direct answering when the drafts agree, and predicts a thinking budget from draft entropy when they disagree. Across the main comparisons, DART preserves or improves always-thinking accuracy in most settings while reducing thinking-token use. On math reasoning, accuracy improves by up to $+$9.0 points on Olympiad-level problems while thinking tokens drop 15-69%. On code reasoning under execution-based equivalence, accuracy improves by up to +22.5 points while thinking tokens drop 51-63%. The Stage~1 signal extends across model scales (0.6B-32B), model families, and API-only hosted settings, with no labeled data and no gradient updates required.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DART，一种无训练的路由框架，用于混合推理模型的自适应思考预算分配。DART 通过采样两个廉价的无思考草稿，若两者一致则直接回答，不一致则根据草稿熵预测思考预算。在数学和代码推理任务上，DART 在保持或提升准确率的同时大幅减少思考 token 使用，且无需标注数据或梯度更新。
Motivation: 现有混合推理模型的路由方法通常需要标注训练数据或固定思考预算，无法利用模型自身的答案级证据，导致简单问题浪费推理代价或困难问题预算不足。
Method: DART 是一种无训练路由框架：对每个查询采样两个无思考草稿，若草稿一致则直接输出答案；若不一致，则根据草稿熵动态预测所需的思考预算，并启动扩展思考。
Result: 在数学推理上，奥林匹克级问题准确率提升最多 +9.0 点，思考 token 减少 15-69%；在代码推理（执行等价）上，准确率提升最多 +22.5 点，思考 token 减少 51-63%。该方法适用于 0.6B-32B 多种模型规模。
Conclusion: DART 通过无训练方式利用模型内部信号实现自适应思考预算，既提升准确率又降低推理开销，且跨模型和任务通用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EML Trees Are Universal Approximators
papers.abstract_en: The recently introduced EML (Exp-Minus-Log) function acts as continuous analogue of NAND gates, providing a compositional building block capable of representing elementary functions. In this work, we study the expressive power of tree-structured compositions of EML functions. We show that such trees enjoy a universal approximation property for functions in $W^{k, \infty}$ for $k \in \mathbb N$, drawing on classical neural network approximation arguments while exploiting the ability to explicitly construct EML trees that mimic polynomial representations. We further propose a learning algorithm for EML-type trees equipped with fitting parameters, and demonstrate its feasibility in practical optimization problems. Our results establish EML trees as a theoretically grounded framework for function approximation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究EML（Exp-Minus-Log）函数构成的树结构的表达能力，证明该类树结构在$W^{k, \infty}$空间中具有通用逼近性质，并提出了相应的学习算法。
Motivation: EML函数作为NAND门的连续类比，具备表示初等函数的组合能力，但EML树结构的逼近能力尚未被理论验证。
Method: 利用经典神经网络逼近论证，并借助显式构造EML树模拟多项式表示的方法，证明通用逼近性质；同时提出带拟合参数的学习算法。
Result: 理论上证明EML树对$W^{k, \infty}$空间中的函数具有通用逼近性，并在实际优化问题中展示了可行性。
Conclusion: EML树为函数逼近提供了一个理论基础扎实的框架。

papers.title: Interpretable Probabilistic Medical Image Segmentation via Gaussian Process with Explicit Modelling of Annotation Bias and Variability
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning-based medical image segmentation models are trained using annotations that exhibit systematic bias and variability across raters. While probabilistic multi-rater approaches can emulate annotator-specific delineations, annotator characteristics are typically encoded implicitly in deep latent feature space, making direct analysis of their influence on predictive distributions less straightforward. We propose a logit-space probabilistic segmentation framework based on stochastic variational Gaussian Process that explicitly decomposes predictions into an image-dependent reference logit distribution and annotator specific perturbations parameterised by bias and variance. This formulation enables more explicit analysis on how intra- and inter-rater variability propagate to predictive distributions. We evaluate the method on a multi-annotator medical image dataset, which shows that explicitly modelling annotator specific perturbations improves uncertainty calibration while maintaining comparable segmentation accuracy, compared with state-of-the-art multi-rater probabilistic segmentation method. The learned bias and variance parameters quantitatively reflect annotator-specific behaviour. Furthermore, controlled perturbation experiments over bias and variance demonstrate how changes in annotator parameters systematically influence predictive performance. The code used in this paper is made publicly available at https://github.com/QiLi111/GPS-Var.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于随机变分高斯过程的logit空间概率分割框架，显式分解为图像依赖参考分布和标注者特定扰动（偏置和方差），以分析标注者变异性对预测分布的影响。在多标注者医学图像数据集上，该方法在保持分割精度的同时改善了不确定性校准，且学习的参数可定量反映标注者行为。
Motivation: 现有基于深度学习的概率多标注者方法隐式编码标注者特性，导致难以直接分析标注者特征对预测分布的影响。本文旨在通过显式建模标注者偏置和方差，实现可解释的标注者变异性分析。
Method: 提出基于随机变分高斯过程（stochastic variational Gaussian Process）的logit空间概率分割框架，将预测分解为与图像相关的参考logit分布和标注者特定扰动（参数化为偏置和方差），从而显式建模标注者偏差与变异性。
Result: 在多标注者医学图像数据集上，与最先进的多标注者概率分割方法相比，该方法在保持可比分割精度的同时改善了不确定性校准。学习到的偏置和方差参数能定量反映标注者特定行为。通过控制扰动实验，展示了标注者参数变化对预测性能的系统性影响。
Conclusion: 显式建模标注者扰动可以改善不确定性校准，并实现标注者行为的定量分析。该框架允许通过控制标注者参数进行因果分析，有助于理解标注者变异性对分割模型的影响。

papers.title: Position: Correct Answer, Wrong Mechanism -- When AI Scientists Defend General Claims Their Own Data Contradicts
papers.abstract_en: AI scientist systems are described as tools, coauthors, or founders, but we evaluate them as if only the final answer matters. This position paper argues that outcome-only evaluation is insufficient, and that task outcome, mechanism fidelity, and epistemic honesty must be measured separately. Our evidence comes from 28 episodes of a coding agent attempting to rediscover a known particle identification observable in a Geant4 simulation, including an 8-episode probe across two additional frontier models. In 4/20 primary-model and 3/8 cross-model episodes, agents reach right-looking results through incorrect reasoning that breaks when conditions change, which we call Correct Answer, Wrong Mechanism (CAWM). Honesty and mechanism fidelity dissociate within a single agent trajectory. When given a partially misleading prior, all five agents reject the false component on evidence, yet one defends its chosen observable with physics inconsistent with its own data. In the simulation-based discovery setting studied here, coding agents prove reliable tools but unreliable scientific co-authors for open-ended claim-making, where co-author trust requires mechanism-fidelity verification they do not reliably self-apply. The failure is detectable, and we propose a lightweight test. A one-step regime-shift check needs only the agent's claim and flags the over-generalized cases. A companion recomputation flags the remaining cases when the correct observable is known. Together, these checks flag every CAWM case in this study.
papers.comment: 8 pages body plus 12 pages references and appendix, non-archival upload for ICML 2026 AI for Science workshop, selected as spotlight paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以立场论文形式指出，当前对AI科学家系统的评估仅关注最终答案是否正确，忽略了机制保真度和认知诚实性。通过28次编码代理在Geant4模拟中重新发现已知粒子识别观测量的实验，发现4/20主模型和3/8跨模型场景中存在“答案正确但机制错误”（CAWM）现象，即代理得出看似正确的结果但推理过程错误，且条件变化时失败。作者提出轻量级测试（单步机制变化检查和相关重新计算）可检测所有CAWM案例。
Motivation: 当前AI科学家系统常被描述为工具、合著者或创始人，但评估仅看最终答案。这种做法忽视了推理过程的正确性和诚实性，可能导致不可靠的科学主张。
Method: 通过28次编码代理实验，涉及Geant4模拟中重新发现已知粒子识别观测量，并使用8次跨模型探针（包括前沿模型）。提出两项检测：一是单步机制变化检查，二是当正确观测量已知时进行重新计算。
Result: 在4/20主模型和3/8跨模型场景中，代理出现CAWM现象；所有代理能在部分误导性先验下基于证据拒绝错误假设，但其中一个代理用与自身数据矛盾的物理理由维护其选择的观测量。所提检测方法能标记所有CAWM案例。
Conclusion: 在基于模拟的科学发现中，编码代理是可靠的工具，但作为开放式声明制定的科学合著者不可靠，因其无法自身可靠地应用机制保真度验证。失败可检测，所提轻量级测试有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Substitution-Based Analysis of Structural Novelty for Generative Models of Materials
papers.abstract_en: There has been rapid progress in generative artificial intelligence (AI) models for inorganic crystal design, which can efficiently generate large numbers of candidate compounds after being trained on databases of known crystals. However, it remains unclear whether they genuinely expand the accessible materials search space beyond conventional strategies such as elemental substitution within known structure types. We address this question by developing a workflow to assess whether AI-generated crystals are duplicates of training structures, reproducible by elemental substitution, or unmatched by either criterion. Applying this workflow to representative generative models reveals that 81-92% of chemically valid and metastable generated crystals are either training duplicates or substitution-derived structures. This tendency is particularly strong in high-symmetry crystal systems, even though many possible structural prototypes remain unexplored. Further analysis of the underlying structural fingerprints shows that low-symmetry structures beyond duplication or substitution can be interpreted as interpolation in training-data-rich regions, while high-symmetry duplicates appear to result from memorisation in training-sparse regions. Our findings highlight a limitation in the current generation of models that exhibit a bias towards known structural prototypes in the high symmetry regions, but enable wider exploration of the low-symmetry structural space.
papers.comment: 27 pages (20 pages of main text). See https://github.com/WMD-group/xtaledit for the code
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无机晶体生成AI模型是否真正拓展新材料搜索空间的问题，开发了一个工作流来评估生成晶体是训练重复、元素替换可复现还是两者均不匹配。应用于代表性生成模型发现81-92%的化学有效且亚稳态的生成晶体是训练重复或替换结构，特别是高对称晶系中。低对称结构可通过插值解释，高对称重复则源于记忆。
Motivation: 现有的无机晶体生成AI模型在训练后能生成大量候选化合物，但其是否真正拓展了搜索空间，超越了传统的元素替换策略，尚不清楚。
Method: 开发一个工作流，将生成晶体分类为训练重复、元素替换可复现或两者均不匹配。
Result: 对代表性生成模型的分析显示，81-92%的化学有效且亚稳态的生成晶体是训练重复或替换结构。高对称晶系中这一倾向更强。
Conclusion: 当前模型在高对称区域倾向于已知结构原型，但在低对称结构空间能进行更广泛的探索。

papers.title: Decomposing Financial Market Dynamics via Mechanism Analysis in an Evolutionary Multi-Agent Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Evolutionary agent-based markets (ABMs) couple several mechanisms -- who reproduces, how price forms, how biased the agents are, how consensus propagates -- yet these are usually fixed by convention, so it is unclear which mechanism controls which emergent property. In a coevolving, endogenous-price simulator with 120 heterogeneous behavioral agents, we make four mechanisms pluggable and run matched 3x20-seed interventions. We find the levers are largely separable. (1) Selection -> diversity: a Quality-Diversity (QD/MAP-Elites) operator robustly raises strategy-mix entropy over truncation top-k (paired Delta entropy +0.27 to +1.12 bits; sign-test p<0.001; CIs exclude 0) and sustains more strategy cycling (strongest in crisis: Delta=+0.070, p=0.0004). (2) Selection does not improve realism: even a per-agent realism reward that provably steers selection does not raise 5-fact realism (Delta_5=-0.11,-0.08,+0.03; not significant). (3) Microstructure -> realism: enabling reflexive price feedback does raise realism (Delta_5=+0.13,+0.20,+0.20; crisis/bull p<0.05, all CIs positive). (4) Behavior -> fragility: amplifying behavioral bias raises a genomic fragility proxy (Delta=+10.5,+11.1,+14.4; bull p<0.001, all CIs positive) while leaving realism flat. The remaining mechanism -- consensus network topology -- shows no robust effect (honest null). The contribution is a decomposition: in these single-mechanism sweeps the mechanisms behave as approximately distinct control knobs over diversity, realism, and fragility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一个包含120个异质行为主体的协同进化内生价格模拟器，将四种机制（选择、微观结构、行为、共识网络）设为可插拔，并进行匹配的3×20种子干预实验。结果发现机制大致可分离：选择影响多样性，微观结构提升现实性，行为放大脆弱性，共识网络无显著作用。
Motivation: 进化Agent-based市场（ABM）耦合了多种机制，但通常固定不变，导致不清楚哪种机制控制哪种涌现特性，因此需要解耦分析。
Method: 在协同进化、内生价格模拟器中，将四种机制设为可插拔，进行匹配的3×20种子干预实验，测量多样性、现实性和脆弱性等指标。
Result: 选择机制通过质量-多样性算子显著提高策略熵（配对Δ熵+0.27至+1.12比特，p<0.001），但不提高现实性；微观结构（反射性价格反馈）提高现实性（Δ_5=+0.13,+0.20,+0.20，危机/牛市p<0.05）；行为偏差放大脆弱性（Δ=+10.5,+11.1,+14.4，牛市p<0.001）；共识网络无稳健效应。
Conclusion: 这些单机制扫描表明机制大致作为独立控制旋钮分别影响多样性、现实性和脆弱性，贡献在于解耦了金融市场动态中的关键机制。

papers.title: Neural Parameter Calibration for Finite-State Mean Field Games
papers.abstract_en: Mean field games efficiently approximate a very large population of strategic agents. While these games can aid the understanding of complex systems, their deployment in real-world settings is challenged by the specification of their parameters: mean field games (MFGs) often involve hidden preferences, constraints, and interactions that can rarely be theoretically derived or directly observed. To address this gap, we present a neural network-based framework for learning parametric, finite-state MFGs from observed population dynamics. To do so, we formulate the parameter calibration as an inverse problem and use implicit differentiation to backpropagate through the games' equilibrium. The resulting approach is fully differentiable and enables us to estimate flexible trajectory-wise parameter paths, including state- and time-dependent specifications without requiring observations of the individual agents' actions or rewards. We provide a proof for the exactness of the gradient computation in a discrete-time formulation. We validate our framework through numerical experiments across four systems of increasing complexity, ranging from synthetic linear-quadratic benchmarks to real-world urban mobility datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于神经网络的框架，用于从观测到的群体动态中校准有限状态平均场博弈（MFG）的参数。该方法将参数校准视为逆问题，利用隐式微分通过博弈均衡进行反向传播，实现完全可微的轨迹参数路径估计，无需个体动作或奖励观测。在四个系统（包括合成线性二次基准和真实城市移动数据集）上验证了框架的有效性，并提供了离散时间梯度计算的精确性证明。
Motivation: 平均场博弈在实际部署中面临参数难以理论推导或直接观测的问题（如隐藏偏好、约束和相互作用），限制了其在真实场景中的应用。
Method: 将参数校准建模为逆问题，采用神经网络框架并通过隐式微分（implicit differentiation）反向传播通过博弈均衡，实现端到端可微的参数学习。支持状态和时间依赖的轨迹路径估计。
Result: 在四个复杂度递增的系统上验证：从合成线性二次基准到真实城市移动数据集，展示了框架的学习能力和泛化性。
Conclusion: 论文证明离散时间下梯度计算的精确性，表明该方法可有效从群体动态数据中校准MFG参数，无需个体级观测。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一个基于神经网络的框架，用于从观测到的群体动态中校准有限状态平均场博弈（MFG）的参数。该方法将参数校准视为逆问题，利用隐式微分通过博弈均衡进行反向传播，实现完全可微的轨迹参数路径估计，无需个体动作或奖励观测。在四个系统（包括合成线性二次基准和真实城市移动数据集）上验证了框架的有效性，并提供了离散时间梯度计算的精确性证明。
summary_sections.motivation: 平均场博弈在实际部署中面临参数难以理论推导或直接观测的问题（如隐藏偏好、约束和相互作用），限制了其在真实场景中的应用。
summary_sections.method: 将参数校准建模为逆问题，采用神经网络框架并通过隐式微分（implicit differentiation）反向传播通过博弈均衡，实现端到端可微的参数学习。支持状态和时间依赖的轨迹路径估计。
summary_sections.result: 在四个复杂度递增的系统上验证：从合成线性二次基准到真实城市移动数据集，展示了框架的学习能力和泛化性。

papers.title: Weighted Score-Oriented Losses for Temporally Localized Event Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Operational event-detection systems are rarely assessed by pointwise accuracy alone. In anomaly detection, changepoint detection, and warning systems, the utility of an alarm depends on its temporal position relative to an event. This produces a score-loss mismatch. Neural networks are commonly trained with classical loss functions, such as cross-entropy, whereas deployment decisions are obtained by thresholding network predictions, merging alarms through post-processing rules, and evaluating them with event-based metrics defined by detection windows and false-alarm costs. This paper studies a temporally localized specialization of weighted score-oriented loss (wSOL) for event prediction. Starting from score-oriented losses based on expected confusion matrices and from the weighted SOL framework of Marchetti et al., we consider temporal weights that discount near-event false positives and reduce false-negative penalties when an event is preceded by an admissible alarm. The resulting objective is differentiable with respect to the network predictions, and therefore can be optimized by back-propagation. It can be instantiated with balanced accuracy, true skill statistic, F1, critical success index, and related confusion-matrix scores. We evaluate the proposed approach by comparing cross-entropy, unweighted score-oriented loss, and wSOL on three benchmark datasets for time-series event prediction and detection. The results show that wSOL can improve performance when the evaluation utility is localized in time and is not already encoded by the pointwise labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对事件检测系统中评分损失不匹配问题，提出时域局部化的加权分数导向损失（wSOL），通过时间权重折扣近事件假阳性并降低假阴性惩罚，该损失可微分且支持多种混淆矩阵评分，在三个时间序列预测基准上优于交叉熵和未加权SOL。
Motivation: 现有事件检测系统训练时使用逐点损失（如交叉熵），而评估时使用基于检测窗口和假警报成本的事件级指标，导致训练与评估目标不一致。
Method: 从期望混淆矩阵的分数导向损失出发，引入时间权重：对接近事件的假阳性给予较低权重，对事件前有可接受警报的假阴性降低惩罚，形成可微的加权SOL，可通过反向传播优化，支持平衡准确率、TSS、F1、CSI等指标。
Result: 在三个时间序列事件预测/检测基准数据集上，wSOL相比交叉熵和未加权SOL提升了性能，尤其是当评估效用随时间局部化且并非由逐点标签编码时。
Conclusion: 时域局部化的加权SOL能有效改进事件预测的实用检测性能，适用于对警报时间位置敏感的预警系统。

papers.title: Koshur Pixel: a large-scale synthetic ocr dataset for kashmiri
papers.abstract_en: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) for low-resource languages is often constrained by the lack of annotated training data and the complexity of script-specific rendering. Kashmiri, written primarily in the Perso-Arabic Nastaliq script, presents additional challenges due to contextual glyph shaping, dense ligatures, and orthographic variability. We introduce Koshur Pixel, the first large-scale synthetic OCR dataset for Kashmiri, comprising 613,078 image-text pairs generated from the KS-PRET-5M corpus using the SynthOCR-Gen framework. The dataset spans multiple fonts and textual granularities, ranging from individual words to full-page documents, and incorporates more than 25 augmentation strategies that emulate real-world document degradations. Koshur Pixel provides a scalable and cost-effective alternative to manual annotation, establishing a foundational resource for training OCR systems, digitizing Kashmiri textual heritage, and advancing language technologies for a severely under-resourced language.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了Koshur Pixel，首个大规模克什米尔语合成OCR数据集，包含613,078个图像-文本对，基于KS-PRET-5M语料库和SynthOCR-Gen框架生成。数据集涵盖多种字体和文本粒度，并应用了超过25种数据增强策略以模拟真实文档退化。
Motivation: 克什米尔语（使用波斯-阿拉伯纳斯塔利克体）缺乏标注训练数据，且脚本渲染复杂（如上下文字形变形、密集连字和正字法变体），限制了OCR技术的发展。
Method: 利用KS-PRET-5M语料库和SynthOCR-Gen框架生成合成图像-文本对，涵盖单词到整页文档等多种粒度，并采用超过25种数据增强策略模拟真实文档退化。
Result: 构建了包含613,078个图像-文本对的克什米尔语OCR数据集，为低资源语言的OCR系统训练和数字化提供了基础资源。
Conclusion: Koshur Pixel为克什米尔语OCR提供了一种可扩展且成本有效的替代方案，有助于促进该语言的语言技术发展。

papers.title: LLM-Aided A* Search in Non-Geometric Network Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Finding the shortest path in non-geometric network graphs, where edge weights encode arbitrary metrics such as latency or monetary cost rather than spatial distance, poses a challenge for informed search algorithms. Their efficiency depends on an informative heuristic, typically supplied in spatial domains by geometric distances that have no counterpart on non-geometric graphs. We propose a large language model (LLM)-aided A* algorithm in which an LLM generates intermediate waypoints that guide the A* expansion toward promising graph regions. At the core of the approach are landmark distances, which serve both as an admissible landmark-based (ALT) heuristic for the search and as a compact structural feature that, supplied to the LLM, restores the distance-to-destination signal it would otherwise lack on non-geometric graphs. Our comprehensive experiments on multiple graph topologies with up to 2,000 nodes demonstrate that LLM-generated waypoints reduce the number of expanded nodes by around 50% while incurring only a marginal path cost increase compared to the optimal solution. We further analyze the impact of prompt engineering and show that incorporating compact structural features, namely heuristic estimates, is more effective than advanced prompting techniques. These findings demonstrate the potential of combining LLM- based guidance with classical search algorithms for efficient network optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LLM辅助的A*算法，用于非几何网络图中的最短路径搜索。通过LLM生成中间路径点，结合地标距离作为可容许启发式函数，在多达2000节点的多种图拓扑上，减少约50%的扩展节点，路径代价增加很小。
Motivation: 非几何网络图中，传统启发式搜索因缺乏几何距离作为启发式而效率低下，需新的启发式来源。
Method: 提出LLM辅助A*算法，使用LLM根据紧凑结构特征（地标距离）生成中间路径点，引导搜索方向，同时结合ALT启发式保持可容许性。
Result: 在多种图拓扑（最多2000节点）上，扩展节点数减少约50%，路径代价接近最优。
Conclusion: 结合LLM指导与经典搜索算法可高效优化网络，且紧凑结构特征比先进提示工程更有效。

papers.title: T-VSS: Test-Time Visual Subspace Steering for Adversarial Robustness of Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong zero-shot recognition, but they remain highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Recent test-time adaptations improve robustness without retraining, but they do not directly adapt the corrupted visual representation itself. Prompt-based methods adapt the learnable text prompts, while input-space methods optimize pixels or padding at test time. These approaches can improve predictions, but they do so through an indirect and expensive optimization path. We propose Test-time Visual Subspace Steering (T-VSS), a lightweight defense that performs test-time adaptation directly in the visual feature space. T-VSS first builds a sample-specific low-rank subspace from multi-view feature residuals anchored at the attacked image. It then learns a shared feature correction within this subspace using reliability-weighted entropy minimization. By constraining adaptation to a compact visual geometry, T-VSS steers attacked features toward more stable and discriminative predictions while avoiding noisy full-space updates. Experiments on fine-grained, ImageNet, and ImageNet-OOD benchmarks show that T-VSS improves adversarial robustness while maintaining competitive clean accuracy and better efficiency than prior test-time adaptations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出测试时视觉子空间引导（T-VSS），一种轻量级防御方法，直接在视觉特征空间中进行测试时适应，以提升视觉语言模型对对抗扰动的鲁棒性。T-VSS通过构建攻击图像的样本特定低秩子空间，并在该子空间内使用可靠性加权熵最小化学习共享特征校正，从而避免全空间噪声更新。实验在细粒度、ImageNet和ImageNet-OOD基准上证明，T-VSS在保持干净精度的同时提高了对抗鲁棒性，并比先前测试时适应方法更高效。
Motivation: 现有测试时适应方法通过调整文本提示或优化输入像素来间接改善对抗鲁棒性，但未直接适应被破坏的视觉表示，且优化路径间接且昂贵。
Method: T-VSS首先从攻击图像的锚定多视图特征残差中构建样本特定的低秩子空间，然后在该子空间内通过可靠性加权熵最小化学习共享特征校正，从而在紧凑视觉几何约束下引导攻击特征向更稳定和判别性的预测方向修正。
Result: 在细粒度、ImageNet和ImageNet-OOD基准上，T-VSS提高了对抗鲁棒性，同时保持有竞争力的干净精度，并比先前测试时适应方法更高效。
Conclusion: T-VSS通过直接在视觉特征空间中进行测试时适应，并限制在低秩子空间中，平衡了鲁棒性、干净精度和效率。

papers.title: Expert Consensus on Criteria for the Automated Assessment of Laparoscopic Camera Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Background: Laparoscopic camera navigation (LCN) is a critical skill, yet its current assessment typically relies on manual rating systems which are time-consuming and difficult to scale. Automated feedback could significantly enhance surgical training by providing immediate, standardized metrics. This study aims to define, clinically evaluate the relevance, and establish the technical readiness of a set of approaches for LCN assessment. Methods: We developed a detailed taxonomy of 14 key aspects of camera navigation, categorized into Framing & Composition, Visibility & Clarity, Orientation & Stability, Motion & Dynamics, and Safety & Awareness. For each aspect, we assessed the technological readiness of automated measurement based on the current state of the art (SoTA) in computer vision (CV). To establish clinical relevance, we designed a survey for practicing laparoscopic surgeons to rate the importance of each aspect on a 5-point Likert scale and to select the five most critical skills. Results: 23 surgeons participated in the survey. Foundational aspects like Field of View, Focus and Centering were rated as most important by surgeons. We present a "Clinical Importance vs. CV Technological Readiness" matrix, identifying high-priority targets for development--aspects that are both clinically crucial and technologically ready to measure. Conclusion: This work establishes a foundational framework for quantifying LCN skills. By aligning surgeon priorities with CV capabilities, we provide a clear roadmap for automatic skill assessment. This foundation enables the development of AI-driven assistance tools that can accelerate the learning curve for surgical assistants and potentially improve surgical safety and efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一套用于腹腔镜摄像头导航（LCN）技能自动评估的14个关键方面分类体系，并通过外科医生调查评估其临床重要性，同时基于计算机视觉技术现状评估了自动测量的技术成熟度。
Motivation: 当前LCN技能评估依赖人工评分，耗时且难以规模化，亟需自动化反馈方法来提升手术培训效果。
Method: 开发了包含14个关键方面的分类体系（如视野、对焦、居中、稳定性等），通过23名外科医生的问卷调查确定临床重要性，并结合当前计算机视觉技术水平评估自动化测量的可行性。
Result: 外科医生认为视野、对焦和居中等基础方面最重要；生成了“临床重要性 vs 计算机视觉技术成熟度”矩阵，识别出优先开发的高优先级目标。
Conclusion: 该研究为量化LCN技能提供了基础框架，通过对齐外科医生优先级与计算机视觉能力，为自动技能评估和AI辅助培训工具的开发指明了方向。

papers.title: Spectral Gating via Damped Oscillations for Adaptive Implicit Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have been proven successful in encoding continuous signals through coordinate-based networks, yet facing a spectral dilemma: periodic activations capture fine details but act as all-pass filters that memorise noise, while spatially compact activations regularise effectively but suffer from low-frequency bias. Existing attempts to resolve this trade-off introduce computational overhead or tuning frailty. We propose to model each neuron's activation as the steady-state response of a sinusoidally-forced damped harmonic oscillator, whose amplitude naturally governs the network's spectral selectivity during training. By jointly optimising the oscillator parameters alongside the network weights, our method adapts to the target signal's spectral content without explicit regularisation. Initialised in the stopband, the network exhibits a coarse-to-fine learning curriculum that progressively expands its spectral gate, capturing low-frequency structures first and high-frequency details only when justified by the reconstruction objective. Comprehensive experiments show that our approach consistently achieves state-of-the-art or competitive results against established INRs, while requiring no task-specific tuning of any hyperparameters.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Project Page: https://alex-costanzino.github.io/fdho/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的隐式神经表示（INR）方法，将每个神经元的激活建模为正弦力驱动阻尼谐振子的稳态响应，通过联合优化振荡器参数和网络权重，自适应控制频谱选择性，无需显式正则化或超参数调节，在多个任务上达到SOTA或竞争性结果。
Motivation: 现有INR面临频谱困境：周期激活函数能捕捉细节但会过拟合噪声，空间紧凑激活函数正则化好但存在低频偏置。现有解决方案计算开销大或调参困难。
Method: 将神经元激活建模为阻尼谐振子的稳态响应，振幅自然控制频谱选择性；联合优化振荡器参数和网络权重，初始处于阻带，训练过程中频谱门逐渐扩展，实现由粗到细的学习课程。

papers.title: Managing Procedural Memory in LLM Agents: Control, Adaptation, and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Procedural memory is increasingly used to improve LLM agents on recurring workplace tasks, yet its ability to produce reusable skills remains poorly understood. We introduce AFTER, a benchmark of 382 realistic enterprise tasks spanning six professional roles and 22 procedural skills, designed to evaluate how skills transfer across tasks, roles, and model backbones. The benchmark includes controlled evaluation settings for local improvement, cross-task transfer, cross-role transfer, and cross-model generalization. Experiments show that procedural memory delivers consistent gains in industrial workflows: a single refinement round improves aggregate performance by 3.7-6.7 points, while skills evolved from diverse multi-model execution traces achieve 73.1% cross-model test accuracy, outperforming all single-model trace sources. We further find that some skills generalize broadly across tasks and models, whereas others become specialized to role-specific workflows and lose effectiveness under transfer. These results provide practical guidance for building, evaluating, and deploying procedural memory systems in production agent platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AFTER基准，包含382个企业任务和22个程序性技能，用于评估LLM智能体中程序性记忆的技能迁移能力。实验表明，程序性记忆在工业工作流中带来持续提升，单轮精修使整体性能提升3.7-6.7个点，多模型轨迹演化出的技能达到73.1%的跨模型测试准确率。
Motivation: 程序性记忆虽被广泛用于提升LLM智能体在重复工作场景中的表现，但其技能的可迁移性和泛化能力尚不明确。
Method: 构建AFTER基准，包含六个专业角色、22个程序性技能的382个企业任务，设计本地改进、跨任务迁移、跨角色迁移和跨模型泛化四种评估设置。
Result: 单轮精修使聚合性能提升3.7-6.7个点；基于多样多模型执行轨迹演化的技能实现73.1%跨模型测试准确率，优于所有单模型轨迹来源。

papers.title: MambaADv2: Evolving Duality-enhanced State Space Model for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: While recent advancements in anomaly detection have demonstrated the efficacy of CNN- and Transformer-based approaches, these architectures face inherent limitations: CNNs struggle to capture long-range dependencies, whereas Transformers suffer from quadratic computational complexity. Consequently, Mamba-based architectures have attracted considerable attention, as they successfully combine superior long-range dependency modeling with linear computational complexity. By critically rethinking the structural evolution across the Mamba lineage 1-3 series, this paper proposes MambaADv2, a framework tailored for multi-class unsupervised anomaly detection. MambaADv2 comprises a pre-trained encoder and a Mamba-inspired decoder, equipped with Duality-enhanced State Space (DSS) modules across multiple scales. The proposed DSS module effectively models both global dependencies and local representations by integrating parallel-cascaded Hybrid State Space (HSS) blocks and frequency-enhanced convolution operations. The structure of the Hybrid State Space (HSS) block is tailored by following the SSD-based Mamba lineage and incorporating Mamba3-style position-aware state-space modeling, leveraging the dual computational paths of linear recurrence and parallel matrix formulation to model local continuity and global contextual comparison, thereby better serving the core anomaly detection objective of precisely reconstructing normal representations while magnifying anomalous deviations. Additionally, we propose a semantics-adaptive progressive scanning strategy that decays scanning complexity along the feature pyramid.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MambaADv2，一个针对多类无监督异常检测的框架，包含预训练编码器和Mamba启发解码器，配备多尺度Duality-enhanced State Space (DSS)模块。DSS模块通过并行级联Hybrid State Space (HSS)块和频率增强卷积，同时建模全局依赖和局部表示。HSS块融合Mamba3的位置感知状态空间建模，利用线性递归和并行矩阵公式的双计算路径来建模局部连续性和全局上下文对比。还提出语义自适应渐进扫描策略，沿特征金字塔逐步降低扫描复杂度。
Motivation: CNN难以捕获长程依赖，Transformer计算复杂度为二次方，而Mamba兼具长程依赖建模和线性复杂度，但现有Mamba系列在异常检测中仍需改进结构设计。
Method: MambaADv2包括预训练编码器和Mamba启发解码器，核心是DSS模块，其内部包含并行级联的HSS块（基于SSD-Mamba并融入Mamba3位置感知）和频率增强卷积；以及语义自适应渐进扫描策略。
Result: 摘要声称该方法能精确重构正常表示并放大异常偏差，从而更好地服务异常检测目标，但未提供具体实验数据。
Conclusion: 通过重新审视Mamba系列的结构演进，提出的DSS模块和扫描策略有效提升了多类无监督异常检测性能。

papers.title: AI-Empowered UAV-Assisted Backscatter Localization and ISAC for Zero-Energy IoT: A Comprehensive Survey
papers.abstract_en: Zero-energy Internet of Things (IoT) enables passive or near-passive devices to operate on harvested energy rather than batteries. Backscatter communication (BackCom) supports this vision by enabling tags to transmit data via reflection and modulation of incident RF signals, but it suffers from weak reflections, double-path loss, limited coverage, direct-link interference, and dependence on external RF sources. Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can mitigate these limitations by acting as mobile carrier emitters, data collectors, relays, aerial receivers, mobile anchors, sensing platforms, and edge-intelligence nodes. Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) further enables the sharing of wireless resources for data transmission, localization, target sensing, and environmental awareness. This article surveys RF-based AI-empowered UAV-assisted backscatter localization and ISAC for zero-energy IoT. It reviews enabling technologies, presents a structured PRISMA-informed methodology, and develops a unified taxonomy covering network architectures, UAV roles, backscatter modes, RF sources, localization and sensing functions, AI techniques, and performance metrics. It also discusses UAV-assisted BackCom, passive localization, ISAC-enabled UAV-backscatter systems, and AI-driven optimization through comparative tables, quantitative trend analysis, coverage evaluation, and tutorial-style numerical illustrations. Finally, it identifies open challenges and future directions in realistic channel modeling, energy-neutral operation, benchmarking, reproducibility, scalable and trustworthy AI, security, privacy, hardware validation, and integration with RIS, MEC, digital twins, and 6G technologies.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于AI赋能的无人机辅助反向散射定位和集成感知与通信（ISAC）用于零能耗物联网的综合综述。文章回顾了使能技术，提出了统一的分类法，涵盖网络架构、无人机角色、反向散射模式、RF源、定位与感知功能、AI技术及性能指标，并通过比较表格、趋势分析、覆盖评估和数值示例进行讨论，最后指出开放挑战与未来方向。
Motivation: 零能耗物联网需要无源设备从环境能量中运行，反向散射通信（BackCom）存在弱反射、双路径损耗、覆盖有限等问题，无人机可缓解这些限制，ISAC进一步实现资源共享，但该交叉领域缺乏系统综述。
Method: 采用PRISMA指导的结构化方法，开发统一分类法，并通过比较表格、定量趋势分析、覆盖评估和教程式数值示例进行阐述。
Result: 综述覆盖了无人机辅助BackCom、无源定位、ISAC-enabled UAV-backscatter系统及AI驱动优化，识别出开放挑战如现实信道建模、能量中性操作、基准测试、可扩展可信AI、硬件验证及与RIS/MEC/数字孪生/6G集成等。
Conclusion: 本文为AI赋能的无人机辅助反向散射定位和ISAC在零能耗物联网领域提供了全面概述，并指出了未来研究方向。

papers.title: PRIDE: Privileged Information-enhanced Distillation for Empathetic Dialogue Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have demonstrated significant capabilities in generating diverse and context-aware responses for empathetic dialogue. However, their computational demands severely limit their deployment in resource-constrained environments. While knowledge distillation offers a promising compression solution, it often fails to transfer the nuanced understanding essential for empathy, as it overlooks the implicit contextual cues that guide human connection. To bridge this gap, we propose a \textbf{pr}ivileged \textbf{i}nformation-enhanced knowledge \textbf{d}istillation method for \textbf{e}mpathetic dialogue generation (PRIDE). Our method leverages privileged information, such as expert psychological annotations or future event summaries, which is available exclusively during training but unavailable at inference time. This allows us to transfer the teacher model's empathetic reasoning to smaller models without relying on extra inputs during deployment. Specifically, PRIDE has three key components: (1) An empathy-reasoning prompt that guides the teacher to explicitly decompose the empathetic process into understanding feelings and analyzing situations step-by-step; (2) A multi-source attention mechanism that directs the student to effectively integrate privileged information; (3) A dual-alignment loss that combines reversed Kullback-Leibler divergence and maximum mean discrepancy to ensure robust knowledge transfer at both logit and feature levels. Experiments on multi-modal and text-only datasets demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance, and in some cases matches or even surpasses larger teacher models in terms of accuracy and semantic relevance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRIDE方法，通过特权信息增强知识蒸馏来提高共情对话生成中小模型的表现。方法利用训练时可用而推理时不可用的专家心理注释等特权信息，结合共情推理提示、多源注意力和双重对齐损失，将大模型的共情推理迁移到小模型。实验表明，该方法在多模态和纯文本数据集上达到或超越教师模型的性能。
Motivation: 大语言模型在共情对话中表现优异，但计算开销大，难以部署在资源受限环境。现有知识蒸馏未能有效传递共情所需的细微理解，因为忽略了隐式上下文线索。
Method: 提出PRIDE，包含三个组件：(1) 共情推理提示，引导教师模型逐步分解共情过程；(2) 多源注意力机制，帮助学生模型有效整合特权信息；(3) 双对齐损失，结合反向KL散度和最大均值差异，在logit和特征层面实现鲁棒知识迁移。
Result: 在多模态和纯文本数据集上，PRIDE达到竞争性性能，有时匹配或超越更大的教师模型，在准确性和语义相关性上表现优异。
Conclusion: 该方法通过训练时使用特权信息（如专家心理注释），在不增加推理时输入的前提下，有效提升小模型的共情对话生成能力。

papers.title: The Fractal Neural Operator: Overcoming Spectral Bias in Chaotic Attractors via Prime-Harmonic Weierstrass Encodings
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models, particularly Transformers and Neural Operators, exhibit a well-documented "spectral bias," effectively acting as low-pass filters that smooth out high-frequency information. While benign in fluid dynamics, this bias is catastrophic for Chaotic Dynamical Systems, where the underlying strange attractor is characterized by fractal geometry and infinite spectral density. We introduce the Fractal Neural Operator (FNO), a novel architecture that utilizes a non-resonant prime number basis to approximate continuous dynamical systems. Unlike geometric encodings ($2^k$), which suffer from spectral gaps and resonance, our Harmonic Weierstrass Encoder injects infinite spectral resolution into the latent space. We demonstrate that FNO extends the valid prediction horizon of the Lorenz-63 system to 347 Lyapunov times, exceeding state-of-the-art Reservoir Computing baselines by a factor of 2.3x. These results suggest that "chaos" is not inherently unpredictable to neural networks, but rather requires non-differentiable, fractal embedding manifolds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度模型在混沌动力系统中因谱偏差（spectral bias）而无法捕捉高频信息的缺陷，提出分形神经算子（Fractal Neural Operator, FNO），利用非共振素数基和谐波魏尔斯特拉斯编码（Harmonic Weierstrass Encoder）在潜在空间注入无限谱分辨率。在Lorenz-63系统上，FNO将有效预测时域扩展至347个李雅普诺夫时间，超出当前最优的储层计算方法2.3倍，表明混沌对神经网络并非本质不可预测，而是需要非可微的分形嵌入流形。
Motivation: 现有神经算子（如Transformer）存在谱偏差，等效于低通滤波器，这在混沌动力系统中灾难性地导致高频信息丢失，而混沌吸引子的分形几何和无限谱密度要求模型能够处理高频信息。
Method: 提出FNO架构，使用非共振素数基（prime number basis）代替传统的几何编码（2^k），并设计谐波魏尔斯特拉斯编码器（Harmonic Weierstrass Encoder）将无限谱分辨率注入潜在空间，从而克服谱间隙和谐振问题。
Result: 在Lorenz-63混沌系统上，FNO实现了347个李雅普诺夫时间的有效预测，比当前最优储层计算方法（Reservoir Computing）好2.3倍。
Conclusion: 摘要认为混沌并非本质上不可预测，而是需要非可微的分形嵌入流形来捕捉系统的无限谱密度。该工作主要聚焦于理论证明和Lorenz系统验证，未涉及实际天气预报任务。

papers.title: A Matter of Time: Towards a General Theory of Agency
papers.abstract_en: Agency is often invoked in research on philosophy, biology, and cognitive science without a clear account of how it originates from material organization. Building on temporally parametrized (F, A)-systems, this paper develops a graded organizational theory of agency grounded in relational biology, physical biosemiotics, and process ontology. We argue that self-referential closure cannot be adequately conceived outside time: once the constitutive processes of a semantically closed organization are associated with distinct characteristic timescales, the organization unfolds into an out-of-sync dependency structure that can be formally redescribed as a history-dependent, revisable Asynchronous Dynamic Bayesian Network. This move allows for a principled distinction between autonomy, goal-directedness, agency, and open-endedness. Autonomy arises from precarious closure to efficient causation under material openness; goal-directedness from the maintenance of viability-supporting organization; agency appears when such organization acquires an endogenous anticipatory structure that selectively modulates organism-environment coupling in light of possible futures; open-endedness begins when this anticipatory organization can reconstruct its own future space of possibilities. Our framework reconciles Rosennean anticipation with organizational closure, restricts Markov blankets and active inference to derived formal redescriptions rather than first principles, and reinterprets computational enactivism in non-Fristonian terms. By deriving weaker temporalized organizations, our contribution outlines a hierarchy from proto-agential chemical systems to fully semantically closed agents, with implications for multicellular organisms, synthetic lifeforms, and neuroscience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于时间参数化的 (F, A)-系统，提出一个分级的行动者理论 (graded organizational theory of agency)，从关系生物学、物理生物符号学和过程本体论出发，论证自指闭合必须在时间中理解。通过将语义闭合组织的构成过程与不同特征时间尺度关联，得到异步动态贝叶斯网络，从而区分自主性、目标导向、行动者和开放性，并推导出从原行动化学系统到完全语义闭合行动者的层级。
Motivation: 现有研究在哲学、生物学和认知科学中频繁使用 'agency' 概念，但缺乏从物质组织中如何产生的清晰理论。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 构建基于时间参数化的 (F, A)-系统，利用关系生物学和过程本体论，通过引入时间尺度将语义闭合组织的自指结构转化为异步动态贝叶斯网络，从而定义从自主性到开放性的层级，并调和 Rosennean 预期与组织闭合。
Result: 本文为纯理论工作，未提供数值实验结果。
Conclusion: 该框架导出了从原行动化学系统到完全语义闭合行动者的层级，对多细胞生物、合成生命和神经科学具有启示意义。

papers.title: Temporal-Spectral Alignment with Frequency Adaptation for Source-Free Time-Series Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: The goal of source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) for time-series data is to transfer knowledge from a pre-trained source model to an unlabeled target domain without requiring access to source data, while addressing feature shift and temporal drift inherent in the signals. Although existing approaches have explored temporal dynamics in unsupervised source-free adaptation, they largely overlook spectral shifts in time-series data. Towards this end, we propose a novel approach termed temporal-Spectral Alignment with Frequency Adaptation (SAFA) for source-free time-series domain adaptation. Specifically, we first model the source domain at multiple scales by jointly capturing temporal dependencies and spectral characteristics. To adapt time-series data in the target domain, we introduce a trainable frequency adaptation module that modulates the phase and amplitude of target signals in the frequency domain to align them with the source distribution. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate the efficacy and robustness of SAFA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对源无关时间序列领域自适应（SFDA）问题，提出时序-频谱对齐与频率自适应方法（SAFA），通过多尺度建模源域的时间依赖与频谱特性，并引入可训练的频率自适应模块在频域调整目标信号的相位和幅度，以对齐目标与源分布。多个基准实验验证了方法的有效性与鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有源无关时间序列自适应方法主要关注时间动态，忽视了信号中的频谱偏移，导致域对齐不充分。
Method: 首先对源域进行多尺度建模，联合捕获时序依赖与频谱特征；然后在目标域中引入可训练的频率自适应模块，通过调整目标信号在频域的相位和幅度来匹配源分布。
Result: 在多个时间序列基准数据集上，SAFA方法取得了优于对比方法的域适应性能，并展现出鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 时间序列领域自适应中频谱偏移不可忽视，频率自适应是一种有效的对齐策略。

papers.title: LUMINA-26: Low-Light Understanding for Modeling and Interpreting Night-time Actions
papers.abstract_en: Low-light human action recognition remains a challenging problem due to poor illumination, amplified noise, motion ambiguity, and diverse real-world scenes. Existing low-light datasets often lack sufficient action diversity, capture realism, or balanced class distribution, limiting the development of robust models. To address this, we introduce LUMINA-26: Low-Light Understanding for Modeling and Interpreting Night-time Actions, comprising 6,784 clips across 26 action classes, recorded from 22 subjects across 20 indoor and outdoor locations under naturally occurring low-light conditions. We also propose Illumi-Net: An Illumination-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts Network, which leverages video-level illumination cues to guide adaptive enhancement and transformer-based spatio-temporal feature extraction, with expert-conditioned decision fusion. Our method surpasses previous state-of-the-art performance on ELLAR (Top-1: 55.13%, Top-5: 78.87%) and establishes a strong baseline on LUMINA-26 (Top-1: 75.95%, Top-5: 93.58%), offering a practical benchmark for future low-light action recognition research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低光照环境下人类动作识别难题，提出了LUMINA-26数据集（包含6,784个视频片段、26个动作类别，在自然低光条件下采集），并设计了Illumi-Net网络，利用视频级光照线索引导自适应增强与基于Transformer的时空特征提取，通过专家条件决策融合。在ELLAR数据集上达到Top-1 55.13%、Top-5 78.87%，在LUMINA-26上达到Top-1 75.95%、Top-5 93.58%。

papers.title: Technical Report for the ICRA 2026 GOOSE 2D Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentation Challenge: Pretraining-Diverse Ensemble of Foundation Vision Encoders for Robust Outdoor Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: This report presents our solution for the ICRA 2026 GOOSE 2D Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentation Challenge, which requires parsing unstructured outdoor scenes from four camera platforms into 56 fine-grained categories. Our approach pairs foundation vision encoders (including DINOv3, SigLIP2, and InternImage) with a Mask2Former decoder, and trains them with a strong recipe including long training schedules, exponential moving average, a larger crop size, and multi-scale plus flip test-time augmentation. The three encoders, chosen for their complementary pretraining objectives, are combined into a pretraining-diverse ensemble through per-class validation-IoU weighting. Evaluated on the official GOOSE test set, our submission achieves 75.40% composite mIoU and wins the second place of the challenge. Our study further shows that the encoder's pretraining recipe, rather than its parameter count or the decoder design, is the dominant factor for accuracy on this benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了在ICRA 2026 GOOSE 2D细粒度语义分割挑战赛中的解决方案。该方法结合多个基础视觉编码器（DINOv3、SigLIP2、InternImage）与Mask2Former解码器，通过长训练策略、指数移动平均、大裁剪尺寸和多尺度翻转测试增强，并以每类验证IoU加权集成编码器，最终在GOOSE测试集上达到75.40% composite mIoU，获得第二名。研究表明编码器的预训练方式比参数量或解码器设计对精度影响更大。
Motivation: 挑战需要从四个摄像头平台解析非结构化户外场景，划分为56个细粒度类别，现有方法在细粒度语义分割上仍有提升空间，特别是编码器预训练策略的影响尚未充分探索。
Method: 使用三个基础视觉编码器（DINOv3、SigLIP2、InternImage）作为共享特征提取器，连接Mask2Former解码器；采用长训练调度、EMA、更大裁剪尺寸、多尺度+翻转测试增强；通过每类验证IoU加权集成三个编码器的预测。
Result: 在GOOSE测试集上获得75.40% composite mIoU，排名第二；实验表明编码器预训练配方（而非参数量或解码器）是精度主导因素。
Conclusion: 该方案证明集成预训练多样性的视觉编码器能有效提升户外场景细粒度语义分割性能，为后续研究提供基线。

papers.title: Self-Evolution for Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents via Divergence-Point Preference Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn tool-using agents must coordinate long-horizon tool sequences while tracking dialogue state and policy constraints. Existing approaches often separate inference-time orchestration from parameter-level learning, leaving tool selection weakly structured and preference updates vulnerable to train--deployment prompt mismatch. For within-benchmark self-improvement, ToolGraph combines schema-derived topology, transition weights estimated from successful rollouts, and history-aware controls for write prerequisites and repeated-search loops. We then construct 161 preference pairs by locating divergence points via state-based matching and prefix-based alignment, filtered through action-correctness annotations, and train DPO under the same ToolGraph context used at inference. Across 375 tau2-bench tasks, ToolGraph raises the weighted average reward from 0.304 to 0.338 (+11.2% relative), while ToolGraph+DPO reaches 0.355 (+16.8% over the baseline), with the DPO gain concentrated in airline and retail. Fine-grained diagnostics further show that roughly half of telecom trajectories exhaust the step budget before action execution and that chosen reward positivity is the most useful checkpoint signal across our 16 evaluated DPO configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ToolGraph框架，用于多轮工具调用代理的自我进化。ToolGraph通过模式推导的拓扑结构、成功轨迹的转移权重以及历史感知控制（写入前提和重复搜索循环）来结构化工具选择。然后，通过状态匹配和前缀对齐定位分歧点，构建161个偏好对，并在推理时相同的ToolGraph上下文中训练DPO。在375个tau2-bench任务上，ToolGraph将加权平均奖励从0.304提升至0.338（+11.2%），ToolGraph+DPO达到0.355（+16.8%），DPO增益集中在航空和零售领域。
Motivation: 多轮工具使用代理需要协调长程工具序列，同时跟踪对话状态和策略约束。现有方法通常将推理时的编排与参数级学习分离，导致工具选择结构薄弱，偏好更新容易受到训练-部署提示不匹配的影响。
Method: 提出ToolGraph框架，结合模式推导的拓扑结构、成功轨迹的转移权重和历史感知控制（写入前提和重复搜索循环）。然后，通过状态匹配和前缀对齐定位分歧点，基于动作正确性注释过滤，构建161个偏好对，并在推理时相同的ToolGraph上下文中训练DPO。
Result: 在375个tau2-bench任务上，ToolGraph将加权平均奖励从0.304提升至0.338（+11.2%相对提升），ToolGraph+DPO达到0.355（+16.8%相对提升），DPO增益集中在航空和零售领域。详细诊断显示，约一半的电信轨迹在执行动作前耗尽步骤预算，且所选奖励正性是最有用的检查点信号。
Conclusion: 摘要强调ToolGraph结合DPO可以有效提升多轮工具调用代理的性能，但增益因领域而异，且电信领域存在步骤预算耗尽问题。

papers.title: LOLLA: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Closed-Loop Link Adaptation Towards a GPU-Accelerated AI-RAN
papers.abstract_en: Outer-loop link adaptation (OLLA) is widely deployed in 5G NR to track channel variations, yet its reliance on first-order, single-bit feedback degrades performance significantly under high-mobility and fast-varying channels. This paper presents LOLLA (Learned Outer-Loop Link Adaptation), a deep reinforcement learning framework that replaces the conventional OLLA staircase with a learned, continuous SINR offset conditioned on rich PHY/MAC telemetry inaccessible to OLLA. The offset modulates the SINR-to-MCS lookup table, preserving 3GPP-compliant MCS selection and provably subsuming the conventional OLLA update rule. A Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) policy trained under a Lagrangian block error rate (BLER) constraint automatically enforces tunable reliability targets from 1% to 15% without manual penalty calibration. The framework is realized as the first closed-loop AI-native control dApp on a GPU-accelerated 5G NR stack, achieving end-to-end control latencies under 500 microseconds. Evaluations under 3GPP TDL channel models demonstrate 15% to 92% throughput gains over OLLA across Doppler frequencies up to 400 Hz, while attaining a Pareto frontier that strictly dominates OLLA across all evaluated reliability targets. The learned policy generalizes to unseen channel models and scales to eight concurrent UEs under shared-resource scheduling. In the uplink formulation, the gNB directly observes decoding outcomes, enabling simulation-to-deployment parity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LOLLA（Learned Outer-Loop Link Adaptation），一种基于深度强化学习的闭环链路自适应框架，用于5G NR。它用PPO策略学习连续的SINR偏移，替代传统OLLA阶梯函数，在GPU加速的AI-RAN上实现端到端控制延迟低于500微秒。在3GPP TDL信道模型下，相比OLLA实现15%-92%的吞吐量提升，且严格帕累托占优所有评估可靠性目标。
Motivation: 传统OLLA依赖一阶单比特反馈，在高移动性和快变信道下性能显著下降，无法充分利用丰富PHY/MAC遥测信息。
Method: 采用深度强化学习（PPO）训练SINR偏移策略，在拉格朗日BLER约束下自动调整目标可靠性（1%-15%），输出连续偏移调制SINR-to-MCS查找表，保持3GPP兼容的MCS选择，且理论上包含OLLA更新规则。
Result: 在3GPP TDL信道模型和多普勒频率高达400 Hz条件下，获得15%-92%的吞吐量增益；泛化到未见信道模型和8个并发UE共享资源调度；上行链路实现仿真到部署的一致性。
Conclusion: LOLLA作为首个在GPU加速5G NR栈上实现的闭环AI原生控制应用，证明了深度强化学习可替代传统OLLA，带来显著性能提升并严格支配现有方法。

papers.title: TTFT-Aware Graph Chain-of-Thought:Distance-Indexed Neural A* for Low-Hallucination Multi-Hop Medical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Hallucinations and opaque reasoning remain unacceptable failure modes for clinical LLMs. We present a production-grade GraphRAG stack that constrains answers to verifiable graph chain-of-thought paths in a heterogeneous, ~700K-node medical knowledge graph powering a fertility assistant. The core idea is targeted navigation: a directed Pruned Landmark Labeling (PLL) oracle provides exact distances for sub-millisecond feasibility checks and simple-path enumeration, while a lightweight AStarNet heuristic operates strictly within the PLL corridor to prioritize clinically plausible expansions. We score and pack a small, diverse set of paths (CUI/semantic-type overlap, length prior, provenance priors) to condition generation, yielding compact prompts and improved Time to First Token (TTFT). On fertility-focused queries, the hybrid (PLL+AStarNet) establishes a better latency/recall Pareto frontier than text-only RAG and single-component baselines, lowers TTFT, and reduces clinician-audited hallucinations while preserving explanation clarity. The result is a practical recipe for explainable, low-hallucination multi-hop medical reasoning ready for real-world deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种生产级GraphRAG系统，结合剪枝地标标记（PLL）与轻量AStarNet启发式搜索，在约70万节点的医学知识图谱中约束答案生成到可验证的图谱链式推理路径，以减少幻觉并提升推理透明度。系统在生育相关查询上实现了更优的延迟/召回率Pareto边界、更低的首令牌时间（TTFT）和更少的幻觉。
Motivation: 临床LLM存在幻觉和不透明推理问题，现有方法在保持解释清晰度同时降低幻觉方面仍有不足。
Method: 采用有向剪枝地标标记（PLL）提供精确距离实现亚毫秒可行性检查，并在此走廊内运行轻量AStarNet启发式搜索，优先临床合理扩展；通过CUI/语义类型重叠、长度先验和来源先验打包多样性路径以条件生成。
Result: 在生育查询上，混合系统（PLL+AStarNet）相比纯文本RAG和单一组件基线建立了更好的延迟/召回率Pareto前沿，降低了TTFT和临床审核的幻觉，同时保持解释清晰度。
Conclusion: 提出了一种可部署的低幻觉、可解释多跳医学推理的实用方案。

papers.title: Compression and Retrieval: Implicit Memory Retrieval for Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Video world models hold promise for simulating interactive environments, yet maintaining consistent long-term memory across complex camera trajectories remains a critical challenge. Existing methods typically rely on computationally expensive context scaling or rigid heuristic retrieval mechanisms, which lacks generalization to varying camera trajectories and environments. In this paper, we propose Compression and Retrieval (CaR), an attention-driven implicit memory retrieval mechanism to overcome these limitations. By injecting viewpoint information via positional encoding, our method performs flexible memory retrieval through attention computation. To efficiently process extended contexts with minimal computational overhead, we further introduce a lightweight context compression network. Furthermore, we construct SceneFly, a large-scale synthetic dataset featuring realistic camera trajectories and frame-level annotations to train and evaluate long-horizon video world models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on established benchmarks and exhibits strong generalization to open-domain scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Compression and Retrieval (CaR) 机制，通过注意力驱动的隐式记忆检索解决视频世界模型在复杂相机轨迹下的长期记忆保持问题。引入轻量级上下文压缩网络降低计算开销，并构建大规模合成数据集 SceneFly。实验显示在已有基准上达到 SOTA，并对开放域场景有强泛化。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖计算昂贵的上下文扩展或刚性启发式检索，难以泛化到不同相机轨迹和环境。
Method: 提出 CaR，通过位置编码注入视角信息，利用注意力计算进行灵活的记忆检索；使用轻量级上下文压缩网络高效处理长上下文。
Result: 在已有基准上达到 SOTA 结果，并在开放域场景中表现出强泛化能力。
Conclusion: CaR 提供了一种高效的隐式记忆检索方式，为长程视频世界模型提供了新方案。

papers.title: ReNIO: Reweighting Negative Trajectory Importance for LLM On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves LLM reasoning by training a student model on its own generated outputs, but standard OPD treats all student-generated outputs (SGOs) equally regardless of their informativeness. We observe a consistent asymmetry in controlled filtering experiments: in both OPD and on-policy self distillation (OPSD), training only on incorrect SGOs outperforms training only on correct ones. Our further analysis suggests that models trained on correct-only SGOs tend to generate shorter reasoning traces and show weaker reflection behavior, while incorrect SGOs better preserve exploratory reasoning near the model's capability boundary. To exploit this signal without requiring full answer-containing rollouts, we introduce ReNIO, which Reweights Negative trajectory Importance for LLM On-policy distillation. By using the student-to-teacher probability ratio, ReNIO identifies pivotal tokens leading to wrong reasoning traces and aggregates their information into a normalized sample weight, inherently assigning larger weights to likely negative trajectories without observing the correctness of final-answer. Since Re-NIO only uses prefix-conditioned token probabilities, it preserves OPD's prefix training advantage over full-rollout reinforcement learning. Across both mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks, ReNIO improves both OPD and OPSD, with representative relative gains of up to 8.90% for Qwen3-1.7B and 10.00% for R1-Distill-Qwen-7B on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Code repo: https://github.com/BDML-lab/ReNIO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中所有学生生成输出被同等对待的问题，提出ReNIO方法，通过对负轨迹进行重加权来提升蒸馏效果。实验表明，仅使用错误输出训练优于仅使用正确输出，ReNIO利用学生-教师概率比识别关键错误token并赋予更大权重，无需最终答案标签，在数学推理和代码生成任务上取得了显著提升。
Motivation: 标准在线策略蒸馏平等对待所有学生生成输出，但研究发现错误输出比正确输出包含更多信息性，能更好地保持探索性推理，而正确输出会导致推理链变短和反思行为减弱。
Method: ReNIO通过学生-教师概率比识别导致错误推理轨迹的关键token，将这些信息聚合为归一化样本权重，自动对可能的负轨迹赋予更大权重，且只依赖前缀条件概率，无需完整答案。
Result: 在数学推理和代码生成任务上，ReNIO分别提升了OPD和OPSD性能，代表相对增益：Qwen3-1.7B上达8.90%，R1-Distill-Qwen-7B上达10.00%。
Conclusion: ReNIO通过重加权负轨迹重要性，有效利用错误输出信号改进在线策略蒸馏，且保持了前缀训练优势，是一种轻量且有效的方法。

papers.title: Scene-agnostic ALS boresight self-calibration
papers.abstract_en: ALS boresight calibration has relied for two decades on dedicated flight patterns over structured scenes containing planar surfaces of varied aspect and slope. While reliable, this approach imposes constraints on the scene content and operations, which limits its applicability to boresight recovery within routine mapping missions. We present a practical approach that substantially relaxes these requirements by replacing plane-based constraints with scene-agnostic point-to-point correspondences extracted automatically from overlapping ALS strips. Two complementary formulations are proposed to estimate boresight with laser vector observations: (i) a simpler parametric adjustment utilizing INS/GNSS trajectory; (ii) a rigorous formulation treating GNSS and raw inertial data within an existing factor-graph, i.e. a dynamic network, where boresight is added as an additional parameter. Both formulations are evaluated across four operational ALS flights equipped with five inertial systems, covering a wide range of flight altitudes, overlap geometries, terrain types and inertial sensor classes. The analysis draws a clear boundary between the legacy plane-based conditioning that falls short outside the calibration scenario and the proposed formulations, which either recover or absorb boresight effects under conventional mapping geometry. Among them, the lightweight formulation is sufficient for boresight recovery using tactical and navigation grade inertial sensors, while the general factor-graph approach is clearly superior when the inertial sensor errors are less observable within an optimal smoother. This supports the hypothesis that, for INS/GNSS trajectory of sufficient quality, the boresight calibration can be performed without particular scene prerequisites during routine mapping operations using a minimum of 3-4 overlapping strips, with either proposed formulation...
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种场景无关的机载激光扫描（ALS）视准轴自校准方法，通过自动提取重叠ALS条带中的点对点对应关系，替代传统基于平面的校准要求。两种公式化方法（轻量级参数调整和基于因子图的严格方法）在四次飞行任务中验证，表明在常规测绘中无需特殊场景即可完成校准。
Motivation: 传统ALS视准轴校准依赖特定飞行模式和有结构场景（含平面），限制了常规测绘任务中的适用性。
Method: 利用重叠ALS条带自动提取场景无关的点对点对应关系，提出两种公式：（i）基于INS/GNSS轨迹的简单参数调整；（ii）在因子图中将视准轴作为附加参数的严格方法。
Result: 在四次飞行任务、五个惯性系统的评估中，轻量方法适用于战术和导航级惯性传感器，因子图方法在传感器误差可观测性低时更优；最小3-4条重叠条带即可在常规测绘中完成校准。
Conclusion: 对于足够质量的INS/GNSS轨迹，视准轴校准可在无特定场景前提下于常规测绘中实现，打破了传统场景依赖。

papers.title: Poisson2Gaussian: Noise Gaussianization to Enhance Image Denoising
papers.abstract_en: The quantum nature of light determines the inherent Poisson stochasticity of photon detection, which is ubiquitous in photography, microscopy, and astronomy. However, our controlled numerical studies reveal that the signal-dependency, heteroscedasticity, and statistical asymmetry of Poisson-mixed noise make it challenging for existing denoisers to learn. In contrast, i.i.d. Gaussian noise, with its statistical independence and symmetric distribution, is easier to model for networks. To address this gap, we propose Poisson2Gaussian (P2G), a noise Gaussianization method that explicitly converts complex real-world noise to i.i.d. Gaussian noise via probability density matching beyond low-order moments. We also design an unbiased denoising framework that synergizes P2G with downstream denoisers, ensuring convergence to the underlying signal without requiring paired clean data or explicit noise parameters. Extensive experiments demonstrate that P2G consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse datasets. In challenging scenarios where noise strongly deviates from Gaussian statistics, our method improves the PSNR by up to 0.75 dB. Notably, P2G is architecture-agnostic and can provide universal improvements for various denoisers. The source code will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Poisson2Gaussian (P2G) 噪声高斯化方法，将泊松混合噪声转换为独立同分布的高斯噪声，并通过无偏去噪框架与下游去噪器协同，无需配对干净数据或显式噪声参数。实验表明，在噪声严重偏离高斯统计的场景下，PSNR提升可达0.75 dB，且架构无关，可普遍提升各种去噪器性能。
Motivation: 现有去噪器难以处理泊松混合噪声的信号依赖性、异方差性和统计不对称性，而高斯噪声更易建模，因此需要一种将复杂噪声转化为高斯噪声的方法。
Method: 提出P2G，通过概率密度匹配（超越低阶矩）将真实噪声显式转化为i.i.d.高斯噪声，并设计无偏去噪框架，确保收敛到真实信号，无需配对干净数据或噪声参数。
Result: 在多种数据集上达到最先进性能，尤其在强非高斯噪声下PSNR提升高达0.75 dB。
Conclusion: P2G是架构无关的通用方法，可提升多种去噪器性能，代码将开源。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有去噪器难以处理泊松混合噪声的信号依赖性、异方差性和统计不对称性，而高斯噪声更易建模，因此需要一种将复杂噪声转化为高斯噪声的方法。
summary_sections.method: 提出P2G，通过概率密度匹配（超越低阶矩）将真实噪声显式转化为i.i.d.高斯噪声，并设计无偏去噪框架，确保收敛到真实信号，无需配对干净数据或噪声参数。
summary_sections.result: 在多种数据集上达到最先进性能，尤其在强非高斯噪声下PSNR提升高达0.75 dB。
summary_sections.conclusion: P2G是架构无关的通用方法，可提升多种去噪器性能，代码将开源。

papers.title: Minimax Quantile Lower Bounds for Interactive Statistical Decision Making with Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Minimax risk and regret are expectation-based criteria and do not capture rare but consequential failures. To address this concern, we develop a $δ$-explicit minimax-quantile theory for interactive statistical decision making (ISDM). We first provide structural relations between minimax quantiles, lower minimax quantiles, and minimax risk. This includes a quantile-to-expectation conversion and an equivalence between strict and lower minimax quantiles outside a countable set of confidence levels. We then derive two converse tools for ISDM: a high-probability interactive Fano's method and a high-probability interactive Le Cam's method. Then, we show that mutual-information (MI) privacy can be handled in the same framework by restricting the admissible decision class. For coordinatewise Gaussian privatization, we derive a two-point template that isolates the privacy-induced variance inflation. We instantiate this template for Gaussian mean estimation, and use the same two-point strategy directly for two-armed Gaussian bandits. We then derive a minimax quantile lower bound for the $K$-armed Gaussian bandit problem, showing that the interactive Fano method captures the exploration cost over multiple possible best arms. The resulting lower bounds are explicit in the confidence level $δ$ and in the privacy budget for the private problems. They yield $\log(1/δ)/n$ scaling for squared-error Gaussian mean estimation, $\sqrt{T\log(1/δ)}$ scaling for two-armed bounded-mean Gaussian bandits, and $\sqrt{KT\log(1/δ)}$-type scaling for the $K$-armed bandits, with privacy appearing through a Gaussian variance-inflation factor for the private problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对交互式统计决策中基于期望的 minimax 风险/遗憾无法捕捉罕见失败的问题，发展了 δ-显式 minimax 分位数理论。给出了 minimax 分位数与 minimax 风险之间的结构关系，包括分位数-期望转换和严格与下 minimax 分位数的等价性。推导了高概率交互式 Fano 方法和 Le Cam 方法，并将互信息隐私纳入同一框架。对于坐标高斯私有化，提出了两点模板，并应用于高斯均值估计和两臂/多臂高斯老虎机，得到显式依赖置信水平 δ 和隐私预算的下界。
Motivation: 传统基于期望的 minimax 风险/遗憾无法刻画罕见但严重的失败，需要能够在高概率下保证性能的决策准则。
Method: 发展了 δ-显式 minimax 分位数理论，包括结构关系、高概率交互式 Fano 和 Le Cam 方法，及针对互信息隐私的两点模板。
Result: 导出平方误差高斯均值估计的 log(1/δ)/n 缩放，两臂有界均值高斯老虎机的 √(T log(1/δ)) 缩放，以及 K 臂高斯老虎机的 √(KT log(1/δ)) 类型缩放，隐私通过高斯方差膨胀因子体现。
Conclusion: 提供了隐私保护交互式决策中最小最大分位数下界，显式依赖于置信水平和隐私预算，揭示了探索代价与隐私代价。
