papers.title: Generalized nonparametric regression in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces: Consistency and rates of convergence
papers.abstract_en: We develop a comprehensive theory for regularized M-estimation in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces. Under mild conditions on the loss we establish existence and measurability of the estimator, covering a wide range of convex and non-convex losses, including bounded robust losses. We further prove sharp rates of convergence with an explicit bias-variance decomposition governed by a novel complexity measure. We show that the variance is independent of misspecification, while the bias depends on a source condition parameter known in the learning literature. For tensor product Sobolev spaces we obtain new rates that connect to spaces of functions with dominating mixed smoothness, substantially extending existing results and explaining why these estimators circumvent the curse of dimensionality. Our methodology, combining elements from both functional analysis and empirical process theory, allows for an asymptotic linearisation of the objective function that avoids both closed-form solutions and global Lipschitz assumptions, and may be of independent interest. The estimators are implemented in C++ and theory is supported by numerical experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文建立了再生核希尔伯特空间中正则化M-估计的完整理论，在温和损失条件下证明了估计量的存在性和可测性，并推导出具有显式偏差-方差分解的尖锐收敛速率。通过张量积Sobolev空间的新速率，解释了这些估计量如何规避维数灾难。
Motivation: 现有非参数回归理论在处理非凸损失或鲁棒损失时存在空白，且对高维函数空间的收敛速率理解不足。
Method: 结合泛函分析与经验过程理论，对目标函数进行渐近线性化，避免闭式解和全局Lipschitz假设，提出新的复杂度度量来控制偏差-方差分解。
Result: 获得与源条件参数相关的偏差项和与误设定无关的方差项；在张量积Sobolev空间上得到连接优势混合光滑函数空间的新速率，超越现有结果。
Conclusion: 该理论框架统一了多种损失函数下的正则化M-估计，并为避免维数诅咒提供了理论解释，但方法依赖抽象泛函假设，实际实现需进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neural Architecture Search of Sample Reweighting Networks for Complex Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Sample reweighting is a major approach to addressing distribution shifts, such as label noise and class imbalance. Meta-Weight-Net (MW-Net) is a promising sample reweighting network that computes weights based on classification loss. Although MW-Net improves prediction performance under a single type of distribution shift using a simple neural network, its performance degrades when facing both label noise and class imbalance, where it is hard to determine appropriate weights solely from classification loss and using a simple network. In this study, we introduce neural architecture search to MW-Net to mitigate such performance degradation. Using the tree-structured Parzen estimator, we explore the optimal number of hidden layers and nodes and select the most suitable intermediate layer in the classification model to serve as the input for MW-Net. Experimental results on the CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 datasets that were modified to include both label noise and class imbalance demonstrate the effectiveness of neural architecture search for MW-Net.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Meta-Weight-Net (MW-Net) 在同时面临标签噪声和类别不平衡时性能下降的问题，引入神经架构搜索（NAS）自动优化MW-Net的网络结构。使用树结构Parzen估计器搜索隐藏层数和节点数，并选择分类模型中合适的中间层作为MW-Net输入。在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上模拟复合分布偏移的实验验证了NAS的有效性。
Motivation: 现有MW-Net在单一分布偏移下表现良好，但在标签噪声和类别不平衡同时存在时，仅靠分类损失难以确定合适权重，且简单网络结构容量不足，导致性能下降。
Method: 采用神经架构搜索（NAS）优化MW-Net，具体使用树结构Parzen估计器（TPE）搜索隐藏层数和节点数，并选择分类模型中最佳的中间层特征作为MW-Net的输入。
Result: 在人工引入标签噪声和类别不平衡的CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集上，NAS优化的MW-Net相比原始MW-Net提升了分类准确率。
Conclusion: 神经架构搜索能够有效提升MW-Net在复杂分布偏移下的样本重加权能力，但当前实验限于图像分类任务，未测试其他类型偏移或更大规模数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can Single-View Mesh Reconstruction Generalize to Robot Camera Rotation?
papers.abstract_en: Single-view mesh reconstruction predicts object meshes and spatial layouts from a single observation, making it attractive for fast robot spatial reasoning and real-to-sim digital twins. However, robot-mounted cameras naturally rotate during manipulation and navigation, while learned single-view reconstruction models often rely on view-dependent priors and may generalize poorly to out-of-distribution camera rotations. Such rotations can introduce 3D inconsistencies, incorrect layouts, and violations of physical constraints, but this failure mode remains under-evaluated. We introduce an evaluation protocol with controlled axis-wise roll, pitch, and yaw sweeps to trace errors in monocular depth estimation (MDE), canonical object meshes, camera-space layout, and physical plausibility within a representative SAM3D-style pipeline. On the Aria Digital Twin dataset and a real Franka wrist-camera sequence, camera rotations induce MDE distortion, layout drift, and collision penetration, while canonical mesh predictions remain relatively stable. A two-stage SAM3D+FoundationPose pipeline is more robust than one-stage feed-forward layout prediction, and our Gravity-Aware Refinement reduces one-stage pairwise ICP-based layout-orientation error by 47.1$\%$. Our evaluation reveals that current single-view mesh reconstruction methods generalize poorly to robot camera rotation, and suggests that explicit gravity cues are important for reliable robotic single-view mesh reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究单视图网格重建方法在机器人相机旋转下的泛化能力。作者发现现有方法对旋转泛化差，并提出评估协议和重力感知细化（Gravity-Aware Refinement）来改善布局朝向误差。实验表明，重力感知细化将布局朝向误差降低47.1%。
Motivation: 机器人相机在操作和导航中自然旋转，但现有单视图重建模型依赖视角先验，对分布外旋转泛化差，导致3D不一致和布局错误。
Method: 引入控制轴旋转的评估协议，在SAM3D风格流水线上分析误差，并提出重力感知细化（Gravity-Aware Refinement）以利用显式重力线索。
Result: 在Aria Digital Twin数据集和真实Franka腕部相机序列上，相机旋转导致深度估计失真、布局漂移和碰撞穿透；重力感知细化将布局朝向误差降低47.1%。
Conclusion: 当前单视图重建方法对相机旋转泛化差，显式重力线索对可靠重建重要。

papers.title: Subject-Level Unknown-Identity Identification from Leap Motion Controller 2 Hand Landmarks
papers.abstract_en: This work studies subject recognition from Leap Motion Controller 2 (LMC2) hand landmark data under a subject-level unknown-identity identification protocol on the Multi View Leap2 Hand Pose (ML2HP) dataset. Using only the landmark modality, we retain the original geometric representation and enrich it with fingertip-to-palm distances and palm-normalized inter-finger angular descriptors. Evaluation is performed under a Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) protocol in which, for each outer fold, one subject is excluded from the enrolled set and treated as unknown at test time. To avoid tuning on the true outer unknown subject, the unknown-rejection threshold is selected in an inner validation step by temporarily withholding one enrolled subject from the inner gallery and using it only for threshold estimation. We compare a tree ensemble baseline with two neural alternatives: a learned embedding baseline based on centroid matching and cosine-similarity-based rejection, and an MLP+OpenMax model, which represents a more established open-set recognition approach. Under this evaluation setup, Extra Trees remains the strongest overall method, indicating that the main challenge on this benchmark is not enrolled-subject discrimination alone, but robust score separation between known and unknown probes. The results support the feasibility of compact, interpretable landmark-based descriptors for contactless hand-based unknown-subject rejection and identification on a small-cohort dataset.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于Leap Motion Controller 2 (LMC2) 手部地标数据进行未知身份识别。在Multi View Leap2 Hand Pose (ML2HP) 数据集上采用留一主体（LOSO）协议，通过指尖到手掌距离和手掌归一化的指间角度描述符丰富原始几何表示，并比较了树集成、嵌入基线和MLP+OpenMax等开放集识别方法。结果表明Extra Trees方法在已知与未知探针的得分分离上表现最佳，支持基于地标的紧凑描述符用于接触式手部未知主体拒绝与识别的可行性。
Motivation: 现有手部识别研究多聚焦于已知主体分类，缺乏对未知主体拒绝能力的系统评估，且基于地标的轻量级开放集识别方法尚未充分探索。
Method: 保留原始地标几何表示，并添加指尖到手掌距离和手掌归一化的指间角度描述符。采用LOSO协议，内折交叉验证选择未知拒绝阈值。对比三种方法：Extra Trees树集成、基于质心匹配和余弦相似度拒识的嵌入基线，以及MLP+OpenMax模型。
Result: 在LOSO协议下，Extra Trees方法在已知vs未知主体识别中表现最佳，表明挑战主要在于鲁棒的得分分离而非仅已知主体判别。
Conclusion: 基于手部地标的紧凑、可解释描述符可用于小规模数据集上的接触式未知主体拒绝与识别，但方法在更大规模或更复杂场景下的泛化性有待验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scalable Physics-Inspired Transformers for Spin Glasses
papers.abstract_en: Efficient sampling of the Boltzmann distribution in frustrated spin glasses is central to statistical mechanics and combinatorial optimization. Despite advances in machine-learning-based approaches, two issues persist: limited understanding of why variational models fail to benefit from increased scale, unlike the monotonic scaling law of large language models; and high computational cost on large systems that negates advantages over classical sampling methods. Here, we develop a physics-inspired transformer with interpretable sparse attention and spin-tailored positional embeddings to address these challenges. By further leveraging FlashAttention for parallel ancestral sampling, it achieves up to two orders of magnitude speedup over vanilla variational autoregressive networks, enabling neural-network simulations of spin-glass systems to unprecedented sizes on a single GPU. It can resolve full probability distributions, free energies, and overlap statistics across temperatures, for Sherrington-Kirkpatrick and 2D or 3D Edwards-Anderson models, where existing machine-learning methods encounter limitations at certain temperatures. This framework thus establishes a scalable paradigm for frustrated spin-glass systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对阻挫自旋玻璃中玻尔兹曼分布高效采样的难题，提出一种物理启发的Transformer模型。该模型采用可解释的稀疏注意力和自旋定制的位置嵌入，并利用FlashAttention实现并行祖先采样，相比传统变分自回归网络加速两个数量级，能够在一张GPU上模拟此前无法达到的系统尺寸。在Sherrington-Kirkpatrick和Edwards-Anderson模型上，该方法可解析全概率分布、自由能和重叠统计，克服了现有机器学习方法在特定温度下的局限。
Motivation: 阻挫自旋玻璃的玻尔兹曼采样是统计力学和组合优化的核心问题。现有基于机器学习的方法存在两个问题：一是对变分模型未能像大语言模型那样从规模扩展中获益的原因理解不足；二是大系统上的高计算成本抵消了相对于经典采样方法的优势。
Method: 开发了一种物理启发的Transformer，包含可解释的稀疏注意力和自旋定制的位置嵌入。进一步利用FlashAttention实现并行祖先采样，从而大幅提升计算效率。
Result: 方法在速度上比传统变分自回归网络提升两个数量级，使得神经网络模拟自旋玻璃系统可在单GPU上扩展到前所未有的大小。在Sherrington-Kirkpatrick和2D/3D Edwards-Anderson模型中，能够解析完整概率分布、自由能和重叠统计，并在现有机器学习方法受限的温度区间内依然有效。
Conclusion: 该框架为阻挫自旋玻璃系统建立了一个可扩展的范例。

papers.title: Joint Air Traffic Flow and Capacity Management via Answer Set Programming
papers.abstract_en: Operational Air Traffic Flow and Capacity Management (ATFCM) balances flight demand with available sector capacity, to ensure safe and efficient operations. Mathematical models enhance operational ATFCM performance by framing demand-capacity balancing as an optimization problem, maximizing efficiency while adhering to safety constraints. However, SOTA research optimizes the aircraft trajectories (called ATFM) or the sector configuration (called DAC) separately. This leaves a research gap of whether joint optimization of ATFM and DAC can bring benefits. We partially address this limitation by introducing a joint ATFCM model with an encoding in Answer Set Programming (ASP). The ASP implementation is evaluated against two baselines applied to our joint model: a SOTA Mixed Integer Programming (MIP) model and an iterative CASA-based heuristic. Computational experiments utilize an instance generator fitted to historical OpenSky Network flight data. Our results indicate that the ASP model outperforms the MIP model, while ASP remains competitive against heuristics on small instances. Furthermore, while DAC has the largest improvement on solving performance compared to rerouting and delaying, unrestricted variants of DAC or rerouting lead to search space thrashing.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于答案集编程（ASP）的联合航空交通流量与容量管理（ATFCM）模型，同时优化飞机航迹（ATFM）和扇区配置（DAC），并利用OpenSky Network历史数据进行实验。实验表明ASP模型优于混合整数规划（MIP）模型，在小规模实例上与启发式方法竞争力相当，但DAC和改航的无限制变体会导致搜索空间爆炸。
Motivation: 现有研究分别优化ATFM和DAC，缺乏联合优化的研究，而联合优化可能带来额外收益。
Method: 构建联合ATFCM模型，采用答案集编程（ASP）进行编码，并设计实例生成器拟合OpenSky Network数据。
Result: ASP模型优于MIP模型，在小规模实例上与CASA启发式方法竞争力相当；DAC对求解性能提升最大，但无限制变体导致搜索空间爆炸。
Conclusion: ASP是联合ATFCM问题的可行方法，但无限制的DAC或改航会引发搜索空间问题，需进一步约束。

papers.title: StatABench: Dataset and Framework for Evaluating Statistical Analysis Capabilities of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Statistical analysis is a broad, complex field requiring both domain knowledge and tool proficiency. While prior work has evaluated large language models (LLMs) in this domain, existing benchmarks remain limited in scope and format. To bridge this gap, we introduce StatABench (Statistical AnalysisBenchmark), a benchmark designed to systematically assess LLMs' statistical analysis capabilities. StatABench comprises two complementary components: Stat-Closed, containing 404 questions across 18 statistical topics in multiple formats (multiple-choice, fill-in-the-blank, decision-making, and practical application), and Stat-Open, featuring 30 complex open-ended modeling tasks adapted from professional competitions. We evaluate diverse LLMs using the LangChain MCP framework and multiple data science agents, and assess Stat-Open solutions via a validated LLM-as-Judge protocol. Experiments show that even GPT-5.1 achieves only 68.6% on Stat-Closed, while the best open-source model reaches 60.6%. On Stat-Open, the top agent framework scores 61.86 on average. These results reveal the gap between current LLMs and reliable statistical analysis, highlighting persistent challenges in tool-grounded reasoning, methodological decision-making, and end-to-end statistical modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StatABench是一个系统评估大语言模型（LLMs）统计分析能力的基准，包含Stat-Closed（404道题，覆盖18个统计主题，多种格式）和Stat-Open（30个复杂开放式建模任务）。实验表明，即使GPT-5.1在Stat-Closed上也只有68.6%的准确率，最佳开源模型为60.6%；Stat-Open上最佳框架平均得分为61.86，揭示当前LLMs在可靠统计分析上的差距。
Motivation: 现有LLM在统计分析领域的评估基准范围有限且格式单一，缺乏全面系统性的测试，因此需要更全面的基准来揭示LLM在该领域的能力缺陷。
Method: 提出了StatABench基准，包含封闭式（Stat-Closed）和开放式（Stat-Open）两部分；利用LangChain MCP框架和数据科学智能体评估LLM；采用LLM-as-Judge协议评估Stat-Open解决方案。
Result: GPT-5.1在Stat-Closed上得分为68.6%，最佳开源模型为60.6%；Stat-Open上最佳智能体框架平均得分为61.86。
Conclusion: 当前LLMs在工具接地推理、方法决策和端到端统计建模方面仍面临持续挑战，距离可靠统计分析存在明显差距。

papers.title: Understanding Parallel Samplers in Masked Diffusion via Random Walks on Graphs
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose using random walks on graphs as a verifiable sandbox to study different parallel sampling strategies in masked diffusion models (MDMs). We train an MDM on random walk samples from a fixed graph. The graph or the transition kernel is never shown to the model explicitly and plays the role of latent structure in the sequences, albeit one that is controllable and can be used for quantitative evaluation. Thus, this framework enjoys a Sudoku-like validity check: verifying that an output is a valid walk and estimating the Markov kernel from the walks to measure distribution fidelity. Using simple graphs, we theoretically prove that parallel unmasking via widely used scores like lowest entropy is not uniformly better than a random parallel sampler; the performance critically depends on the structure of the underlying graph. We develop a new bisection sampler for random walks, which takes logarithmic steps in the sequence length and is provably exact under perfect training. Experiments on various graph walk tasks show that different parallel samplers are better for different graphs even in practice. Our initial experiments on a pretrained OpenWebText MDM show that the bisection-style samplers improve speed-quality tradeoffs even for language generation. Together, these results position graph random walks as a mechanistic benchmark for diagnosing and designing parallel samplers for masked diffusion models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用图上的随机游走作为可控沙盒，研究掩码扩散模型中的并行采样策略。在固定图上训练MDM，理论证明并行采样性能依赖于图结构，并提出对数步长的二分采样器，在语言生成实验中改善速度-质量权衡。
Motivation: 现有并行采样策略在掩码扩散模型中缺乏可验证的理论基准，其性能与底层结构的关系不清晰。
Method: 将随机游走作为可控沙盒，在固定图上训练MDM，通过Sudoku式验证检查输出有效性并估计马尔可夫核。提出新的二分采样器，理论证明在完美训练下精确。
Result: 理论证明最低熵等常用并行采样并非总是优于随机采样；实验表明不同采样器在不同图下表现不同；二分采样器在语言生成中改善速度-质量权衡。
Conclusion: 图随机游走可作为诊断和设计掩码扩散模型并行采样器的机械性基准。

papers.title: TaLK: Text-attributed Graph Dataset Distillation via Coupling Language Model with Graph-Aware Kernel
papers.abstract_en: Text-attributed graphs (TAGs) are widely used in many real-world domains, and learning on TAGs requires jointly modeling text semantics and graph structure. A standard approach for modeling TAGs is to combine a language model (LM) and a graph neural network (GNN), but joint training is computationally expensive and difficult to scale. Dataset distillation is a promising way to reduce training costs, but existing methods are not well suited to TAGs because they are typically designed for a single modality or still require repeatedly training expensive LM-GNN models on the full dataset during distillation. To address this, we propose TaLK, an effective dataset distillation method for TAGs that couples an LM with a graph-aware neural tangent kernel.This design enables efficient dataset distillation, avoiding repeated joint training on the full dataset while reflecting both textual and structural information for effective TAG learning.Experiments on multiple TAG benchmarks show that TaLK consistently outperforms existing baselines and achieves up to 97% of full-dataset performance with only 1% synthetic data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TaLK，一种针对文本属性图（TAG）的数据集蒸馏方法，通过耦合语言模型与图感知神经切线核，避免在蒸馏过程中重复训练完整的LM-GNN模型。实验表明，仅用1%的合成数据即可达到全数据集性能的97%。
Motivation: 现有TAG学习方法需要联合训练语言模型和图神经网络，计算成本高且难以扩展。数据集蒸馏虽有潜力，但现有方法不适合TAG，因为它们通常针对单模态设计，或在蒸馏过程中仍需在完整数据集上反复训练昂贵的LM-GNN模型。
Method: 提出TaLK，将语言模型与图感知神经切线核（graph-aware neural tangent kernel）耦合，实现高效的数据集蒸馏，同时保留文本和结构信息。
Result: 在多个TAG基准上，TaLK一致优于现有基线，仅用1%的合成数据即可达到全数据集性能的97%。
Conclusion: TaLK通过避免重复联合训练，实现了高效的TAG数据集蒸馏，并验证了其有效性。

papers.title: When Preferences Fail to Become Incentives: A Utility-Behavior Gap in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent work on preference elicitation in large language models (LLMs) has demonstrated that, when given a series of choices between two outcomes, LLMs reveal a coherent, model-specific utility structure. Notably, this structure often includes preferences that the models' trainers did not intend, such as valuing people of some nationalities above others, raising the possibility that LLMs might be forming emergent, misaligned goals, which, if true, would have major safety implications. However, the choice paradigms in which these preferences are observed are not reflective of real-world situations in which misaligned behavior would be a practical concern. Therefore, we design an experimental paradigm to probe whether these preferences serve as motivations for LLM behavior in realistic scenarios. First, we reproduce prior findings on consistent preference elicitation. Next, we create a set of common writing tasks - essays, grant proposal abstracts, incident postmortems, and translations - where quality can be assessed by a blind, independent LLM judge panel. Then, we demonstrate that LLMs can be motivated via direct exhortation and other explicit cues to modulate their output quality on these tasks. Finally, we probe whether utilities inferred from explicitly reported preferences can shift output quality on these tasks by offering LLMs high-utility incentives for high-quality outputs. In all tasks, across all models tested, offering LLMs outcomes that they report in the choice paradigm as being highly preferred does not lead them to create higher quality outputs than offering them dispreferred outcomes, or even no outcomes at all. We conclude that the existence of coherent preferences as demonstrated in choice paradigms should not be taken as evidence that those preferences have incentive value for the models or affect their behavior in other contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究了大语言模型在偏好诱导中表现出的连贯效用结构是否能够激励其行为。作者发现，尽管LLM在二元选择中展示出明确的偏好（例如对某些国籍的偏好），但将高度偏好的结果作为激励并不会促使LLM在现实写作任务中生成更高质量的输出。这表明偏好诱导范式中的偏好并不等同于对模型行为有激励价值。
Motivation: 先前研究表明LLM在选择范式中表现出连贯的、可能不受欢迎的偏好，这引发了关于LLM可能形成新兴、未对齐目标的担忧。然而，这些偏好是否在现实场景中驱动行为尚不清楚。
Method: 作者设计了实验流程：复现先前的一致性偏好诱导结果；创建一组常见写作任务（论文、拨款摘要、事故后分析、翻译），由盲审的独立LLM评审团评估质量；通过直接告诫和其他显式线索激励LLM调节输出质量；最后，通过提供高偏好结果作为激励，观察输出质量是否改变。
Result: 在所有任务和所有测试模型中，提供LLM在偏好诱导中高度偏好的结果并未导致其生成比提供不偏好结果或根本不提供结果时更高质量的输出。
Conclusion: 作者得出结论，选择范式中存在的连贯偏好不应被视作这些偏好具有激励价值或能在其他情境下影响模型行为的证据。

papers.title: Humanoid-OmniOcc: Stereo-Based Full-View Occupancy Dataset for Embodied AI
papers.abstract_en: Occupancy prediction at voxel-level granularity is essential for safe robotic navigation and interaction in complex environments. Existing occupancy datasets, however, are predominantly designed for autonomous driving with vehicle-centric biases -- forward-facing cameras, far-field geometry, and static road priors -- limiting their applicability to embodied humanoid perception. We present Humanoid-OmniOcc, a large-scale panoramic stereo-based occupancy dataset tailored for humanoid robots. The dataset encompasses 15 diverse simulated indoor scenes and 5 real-world environments, yielding over 155K samples with broad scene and style diversity. Importantly, the dataset is designed around a Real2Sim2Real closed-loop paradigm: real sensor specifications drive physically accurate simulation, simulation produces large-scale annotated training data, and models trained in simulation are directly evaluated on real-world captures -- enabling iterative refinement of the sim-to-real pipeline. We further propose \textbf{H}umanoid \textbf{S}urround \textbf{S}tereo-guided \textbf{Occ}upancy model (Humanoid-OmniOcc) that exploits robust depth priors for accurate 2D-to-3D lifting. Extensive experiments show that Humanoid-OmniOcc consistently outperforms monocular baselines and generalizes well to both unseen simulated test scenes and real-world environments, validating the effectiveness of the Real2Sim2Real design. Code and data will be available upon acceptance at https://d-robotics-ai-lab.github.io/humanoid-omniocc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 Humanoid-OmniOcc，一个面向人形机器人的大规模全景立体占据预测数据集，包含 15 个模拟室内场景和 5 个真实环境，共计 15.5 万样本，采用 Real2Sim2Real 闭环设计。同时提出了 Humanoid-OmniOcc 模型，利用深度先验进行 2D 到 3D 的精确映射，实验表明其优于单目基线，并泛化到未见场景。
Motivation: 现有占据预测数据集多针对自动驾驶，存在前视相机、远场几何和静态道路先验等车辆中心偏差，不适用于人形机器人的感知需求。
Method: 构建了全景立体占据数据集，基于 Real2Sim2Real 范式：真实传感器参数驱动模拟，模拟生成标注数据，模型在模拟训练后直接在真实环境评估。提出 Humanoid-OmniOcc 模型，利用立体深度先验改进 2D-3D 提升。
Result: Humanoid-OmniOcc 在所有测试中优于单目基线，在未见模拟场景和真实环境中均表现良好，验证了 Real2Sim2Real 设计的有效性。
Conclusion: 该工作填补了人形机器人占据预测数据集的空白，并通过闭环设计提高了模拟到真实的迁移能力。

papers.title: Topological Out-of-Domain Generalization in Dynamical Systems Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting the behavior of dynamical systems (DS) beyond the dynamical and parameter regimes observed in training is a pivotal and essentially unresolved problem in scientific ML. It is central to any good scientific theory, which we expect to be able to make predictions about regimes not covered by currently available data. Recent hierarchical and hyper-network guided approaches for DS reconstruction (DSR) enable training on many DS simultaneously, and revealed that extracted latent features are often related to crucial control parameters of the underlying DS that varied across the training corpus. However, true out-of-domain forecasting abilities of these models, e.g., across tipping points, remain limited, and fine-tuning, or even full model retraining, on time series from the new dynamical regime is usually required. Here, we mathematically analyze the root of these limitations in previous model formulations and identify three core shortcomings rooted in a mismatch between structural assumptions of the reconstruction model and typical properties of physical systems. We propose a combination of remedies for these shortcomings, most importantly feature splitting, and furthermore derive a closed-form bound on the reliable extrapolation range. We demonstrate empirically that our techniques allow for accurate zero-shot prediction into new dynamical regimes, outside the observed training regime, as, e.g., encountered across tipping points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从数学上分析了动力系统重构模型在域外预测（如穿越临界点）时失效的根本原因，指出三个核心缺陷：重构模型的结构假设与物理系统属性不匹配。提出以特征分裂为主的修复方案，并推导出可靠外推范围的闭式界。实验表明该方法能在训练观测范围外实现准确的零样本预测。
Motivation: 现有动力系统重构方法在训练数据未覆盖的动力学或参数区域（如穿越临界点）预测能力有限，通常需要微调或重训练，这限制了科学ML中真正域外泛化的实现。
Method: 识别三个核心缺陷并给出组合修复方案，核心是特征分裂（feature splitting），同时推导出可靠外推范围的闭式界。
Result: 实验表明所提技术能在训练观测范围外实现准确的零样本预测，例如穿越临界点等新动力学区域。
Conclusion: 通过修复结构假设与物理系统属性之间的失配，动力系统重构模型可以实现真实的域外泛化，无需针对新动力学区域重新训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Attacking the Trusted Imagination: Oracle-Level Integrity Attacks on Imagine-then-Act World Models
papers.abstract_en: Many recent vision-language-action (VLA) policies adopt an imagine-then-act design. A world-action model (WAM) first imagines a short future as a latent trajectory z~, on which the action is then conditioned. We identify this trusted imagination, rather than the reactive policy, as the exposed attack surface. A downstream oracle, such as a safety gate, a visual model-predictive-control (MPC) planner, or an imagine-then-check verifier, consumes z~ as a prediction of the future. The robustness of the policy therefore does not entail the robustness of systems that rely on the WAM. The underlying phenomenon is an asymmetry. Corrupting the imagination is easy, since it requires only displacing z~ from its natural-future manifold. Steering it precisely is hard, since it must reach a specified on-manifold target. We adopt a capability-based threat model with an L-infinity-bounded observation perturbation. The attacker applies projected gradient descent through the fully differentiable observation-to-imagination map. The same off-manifold property motivates a parameter-free denoiser detector. We evaluate three targets: RynnVLA-002, LingBot-VA, and LaDi-WM. Untargeted corruption is roughly 60x stronger than random and is detected at AUC 1.0. Targeted control remains bounded. An adaptive attacker evades detection only by forgoing corruption. The reactive policy remains robust to corrupted imagination. A native imagination-driven MPC, however, exhibits the first adversary-specific task failure (at epsilon=0.01, success 0.70 versus 0.05; Fisher p < 10^-4).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文识别了想象-行动世界模型中“可信想象”的攻击面，并提出通过L∞有界观测扰动进行oracle级完整性攻击。在RynnVLA-002、LingBot-VA和LaDi-WM三个模型上，无目标干扰比随机强约60倍且检测AUC达1.0，而有目标控制效果有限。自适应攻击者只有放弃干扰才能逃避检测。
Motivation: 现有的VLA策略依赖世界模型预测的未来潜在轨迹作为下游oracles的输入，这种“可信想象”容易受到攻击，而下游系统（如安全门、MPC规划器）的鲁棒性并不等价于策略本身的鲁棒性。
Method: 采用基于能力的威胁模型，通过可微的观测到想象映射执行投影梯度下降攻击，并引入参数无关的去噪检测器。
Result: 无目标干扰效果比随机强60倍，检测AUC为1.0；有目标控制效果有限；自适应攻击者只有在放弃干扰时才能逃避检测。
Conclusion: 反应策略对受损想象保持鲁棒，但本地MPC规划器出现首个特定于攻击者的任务失败（epsilon=0.01时成功率0.70 vs 0.05，Fisher p<10^-4）。

papers.title: Concept Alignment Contrast and Long-Short Prompt Memory for Test-Time Adaptation of SAM3 in Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Concept segmentation models like Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) show strong generalization on natural images, yet their performance degrades in medical imaging due to the domain gap caused by different imaging principles and styles. Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) is essential for improving the testing performance by updating the model on the fly without annotations. However, existing vision-language TTA methods are mainly driven by image-level uncertainty minimization, which does not necessarily reflect region-level semantic correctness in medical segmentation. Moreover, they often lack mechanisms to maintain stability in continual one-pass adaptation, leading to limited performance when reliable dense supervision is missing for segmentation. To address these issues, we propose Concept Alignment Contrast and LongShort Prompt Memory for Test-Time Adaptation (CM-TTA) of SAM3 for medical images. First, for a test sample with multiple augmentations, we introduce a novel Concept Alignment Contrast (CAC) metric, which leverages textual-visual semantic consistency to robustly evaluate prediction quality to select the best augmented view as the supervision. Second, to balance rapid and stable adaptation, we design a Long-Short Prompt Memory (LSPM) module. The short memory dynamically fuses recent prompts based on CAC scores for agile local adaptation, while the long memory maintains a stable global prompt to generate enhanced pseudo-labels. Finally, a Densely Supervised Prompt Update (DSPU) strategy is proposed to optimize the prompt embeddings with enhanced pseudo labels as dense supervision. Extensive experiments on prostate and skin lesion segmentation demonstrate that our CM-TTA framework significantly outperforms existing methods for TTA of SAM3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CM-TTA框架，用于医学图像分割中SAM3模型的测试时自适应。方法包括概念对齐对比（CAC）指标评估预测质量，长短提示记忆模块（LSPM）平衡快速与稳定适应，以及密集监督提示更新（DSPU）策略。在前列腺和皮肤病变分割任务上，该方法显著优于现有TTA方法。
Motivation: SAM3在自然图像上表现优异，但在医学图像上因域差异性能下降。现有视觉语言TTA方法依赖图像级不确定性最小化，无法反映区域级语义正确性，且缺乏连续自适应中的稳定性机制。
Method: 提出CM-TTA：1) 概念对齐对比（CAC）利用文本-视觉语义一致性评估预测质量，选择最佳增强视图作为监督；2) 长短提示记忆（LSPM）模块，短记忆动态融合近期提示用于局部适应，长记忆维持全局提示生成增强伪标签；3) 密集监督提示更新（DSPU）优化提示嵌入。
Result: 在前列腺和皮肤病变分割数据集上，CM-TTA显著优于现有TTA方法。
Conclusion: CM-TTA通过概念对齐和双记忆模块有效提升了SAM3在医学图像分割中的测试时自适应性能。

papers.title: The Impact of VAE Design on Latent Pose Representations for Diffusion-based Sign Language Production
papers.abstract_en: Latent diffusion approaches to sign language production (SLP) rely on an initial stage that learns an encoding of sign pose sequences, enabling generative modeling in the resulting latent space. The autoencoder used in this stage is typically evaluated in terms of reconstruction quality using geometric metrics common in SLP. While informative, these metrics do not fully capture latent space properties that may influence the training and performance of the downstream generative model. In this work, we investigate how architectural and training objective design choices in a variational autoencoder (VAE) for sign pose encoding affect latent space structure, and how these differences translate into the performance of a latent diffusion model for text-to-sign generation. Our experiments on Phoenix14T dataset show that variations in generative performance, measured through back-translation BLEU scores, can sometimes be better explained by differences in latent space properties than by VAE reconstruction accuracy alone.
papers.journal_ref: GenSign Generative AI for Sign Language CVPR 2026 Workshop, Jun 2026, Denver (Colorado, USA), France. pp. 10631-10640
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了变分自编码器（VAE）的架构和训练目标设计对潜在空间结构的影响，及其对基于潜在扩散的手语生成（SLP）下游模型性能的影响。在Phoenix14T数据集上的实验表明，生成性能（通过反向翻译BLEU分数衡量）的变化有时可以通过潜在空间属性的差异更好地解释，而不仅仅是VAE重建精度。
Motivation: 现有手语生成中，用于编码手语姿态序列的自动编码器通常仅用几何指标评估重建质量，但这些指标未能充分捕捉潜在空间属性，而这些属性可能影响下游生成模型的训练和性能。
Method: 通过系统比较不同VAE架构和训练目标设计（如潜在空间正则化、编码器/解码器结构等）对手语姿态编码的影响，并评估这些差异对潜在扩散模型在文本到手语生成任务中的性能影响。
Result: 在Phoenix14T数据集上，生成性能的变化（以BLEU分数衡量）有时与潜在空间属性的差异相关性更强，而非VAE重建精度本身。
Conclusion: 在潜在扩散手语生成流程中，VAE设计应不仅关注重建质量，还需考虑潜在空间结构对下游生成任务的影响。

papers.title: PG-MAP: Joint MAP Optimization for Inference-Time Alignment of Diffusion and Flow-Matching Models
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time alignment of pretrained text-to-image models is typically performed along a single control axis, such as classifier-free guidance, attention editing, or reward-based latent perturbations. This limitation prevents modeling joint dependencies between conditioning and latent variables and hinders transfer across generative transports. We propose PG-MAP, a training-free framework that formulates inference-time alignment as a trajectory-level Gibbs-MAP / proximal energy optimization over the conditioning $c$ and latent state $z_t$ via a forward-consistency coupling, optionally guided by a frozen preference reward. This joint formulation enables coordinated updates across modalities while remaining compatible with both diffusion and flow-matching models through transport-specific adaptations. Across diffusion backbones (SD~1.5, SDXL), PG-MAP consistently improves alignment metrics such as PickScore and Aesthetic, and can be effectively combined with tuned classifier-free guidance to achieve the strongest overall performance. On flow-matching models (SD3.5-medium), the framework reduces to a latent-only variant, achieving $\mathbf{91.9\%}$ PickScore and $75.7\%$ HPS win rates against a static baseline, with controlled experiments ruling out noise-related artifacts. Human evaluations further confirm consistent preference over strong baselines, including tuned CFG and compute-matched universal guidance. Finally, an oracle-routing analysis shows that the relative importance of conditioning and latent optimization depends on prompt types, surfacing further headroom that a per-prompt selector could exploit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PG-MAP，一种无需训练的推理时对齐框架，将扩散和流匹配模型的对齐问题形式化为轨迹级的 Gibbs-MAP / 近端能量优化，通过前向一致性耦合同时优化条件 c 和潜在状态 z_t。在扩散模型（SD 1.5, SDXL）上持续提升 PickScore 和 Aesthetic 等对齐指标，在流匹配模型（SD3.5-medium）上达到 91.9% PickScore 和 75.7% HPS 胜率。人类评估也确认了对强基线的偏好。
Motivation: 现有推理时对齐方法通常局限于单一控制轴（如无分类器引导、注意力编辑或奖励基潜在扰动），无法建模条件与潜在变量之间的联合依赖关系，且在不同生成传输机制间迁移困难。
Method: 提出 PG-MAP 框架，将推理时对齐公式化为轨迹级 Gibbs-MAP / 近端能量优化，通过前向一致性耦合在条件 c 和潜在状态 z_t 上联合优化，并可选择以冻结的偏好奖励为指导。框架兼容扩散和流匹配模型，通过传输特定调整适配。
Result: 在扩散模型（SD 1.5, SDXL）上，PG-MAP 一致提升 PickScore 和 Aesthetic 指标，并能与调谐的无分类器引导结合达到最强性能。在流匹配模型（SD3.5-medium）上，简化版本（仅优化潜在变量）实现 91.9% PickScore 和 75.7% HPS 胜率，消融实验排除噪声伪影。人类评估也确认对强基线（包括调谐 CFG 和计算匹配的通用引导）的一致偏好。
Conclusion: PG-MAP 作为一种无需训练的对齐框架，通过联合优化条件与潜在变量，在扩散和流匹配模型上均有效提升对齐性能。Oracle 路由分析表明，条件与潜在优化的相对重要性取决于提示类型，这为每提示选择器提供了进一步改进空间。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Evo-RAD: Navigating Rare Retinal Disease Diagnosis via Self-Evolving Agentic Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale pretrained foundation models have revolutionized general medical screening, but often falter on rare diseases because such conditions are underrepresented in real-world clinical datasets. While retrieval-augmented diagnosis attempts to mitigate this, conventional static methods frequently succumb to the hubness problem, retrieving visually similar but semantically incorrect common diseases. To address this, we propose Evo-RAD, a self-evolving agentic framework that transforms evidence acquisition into a dynamic decision-making task. We formulate retrieval as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) where a graphbased agent observes the reference set state and executes actions to purge discordant evidence (DELETE), acquire pathologically consistent samples (INSERT), or conclude the evolution (TERMINATE). Optimized via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a homogeneityaware reward, the agent learns to maximize the diagnostic homogeneity of the support reference set. Experiments on retinal disease benchmarks show that Evo-RAD substantially improves rare-disease diagnosis, outperforming retinal foundation models by +21.04%, while also surpassing retrieval-based and parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods by +3.56%. Code is available at https://github.com/SDH-Lab/Evo-RAD.
papers.comment: Accepted by MICCAI 2026. 10 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Evo-RAD，一种自进化代理框架，将罕见视网膜疾病诊断中的证据获取建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。通过图基代理执行删除、插入或终止动作，并利用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）和同质性感知奖励来优化支持参考集的诊断同质性。在视网膜疾病基准上，Evo-RAD 在罕见病诊断上超过视网膜基础模型 21.04%，并优于检索增强和参数高效微调方法 3.56%。
Motivation: 大规模预训练基础模型在通用医疗筛查中表现优异，但罕见病由于在真实临床数据中代表性不足而性能下降。传统的静态检索增强诊断存在中心点问题（hubness problem），即检索到视觉相似但语义错误的常见疾病。
Method: 将检索过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），图基代理观察参考集状态并执行三种动作：删除不一致证据（DELETE）、插入病理一致样本（INSERT）或终止演化（TERMINATE）。通过群体相对策略优化（GRPO）和同质性感知奖励进行优化。
Result: 在视网膜疾病基准上，罕见病诊断准确率比视网膜基础模型提升 21.04%，比检索增强和参数高效微调方法提升 3.56%。
Conclusion: Evo-RAD 通过动态决策框架有效改善了罕见视网膜疾病的诊断性能，代码已开源。

papers.title: Plans Don't Persist: Why Context Management Is Load Bearing for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents depend on context management: systems compress, summarize, and evict old tokens so tasks can continue beyond finite windows. That is safe only when dropped information is no longer needed or has been internalized. Plans are the stress case: they are written early, used for many steps, and first to be evicted. We introduce replay pairing, a diagnostic that runs the same trajectory with and without the plan in history and measures hidden-state cosine distance. On Llama-3.1-70B, plan signal spikes to 0.453 one step after the plan, then falls 4.1x in a single action-observation step; HotpotQA falls 12.4x. This is evidence that standard LLM agents do not carry plans forward as persistent state, and instead depend on the plan remaining in context. A layer-L32 probe detects this decay as a diagnostic, not as proof that it reads plan content itself. Reasoning models add a measurement confound: their `<think>` traces re-derive plan content, so standard stripping leaves plan evidence in the stripped condition. We name this the reasoning-trace confound and fix it with strict stripping, which removes prior `<think>` blocks from the stripped run only. It recovers +163% of the step+1 signal in-sample and +153% held out, while not meaningfully changing non-reasoning Llama (+4.8%). On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B, a Llama-trained probe transfers at AUROC 0.748 (p=6e-4), while R1-specific probes reach 1.000, suggesting R1 encodes plan signal in a different hidden-state direction. Finally, a compression stress test shows the practical cost: naive plan eviction cuts ALFWorld success by 34.7pp, while probe-gated re-surfacing does not recover it. The contribution is a measurement and stress-test framework showing that agent-critical information can be context-resident rather than persistent. Context management is load bearing, but plan protection alone is not enough.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长视野LLM代理的上下文管理问题，发现代理的关键信息（如计划）并非持久状态，而是依赖于上下文存在。通过“重放配对”方法测量隐藏状态余弦距离，证明计划信号在上下文中快速衰减。工作还包括检测、推理痕迹混淆和压缩压力测试，表明上下文管理是关键支撑。
Motivation: 长视野代理依赖上下文管理（压缩、总结、遗忘旧token）来扩展窗口，但计划类信息在早期写入、多次使用，最容易被遗忘，导致任务失败。
Method: 引入“重放配对”诊断方法，比较有/无计划在历史中的轨迹隐藏状态余弦距离；针对推理模型提出严格剔除（strict stripping）消除推理痕迹混淆。
Result: 在Llama-3.1-70B上计划信号在下一步后降至0.453，然后单步下降4.1倍；HotpotQA下降12.4倍。严格剔除恢复+163%信号。ALFWorld计划删除降低成功率34.7个百分点。
Conclusion: 论文强调上下文管理是负载支撑的，但仅保护计划不足以解决问题；所提框架可用于测量和压力测试代理关键信息的持续性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Domain-incremental audio classification using domain-specific experts and prototype classifier
papers.abstract_en: This technical report presents submission systems for Task 7(domain-incremental audio classification) of the DCASE 2026 Challenge. The main obstacle is that, the system is unable to access to past or future domain's data at once. We approached domain-incremental learning (DIL) as a frozen-feature replay problem. At each incremental stage, one or two compact experts are trained and then kept fixed; at the final stage, the penultimate features from all frozen experts are concatenated and used to train a lightweight per-class prototype classifier solely on cached features. This design prevents catastrophic forgetting by preserving each expert models at inference. To retain earlier-domain knowledge without storing raw audio, some experts were trained with DeepInversion-based generative replay. A cross-stage regression imputer was trained to fill the expert feature slots that did not yet exist at an ealier stage. We submit four fully DIL-compliant systems: three systems based on diverse frozen five-expert backbones and their cross-stack ensemble achieving 78.15% micro / 77.03% macro on the development set, outperforming every individual backbone on both evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对DCASE 2026 Challenge任务7（域增量音频分类），提出一种冻存特征重放方法：在每个增量阶段训练紧凑专家并冻结，最后阶段拼接所有倒数第二层特征训练轻量级原型分类器。实验表明集成系统在开发集上达到78.15% micro/77.03% macro，优于各单独骨干。
Motivation: 域增量学习面临无法同时访问过去或未来域数据的障碍，导致灾难性遗忘。本文旨在设计无需存储原始音频即可保留早期领域知识的分类系统。
Method: 采用冻存特征重放：每阶段训练1-2个紧凑专家并固定，最后阶段拼接所有专家的倒数第二层特征，训练每类原型分类器。为保留早期知识，使用DeepInversion生成式重放训练部分专家，并训练跨阶段回归插补器填充缺失特征槽。
Result: 提交四个完全符合DIL的系统，其中三个基于不同五专家骨干，其交叉堆叠集成在开发集上取得78.15% micro和77.03% macro，优于每个单独骨干。
Conclusion: 本文设计的冻存专家和原型分类器框架能有效应对域增量音频分类，集成方法进一步提升性能。

papers.title: DT-GOL: Dual-Track Geometric Online Learning in Nonstationary Environment with Label Delay
papers.abstract_en: Online learning is crucial for handling complex data streams in big data applications. Recent research has begun to focus on dynamic scenarios, i.e., non-stationary environments. However, a crucial yet often overlooked aspect is label latency, where new data may not receive labels in time due to the slow and expensive labeling process, thus hindering rapid adaptation to dynamic environments. To resolve this impasse, we propose Dual-Track Geometry Online Learning (DT-GOL), a novel framework that shifts from temporal compensation to spatial reasoning to bridge the supervised latency gap. By modeling the delay challenge as a semi-supervised task, we leverage real-time topological evolution of features as a reliable geometric surrogate for unobservable conceptual changes to achieve proactive supervised adaptation within the delay window. Unlike rigid self-training, we introduce a dynamic evidence calibration mechanism that distills geometric information into soft labels that perceive uncertainty, effectively mitigating the confirmation bias inherent in hard pseudo-labels. Furthermore, to resolve the stability-plasticity dilemma, we design a decoupled dual-track architecture in which a master learner serves as a stable anchor, updated strictly from delayed ground truth, while a transient branch leverages soft geometric knowledge for low-risk forward adaptation. Extensive experiments on real and synthetic datasets demonstrate that DT-GOL significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art baseline methods, especially in scenarios with concept drift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DT-GOL框架，解决非平稳环境中标签延迟问题，通过几何在线学习进行空间推理而非时间补偿，利用特征拓扑演化实现主动监督适应，并设计解耦双轨架构缓解稳定性-可塑性困境。
Motivation: 现有在线学习研究关注非平稳环境，但标签延迟问题常被忽略，新数据无法及时获得标签，阻碍快速适应动态环境。
Method: 将标签延迟建模为半监督任务，利用实时特征拓扑演化作为几何代理，提出动态证据校准机制将几何信息蒸馏为不确定性感知的软标签，并设计解耦双轨架构：主学习器用延迟真实标签更新保持稳定，瞬态分支利用软几何知识进行低风险前向适应。
Result: 在真实和合成数据集上的实验表明，DT-GOL显著优于现有最先进基线方法，尤其在概念漂移场景下。
Conclusion: DT-GOL通过空间推理和几何信息有效处理标签延迟，在非平稳环境中表现优异。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: ENVS: Environment-Native Verified Search for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: As multimodal agents move from interface understanding to real software control, successful trajectory discovery in live desktop environments becomes a key challenge. GUI tasks require long-horizon sequences of precise mouse and keyboard actions, while feedback is sparse, delayed, and costly to obtain through VM rollouts. We propose Environment-Native Verified Search (ENVS), a training-time search-and-filter pipeline that uses the environment to construct verified supervision before policy optimization: it branches over behaviorally distinct GUI actions in live OSWorld VMs, verifies successful leaves, and trains from globally balanced step-level supervision. To evaluate robustness under realistic desktop interruptions, we also introduce OSWorld-Noisy, a dynamic benchmark for recoverable desktop interruptions that preserves the original tasks while testing whether agents can refocus, dismiss, wait, or recover under live perturbations. On the 300-task OSWorld pool, ENVS reaches 30.3 pass@8 on original evaluations and 29.0 on OSWorld-Noisy, outperforming matched ARPO-style online RL while reducing compute from 184-192 to 138-153 GPU-hours; even with only 30% of its search data, ENVS reaches 27.0 pass@8, exceeding ARPO from the base model. Training from noisy environments also better preserves visual-reasoning abilities on auxiliary benchmarks, including OSWorld-G Refusal (16.7 vs. 1.9) and BLINK Functional Correspondence (26.2 vs. 23.1).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出ENVS，一种训练时搜索与过滤管道，在真实桌面环境（OSWorld VM）中分支执行行为不同的GUI动作，验证成功的叶子节点，并从全局平衡的步骤级监督中训练。引入OSWorld-Noisy基准测试评估在桌面干扰下的鲁棒性。在300任务OSWorld池上，ENVS达到30.3 pass@8，优于ARPO风格在线RL，并减少了GPU时间。
Motivation: GUI代理在长序列精确鼠标键盘操作中面临反馈稀疏、延迟且通过VM回滚获取成本高的问题，需要更高效的训练方法。
Method: 提出ENVS，在真实OSWorld VM中分支执行行为不同的GUI动作，验证成功路径，构建全局平衡的步骤级监督训练。

papers.title: Neural Operator Processes for Probabilistic Operator Learning under Partial Observations
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, but are typically developed with dense input-output training fields and fully observed inputs at inference. Many scientific problems require instead predicting solution fields from sparse, irregular, or partial observations under uncertainty. We introduce Neural Operator Processes (NOPs), a framework that unifies neural-process conditioning with neural-operator decoding to predict full output fields from limited context. NOPs condition on sparse joint input-output observations and support deterministic and probabilistic prediction within a shared encoder-decoder architecture. We study two conditioning strategies, convolutional pooled summaries and query-aligned attention, and analyze how their interaction with latent stochastic variables depends on PDE geometry. Across function regression and three PDE benchmarks, we find that sparse conditional operator learning is viable and can match dense-grid behavior in several regimes, that preserving local context-query geometry is essential in non-periodic settings but less so in spectrally smooth periodic regimes, and that uncertainty-aware operator learning succeeds when latent conditioning complements rather than overwrites the local geometric pathway. These results provide a basis for probabilistic operator learning under partial observations and help bridge operator learning and probabilistic meta-learning in function space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经算子过程 (Neural Operator Processes, NOPs)，将神经过程 (Neural Process) 的条件建模与神经算子 (Neural Operator) 的解码相结合，用于从稀疏、不规则的部分观测中预测完整输出场，支持确定性和概率性预测。在函数回归和三个 PDE 基准上验证了方法的可行性，并分析了不同条件策略与潜在随机变量在周期性/非周期性 PDE 几何中的相互作用。
Motivation: 现有神经算子通常假设密集输入-输出训练场和完全观测的输入，但许多科学问题（如天气预报、地球物理模拟）需要从不完全、稀疏的观测中预测解场，且需要考虑不确定性。
Method: 将神经过程的条件机制（如卷积池化摘要、查询对齐注意力）与神经算子的解码架构统一在一个编码器-解码器中，通过稀疏联合输入-输出观测进行条件化，实现确定性或概率性预测。
Result: 稀疏条件算子学习在多个基准上可行，能在某些场景匹配密集网格性能；非周期设置中保留局部上下文-查询几何至关重要，而谱平滑周期设置中则不那么敏感；不确定性感知算子学习在潜在条件与局部几何路径互补而非覆盖时成功。
Conclusion: NOPs 为部分观测下的概率算子学习提供了基础，有助于在函数空间上桥接算子学习和概率元学习，但论文未在真实天气预报或降水应用中验证。

papers.title: Controllable Texture Tiling with Transformed RoPE-Enhanced Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Realistic integration of user-specified textures into scene images is a fundamental task in computer graphics and image editing. While existing material transfer and reference-guided inpainting methods can edit surface appearances, they often fail to address the specific requirements of texture tiling. This task necessitates precisely repeating a reference pattern according to user-defined parameters such as frequency, orientation, and scale. Furthermore, current generative approaches often struggle to maintain the structural fidelity of the reference texture, limited by either destructive pixel-level resampling or the lack of fine-grained spatial information in semantic image encoders, and they frequently fail to preserve the coherent lighting and geometry of the original scene. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for controllable and high-fidelity texture tiling based on Diffusion Transformers. Our approach introduces two key technical innovations to decouple spatial manipulation from content generation. First, we propose a Coordinate-Transformed Rotary Embedding mechanism. By applying 2D affine transformations directly to the relative positional embeddings between the target latent and the image condition, we achieve precise control over tiling patterns without explicit pixel warping, thereby utilizing the full information of the reference condition without degradation. Second, a Disjoint Attention Mask is employed to shield reference features from semantic leakage. This preserves structural integrity while seamlessly blending the synthesized texture with the scene's original lighting and geometry. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both control accuracy and texture fidelity.
papers.comment: The code and dataset are publicly accessible at https://github.com/junrongh/ControlTile
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩散Transformer的可控纹理平铺框架，通过坐标变换的旋转位置嵌入（Coordinate-Transformed Rotary Embedding）实现精确的平铺参数控制，并利用不交并注意力掩码（Disjoint Attention Mask）保持参考纹理的结构完整性，同时与场景光照几何无缝融合。实验表明该方法在控制精度和纹理保真度上超越现有基线。
Motivation: 现有纹理编辑方法无法满足纹理平铺任务中精确重复参考图案的需求（如频率、方向、尺度），且生成方法常因像素级重采样或缺乏细粒度空间信息而破坏结构保真度，同时难以保持场景光照和几何一致性。
Method: 提出两个关键技术：1）坐标变换旋转位置嵌入（CT-RoPE），对目标潜变量与图像条件之间的相对位置嵌入施加2D仿射变换，实现无需显式像素扭曲的平铺控制；2）不交并注意力掩码，防止参考特征语义泄漏，在合成纹理时保留场景原始光照和几何。
Result: 在多个基准上，该方法的控制精度和纹理保真度均优于现有最先进基线。
Conclusion: 该框架通过解耦空间操作与内容生成，实现了可控且高保真的纹理平铺，适用于计算机图形学和图像编辑中的实际应用。

papers.title: Evaluating self-supervised echocardiographic representations across downstream extraction strategies for left-ventricular segmentation and ejection fraction estimation
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is increasingly used in medical imaging to reduce annotation requirements, but representation quality is often judged using a single downstream evaluation setting. For dense clinical tasks, this can confound representation quality with the capacity of the downstream model used to recover task-relevant information. We present a systematic evaluation of self-supervised representations for left-ventricular segmentation and ejection fraction (EF) estimation from apical four-chamber echocardiography on EchoNet-Dynamic. Rather than relying on a single downstream probe, we compare a hierarchy of extraction strategies with increasing expressivity: heuristic extraction without mask-supervised training, frozen linear probes, frozen lightweight decoder probes, and partial fine-tuning. We apply this framework to two complementary representation families: generic frozen self-DIstillation with NO labels (DINOv3) features and a task-adapted dense self-supervised representation, Bootstrap Your Own Segmentation (BYOS). In both families, heuristic extraction substantially understated what was recoverable from the frozen representation. For DINOv3, performance improved from Dice 0.684 and EF mean absolute error (MAE) 13.01 under heuristic extraction to Dice 0.906 and EF MAE 9.65 with a frozen lightweight decoder, approaching a supervised U-Net baseline (Dice 0.915, EF MAE 9.72). For BYOS, performance improved from Dice 0.687 and EF MAE 17.83 under heuristic extraction to Dice 0.902 and EF MAE 8.74 with a frozen lightweight decoder. These results show that conclusions about self-supervised representation quality in dense echocardiographic analysis depend strongly on the downstream extraction strategy used for evaluation. We therefore argue that multi-strategy evaluation is an important methodological consideration for SSL in dense medical image analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了自监督学习（SSL）在左心室分割和射血分数估计中的表示质量，针对EchoNet-Dynamic数据集上的心尖四腔超声图像。不同于依赖单一下游探测方法，作者比较了从启发式提取到冻结线性探针、冻结轻量化解码器探针和部分微调等一系列表示提取策略。结果表明，启发式提取严重低估了冻结表示的可恢复性能，而多策略评估对于SSL在密集医学图像分析中的结论至关重要。
Motivation: 自监督学习在医学影像中广泛应用，但表示质量常仅通过单一下游评估设置来判断。对于密集临床任务，这可能会混淆表示质量与下游模型恢复任务相关信息的能力，因此需要系统评估不同的下游提取策略。
Method: 提出层次化评估框架，比较四种表示提取策略：启发式提取（无监督训练）、冻结线性探针、冻结轻量化解码器探针和部分微调。应用该框架评估两种互补表示家族：通用的冻结DINOv3特征和任务适应的密集自监督表示BYOS。
Result: 对于DINOv3，启发式提取的Dice为0.684、EF MAE为13.01，使用冻结轻量化解码器后提升至Dice 0.906、EF MAE 9.65，接近有监督U-Net基线（Dice 0.915、EF MAE 9.72）。对于BYOS，从启发式提取的Dice 0.687、EF MAE 17.83提升至冻结轻量化解码器的Dice 0.902、EF MAE 8.74。
Conclusion: 结论表明，在密集超声心动图分析中，关于自监督表示质量的结论强烈依赖于下游提取策略。因此，多策略评估应成为SSL在密集医学图像分析中的方法论考量。

papers.title: CITADEL: CSI-Based Jamming Detection and Open-Set Classification for IIoT Networks
authors: Ildi Alla (this http URL)
Vincent Lenders (this http URL)
papers.abstract_en: Radio frequency jamming poses a critical threat to the availability of wireless Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) networks. Existing detection and classification techniques are poorly suited to this setting: coarse signal-strength and cross-layer features lack information richness, while raw I/Q baseband approaches require hardware and throughput that is impractical at the scale of hundred-node IIoT deployments. This paper presents CITADEL, a lightweight two-stage hierarchical pipeline that uses only Channel State Information (CSI) measurements, which are natively available on commodity IIoT devices, to detect and classify jamming attacks including previously unseen ones. While prior work has shown that jamming leaves observable CSI signatures, CITADEL is the first system to translate this insight into an end-to-end pipeline that jointly achieves closed-set classification of known attacks, open-set detection of zero-day attacks, and resistance to adversarial evasion. Evaluated across 6 known attack types and 15 zero-day scenarios, CITADEL achieves 100% known-attack detection and 97.1% zero-day detection at a 0.4% end-to-end false positive rate. Under adversarial evaluation spanning white-box and black-box threat models, gradient-based evasion remains below 2% across all tested perturbation budgets and the strongest published CSI attack generator achieves less than 5% average evasion. A systematic comparison against eight baselines confirms that no existing method achieves comparable performance on CSI data across all three axes: detection, generalization, and robustness. The full pipeline completes inference in 14.2 ms at 95.9 mJ on an edge GPU, establishing CITADEL as a practical solution for large-scale IIoT network security.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CITADEL，一种基于信道状态信息（CSI）的轻量级两级分层流水线，用于工业物联网（IIoT）网络中的干扰检测与开放集分类。它利用IIoT设备原生可用的CSI测量，实现已知攻击的闭集分类、零日攻击的开放集检测以及对抗性规避的抵抗。在6种已知攻击类型和15种零日场景下评估，已知攻击检测率100%，零日检测率97.1%，端到端假阳性率0.4%。在边缘GPU上推理时间14.2 ms，能耗95.9 mJ。
Motivation: 射频干扰对IIoT网络可用性构成威胁，现有检测和分类技术不适用于大规模IIoT场景：粗粒度信号强度与跨层特征信息不足，原始I/Q基带方法硬件和吞吐量要求不切实际，需要一种轻量级且使用CSI的方法。
Method: 提出CITADEL，一种仅使用CSI测量的两级分层流水线，第一级检测干扰，第二级进行开放集分类（包括已知攻击和零日攻击），并融入对抗性鲁棒性设计。
Result: 在6种已知攻击和15种零日场景下，已知攻击检测100%，零日检测97.1%，假阳性率0.4%。对抗性评估中梯度逃脱率低于2%，最强CSI攻击生成器平均逃脱率低于5%。与8个基线比较，在所有三个轴（检测、泛化、鲁棒性）上均无现有方法可比。边缘GPU推理14.2 ms，能耗95.9 mJ。
Conclusion: CITADEL是首个将CSI干扰签名转化为端到端流水线的系统，同时实现闭集分类、开放集检测和对抗鲁棒性，且足够轻量适用于大规模IIoT网络安全。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Provable Benefits of RLVR over SFT for Reasoning Models: Learning to Backtrack Efficiently
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated that reinforcement fine-tuning of pretrained base models can lead to significant gains in reasoning performance at inference time. In this work, we theoretically analyze why reinforcement fine-tuning induces better reasoning ability than purely supervised fine-tuning (SFT) methods. We model chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning as a pathfinding problem on graphs and compare the popular method of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) against traditional SFT. We prove that SFT, when trained on golden shortest paths without negative examples, fails to learn how to efficiently backtrack. In contrast, an RLVR-trained model can learn how to efficiently backtrack from dead ends using only outcome reward. This leads to an exponential separation in inference-time compute between the two methods, and demonstrates that RLVR leads the model to learn the location of difficult decisions in a reasoning chain, ultimately allowing for better allocation of inference-time compute. Finally, we show that the reasoning traces of an RLVR model can be distilled to train a base model to backtrack efficiently as well.

papers.title: When Agents Commit Too Soon: Diagnosing Premature Commitment in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents can fail quietly: they settle on one reading of the evidence early, then spend the rest of the run defending it. We call this premature commitment. Final-answer scoring misses the failure mode because it sees only the answer, not whether the process has already collapsed to a stable path. We define representational commitment as cross-run hidden-state convergence at a fixed reasoning step, and use it as an early diagnostic of trajectory consistency. On Llama-3.1-70B running ReAct on HotpotQA, step-4 hidden-state similarity predicts downstream behavioral consistency (r = -0.35, partial r = -0.45), with a localized temporal and layer-wise signature. The signal replicates across Qwen-2.5-72B and Phi-3-14B, and on StrategyQA (r = -0.83). It does not track correctness: committed-wrong and committed-correct questions are not separable in activation similarity. That boundary is central to the claim. Commitment tells us whether an agent has settled, not whether it is right. A runtime monitor detects inconsistent trajectories from hidden states at AUROC up to 0.97 (0.85--0.88 under a stricter split), and a prompting intervention cuts behavioral variance by 28% against a token-matched control while leaving accuracy statistically unchanged. We also test whether the signal can route self-consistency compute; on a harder benchmark it helps only modestly and is matched by a simpler output-based baseline. The result is a diagnostic for a hidden process failure, with clear limits rather than a general accuracy lever.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现长周期LLM代理存在一种隐蔽的失败模式：过早承诺（premature commitment），即代理在任务早期就固定了对证据的一种解读，后续只是维护这一解读。作者提出表征承诺（representational commitment）作为诊断指标，通过跨运行的隐藏状态收敛性来检测轨迹是否已坍塌为稳定路径。在Llama-3.1-70B等模型和HotpotQA等基准上，该方法能高精度（AUROC达0.97）检测不一致轨迹，但该信号不追踪正确性，且作为自我一致性计算路由的效果有限。
Motivation: 现有最终答案评分无法捕捉代理在推理过程中过早固定的失败模式，因为评分只关注最终答案而忽略推理过程是否已固化。作者希望提出一种早期诊断方法来检测这种隐性过程失败。
Method: 定义表征承诺为同一推理步骤在不同运行中隐藏状态的收敛程度，并以此作为轨迹一致性的早期诊断指标。在ReAct框架下使用Llama-3.1-70B等模型进行实验，并通过运行时监控器从隐藏状态检测不一致轨迹（AUROC达0.97），同时采用提示干预降低行为方差。
Result: 在HotpotQA上，第4步隐藏状态相似性可预测下游行为一致性（r=-0.35, 偏相关r=-0.45）；在StrategyQA上相关性更强（r=-0.83）。监控器在标准设定下AUROC达0.97，更严格划分下为0.85–0.88。提示干预使行为方差降低28%而不显著改变准确率。但该信号不能有效区分正确和错误的承诺，且作为自一致性计算路由仅带来微弱提升。
Conclusion: 提出的诊断方法能有效检测代理推理过程中的过早承诺这一隐性失败，但明确指出了其局限性：不追踪正确性，且在改善硬基准任务准确率方面作用有限，不能作为通用的准确性杠杆。

papers.title: Hybrid Compression: Integrating Pruning and Quantization for Optimized Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks have witnessed remarkable advancements in recent years and have become integral to various applications. However, alongside these developments, training and deployment of neural network models on embedding and edge devices face significant challenges due to limited memory and computational resources. These problems can be addressed with deep neural network compression, which involves a trade-off between model size and performance. In this paper, we propose a novel method for model compression through two phases. First, we utilize model compression techniques, such as pruning and quantization, to significantly reduce the model size. Then, we use Mixture of Experts to route the previously compressed models to enhance performance while maintaining a balance in inference efficiency. MoEs consist of multiple expert models (i.e., compressed models) that are moderately sized and deliver stable performance. Experimental results on several benchmark datasets show that our method successfully compresses CNN models which achieves substantial reductions in FLOPs and parameters with a negligible accuracy drop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种两阶段混合压缩方法，先对深度神经网络进行剪枝和量化以减小模型尺寸，再使用混合专家（Mixture of Experts）路由多个压缩后的子模型以提升性能并保持推理效率。在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法能显著降低CNN模型的FLOPs和参数量，且精度损失极小。
Motivation: 深度神经网络在嵌入式设备和边缘设备上部署时面临内存和计算资源限制，现有压缩方法在模型大小与性能之间存在权衡。
Method: 提出两阶段压缩：第一阶段采用剪枝和量化技术减小模型尺寸；第二阶段使用混合专家（MoE）路由多个压缩后的子模型，在保持推理效率的同时提升性能。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上，该方法成功压缩CNN模型，实现了FLOPs和参数量的显著减少，且精度下降可忽略。
Conclusion: 混合压缩结合剪枝、量化与MoE路由可有效平衡模型大小与性能，适用于资源受限的设备。

papers.title: FORGE: Fused On-Register Gradient Elimination for Memory-Efficient LLM Training
papers.abstract_en: Reverse-mode differentiation computes every weight gradient, writes it to memory, and only then lets the optimizer read it back. This two-phase schedule sets the memory ceiling of modern training: at the seam between the phases, every layer's gradient is live at once. We argue that this materialized gradient is an artifact of how differentiation is staged, not a quantity that learning requires -- and we eliminate it. FORGE folds the optimizer step into the backward pass and applies it one tile at a time, entirely in registers, so each gradient tile is consumed the instant it is produced and never becomes a tensor. The fusion changes only when the update happens, not what it computes: in full precision the fused step is provably exact -- the identical optimizer update, for every element-wise rule -- and that exactness survives tensor- and sequence-parallel sharding; in the bf16 and 8-bit regimes used in practice it is faithful rather than bit-identical, its deviation bounded and, for the weight store, rendered unbiased by stochastic rounding. Because each gradient tile is born and consumed in the same registers, it is never converted down to bf16 to be stored and read back; FORGE thus preserves the full-precision fidelity that both bf16 and 8-bit optimizers lose to that conversion. Nor is the method tied to one architecture or one optimizer: linear layers are ubiquitous, and FORGE reclaims the gradient memory of any of them under any element-wise rule. Empirically FORGE more than halves the memory of an optimizer step and, at the small batch sizes typical of fine-tuning and continued pretraining, runs about 1.5x faster; integrated into tensor-parallel Megatron-LM it fits 8B training at four times the micro-batch a standard optimizer allows on the same GPUs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FORGE 方法，通过在反向传播过程中融合优化器步骤，在寄存器中逐块处理梯度，从而消除梯度张量的物化。该方法在保持全精度保真度的同时，降低了训练内存需求，并在小批量场景下提升了训练速度。实验表明，FORGE 在张量并行 Megatron-LM 中可将微批量大小提升至标准方法的四倍。
Motivation: 传统反向传播中，所有梯度被计算并写入内存后，优化器再读取，导致存储大量梯度张量成为内存瓶颈。本文认为这种物化梯度是计算阶段的产物，并非学习所必需。
Method: FORGE 将优化器更新步骤融合到反向传播中，以寄存器级粒度逐块处理梯度，每个梯度块生成后立即被消费，从不形成完整张量。该方法支持全精度精确等价，且在 bf16 和 8 位模式下通过随机舍入保证无偏性。
Result: FORGE 将优化器内存使用减少一半以上，在小批量微调场景下训练速度提升约 1.5 倍。集成到张量并行 Megatron-LM 后，可在相同 GPU 上支持 8B 模型以四倍标准微批量大小训练。
Conclusion: FORGE 与模型架构和优化器无关，适用于任意逐元素优化规则的线性层，有效消除梯度存储并保持全精度精度。

papers.title: BEV-Denoise: Learning Intrinsic Noise for Accurate Bird's-Eye-View Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present a framework dubbed \textbf{BEV-Denoise} that estimates and removes intrinsic noise from learned Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) features to achieve accurate BEV semantic segmentation. Inspired by the noise estimation capability of Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM), we design a UNet-based noise estimation module that learns to estimate the noise from the learned BEV features. The estimated noise is then subtracted from the BEV features and fed to BEV map decoders for the final prediction results. To facilitate supervision for the noise estimation module, we follow a sequential learning paradigm called Task Decomposition (TD) where a pre-trained BEV map autoencoder is employed to train a view transformation (VT) encoder. We share three key insights learned from our intensive experiments that are critical for improved performance. We apply our framework to four existing models, encompassing the three major VT paradigms. Experimental results on a large-scale real-world dataset, nuScenes, demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BEV-Denoise框架，利用去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）的噪声估计能力，设计UNet-based噪声估计模块，从学习到的鸟瞰图（BEV）特征中估计并移除固有噪声，以提升BEV语义分割精度。采用任务分解（Task Decomposition）的序贯学习范式，使用预训练BEV自编码器训练视图变换编码器。在nuScenes真实世界数据集上应用于四种现有模型，验证了有效性。
Motivation: BEV特征中存在的固有噪声会降低语义分割精度，现有方法缺乏针对性的噪声估计与去除机制。
Method: 设计UNet-based噪声估计模块，借鉴DDPM的噪声估计能力，从BEV特征中学习噪声并减去；采用任务分解范式，利用预训练BEV自编码器监督训练视图变换编码器。
Result: 在nuScenes数据集上，该方法应用于四种现有模型（涵盖三种主要视图变换范式）均提升了BEV语义分割性能。
Conclusion: 噪声估计与去除是提升BEV语义分割的有效途径，所提框架具有通用性且效果显著。

papers.title: EEG Benchmarking Needs a Task Specification Layer: NeuroDoc for Rulebook-Guided, Executable Benchmark Construction
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models increasingly rely on multi-dataset training and evaluation, yet public EEG datasets still lack a shared task specification layer that can turn heterogeneous recordings into reusable benchmark units. Existing standards organize files, metadata, and provenance, but they do not specify EEG tasks under a common language and rulebook, leaving critical task semantics scattered across papers, code, and manual interpretation. We investigate whether heterogeneous public EEG datasets can be standardized through a structured task specification language paired with a shared rulebook. Our methodology represents each benchmark entry as a task document synchronized with an executable task kernel, with the rulebook defining task fields, evidence requirements, document-kernel alignment, review states, and machine-checkable constraints. Using this methodology, we release a community-reviewed EEG benchmark corpus centered on 53 completed and reviewed entries with 245 task definitions spanning diverse paradigms, and we introduce NeuroDoc and NeuroAudit as the operational support layer for rulebook-guided drafting, upgrading, review, amendment, and release management. We further examine whether the resulting benchmark units can be instantiated in a shared downstream setting across four EEG foundation model backbones, providing execution-based evidence for reusable, auditable, and executable EEG benchmarking infrastructure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对EEG基础模型在多数据集训练和评估中缺乏共享任务规范层的问题，提出了一种结构化任务规范语言和共享规则书，用于将异构EEG数据集标准化为可执行的基准单元。通过NeuroDoc和NeuroAudit工具，构建了一个包含53个已完成条目和245个任务定义的社区审查EEG基准语料库，并在四个EEG基础模型上验证了其可重用性和可审计性。
Motivation: 现有EEG数据集缺乏统一的语言和规则书来定义任务，导致任务语义分散在论文、代码和人工解释中，阻碍了基准测试的可重复性和可扩展性。
Method: 提出方法论：每个基准条目表示为一个任务文档（task document）与一个可执行任务内核（executable task kernel）同步，规则书定义任务字段、证据要求、文档-内核对齐、审查状态和机器可检查约束。同时开发NeuroDoc和NeuroAudit支持规则书指导的起草、升级、审查、修订和发布管理。
Result: 发布了一个社区审查的EEG基准语料库，包含53个已完成条目和245个任务定义，并在四个EEG基础模型上提供了执行证据，证明该方法可生成可重用、可审计、可执行的基准测试基础设施。

papers.title: MythraGen: Two-Stage Retrieval Augmented Art Generation Framework
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image generation has seen rapid advancements, especially with the development of generative models. However, challenges remain in achieving high-quality, contextually accurate image outputs that faithfully match the provided textual descriptions, especially in artistic generation. In this paper, we present a simple yet efficient retrieval augmented generation framework, namely MythraGen, for text-to-artistic image generation by integrating an art retrieval mechanism with LoRA-based model fine-tuning. Our method extracts features from a large-scale art dataset, optimizing the generation process by combining artist-specific styles and content. Particularly, retrieved images from an external art database that have the highest similarity to the query prompt are used to finetune Stable Diffusion using LoRA for desired art generation. Experimental results and user studies on the WikiArt dataset show that our proposed method can generate artworks that closely match the user's input, significantly outperforming existing solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MythraGen，一个两阶段检索增强的艺术图像生成框架，结合艺术检索机制和LoRA模型微调，从大型艺术数据集中提取特征，使用与查询提示最相似的检索图像微调Stable Diffusion。在WikiArt数据集上的实验和用户研究表明，该方法能生成更符合用户输入的艺术作品，显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 文本到图像生成在艺术生成领域仍面临生成图像质量不高、上下文不准确、难以匹配文本描述的问题。
Method: 提出两阶段检索增强生成框架：首先从外部艺术数据库检索与提示最相似的图像，然后使用这些图像通过LoRA微调Stable Diffusion，以融合艺术家风格和内容。
Result: 在WikiArt数据集上，该方法生成的艺术作品在用户研究和定量指标上显著优于现有解决方案。
Conclusion: 检索增强结合LoRA微调能有效提升文本到艺术图像生成的准确性和质量。

papers.title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Sparse-Reward Search in Commutative Algebra
papers.abstract_en: Applying machine learning techniques to solving long-standing mathematical conjectures can be particularly challenging due to their extreme reward sparsity. As an illustrative example, we consider Kalai's algebraic Hirsch conjecture and recast the construction of its counterexamples as a sparse-reward reinforcement learning problem on graphs. We propose a constrained options-based HRL framework with an equivariant graph neural network policy, which allows us to learn useful temporal abstractions for this task. We evaluate our approach over a wide range of degrees and demonstrate that it consistently outperforms classical RL algorithms as well as greedy search. By exploiting the hierarchical structure of the problem, we effectively provide a first-of-its-kind application of HRL to a problem in commutative algebra.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 15 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对数学猜想求解中奖励极度稀疏的问题，以Kalai代数Hirsch猜想为例，将反例构造转化为图上的稀疏奖励强化学习问题。提出基于约束选项（options）的分层强化学习（HRL）框架，策略网络采用等变图神经网络（equivariant GNN），学习有用的时间抽象（temporal abstractions）。实验在广泛度数范围内表明，该方法持续优于经典RL算法和贪心搜索，是HRL在交换代数问题上的首次应用。
Motivation: 数学猜想求解中奖励极度稀疏，传统强化学习方法难以有效探索；此前缺乏将分层强化学习应用于交换代数问题的研究。
Method: 将Kalai代数Hirsch猜想的反例构造建模为图上的稀疏奖励强化学习问题；提出约束选项（constrained options）的HRL框架，策略网络使用等变图神经网络；通过分层结构学习时间抽象以指导探索。
Result: 在广泛度数范围内，所提HRL方法持续优于经典RL算法和贪心搜索。
Conclusion: 该工作首次将HRL应用于交换代数问题，展示了利用分层结构解决稀疏奖励数学问题的有效性。

papers.title: Each Judge Its Own Yardstick: Discovering Per-VLM Taxonomies for Physical Video Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Maintaining physical consistency in video generators and world models increasingly relies on vision-language models (VLMs) as automated judges that provide reward signals, ranking decisions, and data-filtering criteria. Yet VLMs differ substantially in training data and architecture, encoding physical phenomena through distinct internal representations. A single global evaluation schema therefore gives every VLM the same axes of competence, regardless of what each can actually perceive. We propose JudgeFit, an iterative refinement procedure that discovers a per-VLM evaluation taxonomy. An initial taxonomy is constructed by prompting the target VLM to enumerate physics errors on a small set of videos and clustering the resulting descriptions. The taxonomy is then refined through a diagnostic step: we calibrate the VLM's per-dimension scores to human physical-commonsense ratings, diagnose which dimensions it scores unreliably or redundantly, and prompt an LLM to repair them, iterating until convergence. We further instantiate this procedure as a benchmark and apply it to 16 VLMs spanning eight model families. The refined taxonomy outperforms the global-schema baseline on held-out videos for every VLM tested, with a mean relative improvement of approximately 32%. Beyond aggregate accuracy, the per-VLM profiles expose model-specific blind spots that overall rankings cannot anticipate, with reliability patterns differing markedly across model families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出JudgeFit，一种为每个视觉语言模型（VLM）发现其自身评估分类法的迭代优化方法，用于物理视频一致性的自动评估。通过在16个VLM上的实验，该方法的细粒度分类法在每个VLM上都优于全局统一基线，平均相对提升约32%，并揭示了模型家族间的盲点差异。
Motivation: 现有全局评估分类法假设所有VLM具有相同的感知能力，忽视了不同VLM在训练数据和架构上的差异，导致评估不准确。
Method: JudgeFit通过两步迭代实现：首先用目标VLM对少量视频列举物理错误并聚类构建初始分类法，然后通过诊断步骤校准各维度得分至人类常识、识别不可靠或冗余维度，并用LLM修复，直至收敛。
Result: 在16个VLM（涵盖8个模型家族）的测试中，每类VLM的定制分类法在留出视频上均优于全局基线，平均相对改进约32%，并暴露了模型特定的盲点。
Conclusion: 作者认为每个VLM需要量身定制的评估轴，全局排名无法预测各模型的可靠模式，JudgeFit为可靠自动化物理评估提供了新方向。

papers.title: GRAIN: Group Aggregation via Min-Norm Objective
papers.abstract_en: Learning instability is a long-standing problem across machine learning, but it is especially acute in the overparameterized regime that defines modern deep learning: large models fine-tuned or trained on limited data traverse flat loss landscapes with many nearly-equivalent minima, and stochastic factors (initialization, data order, dropout, hardware non-determinism) can route optimization to very different solutions. The rise of large pretrained models (LPMs) makes the problem more urgent: training cost is high, downstream data is often small, and repeated runs for variance reduction are prohibitive. We introduce \textbf{GRAIN} (\textbf{G}roup \textbf{A}ggregation via m\textbf{IN}-norm objective), a lightweight training algorithm that replaces the mean aggregation used in mini-batch optimization (both across mini-batches and within a mini-batch) with a min-norm convex combination of group-wise gradients. \mName guarantees a non-negative inner product between the aggregated update and every group gradient, resolving intra- and inner-batch gradient conflict, and retains an $\mathcal{O}(1/T)$ convergence rate comparable to SGD. Under mild smoothness and absolute-continuity assumptions, the min-norm solution differs almost surely from the arithmetic mean, which yields a uniform-stability bound for \mName strictly tighter than the standard bound for SGD. Empirically across generation, classification, and regression at LPM scale, \mName delivers consistent improvements in mean performance and reductions in run-to-run variance over a broad suite of tasks, with no extra training-time or storage cost beyond a single backward pass.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GRAIN算法，用最小范数凸组合替代小批量优化中的均值聚合，解决梯度冲突，并证明其收敛性和更紧的一致稳定性界。在大规模预训练模型上实验显示性能提升和方差降低。
Motivation: 现代深度学习中过参数化模型训练不稳定，随机因素导致不同解；大规模预训练模型训练成本高，下游数据有限，重复运行降方差不可行。
Method: 提出GRAIN算法，将小批量优化中的均值聚合替换为基于组梯度最小范数凸组合的聚合方式，保证聚合更新与每个组梯度内积非负，并保持与SGD相当的O(1/T)收敛率。
Result: 在生成、分类和回归等大规模预训练模型任务上，GRAIN在平均性能和运行间方差方面均有改善，且不增加额外训练时间或存储成本。
Conclusion: GRAIN是一种轻量级训练算法，通过最小范数聚合解决梯度冲突，并理论上提供更紧的稳定性界。实验证明其有效性。

papers.title: Intent-Governed Tool Authorization for AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents increasingly act through external tools: they read private data, construct structured payloads, submit write requests, export records, and coordinate workflows across application boundaries. Existing authorization mechanisms usually ask whether an integration credential, app, or token can call a tool. That question is necessary but incomplete. A tool call can be authorized by static credentials and still be unjustified by the user's current request. For example, a credential that can read and export records should not expose export authority when the user only asked for a bounded summary, and a model-generated delete call should not execute merely because the integration has a delete scope. This paper proposes Intent-Governed Access Control (IGAC), a server-side authorization layer that treats the user's expressed intent as a monotone, auditable policy attribute for AI-agent tool use. IGAC introduces intent certificates, session-scoped policy narrowing, intent-aware manifest filtering, and intent-tool-payload consistency checks. The central invariant is that user intent may only reduce the authority granted by static integration policy; it never expands scopes, data policy, tenant boundaries, or review requirements. We map IGAC onto OpenPort, an existing governance substrate that already implements authorization-dependent discovery, scope and ABAC-style policy checks, draft-first writes, preflight impact binding, state-witness checks, idempotency, stable reason codes, and audit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Intent-Governed Access Control (IGAC)，一种服务端授权层，将用户的表达意图作为单调、可审计的策略属性用于 AI 代理工具调用。IGAC 引入意图证书、会话范围策略收紧、意图感知清单过滤以及意图-工具-载荷一致性检查，确保用户意图只能减少静态集成策略的授权范围，不会扩大权限。文章将 IGAC 映射到现有治理平台 OpenPort 上。
Motivation: 现有授权机制仅检查凭证、应用或令牌是否有权调用工具，但未考虑工具调用是否与用户当前请求的意图相匹配。例如，有读写权限的凭证不应在用户仅请求摘要时暴露导出权限，模型生成的删除调用不应仅因集成有删除范围而执行。
Method: 提出 IGAC 框架，核心包括：意图证书、会话范围策略收紧、意图感知清单过滤、意图-工具-载荷一致性检查。意图作为单调政策属性，仅能缩小权限，不能扩大。
Result: 论文未提供实验评估，主要贡献为概念框架和系统设计，并将其映射到 OpenPort 平台。
Conclusion: IGAC 提供了一种原则性的方法，确保 AI 代理的工具调用受用户当前意图约束，增强安全性和可审计性。

papers.title: PromptDyG: Test-Time Prompt Adaptation on Dynamic Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Activities in numerous evolving systems can be represented as dynamic graphs in snapshot form at different time intervals, i.e., discrete-time dynamic graphs (DTDGs). Existing methods show impressive advances in capturing historical temporal evolution patterns in DTDGs, but they focus on addressing an offline learning setting, where models are trained using historical snapshots once and then evaluated to all subsequent graph snapshots without further updating. This fails to capture 1) the nature of evolving complexities across graph snapshots and 2) the distribution shift in the testing graph snapshots. To address these problems, we propose PromptDyG, a novel framework that leverages unsupervised test-time Prompt adaptation for Dynamic Graph learning under a live-update online setting. The key insight is that an expressive dynamic graph prompt can be learned on a frozen backbone via minimization of feature-wise, label-free entropy to efficiently and continuously model the evolving patterns. We show theoretically that this unsupervised prompt adaptation can guarantee a larger similarity margin between positive and negative pairs, facilitating more accurate dynamic predictions. It is further confirmed by our extensive empirical results on six benchmark datasets that show consistent and significant improvements of PromptDyG over state-of-the-art baselines.

Result: 在六个基准数据集上，PromptDyG 相对于最先进基线取得一致且显著的性能提升。
Conclusion: 该无监督提示适应方法在理论上能保证更大正负样本对相似性间隔，从而支持更准确的动态预测，实验进一步验证了有效性。

papers.title: Intend, Reflect, Refine: An Adaptive Multimodal Reflection Framework for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced end-to-end autonomous driving by incorporating reasoning for better interpretability and planning quality. However, most existing approaches directly generate the final trajectory without explicitly examining its future consequences, which limits their reliability in complex and dynamic environments. To address this limitation, we propose IRR-Drive (Intend, Reflect, Refine), an adaptive multimodal reflection framework for autonomous driving. Specifically, to tightly couple high-level reasoning with physical constraints, IRR-Drive first generates a preliminary textual intention and anticipates potential interactions by predicting future semantic bird's-eye view (BEV) representations. This dual-modality (Text + BEV) reflection space explicitly models anticipated scene evolution, enabling the model to rigorously self-correct and refine its initial intent before generating the final trajectory. Furthermore, to balance planning performance and computational efficiency, we construct reflection-oriented training data and design an adaptive reflection reward, enabling the model to adaptively select its reasoning mode according to scene complexity. Instead of using reasoning primarily as an auxiliary interpretation, IRR-Drive directly integrates an adaptive reflection mechanism into the planning framework, enabling grounded, decision-aware trajectory correction that is driven by scene complexity. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the NAVSIM benchmark in both PDMS and EPDMS. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our multimodal reflection framework and validate the efficacy of the proposed adaptive reflection strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IRR-Drive，一个用于自动驾驶的自适应多模态反思框架。它首先生成初步的文本意图，预测未来语义鸟瞰图（BEV）表示，形成文本+BEV的双模态反思空间，使模型能够自我纠正并优化初始意图，然后生成最终轨迹。通过构建反思导向的训练数据和自适应反思奖励，模型可根据场景复杂度自适应选择推理模式。在NAVSIM基准上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型直接生成最终轨迹，未明确检查其未来后果，限制了在复杂动态环境中的可靠性。
Method: 提出IRR-Drive框架，包括：生成初步文本意图并预测未来语义BEV表示，形成双模态反思空间；构建反思导向训练数据和自适应反思奖励，使模型根据场景复杂度选择推理模式。
Result: 在NAVSIM基准上，PDMS和EPDMS均达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将自适应反思机制直接集成到规划框架中，实现基于场景复杂性的、扎根的、决策感知的轨迹修正。
