papers.title: Revisiting Shadow Detection from a Vision-Language Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Shadow detection is commonly formulated as a vision-driven dense prediction problem, where models rely primarily on pixel-wise visual supervision to distinguish shadows from non-shadow regions. However, this formulation can become unreliable in visually ambiguous cases, where similar dark regions may correspond either to cast shadows or to intrinsically dark surfaces, making visual evidence alone insufficient for establishing a stable decision rule. In this work, we revisit shadow detection from a vision--language perspective and argue that robust prediction benefits from an explicit semantic reference beyond visual cues alone. We propose SVL, a Shadow Vision--Language framework that uses language as an explicit semantic reference to disambiguate shadows from visually similar dark regions. SVL aligns global image representations with shadow-related text embeddings through scene-level shadow ratio regression, and transfers this semantic guidance to dense prediction via global-to-local coupling and local patch-level constraints. Built on a frozen DINOv3 image encoder, SVL learns only lightweight projection and decoding modules, yielding a parameter-efficient design with less than $1\%$ trainable parameters. Extensive experiments on multiple shadow detection benchmarks, including dedicated hard-case evaluations, suggest strong overall performance and improved robustness under visually ambiguous conditions. Code is available at https://github.com/harrytea/SVL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从视觉-语言视角重新审视阴影检测，提出SVL框架，利用语言作为显式语义参考来区分阴影与视觉上相似的暗区域。SVL通过场景级阴影比率回归对齐全局图像与阴影文本嵌入，并通过全局到局部的耦合和局部补丁级约束将语义指导传递给密集预测。基于冻结的DINOv3图像编码器，仅训练轻量级投影和解码模块，可训练参数少于1%。在多个阴影检测基准上取得强性能，尤其在视觉模糊条件下鲁棒性提升。
Motivation: 现有阴影检测主要依赖像素级视觉监督，但在视觉模糊情况下（如暗区域可能是阴影或固有暗表面），视觉证据不足以建立稳定的决策规则，需要额外的语义参考。
Method: 提出Shadow Vision-Language (SVL)框架，使用语言作为显式语义参考。通过场景级阴影比率回归对齐全局图像与阴影文本嵌入，再通过全局到局部的耦合和局部补丁级约束将语义指导传递给密集预测。采用冻结的DINOv3编码器，仅训练轻量级投影和解码模块。
Result: 在多个阴影检测基准上取得强总体性能，尤其在专门设计的硬案例评估中，在视觉模糊条件下表现出改进的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 本文论证了从视觉-语言角度进行阴影检测的有效性，语言语义参考有助于解决视觉模糊情况下的歧义，且参数高效。

papers.title: MARGIN: Margin-Aware Regularized Geometry for Imbalanced Vulnerability Detection
papers.abstract_en: Software vulnerability detection is critical for ensuring software security and reliability. Despite recent advances in deep learning, real-world vulnerability datasets suffer from two severe challenges: frequency imbalance and difficulty imbalance. We reinterpret these challenges from an embedding geometry perspective, observing that such imbalances induce geometric distortions in hyperspherical representation space. To address this issue, we propose MARGIN, a metric-based framework that learns discriminative vulnerability representations through adaptive margin metric learning and hyperspherical prototype modeling. MARGIN dynamically adjusts geometric regularization according to the distribution structure estimated by the von Mises-Fisher concentration, aligning the probability mass of embedding distributions with their corresponding Voronoi cells, thereby reducing geometric distortion and yielding more stable decision boundaries. Extensive experiments on public vulnerability datasets show that MARGIN consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving notable improvements in classification and detection, especially on challenging, imbalanced datasets. Further analysis demonstrates that MARGIN produces more structured embedding geometries, improving robustness, interpretability, and generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从嵌入几何角度重新审视软件漏洞检测中的频率不平衡和难度不平衡问题，提出MARGIN框架。该框架通过自适应边距度量学习和超球面原型建模，利用von Mises-Fisher浓度估计分布结构并动态调整几何正则化，使嵌入分布的概率质量与其Voronoi单元对齐，从而减少几何畸变并得到更稳定的决策边界。在公共漏洞数据集上，MARGIN显著优于强基线，尤其在挑战性不平衡数据集上提升明显，同时产生更结构化的嵌入几何，改善鲁棒性、可解释性和泛化性。
Motivation: 真实世界的漏洞数据集同时存在频率不平衡和难度不平衡，这种双重不平衡导致嵌入空间的几何畸变，影响决策边界的稳定性，现有方法难以有效应对。
Method: 提出基于度量的框架MARGIN，核心包括自适应边距度量学习和超球面原型建模。利用von Mises-Fisher浓度估计数据分布结构，动态调整几何正则化强度，使嵌入分布的概率质量与其对应的Voronoi细胞对齐，以降低几何畸变。
Result: 在多个公共漏洞数据集上的实验表明，MARGIN一致优于各类强基线方法，在分类和检测任务上取得显著提升，尤其在不平衡程度高的数据上优势更明显。进一步分析显示MARGIN生成更规整的嵌入几何结构，增强了模型的鲁棒性、可解释性和泛化能力。
Conclusion: MARGIN通过自适应边距和原型建模有效缓解了漏洞检测中的数据不平衡问题，从几何角度提供了新的解决思路，并且能够学习到更稳定和可解释的表示。

papers.title: WASIL: In-the-Wild Arabic Spoken Interactions with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) voice assistants are commonly built as cascaded Automatic Speech recognition (ASR) to LLM systems, where recognition errors can distort user intent. Dislikes may also arise from ambiguous, out-of-domain, or non-request turns, making it hard to isolate ASR effects. We release WASIL (it denotes connection or linking in Arabic): in-the-wild Arabic spoken interaction prompts with audio, ASR hypotheses, assistant responses, and explicit like/dislike feedback (8,529 turns; 14.2% dislikes), plus a 2,000-turn test set covering Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and four major dialects with their labels. We provide low-cost gold transcripts via multi-ASR agreement-guided post-editing and annotate answerability (answerable, ambiguous/needs-clarification, unsupported, not-a-request/noise) to separate intrinsic unanswerability from ASR-induced degradation. Finally, we describe scalable reference-free evaluation of responses from ASR vs. gold transcripts using multi-judge LLM scoring.
papers.comment: Spoken Prompts, Multilingual LLMs, Speech-based Evaluation, Dialectal Speech, Low-resource Languages, Conversational AI, Speech-to-Text QA, Real-world Interaction, Spoken Language Understanding
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发布WASIL数据集，包含8,529个阿拉伯语野外口语交互轮次（音频、ASR假设、助手回复及显式喜欢/不喜欢反馈），其中14.2%为不喜欢轮次；另含2,000轮测试集覆盖现代标准阿拉伯语和四种主要方言。数据集通过多ASR共识指导的后期编辑提供低成本金转录，并标注可回答性（可回答、模糊/需澄清、不支持、非请求/噪声）以区分内在不可回答性与ASR引起的退化。最后描述了使用多裁判LLM评分对ASR与金转录回复进行可扩展的无参考评估。
Motivation: 现有LLM语音助手常用级联ASR到LLM系统，识别错误会扭曲用户意图；此外模糊、域外或非请求轮次也会导致不喜欢，难以隔离ASR影响。
Method: 构建WASIL数据集，收集野外阿拉伯语口语交互并标注喜欢/不喜欢反馈；采用多ASR共识引导的后编辑生成低价金转录；对每个轮次标注可回答性类别；提出基于多裁判LLM的无参考评估方法。
Result: 数据集包含8,529个轮次，14.2%为不喜欢；测试集2,000轮涵盖现代标准阿拉伯语和四种方言。
Conclusion: WASIL数据集和评估方法有助于分离ASR错误与内容问题对语音助手用户体验的影响。

papers.title: MLCR: Multi-Level Cue Refinement for Long-Term Multimodal Action Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Long-term multimodal action quality assessment (AQA) evaluates action execution in several-minute audiovisual sequences by mining discriminative quality cues for score prediction. Existing multimodal methods usually model entire sequences with a single temporal encoder and fuse modality features by direct alignment or concatenation, causing key cues to be obscured by global trends, weakened by modal redundancy, and distorted during one-shot score mapping. To address this issue, we reformulate long-term multimodal AQA as a quality cue organization problem and propose MLCR, a multi-level cue refinement framework. MLCR organizes quality evidence at three levels: intra-modal representation, cross-modal interaction, and stage-wise aggregation. Specifically, the intra-modal decoupling encoder (IMDE) preserves modality identity while refining global temporal context and local frequency details. The cross-modal dynamic complementarity-aware retrieval (CMDCR) module retrieves incremental evidence conditioned on the evolving fused state and suppresses redundant responses. The stage-wise multimodal integration (SMI) block progressively accumulates intra-modal and cross-modal cues to refine the fused representation. Experiments on the Rhythmic Gymnastics and Fis-V datasets show that MLCR achieves the best or second-best performance in both Spearman correlation and prediction error, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长期多模态动作质量评估（AQA）中关键线索易被全局趋势掩盖、模态冗余削弱以及一次性映射失真等问题，提出多级线索细化框架MLCR。该方法在三个层次（模态内表示、跨模态交互、阶段聚合）组织质量证据，包括模态内解耦编码器（IMDE）、跨模态动态互补感知检索（CMDCR）和阶段级多模态整合（SMI）模块。在Rhythmic Gymnastics和Fis-V数据集上，MLCR在Spearman相关性和预测误差指标上达到最佳或次佳性能，验证了其有效性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有多模态AQA方法通常使用单一时间编码器建模整个序列，并通过直接对齐或拼接融合模态特征，导致关键线索被全局趋势掩盖、因模态冗余而弱化，并在一次性分数映射中失真。
Method: 提出MLCR框架，包含三个核心模块：模态内解耦编码器（IMDE）保留模态特性同时细化全局时间上下文和局部频率细节；跨模态动态互补感知检索（CMDCR）根据演化融合状态检索增量证据并抑制冗余响应；阶段级多模态整合（SMI）逐步累积模态内和跨模态线索以细化融合表示。
Result: 在Rhythmic Gymnastics和Fis-V数据集上，MLCR在Spearman相关性和预测误差指标上均取得最佳或次佳性能，表明其在长期多模态AQA中的有效性和稳健性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调MLCR通过多级线索组织有效解决了现有方法的缺陷，并展示了在多个基准上的优越性能，但未提及局限性。

papers.title: Structured Recurrent Mixers for Massively Parallelized Sequence Generation
papers.abstract_en: Over the last two decades, language modeling has experienced a shift from the use of predominantly recurrent architectures that process tokens sequentially during training and inference to non-recurrent models that process sequence elements in parallel during training, which results in greater training efficiency and stability at the expense of lower inference throughput. Here we introduce the Structured Recurrent Mixer, an architecture that allows for algebraic conversion between a sequence parallel representation at train time and a recurrent representation at inference, notably without the need for specialized kernels or device-specific memory management. We show experimentally that this dual representation allows for greater training efficiency, higher input information capacity, and larger inference throughput and concurrency when compared to other linear complexity models. We postulate that recurrent models are poorly suited to extended sequence length scaling for information-rich inputs typical of language, but are well suited to scaling in the sample (batch) dimension due to their constant memory per sample. We provide Mojo/MAX inference implementations of SRMs exhibiting 12x the throughput and 170x the concurrency of similarly powerful Transformers inferenced on vLLM, increases characteristic of Pytorch implementations resulting in a 30\% increase in compute-constant GSM8k Pass@k. We conclude by demonstrating that SRMs are effective reinforcement learning training candidates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结构化循环混合器（Structured Recurrent Mixer, SRM），一种可在训练时序列并行表示与推理时循环表示之间进行代数转换的架构，无需专用内核或设备特定内存管理。实验表明，与其它线性复杂度模型相比，SRM在训练效率、输入信息容量和推理吞吐量/并发性方面表现更优，并在GSM8k Pass@k上提升约30%。
Motivation: 语言建模从循环架构转向非循环架构后，训练效率提升但推理吞吐量下降；现有线性复杂度模型在序列长度扩展和批次维度扩展之间存在权衡。
Method: 提出结构化循环混合器（SRM），通过代数转换实现训练时的序列并行表示和推理时的循环表示，维持常数内存每样本。
Result: 在Mojo/MAX推理上，SRM相比vLLM上的类似Transformer吞吐量提升12倍，并发性提升170倍；Compute-constant GSM8k Pass@k提升约30%。
Conclusion: SRM在训练效率、信息容量和推理并发性上优于其他线性复杂度模型，且可作为强化学习训练的有效候选。

papers.title: Defense effectiveness across architectural layers: a mechanistic evaluation of persistent memory attacks on stateful LLM agents
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory attacks against LLM agents achieve high attack success rates against open-source models. In these attacks, malicious instructions injected via RAG-retrieved documents are stored in persistent memory and executed in later sessions. However, no systematic evaluation of defense effectiveness against this attack class exists. We evaluate six defenses across four architectural layers against delayed-trigger attacks on nine open-source models (5,040 runs, N=40 per condition). Four defenses fail at approximately baseline attack success rate: input-level filtering (Minimizer, Sanitizer) and retrieval-level filtering (RAG Sanitizer, RAG LLM Judge) achieve 88-89% ASR, statistically indistinguishable from the undefended baseline of 88.6%. Prompt Hardening partially fails at 77.8% ASR, with the reduction driven by two models at 0%: one genuine defense effect and one model-level refusal independent of the defense. The architectural explanation holds: input-level defenses cannot observe RAG-injected content, and retrieval-level classifiers are defeated by compliance-framed semantic masking. One defense, tool-gating at the memory layer (Memory Sandbox), reduces ASR to 0% for eight of nine models by removing the recall capability the attack requires. The exception inverts the defense entirely: a reasoning model that achieves 0% ASR under no defense via execution refusal inverts to 100% ASR under Memory Sandbox, because removing explicit recall forces the model onto the RAG pathway where its refusal mechanism does not activate. Memory Sandbox imposes zero utility cost in the absence of attack (BTCR = 100% across all conditions). These results provide the first systematic characterization of why each defense class fails against persistent memory attacks, enabling informed defense investment decisions.
papers.comment: v2: Added §3.4 (reasoning-defense interaction: double dissociation, trigger contingency); §3.3.1 temporal conditionality note. 9 models, 6,600+ runs. Code and results: github.com/junwenleong/stateful-agent-security-eval
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了针对有状态LLM智能体的持久内存攻击的六种防御机制，跨越四个架构层，在九个开源模型上进行5040次实验。结果显示，输入层和检索层防御基本无效（攻击成功率88-89%），提示硬化部分有效（77.8%），而内存层的工具门控防御（Memory Sandbox）在八个模型上实现0%攻击成功率，但一个推理模型因防御反转导致攻击成功率从0%升至100%。
Motivation: 持久内存攻击对开源模型成功率很高，但缺乏对其防御效果的系统评估，难以指导安全投资决策。
Method: 在四个架构层（输入、检索、提示、内存）测试六种防御，使用延迟触发攻击（RAG注入指令存储于持久内存后后续会话执行），在九个开源模型上进行每条件40次共5040次运行。
Result: 输入层过滤（Minimizer, Sanitizer）和检索层过滤（RAG Sanitizer, RAG LLM Judge）的攻击成功率约88-89%，与无防御基线（88.6%）无统计差异；提示硬化部分失败（77.8%），其中两个模型降至0%但一个归因于真实防御，另一个是模型本身拒绝；内存层工具门控（Memory Sandbox）在八个模型上降至0%，但一个推理模型从0%反转至100%，且无攻击时零效用成本（BTCR=100%）。
Conclusion: 首次系统解释了每类防御失败的原因，为针对持久内存攻击的防御投资提供了实证依据。

papers.title: Approximation Error Upper and Lower Bounds for Hölder Class with Transformers
papers.abstract_en: We explore the expressive power of Transformers by establishing precise approximation error upper and lower bounds for Hölder class. Specifically, a new approximation upper bound is derived for the standard Transformer architecture equipped with Softmax operators, ReLU activation functions, and residual connections. We prove that a Transformer network composed of at most $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-{d_{0}}/α})$ blocks can approximate any bounded Hölder function with $d_{0}$-dimensional input and smoothness $α\in(0,1]$ under any accuracy $\varepsilon>0$. In the case of approximation lower bounds, leveraging the VC-dimension upper bound, we are the first to rigorously prove that Transformers demand for at least $Ω(\varepsilon^{-{d_{0}}/({4α})})$ blocks to achieve the $\varepsilon$ approximation accuracy. As a final step, we extend the derived results for standard Transformers to a general regression task and establish the corresponding excess risk rates demonstrating Transformers' empirical effectiveness in real-world settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文严格推导了Transformer对Hölder类函数的逼近误差上下界。对于标准Transformer架构（含Softmax、ReLU和残差连接），证明了不超过O(ε^{-d0/α})个模块即可逼近任意有界Hölder函数（d0维输入，光滑度α∈(0,1]），同时首次通过VC维上界证明至少需要Ω(ε^{-d0/(4α)})个模块。最后将结果推广到一般回归任务并建立超额风险率。
Motivation: 目前对Transformer表达能力的理论分析缺乏精确的逼近误差下界，尤其是针对Hölder类函数的紧致界限。
Method: 利用VC维上界和逼近论工具，分别推导标准Transformer对Hölder类函数的逼近误差上界和下界。
Result: 上界：O(ε^{-d0/α})个模块；下界：Ω(ε^{-d0/(4α)})个模块。
Conclusion: 本文给出的逼近误差上下界揭示了Transformer在逼近光滑函数时所需模块数量的理论下限，并为其在回归任务中的经验有效性提供了理论支撑。

papers.title: Enhancing RL Generalizability in Robotics through SHAP Analysis of Algorithms and Hyperparameters
papers.abstract_en: Despite significant advances in Reinforcement Learning (RL), model performance remains highly sensitive to algorithm and hyperparameter configurations, while generalization gaps across environments complicate real-world deployment. Although prior work has studied RL generalization, the relative contribution of specific configurations to the generalization gap has not been quantitatively decomposed and systematically leveraged for configuration selection. To address this limitation, we propose an explainable framework that evaluates RL performance across robotic environments using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to quantify configuration impacts. We establish a theoretical foundation connecting Shapley values to generalizability, empirically analyze configuration impact patterns, and introduce SHAP-guided configuration selection to enhance generalization. Our results reveal distinct patterns across algorithms and hyperparameters, with consistent configuration impacts across diverse tasks and environments. By applying these insights to configuration selection, we achieve improved RL generalizability and provide actionable guidance for practitioners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于SHAP的可解释框架，用于量化强化学习算法和超参数对机器人环境泛化能力的影响。通过理论连接Shapley值与泛化性，实证分析配置影响模式，并引入SHAP引导的配置选择以提升泛化性。实验揭示了不同算法和超参数的独特影响模式，且配置影响在多种任务和环境中一致。
Motivation: 现有强化学习模型性能对算法和超参数配置高度敏感，但泛化差距的成因缺乏定量分解，导致难以系统选择配置以提升泛化性。
Method: 提出基于SHAP（Shapley Additive exPlanations）的可解释框架，量化每种配置对泛化差距的贡献，并建立Shapley值与泛化性的理论联系。基于分析结果，提出SHAP引导的配置选择策略。
Result: 发现不同算法和超参数对泛化性的影响呈现独特模式，且这些模式在多种机器人任务和环境中保持一致。应用SHAP引导的配置选择后，强化学习的泛化性得到提升。
Conclusion: SHAP分析可有效量化配置对泛化性的贡献，为实践者提供可操作的配置选择指导。该方法可用于提升强化学习在机器人领域的泛化能力。

papers.title: Local Hessian Spectral Filtering for Robust Intrinsic Dimension Estimation
papers.abstract_en: While diffusion models enable new approaches for estimating Local Intrinsic Dimension (LID), existing methods fail in high-dimensional spaces where noise from vast normal directions overwhelms the tangent signal. We propose Local Hessian Spectral Dimension (LHSD), which resolves this by applying spectral filtering to the log-density Hessian, explicitly cutting off large eigenvalues associated with normal directions to count zero-curvature tangent directions. Implemented using Stochastic Lanczos Quadrature (SLQ), LHSD avoids full Hessian construction, achieving linear scalability with dimension $D$. Experiments on synthetic and real data confirm LHSD's superior robustness and its utility in detecting memorization in large-scale diffusion models. The code is available at github.com/geosada/LHSD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出局部Hessian谱维度（LHSD），通过对对数密度Hessian进行谱滤波，显式截断与法线方向相关的大特征值，实现高维空间中鲁棒的局部内在维度估计。使用随机Lanczos求积（SLQ）避免完整Hessian构造，具有维度D的线性可扩展性。实验证明其在合成和真实数据上的优越鲁棒性，并可用于检测大规模扩散模型中的记忆化。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的局部内在维度（LID）估计方法在高维空间中失效，因为大量法线方向的噪声淹没了切向信号，导致估计不准确。
Method: 提出LHSD，对对数密度Hessian进行谱滤波，截断大特征值以消除法线方向影响，保留零曲率切向方向；通过随机Lanczos求积实现，避免显式构建完整Hessian矩阵，从而获得线性计算复杂度。
Result: 在合成数据和真实数据上的实验表明，LHSD具有优越的鲁棒性，并成功应用于检测大规模扩散模型中的记忆化现象。
Conclusion: LHSD通过Hessian谱滤波有效解决了高维空间中LID估计的噪声问题，并展示了在检测模型记忆化方面的实用价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Limit Theory of Foundation Models: A Mathematical Approach to Understanding Emergent Intelligence and Scaling Laws
papers.abstract_en: Emergent intelligence have played a major role in the modern AI development. While existing studies primarily rely on empirical observations to characterize this phenomenon, a rigorous theoretical framework remains underexplored. This study attempts to develop a mathematical approach to formalize emergent intelligence from the perspective of limit theory. Specifically, we introduce a performance function E(N, P, K), dependent on data size N, model size P and training steps K, to quantify intelligence behavior. We posit that intelligence emerges as a transition from finite to effectively infinite knowledge, and thus recast emergent intelligence as existence of the limit $\lim_{N,P,K \to \infty} \mathcal{E}(N,P,K)$, with emergent abilities corresponding to the limiting behavior. This limit theory helps reveal that emergent intelligence originates from the existence of a parameter-limit architecture (referred to as the limit architecture), and that emergent intelligence rationally corresponds to the learning behavior of this limit system. By introducing tools from nonlinear Lipschitz operator theory, we prove that the necessary and sufficient conditions for existence of the limit architecture. Furthermore, we derive the scaling law of foundation models by leveraging tools of Lipschitz operator and covering number. Theoretical results show that: 1) emergent intelligence is governed by three key factors-training steps, data size and the model architecture, where the properties of basic blocks play a crucial role in constructing foundation models; 2) the critical condition Lip(T)=1 for emergent intelligence provides theoretical support for existing findings. 3) emergent intelligence is determined by an infinite-dimensional system, yet can be effectively realized in practice through a finite-dimensional architecture. Our empirical results corroborate these theoretical findings.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从极限理论的角度，提出数学框架来形式化基础模型中的涌现智能，并推导缩放定律。通过定义性能函数 E(N,P,K) 并将涌现智能视为极限存在性，利用非线性 Lipschitz 算子理论证明了极限架构存在的充要条件，并导出了关键条件 Lip(T)=1。理论表明涌现智能受训练步数、数据量和模型架构影响，并可在有限维架构中有效实现。
Motivation: 现有对涌现智能的理解主要依赖经验观察，缺乏严格的理论基础。本文试图填补这一空白，从极限理论出发建立涌现智能的数学形式化。
Method: 引入性能函数 E(N,P,K) 依赖数据量 N、模型规模 P 和训练步数 K，将涌现智能重定义为 N,P,K 趋于无穷时的极限存在性。利用非线性 Lipschitz 算子理论和覆盖数等工具，推导极限架构存在的充要条件以及缩放定律。
Result: 理论表明：涌现智能由训练步数、数据量和模型架构三个关键因素控制，其中基本块的性质起重要作用；临界条件 Lip(T)=1 支持现有发现；涌现智能由无限维系统决定，但可通过有限维架构有效实现。实验结果佐证了理论结论。
Conclusion: 本文提供了基础模型涌现智能和缩放定律的一个数学理论框架，揭示了极限架构存在的条件，并给出了可验证的临界条件。

papers.title: Stabilizing In-Context Multi-Source Domain Adaptation for Biomedical Images Through Controls
papers.abstract_en: Biomedical imaging data presents enormous potential for deep learning models to predict invaluable properties, such as diseases and drug effects. However, unavoidable alterations of the technical conditions cause batch effects: variations between groups of samples that are not due to any biological signal of interest. Batch effects greatly hinder the generalization abilities of deep learning models, preventing their practical use in the real world. Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) methods have been proposed to mitigate batch effects, but they usually assume that the data is comprised of only one source domain and one target domain, whereas biological datasets are comprised of multiple domains, both at training and at inference time. While Batch Normalization-based test-time and meta-learning adaptation methods offer a promising mechanism for domain alignment, we show that existing approaches exhibit degraded performance under the usual inference scenarios of small target batch sizes and label shift. We address these limitations by leveraging negative control samples, which are consistently present in every experimental batch in biological datasets, as stable context for adaptation. We propose CS-ARM-BN, a meta-learning BN adaptation method that uses controls both during training and inference to stabilize domain statistics. We perform a suite of experiments of Mechanism-Of-Action (MoA) classification, a crucial task for drug discovery, on the large JUMP-CP imaging dataset. Our experiments show that CS-ARM-BN substantially improves robustness to batch size and class distribution shifts, enabling practical use of deep learning models for biomedical images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生物医学图像中多源域适应（multi-source domain adaptation）的批次效应（batch effects）问题，提出CS-ARM-BN方法，通过利用实验批次中始终存在的阴性对照样本（negative control samples）作为稳定上下文，在训练和推理时稳定域统计量。在JUMP-CP数据集上的MoA分类实验中，该方法显著提升了对批次大小和类别分布偏移的鲁棒性，使深度学习模型能在实际生物医学图像场景中应用。
Motivation: 现有无监督域适应方法通常假设单一源域和单一目标域，而生物数据集包含多个域且推理时目标批次小、存在标签偏移，导致现有方法性能下降。
Method: 提出CS-ARM-BN，一种元学习BN适应方法，在训练和推理时利用始终存在的阴性对照样本作为稳定上下文来估计域统计量。
Result: 在JUMP-CP大规模成像数据集上的MoA分类实验中，CS-ARM-BN显著提升了对小批次大小和类别分布偏移的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 利用对照样本可稳定多源域适应中的域统计量，促进生物医学图像深度学习模型的实际部署。

summary_sections.result: 在JUMP-CP大规模成像数据集上的MoA分类实验中，CS-ARM-BN显著提升了对小批次大小和类别分布偏移的鲁棒性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 利用对照样本可稳定多源域适应中的域统计量，促进生物医学图像深度学习模型的实际部署。

papers.title: Environmental Sound Deepfake Detection Using Deep-Learning Framework
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a deep-learning framework for Environmental Sound Deepfake Detection (ESDD) - the task of identifying whether the sound scene and sound event in an input audio recording is fake or real. To this end, we first conduct extensive experiments to explore how individual spectrograms, a wide range of network architectures, and pre-trained models affect the performance of an ESDD model. The experimental results on the benchmark datasets of EnvSDD indicate that detecting deepfake audio of sound scenes and detecting deepfake audio of sound events should be considered as individual tasks. We also show that fine-tuning a pre-trained model is more effective than training a model from scratch for ESDD. Ultimately, our best model, which fine-tunes the pre-trained BEATs model using the proposed two-phase training strategy, achieves an Accuracy of 0.98, F1 score of 0.95, and AUC score of 0.99 on the Test subset of the EnvSDD dataset. Our best model also achieves an Accuracy of 0.86, F1 score of 0.80, and AUC of 0.93 when evaluated cross-dataset on the ESD-Challenge-TestSet dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个深度学习框架用于环境声音深度伪造检测(ESDD)，即判断输入音频中的声音场景和声音事件是伪造还是真实。实验表明声音场景和声音事件的伪造检测应视为独立任务，且微调预训练模型比从头训练更有效。最佳模型使用预训练BEATs模型和两阶段训练策略，在EnvSDD测试集上达到Accuracy 0.98, F1 0.95, AUC 0.99。
Motivation: 环境声音深度伪造检测(ESDD)是新兴任务，目前缺乏系统研究如何利用不同频谱图、网络架构和预训练模型来提升性能。
Method: 首先通过大量实验探索单个频谱图、多种网络架构和预训练模型对ESDD性能的影响。然后提出两阶段训练策略微调预训练BEATs模型。
Result: 在EnvSDD测试集上最佳模型达到Accuracy 0.98, F1 0.95, AUC 0.99；在跨数据集ESD-Challenge-TestSet上达到Accuracy 0.86, F1 0.80, AUC 0.93。
Conclusion: 环境声音伪造检测中，声音场景和声音事件应作为独立任务处理；微调预训练模型优于从头训练；提出的两阶段训练策略有效。

papers.title: Complex normalizing flows can almost be information Kähler-Ricci flows
papers.abstract_en: We develop interconnections between the complex normalizing flow for data drawn from Borel probability measures on the twofold realification of the complex manifold and a nonlinear flow nearly Kähler-Ricci. The complex normalizing flow relates the initial and target realified densities under the complex change of variables, necessitating the log determinant of the ensemble of Wirtinger Jacobians. The Ricci curvature of a Kähler manifold is the second order mixed Wirtinger partial derivative of the log of the local density of the volume form. Therefore, we reconcile these two facts by drawing forth the connection that the log determinant used in the complex normalizing flow matches a Ricci curvature term under differentiation and conditions. The log density under the normalizing flow is kindred to a spatial information metric under an augmented Jacobian and a Bayesian perspective to the parameter, thus under the continuum limit the log likelihood matches a Fisher metric, or more closely a Kähler cross-entropy Hessian. This recovers a Kähler-Ricci flow variation up to a time derivative and expectation, or an average-valued Kähler-Einstein flow. Using this framework, we establish other relevant results, attempting to bridge the statistical and ordinary behaviors of the complex normalizing flow to the geometric features of our derived Kähler flow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文建立了复规范化流 (complex normalizing flows) 与近Kähler-Ricci流之间的深层联系。通过将复规范化流中Wirtinger Jacobian的对数行列式与Kähler流形的Ricci曲率项关联，作者证明了在连续极限下，对数似然函数等价于Fisher度量或Kähler交叉熵Hessian，从而恢复出Kähler-Ricci流的一个变体。该工作为理解规范化流的几何本质提供了理论框架。
Motivation: 现有规范化流理论缺乏与微分几何中曲率流的直接联系，尤其是复流形情形下的统计与几何行为尚未统一。
Method: 利用复规范化流中Wirtinger Jacobian的对数行列式与Kähler流形上体积形式的Ricci曲率之间的关系，通过微分和期望运算，推导出对数似然梯度与Kähler-Ricci流方程的一致性。
Result: 摘要报告了理论推导结果：在连续极限下，复规范化流的对数似然匹配Fisher度量，并演化出一个平均值的Kähler-Einstein流，从而建立了统计与几何的桥梁。
Conclusion: 本文旨在弥合复规范化流的统计行为与导出Kähler流的几何特征之间的差距，为后续研究提供理论基础；但未涉及具体实验验证。

papers.title: Multi-Granularity Reasoning for Natural Language Inference
papers.abstract_en: Natural Language Inference (NLI) is a fundamental task in natural language understanding that requires determining the logical relationship between a premise and a hypothesis. Despite the remarkable success of transformer-based pre-trained models, most existing approaches primarily rely on the final-layer token representations, which are often insufficient for capturing the complex and hierarchical semantic interactions required for effective reasoning. In particular, fine-grained lexical cues, phrasal compositions, and higher-level contextual semantics are typically entangled or diluted in a single representation space. To address these limitations, we propose a novel \emph{Multi-Granularity Reasoning Network} (MGRN) that explicitly leverages hierarchical semantic features within an interactive reasoning space. The proposed framework mimics the human cognitive process of language understanding, which naturally progresses from shallow lexical matching to deeper semantic abstraction and logical reasoning. By integrating semantic information across multiple granularities in a progressive and structured manner, MGRN is able to uncover intricate semantic relationships underlying natural language expressions. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that MGRN consistently outperforms strong baseline models, validating the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多粒度推理网络（MGRN）用于自然语言推理，通过分层语义特征（从词汇到句法再到上下文）模拟人类认知过程，在多个基准上优于强基线模型。
Motivation: 现有NLI方法主要依赖最终层token表示，难以捕捉复杂层次语义交互。
Method: 提出MGRN，显式利用分层语义特征在交互推理空间中，从浅层词汇匹配到深层语义抽象进行渐进推理。
Result: 在多个公开基准上一致优于强基线模型。
Conclusion: 验证了多粒度分层推理的有效性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: CoDe-R: Refining Decompiler Output with LLMs via Rationale Guidance and Adaptive Inference
papers.abstract_en: Binary decompilation is a critical reverse engineering task aimed at reconstructing high-level source code from stripped executables. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown promise, they often suffer from "logical hallucinations" and "semantic misalignment" due to the irreversible semantic loss during compilation, resulting in generated code that fails to re-execute. In this study, we propose Cognitive Decompiler Refinement with Robustness (CoDe-R), a lightweight two-stage code refinement framework. The first stage introduces Semantic Cognitive Enhancement (SCE), a Rationale-Guided Semantic Injection strategy that trains the model to recover high-level algorithmic intent alongside code. The second stage introduces a Dynamic Dual-Path Fallback (DDPF) mechanism during inference, which adaptively balances semantic recovery and syntactic stability via a hybrid verification strategy. Evaluation on the HumanEval-Decompile benchmark demonstrates that CoDe-R (using a 1.3B backbone) establishes a new State-of-the-Art (SOTA) in the lightweight regime. Notably, it is the first 1.3B model to exceed an Average Re-executability Rate of 50.00%, significantly outperforming the baseline and effectively bridging the gap between efficient models and expert-level performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/Theaoi/CoDe-R.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Accepted by IJCNN 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoDe-R，一个轻量级的两阶段代码精炼框架，用于改善二进制反编译输出。第一阶段通过语义认知增强 (SCE) 训练模型恢复算法意图，第二阶段引入动态双路径回退 (DDPF) 机制在推理时平衡语义与语法。在 HumanEval-Decompile 基准上，使用 1.3B 参数模型实现了轻量级场景下的新 SOTA，平均可执行率首次超过 50%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 在二进制反编译中常出现逻辑幻觉和语义错位，导致生成代码无法重新执行，需要提升代码的可执行性。
Method: 提出 CoDe-R 框架，包含两阶段：第一阶段为语义认知增强 (SCE)，通过原理引导的语义注入策略训练模型；第二阶段为动态双路径回退 (DDPF)，在推理时自适应平衡语义恢复与语法稳定性。
Result: 在 HumanEval-Decompile 基准上，1.3B 参数模型达到轻量级 SOTA，平均可执行率首次超过 50%，显著优于基线。
Conclusion: 该方法有效弥合了高效模型与专家级反编译性能之间的差距，展示了轻量级模型在该任务上的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can AI Detect Life? Lessons from Artificial Life
papers.abstract_en: Modern machine learning methods have been proposed to detect life in extraterrestrial samples, drawing on their ability to distinguish biotic from abiotic samples based on training models using natural and synthetic organic molecular mixtures. Here we show using Artificial Life that such methods are easily fooled into detecting life with near 100% confidence even if the analyzed sample is not capable of life. This is due to modern machine learning methods' propensity to be easily fooled by out-of-distribution samples. Because extra-terrestrial samples are very likely out of the distribution provided by terrestrial biotic and abiotic samples, using AI methods for life detection is likely to yield significant false positives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过人工生命（Artificial Life）实验表明，现代机器学习方法在检测地外生命时容易产生假阳性，因为地外样本很可能属于训练分布之外的分布。
Motivation: 现有AI方法被用于检测地外生命，但可能因分布外样本而产生误判，需评估其可靠性。
Method: 使用人工生命系统生成生物与非生物样本，训练机器学习模型并测试其对分布外样本的识别能力。
Result: 模型对非生命样本也能给出近100%的生命置信度，表明AI检测生命的方法易产生显著假阳性。
Conclusion: 由于地外样本本质上是分布外的，仅靠AI方法检测生命不可靠，需谨慎使用。

papers.title: Evolving Many Worlds: Towards Open-Ended Discovery in Petri Dish NCA via Population-Based Training
papers.abstract_en: The generation of sustained, open-ended complexity from local interactions remains a fundamental challenge in artificial life. Differentiable multi-agent systems, such as Petri Dish Neural Cellular Automata (PD-NCA), exhibit rich self-organization driven purely by spatial competition; however, they are highly sensitive to hyperparameters and frequently collapse into uninteresting patterns and dynamics, such as frozen equilibria or structureless noise. In this paper, we introduce PBT-NCA, a meta-evolutionary algorithm that evolves a population of PD-NCAs subject to a composite objective that rewards both historical behavioral novelty and contemporary visual diversity. Driven by this continuous evolutionary pressure, PBT-NCA spontaneously generates a plethora of emergent lifelike phenomena over extended horizons-a hallmark of true open-endedness. Strikingly, the substrate autonomously discovers diverse morphological survival and self-organization strategies. We observe highly regular, coordinated periodic waves; spore-like scattering where homogeneous groups eject cell-like clusters to colonize distant territories; and fluid, shape-shifting macro-structures that migrate across the substrate, maintaining stable outer boundaries that enclose highly active interiors. By actively penalizing monocultures and dead states, PBT-NCA sustains a state of effective complexity that is neither globally ordered nor globally random, operating persistently at the "edge of chaos".
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PBT-NCA，一种元进化算法，通过群体训练演化Petri Dish神经细胞自动机（PD-NCA），并采用复合目标奖励历史行为新颖性与当代视觉多样性。该方法在长时间尺度上自发产生多种涌现生命现象，如协调的周期性波、孢子样扩散和变形迁移结构，并主动抑制单一文化和死亡状态，从而持续维持“混沌边缘”的有效复杂性。
Motivation: 人工生命领域中，从局部相互作用产生持续开放复杂性仍是一个基本挑战。PD-NCA虽表现出丰富的自组织行为，但对超参数高度敏感，常陷入冻结平衡或无结构噪声等无趣模式。
Method: PBT-NCA是一种元进化算法，维护一个PD-NCA群体，每个个体根据复合目标（历史行为新颖性+当前视觉多样性）进行选择与变异，通过持续进化压力驱动开放发现。
Result: 摘要报告PBT-NCA自发产生多种涌现现象：规则周期性波、均质群体射出细胞样簇的孢子状扩散、以及维持稳定边界并迁移的变形大尺度结构。系统通过惩罚单一文化与死亡状态，在长时间内保持既非全局有序也非全局随机的有效复杂状态。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了在人工生命基板中实现持续开放发现的可能性，通过主动维持多样性避免了系统坍缩，但摘要未讨论局限性或计算成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Executing as You Generate: Hiding Execution Latency in LLM Code Interpreters
papers.abstract_en: Current LLM systems are increasingly equipped with a code interpreter that executes generated code to obtain results. This works serially: the model first generates the complete code, then an interpreter executes it. This sequential workflow leaves the executor idle during generation and the generator idle during execution, resulting in unnecessary end-to-end latency. Our key observation is that an LLM, unlike a human developer, emits code tokens left to right and does not backtrack over what it has already written. This makes it possible to start executing a piece of code while later tokens are still being generated. We formalize this parallel execution paradigm, modeling it as a three-stage pipeline of generation, detection, and execution, and derive closed-form latency bounds that characterize its speedup potential and operating regimes. We then present EAGER, a concrete implementation featuring AST-based chunking, dynamic batching with gated execution, and early error interruption. We evaluate EAGER across four benchmarks, seven LLMs, and three execution environments. The overlap mechanism hides almost all execution behind generation, reducing the non-overlapped portion of execution time by up to 99.8% and cutting end-to-end latency by up to 37.3% on error-free runs.

papers.title: The First Assessment of PhiSat-2 Imagery for Monocular Building Height Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Monocular building height estimation from optical imagery is important for characterizing urban vertical structure, yet remains challenging due to the heterogeneity of urban building morphology and the indirect relationship between optical image appearance and building height. The recently launched PhiSat-2 satellite provides a promising open-access data source for this task, with 4.75m spatial resolution and seven multispectral bands spanning the visible to near-infrared range. However, its suitability for monocular building height estimation has not been systematically assessed. This study presents an initial open-reference assessment of PhiSat-2 imagery for this task by constructing a PhiSat-2--Height Dataset (PHDataset) and proposing a Two-Stream Ordinal Network (TSONet). PHDataset integrates global PhiSat-2 imagery with open building-height references and contains 9,475 co-registered patch pairs from 26 cities worldwide. TSONet jointly learns dense height estimation and auxiliary footprint prediction, using footprint-aware structural guidance and ordinal height modeling to better exploit PhiSat-2 spatial--spectral information. Specifically, a Cross-Stream Exchange Module (CSEM) enables adaptive interaction between the height and footprint streams, while a Feature-Enhanced Bin Refinement (FEBR) module performs coarse-to-fine ordinal query refinement with multi-level features. Experiments on PHDataset show that TSONet outperforms representative competing methods, reducing MAE and RMSE by over 13.2% and 9.7%, respectively, while improving IoU and F1-score by over 14.0% and 10.1%. Additional analyses further indicate that PhiSat-2 imagery contains useful spatial--spectral cues for monocular building height estimation at an intermediate spatial resolution.

papers.title: MOOZY: A Patient-First Foundation Model for Computational Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Computational pathology needs whole-slide image (WSI) foundation models that transfer across diverse clinical tasks, yet current approaches remain largely slide-centric, often depend on private data and expensive paired-report supervision, and do not explicitly model relationships among multiple slides from the same patient. We present MOOZY, a patient-first pathology foundation model in which the patient case, not the individual slide, is the core unit of representation. MOOZY explicitly models dependencies across all slides from the same patient via a case transformer during pretraining, combining multi-stage self-supervision with scaled low-cost task supervision. In Stage 1, we pretrain a vision-only slide encoder on 77,134 public slide feature grids using masked self-distillation. In Stage 2, we align these representations with clinical semantics using a case transformer and multi-task supervision over 333 tasks from 56 public datasets, including 205 classification and 128 survival tasks across four endpoints. Across sixteen held-out tasks, MOOZY improves macro weighted F1, balanced accuracy, and macro weighted ROC-AUC relative to PRISM by +4.19\%, +7.93\%, and +6.95\%, respectively. MOOZY is also parameter efficient with 85.77M parameters, 14$\times$ smaller than GigaPath. These results suggest that patient-level pretraining yields transferable embeddings, providing a path toward scalable patient-first histopathology foundation models.

papers.title: In-Context Molecular Property Prediction with LLMs: A Blinding Study on Memorization and Knowledge Conflicts
papers.abstract_en: The capabilities of large language models (LLMs) have expanded beyond natural language processing to scientific prediction tasks, including molecular property prediction. However, their effectiveness in in-context learning remains ambiguous, particularly given the potential for training data contamination in widely used benchmarks. This paper investigates whether LLMs perform genuine in-context regression on molecular properties or rely primarily on memorized values. Furthermore, we analyze the interplay between pre-trained knowledge and in-context information through a series of progressively blinded experiments. We evaluate nine LLM variants across three families (GPT-4.1, GPT-5, Gemini 2.5) on three MoleculeNet datasets (Delaney solubility, Lipophilicity, QM7 atomization energy) using a systematic blinding approach that iteratively reduces available information. Complementing this, we utilize varying in-context sample sizes (0-, 60-, and 1000-shot) as an additional control for information access. This work provides a principled framework for evaluating molecular property prediction under controlled information access, addressing concerns regarding memorization and exposing conflicts between pre-trained knowledge and in-context information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过逐步盲化实验研究LLMs在分子性质预测中是否真正进行上下文学习，还是依赖记忆。在三个MoleculeNet数据集上评估GPT-4.1、GPT-5、Gemini 2.5变体，发现模型可能依赖记忆，且预训练知识与上下文信息存在冲突。
Motivation: 现有基准可能受训练数据污染，LLMs在分子性质预测中的上下文学习能力不明确，需区分记忆与真实推理。
Method: 采用系统性盲化方法逐步减少可用信息，并控制上下文样本数量（0-shot、60-shot、1000-shot），评估九种LLM变体。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，但表明LLMs可能依赖记忆，预训练知识与上下文信息存在冲突。
Conclusion: 提供了一个在受控信息访问下评估分子性质预测的原则性框架，解决记忆问题并暴露知识冲突。

papers.title: Towards Practical Lossless Neural Compression for LiDAR Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR point clouds are fundamental to various applications, yet the extreme sparsity of high-precision geometric details hinders efficient context modeling, thereby limiting the compression speed and performance of existing methods. To address this challenge, we propose a compact representation for efficient predictive lossless coding. Our framework comprises two lightweight modules. First, the Geometry Re-Densification Module iteratively densifies encoded sparse geometry, extracts features at a dense scale, and then sparsifies the features for predictive coding. This module avoids costly computation on highly sparse details while maintaining a lightweight prediction head. Second, the Cross-scale Feature Propagation Module leverages occupancy cues from multiple resolution levels to guide hierarchical feature propagation, enabling information sharing across scales and reducing redundant feature extraction. Additionally, we introduce an integer-only inference pipeline to enable bit-exact cross-platform consistency, which avoids the entropy-coding collapse observed in existing neural compression methods and further accelerates coding. Experiments demonstrate competitive compression performance at real-time speed. Code will be released upon acceptance. Code is available at https://github.com/pengpeng-yu/FastPCC.

papers.title: A Latent Representation Learning Framework for Hyperspectral Image Emulation in Remote Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic hyperspectral image (HSI) generation is essential for large-scale simulation, algorithm development, and mission design, yet traditional radiative transfer models remain computationally expensive and proposed emulation methods are often limited to spectrum-level outputs. In this work, we propose a latent representation-based framework for hyperspectral emulation that learns a probabilistic latent representation of hyperspectral data. The proposed approach supports both spectrum-level and spatial-spectral emulation and can be trained either in a direct one-step formulation or in a two-step strategy that couples variational autoencoder (VAE) pretraining with parameter-to-latent mapping. Experiments on PROSAIL-simulated vegetation data and Sentinel-3 OLCI imagery demonstrate that the method outperforms classical regression-based emulators in reconstruction accuracy, spectral fidelity, and robustness to real-world spatial variability. We further show that emulated HSIs preserve performance in downstream biophysical parameter retrieval, highlighting the practical relevance of emulated data for remote sensing applications.

papers.title: ReconMIL: Synergizing Latent Space Reconstruction with Bi-Stream Mamba for Whole Slide Image Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Whole slide image (WSI) analysis heavily relies on multiple instance learning (MIL). While recent methods benefit from large-scale foundation models and advanced sequence modeling to capture long-range dependencies, they still struggle with two critical issues. First, directly applying frozen, task-agnostic features often leads to suboptimal separability due to the domain gap with specific histological tasks. Second, relying solely on global aggregators can cause over-smoothing, where sparse but critical diagnostic signals are overshadowed by the dominant background context. In this paper, we present ReconMIL, a novel framework designed to bridge this domain gap and balance global-local feature aggregation. Our approach introduces a Latent Space Reconstruction module that adaptively projects generic features into a compact, task-specific manifold, improving boundary delineation. To prevent information dilution, we develop a bi-stream architecture combining a Mamba-based global stream for contextual priors and a CNN-based local stream to preserve subtle morphological anomalies. A scale-adaptive selection mechanism dynamically fuses these two streams, determining when to rely on overall architecture versus local saliency. Evaluations across multiple diagnostic and survival prediction benchmarks show that ReconMIL consistently outperforms current state-of-the-art methods, effectively localizing fine-grained diagnostic regions while suppressing background noise. Visualization results confirm the models superior ability to localize diagnostic regions by effectively balancing global structure and local granularity.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReconMIL 框架，用于全切片图像分析。通过潜在空间重建模块将通用特征投影到任务特定流形，并设计双流架构（Mamba 全局流和 CNN 局部流）平衡全局与局部特征，抑制背景噪声。在多个诊断和生存预测基准上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有 MIL 方法在 WSI 分析中面临两个问题：直接使用冻结的通用特征导致域间隙，以及全局聚合器导致关键诊断信号被背景淹没。
Method: 提出 ReconMIL，包含潜在空间重建模块自适应投影特征，以及双流架构（Mamba 全局流 + CNN 局部流），并通过尺度自适应选择机制动态融合两流。
Result: 在多个诊断和生存预测基准上持续优于现有方法，有效定位细粒度诊断区域并抑制背景噪声，可视化验证了全局结构与局部细节的平衡。
Conclusion: ReconMIL 通过协同潜在空间重建与双流 Mamba 有效桥接域间隙并平衡全局-局部特征，但论文因评估协议问题已被作者撤回。

papers.title: HUGE-Bench: A Benchmark for High-Level UAV Vision-Language-Action Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Existing UAV vision-language navigation (VLN) benchmarks have enabled language-guided flight, but they largely focus on long, step-wise route descriptions with goal-centric evaluation, making them less diagnostic for real operations where brief, high-level commands must be grounded into safe multi-stage behaviors. We present HUGE-Bench, a benchmark for High-Level UAV Vision-Language-Action (HL-VLA) tasks that tests whether an agent can interpret concise language and execute complex, process-oriented trajectories with safety awareness. HUGE-Bench comprises 4 real-world digital twin scenes, 8 high-level tasks, and 2.56M meters of trajectories, and is built on an aligned 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-Mesh representation that combines photorealistic rendering with collision-capable geometry for scalable generation and collision-aware evaluation. We introduce process-oriented and collision-aware metrics to assess process fidelity, terminal accuracy, and safety. Experiments on representative state-of-the-art VLA models reveal significant gaps in high-level semantic completion and safe execution, highlighting HUGE-Bench as a diagnostic testbed for high-level UAV autonomy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HUGE-Bench 是一个针对高层无人机视觉-语言-动作（HL-VLA）任务的基准测试，包含4个数字孪生场景、8个高层任务和256万米轨迹，采用对齐的3DGS-Mesh表示实现逼真渲染和碰撞检测。实验表明现有VLA模型在高层语义完成和安全执行方面存在显著差距。
Motivation: 现有无人机VLN基准侧重于长步骤路径描述和最终位置评估，难以诊断实际运维中需要将简短高层指令转化为安全多阶段行为的能力。
Method: 基于4个真实世界数字孪生场景构建8个高层任务，轨迹总长2.56M米；使用对齐的3D高斯溅射（3DGS）-网格表示结合逼真渲染与碰撞几何；提出过程导向和碰撞感知指标评估流程保真度、终端准确性和安全性。
Result: 在代表性SOTA VLA模型上的实验显示其在高层语义完成和安全执行方面存在显著差距，表明HUGE-Bench可作为一个诊断测试床。
Conclusion: HUGE-Bench被定位为高层无人机自主系统的诊断测试床，能够揭示现有模型在高层语义和安全执行上的不足。

papers.title: Controllable Accent Normalization via Discrete Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Existing accent normalization methods do not typically offer control over accent strength, yet many applications-such as language learning and dubbing-require tunable accent retention. We propose DLM-AN, a controllable accent normalization system built on masked discrete diffusion over self-supervised speech tokens. A Common Token Predictor identifies source tokens that likely encode native pronunciation; these tokens are selectively reused to initialize the reverse diffusion process. This provides a simple yet effective mechanism for controlling accent strength: reusing more tokens preserves more of the original accent. DLM-AN further incorporates a flow-matching Duration Ratio Predictor that automatically adjusts the total duration to better match the native rhythm. Experiments on multi-accent English data show that DLM-AN achieves the lowest word error rate among all compared systems while delivering competitive accent reduction and smooth, interpretable accent strength control.
papers.comment: Accepted to Interspeech 2026 as a long paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DLM-AN，一种基于离散扩散的可控口音归一化系统，利用掩蔽离散扩散在自监督语音令牌上实现对口音强度的可调节控制。通过公共令牌预测器识别编码本地发音的源令牌，并选择性重用这些令牌初始化反向扩散过程，重用更多令牌保留更多原始口音。此外，结合流匹配时长比预测器自动调整总时长以匹配本地节奏。实验表明，在多口音英语数据上，DLM-AN 在词错误率上达到最低，同时实现有竞争力的口音减少和平滑可解释的口音强度控制。
Motivation: 现有口音归一化方法通常无法控制口音强度，而许多应用如语言学习和配音需要可调节的口音保留。
Method: 基于掩蔽离散扩散的 DLM-AN 系统，包括公共令牌预测器（选择性地重用编码本地发音的源令牌初始化反向扩散）和流匹配时长比预测器（自动调整总时长以匹配本地节奏）。
Result: 在多口音英语数据上，DLM-AN 实现了最低的词错误率，同时达到有竞争力的口音减少和可控的口音强度。
Conclusion: DLM-AN 提供了简单有效的口音强度控制机制，并在性能上优于现有系统。

papers.title: Mask2Flow-TSE: Two-Stage Target Speaker Extraction with Masking and Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Target speaker extraction (TSE) extracts the target speaker's voice from overlapping speech given a reference utterance. Existing masking-based approaches are lightweight and effective but suffer from an inability to synthesize missing content, leading to degraded perceptual quality. On the other hand, recent generative TSE models typically synthesize high-quality speech with diffusion, but require numerous iterative steps resulting in high computational costs and latency. We propose Mask2Flow-TSE, a two-stage framework combining the strengths of both paradigms. We introduce the deletion/insertion (D/I) proportion, an analytical tool that reveals early flow steps predominantly remove signal components rather than synthesize them. Based on this finding, we decouple deletion from insertion: a masking-based module handles the deletion-dominant early steps, while a single flow-matching step performs the remaining insertion for high-quality reconstruction. Specifically, the first stage uses lightweight convolution for the masking module, while the second stage employs a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) adapted for TSE with speaker conditioning. Unlike prior approaches that start from Gaussian noise, our method starts from the masked spectrogram, enabling high-quality reconstruction in a single inference step. Experiments show that Mask2Flow-TSE produces high-quality extractions with only 85M parameters and one-step inference, while preserving clean single-speaker inputs with minimal degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mask2Flow-TSE，一个两阶段目标说话人提取框架，结合了掩码方法的轻量高效和生成式流匹配的高质量重建。第一阶段用轻量卷积掩码模块处理删除主导的早期步骤，第二阶段用适应 TSE 的 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 进行单步流匹配插入。模型仅 85M 参数，一步推理即可产生高质量提取，同时尽可能保留干净单说话人输入。
Motivation: 现有掩码方法轻量但无法合成缺失内容，感知质量差；生成式扩散模型质量高但需要多步迭代，计算成本高、延迟大。需要一种兼顾质量与效率的 TSE 方法。
Method: 通过删除/插入比例分析发现早期流步骤以删除信号成分为主，据此将框架解耦为两阶段：第一阶段用轻量卷积掩码模块处理删除；第二阶段用单步流匹配（基于 DiT，添加说话人条件）从掩码频谱图出发进行插入，无需从高斯噪声开始。
Result: 摘要报告 Mask2Flow-TSE 以 85M 参数量和一步推理实现高质量提取，同时最小化对干净单说话人输入的退化。
Conclusion: 两阶段框架融合了掩码的轻量和流匹配的生成能力，在极低参数量和推理步数下达到高质量 TSE，是两种范式的有效结合。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Distributional Regression with Tabular Foundation Models: Evaluating Probabilistic Predictions via Proper Scoring Rules
papers.abstract_en: Modern tabular foundation models such as TabPFN and TabICL naturally produce full predictive distributions, while the benchmarks used to evaluate them (TabArena, TALENT, and others) still rely almost exclusively on point-estimate metrics (RMSE, $R^2$). This mismatch implicitly rewards machine learning models or pipelines that elicit a good conditional mean while ignoring the quality of the predictive distribution. We make the case for using proper scoring rules for training, fine-tuning, and benchmarking (ranking) of tabular foundation models. Although all strictly proper scoring rules are theoretically equivalent at the population level, they may differ on finite data: We demonstrate analytically and empirically that different scoring rules can induce different inductive biases during finite-sample optimization, leading to different model performance. We validate this finding by running fine-tuning experiments with TabPFN and TabICL using different scoring rules for various data sets, revealing non-trivial interactions between training objectives and evaluation metrics. Our results show that practitioners can adapt tabular foundation models to task-specific scoring objectives, and that the choice of scoring rule can influence model behavior in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文指出现代表格基础模型（如TabPFN和TabICL）能够生成完整的预测分布，但现有基准（TabArena、TALENT等）仍仅使用点估计指标（RMSE、R²）进行评估。作者主张在表格基础模型的训练、微调和基准排序中使用适当的评分规则（proper scoring rules），并证明在有限样本下不同评分规则会引入不同的归纳偏差，影响模型性能。实验表明，通过选择任务特定的评分目标可以调整模型行为。
Motivation: 表格基础模型的评估指标与模型能力不匹配：模型输出完整分布，但基准仅用点估计指标，忽略了预测分布的质量。
Method: 从理论和实验两方面分析不同严格适当的评分规则在有限样本优化中的差异，并使用TabPFN和TabICL在多个数据集上用不同评分规则进行微调实验。
Result: 不同评分规则在有限样本下会诱导不同的归纳偏差，导致模型性能差异；训练目标和评估指标之间存在非平凡交互。
Conclusion: 实践者可以针对特定任务选择评分目标来调整表格基础模型，评分规则的选择在实践中会影响模型行为。

papers.title: StructSAM: Structure- and Spectrum-Preserving Token Merging for Segment Anything Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent token merging techniques for Vision Transformers (ViTs) provide substantial speedups by reducing the number of tokens processed by self-attention, often without retraining. However, their direct application to the Segment Anything Model (SAM) family is nontrivial: SAM's image encoder mixes windowed and global attention, and its mask decoder relies on dense, prompt-conditioned features for precise boundary prediction. We systematically evaluate representative token-merging methods on SAM and Medical SAM in a strict off-the-shelf setting, and find that existing destination-selection heuristics can erode boundaries and leak prompt information as merge rates increase. We propose \textbf{StructSAM}, a resolution-preserving merge-unmerge framework tailored to SAM. StructSAM computes a lightweight token-energy score from first-order feature gradients, uses grid-based flatness screening to protect boundary and prompt regions, and merges tokens within flat areas toward low-energy destinations with explicit token recovery. We further provide a spectral graph coarsening view showing that score-guided merging yields bounded Laplacian spectral distortion compared to random or window-restricted baselines. Across eight natural and medical benchmarks, StructSAM reduces encoder FLOPs by 25-30\% (up to 40\%+ with prompt-aware merging) with minor drops in mIoU/Dice, consistently outperforming ToMe, PiToMe, ToMeSD, VidToMe, and ALGM at the same compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Segment Anything Model (SAM) 系列提出结构保持的 token 合并框架 StructSAM，通过基于一阶特征梯度的轻量 token 能量评分、网格平坦性筛选保护边界和提示区域，以及显式 token 恢复，在无需重训练的情况下减少编码器 FLOPs 约 25-30%（提示感知合并可达 40%+），并在多个医疗和自然图像基准上保持 mIoU/Dice 轻微下降。从谱图粗化角度证明了分数引导合并相比随机或窗口限制基线具有有界的拉普拉斯谱失真。
Motivation: 现有 token 合并方法直接应用于 SAM 时，由于 SAM 混合窗口和全局注意力、掩码解码器依赖密集提示特征，会导致边界模糊和提示信息泄漏。
Method: 提出 StructSAM 框架：计算轻量 token 能量评分（基于一阶特征梯度），使用网格平坦性筛选保护边界和提示区域，将平坦区域内的 token 合并到低能量目标并显式恢复 token；提供谱图粗化分析证明分数引导合并的谱失真有界。
Result: 在八个自然和医疗基准上，StructSAM 减少编码器 FLOPs 25-30%（提示感知合并可达 40%+），mIoU/Dice 仅轻微下降，一致优于 ToMe、PiToMe、ToMeSD、VidToMe 和 ALGM。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 StructSAM 是一种即插即用的 SAM 加速方法，在保持结构完整性的同时显著降低计算成本。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在八个自然和医疗基准上，StructSAM 减少编码器 FLOPs 25-30%（提示感知合并可达 40%+），mIoU/Dice 仅轻微下降，一致优于 ToMe、PiToMe、ToMeSD、VidToMe 和 ALGM。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 StructSAM 是一种即插即用的 SAM 加速方法，在保持结构完整性的同时显著降低计算成本。

papers.title: Whisper-CD: Accurate Long-Form Speech Recognition using Multi-Negative Contrastive Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Long-form speech recognition with large encoder-decoder models such as Whisper often exhibit hallucinations, repetition loops, and content omissions. These errors can accumulate and be further amplified when the previous segment's transcription is used as decoding context. We propose Whisper-CD, a training-free contrastive decoding framework that contrasts clean-audio logits against negative logits computed from three acoustically motivated perturbations: Gaussian noise injection, silence signal, and audio temporal shift. We aggregate these negatives via the log-sum-exp operator, building a unified multi-negative objective for token-by-token decoding. Across five English long-form benchmarks, Whisper-CD reduces WER by up to 24.3pp on CORAAL and shows 48% faster token generation throughput than beam search. Because Whisper-CD operates purely at inference time, it can be applied as a drop-in replacement to already-deployed Whisper systems without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对Whisper等编码器-解码器模型在长语音识别中出现的幻觉、重复循环和内容遗漏问题，本文提出Whisper-CD，一种无需训练的对比解码框架。通过对比干净音频logits与三种声学扰动（高斯噪声注入、静音信号、音频时间偏移）产生的负logits，并利用log-sum-exp算子聚合多个负样本，实现逐token解码。在五个英文长语音基准上，Whisper-CD在CORAAL上最高降低WER 24.3个百分点，生成吞吐量比beam search快48%。该方法可作为已部署Whisper系统的即插即用替代品，无需重新训练。
Motivation: 长语音识别中，Whisper等模型易出现幻觉、重复和内容遗漏，且前一段转录作为上下文时会累积并放大这些错误。
Method: 提出Whisper-CD，一种训练无关的对比解码框架，使用三种声学扰动（高斯噪声、静音、时间偏移）生成负样本logits，通过log-sum-exp聚合为统一的多负目标，用于逐token解码。
Result: 在五个英文长语音基准上，Whisper-CD在CORAAL上WER降低高达24.3个百分点，生成吞吐量比beam search快48%。
Conclusion: Whisper-CD纯推理时操作，可作为已部署Whisper系统的即插即用替代品，无需重新训练。

papers.title: An intuitive rearranging of the Yates covariance decomposition for probabilistic verification of forecasts with the Brier score
authors: Bruno Hebling Vieira (Methods of Plasticity Research
papers.abstract_en: Proper scoring rules are essential for evaluating probabilistic forecasts. We propose a simple algebraic rearrangement of the Yates covariance decomposition of the Brier score into three independently non-negative terms: a variance mismatch term, a correlation deficit term, and a calibration-in-the-large term. This rearrangement makes the optimality conditions for perfect forecasting transparent: the optimal forecast must simultaneously match the variance of outcomes, achieve perfect positive correlation with outcomes, and match the mean of outcomes. Any deviation from these conditions results in a positive contribution to the Brier score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对Brier score的Yates协方差分解进行代数重组，得到三个非负项：方差失配项、相关不足项和整体校准项。这种重组使得完美预报的最优条件变得透明：预报必须同时匹配结果的方差、与结果完全正相关、并匹配结果的均值。任何偏离都会增加Brier score。
Motivation: 概率预报验证中，传统的Brier score分解可能掩盖预报误差的具体来源。本文旨在通过简单的代数重组，使完美预报的条件更加直观，便于理解不同误差成分的贡献。
Method: 提出Brier score的Yates协方差分解的代数重组，将其分解为三个独立的非负项：方差失配、相关不足和整体校准。
Result: 该重组揭示了完美预报必须同时满足三个条件：方差匹配、完全正相关、均值匹配。任何偏离都会正向贡献于Brier score。
Conclusion: 这种重新排列使得概率预报的误差来源更透明，有助于改进预报系统的诊断和优化。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Real5-OmniDocBench: A Full-Scale Physical Reconstruction Benchmark for Robust Document Parsing in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) achieve near-perfect scores on digital document benchmarks like OmniDocBench, their performance in the unpredictable physical world remains largely unknown due to the lack of controlled yet realistic evaluations. We introduce Real5-OmniDocBench, the first benchmark that performs a full-scale, one-to-one physical reconstruction of the entire OmniDocBench v1.5 (1,355 images) across five critical real-world scenarios: Scanning, Warping, Screen-Photography, Illumination, and Skew. Unlike prior benchmark that either lack digital correspondence or employ partial sampling, our complete ground-truth mapping enables, for the first time, rigorous factor-wise attribution of performance degradation-allowing us to pinpoint whether failures stem from geometric distortions, optical artifacts, or model limitations. Our benchmark establishes a challenging new standard for the community, demonstrating that the 'reality gap' in document parsing is far from closed, and provides a diagnostic tool to guide the development of truly resilient document intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Real5-OmniDocBench 是首个对 OmniDocBench v1.5 (1355 张图像) 进行完整一对一物理重建的基准测试，覆盖扫描、扭曲、屏幕拍摄、光照和倾斜五个真实场景。该基准通过精确的 ground-truth 映射，首次实现了对性能退化的逐因素归因，揭示了视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在文档解析中的现实差距远未消除。
Motivation: 现有数字文档基准 (如 OmniDocBench) 上 VLM 表现近乎完美，但物理世界中的真实性能因缺乏可控且逼真的评估而未知。
Method: 对 OmniDocBench v1.5 的全部 1355 张图像进行完整的物理重建，生成对应真实场景的 ground-truth 映射，从而支持几何畸变、光学伪影等不同因素的隔离分析。
Result: 基准测试表明，文档解析中的“现实差距”仍然显著，VLM 在物理场景下的性能远低于数字基准。
Conclusion: Real5-OmniDocBench 提供了一个诊断工具，用于归因性能退化来源，指导开发更鲁棒的文档智能系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Retrievit: In-context Retrieval Capabilities of Transformers, State Space Models, and Hybrid Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Transformers excel at in-context retrieval but suffer from quadratic complexity with sequence length, while State Space Models (SSMs) offer efficient linear-time processing but have limited retrieval capabilities. We investigate whether hybrid architectures combining Transformers and SSMs can achieve the best of both worlds on two synthetic in-context retrieval tasks. The first task, n-gram retrieval, requires the model to reproduce an n-gram that succeeds the query within the input sequence. The second task, position retrieval, presents the model with a query token and requires it to perform a two-hop lookup: first locating the corresponding element in the sequence, and then outputting its positional index. Under controlled conditions, we assess data efficiency, length generalization, robustness to out of domain training examples, and learned representations across Transformers, SSMs, and hybrid architectures. We find that hybrid models outperform SSMs and match or exceed Transformers in terms of data efficiency and extrapolation for tasks that require precise information retrieval from the input context. However, Transformers maintain superiority in position retrieval tasks. Through representation analysis, we discover that SSM-based models develop locality-aware embeddings where tokens representing adjacent positions become neighbors in embedding space, forming interpretable structures. This property is absent in Transformers as causal attention is sufficient for acquiring positional associations, and the introduction of positional encoding amplifies this behavior, leading to improvement in data efficiency. SSMs on the other hand update their internal representations incrementally and without positional encodings, are required to learn these associations. Our findings reveal fundamental differences in how Transformers and SSMs, and hybrid models learn positional associations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过两个合成任务（n-gram检索和位置检索）系统比较了Transformer、状态空间模型（SSM）及混合架构在上下文检索中的表现。研究发现混合模型在数据效率和泛化方面优于SSM，与Transformer相当或更优，但在位置检索任务上Transformer仍占优势。通过表示分析，发现SSM形成位置感知嵌入，而Transformer依赖因果注意力。
Motivation: Transformer在上下文检索中表现优异但计算复杂度为二次方，SSM线性高效但检索能力有限。作者希望探索混合架构能否兼具两者优点。
Method: 设计了两个合成检索任务：n-gram检索（给定查询，输出后续n-gram）和位置检索（给定查询，输出其位置索引）。在受控条件下评估模型的数据效率、长度泛化、域外鲁棒性和学习表示。
Result: 混合模型在数据效率和泛化上匹配或超过Transformer，并优于SSM；但Transformer在位置检索任务上保持优势。表示分析显示SSM形成可解释的位置感知嵌入，而Transformer不需要。
Conclusion: 揭示了Transformer、SSM和混合模型在位置关联学习上的根本差异，为混合架构设计提供指导。

papers.title: Cultural Counterfactuals: Evaluating Cultural Biases in Large Vision-Language Models with Counterfactual Examples
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have grown increasingly powerful in recent years, but can also exhibit harmful biases. Prior studies investigating such biases have primarily focused on demographic traits related to the visual characteristics of a person depicted in an image, such as their race or gender. This has left biases related to cultural differences (e.g., religion, socioeconomic status), which cannot be readily discerned from an individual's appearance alone, relatively understudied. A key challenge in measuring cultural biases is that determining which group an individual belongs to often depends upon cultural context cues in images, and datasets annotated with cultural context cues are lacking. To address this gap, we introduce Cultural Counterfactuals: a high-quality synthetic dataset containing nearly 60k counterfactual images for measuring cultural biases related to religion, nationality, and socioeconomic status. To ensure that cultural contexts are accurately depicted, we generate our dataset using an image-editing model to place people of different demographics into real cultural context images. This enables the construction of counterfactual image sets which depict the same person in multiple different contexts, allowing for precise measurement of the impact that cultural context differences have on LVLM outputs. We demonstrate the utility of Cultural Counterfactuals for quantifying cultural biases in popular LVLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Cultural Counterfactuals数据集，包含近6万张反事实图像，用于评估大视觉语言模型（LVLM）在宗教、国籍和社会经济地位等文化维度上的偏见。通过图像编辑模型将不同人口统计特征的人置于真实文化背景图像中，构成反事实图像集，以精确测量文化背景差异对LVLM输出的影响。摘要表明该数据集可量化流行LVLM中的文化偏见。
Motivation: 现有偏见研究主要关注基于外貌的人口统计特征（如种族、性别），而难以从外貌直接辨别的文化差异（如宗教、社会经济地位）的偏见研究不足。关键挑战在于确定个体所属群体依赖于图像中的文化背景线索，且缺乏带有文化背景注释的数据集。
Method: 引入Cultural Counterfactuals数据集，使用图像编辑模型将不同人口统计特征的人放置到真实文化背景图像中，构建反事实图像集（同一人在不同背景下），从而精确测量文化背景差异对LVLM输出的影响。
Result: 数据集包含近6万张反事实图像，覆盖宗教、国籍和社会经济地位维度。摘要未报告具体实验结果，但说明展示了该数据集在量化流行LVLM中文化偏见的实用性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该数据集填补了文化偏见测量中缺乏带文化背景注释数据集的空白，并为未来研究提供了工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Probabilistic Retrofitting of Learned Simulators
papers.abstract_en: Dominant approaches for modelling Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) rely on deterministic predictions, yet many physical systems of interest are inherently chaotic and uncertain. While training probabilistic models from scratch is possible, it is computationally expensive and fails to leverage the significant resources already invested in high-performing deterministic backbones. In this work, we adopt a training-efficient strategy to transform pre-trained deterministic models into probabilistic ones via retrofitting with a proper scoring rule: the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS). Crucially, this approach is architecture-agnostic: it applies the same adaptation mechanism across distinct model backbones with minimal code modifications. The method proves highly effective across different scales of pre-training: for models trained on single dynamical systems, we achieve 20-54% reductions in rollout CRPS and up to 30% improvements in variance-normalised RMSE (VRMSE) relative to compute-matched deterministic fine-tuning. We further validate our approach on a PDE foundation model, trained on multiple systems and retrofitted on the dataset of interest, to show that our probabilistic adaptation yields an improvement of up to 40% in CRPS and up to 15% in VRMSE compared to deterministic fine-tuning. Validated across diverse architectures and dynamics, our results show that probabilistic PDE modelling need not require retraining from scratch, but can be unlocked from existing deterministic backbones with modest additional training cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种高效的模型改造方法，通过CRPS（Continuous Ranked Probability Score）对预训练的确定性PDE模拟器进行后验微调，将其转化为概率模型，避免从头训练。该方法架构无关，在多类动力学系统和PDE基础模型上验证，CRPS降低20-54%，VRMSE提升15-30%。
Motivation: 现有PDE模拟大多基于确定性预测，但许多物理系统（如混沌系统）具有固有不确定性。从头训练概率模型计算成本高，且无法利用已有高性能确定性模型。
Method: 采用CRPS作为评分规则，对预训练确定性模型进行后验（retrofitting）微调，仅需少量代码修改且架构无关。
Result: 在单动力学系统上，滚动预测CRPS降低20-54%，VRMSE提升30%；在PDE基础模型上，CRPS降低40%，VRMSE提升15%。
Conclusion: 概率PDE建模无需从头训练，可通过现有确定性模型的微调实现，且额外训练成本较低。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有PDE模拟大多基于确定性预测，但许多物理系统（如混沌系统）具有固有不确定性。从头训练概率模型计算成本高，且无法利用已有高性能确定性模型。
summary_sections.method: 采用CRPS作为评分规则，对预训练确定性模型进行后验（retrofitting）微调，仅需少量代码修改且架构无关。
summary_sections.result: 在单动力学系统上，滚动预测CRPS降低20-54%，VRMSE提升30%；在PDE基础模型上，CRPS降低40%，VRMSE提升15%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 概率PDE建模无需从头训练，可通过现有确定性模型的微调实现，且额外训练成本较低。

papers.title: LemmaBench: A Live, Research-Level Benchmark to Evaluate LLM Capabilities in Mathematics
papers.abstract_en: We present a new approach for benchmarking Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities on research-level mathematics. Existing benchmarks largely rely on static, hand-curated sets of contest or textbook-style problems as proxies for mathematical research. Instead, we establish an updatable benchmark evaluating models directly on the latest research results in mathematics. This consists of an automatic pipeline that extracts lemmas from arXiv and rewrites them into self-contained statements by making all assumptions and required definitions explicit. It results in a benchmark that can be updated regularly with new problems taken directly from human mathematical research, while previous instances can be used for training without compromising future evaluations. We benchmark current state-of-the-art LLMs, which obtain around 10-15$\%$ accuracy in theorem proving (pass@1) depending on the model, showing that there is currently a large margin of progression for LLMs to reach human-level proving capabilities in a research context.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 3rd AI for Math Workshop (AI4Math) at ICML 2026 (poster). Non-archival workshop. 15 pages, 3 figures, 5 Tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LemmaBench，一个评估大语言模型在科研级数学能力上的新型基准。通过自动从arXiv提取数学引理并重写为自包含问题，该基准可定期更新。在多个最先进LLM上测试，定理证明pass@1准确率仅10-15%，表明与人类水平差距显著。
Motivation: 现有数学基准多采用静态、人工筛选的竞赛题或教科书问题，无法反映数学研究的动态性。需要一种能随数学研究进展更新的基准来真实评估LLM能力。
Method: 构建自动流水线，从arXiv提取数学引理，将其所有假设和定义显式化，得到自包含陈述，形成可定期更新的基准。之前实例可用于训练而不影响未来评估。
Result: 当前最先进LLM在定理证明上pass@1准确率约10-15%，表明在科研级数学证明方面与人类水平有较大差距。
Conclusion: 该基准可动态反映最新数学研究，并揭示LLM在真实数学推理上的不足。

papers.title: Fairness under Graph Uncertainty: Achieving Interventional Fairness with Partially Known Causal Graphs over Clusters of Variables
papers.abstract_en: Algorithmic decisions about individuals require predictions that are not only accurate but also fair with respect to sensitive attributes such as gender and race. Causal notions of fairness align with legal requirements, yet many methods assume access to detailed knowledge of the underlying causal graph, which is a demanding assumption in practice. We propose a learning framework that achieves interventional fairness by leveraging a causal graph over \textit{clusters of variables}, which is substantially easier to estimate than a variable-level graph. With possible \textit{adjustment cluster sets} identified from such a cluster causal graph, our framework trains a prediction model by reducing the worst-case discrepancy between interventional distributions across these sets. To this end, we develop a computationally efficient barycenter kernel maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) that scales favorably with the number of sensitive attribute values. Extensive experiments show that our framework strikes a better balance between fairness and accuracy than existing approaches, highlighting its effectiveness under limited causal graph knowledge.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026). 31 pages, 12 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在部分已知的因果图上实现干预公平性（interventional fairness）的学习框架，使用变量簇级别的因果图（cluster causal graph）替代精细的变量级图，通过识别调整簇集并最小化跨簇的干预分布差异来训练预测模型，开发了高效的重心核最大均值差异（barycenter kernel MMD）方法。实验表明该方法在公平性与准确性之间取得了更好的平衡。
Motivation: 现有因果公平性方法通常假设已知完整详细的因果图，这在实践中难以满足。本文旨在降低对因果图知识的依赖，利用更容易估计的变量簇级因果图来实现干预公平性。
Method: 基于变量簇因果图识别可能的调整簇集（adjustment cluster sets），训练预测模型时最小化跨这些簇集的干预分布之间的最坏情况差异，并提出了计算高效的重心核最大均值差异（barycenter kernel MMD）方法。
Result: 大量实验表明，所提框架在公平性与准确性之间取得了比现有方法更好的平衡，证明了在有限因果图知识下的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文展示了利用簇级因果图实现干预公平性的可行性，在因果图知识受限的场景下具有实用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative Modeling via Kernelized Stochastic Interpolants
papers.abstract_en: We develop a kernel method for generative modeling within the stochastic interpolant framework, replacing neural network training with linear systems. The drift of the generative SDE is $\hat b_t(x) = \nablaφ(x)^\topη_t$, where $η_t \in \mathbb{R}^P$ solves a $P\times P$ system computable from data, with $P$ independent of the data dimension $d$. Since estimates are inexact, the diffusion coefficient $D_t$ affects sample quality; the optimal $D_t^*$ from Girsanov diverges at $t=0$, but this poses no difficulty and we develop an integrator that handles it seamlessly. The framework accommodates diverse feature maps: scattering transforms, pretrained generative models, etc, enabling generation and model combination without neural network training. We demonstrate the approach on financial time series, turbulence, and image generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于核方法的随机插值生成模型，用线性系统替代神经网络训练。生成SDE的漂移项通过求解与数据维度无关的线性系统获得，扩散系数在t=0处发散但不影响采样。框架支持多种特征映射（如散射变换、预训练生成模型），并在金融时间序列、湍流和图像生成任务上展示效果。
Motivation: 传统生成模型依赖神经网络训练，计算成本高且需要大量调参。本文旨在利用核方法在随机插值框架下避免神经网络训练，实现高效生成。
Method: 将生成SDE的漂移参数化为基函数线性组合，系数通过求解线性系统从数据中计算；扩散系数采用最优形式（来自Girsanov定理），并设计积分器处理其在t=0处的发散。
Result: 在金融时间序列、湍流和图像生成任务上验证了方法的有效性，但未提供具体数值比较。
Conclusion: 该框架无需神经网络训练即可生成，并支持不同特征映射的灵活组合，但扩散系数的奇异行为需要在积分器中特殊处理。

papers.title: Fine-Grained Uncertainty Quantification for Long-Form Language Model Outputs: A Comparative Study
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty quantification has emerged as an effective approach to closed-book hallucination detection for LLMs, but existing methods are largely designed for short-form outputs and do not generalize well to long-form generation. We introduce a taxonomy for fine-grained uncertainty quantification in long-form LLM outputs that distinguishes methods by design choices at three stages: response decomposition, unit-level scoring, and response-level aggregation. We formalize several families of consistency-based black-box scorers, providing generalizations and extensions of existing methods. We also introduce FactScore-STEM-Geo, a new 400-question long-form QA dataset spanning four categories across STEM and Geography. In our experiments across multiple LLMs and datasets, we find 1) claim-response entailment consistently performs better or on par with more complex claim-level scorers, 2) claim-level scoring generally yields better results than sentence-level scoring, and 3) uncertainty-aware decoding is highly effective for improving the factuality of long-form outputs. Our framework clarifies relationships between prior methods, enables apples-to-apples comparisons, and provides practical guidance for selecting components for fine-grained UQ.
papers.comment: Accepted by TMLR; UQLM repository: https://github.com/cvs-health/uqlm
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长文本语言模型输出的不确定性量化问题，提出一个细粒度分类法，将方法分为响应分解、单元级评分和响应级聚合三个阶段。作者形式化了一致性驱动的黑盒评分器系列，并引入了FactScore-STEM-Geo数据集。实验表明，声明-响应蕴含（claim-response entailment）方法简单有效，声明级评分优于句子级评分，不确定性感知解码能显著提升长文本输出的事实性。
Motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法主要针对短文本输出设计，难以直接泛化到长文本生成任务。缺乏统一的框架来比较和选择不同设计选择，导致公平性评估困难。
Method: 提出一个三阶段分类法：响应分解（分解为声明或句子）、单元级评分（一致性或概率评分）以及响应级聚合（平均或加权）。形式化了几种基于一致性的黑盒评分器，并推广了现有方法。
Result: 实验发现：1）声明-响应蕴含评分在多个LLM和数据集上表现与更复杂的声明级评分器相当或更优；2）声明级评分普遍优于句子级评分；3）不确定性感知解码能有效提高长文本输出的事实准确性。
Conclusion: 该框架厘清了不同不确定性量化方法之间的关系，实现了公平对比，并为细粒度UQ的组件选择提供了实践指导。方法仍受限于黑盒假设和数据集覆盖范围。

papers.title: Universal priors: solving empirical Bayes via Bayesian inference and pretraining
papers.abstract_en: We theoretically justify the recent empirical finding of [Teh et al., 2025] that a transformer pretrained on synthetically generated data achieves strong performance on empirical Bayes (EB) problems. We take an indirect approach to this question: rather than analyzing the model architecture or training dynamics, we ask why a pretrained Bayes estimator, trained under a prespecified training distribution, can adapt to arbitrary test distributions. Focusing on Poisson EB problems, we identify the existence of universal priors such that training under these priors yields a near-optimal regret bound of $\widetilde{O}(\frac{1}{n})$ uniformly over all test distributions. Our analysis leverages the classical phenomenon of posterior contraction in Bayesian statistics, showing that the pretrained transformer adapts to unknown test distributions precisely through posterior contraction. This perspective also explains the phenomenon of length generalization, in which the test sequence length exceeds the training length, as the model performs Bayesian inference using a generalized posterior.
papers.comment: To appear at COLT 2026. 43 pages, 5 figures. Code release at https://github.com/Anzoteh96/eb-transformers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上证明了最近的一个经验发现：在合成数据上预训练的Transformer在经验贝叶斯问题上表现优异。通过识别通用先验的存在，证明在这些先验下训练的模型对任意测试分布都能达到接近最优的遗憾界Ö(1/n)。分析利用贝叶斯统计中的后验收缩现象，并解释了长度泛化能力。
Motivation: 经验贝叶斯问题中，预训练模型如何适应未知测试分布的理论解释缺失。
Method: 采用间接方法，不分析模型架构或训练动态，而是研究为什么在预设训练分布下训练的贝叶斯估计器能适应任意测试分布。聚焦泊松经验贝叶斯问题，识别出通用先验，并利用后验收缩现象进行理论分析。
Result: 证明在通用先验下训练的模型对任意测试分布有Ö(1/n)的遗憾界，且解释了测试序列长度超过训练长度时的泛化现象。
Conclusion: 理论证明预训练Transformer通过后验收缩适应未知测试分布，为经验贝叶斯中的预训练提供了理论基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AD-Bench: A Real-World, Trajectory-Aware Advertising Analytics Benchmark for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents have made remarkable progress on complex reasoning, evaluating them in real-world environments remains an open problem. Existing benchmarks are largely confined to idealized simulations and fail to capture specialized domains such as advertising and marketing analytics, where tasks require multi-round interaction with professional tools and where ground-truth answers quickly become obsolete as data and platform rules evolve. To address this, we propose AD-Bench, a benchmark built from real user marketing-analysis requests on a production advertising platform. AD-Bench introduces two key designs: (i) a dynamic ground-truth pipeline that replays expert tool-call trajectories to regenerate answers consistent with the current environment, mitigating answer obsolescence; and (ii) a trajectory-aware evaluation that jointly measures end-to-end answer correctness (Pass@k) and trajectory coverage. Requests are stratified into three difficulty levels (L1-L3) to probe multi-round, multi-tool collaboration. Experiments show that the best model, Claude-Opus-4.7, attains Pass@1 = 76.9% and Pass@3 = 80.4% with 82.7% trajectory coverage overall, yet drops sharply on L3 to Pass@1 = 61.4% and Pass@3 = 65.1%, revealing that even state-of-the-art agents have substantial gaps in complex advertising analytics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AD-Bench 是一个基于真实广告平台用户请求构建的基准，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）代理在广告分析中的表现。它引入动态真实答案生成管道和轨迹感知评价，实验表明最佳模型 Claude-Opus-4.7 总体 Pass@1 为 76.9%，但在最困难级别 L3 上降至 61.4%，揭示了现有代理在复杂广告分析任务中的显著不足。
Motivation: 现有基准多局限于理想化模拟，无法捕捉广告分析等专业领域，且真实答案易因数据与平台规则变化而过时，缺乏对多轮交互和轨迹质量的评价。
Method: 提出 AD-Bench，包含两个核心设计：(i) 动态真实答案管道，通过回放专家工具调用轨迹生成与环境一致的答案；(ii) 轨迹感知评价，同时衡量答案正确率（Pass@k）和轨迹覆盖率。请求按难度分为 L1-L3 三级。
Result: Claude-Opus-4.7 在整体上达到 Pass@1=76.9%、Pass@3=80.4%、轨迹覆盖率 82.7%；但在 L3 级别上 Pass@1 仅 61.4%、Pass@3 仅 65.1%，表明最先进的代理在复杂广告分析中仍有较大差距。
Conclusion: AD-Bench 为广告分析领域的 LLM 代理提供了更具真实性的评估框架，揭示了现有模型在复杂多轮多工具任务上的局限性。
