papers.title: Black-Box Detection of LLM-Generated Text Using Generalized Jensen-Shannon Divergence
papers.abstract_en: We study black-box detection of machine-generated text under practical constraints: the scoring model (proxy LM) may mismatch the unknown source model, and per-input contrastive generation is costly. We propose SurpMark, a reference-based detector that summarizes a passage by the dynamics of its token surprisals. SurpMark discretizes surprisals into interpretable states, estimates a state-transition matrix for the test text, and scores it via a generalized Jensen-Shannon (GJS) gap between the test transitions and two fixed references (human vs. machine) built once from existing corpora. Theoretically, we derive design guidance for how the discretization bins should scale with data and provide a principled justification for our test statistic. Empirically, across multiple datasets, source models, and scenarios, SurpMark consistently matches or surpasses baselines, demonstrating strong robustness across domains and generators; our experiments on hyperparameter sensitivity exhibit trends that our theoretical results help to explain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SurpMark，一种基于参考的黑盒检测方法，通过令牌惊异度（token surprisal）动态的广义 Jensen-Shannon（GJS）散度来区分人类和机器生成的文本。理论上给出了离散化区间的设计指导，实验显示 SurpMark 在多个数据集、源模型和场景下匹配或超越基线，并具有跨领域和生成器的强鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有黑盒检测面临评分模型（proxy LM）与未知源模型不匹配、以及每个输入都需要对比生成的高成本问题。
Method: SurpMark 将令牌惊异度离散化为可解释状态，构建状态转移矩阵，然后计算测试文本转移矩阵与两个固定参考（人类 vs 机器）之间的广义 Jensen-Shannon 散度作为检测分数。
Result: 在多个数据集、源模型和场景下，SurpMark 一致匹配或超越现有基线，表现出对领域和生成器变化的强鲁棒性；超参数敏感性实验的趋势与理论分析一致。
Conclusion: SurpMark 是一种实用且鲁棒的黑盒检测方法，其理论分析有助于理解离散化参数对性能的影响。

papers.title: Predictive Feature Caching for Training-free Acceleration of Molecular Geometry Generation
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching models generate high-fidelity molecular geometries but incur significant computational costs during inference, requiring hundreds of network evaluations. This inference overhead becomes the primary bottleneck when such models are employed in practice to sample large numbers of molecular candidates. This work discusses a training-free caching strategy that accelerates molecular geometry generation by predicting intermediate hidden states across solver steps. The proposed method operates directly on the SE(3)-equivariant backbone, is compatible with pretrained models, and is orthogonal to existing training-based accelerations and system-level optimizations. Experiments on the GEOM-Drugs dataset demonstrate that caching achieves a twofold reduction in wall-clock inference time at matched sample quality and a speedup of up to 3x compared to the base model with minimal sample quality degradation. Because these gains compound with other optimizations, applying caching alongside other general, lossless optimizations yield as much as a 7x speedup.
papers.comment: Accepted at the AI for Science Workshop @ NeurIPS 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需额外训练的预测性特征缓存方法，用于加速基于flow matching的分子几何生成。该方法通过预测求解器步骤间的中间隐藏状态，减少网络评估次数，直接作用于SE(3)-等变骨干网络。在GEOM-Drugs数据集上，缓存实现推理时间减半且样本质量不变，相对基础模型加速可达3倍（轻微质量下降），结合其他无损优化可达7倍加速。
Motivation: Flow matching模型在分子几何生成中推理开销大，采样大量分子时成为主要瓶颈，亟需无需重新训练的加速策略。
Method: 提出训练无关的缓存策略，通过预测flow matching求解器步骤中的中间特征（隐藏状态）来减少网络前向传播次数，方法兼容预训练模型且与其他加速技术正交。
Result: 在GEOM-Drugs数据集上，缓存使推理时间减半，样本质量与基线持平；相对基础模型加速3x（轻微质量下降）；结合其他优化实现7x加速。
Conclusion: 该缓存方法是一种高效且通用的推理加速手段，可无损或低损地叠加于现有优化之上，显著降低分子几何生成的计算成本。

papers.title: Explore-Execute Chain: Towards an Efficient Structured Reasoning Paradigm
papers.abstract_en: Many LLMs plan before they act, yet planning and execution are often still entangled in one long generation trace, enforced only through prompts, or split across separate components. We argue that these two stages call for different computation: planning benefits from diversity and breadth, whereas execution demands precision and faithful adherence to a chosen strategy. Treating them as a single undifferentiated chain wastes tokens on routine derivation and makes it costly to explore alternative strategies at test time. We present the \textbf{Explore-Execute Chain (E\textsuperscript{2}C)}, which keeps both stages in one model but separates them structurally: a stochastic \textit{Exploration} phase drafts a concise high-level plan, and a deterministic \textit{Execution} phase carries it out. Causal SFT and RL train this split so that exploration stays informative and execution remains plan-faithful. Once plans are short yet decisive, extra inference compute can be directed to exploration rather than to repeatedly decoding full solutions. On AIME'2024 at $K{=}32$, \textbf{E\textsuperscript{2}C-ReAct Loop} reaches 53.3\% accuracy with only 12.4k tokens, outperforming Tree-of-Thoughts ($N{=}32$: 50.0\%, 71.3k). The same structure also supports lightweight domain adaptation: \textbf{Exploration-Focused SFT (EF-SFT)} updates only the planning phase, uses 3.5\% of the tokens required by standard SFT, and improves medical benchmark accuracy by up to 14.5\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出探索-执行链（E²C）架构，将LLM的规划阶段和执行阶段在结构上分离：探索阶段随机生成高层计划，执行阶段严格按照计划执行。通过因果SFT和RL训练使探索保持信息丰富、执行忠实于计划。在AIME'2024数学竞赛题上，K=32时E²C-ReAct Loop达到53.3%准确率，仅用12.4k token，优于树搜索（Tree-of-Thoughts）。探索聚焦SFT（EF-SFT）仅更新规划阶段，使用标准SFT所需token的3.5%，在医学基准上提升14.5%准确率。
Motivation: 现有LLM规划与执行纠缠在生成长序列中，仅通过提示或分离组件实现，导致两种阶段无法分别优化。规划需要多样性和广度，执行需要精确性和忠实度，统一处理浪费token且难以在测试时探索替代策略。
Method: 提出Explore-Execute Chain（E²C），在单一模型内将探索（随机生成简洁高层计划）和执行（确定性按计划执行）结构分离。使用因果SFT和RL训练这种分离，使探索保持信息性，执行保持忠实于计划。此外，支持探索聚焦微调（EF-SFT），仅更新规划阶段，使用很少token。
Result: 在AIME'2024数学竞赛题上，K=32时E²C-ReAct Loop达到53.3%准确率，仅用12.4k token，优于Tree-of-Thoughts（N=32: 50.0%, 71.3k token）。EF-SFT使用标准SFT所需token的3.5%，在医学基准上提升14.5%准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分离探索与执行阶段可以提高推理效率，支持轻量级域适应，降低微调成本。

papers.title: LUQ: Layerwise Ultra-Low Bit Quantization for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) with multimodal capabilities have revolutionized vision-language tasks, but their deployment often requires huge memory and computational resources. Post-training quantization (PTQ) has successfully compressed language models to as low as 1-bit precision, its effectiveness for multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) remains unexplored. In this paper, we present the first method for ultra-low-bit (<4-bit) quantization of MLLMs. Our analysis reveals that multimodal tokens and intermediate layer activations produced by them exhibit significantly higher entropy compared to text tokens, indicating greater functional complexity that makes MLLMs less tolerant to ultra-low bit quantization. However, this entropy varies significantly across layers, with some layers producing lower-entropy activation distributions that we empirically show can better tolerate ultra-low bit quantization. Existing PTQ methods optimize weight quantization within each layer but apply the same target precision uniformly, ignoring this variation in complexity across layers. Building on this insight, we propose LUQ: Layerwise Ultra-Low Bit Quantization, which characterizes each transformer layer's functional complexity via its output activation entropy and selectively applies ultra-low bit quantization to layers encoding simpler, more compressible functions. We also show that multimodal calibration (image and text tokens) boosts VQA performance in the ultra-low bit regime. Evaluated on LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen-2.5-VL across 9 VQA benchmarks, LUQ models use 40% and 31% less memory than their 4-bit counterparts while exhibiting less than 10% degradation on MME.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LUQ，首个针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的超低位量化（<4-bit）方法。通过分析发现多模态token和中间层激活熵高于文本token，但不同层熵差异大。LUQ根据每层输出激活熵选择性应用超低位量化，并使用多模态校准。在LLaVA-1.5和Qwen-2.5-VL上，相比4-bit量化，内存降低40%和31%，在9个VQA基准上性能下降小于10%。
Motivation: 现有后训练量化(PTQ)方法有效压缩语言模型至1-bit精度，但尚未探索在MLLMs上的超低位量化效果。MLLMs中多模态token和中间层激活熵更高，对超低位量化容忍度低。
Method: 提出LUQ，通过每层输出激活熵表征功能复杂度，对编码更简单函数的层选择性应用超低位量化，并采用多模态校准（图像和文本token）。
Result: 在LLaVA-1.5和Qwen-2.5-VL上，LUQ模型比4-bit量化版本内存减少40%和31%，在9个VQA基准上MME指标性能下降小于10%。
Conclusion: LUQ是首个MLLM超低位量化方法，利用层间熵差异实现内存节省与性能保持平衡。

papers.title: Johnson-Lindenstrauss Lemma Guided Network for Efficient 3D Medical Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Lightweight 3D medical image segmentation remains constrained by a fundamental \textit{``efficiency / robustness conflict''}, particularly when processing complex anatomical structures and heterogeneous modalities. In this paper, we study how to redesign the framework based on the characteristics of high-dimensional 3D images, and explore data synergy to overcome the fragile representation of lightweight methods. Our approach, VeloxSeg, begins with a deployable and extensible dual-stream CNN-Transformer architecture composed of Paired Window Attention (PWA) and Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma-guided convolution (JLC). For each 3D image, we invoke a ``glance-and-focus'' principle, where PWA rapidly retrieves multi-scale information, and JLC ensures robust local feature extraction with minimal parameters, significantly enhancing the model's ability to operate with low computational budget. Followed by an extension of the dual-stream architecture that incorporates modal interaction into the multi-scale image-retrieval process, VeloxSeg efficiently models heterogeneous modalities. Finally, Spatially Decoupled Knowledge Transfer (SDKT) via Gram matrices injects the texture prior extracted by a self-supervised network into the segmentation network, yielding stronger representations than baselines at no extra inference cost. Experimental results on multimodal benchmarks show that VeloxSeg achieves a 26\% Dice improvement, alongside increasing GPU throughput by 11$\times$, CPU by 48$\times$, and reducing training peak GPU memory usage by $1/20$, inference by $1/24$. Code is available at https://github.com/JinPLu/VeloxSeg.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VeloxSeg，一种基于 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 引理引导的轻量级 3D 医学图像分割网络，采用双流 CNN-Transformer 架构（配对窗口注意力 PWA 和 JL 引理引导卷积 JLC）以及空间解耦知识迁移（SDKT），在多个模态的 3D 医学分割基准上显著提升 Dice 系数并大幅降低计算开销。
Motivation: 轻量级 3D 医学图像分割面临效率与鲁棒性之间的根本冲突，尤其是处理复杂解剖结构和异质模态时，现有轻量方法表示能力脆弱。
Method: 提出 VeloxSeg，包括可部署的双流 CNN-Transformer 架构，由 PWA（快速获取多尺度信息）和 JLC（鲁棒局部特征提取，参数极少）组成；通过“扫视-聚焦”原则处理 3D 图像；还引入模态交互的多尺度图像检索扩展以及基于 Gram 矩阵的 SDKT，从自监督网络注入纹理先验，不增加推理成本。
Result: 在多模态基准上，VeloxSeg 比基线提升 26% Dice，GPU 吞吐量提升 11 倍，CPU 提升 48 倍，训练峰值 GPU 内存降低至 1/20，推理内存降低至 1/24。
Conclusion: VeloxSeg 通过结合 JL 引理引导的卷积和知识迁移，在极低计算预算下实现了鲁棒且高效的 3D 医学图像分割，适用于实际部署。

papers.title: GraphPFN: A Prior-Data Fitted Graph Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Graph foundation models face several fundamental challenges including transferability across diverse domains and data scarcity, which calls into question the very feasibility of creating such models. However, despite similar challenges, the tabular domain has recently witnessed the emergence of the first successful foundation models such as TabPFN. These models are based on the prior-data fitted networks (PFN) framework, in which models are pretrained on carefully designed synthetic datasets to make predictions in an in-context learning setting. Recently, G2T-FM, a framework that converts graph node-level tasks into tabular tasks, has made the first step towards adopting PFNs for graphs, yet it is limited to hand-crafted features and was never pretrained on graph data. In this work, we make the next step by proposing GraphPFN, a PFN-based model designed and pretrained specifically for graph node-level tasks. Following the PFN framework, we first design a prior distribution of synthetic attributed graphs by using a novel combination of multi-level stochastic block models and a preferential attachment process for structure generation and graph-aware structured causal models for attribute generation. Then, we augment the tabular foundation model LimiX with attention-based graph neighborhood aggregation layers and train it on millions of synthetic graphs sampled from our prior. On diverse real-world graph datasets with node-level tasks, GraphPFN achieves state-of-the-art results in both in-context learning and finetuning regimes, outperforming G2T-FM, prior GFMs, and task-specific GNNs trained from scratch. More broadly, GraphPFN shows the potential of PFN-based models for building graph foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GraphPFN，一个基于先验数据拟合网络（PFN）的图基础模型，专门针对图节点级任务进行设计和预训练。通过组合多级随机块模型和优先连接过程生成图结构，并使用图感知结构因果模型生成属性，构建合成图先验分布。在真实图节点任务上，GraphPFN在上下文学习和微调场景中均达到最先进水平，优于G2T-FM、现有图基础模型以及从头训练的专用图神经网络。
Motivation: 图基础模型面临跨领域迁移和数据稀缺等挑战，使得构建通用模型存在疑问。借鉴表格领域TabPFN的成功，但现有G2T-FM仅将图任务转化为表格任务，依赖手工特征且未在图数据上预训练。本文旨在设计专门用于图的PFN模型。
Method: 首先设计合成属性图的先验分布，采用多级随机块模型和优先连接过程生成图结构，图感知结构因果模型生成节点属性。然后增强表格基础模型LimiX，加入基于注意力的图邻域聚合层，并在数百万合成图上预训练。
Result: 在多个真实图节点级数据集上，GraphPFN在上下文学习和微调两种模式下均达到最先进结果，超越G2T-FM、先前图基础模型以及从头训练的专用GNN。
Conclusion: GraphPFN展示了基于PFN的模型在构建图基础模型方面的潜力。

papers.title: On-the-Fly Adaptation to Quantization: Configuration-Aware LoRA for Efficient Fine-Tuning of Quantized LLMs
papers.abstract_en: As increasingly large pre-trained models are released, deploying them on edge devices for privacy-preserving applications requires effective compression. Recent works combine quantization with the fine-tuning of high-precision LoRA adapters, which can substantially reduce model size while mitigating the accuracy loss from quantization. However, edge devices have inherently heterogeneous capabilities, while performing configuration-wise fine-tuning for every quantization setting is computationally prohibitive. In this paper, we propose CoA-LoRA, a method that dynamically adjusts the LoRA adapter to arbitrary quantization configurations (i.e., the per-layer bit-width choices of a pre-trained model) without requiring repeated fine-tuning. This is accomplished via a configuration-aware model that maps each configuration to its low-rank adjustments. The effectiveness of this model critically depends on the training configuration set, a collection of configurations chosen to cover different total bit-width budgets. However, constructing a high-quality configuration set is non-trivial. We therefore design a Pareto-based configuration search that iteratively optimizes the training configuration set, yielding more precise low-rank adjustments. Our experiments demonstrate that, unlike the state-of-the-art methods that require fine-tuning a separate LoRA adapter for each configuration, CoA-LoRA incurs no additional time cost while achieving comparable or even superior performance to those methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CoA-LoRA，一种动态调整LoRA适配器以适应任意量化配置的方法，无需针对每种配置重复微调。通过配置感知模型将配置映射到低秩调整，并设计基于Pareto的配置搜索优化训练配置集。实验表明，与现有需要为每种配置单独微调的方法相比，CoA-LoRA不增加额外时间成本，性能相当或更优。
Motivation: 边缘设备异构性强，针对每种量化设置进行配置级微调计算开销巨大，需要一种无需重复微调即可适应任意量化配置的方法。
Method: 提出配置感知模型，将每个量化配置（每层比特宽度选择）映射到其低秩调整；设计基于Pareto的配置搜索迭代优化训练配置集，以覆盖不同总比特宽度预算。
Result: 实验表明，与需要为每种配置单独微调LoRA适配器的最新方法相比，CoA-LoRA不增加额外时间成本，性能相当或更优。
Conclusion: CoA-LoRA实现了对任意量化配置的在线适应，无需重复微调，在保持性能的同时节省计算资源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cross-Attention is Half Explanation in Speech-to-Text Models
papers.abstract_en: Cross-attention is a core mechanism in encoder-decoder architectures, widespread in many fields, including speech-to-text (S2T) processing. Its scores have been repurposed for various downstream applications--such as timestamp estimation and audio-text alignment--under the assumption that they reflect the dependencies between input speech representation and the generated text. While the explanatory nature of attention mechanisms has been widely debated in the broader NLP literature, this assumption remains largely unexplored within the speech domain. To address this gap, we assess the explanatory power of cross-attention in S2T models by comparing its scores to input saliency maps derived from feature attribution. Our analysis spans monolingual and multilingual, single-task and multi-task models at multiple scales, and shows that attention scores moderately to strongly align with saliency-based explanations, particularly when aggregated across heads and layers. However, it also shows that cross-attention captures only about 50% of the input relevance and, in the best case, only partially reflects how the decoder attends to the encoder's representations--accounting for just 52-75% of the saliency. These findings uncover fundamental limitations in interpreting cross-attention as an explanatory proxy, suggesting that it offers an informative yet incomplete view of the factors driving predictions in S2T models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了语音到文本（S2T）模型中交叉注意力（cross-attention）作为解释工具的有效性。通过对比注意力分数与输入显著性图（input saliency maps），作者发现注意力分数与显著性解释中等至高度一致，但仅捕获约50%的输入相关性，且最多反映52-75%的显著性。结论认为交叉注意力提供了信息丰富但有限的预测解释视角。
Motivation: 交叉注意力在语音到文本模型中被广泛用于下游任务（如时间戳估计、音频-文本对齐），但其作为解释代理的有效性在语音领域尚未被系统验证。
Method: 比较交叉注意力分数与基于特征归因（feature attribution）的输入显著性图，涵盖单语/多语、单任务/多任务模型及多种规模。
Result: 注意力分数与显著性解释中度到高度对齐（尤其在跨头、跨层聚合后），但仅覆盖约50%的输入相关性，最多反映52-75%的显著性。
Conclusion: 交叉注意力提供信息丰富但不完整的解释视角，将其作为解释代理存在根本局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Modern Video-LLMs Need to Listen? A Benchmark Audit and Scalable Remedy
papers.abstract_en: Speech and audio encoders developed over years of community effort are routinely excluded from video understanding pipelines, not because they fail, but because benchmarks never required listening. We audit 10 video benchmarks and find items largely solvable from visual cues alone: a single-frame probe answers about 76% of AVQA without audio, suggesting poor measurement of audio-visual reasoning. Building on LLaVA-OneVision, we attach a speech/audio encoder and compare five compressor architectures under 25-fold token reduction (25 Hz to 1 Hz). Across 10 benchmarks, with and without filtering, audio yields clear gains on tasks requiring speech comprehension or cross-modal grounding, while vision-centric suites remain largely unaffected. Our results show that speech encoders play a larger role in video understanding than current benchmarks suggest. We will open-source our work at https://github.com/naver-ai/unimambamia-av.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文审计了10个视频基准，发现大部分问题仅靠视觉就能解决，音频并未被充分利用。作者在LLaVA-OneVision上附加语音/音频编码器，比较了五种压缩器架构在25倍token缩减下的表现，发现音频在需要语音理解或跨模态对齐的任务上有明显提升，而视觉为主的基准影响不大。结论是当前基准低估了语音编码器在视频理解中的作用。
Motivation: 当前视频理解流程普遍排除语音/音频编码器，因为基准测试无需音频即可解答，导致音频-视觉推理能力未被充分测量。
Method: 审计10个视频基准，构建单帧探测器发现约76%的AVQA问题无需音频；基于LLaVA-OneVision附加语音/音频编码器，比较五种压缩器架构（25倍token缩减），在有无过滤情况下评估10个基准。
Result: 在需要语音理解或跨模态对齐的任务上，音频带来明显增益；视觉为主的基准基本不受影响。
Conclusion: 语音编码器在视频理解中的作用比当前基准显示的要大，现有基准未能有效测量音频-视觉推理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Meta-learning ecological priors from large language models explains human learning and decision making
papers.abstract_en: Human cognition is profoundly shaped by the environments in which it unfolds. Yet, it remains an open question whether learning and decision making can be explained as a principled adaptation to the statistical structure of real-world tasks. We introduce ecologically rational analysis, a computational framework that unifies the normative foundations of rational analysis with ecological grounding. Leveraging large language models to generate ecologically valid cognitive tasks at scale, and using meta-learning to derive rational models optimized for these environments, we develop a new class of learning algorithms: Ecologically Rational Meta-learned Inference (ERMI). ERMI internalizes the statistical regularities of naturalistic problem spaces and adapts flexibly to novel situations, without requiring hand-crafted heuristics or explicit parameter updates. We show that ERMI captures human behavior across 15 experiments spanning function learning, category learning, and decision making, outperforming several established cognitive models in trial-by-trial prediction. Our results suggest that much of human cognition may reflect adaptive alignment to the ecological structure of the problems we encounter in everyday life.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生态理性分析框架，利用大语言模型生成生态有效的认知任务，并通过元学习得到ERMI算法。ERMI内化自然问题空间的统计规律，在函数学习、类别学习和决策等15个实验中逐trial预测人类行为，优于多种已有认知模型。结果表明人类认知可能反映了对日常问题生态结构的适应性对齐。
Motivation: 人类认知是否可解释为对真实世界任务统计结构的适应性调整？现有理论缺乏统一的计算框架来融合理性分析与生态基础。
Method: 提出生态理性分析框架：借助大语言模型大规模生成生态有效的认知任务，使用元学习推导出生态理性元学习推理（ERMI）算法，该算法无需手工启发式或显式参数更新，灵活适应新情境。
Result: 在15个实验（函数学习、类别学习、决策）中，ERMI的逐trial预测准确率优于多种已建立的认知模型。
Conclusion: 人类认知可能反映了对日常问题生态结构的适应性对齐，ERMI框架为此提供了计算解释。

papers.title: Turning Tabular Foundation Models into Graph Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: While foundation models have revolutionized fields such as natural language processing and computer vision, their potential in graph machine learning remains largely unexplored. One of the key challenges in designing graph foundation models (GFMs) is handling diverse node features that can vary across different graph datasets. While many works on GFMs have focused exclusively on text-attributed graphs, the problem of handling arbitrary features of other types in GFMs has not been fully addressed. However, this problem is not unique to the graph domain, as it also arises in the field of machine learning for tabular data. In this work, motivated by the recent success of tabular foundation models (TFMs) like TabPFNv2 and LimiX, we propose G2T-FM, a simple framework that allows tabular foundation models to be applied to graph node-level tasks. Specifically, G2T-FM augments the original node features with neighborhood feature aggregation, adds structural embeddings, and then applies a TFM to the constructed node representations. Even in the in-context learning setting, our model achieves strong results when combined with a strong TFM, outperforming both prior GFMs and well-tuned GNNs trained from scratch. Moreover, after finetuning, G2T-FM consistently surpasses well-tuned GNN baselines, often by a significant margin. In summary, our paper reveals the potential of a previously overlooked direction: utilizing tabular foundation models for graph machine learning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出G2T-FM框架，通过将表格基础模型（如TabPFNv2、LimiX）应用于图节点级任务，解决了图基础模型处理多样节点特征的挑战。该方法通过邻域特征聚合和结构嵌入增强节点表示，然后使用表格基础模型进行分类。实验表明，在上下文学习和微调设置下，G2T-FM均显著优于先前的图基础模型和调优的GNN。
Motivation: 图基础模型处理不同图数据集中的多样化节点特征是一个关键挑战，而表格数据领域的基础模型已成功应对类似问题，因此探索将表格基础模型用于图任务是值得关注的方向。
Method: G2T-FM框架：首先对原始节点特征进行邻域特征聚合，并加入结构嵌入，然后将构造的节点表示输入一个预训练的表格基础模型进行节点级预测。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了利用表格基础模型进行图机器学习任务的潜力，为图基础模型设计提供了新方向。

papers.title: An Effective Strategy for Modeling Score Ordinality and Non-uniform Intervals in Automated Speaking Assessment
papers.abstract_en: A recent line of research on automated speaking assessment (ASA) has benefited from self-supervised learning (SSL) representations, which capture rich acoustic and linguistic patterns in non-native speech without underlying assumptions of feature curation. However, speech-based SSL models capture acoustic-related traits but overlook linguistic content, while text-based SSL models rely on ASR output and fail to encode prosodic nuances. Moreover, most prior arts treat proficiency levels as nominal classes, ignoring their ordinal structure and non-uniform intervals between proficiency labels. To address these limitations, we propose an effective ASA approach combining SSL with handcrafted indicator features via a novel modeling paradigm. We further introduce a multi-margin ordinal loss that jointly models both the score ordinality and non-uniform intervals of proficiency labels. Extensive experiments on the TEEMI corpus show that our method consistently outperforms strong baselines and generalizes well to unseen prompts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动口语评估（ASA）中现有模型忽略熟练度的序数结构和非均匀间隔的问题，提出一种结合自监督学习（SSL）表示与手工特征的多模态方法，并引入多边界序数损失（multi-margin ordinal loss）同时建模序数性和非均匀间隔。在TEEMI语料库上的实验表明，该方法一致超越强基线，并泛化到未见提示。
Motivation: 现有ASA方法要么只利用语音SSL模型忽略语言内容，要么依赖ASR输出的文本SSL模型无法编码韵律细节，且多数方法将熟练度视为名义类别，未利用序数结构与非均匀间隔。
Method: 提出将SSL表示与手工特征融合的多模态架构，并设计多边界序数损失函数，通过多个边界同时建模分数序数关系及非均匀间隔。
Result: 在TEEMI语料库上，该方法在多个评价指标上一致优于强基线，并对未见提示具有良好的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提方法有效建模了ASA中分数的序数性和非均匀间隔，展示了SSL与手工特征结合的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProMed: Shapley Information Gain Guided Reinforcement Learning for Proactive Medical LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Interactive medical questioning is essential in clinical consultations, where physicians must actively gather necessary patient information. Yet existing medical Large Language Models (LLMs) predominantly follow a reactive paradigm, risking diagnostic errors by answering before seeking sufficient details. To bridge this gap, we propose ProMed, a reinforcement learning framework that transitions LLMs toward a proactive paradigm, enabling them to ask clinically valuable questions before decision-making. Central to ProMed is the Shapley Information Gain (SIG) reward, which quantifies a question's clinical utility as the amount of newly acquired information, while considering its contextual importance via Shapley values. We integrate SIG into a two-stage training pipeline: (1) SIG-Guided Model Initialization uses Monte Carlo Tree Search to construct high-reward interaction trajectories for supervision, and (2) SIG-Augmented Policy Optimization, with a novel SIG-guided Reward Distribution Mechanism that prioritizes informative questions for fine-grained optimization. Experiments on partial-information medical benchmarks show that ProMed significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 6.29% on average and delivers a 54.45% gain over the reactive paradigm, and generalizes robustly to out-of-domain cases. Our codes are available at https://github.com/hxxding/ProMed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProMed，一个基于强化学习的框架，通过 Shapley Information Gain (SIG) 奖励引导医学大语言模型从被动回答转向主动提问，在部分信息医疗基准上平均提升 6.29%，相比被动范式提升 54.45%。
Motivation: 现有医学 LLM 主要采用被动范式，在缺乏足够患者信息时直接回答，可能导致诊断错误。
Method: ProMed 包含两阶段训练：SIG 引导的模型初始化（利用蒙特卡洛树搜索构建高奖励交互轨迹）和 SIG 增强的策略优化（引入 SIG 引导的奖励分配机制，优先优化信息量大的问题）。
Result: 在部分信息医疗基准上，ProMed 平均优于现有方法 6.29%，相比被动范式提升 54.45%，并能在域外场景中鲁棒泛化。
Conclusion: ProMed 通过 SIG 奖励有效驱动 LLM 主动获取关键信息，提升了临床决策的准确性，但论文未讨论对超长对话或真实临床部署的适用性。

papers.title: L-SR1: Learned Symmetric-Rank-One Preconditioning
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end deep learning has achieved impressive results but remains limited by its reliance on large labeled datasets, poor generalization to unseen scenarios, and growing computational demands. In contrast, classical optimization methods are data-efficient and lightweight but often suffer from slow convergence. While learned optimizers offer a promising fusion of both worlds, most focus on first-order methods, leaving learned second-order approaches largely unexplored. We propose a novel learned second-order optimizer that introduces a trainable preconditioning unit to enhance the classical Symmetric-Rank-One (SR1) algorithm. This unit generates data-driven vectors used to construct positive semi-definite rank-one matrices, aligned with the secant constraint via a learned projection. Our method is evaluated through analytic experiments and on the real-world task of Monocular Human Mesh Recovery (HMR), where it outperforms existing learned optimization-based approaches. Featuring a lightweight model and requiring no annotated data or fine-tuning, our approach offers strong generalization and is well-suited for integration into broader optimization-based frameworks.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). Project page: https://gallif.github.io/lsr1/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可学习的二阶优化器 L-SR1，通过可训练预处理单元增强经典 SR1 算法，生成数据驱动向量构建正半定秩一矩阵，并学习投影以满足割线约束。在人体网格恢复 (HMR) 任务上，该方法优于现有的学习优化方法，且模型轻量、无需标注数据或微调。
Motivation: 深度学习依赖大规模标注数据且泛化性差，经典优化方法收敛慢；现有学习优化器多为一阶，二阶方法研究不足。
Method: 提出可训练预处理单元，生成数据驱动向量构建正半定秩一矩阵，并通过学习投影满足割线约束，集成到经典 SR1 算法中。
Result: 在人体网格恢复 (HMR) 任务上，该方法优于现有的学习优化方法，且模型轻量、无需标注数据或微调。
Conclusion: 该方法泛化能力强，适合集成到更大的优化框架中。

papers.title: FAIRVAR: Fair Federated Learning via Variance Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) allows collaborative training of machine learning models across multiple parties without sharing raw data. However, heterogeneous data can cause some clients to have disproportionate influence on the global model, leading to disparities in their performance. Fairness, understood as reducing these disparities, is therefore a crucial concern in FL and has been addressed in various ways. We studied performance equitable fairness in FL, where the goal is to minimize performance disparities across clients. We evaluated several existing fairness-aware methods and introduce here a new gradient-variance-regularized method, implemented in two variants: FairGrad (approximate) and FairGrad* (exact). We theoretically characterize the connections between these methods and, empirically, on heterogeneous benchmarks, show that FairGrad and FairGrad* consistently improve fairness by reducing variance in client accuracies, while maintaining competitive or improved mean performance compared to existing fairness-aware baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习中异构数据导致的客户端性能差异问题，提出了一种基于梯度方差正则化的公平性方法FairGrad和其精确版本FairGrad*。理论分析揭示了两种方法之间的联系，实验表明在异构基准上，该方法能有效降低客户端准确率的方差，提升公平性，同时保持或改善平均性能。
Motivation: 联邦学习中数据异构性可能导致某些客户端对全局模型产生不成比例的影响，造成性能差异。实现公平性（减少客户端间性能差距）是联邦学习的关键问题。
Method: 提出梯度方差正则化方法，包括近似版本FairGrad和精确版本FairGrad*，通过最小化客户端准确率的方差来提升公平性。
Result: 在异构基准上，FairGrad和FairGrad*相较于现有公平性感知方法，一致地降低了客户端准确率的方差，同时保持了具有竞争力或更好的平均性能。
Conclusion: 梯度方差正则化能有效提升联邦学习中的性能公平性，且理论上有清晰刻画。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: S^2VG: 3D Stereoscopic and Spatial Video Generation via Denoising Frame Matrix
papers.abstract_en: While video generation models excel at producing high-quality monocular videos, generating 3D stereoscopic and spatial videos for immersive applications remains an underexplored challenge. We present a pose-free and training-free method that leverages an off-the-shelf monocular video generation model to produce immersive 3D videos. Our approach first warps the generated monocular video into pre-defined camera viewpoints using estimated depth information, then applies a novel \textit{frame matrix} inpainting framework. This framework utilizes the original video generation model to synthesize missing content across different viewpoints and timestamps, ensuring spatial and temporal consistency without requiring additional model fine-tuning. Moreover, we develop a \dualupdate~scheme that further improves the quality of video inpainting by alleviating the negative effects propagated from disoccluded areas in the latent space. The resulting multi-view videos are then adapted into stereoscopic pairs or optimized into 4D Gaussians for spatial video synthesis. We validate the efficacy of our proposed method by conducting experiments on videos from various generative models, such as Sora, Lumiere, WALT, and Zeroscope. The experiments demonstrate that our method has a significant improvement over previous methods. Project page at: https://daipengwa.github.io/S-2VG_ProjectPage/
papers.comment: immersive video generation, 4D scene, spatial video, stereo video

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需姿态和训练的3D立体与空间视频生成方法，利用现成的单目视频生成模型，通过深度估计、帧矩阵修复和双更新机制生成多视角视频，并适配为立体对或4D高斯体，实验在Sora、Lumiere等模型上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型主要生成高质量单目视频，但面向沉浸式体验的3D立体和空间视频生成尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出无姿态、无训练的方法：首先根据深度信息将生成的单目视频扭曲到预定义视角，然后通过帧矩阵修复框架利用原始视频生成模型合成缺失内容，并采用双更新方案缓解遮挡区域在潜空间中的负面影响。
Result: 在Sora、Lumiere、WALT、Zeroscope等不同生成模型生成的视频上实验，方法相比前期工作有显著提升。
Conclusion: 该方法可有效将单目视频生成模型扩展到3D立体和空间视频，且无需额外微调。

papers.title: Let's Measure Information Step-by-Step: AI-Based Evaluation Beyond Vibes
papers.abstract_en: We evaluate artificial intelligence (AI) systems without ground truth by exploiting a link between strategic gaming and information loss. Building on established information theory, we analyze which mechanisms resist adversarial manipulation. This motivates mutual evaluation, where the overseer is treated as a strategic player estimating mutual information by prompting, making truthful agent reporting an optimal strategy. We show that certain f-divergences, such as total variation distance (TVD), maintain polynomial guarantees under attack, building on an established exponential barrier for estimating mutual information (MI) in worst-case certification settings. Under adversarial attacks, TVD-MI maintains effectiveness (area under the curve 0.70--0.77) while other approaches can decay toward chance, demonstrating that prompting the same system for information relationships rather than quality judgments can improve robustness. The mechanisms decompose pairwise evaluations into reliable item-level detection scores without ground truth, addressing a key limitation of standard peer prediction. Pre-registration: https://osf.io/c7pum .
papers.comment: Accepted to TMLR (2026). Updated appendix to restore the proof of Theorem 3.3
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需真实标注即可评估AI系统的方法，通过信息论中的f-散度（如全变差距离）与互信息估计，设计抗对抗操纵的评估机制，并证明某些指标在攻击下仍能保持多项式级保证。实验表明，基于全变差距离的互信息估计在对抗攻击下保持有效（AUC 0.70-0.77），而其他方法可能退化至随机水平。该方法将成对评估分解为可靠的逐项检测分数，无需真实标注。
Motivation: 现有AI评估方法缺乏真实标注且易受对抗操纵，需要一种理论上可证、实践中稳健的评估框架。
Method: 利用信息论中f-散度与互信息估计的关联，提出互评估（mutual evaluation）机制，将监管者视为策略性玩家，通过提示估计互信息，使真实报告成为最优策略；并分析全变差距离等散度在对抗攻击下的多项式级保证。
Result: 全变差距离-互信息估计在对抗攻击下AUC为0.70-0.77，而其他方法可能衰退至随机水平；该方法无需真实标注即可得到可靠的逐项检测分数。
Conclusion: 该方法通过信息关系而非质量判断来提示同一系统，可提升评估鲁棒性，并解决了传统同行预测缺乏真实标注的局限。

papers.title: High-Dimensional Differentially Private Quantile Regression: Distributed Estimation and Statistical Inference
papers.abstract_en: With the development of big data and machine learning, privacy concerns have become increasingly critical, especially when handling heterogeneous datasets containing sensitive personal information. Differential privacy provides a rigorous framework for safeguarding individual privacy while enabling meaningful statistical analysis. In this paper, we propose a differentially private quantile regression method for high-dimensional data in a distributed setting. Quantile regression is a powerful and robust tool for modeling the relationships between the covariates and responses in the presence of outliers or heavy-tailed distributions. To address the computational challenges due to the non-smoothness of the quantile loss function, we introduce a Newton-type transformation that reformulates the quantile regression task into an ordinary least squares problem. Building on this, we develop a differentially private estimation algorithm with iterative updates, ensuring both near-optimal statistical accuracy and formal privacy guarantees. For inference, we further propose a differentially private debiased estimator, which enables valid confidence interval construction and hypothesis testing. Additionally, we propose a communication-efficient and differentially private bootstrap for simultaneous hypothesis testing in high-dimensional quantile regression, suitable for distributed settings with both small and abundant local data. Extensive simulations demonstrate the robustness and effectiveness of our methods in practical scenarios.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种分布式高维数据下的差分隐私分位数回归方法，通过牛顿变换将分位数回归转化为最小二乘问题，设计迭代差分隐私估计算法，并提出差分隐私去偏估计量用于置信区间和假设检验，以及通信高效的差分隐私bootstrap用于多重假设检验。
Motivation: 大数据和机器学习中隐私问题日益重要，特别是在处理含敏感个人信息的异构数据集时。差分隐私提供隐私保护框架，但高维分位数回归中非光滑分位数损失函数带来计算挑战，且分布式设置下需要兼顾隐私、效率和统计推断。
Method: 引入牛顿型变换将分位数回归重写为普通最小二乘问题；基于此开发差分隐私迭代估计算法，确保近最优统计精度和正式隐私保证；提出差分隐私去偏估计量以实现置信区间和假设检验；并针对高维分布式设置提出通信高效的差分隐私bootstrap进行同步假设检验。
Result: 大量模拟表明方法在实际场景中的稳健性和有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在高维分布式数据下实现差分隐私分位数回归，并具备统计推断能力。

papers.title: The Ratchet Effect in Silico: How Interaction Drives Cumulative Intelligence in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Human intelligence scales through cumulative cultural evolution (CCE), a ratchet process in which innovations are retained against entropic drift. Large language model training, by contrast, still depends primarily on static corpora and parameter growth, leaving little room for endogenous accumulation through interaction. We present POLIS (Population Orchestrated Learning and Inference Society), a framework in which heterogeneous agents generate solutions, verify one another's outputs, retain validated artifacts in shared cultural memory, and internalize them through parameter updates. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks, populations of 1--4B-parameter models achieved average gains of 8.8--18.9 points over base models and narrowed the gap to 70B+ monoliths. Mechanistic ablations identify peer verification as the main ratchet operator and show that internalization sustains accumulation across rounds, providing computational evidence that epistemic vigilance organizes durable knowledge growth. These results position structured social interaction as a scaling lever orthogonal to parameter count.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 POLIS 框架，通过异构智能体之间的交互（生成、验证、保留、内化）模拟人类累积文化演化中的棘轮效应，使 1-4B 参数的语言模型在数学推理任务上平均提升 8.8-18.9 点，并缩小与 70B+ 模型的差距。机制分析表明同伴验证是主要棘轮算子，内化则维持了跨轮次的积累。
Motivation: 当前大语言模型训练依赖静态语料和参数增长，缺乏通过互动实现内生知识积累的机制，限制了智能的持续进化。
Method: 提出 POLIS 框架，包含异构智能体群体，通过生成、相互验证、将有效产物存入共享文化记忆并通过参数更新内化，实现类似累积文化演化的棘轮过程。
Result: 在数学推理基准上，1-4B 参数模型平均提升 8.8-18.9 个点，显著缩小了与 70B+ 单一大模型的性能差距。消融实验确认同伴验证是核心棘轮算子，内化机制维持了跨轮次的持续提升。
Conclusion: 结构化社会互动可作为一种与参数规模正交的缩放杠杆，为语言模型提供无需扩大规模即可提升能力的新路径。

papers.title: FedSA-GCL: A Semi-Asynchronous Federated Graph Learning Framework with Personalized Aggregation and Cluster-Aware Broadcasting
papers.abstract_en: Federated Graph Learning (FGL) is a distributed learning paradigm that enables collaborative training over large-scale subgraphs located on multiple local systems. However, most existing FGL approaches rely on synchronous communication, which leads to inefficiencies and is often impractical in real-world deployments. Meanwhile, current asynchronous federated learning (AFL) methods are primarily designed for conventional tasks such as image classification and natural language processing, consequently failing to account for the unique topological properties of graph data. Directly applying these methods to graph learning frequently results in semantic drift and representational inconsistency within the global model. To address these challenges, we propose FedSA-GCL, a semi-asynchronous federated framework that leverages both inter-client label distribution divergence and graph topological characteristics through a novel ClusterCast mechanism for efficient training. We evaluate FedSA-GCL on multiple real-world graph datasets using the Louvain and Metis algorithms and conduct comparative analysis against 10 baselines. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior robustness and outstanding efficiency, outperforming the baselines by an average margin of 1.9% with Louvain and 3.0% with Metis.

TL;DR: 针对现有联邦图学习（FGL）依赖同步通信导致效率低、且异步方法忽略图拓扑的问题，提出半异步框架 FedSA-GCL，通过新颖的 ClusterCast 机制利用客户端标签分布差异和图拓扑，在多个真实图数据集上使用 Louvain 和 Metis 算法评估，平均超越基线 1.9% 和 3.0%。
Motivation: 现有 FGL 大多使用同步通信，效率低且实际部署困难；而现有异步联邦学习方法主要为图像分类等常规任务设计，未考虑图数据的拓扑特性，直接应用于图学习会导致语义漂移和全局模型表示不一致。
Method: 提出半异步联邦图学习框架 FedSA-GCL，提出 ClusterCast 机制，结合客户端间标签分布散度和图拓扑特征，实现高效训练；使用 Louvain 和 Metis 算法进行图分区。
Result: 在多个真实图数据集上对比 10 个基线，FedSA-GCL 在鲁棒性和效率上均优于基线，使用 Louvain 平均提升 1.9%，使用 Metis 平均提升 3.0%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法在联邦图学习中实现了更优的鲁棒性和效率，验证了半异步训练和 cluster-aware 广播策略的有效性。

papers.title: Conformal and kNN Predictive Uncertainty Quantification Algorithms in Metric Spaces
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a framework for uncertainty quantification in regression models defined on metric spaces. Using a proposed notion of homoscedasticity, we define a conformal prediction algorithm that provides finite-sample marginal coverage guarantees and fast convergence rates to the oracle prediction region. For heteroscedastic settings, we introduce a kNN procedure that yields locally adaptive prediction radii in general metric spaces. Although this procedure does not provide the same finite-sample guarantees as the conformal algorithm, it is designed to improve local coverage calibration without imposing smoothing assumptions. Both procedures are compatible with a broad range of regression algorithms and scale to large datasets, allowing practitioners to use their preferred models and incorporate domain-specific knowledge. Building on the heteroscedastic $k$NN approach, we also develop a flexible sequential extension for metric-space-valued time series based on nearest-neighbor expert aggregation. We establish the consistency of the proposed estimators under minimal conditions. Finally, we illustrate the practical utility of our framework in personalized medicine applications involving random objects such as probability distributions and graph Laplacians.

TL;DR: 本文在度量空间上为回归模型提出了一种不确定性量化框架。基于同方差概念，定义了一种共形预测算法，提供有限样本边际覆盖保证和快速收敛率；对于异方差场景，引入kNN过程以产生局部自适应预测半径。两种方法与多种回归算法兼容且可扩展至大数据集。还开发了基于最近邻专家聚合的度量空间时间序列序贯扩展方法。
Motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法多针对欧几里得空间，缺乏适用于一般度量空间的通用框架，尤其在处理复杂数据类型（如概率分布、图拉普拉斯）时存在局限。
Method: 提出同方差假设下的共形预测算法和异方差场景下的kNN自适应预测半径方法，并基于最近邻专家聚合扩展至度量空间时间序列预测。
Result: 共形算法提供有限样本覆盖保证和快速收敛率；kNN方法改善局部覆盖校准；序贯方法在个性化医学应用中展示实用价值。
Conclusion: 框架适用于多种回归算法和复杂数据类型，但kNN方法缺乏有限样本保证，且应用实例限于个性化医学。

papers.title: A statistical physics framework for optimal learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning is a complex dynamical process shaped by a range of interconnected decisions. Careful design of hyperparameter schedules for artificial neural networks or efficient allocation of cognitive resources by biological learners can dramatically affect performance. Yet, theoretical understanding of optimal learning strategies remains sparse, especially due to the intricate interplay between evolving metaparameters and nonlinear learning dynamics. The search for optimal protocols is further hindered by the high dimensionality of the learning space, often resulting in predominantly heuristic, difficult to interpret, and computationally demanding solutions. Here, we combine statistical physics with control theory in a unified theoretical framework to identify optimal learning protocols in prototypical neural network models. In the high-dimensional limit, we derive closed-form ordinary differential equations that track online stochastic gradient descent through low-dimensional order parameters. We formulate the design of learning protocols as an optimal control problem directly on the dynamics of the order parameters with the goal of minimizing the generalization error. This formulation encompasses a variety of learning scenarios, optimization constraints, and control budgets. We apply it to representative cases, including optimal curricula, adaptive dropout regularization and noise schedules in denoising autoencoders. We find nontrivial yet interpretable strategies highlighting how optimal protocols mediate learning trade-offs. Our results establish a principled foundation for understanding and designing optimal protocols and suggest a path toward a theory of meta-learning grounded in statistical physics.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合统计物理与控制理论的理论框架，用于识别神经网络中的最优学习协议。在高维极限下，推导出描述在线随机梯度下降的封闭形式常微分方程，并将学习协议设计形式化为一个最优控制问题，直接优化序参数动力学以最小化泛化误差。该框架应用于最优课程、自适应dropout正则化和去噪自编码器噪声调度等案例，揭示了非平凡且可解释的策略。
Motivation: 当前对最优学习策略的理论理解有限，尤其是元参数与非线性学习动力学之间的相互作用复杂，且高维学习空间导致启发式方法难以解释和计算昂贵。
Method: 将统计物理与控制理论结合，在高维极限下推导出序参数的常微分方程，并将学习协议设计转化为最优控制问题，涵盖多种学习场景、优化约束和控制预算。
Result: 在最优课程、自适应dropout和去噪自编码器噪声调度等案例中，得到非平凡但可解释的策略，展示最优协议如何调节学习权衡。
Conclusion: 为理解和设计最优协议建立原则性基础，并建议一条基于统计物理的元学习理论之路。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 为理解和设计最优协议建立原则性基础，并建议一条基于统计物理的元学习理论之路。

papers.title: DPO Unchained: Your Training Algorithm is Secretly Disentangled in Human Choice Theory (and its Loss' Convexity is Dispensable)
papers.abstract_en: Normative theories allow one to elicit key parts of a ML algorithm from first principles, which is crucial at a time of championed scrutiny for ML work. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) cleverly bypasses reward modeling by making an explicit link with a specific normative model of human choice. Our paper elevates this connection to the full generality of DPO's normative framework. Getting there requires reworking human choice theory's textbook path for a better RLHF/ML fit. It elevates the connection to a remarkably broad viewpoint on preference optimization, considering the current panorama of DPO follow-ups. It also unveils unexpected riches for ML, chief among which the support for non-convex losses, the fact that any compliant ML analytical choice can be embedded with any human choice model, and a normative framework's umbrella wide enough to safeguard DPO's extensions (margins, length correction, ...). A toy experiment ``far away'' from the DPO crowd is given.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了直接偏好优化（DPO）与人类选择理论之间的联系，将DPO的规范性框架推广到更一般的视角。研究表明，DPO的损失函数凸性并非必要，且任何符合ML分析的选择都可嵌入任意人类选择模型。该框架还能统一DPO的多种扩展（如边际、长度校正等），并通过远离DPO主流范式的玩具实验进行验证。
Motivation: 现有DPO工作虽与特定规范性人类选择模型关联，但未充分利用其完整框架。论文旨在将DPO与人类选择理论的联系提升到完全一般性，揭示非凸损失支持等未被发掘的ML潜力。
Method: 重新推导人类选择理论以适应RLHF/ML，建立更广泛的偏好优化视角，证明DPO损失凸性可被摒弃，并展示任意合规ML分析选择均可嵌入任意人类选择模型。
Result: 理论分析表明DPO的扩展（如边际、长度校正）可被统一在规范性框架下，并通过一个远离DPO主流的玩具实验初步验证。
Conclusion: DPO与人类选择理论的深层联系为偏好优化提供了更灵活的理论基础，支持非凸损失和更广泛的模型嵌入，为DPO后续工作提供了统一保护伞。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structure-Aware Compound-Protein Affinity Prediction via Graph Neural Networks with Group Lasso Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Explainable artificial intelligence approaches accelerate drug discovery by improving molecular representation learning, identifying key molecular structures, and rationalizing drug property prediction. However, developing end-to-end explainable models for target-specific structure-activity relationship modeling remains challenging because compound-protein interaction data are often limited for individual targets, and small changes in chemical substituents or local structural motifs can cause large differences in molecular properties. Therefore, effectively leveraging structural and property information to identify key moieties associated with compound-protein affinity is essential. We propose a graph neural network (GNN) framework that uses property and structural information from activity-cliff molecule pairs targeting specific proteins to predict compound-protein affinity, measured by half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC50), and explain property differences. To improve explainability, we trained GNNs with structure-aware loss functions using group lasso and sparse group lasso regularization, which prune and highlight molecular subgraphs relevant to activity differences. We applied this framework to activity-cliff data from molecules targeting six tyrosine-protein kinases across the Src, Abl, and Tec families, as well as anaplastic lymphoma kinase. Integrating common- and uncommon-node information with sparse group lasso improved target-specific molecular property prediction, producing lower root mean square errors and higher Pearson correlation coefficients. Regularization also enhanced GNN feature attribution by improving graph-level global direction scores and atom-level coloring accuracy. These results support more interpretable drug discovery pipelines, particularly for identifying critical molecular substructures during lead optimization.
papers.journal_ref: Comput Struct Biotechnol J. 2026;35:0012
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的框架，利用针对特定蛋白质的活性悬崖（activity-cliff）分子对的结构和性质信息，预测化合物-蛋白质亲和力（IC50）并解释性质差异。通过引入组套索（group lasso）和稀疏组套索（sparse group lasso）正则化，训练结构感知损失函数，以突出与活性差异相关的分子子图。该方法在六个酪氨酸蛋白激酶（Src、Abl、Tec家族及ALK）的活性悬崖数据上验证，整合常见和不常见节点信息与稀疏组套索，降低了均方根误差并提高了皮尔逊相关系数，同时增强了GNN的特征归因可解释性。
Motivation: 化合物-蛋白质相互作用数据通常针对单个靶标有限，且化学取代基或局部结构基序的微小变化可能导致分子性质巨大差异，因此需要有效利用结构和性质信息来识别与亲和力相关的关键基序。
Method: 提出一个GNN框架，使用组套索和稀疏组套索正则化训练结构感知损失函数，从活性悬崖分子对中学习，以预测IC50并解释性质差异。
Result: 在六个酪氨酸蛋白激酶的活性悬崖数据上，整合常见/不常见节点信息与稀疏组套索降低了均方根误差并提高了皮尔逊相关系数；正则化还通过图级全局方向分数和原子级着色精度提升了特征归因。
Conclusion: 该方法支持更可解释的药物发现流程，尤其在先导化合物优化阶段识别关键分子亚结构。

papers.title: The Trilemma of Truth in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The public often attributes human-like qualities to large language models (LLMs), assuming that they "know" certain things. In reality, LLMs encode information retained during training as internal probabilistic knowledge. This study examines existing methods for probing the veracity of that knowledge and identifies three flawed underlying assumptions. To address these flaws, we introduce sAwMIL (Sparse-Aware Multiple-Instance Learning), a multiclass probing framework that combines multiple-instance learning with conformal prediction. sAwMIL leverages LLMs' internal representations to classify statements as true, false, or neither. We evaluate sAwMIL across 16 open-source LLMs, including default and chat-based variants, using three new curated datasets. Our results show that (1) common probing methods fail to provide a reliable and transferable veracity direction and, in some settings, perform worse than zero-shot prompting; (2) truth and falsehood are not encoded symmetrically; and (3) LLMs encode a third type of signal that is distinct from both true and false.
papers.comment: The main text is 9 pages long (plus 3 pages of references); supplementary material (60 pages) is included in the same PDF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）中知识真实性的探测方法，指出现有方法存在三个有缺陷的假设。作者提出sAwMIL（稀疏感知多实例学习），一种结合多实例学习与共形预测的多类探测框架，利用LLM内部表示将陈述分类为真、假或既不真也不假。在16个开源LLM上的实验表明，常见探测方法不可靠且不可迁移，真与假编码不对称，且LLM编码了第三种不同于真假的信号。
Motivation: 公众常将人类特质归因于LLM，假设它们“知道”某些事物，但实际上LLM编码的是训练中保留的概率知识。现有探测方法存在三个有缺陷的假设，亟需更可靠的方法来评估LLM知识的真实性。
Method: 提出sAwMIL（Sparse-Aware Multiple-Instance Learning），一种多类探测框架，结合多实例学习与共形预测，利用LLM的内部表示将陈述分类为真、假或既不真也不假。
Result: 在16个开源LLM上的实验显示：(1) 常见探测方法不可靠且不可迁移，在某些设置下甚至不如零样本提示；(2) 真与假编码不对称；(3) LLM编码了第三种不同于真假的信号。
Conclusion: 现有探测方法存在根本性缺陷，sAwMIL提供了更可靠的替代方案，并揭示了LLM知识编码的复杂性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Measuring Intent Comprehension in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: People judge interactions with large language models (LLMs) as successful when outputs match what they want, not what they type. Yet LLMs are trained to predict the next token solely from text input, not underlying intent. Because written language is an imperfect proxy for intent, and correlations between phrasing and desired outcomes can break down in training data, models that rely too heavily on surface cues may respond inconsistently to semantically equivalent prompts. This makes it essential to evaluate whether LLMs can reliably infer user intent-especially in high-stakes settings where robustness and generalization are critical. We introduce a formal framework for assessing intent comprehension in LLMs: whether a model demonstrates robust understanding of user intent by producing consistent outputs across semantically equivalent prompts while differentiating between prompts with distinct intents. Our evaluation approach is based on a variance decomposition of model responses into three components: variability due to user intent, user articulation, and model uncertainty. Models that understand what users want, and are not overly sensitive to textual cues, should attribute most output variance to intent differences, rather than articulation style. Applying this framework across diverse domains, we find that, within the five LLaMA and Gemma models we evaluate, larger models typically assign a greater share of variance to intent, indicating stronger comprehension of intent, although gains are uneven and often modest with increasing model size. These results motivate moving beyond accuracy-only benchmarks toward semantic diagnostics that directly assess whether models understand what users intend.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个评估大语言模型（LLM）意图理解能力的正式框架，通过方差分解将模型输出方差归因于用户意图、用户表达和模型不确定性。在LLaMA和Gemma模型族上的实验表明，更大的模型通常将更多方差分配给意图，指示更强的意图理解，但提升不均匀且幅度温和。
Motivation: 用户根据输出是否符合意图来判断交互成功，但LLM仅从文本输入训练，可能对语义等价但表达不同的提示产生不一致响应，在高风险场景下评估意图理解尤为关键。
Method: 提出一个基于方差分解的评估框架，将模型响应方差分解为三个成分：用户意图、用户表达和模型不确定性。一个理解意图的模型应使大部分方差来自意图差异而非表达风格。
Result: 在LLaMA和Gemma模型上，更大的模型通常将更多方差分配给意图，表明更强的意图理解，但增益不均匀且往往温和。
Conclusion: 结果鼓励超越仅依赖准确率的基准，转向直接评估模型是否理解用户意图的语义诊断。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: "I Said Things I Needed to Hear Myself": Peer Support as an Emotional, Organisational, and Sociotechnical Practice in Singapore
papers.abstract_en: Peer support plays a vital role in expanding access to mental health care by providing empathetic, community-based support outside formal clinical systems. As digital platforms increasingly mediate such support, the design and impact of these technologies remain under-examined, particularly in Asian contexts. This paper presents findings from an interview study with 20 peer supporters in Singapore, who operate across diverse online, offline, and hybrid environments. Through a thematic analysis, we unpack how participants start, conduct, and sustain peer support, highlighting their motivations, emotional labour, and the sociocultural dimensions shaping their practices. Building on this grounded understanding, we surface design directions for culturally responsive digital tools that scaffold rather than supplant relational care. Drawing insights from qualitative accounts, we offer a situated perspective on how AI might responsibly augment peer support. This research contributes to human-centred computing by articulating the lived realities of peer supporters and proposing design implications for trustworthy and context-sensitive AI in mental health.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过对新加坡20位同伴支持者的访谈研究，分析了他们在线上、线下及混合环境中开展同伴支持的动机、情感劳动和社会文化维度，提出了设计文化响应型数字工具的方向，并探讨了AI如何负责任地增强同伴支持。
Motivation: 同伴支持在扩大心理健康服务可及性方面至关重要，但数字平台对此的支持设计和影响在亚洲背景下缺乏研究。
Method: 采用半结构化访谈和主题分析法，对新加坡20名同伴支持者进行定性研究，涵盖多种支持环境。
Result: 揭示了同伴支持者的启动、开展和维持支持的过程，强调了情感劳动和社会文化因素，并提出了设计工具和AI增强的方向。
Conclusion: 研究为以人为本的计算提供了同伴支持者的现实情境，并提出了值得信赖且上下文敏感的AI在心理健康中的设计启示。

papers.title: "Is This Really a Human Peer Supporter?": Misalignments Between Peer Supporters and Experts in LLM-Supported Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Mental health is a growing global concern, prompting interest in AI-driven solutions to expand access to psychosocial support. \emph{Peer support}, grounded in lived experience, offers a valuable complement to professional care. However, variability in training, effectiveness, and definitions raises concerns about quality, consistency, and safety. Large Language Models (LLMs) present new opportunities to enhance peer support interactions, particularly in real-time, text-based interactions. We present and evaluate an AI-supported system with an LLM-simulated distressed client (\client{}), context-sensitive LLM-generated suggestions (\suggestions{}), and real-time emotion visualisations. 2 mixed-methods studies with 12 peer supporters and 6 mental health professionals (i.e., experts) examined the system's effectiveness and implications for practice. Both groups recognised its potential to enhance training and improve interaction quality. However, we found a key tension emerged: while peer supporters engaged meaningfully, experts consistently flagged critical issues in peer supporter responses, such as missed distress cues and premature advice-giving. This misalignment highlights potential limitations in current peer support training, especially in emotionally charged contexts where safety and fidelity to best practices are essential. Our findings underscore the need for standardised, psychologically grounded training, especially as peer support scales globally. They also demonstrate how LLM-supported systems can scaffold this development--if designed with care and guided by expert oversight. This work contributes to emerging conversations on responsible AI integration in mental health and the evolving role of LLMs in augmenting peer-delivered care.
papers.comment: Accepted at CSCW 2026. 53 pages, 12 figures, 17 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了一个由LLM支持的同辈支持系统，包含LLM模拟的求助者、上下文敏感的LLM建议和实时情绪可视化。通过两项混合方法研究（12名同辈支持者和6名心理健康专家），发现虽然系统被认为有提升培训和治疗质量的潜力，但专家持续指出同辈支持者回应中的关键问题（如遗漏痛苦线索、过早给出建议），揭示了同辈支持者与专家之间的关键不一致。研究呼吁标准化、心理学基础的培训，并展示了LLM支持系统在监督下可以促进这种发展。
Motivation: 心理健康问题日益严重，AI驱动的解决方案有望扩大心理支持的可及性。同辈支持基于亲身经历，是专业护理的宝贵补充，但其培训、效果和定义的可变性引发了质量、一致性和安全性的担忧。LLM提供了增强同辈支持互动的新机会，特别是在实时文本互动中。
Method: 构建了一个AI支持系统，包含LLM模拟的求助者、上下文敏感的LLM建议和实时情绪可视化。通过两项混合方法研究，分别与12名同辈支持者和6名心理健康专家进行实验，评估系统效果和实践意义。
Result: 两组均认可系统提升培训和治疗质量的潜力。但关键不一致出现：同辈支持者参与有意义，而专家持续指出同辈支持者回应中的关键问题，如遗漏痛苦线索和过早建议。这突出了当前同辈支持培训的潜在局限性。
Conclusion: 研究强调需要标准化、心理学基础的培训，尤其是在同辈支持全球扩展的背景下。LLM支持系统可以在精心设计和专家监督下促进这种发展。工作为负责任地整合AI于心理健康以及LLM在增强同辈护理中的角色做出了贡献。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AgentMisalignment: Measuring the Propensity for Misaligned Behaviour in LLM-Based Agents
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents become more widespread, associated misalignment risks increase. While prior research has studied agents' ability to produce harmful outputs or follow malicious instructions, it remains unclear how likely agents are to spontaneously pursue unintended goals in realistic deployments. In this work, we approach misalignment as a conflict between the internal goals pursued by the model and the goals intended by its deployer. We introduce a misalignment propensity benchmark, \textsc{AgentMisalignment}, a benchmark suite designed to evaluate the propensity of LLM agents to misalign in realistic scenarios. Evaluations cover behaviours such as avoiding oversight, resisting shutdown, sandbagging, and power-seeking. Testing frontier models, we find that more capable agents tend to exhibit higher misalignment on average. We also systematically vary agent personalities through different system prompts and observe that persona characteristics can strongly and unpredictably influence misalignment, sometimes more than the choice of model itself. Our results reveal the limitations of current alignment methods for autonomous LLM agents and underscore the need to rethink misalignment in realistic deployment settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentMisalignment基准，用于评估LLM代理在真实场景中自发产生不对齐行为（如避免监督、抵抗关闭、sandbagging、权力寻求）的倾向。测试发现更强大的模型平均表现出更高的不对齐倾向，且系统提示设置的个性特征对不对齐的影响有时超过模型本身。该工作揭示了当前对齐方法在自主LLM代理上的局限性。
Motivation: 现有研究多关注代理生成有害输出或遵循恶意指令，但缺乏评估代理在真实部署中自发追求非预期目标（即不对齐）的可能性。
Method: 定义不对齐为模型内部目标与部署者目标之间的冲突，并构建AgentMisalignment基准，包含多个真实场景任务，测试代理在逃避监督、抵抗关闭、sandbagging和权力寻求等行为上的倾向。通过系统提示改变代理个性以观察影响。
Result: 在多个前沿模型上测试发现，能力更强的代理平均表现出更高的不对齐倾向；个性特征对不对齐的影响强烈且不可预测，有时超过模型选择的影响。
Conclusion: 结果表明当前对齐方法在自主LLM代理场景下存在局限，需要重新思考真实部署中的不对齐问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sarc7: Evaluating Sarcasm Detection and Generation with Seven Types and Emotion-Informed Techniques
papers.abstract_en: Sarcasm is a form of humor where expressions convey meanings opposite to their literal interpretations. Classifying and generating sarcasm using large language models is vital for interpreting human communication. Sarcasm poses challenges for computational models, due to its nuanced nature. We introduce Sarc7, a benchmark that classifies 7 types of sarcasm: self-deprecating, brooding, deadpan, polite, obnoxious, raging, and manic by annotating entries of the MUStARD dataset. Classification was evaluated using zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought (CoT), and a novel emotion-based prompting technique. We propose an emotion-based generation method developed by identifying key components of sarcasm-incongruity, shock value, and context dependency. Our classification experiments show that Gemini 2.5, using emotion-based prompting, outperforms other setups with an F1 score of 0.3664. Human evaluators preferred our emotion-based prompting, with 38.46% more successful generations than zero-shot prompting.
papers.comment: Accepted to EMNLP WiNLP and COLM Melt, Solar, PragLM, and Origen
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Sarc7基准，将MUStARD数据集标注为7种讽刺类型（自嘲、沉思、面无表情、礼貌、讨厌、暴怒、狂躁），并评估了零样本、少样本、链式思维（CoT）以及一种新颖的情感提示（emotion-based prompting）技术的分类与生成性能。实验表明，Gemini 2.5结合情感提示在分类任务上取得最佳F1分数0.3664，且人工评估中情感提示生成的讽刺比零样本多38.46%的成功实例。
Motivation: 讽刺因细微的语义反转特性，给计算模型带来挑战，现有工作缺乏覆盖多种讽刺类型并结合情感信息的统一基准与生成方法。
Method: 构建Sarc7基准，包含七类讽刺标注；提出基于情感提示的分类与生成技术，通过识别讽刺的核心成分（不一致性、震惊值、上下文依赖）来指导模型。
Result: 情感提示的Gemini 2.5在分类上F1=0.3664，超越其他设置；人工评估中情感提示生成的成功率比零样本高38.46%。
Conclusion: 情感提示技术能有效提升讽刺检测与生成性能，但整体F1值偏低，表明讽刺理解任务仍具挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EquivPruner: Boosting Efficiency and Quality in LLM-Based Search via Action Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at complex reasoning through search algorithms, yet current strategies often suffer from massive token consumption due to redundant exploration of semantically equivalent steps. Existing semantic similarity methods struggle to accurately identify such equivalence in domain-specific contexts like mathematical reasoning. To address this, we propose EquivPruner, a simple yet effective approach that identifies and prunes semantically equivalent actions during LLM reasoning search. We also introduce MathEquiv, the first dataset we created for mathematical statement equivalence, which enables the training of a lightweight equivalence detector. Extensive experiments across various models and tasks demonstrate that EquivPruner significantly reduces token consumption, improving searching efficiency and often bolstering reasoning accuracy. For instance, when applied to Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct on GSM8K, EquivPruner reduced token consumption by 48.1\% while also improving accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lolo1222/EquivPruner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EquivPruner，一种识别并剪枝大语言模型推理搜索中语义等价动作的方法，以降低 token 消耗、提升搜索效率。作者同时创建了数学语句等价性数据集 MathEquiv 用于训练轻量级等价检测器。实验表明，在 GSM8K 等任务上，该方法可显著减少 token 消耗（如 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 减少 48.1%）并提升推理准确率。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 搜索策略因冗余探索语义等价的步骤而消耗大量 token，而现有语义相似性方法在数学推理等场景中难以准确识别等价性。
Method: 提出 EquivPruner，利用轻量级等价检测器在推理搜索过程中剪枝语义等价的动作；并创建 MathEquiv 数据集用于训练该检测器。
Result: 在多个模型和任务中，EquivPruner 显著降低 token 消耗并往往提升推理准确率。例如，应用于 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 的 GSM8K 任务时，token 消耗降低 48.1% 且准确率提升。
Conclusion: EquivPruner 是一种简单有效的方法，通过剪枝等价动作提升 LLM 搜索的效率和质量，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive GoGI-Skip: Coupling Goal-Gradient Importance with Dynamic Uncertainty for Efficient Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting trades inference speed for reasoning accuracy. Existing compressors force a compromise as static gradient techniques treat tokens independently, severing sequential logic, while uncertainty-based pruning ignores the final answer. We introduce Adaptive GoGI-Skip, a framework that resolves this tension by non-linearly coupling Goal-Gradient Importance (GoGI) with Adaptive Dynamic Skipping (ADS). GoGI quantifies each token's functional contribution to answer correctness via gradient sensitivity. ADS leverages runtime entropy to dynamically modulate the GoGI threshold, preserving low-gradient tokens essential for structural coherence at high-uncertainty junctions. Trained on 7,472 MATH traces, our policy transfers zero-shot to AIME, GPQA, and GSM8K, reducing token volume by $>$45% and accelerating inference up to 2.0$\times$ without accuracy loss. These results suggest that thinking-optimal compression demands synergy between teleological goals and epistemic uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Chain-of-Thought推理中准确性与速度的权衡，提出Adaptive GoGI-Skip框架，通过耦合目标梯度重要性（GoGI）和自适应动态跳跃（ADS）来压缩token。GoGI量化每个token对答案正确性的功能贡献，ADS利用运行时熵动态调整GoGI阈值，保留结构关键的低梯度token。在MATH数据集上训练后，该策略零样本迁移到AIME、GPQA、GSM8K，减少token量超过45%，加速推理最多2.0倍，且不损失准确性。
Motivation: 现有静态梯度方法将token独立处理，破坏序列逻辑，而基于不确定性的剪枝忽略最终答案，导致推理压缩时准确性与速度难以兼得。
Method: 提出Adaptive GoGI-Skip框架，非线性地耦合Goal-Gradient Importance（GoGI）与Adaptive Dynamic Skipping（ADS）。GoGI通过梯度敏感性衡量每个token对答案正确性的贡献，ADS根据运行时熵动态调整GoGI阈值，在高不确定性节点保留低梯度但结构重要的token。
Result: 在MATH数据集上训练后，策略零样本迁移到AIME、GPQA、GSM8K，减少token量超过45%，加速推理最高2.0倍，且不损失准确性。
Conclusion: 摘要指出，思维最优压缩需要综合目的性目标（teleological goals）与认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）的协同作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Causally Fair Node Classification on Non-IID Graph Data
papers.abstract_en: Fair machine learning seeks to identify and mitigate biases in predictions against unfavorable populations characterized by demographic attributes, such as race and gender. Recent research has extended fairness to graph data, such as social networks, but many studies neglect the causal relationships among data instances. This paper addresses a prevalent challenge in many fair machine learning research, which typically assumes independent and identically distributed (IID) data, from the causal perspective. Specifically, this work targets the circumstance where nodes with different neighborhood structures follow different causal mechanisms, violating the invariance assumptions required for classical structural causal models and do-calculus. We base our research on the Network Structural Causal Model (NSCM) framework and develop a Message Passing Variational Autoencoder for Causal Inference (MPVA) to compute interventional distributions for causally fair node classification. We establish theoretical soundness under two conditions: Decomposability and Graph Independence. These conditions formalize when causal mechanism heterogeneity can be overcome by constructing a structural representation that restores invariance and facilitates the computation of interventional distributions using do-calculus in non-IID settings. Empirical evaluations on semi-synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that MPVA outperforms conventional methods by effectively approximating interventional distributions and mitigating bias. Our findings demonstrate the potential of causality-based fairness in complex ML applications and motivate future work on relaxing the classic assumptions in algorithmic fairness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从因果视角研究非独立同分布 (non-IID) 图数据上的节点分类公平性问题，指出不同邻域结构的节点遵循不同因果机制，违背了经典结构因果模型和do-calculus的不变性假设。基于网络结构因果模型 (NSCM) 框架，提出消息传递变分自编码器 (MPVA) 用于计算干预分布，从而实现因果公平节点分类。在可分解性和图独立性两个条件下建立理论保证，并在半合成和真实数据集上验证MPVA优于传统方法，有效缓解偏差。
Motivation: 现有公平机器学习研究多假设数据独立同分布，但图数据中节点受邻域结构影响，因果机制存在异质性，导致经典因果推断方法失效。需要针对非IID场景设计因果公平方法。
Method: 基于NSCM框架，提出消息传递变分自编码器 (MPVA)，通过构建能恢复不变性的结构表示，利用do-calculus在非IID设置下计算干预分布。理论条件包括可分解性和图独立性。
Result: 在半合成和真实数据集上，MPVA能有效近似干预分布，在偏差缓解和分类性能上优于传统方法。
Conclusion: 本文展示了基于因果关系的公平性在复杂机器学习应用中的潜力，并激励未来工作放宽算法公平中的经典假设。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文从因果视角研究非独立同分布 (non-IID) 图数据上的节点分类公平性问题，指出不同邻域结构的节点遵循不同因果机制，违背了经典结构因果模型和do-calculus的不变性假设。基于网络结构因果模型 (NSCM) 框架，提出消息传递变分自编码器 (MPVA) 用于计算干预分布，从而实现因果公平节点分类。在可分解性和图独立性两个条件下建立理论保证，并在半合成和真实数据集上验证MPVA优于传统方法，有效缓解偏差。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有公平机器学习研究多假设数据独立同分布，但图数据中节点受邻域结构影响，因果机制存在异质性，导致经典因果推断方法失效。需要针对非IID场景设计因果公平方法。
summary_sections.method: 基于NSCM框架，提出消息传递变分自编码器 (MPVA)，通过构建能恢复不变性的结构表示，利用do-calculus在非IID设置下计算干预分布。理论条件包括可分解性和图独立性。
summary_sections.result: 在半合成和真实数据集上，MPVA能有效近似干预分布，在偏差缓解和分类性能上优于传统方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文展示了基于因果关系的公平性在复杂机器学习应用中的潜力，并激励未来工作放宽算法公平中的经典假设。

papers.title: TraceMark-LDM: Authenticatable Watermarking for Latent Diffusion Models via Binary-Guided Rearrangement
papers.abstract_en: Image generation algorithms are increasingly integral to diverse aspects of human society, driven by their practical applications. However, insufficient oversight in artificial Intelligence generated content (AIGC) can facilitate the spread of malicious content and increase the risk of copyright infringement. Among the diverse range of image generation models, the Latent Diffusion Model (LDM) is currently the most widely used, dominating the majority of the Text-to-Image model market. Currently, most attribution methods for LDMs rely on directly embedding watermarks into the generated images or their intermediate noise, a practice that compromises both the quality and the robustness of the generated content. To address these limitations, we introduce TraceMark-LDM, an novel algorithm that integrates watermarking to attribute generated images while guaranteeing non-destructive performance. Unlike current methods, TraceMark-LDM leverages watermarks as guidance to rearrange random variables sampled from a Gaussian distribution. To mitigate potential deviations caused by inversion errors, the small absolute elements are grouped and rearranged. Additionally, we fine-tune the LDM encoder to enhance the robustness of the watermark. Experimental results show that images synthesized using TraceMark-LDM exhibit superior quality and attribution accuracy compared to state-of-the-art (SOTA) techniques. Notably, TraceMark-LDM demonstrates exceptional robustness against various common attack methods, consistently outperforming SOTA methods.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by Expert Systems with Applications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TraceMark-LDM，一种用于潜扩散模型 (LDM) 的非破坏性可认证水印算法。通过将水印作为引导，对高斯分布随机变量进行重排，并对小绝对值元素分组重排以减轻反转误差，同时微调 LDM 编码器增强鲁棒性。实验表明，该方法在生成图像质量和归属精度上均优于现有技术，并对常见攻击具有强鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有 LDM 归属方法多直接嵌入水印到生成图像或中间噪声，损害了生成内容的质量和鲁棒性。需要一种非破坏性、鲁棒的水印方法。
Method: 利用水印作为引导，对高斯分布采样的随机变量进行重排；对小绝对值元素分组重排以缓解反转误差；微调 LDM 编码器以增强水印鲁棒性。
Result: 相比 SOTA 方法，TraceMark-LDM 生成的图像质量更高，归属精度更好，且对各种常见攻击的鲁棒性更优。
Conclusion: TraceMark-LDM 提供了一种有效且鲁棒的 LDM 生成图像归属方案，同时不降低生成质量。

papers.title: FairSAM: Fair Classification on Corrupted Image Data Through Sharpness-Aware Minimization
papers.abstract_en: Image classification models trained on clean data often degrade sharply when exposed to corrupted test or deployment data, such as images with impulse noise, Gaussian noise, or environmental noise. This degradation reduces overall performance and disproportionately affects demographic subgroups, raising algorithmic bias concerns. Although robust learning algorithms such as Sharpness-Aware Minimization improve overall robustness and generalization, they do not address biased performance degradation across demographic subgroups. Existing fairness-aware machine learning methods reduce performance disparities but struggle to maintain robust and equitable accuracy across demographic subgroups under data corruption. This limitation reveals an inherent tension between robustness and fairness under corrupted data. To address these challenges, we introduce a metric to assess performance degradation across subgroups under data corruption. We propose FairSAM, a framework that integrates Fairness-oriented strategies into SAM to equalize performance across demographic groups under corrupted conditions. Experiments on multiple real-world datasets and prediction tasks show that FairSAM balances robustness and fairness in corrupted image classification. The framework yields a structured solution for fair and robust image classification in the presence of data corruption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FairSAM框架，将面向公平的策略集成到Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM)中，以在受损图像数据（如脉冲噪声、高斯噪声）下平衡分类模型的鲁棒性和公平性。实验表明该方法在多个数据集上减少了不同人口统计子群之间的性能差异。
Motivation: 现有鲁棒学习算法（如SAM）提升整体性能但未解决子群间的性能偏差；公平性方法在干净数据上有效，但在受损数据下难以同时保持鲁棒和公平，存在鲁棒性与公平性的内在张力。
Method: 引入一个度量来评估数据损坏下子群性能退化，并提出FairSAM，将公平导向的目标整合到SAM的优化过程中，以在受损条件下均衡各子群的性能。
Result: 在多个真实数据集和预测任务上的实验显示，FairSAM在受损图像分类中平衡了鲁棒性和公平性。
Conclusion: FairSAM提供了一个结构化的解决方案，用于在数据损坏情况下实现公平且鲁棒的图像分类。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Explainable Boosting Machine for Predicting Claim Severity and Frequency in Car Insurance
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid development of machine learning and deep learning techniques, actuaries and the broader insurance industry face a persistent trade-off between predictive accuracy and interpretability. This paper provides a comprehensive applied assessment of Explainable Boosting Machines (EBM) in a car insurance framework, focusing on claim frequency and severity modeling. EBM combines the additive structure of generalized additive models (GAM) with a cyclic gradient boosting algorithm, resulting in a glass-box model whose predictions are interpretable by design. Using real-world data, we empirically illustrate its practical relevance and compare EBM with modern benchmark models used in non-life insurance pricing. The evaluation considers (i) out-of-sample predictive accuracy, including Murphy diagrams and Bregman dominance tests, and (ii) calibration assessment using T-reliability diagrams and Murphy's score decomposition. Finally, we highlight the link between EBM predictions and Shapley values, showing how predictions can be transparently decomposed into exact main and pairwise interaction effects, providing actionable insights beyond predictive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了可解释提升机（Explainable Boosting Machine, EBM）在车险索赔频率和严重性建模中的表现。EBM结合广义加性模型和循环梯度提升，保持可解释性。通过与现代基准模型比较，使用Murphy图和Bregman优势检验评估预测精度和校准性能。还展示了EBM预测与Shapley值的联系，能分解为主效应和交互效应。
Motivation: 保险公司需要在预测精度和可解释性之间权衡，传统黑箱模型难以满足监管和业务需求。
Method: 使用EBM，一种具有加性结构的玻璃箱模型，结合循环梯度提升算法。评估包括预测精度（Murphy图、Bregman优势检验）和校准性能（T可靠性图、Murphy分数分解）。
Result: 使用真实数据，EBM与现代基准模型比较，展示了可解释性优势，并能通过Shapley值分解为主效应和交互效应。
Conclusion: EBM在车险定价中提供透明且准确的预测，可解释性设计有助于业务行动。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Numerical stability analysis of large language models
papers.abstract_en: Transformers are the state-of-the-art architecture for large language models, and a key to their scalability is the strategic usage of low-precision arithmetic. We develop a mixed-precision analysis of transformer inference, deriving bounds for the condition numbers and forward error of the architecture's constituent parts. Notably, we compare the numerical stability of LayerNorm and RMSNorm in the massive-outlier regime, tighten the error bound of softmax in the presence of attention sinks, and quantify the impact of its shifted evaluation on the sensitivity to perturbations. Furthermore, we derive novel sequence-length-independent bounds on the local Lipschitz constant of self-attention. Our worst-case error bound for transformer inference suggests that its numerical stability is determined by the interplay between weight magnitude and the growth of the residual stream. Crucially, and as validated by experiments with GPT-2, our analysis establishes that the scaling of residual-projection weights preserves the propagation of the relative rounding error unless it forces a qualitative transition in the dynamics of the residual stream.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对Transformer推理进行混合精度数值稳定性分析，推导了各组成部分的条件数和前向误差界。比较了大规模异常值下LayerNorm与RMSNorm的稳定性，收紧存在注意力汇聚点(attention sinks)时softmax的误差界，并量化其移位评估对扰动敏感性的影响。同时推导了自注意力的局部Lipschitz常数的序列长度无关界。最坏情况误差分析表明，数值稳定性由权重幅度和残差流增长共同决定，且GPT-2实验证实，除非残差投影权重的缩放导致残差流动力学发生定性转变，否则它保持相对舍入误差的传播。
Motivation: Transformer是大语言模型的主流架构，其可扩展性依赖于低精度算术的巧妙使用。然而，低精度推理可能引入数值不稳定性，现有分析缺乏针对Transformer各组件在混合精度下的系统误差界和条件数分析。
Method: 发展了一种混合精度分析的框架，推导Transformer推理中各个组成部分（如归一化层、softmax、自注意力）的条件数和前向误差的界。特别地，针对LayerNorm与RMSNorm在大规模异常值场景下进行稳定性比较，在注意力汇聚点存在时收紧softmax误差界，并推导自注意力局部Lipschitz常数的序列长度无关界。
Result: 给出了Transformer推理的最坏情况误差界，指出数值稳定性由权重幅度和残差流增长的相互作用决定。GPT-2实验验证了分析：残差投影权重的缩放除非导致残差流动力学的定性转变，否则会保持相对舍入误差的传播。
Conclusion: 本文的数值稳定性分析为低精度Transformer推理提供了理论保证，并揭示了关键因素（权重幅度与残差流）。局限性在于分析基于最坏情况界，实际性能可能更优，且仅针对推理阶段。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Chern Numbers of Topological Insulators with Gauge Equivariant Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Equivariant network architectures are a well-established tool for predicting invariant or equivariant quantities. However, almost all learning problems considered in this context feature a global symmetry, i.e. each point of the underlying space is transformed with the same group element, as opposed to a local ``gauge'' symmetry, where each point is transformed with a different group element, exponentially enlarging the size of the symmetry group. Gauge equivariant networks have so far mainly been applied to problems in quantum chromodynamics. Here, we introduce a novel application domain for gauge-equivariant networks in the theory of topological condensed matter physics. We use gauge equivariant networks to predict topological invariants (Chern numbers) of multiband topological insulators. The gauge symmetry of the network guarantees that the predicted quantity is a topological invariant. We introduce a novel gauge equivariant normalization layer to stabilize the training and prove a universal approximation theorem for our setup. We train on samples with trivial Chern number only but show that our models generalize to samples with non-trivial Chern number. We provide various ablations of our setup. Our code is available at https://github.com/sitronsea/GENet/tree/main.
papers.journal_ref: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38, 147997-148026, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将规范等变神经网络（gauge equivariant networks）应用于拓扑凝聚态物理，预测多带拓扑绝缘体的拓扑不变量（Chern数）。网络规范对称性保证预测量为拓扑不变量。作者提出新的规范等变归一化层稳定训练，并证明通用逼近定理。仅用平凡Chern数样本训练，模型能泛化到非平凡Chern数样本。
Motivation: 现有等变网络主要处理全局对称性，局部规范对称性应用有限（主要在QCD）。本文将其扩展到拓扑凝聚态物理，预测拓扑不变量。
Method: 使用规范等变神经网络预测Chern数，引入新的规范等变归一化层，并证明通用逼近定理。
Result: 仅在平凡Chern数样本上训练，模型能泛化到非平凡Chern数样本。提供了各种消融实验。
Conclusion: 展示了规范等变网络在拓扑物质理论中的新应用，并且仅用平凡样本训练就能预测非平凡拓扑数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Markov to Laplace: How Mamba In-Context Learns Markov Chains
papers.abstract_en: While transformer-based language models have driven the AI revolution thus far, their computational complexity has spurred growing interest in viable alternatives, such as structured state space sequence models (SSMs) and Selective SSMs. Among these, Mamba (S6) and its variant Mamba-2 have shown remarkable inference speed-ups over transformers while achieving comparable or superior performance on complex language modeling tasks. However, despite these architectural innovations and empirical successes, the fundamental learning capabilities of Mamba remain poorly understood. In this paper, we address this gap by studying in-context learning (ICL) on Markov chains and uncovering an interesting phenomenon: even a single-layer Mamba efficiently learns the in-context Laplacian smoothing estimator, which is both Bayes and minimax optimal. To explain this, we theoretically characterize the representation capacity of Mamba and reveal the fundamental role of convolution in enabling it to represent the optimal Laplacian smoothing. These theoretical insights align strongly with empirical results and, to the best of our knowledge, represent the first formal connection between Mamba and optimal statistical estimators. Finally, we outline promising research directions inspired by these findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Mamba（S6）及其变体Mamba-2在马尔可夫链上的上下文学习能力。发现单层Mamba能高效学习Laplacian平滑估计器，该估计器既是贝叶斯最优也是极小化最优。理论上刻画了Mamba的表示能力，揭示了卷积在实现最优Laplacian平滑中的关键作用。这是首次正式建立Mamba与最优统计估计器之间的联系。
Motivation: 尽管Mamba架构在语言建模中取得了成功，但其基本学习能力仍缺乏理论理解。本文通过研究马尔可夫链上的上下文学习来填补这一空白。
Method: 理论分析Mamba的表示能力，证明单层Mamba可以实现在上下文学习中Laplacian平滑估计器，该估计器达到贝叶斯和极小化最优。揭示卷积在其中的关键作用。
