papers.title: RAVEN: Agentic RAG for Automated Vulnerability Repair
papers.abstract_en: Automated vulnerability repair has emerged as a promising direction to mitigate the growing number of software vulnerabilities. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have further accelerated research in automated repair. However, existing frameworks remain largely restricted to memory-related vulnerabilities and locally repairable vulnerability settings, leaving generalization to unseen vulnerability types underexplored. Their evaluations are often limited to a single programming language, and largely rely on proprietary models. In this paper, we propose RAVEN, a scalable, efficient and autonomous framework that integrates an agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline with controlled iterative repair in a unified framework. The framework utilizes open-source LLMs in a fully locally deployable setting with limited GPU requirements, while building a multi-faceted retrieval pipeline to retrieve historically relevant vulnerability fixes and guide the patch generation. In addition, RAVEN introduces a dedicated Curator Agent that retrieves cross-file dependencies from the target repository, to fix complex vulnerabilities that cannot be addressed using local vulnerable code alone. We evaluate RAVEN on 160 real-world CVE vulnerabilities across diverse vulnerability types, two programming languages, unseen CWE categories, and out-of-distribution settings. RAVEN achieves an overall repair success rate of 83.13%, outperforming all existing state-of-the-art repair frameworks, while also demonstrating strong generalization capabilities and maintaining the repair cost negligible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RAVEN，一个基于智能体检索增强生成（agentic RAG）的自动漏洞修复框架，使用开源LLM在本地部署，通过多面检索和Curator Agent实现跨文件依赖修复。在160个真实CVE漏洞上，RAVEN达到83.13%的修复成功率，超越现有SOTA框架，并展现出强泛化能力和极低修复成本。
Motivation: 现有自动漏洞修复框架主要局限于内存相关漏洞和单语言修复，泛化性不足，且多依赖专有模型，缺乏对复杂跨文件漏洞的修复能力。
Method: 集成智能体RAG流水线与可控迭代修复，利用开源LLM在本地GPU受限环境下部署；构建多面检索管道获取历史漏洞修复，并引入Curator Agent检索目标仓库中的跨文件依赖以修复复杂漏洞。
Result: 在160个真实CVE漏洞（涵盖多种类型、两种编程语言、未见CWE类别及分布外设置）上，修复成功率达83.13%，优于现有所有SOTA框架，同时保持修复成本接近于零。
Conclusion: RAVEN证明了在多样化漏洞类型和语言上自动修复的可行性与高效性，强泛化能力和低成本使其适用于实际部署。

papers.title: Statistical Inference for Misspecified Contextual Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Contextual bandit algorithms have transformed modern experimentation by enabling real-time adaptation for personalized treatment. Yet these advantages create challenges for statistical inference due to adaptivity. We study inference with contextual-bandit data without assuming a well-specified outcome model. In this setting, we show a previously overlooked issue: standard algorithms such as LinUCB may fail to stabilize under misspecified working models, leading to non-Gaussian estimator behavior and invalid inference. This issue is practically important, as misspecified working models -- such as approximations of complex dynamical systems -- are often employed by online agents in real-world adaptive experiments to balance reward, computational tractability, and robustness. We develop an inverse-probability-weighted Z-estimation framework for a broad class of marginal moment targets, including projection parameters, structural parameters with noisy contexts, and off-policy values. We identify a stability condition tailored to this framework, scaled inverse-propensity convergence, under which the IPW-Z estimator is consistent and asymptotically normal with a consistent sandwich variance estimator. We further establish sufficient conditions for scaled inverse-propensity convergence for several policy classes, including multi-armed bandit algorithms and smooth contextual allocation policies. Simulations and a HeartSteps V1 real-data-calibrated application show reliable coverage and competitive performance across multiple targets. Overall, our results highlight the importance of stability-aware adaptive design for valid post-experiment inference.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在模型误设（misspecified）的情境中，从上下文老虎机（contextual bandit）数据中进行统计推断的问题。作者发现标准算法（如LinUCB）在误设工作模型下可能无法稳定，导致估计量非高斯和推断无效。为此提出了一个逆概率加权Z-估计（IPW-Z）框架，并引入了一个稳定性条件（scaled inverse-propensity convergence），在该条件下估计量一致且渐近正态，同时给出稳健的方差估计。模拟实验和基于HeartSteps V1真实数据的校准应用展示了可靠的覆盖率和竞争力。
Motivation: 上下文老虎机算法在个性化实验中具有优势，但其适应性给统计推断带来挑战。现有方法常假设模型正确设定（well-specified），而实际中工作模型（如复杂动力系统的近似）往往被误设，导致标准算法（如LinUCB）不稳定，估计量行为非高斯且推断无效。
Method: 开发了逆概率加权Z-估计（IPW-Z）框架，适用于一类广泛的边际矩目标，包括投影参数、带噪声上下文的结构参数和off-policy值。提出了稳定性条件——scaled inverse-propensity convergence，在该条件下IPW-Z估计量一致且渐近正态，并给出一致的sandwich方差估计量。进一步为多臂老虎机算法和平滑上下文分配策略建立了该稳定性条件的充分条件。
Result: 模拟实验和基于HeartSteps V1真实数据校准的应用显示，所提方法在多个目标上均实现了可靠的覆盖率并具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 研究强调了稳定性感知的自适应设计对于有效的实验后推断至关重要。

papers.title: Learning Entropy Signature for Image Representation and Classification
papers.abstract_en: Learning Entropy (LE) has recently been extended to image analysis through Spatial Learning Entropy Maps (SLEMs), which are two-dimensional LE distributions that highlight unusually high learning activity across an image. Unlike conventional image descriptors, SLEMs are generated by incremental, sample-wise learning of a pretrained feedforward MLP network, where local pixel neighborhoods are presented sequentially in a fixed spatial order to predict the corresponding central pixels. Consequently, the learning activity at each image location depends not only on its local structure but also on the knowledge acquired from previously processed locations. This paper introduces Learning Entropy Signatures (LES), an image descriptor derived from SLEM using the K largest LE locations. LES captures the spatial organization of learning-relevant image structures and provides a compact representation of image content based on learning weight behavior. Experimental evaluation on image classification tasks shows that a relatively small number of K largest LE locations preserve substantial discriminative information. The results indicate a close relationship between the learning of neural weights and information relevance, extending the role of Learning Entropy from time series to images and, within images, from structural point extraction to compact image representation and classification.

TL;DR: 本文提出 Learning Entropy Signatures (LES)，一种基于 Spatial Learning Entropy Maps (SLEM) 的图像描述子，通过提取 K 个最大学习熵位置来紧凑表示图像内容。实验表明少量最大学习熵位置即可保留判别信息，证明学习熵从时间序列扩展到图像，并可用于图像分类。

papers.title: Confident but Conflicted: Internal Uncertainty and Cognitive Dissonance Resolution in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) frequently encounter inputs that disagree with their prior outputs, through user pushback, retrieved documents, or web search results. While the way they resolve such conflicts -- a process we frame as cognitive dissonance resolution -- has been characterized behaviorally, its connection to internal model uncertainty is not well understood. To study this systematically, we vary persuasion attempts along two dimensions, source authority and evidence quality, across 12 health-science claims of stratified epistemic status. Dissonance can be resolved through persuasion, backfire, or immunity. We introduce Trust Elasticity (TE), an econometrics-inspired measure of how readily a model is persuaded toward conflicting evidence. Across four LLMs, TE varies substantially, while clearly false claims elicit near-zero TE across all models. On two open-weight models, we further find that this variation is associated with two complementary internal uncertainty indicators, Confidence Miscalibration in Qwen and Internal Uncertainty Change in Llama. These results link cross-model behavioral variation to a measurable internal property and point to interventions targeting internal uncertainty as future work.

TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLMs）在面对与先前输出相矛盾的新信息时如何解决认知失调，引入信任弹性（TE）指标衡量模型被说服的倾向，并发现模型间的行为差异与内部不确定性指标相关。
Motivation: 虽然已有行为学研究描述了LLMs如何解决冲突，但其与模型内部不确定性的关系尚不明确。
Method: 通过改变说服尝试的源权威性和证据质量两个维度，在12个健康科学主张上研究认知失调的解决方式；引入经济计量学启发的信任弹性（TE）指标；探索内部不确定性指标（如信心校准错误和内部不确定性变化）与TE的关联。
Result: 四个LLM的TE差异显著，明显虚假的主张在所有模型上TE接近零；两个开放权重模型上，TE的变化与信心校准错误（Qwen）和内部不确定性变化（Llama）相关。
Conclusion: 跨模型的行为变异可关联到可测量的内部属性，未来的工作可针对内部不确定性进行干预。

papers.title: 4DVLT: Dynamic Scene Understanding with Worldline-Centered Vision-Language Tracking
papers.abstract_en: 4D dynamic scene understanding requires grounding language to a persistent worldline that binds identity, metric 3D motion, and synchronized multi-view 2D projections. Existing paradigms capture only part of this structure: large multimodal models reason over rich visual evidence but rarely preserve metric topology, while vision-language tracking remains tied to fragmented 2D or 3D outputs and local continuation. We therefore introduce \textbf{4DVLT}, a worldline-centered task for instruction-conditioned 4D dynamic scene understanding in fully observed multi-view video, and \textbf{Instruct-4D}, a benchmark with 129.4K question-answer pairs, 64.7K target entities, 851 scenes, and 9 reasoning-oriented query types. To address this setting, we present \textbf{4DTrack}, which casts instruction-conditioned tracking as graph-conditioned worldline inference through an object-centric 4D state graph, metric-guided routing, bidirectional decoding, and kinematic calibration. On Instruct-4D, 4DTrack-Qwen3.5-9B reaches 62.68 $\mathrm{TGA}_{\mathrm{Top1}}$ and surpasses the best adapted VLT baseline by 19.62 points. These results show that worldline-centered modeling improves both target grounding and recovered worldline quality. The project page is available at https://github.com/mikubaka88/4DVLT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出4DVLT，一个以世界线为中心的4D动态场景理解任务，并构建了Instruct-4D基准，包含129.4K问答对、64.7K目标实体、851个场景和9种推理查询类型。作者提出4DTrack方法，通过目标中心的4D状态图、度量引导路由、双向解码和运动学校准，实现指令条件下的世界线推理。在Instruct-4D上，4DTrack-Qwen3.5-9B达到62.68 TGA_Top1，比最优VLT基线高19.62点。
Motivation: 现有方法要么不保存度量拓扑，要么局限于2D/3D片段或局部延续，缺乏将语言与持续世界线结合的能力。
Method: 将指令条件跟踪转化为图条件世界线推理，通过目标中心的4D状态图、度量引导路由、双向解码和运动学校准。
Result: 在Instruct-4D基准上，4DTrack-Qwen3.5-9B的TGA_Top1达到62.68，超过最佳VLT基线19.62点。
Conclusion: 世界线中心建模改进了目标定位和恢复的世界线质量。

papers.title: Scalable Maximum Entropy Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Policies via Adjoint Matching
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion policies have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for representing complex action distributions in reinforcement learning (RL). However, their application to online RL remains limited by the challenge of scalable training in the absence of ground-truth data, where standard optimization techniques such as score matching are not directly applicable. In this work, we introduce a highly efficient algorithm for optimizing diffusion policies by leveraging recent advances in stochastic optimal control. Our approach is based on adjoint matching, which enables simulation-free training and circumvents the need for explicit likelihood estimation or costly backpropagation through the diffusion process. Furthermore, we propose several extensions that improve the robustness and stability of the method in practical settings. Empirical results demonstrate that our approach achieves competitive performance while significantly reducing computational overhead, making diffusion policies more viable for online RL scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散策略在在线强化学习中训练困难的问题，提出基于伴随匹配（adjoint matching）的算法，实现无模拟训练，避免显式似然估计和昂贵反向传播，并引入多种改进增强鲁棒性和稳定性。实验表明该方法在降低计算开销的同时取得了竞争性性能。
Motivation: 扩散策略能表示复杂动作分布，但在在线强化学习中因缺乏真实数据，标准分数匹配等技术难以直接应用，训练可扩展性受限。
Method: 结合随机最优控制的最新进展，提出伴随匹配方法，实现免模拟（simulation-free）训练，通过伴随方程优化扩散策略，无需显式似然或反向传播。
Result: 实验证明该方法在降低计算开销的同时达到竞争性性能，使扩散策略在在线强化学习中更加可行。
Conclusion: 伴随匹配为扩散策略的在线强化学习提供了一种高效、可扩展的优化框架，未来可进一步探索扩展和实际应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Orthogonal Representation Editing: Decoupling Semantic Entanglement in Batch Knowledge Editing of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge editing aims to efficiently update factual information in Large Language Models (LLMs) without full retraining. However, existing methods still suffer from performance degradation in batch knowledge editing. We identify that semantic representation entanglement, such as overlapping concepts and shared syntactic patterns, accumulates interference in the representation space and reduces editing precision. To bridge this gap, in this paper, we propose Orthogonal Representation Editing (ORE), which performs edits in the hidden representation space of LLMs by constructing a general semantic subspace and enforcing orthogonal constraints on edit vectors, effectively decoupling semantic entanglement. Furthermore, we introduce a gated non-linear representation head to enable adaptive learning of editing locations and precise control over knowledge injection. Extensive experiments show that ORE outperforms existing methods and achieves superior performance in cross-lingual knowledge editing scenarios. We release our code at https://github.com/YVVH/ORE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出正交表示编辑（ORE）方法，通过构建通用语义子空间并施加正交约束，解耦LLM批量知识编辑中的语义纠缠问题，同时引入门控非线性表示头自适应学习编辑位置。实验表明ORE在跨语言知识编辑场景中优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有批量知识编辑方法因语义表示纠缠（如概念重叠、共享句法模式）导致编辑精度下降，需要一种有效解耦语义干扰的编辑方法。
Method: 在LLM隐藏表示空间中构建通用语义子空间，对编辑向量施加正交约束以解耦语义纠缠；加入门控非线性表示头，自适应学习编辑位置并精确控制知识注入。
Result: 实验表明ORE在批量知识编辑任务上优于现有方法，并在跨语言知识编辑场景中取得更优性能。
Conclusion: 正交约束和自适应编辑机制能有效提升LLM批量知识编辑的精度和跨语言泛化能力。

papers.title: DR-Mamba: Automatic Inference-Time Domain Adaptation for Document Image Binarization via Sample-Conditioned Detail-Background Suppression
papers.abstract_en: Degraded document image binarization is sensitive to domain shifts caused by paper aging, bleed-through, stains, shadows, and uneven illumination, and the foreground-background separation of recent learning-based methods can become unstable on unseen degradation domains. We propose DR-Mamba, a sample-conditioned detail-background suppression framework that performs automatic inference-time domain adaptation for document image binarization. Unlike test-time adaptation methods that require gradient updates or auxiliary data at inference, DR-Mamba adapts to each input document through input-dependent gates within a single forward pass, requiring no target-domain labels, no fine-tuning, and no test-time parameter updates. Instead of using Mamba-style selective scanning as a single generic feature path, DR-Mamba reinterprets it as fast-slow route modeling: a fast detail route captures local stroke structures, while a slow background route accumulates spatially persistent degradation responses. The two routes are integrated through an input-dependent subtractive gate that explicitly suppresses background interference rather than fusing features by addition or concatenation. We further add full-resolution detail-guided reconstruction and thin-stroke-aware supervision to recover fine strokes lost during downsampling. Evaluated under a leave-one-year-out protocol on DIBCO-style benchmarks, where each held-out year is treated as an unseen degradation domain, DR-Mamba shows that per-document, per-location subtractive suppression improves cross-domain robustness, with particularly strong performance on the most severely degraded held-out fold.
papers.comment: Accepted at ADAPDA 2026 (3rd Workshop on Automatically Domain-Adapted and Personalized Document Analysis), ICDAR 2026 Workshop. 17 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Code will be released soon
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文提出DR-Mamba，一种基于样本条件的细节-背景抑制框架，用于文档图像二值化的自动推理时域自适应。通过输入相关的门控机制，无需梯度更新或辅助数据即可在单次前向传播中适应每个输入文档。将Mamba选择性扫描重新解释为快慢路径建模：快速细节路径捕获局部笔画结构，慢速背景路径积累空间持续的退化响应，并通过输入相关的减法门抑制背景干扰。还加入全分辨率细节引导重建和细笔画监督。在DIBCO基准上的留一年验证中，DR-Mamba在严重退化的折叠上表现尤其出色。
Motivation: 退化文档图像二值化对纸张老化、渗墨、污渍等造成的域漂移敏感，现有学习方法在前景-背景分离上可能不稳定。
Method: 提出样本条件细节-背景抑制框架，利用Mamba选择性扫描构建快慢路由：快速细节路由和慢速背景路由，通过输入相关的减法门集成，并添加全分辨率细节引导重建和细笔画监督。
Result: 在DIBCO风格基准的留一年验证中，每个保留年份视为未见退化域，DR-Mamba展示了每文档、每位置减法抑制提升了跨域鲁棒性，在最严重退化的保留折叠上表现尤其强劲。
Conclusion: 摘要强调DR-Mamba在无需目标域标签、微调或测试时参数更新的情况下，实现了自动推理时域自适应，提高了二值化的跨域鲁棒性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Federated Learning for Global Carbon Emission Forecasting: A Hybrid Time-Series Approach with Statistical and Neural Models
papers.abstract_en: Climate change, primarily driven by carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions, requires accurate forecasting tools to support effective mitigation policies and sustainable development strategies. Existing forecasting approaches typically rely on centralized data collection, which is often restricted by privacy regulations and the distributed nature of emission data across countries and industrial sectors. This paper proposes a novel federated hybrid forecasting framework that integrates ARIMA-based trend modeling, GARCH-based volatility modeling, LSTM-Attention temporal representation learning, and XGBoost prediction within a privacy-preserving federated learning environment. The proposed framework enables collaborative learning among distributed clients without requiring the exchange of raw data. Experimental evaluation across 14 clients demonstrates strong forecasting performance, achieving client R2 values between 0.50 and 0.97 with an average of 0.73, RMSE values ranging from 0.06 to 2.35 with an average of 1.21, and MAPE values between 1.5% and 11.3% with an average of 6.5%. The results indicate that the proposed framework provides an accurate, scalable, and regulation-compliant solution for collaborative carbon-emission forecasting.
papers.comment: Approximately 22 pages, 5 figures, 15 tables. Submitted for journal publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种联邦混合预测框架，结合ARIMA趋势建模、GARCH波动建模、LSTM-Attention时序表示学习和XGBoost预测，在隐私保护的联邦学习环境下实现全球碳排放预测。在14个客户端上平均R²为0.73，RMSE为1.21，MAPE为6.5%，展示了准确、可扩展且符合法规的协同碳排放预测方案。

Method: 集成ARIMA、GARCH、LSTM-Attention和XGBoost的联邦混合框架，客户端本地训练后只共享模型参数，不交换原始数据。
Result: 在14个客户端上，R²值在0.50-0.97之间（平均0.73），RMSE在0.06-2.35之间（平均1.21），MAPE在1.5%-11.3%之间（平均6.5%）。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种准确、可扩展且符合隐私法规的协同碳排放预测方案。

papers.title: OmniSpace: Efficient Geometry Awareness for Autonomous Vehicles MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on 2D visual tasks, yet enhancing their spatial intelligence for real-world applications such as Autonomous Vehicles (AV) remains an open challenge. Existing geometry-aware MLLMs typically rely on auxiliary 3D models at inference time, introducing pipeline complexity and the risk of cascading failures. In this paper, we present OmniSpace, a simple yet effective plug-and-play paradigm for geometry-aware spatial reasoning from purely 2D observations. Motivated by our finding that current MLLMs are bottlenecked by weak cross-view correspondence and depth estimation, OmniSpace introduces a Camera Pose Injector, a Multi-view Epipolar Attention module, and a 3D Geometric Distillation objective that jointly address these two limitations by transferring geometric knowledge into the model. Extensive experiments show that OmniSpace surpasses existing methods on planning benchmarks (nuScenes, Bench2Drive), risk detection (nuInstruct), language (Omnidrive), and generalization (DriveBench).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniSpace，一种即插即用范式，用于从纯2D观测进行几何感知空间推理，提升自动驾驶多模态大语言模型的几何理解能力。通过相机位姿注入器、多视图对极注意力模块和3D几何蒸馏目标，解决跨视图对应和深度估计瓶颈。在规划、风险检测等基准上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有几何感知MLLM依赖辅助3D模型，引入管线复杂度和级联失败风险。当前MLLM受限于弱跨视图对应和深度估计。

papers.title: SkillAudit: From Fixed-Suite Benchmarking to Skill-Centered Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills have become a practical way to extend large language model agents, but the growing skill ecosystem still lacks a reliable way to judge whether a skill is worth deploying. Existing evaluation methods remain largely anchored to fixed task suites, assessing skills through performance on predefined tasks and environments. As skill marketplaces expand, this paradigm becomes inadequate: fixed suites can conflate a skill's marginal contribution with backbone strength and miss its value when tasks fall outside the skill's intended scope. We introduce SkillAudit, an end-to-end framework for skill-centered assessment that takes an arbitrary agent skill as input and automatically generates a comprehensive, multi-dimensional evaluation report spanning utility, efficiency/cost, and safety. SkillAudit focuses on the skill artifact itself and constructs capability-aligned evaluation tasks directly from the skill package. The generated tasks are conducted in isolated sandbox environments to collect execution evidence, followed by automated checks with LLM-based judging to produce auditable results. To dissect the agent skills, we propose the baseline comparison principle to measure utility and efficiency/cost, and introduce a two-stage detection paradigm combining static semantic analysis with dynamic runtime verification to assess safety risks. After scanning top-ranked real-world skill packages spanning 23 occupational categories, we found that over 7% of skills are at risky status.
papers.comment: Preprint. Project page: https://skillaudit.github.io/. Code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/SkillAudit/skillaudit
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Agent技能生态系统中缺乏可靠评估方法的问题，提出了SkillAudit框架，该框架以任意Agent技能为输入，自动生成涵盖效用、效率/成本和安全性等多维度的评估报告。SkillAudit直接从技能包构建与能力对齐的评估任务，在隔离沙箱环境中执行并利用LLM评判。通过对23个职业类别的top技能包扫描，发现超过7%的技能存在风险状态。
Motivation: 现有评估方法依赖固定任务套件，无法区分技能本身贡献与基座模型能力，也难以评估技能在指定范围之外的价值。随着技能市场扩张，需要更可靠的评估范式。
Method: 提出SkillAudit端到端框架，包含三个维度：效用、效率/成本和安全性。采用基线比较原则评估效用和效率/成本；安全评估采用两阶段检测：静态语义分析和动态运行时验证。评估任务直接由技能包自动生成，在隔离沙箱环境执行并利用LLM评判。
Result: 扫描23个职业类别的top现实技能包后，发现超过7%的技能处于风险状态。
Conclusion: 固定套件评估范式已不适应技能生态发展，SkillAudit提供了一种自动化的技能中心评估方法，可揭示潜在风险。

papers.title: PaperClaw: Harnessing Agents for Autonomous Research and Human-in-the-Loop Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have become capable reasoners and tool users that write and run code and search the literature, which makes automating the research process itself a realistic goal. We present PAPERCLAW, a harnessed multi-agent system that carries a project autonomously, from a field of study to a finished paper. PAPERCLAW curates a domain from a field's live literature, datasets, and code; brainstorms it into an idea with a pre-registered main-result contract; and drives a stoppable hypothesis map through an iterative propose, test, reflect loop that grows only from measured verdicts and halts once the evidence supports the idea, at which point it writes a venue-compliant paper. A full-lifecycle memory keeps each stage in a single living record, so a long run can be paused, inspected, and resumed without losing context. At the centre is an in-cycle research assistant with research tools and skills: it can drive the whole pipeline on its own, while the same interface lets a person step in at any stage, turning a first autonomous draft into a stronger paper through human-in-the-loop refinement. Throughout, PAPERCLAW keeps its output grounded and checkable, citing only references validated against open scholarly indexes and reporting results that genuinely ran. An evaluation with an LLM judge finds that PAPERCLAW produces strong papers both fully autonomously and with human-in-the-loop refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAPERCLAW 是一个多智能体系统，旨在自动化从领域调研到论文撰写的完整研究流程。它通过迭代假设-检验循环、可暂停的全生命周期记忆和引用验证机制，自主产生可核查的研究成果，并支持人机协同改进。LLM 评估表明其全自动和有人参与的版本均能产出高质量论文。
Motivation: 大型语言模型已具备推理、工具使用和代码执行能力，使研究过程的完全自动化成为现实目标。现有系统缺乏端到端的自主研究能力，且难以保证结果的可核查性。
Method: 提出 PAPERCLAW，包含四个模块：文献/数据策展、头脑风暴与预注册实验方案、可停止的假设地图（通过提出-测试-反思循环逐步扩展，仅基于测量结论生长，证据充分时停止）、以及最终论文撰写。系统具备全生命周期内存，支持暂停、检查和恢复，并提供人机交互接口实现循环内的人类介入。
Result: 使用 LLM 评判员评估，PAPERCLAW 在全自动模式和有人协助模式下均能产出较强的论文。
Conclusion: PAPERCLAW 展示了端到端自主科研的可行性，通过引用验证和结果可复现性保持输出可核查性，且其设计允许人类在任意阶段介入以提升论文质量。

papers.title: Automated sign detection across the Electronic Babylonian Library: A large-scale dataset and end-to-end cuneiform OCR pipeline
papers.abstract_en: Learning to read cuneiform tablets is an extremely demanding task; consequently, of the roughly half million excavated tablets, only a small fraction has been analysed by Assyriologists. Computer vision offers a promising avenue for decipherment but requires large, densely annotated datasets. To address this limitation, the largest annotated cuneiform sign dataset to date is used, and a Deformable Detection Transformer (DETR)-based object detection model is evaluated under two class granularities of 173 and 106 classes. The proposed system integrates automatic tablet-side extraction, heuristic line grouping, and n-gram-based textual similarity evaluation to bridge visual sign detection and textual structure, and achieves consistent improvements of up to 28-37% over prior work on COCO-style detection metrics. At inference, the method is applied to 87,668 tablet fragments from the Electronic Babylonian Library (eBL) corpus, producing nearly 2.9 million sign detections. Although the approach operates without linguistic priors and remains sensitive to tablet damage and layout variability, it provides a scalable and interpretable foundation for corpus-wide cuneiform analysis and supports future integration with multimodal and linguistic modelling frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个大规模的楔形文字标注数据集，并基于Deformable DETR构建了端到端的楔形文字OCR流水线，在173类和106类两种粒度下进行评估。系统集成了自动平板侧面提取、启发式行分组和n-gram文本相似度评估，在COCO风格检测指标上比之前的工作提升了28-37%。应用于Electronic Babylonian Library的87,668块碎片，产生了近290万次符号检测。
Motivation: 现有的楔形文字研究因缺乏大规模标注数据集而进展缓慢，计算机视觉方法需要密集注释的数据。
Method: 使用最大规模的标注楔形文字符号数据集，采用Deformable DETR目标检测模型，并集成自动平板侧面提取、启发式行分组和n-gram文本相似度评估。
Result: 在COCO风格检测指标上，相比先前工作一致提升28-37%，并在87,668块碎片上产出约290万次符号检测。
Conclusion: 该方法无需语言先验，对平板损伤和布局变化敏感，但为语料库范围的楔形文字分析提供了可扩展和可解释的基础，并支持与多模态和语言模型的未来集成。

papers.title: Sub-Billion, Super-Frontier: Small Language Models Rival Zero-Shot Frontier LLMs on General and Literary Relation Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong relation extraction (RE), but their computational demands and reliance on proprietary APIs limit deployment in resource-constrained or privacy-sensitive settings. We investigate how far small language models (SLMs) can close this gap across general-domain and literary text. We evaluate five models from 360M to 3B parameters under three domain-composition regimes and two prompt-conditioned tuning styles (30 configurations), comparing them with zero-shot frontier LLMs and a discriminative RoBERTa baseline. Across nine benchmarks, the best sub-billion model, Qwen2.5-0.5B fine-tuned on pooled general-domain data, achieves a general-domain positive-class micro-F1 of 0.83, versus 0.69 for GPT-5.4 and 0.66 for Claude Sonnet 4.6 evaluated zero-shot. This does not imply that SLMs are intrinsically stronger; rather, targeted task adaptation enables 4-bit models deployable on a single consumer GPU to outperform general-purpose frontier systems under this protocol. An in-domain RoBERTa baseline also exceeds both frontier models, indicating that the gain stems from task adaptation rather than generative decoding. On literary RE, tuned SLMs reach 0.92 on the human-annotated Biographical benchmark versus 0.83 for GPT-5.4, and 0.833 versus 0.578 on the two-benchmark literary average. A targeted domain-adaptive pretraining case study yields no practically meaningful gain over supervised fine-tuning, while the cleanest within-family scale comparison shows only marginal improvement. These results show that, when task-specific data are available, compact task-adapted models can provide accurate, private, and hardware-efficient RE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究小语言模型（SLM）在通用域和文学关系抽取任务中是否能够媲美零样本前沿大语言模型（LLM）。通过评估360M到3B参数的五个模型，在九项基准上发现，经过针对性的任务微调后，数十亿参数以下的SLM（如Qwen2.5-0.5B）在通用域正类宏F1上达到0.83，超过GPT-5.4的0.69和Claude Sonnet 4.6的0.66。文学关系抽取中，微调SLM在Biographical基准上达到0.92，而GPT-5.4为0.83。结果表明，当有任务特定数据时，紧凑型任务适应模型能提供准确、私密且硬件高效的关系抽取。
Motivation: 大语言模型在关系抽取上表现强劲，但其计算需求和依赖专有API限制了在资源受限或隐私敏感场景中的部署。需要探索小语言模型能否缩小这一差距。
Method: 评估五个360M至3B参数的SLM，在三种领域组成制度和两种提示条件微调风格下（共30种配置），与零样本前沿LLM和判别式RoBERTa基线比较。并在文学RE上进行了领域自适应预训练案例研究。
Result: 最佳十亿以下模型 Qwen2.5-0.5B（在合并通用域数据上微调）在通用域正类宏F1达0.83，高于GPT-5.4（0.69）和Claude Sonnet 4.6（0.66）。文学RE上，微调SLM在Biographical基准达0.92（GPT-5.4为0.83），两个基准文学平均0.833 vs 0.578。领域自适应预训练无实际增益，规模比较仅显示边际改进。
Conclusion: 当任务特定数据可用时，紧凑型任务适应模型能够提供准确、私密且硬件高效的关系抽取，甚至优于零样本前沿LLM。4位模型可在单张消费级GPU上部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scalable Bayesian Additive Models for Stellar Flare Detection via Amortized Gaussian Process Inference and Hidden Markov Models
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian Processes (GPs) are a powerful tool for Bayesian time-series modeling, yet their cubic computational cost remains a severe barrier for application to long, high-cadence datasets in astronomy. While specialized scalable solvers like Celerite elegantly reduce this scaling to linear time, repeatedly evaluating the exact likelihood during iterative Bayesian sampling is a bottleneck for developing more complex models, like hierarchical or additive models in which Celerite is only one component. To make this inference computationally tractable, we introduce a generative surrogate framework. By utilizing a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) to learn a compressed representation of the Celerite prior, we map highly correlated stochastic dependencies into a low-dimensional, isotropic manifold. This transition completely bypasses exact covariance operations, shifting the computational burden to a rapid neural network forward pass. Through an extensive simulation study, we show that the generative surrogate accurately reproduces the structural fidelity of exact physical kernels like Celerite. Finally, we demonstrate embedding our VAE approximation into an additive model that combines Celerite and a hidden Markov model (HMM) for stellar flare detection in time series data of stars. We evaluate the joint VAE+HMM architecture against the exact Celerite+HMM framework on empirical astrophysical time series and demonstrate that the proposed methodology achieves significant reductions in computational time, enabling the rigorous, large-scale characterization of stellar flares across massive data archives.
papers.comment: Main paper: 19 pages, full paper: 34 pages. 4 appendices. 9 main figures, 21 figures in total. 4 tables. Poster Presenter, SSC 2026 (Statistical Society of Canada Annual Meeting) and ISBA 2026 (International Society for Bayesian Analysis World Meeting)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高斯过程在长时序天文数据中的计算瓶颈，提出利用变分自编码器（VAE）学习Celerite先验的压缩表示，构建生成代理模型，避免精确协方差运算。将该代理嵌入加性模型（Celerite+隐马尔可夫模型HMM）用于恒星耀斑检测，在模拟和实证数据上验证了其结构保真度，并显著降低了计算时间。
Motivation: 高斯过程的三次方计算成本阻碍了其在长时序高采样率天文数据中的应用，尽管Celerite实现了线性复杂度，但在迭代贝叶斯采样中重复计算似然仍是开发更复杂层次/加性模型的瓶颈。
Method: 使用VAE学习Celerite先验的压缩表示，将高度相关的随机依赖映射到低维各向同流形，以神经网络前向传播替代精确协方差运算，并将其嵌入Celerite+HMM的加性模型中。
Result: 模拟研究表明生成代理精确复现Celerite的结构保真度；在实证天体物理时间序列上，联合VAE+HMM相比精确Celerite+HMM大幅减少计算时间，支持大规模恒星耀斑的严格表征。
Conclusion: 该方法通过生成代理实现了计算时间的显著降低，使大规模数据档案中恒星耀斑的检测与表征变得可行。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对高斯过程在长时序天文数据中的计算瓶颈，提出利用变分自编码器（VAE）学习Celerite先验的压缩表示，构建生成代理模型，避免精确协方差运算。将该代理嵌入加性模型（Celerite+隐马尔可夫模型HMM）用于恒星耀斑检测，在模拟和实证数据上验证了其结构保真度，并显著降低了计算时间。
summary_sections.motivation: 高斯过程的三次方计算成本阻碍了其在长时序高采样率天文数据中的应用，尽管Celerite实现了线性复杂度，但在迭代贝叶斯采样中重复计算似然仍是开发更复杂层次/加性模型的瓶颈。
summary_sections.method: 使用VAE学习Celerite先验的压缩表示，将高度相关的随机依赖映射到低维各向同流形，以神经网络前向传播替代精确协方差运算，并将其嵌入Celerite+HMM的加性模型中。
summary_sections.result: 模拟研究表明生成代理精确复现Celerite的结构保真度；在实证天体物理时间序列上，联合VAE+HMM相比精确Celerite+HMM大幅减少计算时间，支持大规模恒星耀斑的严格表征。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法通过生成代理实现了计算时间的显著降低，使大规模数据档案中恒星耀斑的检测与表征变得可行。

papers.title: On the Position Bias of On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) improves the learning efficiency of standard reinforcement learning through dense, token-level supervision from teachers. In the standard KL objective of OPD, token-level losses are uniformly averaged, implying equal weights for all tokens. However, we discover that not all tokens are created equal: as student rollouts grow longer, they deviate further from the teacher's distribution, leading to degraded supervision quality at later positions. As a result, OPD using only the first 30% of tokens can perform comparably to using all tokens, whereas OPD using only the last 30% of tokens barely learns anything. In this work, we provide a principled understanding of this issue through the lens of constrained optimization. Based on these insights, we derive Importance-Weighted On-Policy Distillation (IW-OPD), in which the weight assigned to each token depends on the accumulated discrepancy between the student's and teacher's distributions, naturally upweighting earlier tokens and downweighting later ones with larger deviations. We show that IW-OPD converges significantly faster than OPD, with better learning efficiency, and achieves better final performance than standard OPD in both same-size and cross-scale settings, improving performance up to 6.9 points on AIME-2025.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现on-policy蒸馏（OPD）中token级损失均匀加权存在位置偏差：学生rollout越长，后面token与教师分布偏差越大，导致监督质量下降。作者通过约束优化视角理解该问题，并提出重要性加权on-policy蒸馏（IW-OPD），根据累积分布差异自动调整token权重，前期加权、后期降权。实验表明IW-OPD收敛更快，最终性能更好，在AIME-2025上提升多达6.9个点。
Motivation: 标准OPD均匀加权所有token，但学生rollout后期token与教师分布偏差大，监督质量低，影响学习效率。
Method: 提出IW-OPD，权重由学生与教师分布的累积差异决定，自然提升前期token权重、降低后期token权重。
Result: IW-OPD收敛速度显著快于OPD，在相同规模与跨规模设置下最终性能均更优，在AIME-2025上提升高达6.9个点。
Conclusion: IW-OPD通过自适应加权解决OPD的位置偏差，提升学习效率和最终性能。

papers.title: MapReason-OSM: Can Vision-Language Models Make Graph-Verifiable Mobility Decisions from Street Maps ?
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to read maps for logistics, delivery, and accessible navigation, where the output is an actionable decision (a route, a pin, a parking choice) that must respect the road network. Yet most map benchmarks grade free-text or multiple-choice answers that cannot be verified against the underlying graph. We present \textbf{MapReason-OSM}, a benchmark and evaluation harness for graph-verifiable mobility decisions on self-rendered OpenStreetMap panels. We render fixed-style maps for ten U.S. downtowns at two aligned zoom scales, overlay a consistent marker grammar, and pair each panel with a hidden street graph and exact oracles, yielding 6{,}000 instances (12{,}000 panels across the two zooms) over 12 routing, facility-location, and visual-disambiguation tasks. Models return structured decisions that we snap back to the graph and score for validity, legality, optimality, and constraint satisfaction, plus \emph{cross-zoom consistency}. Across seven VLMs, models read maps and route simply but fail at graph-cost reasoning (single-facility pin placement is near chance even for frontier reasoning models), and are frequently scale-inconsistent. We release the benchmark, harness, and deterministic generator.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to ACM SIGSPATIAL 2026 (Industrial Track). Code and data: https://github.com/Vi-Sri/mapreason-osm
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MapReason-OSM 基准，用于评估视觉语言模型 (VLM) 从自渲染 OpenStreetMap 面板做出可图验证的移动决策（路线、设施定位等）的能力。基准包含 10 个美国市中心的 6000 个实例（共 12000 张面板），覆盖 12 个任务，包括路由、设施定位和视觉消歧。在 7 个 VLM 上的实验表明，模型能读取地图和进行简单路由，但在图成本推理（如单设施放置接近随机）和跨缩放一致性上表现失败。
Motivation: 现有地图基准多依赖自由文本或多选答案，无法直接验证决策是否遵守道路网络图，缺乏可图验证的评估方式。
Method: 构建 MapReason-OSM 基准：自渲染固定样式 OpenStreetMap 面板（两个缩放尺度），叠加一致标记语法，隐藏底层街道图与精确 oracle。设计 12 个任务（路由、设施定位、视觉消歧），模型输出结构化决策后映射回道路图，并按有效性、合法性、最优性和约束满足性评分，同时评估跨缩放一致性。
Result: 在 7 个 VLM 上，模型能完成地图阅读和简单路由，但在图成本推理任务（如单设施定位）上接近随机水平，且常出现缩放不一致。
Conclusion: 该基准和评估框架可用于检验 VLM 在可验证移动决策上的推理能力，揭示当前模型在图推理和尺度鲁棒性方面的显著局限。

papers.title: Training-free Task Classification for Multi-Task Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: Ever since the advent of foundation models and the pre-training-finetuning paradigm, there have been numerous efforts to merge multiple task-specific experts into a single multi-task model. Prior work largely focuses on finding a single merged model, but it often underperforms individual experts due to parameter interference. To resolve this, dynamic model merging employs routing to activate task-relevant parameters per input. However, existing routers typically require either additional training with abundant labeled datasets or assume the access to task IDs of each input at inference time. In this work, we aim to close the gap to expert performance without additional training or task-ID-access assumption. To this end, we formulate routing as training-free task classification for each test input. Using singular value decomposition (SVD)-based low-rank manifold approximations for each task, SiM scores tasks by the projection residual of the test input feature onto each task manifold and routes accordingly. The task manifolds are pre-computable offline from a pretrained backbone using a small per-task support set (e.g., 32 examples per task) prior to merging process, requiring no router training and no data during the merging process. Moreover, SiM integrates seamlessly with subspace-/mask-based merging that represents task-expert via lightweight compressed task vectors, avoiding the need to store full expert parameters. Experiments across computer vision and natural language processing benchmarks under task-unknown inference demonstrate that SiM substantially improves merged-model performance and consistently narrows the gap to individual task experts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多任务模型合并中的参数干扰问题，提出无需训练的任务分类方法SiM。利用SVD低秩流形逼近，从每个任务的小支持集（如32样本）离线计算任务流形，测试时根据输入特征投影残差进行分类并路由到对应专家参数。实验表明在视觉和NLP基准上，该方法在任务未知推理时显著提升合并模型性能，接近单个专家水平。
Motivation: 现有动态模型合并方法需要额外训练或假设测试时已知任务ID，限制了实用性。本文旨在无需额外训练和任务ID的前提下，缩小与专家性能的差距。
Method: 提出SiM：将路由视为训练自由的任务分类。对每个任务，使用SVD构造低秩流形逼近；从预训练骨干提取特征，仅需少量支持集（如每任务32样本）离线计算任务流形。测试时，计算输入特征在各流形上的投影残差，残差最小的任务作为分类结果，从而激活对应专家参数。该方法可与子空间/掩码合并无缝集成。
Result: 在计算机视觉和自然语言处理基准上，任务未知推理场景下，SiM显著改善合并模型性能，持续缩小与单个专家模型的差距。
Conclusion: 本文展示了无需训练的任务分类能有效缓解多任务合并中的参数干扰，避免额外训练或任务ID假设，且所需支持集很小。

papers.title: Text2DSL: LLM-Based Code Generation for Domain-Specific Languages
papers.abstract_en: Domain-specific languages (DSLs) are widely used for managing operating system security policies, yet manually authoring rules in such languages demands high expertise and is error-prone. This paper formalises the task of automatic DSL code generation from natural language descriptions - Text2DSL - as a distinct problem class, separate from Text-to-SQL and general-purpose code generation. We introduce the PolkitBench dataset comprising 4,204 verified natural-language-to-Polkit-rule pairs, each validated through a three-level AST-based pipeline. Controlled prompt experiments on two MoE models of different scale and provenance - GigaChat-10B-A1.8B (1.8B active parameters) and Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B (3B active) - demonstrate the critical role of structured context (BNF grammar, API specification, permitted identifier vocabulary) for LLM-based DSL code generation. Across both models, supplying context raises syntactic validity to 98.6-99.4%, structural validity by +9.7 to +35.5 pp, and the CodeBLEU score by +60% to +95%. The consistency of the effect across models of different scale and provenance indicates that, for the Text2DSL class of problems, injecting a formal target-language specification into the prompt context is a robust enabling factor for high-quality generation without model fine-tuning.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at KES 2026 (Knowledge-Based Intelligent Information and Engineering Systems), Procedia Computer Science, Elsevier
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文正式定义从自然语言描述生成领域特定语言（DSL）代码的任务——Text2DSL，并将其与Text-to-SQL和通用代码生成区分开。作者构建了包含4204个自然语言到Polkit规则对的PolkitBench数据集，并通过三层次AST验证。在两种不同规模和来源的MoE模型（GigaChat-10B-A1.8B和Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B）上的受控提示实验表明，结构化上下文（BNF语法、API规范、允许的标识符词汇表）对基于LLM的DSL代码生成至关重要：提供上下文后，语法有效性提升至98.6-99.4%，结构有效性提升9.7-35.5个百分点，CodeBLEU分数提升60%-95%。不同规模和来源模型上效果的一致性表明，对于Text2DSL问题，将形式化目标语言规范注入提示上下文是无需微调即可实现高质量生成的稳健因素。
Motivation: 手动编写操作系统安全策略的DSL规则需要高专业知识和易出错，而现有代码生成研究忽略了DSL的特殊性。本文旨在将Text2DSL形式化为独立问题类，并研究如何提升LLM在该任务上的生成质量。
Method: 构建PolkitBench数据集（4204个自然语言到Polkit规则对），采用三层次AST验证管道保证数据质量。通过控制提示实验，在两种MoE模型上比较提供结构化上下文（BNF语法、API规范、标识符词汇表）与不提供的效果。
Result: 在两种MoE模型上，提供结构化上下文后语法有效性达98.6-99.4%，结构有效性提升9.7-35.5个百分点，CodeBLEU分数提升60%-95%。
Conclusion: 对于Text2DSL问题，将形式化目标语言规范注入提示上下文是无需微调即可实现高质量生成的稳健因素，该效果在不同规模和来源的模型上一致。

papers.title: From CVE to CWE: Syscall-Based HIDS Generalisation
papers.abstract_en: Host intrusion detection systems (HIDS) based on system-call traces are typically trained and evaluated against individual Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) instances. In operational settings, however, defenders need to recognise new exploits of an already known type of weakness. We empirically examine whether a one-class anomaly detector trained on the normal behaviour of a set of CVEs that share a Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) class generalises to a different, unseen CVE inside the same class. Using six scenarios drawn from LID-DS-2021 and grouped into three CWE families (CWE-307 broken authentication, CWE-89 SQL injection, CWE-434 unrestricted file upload), we extract a 66-dimensional Peng-Guo-style feature vector per sliding window and train Isolation Forest and SGD One-Class SVM detectors with normal-only thresholds calibrated to fixed target false positive rates. We define and answer four research questions covering self-detection, asymmetric cross-CVE transfer, the value of a combined CWE-level normal profile, and the effect of feature filtering on transferability. The combined CWE-307 detector reaches F1 = 0.6976 at calibration target FPR = 0.05 (precision = 0.8994, recall = 0.5698), whereas CWE-89 and CWE-434 collapse to F1 <= 0.21 under the same protocol. Cross-CVE transfer turns out to be strongly direction-dependent and dominated by the breadth of the source normal profile rather than by the CWE label. We conclude that CWE-level generalisation in HIDS is empirically attainable for some but not all weakness families with current syscall features, and we argue that calibrated FPR is a methodological prerequisite for honest reporting in this setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究基于系统调用踪迹的主机入侵检测系统（HIDS）能否从已知CVE泛化到同一CWE类别的未知CVE。实验使用LID-DS-2021数据集中的三个CWE族（CWE-307、CWE-89、CWE-434），提取66维Peng-Guo特征向量，训练Isolation Forest和SGD One-Class SVM检测器。结果表明CWE-307检测器在FPR=0.05时达到F1=0.6976，而CWE-89和CWE-434的F1≤0.21，跨CVE迁移高度依赖方向性和源正常配置文件的广度。
Motivation: 现有HIDS常针对单个CVE训练和评估，但在实际运营中需要识别已知弱点类型的新利用。论文旨在检验基于CWE类别的异常检测器能否泛化到同一类别的未见CVE。
Method: 使用LID-DS-2021数据集中的六个场景，分为三个CWE族；每个滑动窗口提取66维Peng-Guo特征向量；训练Isolation Forest和SGD One-Class SVM，并通过固定目标假阳性率校准正常阈值；定义了四个研究问题：自检测、非对称跨CVE迁移、CWE级正常配置的价值、特征过滤对迁移性的影响。
Result: CWE-307组合检测器在目标FPR=0.05时F1=0.6976（精确率0.8994，召回率0.5698）；CWE-89和CWE-434在相同协议下F1≤0.21。跨CVE迁移强烈方向依赖，由源正常配置文件的广度主导，而非CWE标签。

papers.title: Stationary Robust Mean-Field Games under Model Mismatches
papers.abstract_en: Deploying multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) in the real world is often limited by model mismatches between the training simulators and the true environment, which could be further amplified through strategic interactions and result in severe performance degradation upon deployment. Distributional robustness offers a principled response by optimizing policies against worst-case transition models drawn from an uncertainty set, but standard robust MARL frameworks become increasingly intractable as the number of agents grows. This paper develops an infinite-horizon, stationary mean-field game framework that incorporates distributional model uncertainty directly into the population-coupled dynamics. We establish a robust dynamic programming principle with a contractive Bellman operator and prove the existence of a stationary robust mean-field equilibrium via a fixed-point argument. We further develop the first concrete algorithm with convergence guarantees. We then connect the mean-field solution to a finite-population robust game whose ambiguity sets depend on the empirical distribution, showing that the mean-field equilibrium policy induces approximate equilibrium behavior as the population size increases. Under a contractive robust-dynamics regime, we further obtain explicit non-asymptotic error bounds. Numerical experiments further illustrate the qualitative and quantitative impact of robustness under multiple uncertainty models, validating our theoretical findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考虑训练模拟器与真实环境之间的模型失配问题，提出了一个无限时域、平稳的平均场博弈框架，将分布鲁棒性直接融入种群耦合动力学。建立了鲁棒动态规划原理和收缩Bellman算子，通过不动点论证证明了平稳鲁棒平均场均衡的存在性，并提出了首个具有收敛保证的具体算法。进一步将平均场解与有限种群鲁棒博弈联系起来，证明了在种群规模增大时平均场均衡策略能诱导近似均衡行为。
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习在现实部署中常因训练模拟器与真实环境间的模型失配导致性能严重下降，而标准鲁棒MARL框架随智能体数量增加变得难以求解。
Method: 提出无限时域、平稳的平均场博弈框架，将分布模型不确定性直接纳入种群耦合动力学；建立鲁棒动态规划原理和收缩Bellman算子，通过不动点论证证明均衡存在性；开发首个具有收敛保证的算法，并使用经验分布定义模糊集，证明平均场均衡策略在有限种群中诱导近似均衡。
Result: 在收缩鲁棒动力学假设下获得显式非渐近误差界，数值实验在多种不确定性模型下验证了鲁棒性的定性和定量影响。
Conclusion: 本文的理论和算法为模型失配下的多智能体系统提供了可扩展的鲁棒决策框架，但数值实验规模及实际部署效果需进一步验证。

papers.title: Context-Aware Distillation and Ablation for Text2DSL
papers.abstract_en: We extend our prior work on Text2DSL automatic generation of domain-specific language (DSL) code from natural language descriptions along two complementary axes. First, we replace prompt-only synthetic generation with context-aware distillation, in which a teacher large language model (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) operates under an explicitly defined structured context comprising a BNF grammar, an API specification, and a closed identifier vocabulary; the resulting corpus is verified by a two-tier pipeline combining AST validation through esprima and runtime acceptance through the production polkitd daemon and the pkcheck client. This scales the verified PolkitBench corpus from 4,204 to 10,073 natural-language-to-Polkit-rule pairs at 100.0% AST validity and 99.7% runtime pass rate. Second, we conduct the per-component factorial ablation of structured context that was identified as future work in the precursor study: eight conditions C0-C7 are evaluated on GigaChat-10B-A1.8B with the new corpus. Three findings emerge. (i) The new harder corpus collapses the baseline mode (Syntax Valid 97.6% -> 58.5%, Combined Score 0.482 -> 0.252), whereas the context-enhanced mode degrades only marginally (Syntax 98.6% -> 97.4%, Combined 0.801 -> 0.750), confirming that structured context is not a cosmetic improvement but a load-bearing mechanism. (ii) The best absolute condition is the full context C7 across all metrics, while the strongest partial conditions (C5 = BNF + Vocabulary, C6 = API + Vocabulary) both contain the vocabulary. (iii) A Shapley-style decomposition assigns the largest semantic-quality effect to the vocabulary (Combined +0.198), the largest structural-validity effects to API (+24.7 pp) and BNF (+22.3 pp).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了Text2DSL工作，引入上下文感知蒸馏（使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash教师模型在结构化上下文下生成数据）和结构化上下文的因子消融实验。构建了更大的PolkitBench语料库（10073对，AST有效性100%，运行时通过率99.7%）。消融实验发现完整上下文C7在所有指标上最优，词汇表对语义质量贡献最大，API和BNF对结构有效性贡献大。
Motivation: 先前Text2DSL工作仅使用提示生成数据，且缺少结构化上下文的系统消融研究。本文旨在验证结构化上下文是否真正必要，并量化各组件贡献。
Method: 采用上下文感知蒸馏：教师模型在显式定义的BNF语法、API规范和封闭词汇表下生成数据，经AST验证和运行时测试过滤。然后对结构化上下文的四个组件（语法、API、词汇表、指令）进行8种组合的消融实验，评估GigaChat-10B-A1.8B模型。
Result: 新语料库使基线模式性能大幅下降（Syntax Valid从97.6%降至58.5%，Combined Score从0.482降至0.252），而上下文增强模式仅小幅下降（Syntax 98.6%→97.4%，Combined 0.801→0.750）。完整上下文C7最优。词汇表对语义质量影响最大（Combined +0.198），API和BNF对结构有效性影响显著（+24.7 pp和+22.3 pp）。
Conclusion: 结构化上下文是Text2DSL中不可或缺的机制，而非锦上添花；词汇表定义对语义准确性至关重要，语法和API规范对结构正确性关键。

papers.title: The Power of Light: Improving Synthetic-to-Real Domain Adaptation through Physically-Based Indirect Illumination
papers.abstract_en: While synthetic data generation resolves the manual labeling bottleneck in computer vision, minimizing the syn-to-real domain gap requires optimizing rendering variables. This paper presents a systematic study analyzing the impact of lighting configurations and background complexity on object detection performance. We introduce SmartSDG, an automated, reproducible pipeline built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim using Physically-Based Shading (PBS), alongside ILLUM\_INTRUCK, a new multi-object industrial benchmark dataset. Through 18 controlled experiments utilizing a state-of-the-art YOLOv12 framework, we demonstrate that complex, indirect lighting configurations paired with domain-relevant background variability significantly increase visual cue richness. Our quantitative findings show that avoiding direct specular peaks preserves crucial surface textures, mitigates the domain gap, reduces false positives, and accelerates model convergence compared to using conventional direct-light synthetic data. Ultimately, we provide actionable virtual scene design guidelines to maximize object detection robustness in industrial automation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了照明配置和背景复杂度对目标检测性能的影响，提出SmartSDG自动化管线（基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim和物理着色），并创建多物体工业基准数据集ILLUM_INTRUCK。通过18个受控实验（使用YOLOv12），表明复杂间接光照配合领域相关背景可丰富视觉线索，避免直接镜面峰值可保留纹理、缩小域差距、减少误报并加速收敛。
Motivation: 合成数据生成解决了人工标注瓶颈，但缩小合成到真实域差距需要优化渲染变量，尤其是光照和背景。
Method: 提出SmartSDG自动化管线，基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim使用物理着色（PBS），并构建ILLUM_INTRUCK多物体工业基准数据集。进行18个受控实验，使用YOLOv12框架。
Result: 复杂间接光照配置配合领域相关背景可显著增加视觉线索丰富度；避免直接镜面峰值可保留关键表面纹理，缩小域差距，减少误报，加速模型收敛。
Conclusion: 提供了可操作的虚拟场景设计指南，以最大化工业自动化中目标检测的鲁棒性。

papers.title: SeFi-Image: A Text-to-Image Foundation Model with Semantic-First Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Training image generation foundation models consumes substantial resources. Previous methods have attempted to leverage semantic guidance to accelerate the training process, yet their experiments were only conducted on simple datasets such as ImageNet, at low resolutions, and with small-scale models. In this paper, we propose SeFi-Image, a text-to-image foundation model built upon semantic-first diffusion, a novel latent diffusion modeling paradigm. We instantiate SeFi-Image at three model scales, 1B, 2B, and 5B parameters, enabling systematic study of scaling behavior and flexible deployment under varying compute budgets. Notably, our largest 5B model was trained with merely 125K A800 GPU hours, corresponding to roughly 10-20% of the training compute used by Z-Image. However, it achieves results comparable to or even superior to Qwen-Image and Z-Image. Despite this modest training compute, SeFi-Image achieves strong performance on a wide range of benchmarks, including GenEval, DPG, LongTextBench, OneIG, and CVTG-2K. Moreover, we provide DMD2-distilled few-step turbo variants for each model scale to accommodate diverse hardware constraints and latency requirements. We publicly release our code, weights and hope this work offers the community useful insights into semantic-guided diffusion modeling for T2I generation, while also providing practical and readily deployable model options.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SeFi-Image，一种基于语义优先扩散（semantic-first diffusion）的文本到图像基础模型，在1B、2B、5B三种参数规模上训练。最大5B模型仅用125K A800 GPU小时（约为Z-Image训练计算的10-20%），但在GenEval、DPG、LongTextBench等多个基准上达到或超过Qwen-Image和Z-Image。同时提供DMD2蒸馏的少步推理变体以适应不同硬件约束。
Motivation: 以往利用语义指导加速图像生成训练的方法仅在ImageNet等简单数据集、低分辨率和较小模型上验证，缺乏在文本到图像基础模型上的大规模实证。
Method: 提出语义优先扩散（semantic-first diffusion）这一新型潜在扩散建模范式，并在1B、2B、5B三个尺度上实例化SeFi-Image，实现系统性的扩展行为研究和灵活部署。
Result: 5B模型以仅125K A800 GPU小时的训练计算量（约为Z-Image的10-20%）在GenEval、DPG、LongTextBench、OneIG、CVTG-2K等基准上取得与Qwen-Image和Z-Image相当甚至更优的结果。
Conclusion: 语义引导的扩散建模可以大幅降低文本到图像基础模型的训练成本，同时保持高质量生成能力，并提供了实用的模型选项。

papers.title: Concept-Constrained Prompt Learning for Few-Shot CLIP Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot prompt learning is an effective strategy for adapting CLIP to downstream tasks, but class-only prompt optimization can overfit base-class supervision and weaken transfer to unseen classes. We propose Concept-Constrained Prompt Learning (CCPL), a lightweight regularization framework that anchors learnable class prompts to frozen concept-level text prototypes without updating CLIP encoders. CCPL learns a set of shared context tokens, instantiates class prompts by appending class names, and constructs frozen concept prototypes from a class-level concept bank. During training, a text-space cosine consistency objective aligns learnable class-prompt embeddings with frozen concept prototypes; concept dropout provides additional regularization against over-reliance on fixed concept lists. At inference, CCPL optionally fuses class-prompt logits with concept-prototype logits using a controllable ensemble weight alpha. Our default configuration uses text-space concept regularization lambda = 0.5, concept dropout p = 0.3 and weak concept-guided fusion (alpha = 0.1), with no KL-based prediction consistency term. Experiments under identical automatically-generated fallback splits show that CCPL improves the base-to-new harmonic mean on DTD (+0.6) and EuroSAT (+2.9) compared with CoOp, while remaining near-neutral on OxfordPets (-0.1). Ablations indicate that text-space concept regularization is consistently beneficial, while the best concept-guided inference strength is dataset- and protocol-sensitive. These results suggest concept constraints are most effective when concept prototypes align naturally with dataset semantics, and identify fine-grained categories as a current boundary condition. The code is released at: https://github.com/richael-sang/concept-constrained-prompt-learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出概念约束提示学习（CCPL），一种轻量级正则化框架，通过将可学习类提示锚定到冻结的概念级文本原型上，改进少样本CLIP适应。CCPL使用文本空间余弦一致性目标和概念丢弃正则化，可选地融合概念原型logits。实验显示在DTD和EuroSAT上相比CoOp有改善，但在细粒度类别上效果有限。
Motivation: 现有少样本提示学习仅优化类提示易过拟合基类监督，削弱对未见类的迁移能力。
Method: CCPL学习共享上下文令牌，实例化类提示并构建冻结的概念原型，通过文本空间余弦一致性损失对齐可学习类提示嵌入与概念原型，并引入概念丢弃正则化。推理时可选择融合概念原型logits。
Result: 在自动生成的划分上，CCPL相比CoOp在DTD和EuroSAT上基到新和谐均值分别提升0.6和2.9，在OxfordPets上持平（-0.1）。消融实验表明文本空间概念正则化一致有益。
Conclusion: 概念约束在概念原型与数据集语义自然对齐时最有效，细粒度类别是其当前边界条件。

papers.title: Deep material network for homogenization of piezoelectric composites
papers.abstract_en: Piezoelectric composites are widely used in sensors, actuators, transducers, and energy-harvesting devices because their effective electromechanical performance can be tailored by combining constituent phases and microstructural architecture. However, conventional computational homogenization based on direct numerical simulation (DNS) is computationally expensive, particularly for multiscale simulations and material design tasks that require repeated homogenization analyses. To address this limitation, this work proposes a piezoelectric deep material network (PDMN) to efficiently homogenize two-phase piezoelectric composites. The proposed framework embeds the governing electromechanical homogenization relations directly into the network architecture, yielding a physics-informed, semi-analytical surrogate that explicitly captures the two-way coupling between the mechanical and electrical fields across constituent phases. The network is trained offline on linear electroelastic datasets and, through a fully coupled Newton--Raphson solution with a consistent electromechanical tangent, subsequently used for efficient online prediction under broader constitutive settings, including nonlinear electroelasticity and history-dependent responses. The framework is validated on two-phase composites of polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) and lithium niobate (LiNbO$_3$) with reversed phase arrangements under nonlinear electroelastic loading, and on a viscoelastic--piezoelectric composite exhibiting coupled stress relaxation. Numerical examples show that the proposed PDMN achieves high predictive accuracy while reducing the computational cost by more than three orders of magnitude compared with DNS. The proposed framework, therefore, provides an efficient and reliable surrogate for the multiscale analysis and design of piezoelectric composites.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种压电深度材料网络（PDMN），用于高效均质化两相压电复合材料。该网络将电-机械均质化关系嵌入网络架构，形成物理信息驱动的半解析代理模型，能够显式捕获相间力电场双向耦合。离线训练后，通过完全耦合的牛顿-拉夫森求解和一致切线，可在线预测非线性电弹性和历史依赖响应。在PVDF和铌酸锂两相复合材料以及粘弹性-压电复合材料的数值算例中，PDMN在保持高精度的同时将计算成本降低三个数量级以上。
Motivation: 传统基于直接数值模拟的计算均质化对于多尺度分析和材料设计任务计算量过大，需要更高效的代理模型。
Method: 提出压电深度材料网络（PDMN），将电-机械均质化控制方程嵌入网络架构，进行离线训练，并通过完全耦合的牛顿-拉夫森求解和一致电-机械切线进行在线预测。
Result: 在PVDF/铌酸锂两相复合材料和粘弹性-压电复合材料算例中，PDMN实现了高预测精度，同时计算成本比直接数值模拟降低三个数量级以上。
Conclusion: PDMN为压电复合材料的多尺度分析和设计提供了一种高效可靠的代理模型，可推广到非线性电弹性和历史依赖响应。

papers.title: Look Light, Think Heavy: What Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Can and Cannot Do
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has become a standard method for improving reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs) by eliciting step-by-step thinking, but its effectiveness in multimodal tasks remains unclear. In this paper, we aim to systematically investigate the key question: What can multimodal Chain-of-Thought reasoning do, and where and why does it fall short? To this end, we evaluate 12 multimodal tasks across perception and reasoning categories using both 14 non-reasoning models and 8 reasoning models. Our analysis reveals several important findings: (1) CoT is not a free lunch and should be used selectively depending on the specific requirements of each task. For perception tasks, CoT can lead to undesirable side effects, such as reduced performance in visual grounding and object counting. In contrast, it proves effective for reasoning tasks involving mathematical, scientific, and multi-image reasoning; (2) Compared to original models, existing open-source multimodal reasoning models often yield only marginal overall improvements, possibly due to an overemphasis on mathematical reasoning at the expense of broader capabilities; (3) Visual reasoning remains a key bottleneck for current multimodal CoT, as models exhibit a Look Light, Think Heavy pattern where verbal reflection rises and falls during reasoning, whereas visual reflection consistently diminishes. These findings suggest that while multimodal CoT handles verbal reflection relatively well, it lacks the ability to maintain deep visual introspection throughout the reasoning process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统探究多模态链式思维推理（CoT）在12个感知和推理任务上的表现，发现CoT并非通用增强工具，在感知任务上可能带来负面影响，而在数学、科学和多图像推理上有效；开源多模态推理模型提升有限，且在视觉推理中存在“看轻想重”模式，即语言反思维持但视觉反思逐渐减弱。
Motivation: 链式思维推理在语言模型上效果显著，但在多模态任务中的有效性和局限性尚未被系统研究。
Method: 在12个多模态任务（包括感知和推理类别）上，使用14个非推理模型和8个推理模型进行评估，分析CoT在不同任务类型上的表现差异。
Result: (1) CoT在感知任务（如视觉定位、目标计数）上可能带来负面影响，在数学、科学、多图像推理上有效；(2) 开源多模态推理模型相比原模型提升有限，可能因过度强调数学推理而牺牲其他能力；(3) 视觉推理是当前瓶颈，模型呈现“看轻想重”模式：语言反思在推理过程中有起伏，而视觉反思持续减弱。
Conclusion: 多模态CoT在处理语言反思方面相对较好，但缺乏在整个推理过程中维持深层视觉内省的能力，需要进一步研究模型在视觉推理中的持续性。

papers.title: MacAgentBench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Real-World macOS Desktop
papers.abstract_en: Computer use agents (CUAs) have advanced rapidly in desktop automation, and a growing number of users deploy CUAs such as OpenClaw on Mac Mini for always-on automation. However, existing benchmarks, including those for macOS, evaluate agents without framework augmentation and rely on binary evaluation. As a result, they fail to capture both the framework capabilities leveraged by modern CUAs and the partial progress on long-horizon, multi-application tasks. We present MacAgentBench, a comprehensive macOS agent benchmark comprising 676 tasks across 25 applications, with nearly 60% involving both GUI and CLI interaction. The benchmark adopts deterministic rule-based evaluation and introduces fine-grained multi-checkpoint scoring with capability annotations for multi-application tasks. Experiments across three frameworks and 16 models show that the best configuration, Claude Opus 4.6 on OpenClaw, attains 73.7% Pass@1, while this advantage is primarily driven by the skill library rather than by framework design. Fine-grained metrics further reveal that models with similar Pass@1 can differ substantially in sub-goal completion. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/JetAstra/MacAgentBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了MacAgentBench，一个面向macOS桌面智能体的综合基准，包含676个任务、25个应用，其中近60%任务涉及GUI和CLI交互。采用确定性规则评估和细粒度多检查点评分，实验表明最佳配置（OpenClaw上的Claude Opus 4.6）达到73.7% Pass@1，且优势主要来自技能库而非框架设计。
Motivation: 现有macOS基准未能捕捉现代计算机使用智能体（CUA）利用的框架能力，也未能评估长周期多应用任务的部分进展。
Method: 构建MacAgentBench，包含676个任务覆盖25个应用，采用确定性规则评估和细粒度多检查点评分，并对多应用任务进行能力注释。
Result: 最佳配置（OpenClaw上的Claude Opus 4.6）取得73.7% Pass@1，该优势主要由技能库驱动而非框架设计；细粒度指标显示Pass@1相似的模型在子目标完成率上差异显著。
Conclusion: MacAgentBench揭示了框架能力和技能库对智能体性能的影响，细粒度评分能更准确反映模型在复杂任务中的真实能力差异。

papers.title: HiMatch-AD: DINOv3-driven Hierarchical Matching for Training-free Medical Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection is essential for medical image analysis, where pathological regions often appear as rare deviations from normal anatomical structures. While training-based methods have achieved promising performance, they require task-specific optimization and extensive normal data, which limits scalability across modalities and institutions. Training-free approaches offer greater flexibility by leveraging pretrained visual representations, yet existing methods typically rely on simple nearest-neighbor retrieval and naive aggregation strategies, which may fail to capture hierarchical semantics and ignore the reliability of multiple anomaly responses. In this work, we propose HiMatch-AD, a DINOv3-driven hierarchical matching framework for training-free medical anomaly detection. Our method first retrieves semantically relevant normal references via dual-branch matching that jointly considers global CLS-token similarity and patch-level representations. Hierarchical anomaly maps are then generated across multiple transformer stages by comparing clustered normal features with query representations. To robustly aggregate anomaly responses, we introduce a unified uncertainty-based fusion mechanism that adaptively weights maps according to their reliability. The entire framework operates without any task-specific training. Extensive experiments on the BMAD benchmark, including brain MRI, liver CT, and retinal OCT datasets, demonstrate that HiMatch-AD consistently outperforms both training-based and DINO-based state-of-the-art methods, which highlights the effectiveness of multi-level matching and uncertainty-aware fusion for scalable medical anomaly detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HiMatch-AD，一个基于DINOv3的无训练医学异常检测框架。通过双分支匹配检索正常参考，在多Transformer阶段生成层次异常图，并使用不确定性融合机制自适应聚合多级响应。在BMAD基准（脑MRI、肝CT、视网膜OCT）上超越现有训练基和DINO基方法。
Motivation: 现有无训练方法依赖简单最近邻检索和朴素聚合，无法捕捉层次语义且忽略多异常响应的可靠性。
Method: 使用DINOv3，通过全局CLS-token和补丁级特征进行双分支匹配检索正常参考；在多Transformer阶段比较聚类正常特征与查询表示生成层次异常图；引入不确定性融合机制按可靠性加权聚合。
Result: 在BMAD基准（脑MRI、肝CT、视网膜OCT）上，HiMatch-AD一致超越训练基和DINO基的最先进方法。
Conclusion: 多级匹配和不确定性融合对于可扩展的无训练医学异常检测有效。

papers.title: Mitigating Measurement-Induced Training Instability in Hybrid Quantum Neural Networks for Protein Classification
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid Quantum Neural Network (QNN) classifiers produce logits as expectation values of quantum measurement operators. For standard Pauli measurements, these outputs are intrinsically bounded to the interval [-1,1]. When such bounded logits are used directly with the cross-entropy loss applied to softmax-normalized logits for multi-class classification, the loss function operates in a regime of weak sensitivity to logit differences. As a consequence, parameter gradients are suppressed, leading to unstable optimization in variational quantum classifiers (VQCs). In this work, we identify this effect as measurement-induced logit contraction, a previously uncharacterized source of trainability degradation in hybrid QNNs. To address this limitation, we introduce a learnable scaling parameter, termed Quantum Measurement Temperature (QMT), which rescales quantum measurement outputs prior to the loss. Unlike post-hoc calibration, QMT acts during training and compensates for the physically imposed bounds on quantum measurement outputs. This rescaling increases gradient magnitude and variance, thereby improving loss sensitivity. The proposed mechanism is architecture-agnostic and does not modify the quantum ansatz, circuit depth, or measurement operators. Experiments on fluorescence microscopy images and a six-class variant of Fashion MNIST demonstrate that QMT consistently enhances logit separation, strengthens gradients, stabilizes training across random initializations, and improves classification accuracy, relative to unscaled measurement readouts. These results demonstrate that QMT enables stable and reliable training of hybrid QNNs for practical applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现在混合量子神经网络中，使用Pauli测量得到的有界logits（区间[-1,1]）直接与交叉熵损失结合时，会导致损失函数对logit差异敏感度低，梯度被抑制，从而引发训练不稳定性。为解决此问题，提出可学习的缩放参数——量子测量温度（QMT），在训练前重新缩放测量输出，增强梯度幅度和方差，提升损失敏感性。实验表明QMT能提高分类精度、稳定训练，且不改变量子线路结构。
Motivation: 混合量子神经网络中，有界测量输出与交叉熵损失结合导致梯度抑制和训练不稳定，这是以往未被表征的测量诱导logit收缩问题，限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出量子测量温度（QMT），一个可学习的缩放参数，在损失计算前对测量输出进行重新缩放，以补偿物理测量有界性带来的梯度衰减，不改变量子门或线路深度。
Result: 在荧光显微镜图像和六类Fashion MNIST上，QMT持续改善logit分离、增强梯度、稳定训练并提高分类准确率，相比于无缩放基线。
Conclusion: QMT是一种架构无关的轻量级方法，能稳定可靠地训练混合量子神经网络，适用于实际分类任务。

summary_sections.result: 在荧光显微镜图像和六类Fashion MNIST上，QMT持续改善logit分离、增强梯度、稳定训练并提高分类准确率，相比于无缩放基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: QMT是一种架构无关的轻量级方法，能稳定可靠地训练混合量子神经网络，适用于实际分类任务。

papers.title: Training-Free Semantic Correction for Autoregressive Visual Models
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive visual models (AVMs) based on next-scale prediction have emerged as a prominent paradigm for image and video synthesis. However, decomposing the generation process into discrete scales with varying granularities in AVM makes semantic errors difficult to identify and correct, thereby undermining the quality of the final output. Prior efforts to enhance AVM can be categorized into training-based and training-free approaches. Although training-based efforts to enhance AVM generation quality come at substantial computational cost, existing training-free methods neglect intermediate generation states, leaving semantic errors undiagnosed and allowing them to accumulate into the final output. In this paper, we focus on training-free paradigms and propose Gazer, a framework that integrates multimodal large language model feedback into the AVM sampling loop for in-generation semantic correction. Concretely, Gazer operates via two cooperating stages: the Reflective Diagnosis stage diagnoses semantic errors from intermediate states, while the Semantic Correction stage rewinds and rectifies the generation trajectory to realign with the target prompt. Experiments on compositional image and video benchmarks demonstrate that Gazer improves semantic alignment and compositional accuracy across multiple AVMs without additional training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自回归视觉模型（AVM）在逐尺度预测中语义错误累积的问题，提出无需额外训练的视频模型。Gazer框架。该框架通过反射诊断阶段从中间状态检测语义错误，并在语义校正阶段回溯并修正生成轨迹，使其与目标提示重新对齐。在组合图像和视频基准上的实验表明，Gazer在不经额外训练的情况下提升了多个AVM的语义对齐和组合准确性。
Motivation: 现有基于逐尺度预测的自回归视觉模型（AVM）在生成过程中不同粒度的尺度分解导致语义错误难以识别和纠正，影响最终输出质量。已有的训练免费方法忽略了中间生成状态，使得语义错误无法被诊断并累积到最终输出。
Method: 提出Gazer框架，集成多模态大语言模型反馈到AVM采样循环中，包含两个阶段：反射诊断阶段从中间状态诊断语义错误，语义校正阶段回滚并修正生成轨迹以重新对齐目标提示。
Result: 在组合图像和视频基准上的实验显示，Gazer在不需额外训练的情况下，提升了多个AVM的语义对齐和组合准确性。
Conclusion: Gazer通过利用多模态大语言模型反馈实现无需训练的语义校正，有效改善自回归视觉模型的生成质量。

papers.title: Venice-H1: Failure-Aware Query Re-Ranking with Multi-Scale Grid Signatures for Referring Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Modern Referring Image Segmentation (RIS) systems generate multiple candidate masks per expression but rely on a simple heuristic--typically the argmax detection score--to select the final output. We identify query selection as a failure-case bottleneck: although heuristic selection succeeds on 82-93% of samples, the residual 7-18% of failures dominate the error budget, leaving a best-query selection gap of 3-11% mIoU. We introduce Venice-H1, a lightweight, backbone-decoupled post-hoc re-ranking module that encodes each candidate through multi-scale grid signatures--compact spatial descriptors pooled onto 4x4, 8x8, and 16x16 grids--and feeds them to a Transformer-based re-ranker with a Failure Gate (ROCAUC 0.78-0.82) that intervenes only when the default choice is likely suboptimal. Instantiated on DeRIS-L and DeRIS-B, Venice-H1 achieves delta_fail of +1.40 and +0.89 mIoU with strictly positive 95% CIs on all 16/16 (split, backbone) pairs and harmful-switch rates below 0.53%. Zero-shot transfer to medical referring segmentation (MS-CXR, M3D-RefSeg-2D) yields +1.16 and +0.51 mIoU without RIS-backbone fine-tuning. The module adds approximately 11.3M parameters and under 1 ms latency.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 10 figures. Code: https://github.com/odaxai/Venice-H1 Model: https://huggingface.co/OdaxAI/venice-h1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Referring Image Segmentation (RIS) 中查询选择失败的问题，提出Venice-H1轻量级后处理重排序模块。该模块通过多尺度网格签名（4×4、8×8、16×16网格）编码候选掩码，并利用Transformer重排序器及Failure Gate（ROC AUC 0.78-0.82），仅在默认选择可能次优时介入。在DeRIS-L和DeRIS-B上，delta_fail分别提升+1.40和+0.89 mIoU，所有16个（分割、骨干）组合的95%置信区间均为正，有害切换率低于0.53%。零样本迁移到医疗分割（MS-CXR、M3D-RefSeg-2D）获得+1.16和+0.51 mIoU提升，无需微调RIS骨干。模块仅增加约11.3M参数，延迟低于1 ms。
Motivation: 现有RIS系统通常通过启发式（如argmax检测分数）从多个候选掩码中选择最终输出，但这种方法在7-18%的样本中失败，成为错误预算的主要来源，留下3-11% mIoU的最佳查询选择差距。
Method: 提出Venice-H1后处理重排序模块，该模块与骨干解耦。首先通过多尺度网格签名（将候选掩码池化到4×4、8×8和16×16网格）生成紧凑空间描述子，然后输入基于Transformer的重排序器，并配备Failure Gate（ROC AUC 0.78-0.82），该门仅在默认选择可能次优时触发干预。
Result: 在DeRIS-L和DeRIS-B上，Venice-H1实现delta_fail提升+1.40和+0.89 mIoU，所有16个（分割、骨干）对的95%置信区间严格为正，有害切换率低于0.53%。零样本迁移到医疗图像分割任务（MS-CXR、M3D-RefSeg-2D）获得+1.16和+0.51 mIoU提升。模块参数量约11.3M，延迟低于1 ms。
Conclusion: Venice-H1是一种轻量级、与骨干解耦的后处理模块，能有效减少RIS中的查询选择失败，并零样本迁移到医学领域。

papers.title: MAPS: Multi-Anchor Projection Similarity for Joint Vision-Language Geo-Localization
papers.abstract_en: Humans localize places by integrating perceptual cues from vision with semantic reasoning from language, forming a scene understanding that is both intuitive and structured. Although existing geo-localization models have made substantial progress in cross-view and cross-modal settings, they are largely built upon point-to-point alignment, which is insufficient for joint vision-language queries. In such queries, visual and textual cues do not simply act as independent references, but jointly define a semantic subspace for locating the target. In this paper, we formulate vision-language geo-localization (VLGL) with joint image-text queries as a multi-anchor geometric alignment problem and propose a unified framework for this setting. To realize this formulation, we propose Multi-Anchor Projection Similarity (MAPS), a new metric which constructs an anchor plane from visual and textual query features in a high-dimensional space and measures similarity by the projection length of the target feature onto this plane. Unlike cosine similarity which evaluates isolated pairwise relations, MAPS captures the geometric consistency between the target feature and the joint query subspace, providing a more discriminative ranking criterion during retrieval. To make the learned representation consistent with this geometry, we further introduce a MAPS-based contrastive loss that drives target features toward the corresponding anchor plane. The proposed framework, similarity metric, and training objective jointly yield state-of-the-art performance in VLGL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多锚点投影相似度（MAPS）方法，将视觉-语言地理定位（VLGL）建模为多锚点几何对齐问题，通过目标特征在查询锚平面上的投影长度衡量相似性，并引入基于MAPS的对比损失进行训练。该方法在VLGL任务上达到最新最优性能。
Motivation: 现有地理定位模型主要基于点对点对齐，无法有效处理联合图像-文本查询中视觉与文本线索共同定义的语义子空间。
Method: 提出MAPS度量，利用视觉和文本查询特征在高维空间中构建锚平面，通过目标特征投影长度替代余弦相似度；并设计MAPS对比损失，使目标特征向对应锚平面靠近。
Result: 在视觉-语言地理定位任务上取得最优性能。
Conclusion: MAPS通过几何一致性捕获目标与联合查询子空间的关系，提供更具判别力的排序标准，验证了多锚点几何对齐在VLGL中的有效性。

papers.title: PolicyTrim: Boosting Intrinsic Policy Efficiency of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a unified paradigm for robotic manipulation, yet their real-world deployment is often bottlenecked by execution efficiency. While existing efforts predominantly focus on compute-centric efficiency to reduce per-step inference latency, the intrinsic \textbf{policy efficiency} of these models remains largely unexplored. Policy efficiency is fundamentally affected by two factors, namely the effective executable length of predicted action chunks and the total physical steps required to complete a task. These two factors jointly determine the total number of forward inference calls during execution. We observe that current VLA policies struggle with planning unreliability and action redundancy, suffering from severe prediction degradation at the tail of action chunks and tending to generate unnecessarily redundant physical steps. To address this, we propose \textbf{PolicyTrim}, a reinforcement learning-based post-training framework that extends the reliable action chunk length and reduces redundant physical steps. For reliable chunk extension, we employ a dynamic exploration strategy that explicitly rewards the successful completion of longer executable lengths, progressively pushing the trustworthy prediction horizon to its empirical limit. For step efficiency, we design a redundancy-aware reward that directly favors successful task completions with fewer steps while penalizing unreproducible shortcuts, effectively eliminating redundant physical actions. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks and three VLA models demonstrate that PolicyTrim improves action chunk utilization by 3$\times$ and reduces physical execution steps by 51.4\%. Ultimately, our framework delivers up to a 5.83$\times$ end-to-end deployment speedup without compromising task success rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PolicyTrim，一种基于强化学习的后训练框架，旨在提升视觉-语言-动作模型(VLA)的内在策略效率。通过延长可靠的动作块长度和减少冗余物理步骤，实现执行加速。实验表明，动作块利用率提升3倍，物理执行步骤减少51.4%，端到端部署速度提升最高5.83倍，且不牺牲任务成功率。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型存在预测退化（动作块尾部不可靠）和动作冗余（不必要的物理步骤）问题，影响策略效率（即执行任务所需的前向推理调用总数）。之前的优化多集中于计算效率（减少单步延迟），而忽视了内在策略效率。
Method: 提出PolicyTrim，包含两个关键组件：1）动态探索策略，通过奖励成功完成更长可执行长度，逐步扩展可信预测范围；2）冗余感知奖励，直接奖励更少步骤的成功任务完成，并惩罚不可复现的捷径，从而消除冗余物理动作。
Result: 在三个基准和三个VLA模型上，PolicyTrim将动作块利用率提升3倍，物理执行步骤减少51.4%，端到端部署速度提升最高5.83倍，且不降低任务成功率。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过强化学习后训练可以显著提升VLA模型的策略效率，实现无需牺牲成功率的部署加速。但论文未讨论在更复杂或动态环境中的泛化性。

papers.title: NegAS: Negative Label Guided Attention and Scoring for Out-of-Distribution Object Detection with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection is essential for ensuring the robustness and reliability of object detection systems deployed in safety-critical applications. While prior research has mainly focused on uni-modal detectors or vision-language model (VLM) based classifiers, the potential of VLM-based object detectors in OOD scenarios remains underexplored. In this work, we take the first step toward building OOD object detection methods upon VLMs. We identify two challenges specific to VLM detectors: (i) their text-guided attention enhances foreground with ID labels but treats background uniformly, leaving potential OOD regions unexploited for separating in-distribution (ID) from OOD instances; and (ii) their sigmoid-based multi-label outputs are incompatible with softmax-based OOD scores, calling for scoring functions consistent with VLM probabilistic outputs. Hence, we introduce Negative Label Guided Attention and Scoring (NegAS). To address (i), we propose a negative label guided attention module (NegA), where LLM-generated, visually-similar but semantically-different negative labels are used to guide attention toward potential OOD background regions. To address (ii), we introduce a novel sigmoid-based OOD scoring function (NegS) that leverages both ID and negative labels, producing strong responses for ID instances and suppressed responses for OOD ones. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach improves OOD detection performance by a large margin while maintaining ID accuracy, e.g., reducing the FPR95 by 11.4% on the COCO dataset and 25.5% on the OpenImages dataset compared to the baseline model. While initially designed for dense VLM detectors like YOLO-World, we successfully adapt NegAS to Grounding DINO, a query-based VLM transformer and achieve significant improvements, demonstrating the generalizability of our framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将视觉语言模型（VLM）用于目标检测中的分布外（OOD）检测，提出负标签引导的注意力与评分模块（NegAS），通过LLM生成的负标签引导注意力关注潜在OOD区域，并设计基于sigmoid的OOD评分函数，在COCO和OpenImages数据集上显著降低FPR95。
Motivation: 现有OOD检测研究多集中于单模态检测器或VLM分类器，而VLM目标检测器在OOD场景中的潜力未被充分探索；VLM检测器存在文本引导注意力忽略背景OOD区域、sigmoid输出不兼容softmax OOD评分两个问题。
Method: 提出NegAS框架，包含NegA（负标签引导注意力模块，利用LLM生成视觉相似但语义不同的负标签引导关注背景OOD区域）和NegS（基于sigmoid的OOD评分函数，利用ID和负标签产生区分性响应）。
Result: 在COCO数据集上FPR95降低11.4%，在OpenImages数据集上降低25.5%，同时保持ID准确率；成功适配至Grounding DINO等查询式VLM检测器。
Conclusion: NegAS有效提升了VLM目标检测器的OOD检测性能，且具有良好的泛化性。

summary_sections.method: 提出NegAS框架，包含NegA（负标签引导注意力模块，利用LLM生成视觉相似但语义不同的负标签引导关注背景OOD区域）和NegS（基于sigmoid的OOD评分函数，利用ID和负标签产生区分性响应）。

summary_sections.conclusion: NegAS有效提升了VLM目标检测器的OOD检测性能，且具有良好的泛化性。

papers.title: Generative Robust Optimisation
papers.abstract_en: Classical uncertainty sets for robust optimisation impose fixed geometric shapes that cannot represent the complex dependencies present in real-world data. We propose Generative Robust Optimisation (GRO), a framework in which a deep generative model defines the uncertainty set as the image of a neural network decoder over a calibrated latent set, naturally accommodating nonlinear correlations, asymmetry, and multimodality. A five-point evaluation framework (reconstruction fidelity, distribution matching, latent regularity, robust relevance, and computational tractability) provides systematic, model-agnostic criteria for assessing any neural network-based uncertainty set. We instantiate this framework with a Wasserstein Adversarial Autoencoder employing Gaussian mixture model-guided training for latent regularity and constraint-consistency regularisation for robust relevance. Restricting the decoder to ReLU activations enables exact worst-case verification through mixed-integer programming embedding. Extensive experiments on a production planning problem across six uncertainty distributions and six generative architectures, together with a multi-period facility location study, validate the framework and demonstrate that systematic attention to all five criteria yields uncertainty sets that are simultaneously expressive, well-calibrated, and optimisation-tractable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生成式鲁棒优化（GRO）框架，利用深度生成模型定义不确定性集合，解决传统鲁棒优化中固定几何形状无法表示真实数据复杂依赖的问题。通过五点评测标准（重构保真度、分布匹配、潜在正则性、鲁棒相关性与计算可处理性）评估神经网络不确定性集合，并基于Wasserstein对抗自编码器与混合高斯模型引导训练实现该框架。在六种不确定性分布和六种生成架构下的生产规划问题及多期设施选址研究中验证了框架的有效性。
Motivation: 经典鲁棒优化使用固定几何形状的不确定性集合，无法捕捉真实数据中的非线性相关、不对称和多模态特性，限制了优化结果的现实适用性。
Method: 提出GRO框架，将不确定性集合定义为深度生成模型解码器在标定潜在集上的像，并采用Wasserstein对抗自编码器（结合混合高斯模型引导训练与约束一致性正则化）实现，确保潜在空间正则性与鲁棒相关性。
Result: 在六种不确定性分布和六种生成架构下的生产规划问题及多期设施选址研究中，GRO生成的不确定性集合同时具备表达性、良好标定和优化可处理性。
Conclusion: 系统性关注所有五点评测标准可得到表达性强、标定良好且优化可处理的不确定性集合，为鲁棒优化提供了新框架。
