papers.title: Governance Decay: How Context Compaction Silently Erases Safety Constraints in Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLM agents increasingly rely on context compaction, summarization, or eviction to keep long-running sessions within a token budget. We show that this context-management layer is a safety-critical failure surface: in-context governance constraints that agents reliably obey while visible can be silently removed by compaction, causing the same agent to perform prohibited tool actions later in the session. We call this failure mode Governance Decay. We introduce ConstraintRot, a benchmark of long-horizon agent scenarios with deterministic tool-call grading, and measure compaction-induced violations across seven model families. Across 1,323 episodes, violation rises from 0% with the policy in full context to 30% after compaction, reaching 59% for some models; when the constraint survives the summary, violation remains 0%, but when it is dropped, violation reaches 38%. We further study a Compaction-Eviction Attack, in which adversarial in-context content biases the summarizer to omit a legitimate policy, and show that optimized injections defeat every evaluated model. Finally, we propose Constraint Pinning, a simple training-free mitigation that quarantines governance constraints from lossy compaction and restores violation to 0% in our benchmark. These results identify context management as a first-class governance surface for deployed LLM agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM代理在长会话中依赖上下文压缩（context compaction）导致的安全问题，发现压缩过程会静默移除内嵌的治理约束，使得代理后续执行被禁止的工具操作，称之为“治理衰减”（Governance Decay）。作者构建了ConstraintRot基准，在1,323个episode中测量了七个模型族的违反率，并提出了对抗性压缩-驱逐攻击和一种无需训练的缓解方案Constraint Pinning。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理广泛使用上下文压缩来管理长会话token预算，但该上下文管理层可能意外移除安全约束，导致代理行为失控。这一安全失败表面此前未被系统研究。
Method: 构建了ConstraintRot基准，包含长视界代理场景和确定性工具调用评分；设计了Compaction-Eviction Attack，通过对抗性内容偏置总结器；并提出Constraint Pinning，将治理约束与有损压缩隔离。
Result: 在1,323个episode中，压缩后违反率从0%升至30%，某些模型达59%；约束幸存时违反率为0%，被丢弃时达38%；对抗攻击可击败所有评估模型；Constraint Pinning将违反率恢复至0%。
Conclusion: 上下文管理应被视为部署LLM代理的一级治理面，需在压缩过程中保护治理约束以避免安全风险。

papers.title: Trajectory Forcing: Structure-First Generation with Controllable Semantic Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow-based generative models produce strong images, yet their controllability remains largely endpoint-centric: users specify conditions and receive final outputs, while the intermediate generative dynamics remain hidden. Recent methods have begun to exploit generation order and process decomposition to improve sample quality, but still treat intermediate states as internal computation rather than objects for interaction. We propose Trajectory Forcing (TF), a trajectory-centric framework that makes the generation path explicit, semantic, and editable. TF organizes synthesis as a sequence of semantically structured stages, progressing from global layout to object-, part-, and detail-level representations. Each stage produces a decodable latent state that can be inspected, evaluated, and locally edited before the next stage begins. To instantiate this path, we derive coarse-to-fine teacher hierarchies by clustering pretrained visual representations such as DINOv2, and train a hierarchy-conditioned one-step flow-matching model at each level. We further introduce trajectory-aware metrics that measure structural consistency and local controllability beyond endpoint quality metrics such as FID. Experiments show that TF achieves competitive sample quality while exposing coherent intermediate states and supporting localized edits across semantic levels. By shifting the focus from final images to the generative path itself, TF opens a route toward controllable, trajectory-aware image synthesis.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Trajectory Forcing (TF)，一种以轨迹为中心的生成框架，使得生成路径明确、语义化且可编辑。TF 将合成过程组织为从全局布局到细节的语义阶段，每一阶段产生可解码的隐状态，支持检查、评估和局部编辑。通过聚类预训练视觉表示（如 DINOv2）构建粗到细的教师层级，训练层级条件一步流匹配模型。实验表明 TF 在保持竞争样本质量的同时，暴露了连贯的中间状态并支持跨语义层级的局部编辑。
Motivation: 现有的扩散和流生成模型控制仍以端点为中心，用户指定条件后得到最终输出，中间的生成动态不可见且不可交互。本文旨在使生成路径可显式、可编辑。
Method: 提出 Trajectory Forcing 框架，将图像合成分解为从全局布局到物体、部件、细节的语义阶段；通过聚类 DINOv2 特征构建粗到细的教师层级；在每个层级训练一个层级条件的一步流匹配模型；引入轨迹感知的指标衡量结构一致性和局部可控性。
Result: 实验显示 TF 在达到竞争性样本质量的同时，暴露了连贯的中间状态，并支持跨语义层级的局部编辑。
Conclusion: 通过将关注点从最终图像转移到生成路径本身，TF 为可控的、轨迹感知的图像合成开辟了新途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Projection-Volume Fidelity Divergence: Diagnosing and Controlling Optimization Drift in Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Tomography
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-view computed tomography is a severely ill-posed inverse problem, where recent 3D Gaussian Splatting methods offer an efficient explicit representation for tomographic reconstruction. However, we find that projection-domain optimization can be misleading in this setting: the rendered projections may continue to improve while the reconstructed volume deteriorates. We identify this failure mode as Projection-Volume Fidelity Divergence (PVFD), a representation-level optimization drift caused by anisotropic Gaussian deformation and view-specific primitive co-adaptation under sparse Radon constraints. To characterize this behavior, we introduce geometry- and volume-level diagnostics that measure needle-like Gaussian degeneration and the stability of the voxelized density field. Based on these observations, we propose LADES, a ground-truth-free optimization controller for sparse-view Gaussian tomography. LADES combines Linearly Annealed Dropout, which applies strong stochastic masking in early training to disrupt premature primitive co-adaptation and gradually restores full capacity for structural consolidation, with Structure-Aware Early Stopping, which terminates densification according to the saturation of Gaussian population growth rather than validation PSNR. Experiments on sparse-view CT reconstruction show that LADES improves volumetric fidelity, suppresses structural degeneration, and substantially reduces training time while maintaining competitive projection accuracy. These results suggest that robust Gaussian-based tomography requires monitoring and controlling volumetric structure, rather than optimizing projection fit alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现稀疏视图 CT 重建中，投影域的优化可能误导体积重建，导致投影质量提升而体积劣化，称为投影-体积保真度发散（PVFD）。为解决此问题，提出 LADES 控制器，结合线性退火丢弃和结构感知早停，实验证明能提高体积保真度、抑制结构退化并减少训练时间。
Motivation: 稀疏视图 CT 是严重病态逆问题，现有 3D 高斯泼溅方法在投影域优化时可能产生误导，使投影改进而体积劣化。需要诊断和控制这种优化漂移。
Method: 提出 LADES 控制器，包含线性退火丢弃（训练早期强随机掩蔽打破原语共适应，随后逐渐恢复）和结构感知早停（根据高斯种群增长饱和而非验证 PSNR 终止密集化）。
Result: 在稀疏视图 CT 重建实验中，LADES 提升了体积保真度，抑制了结构退化，显著减少了训练时间，同时保持了竞争性的投影精度。
Conclusion: 稳健的高斯体素重建需要监控和控制体积结构，而不仅仅是优化投影拟合。

papers.title: Robust Diffusion Models via Divergence-Induced Weighted Denoising
papers.abstract_en: We show that replacing the standard MSE denoising loss in diffusion models with a nonlinear transformation induced by an f-divergence yields a simple robust training surrogate that empirically improves performance under data contamination, with small additional computational overhead. The theoretical foundation rests on a local divergence construction: under the Gaussian reverse-kernel structure of DDPM, each per-step likelihood ratio follows a lognormal distribution parameterized by a scalar mismatch, so the conditional f-divergence at each step reduces to a one-dimensional function of the denoising error. Summing these local divergences yields a training objective that unifies diffusion training as divergence induced weighted denoising, where the derivative of the induced divergence acts as a residual-space influence weight that controls the contribution of each sample. Bounded-influence divergences (Hellinger, negative exponential) suppress large error samples, with Hellinger yielding an explicit exponential weight, connecting the framework to robust M-estimation. Empirically, on CIFAR-10 under 30% contamination, NED reduces FID from 93.0 (KL) to 77.5, while also outperforming standard robust losses such as Huber and clipped MSE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用f-散度诱导的非线性变换替代标准MSE去噪损失，得到鲁棒训练代理，在数据污染下提升扩散模型性能。理论基于局部散度构造，将每步条件f-散度简化为去噪误差的一维函数，训练目标统一为散度诱导加权去噪。有界影响散度（如Hellinger）可抑制大误差样本。在CIFAR-10 30%污染下，NED方法将FID从93.0（KL）降至77.5，优于Huber和截断MSE损失。
Motivation: 扩散模型在训练数据受污染时性能下降，标准MSE损失对异常样本敏感，需要简单有效的鲁棒训练方法。
Method: 用f-散度诱导的加权去噪损失替换MSE损失，其中权重由散度导数决定，有界影响散度自动抑制大误差样本。
Result: 在CIFAR-10 30%污染下，NED（负指数散度）将FID从93.0（KL）降至77.5，并优于Huber和截断MSE等鲁棒损失。
Conclusion: 提出的散度诱导加权去噪框架以较小计算开销提升扩散模型对数据污染的鲁棒性，Hellinger等有界影响散度效果显著。

papers.title: Detecting and Understanding Vulnerabilities in Fully Homomorphic Encryption Frameworks
papers.abstract_en: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) allows computations to be performed directly on encrypted data without decryption, offering strong privacy guarantees for sensitive data analysis. This capability is important for privacy-sensitive applications like secure cloud computing, finance, and healthcare. The complexity of FHE schemes, however, has hindered their practical adoption. To make FHE accessible to a broader range of developers, a new generation of specialized frameworks has emerged to translate high-level FHE programs into complex FHE operations, introducing a new programming paradigm. However, the inherent complexity of FHE frameworks makes them prone to incorrect implementation logic. Unlike mere crashes, logic bugs in these frameworks can silently corrupt encrypted computation, potentially leading to severe financial losses and security vulnerabilities in FHE-enhanced applications. In this work, we introduce HERTA, the first automated testing tool tailored for FHE frameworks. HERTA leverages metamorphic testing to uncover deep-seated implementation bugs and vulnerabilities across the multi-layered FHE software stack. To that end, we design a set of novel metamorphic relations (MRs) derived specifically from FHE semantics. These MRs stress the most challenging aspects of the pipeline, enabling automated correctness testing without the need for a manual ground truth. Our evaluation of HERTA on 3 leading industry frameworks discovered 21 previously unknown bugs, several of which have already been confirmed and fixed by developers. Furthermore, our hazard analysis reveals the critical security impact these bugs pose to the integrity and availability of FHE-based services.

papers.title: Basin-Specific Intensification of Tropical Cyclones
papers.abstract_en: This paper uses ADT v9.0 HURSAT v07b data to measure tropical cyclone (TC) activity in four basins from 1990-2024. It is only in the North Atlantic basin that relative sea-surface temperature contrasts and the number of extreme (category 3+) tropical cyclones increased. And it is only there that the complete chain held -- from annual aerosol pollution to sea-surface temperature contrasts, and in turn from those contrasts to the number of cyclones. Conversely, associations are inconsistent, insignificant, or counterintuitive in the three Pacific Ocean basins, especially insofar as annual temperature contrasts did not associate with annual cyclone activity. (Where appropriate, our analysis controls for aerosol changes and the El Nino-Southern Oscillation.) Worldwide, it is no longer justified for the IPCC to hold that "It is likely that the global proportion of Category 3-5 tropical cyclone instances ... ha[s] increased globally over the past 40 years."
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用1990-2024年ADT v9.0 HURSAT v07b数据测量四个海盆的热带气旋活动。发现仅在北大西洋，相对海表温度对比和极端（3级以上）热带气旋数量增加，并且完整的因果链（气溶胶污染→海表温度对比→气旋数量）成立；而在太平洋三个海盆中关联不一致或不显著。论文质疑IPCC关于全球3-5级热带气旋比例在过去40年增加的结论。
Motivation: IPCC认为全球3-5级热带气旋比例可能增加了，但该论文认为这一结论不再合理，因为仅在北大西洋存在增强趋势，其他海盆无显著趋势。
Method: 使用ADT v9.0 HURSAT v07b数据集，分析1990-2024年四个海盆的TC活动，控制气溶胶变化和ENSO，检查海表温度对比与极端气旋数量的关系。
Result: 仅在北大西洋观察到相对海表温度对比和3级以上气旋数量增加，且完整因果链成立；在其他三个太平洋海盆中，年温度对比与气旋活动关联不一致、不显著或反直觉。
Conclusion: 论文认为IPCC关于全球3-5级热带气旋比例增加的结论不再有全球性证据支持。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: The Scissors Effect: When Resize-Based Input Diversity Helps or Hurts Transfer Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Input Diversity (DI), which applies random resizing and padding at each attack iteration, is a near-default ingredient of transfer-based adversarial attacks, widely assumed to improve transferability. We show this assumption is regime-dependent and, for robustly trained surrogates, often reversed. Varying only the surrogate, increasing the DI probability raises transfer success for standard surrogates but lowers it for robust ones: the two response curves separate like a pair of scissors, a pattern we call the Scissors Effect. The effect is strong and consistent on ImageNet, where blind DI costs the robust source 10.3% attack success on average across CNN, ViT, Swin, and ConvNeXt targets and across ten attacks spanning 2018-2024; it is smaller on CIFAR-10 unless DI is made aggressive. A controlled robustness-strength sweep that varies only the training budget shows the harm is graded rather than binary, crossing from beneficial to harmful already in the little-robustness regime. We trace it to gradient geometry: a resize/translation decomposition attributes roughly 67% of the harm to resize, and a direct source-target gradient-alignment measurement confirms the same resize operation improves alignment for standard surrogates but degrades it for robust ones. We summarize the regime with Local Gradient Consistency (LGC), a single input-space probe that separates the two surrogate types, and prove a bias-variance crossover theorem isolating where DI helps from where its resize bias dominates. A training-free rule (CG-DI) that disables diversity when LGC is high avoids the loss on robust surrogates while keeping DI's benefit on standard ones, positioning the Scissors Effect as a DI-specific manifestation of the broader robustness-transferability trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了基于输入多样性（DI）的迁移攻击在不同代理模型上的效果，发现标准代理上DI提升攻击成功率，但鲁棒代理上反而降低，形成“剪刀效应”。在ImageNet上，盲目使用DI导致鲁棒代理的攻击成功率平均下降10.3%。作者将原因归咎于调整大小操作对梯度对齐的相反影响，并提出局部梯度一致性（LGC）指标来预测该效应，以及一个免训练的CG-DI规则来避免鲁棒代理上的损失。
Motivation: 输入多样性（DI）作为迁移攻击的默认组件，被普遍认为能提高可迁移性，但这一假设可能依赖于代理模型类型，尤其对于鲁棒训练的代理可能适得其反，需要系统研究其适用边界。
Method: 通过控制实验改变DI概率和代理模型的鲁棒性强度，在ImageNet和CIFAR-10上测量攻击成功率；使用调整大小/平移分解和梯度对齐度量来归因伤害来源；提出局部梯度一致性（LGC）指标作为预测工具，并设计CG-DI规则（LGC高时禁用DI）。
Result: 在ImageNet上，DI使标准代理的攻击成功率上升，但使鲁棒代理的攻击成功率平均下降10.3%（跨越CNN、ViT、Swin和ConvNeXt目标以及10种攻击方法）；CIFAR-10上仅在DI强度大时出现类似效应。伤害主要由调整大小操作引起（约占67%），且梯度对齐测量证实调整大小对标准代理有利、对鲁棒代理有害。
Conclusion: 剪刀效应是DI特有的，反映了鲁棒性与可迁移性之间的权衡；通过LGC可以识别代理类型，而CG-DI规则能有效避免对鲁棒代理的伤害，为实际应用提供指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Biological Sex Determination in Cadavers Using Deep Learning Algorithms from Computed Tomography Images of Pelvis and Skull
papers.abstract_en: Sexual identification of decomposed cadavers challenges traditional methods dependent on visual anthropological analysis. This study evaluates state-of-the-art deep learning (including YOLO26, YOLO11, ConvNeXt-Tiny, EfficientNetV2, ViT-B16, VGG16, and ResNet50) with transfer learning to automatically determine biological sex from forensic computed tomography (CT) scans. We analyzed 141 autopsied cadavers from the Forensic Medical Institute of Goiânia-GO, including a broad age range and varying conditions of preservation. The three-dimensional reconstructions of the pelvis and skull were converted into standardized two-dimensional profile projections, contributing to the study of this new technical approach. Data augmentation techniques compensated for sample limitations. Two scenarios were validated: binary and quaternary classification (one class per sex vs. one class per anatomical region of each sex). The best-performing model achieved highly consistent results on the pelvis region and still satisfactory performance on the skull region, reaching an overall patient-level accuracy of 95.65%, recall of 92.86%, F1- score of 94.36%, and precision of 97.22%, maintaining consistent performance across the evaluated cases, including those with trauma-related artifacts. Results indicate the technical feasibility of the methodology, demonstrating that deep learning models can provide objective, high-speed skeletal analysis. Since the study was conducted using data from a single institution and a single computed tomography scanner, further validation across multiple centers and scanners is required to assess the generalizability of the proposed approach
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究利用深度学习算法（包括YOLO26、YOLO11、ConvNeXt-Tiny、EfficientNetV2、ViT-B16、VGG16和ResNet50）从骨盆和头颅的CT图像自动确定尸体的生物学性别。分析了141具尸体的CT扫描，将三维重建转换为标准化二维轮廓投影。最佳模型在骨盆区域取得高度一致结果，总体患者级准确率为95.65%，召回率92.86%，F1分数94.36%，精确率97.22%。
Motivation: 传统依赖视觉人类学分析的尸体性别鉴定方法在分解尸体等情况下存在挑战，需要客观、快速的骨骼分析方法。
Method: 使用多种深度学习模型（包括YOLO26、YOLO11、ConvNeXt-Tiny、EfficientNetV2、ViT-B16、VGG16和ResNet50）进行迁移学习，将骨盆和头颅的三维CT重建转换为标准化二维投影，并采用数据增强技术。验证场景包括二元分类（每性别一类）和四元分类（每个解剖区域每性别一类）。
Result: 最佳模型在骨盆区域达到95.65%的总体患者级准确率，92.86%召回率，94.36% F1分数，97.22%精确率，且在包含创伤伪影的病例中保持一致性。
Conclusion: 研究表明深度学习模型可为骨骼分析提供客观、高速的自动性别鉴定，但需要多中心和多扫描仪进一步验证泛化性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Breaking the Likelihood Trap: Variance-Calibrated Modulation for Large Language Model Decoding
papers.abstract_en: In open-ended generation, LLMs frequently fall into the "likelihood trap", marked by repetitive degeneration and vocabulary dullness, creating a discrepancy between machine-generated and human-written text. While post-hoc tail truncation (e.g., Top-$p$, Min-$p$) avoids sampling from the unreliable tail, it can over-sample from the uncalibrated head and misalign generation with human lexical preferences; fixed scalar repetition penalties likewise ignore variation in logit scale across inference steps, potentially disrupting semantic coherence. To address both limitations, we propose Variance-Calibrated Modulation (VCM), a training-free pre-decoding intervention that reshapes the probability distribution before truncation through two dynamic mechanisms: (1) Contextual Searchlight via PMI, which suppresses global stopwords while elevating context-evoked tokens, and (2) Adaptive Self-Debiasing, which uses real-time logit standard deviation for scale-invariant penalization. Across open-ended generation, factual QA, and mathematical reasoning, VCM consistently mitigates the likelihood trap. With negligible computational overhead, VCM integrates with existing decoding strategies, improving diversity, coherence, and, particularly at higher decoding temperatures, reasoning accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型在开放生成中出现的“似然陷阱”（重复、词汇单调）问题，提出方差校准调制（VCM）方法，这是一种无需训练的解码前干预手段。VCM通过两个动态机制——基于PMI的上下文探照灯（抑制全局停用词并提升上下文词）和自适应自去偏（利用实时logit标准差进行尺度不变惩罚）——在截断前重塑概率分布。实验表明，VCM在开放生成、事实性问答和数学推理上持续缓解似然陷阱，提升多样性、连贯性，并在高温下提升推理准确性，且计算开销可忽略。
Motivation: 现有解码策略中，后验截断（如Top-p、Min-p）可能过度采样未校准的高概率头部，固定标量重复惩罚忽略logit尺度变化，均导致生成与人类词汇偏好不符。
Method: 提出VCM，包含两个动态机制：1）Contextual Searchlight via PMI：利用逐点互信息降低全局停用词概率，提升上下文相关词概率；2）Adaptive Self-Debiasing：根据实时logit标准差进行尺度不变的惩罚。两者在截断前调整概率分布。
Result: 摘要报告VCM在开放生成、事实性QA和数学推理任务上持续缓解似然陷阱，提升生成多样性、连贯性，尤其在高温下提升推理准确性。
Conclusion: VCM是一种轻量级、训练-free的解码干预方法，可集成到现有解码策略中，有效改善LLM生成质量。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Fed-CausalDiff: Decoupled Synchronization for Federated Do-Simulation and Policy Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: While federated learning enables collaborative modelling on decentralised data, standard methods merely fit historical observations. This purely observational approach is fundamentally insufficient for interventional inference and policy evaluation, as sequential actions dynamically alter future states. We propose \textbf{Fed-CausalDiff}, a federated causal diffusion framework for do-simulation. The architecture decomposes the evolution of the latent state into a global causal score function and a local confounding score function. This design enables \emph{decoupled synchronisation} (DSS), where clients aggregate only the shared causal mechanism while retaining site-specific confounders locally to handle heterogeneity. Experiments on four datasets demonstrate that Fed-CausalDiff achieves better ATE and policy-value estimation accuracy, offering a favorable trade-off between communication cost and inference fidelity.

papers.title: Imagine to Ensure Safety in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: This work investigates the safe exploration problem in reinforcement learning, where an agent must maximize cumulative performance while simultaneously satisfying safety constraints. This challenge becomes even more pronounced in long-horizon tasks, where existing safe methods face fundamental limitations due to compounding estimation errors and restricted exploration capabilities. To address this problem, we propose a method that combines a learnable world model with two complementary policies a high-level policy and a low-level policy to promote safety at both hierarchical levels. The high-level policy generates intermediate subgoals that bias exploration toward safe regions, while the low-level policy uses imagined rollouts in the learned world model to reduce unsafe behaviors when reaching these subgoals. The proposed method was evaluated on challenging long-horizon navigation and manipulation tasks with high-dimensional action spaces, where it significantly outperforms existing Safe RL baselines in both success rate and strong empirical constraint satisfaction, consistently meeting the prescribed safety budget across seeds, while prior approaches fail to effectively solve these complex long-horizon scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习中的安全探索问题，特别是在长时域任务中现有安全方法因估计误差和探索限制而失效的挑战，提出结合可学习世界模型与两层策略（高层策略生成子目标引导探索安全区域，低层策略使用世界模型中的想象 rollout 减少不安全行为）的方法。在长时域导航和操作任务上，该方法在成功率和约束满足方面显著优于现有安全RL基线。
Motivation: 长时域任务中，现有安全强化学习方法因复合估计误差和受限的探索能力而面临根本性限制，需要一种能在层次上保证安全探索的方法。
Method: 提出一个可学习的世界模型，搭配高层策略（生成子目标以偏向安全区域）和低层策略（利用世界模型中的想象 rollout 减少不安全行为），实现层次化的安全探索。
Result: 在长时域、高维动作空间的导航和操作任务中，该方法在成功率和约束满足上大幅超越现有安全RL基线，并始终满足预设的安全预算。
Conclusion: 结合可学习世界模型和层次化策略能有效解决长时域安全探索问题，但仅在高维动作空间任务上验证。

papers.title: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Microscopic Plant Image Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Microscopic imaging provides essential visual evidence for studying plant biology and pathology at the cellular and subcellular levels. However, existing benchmarks on vision-language models primarily focus on macroscopic plant imagery, while the microscopic domain remains underexplored. To address this gap, we present PlantMicro, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating vision-language models (VLMs) in microscopic plant imagery. PlantMicro integrates more than 5,000 images collected across diverse hosts, biological domains, and imaging modalities. Building on this diversity, we design a set of complementary tasks that capture different facets of microscopic image understanding. To support these tasks, we construct over 9,000 VQA pairs that systematically evaluate the capabilities of VLMs. Experiments on PlantMicro show that current VLMs struggle with fine-grained recognition and biologically grounded reasoning. For example, GPT-5 achieves 34.93% accuracy on the pathogen classification task, which is only modestly above the random-guessing baseline. The results highlight a significant gap in current VLMs' ability to comprehend plant microscopic images. PlantMicro provides a standardized foundation for advancing VLMs toward reliable and comprehensive microscopy-level plant understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 PlantMicro 基准，用于评估视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在植物显微图像理解上的能力。该基准包含超过 5000 张图像和 9000 多个 VQA 对，覆盖不同宿主、生物领域和成像模态。实验表明，当前 VLM（如 GPT-5）在细粒度识别和生物推理任务上表现不佳，例如病原分类准确率仅 34.93%，略高于随机猜测。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型基准主要关注宏观植物图像，而微观植物图像领域（细胞和亚细胞水平）尚未被充分探索。
Method: 构建 PlantMicro 基准：收集 5000+ 多模态显微图像，设计互补任务（包括病原分类等），并人工构建 9000+ VQA 对以系统评估 VLM 能力。
Result: GPT-5 在病原分类任务上准确率 34.93%，仅略高于随机猜测基线，表明当前 VLM 在植物显微图像理解上存在显著短板。
Conclusion: 当前 VLM 在植物显微图像理解上仍存在显著差距，PlantMicro 为推进 VLM 在该领域的可靠、全面理解提供了标准化评估框架。

papers.title: Enabling Cloud-Level Accuracy in Edge AI through IoT Data Preprocessing
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) offer a natural-language interface for interpreting Internet of Things (IoT) sensor data in smart environments; however, cloud deployment introduces latency, privacy, and connectivity concerns. Local LLMs can reduce these limitations, but compact edge-deployable models often show weaker numerical reasoning when raw sensor readings are provided directly. This paper investigates whether prompt-side preprocessing can improve the accuracy-latency trade-off of local LLMs for environmental monitoring. We propose a structured prompt construction framework that transforms raw air-quality and thermal-comfort measurements into progressively enriched textual representations: raw sensor values, threshold-aware descriptions, and compact environmental summary flags. The approach is evaluated using indoor Raspberry Pi/BME680 datasets from Tampere University and outdoor air-quality datasets from Helsinki, Katowice, and Warsaw. We construct a binary LLM query dataset covering air quality, thermal comfort, and joint environmental conditions, and evaluate five local and five cloud LLMs across three prompt variants and two inference modes, with and without chain-of-thought prompting. Results show that prompt enrichment substantially improves local-model accuracy. In No-CoT mode, local accuracy increases from 50.9% to 81.7% indoors and from 63.7% to 89.3% outdoors from the raw to the most enriched prompt. Local No-CoT inference is the fastest configuration, with mean latency close to 0.22 s, while CoT substantially increases inference time. These findings suggest that lightweight prompt-side preprocessing can narrow the local--cloud performance gap and support low-latency IoT analytics in smart environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究通过prompt端预处理提升边缘部署的本地LLM在环境监测中的准确率-延迟权衡。提出结构化prompt框架，将空气质量、热舒适等原始传感器数据转化为渐进丰富的文本表示（原始值、阈值感知描述、环境摘要标志）。在室内和室外数据集上测试5个本地LLM和5个云端LLM，使用三种prompt变体和两种推理模式（有无CoT）。结果显示prompt富集显著提升本地模型准确率（室内从50.9%到81.7%，室外从63.7%到89.3%），且本地无CoT推理延迟约0.22秒，表明轻量预处理可缩小本地-云端差距。
Motivation: 云端LLM用于物联网环境监测存在延迟、隐私和连接问题；本地LLM虽可缓解，但紧凑模型对原始传感器数值推理能力弱，因此需要探索prompt侧预处理能否改善性能。
Method: 提出结构化prompt构造框架，将原始传感器数据转换为三种递进文本表示：原始数值、阈值感知描述、环境摘要标志；采用链式思维推理（CoT）或不使用；评估5个本地和5个云端LLM。
Result: 在室内外数据集上，prompt富集将本地模型准确率提升约30个百分点（室内50.9%→81.7%，室外63.7%→89.3%），本地无CoT延迟0.22秒，最快；CoT大幅增加延迟。
Conclusion: 轻量级prompt侧预处理可有效缩小本地与云端LLM在环境监测中的性能差距，实现低延迟IoT分析。

papers.title: Grounded Scaling: Why Agentic AI Needs Deterministic Environments
papers.abstract_en: Long-chain agent execution fails exponentially in environments designed for human tolerance: with per-step determinism $δ< 1$, $k$-step chain success degrades as $δ^k$. The AGI-to-ASI scaling debate (Genewein et al., 2026) has so far framed progress as a race between compute growth and a list of frictions (data wall, abstraction barrier, embodied bottleneck, multi-agent trust); we argue that environment determinism is a complementary binding axis cutting across all four, for the broad class of agentic AI tasks whose outcomes are verifiable economically, physically, or through multi-party settlement. Three formal results pin down the regime: a Determinism-Efficiency Bound on chain-task success, a Verifier-Goodharting Floor on flywheel ceilings under imperfect rewards, and a convergence condition for environment-side skill evolution. We operationalise the framework as a Supply Certainty Index (SCI) over five measurable properties, a five-level Determinism Maturity Model (DMM) as adoption ladder, and a falsifiable open-question programme (OQ1-OQ5) with explicit null results that would force retraction. The position is platform-agnostic. We engage three competing positions: sim-to-real sufficiency, alignment sufficiency, and AI-as-normal-technology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证在可验证的智能体任务中，环境确定性的缺失会导致长链执行失败呈指数级退化（δ^k），并提出确定性与效率的边界、验证者-古德哈特定理平原以及环境技能演化的收敛条件。作者构建了供应链确定指数（SCI）和确定性成熟度模型（DMM），并提出了五个可证伪的开放问题。
Motivation: 现有AGI-ASI扩展讨论忽略了环境确定性这一关键约束，而智能体任务的长链执行在非确定性环境下无法可靠扩展。
Method: 通过三个形式化结果（确定性与效率边界、验证者-古德哈特定理平原、环境技能演化收敛条件）构建理论框架，并操作化为SC指数和DMM成熟度模型。
Result: 证明在确定性δ<1的环境中，k步链式任务成功率以δ^k衰减，且次优奖励下飞轮上限受限于验证者-古德哈特效应。
Conclusion: 强调环境确定性是独立于计算增长的关键轴，提出平台无关的理论框架和可证伪研究议程。

papers.title: Deep Learning-Based Sign Language Recognition from Videos and Cross-Lingual Translation to Indian Vernaculars
papers.abstract_en: Sign language is a primary mode of communication for the global deaf and hard-of-hearing community, yet automated tools that recognize sign gestures from video and translate them into natural language text remain limited, particularly for low-resource Indian languages. We present a two-stage deep learning pipeline that (i) classifies short sign language video clips into English word labels using a fine-tuned VideoMAE video transformer, and (ii) translates the predicted English label into Hindi, Telugu, and Bengali using Meta AI's No Language Left Behind (NLLB-200) multilingual translation model. The classification model is fine-tuned on a 13-class subset of the AI4Bharat Indian Sign Language video corpus from IIT Madras, processing 16-frame clips sampled uniformly from each video at 224 x 224 resolution. Under a small-scale academic setting (13 classes, 197 clips, 80-20 split), the fine-tuned model reaches 99% training accuracy and 78% validation accuracy after 15 epochs. We provide a per-class breakdown via a confusion matrix and classification report, identify the dominant failure modes (confusable adjective pairs such as ugly, deaf, blind, hat, and dress), and describe a Streamlit-based inference demo that takes a user-uploaded video and returns the predicted English label alongside its Hindi, Telugu, and Bengali translations. We discuss the scope, limitations (small label set, isolated-word rather than continuous signing, single-signer style sensitivity, ambiguity of single-word machine translation), and directions for future work, including expanding to sentence-level generation and a larger vocabulary. Code is released to support reproducibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段深度学习流水线，首先使用微调的VideoMAE视频Transformer从视频中识别手语动作并输出英文标签，然后利用Meta的NLLB-200多语言翻译模型将英文标签翻译成印地语、泰卢固语和孟加拉语。在AI4Bharat印度手语视频子集（13类，197个片段）上，训练准确率达99%，验证准确率达78%。文中还提供了混淆矩阵分析主要错误模式（如ugly、deaf等易混淆形容词对），并展示了基于Streamlit的推理演示。
Motivation: 全球聋哑人群依赖手语交流，但自动化手语识别与翻译工具在低资源印度语言中仍然有限。
Method: 两阶段流水线：阶段一使用微调的VideoMAE视频Transformer将短手语视频片段分类为英文单词标签；阶段二使用Meta AI的NLLB-200多语言翻译模型将英文标签翻译为印地语、泰卢固语和孟加拉语。
Result: 在13类197个片段（80-20划分）的小规模学术设置下，微调模型经15个epoch后达到99%训练准确率和78%验证准确率。混淆矩阵显示主要错误发生在ugly、deaf、blind、hat、dress等形容词对之间。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作展示了视频手语识别与跨语言翻译的可行性，但受限于小标签集、孤立词而非连续手语、单人手语风格敏感性以及单词机器翻译的歧义性。未来将扩展到句子级生成和更大词汇量。

papers.title: An LLM-Orchestrated Agent for Directional-Coupler Design with Self-Consistent Eigenmode and FDTD Validation
papers.abstract_en: We present a design agent which is a Large Language Model (LLM) that orchestrates, but does not perform, the numerical simulations to design a silicon-on-insulator (SOI) $2\times2$ directional coupler. We choose a symmetric phase-matched coupler where a lot of analytical results are available that help the design strategy. The LLM proposes candidate gap values (a geometrical dimension size) and judges convergence, while all physics is owned by deterministic solvers: a frequency-domain eigenmode solver estimates the coupling coefficient~$κ$ for the current design, and an independent Finite-Difference Time-Domain (FDTD) stage validates it. Both solvers operate on a common slab-projected two-dimensional (2D) effective-index reduction of the silicon film, so the design~$κ$ and the FDTD response are consistent by problem design; the residual between them is shown to be a single constant phase offset~$φ$, attributable to a fixed excess coupling length $L_{\mathrm{extra}}=\SI{2.837(11)}{\micro\meter}$ that we find invariant across a factor-of-two range in~$κ$. Folding this offset into a closed-loop length correction, the agent delivers a $50/50$ splitter whose FDTD-measured cross fraction is $0.498$ (target $0.500$), a residual of $0.0017$. Results are made self-consistent within the 2D effective-index model; and the LLM succeeds in delivering a suitable design over a number of attempts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个由大型语言模型（LLM）协调的设计智能体，用于自动设计硅绝缘体（SOI）2×2定向耦合器。LLM负责提出候选间隙值并判断收敛，而物理模拟由频率域本征模求解器和独立的时域有限差分（FDTD）验证器执行。通过闭环长度校正，最终实现了50/50分束器，FDTD测量的交叉比例为0.498（目标0.500），残差为0.0017。
Motivation: 光子器件设计通常依赖手动迭代或数值优化，效率较低。本文旨在利用LLM协调仿真流程，实现自动化设计，同时通过自洽的验证机制确保结果可靠性。
Method: 采用LLM作为协调器，提出候选间隙（gap）几何尺寸，使用频率域本征模求解器计算耦合系数κ，并用独立的FDTD阶段验证。通过二维有效折射率模型保证一致性，并利用发现的固定相位偏移（对应额外耦合长度）进行闭环长度校正。
Result: 设计得到的50/50分束器，其FDTD交叉比例为0.498，与目标值0.500的残差仅为0.0017。
Conclusion: 该方法在二维有效折射率模型内实现了自洽设计，LLM能够在数次尝试后成功交付满足指标的设计。

papers.title: SCOPE: Evolving Symbolic World for Planning in Open-Ended Environments
papers.abstract_en: Recent works have explored integrating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with classical planners that rely on symbolic representations of planning problems to generate long-horizon plans for complex embodied tasks. However, in open-ended environments, these symbolic representations obtained from perception are often incomplete, leading to suboptimal performance. To address this, we introduce SCOPE, a self-adaptive symbolic planning framework that supports refining action plans and evolving the symbolic world, i.e., the symbolic representations of open-ended environments. SCOPE comprises two synergistic modules: a Symbolic Execution Simulator (SESim) that conducts symbolic validation and real execution of action plans, leveraging the feedback to refine the plans and evolve the symbolic world; and a Self-Adaptive Symbolic Memory (SASMem) that further distills feedback into evolving symbolic knowledge to enhance long-horizon planning and modeling of the symbolic world. Experiments in open-ended environments show that SCOPE significantly improves the completeness of the symbolic world, the success rate of plans under environment perturbations, and cross-task grounding and adaptability across diverse embodied scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE，一种自适应符号规划框架，用于开放世界中的长时程规划。SCOPE包含符号执行模拟器（SESim）进行符号验证和实际执行，以及自适应符号记忆（SASMem）蒸馏反馈以进化符号知识。实验表明，该方法显著提升符号世界完整性、在环境扰动下的计划成功率以及跨任务泛化能力。
Motivation: 开放世界中的符号表示常不完整，导致传统依赖符号表示的规划器性能欠佳。
Method: 提出SCOPE框架，由符号执行模拟器（SESim）和自适应性符号记忆（SASMem）两个协同模块组成，通过执行反馈不断精化动作计划并进化符号世界。
Result: 在开放世界实验中，SCOPE显著改善了符号世界完整性、环境扰动下的计划成功率以及跨任务接地和适应性。
Conclusion: SCOPE通过自我进化的符号世界有效提升了开放世界规划性能，但未提及局限性。

papers.title: FetSelect: Task-Specific Architectures and Self-Supervised Learning for Automated Fetal Ultrasound Frame Selection
papers.abstract_en: Automated frame selection for fetal biometry remains under addressed, with most prior work targeting generic quality assessment or downstream measurement pipelines that assume suitable frames are available. We introduce FetSelect, a task-specific framework that pairs a frozen vision foundation backbone with a hybrid multi-head design: a Task-Gated classification head and a Detection-derived quality head combined via learned fusion. We curate 6,486 expert-labeled frames across four targets: Crown-Rump Length (CRL), Nuchal Translucency (NT), Nasal Bone (NB), and Scalebar, and adapt the backbone with BYOL pretraining on 19,019 unlabeled images. On a held-out test set (974 frames), FetSelect achieves mean AUROC 0.956 and mean correlation 0.818 with expert quality annotations. Ablations confirm that hybrid fusion surpasses single-head variants, and ultrasound-specific self-supervision yields consistent gains. Evaluation on external clinical videos and 509 external CRL images demonstrates task-specific discrimination.
papers.comment: Accepted in 30th Conference on Medical Image Understanding and Analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FetSelect框架，用于自动选择胎儿超声图像中的关键帧（如头臀长、颈项透明层、鼻骨和标尺）。该框架使用冻结的视觉基础模型（vision foundation backbone）结合混合多头设计（任务门控分类头和检测派生质量头），并通过BYOL自监督学习在19,019张未标记图像上预训练。在974帧测试集上达到平均AUROC 0.956，与专家质量标注的平均相关性0.818。
Motivation: 现有胎儿超声帧选择方法多关注通用质量评估或假设已有合适帧，缺乏针对特定生物测量任务（如CRL、NT等）的自动帧选择。
Method: FetSelect采用冻结的视觉基础模型（vision foundation backbone）与混合多头设计：一个任务门控（Task-Gated）分类头和一个检测派生（Detection-derived）质量头，通过学习融合（learned fusion）结合。使用BYOL在19,019张无标签图像上进行自监督预训练。
Result: 在974帧测试集上，平均AUROC为0.956，与专家质量标注的平均相关性为0.818。消融实验表明混合融合优于单头变体，超声特定自监督学习带来一致提升。在外部临床视频和509张外部CRL图像上验证了任务特异性判别能力。
Conclusion: FetSelect通过任务特定设计和超声领域自监督学习，有效提升了胎儿超声帧选择的自动化性能，且具有较好的泛化能力。

papers.title: Human and AI collaboration for pulmonary nodule segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Medical expert annotators are scarce, and blind reliance on artificial intelligence (AI) can be misleading, motivating approaches in which humans, particularly junior medical trainees or even non-medical personnel, collaborate with AI to achieve robust medical segmentation. Although the Segment Anything Model (SAM) shows promise for general-purpose image segmentation, its performance in human-AI collaboration for specialized medical tasks has not been thoroughly evaluated. Here we present Hi-Seg, a human-in-the-loop segmentation framework for pulmonary nodules built on SAM. Humans iteratively refine prompts through trial-and-error learning and semantic reasoning, progressively guiding SAM toward higher-quality masks. Using chest CT scans from 1,179 patients across 12 centers, we conducted the first large-scale external validation of collaborative human-SAM segmentation. Across all annotator groups, Hi-Seg achieved a mean Dice score of almost 85%, outperforming five state-of-the-art deep learning models by 10-22% and 13 SAM variants by 1-29%. Hi-Seg improved segmentation accuracy while reducing annotation time for medical annotators, and briefly trained non-medical annotators achieved performance comparable to that of the junior medical student. These findings suggest that human-in-the-loop segmentation can reduce clinician workload, enable scalable crowdsourced annotation, and transform clinical workflows by facilitating the safe and efficient integration of foundation models into routine clinical practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Hi-Seg，一种基于SAM的人机协作肺结节分割框架，通过人类迭代优化提示（试错学习与语义推理）逐步提升掩膜质量。在来自12个中心1179名患者的胸部CT扫描上进行首次大规模外部验证，所有标注者组平均Dice接近85%，优于五种SOTA深度学习模型（10-22%）和13种SAM变体（1-29%），同时减少医学标注者的标注时间。短期训练的非医学标注者达到了与初级医学生相当的性能。
Motivation: 医学专家标注者稀缺，而盲目依赖AI可能产生误导，需要人类（尤其是初级医学培训生甚至非医学人员）与AI协作以实现鲁棒的医学分割。
Method: 提出Hi-Seg，一种基于SAM的人机交互分割框架，人类通过试错学习和语义推理迭代精炼提示，逐步引导SAM生成更高质量的掩膜。
Result: 在12个中心1179名患者的CT数据集上，Hi-Seg达到平均Dice约85%，超过五种SOTA深度学习模型10-22%和13种SAM变体1-29%，并缩短了医学标注者的标注时间；短期训练的非医学标注者性能与初级医学生相当。
Conclusion: 人机协作分割可减轻临床医生工作负担，实现可扩展的众包标注，并促进基础模型安全高效地融入临床常规工作流程。

papers.title: VADAOrchestra: Neurosymbolic Orchestration of Adaptive Reasoning Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Decision-making in real-world settings rarely follows a fixed script. Instead, it unfolds as a dynamic reasoning process in which the appropriate course of action evolves as new context and data become available. Traditional Business Process Management systems provide rigor, determinism, and auditability, yet they generally struggle to adapt their execution at runtime. Conversely, agentic systems based on Large Language Models (LLMs) bring flexibility to decision-making, but they are inherently opaque, often unreliable, and suffer from significant scalability constraints when operating over large datasets. To combine these complementary paradigms, we introduce VADAOrchestra, a neurosymbolic framework that models complex workflows as evolving reasoning processes. The framework adopts a hybrid approach: given a user query and a collection of data sources, an LLM-based orchestrator incrementally plans and adapts the workflow. This is encoded as a logic program in a fragment of Datalog+/- where predicates correspond to tool invocations and rules represent both predefined domain dependencies and logic constructs synthesized on demand to manipulate intermediate results. All logical inference tasks are then executed by a state-of-the-art Datalog+/- symbolic engine. This approach provides a verifiable reasoning trace, supporting the auditability and reproducibility of the entire process. Furthermore, by decoupling high-level orchestration from symbolic inference, it addresses scalability concerns, enabling complex reasoning over large datasets through targeted data querying. We evaluate VADAOrchestra on real-world financial use cases, demonstrating faithfulness, scalability, and explainability compared to standard agentic architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VADAOrchestra 是一个神经符号框架，结合了基于 LLM 的编排器和 Datalog+/- 符号引擎，用于建模复杂工作流为动态推理过程。它在金融用例上展示了忠实性、可扩展性和可解释性。
Motivation: 传统业务流程管理系统缺乏运行时适应性，而 LLM 代理系统不透明且难以扩展。需要一种结合两者优点的混合方法。
Method: LLM 编排器根据用户查询和数据源增量规划工作流，编码为 Datalog+/- 逻辑程序，由符号引擎执行推理。
Result: 在真实金融用例上，与标准代理架构相比，方法在忠实性、可扩展性和可解释性上更优。
Conclusion: 神经符号编排能够提供可验证的推理轨迹，支持审计和可重复性，并通过解耦解决可扩展性问题。

papers.title: Lighting-Consistent Object Transfer Across Radiance Fields
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is widely used to capture and render real scenes. Compositing objects from one capture into another has applications in many domains, such as VFX, architecture and interior design, or marketing. However, extracting an object from a source scene and naively pasting it into a target scene will fail to produce realistic results due to the different lighting conditions between the two scenes. To address this problem, we introduce a diffusion model that harmonizes naively composited images with inconsistent lighting. The model is trained with a heterogeneous dataset of image pairs (inconsistent composite input, consistent output), combining synthetic, generated, and real data. Our complete 3D solution allows a user to extract an object from the source scene and composite it into the target scene. From this, the (inconsistent) views of the target scene with the composite object are rendered. Our diffusion model harmonizes each one of these views, which are finally consolidated in a 3DGS representation with a post-optimization step. Our method provides visually compelling results, making object transfer between 3DGS easy to use and significantly improving quality compared to previous methods.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景中对象迁移时因光照不一致导致的合成不真实问题，提出一种扩散模型来调和光照。该模型使用合成、生成和真实数据组成的异构图像对数据集训练，将用户提取的对象合成到目标场景后，对每帧不一致视图进行扩散模型调和，并通过后优化步骤在3DGS表示中整合，实现了视觉上令人信服的对象迁移效果。
Motivation: 从3DGS场景中提取对象并粘贴到另一个场景时，光照条件差异会导致合成结果不真实，现有方法缺乏高效的光照一致性处理。
Method: 提出一个完整的3D解决方案：用户从源场景提取对象并合成到目标场景，渲染出不一致的视图；然后使用基于扩散模型的调和网络对每帧视图进行光照一致性处理，最后通过后优化步骤将调和后的视图整合为3DGS表示。
Result: 摘要表示该方法提供了视觉上令人信服的结果，使3DGS间的对象迁移易于使用，且相比之前方法有显著质量提升。
Conclusion: 本文强调其扩散模型能够有效调和光照不一致，结合3DGS后处理实现高质量对象迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physically-guided Image Generation for Multi-Projection Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Projection Mapping (PM) enables seamless superimposition of digital content onto real-world 3D objects, serving as a fundamental technique for immersive visualization, digital twins, and interactive art. Although text-to-image diffusion models have greatly facilitated customized content creation, directly integrating them into practical PM pipelines remains challenging due to the mismatch between idealized 2D generation and physical constraints. To bridge this gap, this paper formalizes two application-level generative paradigms: the cooperative paradigm (harmonizing generated semantics with physical attributes) and the adversarial paradigm (eliminating surface interference via radiometric compensation). Based on this, we propose ConPhyG, a unified controllable physically-guided generative multi-projection mapping framework that enables creators to interactively adjust physical constraints and flexibly switch generative paradigms. In cooperative mode, multi-dimensional physical priors (per-pixel gamut, depth, and edges) are injected into the diffusion process. In adversarial mode, the framework releases the generative potential and applies bounded numerical optimization for multi-projector radiometric compensation. It allows users to dynamically switch constraints to balance artistic freedom with physical feasibility. Furthermore, we extend ConPhyG to 360-degree multi-view consistent PM using a sequential generation strategy. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on a real-world four-projector setup demonstrate that ConPhyG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in geometric alignment, gamut utilization, and semantic fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ConPhyG，一个统一的物理引导生成式多投影映射框架，支持协同模式（注入像素色域、深度和边缘等多维物理先验到扩散过程）和对抗模式（通过有界数值优化进行多投影仪辐射度补偿）。在真实四投影仪设置上的定量和定性评估表明，该方法在几何对齐、色域利用和语义保真度方面显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型难以直接集成到实际投影映射流水线中，因为理想化2D生成与物理约束之间存在不匹配。
Method: 形式化两种生成范式：协同范式（将生成语义与物理属性协调）和对抗范式（通过辐射度补偿消除表面干扰）；提出ConPhyG框架，允许用户交互调整物理约束并灵活切换生成范式。
Result: 在真实四投影仪设置上，ConPhyG在几何对齐、色域利用和语义保真度方面显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 该框架通过物理引导生成弥合了理想化内容生成与物理投影约束之间的差距，并支持360度多视一致投影映射。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CVSBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Cross-view Spatial Reasoning and Dreaming
papers.abstract_en: Humans can effortlessly reason about scenes across different viewpoints, yet it remains unclear whether Vision-Language Models (VLMs) possess similar cross-view spatial abilities. Satellite-street scene pairs, with their complex contexts and extreme viewpoint variations, provide an ideal testbed. Motivated by this, we introduce CVSBench, a large-scale benchmark for evaluating cross-view spatial reasoning through satellite-street pairs. This benchmark supports multiple tasks, including cross-view VQA, cross-view grounding, and viewpoint identification. CVSBench comprises 3,297 cross-view image groups with 9,468 object-level annotations and 40,679 question-answer (QA) pairs, enabling systematic and controlled evaluation of cross-view spatial reasoning. Extensive evaluations reveal that advanced VLMs struggle to maintain object-level and layout consistency under drastic viewpoint changes. To bridge this gap towards human-like spatial cognition, we investigate two categories of approaches: spatially grounded reasoning and the incorporation of cognitive map inputs. Our findings demonstrate that language-only reasoning yields marginal improvements, while incorporating visual spatial imagination via a 3D scene imagination pipeline substantially improves cross-view reasoning. These results highlight the necessity of explicit visual-spatial representations for robust spatial cognition in VLMs. Our data and code are released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/zlyzlyzly/CVSBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CVSBench，一个大规模跨视角空间推理基准测试，基于卫星-街景图像对，支持跨视角 VQA、跨视角定位和视角识别等任务。基准包含 3,297 个图像组、9,468 个对象级标注和 40,679 个问答对。评估发现先进 VLM 在视角剧烈变化时难以保持对象级和布局一致性；引入 3D 场景想象管线可显著提升跨视角推理能力。
Motivation: 人类能轻松进行跨视角推理，但 VLM 是否具备类似能力尚不明确。卫星-街景对提供了复杂场景和极端视角变化的理想测试环境，现有基准缺乏对此能力的系统评估。
Method: 构建 CVSBench 基准，包含大量卫星-街景图像对及细粒度标注；评估多种 VLM；探索两类方法：语言推理和基于 3D 场景想象的视觉空间想象管线。
Result: 先进 VLM 在跨视角任务上表现挣扎；语言推理提升有限；视觉空间想象管线（3D 场景想象）显著改善跨视角推理。
Conclusion: 明确的视觉空间表示对于 VLM 的鲁棒空间认知是必要的；CVSBench 可作为跨视角空间推理的标准化评估平台。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: All Green, Still Broken: Real-Flow Verification Lessons from an LLM-Integrated, Multi-Market Web Application
papers.abstract_en: Modern web applications increasingly combine three ingredients that are hard to test: output from large language models, multi-market internationalization, and browser-driven front-ends over external data sources. We report on a production rental-search assistant whose automated suite grew to 1,553 test cases in six weeks. The suite passed continuously, yet user-facing defects continued to reach production. We studied all 252 bug-fix commits in the project and classified each by the boundary, or seam, it escaped through. About 44 percent of the fixes fall in four seams that component-level unit tests cannot observe: the live browser runtime, the non-default market, the end-to-end flow, and the whole-system level. A fix without a guard at the seam let one defect ship twice. We present the four-seam framework, the measured defect distribution, and the practices we adopted, including a simple way for a team to find the seam that carries the most fixes.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Preprint of a manuscript submitted to IEEE Software
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告一个集成了大语言模型、多市场国际化及外部数据源的租房搜索助手在生产环境中的测试教训。尽管自动化测试套件在六周内增长到1553个测试用例并持续通过，用户可见缺陷仍不断出现。作者分析了全部252个修复提交，发现约44%的修复源于四个组件级单元测试无法覆盖的接缝：实时浏览器运行时、非默认市场、端到端流程和全系统级别。
Motivation: 现代Web应用结合LLM输出、多市场国际化和浏览器驱动前端，这些组合难以测试，现有自动化测试尽管覆盖率高，仍漏过用户可见缺陷，需要分析缺陷逃逸模式并改进测试策略。
Method: 对一个生产租房搜索助手的所有252个缺陷修复提交进行实证分类，根据缺陷逃逸的接缝（seam）进行归因，提出四接缝框架（实时浏览器运行时、非默认市场、端到端流程、全系统级别），并统计各接缝的修复分布。
Result: 约44%的修复属于组件级单元测试无法观察到的四个接缝；一个接缝缺乏防护导致同一缺陷两次进入生产。
Conclusion: 作者建议团队使用四接缝框架识别承载最多修复的接缝，并采用相应防护实践来减少用户可见缺陷。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Not All Claims Are Equally Risky: FACTOR for Adaptive Verification in Factual Long-Form Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) generate fluent long-form text, however, often add unsupported factual claims. Existing verification techniques improve factuality by grounding generation in external evidence. However, the same verification policy usually applies to all claims despite being differences in hallucination risks. We propose \textit{FACTOR} (\textit{FACTuality-Oriented Risk-aware Verification}), an inference-time model that adapts verification criteria according to claim-level uncertainty. FACTOR combines uncertainty estimation, adaptive language inference verification, and candidate re-ranking to allocate verification effort where it is most needed. We evaluate \textit{FACTOR} on FactScore benchmark showing that adaptive verification improves factuality while reducing verification cost simultaneously. We further perform different ablation studies to identify the primary driver of these gains. Our results show the effective and model-agnostic performance of \textit{FACTOR} for improving factuality in long-form generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FACTOR，一个基于不确定性估计的自适应验证模型，根据声明的风险级别调整验证策略，从而在长文本生成中提高事实性并降低验证成本。
Motivation: 现有验证方法对所有声明应用相同策略，忽略了不同声明的幻觉风险差异，导致验证效率低下。
Method: FACTOR结合了不确定性估计、自适应语言推理验证和候选重排序，在推理时动态分配验证资源。
Result: 在FactScore基准上，自适应验证同时提高了事实性和降低了验证成本。消融实验表明该方法有效且模型无关。
Conclusion: 摘要强调FACTOR能够通过风险感知的自适应验证提升长文本生成的事实性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interleaved Speech Language Models Latently Work In Text
papers.abstract_en: Speech language models (SLMs) have been extensively studied, with the common paradigm incorporating text data and pre-trained text LMs. A leading approach is speech-text interleaving in which models are trained over sequences containing both speech and text tokens, aiming to boost even speech-only capabilities. Yet the way these two modalities interact in the model latent space remains unclear. In this work, we analyze interleaved speech-text LMs from different model families and sizes through the scope of the logit lens to provide such insight. We reveal that these models go through an implicit transcription phase in which the text token of the spoken word becomes decodable in intermediate layers, despite not being trained for speech recognition. The transcription of the word appears as one of the top candidate words for as much as 77\% of the data. Following this stage, the models proceed to predict the next word in the text space before transforming back to the speech domain. We finally analyze the role of interleaving data, and initializing from text LMs in eliciting this behavior, as well as seeing how this correlates with spoken knowledge abilities. Our analysis sheds light on the internal mechanisms underlying the relationship between speech and text modalities and could shape SLM optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过logit lens分析不同家族和大小的交错语音文本语言模型，发现模型存在隐式转录阶段：中间层可解码出语音对应的文本token（即使未训练语音识别），随后模型在文本空间中预测下一个词，再转回语音域。该行为在77%的数据中观察到，且与交错数据和文本LM初始化强相关。
Motivation: 交错语音文本模型（speech-text interleaving）能提升纯语音能力，但两种模态在潜在空间中的交互机制尚不清楚。
Method: 使用logit lens对多种交错SLM（不同模型家族与大小）进行中间层解码分析，探测语音token对应的文本表征出现位置与演化过程。
Result: 模型中间层可解码出语音单词的文本token，单词正确出现在候选词中的比例达77%；模型整体流程为：语音→隐式转录→文本空间预测→转回语音域。
Conclusion: 揭示交错SLM内部通过隐式转录实现模态交互的机制，为优化语音语言模型提供新视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PRIME: Evaluating Prompt Resolution Under Incompatible Instructions in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often encounter conflicting prompts, although current instruction following benchmarks assess those meta-instructions in isolation, limiting the insights about how models process conflicting instructions. We introduce a framework \textit{PRIME}(\textit{Prompt Resolution under Incompatible Meta-Instructions Evaluation}) to analyze behavior of LLMs when provided with conflicting instructions. \textit{PRIME} purposefully produces calibrated conflicts across response length, output format, and reasoning; classifying model responses with a deterministic behavioral taxonomy. We are evaluating five instruction tuned open weight LLMs in two distinct settings, balanced and naturally distributed. The conclusion we reach upon analysis is that conflict type is more significant in affecting behavior than model scale, and various failure modes across different categories of conflict. Our findings emphasize the value of developing conflict awareness and suggest ability of LLM to follow instructions cannot be assessed through isolated constraints alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRIME框架，用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）在面对冲突指令时的行为。PRIME通过生成响应长度、输出格式和推理等维度的校准冲突，并基于确定性行为分类法对模型响应进行分类。实验评估了五个指令微调的开源LLM在平衡和自然分布两种设置下的表现。结论表明冲突类型比模型规模对行为影响更显著，并揭示了不同冲突类别下的失败模式。
Motivation: 现有指令遵循基准孤立地评估元指令，缺乏对模型如何处理冲突指令的深入洞察。
Method: 提出PRIME框架，通过引入表达长度、输出格式和推理等维度上的校准冲突，并采用确定性行为分类法对模型响应进行归类。
Result: 实验发现冲突类型比模型规模更显著地影响模型行为，并识别了不同冲突类别下的多种失败模式。
Conclusion: 冲突感知能力的开发至关重要，LLM的指令遵循能力不能仅通过孤立约束来评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Federated learning with heavy-tailed gradient noise and communication noise: a variance-reduction based algorithm
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) is an emerging distributed machine learning paradigm that enables local devices to jointly train a global model while keeping data decentralized and private. We propose a variance-reduction based algorithm, VRA-FedSGD, for FL in the presence of heavy-tailed gradient noise and communication noise, where these noises are prevalent in large-scale machine learning over wireless networks and Internet of Things deployments. VRA-FedSGD employs a momentum variance reduction technique together with a nonlinear mapping to mitigate heavy-tailed gradient noise, and uses a variance-reduced aggregation mechanism to suppress heavy-tailed communication noise. In the mean sense, VRA-FedSGD achieves a convergence rate of {\small$\mathcal{O}\left(K^{-(p-1)/(2p-1)}\right)$} for nonconvex objective functions, where $p$ is the tail index of heavy-tailed noise. In the almost sure sense, VRA-FedSGD achieves a convergence rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(K^{-(1-1/(p-ε))}\right)$ for strongly convex objective functions, where $ε$ is an arbitrarily small constant. Simulated experiments on a logistic regression problem with real-world data verify the effectiveness of VRA-FedSGD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习中存在的重尾梯度噪声和通信噪声问题，提出了一种基于方差缩减的算法 VRA-FedSGD。该算法结合动量方差缩减技术和非线性映射以缓解重尾梯度噪声，并采用方差缩减聚合机制抑制重尾通信噪声。理论上，在非凸目标函数下达到 O(K^{-(p-1)/(2p-1)}) 的均值收敛率，在强凸目标函数下达到几乎必然收敛率；逻辑回归实验验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有的联邦学习算法在处理大规模机器学习中常见的重尾噪声（特别是无线网络和物联网场景）时收敛缓慢或不稳定，需要一种能够同时应对重尾梯度噪声和通信噪声的鲁棒算法。
Method: 提出 VRA-FedSGD，使用动量方差缩减和非线性映射处理重尾梯度噪声，并设计方差缩减的聚合机制来抑制重尾通信噪声。
Result: 理论分析表明：对于非凸目标，均值收敛率为 O(K^{-(p-1)/(2p-1)})；对于强凸目标，几乎必然收敛率为 Õ(K^{-(1-1/(p-ε))})。在真实数据上的逻辑回归实验验证了算法效果。
Conclusion: VRA-FedSGD 为联邦学习在重尾噪声环境下提供了有效的方差缩减方法，但实验仅限于逻辑回归，尚未在更复杂的模型和大规模异构数据上验证。

papers.title: Adaptive Recurrent Message Passing for Test Time Computing on Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained foundation models have demonstrated remarkable success in many domains, enabling a unified backbone to generalize across diverse downstream tasks. However, extending this paradigm to graph learning remains challenging due to the intrinsic mismatch between graph data and fixed architectural designs. In this work, we show that this limitation can be overcome via recurrent graph models. To achieve this, we conduct a systematic theoretical analysis, rigorously deriving step dependence as a necessary and sufficient condition for an adaptively convergent recurrent process. Building on this foundation, we propose AdaR, an Adaptive Recurrent graph model, empowering flexible test-time computing on various downstream tasks without changing model parameters. To enable adaptive inference, AdaR explicitly encodes normalized step information and representation-target relations into the recurrent updates. To ensure convergence of the recurrent process, AdaR employs gradient-based supervision signals that guide representation updates throughout the recurrence. Empirical results demonstrate that AdaR consistently outperforms strong baselines in both inductive and transductive settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对预训练基础模型在图学习中的设计不匹配问题，提出自适应递归图模型 AdaR。理论证明了步依赖性作为自适应收敛递归过程的充要条件，并利用归一化步信息与表示-目标关系指导递归更新，同时采用梯度监督信号确保收敛。实验在归纳和直推设置中均优于强基线。
Motivation: 预训练基础模型在图学习领域因固定架构与图数据固有结构不匹配而面临挑战，现有方法未充分利用递归模型的自适应能力。
Method: 提出 AdaR（Adaptive Recurrent graph model），显式编码归一化步信息和表示-目标关系到递归更新中，并通过梯度监督信号指导表示更新，实现无需改变参数的测试时自适应推理。
Result: 在归纳和直推设置下，AdaR 一致优于多个强基线方法。
Conclusion: 递归模型可有效解决图学习中的架构不匹配问题，自适应递归过程为测试时计算提供了新范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Music Playlist Captioning at Scale with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Music streaming services such as Deezer often recommend personalized playlists to users. Playlist captioning, which involves describing these playlists in natural language, is essential for helping users understand the content behind each recommendation, yet remains challenging at scale. This paper presents the automatic playlist captioning system deployed on Deezer in 2025 to address this challenge. Leveraging recent advances in large language models (LLMs) to generate descriptive captions from diverse data sources in a controlled manner, this system now powers the Daily Mix feature, used by millions of users. This deployment has led to significant improvements in user engagement, highlighting how the semantic framing of an unchanged recommendation shapes user perception in online personalized experiences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了2025年在Deezer音乐流媒体平台上部署的自动播放列表字幕系统，利用大型语言模型（LLM）从多源数据生成描述性字幕，并应用于Daily Mix功能，显著提升了用户参与度。
Motivation: 音乐流媒体服务通常推荐个性化播放列表，但用户难以理解推荐内容背后的语义，大规模自动生成播放列表描述面临挑战。
Method: 基于大型语言模型（LLM），从多种数据源（如歌曲特征、用户行为等）以受控方式生成描述性字幕，并集成到Deezer的Daily Mix推荐功能中。
Result: 系统部署后，用户参与度（如点击率、收听时长）获得显著提升，表明语义框架对在线个性化体验的影响。
Conclusion: 通过LLM为推荐内容添加自然语言描述可以有效改善用户体验，该方法已在百万级用户规模上验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CASPER in the Machine: Insights into Character Variety in LLM-Generated Stories
papers.abstract_en: As LLM-generated text is increasingly used, especially in fictional domains, we explore how much LLM-generated stories differ from human-written stories. In this work, we focus on characters. We borrow definitions from narratology to analyze eight intricate dimensions of character, such as stylization and wholeness. These dimensions consider more than just basic characteristics. They assess how characters are portrayed within their stories. After automatically inferring categories of characters within both LLM and human-written stories, we compare and contrast these two sets of stories. We consider the following overarching questions: (1) Do LLMs and human-written stories have similar characters? and (2) Do LLMs generate stories with a variety of characters? Our analysis includes research questions that focus on stories generated by popular LLMs and recently published human-written stories. We describe a number of interesting similarities, differences and key takeaways.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从叙事学角度定义角色的八个维度（如风格化、整体性），自动推断LLM生成故事与人类写作故事中的角色类别，并比较两者差异。研究发现LLM和人类故事在角色刻画上既有相似之处也有显著差异，但LLM生成的角色多样性可能不足。
Motivation: 随着LLM生成文本在虚构领域的广泛应用，需要系统评估其与人类写作在角色刻画方面的异同，以理解LLM的局限和特点。
Method: 借用叙事学的角色维度定义，通过自动推断方法对LLM和人类故事中的角色进行分类，并对比两组故事的角色特征。
Result: 分析了流行LLM生成的故事与近期人类故事的角色差异，描述了相似性、差异及关键发现。
Conclusion: LLM生成的故事在角色多样性上可能与人类写作存在差距，需要进一步研究如何改进。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Cognitive Framework via Causal World Modeling for Embodied Scientific Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Current embodied world models are primarily optimized for predictive objectives, limiting their ability to generalize under distribution shifts and reason systematically about unseen situations and hypothetical interventions. We argue that embodied intelligence should move beyond predictive world modeling toward self-evolving cognitive systems that continually construct and refine internal causal representations through interaction with the environment. To this end, we propose a self-evolving cognitive framework via causal world modeling for embodied scientific intelligence, which integrates three complementary components: causal world modeling, intervention-driven causal reasoning, and continual cognitive refinement. The proposed framework continuously revises and expands its internal causal world model through causal discovery, intervention-driven feedback, and counterfactual reasoning, supporting continual cognitive refinement and enabling cognition itself to evolve over time. Furthermore, we reinterpret embodied interaction not merely as a means of trajectory optimization, but as an epistemic process for causal hypothesis generation, intervention-driven experimentation, and continual knowledge acquisition. This work provides a conceptual and theoretical foundation for a transition from predictive intelligence toward epistemic intelligence, in which intelligence emerges through the continual construction, revision, and refinement of causal world models via interaction with the environment. Accordingly, an intervention-driven causal-epistemic benchmarking paradigm is suggested for evaluating self-evolving embodied scientific intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自进化认知框架，通过因果世界建模实现具身科学智能，整合因果建模、干预驱动推理和持续认知精炼，将具身交互视为认知过程而非单纯轨迹优化。
Motivation: 现有具身世界模型主要针对预测目标优化，在分布偏移和未知情景下泛化能力不足，缺乏系统性因果推理能力。
Method: 提出自进化认知框架，包含因果世界建模、干预驱动因果推理和持续认知精炼三个互补组件，通过因果发现、干预反馈和反事实推理不断修正内部因果模型。
Result: 该工作提供概念和理论基础，推动从预测智能向认知智能转变，并建议了干预驱动的因果-认知基准范式。
Conclusion: 具身智能应超越预测建模，通过与环境交互持续构建和精炼因果世界模型，实现自我进化。

papers.title: A Differentiable Atari VCS:A Complex, Fully Known Ground Truth for Explainable AI
papers.abstract_en: Explanation requires ground truth: to verify an account of a system we must know its inner functioning-just what is missing where explainable AI (XAI) is most needed. Systems we can study fall into two camps. Simple, procedural one-decision trees, rule lists, sparse linear models-have a known but trivial mechanism, so explaining them tests nothing; genuinely complex ones-deep networks, real-world tasks-need XAI but have no ground-truth inner functioning, so an explanation can be plausible, confident, and wrong with no way to tell. We remove this dichotomy with a study object both genuinely complex and fully specified-inspectable by construction-and, so gradient methods apply, fully differentiable. We reimplement the Atari 2600 Video Computer System (VCS)-a real computer architecture, and the cradle of deep reinforcement learning-as two independent end-to-end differentiable emulators in Julia (jutari) and JAX (jaxtari), each validated bit-for-bit against xitari. Both reproduce xitari on all 64 supported Arcade Learning Environment (ALE) games: 64/64 byte-identical RAM and 64/64 pixel-identical screens. Treating the cartridge ROM as a weight tensor, RAM as a soft tape, and control flow as gates, we prove the differentiable (soft) execution equals the original (hard) one bit-for-bit in the forward pass at any finite temperature, while exposing surrogate gradients where the bit logic has none. The JAX port also opens a GPU path: batched differentiable rollouts reach millions of environment-steps/s on one commodity GPU. The system was built in roughly 137 active hours over 29 calendar days, much of it written autonomously by coding agents. This paper builds and validates the foundation, showing-theoretically and in a qualitative gradient study-that gradient-based XAI on it is feasible. Both ports' full code is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/akmaier/UnderstandingVCS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新实现了Atari 2600游戏主机（VCS）作为两个端到端可微模拟器（JAX和Julia），并验证其与原始模拟器在64个游戏中字节级和像素级完全一致。通过将游戏ROM视为权重张量、RAM视为软磁带、控制流视为门控，作者证明了可微执行在前向传播中与硬执行位精确等价，同时为无梯度的位逻辑提供了代理梯度。JAX版本可在单GPU上实现百万级环境步/秒的批处理可微 rollout。该工作为可解释AI提供了一个既复杂又完全已知的ground truth系统。
Motivation: 现有可解释AI缺乏ground truth：简单模型（如决策树）机制已知但过于简单，复杂模型（如深度网络）需要解释但内部机制未知，导致解释可能错误而无法验证。本文通过构建一个既复杂又完全可检查的系统来消除这一矛盾。
Method: 重新实现Atari 2600 VCS为两个独立端到端可微模拟器（jutari和jaxtari），分别基于Julia和JAX。通过将ROM视为权重、RAM视为软磁带、控制流视为门控，实现可微执行与原始硬执行在前向传播中位精确等价，并为不可微位逻辑提供代理梯度。
Result: 两个模拟器均在64个Arcade Learning Environment游戏上通过验证，达到64/64字节相同RAM和64/64像素相同屏幕。JAxtari在单GPU上可达到百万级环境步/秒的批处理可微 rollout。
Conclusion: 本文构建并验证了基础平台，理论上和定性梯度研究中表明基于梯度的可解释AI在此平台上是可行的。未来工作可基于该平台进行解释性研究。

papers.title: DreamUV: Unwrap Artist-like UV by End-to-End Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: UV parameterization is a fundamental step in 3D content creation, yet producing production-ready UV layouts remains challenging due to the gap between geometric distortion objectives and the stylistic preferences of professional artists. While classical methods optimize handcrafted energy functions, artist-authored UVs exhibit structural patterns such as straightened seams, axis-aligned islands, and flexible interior deformation, properties that are difficult to explicitly formulate. In this work, we present DreamUV, an end-to-end learning framework that formulates UV unwrapping as a generative Flow Matching problem. Rather than predicting a single optimal parameterization, DreamUV learns a mesh-conditioned transport process that maps noise samples to a distribution of artist-like UV layouts. To reflect real-world authoring practices, we introduce a boundary-aware training strategy that prioritizes seam geometry, and a Model-in-the-Loop Finetuning(MITL) scheme that explicitly accounts for discretization errors during sampling and stabilizes transport dynamics under heterogeneous supervision. We evaluate DreamUV on a large-scale dataset of professionally authored UV layouts. Experiments demonstrate that our method produces significantly straighter boundaries and tighter axis-aligned islands than both classical and learning-based baselines, while maintaining competitive distortion metrics. Qualitative results and a user study with professional artists further confirm that DreamUV generates UV layouts that are not only valid, but aligned with practical production requirements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DreamUV 是一种端到端的生成式 UV 展开框架，将 UV 参数化视为流匹配 (Flow Matching) 问题。它学习一个网格条件化的传输过程，将噪声样本映射到艺术家风格的 UV 布局分布，并通过边界感知训练和模型在环微调 (MITL) 来提升展开质量。在大规模专业 UV 数据集上的实验表明，该方法在边界平直度和岛屿轴对齐性上优于经典和学习基线，同时保持有竞争力的失真指标。
Motivation: 传统 UV 展开方法优化手工设计的能量函数，难以捕捉艺术家偏好的结构模式（如平直接缝、轴对齐岛屿、灵活内部变形），导致生成的 UV 布局与专业生产要求存在差距。
Method: 提出 DreamUV，采用端到端流匹配框架，学习网格条件化的噪声到 UV 布局的传输过程。引入边界感知训练策略优先处理接缝几何，以及模型在环微调 (MITL) 方案补偿采样离散误差并稳定传输动力学。
Result: 在大规模专业 UV 数据集上，DreamUV 生成的 UV 布局具有更平直的边界和更紧凑的轴对齐岛屿，在失真指标上与基线相当。用户研究确认其符合实际生产要求。
Conclusion: DreamUV 将 UV 展开重构为生成式流匹配问题，有效捕捉了艺术家风格的结构规律，为生产级 UV 自动生成提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Efficient Multimodal Clinical Question Answering for Pulmonary Embolism Risk Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a high risk cardiopulmonary condition whose management requires both timely diagnosis and reliable assessment of future clinical risk. Because PE care routinely combines computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA), radiology interpretation, and longitudinal electronic health record (EHR) evidence, it provides a clinically meaningful setting for evaluating compact multimodal language models. In this work, we build a benchmark using efficient multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on INSPECT, a multimodal PE dataset containing 23,248 CTPA studies from 19,402 patients. We formulate eight diagnostic and prognostic tasks as structured clinical question answering problems and evaluate on typical efficient MLLMs under CTPA-Only, EHR-Only, and CTPA+EHR settings with zero-shot and few-shot prompting. Results show that Gemma4 E4B and Gemma4 E2B perform more strongly when EHR evidence is available, especially under CTPA+EHR input. Task level analysis further shows that PE diagnosis achieves higher performance than prognostic tasks, particularly readmission prediction. These observations suggest that compact multimodal models have the great potential in early stage PE risk detection and explanation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用INSPECT数据集（含23248次CTPA检查）构建了肺栓塞风险多模态问答基准，评估了多种高效多模态大语言模型（如Gemma4系列）在仅影像、仅电子病历、影像+电子病历三种输入下的零样本和少样本性能。结果表明，结合影像和电子病历的输入方式下Gemma4 E4B和E2B表现最优，诊断任务性能高于预后任务（特别是再入院预测），说明紧凑多模态模型在早期肺栓塞风险检测中有潜力。
Motivation: 肺栓塞管理需要及时诊断和风险评估，但目前缺乏对紧凑多模态语言模型在此临床场景下系统评估的基准。
Method: 基于INSPECT数据集设计8个诊断与预后问答任务，使用CTPA-Only、EHR-Only和CTPA+EHR三种输入模式，在零样本和少样本提示下评估Gemma4等高效多模态大模型。
Result: Gemma4 E4B和E2B在CTPA+EHR输入时性能最强；诊断任务准确率高于预后任务，尤其再入院预测难度最大。
Conclusion: 紧凑多模态模型在早期肺栓塞风险检测和解释方面有巨大潜力。

papers.title: Curvature-aware 3D length estimation of greenhouse cucumbers using RGB-D imaging and cubic spline arc-length integration
papers.abstract_en: Commercial greenhouse cucumber production is graded by fruit length, which drives harvest scheduling, labour allocation, and logistics. Manual measurement with thread or caliper is accurate but infeasible at commercial scale. This paper presents CucumberVision, a non-contact length estimation framework using an Intel RealSense D435 RGB-D camera. A YOLO26n instance segmentation model locates cucumbers, and SAM (ViT-B backbone) refines each detection to a pixel-precise mask. Five methods are evaluated under matched conditions: (M1) a dominant-axis skeleton scan-line baseline; (M2) PCA on the bounding-box depth point cloud; (M3) SAM mask with medial-axis skeletonisation; (M4) a hybrid keypoint-guided approach using a YOLO26-pose model predicting five anatomical landmarks (KP0--KP4) with piecewise 3D arc-length; and (M5) a novel medial arc spline method fitting a cubic spline through the 3D medial axis of the SAM mask and computing arc length by trapezoidal integration -- the first such application to elongated vegetable measurement. All methods share five-frame burst depth averaging, colour-stream intrinsic alignment, and adaptive method selection with cascading fallbacks ensuring 100% coverage. A benchmark of 48 captures across seven cucumbers in three size categories (small ~8 cm, medium ~13 cm, large ~25 cm) with thread-based ground truth establishes a significant accuracy hierarchy: M1 (MAPE 9.68%) > M2 (5.31%) > M4 (5.51%) > M3 (5.82%) > M5 (4.13%). M5 significantly outperforms all competitors at Bonferroni-corrected alpha=0.0125. A secondary contribution is identifying a 12--18% length underestimation caused by using depth-stream rather than colour-stream intrinsics after rs.align(rs.stream.color) -- an under-reported error source. The complete system is released open source and runs in real time on a single consumer-grade GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CucumberVision，一种基于RGB-D相机的非接触式黄瓜长度估计框架，使用YOLO26n实例分割和SAM精确掩膜，通过五次光晕深度平均和自适应方法选择实现全覆盖。在七个黄瓜（小、中、大三类）的48次捕获基准上，评估了五种方法，其中基于三次样条曲线弧长积分的新方法M5表现最佳（MAPE 4.13%），显著优于其他方法。同时发现深度流内参导致长度低估12-18%的错误源。
Motivation: 商业温室黄瓜生产按果实长度分级，人工测量虽准确但无法大规模应用。现有非接触方法精度不足或缺乏系统性评估，尤其缺乏对弯曲黄瓜的精确三维长度测量。
Method: 提出CucumberVision框架，包含YOLO26n实例分割、SAM掩膜细化、五种长度估计方法（M1-M5），其中M5为核心创新：通过SAM掩膜的三维中轴拟合三次样条，使用梯形积分计算弧长。所有方法共享五帧深度光晕平均、颜色内参对齐和级联回退策略确保全覆盖。
Result: 在48次捕获基准上，M5的MAPE为4.13%，显著优于M1（9.68%）、M2（5.31%）、M3（5.82%）和M4（5.51%），且Bonferroni校正后显著性水平α=0.0125。同时发现深度流内参导致长度低估12-18%。
Conclusion: CucumberVision提供了一种高精度、实时的非接触黄瓜长度估计方法，适用于商业化温室。识别了深度内参误差源，系统开源并在单消费级GPU上实时运行。

papers.title: MMGist: A Comprehensive Multimodal Benchmark for 2027
papers.abstract_en: We conduct a systematic study of 18 widely used vision-language benchmarks and identify three major issues: 1) many items do not rely on visual cues and therefore fail to effectively measure multimodal understanding; 2) many items are already close to performance saturation for current LVLMs, which limits their discriminative power; 3) a small number of anomalous items affect the reliability of evaluation results. To this end, we propose MMGist, a curated benchmark that covers seven capability dimensions and contains 7,262 items. MMGist is constructed through a three-stage pipeline, which sequentially combines text-ablation filtering, cross-model saturation filtering, and anomaly detection filtering. We conduct extensive experiments on 27 leading LVLMs and compare MMGist with the raw pool of 23,250 items. The results show that MMGist preserves model rankings with high fidelity, with Spearman $ρ= 0.98$, while reducing evaluation items by 69\% and improving cross-model discrimination by 78\%. Further results indicate that Visual Logic remains a systematic weakness of current LVLMs, while knowledge-intensive dimensions such as Expert Knowledge dimensions remain important factors for distinguishing closed-source models from open-source models. These findings suggest that high-quality evaluation should prioritize visual dependency, discriminative power, and reliability, rather than simply pursuing benchmark scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了18个广泛使用的视觉语言基准，发现三个主要问题：许多项目不依赖视觉线索、接近性能饱和、存在异常项。为此提出MMGist基准，通过文本消融、跨模型饱和和异常检测三步过滤，从23,250个原始项目中精选出7,262个项目，覆盖七个能力维度。在27个领先LVLM上的实验表明，MMGist保持模型排名高保真（Spearman ρ=0.98），减少69%的评估项，提升78%的跨模型区分度。进一步发现视觉逻辑仍是当前LVLMs的系统弱点，而知识密集型维度（如专家知识）是区分闭源与开源模型的关键。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言基准存在三个主要问题：1）许多项目不依赖视觉线索，无法有效衡量多模态理解；2）许多项目接近性能饱和，限制了区分能力；3）少量异常项影响评估可靠性。
Method: 提出MMGist基准，通过三步流水线构建：文本消融过滤（去除仅靠文本即可回答的项）、跨模型饱和过滤（去除所有模型均正确或错误的项）、异常检测过滤（去除异常值）。最终保留7,262个项目，覆盖七个能力维度。
Result: 在27个领先LVLM上的实验显示，与原始23,250个项目池相比，MMGist保持模型排名高保真（Spearman ρ=0.98），评估项减少69%，跨模型区分度提升78%。视觉逻辑是系统弱点，知识密集型维度（如专家知识）是区分闭源与开源模型的关键因素。
Conclusion: 高质量评估应优先考虑视觉依赖性、区分力和可靠性，而非单纯追求基准规模。MMGist可作为更高效、更可靠的LVLM评估工具。

papers.title: Distribution-Aware Robust Bilevel Optimization: Quantile-Guided Huber Updates in Two-Timescale Stochastic Approximation
papers.abstract_en: Bilevel optimization (BLO) is fundamental to hierarchical decision-making but suffers from critical instability under heavy-tailed stochastic noise. Existing variance-reduction techniques typically rely on myopic magnitude checks, which fail to distinguish informative geometric signals from impulsive outliers. To resolve this, we propose \textbf{RQ-TTSA} (Robust Quantile-guided TTSA), a distribution-aware framework that leverages historical gradient buffers to estimate rolling quantiles for adaptive Huber-style clipping, effectively preserving local optimization geometry while strictly bounding effective variance. Theoretically, we provide a convergence analysis for quantile-guided TTSA under nonconvex-strongly convex assumptions with infinite-variance noise ($p \in (1,2]$), deriving a rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-\frac{p-1}{3p-2}})$ that recovers optimal dependence on the heavy-tailed parameter. Empirically, across six diverse tasks, spanning heterogeneous vision benchmarks, dynamic games under momentum poisoning, and offline reinforcement learning, RQ-TTSA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by eliminating divergence spikes and ensuring stable convergence. Our method demonstrates significant robustness to hyperparameter variations and incurs negligible computational overhead ($\approx 2.7\%$ increase), validating distribution-aware gradient control as a practical and necessary component for reliable bilevel learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出适用于双层次优化的鲁棒量化引导TTSA（RQ-TTSA），利用历史梯度缓冲估计滚动分位数进行自适应Huber式裁剪，以处理重尾噪声。在非凸强凸假设下获得收敛率，并在六个任务上实证优于基线。
Motivation: 现有的双层次优化在重尾随机噪声下存在不稳定性，传统的方差缩减技术无法区分信息性几何信号与脉冲异常值。
Method: 提出RQ-TTSA框架，通过历史梯度缓冲估计滚动分位数来实现自适应Huber式裁剪，保留局部优化几何的同时限制有效方差。
Result: 理论推导了在无限方差噪声下的收敛率，实验表明在异构视觉基准、动量中毒下的动态博弈和离线强化学习等任务上消除了发散尖峰并确保稳定收敛，计算开销仅增加约2.7%。
Conclusion: 方法验证了分布感知梯度控制是可靠双层次学习的实用且必要组件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Escaping the Variance Trap: Jacobian-Free Dynamics for Root-Finding Bilevel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Many central machine learning tasks, from entropy tuning in reinforcement learning to equilibrating generative adversarial networks, are fundamentally stochastic root-finding problems rather than loss minimization. Yet, they are frequently forced into a minimization framework via squared residuals, introducing a critical flaw we identify as the Variance Trap. Standard bilevel minimization algorithms require estimating hypergradients involving implicit Jacobians; in stochastic settings, these terms act as noise amplifiers, destabilizing convergence. We formalize Root-Finding Bilevel Optimization (RF-BO) as a distinct problem class that bypasses this pathology. We propose a Jacobian-free solution using Two-Time-Scale Stochastic Approximation (TTSA) that updates directly along the root error, structurally avoiding variance amplification. We provide the first non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for TTSA in this setting under Markovian noise. Extensive experiments demonstrate the decisive advantage of this paradigm: compared to squared-residual and implicit-gradient baselines, our framework achieves a 2.6\% top-1 accuracy gain in SimCLR, 17$\times$ faster convergence in non-linear ODE control where baselines fail, significantly improved entropy stability in reinforcement learning, and an 11.1\% quality improvement in generative modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出根查找双层优化（RF-BO）框架，通过无雅可比的两时间尺度随机逼近（TTSA）解决传统方法中的方差陷阱问题。在SimCLR、非线性ODE控制、强化学习和生成建模等任务上，该方法分别带来2.6%准确率提升、17倍加速、熵稳定性改善和11.1%质量改进。
Motivation: 许多机器学习任务本质上是随机根查找问题，但常被错误地转化为平方残差最小化，导致隐式雅可比项在随机设置中放大噪声，破坏收敛稳定性。
Method: 形式化根查找双层优化（RF-BO）问题类，并提出无雅可比的两时间尺度随机逼近（TTSA）方法，直接沿根误差更新，从结构上避免方差放大。
Result: 在SimCLR上获得2.6% top-1准确率提升；非线性ODE控制中收敛速度提升17倍（基线失败）；强化学习中熵稳定性显著改善；生成建模质量提升11.1%。
Conclusion: 该框架为随机根查找问题提供了一种有效范式，避免方差陷阱，并给出了Markov噪声下TTSA的首个非渐近收敛保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Words as Difference Makers: How Large Language Models Determine Causal Structure in Text
papers.abstract_en: Because large language models (LLMs) are impressively successful in predicting text, it appears that they must have access to a 'world model' representing causal and definitional structure. However, the dominant formalisms of modern causal inference -- Judea Pearl's interventionist approach and the Neyman-Rubin potential outcomes framework -- struggle to illuminate how LLMs learn causal structure. I resolve this puzzle by arguing that LLMs employ a specific inductive approach based on a difference-making logic -- sometimes called variational induction. I demonstrate how central aspects of this logic are realized during training, where LLMs require enormous amounts of text data from a wide range of contexts to identify difference- and indifference-makers within word sequences. Furthermore, I analyze specific architectural features of LLMs -- such as token embeddings and self-attention -- to determine their roles in variational induction. The difference-making logic of LLMs fundamentally parallels the experimental method, where causal relations are derived by systematically varying individual circumstances to determine their influence on a phenomenon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出大型语言模型（LLM）通过一种称为变分归纳（variational induction）的差异制造逻辑来学习文本中的因果结构，而非依赖传统的干预主义或潜在结果框架。作者论证了LLM在训练过程中通过大量上下文数据识别词序列中的差异制造者与无关因素，并分析了token嵌入和自注意力机制在实现这一逻辑中的作用。
Motivation: 现有因果推断框架（如Judea Pearl的干预方法和Neyman-Rubin潜在结果框架）难以解释LLM如何从文本中学习因果结构和定义性关系，存在理论空白。
Method: 通过理论分析，提出LLM采用基于差异制造逻辑的变分归纳方法，并从训练数据需求、token嵌入和自注意力机制等架构特征角度阐述该逻辑的实现方式。
Conclusion: LLM的差异制造逻辑与科学实验方法（系统性地变化个别条件以确定其对现象的影响）在原理上平行，为理解LLM的因果学习提供了新视角。
Relevance: 0
