papers.title: Enhancing LLMs for Graph Tasks via Graph-aware LoRA Generation
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) tightly couple their input-output parameters to dataset-specific feature spaces and target sets, exhibiting limited transferability across different datasets. In contrast, language models (LMs) generalize flexibly via a unified input-output interface, motivating recent attempts to adapt LMs to graph tasks. However, existing methods struggle to encode whole-graph information, leading to potential information loss and suboptimal graph understanding. In this work, we propose a novel weight-level information injection paradigm for adapting LMs to graph tasks. This paradigm injects whole-graph information by generating task-specific weight updates that interact directly with hidden representations. Instantiating this paradigm following low-rank adaptation (LoRA), we introduce GaRA, a Graph-aware LoRA generation model. GaRA constructs low-rank weight updates conditioned on the original graph structures and constrains the norm of the generated updates, thus injecting whole-graph information and avoiding the optimization bias in the weight generation. Empirical studies demonstrate that GaRA consistently outperforms baselines on zero-shot graph learning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的权重级信息注入范式，通过生成任务特定的权重更新来使语言模型适应图任务。具体实例化为GaRA（Graph-aware LoRA Generation），它基于原始图结构构造低秩权重更新并约束更新范数，从而注入全图信息并避免优化偏差。实验表明GaRA在零样本图学习任务上持续优于基线。
Motivation: 现有方法难以编码全图信息，导致信息损失和图理解次优；语言模型通过统一接口泛化灵活，但适应图任务时存在困难。
Method: 提出权重级信息注入范式，通过生成与隐藏表示直接交互的任务特定权重更新来注入全图信息。实例化为GaRA，采用低秩适应（LoRA）方式，条件于原始图结构生成权重更新，并约束更新范数。
Result: 在零样本图学习任务上，GaRA持续优于基线方法。
Conclusion: GaRA为语言模型适应图任务提供了一种有效的权重级信息注入方法，能够更好地编码全图信息并避免优化偏差。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SVGym (SciVerseGym): An Environment for Reinforcement Learning and Bayesian Optimization in Crystal Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learned interatomic potentials now enable efficient atomistic evaluation for interactive materials discovery, yet closed-loop crystal search methods remain fragmented across bespoke pipelines for editing, relaxation, scoring, constraints, and bookkeeping. We introduce SciVerseGym, a Gymnasium-compatible environment for sequential crystal discovery that frames crystal design as a Markov decision process. Agents observe an atomistic structure, apply chemically meaningful edits, and receive feedback from a configurable evaluator. SciVerseGym supports local and global actions, including elemental substitution, lattice perturbation, atomic displacement, vacancy creation, and atom insertion, along with configurable chemical spaces, structure pools, atomistic and graph-based observations, custom rewards, optional relaxation, and stability or phonon-related diagnostics. Each step applies an edit, evaluates the candidate using a machine-learned interatomic potential or any ASE-compatible calculator, and returns the standard (obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info) tuple. By decoupling agent logic from materials infrastructure, SciVerseGym provides an open, reproducible, and extensible testbed for reinforcement learning, Bayesian optimization, evolutionary search, and language-agent workflows in closed-loop crystal discovery. Code is available at: https://github.com/Bin-Cao/SciVerseGym.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 SciVerseGym，一个基于 Gymnasium 的晶体发现环境，将晶体设计建模为马尔可夫决策过程，支持元素替换、晶格扰动等原子编辑操作，并使用机器学习势或 ASE 兼容计算器进行评估，为闭环晶体发现的强化学习、贝叶斯优化等研究提供了标准化测试平台。
Motivation: 现有的闭环晶体搜索方法依赖于分散的定制化流程，缺乏统一、可复现的环境，阻碍了强化学习等通用算法在该领域的应用。
Method: 设计了一个 Gymnasium 兼容的环境，将晶体发现问题形式化为 MDP，智能体可以执行局部或全局原子操作，并接收来自可配置评估器的奖励信号，支持多种观察表示和诊断。
Result: 该环境通过解耦智能体逻辑与材料计算基础设施，为强化学习、贝叶斯优化、进化搜索等工作流提供了开放、可扩展的测试平台，但未报告具体数值结果。
Conclusion: SciVerseGym 旨在推动机器学习方法在晶体发现中的系统性应用，其代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlowDec: Temporal Conditional Flow Decorruptor for Robust Continuous Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires agents to follow natural-language instructions in unseen scenes. While Large Models (LMs) have advanced VLN-CE, their performance remains severely degraded by real-world visual corruptions, a critical yet underexplored domain constraint. We introduce Temporal Conditional Flow Decorruptor (FlowDec), a novel image restoration framework tailored for LM-based VLN-CE. FlowDec integrates a hybrid temporal conditioning strategy to align the generative flow path with historical context and employs action-centroid guided filtering to dynamically assess and integrate outputs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FlowDec outperforms state-of-the-art decorruption methods in both navigation accuracy and generation latency. Our approach establishes a robust, efficient paradigm for resilient embodied navigation in unpredictable real-world conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowDec，一种面向基于大语言模型的连续环境视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）的时序条件流去损坏框架。FlowDec 融合混合时序条件策略和动作质心引导滤波，以恢复被真实世界视觉损坏的图像，提升导航鲁棒性。实验表明 FlowDec 在导航精度和生成延迟上优于现有去损坏方法。
Motivation: 大语言模型在 VLN-CE 任务中受真实世界视觉损坏影响严重，该问题尚未被充分探索，亟待鲁棒的图像恢复方法。
Method: FlowDec 采用时序条件生成流路径，结合历史上下文进行混合条件对齐，并通过动作质心引导滤波动态评估并整合去损坏输出。
Result: 在导航精度和生成延迟上，FlowDec 均优于现有去损坏方法，建立了鲁棒高效的具身导航范式。
Conclusion: 本文为不可预测真实环境下的弹性具身导航提供了有效路径，验证了时序流去损坏的可行性与效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: QeHDC: Hyperdimensional Computing based on Quantum-enhanced binding and SuperClass Construction
papers.abstract_en: Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC) is a robust computational framework inspired by human cognition characterized by simple and efficient operations within high-dimensional vector spaces. Quantum-enhanced Hyperdimensional Computing (QeHDC) extends classical HDC by leveraging quantum mechanical properties to enhance computational efficiency. In this paper, we propose a novel Quantum HDC framework featuring a one-pass training method, leveraging sinusoidal and quantum encoding to project classical data into quantum amplitude states efficiently. Our framework introduces an innovative reference-state-based quantum binding operation realized via quantum circuits. Furthermore, we propose a density-matrix-based superclass generation strategy employing eigenvalue decomposition to extract critical quantum state features effectively, enabling a more accurate and robust class representation. Experimental evaluations conducted on standard benchmark datasets demonstrate our approach's superior performance, robustness to noise, and computational feasibility compared to traditional classical and existing quantum-enhanced approaches. The results highlight the practical benefits and potential of Quantum HDC for quantum-enhanced classification tasks and pave the way for future advancements in quantum-inspired computational paradigms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量子增强超维计算（QeHDC）框架，利用正弦和量子编码将经典数据映射到量子振幅态，提出基于参考态的量子绑定操作和基于密度矩阵的超类生成策略。在标准基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在分类性能、噪声鲁棒性和计算可行性方面优于传统经典方法和现有量子增强方法。
Motivation: 经典超维计算在计算效率和表示能力上存在局限，量子力学特性有望进一步提升其性能。
Method: 提出一种单次训练方法，结合正弦编码和量子编码；设计基于参考态的量子绑定电路；利用密度矩阵和特征值分解构建超类表示。
Result: 在标准基准数据集上，该方法相比传统经典方法和现有量子增强方法展现出更优的分类性能、更强的噪声鲁棒性和可行的计算成本。
Conclusion: 研究展示了量子增强超维计算在分类任务中的实际潜力，并为量子启发计算范式的发展提供了方向。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出一种单次训练方法，结合正弦编码和量子编码；设计基于参考态的量子绑定电路；利用密度矩阵和特征值分解构建超类表示。
summary_sections.result: 在标准基准数据集上，该方法相比传统经典方法和现有量子增强方法展现出更优的分类性能、更强的噪声鲁棒性和可行的计算成本。
summary_sections.conclusion: 研究展示了量子增强超维计算在分类任务中的实际潜力，并为量子启发计算范式的发展提供了方向。

papers.title: Code Isn't Memory: A Structural Codebase Index Inside a Coding Agent
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents now interleave LLMs with retrieval over the working repository, and retrieval implementations vary widely across deployed harnesses. Inside a fixed coding-agent harness on a fixed model, does adding a structural codebase index actually change cost or resolve? We ran three arms (the harness with the index, the same harness without it, and an agentic-grep comparator) on SWE-PolyBench Verified and SWE-bench Pro with Claude Opus 4.7 held fixed throughout, across three seeds, inside a leak-audited per-task sandbox. The within-harness ablation produces a large localization gain and a statistically separated resolve gain, with no cost penalty per cell and lower cost per solve. The cross-harness check shows that the index does not regress against an agentic-grep baseline on resolve or localization, again at no cost penalty. We release the per-cell exclusion ledger, the leak-audit script, the localization extractor, and the results database. The deployment question for a structural codebase index is thus not whether it is too expensive to run (across seeds, the index lands at a lower $/solved than agentic grep) but whether the workload includes multi-file changes where structural ranking pays off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文通过固定编码代理框架下的消融实验，研究添加结构化代码库索引对成本和解决率的影响。在 SWE-PolyBench Verified 和 SWE-bench Pro 上使用 Claude Opus 4.7 进行三臂实验（有索引、无索引、agentic-grep 比较器），发现索引带来显著的定位和解决率提升，且无成本惩罚。结论是：部署问题不在于成本，而在于工作负载是否包含多文件更改。
Motivation: 现有编码代理的检索实现差异很大，缺乏对添加结构化代码库索引实际效果的严格消融研究。
Method: 在固定编码代理框架下进行三臂实验：有结构索引、无索引、agentic-grep 比较器，使用 Claude Opus 4.7，三个种子，在泄漏审计的沙箱中评估 SWE-PolyBench Verified 和 SWE-bench Pro。
Result: 索引在定位和解决率上均有显著提升，解决率提升统计上显著；每单元成本无惩罚，每解决成本更低。与 agentic-grep 基线相比，解决率和定位均未退化且无成本惩罚。
Conclusion: 结构化代码库索引的部署问题不在于成本过高，而在于工作负载是否包含多文件更改，从而使结构排名发挥作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gen2Balance: Generative Balancing for Long-Tailed Video Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: We address the problem of training on long-tailed data for video action recognition. We propose to augment the training set using a text-to-video generative model, conditioned on diverse text prompts grounded in action profiles and training exemplars. Our approach, called Gen2Balance, converts an imbalanced training set into a balanced combination of real and generated video clips. To effectively learn from such data, we employ a two-stage training strategy that mitigates domain shift and yields significant improvements. We evaluate on long-tailed versions of standard benchmarks: UCF-101 (UCF-LT) and a 100-class subset of Kinetics (K100-LT) selected to prioritise temporally challenging actions. Gen2Balance improves accuracy over the strongest baselines for long-tailed learning by 5.1% and 7.0% on the respective datasets. On rare actions from the RareAct dataset (e.g., cut keyboard), Gen2Balance improves accuracy by 31.9%, demonstrating effectiveness for scarce actions. By varying the amount of synthetic data added, we show that partial balancing already achieves 79% of the performance gains at 27% of the compute cost on K100-LT, highlighting the practical scalability of Gen2Balance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Gen2Balance方法，利用文本到视频生成模型为长尾视频动作识别任务生成合成视频片段，平衡训练集分布。采用两阶段训练策略缓解域偏移，在UCF-LT和K100-LT长尾基准上分别提升准确率5.1%和7.0%，在罕见动作数据集RareAct上提升31.9%。
Motivation: 视频动作识别中的长尾分布导致模型偏向头部类别，尾部类别性能差，传统重采样方法易过拟合。
Method: 使用文本到视频生成模型，基于动作描述和训练样本生成多样化的合成视频，将不平衡训练集转化为真实与生成的平衡组合；配合两阶段训练策略处理域偏移。
Result: 在UCF-LT和K100-LT上相对于最强长尾学习方法分别提升5.1%和7.0%准确率；在RareAct罕见动作上提升31.9%；部分平衡策略以27%计算成本达到79%的增益。
Conclusion: 生成式平衡方法有效提升长尾视频动作识别性能，尤其在稀有类别上优势显著，且计算成本可控。

papers.title: Gold Points Sniper: Self-guided Visual Reasoning in VLM for Fine-grained Action Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Robots operating in everyday environments must understand fine-grained human actions, intentions, and contextual cues from broad views where people occupy only small regions, a capability unmet by current systems. While open-vocabulary action recognition methods remain limited to assigning predefined labels, and vision-language models (VLMs) face an inherent trade-off between informational richness and factual fidelity in their outputs, neither approach achieves the deep semantic interpretation required for reliable human-robot interaction. We propose Gold Points Sniper (GPS), a novel framework that empowers lightweight VLMs with self-guided multimodal reasoning capabilities for fine-grained human action understanding. Our approach comprises three key modules: Gold Points Extractor trains VLMs to identify critical action-relevant details, Selective Socratic Questioner validates and refines these details through selective self-questioning, and Semantic Entailment Evaluator quantitatively assesses factual consistency using semantic entailment classification. Extensive experiments on our curated instruction-tuning dataset based on the CAP benchmark demonstrate that GPS-enhanced lightweight VLMs achieve substantial performance improvements, with some models reaching performance comparable to proprietary GPT-4o while maintaining superior factual accuracy. Our work establishes a reliable foundation for fine-grained action understanding in domestic robotics, enabling robots to safely interpret human behavior through information-dense yet factually grounded descriptions. Source code, training configurations, annotation prompts, and dataset details are released at https://github.com/Haodi-Liu/GPS-Gold-Point-Sniper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Gold Points Sniper (GPS) 框架，使轻量级视觉语言模型 (VLM) 具备自引导多模态推理能力，用于细粒度人类动作理解。GPS 包含三个模块：Gold Points Extractor 识别关键动作细节，Selective Socratic Questioner 通过自问自答验证和细化细节，Semantic Entailment Evaluator 评估事实一致性。在基于 CAP 基准构建的指令微调数据集上，GPS 增强的轻量级 VLM 在细粒度动作理解上取得显著提升，部分模型达到 GPT-4o 水平且事实准确性更优。
Motivation: 当前系统难以从宽视角中理解细粒度人类动作，开放词汇动作识别局限于预定义标签，而 VLM 在信息丰富性和事实保真度之间存在权衡，无法实现可靠的人机交互所需的深层语义理解。
Method: GPS 框架包含三个模块：Gold Points Extractor 训练 VLM 识别动作关键细节；Selective Socratic Questioner 通过选择性自提问验证并优化细节；Semantic Entailment Evaluator 利用语义蕴含分类定量评估事实一致性。
Result: 在基于 CAP 基准的指令微调数据集上，GPS 增强的轻量级 VLM 在细粒度动作理解任务中性能大幅提升，部分模型达到与专有 GPT-4o 相当的性能，同时保持更优的事实准确性。
Conclusion: GPS 为家用机器人中的细粒度动作理解建立了可靠基础，使机器人能够通过信息密集且事实准确的描述安全地解释人类行为。代码、训练配置、标注提示和数据集已开源。

papers.title: Asymptotic Signal Subspace Recovery in Softmax Attention Models
papers.abstract_en: Attention mechanisms have demonstrated remarkable empirical success in identifying relevant information from large collections of tokens, yet the theoretical principles underlying this behavior remain poorly understood. We study a stylized softmax-attention model in which a query vector is learned by stochastic gradient ascent from a collection of informative and nuisance tokens. Exploiting the symmetry of the model, we derive a population objective and characterize the limiting ordinary differential equation governing the learning dynamics. Using tools from stochastic approximation and dynamical systems theory, we establish a rigorous connection between the stochastic learning algorithm and its deterministic limit. Our main result shows that, under suitable high-dimensional scaling assumptions and standard step-size conditions, the learned query converges almost surely to the one-dimensional signal subspace spanned by the latent informative direction. Equivalently, the query asymptotically recovers the latent signal up to the intrinsic sign ambiguity. These results provide a rigorous theoretical foundation for understanding attention mechanisms as signal extraction procedures in high-dimensional noisy environments and offer a dynamical-systems perspective on how attention discovers relevant information in the presence of substantial noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了一个简化的softmax注意力模型，其中查询向量通过随机梯度上升从信息标记和噪声标记中学习。利用对称性，推导出群体目标，并描述了学习动力学的极限常微分方程。主要结果表明，在高维缩放假设和标准步长条件下，学习到的查询几乎必然收敛到潜在信息方向的一维信号子空间，即渐近恢复信号（除符号模糊性外），为注意力机制作为高维噪声环境下的信号提取提供了理论基础。
Motivation: 注意力机制在实践中能够从大量标记中识别相关信息，但其背后的理论原理尚不清晰。本文旨在建立严格的理论基础，解释注意力如何在噪声中发现相关信息。
Method: 采用随机近似和动力系统理论，针对一个简化的softmax注意力模型，利用模型的对称性导出群体目标，并通过随机梯度上升的动力学分析，建立随机学习算法与确定性极限常微分方程之间的联系。
Result: 理论结果表明，在适当的高维缩放假设和标准步长条件下，学习到的查询几乎必然收敛到潜在信息方向的一维信号子空间，即渐近恢复信号（仅存在固有符号模糊性）。
Conclusion: 本文为理解注意力机制作为高维噪声环境下的信号提取过程提供了严格的理论基础，并提供了注意力如何从噪声中发现相关信息的动力系统视角。

papers.title: Reinforcement learning to improve large language model-based automated code compliance systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based approaches for automated code compliance (ACC) of building regulations are prone to generating incorrect and hallucinated computer-processable rules. This paper introduces P4IR, a two-stage framework that uses supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to instill domain knowledge in an LLM, followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to improve the accuracy of the generated intermediate representations in the form of high-level code skeletons. The framework achieved reductions of up to 23.8% and 38.6% in tree edit distance and token-level Levenshtein distance respectively, relative to the SFT baselines. Comparative analysis demonstrates that this approach in a zero-shot setting outperforms leading LLMs in both code structure and semantics, specifically Claude Opus and Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5.2, Qwen-3-Max, and GLM-4.7, evaluated via few-shot prompting. Additionally, the GRPO stage produced a small yet statistically significant reduction in false positives. By combining SFT with GRPO to optimize directly for domain-specific objectives, this approach offers a path toward more accurate and reliable LLM-based ACC systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 P4IR 框架，采用监督微调 (SFT) 和组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 两阶段训练，提升大语言模型 (LLM) 在建筑规范自动代码合规 (ACC) 中的准确性。该方法在零样本设置下优于 Claude Opus、GPT-5.2 等先进模型，树编辑距离降低 23.8%，token 级 Levenshtein 距离降低 38.6%，并显著减少误报。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的自动代码合规系统容易生成错误和幻觉的计算机可处理规则，需要更准确的中间表示生成方法。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段用监督微调 (SFT) 注入领域知识；第二阶段用组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 直接优化高阶代码骨架形式的中间表示准确性。
Result: 相对于 SFT 基线，树编辑距离降低 23.8%，token 级 Levenshtein 距离降低 38.6%；零样本设置下在代码结构和语义上优于 Claude Opus、Sonnet 4.5、GPT-5.2、Qwen-3-Max 和 GLM-4.7；GRPO 阶段带来统计显著的误报减少。
Conclusion: 结合 SFT 与 GRPO 直接优化领域特定目标，可为更准确可靠的 LLM 自动代码合规系统提供可行路径。

papers.title: Multi-cancer detection using a computationally efficient CNN with transfer learning
papers.abstract_en: This study introduces a computationally efficient convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture enhanced with transfer learning for multi-cancer detection using biomedical images. The proposed lightweight CNN model is designed to reduce computational complexity while maintaining high classification performance, making it suitable for deployment in resource-constrained environments. We evaluate this approach on three distinct tumor datasets comprising brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and lung and kidney computed tomography (CT) scans. The model achieves test accuracy of 90.85 +- 2.22%, 98.64 +- 2.43% and 99.92 +- 0.08% for brain, lung, and kidney cancer classification, respectively, using 5-fold stratified cross-validation (CV). Transfer learning is employed by pretraining the model on one cancer type and fine-tuning it on the others, requiring only 20 additional epochs to achieve performance comparable to models trained from scratch. The fine-tuning process involves updating the classification part of the CNN and requires approximately 0.014 seconds per image per epoch using an NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960. Comparative evaluations show that the proposed model outperforms several state-of-the-art pretrained architectures, such as Xception, VGG16, VGG19, MobileNetV2 and DenseNet121. Overall, the model's effectiveness is evaluated across three types of cancer with distinct morphological characteristics, assessing its performance on both MRI and CT imaging modalities and demonstrating robust performance across diverse tasks and data types. These findings underscore the potential of streamlined deep learning (DL) frameworks in accelerating cancer diagnosis without sacrificing accuracy, especially in settings with limited computational resources.

papers.title: Curvature-Adaptive Consistency Flow Matching: Autonomous Trajectory Optimization via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Consistency distillation has significantly accelerated the inference of diffusion models. In this work, we reveal an intriguing asymmetry: while Logit-Normal sampling priors are highly efficacious for standard iterative generation, consistency distillation exhibits a distinctly different difficulty profile (e.g., U-shaped). We identify that the primary optimization bottlenecks reside at the boundary stages (initialization or final refinement) rather than the intermediate steps. To address the limitations of static sampling in accommodating evolving learning requirements, we propose Curvature-Adaptive Consistency Flow Matching (CACFM). By formulating distillation as a dynamic decision process, CACFM employs a lightweight Reinforcement Learning agent to actively probe Probability Flow ODE trajectories, automatically constructing an efficiency-oriented curriculum that prioritizes critical regions without manual scheduling. Integrated with a novel Flow Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) objective, our approach achieves new state-of-the-art results on large-scale models such as FLUX and SDXL. It effectively mitigates structural deformities and preserves high-frequency details in extreme few-step regimes, achieving unprecedented visual fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示一致性蒸馏在标准迭代生成和一致性蒸馏中存在不对称的难度分布（U形），边界阶段（初始化或最终精化）是优化瓶颈。为此提出曲率自适应一致性流匹配（CACFM），将蒸馏视为动态决策过程，利用轻量级强化学习智能体主动探索概率流ODE轨迹，自动构建效率导向的课程，无需手动调度。结合新颖的流分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）目标，在FLUX和SDXL等大规模模型上取得新SOTA，在极少数步下有效缓解结构畸形并保留高频细节。
Motivation: 现有静态采样策略无法适应一致性蒸馏中边界阶段与中间步骤的不同学习需求，导致优化效率低下。
Method: 提出Curvature-Adaptive Consistency Flow Matching (CACFM)，将蒸馏建模为动态决策过程，使用轻量级强化学习智能体主动探索概率流ODE轨迹，自动构建聚焦关键区域的效率导向课程，并联合Flow Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD)目标进行优化。
Result: 在FLUX和SDXL等大规模扩散模型上取得新SOTA，在极少数步生成中显著改善结构畸形并保留高频细节，实现前所未有的视觉保真度。
Conclusion: CACFM通过强化学习自适应调度轨迹，有效应对一致性蒸馏中的非均匀难度分布，为少步生成提供了高效方案。

papers.title: On the Asymptotic Inadmissibility of Double Machine Learning Estimators Under Structure-Agnostic Models
papers.abstract_en: Structure-agnostic (SA) models introduced by Balakrishnan et al. (2026) aim to reflect the general lack of knowledge of structural assumptions on data-generating laws such as smoothness or sparsity in practice. Roughly speaking, SA models restrict the observed-data generating law to be in some rn-neighborhood of (black-box machine learning) estimates, treated as given and fixed, where rn encodes the convergence rates of the estimates to the truth. Under SA models, Balakrishnan et al. (2026) show that the popular Double Machine Learning (DML) estimators for three functionals, the quadratic functional in the Gaussian sequence model, the quadratic density integral functional and the expected conditional covariance, are minimax. However, minimax estimators may be inadmissible. In this paper, we show that, for the first two of the three functionals, the DML estimator is asymptotically inadmissible under the SA model. In particular, we show that these two functionals fall into a class of functionals, which we refer to as the monotone bias class. For this class, we exhibit second-order (U-statistic) estimators, which asymptotically dominate DML estimators, under the SA model. These second-order estimators are empirical higher-order influence function (HOIF) estimators introduced in Liu et al. (2017). Furthermore, the empirical HOIF estimator, like the DML estimator, is minimax for the third functional (the expected conditional covariance), although neither asymptotically dominates the other.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在结构不可知（SA）模型下研究双机器学习（DML）估计量的渐近性质，发现对于二次泛函和二次密度积分泛函，DML估计量是渐近不可容许的，而二阶U统计量（即经验高阶影响函数估计量）渐近占优DML。对于期望条件协方差泛函，两者均为极小极大且互不占优。
Motivation: SA模型反映了实际中对数据生成律结构假设的缺乏，Balakrishnan等人（2026）表明DML估计量在SA模型下是极小极大的，但极小极大估计量可能不可容许，本文旨在检验DML估计量是否渐近不可容许。
Method: 通过识别二次泛函和二次密度积分泛函属于单调偏差类，构造二阶U统计量（经验高阶影响函数估计量），并在SA模型下比较其与DML估计量的渐近风险。
Result: 对于前两个泛函，二阶U统计量渐近占优DML估计量；对于期望条件协方差泛函，两者均为极小极大且互不占优。
Conclusion: 在SA模型下，DML估计量对某些目标参数是渐近不可容许的，而经验HOIF估计量可作为更优的替代方案。

papers.title: Bypassing Minimization Bias: A Shift-Invariant Variance Estimator for Off-Equilibrium Local Learning Coefficients
papers.abstract_en: Singular Learning Theory leverages the Local Learning Coefficient (LLC) to quantify the geometry of neural network loss landscapes. However, mean-energy LLC estimators depend explicitly on an additive loss baseline, typically an estimate of the local minimum. During transient, off-equilibrium training phases, this minimum is unknown; substituting it with the lowest noisy mini-batch loss induces a systematic minimization bias that distorts the geometric measurement. In this paper, we propose the Shift-Invariant Variance Estimator (SIVE), a variance-based local LLC probe that structurally eliminates the unknown additive baseline through the variance operator. Combining this shift-invariant observable with an explicit correction derived from the Law of Total Variance, SIVE separates geometric loss fluctuations from mini-batch evaluation noise. Controlled experiments on analytically tractable toy models show that SIVE recovers the expected finite-temperature geometric signal in regimes where anchored mean estimators fail. Applied to deep neural networks, SIVE provides a robust, localized online diagnostic for tracking structural phase transitions throughout training.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/yingjiacai/SIVE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对奇异学习理论中局部学习系数（LLC）在非平衡训练阶段受最小化偏差影响的问题，提出了一种基于方差的移位不变估计器（SIVE）。SIVE通过方差算子消除未知的加法损失基线，并结合全方差公式进行显式校正，从而分离几何损失波动与小批量评估噪声。在可解析的玩具模型和深度神经网络上的实验表明，SIVE能够恢复预期的有限温度几何信号，并提供鲁棒的在线诊断。
Motivation: 传统的均值能量LLC估计器依赖于未知的局部最小损失基线，在非平衡训练阶段，用最低噪声小批量损失替代会导致系统性最小化偏差，扭曲几何测量。
Method: 提出Shift-Invariant Variance Estimator (SIVE)，利用方差算子消除未知加法基线，并结合Law of Total Variance推导显式校正项，从几何损失波动中分离出小批量评估噪声。
Result: 在可解析玩具模型上，SIVE在锚定均值估计器失效的区域能恢复预期的有限温度几何信号；应用于深度神经网络时，SIVE为跟踪训练过程中的结构相变提供了鲁棒、局部化的在线诊断。
Conclusion: SIVE是一种无需弱先验方差假设的LLC局部探针，能够有效克服非平衡训练阶段的最小化偏差，适用于动态监测模型几何结构变化。

papers.title: PlanBench-XL: Evaluating Long-Horizon Planning of LLM Tool-Use Agents in Large-Scale Tool Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly operate in large tool ecosystems, where real-world tasks require discovering relevant tools, inferring implicit sub-goals, and adapting to dynamic environments over long horizons. However, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate planning under retrieval-limited tool visibility. To address this gap, we introduce PlanBench-XL, an interactive benchmark of 327 retail tasks over 1,665 tools that tests whether agents can iteratively retrieve usable tools, invoke them to uncover intermediate evidence for subsequent calls toward the final goal. PlanBench-XL further features an optional blocking mechanism that simulates real-world unpredictability through missing, failing, or distracting tool functions, forcing agents to detect disrupted paths and adapt at runtime. Experiments on ten leading LLMs show that massive-tool planning remains challenging: while GPT-5.4 achieves 51.90% accuracy in block-free settings, it collapses to 11.36% under the most severe blocking condition. Further analysis shows that agents are especially vulnerable when failures lack explicit error signals or when recovery requires longer alternative tool-use paths. These results establish PlanBench-XL as a testbed for diagnosing agentic planning failures and highlight the need for robust adaptive planning in long-horizon tasks with large, imperfect tool environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PlanBench-XL是一个面向大规模工具生态系统中LLM代理长程规划能力的交互式基准测试，包含327个零售任务和1665个工具。它通过限制工具可见性和可选的阻塞机制模拟真实世界的不确定性，测试代理能否迭代检索、调用工具并适应动态环境。对十个前沿LLM的实验表明，大规模工具规划仍具挑战性：GPT-5.4在无阻塞下准确率51.90%，但在最严重阻塞下骤降至11.36%。
Motivation: 现有基准很少评估在检索受限的工具可见性下的规划能力，而真实世界任务需要代理发现相关工具、推断隐式子目标并长期适应动态环境。
Method: 构建包含327个零售任务和1665个工具的交互式基准PlanBench-XL，通过有限工具可见性和可选阻塞机制（工具缺失、失败或干扰）迫使代理检测中断路径并实时适应。
Result: GPT-5.4在无阻塞设置下准确率51.90%，在最严重阻塞下准确率降至11.36%；代理在缺乏明确错误信号或需要更长替代工具路径时尤其脆弱。
Conclusion: PlanBench-XL可作为诊断代理规划失败的测试平台，凸显了长程任务中大规模、不完美工具环境下鲁棒自适应规划的必要性。

papers.title: MetaPS: Adaptive Programmatic Strategy Selection for Market Agents
papers.abstract_en: No single market strategy always wins: momentum, mean reversion, risk control,and event-driven rules can each succeed or fail as market conditions change.Rather than asking large language models to directly generate market actions,we study an executable decision paradigm where an agent selects from a library of programmatic strategies, each implemented as a code module mapping market observations to actions.We propose \textbf{MetaPS}, a simulation-guided framework for adaptive programmatic strategy selection. MetaPS rolls out candidate strategies in simulated or backtested markets, identifies states where particular strategies lead to better future outcomes, and converts these state--strategy pairs into supervised fine-tuning data. During inference, the simulator is no longer queried: MetaPS observes only the current market state and candidate strategy context, selects a suitable strategy program, and the selected program produces the final action. Experiments on multi-stock trading and a controlled goods-exchange sandbox show that MetaPS consistently improves across model scales from 0.8B to 9B parameters. It outperforms fixed-strategy baselines, direct decision-making agents, and prompted API-based LLM agents; in several settings, compact fine-tuned models even surpass stronger API models. These results demonstrate that market simulations can provide scalable and targeted supervision for learning adaptive, interpretable, and executable strategy selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MetaPS框架，通过市场模拟生成监督数据，让智能体从程序化策略库中自适应选择策略执行交易。实验表明，该方法在股票交易和商品交换模拟中优于固定策略、直接决策和提示式LLM基线。
Motivation: 单一市场策略无法适应所有市场条件，现有方法依赖LLM直接生成动作或固定策略，缺乏可解释性和自适应能力。
Method: MetaPS利用市场模拟回滚候选策略，识别状态与策略的有利配对，构造监督微调数据。推理时仅根据当前状态选择策略程序，由程序生成最终动作。
Result: 在0.8B到9B参数模型上均提升性能，超越固定策略、直接决策和提示式LLM基线，小模型甚至超过强API模型。
Conclusion: 市场模拟可提供可扩展的针对性监督，用于学习自适应的可解释策略选择。

papers.title: Structured Hyperedge Adaptation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has become a practical solution for adapting large pretrained vision transformers (ViTs) to downstream tasks while updating only a small subset of parameters. However, existing adapter-based methods perform adaptation independently for each token, implicitly assuming that token refinements should be learned in isolation. This token-wise formulation overlooks the structured relationships among tokens that naturally arise in visual scenes, potentially leading to redundant updates and spatially inconsistent feature refinement. In this work, we revisit the design of parameter-efficient adapters and propose to perform adaptation in hyperedge space rather than token space. We introduce HyperAdapter, a hypergraph-based adapter architecture that enables structured, group-aware adaptation through soft token routing. HyperAdapter constructs a soft hypergraph over ViT tokens using prototype-based assignments, aggregates token features into latent hyperedge representations, applies lightweight bottleneck adaptation at the hyperedge level, and diffuses the resulting updates back to tokens via the hypergraph incidence structure. This design injects an explicit structural inductive bias into PEFT while preserving the modularity and efficiency of standard adapters. Extensive experiments across diverse visual benchmarks demonstrate that structured hyperedge adaptation consistently outperforms strong PEFT baselines under comparable parameter budgets, with particularly pronounced gains on tasks requiring structured reasoning. Our results suggest that the choice of adaptation space is a critical yet underexplored dimension in parameter-efficient transfer for ViTs.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperAdapter，一种基于超图的适配器架构，用于视觉 Transformer 的参数高效微调 (PEFT)。它通过在超边空间而非 token 空间进行适配，利用原型构建软超图、超边级别瓶颈适配和超图关联结构扩散，显式地注入结构化归纳偏置。实验表明该方法在多种视觉基准上优于现有 PEFT 方法，尤其在需要结构化推理的任务上提升显著。
Motivation: 现有适配器方法独立处理每个 token，忽略视觉场景中 token 之间的结构化关系，导致冗余更新和空间不一致的特征细化。
Method: HyperAdapter 架构：基于原型分配构建软超图，将 token 特征聚合为潜在超边表示，在超边层应用轻量瓶颈适配，再通过超图关联结构将更新扩散回 token。
Result: 在多种视觉基准上，以可比参数预算一致优于强 PEFT 基线，在需要结构化推理的任务上增益尤为显著。
Conclusion: 适配空间的选择是 ViT 参数高效迁移中关键但未充分探索的维度；结构化超边适配在保持模块化和效率的同时引入了结构归纳偏置。

papers.title: Large Language Model-Assisted Cleaning of Report-Derived Labels in a Large-Scale Chest CT Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Purpose: To evaluate whether large language model (LLM)-assisted label cleaning can identify label-report discordance in CT-RATE, a large-scale public chest CT dataset. Materials and Methods: After report-level deduplication, 24,446 unique radiology reports were identified. Twelve reports were excluded from the primary GPT-5.4 analysis because of Microsoft Azure AI Foundry content-safety filtering, leaving 24,434 reports and 439,812 label instances across 18 abnormality categories. GPT-5.4-derived binary labels were generated from report text using structured JSON output and compared with existing CT-RATE labels. Discordant instances were adjudicated by radiologists. In addition, 100 randomly sampled reports were manually annotated to compare CT-RATE labels, individual LLM-derived labels, and multi-LLM majority-vote labels against radiologist-annotated reference labels. Results: Overall agreement between GPT-5.4-derived and CT-RATE labels was 96.4%, with Cohen's kappa of 0.884. Lymphadenopathy showed the lowest agreement and kappa. In discordance review, radiologist adjudication supported GPT-5.4-derived labels in 72 of 97 (74.2%) general discordant instances and 91 of 99 (91.9%) targeted lymphadenopathy discordant instances. Against radiologist-annotated reference labels, multi-LLM majority-vote labels achieved the highest label-macro-averaged F1 score and Cohen's kappa. Conclusion: LLM-assisted label cleaning identified clinically meaningful label-report discordance in CT-RATE and may support scalable quality improvement of public imaging datasets. The cleaned dataset will be made publicly available to support future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了大型语言模型（LLM）辅助标签清理在CT-RATE数据集上的有效性。通过GPT-5.4生成二进制标签并与现有标签比较，发现96.4%的一致性，放射科医师裁决支持LLM标签。多LLM多数投票标签在F1和kappa上表现最佳。结论：LLM辅助标签清理可识别标签-报告不一致，支持公共影像数据集的质量改进。
Motivation: 公共影像数据集可能存在标签与报告不一致的问题，影响下游模型性能。手动清理成本高，需要自动化方法。
Method: 使用GPT-5.4从放射学报告中提取结构化二进制标签，与CT-RATE现有标签比较，对不一致实例由放射科医师裁决。此外，对100份随机样本进行人工标注，比较不同标签生成方法。
Result: GPT-5.4与CT-RATE标签总体一致性96.4%，kappa=0.884。在97个一般不一致实例中，放射科医师支持LLM标签74.2%；在99个淋巴结肿大不一致实例中支持91.9%。多LLM多数投票标签在标签宏平均F1和kappa上最高。
Conclusion: LLM辅助标签清理可识别临床有意义的不一致，支持可扩展的公共数据集质量改进。清理后的数据集将公开。

papers.title: Enhancing Road Safety: An IoT-Based Accident Detection and Prevention Mechanism
papers.abstract_en: Road traffic accidents remain a critical global crisis, consistently serving as a primary driver of preventable mortality and severe injury. These incidents are frequently precipitated by human error, including overspeeding, driving under the influence of alcohol, and cognitive fatigue. To address this urgent public safety challenge, this paper presents an intelligent, Internet of Things (IoT)-based Accident Prevention and Detection System (APDS) designed to systematically mitigate driver risk and optimize post-collision emergency responses. The proposed framework features a multi-tiered architecture capable of executing continuous real-time telemetry monitoring, proactive local alarm triggering, and automated situational intervention. Furthermore, the system integrates automated emergency communication protocols that aggregate immediate spatial coordinates via GPS and dispatch targeted alerts to medical facilities in close proximity, thereby optimizing response times and reducing accident-related fatalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于物联网的道路交通事故检测与预防系统（APDS），通过实时遥测监控、本地报警和自动紧急通信来减少事故伤亡。系统利用GPS和传感器数据，在事故发生后自动向医疗设施发送警报。
Motivation: 道路交通事故是全球主要的死亡和伤害原因，多由超速、酒驾和疲劳驾驶等人为错误引起。现有方法缺乏系统性的风险缓解和高效的应急响应机制。
Method: 设计了一种多层级架构，包括连续实时遥测监控、主动本地报警触发和自动情境干预。系统集成GPS获取位置坐标，并通过自动紧急通信协议向附近医疗机构发送定向警报。
Result: 摘要未提供具体的定量结果，但声称该系统能够优化应急响应时间，减少事故相关死亡。
Conclusion: 该物联网系统有望通过预防和快速响应来提高道路安全。

papers.title: Following the Flow: Advection-Consistent Modeling for Event-based Small Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras enable high-frequency visual perception with microsecond latency, offering advantages for dynamic scenes. However, event-based small object detection remains challenging due to sparse asynchronous measurements and weak object responses that are easily disrupted by noise. Limited spatial support causes small-object signals to lose temporal continuity, resulting in fragmented and unstable predictions. To address this issue, we propose a physics-guided advection-consistent modeling framework, termed PACT, which formulates event evolution as a motion-driven feature transport process. Instead of relying solely on local spatio-temporal aggregation, PACT propagates features along estimated velocity fields and enforces trajectory-level consistency through advection constraints. This design preserves weak event responses over time and prevents their degradation under complex background interference. Technically, PACT integrates motion-aware feature extraction with a differentiable advection-based transport operator, enabling coherent motion representation and effective noise suppression during temporal evolution. Extensive experiments on benchmark event-based datasets demonstrate that PACT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving improvements of 20.72\% in IoU and 15.03\% in accuracy while maintaining comparable computational efficiency. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/fulongcai/PACT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出物理引导的平流一致性建模框架PACT，用于事件相机小目标检测。通过沿估计速度场传播特征并施加轨迹级一致性约束，解决小目标信号因稀疏异步测量和噪声导致的时间不连续问题。在事件相机基准数据集上，PACT在IoU和准确率上分别提升20.72%和15.03%，且计算效率相当。
Motivation: 事件相机小目标检测面临稀疏异步测量和弱目标响应易受噪声干扰的挑战，有限空间支持导致信号失去时间连续性，产生碎片化和不稳定的预测。
Method: 提出PACT框架，将事件演化建模为运动驱动的特征传输过程，通过可微的平流传输算子沿速度场传播特征，并施加轨迹级平流一致性约束。
Result: 在事件相机基准数据集上，PACT在IoU和准确率上分别超越现有方法20.72%和15.03%，保持相当的计算效率。
Conclusion: 平流一致性建模能有效保留弱事件响应的时间连续性，抑制复杂背景干扰，提升小目标检测性能。

papers.title: Multigrid Training for Molecular Generation using Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has demonstrated significant success for modeling biochemical molecular systems, where inputs are commonly represented as graphs or 3D grids. A major challenge is that computational cost scales with resolution, making full graph/grid computation of molecular densities expensive and often unstable. We introduce a multigrid training strategy that leverages low-resolution optimization to accelerate learning at higher resolution through parameter transfer across discretizations. For graph molecular representations, we progressively transfer parameters learned from a coarse graph to a sequence of increasingly finer graphs via biased random walk upsampling. For 3D molecular generation, we voxelize the molecular structures at multiple resolutions, pretrain a coarse-resolution conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE), and initialize a fine-resolution CVAE by transferring shape compatible convolutional parameters from the coarse model. Numerical experiments on receptor-conditioned 3D Ligand generation show that multigrid training accelerates convergence and improves generalization compared to training from scratch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多网格训练策略，利用低分辨率优化加速高分辨率学习，通过参数传递跨离散化。对于图分子表示，通过偏置随机游走上采样逐步传递参数；对于3D分子生成，多分辨率体素化后预训练粗分辨率CVAE并初始化细分辨率模型。数值实验表明多网格训练加速收敛并改善泛化。
Motivation: 分子系统建模中计算成本随分辨率增长，全图/网格密度计算昂贵且不稳定，需要高效训练策略。
Method: 提出多网格训练：对图分子表示，用偏置随机游走上采样逐步传递粗图参数到细图；对3D分子生成，多分辨率体素化，预训练粗分辨率CVAE并用其形状兼容卷积参数初始化细分辨率CVAE。
Result: 在受体条件3D配体生成任务上，多网格训练相比从头训练加速收敛并提升泛化。
Conclusion: 多网格训练策略能有效降低分子生成模型的计算成本并改善性能。

papers.title: ARIA: A Causal-Aware Framework for Rescuing LLM Reasoning in Trustworthy Materials Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have revolutionized the process of materials discovery, yet they often fail to satisfy underlying physical causality. Through an analysis of Large Language Models (LLMs) augmented with knowledge graphs derived from current literature, we uncover a phenomenon termed contextual tunneling, where models "over-anchor" on narrow, retrieved evidence while suppressing global physical reasoning. To address this problem, we introduce ARIA, a causal-aware framework that conditions knowledge use on mechanistic completeness. ARIA routes each query through a three-tier cascade: (i) direct causal reasoning when complete evidence chains of Process-Structure-Property (PSP) are available, (ii) physics-informed analogical transfer for sparse or novel material systems, and (iii) explicit parametric fallback when external evidence is incomplete. As a proof of concept, we construct a Knowledge Graph (KG) containing 2,839 extracted PSP relations from peer-reviewed articles in the materials literature and evaluate ARIA on forward prediction and inverse design tasks for two-dimensional (2D) materials. ARIA mitigates contextual tunneling, improves over unaugmented and naive KG-augmented baselines, and provides further gains when an online literature search is used for evidence enrichment. Crucially, ARIA produces auditable causal traces, enabling physically grounded and trustworthy AI-assisted materials discovery.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现大语言模型（LLM）在材料发现中存在“上下文隧道”现象（过度锚定于狭窄检索证据，抑制全局物理推理），并提出因果感知框架ARIA。ARIA通过三层级级联（直接因果推理、物理启发类比迁移、显式参数回退）确保知识使用基于机制完整性。在包含2839个过程-结构-属性（PSP）关系的知识图谱上评估，ARIA缓解了上下文隧道，在二维材料的前向预测和逆向设计任务上优于基线，并产生可审计的因果痕迹。
Motivation: 生成模型在材料发现中常违反物理因果性，LLM存在上下文隧道现象，即过度依赖局部检索证据而忽略整体物理推理，导致不可靠的结果，亟需因果感知的方法。
Method: 提出ARIA框架，通过三层级级联路由查询：（i）完整PSP证据链可用时使用直接因果推理，（ii）稀疏或新材料系统时使用物理启发类比迁移，（iii）外部证据不完整时使用显式参数回退。构建了从同行评审文献中提取的2839个PSP关系的知识图谱作为概念验证。
Result: 在二维材料的前向预测和逆向设计任务上，ARIA缓解了上下文隧道，优于未增强和朴素知识图谱增强基线；使用在线文献搜索进行证据丰富时，性能进一步提升。
Conclusion: ARIA能产生可审计的因果痕迹，从而实现物理可信且值得信赖的AI辅助材料发现。本文作为概念验证，评估局限于二维材料领域。

papers.title: ZeroGVC: Zero-Shot Generative Video Compression with Autoregressive Diffusion Priors
papers.abstract_en: Recent generative video compression methods leverage powerful generative priors to achieve perceptually pleasing reconstructions. However, most existing approaches require additional training to adapt generative models to produce realistic reconstructions from compact representations. In this paper, we propose ZeroGVC, a zero-shot generative video compression framework that leverages pretrained autoregressive diffusion priors for low-delay video reconstruction. ZeroGVC encodes the first frame of each group of pictures (GOP) with an image codec and represents subsequent P-frames through Codebook-Guided Autoregressive Latent Compression. This design is motivated by our observation that the compression scheme of denoising diffusion codebook models is effective in few-step consistency sampling. By selecting compact combinations of reproducible codebook noise vectors, ZeroGVC steers the latent denoising trajectory toward the target P-frame while allowing the decoder to reproduce the same trajectory in only a few denoising steps. In addition, we design an optional bidirectional reference mode that mitigates error propagation by leveraging the next I-frame context without introducing any additional bitrate overhead. Extensive experiments on standard video compression benchmarks demonstrate that ZeroGVC achieves superior perceptual reconstruction quality at ultra-low bitrates without any additional training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ZeroGVC，一种零样本生成式视频压缩框架，利用预训练的自回归扩散先验实现低延迟视频重建。它用图像编解码器编码GOP首帧，并通过码本引导的自回归潜在压缩表示后续P帧。摘要显示在超低比特率下达到优越的感知重建质量，无需额外训练。
Motivation: 现有生成式视频压缩方法需要额外训练来使生成模型从紧凑表示产生真实重建，缺乏零样本能力。
Method: 提出ZeroGVC，采用码本引导自回归潜在压缩，通过选择可复现的码本噪声向量组合，引导潜在去噪轨迹朝向目标P帧，解码器仅需少量去噪步骤即可复现相同轨迹。还设计了可选的双向参考模式，利用下一I帧上下文减轻误差传播而不增加比特开销。
Result: 在标准视频压缩基准上的实验表明，ZeroGVC在超低比特率下实现了优越的感知重建质量，且无需任何额外训练。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了零样本能力、码本引导自回归潜在压缩的有效性以及双向参考模式对误差传播的抑制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Error-Free Long Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video generation have made minute-level synthesis possible; however, generating long videos remains challenging due to error accumulation, attribute drift, and the limited availability of long video data. In this paper, we introduce an infinite-length video generation framework that focusing on addressing these issues and produces high-quality, dynamic, and identity-consistent single-shot long videos. We first finetune a diffusion model as a video extension model on large-scale short video data to autoregressively generate temporally coherent clips. Inspired by the success of large language models (LLMs), we adopt causal attention computation between clips to further finetune this model on long video data. In this way, the tokens in one clip (short video) are computed by bidirectional attention while tokens among clips are computed by unidirectional attention. This design leverages the strengths of modern diffusion models while preserving long-term context information, effectively mitigating error accumulation and attribute drift. To achieve memory efficiency during inference, we adopt a key-value (KV) caching mechanism to maintain a constant KV memory. Furthermore, we introduce truncation-rectified flow (T-RFlow) technique to further suppress error accumulation. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. Our framework establishes a new benchmark for realistic and coherent minute-level video synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个无限长度视频生成框架，旨在解决长视频生成中的错误累积、属性漂移和长视频数据稀缺问题。该方法首先在短视频数据上微调扩散模型作为视频扩展模型，通过自回归方式生成时间连贯的片段；然后引入因果注意力（causal attention）在片段间进行单向计算，片段内使用双向注意力，以保持长期上下文信息。采用KV缓存机制维持恒定内存，并引入截断整流流（T-RFlow）技术进一步抑制错误累积。实验表明该方法生成了高质量、动态且身份一致的单镜头长视频，为分钟级视频合成建立了新基准。
Motivation: 现有视频生成方法在生成分钟级长视频时面临错误累积、属性漂移以及长视频数据稀缺等问题。
Method: 提出无限长度视频生成框架：先微调扩散模型作为视频扩展模型在短视频数据上自回归生成片段；使用因果注意力（片段间单向、片段内双向）在长视频数据上进一步微调；推理时采用KV缓存保持恒定内存，并引入T-RFlow抑制误差累积。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在分钟级长视频合成上实现了高真实感、动态一致且身份一致的生成，建立了新基准。
Conclusion: 该方法通过因果注意力和KV缓存等设计有效缓解了错误累积和属性漂移，但摘要未提及在极端长视频或复杂运动场景下的局限性。

papers.title: Kiwano: A Cutting-Edge Open-Source Toolkit for Speaker Verification
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present Kiwano, an open-source toolkit designed to advance research and evaluation for speaker verification. Kiwano provides a lightweight yet extensible framework built on PyTorch, offering standardized recipes, pretrained models, and integration of several widely used speaker verification architectures. The toolkit emphasizes reproducibility, by delivering transparent training pipelines, unified evaluation protocols and ready-to-use baselines across multiple corpora. Beyond conventional training and inference, Kiwano includes tools for benchmarking, experiment tracking and rapid prototyping of new architectures. To foster community adoption, the toolkit is distributed under the Apache 2.0 license, accompanied by comprehensive documentation and reproducible experiments. By lowering entry barriers and standardizing evaluation practices, Kiwano contributes a valuable resource for both academic research and applied development in speaker verification. The toolkit is publicly available at: https://github.com/kiwano-toolkit/kiwano/
papers.journal_ref: Speaker Odyssey 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Kiwano 是一个基于 PyTorch 的开源说话人验证工具包，提供标准化食谱、预训练模型和多种架构集成，强调可复现性和易用性，附带完整文档和 Apache 2.0 许可，旨在降低研究门槛并推动领域标准化。
Motivation: 当前说话人验证研究中缺乏轻量级、可扩展且标准化的开源工具包，导致实验复现困难、评估不一致。
Method: Kiwano 采用 PyTorch 构建，整合了多种主流说话人验证架构，提供统一的训练管道、评估协议和预训练模型，并包含基准测试、实验跟踪和新架构快速原型工具。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，但宣称提供了即用基线、标准化食谱和复现实验，可促进学术研究与工业应用。
Conclusion: Kiwano 通过降低使用门槛和统一评估实践，为说话人验证领域贡献了有价值的开源资源。

papers.title: Reference-Free Assessment of Physical Consistency in World Model-based Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce reference-free measures for evaluating the physical consistency of generated videos, combining relative and absolute approaches to assess fidelity. Although tools like WorldGym or WorldEval enable robotic simulation via video generation, physical fidelity gaps often prevent these environments from accurately reproducing real-world task success rates of VLA models. Unlike existing evaluation methods, which require costly human voting (Elo) or unavailable ground-truth references (FVD), our approach utilizes DROID-SLAM and SEA-RAFT to quantify physical inconsistencies, motivated by WorldScore. Videos filtered using our relative consistency assessment show an improvement in task success rates of over 8%, effectively narrowing the simulation-to-reality gap. Furthermore, our absolute assessment enables spatio-temporal localization, providing visualization of when and where physical artifacts occur.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出无参考视频生成物理一致性评估方法，结合相对与绝对指标衡量生成视频的物理保真度。利用DROID-SLAM和SEA-RAFT量化不一致性，相对评估过滤后的视频可提升任务成功率超8%，绝对评估支持时空定位人工痕迹。
Motivation: 现有视频生成评估方法需要昂贵的人类投票或不可用的参考真值（如FVD），且物理保真度不足导致仿真环境无法准确复现真实任务成功率。
Method: 提出无参考物理一致性评估，结合相对与绝对方法：相对评估通过DROID-SLAM和SEA-RAFT量化物理不一致性；绝对评估实现时空定位，可视化人工痕迹出现位置与时间。
Result: 使用相对一致性评估过滤后的视频，在机器人任务上成功率提升超过8%，缩小仿真到现实的差距；绝对评估提供时空定位能力。
Conclusion: 该方法无需参考视频即可有效评估视频生成的物理一致性，有助于提升世界模型在机器人仿真中的可靠性。

papers.title: First-Token Broadcasters: Mechanistic Origins of Language Identity and Distributed Robustness in Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Why do multilingual language models sometimes generate in the wrong language, and why is this so hard to fix? We introduce Language Identity Head Ablation (LIHA), a causal intervention that zeros each attention head individually and measures the resulting language switch rate across a parallel dataset of 2,700 prompt-language pairs spanning seven languages. Applied to GPT-2, LIHA identifies a small set of first-token broadcaster heads - led by L6H1 (switch rate 0.32, 3.23 $σ$ above the population mean) - that attend persistently to the first prompt token, propagating its language signal throughout generation. Compensatory redistribution when heads are ablated is statistically significant (p < $10^{-5}$) and follows a directional, hierarchical pattern: compensation always recruits heads in layers above the ablated head, suggesting a feedforward cascade rather than global diffusion. To probe how training regime shapes these circuits, we apply LIHA to a controlled pair - Qwen2.5-1.5B-Base and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct - identical in architecture and size, differing only in training. The base model is nearly flat (max SR=0.016, 200/336 heads at SR=0.0); the instruct model concentrates causal influence sharply at layer 0, led by L0H5 (SR=0.224, 8.93 $σ$ above mean), with all other layers near zero. This controlled comparison provides direct causal evidence that instruction tuning reorganizes language identity circuits toward early-layer localization. Extended experiments with Chinese and Russian confirm that first-token broadcasting is script-specific in GPT-2, with non-Latin languages handled at layer 0 - the same locus as the instruction-tuned model. Code and data will be released upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过因果干预方法LIHA，系统性研究多语言Transformer模型为何偶尔生成错误语言，并发现一组‘首词广播头’（first-token broadcaster heads），尤其是GPT-2中的L6H1（开关率0.32，高于均值3.23σ），它们持续关注首个提示词并传播语言信号。补偿分布具有显著的方向层级性（p<10⁻⁵），总是招募上方层的头。对比Qwen2.5的base与instruct模型，指令微调将语言身份电路集中在第0层（L0H5，SR=0.224，8.93σ高于均值），而base模型近乎平坦。非拉丁语言（中文、俄语）在GPT-2中也由第0层处理，与指令微调模型定位一致。
Motivation: 多语言语言模型有时会以错误语言生成输出，这一问题难以修复。现有方法缺乏对语言身份表征机制的因果理解。
Method: 提出语言身份头消融（Language Identity Head Ablation, LIHA），逐一将每个注意力头的输出置零，并在包含2,700个提示-语言对的平行数据集上测量由此导致的语言切换率，从而识别对语言身份贡献关键的头。
Result: GPT-2中L6H1产生0.32的开关率，高出总体均值3.23个标准差；补偿分布统计显著（p<10⁻⁵）且遵循前馈层级模式。Qwen2.5-Base的开关率近乎平坦（最大SR=0.016，200/336头SR=0.0），而Instruct模型因果影响强烈集中于第0层（L0H5，SR=0.224，高出均值8.93σ），表明指令微调将语言身份电路重组到早期层。非拉丁语言（中文、俄语）在GPT-2中也由第0层处理。
Conclusion: 论文强调语言身份来源于少数‘首词广播头’的持续性关注，指令微调使这些电路集中于早期层，并且非拉丁语言的处理天然位于第0层。这些发现为多语言模型的语言控制提供机理基础。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文通过因果干预方法LIHA，系统性研究多语言Transformer模型为何偶尔生成错误语言，并发现一组‘首词广播头’（first-token broadcaster heads），尤其是GPT-2中的L6H1（开关率0.32，高于均值3.23σ），它们持续关注首个提示词并传播语言信号。补偿分布具有显著的方向层级性（p<10⁻⁵），总是招募上方层的头。对比Qwen2.5的base与instruct模型，指令微调将语言身份电路集中在第0层（L0H5，SR=0.224，8.93σ高于均值），而base模型近乎平坦。非拉丁语言（中文、俄语）在GPT-2中也由第0层处理，与指令微调模型定位一致。

papers.title: ORBIT: Training-Free Multi-Attribute Behavioral Steering via Orthogonal Subspace Rotation
papers.abstract_en: Language models are widely used in assistant settings, where controlling behavioral attributes is often essential. Activation steering modifies hidden-state representations at inference time, providing a lightweight, training-free mechanism that can be toggled at runtime. Existing methods, however, have focused primarily on steering a single attribute at a time. When multiple attributes must be controlled simultaneously, naive summation of per-attribute steering vectors suffers from norm imbalance and directional cancellation, while classifier-based approaches require retraining whenever the attribute set changes. We introduce ORBIT (Orthogonal Rotation-Based Intervention Technique), a training-free extension of rotation-based steering to the multi-attribute setting. Our method constructs a joint subspace from per-attribute steering planes via singular value decomposition and applies a single norm-preserving rotation within that subspace toward a combined target direction. Adaptive per-token gating identifies which attributes need correction at each position, and an optional additive boost strengthens attributes with weak initial projection. We also introduce TraitFactory, a new multi-attribute benchmark that focuses on behavioral tendencies rather than surface-level style. We evaluate ORBIT on TraitFactory and ToneBank across three models (Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B) while steering multiple attributes simultaneously, showing that it achieves stronger and more balanced multi-attribute steering than existing training-free baselines while better preserving output coherence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ORBIT，一种无训练的多属性行为操控方法，通过正交子空间旋转实现多属性同时控制，并引入新基准TraitFactory。实验表明ORBIT在多个模型上比现有无训练基线实现更强更平衡的多属性操控，同时更好保持输出连贯性。
Motivation: 现有激活操控方法主要操控单一属性，同时控制多属性时，简单求和存在范数不平衡和方向抵消问题，而基于分类器的方法需重新训练。
Method: ORBIT通过奇异值分解构建联合子空间，在该子空间内应用单一保范旋转朝向组合目标方向，并采用自适应逐词门控和可选增强模块。
Result: 在TraitFactory和ToneBank上评估Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B，ORBIT实现更强更平衡的多属性操控，同时更好保持输出连贯性。
Conclusion: ORBIT提供了无训练的多属性行为操控扩展，并且新基准TraitFactory关注行为倾向而非表面风格。

papers.title: Interest Entanglement: The Hidden Barrier to Blind Super-Resolution Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Fidelity and perceptual quality are two inherently competing and conflicting objectives in the image super-resolution (SR) task. Different loss functions focus on these objectives to varying extents. Regression losses enhance the model's fidelity but lack sufficient attention to high-frequency details, resulting in a loss of fine details. In contrast, perception losses improve the model's visual quality but may introduce undesirable artifacts. Balancing these two optimization goals can be viewed as a Multi-Objective Optimization problem. Existing methods are limited to cautiously adjusting weight parameters between these losses, overlooking the underlying Interest Entanglement problem. To address this problem, we explore the inherent frequency-domain conflict between the regression objective and the perceptual objective, and analyze the causes of Interest Entanglement in SR tasks. According to our findings, we propose the Shared-Feature-Representation based Super-Resolution framework (SFR), which decouples the learning process of different optimization objectives, allowing the model to explore a common optimization direction for both goals and achieve an effective balance between them. To better leverage shared features, we also proposed the InfoSqueeze module, which filters redundant information through a dimensionality reduction and expansion process, effectively transforming features into a consistent space. Quantitative and qualitative experiments across five representative datasets affirm the superiority of SFR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图像超分辨率中保真度与感知质量之间的冲突，将其视为多目标优化问题。作者发现现有方法仅调整损失权重而忽略了“兴趣纠缠”问题，通过频域分析揭示了回归目标与感知目标之间的冲突，并提出基于共享特征表示的超分辨率框架（SFR），通过InfoSqueeze模块解耦不同优化目标的学习过程，实现有效平衡。在五个代表性数据集上验证了SFR的优越性。
Motivation: 图像超分辨率中保真度与感知质量是相互竞争的目标，现有方法仅通过调整损失权重来平衡，忽视了底层的兴趣纠缠问题，导致优化受限。
Method: 提出Shared-Feature-Representation based Super-Resolution (SFR)框架，通过频域分析解耦回归和感知目标的学习过程；并提出InfoSqueeze模块，通过降维和扩展过程过滤冗余信息，将特征变换到一致空间。
Result: 在五个代表性数据集上的定性和定量实验表明SFR优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 该工作揭示了超分辨率中兴趣纠缠问题的存在，并提供了有效的解耦方案，实现了保真度和感知质量更好的平衡。

papers.title: On the Sparsity-Storage-Accuracy Tradeoff in Parsimoniously Activated Dictionary Learning
papers.abstract_en: Dictionary learning has long been studied from both optimization and probabilistic perspectives. While formulations with element-wise sparsity regularization (e.g., L1-based sparse coding) admit well-established probabilistic interpretations, many structured variants that impose global constraints lack a clear and tractable generative view. In this paper, we revisit a class of practically effective yet theoretically under-explored dictionary learning methods that impose a simple global regularization on the number of activated dictionary atoms, which we term parsimoniously activated dictionary learning (PADL). We show that PADL admits an equivalent formulation as maximum a posteriori estimation under a structured generative model, with auxiliary latent variables that govern global activation patterns. This formulation allows us to derive generalization guarantees that are difficult to obtain under the original formulation. More importantly, it yields an analytical characterization of the tradeoff between sparsity, storage cost, and reconstruction accuracy, enabling data-driven estimation of optimal hyperparameters. Based on this connection, we develop an efficient and interpretable PADL algorithm that eliminates manual hyperparameter tuning, achieving improved reconstruction performance under comparable sparsity levels on visual benchmarks. We further demonstrate its practical utility in accelerating inference for vision-language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新研究一类在实践中有效但理论上被忽视的字典学习方法——节俭激活字典学习（PADL），该方法对激活的字典原子数量施加全局正则化。作者证明PADL等价于结构化生成模型下的最大后验估计，从而导出泛化保证和稀疏性、存储成本与重建准确率之间的分析权衡。基于此，开发出无需手动调参的高效可解释PADL算法，在视觉基准上以可比稀疏性获得更好重建性能，并加速视觉语言模型推理。
Motivation: 现有字典学习方法中，基于元素级稀疏正则化的方法有成熟的概率解释，但许多施加全局约束的结构化变体缺乏清晰可处理的生成模型视角，导致理论分析困难。
Method: 通过将PADL重新表述为结构化生成模型下的最大后验估计，引入辅助潜变量控制全局激活模式，从而导出泛化保证和稀疏性-存储-准确率的权衡解析式，并基于此设计无需手动调参的高效算法。
Result: 在视觉基准上，该方法在可比稀疏度下实现了更好的重建性能，并展示了在加速视觉语言模型推理中的实际效用。
Conclusion: PADL的结构化生成模型解释提供了理论支撑，并使得数据驱动的最优超参数估计成为可能，从而提升字典学习的实用性和可解释性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Reliability-Guided Adaptive Ensembling for Robust Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) can mitigate domain shift without source data, but it is highly brittle under adversarially contaminated test streams, where corrupted inputs also destabilize online updates. We study robust test-time adaptation (RTTA) in the adversarial-stream setting, which remains comparatively underexplored relative to standard TTA, and propose SAFER (Stochastic Augmentation Framework for Enhanced Robustness), a training-free reliability-guided augmentation wrapper for RTTA. SAFER preserves the wrapped TTA objective while replacing brittle single-view predictions with a reliability-guided pooled predictor. For each test sample, SAFER generates stochastic augmentations and aggregates their predictions through correlation-weighted pooling with outlier detection. We further study an adaptive-mixing extension that improves clean-performance retention by adjusting original-versus-augmentation weighting using feature disagreement signals. We evaluate on PACS, VLCS, and OfficeHome under PGD attacks at various attack rates. Across benchmarks, SAFER improves resilience of TTA methods to adversarial attacks while maintaining competitive clean performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对对抗性污染测试流下的鲁棒测试时适应（RTTA）问题，提出SAFER，一种训练无关的可靠性引导增强框架，通过随机增强和相关性加权池化聚合预测，结合异常检测，提升TTA方法的鲁棒性。在PACS、VLCS和OfficeHome数据集上，SAFER在PGD攻击下增强了TTA方法的抵抗能力，同时保持了良好的清洁性能。
Motivation: 标准测试时适应（TTA）在面对对抗性污染的测试流时高度脆弱，鲁棒测试时适应（RTTA）在对抗流设置下相对未被充分探索。
Method: 提出SAFER，一种无需训练的可靠性引导增强包装器。对每个测试样本生成随机增强，通过相关性加权池化聚合预测，并带有异常检测。还研究了自适应混合扩展，通过特征不一致信号调整原始和增强权重的比例。
Result: 在PACS、VLCS、OfficeHome数据集上，PGD攻击下，SAFER提升了TTA方法对对抗攻击的鲁棒性，同时保持了有竞争力的清洁性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调SAFER是一种简单而有效的方法，能够增强TTA的鲁棒性，且无需额外训练。

papers.title: Select-to-Act: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning via Adaptive Language Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been widely applied to sequential decision-making, yet it often suffers from poor sample efficiency due to costly interactions with the environment. A limited line of recent work has started exploring improving RL efficiency by leveraging external knowledge expressed in natural-language instructions. However, the few existing approaches typically treat the entire instruction as a single conditioning input, failing to account for the stage-dependent nature of language guidance, especially in complex environments. In this paper, we propose \emph{Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Language Instructions (HRLLI)}, a hierarchical RL framework that explicitly models natural-language instructions as dynamically selectable semantic guidance during decision-making. HRLLI decomposes instructions into a set of piecewise guidance elements, where each instruction piece may become relevant at different stages of interaction with the environment. A novel hierarchical RL policy structure is then formulated in a \emph{Select-to-Act} paradigm: a high-level semantic policy acts as a guidance selector that selects the most relevant instruction piece to the current state to guide the low-level agent's decision, while a low-level policy executes environment actions conditioned on the selected guidance. The two-level policies are learned simultaneously to maximize augmented expected returns from interactions with the environment. This design enables the agent to adaptively ground language instructions into stage-specific decisions during interaction. Experiments on the instruction-intensive RTFM benchmark show that HRLLI consistently outperforms strong instruction-conditioned RL baselines, demonstrating that explicitly modeling adaptive instruction selection significantly improves the effectiveness of RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Language Instructions (HRLLI)，一种分层强化学习框架，将自然语言指令分解为分段的指导元素，并通过高层语义策略动态选择最相关的指令片段来引导低层策略的决策。在 RTFM 基准上，HRLLI 优于现有指令条件强化学习方法，证明自适应指令选择能显著提升强化学习效果。
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法利用外部自然语言指导时，通常将整个指令作为单一条件输入，忽略了语言指导在不同交互阶段的相关性变化，导致效率低下。
Method: 提出 Select-to-Act 范式：高层语义策略作为指导选择器，依据当前状态选择最相关的指令片段；低层策略则根据所选指导执行环境动作。两层策略通过最大化增广期望回报联合学习。
Result: 在指令密集型 RTFM 基准上，HRLLI 持续优于多种强指令条件强化学习基线。
Conclusion: 显式建模自适应指令选择能显著提升强化学习在复杂环境中的有效性。

papers.title: Emergence of Chaos in the Tropical Atmosphere: Study of the Weak Temperature Gradient System
papers.abstract_en: The atmospheric tropical belt is believed to be more predictable than the extratropics. This question is revisited here by exploring the emergence of chaos in reduced-order model versions of the vorticity equation under the weak temperature gradient hypothesis, which provides a good description of the large-scale tropical atmosphere. The analysis reveals that under fairly realistic divergence forcing amplitudes, chaos may emerge, sometimes with Lyapunov time scales of less than a day. This result contrasts with the idea of a predictable tropical atmosphere, and opens important questions on the effective origin of predictability in the Tropics.

TL;DR: 本文通过弱温度梯度假设下的降阶涡度方程模型，研究热带大气混沌的出现。发现在现实辐散发强迫下混沌可能产生，李雅普诺夫时间尺度可小于一天，挑战了热带大气更可预测的传统观点。
Motivation: 传统认为热带大气比中纬度更可预测，本文质疑这一观点，通过简化模型探究混沌的起源和条件。
Method: 采用弱温度梯度假设下的涡度方程降阶模型，分析不同辐散发强迫振幅下的动力学行为，并计算李雅普诺夫指数以表征混沌。
Result: 在现实强迫幅度下观察到混沌，李雅普诺夫时间尺度小于一天，表明热带大气可预测性可能比预期更低。
Conclusion: 结果挑战了热带大气可预测性的传统认识，并提出关于热带可预测性有效起源的重要问题。

papers.title: Customizing Video Portraits via Identity-ActionDecoupling
papers.abstract_en: Identity-Preserving Text-to-Video Generation (IPT2V) seeks to synthesize a temporally coherent video from a reference image and a textual description, while simultaneously preserving the subject's identity and allowing fine-grained control over facial dynamics. Although recent methods such as ID-Animator and ConsisID inject identity features only at inference time, they ignored the ID-irrelevant information contained in Facial embedding, leading to monotonous or inaccurate facial movements that poorly follow the prompt. We introduce Identity-Action Decoupling (IaD) framework as well as two loss function Identity Decoupling Loss and Text Alignment Loss to solve this problem. Without any subject-specific fine-tuning, IaD yields videos that (1) maintain cross-temporal identity consistency and (2) exhibit rich, controllable expressions and scene variations that closely match the input text.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出身份-动作解耦（IaD）框架，用于身份保持的文本到视频生成（IPT2V）。通过身份解耦损失和文本对齐损失，在无需特定主体微调的情况下，生成同时保持跨时间身份一致性且表情与场景丰富可控的视频。
Motivation: 现有IPT2V方法仅关注身份特征注入，忽略面部嵌入中的身份无关信息，导致面部动作单调或不准确，难以精确跟随文本提示。
Method: 提出IaD框架，包含身份解耦损失（Identity Decoupling Loss）和文本对齐损失（Text Alignment Loss），无需针对特定主体微调。
Result: 生成视频保持跨时间身份一致性，并展现丰富、可控的表情与场景变化，紧密匹配输入文本描述。
Conclusion: IaD框架有效解耦身份与动作，提升IPT2V的生成质量和可控性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Flow Annealing Posterior Sampling for Function-Space Regression and Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Principled regression for stochastic processes is a long-standing challenge with deep connections to scientific inverse problems. We introduce Flow Annealing Posterior Sampling (FAPS), to our knowledge the first function-space posterior sampling framework that unifies stochastic-process regression and PDE inverse problems. Built on pretrained function-space flow-matching priors, FAPS enables likelihood-guided posterior inference from sparse and noisy observations, supports variable query discretizations, and avoids explicit prior-density evaluation. Its Langevin correction uses a low-rank covariance preconditioner to exploit dominant function-space correlations across discretizations. Across Gaussian and non-Gaussian stochastic-process regression benchmarks and diverse PDE inverse problems, FAPS produces coherent posterior samples with accurate uncertainty quantification, significantly outperforming existing functional regression baselines and achieving competitive or better PDE noisy inverse performance than diffusion-based posterior samplers while reducing test-time sampling cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出流退火后验采样（FAPS），一种统一的函数空间后验采样框架，用于随机过程回归和偏微分方程反问题。该方法基于预训练的函数空间流匹配先验，通过似然引导从稀疏含噪观测中进行后验推断，支持可变查询离散化，并避免显式先验密度评估。在多种随机过程回归和PDE反问题基准上，FAPS生成相干的后验样本，不确定性量化准确，显著优于现有函数回归基线，且测试时采样成本更低。
Motivation: 随机过程的原理性回归长期存在挑战，与科学反问题有深刻联系；现有方法在处理函数空间后验采样时存在局限。
Method: FAPS利用预训练的函数空间流匹配先验，结合似然引导的后验推断，采用低秩协方差预条件器的朗之万校正来利用跨离散化的主导函数空间相关性。
Result: 在高斯和非高斯随机过程回归基准以及多种PDE反问题上，FAPS产生的后验样本具有准确的不确定性量化，显著优于现有函数回归基线，在PDE含噪反问题上与基于扩散的后验采样器性能相当或更好，同时降低了测试时采样成本。
Conclusion: FAPS是第一个统一随机过程回归和PDE反问题的函数空间后验采样框架，展示了利用预训练流匹配先验进行高效后验推断的潜力。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: T-IMPACT: A Severity-Aware Benchmark for Contextual Image-Text Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in vision-language models and generative editing systems have made it increasingly easy to produce persuasive multimodal misinformation by altering images, text, or both jointly. However, existing datasets focus mainly on authenticity, out-of-context mismatch, or manipulation type, and rarely capture how strongly an edit changes the likely interpretation of a post. We introduce T-IMPACT, a first-release severity-aware benchmark for manipulated news-style image-text pairs. T-IMPACT contains 98,786 examples spanning pristine, image-only, text-only, and joint manipulations, with a calibrated continuous severity signal, coarse low/medium/high labels, and supporting grounding metadata. Starting from a news image-text pair, the pipeline extracts semantic anchors, grounds them spatially, performs localized image edits and constrained caption rewrites, and calibrates contextual-impact scores using limited human ratings. In this release, the calibrated continuous score is the primary severity target, while the low/medium/high bands should be interpreted as coarse operating buckets rather than balanced classes. Experiments show that current models recover some authenticity signal, but severity prediction remains substantially harder and only weakly aligned with human judgment. T-IMPACT provides an initial benchmark for studying multimodal manipulation beyond binary real/fake classification toward graded contextual impact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 T-IMPACT，一个面向新闻风格图像-文本对的严重性感知操纵检测基准，包含 98,786 个样本，覆盖原始、仅图像、仅文本和联合操纵，提供校准的连续严重性分数和粗粒度低/中/高标签。实验表明现有模型能恢复部分真实性信号，但严重性预测远弱于人类判断。
Motivation: 现有数据集主要关注真实性、上下文不匹配或操纵类型，很少衡量编辑对帖子解释的改变程度，缺乏对操纵严重性的细粒度评估。
Method: 从新闻图像-文本对出发，提取语义锚点并空间定位，执行局部图像编辑和受限字幕重写，利用有限人工评分校准上下文影响分数，构建连续严重性目标和粗粒度标签。
Result: 当前模型在真实性检测上表现尚可，但严重性预测与人类判断一致性弱，表明该任务更具挑战性。
Conclusion: T-IMPACT 提供了超越二元真假分类、面向分级上下文影响的基准，揭示了严重性预测的困难。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Benchmarking Robot Memory Under Interference
papers.abstract_en: Robots deployed in realistic settings will accumulate experience across many sessions and tasks over their deployment. The robot's tasks may often require it to remember information from multiple sessions ago, making long-context robot memory important for real-world deployments. However, most robot-memory benchmarks today are based on single episodes or a short context. To measure how current robot memory systems perform on longer sessions with more distractions, we introduce RoboMME-Interference, a cross-session benchmark built on RoboMME. For each query episode, we construct a session history using the query's relevant prior demonstration followed by a controlled number of unrelated sessions, which we provide to the VLA as memory and measure accuracy. Running RoboMME's released memory-augmented $π_{0.5}$ variants unmodified through this benchmark, we find that while perceptual memory variants improve success when given the history without any distractors, they decay strongly and steadily as unrelated sessions accumulate. With this release, we emphasize the importance of long-context memory and robustness to interference and show that current systems largely fail on such capabilities. The project page, videos, code, and data are at https://robotmemorybench.com.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RoboMME-Interference基准，用于评估机器人记忆系统在跨会话、多干扰条件下的长期记忆能力。实验表明，现有记忆增强的VLA模型（如π_{0.5}）在无干扰时表现良好，但随无关会话积累性能急剧下降。作者强调长期记忆和对干扰的鲁棒性是当前系统的短板。
Motivation: 现有机器人记忆基准多基于单幕或短上下文，缺乏对长时间跨度、多干扰场景的评估，而实际部署中机器人需要记住多个会话前的信息。
Method: 基于RoboMME构建跨会话基准RoboMME-Interference，为每个查询片段构造包含相关先验演示和可控数量的无关会话的会话历史，将其作为VLA的记忆输入并测量准确率。
Result: 未修改的π_{0.5}变体在无干扰时成功率提升，但随无关会话积累性能持续稳定下降，表明当前系统对干扰的鲁棒性不足。
Conclusion: 该基准凸显了长期上下文记忆和抗干扰能力的重要性，并显示当前机器人记忆系统在此类能力上普遍失败。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Null-Calibrated Conformal Selection via Target-Membership Scores
papers.abstract_en: Conformal selection aims to identify test candidates whose unknown responses fall in a target region while controlling the false discovery rate. Existing methods often inherit prediction-oriented nonconformity scores, such as residual or clipped residual scores, from conformal prediction. We argue that the natural score for selection is instead the target-membership probability. This score directly addresses the binary event being selected, and any monotone transform of it gives the Neyman--Pearson oracle ranking at a fixed null selection level. This distinction is irrelevant for mean-monotone targets, where conventional scores induce essentially the same ranking, but becomes important for interval-valued, variance-driven, multimodal, or multi-condition targets, where prediction-oriented scores can be misaligned with selection power. We study membership-score-based conformal selection and isolate one conformal calibration route, Null-Calibrated Conformal Selection (NCCS), which ranks test scores against confirmed non-target calibration examples. Under null exchangeability, NCCS yields finite-sample valid null p-values, which can be combined with BY under arbitrary dependence or with BH under standard positive-dependence conditions. Experiments support the score principle: membership scores match conventional scores on mean-monotone targets, substantially improve over mean-score selection on variance-driven targets, and, when calibrated by NCCS, trade power for finite-sample null validity in rare-target regimes where direct empirical-FDP thresholding can be anti-conservative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了基于目标成员分数（target-membership scores）的共形选择方法，并引入零校准共形选择（NCCS），通过将测试分数与确认的非目标校准样本进行排序，在有限样本下控制错误发现率。实验表明，成员分数在非均值单调目标（如方差驱动、多模态等）上优于传统预测导向的分数。
Motivation: 现有共形选择方法通常继承预测导向的非一致性分数（如残差），但这些分数在区间值、方差驱动、多模态或多条件目标上可能与选择能力不一致，导致功效损失。
Method: 提出基于目标成员分数的共形选择框架，并聚焦于零校准共形选择（NCCS），该方法在零假设可交换性下生成有限样本有效的零假设p值，可与BY或BH过程结合使用。
Result: 在均值单调目标上，成员分数与传统分数表现相当；在方差驱动目标上，成员分数显著优于均值分数；在罕见目标场景下，NCCS在有限样本有效性上优于直接经验FDP阈值方法。
Conclusion: 成员分数是共形选择更自然的分数，NCCS提供了有限样本零假设有效性，适用于非标准目标分布。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards Whole Hand and Wrist Kinematic Tracking with a Wearable A-Mode Ultrasound Probe
papers.abstract_en: A-mode ultrasound (US) has emerged as a promising modality for hand and wrist motion tracking. Prior works have mainly addressed static gesture classification or regression of a few degrees of freedom (DoFs), typically relying on non-wearable systems and external computing devices, and highlight the need for strategies to ensure robustness to sensor repositioning. In this work, we propose a framework for robust whole-hand and wrist kinematic tracking via wearable A-mode US using the WULPUS platform, tackling the regression of 23 DoFs directly on the probe. First, we introduce a compact (11285 parameters) multi-output convolutional neural network combined with an incremental training strategy, which improves inter-session generalization and reduces mean absolute error by more than 17% compared to a non-incremental approach. Second, we demonstrate, for the first time, the feasibility of end-to-end hand and wrist kinematic tracking entirely on-device. We deploy the model on the WULPUS nRF52832 microcontroller, achieving 0.73 mJ per inference, 29.1 ms latency, and showing the feasibility of full operation (data acquisition, online inference, and BLE streaming of results) within 33 mW, enabling up to 36 hours of continuous use and an 88% reduction in wireless bandwidth compared to raw data transmission.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于可穿戴 A-mode 超声探头（WULPUS 平台）的框架，用于鲁棒的全手和腕部运动学跟踪（23 自由度回归）。采用紧凑卷积神经网络（11285 参数）和增量训练策略，相比非增量方法平均绝对误差降低 17%以上。首次实现端到端手部和腕部运动跟踪完全在设备上运行，在 nRF52832 微控制器上实现每次推理 0.73 mJ、延迟 29.1 ms、总功率 33 mW，支持连续使用 36 小时，无线带宽减少 88%。
Motivation: 先前工作主要解决静态手势分类或少量自由度回归，通常依赖非可穿戴系统和外部计算设备，且对传感器重新定位的鲁棒性不足。
Method: 提出紧凑多输出卷积神经网络（11285 参数）结合增量训练策略，直接回归 23 个自由度；部署在 WULPUS nRF52832 微控制器上实现全设备端操作。
Result: 增量训练相比非增量方法平均绝对误差降低 17%以上；在设备上每次推理 0.73 mJ，延迟 29.1 ms，总功耗 33 mW，连续使用 36 小时，无线带宽减少 88%。
Conclusion: 首次展示了可穿戴 A-mode 超声在设备端进行完全手部和腕部运动跟踪的可行性，并实现了高能效和低带宽。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: No Reference-Free Generalization in Quantum Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Quantum machine learning is often motivated by the exponentially large state space of quantum systems, but this promise leaves a basic generalization problem unresolved: how can a learner assign different meanings to unseen quantum directions when the training data provide no preferred basis, measurement frame, or other orienting structure? We address this identifiability problem by formulating supervised learning without an external quantum reference frame, so that predictions cannot depend on an arbitrary choice of Hilbert-space coordinates. This requirement forces the learned classifier to preserve every unitary symmetry left unbroken by the training data. We prove that whenever the training states fail to span the full Hilbert space, all pure states orthogonal to their span must receive the same prediction -- even when those states are mutually orthogonal and perfectly distinguishable once an appropriate measurement is supplied. The limitation is therefore not caused by state discrimination, optimization, or computational power, but by missing reference information. We further establish a robust version under weak symmetry breaking and show that learning generic unstructured concepts on multiqubit systems requires exponentially many independently oriented training directions. Numerical illustrations visualize the resulting prediction collapse and its controlled relaxation. Our results identify feature maps, measurement bases, Hamiltonians, locality, symmetry priors, architectures, and sufficiently diverse training states as operational resources for generalization. The central implication is that Hilbert-space dimension alone is not a learnable feature space: successful QML must specify the physical structure that gives unseen quantum directions semantic meaning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明在无外部量子参考系的情况下，量子机器学习模型无法泛化到与训练数据正交的纯态，所有这样的态将得到相同预测，即使它们本身可区分。该问题源于缺失的参考信息，而非状态区分或优化能力。
Motivation: 量子机器学习的优势通常被归因于指数级大的希尔伯特空间，但泛化问题未解决：当训练数据不提供偏好基或测量框架时，学习器无法赋予未见的量子方向不同的语义含义。
Method: 形式化无外部参考系的监督学习，要求预测不依赖希尔伯特空间坐标的任意选择，从而迫使学习器保持训练数据未破缺的幺正对称性。
Result: 证明当训练态未张成全希尔伯特空间时，所有与其正交的纯态必须得到相同预测；进一步建立弱对称性破缺下的鲁棒版本，并指出学习多量子比特系统上的通用无结构概念需要指数多个独立定向的训练方向。
Conclusion: 希尔伯特空间维度本身不是可学习的特征空间；成功的量子机器学习必须指定赋予未见量子方向语义意义的物理结构（如特征映射、测量基、哈密顿量、局域性、对称性先验、架构和足够多样化的训练态）。

papers.title: Hypothesis-Driven Skill Optimization for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: External skills can improve action-oriented LLM agents without changing model weights, but persistent skill updates are risky when they are distilled from sparse or noisy trajectories. A plausible reflection may encode a useful procedure, a spurious shortcut, or a rule that the target executor cannot reliably follow. We propose Hypothesis-Driven Skill Optimization (HDSO), a train-free framework in which both the skill curator and the agent executor are frozen inference endpoints. The curator observes executor traces, proposes a falsifiable hypothesis with an explicit validation plan, instantiates the hypothesis as a candidate skill package, validates the package through paired control/treatment executions, reviews behavior differences, and consolidates only supported candidates into an approved repository. The executor consumes approved skills through progressive disclosure, preserving the executor-only path when no skill is selected. On ALFWorld, HDSO improves executor-only baselines by +6.9 Avg. SR points for Qwen3-8B and +4.0 points for Qwen3.6-27B. Under 20% randomly flipped success/failure feedback during skill discovery and validation, HDSO preserves a +7.1-point gain for Qwen3-8B. Transfer and heterogeneous-pair diagnostics further show that validated repositories can be useful beyond the run that produced them, but cross-model curation succeeds only when curator diagnosis, executor capability, and validation evidence align. HDSO provides an auditable skill lifecycle for frozen action agents rather than an unconstrained memory accumulation procedure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出假设驱动技能优化（HDSO），一种免训练框架，使技能策展者和智能体执行者均为冻结推理端点。策展者观察执行者轨迹，提出可证伪假设并实例化为候选技能包，通过成对的对照/处理执行验证，仅将支持的候选合并到已批准仓库。执行者通过渐进式披露使用已批准技能。在ALFWorld上，HDSO相对于仅执行者基线提升了Qwen3-8B 6.9个平均成功率点，Qwen3.6-27B提升4.0个点，并在20%随机翻转的反馈下保持7.1个点的增益。
Motivation: 外部技能可提升面向动作的LLM智能体，但从稀疏或嘈杂轨迹中蒸馏技能时，持久技能更新存在风险，可能编码有用过程、虚假捷径或执行者无法可靠遵循的规则。
Method: 提出HDSO，一种无训练框架，包括技能策展者和智能体执行者，两者均为冻结推理端点。策展者观察执行者轨迹，提出带明确验证计划的可证伪假设，实例化为候选技能包，通过成对的对照/处理执行验证，审查行为差异，仅将支持的候选合并到已批准仓库。执行者通过渐进式披露消费已批准技能，并保留无技能时的仅执行者路径。
Result: 在ALFWorld上，HDSO使Qwen3-8B和Qwen3.6-27B的仅执行者基线分别提升6.9和4.0个平均成功率点。在技能发现和验证过程中反馈随机翻转20%时，Qwen3-8B仍保持7.1个点的增益。跨模型策展仅在策展者诊断、执行者能力和验证证据一致时成功。
Conclusion: HDSO为冻结动作智能体提供可审计的技能生命周期，而非无约束的记忆积累过程。
