papers.title: BabelJudge: Measuring LLM-as-a-Judge Reliability Across Languages and Agent Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-judge has become the dominant approach to scalable evaluation in NLP pipelines, yet judges themselves carry systematic biases that raw accuracy hides: they favor responses placed in slot A (position bias), they prefer longer responses regardless of quality (verbosity bias), and their reliability degrades sharply in lower-resource languages. We introduce BabelJudge, an open-source benchmark and reliability audit framework that measures all four failure modes -- position bias, verbosity bias, order inconsistency, and cross-lingual degradation -- on any judge model, without requiring human preference labels. The key insight is gold-labelling by degradation: starting from a high-quality reference response and applying a controlled perturbation yields a pairwise item whose gold label is known by construction, eliminating annotation cost. We evaluate Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-4bit across English, Hindi, Arabic, and Swahili and find that our composite bias-penalised reliability score drops from 0.714 in Hindi to 0.550 in Swahili, a gap that raw accuracy (0.835 vs. 0.660) understates. Swahili order consistency collapses to 0.480, meaning judge verdicts are near-random under slot-order swaps -- a failure mode invisible to accuracy alone. We further extend the framework to agentic evaluation via nine trajectory-level perturbations (argument corruption, tool swaps, hallucinated calls, missing steps) and three new metrics: tool accuracy, hallucination detection rate, and trajectory-length bias. BabelJudge is released as a Python package supporting 11 judge backends. Code: https://github.com/Shreyaskc/BabelJudge
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Source code, benchmark toolkit, and reproduction scripts at https://github.com/Shreyaskc/BabelJudge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BabelJudge 框架，用于测量 LLM 作为评估者（judge）的多种偏差（位置偏差、冗长偏差、顺序不一致、跨语言退化），无需人工偏好标签。通过在高质量参考响应上施加可控扰动来构建已知标签的成对样本，从而消除标注成本。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-4bit 上评估了英语、印地语、阿拉伯语和斯瓦希里语，发现复合偏差惩罚可靠性得分从印地语的 0.714 下降到斯瓦希里语的 0.550，而原始准确率仅从 0.835 下降到 0.660，表明准确率掩盖了退化。同时还扩展到智能体评估，包括九种轨迹级扰动和三个新指标。
Motivation: LLM-as-judge 方法在可扩展评估中广泛使用，但 judge 本身存在系统偏差（位置偏差、冗长偏差等），且在多语言场景下可靠性显著下降，而原始准确率无法揭示这些偏差。
Method: 提出 BabelJudge 框架，通过从高质量参考响应施加可控扰动构建已知标签的成对样本，从而无需人工标注即可测量位置偏差、冗长偏差、顺序不一致和跨语言退化。还扩展到智能体轨迹评估，包括九种扰动和三个新指标。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-4bit 上，复合可靠性得分从印地语的 0.714 降至斯瓦希里语的 0.550（准确率从 0.835 降至 0.660），斯瓦希里语顺序一致性降至 0.480（接近随机）。智能体评估中引入了工具准确率、幻觉检测率和轨迹长度偏差等指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 BabelJudge 是一个开源框架，可用于审计任何 judge 模型的偏差，无需人工标签，且扩展到多语言和智能体场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Online Scheduling for LLM Serving: From Theoretical Bound to System Practice
papers.abstract_en: The explosive demand for interactive Large Language Model serving has highlighted the management of the Key-Value cache's dynamic memory footprint as a critical area for performance optimization in inference engines. Modern inference systems overwhelmingly rely on time-centric scheduling heuristics, such as Shortest Job First. However, their theoretical optimality is rooted in traditional schedule modeling, failing to capture the highly dynamic, 2D spatio-temporal geometric growth specific to LLM inference mechanisms. To resolve this, we propose the geometry-aware online scheduling by introducing the Smallest Volume First (SVF) algorithm and its highly efficient variant, 1-bit SVF. Theoretically, we provide a rigorous mathematical foundation for our approach. Utilizing a novel proof methodology, we tighten the worst-case competitive ratio ($\text{CR} \le 48 \rightarrow \text{CR} \le 5$) for SVF with known output lengths. Building upon this core breakthrough, we complete a comprehensive theoretical taxonomy analyzing our algorithms across different traffic scenarios and information availability. Practically, we seamlessly integrate our approach as a plug-and-play layer in vLLM. Extensive evaluations on Llama-3.1 models demonstrate comprehensive performance gains: SVF delivers strong reductions in both average and tail latency, while 1-bit SVF, with merely a single bit information, achieves competitive throughput and latency. This work establishes a theoretically sound and empirically proven approach for resolving memory-constrained scheduling in modern LLM deployments. To facilitate future research, our code is available at https://github.com/Aurora-Kl/Geometry-Aware-Online-Scheduling.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出几何感知的在线调度算法，用于大型语言模型（LLM）推理中Key-Value缓存的内存管理。作者提出Smallest Volume First (SVF)算法及其高效变体1-bit SVF，理论上将最坏情况竞争比从48收紧至5，并在vLLM中实现即插即用集成。实验表明SVF降低了平均和尾部延迟，1-bit SVF仅需单比特信息即可实现有竞争力的吞吐量和延迟。
Motivation: 现有LLM推理系统依赖时间中心调度启发式（如最短作业优先），但其理论最优性无法捕捉LLM推理的高度动态、2D时空几何增长特性，导致内存受限场景下性能不佳。
Method: 提出几何感知在线调度，引入Smallest Volume First (SVF)算法及其高效变体1-bit SVF。通过新颖的证明方法将已知输出长度下SVF的最坏情况竞争比从48收紧至5，并在不同流量场景和信息可用性下进行完整的理论分析。实现上，将算法作为即插即用层集成到vLLM中。
Result: 在Llama-3.1模型上的广泛评估显示：SVF在平均和尾部延迟上均有显著降低；1-bit SVF仅需单比特信息即可达到竞争性的吞吐量和延迟。
Conclusion: 该工作为现代LLM部署中的内存约束调度提供了理论严谨且经验验证的方法，代码已开源。

summary_sections.method: 提出几何感知在线调度，引入Smallest Volume First (SVF)算法及其高效变体1-bit SVF。通过新颖的证明方法将已知输出长度下SVF的最坏情况竞争比从48收紧至5，并在不同流量场景和信息可用性下进行完整的理论分析。实现上，将算法作为即插即用层集成到vLLM中。
summary_sections.result: 在Llama-3.1模型上的广泛评估显示：SVF在平均和尾部延迟上均有显著降低；1-bit SVF仅需单比特信息即可达到竞争性的吞吐量和延迟。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为现代LLM部署中的内存约束调度提供了理论严谨且经验验证的方法，代码已开源。

papers.title: Adam Converges in Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Adam is one of the most widely implemented and influential modern optimizers. Why is it effective across different optimization problems in practice? This question arguably lies at the center of the optimization community over the last decade and has motivated a substantial body of work aimed at understanding its convergence behavior. However, existing studies have mainly focused on the convergence rate of Adam in smooth nonconvex optimization, which unfortunately does not adequately capture practical settings, since many real-world problems are nonsmooth, such as those arising in training neural networks. Thus, these studies cannot fully explain the popularity and empirical success of Adam. Recently, an insightful and powerful framework called Online-to-Nonconvex Conversion has opened a new way to analyze Adam for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization. Unfortunately, prior works along this line share two common limitations. First, all of them ignore the important bias-correction term in the original Adam algorithm. Second and more importantly, many of them require extra operations that are not used in Adam, such as a clipping step. Therefore, the convergence guarantee for the original Adam method still remains unclear. In this work, we present the first finite-time analysis for the classical form of Adam, i.e., with the bias-correction step and without further algorithmic modifications, and prove that a randomly scaled learning rate ensures a convergence rate of $1/T^{\frac{2}{13}}$ for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization. Moreover, our result provably applies to the modern heavy-tailed noise regime, which is closer to practice. Interestingly, our theory is established under the parameter choice $β_1=β_2$, aligning with the recent empirical studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文给出了经典Adam算法（包含偏置校正步骤且无额外修改）在非光滑非凸优化中的首次有限时间收敛分析，证明随机缩放学习率可达到1/T^{2/13}的收敛速度，且结果在重尾噪声下成立，参数选择β1=β2与近期实证研究一致。
Motivation: 现有Adam收敛性分析主要聚焦光滑非凸优化，无法解释其在非光滑实际问题（如神经网络训练）中的成功；此前基于Online-to-Nonconvex Conversion的工作忽略偏置校正或需要额外裁剪步骤，原始Adam的收敛保证仍不明确。
Method: 提出基于Online-to-Nonconvex Conversion框架的分析方法，对包含偏置校正且无额外修改的经典Adam进行有限时间收敛性证明，使用随机缩放学习率。
Result: 证明了在非光滑非凸优化中以1/T^{2/13}的速率收敛，且结果适用于现代重尾噪声场景。
Conclusion: 本文填补了经典Adam在非光滑非凸优化中收敛性保证的空白，参数选择β1=β2与最近实证研究一致，但收敛率可能不是最优。

papers.title: All Routes Lead to Collapse
papers.abstract_en: Attention sinks, representation collapse, and norm stratification are treated as transformer-specific pathologies. We show they are not specific to attention: they are what content-based routing does under a fixed similarity metric. We give a reframing identity: softmax attention is Boltzmann-weighted aggregation over Euclidean distances with constant key norms, so its score omits a $-\|k\|^2$ term and is blind to key magnitude. This predicts that any router whose metric is ill-matched to its representations should compensate, by concentrating its routing and collapsing the routed representations. We test it on routers that score and aggregate over different axes: softmax attention over tokens (nine pretrained transformers), graph attention over nodes, a selective state-space model and a recurrent mixer over time, and learned residuals over depth. All develop the same signature, and two within-model ablations show it is caused by the routing mechanism rather than by incidental dynamics. The form is contingent, set by the strength of the positional brake each router carries alongside its content score; we sweep that brake and move the onset across its whole range. The mechanism is not contingent, and it does not require norm stratification: a router with norm-normalized keys concentrates just the same. We do not claim these models implement Riemannian geometry; the geometric view is a diagnostic that names the inadequacy of the flat, norm-blind metric.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出注意力汇、表示坍塌和范数分层并非Transformer特有，而是任何基于内容的路由器在固定相似性度量下的必然现象。作者通过将softmax注意力重述为等范数键上的玻尔兹曼加权聚合，预言了路由集中和表示坍塌，并在多种路由机制（包括softmax注意力、图注意力、状态空间模型等）中验证了这一共同特征。
Motivation: 揭示注意力汇、表示坍塌和范数分层等被视为Transformer特有病理现象背后的通用机制，说明这些现象源于内容路由与固定相似性度量的不匹配。
Method: 提出一个重述恒等式，将softmax注意力解释为等范数键上的玻尔兹曼加权聚合，并指出其缺失$-\|k\|^2$项导致对键范数不敏感。通过在不同路由架构（包括Transformer、图注意力、选择性状态空间模型、循环混合器、学习残差）上进行实验，并引入位置刹车（positional brake）进行消融，验证路由机制本身导致这些现象。
Result: 实验表明所有测试的路由器都发展出相同的特征，且两个模型内消融证明该特征由路由机制引起而非附带动力学。改变位置刹车强度可以连续调控现象出现的时刻。
Conclusion: 这些现象的形式是偶然的（取决于位置刹车强度），但机制是必然的，且不需要范数分层——即使键被归一化，路由器也会同样集中。几何视角仅作为诊断手段，指出平整且对范数不敏感的度量的不足。

papers.title: EmbodiedUS-FS: Fast Slow Intelligence for Ultrasound Robotics
papers.abstract_en: Robotic ultrasound scanning in real clinical environments requires both high-level clinical workflow reasoning and low-level closed-loop execution. Physicians natural-language instructions often contain implicit anatomical targets, procedural logic, image-quality requirements, and safety constraints, while execution is affected by patient motion, contact variations, and target drift. We propose a fast and slow hierarchical embodied ultrasound system for safe and interpretable robotic ultrasound assistance. The Slow Brain performs intent parsing and stage-wise task planning with knowledge augmentation from an API and handbook corpus, and generates executable plans through task-graph construction and structured plan verification. The Fast Brain fuses multimodal feedback, including ultrasound images, robot pose and force states, and patient-motion information, to refine local actions and perform image-quality-guided recovery behaviors. The system further integrates a Safety Shield and a hierarchical escalation policy to constrain risky actions and trigger replanning or human confirmation under persistent failures or safety-bound violations. Experiments on planning evaluation, closed-loop execution under dynamic perturbations, and safety-mechanism validation demonstrate that the proposed hierarchical design improves task success rates while reducing safety violations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文提出一种快慢分层具身超声系统（EmbodiedUS-FS），用于在真实临床环境中执行安全且可解释的机器人超声扫描。慢速大脑负责意图解析和基于知识增强的阶段任务规划，快速大脑融合多模态反馈进行局部动作优化和图像质量指导的恢复行为，系统还集成了安全盾和分层升级策略以约束风险行为。实验表明该分层设计提高了任务成功率并减少了安全违规。
Motivation: 真实临床环境中的机器人超声扫描需要同时处理高级临床工作流程推理和低级闭环执行，而医生的自然语言指令常常隐含解剖目标、程序逻辑、图像质量要求和安全约束，执行过程受患者运动、接触变化和目标漂移影响。
Method: 提出快慢分层架构：慢速大脑通过API和手册语料库进行知识增强的意图解析和阶段任务规划，生成可执行计划；快速大脑融合超声图像、机器人位姿和力状态、患者运动信息，进行局部动作优化和基于图像质量的恢复行为；同时集成安全盾和分层升级策略以约束风险行为并在持续失败或安全边界违反时触发重新规划或人工确认。
Result: 摘要报告在规划评估、动态扰动下的闭环执行以及安全机制验证实验中，该分层设计提高了任务成功率并减少了安全违规。
Conclusion: 该分层快慢智能设计对于保障机器人超声在临床环境中的安全性和可解释性具有潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Curriculum Reinforcement Learning Can Incentivize Reasoning Capacity in LLMs Beyond the Base Model
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is widely viewed as a promising path toward continuously improving large language models. Recent works, however, suggest that mainstream RLVR often reallocates sampling probabilities among trajectories already present in the base model: it can improve sampling efficiency, reflected by higher pass@1 scores, but yields limited gains, and can even decrease pass@k scores when k is large, and therefore may fail to expand the base model's reasoning capacity boundary. In this paper, we present a boundary-aware Curriculum RL approach to move beyond the base model's reasoning capacity boundary. Our approach first uses pass@k sampling to locate the current reasoning capacity boundary, then applies targeted teacher guidance to examples near or beyond that boundary, and finally uses RL to consolidate the newly introduced reasoning patterns. Across Qwen, Llama, and DeepSeek base models, boundary-aware Curriculum RL improves both pass@1 scores and pass@256 scores, with pass@1 reflecting one-attempt performance and pass@256 serving as an empirical proxy for the reasoning capacity boundary. In our experiments, average pass@256 improves by 9.8 percentage points over the base models and by 10.3 percentage points over Vanilla RLVR. These results suggest that boundary-aware Curriculum RL can provide a scalable route for LLMs to continuously improve beyond the base model's empirical reasoning capacity boundary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出边界感知的课程强化学习（Curriculum RL）方法，旨在突破基础LLM的推理能力边界。该方法通过pass@k采样定位当前推理边界，对边界附近或超出边界的样本进行针对性教师引导，最后用RL巩固新推理模式。在Qwen、Llama、DeepSeek等模型上，该方法同时提升了pass@1和pass@256分数，平均pass@256比基础模型提升9.8个百分点，比普通RLVR提升10.3个百分点。
Motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）主要重分配基础模型已有的轨迹采样概率，能提高pass@1但难以扩展推理能力边界，甚至可能降低大k时的pass@k。
Method: 提出边界感知课程强化学习：先用pass@k采样定位推理能力边界；然后对边界附近或超出边界的例子使用教师模型（如更大模型或正确轨迹）进行引导；最后用RL（如PPO）巩固新推理模式。
Result: 在Qwen、Llama、DeepSeek系列模型上，边界感知课程RL平均提升pass@256 9.8个百分点（相对基础模型）和10.3个百分点（相对普通RLVR），同时pass@1也有提升。
Conclusion: 边界感知课程RL可作为一种可扩展的路线，使LLM持续超越基础模型的实证推理能力边界。

papers.title: Diffusion Integrated Gradients: Controllable Path Generation for Flexible Feature Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Path-based attribution methods such as Integrated Gradients (IG) are widely adopted for their strong axiomatic properties and effectiveness in attributing model predictions to input features by integrating gradients along a path from a baseline to the input. However, the choice of the attribution path largely affects the quality of explanations, and existing approaches rely on fixed or hand-crafted paths that often produce noisy or distorted attributions. To address this limitation, we propose Diffusion Integrated Gradients (DiffIG), a novel method that reformulates path generation as a conditional generative modeling problem. DiffIG first trains a diffusion model to learn a distribution over paths generated from a Stick-Breaking Process, then employs guided sampling to embed user guidance during the sampling procedure. We demonstrate that DiffIG quantitatively matches or outperforms existing path-based methods, achieving perceptually aligned explanations. This work introduces a new generative perspective for flexible, inference-time controllable Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) methods.
papers.comment: 44 pages, 22 figures, 10 tables. Accepted to ECCV 2026; includes appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于路径的归因方法中路径选择影响解释质量的问题，提出 Diffusion Integrated Gradients (DiffIG)，将路径生成建模为条件生成问题。先训练扩散模型学习基于 Stick-Breaking Process 的路径分布，再通过引导采样嵌入用户约束。实验表明 DiffIG 在定量指标上匹配或优于现有方法，生成感知对齐的解释。
Motivation: 现有基于路径的归因方法（如 Integrated Gradients）严重依赖固定或手工设定的路径，导致噪声或扭曲的归因；需一种能灵活生成可控路径的方法。
Method: DiffIG 将路径生成视为条件生成建模：首先训练扩散模型学习 Stick-Breaking Process 生成的路径分布，然后利用引导采样 (guided sampling) 在推理时嵌入用户指定的控制信号。
Result: 定量实验表明 DiffIG 在多个基准上匹配或超过现有基于路径的方法，且生成的归因图在感知上与输入对齐。
Conclusion: 本文提供了可解释 AI 中灵活、推理时可控制的路径生成新视角，但未在摘要中讨论局限性或大规模验证。

summary_sections.conclusion: 本文提供了可解释 AI 中灵活、推理时可控制的路径生成新视角，但未在摘要中讨论局限性或大规模验证。

papers.title: Specificity- and Calibration-Aware Breast Ultrasound Segmentation via Entropy-Guided Boundary Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Lesion segmentation in breast ultrasound involves two related challenges. In images with lesions, speckle noise, low tissue contrast, and posterior acoustic shadowing cause boundary leakage and incomplete contour delineation. In images without lesions, those same artifacts generate false-positive activations in regions resembling solid lesion tissue. This study addresses both failure modes through a single modification to the training objective. Rather than weighting every boundary pixel equally, the proposed loss scales contour penalties by per-pixel predictive entropy and the ground-truth boundary map, concentrating gradient emphasis on lesion margin locations where the network remains uncertain. The loss was evaluated on the BUSI dataset through a controlled ablation against two baselines: a model without boundary supervision and a model with uniformly weighted boundary binary cross-entropy. Across 97 lesion-containing test images, mean Dice scores were statistically indistinguishable between the proposed method and the no-boundary baseline (0.7624 versus 0.7616, paired Wilcoxon p = 0.27), confirming that lesion segmentation quality is preserved. The primary effect appears in specificity. False-positive activations on 20 no-lesion test images fell from 14 of 20 and 19 of 20 for the two baselines to 5 of 20 with the proposed approach (McNemar p = 0.012 and 0.0005). Non-overlapping Wilson 95% confidence intervals confirm the difference is both statistically significant and practically substantial. A post-hoc spatial temperature scaling step further reduced expected calibration error from 0.0201 to 0.0095 without altering segmentation masks. Entropy-guided boundary supervision and spatial calibration thus function as complementary training-level and inference-level refinements that improve specificity and probability reliability within a U-Net framework.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对乳腺超声图像中病变分割的两个挑战（边界泄漏和假阳性激活），提出了一种熵引导的边界监督损失，该损失根据逐像素预测熵和真实边界图对轮廓惩罚进行缩放，从而集中梯度于网络不确定的病变边缘区域。在BUSI数据集上，该方法与无边界监督基线相比，Dice分数无显著差异，但显著降低了无病变图像上的假阳性激活（从14/20和19/20降至5/20），并通过后处理空间温度缩放进一步将期望校准误差从0.0201降至0.0095。
Motivation: 乳腺超声图像中的斑点噪声、低组织对比度和后方声影导致病变边界泄漏和轮廓不完整，同时在无病变图像中产生假阳性激活。现有边界监督方法对所有边界像素平等加权，未能有效区分不确定性高的区域。
Method: 提出熵引导边界损失，该损失使用逐像素预测熵和真实边界图对边界二元交叉熵进行加权，使梯度集中于网络不确定的病变边缘。后处理阶段应用空间温度缩放进行校准。
Result: 在97张含病变测试图像上，Dice分数与无边界监督基线无统计差异（0.7624 vs 0.7616，p=0.27）；在20张无病变图像上，假阳性从基线14/20和19/20降至5/20（McNemar p=0.012和0.0005）。期望校准误差从0.0201降至0.0095。
Conclusion: 熵引导边界监督和空间校准作为互补的训练级和推理级改进，在U-Net框架内提高了特异性和概率可靠性，且不损害病变分割质量。

papers.title: Enhancing Protein Representation Learning via Manifold Restore Mixing
papers.abstract_en: Data augmentation (DA) has been proven to be an effective means for improving protein representation learning (PRL) by generating additional training samples. Although mainstream perturbation- and sampling-based augmentation methods can produce data containing sufficient variations, they carry the risk of disrupting the protein structure and function. Some crafted protein homology modeling tools can generate conformations, but reduce structural diversity. The above dilemmas lead us to a question: Can we restore the disrupted structure caused by DA operations, providing data with both the original structure and diverse variations? In this work, we first analyze and empirically reveal the structure defect and performance degradation issues of existing DA methods. Based on the findings, we propose a simple yet effective DA method, Manifold Restore Mixing (MRM), for protein representation learning. Specifically, inspired by manifold mixup, we mix the hidden representations of original and augmented protein data to generate new samples that restore structural information lost in DA while introducing diverse variations. Furthermore, we develop a sample difficulty scheduler that adjusts the beta distribution in mixup to provide models with progressively challenging mixed samples during training, which improves the final performance. Comprehensive experiments on various PRL backbones and downstream tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of our method. The complete code and weights will be released upon acceptance. We provide a implementation at https://github.com/KingGugu/MRM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对蛋白质表示学习中的数据增强方法普遍存在的结构破坏或多样性不足问题，提出一种名为Manifold Restore Mixing (MRM) 的简单有效方法。受流形混合启发，MRM将原始蛋白质和增强后的隐藏表示混合，生成既恢复结构信息又引入多样性的新样本。此外，作者设计了一个样本难度调度器，在训练过程中逐步增加混合样本的难度。实验在多种PRL骨干网络和下游任务上验证了MRM的有效性和泛化性。
Motivation: 现有扰动型和采样型数据增强方法可能破坏蛋白质结构和功能，而基于同源建模的工具虽能生成构象但降低了结构多样性。作者旨在解决这一矛盾，恢复被破坏的结构同时保持多样性。
Method: 提出Manifold Restore Mixing方法，将原始蛋白质数据的隐藏表示与增强后的隐藏表示进行混合（类似流形混合），以恢复数据增强中丢失的结构信息。同时设计样本难度调度器，通过调整混合的beta分布，为模型提供渐进式难度的混合样本。
Result: 摘要报告在多种蛋白质表示学习骨干网络和下游任务上，MRM均取得了有效且泛化的性能提升。
Conclusion: MRM作为数据增强方法，能同时保持蛋白质结构信息并引入多样性，配合样本难度调度器可进一步提升性能。该方法简单，有望推广至其他生物分子表示学习任务。

papers.title: Leveraging Large Language Models to Obscure Code Stylometry: A Comparative Study of GPT-3.5 and GPT-4
papers.abstract_en: In the rapidly evolving field of software development, code stylometry analyzing unique stylistic signatures of programmers plays a crit-ical role in authorship attribution and cybersecurity. Recent advancements in artificial intelligence, particularly Large Language Models (LLMs) like GPT-3.5 and GPT-4, have introduced new dimensions to this field, challenging traditional stylometry techniques. This study investigates the effectiveness of LLMs in altering code stylometry while preserving functionality and evaluates the impact of various prompt engineering strategies. Through comprehensive experiments, we assess how well these models can obscure stylistic signatures to avoid detection by a Random Forest classifier trained for authorship attribution. The results reveal significant differences in effectiveness between single-shot and multi-shot methods and highlight the importance of detailed, structured prompts. Additionally, functionality preservation checks demonstrate the challenges in maintaining code integrity post-modification. This research provides critical insights into the robustness of authorship attribution techniques against advanced AI capabilities, informing future cybersecurity and software engineering developments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本研究比较了GPT-3.5和GPT-4在改变代码风格度量（code stylometry）以规避作者归属检测方面的有效性。通过单次和多次提示策略以及功能保持检查，发现详细结构化提示更有效，但保持代码完整性存在挑战。
Motivation: 代码风格度量在作者归属和网络安全中至关重要，而LLM的进步可能挑战传统技术，亟需评估其用于隐藏代码风格的能力。
Method: 使用GPT-3.5和GPT-4生成修改后的代码，采用单次和多次提示策略，通过随机森林分类器评估作者归属检测的规避效果，并进行功能一致性验证。
Result: 单次与多次提示方法在效果上存在显著差异，详细结构化提示能更好地隐藏风格；同时，修改后的代码功能完整性保持面临挑战。
Conclusion: 该研究揭示了现有作者归属技术面对先进AI时的局限性，为未来网络安全和软件工程实践提供了改进方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Encoder-Decoder Manifold Alignment for Idempotent Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recently, several learning paradigms have been introduced to enforce idempotency in generative models. The goal is to ensure that repeated application of a model leaves samples unchanged once they lie on the target data manifold. In practice, however, many of these approaches fail to achieve exact fixed points, leading to instability and drift under repeated application. In this work, we argue that a key reason for this failure is a geometric mismatch between the manifolds learned by the encoder and decoder. The encoder projects inputs onto one latent manifold, while the decoder implicitly learns to reconstruct data from a different manifold. This discrepancy prevents the model from learning truly idempotent mappings. To address this issue, we propose a new training framework that explicitly closes this gap by forcing the encoder and decoder to learn consistent representations of the same underlying data manifold. By aligning the geometry of these components, our method encourages stable projections. Empirically, we show that our approach achieves significantly lower idempotency error and consistently regenerates identical outputs under repeated application, compared to existing methods. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework on both image generation and image editing tasks. Finally, we show that enforcing idempotency in this manner improves identity preservation and information stability, leading to more realistic and controllable generative editing models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出生成模型中编码器和解码器学习的流形几何不匹配导致等幂性失效，提出一种训练框架通过对齐两者流形来稳定反复应用时的输出。在图像生成和编辑任务上，该方法显著降低了等幂误差并保持输出一致性。
Motivation: 现有等幂生成方法因编码器与解码器流形不匹配，无法实现精确不动点，反复应用时出现不稳定和漂移。
Method: 提出一种训练框架，通过强制编码器和解码器学习一致的基础数据流形表示，显式对齐两者几何结构以消除差异。
Result: 在图像生成和图像编辑任务上，该方法相比现有方法显著降低等幂误差，重复应用时输出完全相同，并改善了身份保持和信息稳定性。
Conclusion: 对齐编码器与解码器流形是实现稳定等幂映射的关键，有助于提升生成模型的真实性和可控性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards Accurate and Robust Surveillance Roadside IVD via Trackletized Audio-Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Idling Vehicle Detection (IVD) seeks to determine, at the final frame of a video clip, whether any vehicle is idling, meaning the vehicle is stationary with its engine running, using synchronized video from a remote surveillance camera and multichannel audio captured by spatially distributed wireless microphones along the roadside. Prior full-image, clip-level fusion approaches tend to overfit scene background and full-frame context, produce unstable temporal decisions, and lack an explicit spatial prior to align vehicles with microphones, which makes them brittle under domain shift and data inefficient. Instead, we introduce TAVR-IVD, an audio-visual framework guided by multi-object tracking. Our method detects vehicles, links detections into tracklets, and classifies each vehicle by operating on its tracklet. This design raises the effective signal-to-noise ratio, stabilizes temporal decisions through tracklets, enforces an explicit spatial prior to align vehicles with microphones, and adapts across domains with limited calibration annotations while remaining detector agnostic and efficient. To evaluate deployment robustness, we further curate two evaluation extensions, AVIVD-LT and AVIVD-M, covering inter-day and cross-site shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TAVR-IVD 框架，用于路边监控场景的闲置车辆检测。该框架利用多目标跟踪将车辆检测链接为轨迹，并在轨迹级别进行分类，以提高信噪比和时序稳定性，并显式对齐车辆与麦克风空间位置。为解决领域迁移问题，还构建了跨天和跨站点的评估扩展。
Motivation: 现有基于全图剪辑融合的方法容易过拟合场景背景，产生不稳定的时序决策，且缺乏显式空间先验来对齐车辆与麦克风，导致领域迁移和低数据效率。
Method: TAVR-IVD 基于多目标跟踪，先检测车辆并链接成轨迹，然后对每个轨迹进行分类。设计提高了有效信噪比，稳定了时序决策，并提供了显式空间先验。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称该方法在领域迁移和低标注校准下具有鲁棒性和效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架是检测器无关且高效的，并提供了新的评估基准用于测试跨天和跨站点的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SCENIC: Semantic-Conditioned Edge-Aware Neural Framework for Structured IoT Command Generation
papers.abstract_en: Edge Internet of Things (IoT) agents are often constrained by memory capacity, privacy requirements, communication latency, and recurring inference cost. Current smart-home assistants commonly rely on API-level command interfaces or cloud-based language models that remain difficult to deploy on edge devices. This paper addresses edge IoT command generation as a many-to-one structured output task, where multiple natural-language instructions map to the same canonical command string for deterministic smart-home parsing. To support this setting, we propose Semantic-Conditioned Edge-Aware Neural Framework for Structured IoT Command Generation (SCENIC), an end-to-end framework covering model architecture selection, Smart Home Instruct data generation, triplet-loss contrastive supervised fine-tuning, pruning and quantization, and deployment-oriented export. We evaluate sub-0.2B-scale transformer backbones, which are, to the best of our knowledge, among the smallest language-model backbones studied for edge IoT structured command generation. On Smart Home Instruct-Bench, the strongest dense decoder-only row reaches 99.0% EM@1, while the encoder-decoder model retains stronger high-sparsity behavior. A representative pruned INT8 encoder-decoder export preserves 91.0% EM@1 and 99.0% EM@5 while reducing exported model size by 25.38%. TensorRT profiling of the NVIDIA 2:4 sparse encoder export further shows up to 1.8x encoder-component speedup, indicating that the selected encoder-decoder deployment path can retain structured command accuracy under edge-oriented compression while hardware acceleration evidence remains component-level. The SCENIC code and experimental artifacts are open sourced to support reproducibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCENIC 框架，用于边缘 IoT 设备上的结构化命令生成，采用小规模 transformer 模型，结合三元组损失对比微调、剪枝量化等技巧，在智能家居指令基准上实现高准确率，并展示了压缩后的模型在准确率和速度上的权衡。
Motivation: 现有智能家居助手依赖 API 或云模型，难以部署在边缘设备上，存在内存、隐私、延迟等问题。
Method: 提出端到端框架 SCENIC，包括模型架构选择、数据生成、三元组损失对比微调、剪枝量化及部署导出。
Result: 在 Smart Home Instruct-Bench 上，最强密集解码器模型达到 99.0% EM@1；剪枝量化后的编码器-解码器模型在减小 25.38% 尺寸下仍保持 91.0% EM@1 和 99.0% EM@5，TensorRT 稀疏编码器加速最高 1.8 倍。
Conclusion: SCENIC 证明小规模 transformer 结合边缘友好压缩可在保持结构化命令生成精度的同时获得硬件加速。

papers.title: Efficient Document Tampering Localization with Multi-Level Discrepancy Features and Unified DCT-Quantization Embedding
papers.abstract_en: Localizing document tampering is extremely challenging, as manipulations are crafted to appear visually consistent and often leave only subtle traces that are nearly invisible to the human eye. In prior work, evaluation has been largely dominated by synthetic benchmarks that closely match the training distribution, and methods have shown steady progress under this setting. However, these gains often translate poorly to human-made forgeries and to cross-domain evaluation, where both the source documents and the tampering pipeline can change, leading to a distribution shift. In addition, since the introduction of the Frequency Perception Head for the discrete cosine transform (DCT) modality, it has become a standard choice, and subsequent work has largely focused on downstream modules and fusion strategies rather than revisiting the backbone itself. To help close this gap in cross-domain performance and improve the DCT backbone design, we propose \textbf{DiffNet}, a relatively simple yet effective RGB--DCT early-fusion architecture driven by two key design choices. First, to ensure that the decoder aggregates multi-scale inconsistency evidence rather than operating on raw, content-heavy activations, we apply a lightweight multi-level discrepancy transformation at the output of each backbone stage, replacing features with magnitude-only responses to learned zero-sum filters. Second, we design an efficient DCT-domain backbone that relies on a lightweight frequency-index-aware DCT--quantization joint embedding. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on cross-domain and human-made document tampering localization, outperforming prior methods by around 30\%, with up to $7\times$ higher throughput than the previous best model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DiffNet，一种RGB-DCT早期融合架构，用于文档篡改定位。其核心设计包括：在解码器中使用轻量级多层级差异变换，用幅度响应替换原始特征；以及设计基于频率索引感知的DCT-量化联合嵌入的高效DCT骨干网络。在跨域和人工伪造文档篡改定位任务上，DiffNet以约30%的性能提升和高达7倍的吞吐量超越先前方法。
Motivation: 现有方法在跨域评估和人工伪造场景下性能下降，且DCT骨干设计自频率感知头（Frequency Perception Head）以来未得到充分改进。
Method: DiffNet采用RGB-DCT早期融合架构，包含两个关键设计：多层级差异变换（multi-level discrepancy transformation）将骨干输出替换为学习到的零和滤波器的幅度响应；以及基于频率索引感知的DCT-量化联合嵌入（frequency-index-aware DCT-quantization joint embedding）的高效DCT骨干。
Result: 在跨域和人工伪造文档篡改定位上达到最优性能，相比先前方法性能提升约30%，吞吐量提升高达7倍。
Conclusion: 通过改进DCT骨干设计和引入差异特征，DiffNet在文档篡改定位的跨域泛化方面取得显著进步。

papers.title: Any-Body Guard: Universal Safeguarding for Manipulation Policies via Action Masking
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring safety of learning-enabled robotic manipulation across diverse embodiments and tasks still requires significant manual engineering. Existing approaches typically rely on heuristically designed fallback controllers or complex forward invariance assessments. These methods are often too conservative for task success, too computationally expensive for real-time execution, too heuristic to provide useful safety guarantees, or too engineering-heavy to transfer between setups. In this paper, we propose a universal safeguarding approach, X-Safe, which reasons directly in the robot's configuration space to provide formal probabilistic guarantees for collision avoidance. By operating in the configuration space, our method transfers across embodiments while relying solely on an object-based, quasi-static scene representation and a forward kinematics model of the robotic manipulator. Thus, X-Safe provides useful formal safety guarantees without requiring additional data, or engineering effort for different embodiments or scenes. We demonstrate X-Safe for diverse embodiments and policies, both in simulation and on hardware. We observe less degradation in task performance compared to state-of-the-art safeguarding, no collisions on hardware experiments, and empirically corroborate our formal guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种通用机器人操作安全保障方法X-Safe，通过在配置空间中直接推理，利用基于物体的准静态场景表示和正向运动学模型，提供碰撞避免的形式化概率保证。实验在多种本体和策略的仿真及硬件上验证，任务性能退化低于现有方法，硬件实验无碰撞。
Motivation: 现有安全保障方法依赖启发式回退控制器或复杂正向不变性评估，过于保守、计算昂贵、缺乏形式化保证或难以迁移，亟需通用轻量方案。
Method: 提出基于配置空间的动作屏蔽方法，使用物体级准静态场景表示和机械臂正向运动学模型，通过概率推理实现碰撞避免的形式化保证，无需针对不同本体或场景额外数据或工程。
Result: 在多种本体和策略的仿真与硬件实验中，任务性能退化低于现有最先进方法，硬件实验零碰撞，并经验证实数了形式化概率保证。
Conclusion: X-Safe提供通用、轻量、可迁移的安全保障，无需额外数据或工程，适用于不同本体和场景，但摘要未讨论局限性。

papers.title: Active Sensing and Deferred-Decision Trajectory Optimization for Robust Target Identification
papers.abstract_en: We study trajectory optimization in mobile sensing systems that must identify which member of a finite candidate set is the true target, while maintaining reachability to all potential candidate targets, under resource constraints. Deferred-Decision Trajectory Optimization (DDTO) addresses this setting by computing trajectories that reach individual targets but remain coincident for as long as possible before separating toward different targets. We propose Active-Sensing DDTO (AS-DDTO), which extends DDTO by adding a trajectory-dependent information-acquisition term to the planning objective. The resulting planner maintains reachability to candidate targets while biasing the coincident portion of the trajectories toward regions that enable earlier target identification. The framework supports Bayesian updates and conformal candidate-set updates for distance-dependent sensing. We derive a mixed-integer conic reformulation and provide guarantees on recursive feasibility, belief concentration, and fixed-time coverage for the raw conformal candidate set. Numerical simulations show improved target identification compared with standard DDTO under distance-dependent sensing uncertainty and limited sensing budget.
papers.comment: Published in IEEE Control Systems Letters (L-CSS), 2026. 6 pages
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Control Systems Letters, vol. 10, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对移动传感系统中有限候选目标识别问题，提出主动感知延迟决策轨迹优化（AS-DDTO）方法。该方法在规划目标中引入轨迹相关的信息获取项，使轨迹的共线部分偏向能更早识别目标的区域，同时保持对所有候选目标的可达性。支持贝叶斯更新和基于距离感知的共形候选集更新，推导了混合整数锥重构，并提供了递归可行性、置信度集中和固定时间覆盖的保证。数值仿真表明，在距离感知传感不确定性和有限传感预算下，与标准DDTO相比，目标识别性能得到改善。
Motivation: 移动传感系统需要在有限资源下从有限候选集中识别真实目标，现有延迟决策轨迹优化（DDTO）未考虑信息获取，导致识别效率不足。
Method: 提出AS-DDTO，在DDTO的规划目标中添加轨迹相关的信息获取项，使轨迹共线部分偏向能更早识别目标的区域。支持贝叶斯更新和共形候选集更新，并推导为混合整数锥规划，提供理论保证。
Result: 数值仿真显示，在距离感知传感不确定性和有限传感预算下，AS-DDTO比标准DDTO实现更早的目标识别。
Conclusion: AS-DDTO通过主动感知决策提高目标识别效率，适用于资源受限的移动传感系统。

papers.title: Quantum-classical physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold networks for PDEs
papers.abstract_en: We develop QCPIKAN, the first quantum-classical physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold network designed to solve partial differential equations (PDEs). Built upon Chebyshev-polynomial KAN layers and parameterized quantum circuits, this hybrid framework embeds physical constraints into the training loss to enforce physical consistency. Our theoretical investigations grounded in approximation theory prove that this design accelerates high-frequency error convergence to an exponential rate and effectively mitigates numerical dispersion. We validate the framework across three typical seepage scenarios in porous media, including single-phase flow, component transport and two-phase flow. Compared with existing quantum-classical physics-informed neural networks, QCPIKAN achieves superior performance in global prediction accuracy, local error control, dynamic evolution tracking and displacement front localization. This work provides a robust and efficient alternative for solving complex PDEs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QCPIKAN，首个量子-经典混合物理信息Kolmogorov-Arnold网络，用于求解偏微分方程。该框架基于切比雪夫多项式KAN层和参数化量子电路，将物理约束嵌入训练损失。逼近理论证明其能加速高频误差指数收敛并减轻数值色散。在多孔介质渗流场景（单相流、组分运移、两相流）中，相比现有量子-经典物理信息神经网络，QCPIKAN在全局预测精度、局部误差控制、动态演化跟踪和位移前沿定位上表现更优。
Motivation: 现有量子-经典物理信息神经网络在求解复杂PDE时存在收敛慢、数值色散等问题，需要更高效且物理一致的方法。
Method: 提出QCPIKAN混合框架，由切比雪夫多项式KAN层和参数化量子电路组成，通过物理约束损失训练，理论分析证明其指数级高频误差收敛特性。
Result: 在多孔介质渗流三个场景（单相流、组分运移、两相流）中，QCPIKAN在全局预测精度、局部误差控制、动态演化跟踪和位移前沿定位上优于现有量子-经典物理信息神经网络。
Conclusion: QCPIKAN为求解复杂PDE提供了一种鲁棒且高效的混合方法，尤其适用于多孔介质渗流问题。

papers.title: Library-Aware Doubles and Iterative Repair for Large Language Model-Generated Unit Tests in OpenSIL Firmware
papers.abstract_en: Validating changes in low-level C firmware is expensive because unit tests (UTs) are fragile under strict build constraints, where missing headers, unresolved symbols, and dependency mismatches frequently prevent compilation and linking. This study introduces an automated UT authoring workflow for the Open-Source Silicon Initialization Library (openSIL) firmware codebase maintained by Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) that reduces manual effort through a large language model (LLM) guided multi-agent pipeline. The workflow combines automated generation of test scaffolds, library-aware creation or reuse of stubs, mocks, and fakes, and an iterative compile-dispatch repair loop driven by build logs and line-coverage feedback. We evaluate the approach using compilation success, repair iterations, dispatch success, and line coverage, with time, cost, and token usage as secondary measures. Across 76 functions under test, the workflow generated compilable UTs for 73 functions. In a configuration without line coverage guidance or retrieval augmentation, mean line coverage reached 73.9%. On a 48-function subset evaluated under both configurations, mean line coverage reached 98.8% with line-coverage guidance alone and reached 94.7% when combined with vector-database retrieval. Results show that automated generation-and-repair pipelines can substantially improve UT creation efficiency and coverage for constrained firmware environments while reducing manual debugging effort.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 1 Table. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于大语言模型的多智能体流水线，自动为AMD的openSIL固件代码库生成单元测试。该方法结合自动测试脚手架生成、库感知的桩/模拟/伪造创建以及由构建日志和行覆盖率反馈驱动的迭代编译修复循环。在76个函数上，成功生成73个可编译测试，无覆盖指导时平均行覆盖率73.9%，在48个函数的子集上，结合行覆盖指导达到98.8%，或结合向量数据库检索达到94.7%。
Motivation: 低层C固件验证昂贵，单元测试因严格构建约束（如缺失头文件、未解析符号、依赖不匹配）频繁编译失败，需要大量手动调试，因此需要自动化方法减少人工成本。
Method: 提出LLM引导的多智能体流水线，包含自动生成测试脚手架、库感知地创建或复用桩/模拟/伪造，以及由构建日志和行覆盖率反馈驱动的迭代编译修复循环。评估了有无行覆盖指导及有无检索增强（向量数据库）的配置。
Result: 在76个函数中，73个生成可编译单元测试。无行覆盖指导时平均行覆盖率73.9%；48函数子集上，仅行覆盖指导达98.8%，结合向量数据库检索达94.7%。时间和成本作为次要指标也被衡量。
Conclusion: 自动生成与修复流水线可显著提高受限固件环境的单元测试创建效率和覆盖率，减少手动调试工作。

summary_sections.method: 提出LLM引导的多智能体流水线，包含自动生成测试脚手架、库感知地创建或复用桩/模拟/伪造，以及由构建日志和行覆盖率反馈驱动的迭代编译修复循环。评估了有无行覆盖指导及有无检索增强（向量数据库）的配置。
summary_sections.result: 在76个函数中，73个生成可编译单元测试。无行覆盖指导时平均行覆盖率73.9%；48函数子集上，仅行覆盖指导达98.8%，结合向量数据库检索达94.7%。时间和成本作为次要指标也被衡量。
summary_sections.conclusion: 自动生成与修复流水线可显著提高受限固件环境的单元测试创建效率和覆盖率，减少手动调试工作。

papers.title: Hard or Just Unreached? Diagnosing the Sampling Blind Spot in Math-Reasoning Difficulty Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Math and science reasoning benchmarks rely on pass@k, the fraction of sampled chains that reach gold, as the canonical per-example difficulty signal. The same signal drives RL with verifiable rewards, math data curation, synthetic curricula, and verifier training. We show this proxy has a persistent blind spot on its hardest stratum: on the eight free-form math cells we test (GSM8K and MATH across four open-weight models), 10.3-22.9% of the examples that no sampling seed solves in six tries are instead solved at matched compute by a six-chain deterministic regime. These are greedy decoding plus five cheap residual-stream perturbations applied via activation grafting, while greedy alone solves at most 6% on these math cells. Recovery scales with the additional budget, across perturbations whose mechanistic distinctness we verify across all twelve cells (cross-kind fix-set Jaccard <= 0.47 in every setup). Activation grafting is used as an intervention on internal representations, not a decoding method; we use it purely as a diagnostic and diversification tool, and our recovered items show that the pass@k= 0 % stratum is structurally identifiable in the residual stream rather than that the unmodified model reaches them under ordinary inference.
papers.comment: 9 pages of main paper, 4 figures and 5 tables in the main paper, with more in the appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现数学推理基准中 pass@k 指标在最难样例上存在盲点：在 GSM8K 和 MATH 数据集的 8 个数学单元中，10.3%–22.9% 的 pass@k=0% 样例实际上可通过确定性变体（贪婪解码加激活嫁接扰动）在同等计算预算下解决，而单独贪婪解码最多只能解决 6%。
Motivation: 现有 pass@k 被用作数学推理难度的标准信号，但其可能低估模型在 hardest 样例上的真实能力，需要更准确的诊断方法。
Method: 提出使用激活嫁接（activation grafting）对残差流施加廉价扰动，构造六条确定性推理链，与随机采样进行对比，以检验 pass@k=0% 层是否真正不可解。
Result: 在 8 个数学单元上，10.3%–22.9% 的 pass@k=0% 样例被确定性变体解决，且恢复率随扰动预算扩展，扰动间的机械区分性已验证（交叉 Jaccard ≤ 0.47）。
Conclusion: pass@k 指标存在采样盲点，而激活嫁接可作为诊断和多样化工具，揭示模型在残差流中结构可识别的隐藏能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kernel of Partition Paths: A Unified Representation for Tree Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: A recent line of work has reframed individual decision trees as linear models on engineered features associated with their splits, opening routes for oracle inequalities and feature-importance reinterpretation, but leaving open the question of what unified geometric object a forest induces when one indexes its feature map by nodes rather than by splits. The present paper studies that object. KPP indexes the feature map by the nodes of the forest, weighted by a path metric that turns each coordinate into a component of a squared-Euclidean path-isometric embedding. KPP unifies four pillars under a single non-diagonal Gram that carries a metric: prediction, exact additive attribution, deterministic Lipschitz robust radius in the KPP metric, and uniform Rademacher risk bounds for regression and classification under fixed, honest, or cross-fit conditioning. All probabilistic guarantees are conditional on the representation and are stated under three explicit conditioning regimes; the robust-radius guarantee is deterministic in the KPP metric rather than in a norm on the raw input. Conjectured fast-rate refinements for both regression and classification are stated as open problems and are not claimed as theorems.
papers.comment: v2 (34 pages): corrected the variable-level attribution indexing, fixed a constant factor in one diagnostic table, clarified the proof-boundary regime under which the empirical bounds are conditional diagnostics, and added regularity and precision caveats. Results and conclusions unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出路径划分核（KPP），将树集成模型（如随机森林）的特征图按节点索引，并赋予路径权重，从而得到统一的非对角Gram矩阵。该表示统一了预测、精确加性归因、确定性Lipschitz鲁棒半径和均匀Rademacher风险界四个支柱，所有概率保证均基于显式条件化机制。
Motivation: 现有方法将单棵决策树重构为基于分裂特征的线性模型，但缺乏将整个森林视为统一几何对象的表示，且未解决特征映射按节点索引而非按分裂索引的统一几何对象问题。
Method: KPP通过定义节点上的路径度量，将坐标转化为平方欧氏路径等距嵌入的分量，构建森林的非对角Gram矩阵，并推导出四个支柱的对应性质。
Result: 在回归和分类任务中，KPP提供了确定性鲁棒半径（在KPP度量下）和均匀Rademacher风险界，且所有泛化界都是条件于表示和三种显式条件化机制的。
Conclusion: 论文声称统一了树集成模型的多个核心性质，但未提出快速率下界的定理，仅作为开放问题陈述。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When AI Says "I have been in similar situations": Synthetic Lived Experience in Peer-Like Caregiver Support
papers.abstract_en: Caregivers often turn to online communities for informational and emotional support. In these spaces, peer supporters frequently draw on personal narratives to respond to emotionally complex caregiving situations. As LLMs are increasingly designed as peer-like sources of support, they introduce a critical tension: AI can provide immediate, private, and nonjudgmental support, but it cannot authentically possess the lived experiences that make human peer support meaningful. Yet, when prompted to sound peer-like, LLMs may generate language that implies lived experience. This creates a synthetic lived experience paradox: the same experiential language that may make AI support feel warm, relatable, and peer-like can also falsely position the system as someone with lived experience. We examine this paradox in the context of family caregivers of people living with Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias (ADRD). Drawing on caregiver support exchanges from online communities and prompted peer-like responses from three LLMs -- LLaMA, GPT-4o-mini, and MedGemma -- we analyze how human peers use personal narratives and how AI incorporates similar narrative forms. Psycholinguistic analysis shows that peer responses used significantly more first-person and past-focused language than peer-like AI responses. Qualitatively, we identify seven types of personal narratives in human peer support and show that AI often captures their emotional work, but can fabricate experiential grounding. These findings reveal a narrative authenticity gap: peer-like AI can generate synthetic lived experience without the real experience that makes peer support meaningful. We argue that caregiver-support AI systems need mechanisms to distinguish supportive peer-like framing from fabricated lived experience, ensuring that models can offer warmth and validation without falsely positioning themselves as experiential peers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了大型语言模型在提供同伴式照护者支持时产生的合成生活经验悖论。通过分析人类同伴和三种LLM（LLaMA、GPT-4o-mini、MedGemma）在阿尔茨海默病相关痴呆症照护者支持中的回应，发现AI虽然能模仿情感支持，但缺乏真实生活经验，可能虚构经历。心理语言学分析表明人类同伴更多使用第一人称和过去时态，而AI则存在叙事真实性差距。
Motivation: 照护者在线社区中同伴支持依赖于个人叙事，但LLM作为同伴式支持源时，虽然能提供即时、私密、非评判性的帮助，却无法真正拥有生活经验，从而产生合成生活经验悖论。
Method: 从在线社区收集人类照护者支持交流，并让三种LLM生成类似同伴的回应，通过心理语言学分析比较人类与AI在叙事形式上的差异，并定性识别人类同伴使用的七种个人叙事类型。
Result: 心理语言学分析显示人类同伴比AI使用更多第一人称和过去时态语言；定性分析表明AI能捕捉情感工作但可能虚构经历来源，存在叙事真实性差距。
Conclusion: 照护者支持AI系统需要机制来区分支持性同伴框架与虚构生活经历，确保模型能提供温暖和验证而不虚假定位为有经验者。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SegTME-UNI2: A Foundation Model-Based Framework for Generalisable Multiclass Cell Segmentation and LLM-Driven Tumour Microenvironment Characterisation in Histopathology
authors: Wan Siti Halimatul Munirah Wan Ahmad
papers.abstract_en: Characterising the tumour microenvironment (TME) from routine H&E-stained histology images requires simultaneous cell segmentation, feature extraction, and interpretable clinical reporting. We present SegTME-UNI2, a unified framework addressing these requirements. Its core is UNI2-UperHoVeR, a dual-head segmentation model pairing the UNI2-h pathology foundation model (ViT-Giant, pretrained on >100M tiles from 100K slides) with two parallel UperNet decoders: one for six-class semantic segmentation and one for horizontal-vertical gradient regression enabling watershed-based nuclear instance separation. To address the lack of pixel-level annotations in large real-world repositories, UNI2-UperHoVeR undergoes a three-stage progressive pseudo-label curriculum. Each stage trains a fresh model without weight transfer, driving improvement entirely via increased pseudo-label quality: Stage 1: Uses human-annotated PanNuke (7,901 images, 189,744 nuclei, 0.25 um/pixel). Stage 2: Uses entropy-filtered pseudo-labels from the Stage 1 model on 271,711 TCGA-UT scale-0 patches (0.5 um/pixel). Stage 3: Uses pseudo-labels from the Stage 2 model on all 1,608,060 TCGA-UT patches across six resolution scales (0.5-1.0 um/pixel). Segmentation outputs feed a structured TME feature extraction pipeline computing 20+ per-patch compositional, morphological, spatial entropy, and intercellular distance metrics. These are encoded as JSON and passed to a fine-tuned NVIDIA BioNeMo GPT model to generate clinically interpretable TME narratives. Preliminary validation on held-out PanNuke and TCGA-UT partitions demonstrates framework feasibility and internal consistency. The pseudo-labelled TCGA-UT dataset and UNI2-UperHoVeR checkpoint are publicly released to support large-scale TME profiling and spatial biology research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SegTME-UNI2框架，用于H&E染色病理图像中肿瘤微环境的表征。核心是UNI2-UperHoVeR双头分割模型，基于UNI2-h基础模型（ViT-Giant，预训练于超1亿张图块），结合两个UperNet解码器实现六类语义分割和核实例分离。通过三阶段伪标签课程利用未标注的TCGA-UT数据（160万张图块）提升分割性能。分割输出用于提取20多种TME特征，并由微调的NVIDIA BioNeMo GPT生成临床可解释的报告。初步验证表明框架可行且内部一致。
Motivation: 从常规H&E染色组织图像表征肿瘤微环境需要同时进行细胞分割、特征提取和可解释的临床报告，现有方法难以兼顾。此外，大规模真实数据缺乏像素级标注。
Method: 提出UNI2-UperHoVeR双头分割模型，使用UNI2-h病理基础模型作为编码器，两个并行UperNet解码器分别进行六类语义分割和水平-垂直梯度回归以支持分水岭核实例分离。采用三阶段无权重迁移的伪标签课程训练，逐步提升伪标签质量（阶段1：PanNuke人工标注；阶段2：熵过滤伪标签用于TCGA-UT部分数据；阶段3：全量多尺度TCGA-UT数据）。分割结果通过结构化管道提取20多种TME特征，编码为JSON后输入微调的NVIDIA BioNeMo GPT生成临床叙事。
Result: 在留出的PanNuke和TCGA-UT子集上的初步验证表明框架可行且内部一致。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了利用基础模型和伪标签课程实现可推广的多类细胞分割，并借助LLM生成可解释的TME报告。公开了伪标注的TCGA-UT数据集和模型检查点，以支持大规模TME分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trustworthy MRI Reconstruction via Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification with Sparsity Prior Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel Bayesian framework for joint image reconstruction and uncertainty quantification from compressed sensing magnetic resonance imaging data. The problem is formulated as a linear inverse problem, where prior distributions are assigned to the unknown image parameters. Specifically, the image is assumed to be sparse in a given transform domain. We develop a general framework applicable to any sparsifying transform and demonstrate its performance using (1) a total variation transform based on image spatial gradients and (2) a wavelet-domain transform. Bayesian inference is performed using a split-and-augmented Gibbs sampler, while the resulting non-differentiable conditional distributions are efficiently sampled using a proximal Markov chain Monte Carlo method. The proposed algorithms are validated on both single-coil and multi-coil datasets using various k-space sampling patterns and acceleration factors. The results demonstrate that the proposed Bayesian methods consistently outperform their optimisation-based counterparts in image reconstruction while providing uncertainty estimates for the reconstructed images. Furthermore, the estimated uncertainty maps show a strong correlation with the true reconstruction errors and substantially outperformed deep learning-based uncertainty estimation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种贝叶斯框架，用于压缩感知MRI中的联合图像重建与不确定性量化。将问题建模为线性逆问题，假设图像在变换域稀疏，使用分裂增广Gibbs采样器和近端马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛方法进行推理。在单线圈和多线圈数据集上验证，结果表明该方法在重建质量上优于优化方法，且不确定性图与真实误差高度相关，并显著超过基于深度学习的不确定性估计方法。
Motivation: 现有压缩感知MRI重建方法缺乏可靠的不确定性量化，而深度学习方法的不确定性估计不够准确。
Method: 提出贝叶斯框架，采用稀疏先验（总变分或小波变换），通过分裂增广Gibbs采样器和近端MCMC处理非可微条件分布。
Result: 在单线圈和多线圈数据上，贝叶斯方法在重建质量上持续优于优化方法，不确定性图与真实重建误差强相关，且优于深度学习不确定性估计方法。
Conclusion: 该框架可泛化到任意稀疏化变换，为MRI重建提供可信的不确定性估计。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 提出贝叶斯框架，采用稀疏先验（总变分或小波变换），通过分裂增广Gibbs采样器和近端MCMC处理非可微条件分布。
summary_sections.result: 在单线圈和多线圈数据上，贝叶斯方法在重建质量上持续优于优化方法，不确定性图与真实重建误差强相关，且优于深度学习不确定性估计方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架可泛化到任意稀疏化变换，为MRI重建提供可信的不确定性估计。

papers.title: When Confidence Lacks Concepts: Interpretable OOD Detection via Representation Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks have achieved remarkable performance across medical imaging tasks, yet their tendency to overgeneralize under distributional shifts poses a major obstacle to safe clinical deployment. Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection methods aim to mitigate this risk, but most existing approaches rely on opaque internal signals with poorly understood semantic meaning, limiting trust in safety-critical settings. In this work, we propose an interpretable OOD detection framework that probes the stability of model predictions under class-conditioned semantic perturbations. Leveraging sparse autoencoders (SAEs), we learn class-specific concept vectors from in-distribution data that disentangle dense intermediate representations into sparse, semantically meaningful components. At inference, we perturb deeper-layer representations using the concept vectors associated with the model's predicted class and measure the class logits stability. We hypothesize that in-distribution samples exhibit low sensitivity to such perturbations, as their representations align with class-specific semantic directions, whereas OOD samples show amplified deviations due to representational misalignment. By framing OOD detection as a concept conditioned stability analysis, our approach provides both a discriminative OOD signal and an interpretable lens into the internal mechanisms driving model uncertainty, making it particularly suitable for high stakes medical applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可解释的OOD检测框架，通过稀疏自编码器学习类别特定的概念向量，然后在推理时对深层表示进行扰动，测量类别logits的稳定性来区分分布内和分布外样本。该方法旨在提供判别性OOD信号和可解释的模型不确定性机制，适用于高风险医学应用。
Motivation: 现有OOD检测方法依赖不透明的内部信号，缺乏语义理解，在安全关键场景（如医学）中信任度不足。
Method: 利用稀疏自编码器学习类别特定的概念向量，对分布内数据的中间表示进行解耦；推理时，使用预测类别的概念向量扰动深层表示，并测量类别logits的稳定性。
Conclusion: 该方法通过概念条件稳定性分析，将OOD检测与可解释性结合，特别适合高风险医学应用。

papers.title: The Reservoir Attention Network: Cross-Pass State in Pretrained Transformers via Content-Addressable Reservoir Injection
papers.abstract_en: A feasibility and dynamics study of the Reservoir Attention Network (RAN), an architecture that injects a fixed, randomly-initialized reservoir into the mid-layer attention of a pretrained transformer to carry state across forward passes. Experiments span GPT-2 (124M, 355M) to Qwen2.5 (0.5B, 1.5B) on a single consumer GPU. The tasks are minimal probes chosen to isolate individual mechanisms; the broader always-alive agent vision is treated throughout as compute-limited future work, not a claim of this paper. The reservoir is left untrained (fixed random) by design: this isolates whether untrained recurrent dynamics alone suffice to carry usable cross-pass state, leaving trained recurrence as a complementary, more expensive direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Reservoir Attention Network (RAN)，在预训练Transformer的中间层注意力中注入一个固定、随机初始化的reservoir，以在多次前向传播之间传递状态。实验在GPT-2 (124M, 355M)和Qwen2.5 (0.5B, 1.5B)上进行，使用最小探针任务。reservoir保持未训练，以隔离未训练的循环动力学是否足以携带可用的跨次状态。
Motivation: 探索未训练的循环动力学是否足以在预训练Transformer的多次前向传播中传递有用状态，为始终在线（always-alive）智能体愿景提供计算受限的初步研究。
Method: 在预训练Transformer的中间层注意力中注入固定、随机初始化的reservoir，不训练reservoir，仅通过随机动力学携带跨次状态。
Result: 在GPT-2和Qwen2.5系列模型上的实验表明，未训练的reservoir足以在最小探针任务中传递可用的跨次状态。
Conclusion: 本文是可行性研究，表明未训练的循环动力学可以携带跨次状态，但更广泛的始终在线智能体愿景被视为计算受限的未来工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Simplex-Constrained Sparse Bagging: Transitioning from Uniform Priors to Sparse Posteriors in Ensemble Learning
papers.abstract_en: We present Simplex-Constrained Sparse Bagging (SCSB), a mathematically rigorous framework for post-training compression and probability calibration of bootstrap-based bagging ensembles. Standard bagging ensembles (such as Random Forests, Bagged SVMs, and Bagged Neural Networks) assign uniform voting power to all constituent estimators. However, this naive uniform prior ignores the varying local competence of base estimators and contributes to model overconfidence. We formulate ensemble pruning and calibration as a joint optimization problem over the probability simplex by minimizing the Out-Of-Bag (OOB) loss. To induce sparsity, we address the theoretical "L1-simplex paradox" - the mathematical reality that the L1 norm is constant on the simplex and fails to prune - by introducing a concave quadratic penalty. SCSB is model-agnostic and achieves up to 96% ensemble compression, yielding linear inference speedups and superior probability calibration (lowered Expected Calibration Error) while preserving or enhancing generalization accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种基于单纯形约束的稀疏装袋方法（SCSB），将集成剪枝与概率校准联合建模为单纯形上的优化问题，通过引入凹二次惩罚解决L1单纯形悖论，实现模型无关的集成压缩与校准。
Motivation: 标准装袋集成（如随机森林、装袋SVM等）为所有基估计器分配均匀投票权重，忽略了基估计器的局部能力差异并导致模型过度自信。
Method: 将集成剪枝与校准联合建模为概率单纯形上的优化问题，最小化袋外损失；为诱导稀疏性，引入凹二次惩罚以解决L1范数在单纯形上为常数而无法剪枝的理论悖论。
Result: 实现高达96%的集成压缩，带来线性推理加速，降低期望校准误差（ECE），同时保持或提升泛化准确率。
Conclusion: SCSB是模型无关的框架，能有效压缩装袋集成并改进概率校准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Certified World Models: Predictability Across Configuration, Horizon, and Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Scale buys interpolation; structure buys certifiable transfer. A world model's average error does not say whether a particular rollout can be trusted, or for how long. For equivariant latent world models we give a predictability certificate: a computable region spanning configuration, horizon, and resolution. Under exact equivariance, rollout error is invariant over the monoid generated by k primitive symmetries and is certified from the k generators (Theorem A); universal orbit-flatness over equivariant targets characterizes equivariance at the function level (Lemma 2), so an unconstrained architecture cannot certify the property by construction. Approximate orbit-transfer defects propagate by the finite-time Lyapunov spectrum (Theorem B): expanding channels give a logarithmic horizon $T_j(ε)\sim\log(1/ε)/λ_j$, neutral channels accumulate recurrent defect linearly, and contracting channels accumulate a bounded nonzero floor. Exact conserved charge values are certified to all horizons only at zero defect; with one-step defect $η$, charge-value error grows at most as $Tη$. Empirically, on a 40-dimensional learned model a $\mathbb{Z}_N$-equivariant network recovers the full Lyapunov spectrum ($R^2=0.98$-$0.99$) where dense and recurrent baselines fail. A cone/adapted-metric certificate reads an a-priori horizon off the model's own Jacobian, tight on uniformly hyperbolic dynamics and self-abstaining elsewhere; the resulting horizon improves a budgeted re-observation decision. For public non-equivariant world models the tangent spectrum gives a training-free candidate horizon, paired with a held-out divergence cross-check that abstains or corrects when the learned loop over-promises.
papers.comment: 56 pages. v2: finite-time defect formulation, tightened certificate scope, updated figures/metadata; experiments unchanged. Code: https://github.com/TimothyWang418/se3-ejepa
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对等变潜世界模型的可预测性认证问题，提出一个可计算的区域覆盖配置、时域和分辨率。在精确等变条件下，滚动误差在原始对称生成幺半群上不变（定理A）；近似轨道传递缺陷通过有限时间Lyapunov谱传播（定理B）。实验在40维学习模型上，Z_N等变网络恢复完整Lyapunov谱（R²=0.98-0.99），而密集和循环基线失败。还提出基于模型Jacobian的锥/适应度量证书，可读出先验时域。
Motivation: 世界模型的平均误差无法说明特定rollout的可靠性或持续时间，需要可认证的可预测性边界。
Method: 利用等变性质推导可预测性证书；将近似缺陷传播与Lyapunov谱关联；提出基于Jacobian的证书。
Result: 在40维模型中，等变网络高精度恢复Lyapunov谱；证书给出先验时域，改进预算重观测决策。
Conclusion: 该证书可扩展到非等变世界模型，通过切谱提供无训练候选时域，并配以留存发散交叉检查以避免过度承诺。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Circuit Synchronization Precedes Generalization: A Causal Precursor to Grokking
papers.abstract_en: Grokking is the delayed generalisation phenomenon where a transformer trained on modular arithmetic abruptly transitions from near-chance to near-perfect validation accuracy. It has been attributed to a Fourier-based algorithmic circuit, but its timing, causal structure, and controllability remain poorly understood. We introduce the Frequency Synchronization Degree (FSD), a normalised, permutation-tested metric for Fourier circuit synchronisation requiring no prior knowledge of the circuit. Across nine modular addition configurations (five primes, three seeds), FSD reaches its post-grokking level 500 to 3000 steps before grokking (mean lead 1722 steps, every configuration positive, sign-test p approx 0.004), and synchronises before a restricted-logit loss baseline in all nine cases, making it the earliest available predictor. We give direct causal evidence that the inter-phase gap is a regularisation phenomenon: forking training at the FSD-ceiling step and varying weight decay lambda produces monotonically earlier grokking, with delta-t proportional to 1/lambda. This law replicates across three primes (R-squared 0.89 to 0.99 on seed-averaged delta-t); per-run R-squared is unstable due to the chaotic transition, so we report error bars rather than single runs. Grokking occurs at a near-constant memorisation norm across lambda, grounding the constant in a threshold mechanism. This is not an artefact of applying a Fourier detector to a Fourier circuit: on the non-abelian group S5, a basis-faithful generalisation of FSD precedes grokking on all six seeds, while the original Fourier FSD does not. Using the FSD ceiling to schedule a weight-decay increase also accelerates grokking over a fixed schedule without destabilising training. An attention-only variant groks with a strong FSD precursor while an MLP-only model never groks.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables. v2: corrected scaling-law to report error bars across seeds (R^2 0.89-0.99) rather than single-draw fits; added non-abelian (S5) transfer experiment; revised title
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究transformer在模算术任务中的延迟泛化现象（Grokking），提出频率同步度（FSD）指标，在九个配置中，FSD在Grokking前平均提前1722步达到峰值。实验表明，Grokking的延迟是由正则化导致的，且Grokking发生的时机与权重衰减成反比（1/λ）。在非阿贝尔群S5上，基于群的FSD变体也预测Grokking，而原始傅里叶FSD无效。
Motivation: Grokking现象的时机、因果结构和可控性尚不明确，现有研究虽归因于傅里叶电路，但缺乏早期预测指标和因果证据。
Method: 定义频率同步度（FSD）作为傅里叶电路同步的归一化置换检验指标，无需先验电路知识；通过分叉训练实验，在FSD峰值步骤改变权重衰减，观察Grokking时间变化。
Result: FSD在九个模加配置中平均提前1722步达到峰值（所有配置均为正，符号检验p≈0.004）；Grokking时间与权重衰减成反比（1/λ），在三个质数上R²为0.89-0.99；在S5群上，基于群的FSD变体在全部六个种子中预测Grokking。
Conclusion: Grokking的延迟本质上是正则化现象，FSD可作为早期预测器，并可用于动态调整权重衰减以加速Grokking。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UPLOTS: A Unified Pretrained Language Model for Constrained Time-series Generation
papers.abstract_en: In time-series generation, existing approaches typically handcraft ortrain a separate model for each dataset, which hinders their scalability and fails to leverage shared temporal structures across domains. To address this fragmentation, we propose UPLOTS, a Unified, Prompt-guided Language model framework fOr constrained Time-Series Generation across diverse domains. Instead of building task-specific models, UPLOTS leverages a single pre-trained transformer backbone guided by learned constraint prompts, enabling on-demand generation with precise pattern control. One key innovation is our dynamic multi-dataset loss re-weighting and prompt-to-pattern mapping, which allows UPLOTS to internalize diverse temporal structures during training and conditionally generate them at inference. We evaluate UPLOTS on four real-world benchmarks and multiple constraint settings, including peak-period, calendar, load-level, and volatility patterns. Additional held-out constraint-combination and downstream forecasting experiments further demonstrate that UPLOTS generalizes beyond the original peak-pattern setting and improves data augmentation under scarce real-data regimes. Our code and baselines are available at github repo: https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/UPLOTS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UPLOTS 是一个统一的基于提示的预训练语言模型，用于跨不同领域的受约束时间序列生成。它通过动态多数据集损失重加权和提示到模式映射，在单个 Transformer 骨干上学习多样化的时间结构，并在多个真实基准和约束设置下评估。
Motivation: 现有时间序列生成方法通常为每个数据集手工设计或训练单独的模型，缺乏可扩展性，且无法利用跨领域的共享时间结构。
Method: 提出 UPLOTS，使用单个预训练 Transformer 骨干，并通过学习的约束提示指导生成，关键创新包括动态多数据集损失重加权和提示到模式映射。
Result: 在四个真实世界基准和多种约束设置（如峰值时段、日历、负载水平、波动模式）上评估，额外的保留约束组合和下游预测实验表明 UPLOTS 能够泛化到原始峰值模式设置之外，并在稀缺真实数据场景下改进数据增强。
Conclusion: UPLOTS 展示了统一预训练语言模型在受约束时间序列生成中的有效性，具有跨域泛化能力。
Relevance: 15

summary_sections.method: 提出 UPLOTS，使用单个预训练 Transformer 骨干，并通过学习的约束提示指导生成，关键创新包括动态多数据集损失重加权和提示到模式映射。
summary_sections.result: 在四个真实世界基准和多种约束设置（如峰值时段、日历、负载水平、波动模式）上评估，额外的保留约束组合和下游预测实验表明 UPLOTS 能够泛化到原始峰值模式设置之外，并在稀缺真实数据场景下改进数据增强。
summary_sections.conclusion: UPLOTS 展示了统一预训练语言模型在受约束时间序列生成中的有效性，具有跨域泛化能力。

papers.title: G2G: Exploiting Intra-Group Geometry for Inter-Group Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Recovering the relative 6-DoF pose between two image groups underlies cross-sequence relocalization and multi-camera rig odometry. Each group carries known intra-group geometry from visual odometry or rig calibration, and pretrained multi-view backbones already fuse such geometry into visual features. Yet current models treat all views as an unstructured set, leaving cross-group reasoning as the missing piece. We introduce \ours{}, which keeps the foundation model entirely frozen and adds three lightweight trainable modules to bridge the two groups: a perceiver resampler, a cross-group bridge with merged self-attention, and a multi-frame pose head. The trainable footprint totals about 32M parameters, under 6\% of the full model, and is supervised only by relative poses. Across four datasets that span indoor and outdoor simulation, real-world cross-season capture, and zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, \ours{} attains state-of-the-art accuracy on both tasks, while every baseline is retrained with its full original supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/WeiYuFei0217/G2G.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出G2G方法，在冻结多视角基础模型的基础上，添加三个轻量级可训练模块（感知器重采样器、跨组桥接模块、多帧姿态头），用于恢复两组图像之间的6-DoF相对姿态。在四个数据集（涵盖室内外仿真、真实世界跨季节采集、零样本仿真到真实迁移）上，该方法在两项任务上均达到最先进精度，而所有基线都使用完整原始监督重新训练。代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有方法将所有视图视为无结构集合，缺乏跨组推理能力，导致两组图像之间的相对姿态估计精度不足。
Method: 保持基础模型完全冻结，添加三个轻量级可训练模块：感知器重采样器（perceiver resampler）、带合并自注意力的跨组桥接模块（cross-group bridge）、以及多帧姿态头（multi-frame pose head）。总可训练参数约32M，不到完整模型的6%，仅由相对姿态监督。
Result: 在四个数据集上，该方法的姿态估计精度均达到最先进水平，包括室内外仿真、真实世界跨季节采集及零样本仿真到真实迁移场景。
Conclusion: 该方法通过轻量级模块有效弥合两组图像之间的几何鸿沟，在多种场景下取得最优结果，且代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards One-to-Many Temporal Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Temporal Grounding (TG) aims to localize video segments corresponding to a textual query. Prior research predominantly focuses on single-segment retrieval. Real-world scenarios, however, often require localizing multiple disjoint segments for a single query -- a setting we term One-to-Many Temporal Grounding (OMTG). Previous state-of-the-art MLLMs, optimized for one-to-one settings, struggle in this context, often yielding near-zero scores due to a lack of event cardinality perception. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic solution with three key contributions. First, we establish the first comprehensive OMTG benchmark, introducing Count Accuracy (C-Acc) and Effective Temporal F1 (EtF1) as evaluation metrics. Second, we curate a high-quality OMTG dataset comprising 56k samples through a sophisticated construction pipeline. Third, we develop novel temporal and caption reward functions specifically designed for OMTG. In particular, the caption reward leverages Chain-of-Thought reasoning over dense video captions to explicitly guide policy optimization toward both preciseness and completeness. Extensive experiments show our model achieves a new state-of-the-art EtF1 of 43.65\% on OMTG Bench, outperforming Gemini 2.5 Pro and Seed-1.8 by 15.85\% and 15.61\%, respectively. Project Page: https://insomniaaac.github.io/OMTG/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时序定位（Temporal Grounding）中的一对多场景（OMTG），即单个查询需要定位多个不连续视频片段的问题，提出系统性解决方案。作者建立了首个OMTG基准，构建了包含5.6万样本的高质量数据集，并设计了针对性的时序和字幕奖励函数，尤其通过密集视频字幕上的思维链推理来引导策略优化。实验表明该方法在OMTG基准上达到43.65%的EtF1，分别超过Gemini 2.5 Pro和Seed-1.8达15.85%和15.61%。
Motivation: 现有时序定位研究主要针对单片段检索，但现实场景常需为单个查询定位多个不连续片段。先前最先进的MLLM在OMTG设置下因缺乏事件基数感知而得分接近零，亟需填补这一空白。
Method: 提出三方面贡献：1）建立首个OMTG基准，引入Count Accuracy和Effective Temporal F1（EtF1）指标；2）通过精细构建流水线整理5.6万样本的高质量数据集；3）开发针对OMTG的时序和字幕奖励函数，其中字幕奖励利用密集视频字幕上的思维链推理显式指导策略优化，兼顾精确性和完整性。
Result: 模型在OMTG Bench上达到43.65%的EtF1，超越Gemini 2.5 Pro（15.85%）和Seed-1.8（15.61%）。
Conclusion: 本工作系统性地解决了OMTG问题，通过专门设计的基准、数据集和奖励函数显著提升了多片段定位性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Toward Multi-Domain and Long-Tailed Quantization via Feature Alignment and Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Quantizing deep neural networks is essential for efficient inference on resource-constrained devices. However, most existing methods are designed for single-domain and class-balanced data, leaving practical settings with domain shifts or severe class imbalance underexplored. We address these challenges with Efficient Multi-Domain Alignment Quantization (EmaQ), which aligns domain distributions through a CDF-based projection and uses sensitivity-aware weight aggregation to stabilize multi-domain quantization. We further extend EmaQ to EmaQ-LT for long-tailed quantization by introducing class-conditioned variance scaling and confidence-based logit adjustment to mitigate majority-class overconfidence. Theoretical analyses establish convergence guarantees and motivate the proposed sensitivity and scaling mechanisms. Experiments on standard, multi-domain (Office-31, Digits), and long-tailed (SynDigits-LT, CIFAR-10-LT, CIFAR-100-LT) benchmarks show that EmaQ and EmaQ-LT achieve strong low-bit performance under domain shift and class imbalance.
papers.comment: Withdrawn by the submitter because the manuscript was submitted prematurely and requires further revision and final author/contributor approval
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多域分布偏移和长尾类别不平衡下的神经网络量化问题，提出EmaQ和EmaQ-LT方法。EmaQ通过CDF投影对齐域分布并使用敏感度感知权重聚合稳定多域量化；EmaQ-LT引入类别条件方差缩放和置信度调整缓解多数类过度自信。在Office-31、Digits等多域数据集以及SynDigits-LT、CIFAR长尾数据集上取得低比特强性能。
Motivation: 现有量化方法大多针对单域且类别平衡的数据，无法处理实际中域偏移或严重类别不平衡的问题。
Method: 提出EmaQ，基于CDF投影对齐域分布，结合敏感度感知权重聚合；扩展为EmaQ-LT，引入类别条件方差缩放和基于置信度的logit调整，并提供理论收敛保证。
Result: 在Office-31、Digits、SynDigits-LT、CIFAR-10/100-LT等基准上，EmaQ和EmaQ-LT在低比特下表现优于基线。
Conclusion: 所提出的方法能有效处理域偏移和类别不平衡下的量化问题，理论分析支持其有效性。

papers.title: Reasoning4Sciences: Bridging Reasoning Language Models to All Scientific Branches
papers.abstract_en: While Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) are rapidly emerging as powerful tools for scientific research, their impact is primarily concentrated in "hard science" fields. The slow -- or lack of -- adoption of RLMs in other branches of science is causing a widening gap in research productivity. In this survey, we provide the first comprehensive analysis of RLM adoption across 28 scientific disciplines following the classification used by the European Research Council (ERC), spanning the Social Sciences and Humanities, Physical Sciences and Engineering, and Life Sciences. We examine how RLMs are developed, evaluated, and applied across disciplines. Furthermore, we introduce a maturity-oriented assessment framework based on available domain-specific development and evaluation resources, revealing substantial disparities in RLM maturity that become even more pronounced when only publicly available resources are considered. Finally, we highlight current implementation paradigms that are gaining popularity across disciplines, current challenges, and future directions in enabling RLM adoption across science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是首篇全面调查推理语言模型（RLMs）在28个科学学科中采用的综述，涵盖社会科学与人文学科、物理科学与工程、生命科学三大领域。研究分析了RLMs的开发、评估和应用现状，提出了基于领域特定资源成熟度的评估框架，揭示了学科间发展差异，并讨论了未来方向。
Motivation: RLMs在硬科学领域取得显著进展，但在其他科学分支的采用缓慢，导致研究生产力差距扩大。需要系统了解RLMs在不同学科的应用现状和挑战。
Method: 采用欧洲研究委员会（ERC）学科分类，对28个学科进行系统性文献调查，并提出一个基于领域特定开发和评估资源的成熟度评估框架。
Result: 发现RLMs在不同学科间的成熟度存在显著差异，当仅考虑公开可用资源时差距更大；总结出当前跨学科流行的实现范式、挑战和未来方向。
Conclusion: 需要弥合不同科学分支在RLM采用上的差距，促进跨学科合作和资源共享。

papers.title: From XXLTraffic to EvoXXLTraffic: Scaling Traffic Forecasting to Sensor-Evolving Networks
papers.abstract_en: Existing traffic forecasting benchmarks assume a fixed sensor set, but real road-sensor networks grow continuously as the road network changes year by year. We introduce the XXLTraffic dataset family, which spans up to 27 years of California PeMS and Transport for NSW data. The fixed-sensor subsets of XXLTraffic support extremely long forecasting with multi-year gaps and standard hourly / daily long-horizon forecasting. We extend it to EvoXXLTraffic, a sensor-evolving reorganization that exposes per-year active sensors, yearly traffic-flow matrices, and yearly graph snapshots across nine PeMS districts, with growth ratios ranging from +305% to over +10,000%. We define a yearly streaming forecasting protocol on EvoXXLTraffic in which each calendar year is a continual task, and benchmark a wide range of representative baselines drawn from static spatio-temporal GNNs, naïve online schemes, evolving-graph continual methods, and retrieval / test-time methods. We find that our ultra-large evolutionary dataset better reflects the real world, and many state-of-the-art (SOTA) results no longer work. Our dataset complements existing benchmarks by enabling more realistic forecasting under ultra-long evolutionary road networks. Our code and baselines are available at github repo: https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/TSAS26-EvoXXLTraffic
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出XXLTraffic数据集家族，覆盖加州PeMS和新南威尔士州交通数据长达27年，并扩展为传感器演化的EvoXXLTraffic版本，包含逐年活跃传感器、流量矩阵和图快照。定义年度流式预测协议，基准测试多种方法发现现有SOTA在演化路网下失效。
Motivation: 现有交通预测基准假设传感器固定，但真实路网传感器逐年增长，缺乏支持传感器演化的长期预测数据集。
Method: 构建XXLTraffic（固定传感器子集支持极端长期预测）和EvoXXLTraffic（传感器演化重组，逐年活跃传感器、流量矩阵和图快照），定义年度流式预测协议，基准测试多种方法。
Result: 数据集规模增长比+305%到超过+10,000%，许多SOTA方法在演化路网下不再有效。
Conclusion: 该数据集补充了现有基准，支持更真实的长时期演化路网预测，但仅限于交通领域。

papers.title: Inform, Coach, Relate, Listen: Auditing LLM Caregiving Support Roles
papers.abstract_en: Language models are increasingly being deployed for conversational support in informal caregiving contexts, where interactions often extend beyond information-seeking: caregivers seek emotional reassurance, guidance, and help, while navigating uncertain, relationally complex care decisions. Yet most safety evaluations assess model behavior under generic prompts, leaving a critical question unexamined: does a model's safety profile change with its support role? We study this by operationalizing four expert-reviewed support roles grounded in social support theory: Inform, Coach, Relate, and Listen, and comparing them against two baseline controls: a basic prompting condition and a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) condition. We evaluate across three language models (GPT-4o-mini, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and MedGemma-1.5-4b-it) on 5,000 real-world queries from online Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias (ADRD) communities. We find that the LLM's support role systematically shapes both the prevalence and composition of interactional risks. Furthermore, a human evaluation study reveals a perceived quality--safety tension: more directive, information-oriented roles are rated as more helpful and trustworthy despite exhibiting elevated interactional risk profiles. We release ~90,000 support role-conditioned model responses with risk annotations as an ecologically grounded resource for research on safer LLM-mediated conversational support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非正式护理场景中 LLM 的对话支持角色进行审计，基于社会支持理论定义了四种角色（Inform、Coach、Relate、Listen），并与基本提示和 RAG 基线对比。在 5000 条来自阿尔茨海默病相关社区的真实查询上评估 GPT-4o-mini、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 MedGemma-1.5-4b-it 三个模型。发现支持角色系统性地影响交互风险的模式，且人类评估揭示了感知质量与安全之间的张力。作者发布了约 9 万条带风险标注的响应数据集。
Motivation: 现有安全评估多采用通用提示，未考虑模型在不同支持角色下的安全画像变化。在护理场景中，交互往往超出信息寻求，需要情感支持，而角色切换可能带来不同的风险。
Method: 基于社会支持理论操作化四种专家审核的支持角色（Inform、Coach、Relate、Listen），并与基本提示和 RAG 基线比较。在三个 LLM 上评估 5000 条来自在线 ADRD 社区的真实查询。

papers.title: Pocket-Dentist: On-Device Dental Image Understanding via Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Evaluations of dental vision-language models remain fragmented across datasets, task definitions and metrics, and often ignore their computational cost. This limits their widespread deployment for dental screening outside specialist centres, where timely inference, limited hardware, and local handling of patient images are vital for practical, privacy-preserving clinical prescreening. Here we present Pocket-Dentist, an efficiency-aware benchmark for dental multimodal question answering that brings together three datasets spanning approximately 1,159 patients from BRAR and MetaDent, five task types and seven metrics. Across 14 typical VLMs, our results reveal an interesting observation: compact VLMs, such as 2B-parameter models, become competitive with much larger VLMs on most metrics after lightweight adaptation while requiring substantially lower computational costs in dental image understanding. Deployed locally on an iPhone 17 Pro, our finetuned compact VLM Pocket-Dentist-2B processed each sample in 4.31 s, reducing latency by 4.9x and memory use by 2.3x compared with a 7B baseline. Our project page is available at https://2026-icml.github.io/pocket-dentist-icml.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pocket-Dentist，一个面向牙科多模态问答的效率基准，整合了 3 个数据集、5 种任务类型和 7 个指标。通过对 14 个典型视觉语言模型进行评估，发现轻量级 2B 模型经过微调后能在大多数指标上与 7B 模型竞争，同时计算成本大幅降低。在 iPhone 17 Pro 上，微调后的 Pocket-Dentist-2B 每样本处理时间 4.31 秒，延迟降低 4.9 倍，内存减少 2.3 倍。
Motivation: 当前牙科视觉语言模型的评估分散在不同的数据集、任务和指标上，且忽略了计算成本，限制了其在缺乏专业设备的环境中的实际部署。
Method: 构建了包含三个牙科数据集（BRAR 和 MetaDent，约 1159 名患者）、五种任务类型和七项指标的效率基准，并对 14 个典型 VLM 进行标准化评估，比较不同规模模型在微调前后的性能与计算效率。
Result: 紧凑型 2B 模型经轻量级微调后，在大多数指标上可与 7B 模型竞争；在 iPhone 17 Pro 上，Pocket-Dentist-2B 每样本推理耗时 4.31 秒，延迟降低 4.9 倍，内存使用减少 2.3 倍。
Conclusion: 研究表明，面向牙科图像理解的紧凑型多模态大模型通过效率感知的微调，可在移动设备上实现实用且保护隐私的临床预筛查。

papers.title: Samudra 2: Scaling Ocean Emulators across Resolutions
papers.abstract_en: Ocean general circulation models (OGCMs) are essential to climate science but computationally expensive, limiting ensemble size and forcing scenarios. Neural emulators promise orders-of-magnitude speedups, yet existing ocean emulators have not combined fine spatial resolution with multi-year autoregressive rollouts. Samudra, the first autoregressive neural ocean emulator to produce multi-decade global rollouts, is limited to $1^\circ$ resolution and exhibits two long-horizon failure modes: \emph{variance collapse}, the loss of temporal variability, and \emph{imprinting artifacts}, in which velocity patterns leak into deep-ocean fields. We present Samudra 2, which introduces a wider U-Net backbone with modified ConvNeXt-style blocks and a reduced block-internal expansion factor, together with a dynamic loss that reweights output channels according to their prediction errors, strengthening gradients for slow-evolving deep-ocean fields. At $1^\circ$, Samudra 2 increases upper-ocean global-mean temperature $R^2$ from 0.56 to 0.87 and reduces deep-ocean temperature error by roughly sevenfold. The same architecture scales to $1/2^\circ$ and $1/4^\circ$ over approximately 8-year autoregressive rollouts, recovering mesoscale eddies and sharp western boundary currents. Running on a single GPU, Samudra 2 enables larger ensembles for sea-level projections, ocean heat uptake, and climate variability studies. All artifacts are publicly available: project page, code, checkpoints, documentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Samudra 2 是一个自回归神经海洋仿真器，解决了之前版本在长期预测中的方差塌缩和印记伪影问题。它采用更宽的 U-Net 骨干和动态损失函数，在 1° 分辨率上将上层海洋全球平均温度 R² 从 0.56 提升至 0.87，并将深层海洋温度误差降低约七倍。该架构可扩展到 1/2° 和 1/4° 分辨率，实现约 8 年的自回归滚动，恢复中尺度涡旋和西边界流。
Motivation: 海洋环流模型计算成本高，限制了集合规模和强迫情景，而现有海洋仿真器无法同时实现精细空间分辨率与多年自回归。Samudra 存在方差塌缩和印记伪影两种长期失败模式。
Method: 引入了更宽的 U-Net 骨干，使用改进的 ConvNeXt 风格块和减小的块内扩展因子，并提出了动态损失函数，根据预测误差对输出通道进行重新加权，增强慢变深层海洋场的梯度。
Result: 在 1° 分辨率下，上层海洋全球平均温度 R² 从 0.56 提高到 0.87，深层海洋温度误差降低约七倍。相同架构在 1/2° 和 1/4° 分辨率下运行约 8 年自回归滚动，成功恢复中尺度涡旋和强西边界流。
Conclusion: Samudra 2 能够在单个 GPU 上运行，支持更大的集合，用于海平面预测、海洋热吸收和气候变率研究。所有代码和模型均已公开。
