papers.title: Spectrally Safe Neural Operator Warm-Starts for Large-Scale Newton Solvers
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators are increasingly used to warm-start Newton solvers for nonlinear PDEs, on the premise that a low test error places the initial guess inside the basin of attraction. We show that this premise is unreliable. An operator trained to the relative \(L^2\) error \(O(10^{-3})\) can still produce an initial state in which the discrete Jacobian is indefinite, because the mean-squared training controls error on average while leaving localized pointwise violations of the underlying physics. For a nearly incompressible hyperelasticity problem, we trace this to the predicted volume change: the operator disperses \(\mathrm{det} F\) well away from one, and the resulting Jacobian acquires negative eigenvalues even when the predicted field is visually indistinguishable from the reference. At a small scale, this is a nuisance; at a multi-million degree-of-freedom scale, it is disqualifying, since the conjugate gradient and other Krylov solvers needed for memory-feasible Newton steps assume a definite spectrum. We then show that a short, label-free fine-tuning phase -- penalizing the operator against the discrete energy, with no additional solution data -- shifts the Jacobian spectrum back to positive definite. Combined with an inexact outer loop, this gives a warm-started Newton method that converges across the full loading range where the unregularized operator fails, reaching up to 5.4\(\times\) wall-clock speedup over incremental continuation on a 3D problem with 6.4 million degrees of freedom.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文指出神经算子用于预热牛顿求解器时，即使测试误差很低（相对L2误差O(10^-3)），仍可能产生离散雅可比矩阵不定（indefinite）的初始猜测，导致牛顿法在大型问题中失效。作者发现对于近不可压缩超弹性问题，神经算子在体积变化预测上的局部偏差是根源。他们提出一种无标签的微调阶段，通过惩罚离散能量来恢复雅可比矩阵的正定性，结合不精确外循环，在全加载范围内收敛，并在640万自由度的3D问题上实现最高5.4倍的加速。
Motivation: 现有工作假设低测试误差的神经算子能将初始猜测置于吸引域内，但该假设在大型非线性PDE求解中不可靠，即使误差很低，雅可比矩阵仍可能不定，导致牛顿法失败，尤其在大规模问题中会因内存限制而无法使用Krylov子空间方法。
Method: 提出一种无标签的微调阶段，不依赖额外的解数据，而是通过惩罚离散能量对神经算子进行正则化，使雅可比矩阵恢复正定；然后结合不精确外循环（inexact outer loop）构成预热的牛顿法。
Result: 在近不可压缩超弹性问题中，未正则化的神经算子失败，而该方法在640万自由度的3D问题上实现全加载范围的收敛，并获得最高5.4倍的实时加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过短期的无标签能量正则化微调，可以解决神经算子预热牛顿法的谱不安全性问题，使方法适用于大规模非线性PDE求解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CNnotator: LLM-Guided Memory Safety Annotation Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Memory safety errors account for a large proportion of security bugs in systems written in C; modern languages such as Java and Rust prevent such bugs because they are memory-safe by design. To migrate systems to safer languages or identify memory errors, we must first determine how legacy code manipulates memory. This information is only represented implicitly in such code. In many cases, memory usage patterns are merely tedious for humans to figure out, rather than truly difficult. In this work, we ask if large language models (LLMs) can perform this task by having them synthesize annotations representing memory usage as specifications in CN, a hybrid testing/verification tool. Our tool, CNnotator, uses LLMs to automatically generate and test CN specifications. We find that current models are able to generate CN specifications for small-to-medium C programs, with the OpenAI o3 reasoning model achieving a 90% success rate on first attempts and 97% overall success, while the chat model GPT-4o correctly annotates 65% of first attempts. These results suggest AI-assisted annotation is becoming practical for real-world C codebases.
papers.comment: 6 pages. Published at ReCode 2026 (1st Workshop on Code Translation, Transformation, and Modernization), co-located with ICSE 2026. This version corrects the description of the property-based testing backend (Bennet, built on Fulminate) relative to the published version
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 1st Workshop on Code Translation, Transformation, and Modernization (ReCode '26), April 12-18, 2026, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. ACM, New York, NY, USA, 6 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CNnotator，利用大语言模型自动为C程序生成CN规范（内存安全注释），以辅助将遗留代码迁移到内存安全语言。实验表明，OpenAI o3推理模型首次尝试成功率达90%，总体成功率达97%，而GPT-4o首次成功率为65%。
Motivation: 内存安全错误是C语言中安全漏洞的主要来源，迁移到安全语言前需理解遗留代码的内存操作模式，但该信息仅在代码中隐式表示，人工标注繁琐。
Method: 使用LLM自动生成CN规范（混合测试/验证工具），并通过属性测试后端（Bennet，基于Fulminate）进行验证和迭代修正。
Result: OpenAI o3推理模型在中小型C程序上首次尝试成功率达90%，总体成功率97%；GPT-4o首次成功率65%。
Conclusion: AI辅助的注释合成对真实C代码库正变得实用，但当前仅限于中小型程序。

papers.title: Local Causal Attribution of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the causal structure of a language model's thought process is a problem of significant importance for both transparency and safety. In this work, we take a local approach toward this goal by analyzing the causal relationships among individual components, termed units, of a given, specific chain-of-thought trace. We construct a structural causal model on these units and relate each unit to the log probability of generating (subsequent) output units. Our algorithm, termed AttriCoT, is a black-box method that performs attribution by estimating importance parameters in the structural causal model using $O(U)$ forward passes through the model, where $U$ is the number of units. Evaluation of perturbation curves across 5 datasets and 4 reasoning models shows that AttriCoT produces attributions that are more faithful to the model's behavior than alternative methods. The attribution results also reveal notable differences in thought structure between models and domains.
papers.comment: Camera-ready version for the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026. 37 pages, 18 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AttriCoT方法，用于分析语言模型链式推理（CoT）中各个组件（单元）之间的局部因果结构，通过O(U)次前向传播估计重要性参数，在5个数据集和4个模型上评估显示比现有方法更忠实于模型行为。
Motivation: 理解语言模型思维过程的因果结构对透明性和安全性至关重要，现有方法缺乏对特定CoT轨迹内组件间因果关系的局部分析。
Method: 构建结构因果模型，将每个单元与生成后续输出单元的对数概率相关联，通过黑盒方式估计重要性参数，仅需O(U)次前向传播。
Result: 在5个数据集和4个推理模型上，AttriCoT生成的归因比替代方法更忠实于模型行为，并揭示了不同模型和领域间思维结构的显著差异。
Conclusion: AttriCoT能有效揭示CoT推理的局部因果结构，但方法仅针对单个轨迹，可能不适用于全局因果分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generating Public Health Responses using Survey-Augmented Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Epidemiological models often rely on survey data to represent how individuals make health-related decisions, such as whether to vaccinate or adopt protective behaviors. However, repeated large-scale surveys are costly, time-consuming, and limited in the range of scenarios they can capture. In this work, we investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can generate synthetic survey responses that reproduce patterns observed in real populations. Using longitudinal data from the FluPaths surveys, we first identify groups associated with broadly positive or negative attitudes toward vaccination through clustering analysis. We then evaluate several LLMs using a cluster-informed prompting approach to generate synthetic survey responses across multiple epidemic waves. Across models, the synthetic data generally reproduce the distributions of demographic characteristics, vaccination-related beliefs, risk perceptions, and health behaviors observed in the survey data. However, they are less successful at capturing how these factors vary together within respondents. Some models reproduce group-level vaccination trends more reliably than others, although performance varies across waves. We also trained a classifier to distinguish real from synthetic records and found that the generated responses remained identifiable as synthetic. Overall, our findings suggest that LLM-generated survey data may provide a useful tool for exploratory data augmentation and we hope that it could support agent-based epidemic modeling approaches. However, the generated data should not be treated as a substitute for human survey data without further methodological improvements and validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索使用大语言模型（LLMs）生成合成调查响应，以复制真实人群在公共卫生决策中的模式。利用FluPaths纵向调查数据，通过聚类识别态度组，并用聚类引导的提示方法生成合成数据。合成数据在人口统计特征、信念和行为分布上总体匹配，但在多变量联合分布上表现不佳，且分类器可区分真实与合成数据。
Motivation: 流行病学模型常依赖调查数据，但大规模重复调查成本高且场景有限。本文旨在研究LLM能否生成高质量的合成调查响应以辅助建模。
Method: 使用FluPaths调查数据，先通过聚类分析识别对疫苗接种持积极或消极态度的群体，然后采用聚类引导的提示方法（cluster-informed prompting）让多个LLM生成合成调查响应。
Result: 合成数据能再现真实数据中人口统计特征、疫苗相关信念、风险感知和健康行为的分布，但未能很好地捕捉这些因素的协变模式。不同模型在再现群体级疫苗接种趋势上表现不一，且训练的分类器可区分合成与真实记录。
Conclusion: LLM生成的调查数据可作为探索性数据增强工具，支持基于智能体的流行病模型，但尚不能替代真实调查数据，需进一步方法改进和验证。

papers.title: RAPID: A Reproducible Multi-Agent Pipeline for Interpretable Disaster Damage Assessment from Satellite and Street-View Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Due to the increasing frequency and intensity of extreme climate events, there is a clear demand for intelligent, scalable, and autonomous approaches to disaster damage assessment. Existing methods, largely based on supervised learning and task-specific fine-tuning, struggle to generalize under domain shifts, long-tailed data distributions, and heterogeneous geospatial data sources, especially in disaster scenarios. They also often lack the ability to integrate and reason across multimodal geospatial information, such as satellite images and street-view images. In this paper, we introduce RAPID, a reproducible multi-agent pipeline for interpretable disaster damage assessment, including damage-level assessment, damage-type interpretation, and actionable suggestions for response, remediation, and recovery. RAPID coordinates specialized agents to perform cross-view understanding, image restoration, structured damage recognition, and geographical reasoning across heterogeneous data modalities. Without task-specific fine-tuning, RAPID supports zero-shot damage assessment by jointly using complementary information from remote sensing and ground-level perspectives. The system produces fine-grained, interpretable assessments and automatically generates location-specific, decision-relevant disaster reports to support early-stage emergency response. We evaluate RAPID across hurricanes, floods, wildfires, and earthquakes using multiple cross-view imagery inputs, including pre- and post-disaster street-view images, post-disaster remote sensing imagery, and street-view image pairs. Experiments show that RAPID achieves 0.92 overall accuracy for multi-disaster type classification and up to 0.627 for cross-view damage severity prediction, highlighting its potential as a foundational framework for autonomous disaster intelligence.

papers.title: Steer, Don't Solve: Training Small Critic Models for Large Code Agents
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end code agent training is resource-intensive and plateaus on the strategy-level reasoning needed to resolve code issues, since jointly optimizing code-level execution and strategy-level reasoning leaves the latter underdeveloped. Instead, we freeze the agent and add a critic model to supply that signal. Prior code critics are post-hoc, scoring completed trajectories rather than steering the agent; we instead train a small critic that provides intra-trajectory feedback via Supervised Fine-Tuning. On SWE-bench Verified, a critic trained on CWM-32B trajectories transfers to two unseen agents (gains of +3.0 to +3.8 points), and adding target-agent trajectories to the corpus increases the gain to +3.8 on CWM-32B and +4.4 to +5.2 on two Qwen agents, at 30-92x lower critic cost than a strong teacher. On Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B, the critic-guided system is both more accurate (25.2% vs. 20.8%) and cheaper (\$0.04 vs. \$0.11) than the agent alone, because the critic also shortens trajectories. Our results show that a small, well-trained critic is a practical complement to scaling agent training. Code: https://github.com/shubhamrgandhi/critic-training. Data and models: https://huggingface.co/collections/shubhamrgandhi/critic-training-for-code-agents
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对代码代理在策略级推理上的不足，提出冻结主代理并训练一个小型批评模型（critic），通过监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning）在轨迹内提供反馈，从而引导代理。在SWE-bench Verified上，该批评模型可迁移到未见过的代理，提升3.0-5.2个点，同时批评模型的成本仅为强教师模型的1/30到1/92。实验还表明，批评模型能缩短轨迹，使系统在保持更高准确率（25.2% vs. 20.8%）的同时降低推理成本（$0.04 vs. $0.11）。
Motivation: 端到端代码代理训练资源消耗大且策略级推理能力发展不足，因为代码执行和策略推理的联合优化导致后者被忽视；现有批评模型是事后评分，无法在轨迹中引导代理。
Method: 冻结主代理，额外训练一个小型批评模型，通过监督微调（SFT）在代理轨迹的中间步骤提供反馈信号；批评模型先在CWM-32B轨迹上训练，再结合目标代理轨迹混合训练。
Result: 在SWE-bench Verified上，仅用CWM-32B轨迹训练的批评模型迁移到两个未见代理上带来+3.0至+3.8的提升；加入目标代理轨迹后，CWM-32B提升+3.8，两个Qwen代理提升+4.4至+5.2，批评成本为强教师的30-92倍。在Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B上，批评引导系统准确率25.2% vs 代理单独20.8%，成本$0.04 vs $0.11。
Conclusion: 一个训练良好的小型批评模型可以成为扩展代理训练的实际补充，在提升准确率的同时降低推理成本，且能有效缩短轨迹。

papers.title: Causal Gaussian Processes for Robust Treatment Effect Evaluation with Unobserved Confounding
papers.abstract_en: The presence of confounding bias poses a key challenge in policy evaluation, as the target causal effects of actions are not identifiable (i.e., underdetermined) from observational data. On the other hand, existing confounding-robust evaluation strategies require detailed prior knowledge about the environment or apply only to discrete treatments and outcomes. This paper investigates causal effect evaluation over the continuous domain from confounded observations, while requiring only basic temporal ordering between the treatment and the outcome. We introduce a universal discretization of the exogenous domains that approximates the observational and interventional distributions of any causal model with arbitrary accuracy using a finite number of latent states. Building on this newfound universal approximation property, we develop a novel family of Causal Gaussian process (CGP) models that effectively approximate the observational and interventional distributions of any causal model with confounded observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对连续域中观测数据存在未观测混杂偏倚时，仅依赖治疗与结果之间的基本时间顺序，提出一种通用离散化方法，用有限潜在状态以任意精度近似任意因果模型的观测和干预分布，并在此基础上开发了新的因果高斯过程（CGP）模型族，用于鲁棒的处理效应评估。
Motivation: 现有混淆鲁棒策略需要详细先验知识或仅适用于离散处理与结果，而连续域中未观测混杂下的因果效应评估仍是一个挑战。
Method: 引入外生域通用离散化，证明其通用近似性质，并据此构建因果高斯过程（CGP）模型，以近似任意具有混淆观测的因果模型的观测与干预分布。
Result: 摘要声称CGP模型能有效近似任意因果模型在混淆观测下的分布，但未提供具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 本文提供的离散化方法和CGP模型为连续域中仅依赖时间顺序的混杂鲁棒推断提供了新的理论框架。

papers.title: Finetuning Vision-Language-Action Models Requires Fewer Layers Than You Think
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models pre-trained on massive video-robot datasets have revolutionized robotic manipulation, yet their multi-billion parameter architectures impose prohibitive computational burdens during downstream fine-tuning and real-time inference. In this work, we reveal a highly non-trivial architectural characteristic of these continuous control foundation policies (e.g., pi_0, GR00T-N1.5): despite being trained on diverse physical trajectories, they exhibit severe layer-wise representational redundancy. To exploit this, we introduce a structural compression pipeline that is entirely training-free, bypassing the need of existing methods to load full-scale models to learn optimized token reductions or dynamic layer selectors. Instead, using only a single forward pass via Centered Kernel Alignment to identify redundant layer features, we remove twin layers to permanently compress the model depth by up to 50% across both the VLM backbone and the continuous control policy head. Downstream fine-tuning of this streamlined architecture yields a dual acceleration benefit: a 40-50% reduction in training time and up to 30% faster real-time inference, while matching or exceeding full-scale base model performance. We comprehensively validate our method across three simulation benchmarks (LIBERO, RoboCasa, SimplerEnv) and 10 diverse real-world manipulation tasks across 4 unique robotic embodiments. These results prove that advanced VLAs require significantly fewer layers than previously assumed, offering a highly compute-efficient paradigm for scalable robot learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在层维度存在严重表示冗余，提出一种无需训练的结构压缩方法，通过中心核对齐（Centered Kernel Alignment）一次性识别并移除冗余层，可将模型深度压缩50%，微调时训练时间减少40-50%，推理速度提升30%，且在多种仿真和真实机器人任务上匹配或超越原模型性能。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型参数量巨大（数十亿），在下游微调和实时推理中计算开销过高，现有压缩方法需加载完整模型来学习优化策略，效率低下。
Method: 仅用单次前向传播通过中心核对齐（Centered Kernel Alignment）识别层间冗余特征，然后永久移除冗余的成对层，压缩VLM骨干和连续控制策略头的深度最高达50%，整个过程无需训练。
Result: 在LIBERO、RoboCasa、SimplerEnv三个仿真基准和10项真实世界操作任务（涉及4种机器人形态）上，压缩后模型微调时间减少40-50%，实时推理加速30%，性能与全尺寸基线持平或更优。
Conclusion: 高级VLA模型所需的层数远少于此前假设，该工作提供了一种计算高效的机器人学习可扩展范式。

papers.title: Token Factory: Efficiently Integrating Diverse Signals into Large Recommendation Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Recommendation Models (LRMs) have demonstrated promising capabilities in industry-scale recommendation tasks. However, holistically integrating traditional signals into these transformer-based architectures effectively and efficiently remains a major challenge. Conventional approaches that "textualize" these signals directly or create discrete item representations often lead to excessively long prompts, substantial memory footprints, and high computational overhead. To overcome these limitations, we propose "Token Factory", a framework designed to transform traditional signals into "soft tokens" that can be directly processed by LRMs. This approach enables efficient integration and compression of heterogeneous input features, preventing prompt length explosion while enhancing model performance. We detail the architecture of Token Factory and present experimental results validating its effectiveness in a production-scale recommendation environment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Token Factory框架，将传统信号转换为软令牌（soft tokens），以便大型推荐模型（LRMs）高效处理。该方法避免了提示长度爆炸和计算开销，并在生产级推荐环境中验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有方法将信号文本化或离散化会导致长提示和巨大内存占用，难以有效集成传统信号到基于Transformer的大型推荐模型中。
Method: Token Factory框架将异构输入特征转换为软令牌，直接由LRM处理，实现高效集成和压缩。
Result: 实验结果表明，在生产规模推荐环境中，Token Factory有效提升了模型性能，同时避免提示长度爆炸。
Conclusion: 该框架为在大型推荐模型中集成多样信号提供了高效解决方案。

papers.title: FAPO: Fully Automated Prompt Optimization of Multi-Step LLM Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step LLM pipelines fail through interactions among retrieval, reasoning, and formatting steps, so prompt-only optimization can miss bottlenecks in the chain. We present Fully Automated Prompt Optimization (FAPO), a framework that lets Claude Code optimize an LLM pipeline inside a standardized codebase. FAPO evaluates a pipeline, inspects intermediate steps, diagnoses failures, proposes scoped changes, and validates variants repeatedly to optimize against a score function. It first tries prompt edits and, only when prompt optimization appears insufficient, changes chain structure within the permitted scope when attribution identifies a structural bottleneck. Across six benchmarks and three task models, FAPO beats the baseline GEPA in 15 of 18 model-benchmark comparisons. In 11 model-benchmark comparisons, FAPO wins with non-overlapping mean $\pm$ trial-standard-deviation ranges, and the mean FAPO-GEPA gain is +14.1 pp. In the six HoVer and IFBench comparisons where prompt-first search escalated to structural changes, FAPO wins all six with a mean gain of +33.8 pp. FAPO also improves performance on security tasks: on CTIBench-RCM, a security CVE-to-CWE task, prompt-only FAPO lifts test accuracy by +4.0 pp on GPT-5, +7.1 pp on Foundation-Sec-8B-Instruct, and +2.0 pp on Foundation-Sec-8B-Reasoning. These results position FAPO as a state-of-the-art pipeline optimization technique for both general-purpose and security-focused tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FAPO（全自动提示优化）框架，用于多步骤大语言模型流水线的自动化优化。FAPO通过Claude Code自动评估流水线、检查中间步骤、诊断故障、提出范围变更并重复验证，以优化得分函数。在六个基准测试和三个任务模型上，FAPO在18个模型-基准比较中击败基线GEPA，平均增益+14.1个百分点；在需要结构性变化的六次比较中，平均增益+33.8个百分点。在安全任务CTIBench-RCM上，仅提示优化即提升测试准确率最高+7.1个百分点。
Motivation: 多步骤大语言模型流水线中，检索、推理和格式化步骤之间的交互可能导致失败，仅优化提示无法解决流水线中的瓶颈问题。
Method: FAPO是一个框架，让Claude Code在标准化代码库中优化LLM流水线。它评估流水线、检查中间步骤、诊断故障、提出范围变更并重复验证变体以优化得分函数。首先尝试提示编辑，当提示优化不足且归因识别出结构性瓶颈时，才在允许范围内改变链结构。
Result: 在六个基准测试和三个任务模型上，FAPO在18个模型-基准比较中击败基线GEPA，其中11个比较中非重叠均值±标准差范围显示FAPO胜出，平均增益+14.1个百分点。在六次HoVer和IFBench比较中，提示优先搜索升级为结构性变化，FAPO全部胜出，平均增益+33.8个百分点。在安全任务CTIBench-RCM上，仅提示优化使GPT-5准确率提升+4.0个百分点，Foundation-Sec-8B-Instruct提升+7.1个百分点，Foundation-Sec-8B-Reasoning提升+2.0个百分点。
Conclusion: FAPO被定位为通用和安全任务的最新流水线优化技术，实验表明其在多种设置下优于基线GEPA。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出FAPO（全自动提示优化）框架，用于多步骤大语言模型流水线的自动化优化。FAPO通过Claude Code自动评估流水线、检查中间步骤、诊断故障、提出范围变更并重复验证，以优化得分函数。在六个基准测试和三个任务模型上，FAPO在18个模型-基准比较中击败基线GEPA，平均增益+14.1个百分点；在需要结构性变化的六次比较中，平均增益+33.8个百分点。在安全任务CTIBench-RCM上，仅提示优化即提升测试准确率最高+7.1个百分点。
summary_sections.motivation: 多步骤大语言模型流水线中，检索、推理和格式化步骤之间的交互可能导致失败，仅优化提示无法解决流水线中的瓶颈问题。
summary_sections.method: FAPO是一个框架，让Claude Code在标准化代码库中优化LLM流水线。它评估流水线、检查中间步骤、诊断故障、提出范围变更并重复验证变体以优化得分函数。首先尝试提示编辑，当提示优化不足且归因识别出结构性瓶颈时，才在允许范围内改变链结构。
summary_sections.result: 在六个基准测试和三个任务模型上，FAPO在18个模型-基准比较中击败基线GEPA，其中11个比较中非重叠均值±标准差范围显示FAPO胜出，平均增益+14.1个百分点。在六次HoVer和IFBench比较中，提示优先搜索升级为结构性变化，FAPO全部胜出，平均增益+33.8个百分点。在安全任务CTIBench-RCM上，仅提示优化使GPT-5准确率提升+4.0个百分点，Foundation-Sec-8B-Instruct提升+7.1个百分点，Foundation-Sec-8B-Reasoning提升+2.0个百分点。

papers.title: Essential Subspace Merging for Multi-Task Learning
papers.abstract_en: Model merging aims to enable multi-task learning by integrating the capabilities of multiple models fine-tuned from the same pre-trained checkpoint into a single model. Its core challenge is inter-task interference among task-specific parameter updates. In this paper, we analyze the output shifts induced by task updates and observe that their energy is concentrated in a small number of principal directions. We call the subspace spanned by these directions the essential subspace. In contrast, most remaining directions carry little task-relevant energy, but their accumulation across multiple task updates can cause severe interference during merging. Motivated by this observation, we propose Essential Subspace Decomposition (ESD), which decomposes each task update according to the principal components of its activation shift. Based on ESD, we introduce Essential Subspace Merging (ESM), a training-free static merging method that orthogonalizes and fuses essential components into one compact multi-task model. We further extend ESM to ESM++, a training-free dynamic merging method that decomposes task-specific residuals into low-rank experts and selects the most relevant expert through prototype-based routing during forward inference. Extensive experiments across multiple task sets and model scales demonstrate that ESM and ESM++ effectively preserves task knowledge while reducing inter-task interference. Code is available at https://github.com/kiddo127/ESM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多任务学习中模型合并时任务间干扰的问题，提出关键子空间合并（ESM）方法。通过分析任务更新的输出偏移能量主要集中在少数主方向，提出关键子空间分解（ESD），并基于此构建训练无关的静态合并方法ESM和动态合并方法ESM++，有效减少任务间干扰。实验在多个任务集和模型规模上验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 多任务模型合并面临的核心挑战是任务特定参数更新之间的相互干扰。现有方法未充分利用任务更新在子空间上的能量分布特性。
Method: 提出关键子空间分解（ESD），将每个任务更新根据其激活偏移的主成分分解；基于ESD提出训练无关的静态合并方法ESM（正交化并融合关键成分）和动态合并方法ESM++（将任务残差分解为低秩专家，通过原型路由选择最相关专家）。
Result: 在多个任务集和模型规模上的实验表明，ESM和ESM++有效保留了任务知识并减少了任务间干扰。
Conclusion: 本文通过分析任务更新的能量集中特性，提出了基于关键子空间的合并方法，为多任务模型合并提供了新思路。代码已开源。

papers.title: FoMoE: Breaking the Full-Replica Barrier with a Federation of MoEs
papers.abstract_en: Pre-training Large Language Models (LLMs) typically demands large-scale infrastructure with tightly coupled hardware accelerators. Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs) architectures partially decouple model capacity from per-token compute. This efficiency alone does not make MoE training feasible over ordinary Internet links or loosely connected commodity hardware since active expert routing still assumes high-speed datacenter fabrics. Low-communication methods such as DiLoCo and Photon reduce synchronization frequency across distributed sites, mitigating bandwidth constraints, yet still require full model replicas at every site. This creates a mismatch: modern MoEs have sparse data paths, but their distributed training infrastructure remains communication-dense and memory-inefficient, limiting attempts to pool geographically distributed compute. In this work, we introduce FoMoE, a system that breaks the full-replica paradigm by partitioning expert layers across workers and skipping non-resident experts during local training. We demonstrate that FoMoE: (I) reduces communication costs by up to 1.42x over efficient baselines and 45.44x over Distributed Data Parallelism (DDP) via partial expert replication in controlled regimes; (II) achieves empirical throughput speedups of up to 1.4x through the skip-token mechanism; and (III) shows stable routing in the trained regimes and projects the communication/memory benefits to 100B-scale configurations through system modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FoMoE是一种分布式训练系统，通过将专家层拆分到不同工作节点、在本地训练时跳过非本地专家，打破了传统MoE训练中每个节点必须持有完整模型副本的限制。实验表明该方法相比高效基线降低1.42倍通信量，相比DDP降低45.44倍，并通过跳跃令牌机制实现1.4倍吞吐提升。系统建模表明该方法可扩展到100B参数规模。
Motivation: 现有MoE训练仍依赖全模型副本在高速数据中心网络下通信，无法有效利用地理分散的普通计算资源，存在通信密集和内存低效的问题。
Method: 提出联邦式MoE（FoMoE），将专家层分区到不同工作节点，本地训练时跳过非本地专家，并通过部分专家复制控制通信开销。
Result: 通信成本比高效基线降低1.42倍、比DDP降低45.44倍，吞吐量提升1.4倍，训练中路由稳定，系统建模显示可扩展至100B参数。
Conclusion: FoMoE通过打破全副本范式，使MoE训练在松散连接的普通硬件上可行，同时保持性能和稳定性。

papers.title: Predicting Immune Biomarkers with MultiModal Mixture-of-Expert Pathology Foundation Models Empowers Precision Oncology
papers.abstract_en: Predicting immune biomarkers associated with the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) is critical for advancing precision oncology, yet existing approaches are largely limited to single image modalities and suffer from insufficient resolution and incomplete utilization of complementary clinical and biological information. Here we introduce MixTIME, a multimodal foundation model that leverages a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture to integrate pathology foundation models trained across distinct modalities: image only (UNIv2), image text (CONCHv1.5), and image transcriptomic (STPath) representations for pixel-level and slide-level prediction of multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) protein expression from hematoxylin and eosin (HE) whole-slide images. MixTIME employs a learnable router to dynamically weight expert contributions and is trained with a distribution- and tendency-aware loss function. Benchmarked on two datasets of different scales, MixTIME achieves state-of-the-art performance across 17 protein markers as measured by correlation metrics. The predicted mIF profiles substantially enhance downstream tasks, including spatial domain identification, survival prediction, and AI-assisted pathology report generation validated by expert pathologists from multiple institutes across the world. Furthermore, MixTIME enables longitudinal tracking of protein expression dynamics across clinical time points and reveals protein gene interaction patterns linked to drug resistance and immune suppression in tumor microenvironments. Collectively, MixTIME provides a scalable framework for multimodal biomarker discovery and clinical translation in computational pathology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MixTIME，一个多模态病理学基础模型，利用混合专家（MoE）架构整合三种不同模态的病理基础模型（图像、图像文本、图像转录组），从 HE 全切片图像预测多重免疫荧光（mIF）蛋白表达。在两个数据集上，MixTIME 在 17 个蛋白标志物上达到最优性能，并提升了空间域识别、生存预测和 AI 辅助病理报告生成等下游任务。
Motivation: 现有方法通常局限于单一图像模态，分辨率不足且未能充分利用临床和生物学互补信息，难以准确预测与肿瘤免疫微环境相关的免疫生物标志物。
Method: MixTIME 采用 MoE 架构，集成三个不同模态的病理基础模型（UNIv2、CONCHv1.5、STPath），通过可学习的路由器动态加权专家贡献，并使用分布和趋势感知损失函数进行训练。
Result: 在两个不同规模的数据集上，MixTIME 在 17 个蛋白标志物的相关性指标上达到最先进水平。预测的 mIF 谱显著改进了空间域识别、生存预测和由多中心病理学家验证的 AI 辅助病理报告生成。
Conclusion: MixTIME 提供了一个可扩展的多模态生物标志物发现和临床转化框架，并揭示了与耐药性和免疫抑制相关的蛋白-基因相互作用模式。

papers.title: Fast Nonparametric Conditional Independence Testing via Two-Stage Regression
papers.abstract_en: Constraint-based causal discovery relies on repeated conditional independence tests, but fast nonparametric tests often sacrifice calibration, especially when variables depend on the conditioning set through nonlinear relationships. We introduce BLITZ (Broad-to-Local Independence Testing via residualiZation), a nonparametric conditional independence test designed to run well under a second while maintaining the accuracy needed for the thousands of queries performed by constraint-based causal discovery algorithms. BLITZ first removes broad smooth dependence on the conditioning set using low-order polynomial regression, then applies a small nonlinear feature map and residualizes those features with shallow tree regressions. The resulting statistic tests residual cross-covariance, with a moment-matched chi-square approximation to the null distribution. We show theoretically that the two-stage design reduces the effective complexity faced by the tree residualizers, allowing shallow trees to control residual conditional-mean bias while avoiding excessive overfitting. In simulations, BLITZ provides better null calibration than fast kernel, random-feature, and regression-based competitors while remaining among the fastest methods tested. In causal discovery experiments on synthetic graphs and flow-cytometry data, BLITZ yields more reliable endpoint orientations among retained adjacencies and competitive structural recovery. These results suggest that broad-to-local residualization is a practical route to calibrated, scalable nonparametric conditional independence testing for causal discovery.
papers.comment: A fast R implementation with C++ back-end is available at https://github.com/ericstrobl/BLITZ
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BLITZ (Broad-to-Local Independence Testing via residualiZation)，一种快速的非参数条件独立性检验方法，用于约束基因果发现中的大量查询。该方法通过两阶段回归：先用低阶多项式回归移除对条件集的宽平滑依赖，再应用小规模非线性特征映射并用浅层树回归残差化特征，最后检验残差交叉协方差并使用矩匹配的卡方近似零分布。理论分析表明两阶段设计降低了树残差化器的有效复杂度。模拟实验显示 BLITZ 在零校准上优于快速核方法、随机特征和基于回归的竞争者，同时保持最快速度之一。因果发现实验在合成图和流式细胞术数据上产生更可靠的端点定向。
Motivation: 约束基因果发现依赖重复的条件独立性检验，但现有快速非参数检验在校准上往往不佳，尤其在变量通过非线性关系依赖条件集时。
Method: 提出 BLITZ：第一阶段用低阶多项式回归移除对条件集的平滑依赖；第二阶段应用小规模非线性特征映射并用浅层树回归残差化特征，最后检验残差交叉协方差，使用矩匹配卡方近似零分布。
Result: 模拟中，BLITZ 在校准上优于快速核、随机特征和基于回归的竞争方法，且保持最快速度之一；因果发现实验中产生更可靠的端点定向和竞争性结构恢复。
Conclusion: 宽到局部残差化是实现校准且可扩展的非参数条件独立性检验的实用路径，适用于因果发现。

papers.title: Follow the Latent Roadmap: Navigating Revocable Decoding for Diffusion LLMs with Anchor Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) offer a promising avenue for parallel generation but face a trade-off between decoding speed and quality. While revocable decoding strategies attempt to mitigate errors by verifying and remasking tokens, they typically operate within a mixed-quality context. This leads to two critical failures: \textit{Error Propagation}, where new tokens absorb toxic information from erroneous context, and \textit{Local Error Reinforcement}, where errors mutually reinforce each other to evade detection. To alleviate these challenges, we propose ASRD (Anchor Supervised Revocable Decoding), a training-free framework that operates within the embedding space. ASRD explicitly decouples the decoding context into trusted \textit{Anchor Tokens}, which are identified via temporal consistency, and uncertain candidates. Leveraging a dynamic Anchor Tokens Cache, we introduce two complementary mechanisms: (1) Anchor-Guided Generation, which injects entropy-weighted anchor signals into masked positions to implicitly rectify attention toward the reliable global skeleton; and (2) Anchor-Perturbed Verification, which applies orthogonal perturbations to uncertain candidate tokens, destabilizing and remasking errors driven by fragile local consensus. Extensive experiments on math and coding benchmarks demonstrate that ASRD outperforms recent remasking baselines, achieving accuracy improvements of up to 6.4\% while accelerating inference throughput by up to 7.2$\times$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散大语言模型（dLLM）中可撤销解码策略的上下文混合质量问题，即错误传播和局部错误强化，提出ASRD框架。ASRD在嵌入空间内运行，通过时间一致性识别锚点令牌（Anchor Tokens）作为可信上下文，并引入锚点引导生成和锚点扰动验证两种互补机制。在数学和编码基准上，ASRD相比基线在准确率上提升达6.4%，推理吞吐量提升达7.2倍。
Motivation: 现有可撤销解码策略在混合质量上下文中操作，导致错误传播（新令牌吸收错误上下文信息）和局部错误强化（错误相互加强难以检测）。
Method: 提出ASRD（Anchor Supervised Revocable Decoding）框架，无训练，在嵌入空间运行。将解码上下文分为通过时间一致性识别的可信锚点令牌和不确定候选令牌。利用动态锚点令牌缓存，引入两种机制：锚点引导生成（向掩码位置注入熵加权锚点信号以校正注意力）和锚点扰动验证（对不确定候选令牌施加正交扰动以破坏脆弱局部共识并重新掩码错误）。
Result: 在数学和编码基准上，ASRD在准确率上提升达6.4%，推理吞吐量提升达7.2倍。
Conclusion: ASRD框架通过显式解耦可信锚点和不确定候选，有效缓解了dLLM可撤销解码中的错误传播和局部错误强化问题。

papers.title: Calibrated Sampling-Free Uncertainty Estimation in Bayesian Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Modern deep learning models remain notoriously prone to overconfidence, limiting their reliability in high-stakes applications. Bayesian methods aim to counter this by learning a distribution over model parameters, and recent advances now make this feasible for large-scale architectures at costs comparable to AdamW. However, a challenge remains at test time: predictions must be averaged across many forward passes with weights sampled from the posterior, which is prohibitively expensive. Variance propagation offers an efficient alternative, computing layer-wise analytical approximations of uncertainty in a single forward pass. While such techniques are effective for MLPs, their extension to modern architectures remains challenging, due to increased depth and diversity of layer types. To fill this gap, we propose Calibrated Variance Propagation (CVP), which introduces a new propagation method for normalization layers, combines it with recent techniques for handling activation functions, and absorbs residual error through a light calibration step. CVP yields comparably accurate uncertainty estimates to MC sampling across transformers and CNNs, at a fraction of the cost. Against prior variance propagation work, CVP improves coverage at $0.5\%$ risk from $8.2\%$ to $14.6\%$ with BEiT-3 on Visual Reasoning (NLVR2) and from $2.6\%$ to $10.8\%$ with ViLT on VQAv2, with gains extending to convolutional architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出校准方差传播（Calibrated Variance Propagation, CVP），一种无需采样的不确定性估计方法，适用于贝叶斯深度学习。CVP为归一化层设计新的传播方法，结合现有激活函数处理技术，并通过轻量校准步骤吸收残差误差，在Transformer和CNN上取得与蒙特卡洛采样相当的不确定性估计精度，且计算成本大幅降低。
Motivation: 贝叶斯深度学习在测试时需对后验参数进行多次前向传播平均预测，计算开销过大。方差传播虽能单次前向传播近似不确定性，但难以适用于现代深度架构中多样的层类型。
Method: 提出CVP，包括归一化层的新传播方法、激活函数的现有处理技术，以及轻量校准步骤以吸收残差误差，实现单次前向传播的校准不确定性估计。
Result: 在BEiT-3的NLVR2任务上，CVP将0.5%风险下的覆盖度从8.2%提升至14.6%；在ViLT的VQAv2任务上，从2.6%提升至10.8%；在卷积架构上也取得改进。
Conclusion: CVP提供了一种低成本、高精度的不确定性估计替代方案，适用于现代深度学习架构。

papers.title: One Goal, Many Commands: Characterizing Denylist Fragility in AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: The adoption of AI agents is increasing rapidly. Terminal AI agents, i.e., AI agents that run in terminal environments, are a widely used type of AI agents. Terminal AI agents rely heavily on shell command execution to interact with the host systems. They adopt a three-list command-gating mechanism to mitigate security risks introduced by command execution, with denylists serving as the load-bearing component. However, modern operating systems often ship a large, ever-expanding set of shell commands with complex functionalities. Our observation is that even a built-in denylist of Claude Code, well-maintained by its developers, can overlook bypass commands that invalidate its effectiveness. Such negligence leads to fragile command denylists that cannot even block operations that practitioners expect them to block. This paper presents the first systematic characterization of command denylist fragility in terminal AI agents. The paper formalizes the command denylist fragility problem and proposes an LLM-driven pipeline, ShellSieve, to detect such fragility. It prompts the LLM to propose possible bypasses and iteratively repairs them using feedback from a validator that executes them in a sandbox. In the evaluation, we applied ShellSieve to 1,709 real-world command denylists (containing 13,332 denylist rules) collected from GitHub. The evaluation shows several key findings, including that 69.0--98.6% of the denylists are fragile, that this fragility occurs consistently across projects and agents, and the validity of several possible root causes for this fragility. Our pipeline and findings will hopefully facilitate future research and practice regarding the command denylists used by AI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对终端AI智能体中命令拒绝列表(denylist)的脆弱性进行首次系统性研究。作者观察到即使维护良好的内置拒绝列表也存在可被绕过的命令，提出LLM驱动的检测流水线ShellSieve，通过提示LLM提出绕过方案并在沙箱中验证迭代修复。对GitHub上1,709个真实拒绝列表（含13,332条规则）的评估显示69.0-98.6%的拒绝列表存在脆弱性。
Motivation: 拒绝列表作为终端AI智能体安全门控的关键组件，却存在被绕过风险，现有缺乏系统性刻画和自动化检测工具。
Method: 形式化定义命令拒绝列表脆弱性问题，提出ShellSieve流水线：使用LLM提议可能的绕过命令，在沙箱中执行验证，并基于反馈迭代修复。
Result: 在1,709个真实世界拒绝列表上的评估显示，69.0-98.6%的拒绝列表存在脆弱性，且脆弱性跨项目和智能体一致，并分析了多个可能原因。
Conclusion: 本文的流水线和发现有望促进AI智能体命令拒绝列表的未来研究和实践改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cognitive Trajectory Modeling: Quantifying Human-AI Co-Creation through Cognitively Grounded Interaction Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Co-creative AI research increasingly seeks methods capable of representing how interaction dynamics evolve through time. While many existing approaches focus on observable interaction characteristics, interaction metrics, behavioral coding schemes, or activity traces, these methods often struggle to capture higher-order interaction dynamics, including how collaborative processes reorganize, stabilize, regulate, and evolve through time. This paper introduces Cognitive Trajectory Modeling (CTM) as a cognitive theory of interaction dynamics that conceptualizes cognition, interaction, and creative processes as temporally organized trajectories unfolding across cognitively meaningful attractor landscapes. CTM builds upon the theoretical foundations of the Enactive Model of Creativity and Creative Sense-Making (CSM), revisiting the role of sense-making curves and cognitive trajectories in representing co-creative interaction dynamics. We formalize this perspective through the Cognitive Trajectory Principle, which states that temporal representations are only theoretically interpretable as cognitive trajectories when their underlying states possess directional cognitive meaning. Building on this principle, CTM generalizes the notion of cognitive trajectories beyond any particular coding scheme and provides a broader framework for modeling interaction dynamics through trajectories unfolding across meaningful attractor landscapes. We further distinguish cognitive trajectories from interaction traces and situate CTM within a broader hierarchy of cognitive, interaction, and domain dynamics. More broadly, we argue that understanding co-creative systems requires methods capable of modeling how cognition and interaction dynamics unfold through time. CTM provides a foundation for studying interaction dynamics across co-creative AI and human-AI interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出认知轨迹建模（CTM），基于具身创造力模型和创造性意义建构（CSM）的理论基础，将认知、交互和创造过程概念化为在认知上有意义的吸引子景观上展开的时间轨迹。CTM通过认知轨迹原理形式化这一视角，强调时间表征只有在其底层状态具有方向性认知意义时才可解释为认知轨迹，并区分认知轨迹与交互痕迹，为研究人机共创中的交互动态提供了框架。
Motivation: 现有共创AI方法多关注可观察的交互特征、行为编码或活动痕迹，难以捕捉协作过程如何随时间重组、稳定、调节和演化的高阶交互动态。
Method: 引入认知轨迹建模（CTM），基于认知轨迹原理，将认知轨迹推广到任何编码方案之外，通过吸引子景观上的轨迹建模交互动态，并区分认知轨迹与交互痕迹，置于认知、交互和领域动态的层次体系中。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，主要提出理论框架和形式化原则。
Conclusion: 理解共创系统需要能够建模认知和交互动态随时间展开的方法，CTM为研究共创AI和人机交互中的交互动态提供了理论基础。

papers.title: Adaptive Turn-Taking for Real-time Multi-Party Voice Agents
papers.abstract_en: Turn-taking in multi-party spoken conversations remains a fundamental challenge for voice-based agents, particularly under dynamic floor competition and varying user expectations. We propose ModeratorLM, a role-playing voice agent that conditions turn-taking behavior on an explicitly assigned role in multi-party settings. The system is built on a speech large language model operating in chunk-wise streaming manner. We further introduce a reasoning-augmented variant that incorporates chain-of-thought reasoning over conversational context and the assigned role. We construct RolePlayConv, a large-scale synthetic dataset of spoken multi-party conversations with diverse assistant roles. Experiments on real-world meeting data and RolePlayConv show improved turn-taking precision by over 40% and recall by more than 70%, while substantially reducing false-positive interruptions compared to non-role-conditioned baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ModeratorLM，一种基于角色扮演的语音代理，通过显式分配角色来调节多人对话中的轮换行为。系统基于流式语音大语言模型（speech LLM），并引入链式推理增强变体。构建了合成多人在线对话数据集 RolePlayConv。实验显示轮换精度提升超过 40%，召回率提升超过 70%，同时显著减少误报打断。
Motivation: 多人对话中轮换（turn-taking）在动态竞争和不同用户期望下仍是一个基本挑战，现有语音代理难以处理。
Method: 提出 ModeratorLM，让语音代理根据明确分配的角色（如主持人、参与者）条件化轮换行为；采用流式分块（chunk-wise streaming）方式工作；引入推理增强变体，利用链式推理（chain-of-thought）分析对话上下文与角色；并构建大规模合成数据集 RolePlayConv。
Result: 在真实会议数据和 RolePlayConv 上，轮换精确度提高超过 40%，召回率提高超过 70%，误报打断显著少于未使用角色条件化的基线。
Conclusion: 通过角色条件化可以显著改善多人语音代理的轮换表现，减少不自然的打断，增强对话流畅性。

papers.title: Learning What to Remember: A Cognitively Grounded Multi-Factor Value Model for Agentic Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-running LLM agents accumulate interaction histories far larger than any context window, forcing a standing decision: what to encode deeply, what to forget, and what to retrieve under a fixed memory budget. Production systems answer with semantic similarity or recency -- both mis-specified for the forgetting decision, which is made at consolidation time before the future query is known. We propose a multi-factor memory value function V(m)=\sum_i w_i f_i(m) over seven interpretable factors (emotional intensity, goal relevance, value alignment, self/user relevance, task utility, reliability, and usage history) drawn from cognitive psychology, whose weights are learned from a downstream objective by a gradient-free optimiser, and whose single scalar uniformly controls encoding depth, forget risk, and retrieval rank. We make a methodological point: on LongMemEval, scoring goal relevance against the held-out evaluation question saturates gold-evidence retention at \approx 0.98 -- this measures retrieval, not forgetting. In the realistic blind regime, a learned multi-factor value retains 0.770 \pm 0.011 of gold evidence across 479 usable cases, versus 0.657 for uniform weights, 0.518 for the best single factor, and 0.368 for recency; every paired gap's 95% bootstrap CI is above zero, and a neural network over the same factors ties the linear model. The learned weights are interpretable -- reliability, emotional intensity, and self/user relevance dominate, while query-time goal similarity is correctly down-weighted for the forgetting decision. A controlled synthetic task with planted confounds confirms the learner recovers a separating weighting (1.00 retention) where uniform weighting fails (0.62). The substrate is open-source; all experiments run on a single CPU with no API calls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长时间运行LLM代理的记忆管理问题，提出一种基于认知心理学七个可解释因素（情感强度、目标相关性、价值对齐、自我/用户相关性、任务效用、可靠性、使用历史）的多因素记忆价值函数V(m)=∑w_i f_i(m)。通过无梯度优化学习权重，单个标量统一控制编码深度、遗忘风险和检索排序。实验表明，在LongMemEval的盲设定下，该方法保留0.770±0.011的黄金证据，优于均匀权重（0.657）和最近性（0.368），且学习到的权重可解释，可靠性、情感强度和自我/用户相关性占主导。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理的记忆系统依赖语义相似性或最近性来决定遗忘，但遗忘决策在合并时做出，未来查询未知，导致这些启发式方法不适用于遗忘任务。
Method: 提出一个线性可加的记忆价值函数，包含七个从认知心理学中提取的可解释因素，权重通过无梯度优化从下游目标学习，该函数同时用于编码深度、遗忘风险和检索排序。
Result: 在LongMemEval上，盲设定下多因素价值保留0.770±0.011的黄金证据（479个案例），高于均匀权重（0.657）、最佳单因素（0.518）和最近性（0.368）；受控合成任务中，学习者恢复分离权重（保留1.00）而均匀权重仅0.62。
Conclusion: 学习到的多因素记忆价值函数在遗忘决策上优于单一启发式，且权重可解释，表明可靠性、情感强度和自我/用户相关性对遗忘影响最大，而查询时的目标相关性应被降权。

summary_sections.result: 在LongMemEval上，盲设定下多因素价值保留0.770±0.011的黄金证据（479个案例），高于均匀权重（0.657）、最佳单因素（0.518）和最近性（0.368）；受控合成任务中，学习者恢复分离权重（保留1.00）而均匀权重仅0.62。
summary_sections.conclusion: 学习到的多因素记忆价值函数在遗忘决策上优于单一启发式，且权重可解释，表明可靠性、情感强度和自我/用户相关性对遗忘影响最大，而查询时的目标相关性应被降权。

papers.title: PolicyGuard: Towards Test-time and Step-level Adversary (Backdoor) Defense for Reinforcement Learning Agent
papers.abstract_en: While real-world applications of reinforcement learning (RL) are becoming increasingly popular, the security of RL systems deserve more attention and exploration. In particular, recent work has revealed that RL agents are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where a victim agent behaves normally under standard conditions but executes malicious actions when a specific trigger is activated. Existing backdoor defenses for RL either require access to the agent's internal parameters, operate only at the model or trajectory level, or are limited to specific attack types. To ensure the security of RL agents, we propose \texttt{PolicyGuard}, a \textit{test-time step-level} backdoor defense which leverages Gaussian Process (GP) posterior variance and adapts pseudo trajectories to enable uncertainty computation for individual time step. Besides, we also provide theoretical foundations to explain the efficacy of GP posterior variance. Extensive experiments across seven RL games demonstrate that PolicyGuard achieves state-of-the-art detection performance in most cases, with average AUROC of 0.856 for perturbation-based attacks and 0.859 for adversary-agent attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PolicyGuard，一种测试时步级别的后门防御方法，利用高斯过程后验方差和自适应伪轨迹计算单个时间步的不确定性，以检测强化学习智能体是否被后门攻击。实验在七个RL游戏上取得平均AUROC 0.856（扰动攻击）和0.859（对抗智能体攻击），达到最先进检测性能。
Motivation: 现有后门防御方法要么需要访问智能体内部参数，要么仅作用于模型或轨迹级别，或局限于特定攻击类型，缺乏测试时步级别的通用防御。
Method: 提出PolicyGuard，在测试时步级别利用高斯过程后验方差，并通过自适应伪轨迹使得每个时间步的不确定性可计算，从而实现后门检测。
Result: 在七个RL游戏上，PolicyGuard在大多数情况下达到最先进检测性能，扰动攻击平均AUROC 0.856，对抗智能体攻击平均AUROC 0.859。
Conclusion: 该方法在测试时步级别有效防御后门攻击，并提供了高斯过程后验方差有效性的理论基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Convergence Rates for Neural-Network Estimation with Current-Status Data
papers.abstract_en: Current-status data arise when an event time is observed only through an indicator of whether it occurred before an examination time. This paper studies a nonparametric neural-network sieve maximum likelihood estimator of the conditional cumulative distribution function of the event time. Under Hölder smoothness assumptions, we establish an explicit convergence rate by combining approximation theory for rectified linear unit neural networks with empirical-process arguments. This result provides theoretical support for neural-network estimation and subsequent inference under current-status observation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在当前状态数据（current-status data）下，使用神经网络筛极大似然估计事件时间条件累积分布函数的收敛速率。基于ReLU神经网络的逼近理论与经验过程论证，在Hölder光滑性假设下建立了显式收敛速率，为神经网络估计和后续推断提供了理论支持。
Motivation: 当前状态数据中事件时间仅通过检查时间前的指示变量观测，传统非参数方法收敛速率不明确，需要为神经网络估计提供理论保证。
Method: 提出非参数神经网络筛极大似然估计方法，结合ReLU神经网络逼近理论与经验过程理论推导收敛速率。
Result: 在Hölder光滑性假设下建立了神经网络的显式收敛速率。
Conclusion: 该结果从理论上支持了当前状态数据下神经网络的估计与推断。

papers.title: Collaborative Human-Agent Protocol (CHAP)
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are moving from response generation into operational roles. They plan across steps, call tools, request human input, coordinate with other agents, and increasingly carry responsibility for work that affects customers, claims, code, contracts, and clinical decisions. Production deployments are no longer one human supervising one model. They are multi-human, multi-agent collaborations that cross teams, time zones, and trust boundaries. The technical surface for this collaboration remains weakly specified. When an agent drafts a response and a human edits it before it ships, the moment of human judgement is the most valuable signal in the system. In current practice it is recorded, if at all, in application code, chat threads, ticket comments, and tribal memory. Two protocol standards address adjacent concerns: MCP standardises agent access to tools and data, and A2A standardises agent-to-agent interoperability. Neither defines the shared workspace in which humans and agents perform accountable work together. This paper presents CHAP, the Collaborative Human-Agent Protocol. Under CHAP, the override that used to vanish into a chat thread becomes a structured event carrying a diff, a rationale, and a content hash. The handoff between shifts becomes a portable envelope rather than a pinned message. The human approval of an agent's draft becomes a non-repudiable signed decision that can be replayed years later. The protocol achieves this through a small Core (workspaces, participants, tasks, artefacts, and an append-only evidence log) together with composable profiles that add review, modes, routing, deliberation, handoff, identity, signatures, and transparency-backed audit as deployments require them. Specification, reference implementation, conformance suite, and worked examples are available at: https://github.com/BrightbeamAI/chap
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出协作人机协议（CHAP），用于多人类与多代理在生产环境中的结构化协作。该协议通过核心组件（工作区、参与者、任务、工件、仅追加的证据日志）和可组合的配置文件（审阅、模式、路由、审议、移交、身份、签名、审计），将人类编辑、审批、移交等操作标准化为不可否认的结构化事件，并附带差异、理由和内容哈希。协议已在GitHub上提供规范、参考实现、一致性测试套件和示例。
Motivation: 当前人类与AI代理的协作缺乏标准化协议，人类判断这一关键信号往往散落在应用代码、聊天记录和口头记忆中，难以审计和复现。现有MCP和A2A协议分别解决了工具访问和代理间互操作，但没有定义人类与代理共同工作的可问责共享空间。
Method: CHAP定义了一个核心数据结构（工作区、参与者、任务、工件）和仅追加的证据日志，并在此基础上提供可组合的配置文件，包括审阅、模式切换、路由、审议、移交、身份验证、数字签名和透明度审计，使得人类对代理输出的覆盖、轮班交接和审批成为结构化的可追溯事件。
Result: 协议已公开规范、参考实现、一致性测试套件和示例，并通过GitHub仓库提供。
Conclusion: CHAP填补了多人类多代理协作中可问责共享工作区的标准空白，将人类判断从隐式信息转变为可审计的结构化证据，适用于生产环境中跨团队、时区和信任边界的协作场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Minibatch Selection for Language Models via Partition Matroid Constrained Gradient Matching
papers.abstract_en: Training large language models (LLMs) on heterogeneous data requires selecting minibatches that balance convergence speed with coverage across domains. Existing methods either select samples independently within each domain or rely on computationally expensive proxy models to learn continuous domain weights. We propose PartitionSel, a cross-domain minibatch selection approach that maximizes a validation-guided gradient-matching utility under per-domain budgets encoded as a partition-matroid constraint. By coupling the per-domain budgets through a single utility, PartitionSel is designed to reduce redundancy in selections across domains. The proposed objective is weakly submodular and admits an orthogonal matching pursuit algorithm with provable approximation guarantees. Empirically, we evaluate PartitionSel for minibatch selection during the fine-tuning of Qwen2.5 and Llama-3 on MetaMathQA and Mol-Instructions. PartitionSel achieves robust gains over per-domain and domain-agnostic baselines on both benchmarks. It also reduces the number of conflicting gradient pairs within each batch, indicating that the cross-domain coupling translates into more compatible training updates.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026), Seoul, South Korea, PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PartitionSel，一种基于分区拟阵约束的跨域小批次选择方法，通过在微调时最大化验证集引导的梯度匹配效用来平衡域覆盖与收敛速度。在 Qwen2.5 和 Llama-3 上使用 MetaMathQA 和 Mol-Instructions 进行实验，该方法相比各域独立采样和域无关基线取得了稳健的改进，并减少了批次内的梯度冲突。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型训练中小批次选择方法要么在各域独立采样，导致域间冗余；要么依赖昂贵代理模型学习连续域权重，计算成本高。需要一种高效且能显式考虑域间耦合的方法。
Method: 提出 PartitionSel，将每个域的采样预算编码为分区拟阵约束，并最大化一个验证引导的梯度匹配效用函数。该目标是弱子模函数，可通过正交匹配追踪算法求解，具有近似保证。
Result: 在 MetaMathQA 和 Mol-Instructions 上微调 Qwen2.5 和 Llama-3，PartitionSel 在验证集性能上超过各域独立和域无关基线，并且每个批次内的冲突梯度对数量更少。
Conclusion: 通过分区拟阵约束实现的跨域耦合能够使梯度更新更兼容，从而提升大语言模型微调的效率和泛化性。

papers.title: Video-Based Prediction of In-Flight Particle Characteristics in Atmospheric Plasma Spraying
papers.abstract_en: Atmospheric plasma spraying (APS) is a widely used coating process in which in-flight particle temperature and velocity strongly influence coating quality. However, these particle characteristics are difficult to monitor continuously during operation, motivating the development of non-invasive data-driven diagnostic methods. In this work, we investigate the predictive potential of high-speed video observations of the plasma plume for estimating in-flight particle characteristics in APS. We introduce three different video-derived feature representations and evaluate them using Tabular Prior-Data Fitted Networks (TabPFN), convolutional neural networks (CNN), and classical regression baselines including Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, Support Vector Regression, and XGBoost. Experiments are conducted using grouped leave-one-out cross-validation on 126 labeled pre- and post-spray video recordings from 63 APS spray runs. Across the engineered feature experiments, TabPFN achieves the most consistent performance for temperature prediction, reaching R2 = 0.86 using the combined feature representation. CNN models particularly perform stronger for velocity prediction, achieving R2 of 0.81. In addition, we evaluate models operating directly on raw video frames using pretrained CNNs and find that the highest performance is achieved by a pretrained CNN with a regression head with R2 of 0.90 and 0.82 for temperature and velocity, respectively. The results demonstrate that video-derived plume information provides a promising and scalable foundation for non-invasive APS diagnostics and real-time process monitoring.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECML PKDD 2026 (Applied Data Science Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用大气等离子喷涂（APS）过程中高速视频观测的等离子体羽流，基于视频衍生特征表示和原始视频帧，预测飞行粒子温度和速度。采用TabPFN、CNN以及随机森林等经典回归模型，在63次喷涂运行的126段标注视频上进行评估。TabPFN在温度预测上最佳（R²=0.86），CNN在速度预测上最佳（R²=0.81），而基于原始视频帧的预训练CNN达到温度R²=0.90、速度R²=0.82。结果表明视频衍生信息可用于非侵入式APS诊断和实时监测。
Motivation: APS中飞行粒子温度和速度强烈影响涂层质量，但难以持续在线监测，亟需非侵入式数据驱动诊断方法。
Method: 从高速摄像机记录的等离子体羽流视频中提取三种视频衍生特征表示，并采用TabPFN、CNN以及随机森林等经典回归模型进行预测；同时评估直接使用原始视频帧的预训练CNN模型。
Result: TabPFN使用组合特征表示时温度预测R²=0.86；CNN在速度预测上达到R²=0.81；原始视频帧的预训练CNN实现温度R²=0.90、速度R²=0.82。
Conclusion: 视频衍生羽流信息为APS非侵入诊断和实时过程监控提供了有前景且可扩展的基础。

papers.title: Where Should Knowledge Enter? A Layered Framework for Knowledge Infusion in Multimodal Iterative Generative Model
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal generative models produce fluent outputs but remain unreliable when generation must respect structured, domain-specific, or safety-critical knowledge. Existing methods incorporate knowledge through mechanisms such as prompt augmentation, guidance, latent editing, or fine-tuning, yet they are typically categorized by technique rather than by the component of the generative process they modify. We argue that knowledge infusion in iterative generative models is fundamentally anintervention-layer problem. Since thegenerative process unfolds as a trajectory of internal states, knowledge can act on four structurally distinct components of this process: the input/output boundary, the transition function, the intermediate state, and the model parameters. This maps to four intervention layers: surface, trajectory, latent, and parametric infusion. We instantiate the framework in diffusion models, map representative methods to all four layers, and derive design principles for multi-layer composition. In a controlled safety-alignment experiment using a multimodal knowledge graph with two diffusion backbones, we implement three of the four layers cumulatively, surface (input-side and output-side) and trajectory--latent (mid-generation). We show empirically that each additional layer addresses failure classes that prior layers cannot reach, reducing knowledge-violating outputs by 70.97% compared to vanilla generation and empirically confirming the framework's complementarity prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态迭代生成模型（如扩散模型）中的知识注入问题，提出一个四层干预框架：表面层、轨迹层、潜在层和参数层，分别作用于输入/输出边界、转移函数、中间状态和模型参数。在安全对齐实验中，通过多模态知识图谱和两种扩散模型骨干，累积实施表面层、轨迹层和潜在层，相比原始生成减少了70.97%的知识违背输出。
Motivation: 现有知识注入方法按技术分类，缺乏对生成过程内部组件的系统性干预视角，导致无法覆盖所有失败模式。
Method: 提出基于干预层的知识注入框架，将知识作用点映射为四个结构不同的层：表面层（输入/输出边界）、轨迹层（转移函数）、潜在层（中间状态）和参数层（模型参数）。在扩散模型中实例化，并推导多层组合的设计原则。
Result: 在安全对齐实验中，累积使用表面层、轨迹层和潜在层，知识违背输出减少70.97%，证实各层互补性。
Conclusion: 该框架为多模态生成模型的知识注入提供了结构化视角，分层干预可互补地解决不同失败模式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OPRD: On-Policy Representation Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises the student exclusively in the output space by matching next-token distributions. This paradigm suffers from two limitations: (i) a high-variance gradient estimator whose signal-to-noise ratio collapses as the student approaches the teacher, and (ii) an LM-head information bottleneck that discards the teacher's intermediate hidden states. We propose On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD), the first method to lift on-policy distillation into the hidden-state space. OPRD aligns student and teacher representations across selected layers on the same on-policy rollouts, providing dense, deterministic, per-layer supervision while bypassing the LM head entirely. Theoretically, OPRD provides a deterministic per-sample gradient, removing the token-level estimation variance that plagues OPD, and exposes structural information that any output-space objective necessarily discards. Empirically, OPRD closes the student-teacher gap on competition mathematics benchmarks (AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and AIMO), where every output-space baseline plateaus below the teacher, while training 1.44x faster and using up to 54% less memory. We further extend OPRD to the cross-architecture setting via OPRD-Bridge. By exploiting the observation that heterogeneous models share a low-rank representational structure, we construct a frozen projector pair that aligns representations across arbitrary depth and width mismatches, shifting the alignment from the output space (which depends on a shared vocabulary) to the representation space. We validate OPRD-Bridge on both cross-architecture (Qwen3-4B -> Qwen3-1.7B-Base) and cross-tokenizer (Phi-4-mini-reasoning -> Qwen3-1.7B-Base) settings, demonstrating successful knowledge transfer even when the vocabulary-based alignment channel is unavailable. Code: https://github.com/ShenzhiYang2000/OPRD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在线策略表示蒸馏 (OPRD)，将蒸馏从输出空间扩展到隐藏状态空间，通过在相同在线策略 rollout 上对齐学生和教师的逐层表示，提供密集、确定性的逐层监督，避免了输出空间蒸馏的高方差梯度估计器和 LM 头信息瓶颈。在竞赛数学基准 (AIME 2024, AIME 2025, AIMO) 上，OPRD 缩小了师生差距，训练速度提升 1.44 倍，内存节省 54%。此外，通过 OPRD-Bridge 扩展到跨架构和跨 tokenizer 设置。
Motivation: 现有在线策略蒸馏 (OPD) 存在两个局限：高方差梯度估计器导致学生接近教师时信噪比下降，以及 LM 头信息瓶颈丢弃教师的中间隐藏状态。
Method: 提出 OPRD，在隐藏状态空间对齐学生和教师同一在线策略 rollout 的表示，提供密集的逐层确定性监督，完全绕过 LM 头。理论分析表明 OPRD 提供确定性的每样本梯度，消除了 OPD 的 token 级估计方差，并暴露了输出空间目标必然丢弃的结构信息。
Result: 在竞赛数学基准 (AIME 2024, AIME 2025, AIMO) 上，OPRD 能缩小师生差距，而所有输出空间基线都停滞在教师以下；同时训练速度快 1.44 倍，内存节省 54%。
Conclusion: OPRD 有效克服了输出空间蒸馏的局限性，并可通过 OPRD-Bridge 扩展到跨架构和跨 tokenizer 场景，实现无需共享词汇的表示空间对齐。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Four-Valued Normative Intermediate Representation for ASP-Oriented Compliance Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Technical-standard compliance reasoning may involve incomplete evidence, inconsistent observations, exceptions, and derived normative outputs. This paper presents \textsc{Monir}, a four-valued normative intermediate representation for ASP-oriented compliance workflows. \textsc{Monir} separates factual support from normative outputs: facts are represented by positive and negative support bits, while deontic labels are rule-generated output constructors interpreted by aggregation policies. Its core semantics is a staged transition system over support configurations. We define the language, rule-state interface, diagnostics, and policy-parametric reporting; characterize admissible staged evaluation by a dependency graph; prove deterministic polynomial-time evaluation for fixed evidence; and give NP/coNP upper bounds, with matching hardness for representative completion-based verdict queries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Monir，一种面向回答集编程（ASP）合规工作流的四值规范中间表示。Monir将事实支持与规范输出分离，事实用正负支持位表示，义务标签通过聚合策略解释。其核心语义是基于支持配置的分阶段转换系统，并给出了确定性多项式时间评估证明及NP/coNP上界。
Motivation: 技术标准合规推理中常涉及不完整证据、不一致观测、异常及衍生规范输出，现有表示方法难以统一处理这些问题。
Method: 提出Monir语言，定义规则-状态接口、诊断及策略参数化报告，使用依赖图刻画可容许的分阶段评估，并建立四值逻辑语义。
Result: 对于固定证据，证明确定性多项式时间评估；给出NP/coNP上界，并证明代表性完成式判决查询的匹配难度。
Conclusion: Monir为ASP合规推理提供了分离事实与规范的中间表示，具有良好计算复杂度边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Audio Deepfake Detection with Half-Truth Localisation Using Cross-Attentive Feature Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Audio deepfake detection is well-studied as a binary problem, but partially manipulated speech, where a short synthesised segment is spliced into an otherwise genuine utterance, poses a harder and more realistic threat. Detecting such half-truth audio requires not only distinguishing it from real and fully fake speech, but also localising where the manipulation occurs. We present CAFNet, a 576k-parameter architecture that addresses both tasks jointly: it performs ternary classification (real, fully-fake, or half-truth) and regresses the temporal boundaries of the synthesised region in a single forward pass. CAFNet fuses Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficient (MFCC), Linear-Frequency Cepstral Coefficient (LFCC), and Chroma Short-Time Fourier Transform (Chroma-STFT) features through parallel depthwise-separable convolution branches with cross-attention, followed by a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) regression head for boundary prediction. On the combined Multi-Lingual Audio Deepfake Detection Corpus (MLADDC) T2+T3 test set, CAFNet achieves 92.71% accuracy and macro Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 0.9910, with boundary localisation Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.075s and a median error of 0.052s. On binary detection, it achieves 96.76% accuracy and 3.20% Equal Error Rate (EER), outperforming fine-tuned XLS-R 300M (78.31%) and AST 87M (93.03%) at over 500 times fewer parameters. A cross-dataset study further shows that standard fine-tuning collapses cross-domain representations even under reduced backbone learning rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAFNet，一个576k参数的轻量级架构，用于检测和定位半真音频（部分拼接合成片段的真实语音）。它同时进行三元分类（真实、全假、半真）和操纵边界的回归。通过融合MFCC、LFCC和Chroma-STFT特征，使用并行深度可分离卷积和交叉注意力，结合BiLSTM回归头。在MLADDC T2+T3测试集上，三元分类准确率92.71%，AUC 0.9910，边界定位MAE 0.075s；二元检测准确率96.76%，EER 3.20%，参数远少于XLS-R和AST。
Motivation: 现有音频深伪检测主要针对全假或真实语音的二元分类，但更现实和困难的威胁是半真音频（部分操控的语音），需要同时检测伪造并定位操纵区域。
Method: 提出CAFNet，融合MFCC、LFCC和Chroma-STFT三种特征，通过并行深度可分离卷积和交叉注意力进行特征融合，然后使用BiLSTM回归头预测操纵的时间边界，并输出三元分类结果。
Result: 在MLADDC T2+T3测试集上，三元分类准确率92.71%，AUC 0.9910，边界定位MAE 0.075s，中位误差0.052s；二元检测准确率96.76%，EER 3.20%，参数仅576k，优于XLS-R 300M和AST 87M。跨数据集实验显示标准微调会导致跨域表示崩溃。
Conclusion: CAFNet以极少参数实现半真音频检测与定位，性能优于更大模型，但跨数据集泛化仍需改进。

papers.title: GEESE: Genotype-aware End-to-End Spatio-temporal Embedding for Behavioral Phenotyping
papers.abstract_en: Behavioral phenotyping of genetic animal models currently requires labor-intensive manual feature engineering that limits reproducibility and scalability. We present GEESE, an end-to-end deep learning framework that learns behavioral representations directly from 3D pose dynamics without hand-crafted features. Using a pretrained time series foundation model, we encode movement sequences into a behavioral manifold that supports both behavior classification and genotype prediction. Evaluated across three autism-associated genetic models (CNTNAP2, CHD8, FMR1), our deep learning approach surpasses hand-crafted feature baselines in both tasks, revealing that learned representations capture genotype-specific behavioral signatures. The framework generalizes across genetic backgrounds, and an all-cohort model identifies both genetic background and genotype from movement patterns alone. We further provide HONK, an interactive intelligent tool enabling researchers without programming expertise to perform behavioral phenotyping from pose data through natural language interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GEESE，一个端到端深度学习框架，直接从 3D 姿态动力学学习行为表示，无需手工特征。在三种自闭症相关基因模型（CNTNAP2, CHD8, FMR1）上，该方法在行为分类和基因型预测任务上均优于手工特征基线，并发现学习到的表示能捕捉基因型特异的行为特征。框架还包含一个名为 HONK 的交互式工具，允许非编程研究人员通过自然语言进行行为表型分析。
Motivation: 当前遗传动物模型的行为表型分析依赖手工特征工程，可重复性和可扩展性受限，需要更自动化的端到端方法。
Method: 使用预训练的时间序列基础模型，将运动序列编码到行为流形中，支持行为分类和基因型预测。
Result: 在三个自闭症模型上，深度学习方法在行为分类和基因型预测上均超越手工特征基线，且学到的表示能区分不同基因背景。
Conclusion: GEESE 提供了一种通用、可扩展的行为表型分析框架，并降低了非专业用户的使用门槛。

papers.title: AnimeAdapter: A Modular Adapter for Appearance-Consistent Anime Character Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present a lightweight appearance adapter for Stable Diffusion that enables controllable and consistent anime character generation under diverse editing conditions. Instead of relying on large-scale vision-language models or per-subject fine-tuning, our method injects fine-grained visual features from a single reference image into the diffusion process. Based on CLIP emergent local spatialization, we develop semantic-selective local attention. To further disentangle character appearance from spatial layout, we incorporate pose-aware conditioning during adapter training. The resulting pretrained adapter remains compact, modular, and fully compatible with Stable Diffusion community workflows, while requiring no additional fine-tuning at deployment time. Furthermore, we present a high-quality anime character dataset based on curated and restructured Danbooru prompts, and evaluate our method across several practical character editing scenarios. Our code, model weights, and dataset will be publicly released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AnimeAdapter，一个轻量级外观适配器，用于Stable Diffusion，实现一致且可控的动漫角色生成。方法基于CLIP局部空间化设计语义选择性局部注意力，并引入姿态感知条件以解耦外观和空间布局。适配器无需微调即可部署，并发布了高质量动漫角色数据集。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖大规模视觉语言模型或逐对象微调，难以在多种编辑条件下生成外观一致的动漫角色。
Method: 提出语义选择性局部注意力，基于CLIP局部空间化；在适配器训练中融入姿态感知条件以解耦外观与布局；适配器为轻量模块，与Stable Diffusion社区兼容。
Result: 在多种角色编辑场景下取得一致生成效果，无需额外微调；开源代码、模型权重和数据集。
Conclusion: 该方法为动漫角色生成提供了一种紧凑、模块化的解决方案，兼容现有工作流，且无需部署时微调。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VISTA: Variance-Gated Inter-Sequence Test-Time Adaptation for Multi-Sequence MRI Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Deploying multi-sequence magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) segmentation models to new clinical environments is challenging due to variations in scanners and acquisition protocols. Although existing TTA methods handle basic per-modality shifts, they often fail under a fundamental dual-shift problem, as their adaptation signals fail to capture modality-interaction shifts that disrupt inter-sequence consistency. To address this, we propose Variance-gated Inter-Sequence Test-time Adaptation (VISTA), a source-free framework that tackles modality-interaction shifts. First, we design an Inter-Sequence Intervention Generator (ISIG) that generates a set of consistency probes by swapping low-frequency spectra and entropy-localized patches across sequences, preserving anatomical semantics while challenging inter-sequence dependencies. Second, we introduce Cross-View Disagreement-Aware Pseudo Labeling (CDPL), which establishes a voxel-wise reliability metric using cross-view disagreement variance to dynamically gate self-training and enforce interventional consistency, encouraging the network to rely on robust anatomical semantics. Extensive experiments adapting from standard adult MRI (BraTS-GLI-Pre) to African low-field (BraTS-SSA) and pediatric (BraTS-PED) cohorts show improved performance over competing methods under clinical shifts, achieving absolute Dice improvements of +1.89% (SSA) and +2.82% (PED) over the source model. The code is available at https://github.com/dzp2095/VISTA.

TL;DR: 本文提出VISTA，一种无源域的自适应框架，用于解决多序列MRI分割中因扫描仪和采集协议变化引起的模态交互漂移问题。通过设计序列间干预生成器和交叉视图不一致感知伪标签，在多个临床数据集上提升了分割性能。
Motivation: 现有测试时自适应方法处理单模态漂移有效，但无法应对多序列MRI中破坏序列间一致性的模态交互漂移问题。
Method: 提出VISTA框架，包含两个组件：1) 序列间干预生成器（ISIG），通过交换低频频谱和熵局部块生成一致性探针；2) 交叉视图不一致感知伪标签（CDPL），利用交叉视图不一致方差建立体素级可靠性指标，动态门控自训练并强制执行干预一致性。
Result: 在从标准成人MRI（BraTS-GLI-Pre）到非洲低场（BraTS-SSA）和儿童（BraTS-PED）数据集的适应实验中，Dice分别提升+1.89%和+2.82%。
Conclusion: VISTA通过显式建模模态交互漂移并利用干预一致性，有效提升了多序列MRI分割在不同临床环境下的泛化能力。

papers.title: The Impact of AI Search on the Online Content Ecosystem: Evidence from Google and Reddit
papers.abstract_en: Search engines traditionally complement online content platforms by directing users seeking information to external websites. The emergence of generative AI search tools that summarize answers directly on the results page may disrupt this relationship by making visits to source platforms optional. We study this question using Google AI Overviews and Reddit, one of the largest online discussion platforms. Our identification exploits Google's content moderation policy: Safe-for-Work (SFW) Reddit communities are indexed by Google organic search and surfaced in Google AI Overviews, while Not-Safe-for-Work (NSFW) communities, though indexed by organic search, are prohibited from being referenced in AI Overview summaries. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that AI Overviews increase engagement in SFW communities: daily comments rise by 12.0 percent and the number of commenting users by 12.4 percent relative to NSFW communities. The effects are concentrated in experience-based discussions (opinions, advice, and personal experiences) rather than fact-based information. However, the subsequent introduction of Google AI Mode, which allows users to interact conversationally with the AI summary, largely eliminates these gains in experience-based content. These results suggest that the effects of AI search depend critically on interface design and types of content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用谷歌AI概览（Google AI Overviews）和Reddit平台，通过差分方法研究生成式AI搜索工具对在线内容生态系统的影响。研究发现，AI概览增加了安全（SFW）社区的互动，但后续的AI模式（AI Mode）消除了这些增益，且效果集中在经验型内容上。
Motivation: 传统搜索引擎通过引流向内容平台提供流量，而生成式AI搜索工具直接在结果页总结答案，可能削弱用户访问源平台的意愿，威胁内容平台的生态。本文旨在量化这种影响及其机制。
Method: 利用Reddit社区的内容审核政策作为自然实验：SFW社区被AI概览引用，NSFW社区虽被索引但不被引用。采用双重差分法（DID）比较两类社区的互动变化，并结合谷歌AI模式的推出进行补充分析。
Result: AI概览使SFW社区每日评论增加12.0%，评论用户数增加12.4%；效应集中在经验型讨论（意见、建议、个人经历），而非事实型信息。但后续AI模式几乎完全消除了这些增益。
Conclusion: AI搜索对内容平台的影响取决于界面设计和内容类型，AI概览可提升社区互动，但交互式AI模式可能反噬流量增益。

papers.title: Wasserstein-Aligned Localisation for VLM-Based Distributional OOD Detection in Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot anomaly localisation via vision-language models (VLMs) offers a compelling approach for rare pathology detection, yet its performance is fundamentally limited by the absence of healthy anatomical context. We reformulate zero-shot localisation as a comparative inference problem in which anomalies are identified through structured comparison against reference distributions of normal anatomy. We introduce WALDO, a training-free framework grounded in optimal transport theory that enables comparative reasoning through: (i) entropy-weighted Sliced Wasserstein distances for anatomically-aware reference selection from DINOv2 patch distributions, (ii) Goldilocks zone sampling exploiting the non-monotonic relationship between reference similarity and localisation accuracy, and (iii) self-consistency aggregation via weighted non-maximum suppression. We theoretically analyse the Goldilocks effect through distributional divergence, and show that references with moderate similarity minimize a bias-variance trade-off in comparative visual reasoning. On the NOVA brain MRI benchmark, WALDO with Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves $43.5_{\pm1.6}\%$ mAP@30 (95\% CI: [40.4, 46.7]), representing a 19\% relative improvement over zero-shot baselines. Cross-model evaluation shows consistent gains: GPT-4o achieves $32.0_{\pm6.5}\%$ and Qwen3-VL-32B achieves $32.0_{\pm6.6}\%$ mAP@30. Paired McNemar tests confirm statistical significance ($p<0.01$). Source code is available at https://github.com/bkainz/WALDO_MICCAI26_demo .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WALDO框架，利用最优传输理论实现基于视觉语言模型的零样本异常定位，通过熵权重切片Wasserstein距离、Goldilocks区域采样和自一致性聚合提升医学图像分布外检测性能。
Motivation: 零样本异常定位缺乏健康解剖结构上下文，性能受限。现有方法未充分利用正常解剖的参考分布进行对比推理。
Method: 提出WALDO框架：基于最优传输理论，包括(i)熵权重切片Wasserstein距离进行解剖感知参考选择，(ii)Goldilocks区域采样利用参考相似性与定位准确性之间的非单调关系，(iii)通过加权非极大值抑制进行自一致性聚合。
Result: 在NOVA脑MRI基准上，Qwen2.5-VL-72B实现43.5±1.6% mAP@30，较零样本基线提升19%；GPT-4o和Qwen3-VL-32B均达到约32% mAP@30。配对McNemar检验p<0.01。
Conclusion: WALDO通过分布对比推理显著提升VLM的异常定位能力，证实Goldilocks效应在视觉比较推理中优化偏置-方差权衡。

papers.title: Data-dependent Exploration for Online Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Online reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has emerged as a promising paradigm for aligning large language models (LLMs) by continuously collecting new preference feedback during training. A foundational challenge in this setting is exploration, which requires algorithms that enable the LLMs to generate informative comparisons that improve sample-efficiency in online RLHF. Existing exploration strategies often derive bonuses via on-policy expectations, which are difficult to estimate reliably from the limited historical preference data available during training; as a result, the policy can prematurely down-weight under-explored regions that may contain high-value behaviors. In this paper, we propose data-dependent exploration for preference optimization (DEPO), a simple and scalable method that leverages historical data to construct an extra uncertainty bonus for high-uncertainty regions, encouraging exploration toward potentially high-value data. Theoretically, we provide a data-dependent regret bound for the proposed algorithm, showing that it adapts to the hardness of the learning task itself and can be tighter than worst-case bounds in practice. Empirically, the proposed method consistently outperforms strong baselines across benchmarks, demonstrating improved sample efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出数据依赖探索偏好优化（DEPO），用于在线强化学习从人类反馈（RLHF）中。该方法利用历史偏好数据构建额外的不确定性奖励，鼓励策略探索高不确定性区域，从而提升样本效率。理论上给出了数据依赖的遗憾界，实验上在多个基准上优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有在线RLHF探索策略依赖on-policy期望，难以从有限历史偏好数据中可靠估计，导致策略过早放弃未充分探索但可能高价值的区域。
Method: 提出DEPO方法，通过历史数据构造不确定性奖励，叠加到偏好优化目标中，鼓励探索高不确定性区域。
Result: 理论上证明数据依赖的遗憾界可自适应任务难度，比最坏情况界更紧；实验上在多个基准上一致优于强基线，样本效率提升。
Conclusion: DEPO通过历史数据驱动探索，有效解决在线RLHF中的探索困境，提升样本效率，且理论保证实际更紧。

papers.title: GraphSVR: A Graph Convolutional Support Vector Regression Framework for Robust Spatiotemporal Air Pollution Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Urban air quality forecasting is challenging because pollutant concentrations are nonlinear, nonstationary, spatiotemporally dependent, and often affected by anomalous observations caused by traffic congestion, industrial emissions, and seasonal meteorological variability. This study proposes a Graph Convolutional Support Vector Regression (GraphSVR) framework for robust spatiotemporal forecasting of urban air pollution. The model combines graph convolutional learning to capture inter-station spatial dependence with support vector regression to model nonlinear temporal dynamics while reducing sensitivity to outlier observations. The proposed framework is evaluated using air quality records from 37 monitoring stations in Delhi and 18 stations in Mumbai, representing inland and coastal metropolitan environments in India. Forecasting performance is assessed across multiple horizons and compared with established temporal and spatiotemporal benchmarks. The results show that GraphSVR consistently improves predictive accuracy and maintains stable performance across seasons and outlier-prone pollution episodes. Statistical test further confirms the reliability of the proposed approach across the datasets. Furthermore, the conformal prediction approach is integrated with GraphSVR to generate calibrated prediction intervals, enhancing its practical value for uncertainty-aware air quality monitoring and public health decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GraphSVR框架，结合图卷积学习与支持向量回归，用于城市空气污染时空预测。在德里和孟买的监测站数据上，该框架在多个预测时域上优于基线方法，并集成分位数回归生成校准的预测区间。
Motivation: 城市空气质量预测受非线性、非平稳、时空依赖及异常观测影响，现有方法对异常点敏感，亟需鲁棒的时空预测模型。
Method: 将图卷积网络用于捕捉站点间空间依赖，支持向量回归用于建模非线性时序动态并降低异常值敏感性，最后集成共形预测生成概率区间。
Result: 在印度德里（37站）和孟买（18站）的空气质量数据上，GraphSVR在多个预测时域上持续提升精度，且季节和异常污染事件下性能稳定。统计检验证实可靠性。
Conclusion: 该框架为不确定性感知的空气质量监测和公共健康决策提供了实用工具。

papers.title: Verifiable Counterfactual Supervision for Process Reward Models
papers.abstract_en: Process reward models (PRMs) require supervision that identifies not only whether a reasoning trajectory is correct, but also where the reasoning process first becomes unsupported by its prefix. We frame this requirement as verifiable counterfactual process supervision with paired correct and erroneous trajectories in which the first invalid transition is known, the error mechanism is controlled, and the downstream continuation remains coherent under the corrupted state. Starting from a verified symbolic reasoning chain, our method injects a template-aware error at a selected intermediate step, recomputes all subsequent steps under the corrupted state, and verifies that the injected step is not derivable from its original prefix. The resulting trajectories provide prefix-valid first-error annotations and are translated into aligned natural-language processes for PRM training and evaluation. Experiments show that the synthesized data improve Best-of-8 reranking on logical reasoning benchmarks and show preliminary transfer to mathematical process evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可验证的反事实监督方法用于过程奖励模型（PRM），通过构造带标注的配对正确/错误推理轨迹，在逻辑推理基准上提升Best-of-8重排序性能，并初步迁移至数学过程评估。
Motivation: 过程奖励模型需要识别推理轨迹中第一个无效步骤，但现有监督数据缺乏精确的错误位置和可控错误机制。
Method: 从已验证的符号推理链出发，在选定中间步骤注入模板感知错误，在错误状态下重新计算后续步骤，并验证注入步骤无法从原始前缀推导，得到前缀有效的一错误标注轨迹，再转换为对齐的自然语言过程。
Result: 合成数据在逻辑推理基准上提升Best-of-8重排序性能，并初步展现向数学过程评估的迁移能力。
Conclusion: 可验证反事实监督能够为过程奖励模型提供高质量监督信号，且能泛化到数学领域。

papers.title: InfiltrNet: Dual-Branch CNN-Transformer Architecture for Brain Tumor Infiltration Risk Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Gliomas are aggressive brain tumors that infiltrate surrounding tissue beyond the visible tumor margins observed on Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI). Predicting the spatial extent of this infiltration is essential for surgical planning and radiation therapy, yet existing deep learning approaches focus on segmenting the visible tumor rather than estimating infiltration risk in the surrounding tissue. This paper presents InfiltrNet, a novel dual-branch architecture that combines a convolutional neural network (CNN) encoder with a Swin Transformer encoder through cross-attention fusion modules to predict three-zone infiltration risk maps from multimodal MRI. A label generation strategy based on distance transforms is proposed to derive reproducible infiltration risk zones from standard Brain Tumor Segmentation (BraTS) annotations. InfiltrNet is trained with a combined Dice-CrossEntropy and boundary-aware loss augmented by auxiliary supervision heads at intermediate decoder levels. Extensive experiments on BraTS 2020 and BraTS 2025 demonstrate that InfiltrNet outperforms five established baselines. Explainability analysis using GradCAM++ and Occlusion sensitivity confirms that the model attends to clinically relevant peritumoral regions.

papers.title: When Embedding-Based Defenses Fail: Rethinking Safety in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-powered multi-agent systems (MAS) enable agents to communicate and share information, achieving strong performance on complex tasks. However, this communication also creates an attack surface where malicious agents can propagate misinformation and manipulate group decisions, undermining MAS safety. Existing embedding-based defenses aim to detect and prune suspicious agents, but their effectiveness depends on a clear separation between the text embeddings of malicious and benign messages. Attackers can circumvent such defenses by crafting messages whose embeddings lie close to benign ones. We analyze this failure mode theoretically and validate it empirically with three attacks, Slow Drift, Benign Wrapper, and Chaos Seeding. Our analysis further reveals a fundamental limitation of embedding-based defenses: because they rely solely on the text embeddings, they ignore token-level confidence signals such as logits, which can remain informative when embeddings are not distinguishable under attack. We propose using confidence scores to prune or down-weight messages during MAS communication. Experiments show improved robustness across models, datasets, and communication topologies. Moreover, we find that the effectiveness of confidence signals decays over communication rounds, highlighting the importance of early intervention. This insights can inform and inspire future work on MAS attacks and defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了LLM多智能体系统中基于嵌入的防御在攻击下的失效机理，提出了利用置信度分数进行剪枝或降权的新防御方法。
Motivation: 现有基于嵌入的防御依赖恶意与良性消息的文本嵌入分离，攻击者可通过构造嵌入接近良性消息的恶意消息来绕过防御，存在根本性局限。
Method: 从理论上分析嵌入防御的失效原因，提出利用置信度（如logits）作为信号，在MAS通信中剪枝或降权可疑消息，并实验验证其鲁棒性。
Result: 实验表明，所提方法在多个模型、数据集和通信拓扑上提升了鲁棒性，但发现置信度信号的效果随通信轮次衰减，早期干预至关重要。
Conclusion: 嵌入防御存在根本局限，置信度信号可作为补充但需在早期应用；本文为MAS攻击与防御未来工作提供洞见。
