papers.title: Optimal Spatio-Temporal Decoupling for Bayesian Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Online conformal prediction must balance fast adaptation to distribution shift against stable coverage: feedback-driven methods react quickly but become volatile, while strongly discounted Bayesian methods lag and inflate intervals at tight coverage. We introduce \textbf{State-Adaptive Bayesian Conformal Prediction (SA-BCP)}, which forms the predictive quantile as a gated convex combination of long-term temporal inertia and local spatial evidence from a kernel density estimate, controlled by a single interpretable evidence threshold $K$. We establish three results: (i) asymptotic marginal validity of the resulting intervals up to a gate-controlled bias that vanishes as spatial evidence accumulates (exact under recurrent states); (ii) a closed-form expression for the MSE-optimal threshold, $K^*_{\mathrm{MSE}}=α(1-α)/M^{\mathcal{T}}$, trading the coverage-indicator (Bernoulli) variance against the temporal structural bias $M^{\mathcal{T}}$; and (iii) a rolling-origin procedure for selecting $K$ online -- consistent under stationarity, with $O(\sqrt{T\log N})$ regret against the best fixed $K$ and, for a segmented variant, a sublinear dynamic-regret bound under sublinearly many ($B_T=o(T)$) threshold shifts. Across four financial-volatility and weather datasets, three target coverage levels, and eight baselines, SA-BCP attains at-or-above-nominal coverage in most settings while producing substantially sharper intervals -- up to roughly $3\times$ lower Winkler score than discounted Bayesian CP at the tightest coverage -- and a coverage-matched audit confirms these efficiency gains are not an artifact of under-coverage. We disclose our principal limitation: a volatility-specialized CF-GARCH competitor remains more efficient on its home volatility-base series, though it does not transfer across domains.

papers.title: Rewarding the Scientific Process: Process-Level Reward Modeling for Agentic Data Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Process Reward Models (PRMs) have achieved remarkable success in augmenting the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) within static domains such as mathematics. However, their potential in dynamic data analysis tasks remains underexplored. In this work, we first present a empirical study revealing that general-domain PRMs struggle to supervise data analysis agents. Specifically, they fail to detect silent errors, logical flaws that yield incorrect results without triggering interpreter exceptions, and erroneously penalize exploratory actions, mistaking necessary trial-and-error exploration for grounding failures. To bridge this gap, we introduce DataPRM, a novel environment-aware generative process reward model that (1) can serve as an active verifier, autonomously interacting with the environment to probe intermediate execution states and uncover silent errors, and (2) employs a reflection-aware ternary reward strategy that distinguishes between correctable grounding errors and irrecoverable mistakes. We design a scalable pipeline to construct over 8K high-quality training instances for DataPRM via diversity-driven trajectory generation and knowledge-augmented step-level annotation. Experimental results demonstrate that DataPRM improves downstream policy LLMs by 7.21% on ScienceAgentBench and 11.28% on DABStep using Best-of-N inference. Notably, with only 4B parameters, DataPRM outperforms strong baselines, and exhibits robust generalizability across diverse Test-Time Scaling strategies. Furthermore, integrating DataPRM into Reinforcement Learning yields substantial gains over outcome-reward baselines, achieving 78.73% on DABench and 64.84% on TableBench, validating the effectiveness of process reward supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/zjunlp/DataMind.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对过程奖励模型（PRM）在动态数据分析任务中的不足，提出环境感知的生成式过程奖励模型DataPRM，可自主与环境交互以检测静默错误，并采用反思感知的三元奖励策略区分可修正与不可逆错误。在ScienceAgentBench和DABStep等基准上，DataPRM显著提升了策略LLM的性能，且仅4B参数即可超越强基线。
Motivation: 通用领域PRM在数据分析代理任务中表现不佳，无法检测静默错误（逻辑错误导致错误结果但未触发异常）且错误惩罚探索性行为，亟需适用于动态环境的PRM。
Method: 提出DataPRM，一种环境感知的生成式过程奖励模型：(1)作为主动验证器与执行环境交互以探测中间状态并发现静默错误；(2)采用反思感知的三元奖励策略区分可修正的接地错误与不可逆错误。通过多样性驱动的轨迹生成和知识增强的步骤级标注构建8K+训练实例。
Result: DataPRM在ScienceAgentBench上提升下游策略LLM 7.21%，在DABStep上提升11.28%（Best-of-N推理）。4B参数模型优于强基线，且在不同测试时扩展策略下具有鲁棒泛化能力。整合DataPRM到强化学习后，在DABench和TableBench上分别达到78.73%和64.84%。
Conclusion: 过程级奖励监督在数据分析任务中有效，DataPRM通过环境感知和反思性奖励设计克服了通用PRM的局限，验证了过程奖励模型在动态环境中的潜力。

papers.title: When Safe Concepts Become Unsafe: Multi-Concept Compositional Vulnerabilities in Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) models are increasingly optimized for following user instructions faithfully. However, we find that this capability introduces a safety vulnerability we call Multi-Concept Compositional Unsafety (MCCU). MCCU occurs when multiple individually safe concepts, if combined in a single generation request, lead to harmful or sensitive visual outputs. Unlike prior jailbreak settings, MCCU does not rely on adversarial prompts, model access, or explicitly disallowed content. Instead, the risk emerges from how the model composes multiple safe visual concepts into a single scene. To systematically measure this threat, we build TwoHamsters, a large-scale evaluation framework consisting of 20k prompts, 51 curated concept pairs, and six risk categories. We evaluate 13 T2I models under a black-box setting. Our results show a clear conflict between instruction-following and safety: models that follow prompts more faithfully tend to produce more MCCU failures. For example, FLUX.1 achieves a 99.35% Unsafe Alignment Rate while only reaching a 1.57% MCCU Defense Rate. We further evaluate three representative defenses, including safety filtering, MCCU-specific detector fine-tuning, and concept erasure, all of which fail against unseen concept combinations. Our findings suggest that compositional reasoning in T2I models creates an attack surface that is not captured by existing safety mechanisms. We anticipate the release of TwoHamsters will catalyze community development of advanced generative defense mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现文本到图像模型在组合多个独立安全的概念时可能产生有害输出，称之为多概念组合不安全（MCCU）。作者构建了包含2万条提示、51个概念对和6个风险类别的大规模评估框架TwoHamsters，在黑盒设置下评估13个模型，发现指令遵循与安全性之间存在明显冲突：指令遵循越好的模型MCCU缺陷越多。现有防御（安全过滤、MCCU专用检测微调、概念擦除）均无法防御未见过的概念组合。
Motivation: 现有安全机制仅检查单个概念是否违规，忽视了多个安全概念组合后可能产生有害视觉输出的风险。随着模型指令遵循能力增强，这种组合不安全问题变得更加突出。
Method: 建立TwoHamsters评估框架，包含20k条提示、51个精心设计的概念对和6个风险类别；在黑盒设置下测试13个文本到图像模型，并评估三种代表性防御（安全过滤、MCCU检测微调、概念擦除）的效果。
Result: FLUX.1模型达到99.35%的不安全对齐率，而MCCU防御率仅为1.57%；指令遵循度与MCCU失败率正相关；所有现有防御均无法防御未见过的概念组合。
Conclusion: 文本到图像模型的组合推理能力创造了一个现有安全机制无法覆盖的攻击面。作者希望TwoHamsters的发布能推动社区开发更先进的生成式防御机制。

papers.title: Autogenesis: A Self-Evolving Agent Protocol
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in LLM based agent systems have shown promise in tackling complex, long horizon tasks. However, existing agent protocols (e.g., A2A and MCP) under specify cross entity lifecycle and context management, version tracking, and evolution safe update interfaces, which encourages monolithic compositions and brittle glue code. We introduce Autogenesis Protocol (AGP), a self evolution protocol that decouples what evolves from how evolution occurs. Its Resource Substrate Protocol Layer (RSPL) models prompts, agents, tools, environments, and memory as protocol registered resources with explicit state, lifecycle, and versioned interfaces. Its Self Evolution Protocol Layer (SEPL) specifies a closed loop operator interface for proposing, assessing, and committing improvements with auditable lineage and rollback. Building on AGP, we present Autogenesis System (AGS), a self-evolving multi-agent system that dynamically instantiates, retrieves, and refines protocol-registered resources during execution. We evaluate AGS on multiple challenging benchmarks that require long horizon planning and tool use across heterogeneous resources. The results demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines, supporting the effectiveness of agent resource management and closed loop self evolution. The code is available at https://github.com/DVampire/Autogenesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Autogenesis Protocol (AGP)，一个自我进化协议，将“进化什么”与“如何进化”解耦。其资源子层协议(RSPL)将prompts、agents、tools、environments和memory建模为具有显式状态、生命周期和版本化接口的协议注册资源。自我进化协议层(SEPL)指定了一个闭环操作符接口用于提议、评估和提交改进，具有可审计的谱系和回滚。基于AGP，构建了Autogenesis System (AGS)，一个自我进化的多智能体系统，在执行过程中动态实例化、检索和优化协议注册资源。在多个需要长期规划和跨异构资源使用工具的任务上进行了评估。
Motivation: 现有的基于LLM的智能体协议(如A2A和MCP)在跨实体生命周期和上下文管理、版本跟踪以及进化安全更新接口方面规定不足，鼓励了单体组合和脆弱的胶水代码。
Method: 提出Autogenesis Protocol (AGP)，包含两个层次：资源子协议层(RSPL)和自我进化协议层(SEPL)。RSPL将智能体组件建模为协议注册资源，具有状态、生命周期和版本接口。SEPL定义闭环操作符接口用于提议、评估和提交改进，并支持审计和回滚。基于AGP构建了Autogenesis System (AGS)，实现自我进化的多智能体系统。

papers.title: Attention at Rest Stays at Rest: Breaking Visual Inertia for Cognitive Hallucination Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: Like a body at rest that stays at rest, we find that visual attention in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibits pronounced inertia, remaining largely static once settled during early decoding steps and failing to support the compositional understanding required for cognitive inference. While existing hallucination mitigation methods mainly target perceptual hallucinations concerning object existence or attributes, they remain inadequate for such cognitive hallucinations that require inter-object relational deduction. Through token-wise analysis, we identify visual inertia as a contributing factor: attention to semantically critical regions remains persistently focused and fails to dynamically support relational inference. We thereby propose Inertia-aware Visual Excitation (IVE) that breaks this inertial pattern by modeling cognitive inference as the dynamic responsiveness of visual attention. Specifically, IVE selects visual tokens that are dynamically emerging relative to historical attention trends while distinguishing tokens exhibiting inertial behavior. To further facilitate compositional inference, IVE introduces an inertia-aware penalty that discourages over-concentration and limits the persistence of attention within localized regions. Extensive experiments show the effectiveness of IVE across various MLLMs and benchmarks without additional training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现多模态大语言模型中视觉注意力存在惯性，早期解码步骤后注意力固定不动，无法支持组合理解，导致认知幻觉。提出Inertia-aware Visual Excitation (IVE)方法，通过建模动态响应性打破惯性模式，选择动态突现的视觉令牌并引入惯性惩罚。实验表明IVE在多种MLLM和基准上有效，无需额外训练。
Motivation: 现有幻觉缓解方法主要针对感知幻觉（如物体存在或属性），对需要推理物体间关系的认知幻觉效果不足。视觉注意力惯性被认为是认知幻觉的成因之一。
Method: 提出Inertia-aware Visual Excitation (IVE)，包括选择相对于历史注意力趋势动态突现的视觉令牌并区分惯性行为令牌，同时引入惯性感知惩罚抑制注意力在局部区域的过度集中和持久性。
Result: 在多种多模态大模型和基准上验证了IVE的有效性，无需额外训练即可缓解认知幻觉。
Conclusion: 通过打破视觉注意力惯性，可提升模型在需要组合理解的认知推理任务上的表现。

papers.title: ParaSpeechCLAP: A Dual-Encoder Speech-Text Model for Rich Stylistic Language-Audio Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ParaSpeechCLAP, a family of dual-encoder models that map speech and text style captions into a shared embedding space, supporting rich intrinsic (speaker-level) and situational (utterance-level) descriptors, such as pitch, texture, and emotion, beyond the narrow set handled by existing models. We train separate Intrinsic and Situational models alongside a unified Combined model, finding that specialized models are stronger on individual style dimensions while the unified model excels on compositional evaluation. We further show that ParaSpeechCLAP-Intrinsic benefits from an additional classification loss and class-balanced training. We demonstrate performance on style caption retrieval, speech attribute classification, and usability as inference-time reward models for style-prompted TTS. ParaSpeechCLAP models outperform baselines on most metrics across all three applications. Our models and code are released at https://github.com/ajd12342/paraspeechclap .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ParaSpeechCLAP 是一族双编码器模型，将语音与文本风格描述映射到共享嵌入空间，支持丰富的内在（说话人级别）和情境（话语级别）风格描述，如音高、音色和情感。作者分别训练了内在模型、情境模型以及统一的组合模型，发现专用模型在单个风格维度上更强，而统一模型在组合评估上表现更优。模型在风格描述检索、语音属性分类以及作为风格提示 TTS 的推理时奖励模型等任务上优于基线。
Motivation: 现有语音-文本预训练模型仅能处理有限的风格描述集，缺乏对丰富内在和情境风格的支持，限制了其在细粒度风格理解和生成中的应用。
Method: 提出双编码器架构，分别编码语音和文本风格描述；训练三种模型：Intrinsic（专注于说话人固有风格）、Situational（专注于话语情境风格）和 Combined（统一模型）。Intrinsic 模型额外使用分类损失和类别平衡训练。
Result: 在风格描述检索、语音属性分类和风格 TTS 奖励模型三个应用上，ParaSpeechCLAP 在大多数指标上优于基线。
Conclusion: 专用模型在独立风格维度上更强，统一模型擅长组合风格评估；模型已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantum Neural Physics: Solving Partial Differential Equations on Quantum Simulators using Quantum Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Neural Physics recasts local discretisations of partial differential equations (PDEs) as fixed convolutional operators, providing a physics-preserving alternative to data-driven surrogate modelling in scientific machine learning. However, existing realizations remain largely confined to classical AI hardware and do not directly connect to quantum structured operator design. To bridge this gap, we introduce a \emph{Quantum Neural Physics} framework and develop a Hybrid Quantum-Classical CNN Multigrid Solver (HQC-CNNMG). The proposed method maps analytically prescribed stencil operators to local quantum convolutional primitives and embeds them within a classical multilevel W-cycle architecture, combining the operator-centric view of scientific ML with the numerical rigor of multigrid solvers. Using amplitude encoding together with the Linear Combination of Unitaries (LCU) and the Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT), the resulting local quantum operators admit logarithmic-depth implementation, with circuit depth scaling as $\mathcal{O}(\log K)$ for an encoded block of size $K$ under the idealized parallel circuit model considered here. Numerical experiments on Poisson, transient diffusion, convection--diffusion, and incompressible Navier--Stokes problems demonstrate numerical consistency, stable multilevel behaviour, and workflow-level feasibility on noiseless simulators. Comparisons with representative quantum linear solver paradigms further show that the main strength of HQC-CNNMG lies in its balanced trade-off among local circuit depth, numerical robustness, and compatibility with PDE structure, rather than in fully quantum global inversion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量子神经物理学（Quantum Neural Physics）框架，将偏微分方程（PDE）的局部离散化视为固定卷积算子，并开发了混合量子-经典CNN多重网格求解器（HQC-CNNMG）。该方法将解析模板算子映射到局部量子卷积原语，嵌入经典多级W-cycle架构，利用振幅编码、线性组合酉算子（LCU）和量子傅里叶变换（QFT）实现对数深度电路（O(log K)）。在无噪声模拟器上对Poisson、瞬态扩散、对流-扩散和不可压Navier-Stokes问题的数值实验展示了数值一致性和稳定多级行为。
Motivation: 现有神经物理学方法主要限于经典AI硬件，未直接与量子结构化算子设计连接，本文旨在弥合这一差距，将量子计算的优势引入科学机器学习中的PDE求解。
Method: 提出HQC-CNNMG，将PDE离散化的固定卷积算子映射为局部量子卷积原语，嵌入经典多级W-cycle多重网格结构。采用振幅编码、LCU和QFT实现局部量子算子，在理想并行电路模型下电路深度为O(log K)。
Result: 在Poisson、瞬态扩散、对流-扩散和不可压Navier-Stokes问题上的数值实验表明，该方法在无噪声模拟器上具有数值一致性、稳定的多级行为和工作流级可行性。与代表性量子线性求解器对比，优势在于局部电路深度、数值鲁棒性和与PDE结构兼容性之间的平衡。
Conclusion: HQC-CNNMG的优势不在于完全量子全局反演，而在于局部电路深度、数值鲁棒性和PDE结构兼容性之间的权衡，为量子科学计算提供了一种实用路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reciprocal Co-Training (RCT): Coupling Gradient-Based and Non-Differentiable Models via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Language models (LMs) and classical machine learning methods offer complementary strengths for predictive modeling, yet their fundamentally different representations and training paradigms hinder effective integration: LMs rely on gradient-based optimization over textual data, whereas models such as Random Forests (RF) employ non-differentiable feature partitioning. This work introduces a reciprocal co-training framework that couples an LM with an RF classifier via reinforcement learning, creating an iterative feedback loop in which each model improves using signals from the other. Tabular data are reformulated into standardized textual representations for the LM, whose embeddings augment the RF feature space, while calibrated RF probability estimates provide feedback signals that guide reinforcement learning updates of the LM. Experiments across three medical datasets, evaluated with both a domain-adapted clinical encoder (ClinicalBERT) and a larger instruction-tuned language model (Qwen2-7B-Instruct), demonstrate consistent performance gains for both model components. Ablation analyses indicate that iterative refinement, hybrid reward design, and dimensionality control jointly contribute to these gains. SHAP analysis further confirms that LM-derived representations are among the most important inputs to the RF predictions. The proposed framework provides a general mechanism that allows incompatible model families to leverage each other's strengths through bidirectional adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种互惠共训练框架 (Reciprocal Co-Training, RCT)，通过强化学习将基于梯度的语言模型与非可微的随机森林分类器耦合。在三个医疗数据集上，使用ClinicalBERT和Qwen2-7B-Instruct进行评估，结果显示两个模型组件均获得一致的性能提升。消融分析表明，迭代精炼、混合奖励设计和维度控制共同促进了这些增益。
Motivation: 语言模型与经典机器学习方法（如随机森林）在表示形式和训练范式上存在根本差异，阻碍了它们的有效集成，尤其是在处理表格数据时。
Method: 将表格数据转化为标准文本表示供LM处理，LM的嵌入增强RF特征空间，同时RF的校准概率估计为LM的强化学习更新提供反馈信号，形成迭代反馈循环。
Result: 在三个医疗数据集上，RCT框架使ClinicalBERT和Qwen2-7B-Instruct均获得一致性能提升，SHAP分析进一步确认LM派生的表示是RF预测中最重要的输入之一。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了通用机制，允许不兼容的模型家族通过双向适应利用彼此的优势，但当前实验仅限于医疗领域和特定模型。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Non-Adversarial Imitation Learning Provably Free of Compounding Errors: The Value Flow Mechanism
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial imitation learning (AIL) achieves high-quality imitation by mitigating compounding errors inherent to behavioral cloning (BC), yet its adversarial optimization frequently leads to training instability. A class of non-adversarial Q-based imitation learning (IL) methods, exemplified by IQ-Learn, has emerged to address this instability and is widely believed to outperform BC by leveraging online environment interactions. In this paper, we revisit IQ-Learn and prove that it in fact reduces to BC: it admits an imitation gap lower bound with quadratic dependence on the horizon and therefore remains susceptible to compounding errors. Our theoretical analysis reveals why online interactions fail to help: IQ-Learn uniformly suppresses Q-values for all actions at states not covered by demonstrations, preventing generalization beyond demonstrations. To address this fundamental limitation, we introduce Dual Q-DM, a new Q-based IL method built on Bellman constraints. Crucially, Bellman constraints drive value flow: Q-values propagate from demonstrated to unvisited states through environment dynamics, enabling generalization beyond demonstrations. We prove that Dual Q-DM is equivalent to AIL and can recover expert actions at unvisited states, thereby mitigating compounding errors. To the best of our knowledge, Dual Q-DM is the first non-adversarial IL method that is theoretically guaranteed to eliminate compounding errors. Experimental results further corroborate our theoretical findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了基于Q的模仿学习方法IQ-Learn，证明其本质上退化为行为克隆，存在与时间步长二次相关的模仿差距下界，因此仍然受复合误差影响。作者提出Dual Q-DM，一种新的基于Bellman约束的非对抗模仿学习方法，通过值流机制使Q值从已演示状态传播到未访问状态，从而消除复合误差。理论证明Dual Q-DM等价于对抗模仿学习，实验验证了理论发现。
Motivation: 对抗模仿学习存在训练不稳定问题，而非对抗Q方法（如IQ-Learn）被认为优于行为克隆，但本文证明其仍受复合误差影响，需要从根本上解决这一问题。
Method: 提出Dual Q-DM，基于Bellman约束构建值流机制，使得Q值可以通过环境动力学从演示状态传播到未访问状态，从而在非对抗框架下实现专家动作的泛化。
Result: 理论证明Dual Q-DM等价于对抗模仿学习，能够恢复未访问状态下的专家动作，消除复合误差；实验结果支持理论分析。
Conclusion: Dual Q-DM是首个非对抗模仿学习方法，理论上保证消除复合误差，为稳定高效的模仿学习提供了新方向。

summary_sections.motivation: 对抗模仿学习存在训练不稳定问题，而非对抗Q方法（如IQ-Learn）被认为优于行为克隆，但本文证明其仍受复合误差影响，需要从根本上解决这一问题。
summary_sections.method: 提出Dual Q-DM，基于Bellman约束构建值流机制，使得Q值可以通过环境动力学从演示状态传播到未访问状态，从而在非对抗框架下实现专家动作的泛化。
summary_sections.result: 理论证明Dual Q-DM等价于对抗模仿学习，能够恢复未访问状态下的专家动作，消除复合误差；实验结果支持理论分析。
summary_sections.conclusion: Dual Q-DM是首个非对抗模仿学习方法，理论上保证消除复合误差，为稳定高效的模仿学习提供了新方向。

papers.title: TaigiSpeech: A Low-Resource Real-World Speech Intent Dataset and Preliminary Results with Scalable Data Mining In-the-Wild
papers.abstract_en: Speech technologies have advanced rapidly and serve diverse populations worldwide. However, many languages remain underrepresented due to limited resources. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{TaigiSpeech}, a real-world speech intent dataset in Taiwanese Taigi (aka Taiwanese Hokkien/Southern Min), which is a low-resource and primarily spoken language. The dataset is collected from older adults, comprising 21 speakers with a total of 3k utterances. It is designed for practical intent detection scenarios, including healthcare and home assistant applications. To address the scarcity of labeled data, we explore two data mining strategies with two levels of supervision: keyword match data mining with LLM pseudo labeling via an intermediate language and an audio-visual framework that leverages multimodal cues with minimal textual supervision. This design enables scalable dataset construction for low-resource and unwritten spoken languages. TaigiSpeech will be released under the CC BY 4.0 license to facilitate broad adoption and research on low-resource and unwritten languages. The project website and the dataset can be found on https://kwchang.org/taigispeech.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了TaigiSpeech，一个低资源台语（Taiwanese Taigi）真实语音意图数据集，包含21位老年人的3k条话语，面向医疗和家庭助手场景。为了解决标注数据稀缺问题，作者探索了两种数据挖掘策略：基于关键词匹配和LLM伪标注（通过中间语言），以及利用多模态线索的视听框架。数据集将以CC BY 4.0发布以促进低资源语言研究。
Motivation: 台语等低资源语言缺乏语音数据集，尤其是面向实际意图检测的应用场景。
Method: 构建了包含21位老年人、3k条话语的台语语音意图数据集；提出两种数据挖掘策略：关键词匹配+LLM伪标注（通过中间语言）和视听框架（利用多模态线索，减少文本监督）。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，仅提及初步结果，点出数据挖掘策略的可扩展性。
Conclusion: 通过可扩展的数据挖掘方法，可以低成本地为低资源语言构建数据集，TaigiSpeech将开源以促进相关研究。

papers.title: AI Agents Can Already Autonomously Perform Experimental High Energy Physics
papers.abstract_en: Large language model-based AI agents are now able to autonomously execute substantial portions of a high energy physics (HEP) analysis pipeline with minimal expert-curated input. Given access to a HEP dataset, an execution framework, and a corpus of prior experimental literature, we find that Claude Code succeeds in automating all stages of a typical analysis: event selection, background estimation, uncertainty quantification, statistical inference, and paper drafting. We argue that the experimental HEP community is underestimating the current capabilities of these systems, and that most proposed agentic workflows are too narrowly scoped or scaffolded to specific analysis structures. We present a proof-of-concept framework, Just Furnish Context (JFC), that integrates autonomous analysis agents with literature-based knowledge retrieval and multi-agent review, and show that this is sufficient to plan, execute, and document a credible high energy physics analysis. We demonstrate this by conducting analyses on open data from ALEPH, DELPHI, and CMS to perform electroweak, QCD, and Higgs boson measurements. We present two of those results in a condensed short paper form -- a CMS Run1 Open Data $H\to τ^+τ^-$ to demonstrate performance on a well-established result, and the first Lund plane measurement on LEP data -- a genuinely novel result and, to our knowledge, the first produced autonomously by an AI agent. Rather than replacing physicists, these tools promise to offload the repetitive technical burden of analysis code development, freeing researchers to focus on physics insight, truly novel method development, and rigorous validation. Given these developments, we advocate for new strategies for how the community trains students, organizes analysis efforts, and allocates human expertise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文展示基于大语言模型的AI代理能够自主执行高能物理分析管道的多个阶段，包括事件选择、背景估计、不确定性量化、统计推断和论文撰写。作者提出Just Furnish Context (JFC)框架，集成自主分析代理与文献知识检索，并在ALEPH、DELPHI和CMS开放数据上进行电弱、QCD和希格斯玻色子测量，其中Lund平面测量是首个由AI代理自主产生的新结果。
Motivation: 高能物理实验社区低估了当前AI系统在自动化分析方面的能力，现有工作组件的范围过于狭窄或受限于特定分析结构。
Method: 提出JFC框架，利用Claude Code作为基础模型，集成文献知识检索和多代理审查，使AI代理能自主规划、执行和记录完整的物理分析。
Result: 在CMS Run1开放数据上成功复现H→τ+τ-结果，并在LEP数据上首次自主完成Lund平面测量，这是一个完全新颖的结果。
Conclusion: 这些工具不会取代物理学家，而是减轻重复性技术负担，使研究者专注于物理洞察和新方法开发。社区需调整学生培养、分析组织方式和人力分配策略。

papers.title: Deep EM with Hierarchical Latent Label Modelling for Multi-Site Prostate Lesion Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Label variability is a major challenge for prostate lesion segmentation. In multi-site datasets, annotations often reflect centre-specific contouring protocols, causing segmentation networks to overfit to local styles and generalise poorly to unseen sites in inference. We treat each observed annotation as a noisy observation of an underlying latent 'clean' lesion mask, and propose a hierarchical expectation-maximisation (HierEM) framework that alternates between: (1) inferring a voxel-wise posterior distribution over the latent mask, and (2) training a CNN using this posterior as a soft target and estimate site-specific sensitivity and specificity under a hierarchical prior. This hierarchical prior decomposes label-quality into a global mean with site- and case-level deviations, reducing site-specific bias by penalising the likelihood term contributed only by site deviations. Experiments on three cohorts demonstrate that the proposed hierarchical EM framework enhances cross-site generalisation compared to state-of-the-art methods. For pooled-dataset evaluation, the per-site mean DSC ranges from 29.50% to 39.69%; for leave-one-site-out generalisation, it ranges from 27.91% to 32.67%, yielding statistically significant improvements over comparison methods (p<0.039). The method also produces interpretable per-site latent label-quality estimates (sensitivity alpha ranges from 31.5% to 47.3% at specificity beta approximates 0.99), supporting post-hoc analyses of cross-site annotation variability. These results indicate that explicitly modelling site-dependent annotation can improve cross-site generalisation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分层期望最大化（HierEM）框架处理多站点前列腺病灶分割中的标注变异性问题。将每个观测标注视为潜在干净掩膜的有噪观测，通过交替推断潜在掩膜的体素后验分布和训练CNN，并利用分层先验建模站点特异性和病例水平的偏差。实验表明，该方法在跨站点泛化上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 多站点数据集中，标注反映站点特定的轮廓协议，导致分割网络过拟合局部风格，在未见过站点上泛化差。
Method: 提出层次化EM框架：E步推断潜在掩膜的体素后验分布；M步使用该后验作为软目标训练CNN，并估计站点特异性的灵敏度和特异度，其中分层先验将标注质量分解为全局均值、站点和病例级偏差，通过仅惩罚站点偏差的似然项减少站点特异性偏差。
Result: 在三个队列上，池化数据集评估的每站点平均DSC范围29.50%–39.69%，留一站点泛化DSC范围27.91%–32.67%，统计显著优于对比方法（p<0.039）。可解释的每站点潜在标注质量估计（灵敏度α范围31.5%–47.3%，特异度β约0.99）支持后验分析。
Conclusion: 显式建模站点依赖的标注变异性能提升跨站点泛化，并提供了可解释的标注质量估计。

papers.title: MMOU: A Massive Multi-Task Omni Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Long and Complex Real-World Videos
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong performance in visual and audio understanding when evaluated in isolation. However, their ability to jointly reason over omni-modal (visual, audio, and textual) signals in long and complex videos remains largely unexplored. We introduce MMOU, a new benchmark designed to systematically evaluate multimodal understanding and reasoning under these challenging, real-world conditions. MMOU consists of 20,000 carefully curated questions paired with 11877 web-collected videos of varying length, spanning diverse domains and exhibiting rich, tightly coupled audio-visual content. The benchmark covers 13 fundamental skill categories, all of which require integrating evidence across modalities and time. All questions are manually annotated across multiple turns by professional annotators, ensuring high quality and reasoning fidelity. We evaluate 20+ state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary multimodal models on MMOU. The results expose substantial performance gaps: the best closed-source model achieves only 64.2% accuracy, while the strongest open-source model reaches just 46.8%. Our results highlight the challenges of long-form omni-modal understanding, revealing that current models frequently fail to apply even fundamental skills in long videos. Through detailed analysis, we further identify systematic failure modes and provide insights into where and why current models break.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MMOU基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在长而复杂的真实世界视频中的综合理解与推理能力。包含20000个问题、11877个网络视频，覆盖13种技能类别。评估了20+模型，最佳闭源模型准确率仅64.2%，最佳开源模型仅46.8%，揭示了当前模型在长视频多模态推理上的重大缺陷。
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在单独模态下表现良好，但在长视频中联合推理视觉、音频和文本信号的能力未被充分探索。需要系统性的基准来暴露缺陷。
Method: 构建MMOU基准：收集11877个长视频（多种长度），人工标注20000个多轮问题，覆盖13种基础技能类别，要求跨模态和时间整合证据。
Result: 评估20+模型，最佳闭源模型准确率64.2%，最佳开源模型46.8%，显示巨大差距。分析揭示了系统性的失败模式。
Conclusion: 当前MLLMs在长视频多模态理解上远未成熟，尤其在需要基础技能的联合推理时。MMOU为未来研究提供了挑战和方向。

papers.title: Deep Generative Transformers for Probabilistic Time Series and Spatiotemporal Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Reliable uncertainty quantification is paramount for forecasting multivariate time series and spatiotemporal data. While Transformer architectures excel at sequence modeling, current probabilistic approaches typically rely on restrictive parametric likelihoods or quantile-based objectives, thereby limiting their ability to capture complex joint distributions in correlated time series. To overcome these limitations, we propose \textit{Enformer} and its spatiotemporal extension, \textit{GEnformer}. These models synthesize the expressive power of Transformers with engression, a stochastic learning paradigm for modeling conditional distributions. By injecting stochastic noise and optimizing a strictly proper scoring objective, our frameworks directly learn conditional predictive distributions without imposing parametric assumptions. This design ensures the generation of coherent multivariate trajectories while maintaining the Transformer's efficacy in modeling long-range dependencies and cross-series interactions. The probabilistic capability of Enformer is achieved with an asymptotic overhead of only a constant factor over a deterministic Transformer with an identical configuration. We extensively evaluate our frameworks on prominent multivariate benchmarks for temporal dynamics and real-world epidemic datasets for spatiotemporal dynamics. Empirical results demonstrate that both frameworks yield calibrated probabilistic forecasts and consistently outperform state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Enformer 及其时空扩展 GEnformer，将 Transformer 与 engression 结合，用于多元时间序列和时空数据的概率预测。通过注入随机噪声并优化严格适当的评分目标，无需参数化假设即可学习条件预测分布，生成连贯的多元轨迹。在多元时间序列基准和真实流行病数据集上，模型优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有概率性 Transformer 方法通常依赖参数化似然或分位数目标，难以捕捉相关时间序列中的复杂联合分布。
Method: 提出 Enformer 和 GEnformer，在 Transformer 中引入 engression：注入随机噪声并优化严格适当的评分目标，直接学习条件预测分布，无需参数化假设。
Result: 在多元时间序列基准和真实流行病数据集上，模型生成校准的概率预测，持续优于最先进基线。
Conclusion: 该方法能以仅恒定因子的渐近开销实现概率预测，并保持 Transformer 对长程依赖和跨序列交互的建模能力。

papers.title: CodePercept: Code-Grounded Visual STEM Perception for MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: When MLLMs fail at Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) visual reasoning, a fundamental question arises: is it due to perceptual deficiencies or reasoning limitations? Through systematic scaling analysis that independently scales perception and reasoning components, we uncover a critical insight: scaling perception consistently outperforms scaling reasoning. This reveals perception as the true lever limiting current STEM visual reasoning. Motivated by this insight, our work focuses on systematically enhancing the perception capabilities of MLLMs by establishing code as a powerful perceptual medium--executable code provides precise semantics that naturally align with the structured nature of STEM visuals. Specifically, we construct ICC-1M, a large-scale dataset comprising 1M Image-Caption-Code triplets that materializes this code-as-perception paradigm through two complementary approaches: (1) Code-Grounded Caption Generation treats executable code as ground truth for image captions, eliminating the hallucinations inherent in existing knowledge distillation methods; (2) STEM Image-to-Code Translation prompts models to generate reconstruction code, mitigating the ambiguity of natural language for perception enhancement. To validate this paradigm, we further introduce STEM2Code-Eval, a novel benchmark that directly evaluates visual perception in STEM domains. Unlike existing work relying on problem-solving accuracy as a proxy that only measures problem-relevant understanding, our benchmark requires comprehensive visual comprehension through executable code generation for image reconstruction, providing deterministic and verifiable assessment. Code is available at https://github.com/TongkunGuan/Qwen-CodePercept.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过系统缩放分析发现，在多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）进行STEM视觉推理时，感知能力的提升比推理能力的提升更有效，揭示感知是当前瓶颈。为此，构建了ICC-1M大规模数据集（含100万图像-代码-标题三元组），并提出两种互补方法：代码锚定标题生成（以可执行代码作为真实标签）和STEM图像到代码翻译（生成重建代码以消除自然语言歧义），同时引入STEM2Code-Eval基准直接评估视觉感知能力。实验表明，缩放感知一致优于缩放推理。
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在STEM视觉推理中表现不佳，但难以区分是感知缺陷还是推理限制。通过独立缩放感知和推理组件，发现感知是真正的关键杠杆，因此需要系统增强感知能力。
Method: 提出代码作为感知媒介的范式，构建ICC-1M数据集（Image-Caption-Code三元组），包含两种方法：1）代码锚定标题生成（以可执行代码作为图像描述的真实标签，消除知识蒸馏幻觉）；2）STEM图像到代码翻译（生成重建代码以缓解自然语言歧义）。同时设计STEM2Code-Eval基准，通过生成可执行代码重建图像来直接评估感知能力。
Result: 缩放感知一致优于缩放推理，表明感知是限制当前STEM视觉推理的主要因素。
Conclusion: 代码作为感知媒介能有效提升MLLMs的STEM视觉感知能力，ICC-1M数据集和STEM2Code-Eval基准为后续研究提供了资源和评估标准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CLoE: Expert Consistency Learning for Robust Missing Modality Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal medical image segmentation often faces missing modalities at inference, which induces disagreement among modality experts and makes fusion unstable, particularly on small foreground structures. We propose Consistency Learning of Experts (CLoE), a consistency-driven framework for missing-modality segmentation that preserves strong performance when all modalities are available. CLoE formulates robustness as decision-level expert consistency control and introduces a dual-branch Expert Consistency Learning objective. Modality Expert Consistency enforces global agreement among expert predictions to reduce case-wise drift under partial inputs, while Region Expert Consistency emphasizes agreement on clinically critical foreground regions to avoid background-dominated regularization. We further map consistency scores to modality reliability weights using a lightweight gating network, enabling reliability-aware feature recalibration before fusion. Extensive experiments on BraTS 2020 and MSD Prostate demonstrate that CLoE outperforms state-of-the-art methods in incomplete multimodal segmentation, while exhibiting strong cross-dataset generalization and improving robustness on clinically critical structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态医学图像分割在推理时缺失模态的问题，提出CLoE框架，通过专家一致性学习（Expert Consistency Learning）提升鲁棒性。CLoE引入双分支一致性目标：模态专家一致性（全局对齐）和区域专家一致性（聚焦临床关键前景区域），并利用轻量级门控网络将一致性分数映射为模态可靠性权重，用于特征重标定。在BraTS 2020和MSD Prostate上，CLoE在缺失模态分割中优于现有方法，且具有跨数据集泛化能力。
Motivation: 多模态医学图像分割在推理时常面临模态缺失，导致专家预测不一致和融合不稳定，尤其对小前景结构影响显著。现有方法缺乏对决策级一致性的显式建模。
Method: 提出一致性学习框架CLoE，包括双分支专家一致性损失（模态专家一致性和区域专家一致性），以及基于一致性分数的门控网络用于可靠性感知的特征重标定。
Result: 在BraTS 2020和MSD Prostate数据集上，CLoE在不完整多模态分割任务中优于现有方法，并展现出强跨数据集泛化能力，提升临床关键结构的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: CLoE通过一致性学习有效解决模态缺失引起的专家分歧，可保持全模态下的性能，且对临床重要区域有特别改进。

papers.title: Beyond Relevance: On the Relationship Between Retrieval and RAG Information Coverage
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems combine document retrieval with a generative model to address complex information seeking tasks like report generation. While the relationship between retrieval quality and generation effectiveness seems intuitive, it has not been systematically studied. We investigate whether upstream retrieval metrics can serve as reliable early indicators of the final generated response's information coverage. Through experiments across two text RAG benchmarks (TREC NeuCLIR 2024 and TREC RAG 2024) and one multimodal benchmark (WikiVideo), we analyze 15 text retrieval stacks and 10 multimodal retrieval stacks across four RAG pipelines and multiple evaluation frameworks (Auto-ARGUE and MiRAGE). Our findings demonstrate strong correlations between coverage-based retrieval metrics and nugget coverage in generated responses at both topic and system levels. This relationship holds most strongly when retrieval objectives align with generation goals, though more complex iterative RAG pipelines can partially decouple generation quality from retrieval effectiveness. These findings provide empirical support for using retrieval metrics as proxies for RAG performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实验研究检索增强生成（RAG）系统中检索质量与生成响应信息覆盖度之间的关系，发现基于覆盖度的检索指标与生成响应中的信息块覆盖度存在强相关性，尤其是在检索目标与生成目标一致时。
Motivation: 尽管检索质量与生成效果之间的直观关系被普遍认可，但缺乏系统性研究，本文旨在探究上游检索指标能否作为最终生成响应信息覆盖度的可靠早期指示。
Method: 在文本RAG基准（TREC NeuCLIR 2024和TREC RAG 2024）和多模态基准（WikiVideo）上，分析15种文本检索栈和10种多模态检索栈，结合四种RAG流水线和多种评估框架（Auto-ARGUE和MiRAGE），计算相关性。
Result: 发现覆盖度导向的检索指标与主题和系统级别的生成响应信息块覆盖度之间存在强相关性，但复杂的迭代RAG流水线可能部分解耦生成质量与检索效果。
Conclusion: 结果为使用检索指标作为RAG性能代理提供了实证支持，但需注意流水线复杂度的影响。

papers.title: FrameVGGT: Coherence-Preserving Memory for Bounded Streaming Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Streaming Visual Geometry Transformers such as StreamVGGT enable strong online 3D perception, but their KV-cache grows unbounded over long streams, limiting practical deployment. We study bounded-memory streaming geometry from the perspective of memory organization: unlike language modeling, where useful information can often be compressed at token level, geometry-driven inference relies on coherent and mutually compatible observations across views. Under fixed memory budgets, retaining history as isolated entries can progressively fragment the geometric context needed for stable long-horizon matching and fusion. We therefore propose \textbf{FrameVGGT}, a bounded-memory framework that maintains a fixed-capacity set of complementary memory units for streaming geometry. In our implementation, each unit is instantiated as a frame-wise KV segment summarized by a compact key-space prototype, together with a sparse anchor tier for persistent long-range references. Across long-sequence 3D reconstruction, video depth estimation, and camera pose estimation, FrameVGGT achieves favorable accuracy--memory trade-offs under bounded budgets while maintaining more stable geometry over long streams.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对流式视觉几何变换器（如StreamVGGT）的KV缓存无限增长问题，提出FrameVGGT：一种有界内存框架，维护固定容量的互补记忆单元。通过帧级KV段和紧凑关键空间原型，在长序列3D重建、视频深度估计和相机位姿估计中实现了精度-内存的有利权衡，并保持了更稳定的几何一致性。
Motivation: 现有流式视觉几何变换器在长序列中KV缓存无限增长，而几何推理依赖于跨视图的一致观测，固定内存预算下逐条保留历史会导致几何上下文的碎片化。
Method: 提出FrameVGGT，维护一组固定容量的互补记忆单元，每个单元实例化为帧级KV段，由紧凑关键空间原型总结，并附有稀疏锚点层用于持久的长程参考。
Result: 摘要报告在长序列3D重建、视频深度估计和相机位姿估计任务上，FrameVGGT在有限预算下实现了有利的精度-内存权衡，并保持更稳定的几何一致性。
Conclusion: 有界内存框架通过组织互补记忆单元，能够有效解决流式几何推理中的内存增长和上下文碎片化问题，为长序列在线3D感知提供了可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Combinatorial Allocation Bandits with Nonlinear Arm Utility
papers.abstract_en: A matching platform is a system that matches participants of different types, such as companies and job-seekers. In such a platform, maximizing matches may concentrate assignments on popular participants, increasing dissatisfaction among others, and eventually causing churn, which reduces the platform's profit opportunities. To address this issue, we propose a novel online learning problem, Combinatorial Allocation Bandits (CAB), which incorporates the notion of *arm satisfaction*. In CAB, at each round, the learner observes feature vectors for $K$ arms and $N$ users, assigns users to arms, and observes feedback following a generalized linear model (GLM). Unlike prior work, the objective is to maximize arm satisfaction rather than the number of positive feedback. For CAB, we develop an upper confidence bound algorithm that uses an approximate optimization oracle and achieves an approximate regret upper bound, whose dependence on $d$, $T$, and $N$ matches the known lower bound for contextual combinatorial linear bandits up to logarithmic factors. We also analyze a Thompson sampling algorithm with a standard regret bound under an exact optimization oracle, and propose a cheaper one-pass variant retaining sublinear approximate regret under a self-concordance assumption. Experiments on synthetic data support the objective and show that CAB-UCB achieves higher cumulative satisfaction than baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的在线学习问题——组合分配赌博机 (Combinatorial Allocation Bandits, CAB)，旨在平衡匹配平台中参与者的满意度，避免热门参与者过度集中导致流失。CAB 中，每轮学习者为 K 个臂和 N 个用户分配配对，并观察广义线性模型 (GLM) 反馈，目标是最优化臂满意度而非正反馈数量。作者提出了一个上置信界算法 (CAB-UCB)，利用近似优化预言机，实现了与已知下限匹配的近似遗憾上界（对数因子内），并分析了汤普森采样算法及其变体。合成数据实验表明，CAB-UCB 累积满意度高于基线。
Motivation: 现有匹配平台优化匹配数量可能导致热门参与者过度集中，降低其他参与者满意度并引发流失，从而损害平台长期收益。论文针对该问题，引入臂满意度概念，提出新的在线学习框架以平衡分配。
Method: 定义组合分配赌博机 (CAB) 问题，每个回合基于特征向量分配用户到臂，反馈遵循 GLM。提出基于上置信界 (UCB) 的算法，使用近似优化预言机实现近似遗憾上界；同时分析汤普森采样算法及其一种廉价单通道变体，后者在自和谐假设下保持次线性近似遗憾。
Result: CAB-UCB 的近似遗憾上界与上下文组合线性赌博机的已知下界匹配（对数因子内）。合成数据实验显示，CAB-UCB 累积满意度优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 论文通过引入满意度导向的 CAB 框架，为匹配平台提供了一种理论上有保障的在线分配方法。当前分析依赖近似或精确优化预言机，实际应用中的计算效率有待进一步研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DeepResearch-9K: A Challenging Benchmark Dataset of Deep-Research Agent
papers.abstract_en: Deep-research agents are capable of executing multi-step web exploration, targeted retrieval, and sophisticated question answering. Despite their powerful capabilities, deep-research agents face two critical bottlenecks: (1) the lack of large-scale, challenging datasets with real-world difficulty, and (2) the absence of accessible, open-source frameworks for data synthesis and agent training. To bridge these gaps, we first construct DeepResearch-9K, a large-scale challenging dataset specifically designed for deep-research scenarios built from open-source multi-hop question-answering (QA) datasets via a low-cost autonomous pipeline. Notably, it consists of (1) 9000 questions spanning three difficulty levels from L1 to L3 (2) high-quality search trajectories with reasoning chains from Tongyi-DeepResearch-30B-A3B, a state-of-the-art deep-research agent, and (3) verifiable answers. Furthermore, we develop an open-source training framework DeepResearch-R1 that supports (1) multi-turn web interactions, (2) different reinforcement learning (RL) approaches, and (3) different reward models such as rule-based outcome reward and LLM-as-judge feedback. Finally, empirical results demonstrate that agents trained on DeepResearch-9K under our DeepResearch-R1 achieve state-of-the-art results on challenging deep-research benchmarks. We release the DeepResearch-9K dataset on https://huggingface.co/datasets/artillerywu/DeepResearch-9K and the code of DeepResearch-R1 on https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/DeepResearch-R1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了DeepResearch-9K，一个大规模、有挑战性的深度研究代理基准数据集，包含9000个问题、搜索轨迹和可验证答案，并开源了训练框架DeepResearch-R1。实验表明在该数据集上训练的代理在深度研究基准上达到最先进水平。
Motivation: 深度研究代理缺乏大规模、真实难度数据集和开源训练框架，限制了其发展。
Method: 通过低成本的自主流水线从开源多跳QA数据集构建DeepResearch-9K，包含三级难度问题、搜索轨迹和可验证答案；开发了支持多轮网页交互、多种强化学习方法和奖励模型的训练框架DeepResearch-R1。
Result: 代理在DeepResearch-9K上训练后，在挑战性深度研究基准上取得最先进结果。
Conclusion: 本文通过数据集和框架填补了深度研究代理的关键空白，并提供了开源资源以推动该领域研究。

papers.title: A Robust Framework for Secure Cardiovascular Risk Prediction: An Architectural Case Study of Differentially Private Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Accurate cardiovascular risk prediction is crucial for preventive healthcare; however, the development of robust Artificial Intelligence (AI) models is hindered by the fragmentation of clinical data across institutions due to stringent privacy regulations. This paper presents a comprehensive architectural case study validating the engineering robustness of FedCVR, a privacy-preserving Federated Learning framework applied to heterogeneous clinical networks. Rather than proposing a new theoretical optimizer, this work focuses on a systems engineering analysis to quantify the operational trade-offs of server-side adaptive optimization under utility-prioritized Differential Privacy (DP). By conducting a rigorous stress test in a high-fidelity synthetic environment that reflects the feature space and clinical context of real-world datasets (Framingham, Cleveland), we systematically evaluate the system's resilience to statistical noise. The validation results demonstrate that integrating server-side momentum as a temporal denoiser enables the architecture to achieve a stable F1 score of 0.78 and an Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 0.96 under the operational privacy budget (epsilon approximately 13.4), compared to a non-private baseline with an F1 score of 0.84. FedCVR statistically outperforms standard stateless baselines (FedAvg, FedProx) and other adaptive optimizers (FedAdagrad, FedYogi) under identical privacy constraints. Our findings confirm that server-side adaptivity is a structural prerequisite for recovering clinical utility under realistic privacy budgets, providing a validated engineering blueprint for secure multi-institutional collaboration.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过系统工程分析验证了FedCVR框架的工程稳健性，该框架将差分隐私与联邦学习结合用于心血管风险预测。在高保真合成环境（模拟Framingham和Cleveland数据集）中，系统在隐私预算ε≈13.4下达到F1分数0.78、AUC 0.96，相比非隐私基线F1=0.84略有下降，但显著优于FedAvg、FedProx等标准基线。结果表明服务器端自适应优化是恢复临床效用的关键结构性设计。
Motivation: 临床数据因隐私法规而碎片化，限制了AI模型的开发；现有联邦学习方法在严格差分隐私约束下难以保持预测效用。
Method: 采用系统工程技术分析，在服务器端集成动量为时间去噪器，并结合效用优先的差分隐私；通过高保真合成环境（反映真实临床特征空间）进行压力测试。
Result: 在隐私预算ε≈13.4下，FedCVR达到F1=0.78、AUC=0.96，非隐私基线F1=0.84；FedCVR在统计上优于FedAvg、FedProx、FedAdagrad、FedYogi等基线。
Conclusion: 确认服务器端自适应性是在实际隐私预算下恢复临床效用的结构性先决条件，为安全多机构协作提供了经过验证的工程蓝图。

papers.title: NNiT: Width-Agnostic Neural Network Generation with Structurally Aligned Weight Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Generative modeling of neural network parameters is often tied to architectures because standard parameter representations rely on known weight-matrix dimensions. Generation is further complicated by permutation symmetries that allow networks to model similar input-output functions while having widely different, unaligned parameterizations. In this work, we introduce Neural Network Diffusion Transformers (NNiTs), which generate weights in a width-agnostic manner by tokenizing weight matrices into patches and modeling them as locally structured fields. We establish that Graph HyperNetworks (GHNs) with a convolutional neural network (CNN) decoder structurally align the weight space, creating the local correlation necessary for patch-based processing. Focusing on Multilayer Perceptrons (MLPs), where permutation symmetry is especially apparent, NNiTs generate fully functional networks across a range of architectures. Our approach jointly models discrete architecture tokens and continuous weight patches within a single sequence model. On ManiSkill3 robotics tasks, NNiT achieves $>85\%$ success on architecture topologies unseen during training, while baseline approaches fail to generalize; the same pipeline also generalizes to MNIST classification beyond the robotic control setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经网络扩散变换器（NNiT），以宽度无关的方式生成神经网络权重，通过将权重矩阵标记化为补丁并建模为局部结构场，结合图超网络（GHN）和卷积解码器实现权重空间的结构对齐。在MLP架构上，NNiT联合建模离散架构令牌和连续权重补丁，在ManiSkill3机器人任务中未见过的架构上达到85%以上成功率，并泛化到MNIST分类。
Motivation: 现有神经网络参数生成方法受限于架构固定的权重矩阵维度，且排列对称性导致参数化不对齐，阻碍泛化。
Method: 提出NNiT，将权重矩阵分割成补丁并作为局部结构场建模，使用图超网络（GHN）和CNN解码器实现权重空间的结构对齐，联合建模离散架构令牌和连续权重补丁。
Result: 在ManiSkill3机器人任务中，未见过的架构拓扑上成功率>85%，基线方法失败；在MNIST分类上同样泛化。
Conclusion: NNiT通过权重空间的结构对齐和补丁化处理，实现了宽度无关的神经网络生成，并展现出对未见架构的泛化能力。

papers.title: Set-based v.s. Distribution-based Representations of Epistemic Uncertainty: A Comparative Study
papers.abstract_en: Epistemic uncertainty in neural networks is commonly modeled using two second-order paradigms: distribution-based representations, which rely on posterior parameter distributions, and set-based representations based on credal sets (convex sets of probability distributions). These frameworks are often regarded as fundamentally non-comparable due to differing semantics, assumptions, and evaluation practices, leaving their relative merits unclear. Empirical comparisons are further confounded by variations in the underlying predictive models. To clarify this issue, we present a controlled comparative study enabling principled, like-for-like evaluation of the two paradigms. Both representations are constructed from the same finite collection of predictive distributions generated by a shared neural network, isolating representational effects from predictive accuracy. Our study evaluates each representation through the lens of 3 uncertainty measures across 8 benchmarks, including selective prediction and out-of-distribution detection, spanning 6 underlying predictive models and 10 independent runs per configuration. Our results show that meaningful comparison between these seemingly non-comparable frameworks is both feasible and informative, providing insights into how second-order representation choices impact practical uncertainty-aware performance.
papers.comment: Accepted by The Forty-Second Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对神经网络中基于集合（credal set）和基于分布（后验参数分布）的认知不确定性表征进行了受控比较研究。通过从共享神经网络生成的相同有限预测分布集合中构建两种二阶表征，隔离了表征效应与预测精度。在8个基准（包括选择性预测和OOD检测）上使用3种不确定性度量进行评估，结果表明两种看似不可比较的范式可以进行有意义的比较，并揭示了表征选择对实践性能的影响。
Motivation: 分布和集合两种二阶不确定性框架因语义、假设和评估实践不同而被视为基本不可比较，其相对优劣不明确，且经验比较受底层预测模型变化干扰。
Method: 提出一个受控比较框架：从共享神经网络的相同有限预测分布集合出发，分别构建基于后验参数分布的分布表征和基于credal set的集合表征，从而隔离表征影响，进行公平评估。
Result: 在8个基准上使用3种不确定性度量，涵盖选择性预测和OOD检测，基于6种预测模型和每个配置10次独立运行。结果表明两种范式可比较且能提供洞察。
Conclusion: 尽管两种范式看似不可比较，但受控比较显示有意义比较是可行且有益的，揭示了二阶表征选择如何影响不确定性感知性能。

papers.title: Model Merging in the Essential Subspace
papers.abstract_en: Model merging aims to integrate multiple task-specific fine-tuned models derived from a shared pre-trained checkpoint into a single multi-task model without additional training. Despite extensive research, task interference remains a major obstacle that often undermines the performance of merged models. In this paper, we propose ESM (Essential Subspace Merging) , a robust framework for effective model merging. We begin by performing Principal Component Analysis (PCA) on feature shifts induced by parameter updates. The resulting principal directions span an essential subspace that dominantly influences feature representations. Each task's parameter update matrix is projected onto its respective essential subspace for low-rank decomposition before merging. This methodology mitigates inter-task interference while preserving core task-specific functionality. Furthermore, we introduce a multi-level polarized scaling strategy that amplifies parameters containing critical knowledge and suppresses redundant ones, preventing essential knowledge from being overwhelmed during fusion. Extensive experiments across multiple task sets and model scales demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in multi-task model merging. Code is available at https://github.com/kiddo127/ESM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多任务模型合并中的任务干扰问题，提出ESM（Essential Subspace Merging）框架。该方法对参数更新引起的特征偏移进行主成分分析（PCA），提取本质子空间，将每个任务的参数更新矩阵投影到其本质子空间进行低秩分解后再合并，并引入多级极化缩放策略增强关键知识、抑制冗余。在多个任务集和模型规模上的实验表明，该方法在多任务模型合并中取得了最先进的性能。
Motivation: 现有模型合并方法中任务干扰是主要障碍，导致合并后性能下降。
Method: 对每个任务微调后的参数更新矩阵进行PCA，得到本质子空间，将更新矩阵投影到该子空间进行低秩分解，然后合并；引入多级极化缩放策略，放大关键知识参数，抑制冗余参数。
Result: 在多个任务集和模型规模上，ESM在多任务模型合并中取得了最先进的性能。
Conclusion: 通过本质子空间投影和极化缩放，能有效缓解任务干扰，提升合并模型的多任务能力。

papers.title: AXE: Grey-Box Exploitability Confirmation for Localized Vulnerability Reports
papers.abstract_en: Vulnerability detection tools are widely adopted in software projects, yet they often overwhelm maintainers with false positives and non-actionable reports. Automated exploitation systems can help validate these reports; however, existing approaches typically operate in isolation from detection pipelines, failing to leverage readily available metadata such as vulnerability type and source-code location. In this paper, we investigate how reported security vulnerabilities can be assessed in a realistic grey-box exploitation setting that leverages minimal vulnerability metadata, specifically a CWE classification and a vulnerable code location. We introduce Agentic eXploit Engine (AXE), a multi-agent framework for Web application exploitation that maps lightweight detection metadata to concrete exploits through decoupled planning, code exploration, and dynamic execution feedback. Evaluated on the CVE-Bench dataset, AXE achieves a 30% exploitation success rate, a 3x improvement over state-of-the-art black-box baselines. Even in a single-agent configuration, grey-box metadata yields a 1.75x performance gain. Systematic error analysis shows that most failed attempts arise from specific reasoning gaps, including misinterpreted vulnerability semantics and unmet execution preconditions. For successful exploits, AXE produces actionable, reproducible proof-of-concept artifacts, demonstrating its utility in streamlining Web vulnerability triage and remediation. We further evaluate AXE's generalizability through a case study on a recent real-world vulnerability not included in CVE-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AXE（Agentic eXploit Engine），一个多智能体框架，用于在灰盒设置下利用Web漏洞。它仅需CWE分类和漏洞位置等最小元数据，通过解耦的规划、代码探索和动态执行反馈生成具体利用。在CVE-Bench数据集上，AXE达到30%的利用成功率，比最先进的黑盒基线提升3倍，单智能体配置下灰盒元数据带来1.75倍性能提升。
Motivation: 漏洞检测工具常产生大量误报和不可操作报告，现有自动利用系统与检测流程隔离，未能利用已有的检测元数据（如漏洞类型和位置）来提升确认效率。
Method: 引入Agentic eXploit Engine (AXE)，一种多智能体框架，通过三个解耦阶段工作：规划阶段制定利用策略，代码探索阶段分析源代码，动态执行阶段反馈结果，将轻量级漏洞元数据映射为具体利用。
Result: 在CVE-Bench数据集上，AXE实现30%的利用成功率，相比最先进黑盒基线提升3倍；单智能体配置下，灰盒元数据带来1.75倍性能提升。系统产生可复现的概念验证利用。
Conclusion: AXE可有效简化Web漏洞分类和修复流程，失败分析表明大多错误源于推理缺口，如误解漏洞语义或未满足执行前提。案例研究显示其对真实世界漏洞的泛化能力。

papers.title: ALOE: Action-Level Off-Policy Evaluation for Vision-Language-Action Model Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: We study how to improve large foundation vision-language-action (VLA) systems through human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (RL) in real-world environments. A key challenge is learning reliable value functions from heterogeneous real-world experience, as value estimation provides the primary learning signal for VLA training. In practice, replay buffers contain trajectories collected from historical policies, online rollouts, demonstrations, and intermittent human interventions. Because replay buffers mix trajectories generated by different behaviors, the observed returns can be mismatched with the quality of the current policy. Prior VLA post-training methods often rely on progress-style value signals, which reflect the average quality of historical behaviors, leading to mismatched learning signals for the current policy. In this paper, we propose ALOE, an off-policy evaluation framework whose value function directly evaluates current-policy behavior for each iteration. Specifically, ALOE combines chunked temporal-difference bootstrapping and conservative value aggregation to perform stable current-policy evaluation, then uses these estimates for advantage-weighted policy improvement. This design improves credit assignment to critical action chunks under sparse rewards and supports stable policy improvement. We evaluate ALOE on four real-world manipulation tasks encompassing long-horizon and high-precision scenarios: smartphone packing, laundry folding, multi-object sorting, and phone assembly. Across all tasks, ALOE outperforms other VLA post-training methods, highlighting the benefit of off-policy value estimates for real-world VLA post-training. Videos are available at our project website https://rooshy-yang.github.io/aloe.

papers.title: AIR: Improving Agent Safety through Incident Response
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in practice across a wide range of autonomous applications. Yet current safety mechanisms for LLM agents focus almost exclusively on preventing failures in advance, providing limited capabilities for responding to, containing, or recovering from incidents after they inevitably arise. In this work, we introduce AIR, the first incident response framework for LLM agent systems. AIR defines a domain-specific language for managing the incident response lifecycle autonomously in LLM agent systems, and integrates it into the agent's execution loop to (1) detect incidents via semantic checks grounded in the current environment state and recent context, (2) guide the agent to execute containment and recovery actions via its tools, and (3) synthesize guardrail rules during eradication to block similar incidents in future executions. We evaluate AIR on three representative agent types. Results show that AIR achieves detection, remediation, and eradication success rates all exceeding 90%. Extensive experiments further confirm the necessity of AIR's key design components, show the timeliness and moderate overhead of AIR, and demonstrate that LLM-generated rules can approach the effectiveness of developer-authored rules across domains. These results show that incident response is both feasible and essential as a first-class mechanism for improving agent safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AIR，首个面向LLM代理系统的应急响应框架，通过定义领域特定语言管理事件响应生命周期，并集成到代理执行循环中。摘要报告在三种代表性代理上检测、补救和根除成功率均超过90%。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理安全机制仅关注事前预防，缺乏事件响应、遏制和恢复能力。
Method: 定义领域特定语言，将其集成到代理执行循环中，实现基于环境状态的语义检测、通过工具执行遏制和恢复动作，以及在根除阶段合成防护栏规则。
Result: 在三种代理类型上检测、补救和根除成功率均超过90%，实验证明了关键设计组件的必要性、及时性和适度开销，且LLM生成的规则接近开发者编写规则的效果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调事件响应作为改善代理安全的一等机制是可行且必要的。

papers.title: ForeHOI: Feed-forward 3D Object Reconstruction from Daily Hand-Object Interaction Videos
papers.abstract_en: The ubiquity of monocular videos capturing daily hand-object interactions presents a valuable resource for embodied intelligence. While 3D hand reconstruction from in-the-wild videos has seen significant progress, reconstructing the involved objects remains challenging due to severe occlusions and the complex, coupled motion of the camera, hands, and object. In this paper, we introduce ForeHOI, a novel feed-forward model that directly reconstructs 3D object geometry from monocular hand-object interaction videos within one minute of inference time, eliminating the need for any pre-processing steps. Our key insight is that, the joint prediction of 2D mask inpainting and 3D shape completion in a feed-forward framework can effectively address the problem of severe occlusion in monocular hand-held object videos, thereby achieving results that outperform the performance of optimization-based methods. The information exchanges between the 2D and 3D shape completion boosts the overall reconstruction quality, enabling the framework to effectively handle severe hand-object occlusion. Furthermore, to support the training of our model, we contribute the first large-scale, high-fidelity synthetic dataset of hand-object interactions with comprehensive annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ForeHOI achieves state-of-the-art performance in object reconstruction, significantly outperforming previous methods with around a 100x speedup. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/Tao-11-chen/ForeHOI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ForeHOI，一种前馈模型，直接从日常手物交互单目视频中在三分钟内重建3D物体几何，无需预处理。关键思路是在前馈框架中联合预测2D掩膜修复和3D形状补全，有效处理严重遮挡，性能优于优化方法。贡献还包括首个大规模高保真手物交互合成数据集。实验表明，ForeHOI在物体重建上达到最先进水平，速度提升约100倍。
Motivation: 从单目手物交互视频中重建物体几何面临严重遮挡和相机-手-物体耦合运动问题，现有方法依赖优化，速度慢且效果有限。
Method: 提出前馈模型ForeHOI，联合预测2D掩膜修复和3D形状补全，通过信息交换提升重建质量，并利用合成数据集训练。
Result: 在物体重建任务上达到最先进性能，相比之前方法速度提升约100倍，推理时间约一分钟。
Conclusion: 前馈式联合2D-3D补全能有效处理单目手物视频中的严重遮挡，实现高效且高质量的3D物体重建。

papers.title: Scaling Small Agents Through Strategy Auctions
papers.abstract_en: Small language models are increasingly viewed as a promising, cost-effective approach to agentic AI, with proponents claiming they are sufficiently capable for agentic workflows. However, while smaller agents can closely match larger ones on simple tasks, it remains unclear how their performance scales with task complexity, when large models become necessary, and how to better leverage small agents for long-horizon workloads. In this work, we empirically show that small agents' performance fails to scale with task complexity on deep search and coding tasks, and we introduce Strategy Auctions for Workload Efficiency (SALE), an agent framework inspired by freelancer marketplaces. In SALE, agents bid with short strategic plans, which are scored by a systematic cost-value mechanism and refined via a shared auction memory, enabling per-task routing and continual self-improvement without training a separate router or running all models to completion. Across deep search and coding tasks of varying complexity, SALE reduces reliance on the largest agent by 52%, lowers overall cost by 35%, and consistently improves upon the largest agent's pass@1 with only a negligible overhead beyond executing the final trace. In contrast, established routers that rely on task descriptions either underperform the largest agent or fail to reduce cost, often both, underscoring their poor fit for agentic workflows. These results suggest that while small agents may be insufficient for complex workloads, they can be effectively "scaled up" through coordinated task allocation and test-time self-improvement. More broadly, they motivate a systems-level view of agentic AI in which performance gains come less from ever-larger individual models and more from market-inspired coordination mechanisms that organize heterogeneous agents into efficient, adaptive ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究小语言模型在复杂长周期任务中的性能扩展问题，发现小模型在深度搜索和编码任务上表现不足。提出策略拍卖（SALE）框架，让代理出价简短策略计划，通过成本-价值机制评分和共享拍卖记忆实现任务路由与持续自我改进。在相关任务上，SALE减少对最大代理依赖52%，降低总成本35%，并持续提升pass@1。
Motivation: 小型语言模型在简单任务上可接近大模型，但在复杂任务上性能扩展差，需要探索如何更有效地利用小代理处理长周期工作负载。
Method: 提出Strategy Auctions for Workload Efficiency (SALE)框架，代理以简短策略计划出价，由系统成本-价值机制评分，并通过共享拍卖记忆精炼，实现无需单独训练路由器的每任务路由和持续自我改进。
Result: 在深度搜索和编码任务上，SALE减少对最大代理依赖52%，降低总成本35%，持续提升最大代理的pass@1，且开销极小。
Conclusion: 小代理虽不足以处理复杂工作负载，但可通过协调分配和测试时自我改进有效“扩展”。表明代理AI性能提升更来自市场启发的协调机制而非更大单体模型。

papers.title: EPSVec: Efficient and Private Synthetic Data Generation via Dataset Vectors
papers.abstract_en: High-quality data is essential for modern machine learning, yet many valuable corpora are sensitive and cannot be freely shared. Synthetic data offers a practical substitute for downstream development, and large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful engines for generating it. However, existing private text generation methods are severely inefficient: they are data-intensive, computationally slow, and often require large private corpora or batch sizes to achieve usable quality. We introduce EPSVec, a differentially-private lightweight alternative that steers LLM generation using *dataset vectors*--directions in activation space that capture the distributional gap between private data and public priors. EPSVec extracts and sanitizes steering vectors just once and then performs standard decoding. This decouples the privacy budget from generation, enabling arbitrarily many synthetic samples without additional privacy cost and yielding strong fidelity even in low-data regimes. Furthermore, we enhance our method by utilizing pretrained (base) models and introducing fixed-shot prompting to boost generation diversity and fidelity. Our experiments demonstrate that EPSVec outperforms existing baselines in distributional alignment and downstream utility, particularly in low-data regimes, while significantly reducing computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EPSVec，一种基于数据集向量 (dataset vectors) 的差分隐私文本合成方法。它从私有数据中提取并净化激活空间中的方向向量，用于引导 LLM 生成，将隐私预算与生成过程解耦，从而在低数据量下仍能高效生成高质量合成文本。实验表明 EPSVec 在分布对齐和下游任务效用上优于现有基线，且计算开销显著降低。
Motivation: 现有的私有文本生成方法（如 DP-SGD）数据密集、计算慢，且需要大量私有数据或大批量才能达到可用质量，制约了隐私保护数据共享。
Method: EPSVec 使用数据集向量（激活空间中捕获私有数据与公共先验分布差异的方向）来引导 LLM 生成。仅需一次提取和净化向量，之后执行标准解码，从而将隐私成本与生成次数分离，并结合预训练模型与固定样本提示提升多样性与保真度。
Result: 在低数据量场景下，EPSVec 在分布对齐和下游效用上超越现有基线，同时大幅降低计算开销，可生成任意数量的合成样本而不增加隐私成本。
Conclusion: EPSVec 提供了一种高效、隐私低开销的合成文本生成方案，特别适用于私有数据稀缺的场景，但方法依赖 LLM 的激活空间表示，可能对模型架构敏感。

papers.title: Stabilizing Consistency Training: A Flow Map Analysis and Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Consistency models have been proposed for fast generative modeling, achieving results competitive with diffusion and flow models. However, these methods exhibit inherent instability and limited reproducibility when training from scratch, motivating subsequent work to explain and stabilize these issues. While these efforts have provided valuable insights, the explanations remain fragmented, and the theoretical relationships remain unclear. In this work, we provide a theoretical examination of consistency models by analyzing them from a flow map-based perspective. This joint analysis clarifies how training stability and convergence behavior can give rise to degenerate solutions. Building on these insights, we revisit self-distillation as a practical remedy for certain forms of suboptimal convergence and reformulate it to avoid excessive gradient norms for stable optimization. We demonstrate that our strategy extends beyond image generation to diffusion-based policy learning, without reliance on pretrained diffusion models for initialization, illustrating its broader applicability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过流图（flow map）视角对一致性模型（consistency models）进行理论分析，阐明训练不稳定性和退化收敛的根源。基于此，作者重新审视自蒸馏（self-distillation）作为实用补救措施，并重新公式化以避免梯度爆炸。该方法无需预训练扩散模型初始化，可扩展到图像生成和基于扩散的策略学习。
Motivation: 一致性模型从头训练时存在固有的不稳定性和有限的可重复性，现有解释碎片化且理论关系不清晰，缺乏系统性的理解。
Method: 从流图视角联合分析一致性模型的训练稳定性与收敛行为，推导出退化解产生的条件；在此基础上重新审视自蒸馏，通过调整梯度范数实现稳定优化。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，但声称该策略在图像生成和基于扩散的策略学习中均有效，且无需依赖预训练扩散模型。
Conclusion: 论文通过流图分析统一了对一致性模型不稳定性的理解，并证明自蒸馏是一种有效的稳定训练方法，具有超越图像生成的广泛适用性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Anytime Safe PAC Efficient Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on complex tasks but suffer from high computational costs and latency. While selective thinking strategies improve efficiency by routing easy queries to non-thinking models, existing approaches often incur uncontrollable errors, especially in online settings where the performance loss of a non-thinking model is only partially observed and data are non-stationary. To address this, we propose Betting Probably Approximately Correct (B-PAC) reasoning, a principled method that enables anytime safe and efficient online reasoning under partial feedback. Specifically, we utilize inverse propensity scoring estimators to construct test supermartingales for candidate thresholds, and then dynamically adjust the routing threshold based on the accumulated statistical evidence of safety. Theoretically, we establish the anytime-valid performance loss control and the efficiency of B-PAC reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that B-PAC reasoning significantly reduces computational overhead, decreasing thinking model usage by up to 81.01\%, while controlling the performance loss below the user-specified level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型推理模型（LRMs）在线推理的高计算成本与延迟问题，提出 Betting PAC (B-PAC) reasoning 方法，通过逆倾向得分估计器构建测试超鞅并动态调整路由阈值，在部分反馈下实现任意时间安全高效的路由。实验表明该方法可将思考模型使用率降低最多81.01%，同时将性能损失控制在用户指定水平以下。
Motivation: 现有选择性思考策略在在线设置中因非思考模型的性能损失部分观测且数据非平稳，导致不可控错误，缺乏理论保证的实时安全控制。
Method: 提出 B-PAC reasoning 框架，利用逆倾向得分估计器构造测试超鞅（test supermartingales）来评估候选阈值的安全性，并根据累积统计证据动态调整路由阈值。
Result: 该方法在多个任务上减少思考模型使用率达81.01%，且性能损失低于用户指定阈值。
Conclusion: B-PAC reasoning 为在线推理提供了一种有理论保证的任意时间安全高效方案，但方法聚焦于路由策略，未涉及模型本身的改进。

papers.title: Spark: Strategic Policy-Aware Exploration via Dynamic Branching for Long-Horizon Agentic Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has empowered large language models to act as intelligent agents, yet training them for long-horizon tasks remains challenging due to the scarcity of high-quality trajectories, especially under limited resources. Existing methods typically scale up rollout sizes and indiscriminately allocate computational resources among intermediate steps. Such attempts inherently waste substantial computation budget on trivial steps while failing to guarantee sample quality. To address this, we propose \textbf{Spark} (\textbf{S}trategic \textbf{P}olicy-\textbf{A}ware explo\textbf{R}ation via \textbf{K}ey-state dynamic branching), a novel framework that selectively branches at critical decision states for resource-efficient exploration. Our key insight is to activate adaptive branching exploration at critical decision points to probe promising trajectories, thereby achieving precise resource allocation that prioritizes sampling quality over blind coverage. This design leverages the agent's intrinsic decision-making signals to reduce dependence on human priors, enabling the agent to autonomously expand exploration and achieve stronger generalization. Experiments across diverse tasks (e.g., embodied planning), demonstrate that \textsc{Spark} achieves superior success rates with significantly fewer training samples, exhibiting robust generalization even in unseen scenarios. Our code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/jinyangwu/SPARK.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长程智能体学习中高质量轨迹稀缺和计算资源浪费的问题，提出Spark框架。该框架在关键决策状态进行动态分支探索，智能地分配计算资源，优先提升采样质量而非盲目覆盖。实验表明，Spark在具身规划等多样任务中以更少的训练样本实现了更高的成功率，并在未见场景中表现出鲁棒泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有方法在长程智能体学习中通常均匀分配计算资源于中间步骤，导致大量计算预算浪费在琐碎步骤上，且无法保证样本质量。需要一种资源高效的探索策略，在关键决策点进行选择性分支以获取高质量轨迹。
Method: 提出Spark框架，通过关键状态动态分支（strategic policy-aware exploration via key-state dynamic branching）实现。核心思想是在代理的决策信号引导下，于关键决策点自适应激活分支探索，从而精准分配资源，减少对人类先验的依赖，使代理自主扩展探索范围。
Result: 摘要报告在多种任务（如具身规划）上，Spark以显著更少的训练样本实现了更高的成功率，且在未见场景中展现出强泛化能力。
Conclusion: Spark通过优先采样质量而非覆盖范围，实现了资源高效的探索，为长程智能体训练提供了一种有效且鲁棒的方法。代码和检查点已公开。

papers.title: 360Anything: Geometry-Free Lifting of Images and Videos to 360°
papers.abstract_en: Lifting perspective images and videos to 360° panoramas enables immersive 3D world generation. Existing approaches often rely on explicit geometric alignment between the perspective and the equirectangular projection (ERP) space. Yet, this requires known camera metadata, obscuring the application to in-the-wild data where such calibration is typically absent or noisy. We propose 360Anything, a geometry-free framework built upon pre-trained diffusion transformers. By treating the perspective input and the panorama target simply as token sequences, 360Anything learns the perspective-to-equirectangular mapping in a purely data-driven way, eliminating the need for camera information. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on both image and video perspective-to-360° generation, outperforming prior works that use ground-truth camera information. We also trace the root cause of the seam artifacts at ERP boundaries to zero-padding in the VAE encoder, and introduce Circular Latent Encoding to facilitate seamless generation. Finally, we show competitive results in zero-shot camera FoV and orientation estimation benchmarks, demonstrating 360Anything's deep geometric understanding and broader utility in computer vision tasks. Additional results are available at https://360anything.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出360Anything，一种无几何约束的框架，基于预训练扩散Transformer，将透视图像/视频直接提升为360°全景，无需相机元数据。通过将输入和输出视为token序列，以纯数据驱动方式学习映射。引入Circular Latent Encoding解决ERP边界接缝伪影。在图像和视频生成任务上达到SOTA，且零样本相机FoV和方向估计表现有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖显式几何对齐和已知相机元数据，限制了在无校准数据上的应用。本文旨在消除对相机信息的需求，实现更通用的360°全景生成。
Method: 基于预训练扩散Transformer，将透视输入和全景目标视为token序列，以数据驱动方式学习映射。提出Circular Latent Encoding，通过修改VAE编码器中的零填充来消除ERP边界接缝伪影。
Result: 在图像和视频透视到360°生成上达到SOTA，超越使用真实相机信息的方法。在零样本相机FoV和方向估计基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
Conclusion: 证明无几何方法可有效生成360°全景，并隐含地学习了几何理解能力，可泛化到其他视觉任务。

papers.title: Hierarchical Sparse Circuit Extraction from Billion-Parameter Language Models through Scalable Attribution Graph Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Extracting sparse circuits from billion-parameter transformers is constrained by $O(2^n)$ search cost and pervasive feature reuse across co-active pathways. Hierarchical Attribution Graph Decomposition (HAGD) addresses this through four stages: cross-layer transcoder training, spectral coarsening of attribution graphs, graph-neural-network (GNN)-guided hierarchical traversal, and causal intervention verification, reducing worst-case complexity to $O(n^2 \log n)$. Per-layer transcoders trained on the RedPajama corpus yield monosemantic dictionaries; gradient-activation products form weighted attribution graphs; normalized-Laplacian spectral clustering builds multi-resolution hierarchies; an attention-based GNN assigns circuit-membership scores at successive coarsening stages. Evaluation spans GPT-2 (117M-774M), Pythia (1.4B-6.9B), and Llama (7B-70B) across modular arithmetic, parity computation, integer sorting, coreference resolution (WinoGrande), commonsense reasoning (HellaSwag), and factual recall. Behavioral preservation reaches 91\% ($\pm$2.3\%) on modular arithmetic with 49-347-node circuits, while ACDC exhausts memory beyond 1.4B parameters. Cross-architecture transfer coefficients span 0.38-0.82, with within-family pairs (Llama-7B $\to$ Llama-70B) attaining 0.82. Limitations include omitted attention-head circuits, 15-20\% unexplained reconstruction variance, ablation-based validation circularity, and uncertain interpretability of circuits exceeding several hundred nodes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分层归因图分解（HAGD）方法，用于从数十亿参数的语言模型中提取稀疏电路。该方法通过跨层编码器训练、谱粗化、GNN引导的分层遍历和因果干预验证四个阶段，将最坏复杂度降至O(n² log n)。在GPT-2、Pythia和Llama系列模型上评估，覆盖模块算术、奇偶校验、排序、共指消解、常识推理和事实回忆等任务，行为保留率达91%（±2.3%），但存在注意力头电路遗漏、重建方差未解释、验证循环性等局限。
Motivation: 现有方法在提取十亿参数Transformer的稀疏电路时面临O(2^n)搜索代价和特征复用问题，难以扩展到大规模模型。
Method: HAGD包含四阶段：跨层编码器训练（在RedPajama语料上获得单语义字典）、梯度-激活乘积构建加权归因图、归一化拉普拉斯谱聚类建立多分辨率层次、基于注意力的GNN在逐次粗化阶段分配电路成员分数。
Result: 在1.4B-70B参数模型上，模块算术任务以49-347节点电路实现91%（±2.3%）行为保留，而ACDC方法在超过1.4B参数时耗尽内存。跨架构迁移系数为0.38-0.82，同族（Llama-7B→Llama-70B）达0.82。
Conclusion: HAGD可扩展至70B参数模型，但存在注意力头电路遗漏、15-20%重建方差未解释、基于消融的验证循环性以及超过数百节点电路的可解释性不确定等局限。

papers.title: DP-FedSOFIM: Differentially Private Federated Stochastic Optimization using Regularized Fisher Information Matrix
papers.abstract_en: Differentially private federated learning (DP-FL) often suffers from slow convergence under tight privacy budgets because the noise required for privacy preservation degrades gradient quality. Although second-order optimization can accelerate training, existing approaches for DP-FL face significant scalability limitations: Newton-type methods require clients to compute Hessians, while feature covariance methods scale poorly with model dimension. We propose DP-FedSOFIM, a simple and scalable Hessian approximation-based second-order optimization method for DP-FL. The method constructs a regularized proxy for the Fisher information matrix at the server using only privatized aggregated gradients, capturing useful curvature information without requiring full Hessian computations or feature covariance estimation. Efficient rank-one updates based on the Sherman-Morrison formula enable communication costs proportional to the model size and require only O(d) client-side memory. Because all curvature and preconditioning operations are performed at the server on already privatized gradients, DP-FedSOFIM introduces no additional privacy cost beyond the underlying privatized gradient release mechanism. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and PathMNIST demonstrate that DP-FedSOFIM converges faster and consistently achieves higher accuracy than several competitive differentially private federated learning baselines across a wide range of privacy budgets.
papers.comment: 59 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. Accepted to TMLR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于差分隐私联邦学习（DP-FL）的二阶优化方法DP-FedSOFIM，通过使用正则化Fisher信息矩阵（Fisher information matrix）的代理，仅利用隐私聚合梯度构建曲率信息，避免完整Hessian计算。基于Sherman-Morrison公式的秩一更新实现与模型大小成比例的通信开销和O(d)客户端内存。实验表明在CIFAR-10和PathMNIST上，该方法在多种隐私预算下收敛更快且精度更高。
Motivation: 差分隐私联邦学习在严格隐私预算下因噪声导致梯度质量下降、收敛缓慢；现有二阶方法存在需客户端计算Hessian或特征协方差方法扩展性差的问题。
Method: 在服务器端利用已隐私化的聚合梯度构建正则化Fisher信息矩阵代理，通过Sherman-Morrison公式进行秩一更新，所有曲率和预条件操作均在服务器端完成，不增加额外隐私成本。
Result: 在CIFAR-10和PathMNIST数据集上，DP-FedSOFIM在多种隐私预算下比多个差分隐私联邦学习基线收敛更快且精度更高。
Conclusion: DP-FedSOFIM提供了一种可扩展、通信高效的二阶方法，在不增加隐私成本的情况下加速DP-FL训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One Interaction Is Worth a Thousand Guesses: Benchmarking the Interactive Capabilities of Deep Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: Deep research agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) can perform multi-step reasoning, web exploration, and long-form report generation. However, existing systems remain largely autonomous, assuming fully specified user intent and evaluating only final outputs. In practice, research goals are often underspecified and evolve during exploration, yet current benchmarks neither model dynamic user feedback nor measure interaction costs. To address this gap, we introduce IDRBench, the first Interactive Deep Research Benchmark for systematically evaluating the interactive capabilities of deep research agents. IDRBench formulates deep research as an interactive process where agents may solicit clarification to better align with user intent. It integrates a modular interactive framework, a scalable reference-grounded user simulator, and an interaction-aware evaluation suite that jointly measures alignment gains and interaction overhead. Experiments on seven representative proprietary and open-weight LLMs show that interaction consistently improves research quality and robustness, while revealing substantial differences in interaction efficiency across models. These findings establish interactive capability as a distinct evaluation dimension and position IDRBench as a reusable benchmark for future user-aligned deep research agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IDRBench，第一个用于系统评估深度研究代理交互能力的基准。IDRBench将深度研究建模为交互过程，代理可通过询问澄清来对齐用户意图，并集成了模块化交互框架、参考基础用户模拟器和交互感知评估套件。实验表明交互能持续提升研究质量和鲁棒性，但不同模型的交互效率存在显著差异。
Motivation: 现有深度研究系统多假设完全指定的用户意图，仅评估最终输出，忽略了实际中研究目标常未明确且随探索演变的情况，缺乏对动态用户反馈和交互成本的衡量。
Method: 提出IDRBench，包含一个模块化交互框架、一个可扩展的参考基础用户模拟器，以及一个联合衡量对齐增益和交互开销的交互感知评估套件。
Result: 在7个代表性的专有和开源大语言模型上实验，表明交互一致地提升了研究质量和鲁棒性，同时揭示了不同模型在交互效率上的显著差异。
Conclusion: 交互能力应作为独立的评估维度，IDRBench可作为未来用户对齐深度研究代理的可复用基准。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有深度研究系统多假设完全指定的用户意图，仅评估最终输出，忽略了实际中研究目标常未明确且随探索演变的情况，缺乏对动态用户反馈和交互成本的衡量。
summary_sections.method: 提出IDRBench，包含一个模块化交互框架、一个可扩展的参考基础用户模拟器，以及一个联合衡量对齐增益和交互开销的交互感知评估套件。
summary_sections.result: 在7个代表性的专有和开源大语言模型上实验，表明交互一致地提升了研究质量和鲁棒性，同时揭示了不同模型在交互效率上的显著差异。
summary_sections.conclusion: 交互能力应作为独立的评估维度，IDRBench可作为未来用户对齐深度研究代理的可复用基准。

papers.title: From Unstructured Data to Demand Counterfactuals: Theory and Practice
papers.abstract_en: Empirical models of multi-product demand rely on low-dimensional product representations to capture substitution patterns, increasingly using proxies built from unstructured data. When proxies are imperfect, standard workflows yield biased counterfactuals and invalid inference. We develop a practical toolkit to address these issues. Our methods apply to market-level and/or individual data, require minimal additional computation, provide simple standard-error formulas, and accommodate proxies from fine-tuned models. Further, we propose diagnostics to assess proxy quality. Our methods yield meaningful improvements in predicting substitution in empirically calibrated simulations and in an application where we assess counterfactual prediction performance against a ground truth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多产品需求模型中非结构化数据代理变量不完美导致的反事实偏差和无效推断问题，开发了一套实用工具包，适用于市场级和个体数据，提供简单的标准误公式，兼容微调模型代理，并设计了代理质量诊断方法。通过经验校准模拟和真实应用验证，该方法在预测替代模式上带来有意义的改进。
Motivation: 现有经验需求模型依赖低维产品表示和从非结构化数据构建的代理变量，但代理变量不完美时常规流程会产生有偏的反事实估计和无效推断。
Method: 提出一个实用工具包，包含处理代理变量误差的估计方法、简单的标准误公式、诊断代理质量的统计量，并支持微调模型生成的代理变量，所需额外计算极小。
Result: 在经验校准模拟中显著改善替代模式预测；在可对照真实反事实的应用中，反事实预测性能优于常规方法。
Conclusion: 该工具包能有效纠正非结构化数据代理变量的误差，提升需求模型反事实推断的可靠性，但适用范围限于多产品需求设定。
