papers.title: ATLAS: Verifier-Guided Adaptive Latent Activation Steering for Efficient LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Recent work on activation and latent steering has demonstrated that modifying internal representations can effectively guide large language models (LLMs) toward improved reasoning and efficiency without updating model parameters. However, most existing approaches rely on fixed steering policies and static intervention strengths, which limit their robustness across problem instances and often result in over- or under-steering. We propose Adaptive Test-time Latent Steering (ATLAS), a lightweight framework that dynamically controls steering decisions at inference time using a trained, lightweight verifier over the latent states. Given intermediate hidden states, the verifier predicts the quality of ongoing reasoning and adaptively selects which steering action to apply, enabling per-example and per-step adjustment with minimal overhead. ATLAS provides a unified framework for combining learned latent verification with test-time activation steering, enabling adaptive reasoning control without additional LLM decoding or inference-time process reward model calls. Experiments on multiple mathematical and coding reasoning benchmarks show that ATLAS consistently outperforms both vanilla decoding and fixed steering baselines, achieving higher accuracy while substantially reducing test-time token usage. These results demonstrate that verifier-guided latent adaptation provides an effective and scalable mechanism for controlling reasoning efficiency without sacrificing solution quality. All source code will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ATLAS框架，利用轻量级验证器在推理时动态调节LLM的潜在激活操控，以提高推理效率并减少token使用。在数学和代码推理基准上，ATLAS相比固定操控基线和标准解码实现了更高的准确率和更低的推理成本。
Motivation: 现有激活操控方法依赖固定策略和静态干预强度，难以适应不同问题实例，导致过度或不足操控。
Method: ATLAS在推理过程中使用一个训练好的轻量级验证器，根据中间隐状态预测推理质量，并自适应地选择操控动作，实现每样本每步的调整，无需额外解码或过程奖励模型。
Result: 在多个数学和代码推理基准上，ATLAS一致优于标准解码和固定操控基线，在提升准确率的同时显著降低测试时token使用量。
Conclusion: 验证器引导的潜在适应为控制推理效率提供了有效且可扩展的机制，且不牺牲解答质量。

papers.title: Exact and Approximate Range Queries for Efficient Ball Mapper Construction
papers.abstract_en: Ball Mapper is a tool in topological data analysis that summarizes a finite metric dataset by covering it with metric balls and encoding their overlaps as a graph. Its construction requires repeated fixed-radius range queries, which can become computationally expensive for large or high-dimensional datasets. This work studies two approaches to accelerating this step: ball tree data structures, which use metric-space pruning, and the FAISS library, which uses optimized similarity-search routines for dense vectors. We distinguish between exact acceleration, where the range sets are preserved, and approximate search, where ball memberships may change. For approximate range queries, we formulate deterministic additive and multiplicative error models and show how these errors affect the covering radius, landmark separation, and graph structure of Ball Mapper. We then evaluate several FAISS index configurations on synthetic datasets with different geometries. The experiments show that the tested approximate indexes behave conservatively. They remove ball memberships and graph edges but do not introduce false-positive memberships or spurious edges. The severity of these effects depends strongly on dataset geometry, with the isotropic Gaussian dataset being more sensitive than clustered or low-dimensional structured data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Ball Mapper（拓扑数据分析工具）构建中固定半径范围查询的加速方法，分别使用ball tree（精确加速）和FAISS（近似加速）。对于近似查询，提出加性和乘性误差模型，并分析误差对覆盖半径、地标分离和图结构的影响。实验表明近似索引行为保守，只移除球成员和边而不引入假阳性，且影响程度依赖于数据几何，各向同性高斯数据更敏感。
Motivation: Ball Mapper构建需要重复进行固定半径范围查询，在大或高维数据集上计算开销大，亟需加速。
Method: 采用ball tree数据结构的精确加速和FAISS库的近似加速；对于近似范围查询，形式化定义了加性和乘性误差模型，并理论分析误差对Ball Mapper覆盖半径、地标分离和图结构的影响。
Result: 实验显示，测试的近似索引行为保守：它们会移除球成员和图中的边，但不会引入假阳性成员或虚假边。影响严重程度强烈依赖于数据集几何，各向同性高斯数据集比聚类或低维结构化数据更敏感。
Conclusion: 本文系统研究了Ball Mapper中范围查询的精确与近似加速方法，并揭示了近似误差对输出结构的影响规律，但未涉及具体应用领域。

papers.title: Enhancing Diversity of LLM-Generated Educational Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown the potential for generating educational content at scale, assisting educators in creating practice tasks or synthesizing data for training educational models. However, LLMs suffer from the ``Artificial Hivemind'' effect, where they produce homogeneous content. This homogeneity limits the diversity of LLM-generated tasks, a crucial factor in these educational settings. In this paper, we investigate how to increase the diversity of generated tasks while keeping their utility high. Inspired by the divergent--convergent thinking stages in creativity literature, we propose a prompting framework with two reasoning stages: (1) exploring the creative space, and (2) satisfying the input requirements. We evaluate CreativeDC, a method instantiated from this framework in the domain of Python programming, using both automated metrics and expert evaluation. Results show that CreativeDC produces significantly more distinct high-utility tasks (about $1.6\times$) than baselines. Our work offers an effective approach for generating and evaluating more diverse tasks at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）生成教育任务时的同质化问题，受创造力理论中发散-收敛思维启发，提出两阶段提示框架CreativeDC。第一阶段探索创意空间，第二阶段满足输入约束。在Python编程任务上，自动指标和专家评估表明，CreativeDC生成的高效用任务数量约为基线方法的1.6倍，显著提升了任务多样性。
Motivation: LLM生成的教育任务存在“人工蜂群思维”效应，导致内容同质化，限制了任务多样性，而多样性对教育实践和数据合成至关重要。
Method: 提出CreativeDC方法，基于发散-收敛两阶段推理：第一阶段鼓励模型探索多样化的创意空间，第二阶段聚焦于满足具体输入需求，平衡多样性与任务效用。
Result: 在Python编程领域，自动多样化度量和专家评估均显示，CreativeDC生成的高效用任务数量约为基线方法的1.6倍，且任务质量保持较高水平。
Conclusion: 该工作为大规模生成和评估多样化教育内容提供了有效框架，可在不损失效用前提下显著提升生成任务的多样性。

papers.title: Sparse Neuron Ablation Triggers Catastrophic Collapse of the Language Core in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown impressive multimodal understanding capabilities, yet the structures that sustain their functionality remain poorly understood from a mechanistic interpretability standpoint. We propose Consistently Activated Neurons (CAN), a progressive neuron ablation method to identify critical neurons whose removal triggers catastrophic collapse, and use it to investigate structural vulnerabilities in representative 7B LVLMs. Experiments reveal that catastrophic collapse can be triggered by ablating as few as four neurons in \texttt{LLaVA-1.5-7b-hf} and a few thousand in \texttt{InstructBLIP-vicuna-7b}, both representing a small fraction of model parameters. Notably, critical neurons are predominantly localized in the language model, particularly in its down-projection layer, rather than in the vision components. We also observe a consistent two-stage collapse pattern: initial expressive degradation followed by sudden, complete collapse. These findings reveal that LVLM functionality depends on a sparse subset of neurons concentrated in the language backbone, offering mechanistic insights into how their functionality is structured and where these models are most vulnerable.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一致性激活神经元（Consistently Activated Neurons, CAN）方法，通过渐进式神经元消融研究大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的结构脆弱性。实验表明，在LLaVA-1.5-7b-hf中消融少至4个神经元即可引发灾难性崩溃，且关键神经元主要集中在语言模型的下投影层，而非视觉组件。
Motivation: 尽管LVLMs展示了强大的多模态理解能力，但其功能维持的结构基础从机械可解释性角度仍不清楚。
Method: 提出CAN（Consistently Activated Neurons）渐进式神经元消融方法，识别导致灾难性崩溃的关键神经元。
Result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7b-hf中消融4个神经元、在InstructBLIP-vicuna-7b中消融数千个神经元即可触发灾难性崩溃；关键神经元主要位于语言模型的下投影层；观察到先表达退化后完全崩溃的两阶段模式。
Conclusion: LVLMs的功能依赖于语言骨干中稀疏的神经元子集，揭示了其功能结构的机械可解释性及模型脆弱性所在。

papers.title: DASIP: Dynamic Test-Time Compute Scaling for Robot Control with Stochastic Interpolant Policies
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion- and flow-based policies deliver state-of-the-art performance on long-horizon robotic manipulation and imitation learning tasks. However, these controllers employ a fixed inference budget at every control step, regardless of task complexity, leading to computational inefficiency for simple subtasks while potentially underperforming on challenging ones. To address these issues, we introduce Difficulty-Aware Stochastic Interpolant Policy (DA-SIP), a framework that enables robotic controllers to adaptively adjust their integration horizon in real time based on task difficulty. Our approach employs a difficulty classifier that analyzes observations to dynamically select the step budget, the optimal solver variant, and ODE/SDE integration at each control cycle. DA-SIP builds upon the stochastic interpolant formulation to provide a unified framework that unlocks diverse training and inference configurations for diffusion- and flow-based policies. Through comprehensive benchmarks across diverse manipulation tasks, DA-SIP achieves 2.6-4.4x reduction in total computation time while maintaining task success rates comparable to fixed maximum-computation baselines. By implementing adaptive computation within this framework, DA-SIP transforms generative robot controllers into efficient, task-aware systems that intelligently allocate inference resources where they provide the greatest benefit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出难度感知随机插值策略（DA-SIP），使基于扩散/流的机器人策略能够根据任务难度实时自适应调整积分步长、求解器类型和ODE/SDE模式。在多种操作任务上，DA-SIP在保持与固定最大计算基线相当的成功率的同时，将总计算时间减少2.6-4.4倍。
Motivation: 现有扩散/流策略在每一步使用固定推理预算，忽略任务复杂性差异，导致简单子任务计算浪费而困难子任务可能计算不足。
Method: 引入难度分类器，基于观测动态选择步数预算、最优求解器变体和ODE/SDE积分方式，并利用随机插值公式统一训练和推理配置。
Result: 在多种操作任务基准上，DA-SIP实现总计算时间降低2.6-4.4倍，任务成功率与固定最大计算基线相当。
Conclusion: 自适应计算将生成式机器人控制器转化为高效、任务感知的系统，智能地分配推理资源到最需要的地方。

summary_sections.method: 引入难度分类器，基于观测动态选择步数预算、最优求解器变体和ODE/SDE积分方式，并利用随机插值公式统一训练和推理配置。
summary_sections.result: 在多种操作任务基准上，DA-SIP实现总计算时间降低2.6-4.4倍，任务成功率与固定最大计算基线相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: 自适应计算将生成式机器人控制器转化为高效、任务感知的系统，智能地分配推理资源到最需要的地方。

papers.title: NOEM$^{3}$A: a Neuro-symbolic Ontology-Enhanced Method for Multi-intent understanding in Mobile Agents
papers.abstract_en: Mobile agents must map natural-language requests to executable intents under tight latency and privacy constraints. Scaling the language model is often an inefficient way to improve this component. We present NOEM$^{3}$A, a lightweight neuro-symbolic layer that augments compact language models with an intent ontology. For each query, NOEM$^{3}$A retrieves a small ontology neighborhood, injects candidate action labels into the prompt and applies a token-level decoding prior toward valid labels. This injects symbolic intent structure into both input and output representations while keeping inference suitable for local interaction. We also use Semantic Intent Similarity (SIS), a hierarchy-aware diagnostic based on ontology depth, to capture semantic proximity when predicted intents differ lexically. Experiments on MultiWOZ 2.3 dialogues show that ontology augmentation consistently improves TinyLlama and Llama-3.2-3B on exact match and Slot-F1. Our results suggest that symbolic alignment is an effective strategy for accurate, responsive and privacy-preserving on-device NLU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NOEM$^{3}$A，一种轻量级神经符号方法，通过意图本体增强紧凑语言模型，实现移动代理中的多意图理解。方法检索本体邻域并将候选标签注入提示，配合令牌级解码先验，提升精确匹配和Slot-F1。在MultiWOZ 2.3数据集上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 移动代理需在低延迟、隐私约束下将自然语言映射为可执行意图，单纯扩大语言模型不够高效，亟需轻量级符号引导方法。
Method: 构建意图本体，对查询检索邻近子图，将候选动作标签拼入提示，并应用令牌级解码偏置以限制输出为合法标签。
Result: 在MultiWOZ 2.3上，TinyLlama和Llama-3.2-3B的精确匹配和Slot-F1均有提升，表明符号对齐对端侧NLU有效。
Conclusion: 符号对齐能在紧凑模型上实现准确、低延迟且保护隐私的意图理解，适合移动设备本地推理。

papers.title: OmniNWM: Omniscient Driving Navigation World Models
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving world models are expected to work effectively across three core dimensions: state, action, and reward. However, existing methods are typically restricted to fragmented modality modeling, short-horizon drift, and imprecise action control, while lacking intrinsic mechanisms for policy evaluation. In this paper, we introduce OmniNWM, an Omniscient panoramic Navigation World Model that addresses all three dimensions within a consistent probabilistic framework. For State, OmniNWM generates panoramic videos of RGB, semantics, metric depth, and 3D occupancy, ensuring pixel-level alignment across modalities with joint distribution modeling. To mitigate autoregressive exposure bias, we propose a structured panoramic forcing strategy to stabilize long-horizon generation via stochastic manifold thickening. For Action, we introduce canonical geometric action encoding with normalized panoramic Plücker ray-maps. This representation decouples motion dynamics from sensor intrinsics, enabling precise, zero-shot trajectory control across heterogeneous datasets and camera configurations. For Reward, we derive intrinsic occupancy-grounded dense rewards directly from generated 3D volumes, establishing a reliable closed-loop simulation cycle for evaluating diverse planning agents. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniNWM achieves SOTA performance in generation fidelity and control precision, with remarkable zero-shot robustness to novel scenes on NuPlan and in-house datasets with distinct camera rigs. Project page is available at https://arlo0o.github.io/OmniNWM/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniNWM，一个全知全景导航世界模型，在状态、动作、奖励三个核心维度上构建一致的概率框架。状态方面生成 RGB、语义、深度和 3D 占用的全景视频，实现像素级跨模态对齐；动作方面引入正则几何动作编码与全景 Plücker 射线图，实现跨数据集和相机配置的零样本轨迹控制；奖励方面从生成的 3D 体积中导出内在占用密集奖励，形成闭环仿真周期。实验在 NuPlan 和内部数据集上达到生成保真度和控制精度的当前最优。
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶世界模型通常局限于碎片化的模态建模、短视漂移和不精确的动作控制，且缺乏用于策略评估的内在奖励机制。
Method: 提出一致的概率框架：状态通过联合分布建模多模态全景视频（RGB、语义、深度、3D 占用）；采用结构化全景强制策略（structured panoramic forcing）减轻自回归暴露偏差；动作以正则几何动作编码和归一化全景 Plücker 射线图表示，解耦运动动力学与传感器内参；奖励直接从生成的 3D 体积中导出内在占用密集奖励。
Result: 在 NuPlan 和内部数据集上的实验表明，OmniNWM 在生成保真度和控制精度上达到当前最优，并在不同相机配置下展现出零样本鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该模型统一了状态、动作和奖励三个维度，为自动驾驶世界模型提供了一致的概率框架，并支持基于生成内容的闭环策略评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Discrete State Diffusion Models: A Sample Complexity Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable performance in generating high-dimensional samples across domains such as vision, language, and the sciences. Although continuous-state diffusion models have been extensively studied both empirically and theoretically, discrete-state diffusion models, essential for applications involving text, sequences, and combinatorial structures, remain significantly less understood from a theoretical standpoint. In particular, all existing analyses of discrete-state models assume score estimation error bounds without studying sample complexity results. In this work, we present a principled theoretical framework for discrete-state diffusion, providing the first sample complexity bound of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-2})$. Our structured decomposition of the score estimation error into statistical, approximation, optimization, and clipping components offers critical insights into how discrete-state models can be trained efficiently. This analysis addresses a fundamental gap in the literature and establishes the theoretical tractability and practical relevance of discrete-state diffusion models.

papers.title: Gradual Capacity Growth for Sparse Network Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Sparse neural network methods typically assume that the target sparsity (or density) is fixed in advance, even though the relationship between network capacity and performance is generally unknown and task-dependent. Existing approaches (including iterative pruning, dynamic sparse training, and pruning at initialization) either rely on dense pretraining, incur substantial retraining cost, or require a preset sparsity budget. We propose Gradual Capacity Growth (GCG), a constructive sparse-to-dense training framework that allocates network capacity progressively during training. Starting from a sparse seed network, GCG grows new connections in stages using PathGrow, a probabilistic path-based growth rule that biases additions toward high-signal input-output pathways while preserving structural diversity. Growth is interleaved with limited training, and a lightweight performance-density extrapolation rule is used to estimate the smallest density beyond which further capacity increases yield diminishing accuracy gains. Experiments on CIFAR, TinyImageNet, and ImageNet show that GCG efficiently identifies sparse networks that achieve near-dense performance at moderate densities, without requiring dense pretraining or exhaustive retraining at each sparsity level. While growth-only methods do not reach the extreme sparsity achievable by pruning or dynamic reallocation techniques, GCG substantially reduces total training cost compared to iterative magnitude pruning and provides a practical mechanism for exploring the accuracy-density tradeoff under limited optimization budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出渐增容量增长（Gradual Capacity Growth, GCG）框架，从稀疏种子网络出发，通过概率路径生长规则（PathGrow）逐步添加连接，并利用轻量级性能-密度外推规则自动确定停止密度。在CIFAR、TinyImageNet、ImageNet上，GCG在无需密集预训练或逐密度重训练的情况下，高效发现中等密度下性能接近密集模型的稀疏网络。
Motivation: 现有稀疏网络方法需预设目标稀疏度或依赖密集预训练，而网络容量与性能的关系未知且任务相关，缺乏在不预知最优密度下高效探索精度-密度权衡的机制。
Method: 提出GCG：从稀疏种子网络开始，采用PathGrow规则（偏向高信号输入-输出路径并保持结构多样性的概率性路径生长）逐步增加连接；生长阶段与有限训练交替进行；通过性能-密度外推规则估计最小有效密度。
Result: 在CIFAR、TinyImageNet、ImageNet上，GCG无需密集预训练或逐密度重训练，在中等密度下达到接近密集模型的准确率，且总训练成本显著低于迭代幅度剪枝。
Conclusion: GCG为有限优化预算下探索精度-密度权衡提供了实用方法，但纯生长方法无法达到剪枝或动态重分配技术所能实现的极端稀疏性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: QAMO: Quality-aware Multi-centroid One-class Learning For Speech Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Recent work shows that one-class learning can detect unseen deepfake attacks by modeling a compact distribution of bona fide speech around a single centroid. However, the single-centroid assumption can oversimplify the bona fide speech representation and overlook useful cues, such as speech quality, which reflects the naturalness of the speech. Speech quality can be easily obtained using existing speech quality assessment models that estimate it through Mean Opinion Score. In this paper, we propose QAMO: Quality-Aware Multi-Centroid One-Class Learning for speech deepfake detection. QAMO extends conventional one-class learning by introducing multiple quality-aware centroids. In QAMO, each centroid is optimized to represent a distinct speech quality subspaces, enabling better modeling of intra-class variability in bona fide speech. In addition, QAMO supports a multi-centroid ensemble scoring strategy, which improves decision thresholding and reduces the need for quality labels during inference. With two centroids to represent high- and low-quality speech, our proposed QAMO achieves an equal error rate of 5.09% in In-the-Wild dataset, outperforming previous one-class and quality-aware systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QAMO，一种质量感知的多质心一类学习方法用于语音深伪检测。通过引入多个质心表示不同语音质量子空间，更好地建模真实语音的类内变化，并利用多质心集成评分策略改善决策阈值。在In-the-Wild数据集上达到5.09%的等错误率，优于之前的一类学习和质量感知系统。
Motivation: 现有的一类学习使用单质心假设过于简化真实语音表示，且忽略了语音质量（如自然度）等有用线索。语音质量可通过现有评估模型轻松获得（如MOS分）。
Method: 提出多质心一类学习（QAMO），每个质心优化代表不同的语音质量子空间；引入多质心集成评分策略，减少推理时对质量标签的依赖。
Result: 在In-the-Wild数据集上，使用高、低质量两个质心，QAMO达到5.09%的等错误率，优于先前的一类学习和质量感知系统。
Conclusion: QAMO通过多质心建模真实语音的类内可变性，有效提升了深伪检测性能，并降低了对质量标签的依赖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Circuit realization and hardware linearization of monotone operator equilibrium networks
papers.abstract_en: It is shown that the port behavior of a resistor-diode network corresponds to the solution of a ReLU monotone operator equilibrium network (a neural network in the limit of infinite depth), giving a parsimonious construction of a neural network in analog hardware. We furthermore show that the gradient of such a circuit can be computed directly in hardware, using a procedure we call hardware linearization. This allows the network to be trained in hardware, which we demonstrate with a device-level circuit simulation. We extend the results to cascades of resistor-diode networks, which can be used to implement feedforward and other asymmetric networks. We finally show that different nonlinear elements give rise to different activation functions, and introduce the novel diode ReLU which is induced by a non-ideal diode model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明电阻-二极管网络的端口行为对应于ReLU单调算子均衡网络（无限深度极限下的神经网络）的解，从而给出了一种用模拟硬件构建神经网络的简洁方法。此外，作者展示了可以直接在硬件中计算该电路的梯度（称为硬件线性化），使得网络可以在硬件中训练，并通过器件级电路模拟进行了演示。结果扩展到电阻-二极管网络的级联，可用于实现前馈和其他非对称网络。最后，不同的非线性元件产生不同的激活函数，并引入由非理想二极管模型诱导的新型二极管ReLU。
Motivation: 寻找一种简洁的模拟硬件实现神经网络的方法，并实现硬件内训练。
Method: 使用电阻-二极管网络实现ReLU单调算子均衡网络，并提出了硬件线性化过程来计算梯度，实现硬件内训练。
Result: 通过器件级电路模拟验证了硬件内训练的有效性，并将方法扩展到级联网络，引入二极管ReLU等新型激活函数。
Conclusion: 本文为单调算子均衡网络提供了简洁的电路实现，并展示了硬件线性化训练的可能性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Graph Alignment via Dual-Pass Spectral Encoding and Latent Space Communication
papers.abstract_en: Graph alignment, the problem of identifying corresponding nodes across multiple graphs, is fundamental to numerous applications. Most existing unsupervised methods embed node features into latent representations to enable cross-graph comparison without ground-truth correspondences. However, these methods suffer from two critical limitations: the degradation of node distinctiveness due to oversmoothing in GNN-based embeddings, and the misalignment of latent spaces across graphs caused by structural noise, feature heterogeneity, and training instability, ultimately leading to unreliable node correspondences. We propose a novel framework employing a dual-pass encoder to inject high-frequency discriminability into node features, paired with a geometry-aware functional map module that learns bijective and isometric transformations to align latent spaces while acting as a low-pass filter on correspondences, enforcing smoothness and robustness as a structural prior in map space. Extensive experiments on graph benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing unsupervised alignment baselines, exhibiting superior robustness to structural inconsistencies and challenging alignment scenarios. The implementation is available at https://github.com/maysambehmanesh/GADL.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督图对齐框架，通过双通道谱编码增强节点特征的区分性，并利用几何感知功能映射模块对齐潜在空间，在多个基准测试上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有无监督图对齐方法面临两个关键局限：GNN嵌入的过度平滑导致节点区分性下降，以及结构噪声、特征异质性和训练不稳定引起的潜在空间错位。
Method: 提出双通道编码器注入高频判别信息，结合几何感知功能映射模块学习双射等距变换以对齐潜在空间，同时在对应空间充当低通滤波器，强制平滑性和鲁棒性作为结构先验。
Result: 在图基准测试中，该方法一致优于现有无监督对齐基线，对结构不一致和具有挑战性的对齐场景表现出更强的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该框架通过联合高频特征注入与几何对齐，有效解决了图对齐中的区分性和空间错位问题，但主要针对图结构数据，与天气预测等领域无直接关联。

papers.title: The Efficiency Frontier: Classical Shadows versus Direct Quantum Measurement
papers.abstract_en: Interfacing quantum and classical processors is an important subroutine in full-stack quantum algorithms. The so-called ``classical shadow'' method efficiently extracts essential classical information from quantum states, enabling the prediction of many properties of a quantum system from only a few measurements. However, for a small number of highly non-local observables, or when classical post-processing power is limited, the classical shadow method is not always the most efficient choice. Here, we address this issue quantitatively by performing a full-stack resource analysis that compares classical shadows with direct quantum measurement. Under certain assumptions, our analysis illustrates an efficiency frontier between classical shadows and direct quantum measurement in the information-extraction stage. For observables expressed as linear combinations of Pauli matrices, the classical shadow method outperforms direct measurement when the number of observables is large and the Pauli weight is small. For observables in the form of large Hermitian sparse matrices, the classical shadow method shows an advantage when the number of observables, the sparsity of the matrix, and the number of qubits fall within a certain range. The key parameters influencing this behavior include the number of qubits $n$, observables $M$, sparsity $k$, Pauli weight $w$, accuracy requirement $ε$, and failure tolerance $δ$. We also compare the resource consumption of the two methods on different types of quantum computers and identify break-even points where the classical shadow method becomes more efficient, which vary depending on the hardware. This paper opens a new avenue for quantitatively designing optimal strategies for hybrid quantum-classical tomography and provides practical insights for selecting the most suitable quantum measurement approach in real-world applications.

TL;DR: 本文通过全栈资源分析，定量比较了经典阴影方法（classical shadows）与直接量子测量在信息提取阶段的效率，绘制了二者的效率前沿。对于大量低权重泡利可观测量或特定稀疏可观测量，经典阴影方法更具优势；反之，直接测量更优。分析还考虑了量子计算硬件类型的影响，找出了交叉点。
Motivation: 经典阴影方法虽能高效提取量子态信息，但在可观测量数量少、非局域性高或经典后处理能力有限时并非最优。当前缺乏定量比较两种方法效率的系统研究。
Method: 对经典阴影和直接量子测量进行全栈资源分析，考虑可观测量数量M、泡利权重w、稀疏度k、量子比特数n、精度ε和容错δ等参数，推导出效率边界条件，并比较不同量子计算机上的资源消耗。
Result: 对于泡利线性组合可观测量，当M大且w小时经典阴影更优；对于大型稀疏厄米可观测量，当M、稀疏度和n在特定范围内时经典阴影有优势。不同硬件下突破点不同。
Conclusion: 本文为混合量子-经典层析成像提供了定量设计最优策略的理论基础，并给出了实际应用中选择测量方法的指导。

papers.title: FCR: Investigating Generative AI models for Forensic Craniofacial Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Craniofacial reconstruction in forensics is one of the processes to identify victims of crime and natural disasters. Identifying an individual from their remains plays a crucial role when all other identification methods fail. Traditional methods for this task, such as clay-based craniofacial reconstruction, require expert domain knowledge and are a time-consuming process. At the same time, other probabilistic generative models like the statistical shape model or the Basel face model fail to capture the skull and face cross-domain attributes. Looking at these limitations, we propose a generic framework for craniofacial reconstruction from 2D X-ray images. Here, we used various generative models (i.e., CycleGANs, cGANs, etc) and fine-tune the generator and discriminator parts to generate more realistic images in two distinct domains, which are the skull and face of an individual. This is the first time where 2D X-rays are being used as a representation of the skull by generative models for craniofacial reconstruction. We have evaluated the quality of generated faces using FID, IS, and SSIM scores. Finally, we have proposed a retrieval framework where the query is the generated face image and the gallery is the database of real faces. By experimental results, we have found that these generative models can be used as an assisting tool for craniofacial identifications in forensic science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索使用生成式AI模型（如CycleGAN、cGAN等）从2D X光图像进行法医颅面重建，首次将2D X光作为颅骨表示用于颅面重建。实验评估了FID、IS、SSIM等指标，并提出了基于生成人脸图像的检索框架，表明生成模型可作为法医颅面识别的辅助工具。
Motivation: 传统颅面重建方法（如粘土重建）需专家知识且耗时，而统计形状模型等概率生成模型难以捕捉颅骨与面部的跨域属性。
Method: 提出通用框架，使用多种生成模型（CycleGAN、cGAN等）并微调生成器和判别器，将2D X光颅骨图像转换为面部图像，属于两个不同域之间的图像翻译。
Result: 评估了生成图像的质量（FID、IS、SSIM），并构建检索框架，以生成人脸为查询在真实人脸库中搜索，实验表明生成模型可作为法医鉴定辅助工具。
Conclusion: 生成模型可用于法医颅面重建，但摘要未提及其他方法对比或实际应用限制。

papers.title: HEAS: Hierarchical Evolutionary Agent-Based Simulation Framework for Multi-Objective Policy Search
papers.abstract_en: HEAS is a Python framework that connects agent-based simulation, evolutionary search, and scenario-based evaluation in a single reproducible pipeline. It is designed for researchers who study systems where local interactions produce system-level outcomes-ecosystems, organizations, markets, or regulatory environments-and who need to search over candidate strategies and compare them across uncertain scenarios. HEAS combines three modules: a hierarchy runtime for composing simulations from reusable process layers, an evolutionary tuner for single- or multi-objective search backed by DEAP, and a game module for evaluating strategies across scenario ensembles. Its central design principle is the "metric contract": the same outcome function is shared by optimization, evaluation, and validation, so that different parts of an analysis cannot silently rank strategies by different quantities.

TL;DR: HEAS 是一个 Python 框架，将基于智能体的模拟、进化搜索和场景评估整合到一个可复现的流水线中，支持在多目标策略搜索中共享同一度量函数，以避免优化、评估和验证之间的指标不一致。

Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，但强调框架的可复现性和一致性。
Conclusion: HEAS 适用于研究本地交互产生系统级结果（如生态系统、组织、市场）的研究者，并提供了 Python 包和在线演示。

papers.title: VRPO: Rethinking Value Modeling for Robust RL under Noisy Supervision in LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) in real-world environments often suffers from ambiguous or incomplete reward supervision, which undermines policy stability and generalization. Such noise may cause models to ignore key information or even collapse in advantage estimation. We find that a strong value model is essential for absorbing unstable signals and producing reliable advantages, offering denser and more robust supervision than the reward model. To better optimize noisy supervision, we propose VRPO, a framework that enhances value modeling for robust RL in LLM post-training. VRPO integrates (1) auxiliary losses guided by entropy and perplexity from a frozen language model, and (2) a variational information bottleneck, enabling the value model to filter noise and capture key words. This design allows the value model to correct noise rewards and generate more reliable advantage estimates, transforming it from a passive predictor into an active noise regulator. Experiments on multi-turn dialogue, math reasoning, and science QA with both rule-based and model-based rewards show that VRPO consistently outperforms baselines such as PPO and GRPO. Our work highlight the central role of the value model in Robust RL and provide a principled and practical approach to policy optimization under noisy supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型后训练中强化学习面临的噪声奖励问题，提出VRPO框架，通过增强价值模型（value model）的鲁棒性来吸收不稳定信号并生成可靠的优势估计。VRPO引入基于冻结语言模型的熵和困惑度辅助损失，以及变分信息瓶颈，使价值模型能够过滤噪声并捕获关键词语。实验在多轮对话、数学推理和科学问答等任务上使用基于规则和基于模型的奖励，表明VRPO一致优于PPO和GRPO等基线。
Motivation: 实际强化学习环境中奖励监督常存在歧义或不完整，导致策略不稳定甚至崩溃。现有方法依赖奖励模型，但价值模型被忽视。作者发现强大的价值模型可以吸收噪声并提供更鲁棒的监督信号。
Method: 提出VRPO框架，在价值模型训练中结合两种技术：(1) 来自冻结语言模型的熵和困惑度辅助损失；(2) 变分信息瓶颈（variational information bottleneck），使价值模型主动过滤噪声并聚焦关键信息，从而修正噪声奖励并生成更可靠的优势估计。
Result: 在多轮对话、数学推理和科学问答任务上，使用基于规则和基于模型的奖励设置，VRPO均一致优于PPO和GRPO等基线方法。
Conclusion: 论文强调价值模型在鲁棒强化学习中的核心作用，并提供了一个在噪声监督下进行策略优化的实用框架。

papers.title: Random Walk Learning and the Pac-Man Attack
papers.abstract_en: Random walk (RW)-based algorithms have long been popular in distributed systems due to low overheads and scalability, with recent growing applications in decentralized learning. However, their reliance on local interactions makes them inherently vulnerable to malicious behavior. In this work, we investigate an adversarial threat that we term the ``Pac-Man'' attack, in which a malicious node probabilistically terminates any RW that visits it. This stealthy behavior gradually eliminates active RWs from the network, effectively halting the learning process without triggering failure alarms. To counter this threat, we propose the Average Crossing (AC) algorithm--a fully decentralized mechanism for duplicating RWs to prevent RW extinction in the presence of Pac-Man. Our theoretical analysis establishes that (i) the RW population remains almost surely bounded under AC and (ii) RW-based stochastic gradient descent remains convergent under AC, even in the presence of Pac-Man, with a quantifiable deviation from the true optimum. Our extensive empirical results on both synthetic and real-world datasets corroborate our theoretical findings. Furthermore, they uncover a phase transition in the extinction probability as a function of the duplication threshold. We offer theoretical insights by analyzing a simplified variant of the AC, which sheds light on the observed phase transition.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分布式学习中随机游走（RW）算法在面对恶意节点时的脆弱性，提出一种名为“Pac-Man”的攻击，其中恶意节点概率性地终止访问它的随机游走，从而逐渐消除网络中的活跃RW，使学习过程停滞而不触发警报。为抵御该攻击，作者提出平均穿越（AC）算法，一种完全去中心化的RW复制机制。理论分析表明，在AC算法下，RW种群几乎必然有界，且基于RW的随机梯度下降在存在Pac-Man攻击时仍能收敛，与真实最优解存在可量化的偏差。在合成和真实数据集上的实验验证了理论结果，并发现了灭绝概率随复制阈值变化的相变现象。
Motivation: 基于随机游走的算法在分布式系统中因低开销和可扩展性而流行，但其对本地交互的依赖使其易受恶意行为攻击。现有研究缺乏对这类攻击的系统分析，尤其是针对随机游走学习过程的隐蔽攻击。
Method: 提出平均穿越（AC）算法，一种完全去中心化的随机游走复制机制，用于防止在Pac-Man攻击下随机游走灭绝。理论分析证明了AC算法下随机游走种群的有界性以及随机梯度下降的收敛性。还通过简化变体分析了相变现象。
Result: 理论结果表明，AC算法确保随机游走种群几乎必然有界，且随机梯度下降在Pac-Man攻击下仍然收敛，偏差可量化。实验显示了灭绝概率随复制阈值变化的相变现象，与理论分析一致。

papers.title: NeedleChain: Measuring Intact Context Comprehension Capability of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent reports suggest that LLMs can handle increasingly long contexts. However, many existing benchmarks for context understanding embed substantial query-irrelevant content, which shifts evaluation toward retrieving relevant snippets rather than fully integrating all provided information. Under this setting, we view that current benchmarks can overestimate true context-understanding ability of LLMs. In particular, we demonstrate that when the context consists entirely of query-relevant text, even advanced models such as GPT-4o fail to reliably integrate inputs as short as 200 tokens. To evaluate this capability more rigorously, we introduce NeedleChain, a benchmark designed to test whether models can faithfully incorporate all given evidence. NeedleChain includes three variants that differ in the required order of comprehension, along with a parallel benchmark based on the needle-in-a-haystack(NIAH) paradigm. By comparing these variants, NeedleChain enables a more comprehensive assessment of context understanding. We further propose a training-free strategy that encourages models to reflect all available information, ROPE contraction, highlighting the importance of full-context integration and pointing to new directions for improving reliable reasoning over context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NeedleChain基准，用于严格评估大语言模型在上下文完全由查询相关文本组成时的整体理解能力。实验表明，即使GPT-4o在处理仅200个token的全相关上下文时也无法可靠整合信息。NeedleChain包含三种变体，通过对比不同理解顺序的需求，并结合平行针尖搜索范式基准，提供了更全面的评估。此外，作者提出一种无需训练的ROPE收缩策略，鼓励模型利用所有可用信息。
Motivation: 现有长上下文基准常包含大量无关内容，偏向于检索相关片段而非完整整合所有信息，导致高估模型理解能力。本文旨在精确测量模型在全相关上下文下的完整理解能力。
Method: 设计了NeedleChain基准，包含三种需要不同理解顺序的变体，以及基于针尖搜索范式的并行基准。同时提出训练自由的ROPE收缩策略，促使模型反思所有可用信息。
Result: 即使GPT-4o在处理200个token的全相关上下文时也出现可靠整合失败，表明当前模型在全上下文理解能力上存在显著不足。
Conclusion: NeedleChain揭示了现有长上下文评估的局限，强调完整上下文整合的重要性，并为改进模型推理提供了新方向。

papers.title: Associative Memory for Non-Stationary Environments: A Self-Sizing Generalization of Hopfield Networks
papers.abstract_en: The Hopfield network made associative memory (AM) the model system of neural computation, but it solves the problem only for a \emph{stationary} world: a fixed set of memories, stored once into frozen weights. Real environments are non-stationary (e.g., memories arrive over time, drift, recur, and must be told apart from noise), where the classical formulation fails by catastrophic interference (the palimpsest problem) and by a capacity fixed in advance. We argue that this is not a peripheral limitation but the crux: under non-stationarity, memory and learning cease to be separate problems, and \emph{adaptation}, rather than one-shot optimization, becomes the operative capacity. We give a fresh formulation of the AM problem for non-stationary environments and a \emph{self-sizing} continual associative memory that generalizes Hopfield's: it stores new memories without erasing old ones (no forgetting), re-binds drifting and recurring memories, allocates a genuinely new memory only for true novelty, and grows its store to the environment's \emph{intrinsic} memory demand and no further. We rigorously show that this demand is the Urysohn width of the problem and can be estimated from data via a contrastive-similarity (CS) operator. The memory's size converges to this capacity online with no preset value and no validation search, matching an oracle capacity search. We use experiments with synthetic datasets to show that the generalization buys self-sizing and retention under non-stationarity, \emph{not} higher per-item recall fidelity, on which it matches strong baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非平稳环境下联想记忆（associative memory）的遗忘和容量固定问题，提出一种自调整的连续联想记忆模型，推广了Hopfield网络。该模型能够持续存储新记忆而不遗忘旧记忆，自动适应环境的固有记忆需求（通过Urysohn宽度度量），并通过对比相似度算子在线估计。实验在合成数据上验证了自调整能力和非平稳环境下的保持性能，但回忆保真度与强基线相当。
Motivation: 经典Hopfield网络仅适用于静态环境，在非平稳环境下（记忆不断到达、漂移、重复、混杂噪声）会出现灾难性干扰（palimpsest问题）和固定容量限制。本文指出这并非边缘缺陷，而是核心难题：非平稳性下记忆和学习不可分离，自适应能力比单次优化更重要。
Method: 重新定义非平稳环境下的联想记忆问题，提出一种自调整的连续联想记忆模型，推广Hopfield网络。该模型通过对比相似度（contrastive-similarity, CS）算子在线估计环境的固有记忆需求（Urysohn宽度），从而自动调整存储大小，无需预设值或验证搜索。
Result: 在合成数据集上，该模型实现了自调整大小和非平稳环境下的记忆保持（无遗忘），同时回忆保真度与强基线持平，并未提升每项回忆的保真度。
Conclusion: 该工作表明通过估计环境的内在记忆需求（Urysohn宽度）并自适应调整存储大小，可以解决非平稳联想记忆中的遗忘和容量限制问题。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: From Empirical Evaluation to Context-Aware Enhancement: Repairing Regression Errors with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: [...] Since then, various APR approaches, especially those leveraging the power of large language models (LLMs), have been rapidly developed to fix general software bugs. Unfortunately, the effectiveness of these advanced techniques in the context of regression bugs remains largely unexplored. This gap motivates the need for an empirical study evaluating the effectiveness of modern APR techniques in fixing real-world regression bugs. In this work, we conduct an empirical study of APR techniques on regression bugs. To facilitate our study, we introduce RegressionBug4APR, a high-quality benchmark of Java and Python regression bugs integrated into a framework designed to facilitate APR research. The current benchmark includes 200 regression bugs collected from widely used real-world GitHub repositories. We begin by conducting an in-depth analysis of the benchmark, demonstrating its diversity and quality. Building on this foundation, we empirically evaluate the capabilities of APR to regression bugs by assessing both traditional APR tools and advanced LLM-based APR approaches. Our experimental results show that classical APR tools fail to repair any bugs, while LLM-based APR approaches exhibit promising potential. Motivated by these results, we investigate impact of incorporating bug-inducing change information into LLM-based APR approaches for fixing regression bugs. We further conduct an ablation study to disaggregate the contribution of each contextual element within the bug-inducing change information. Our results highlight that this context-aware enhancement significantly improves the performance of LLM-based APR, yielding 1.6x more successful repairs compared to using LLM-based APR without such context. Moreover, our findings are consistent across both Java and Python benchmarks, providing preliminary evidence for the generalizability of our findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对回归错误的自动修复问题，构建了RegressionBug4APR基准（200个Java/Python回归错误），并评估了传统APR和基于LLM的APR方法。实验表明传统工具完全失效，而LLM方法有潜力；进一步引入bug诱导更改信息作为上下文可提升1.6倍修复成功率。
Motivation: 现有APR技术主要针对通用错误，对回归错误的修复效果缺乏研究。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 提出RegressionBug4APR基准，收集200个真实回归错误；评估多种APR方法，并探索将bug诱导更改信息作为上下文融入基于LLM的APR。
Result: 传统APR工具修复率为0%；基于LLM的APR方法表现出潜力；结合bug诱导更改信息后，修复成功数量提升1.6倍，且在Java和Python上一致。
Conclusion: 上下文感知增强（引入bug诱导更改信息）能显著提升基于LLM的APR在回归错误修复上的性能，且具有跨语言泛化性。

papers.title: Rapid Quantification of Outdoor Object Visibility in Urban Setting Using Connected-Vehicle Fields of View
papers.abstract_en: Identifying locations that offer maximum visual exposure to passing vehicular traffic is a core problem in urban analytics, with applications spanning urban design, navigation, location-based services, and the placement of street-level assets. Traditional site selection methods often rely on static traffic counts or subjective assessments. This research introduces a data-driven methodology to objectively quantify location visibility by analyzing large-scale connected vehicle trajectory data within urban environments. We model the dynamic driver field-of-view using a forward-projected visibility area for each vehicle position derived from interpolated trajectories. By integrating this with building vertex locations extracted from OpenStreetMap, we quantify the cumulative visual exposure, or ``visibility count'', for thousands of potential points of interest along roadways. The core technical contribution involves the construction of a BallTree spatial index over building vertices. This enables highly efficient (O(logN) complexity) radius queries to determine which vertices fall within the viewing circles of millions of trajectory points across numerous trips, significantly outperforming brute-force geometric checks. Analysis reveals two key findings: 1) Visibility is highly concentrated, identifying distinct 'visual hotspots' receiving disproportionately high exposure compared to average locations. 2) The aggregated visibility counts across vertices conform to a Log-Normal distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据驱动方法，利用连接车辆轨迹数据量化城市中户外物体对过往车辆的可见性。通过将车辆位置投影为动态前向视野区域，结合OpenStreetMap建筑顶点，构建BallTree空间索引高效计算累积可见度计数。实验发现可见性高度集中在特定“视觉热点”，且累积可见度计数服从对数正态分布。
Motivation: 传统选址方法依赖静态交通计数或主观评估，缺乏对动态车辆视野的客观量化。
Method: 基于插值轨迹的车辆位置，定义前向投影视野区域；从OpenStreetMap提取建筑顶点，构建BallTree索引以支持O(logN)复杂度的半径查询，高效判断顶点是否落入视野圈。
Result: 识别出可见性高度集中的视觉热点；累积可见度计数符合对数正态分布。
Conclusion: 该方法可客观量化城市中任意位置对过往车辆的视觉暴露程度，适用于城市设计、导航、资产布局等场景。

papers.title: Learned Controllers for Agile Quadrotors in Pursuit-Evasion Games
papers.abstract_en: In this letter we study 1v1 quadrotor pursuit-evasion, where a pursuer and an evader are trained via reinforcement learning (RL) by competing against each other. Such adversarial settings face well-known challenges: each agent's policy changes during training, creating a non-stationary environment; agents might overfit to the current opponent and forget earlier strategies (catastrophic forgetting); and the competitive dynamics can cause strategy cycling or policy collapse. To address these issues, we propose Asynchronous Multi-Stage Population-Based training with Hedge sampling (AMSPBH), a method based on Policy-Space Response Oracles (PSRO) and adapted to quadrotor RL control. PSRO maintains a population of previously trained policies and trains new approximate best responses against mixtures of that population instead of against a single opponent. In AMSPBH, each generation trains one agent with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) against frozen opponent policies, while a Hedge sampler assigns higher probability to opponents that are currently difficult to beat. We show that: (i) AMSPBH discovers new strategies while retaining competence against older opponents, reaching a regime where additional best-response training gives limited improvement; (ii) compared to training against only the latest opponent, population-based training generalizes better across diverse and unseen strategies; and (iii) the learned population contains distinct pursuit and evasion behaviors, providing useful strategic diversity for finding weaknesses and improving controller robustness. We validate the trained policies with hardware experiments on Crazyflie brushless quadrotors, showing zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of agile, reactive pursuit-evasion behavior against both handcrafted and learned adversaries, with physical flights reaching up to 4.87 m/s.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究1v1四旋翼追逃博弈，提出异步多阶段基于种群的训练方法（AMSPBH），结合Hedge采样和PPO，使无人机通过对抗训练涌现出敏捷的追逃策略，并在Crazyflie硬件上实现最高4.87 m/s的零样本仿真到现实迁移。
Motivation: 追逃博弈中对手策略动态变化导致非平稳环境、过拟合与策略崩溃，现有方法难以解决这些挑战。
Method: 提出AMSPBH，基于策略空间响应或acles（PSRO）框架，维护历史策略种群，用Hedge采样器给当前难应对的对手更高权重，每代用PPO训练近似最佳响应。
Result: AMSPBH能发现新策略且保留应对旧对手的能力；相比对单一对手训练，种群训练泛化性更好；硬件实验验证了零样本迁移，飞行速度达4.87 m/s。
Conclusion: 种群训练能提供策略多样性，提升控制器鲁棒性，但额外最佳响应训练收益有限。

summary_sections.method: 提出AMSPBH，基于策略空间响应或acles（PSRO）框架，维护历史策略种群，用Hedge采样器给当前难应对的对手更高权重，每代用PPO训练近似最佳响应。
summary_sections.result: AMSPBH能发现新策略且保留应对旧对手的能力；相比对单一对手训练，种群训练泛化性更好；硬件实验验证了零样本迁移，飞行速度达4.87 m/s。
summary_sections.conclusion: 种群训练能提供策略多样性，提升控制器鲁棒性，但额外最佳响应训练收益有限。

papers.title: TIP-Search: Time-Predictable Inference Scheduling for Market Prediction under Uncertain Load
papers.abstract_en: Real-time market prediction services need correct predictions before a decision deadline; a correct prediction delivered late is not a usable service output. TIP-Search studies time-predictable inference scheduling over fixed market predictors under uncertain load. It filters conformal latency-quantile feasible models, dispatches over finite workers, and uses shielded constrained online experts to trade accuracy, queue pressure, and deadline risk. The official systems-replay controller is OCO-ACPO, a projected-dual shielded expert selector; SA-OCO-ACPO is a nonstationary stress extension that records interval stress, regret proxies, and constraint-violation proxies while preserving the CPO safety shield. On the optimized deployable pool, TIP-Search reaches 0.994 raw accuracy and 0.991 timely accuracy. On official TLOB FI-2010 h=10, TIP-Search++ raises timely accuracy from 0.156 to 0.239 and deadline satisfaction from 0.391 to 0.962. In the matched h10 profiled systems replay, OCO-ACPO reaches 0.303 timely accuracy and 0.951 deadline satisfaction, with paired condition gains over RAMSIS/SneakPeek/utility-style comparators of $+0.00285$ timely accuracy ($p=0.0118$) and $+0.0146$ deadline satisfaction ($p=1.5{\times}10^{-5}$). SA-OCO-ACPO improves timely/deadline service by 0.188--0.417 over CPO under nonstationary stress. The claim is a systems scheduling result, not a broad LOB classifier leaderboard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TIP-Search 研究在不确定负载下为固定市场预测器提供时间可预测的推理调度。它通过过滤分位数可行性模型、在有限工人上调度并使用受屏蔽约束的在线专家来权衡精度、队列压力和截止时间风险。在优化的可部署池上，原始精度达 0.994，及时精度达 0.991；在 TLOB FI-2010 h=10 上，TIP-Search++ 将及时精度从 0.156 提升至 0.239。
Motivation: 实时市场预测服务需要在决策截止时间前提供正确预测；延迟的正确预测不可用。现有系统在不确定负载下难以保证推理的时间可预测性。
Method: 提出 TIP-Search 框架，包含 conformal 延迟分位数可行性模型过滤、有限 worker 调度，以及基于 OCO-ACPO（投影对偶屏蔽专家选择器）的受屏蔽约束在线专家，并引入 SA-OCO-ACPO 处理非平稳压力。
Result: 在优化池上原始精度 0.994，及时精度 0.991；在 TLOB FI-2010 h=10 上，TIP-Search++ 及时精度从 0.156 升至 0.239，截止时间满意度从 0.391 升至 0.962。OCO-ACPO 在匹配回放中及时精度 0.303，截止时间满意度 0.951，显著优于基线。
Conclusion: 本文是一个系统调度结果，而非广泛的 LOB 分类器排行榜；声称在不确定负载下实现时间可预测的推理调度。

papers.title: Hierarchical Adversarial Bandits for Online Configuration Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by Online Configuration Optimization in large, dynamic parameter spaces, this work studies the nonstochastic multi-armed bandit (MAB) problem in metric action spaces with oblivious Lipschitz adversaries. We propose ABoB (Adversarial Bandit over Bandits), a hierarchical framework that decomposes the configuration space into clusters to accelerate learning and adapt to changing environments. We evaluate ABoB using standard algorithms such as EXP3 and Tsallis-INF on a real-world production storage system, demonstrating significant performance gains of up to $50\%$ compared to state-of-the-art "flat" bandit algorithms. Extensive simulations further confirm that ABoB effectively exploits metric structures, achieving up to $91\%$ improvement in adversarial metric scenarios while significantly reducing computational running time. Theoretical analysis grounds this empirical success: we prove that ABoB maintains a worst-case "safety net" bound of $O(\sqrt{kT})$, matching traditional methods, where $T$ is the number of rounds and $k$ is the number of arms, while capable of accelerating learning to $O(k^{1/4}\sqrt{T})$ under favorable Lipschitz conditions. This combination of operational efficiency and theoretical soundness makes ABoB a practical solution for automated system tuning.
papers.comment: Paper was accepted to ACM SIGKDD 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究非随机多臂赌博机在度量动作空间中的在线配置优化问题，提出层级式对抗性赌博机框架ABoB（Adversarial Bandit over Bandits），将配置空间分解为聚类以加速学习并适应动态环境。在生产存储系统上测试显示，ABoB相比平面型赌博机算法性能提升最高达50%，在对抗性度量场景中提升可达91%，同时理论证明其最坏情况界为O(√(kT))，并在有利Lipschitz条件下加速至O(k^{1/4}√T)。
Motivation: 大型动态参数空间的在线配置优化中，传统非随机赌博机算法忽略了参数空间的度量结构，导致学习效率低下，无法快速适应环境变化。
Method: 提出ABoB层级框架，将配置空间聚类为多个子集，在每个聚类上运行基础算法（如EXP3、Tsallis-INF），并通过顶层赌博机协调各聚类策略，利用度量信息加速学习。
Result: 在真实存储系统上，ABoB相比平面算法性能提升50%；在对抗性度量模拟中改进达91%，计算时间显著降低；理论界匹配最坏情况O(√(kT))并在有利条件下达到O(k^{1/4}√T)。
Conclusion: ABoB结合了操作效率与理论稳健性，为非平稳环境下的自动化系统调优提供了实用方案。

papers.title: SenseExpo: Spatial Exploration and Navigation via Scene Estimation from Expeditious Predictive Operators
papers.abstract_en: We present \textbf{SenseExpo}, a lightweight single-robot exploration framework that integrates a compact map prediction network into a frontier-based strategy. SenseExpo addresses two long-standing challenges in classical methods -- high computational overhead and poor environmental generalization. Our prediction network combines Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Transformers, and Fast Fourier Convolution (FFC) to achieve a remarkably small footprint of only 709K parameters. Despite its compactness, SenseExpo outperforms U-Net (24.5M) and LaMa (51M) on the KTH dataset, achieving PSNR 9.026 and SSIM 0.718, representing a 38.7\% PSNR gain over LaMa. Cross-domain evaluation further verifies strong generalization with an FID of 161.55 on HouseExpo. In exploration experiments, SenseExpo reaches target coverage 67.9\% faster on KTH and 77.1\% faster on MRPB~1.0 than a MapEx-style global obstacle-prediction baseline under the same simulator; because the methods predict different map semantics, this comparison evaluates planning utility rather than a direct predictor ranking. Implemented as a plug-and-play ROS (Robot Operating System) node, our framework integrates with existing navigation stacks, providing an efficient solution for resource-constrained robotic systems.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 经典机器人探索方法存在计算开销大和环境泛化能力差的问题，SenseExpo旨在通过紧凑预测网络解决这两大挑战。
Method: 提出融合GAN、Transformer和FFC的地图预测网络（709K参数），并将其嵌入基于前沿的探索策略中，实现为即插即用的ROS节点。

Conclusion: SenseExpo以极低参数量在环境预测和探索效率上超越大型网络，适合资源受限的机器人系统。

papers.title: HEM: a margin-based loss for visual categorisation tasks
papers.abstract_en: Training deep neural networks (DNNs) on classification tasks can be performed with a number of different losses, but cross-entropy (CE) loss is the de-facto standard. Here, we propose an alternative loss, high error margin (HEM), which is a margin based loss modified to improve the training dynamics of neural networks. HEM loss is evaluated extensively using a wide range of DNN architectures and benchmark datasets with all experimental settings and training hyper-parameters taken from the literature, and hence, optimised for CE loss. HEM is found to be more effective than CE loss across a range of image-based tasks: unknown class rejection, adversarial robustness, learning with imbalanced data, continual learning, and semantic segmentation (a pixel-wise classification task). HEM is inferior to CE only in terms of clean and corrupt image classification with balanced training data, and this difference is small. We also compare HEM to specialised losses that have previously been proposed to improve performance for specific vision tasks. LogitNorm, a loss achieving state-of-the-art performance on unknown class rejection, produces similar performance to HEM for this task, but is much poorer for continual learning and semantic segmentation. Logit-adjusted loss, designed for imbalanced data, has superior results to HEM for that task, but performs worse on unknown class rejection and semantic segmentation. DICE, a popular loss for semantic segmentation, is inferior to HEM loss on all tasks, including semantic segmentation. Overall, HEM is competitive with the best alternative loss for all the tasks we have used and performs better than all other tested losses in terms of rejecting out-of-distribution examples, for continual learning, and by a substantial margin for semantic segmentation.
papers.journal_ref: European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出高误差边界（HEM）损失，一种基于边界的替代交叉熵损失的损失函数，旨在改善深度神经网络分类任务的训练动态。在多个图像任务上广泛评估，包括未知类拒绝、对抗鲁棒性、不平衡学习、持续学习和语义分割，发现HEM在多数任务上优于交叉熵，尤其在语义分割上大幅领先。
Motivation: 交叉熵损失是分类任务的事实标准，但其训练动态可能不是最优的；本文旨在提出一种改进的基于边界的损失函数以提升性能。
Method: 提出高误差边界（HEM）损失，基于边界修改以改善训练动态；在多种架构和基准数据集上使用文献中为交叉熵优化的超参数进行评估。
Result: HEM在未知类拒绝、对抗鲁棒性、不平衡学习、持续学习和语义分割上优于交叉熵；仅在均衡数据下的干净和损坏图像分类上略逊于交叉熵。与专门损失相比，HEM在语义分割上大幅领先于DICE，在持续学习和OOD拒绝上优于LogitNorm和Logit-adjusted loss。
Conclusion: HEM是一种通用的有效损失函数，在多个视觉分类任务上具有竞争力，尤其擅长语义分割、持续学习和未知类拒绝。

papers.title: Multi-Depth Concept Extraction for Post-Hoc Vision Encoder Explanation
papers.abstract_en: Explainable AI methods for vision models aim to identify the parts of the input that are important for the final prediction and subsequently relate these regions to human-understandable concepts. Here, we propose focusing solely on the encoder and relating its intermediate outputs to the input, instead. We introduce Neuro-Activated Vision Explanations (NAVE), a post-hoc, unsupervised, and architecture-agnostic (across CNNs and ViTs) method for extracting and visualizing internal representations from frozen vision model encoders. Specifically, NAVE clusters composite feature activations from multiple encoder depths to produce interpretable segmentation maps with controllable granularity, requiring no fine-tuning or architectural modifications. Through extensive experiments, we quantitatively demonstrate that NAVE's concepts align with input semantics and can be used in downstream tasks. We further demonstrate NAVE as an inspection tool by analyzing how training strategies and architectures affect encoder representations. Overall, our results establish NAVE as an effective tool for post-hoc model inspection and enhancing transparency in vision models. \texttt{https://github.com/Ahcene-B/NAVE}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Neuro-Activated Vision Explanations (NAVE)，一种无需微调、架构无关的后验可解释方法，通过聚类多深度编码器复合特征激活来生成可解释的分割图，并在下游任务中验证其与输入语义的对齐。
Motivation: 现有可解释AI方法通常聚焦于最终预测的输入重要性，而忽略了编码器内部表示与输入的关联。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供一种不修改模型、适用于多种视觉架构的编码器解释工具。
Method: NAVE从冻结的视觉编码器（CNN或ViT）的多个深度提取复合特征激活，并通过聚类生成具有可控粒度的语义分割图，无需微调或架构改动。
Result: 实验定量证明NAVE提取的概念与输入语义对齐，并能在下游任务中使用；同时，NAVE作为检查工具揭示了训练策略和架构对编码器表示的影响。
Conclusion: NAVE是一种有效的后验模型检查工具，可增强视觉模型的透明度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Is Oracle Pruning the True Oracle?
papers.abstract_en: Oracle pruning, which selects unimportant weights by minimizing the pruned train loss, has served as the foundation for most neural network pruning methods for over thirty-five years, while few (if any) have thought about how much the foundation really holds. This paper, for the first time, attempts to systematically examine its validity on deep neural networks through empirical correlation analyses and provides meta-framework reflections on the field of neural network pruning. Specifically, this paper focuses on the pruning algorithms with three stages: training, pruning, and retraining. We analyze the correlation in model performance before and after the retraining stage. Extensive experiments (37K models are trained) across a wide spectrum of models (LeNet5, VGG, ResNets, ViT, MLLM) and datasets (MNIST, CIFAR10/CIFAR100, ImageNet-1K, MLLM data) are conducted. For large-scale experiments, we adopt approximate oracle pruning due to the prohibitive cost of exact oracle pruning. The results point to a counterintuitive conclusion: for deep learning models of nontrivial size (already at the scale of ResNet56 on CIFAR-10), pre-retraining performance is negligibly correlated with post-retraining performance. In other words, the weights identified by oracle pruning can scarcely guarantee strong performance following retraining. This further suggests that existing works that derive pruning criteria from oracle pruning may rest on a questionable foundational premise. Further studies suggest that rising task complexity is a primary factor behind the invalidity of oracle pruning nowadays. Finally, given the evidence, we argue that the retraining stage in a pruning algorithm should be accounted for when developing pruning criteria.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地检验了oracle pruning在深度神经网络中的有效性。通过大规模实验（训练了37K个模型），发现对于中等规模的深度模型（如ResNet56 on CIFAR-10），剪枝前与重训练后的模型性能几乎不相关，表明oracle pruning的前提假设在深度学习中可能不成立。
Motivation: 过去35年，oracle pruning作为多数剪枝方法的基础被广泛使用，但鲜有工作质疑其有效性。本文旨在通过实证分析检验oracle pruning在深度神经网络中的真实可靠性。
Method: 聚焦于‘训练-剪枝-重训练’三阶段剪枝算法，通过分析重训练前后模型性能的相关性来验证oracle pruning的有效性。由于精确oracle pruning成本过高，大规模实验采用近似oracle pruning。
Result: 对于中等规模模型（如ResNet56 on CIFAR-10），剪枝前的性能与重训练后的性能相关性极低，表明oracle pruning无法保证重训练后模型表现良好。任务复杂度的增加是oracle pruning失效的主要原因。
Conclusion: 现有基于oracle pruning的剪枝准则可能建立在有问题的前提上，开发剪枝准则时应将重训练阶段纳入考虑。

papers.title: CATCH: Channel-Aware multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection via Frequency Patching
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection in multivariate time series is challenging as heterogeneous subsequence anomalies may occur. Reconstruction-based methods, which focus on learning normal patterns in the frequency domain to detect diverse abnormal subsequences, achieve promising results, while still falling short on capturing fine-grained frequency characteristics and channel correlations. To contend with the limitations, we introduce CATCH, a framework based on frequency patching. We propose to patchify the frequency domain into frequency bands, which enhances its ability to capture fine-grained frequency characteristics. To perceive appropriate channel correlations, we propose a Channel Fusion Module (CFM), which features a patch-wise mask generator and a masked-attention mechanism. Driven by a bi-level multi-objective optimization algorithm, the CFM is encouraged to iteratively discover appropriate patch-wise channel correlations, and to cluster relevant channels while isolating adverse effects from irrelevant channels. Extensive experiments on 10 real-world datasets and 12 synthetic datasets demonstrate that CATCH achieves state-of-the-art performance. We make our code and datasets available at https://github.com/decisionintelligence/CATCH.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CATCH，一种基于频率分片的多变量时间序列异常检测框架。通过将频域切分为频带以捕捉细粒度频率特征，并设计通道融合模块（CFM），利用逐块掩码生成器和掩码注意力机制学习合适的通道相关性，结合双层多目标优化算法迭代发现通道相关性并聚类相关通道。在10个真实世界和12个合成数据集上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有重建方法在频域学习正常模式虽有效，但难以捕捉细粒度频率特性和通道相关性，导致对异构子序列异常检测能力不足。
Method: 提出频域分片（frequency patching）将频域划分为频带，增强细粒度频率特征捕捉；设计通道融合模块（CFM），包含逐块掩码生成器和掩码注意力机制，通过双层多目标优化算法迭代学习通道相关性。
Result: 在10个真实世界数据集和12个合成数据集上，CATCH 达到最先进的异常检测性能（具体数值需见原文）。
Conclusion: CATCH 通过频域分片和通道融合模块有效提升了多变量时间序列异常检测中对细粒度频率特征和通道相关性的建模能力。

papers.title: Exploration of LLMs, EEG, and behavioral data to measure and support attention and sleep
papers.abstract_en: We explore the application of large language models (LLMs), pre-trained models with massive textual data for detecting and improving attention and sleep. We investigate the use of LLMs to estimate attention states, sleep stages, and sleep quality and generate sleep improvement suggestions and adaptive guided imagery scripts based on electroencephalogram (EEG) and physical activity data (e.g., waveforms, power spectrogram images, numerical features). Our results show that LLMs can estimate sleep quality based on human textual behavioral features and provide personalized sleep improvement suggestions and guided imagery scripts; however, detecting attention, sleep stages, and sleep quality based on EEG and activity data requires further training data and domain-specific knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索使用大语言模型（LLMs）结合脑电图（EEG）和身体活动数据来估计注意力状态、睡眠阶段和睡眠质量，并生成睡眠改善建议和引导想象脚本。结果表明，LLMs 能基于人类文本行为特征估计睡眠质量并提供个性化建议，但基于 EEG 和活动数据检测注意力和睡眠阶段需要更多训练数据和领域知识。
Motivation: 研究如何利用预训练的 LLMs 处理生理和行为数据，以支持注意力和睡眠的监测与改善，弥补传统方法在个性化指导和可解释性上的不足。
Method: 使用 LLMs 分析 EEG 波形、功率谱图图像和数值特征以及身体活动数据，用于估计注意力状态、睡眠阶段和睡眠质量，并生成自适应引导想象脚本和睡眠改善建议。
Result: LLMs 能有效基于人类文本行为特征估计睡眠质量并提供个性化建议；但基于 EEG 和活动数据检测注意力、睡眠阶段和睡眠质量仍需进一步训练数据和领域特定知识。
Conclusion: LLMs 在睡眠质量估计和个性化建议生成方面有潜力，但在生理信号解析方面当前性能有限，需要更多领域适配。

papers.title: A polarity-aware multi-relational model for the signed interaction prediction in biological networks
papers.abstract_en: Predicting signed interactions in biological networks is crucial for understanding drug mechanisms and facilitating drug repurposing. While deep graph models have demonstrated success in modeling complex biological systems, existing approaches often fail to distinguish between positive and negative interactions, limiting their utility for precise pharmacological predictions. In this study, we propose a novel deep graph model, PAMR (polarity-aware multi-relational model), designed to predict both polar (e.g., activation, inhibition) and non-polar (e.g., binding, affect) chemical-gene interactions. Our model integrates graph convolutional networks with tensor decomposition to enhance feature representation and incorporates a conflict-aware sampling strategy to resolve polarity ambiguities. We introduce new evaluation metrics, polarity discrimination score (PDS) and CP@100, to assess the model's ability to differentiate interaction types. Experimental results demonstrate that PAMR outperforms baseline models, achieving superior classification accuracy and improved discrimination of polar edges. Specifically, PAMR-CL attains a Macro AUROC of 0.9072 and CP@100 of 0.974, surpassing RGCN, GraphSAGE, TransE, and BioNet baselines. A case study on nicotine further identifies two novel chemical-gene suppression links, S100A6 and SPP1, that are corroborated by independent experimental literature. Furthermore, we analyze the impact of subgraph components on predictive performance, revealing that additional network structures do not always enhance accuracy. These findings highlight the importance of polarity-aware modeling in drug discovery and network pharmacology, providing a scalable computational framework for polarity-aware chemical-gene interaction prediction and network pharmacology analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PAMR（极性感知多关系模型），用于预测生物网络中的带符号交互（如激活、抑制），可应用于药物发现和药物重定位。模型结合图卷积网络与张量分解，并采用冲突感知采样策略解决极性歧义。在化学-基因交互数据集上，PAMR-CL 达到 Macro AUROC 0.9072 和 CP@100 0.974，超越多个基线模型。
Motivation: 现有深度图模型在生物网络交互预测中未能区分正负交互（如激活 vs 抑制），限制了精确药理预测。
Method: 提出 PAMR，集成图卷积网络与张量分解增强特征表示，并引入冲突感知采样策略处理极性歧义。同时提出极性区分分数 (PDS) 和 CP@100 作为新评估指标。
Result: PAMR-CL 在化学-基因交互预测中取得 Macro AUROC 0.9072 和 CP@100 0.974，优于 RGCN、GraphSAGE、TransE 和 BioNet 等基线。病例研究确认两个新的抑制链接 S100A6 和 SPP1。
Conclusion: 极性感知建模对药物发现和网络药理学重要，额外子图结构未必提升精度。

papers.title: NeuPAN: Direct Point Robot Navigation with End-to-End Model-based Learning
papers.abstract_en: Navigating a nonholonomic robot in a cluttered, unknown environment requires accurate perception and precise motion control for real-time collision avoidance. This paper presents NeuPAN: a real-time, highly accurate, map-free, easy-to-deploy, and environment-invariant robot motion planner. Leveraging a tightly coupled perception-to-control framework, NeuPAN has two key innovations compared to existing approaches: 1) it directly maps raw point cloud data to a latent distance feature space for collision-free motion generation, avoiding error propagation from the perception to control pipeline; 2) it is interpretable from an end-to-end model-based learning perspective. The crux of NeuPAN is solving an end-to-end mathematical model with numerous point-level constraints using a plug-and-play (PnP) proximal alternating-minimization network (PAN), incorporating neurons in the loop. This allows NeuPAN to generate real-time, physically interpretable motions. It seamlessly integrates data and knowledge engines, and its network parameters can be fine-tuned via backpropagation. We evaluate NeuPAN on a ground mobile robot, a wheel-legged robot, and an autonomous vehicle, in extensive simulated and real-world environments. Results demonstrate that NeuPAN outperforms existing baselines in terms of accuracy, efficiency, robustness, and generalization capabilities across various environments, including the cluttered sandbox, office, corridor, and parking lot. We show that NeuPAN works well in unknown and unstructured environments with arbitrarily shaped objects, transforming impassable paths into passable ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuPAN是一种基于端到端模型学习的实时点云机器人导航方法，直接从原始点云映射到潜在距离特征空间以生成无碰撞运动，避免感知到控制管线的误差传播。该方法通过可解释的端到端数学模型求解，结合近端交替最小化网络（PAN），在多种机器人和环境中验证了准确性、效率、鲁棒性和泛化能力。
Motivation: 非完整机器人在杂乱未知环境中导航需要精确感知和运动控制以实现实时碰撞避免，现有方法存在感知到控制的误差传播问题。
Method: 提出NeuPAN，一种紧耦合感知到控制的框架，直接处理原始点云到潜在距离特征空间的映射，利用插件式近端交替最小化网络（PAN）求解具有大量点约束的端到端数学模型，网络参数可通过反向传播微调。
Result: 在移动机器人、轮腿机器人和自动驾驶车辆上，模拟和真实环境（杂乱沙箱、办公室、走廊、停车场）中，NeuPAN在准确性、效率、鲁棒性和泛化能力上优于现有基线，能将不可通行路径转化为可通行路径。
Conclusion: NeuPAN实现了实时、高精度、无地图、易部署且环境不变的运动规划，适用于未知非结构化环境及任意形状物体。

papers.title: Are LLMs Effective Negotiators? Systematic Evaluation of the Multifaceted Capabilities of LLMs in Negotiation Dialogues
papers.abstract_en: A successful negotiation requires a range of capabilities, including comprehension of the conversation context, Theory-of-Mind (ToM) skills to infer the partner's motives, strategic reasoning, and effective communication, making it challenging for automated systems. Despite the remarkable performance of LLMs in various NLP tasks, there is no systematic evaluation of their capabilities in negotiation. Such an evaluation is critical for advancing AI negotiation agents and negotiation research, ranging from designing dialogue systems to providing pedagogical feedback and scaling up data collection practices. This work aims to systematically analyze the multifaceted capabilities of LLMs across diverse dialogue scenarios throughout the stages of a typical negotiation interaction. Our analysis highlights GPT-4's superior performance in many tasks while identifying specific challenges, such as making subjective assessments and generating contextually appropriate, strategically advantageous responses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了大型语言模型（LLM）在谈判对话中的多方面能力，包括上下文理解、心理理论（Theory-of-Mind）、策略推理和有效沟通。分析发现GPT-4在多数任务上表现优越，但在主观评估和生成情境适当、战略优势回应方面存在具体挑战。
Motivation: 谈判需要多种复杂能力，对自动化系统构成挑战，而LLM在谈判中的能力缺乏系统评估。这种评估对推进AI谈判代理及谈判研究（如对话系统设计、教学反馈、数据收集）至关重要。
Method: 系统分析LLM在典型谈判交互各阶段的多方面能力，涵盖多种对话场景。
Result: GPT-4在多数任务上表现优越，但存在具体挑战：主观评估和生成情境适当、战略优势回应。
Conclusion: 强调了对LLM在谈判中能力进行系统评估的必要性，并指出了改进方向。

papers.title: A criterion for Artificial General Intelligence: hypothetic-deductive reasoning, tested on ChatGPT
papers.abstract_en: We argue that a key reasoning skill that any advanced AI, say GPT-4, should master in order to qualify as 'thinking machine', or AGI, is hypothetic-deductive reasoning. Problem-solving or question-answering can quite generally be construed as involving two steps: hypothesizing that a certain set of hypotheses T applies to the problem or question at hand, and deducing the solution or answer from T - hence the term hypothetic-deductive reasoning. An elementary proxy of hypothetic-deductive reasoning is causal reasoning. We propose simple tests for both types of reasoning, and apply them to ChatGPT. Our study shows that, at present, the chatbot has a limited capacity for either type of reasoning, as soon as the problems considered are somewhat complex. However, we submit that if an AI would be capable of this type of reasoning in a sufficiently wide range of contexts, it would be an AGI.

papers.title: Causal Variational Deep Embedding: A Family of Interventional Generators for Confounded Images
papers.abstract_en: Deep generative models reproduce the observational distribution of their training data, inheriting any spurious associations it contains. A common source is an unobserved confounder that shapes both an attribute the user wants to control at sampling time and an attribute expected to vary in response. Existing causal generative approaches resolve the resulting ambiguity by imposing structural assumptions strong enough to single out one interventional distribution; in image domains, such assumptions are rarely warranted, and the data is generally consistent with a set of distinct causal mechanisms -- a feasible region of interventional distributions. We propose CauVaDE (Causal Variational Deep Embedding), built on a canonical augmented SCM in which the unobserved confounder collapses, without loss of generality, into a discrete latent cluster of bounded support while continuous variation is absorbed into independent noises. We prove that this canonical class is dense, in both observational and interventional Wasserstein distance, in the class of augmented SCMs compatible with a given causal diagram, and instantiate it as a mixture variational autoencoder whose cluster variable plays the role of the canonical confounder. An entropy regularizer with weight $γ$ on the cluster posterior then traces a family of candidate causal effects that fit the observational data to comparable likelihood while spanning the feasible region. Experiments on image data benchmarks show that CauVaDE produces diverse interventional samples and improves FID against an unconfounded reference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CauVaDE（因果变分深度嵌入），一种基于增广结构因果模型（SCM）的生成式方法，用于处理图像生成中未观测混杂变量导致的虚假关联。CauVaDE 将未观测混杂变量离散化为有界支撑的潜聚类，并证明该规范类在观测和干预 Wasserstein 距离下稠密。通过熵正则化参数 γ 追踪一组与观测数据似然相当的候选因果效应，在图像基准上生成多样化的干预样本并改善 FID。
Motivation: 深度生成模型会复制训练数据中的虚假关联，例如未观测混杂变量同时影响用户希望控制的属性和期望变化的属性。现有因果生成方法需强结构假设来唯一确定干预分布，但在图像领域这些假设通常不成立。
Method: 提出 CauVaDE，基于规范增广 SCM，将未观测混杂变量离散化为有界支撑的潜聚类，连续变化吸收为独立噪声，并实例化为混合变分自编码器。通过熵正则化参数 γ 控制聚类后验，追踪一个可干预分布族。
Result: 理论上证明该规范类在观测和干预 Wasserstein 距离下稠密。实验上在图像基准上生成多样化的干预样本，并改善 FID，与无混杂的参考相比更优。
Conclusion: CauVaDE 提供了一种在图像领域处理未观测混杂的可行方法，无需强结构假设即可生成多个与观测数据一致的因果效应。

papers.title: Is Agent Code Less Maintainable Than Human Code?
papers.abstract_en: Maintainability is a core dimension of software engineering, shaping how code is written, reviewed, and developed over time. While coding agents have demonstrated strong performance on single-issue tasks, it remains unclear how maintainable their code is when future agents build on top of it, potentially leading to compounding downstream effects. We investigate how agent code compares to human code in these maintenance settings, presenting CodeThread, a framework to construct controlled experiments from repository-level coding benchmarks. Applying CodeThread to four frontier coding agents and four benchmarks, we find that agents are less effective at resolving tasks when building on agent code compared to human code, with task resolve rate drops of up to 13.1%. Regression analysis reveals that many traditional software engineering maintainability metrics do not explain this difference. Instead, the clearest signals are subtler behavioral differences in agent code, such as changes to input validation and error handling, along with differences in downstream code size and task difficulty. These findings highlight the need to evaluate these systems not only by immediate task resolution but also by code maintainability, and point to potential sources of downstream errors introduced by agent code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究AI代理生成的代码与人类代码在可维护性上的差异。作者提出CodeThread框架，在四个前沿编码代理和四个基准上进行实验，发现代理在基于代理代码解决任务时成功率下降最多13.1%，传统软件工程可维护性指标无法解释这一差异，而代理代码在输入验证、错误处理等行为上的细微差异及下游代码大小、任务难度是更清晰的信号。
Motivation: 现有研究关注编码代理的单次任务性能，但未评估其代码在被未来代理继承时的可维护性，尤其是下游影响。
Method: 提出CodeThread框架，从仓库级编码基准构建受控实验，比较代理代码与人类代码在维护场景中的表现。
Result: 代理在基于代理代码解决任务时成功率下降最多13.1%；传统可维护性指标无法解释差异；代理代码在输入验证、错误处理等行为上有细微差异。
Conclusion: 应评估编码系统不仅基于即时任务解决，还需考虑代码可维护性；代理代码可能引入下游错误。

papers.title: Discretizing Reward Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite their widespread use, the role of reward models in shaping reinforcement learning is poorly understood. Reward models offer a tempting promise: they automatically estimate response quality in the absence of verifiers or human judges. Unlike "verifiable rewards" which typically produce binary scores, reward models typically produce continuous scores, allowing them to be sensitive to fine-grained differences in responses. However, we show this apparent strength is a serious weakness: many popular reward models are oversensitive, assigning different scores to equally good responses. Theoretically, we show that seemingly perfect reward models can be highly oversensitive; empirically, this oversensitivity can lead to bad policies. In place of existing notions of "reward model accuracy," we propose evaluating reward models using distinct measures of "discriminative ability" and "specificity" (the complement of oversensitivity). As a solution, we describe a training-free algorithm that uses Monte Carlo dropout on any neural reward model to produce discrete reward clusters. Theoretically, we prove there exist discretizations that reduce oversensitivity at minimal expense of discriminative ability; empirically we show, in both controlled and natural RL settings, that discretizing rewards leads to less reward hacking and better policies than training on the original rewards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示奖励模型（reward models）的过度敏感性问题：看似完美的连续评分模型会对质量等同的回答给出不同分数，导致策略优化失败。作者提出用蒙特卡洛 dropout 对任意神经奖励模型进行离散化，生成离散奖励簇，并引入区分能力（discriminative ability）和特异性（specificity）两个新评估指标。理论和实验均表明，离散化后的奖励能在不显著牺牲区分能力的前提下降低过度敏感性，从而减少奖励黑客（reward hacking）并产生更优策略。
Motivation: 奖励模型被广泛用于强化学习中以自动估计响应质量，但其工作机制未被充分理解。连续评分看似能区分细微差异，实际却导致过度敏感，对同样好的回答给出不同分数，进而产生不良策略。
Method: 提出一种无需再训练的方法：对任意神经奖励模型应用蒙特卡洛 dropout，将其连续输出转化为离散奖励簇（discrete reward clusters）。同时建议用区分能力和特异性两个指标替代传统准确率评估。
Result: 理论上证明存在离散化方案可在最小降低区分能力的前提下显著减少过度敏感；实验上在受控和自然 RL 场景中均显示，离散化奖励比原始连续奖励更少出现奖励黑客，且学得策略更好。
Conclusion: 奖励模型的连续评分优势实为严重弱点，过度敏感是核心问题；离散化是一种简单有效的补救措施，可推广到多种奖励模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: THREAD: Trajectory Planning for Hybrid Rigid-Soft Manipulators with Environment-Aware Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Manipulation in confined environments, such as threading a manipulator through narrow apertures, remains a fundamental challenge, especially for conventional rigid robots. Hybrid rigid-soft manipulators offer promise but face two compounding planning challenges: backbone shapes feasible in free space become infeasible under environmental contact, and planning rigid and soft segments independently ignores their kinematic coupling. We present THREAD, the first diffusion-based trajectory planner for hybrid manipulation, learning a generative prior over physically realizable backbone trajectories conditioned on local environment geometry, with physics-inspired losses encoding curvature, smoothness, and collision constraints jointly across both segments. Trained in simulation, THREAD achieves 92.4% task success with 5x fewer collisions than the strongest baseline. We show cross-embodiment real-world transfer with minimal online updates, successfully threading through apertures as small as 1.3x the soft segment diameter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出THREAD，首个基于扩散模型的混合刚-软机械臂轨迹规划器，利用环境感知的扩散生成先验，结合物理启发损失（曲率、平滑度、碰撞约束）联合规划刚性和柔性段。在仿真中达到92.4%任务成功率，碰撞次数比最强基线少5倍，并通过少量在线更新实现跨实体真实世界迁移，成功穿过仅1.3倍软段直径的狭窄孔径。
Motivation: 混合刚-软机械臂在受限环境（如穿过狭窄孔径）中面临规划挑战：自由空间可行的背骨形状在接触环境下不可行，且刚性和柔性段独立规划忽略运动学耦合。
Method: 提出基于扩散的轨迹规划器THREAD，学习以局部环境几何为条件的物理可实现背骨轨迹的生成先验，使用物理启发损失联合编码曲率、平滑度和碰撞约束。
Result: 仿真中达到92.4%任务成功率，碰撞次数比最强基线少5倍；通过最小在线更新实现跨实体真实世界迁移，成功穿过1.3倍软段直径的孔径。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确总结局限，但展示了跨实体迁移能力，表明该方法在混合机械臂规划中的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Do Lorentz-Equivariant Jet Taggers Learn?
papers.abstract_en: We study what Lorentz-equivariant jet taggers learn internally, using equivariance tests, linear probes and grade ablations across five models including L-GATr, L-GATr-slim and LLoCa-T. Linear probes show that equivariant models suppress frame-dependent pseudorapidity to zero while encoding jet mass and N-subjettiness strongly. Grade ablations on L-GATr reveal that bivector channels are negligible for top-quark tagging while vector-like channels are dominant but seed variable, consistent with the network exploiting multiple representational pathways. These results characterize which physical features and algebraic grade structures carry discriminative information in equivariant taggers and may inform future development of such models.
papers.comment: Accepted at the AI4Physics Workshop, ICML 2026. 21 pages, 15 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了洛伦兹等变喷注标记器（如L-GATr、L-GATr-slim、LLoCa-T）内部学习到的物理特征和代数等级结构。通过线性探针（linear probes）发现等变模型能抑制帧依赖的赝快度（pseudorapidity）并强编码喷注质量（jet mass）和N-subjettiness。等级消融（grade ablation）实验表明，在顶夸克标记任务中，bivector通道贡献可忽略，而vector-like通道占主导但依赖初始种子，揭示了网络利用多重表示路径。
Motivation: 现有洛伦兹等变喷注标记器虽性能优异，但其内部决策依赖的物理特征和代数等级结构尚不明确，缺乏可解释性分析。
Method: 采用等变测试（equivariance tests）、线性探针和等级消融（grade ablations）三种分析方法，在L-GATr、L-GATr-slim和LLoCa-T等五个模型上进行实验。
Result: 线性探针显示等变模型将帧依赖赝快度抑制为零，同时强编码喷注质量和N-subjettiness；等级消融表明bivector通道对顶夸克标记不必要，vector-like通道占主导但随种子变化。
Conclusion: 这些发现明确了等变标记器中携带判别信息的物理特征（喷注质量、N-subjettiness）和代数等级（vector-like通道），可为未来模型设计提供指导。

summary_sections.conclusion: 这些发现明确了等变标记器中携带判别信息的物理特征（喷注质量、N-subjettiness）和代数等级（vector-like通道），可为未来模型设计提供指导。

papers.title: Bayesian three-dimensional seismic travel-time tomography for active- and passive-source seismic data using physics-informed neural network
papers.abstract_en: Accurate 3D seismic velocity modeling through seismic travel-time tomography using both active- and passive-source data provides critical underpinning models for seismicity monitoring and hazard assessment. Because travel-time tomography is an inherently ill-posed inverse problem, UQ of the estimated models using Bayesian methods is also important for reliable downstream interpretations and analyses. However, Bayesian inference for 3D tomography based on conventional grid-based representations faces the ``curse of dimensionality'' and severe computational bottlenecks. Consequently, rigorous Bayesian UQ for margin-wide 3D travel-time tomography has remained largely unexplored. In this study, we propose a meshless 3D Bayesian travel-time tomography method that combines PINNs with a neural representation of the velocity structure, enabling tractable and data-efficient Bayesian inference through function-space particle-based variational inference. To efficiently integrate passive-source data into the Bayesian estimation of the velocity structure, we conduct analytical marginalization treating uncertain source parameters as nuisance parameters, with passive-source relocation carried out in post-processing. We validated the capability of our approach for 3D problems through synthetic experiments. Furthermore, we applied the method to a real-world dataset from marine active-source surveys and natural earthquakes off the Kii Peninsula, Nankai Trough. Our probabilistic 3D ensemble successfully resolves key geological features and provides data-consistent uncertainty maps. The posterior mean hypocenters shifted mainly in the vertical direction by 10-15 km, consistent with a previous relocation result. Finally, the neural representation drastically reduces storage requirements for the entire ensemble velocity model, highlighting the scalability and data efficiency of the proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合物理信息神经网络（PINN）的无网格三维贝叶斯走时层析成像方法，同时利用主动源和被动源地震数据。通过函数空间粒子变分推断实现高维贝叶斯不确定性量化，并在合成实验和日本南海海槽熊野滩实际数据中验证，成功解析关键地质特征并提供数据一致的 uncertainty maps。神经表示显著降低了存储需求。
Motivation: 传统网格化三维贝叶斯走时层析成像面临维数灾难和计算瓶颈，难以实现区域尺度的严格贝叶斯不确定性量化，这限制了地震监测和灾害评估的可靠性。
Method: 采用PINN结合速度结构的神经表示，通过函数空间粒子变分推断进行高效贝叶斯推断。对被动源数据，通过解析边际化将震源参数视为 nuisance 参数，反事后进行震源重定位。
Result: 合成实验验证了该方法对三维问题的能力。实际数据应用表明，后验均值震源主要在垂直方向移动10–15 km，与前人重定位结果一致；概率集合成功分辨关键地质特征并生成 uncertainty maps。神经表示大幅压缩整个集合速度模型的存储。
Conclusion: 该框架为三维走时层析成像提供了可扩展且数据高效的贝叶斯不确定性量化方案，尤其适用于结合主动源和被动源数据的大规模问题。
