papers.title: Improving Text-to-Music Generation with Human Preference Rewards
papers.abstract_en: We describe our entry to the efficiency track of the Academic Text-to-Music (ATTM) Grand Challenge at ICME 2026. Beyond the challenge protocol's FAD-CLAP and CLAP score, we add a learned human-preference reward from TuneJury, a twin pairwise ranker trained over open music-preference datasets. The reward serves both as a training-time conditioning signal and as a sample-selection criterion. The pipeline combines five engineering decisions on a 120M-parameter FluxAudio-S backbone, four at training time and one at inference: (i) training-time reward conditioning that doubles as an inference-time CFG axis, (ii) a sweep over five score-conditioning architectures, where training and inference use different variants, (iii) expert iteration on the top decile, (iv) a short preference-tuning pass (CRPO) for audio-text alignment, and (v) inference post-processing via joint CFG, source separation, and loudness normalization. Per-stage decomposition on 100 Song Describer prompts shows training-time reward conditioning as a functional conditioning axis, expert iteration as the dominant contributor, the preference-tuning pass adding only noise-level gain, and the inference-time score scalar already saturated by the end of the chain.
papers.comment: ICME 2026 Grand Challenge on Academic Text-to-Music Generation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提交至ICME 2026学术文本到音乐生成（ATTM）大挑战的效率赛道。在竞赛协议的标准指标FAD-CLAP和CLAP分数之外，作者引入TuneJury——一个基于公开音乐偏好数据集训练的双重成对排序器，学习人类偏好奖励。该奖励同时作为训练时的条件信号和样本选择标准。整体流水线包含五项工程决策：训练时奖励条件化（同时作为推理时的CFG轴）、五种分数条件化架构的搜索、前10%样本的专家迭代、短偏好微调（CRPO）以及联合CFG、源分离和响度归一化的推理后处理。在100个Song Describer提示上的逐阶段分解表明，训练时奖励条件化是一个有效的条件化轴，专家迭代是主要贡献者，偏好微调仅带来噪声级增益，而推理时的分数缩放因子在链末端已饱和。
Motivation: 现有文本到音乐生成方法的评估指标（如FAD-CLAP和CLAP分数）可能不足以反映人类偏好，需要引入更直接的对齐奖励来提升生成质量。
Method: 提出一种结合人类偏好奖励的文本到音乐生成流水线，使用TuneJury的双重成对排序器学习奖励，并将其用于训练时的条件信号和推理时的样本选择。具体包含五项工程决策：训练时奖励条件化（同时作为CFG轴）、不同分数条件化架构的搜索、专家迭代、短偏好微调（CRPO）以及联合后处理（CFG、源分离、响度归一化）。
Result: 在100个Song Describer提示上的消融实验显示：训练时奖励条件化是一个有效的条件化轴；专家迭代是贡献最大的组件；偏好微调仅带来噪声级增益；推理时的分数缩放因子在链末端已饱和。
Conclusion: 该流水线通过多个工程决策有效提升了文本到音乐生成的质量，其中专家迭代和奖励条件化是关键组件，但偏好微调和推理缩放的作用有限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Framework for Directed Acyclic Hypergraph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continuous optimization methods for learning Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) operate on weighted adjacency matrices and are therefore limited to pairwise causal relationships. We propose a framework for learning Directed Acyclic Hypergraphs (DAHGs) from observational data, capturing joint parental influences that pairwise models cannot represent. Our approach rests on three components: (i) a generalized linear structural equation model (SEM) with multiplicative interaction terms whose non-zero weights correspond one-to-one with directed hyperedges; (ii) a weighted adjacency tensor representation whose acyclicity is characterized via nilpotency under the tensor t-product; and (iii) a differentiable acyclicity constraint derived through the Fourier decomposition of the t-product, which reduces tensor nilpotency to slice-wise matrix nilpotency and enables least-squares learning via the augmented Lagrangian method.
papers.comment: 3 pages. Accepted and presented as an oral presentation at the 9th Graph Signal Processing Workshop (GSP 2026), June 8-10, 2026, Madrid, Spain
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个从观测数据学习有向无环超图（DAHG）的框架，能够捕捉成对模型无法表示的联合父母影响。框架包括三个组成部分：广义线性结构方程模型、权重邻接张量表示、以及基于t积傅里叶分解的可微无环约束。该方法通过增强拉格朗日法实现最小二乘学习。
Motivation: 现有连续优化方法学习有向无环图（DAG）仅能处理成对因果关系，无法捕捉多个父节点对子节点的联合影响（joint parental influences）。本文旨在突破这一限制。
Method: 提出三个组成部分：(i) 带乘法交互项的广义线性结构方程模型，非零权重与有向超边一一对应；(ii) 权重邻接张量表示，其无环性通过张量t积的幂零性刻画；(iii) 基于t积傅里叶分解的可微无环约束，将张量幂零性简化为切片矩阵幂零性，并通过增强拉格朗日法进行最小二乘学习。

papers.title: Hallucination as Context Drift: Synchronization Protocols for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems routinely produce hallucinated outputs that cannot be explained by model deficiencies alone. A significant class of these failures arises not from model incapacity but from context drift: the divergence of internal knowledge states between concurrent agents. When agents enter a collaborative task with mismatched or stale representations of shared world state, their joint reasoning produces contradictions that manifest as hallucination. We define the Context Divergence Score (CDS), a lightweight scalar metric quantifying knowledge-state discrepancy between agent pairs across spatial, temporal, and task dimensions, and propose the Shared State Verification Protocol (SSVP), which lets agents periodically exchange compressed state summaries and flag high-divergence conditions before joint reasoning. We evaluate SSVP across two domains (multi-agent travel and software project planning) using Claude Haiku. In controlled experiments (n=30 per condition, travel; n=10, software) across 8 scenarios, naive full-broadcast synchronization increases hallucination rate by 34% above the no-sync baseline (HR: 0.658 vs. 0.492, p=0.0022, d=1.18), a contamination effect from propagating erroneous agent states. SSVP avoids this failure mode while showing modest, consistent reduction (HR: 0.463, d=0.30) and achieves significantly lower hallucination than full-broadcast (p=0.0005, d=1.47) using 58% fewer API calls. The contamination effect does not replicate in the software domain, where all conditions converge to low HR (<0.2), confirming it is specific to tasks where one erroneous shared belief cascades across evaluation dimensions. Our results reframe hallucination mitigation as a distributed systems problem and establish context synchronization as a first-class primitive in multi-agent LLM design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出多智能体LLM系统的幻觉部分源于上下文漂移，即智能体之间知识状态的分歧。提出上下文分歧分数(CDS)和共享状态验证协议(SSVP)，通过周期性交换压缩状态摘要并标记高分歧来缓解。实验表明全广播同步反而增加幻觉率34%，而SSVP温和降低幻觉率，并节省API调用。结论将幻觉缓解重新定义为分布式系统问题。
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统的幻觉不能仅归因于模型能力不足，一类重要失败源于智能体之间的上下文漂移，即内部知识状态的分歧。
Method: 定义上下文分歧分数(CDS)量化智能体对之间的知识状态差异，提出共享状态验证协议(SSVP)，允许智能体周期性交换压缩状态摘要，并在联合推理前标记高分歧条件。
Result: 在旅行和软件规划两个领域实验：全广播同步使幻觉率增加34%（HR 0.658 vs 0.492, p=0.0022, d=1.18），SSVP温和降低幻觉率（HR 0.463, d=0.30），且比全广播显著更低（p=0.0005, d=1.47），并减少58% API调用。软件领域污染效应不重现，所有条件HR<0.2。
Conclusion: 重新定义幻觉缓解为分布式系统问题，将上下文同步作为多智能体LLM设计的一等原语。

papers.title: UnityShots: Memory-Driven Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation with Boundary-Aware Gating
papers.abstract_en: Generating a coherent multi-shot video requires structured cross-shot memory. Subject appearance, scene context, and speaker identity must persist across cuts. Existing approaches either train end-to-end over fixed-length sequences and cannot scale, generate shot-by-shot with memory banks that grow linearly, or orchestrate pretrained generators under an LLM planner without a multi-shot-aware backbone. We present UnityShots, a memory-driven multi-shot audio-video generation system built on LTX-2.3, trained on annotated cinematic and music-video shots. The video stream maintains two fixed-size slots, a long-term memory (LTM) slot anchored to the opening shot and a short-term memory (STM) slot holding the immediately preceding tail, both updated at every cut by a boundary-conditioned gate that fuses visual cut probability and beat-tracker signals. The audio stream injects a reference speaker token at every shot to preserve vocal timbre without a sliding audio bank. A discrete cut-type prior, learned through AdaLN, becomes an inference-time control knob over transition strength. We release a benchmark of $200$ multi-cultural multi-shot sequences spanning six ethnic regions and ten or more languages, with per-shot reference identities, reference audio, and per-boundary transition labels. Evaluated across I2V, T2V, and R2V conditioning modes, UnityShots leads open-source baselines on every cross-shot coherence metric and matches the strongest closed-source system on the multi-shot axes.

papers.title: Chehre: An Emoji-Prompted Video Dataset for Perceptually Diverse Facial Expression Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Facial expressions are nonverbal social signals used in human interaction, but facial expression recognition datasets often focus on static images, basic emotion categories, or single deterministic annotations. We introduce Chehre, an emoji-prompted video dataset for analyzing dynamic facial expressions across a wide range of expressions for exploring inter-individual perceptual diversity. In Chehre, participants were prompted to express and record 40 facial emojis. Later, their facial motions were transferred onto synthetic faces to preserve privacy. A separate group of annotators analyzed the anonymized videos using emoji and label annotations, resulting in 2,111 high quality videos collected from 203 performers and validated by 902 annotators. We define two benchmark tasks: dominant expression recognition, which tests whether models recover the top human-rated labels, and distributional expression recognition, which tests whether models capture the diversity of human responses. We benchmark recent vision-language models using random sampling and persona prompting to generate multiple predictions per video. Results show that both tasks are challenging: among the models evaluated, the best-performing model achieves only 32.5% Top-1 accuracy on dominant expression recognition and a Spread Ratio well below the human reference on distributional recognition. Chehre provides a benchmark for evaluating diverse, dynamic, and distributional facial expression recognition
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍Chehre，一个由表情符号提示的视频数据集，用于分析动态面部表情及个体间感知多样性。数据集包含203名表演者录制的2,111段高质量视频，由902名标注者验证，并定义了主导表情识别和分布表情识别两个基准任务。评测结果显示当前视觉-语言模型在这些任务上表现有限，最佳模型在主导表情识别上Top-1准确率仅32.5%。
Motivation: 现有面部表情识别数据集多集中于静态图像、基本情绪类别或单一确定性标注，缺乏对动态表情和感知多样性的探索。
Method: 收集参与者根据40个面部表情符号表演并录制的视频，将面部运动迁移到合成面部以保护隐私；由另一组标注者使用表情符号和标签对匿名化视频进行标注；定义两个基准任务：主导表情识别（预测多数人类标签）和分布表情识别（捕捉人类响应的多样性）。
Result: 最佳模型在主导表情识别上Top-1准确率仅32.5%，分布识别的Spread Ratio远低于人类参考值，表明任务具有挑战性。
Conclusion: Chehre为评估多样化、动态和分布的面部表情识别提供了基准，并揭示了当前模型的局限性。

papers.title: PaaF: Raising the perceived quality of INR-Based Image Compression
papers.abstract_en: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for image compression, offering a fundamentally different approach from traditional and learned codecs. Nevertheless, INR-based methods for image compression suffer from long encoding times and a consistent performance gap in classic quality metrics such as PSNR. In this work, we explore the potential of purely INR-based compression methods and we propose PaaF (Picture as a Function), a novel INR-based image codec that introduces improved architectural design, adaptive quantization, and an efficient entropy coding scheme. These components are designed to enhance rate-distortion performance while preserving the simplicity and parallelizability of INR-based decoding. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements over existing INR-based methods in both quantitative metrics and perceptual quality. These findings highlight the potential of INR-based approaches and contribute to narrowing the gap between functional representations and more established compression paradigms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PaaF（Picture as a Function），一种基于隐式神经表示（INR）的图像压缩编解码器。通过改进架构设计、自适应量化和高效熵编码，该方案在保持解码简单性和并行性的同时提升了率失真性能。实验表明，PaaF在定量指标和感知质量上均优于现有INR方法，有助于缩小功能表示与传统压缩范式之间的差距。
Motivation: 现有基于INR的图像压缩方法存在编码时间长、PSNR等经典质量指标落后于传统和学习的编解码器的问题。
Method: 提出PaaF编解码器，包含改进的架构设计、自适应量化模块以及高效的熵编码方案，以提升率失真性能，同时保持INR解码的简洁性和可并行性。
Result: 实验结果显示，PaaF在定量指标和感知质量上均一致优于现有的INR压缩方法。
Conclusion: 该工作凸显了INR方法在图像压缩中的潜力，并有助于缩小功能表示与更成熟压缩范式之间的性能差距。

papers.title: ChainWorld: Composing Long-Horizon Desktop Workloads from Atomic OSWorld Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Computer use agents are evaluated almost exclusively on atomic desktop tasks, but realistic desktop work requires sustaining state across multiple objectives. We study this gap with ChainWorld, which composes atomic OSWorld tasks into long horizon desktop workloads through directional compatibility search while preserving the source evaluators. The resulting workload contains 347 chains of length two to four and compares two renderings of the same task sequence. In single turn evaluation, all tasks are presented together in one prompt. In multi turn evaluation, tasks are revealed one at a time. Across four current computer use agents, maximum chain completion is 31%. Multi turn evaluation improves completion for three models, but both protocols remain challenging. The two protocols also expose different failure profiles. Single turn failures concentrate on artifact precision, while multi turn failures more often reflect session management problems such as fragmented progress and later turn disengagement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChainWorld 通过方向性兼容性搜索将 OSWorld 原子任务组合成长视界桌面工作负载，包含 347 个长度为 2-4 的链，并保留原始评估器。在四个当前计算机使用智能体上，最大链完成率为 31%。单轮评估将所有任务一次给出，多轮评估逐步揭示任务。多轮评估提升了三个模型的完成率，但两种协议均仍具挑战性，且失败模式不同：单轮失败集中于工件精度，多轮失败更多源于会话管理问题（如进度碎片化和后期任务脱离）。
Motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体几乎仅在原子桌面任务上评估，但现实桌面工作需要在多个目标间维持状态，存在评估空白。
Method: 提出 ChainWorld，通过方向性兼容性搜索将原子 OSWorld 任务组合成长序列工作负载，保留原始评估器，并设计单轮（所有任务一次提示）和多轮（逐个揭示任务）两种评估协议。
Result: 在四个当前智能体上，最大链完成率为 31%；多轮评估提升了三个模型的完成率，但两种协议仍具挑战性。单轮失败集中于工件精度，多轮失败更多反映会话管理问题。
Conclusion: 现有智能体在长序列桌面任务中表现有限，两种评估协议揭示了不同的失败模式，需要进一步研究以提升复杂任务中的状态维持能力。

papers.title: Behavioral and Representational Evidence of Binomial Ordering Preferences in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can readily reproduce conventional expressions, yet their ability to model gradient frequency distributions remains underexplored. We investigate this using linguistic binomials, such as men and women, where both word permutations are grammatically valid but exhibit distinct, cross-linguistic variations in conventionality. We formalize binomial ordering as a distributional alignment problem, and construct a multilingual dataset of 600 binomial pairs across 8 languages. With categorical and distributional metrics, we measure and compare the corpus-derived preferences with model-induced ordering probabilities of 6 open-weight LLMs. While models often behaviorally recover the dominant corpus-preferred order, particularly for strongly conventionalized pairs, they align less well with the exact corpus preference distributions. This suggests that apparent directional order overstates how faithfully LLMs capture the statistical nuances of language use. Sparse probing verifies that the concept of preference strength is partially encoded among middle-to-late layers, and steering along probe-derived directions alters model-induced ordering distributions, demonstrating that the statistical behavioral preference of LLMs can be mechanistically measured and manipulated via internal representations.
papers.comment: Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/Zhi-qing-Yang/Linguistic-Binomials-in-Large-Language-Models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究大型语言模型对语言中二项式（如 men and women）排列偏好的建模能力，将其形式化为分布对齐问题，构建了包含8种语言600对二项式的多语言数据集。使用分类和分布度量指标，比较了语料库偏好与6个开放权重模型产生的排序概率，发现模型能恢复主流顺序但无法精确匹配偏好分布，表明表面定向顺序夸大了模型捕捉统计细微差别的忠实性。通过稀疏探测验证偏好强度在中间到后期层部分编码，并可沿探测方向操纵模型排序分布。
Motivation: 现有研究关注LLM对固化表达式的能力，但对梯度频率分布（如二项式中两种合法顺序的不同使用频率）的建模能力尚未充分探索。
Method: 将二项式排序形式化为分布对齐问题，构建600对、8语言数据集；采用分类和分布度量指标比较语料库偏好与模型排序概率；通过稀疏探测和沿探测方向操纵内部表示来验证和影响偏好强度。
Result: 模型在强规约化对（highly conventionalized pairs）上行为上恢复语料库主流顺序，但对精确偏好分布的匹配较差；稀疏探测表明偏好强度在中间至后期层部分编码，且操纵探测方向可改变模型排序分布。
Conclusion: 表面上的定向顺序夸大了LLM忠实地捕捉语言使用统计细微差别的能力；模型内部的偏好强度是可以被测量和机械性操纵的。

papers.title: When Is an LLM Worth It for Hyperparameter Optimization? A Budget-Matched Study on Tabular Data Finds the Warm-Start Is a Default Configuration, Not the Model
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have been proposed as hyperparameter-optimization (HPO) advisors that "warm-start" search from prior knowledge, proposing strong configurations in very few evaluations. We test that claim under a budget-matched, multi-seed protocol on eight PMLB tabular benchmarks, comparing an LLM advisor (LLM-OptFlow) against four classical baselines (random search, Optuna-TPE, Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization, and successive halving) over one shared search space, with paired tests and bootstrap 95% CIs across 8 x 5 = 40 (task, seed) units. The finding is cautionary. The advisor's strong first point is not an LLM output at all: like prior LLM-HPO systems the loop is seeded with a fixed default configuration, evaluated before any model call, which alone reaches 88.7% mean best-CV, identical to within 0.01 pp across all seven advisor models tested. The LLM's own proposals add only +0.40 pp of cross-validation accuracy over that seed and nothing on held-out test (LLM-Default = -0.01 pp, p = 0.92). When the same seed is granted to classical search, the apparent lead collapses: against seeded random search it leads by +0.20 pp at 2 evaluations, is tied by 5, and is behind by 12 (-0.37 pp). Without the seed, classical search ties the advisor by 12 evaluations and beats it by 40 (+0.6 to +0.8 pp, p <= 1e-4). Two LLM-specific behaviors survive: a single-task exploration failure (vehicle), and a rule-based confidence filter that removes ~33% of wasted compute without changing accuracy. The recommendation is deflationary: on tabular HPO, seed classical search with a sensible default; an LLM advisor adds no measurable generalization benefit and is overtaken within a handful of evaluations. We release the harness and a script that reproduces every statistic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过预算匹配的多种子实验，在8个PMLB表格基准上测试LLM作为超参数优化顾问的效果。发现LLM顾问的初始强点实际上来自固定的默认配置，而非LLM输出；LLM的提议仅带来微不足道的精度提升，且很快被经典搜索方法超越。结论是对于表格超参数优化，使用经典搜索加上合理默认配置即可，LLM顾问无额外泛化收益。
Motivation: 已有工作声称LLM能作为HPO顾问通过知识预热搜索，在很少评估次数内给出强配置，但缺乏严格对照实验验证。
Method: 在8个PMLB表格数据基准上，采用预算匹配的多种子协议（8x5=40个单元），比较LLM顾问（LLM-OptFlow）与四种经典基线（随机搜索、Optuna-TPE、高斯过程贝叶斯优化、连续减半），共享搜索空间，配对检验及bootstrap 95%置信区间。

Conclusion: 在表格数据HPO上，简单地将经典搜索与合理默认配置结合即可，LLM顾问不提供可测的泛化增益，且在少量评估次数内被超越。

papers.title: A new classification method based on Minimum Spanning Trees
papers.abstract_en: Minimum Spanning Trees have been used in unsupervised learning, particularly in clustering tasks, due to their ability to recognize clusters by removing edges that are considered inconsistent in defining those clusters. This paper aims to study the use of Minimum Spanning Trees in supervised learning. Specifically, we propose a classification algorithm based on Minimum Spanning Trees. To improve its performance, we introduce a robust version of the method that is also computationally more efficient. We evaluate the effectiveness of our proposed method through an extensive simulation study. We also apply the proposed methodology to a real-world case study involving aircraft trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: MST在无监督聚类中已有成功应用，但其在监督分类中的潜力尚未被充分探索。

papers.title: HERALD: High-Throughput Block Diffusion LLM Serving via CPU-GPU Cooperative KV Cache Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) improve GPU utilization over autoregressive decoding by generating multiple tokens per forward pass, but their KV cache still grows linearly with context, limiting throughput at long contexts. KV cache offloading to host DRAM alleviates this memory pressure, but the limited PCIe bandwidth necessitates recalling only a sparse subset of KV entries. In block dLLMs, the relevant KV entries remain consistent across denoising steps within a block, enabling high-accuracy selection by identifying the top-k entries once and reusing them throughout all denoising steps. This property appears attractive for offloading as it amortizes the selection overhead across the entire block, but it requires exact attention over the full KV cache, which is too expensive under offloading. We present HERALD, a KV offloading system for block dLLMs that resolves this through two opportunities that reduce the required selection compute by a factor of the block size and enable selection to be overlapped with denoising. Across three block dLLMs and five long context tasks, HERALD achieves near-lossless accuracy at 5-10% KV budget and up to 1.59x lower per block latency and 2.47x higher throughput over GPU-only inference, with speedups growing with context length.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HERALD 提出一种面向块状扩散大语言模型 (block dLLM) 的 KV 缓存卸载系统，利用块内去噪步骤间 KV 条目一致性，仅需一次性选择 top-k 条目并在整个块中复用，从而将选择计算量降低数倍并与去噪过程重叠。实验表明在 5-10% KV 预算下实现近无损精度，相比纯 GPU 推理每块延迟降低 1.59 倍，吞吐量提升 2.47 倍，且加速比随上下文长度增长。
Motivation: 扩散 LLM 虽提高了 GPU 利用率，但 KV 缓存仍随上下文线性增长，长上下文时吞吐受限。卸载到主机 DRAM 可缓解内存压力，但 PCIe 带宽有限，需只召回稀疏 KV 条目。
Method: 基于块 dLLM 中 KV 条目在块内去噪步骤间保持一致的特性，提出 HERALD：一次识别 top-k KV 条目并跨所有去噪步骤复用，大幅减少选择计算量；同时将选择与去噪阶段重叠，隐藏卸载开销。
Result: 在三种块 dLLM 和五个长上下文任务中，HERALD 在 5-10% KV 预算下实现近无损精度，每块延迟降低至 1/1.59，吞吐量提升至 2.47 倍，且优势随上下文长度增加而扩大。
Conclusion: HERALD 有效解决了块 dLLM 中 KV 缓存卸载的计算与带宽瓶颈，实现了高吞吐、低延迟的长上下文推理，且精度损失极小。

papers.title: CuratorKIT : Data Curation and Synthetic Data Generation for LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Data curation is a critical part of post-training pipelines for large language models, yet existing tools often treat ingestion, deduplication, synthetic generation, and quality filtering as separate stages. This fragmentation makes it difficult to audit pipeline decisions or understand why individual samples are rejected. CuratorKIT is an open-source Python library that covers this full lifecycle in a single configurable pipeline. The framework is composed of six source format readers and automatic schema detection, a pre-generation data hygiene layer for credentials, PII, and toxic content, eight LLM-powered generation tasks, three complementary quality gates with provenance-exact hallucination verification, structured adaptive recovery, and five training-ready export formats compatible with TRL, Unsloth, and AlignTune. Every pipeline decision is recorded in an append-only per-sample provenance chain, and rejected samples carry structured failure reasons rather than being silently discarded. CuratorKIT supports 100+ LLM providers through LiteLLM, exposes both a Python API and a YAML-driven CLI, and is designed for practitioners who need reproducible, auditable data pipelines at scale .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CuratorKIT 是一个开源 Python 库，为大型语言模型的后训练提供完整的数据策展流水线，涵盖数据摄取、去重、合成数据生成和质量过滤。该框架包含多种输入格式读取器、预生成数据卫生层、八种 LLM 驱动的生成任务、三个质量门控（带有溯源精确的幻觉验证）、结构化自适应恢复以及五种训练就绪导出格式。所有流水线决策记录在不可追加的样本级溯源链中，拒绝样本附带结构化失败原因。
Motivation: 现有工具将数据摄取、去重、合成生成和质量过滤视为分离阶段，导致审计困难和样本拒绝原因不透明。CuratorKIT 通过单一可配置流水线覆盖全生命周期，并提供可审计性。
Method: CuratorKIT 由六个源格式读取器和自动模式检测、预生成数据卫生层（处理凭据、PII 和有毒内容）、八个 LLM 驱动的生成任务、三个互补质量门控（包含来源精确的幻觉验证）、结构化自适应恢复以及五种训练就绪导出格式（兼容 TRL、Unsloth 和 AlignTune）组成。所有流水线决策记录在不可追加的样本级溯源链中。
Result: 摘要未提供具体的定量实验结果，仅描述了框架的功能特性。
Conclusion: CuratorKIT 支持通过 LiteLLM 接入 100+ 个 LLM 提供商，提供 Python API 和 YAML 驱动的 CLI，面向需要可重现、可审计且可扩展数据流水线的从业者。

papers.title: Counsel: A Meta-Evaluation Dataset for Agentic Tasks
papers.abstract_en: As agentic systems tackle increasingly complex multi-step tasks, evaluating their trajectories presents a major bottleneck - human annotation of a single trajectory on popular agentic benchmarks can take hours, making it difficult to scale evaluations for measuring performance or curating training data. This has driven widespread reliance on automated approaches such as LLM-as-a-judge (LLMJ) to critique agents at the process and outcome-levels at scale, however, the soundness of LLMJ critiques often goes unmeasured. Here, we introduce Counsel, the first public dataset of meta-evaluations for agentic tasks. Counsel consists of process-level critiques from open-weight LLMJs on two agent benchmarks: tau-bench (customer support agents) and DA-Code (coding agents), and human meta-evaluations of these critiques. Human annotators label critiques on each flagged error as "spot on", "correct location but poor reasoning", or "should not have flagged", achieving reliable inter-annotator agreement (Krippendorff's alpha of 0.78). The resulting dataset stratifies LLMJ critiques by human alignment across both error location within a trajectory and reasoning quality, serving as valuable data to calibrate, improve, or train LLMJs for agents. Comparing open-weight judges, we find that more capable judge models and more reasoning effort both enabled improved human agreement, with the strongest judge reaching ~88% agreement on location and ~65% on reasoning. Counsel is generated using open-weight models and is permissively licensed for broad community use, which we hope will enable rigorous study and improved alignment of LLM-based evaluators for agentic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了Counsel，首个针对智能体（agentic）任务的元评估（meta-evaluation）公开数据集。该数据集包含两个智能体基准（tau-bench和DA-Code）上开源LLM裁判（LLM-as-a-judge）对过程级错误标注的批评，以及人类对这些批评的元评估（标注为“准确”、“位置正确但推理差”、“不应标记”），实现较高一致性（Krippendorff's alpha 0.78）。实验发现，更强的裁判模型和更多推理努力均能提升与人类的一致性，最强裁判在错误定位和推理质量上分别达到约88%和65%的一致率。
Motivation: 智能体系统处理多步复杂任务时，人工评估每条轨迹耗时数小时，难以规模化为衡量性能或收集训练数据。自动评估方法（如LLM-as-a-judge）虽被广泛采用，但其批评质量常缺乏度量。
Method: 构建Counsel数据集：收集开源LLM裁判在tau-bench和DA-Code两个智能体基准上的过程级批评，并由人工标注员对每条批评的定位和推理质量进行三级元评估（‘准确’、‘位置正确但推理差’、‘不应标记’），确保标注者间一致（Krippendorff's alpha 0.78）。
Result: 比较不同开源裁判模型发现，更强模型和更多推理努力均能提升与人类标注的一致率，最优模型在错误定位上达到约88%一致率，在推理质量上达到约65%一致率。
Conclusion: Counsel数据集可用于校准、改进或训练面向智能体的LLM裁判，其使用开放权重模型生成并采用宽松许可，旨在促进对LLM评估者对齐的严谨研究。

papers.title: A DVDrive Approach for doScenes Instructed Driving Challenge
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-conditioned trajectory prediction is an emerging problem in autonomous driving, where a model predicts the future ego trajectory not only from visual scene context and historical motion, but also from a natural-language maneuver instruction. This paper presents our submission to the doScenes Instructed Driving Challenge, built upon OmniDrive, a vision-language-action driving agent with 3D perception, reasoning, and planning capabilities. We adapt OmniDrive to the doScenes setting by training it on instruction-annotated nuScenes scenes and generating a 6-second ego trajectory represented by 12 future waypoints. To improve multi-view visual grounding, we further introduce a DVPE-style divided-view perception module into the OmniDrive perception head. Instead of attending globally to all camera features, the proposed module groups query features and image tokens into divided local view spaces and performs visibility-aware cross-attention within each view. This design reduces irrelevant cross-view interference and helps the model better align language instructions with local driving-relevant visual evidence. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/feel12348/doscenes-omnidrive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对doScenes指令驾驶挑战，本文基于OmniDrive提出改进，引入分视角感知模块（DVPE-style），将查询特征和图像令牌分组到局部视图空间进行可见性感知交叉注意力，以减少跨视角干扰，提升自然语言指令条件下的多视角视觉定位能力。模型在nuScenes上训练，生成6秒12个航点的未来轨迹。
Motivation: 现有指令条件轨迹预测中，模型难以将语言指令与多摄像头视觉证据正确对齐，存在跨视角干扰问题。
Method: 在OmniDrive感知头中引入分视角感知模块，将查询特征和图像令牌分组到划分的局部视图空间，每个视图内进行可见性感知交叉注意力，减少无关跨视角干扰。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化结果，仅描述方法设计。
Conclusion: 所提分视角注意力机制有助于模型更好对齐语言指令与驾驶相关视觉证据。

summary_sections.conclusion: 所提分视角注意力机制有助于模型更好对齐语言指令与驾驶相关视觉证据。

papers.title: Evaluating Document-Tuned Transformer Representations for Person-level Mental Health Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Person-level psychological assessment requires aggregating meaning across many messages from the same individual, a task that document-level training objectives were not explicitly designed for. We present a systematic, empirical comparison between architecturally matched traditional (a) base-transformers and (b) document-tuned-transformers (further contrastively fine-tuned at the document-level, sometimes referred to as "sentence transformers") under otherwise identical conditions. Comparing layer-wise and overall performance across two longitudinal mental health and psychological datasets, we find document-tuned models demonstrated a consistent improvement over base representations (increase in Pearson r of 13.4%, p=.015). Robustness analyses revealed document-tuned models remained more accurate under perturbations to word deletion, synonym replacement, typo injection, and back translation. Further, hedged language (e.g., `usually') was more characteristic of outcomes in document-tuned embeddings while abundance (e.g., `lot') was more characteristic of base-transformers, suggesting document-tuned models may better capture uncertainty. These results suggest representation choice impacts mental health prediction, document-tuned models often being more adept.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了基础Transformer和文档级微调Transformer（document-tuned transformers）在个体心理健康评估中的表现。在纵向心理健康数据集上，文档微调模型在Pearson r上平均提升13.4%（p=0.015），并对单词删除、同义词替换等扰动表现出更强鲁棒性。词分析表明文档微调嵌入更关注不确定语言（如“通常”），而基础模型更关注丰度词（如“很多”）。
Motivation: 个体层面的心理评估需要聚合同一人多条消息的语义，但文档级训练目标并非为此设计。现有方法缺乏对表示选择影响的系统比较。
Method: 在相同条件下对比两类架构：基础Transformer（base-transformer）与文档级对比微调后的Transformer（document-tuned transformer，常称sentence transformer）。在纵向心理健康数据集上逐层及整体比较，并做鲁棒性分析和嵌入词特征分析。
Result: 文档微调模型在Pearson r上提升13.4%（p=0.015），且在单词删除、同义词替换、打字错误注入和回译扰动下保持更高准确率。其嵌入更倾向于表达不确定性的词（如“通常”），而基础模型更倾向丰度词（如“很多”）。
Conclusion: 表示选择显著影响心理健康预测性能，文档微调模型通常表现更佳。

papers.title: The Alignment Problem in Constrained Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in code generation, but their outputs frequently contain syntax or type errors that result in compilation failures. Constrained decoding has been proposed as a solution to mitigate compilation errors by construction, improving functional correctness as a byproduct. However, previous works overlook a critical aspect of constrained decoding: the alignment between constrainer (e.g., types), language model and the target specification language (e.g., TypeScript). Misalignment is caused by the constrainer being incomplete--rejecting programs that belong to the target--or unsound--allowing programs that are not part of the target. The bias created by incompleteness distorts the language model distribution, and can be detrimental for code generation. We evaluate this hypothesis using seven language models, two target languages, two constrainers, enforcing types and syntax during decoding, and we study how language models react to varying levels of incompleteness. On three benchmarks, when the constrainer is incomplete, unconstrained decoding significantly outperforms constrained decoding in terms of functional correctness. Incompleteness pushes the model into low-probability regions of the program space, causing the generation to frequently time out, and reducing functional correctness by up to 97%. These contributions make the community aware of the negative effects of misalignment in constrained decoding, and provide quantitative insights on how to design constrainers that are beneficial for code generation systems with formal guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究约束解码在代码生成中的对齐问题，发现约束器（如类型检查器）的不完整性会扭曲语言模型分布，导致无约束解码在功能正确性上显著优于约束解码，甚至使功能正确性降低高达97%。
Motivation: 现有约束解码方法忽略约束器、语言模型和目标规范语言之间的对齐问题，约束器的不完整或不正确会损害代码生成性能。
Method: 使用七个语言模型、两个目标语言和两个约束器（强制类型和语法）进行实验，测量不同不完整性水平下语言模型的行为。
Result: 在三个基准上，当约束器不完整时，无约束解码在功能正确性上显著优于约束解码，约束解码导致生成超时频繁，功能正确性降低高达97%。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁社区注意约束解码中未对齐的负面效应，并提供设计有益约束器的定量见解。

papers.title: Cross-Modal Corroboration for Annotation-Free Wildlife Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Scaling wildlife monitoring for real-world conservation deployments requires automated analysis of smart sensors that operate under severe annotation scarcity. We propose leveraging expert knowledge of species activity patterns as an annotation-free validation signal for multimodal monitoring pipelines. We operationalize agreement as the alignment of independently derived hourly activity curves both with each other and with published behavioral priors-a three-way convergence that rules out shared-data confounds and dataset-internal correlation as alternative explanations. Our vision pipeline combines zero-shot species detection via BioCLIP 2, sliced inference to handle deployment-constrained camera positioning, and geometry-based geographic localization from camera trap imagery. Our acoustic pipeline detects species vocalizations via a fine-tuned classifier. We validate the pipeline on a breeding herd of Milu deer and demonstrate that both modalities independently recover activity patterns consistent with known deer behavioral ecology with minimal manual annotation. The framework applies to species detectable in both visual and acoustic modalities for which behavioral priors are documented in the literature, suggesting a practical path toward self-validating wildlife-monitoring pipelines at conservation scale.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无标注的跨模态验证框架用于野生动物监测，利用物种活动模式的专家知识作为验证信号。方法结合视觉（BioCLIP 2）和声学（分类器）管道，通过三路一致性（模态间对齐、与行为先验对齐）避免数据污染。在Milu鹿群上验证，两种模态独立恢复的活动模式与已知行为生态一致。
Motivation: 野生动物监测部署面临标注稀缺问题，需要无标注的自动分析方法。
Method: 提出跨模态验证框架，视觉管道使用BioCLIP 2零样本检测、切片推理和几何定位；声学管道使用微调分类器检测鸣叫。通过三路一致性（模态间、与行为先验）进行验证。
Result: 在Milu鹿繁殖群上验证，两模态独立恢复的活动模式与已知鹿行为生态一致，需要最少人工标注。
Conclusion: 框架适用于视觉和声学均可检测的物种，且文献中有行为先验，提供一条通向自验证野生动物监测管道的实用路径。

papers.title: The Two-Hump Problem: Bridging the Difficulty Gap in Mathematical Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Mathematical search problems present a unique challenge for Reinforcement Learning (RL) due to vast search spaces and sparse rewards. In previous works, the Andrews-Curtis (AC) conjecture was established as an illustrative example of such problems. In this work, we identify a critical structural barrier in the AC landscape: a "Two-Hump" distribution, where problem instances are either trivially solvable or effectively impossible, with a scarcity of intermediate "hard-but-solvable" instances required for effective learning. We tackle this challenge through two primary avenues: novel data generation techniques to populate the difficulty gap, and significant algorithmic enhancements including the introduction of supermoves and Transformer-based architectures. We demonstrate substantial performance improvements over previous baselines, and release new comprehensive benchmark datasets including AC-19 (125,192 AC-trivial presentations of varying difficulty with length at most 19) and AC-1M (1,136,154 hard AC-trivial presentations of length at most 30), the first large-scale, publicly available datasets of this kind.

papers.title: CurvSegFlow: Time-Conditioned Flow Matching for Robust Segmentation of Curvilinear Structures in Noisy Biomedical Images
papers.abstract_en: Accurate segmentation of curvilinear structures remains challenging in biomedical imaging due to their thin geometry, complex topology, and sensitivity to noise. This is particularly critical for microscopy images of cytoskeletal network, where low signal-to-noise ratios and dense filament crossings often lead to fragmented or inaccurate segmentation. In this work, we propose CurvSegFlow, a segmentation framework based on time-conditioned flow matching. Instead of predicting a segmentation mask in a single pass, the method models segmentation as a dynamic process that progressively refines a noisy initialization into the target structure through a learned velocity field. The proposed model combines a U-Net backbone with triple-term loss function and temporal embeddings to guide the refinement process across reconstruction stages. This formulation enables gradual error correction and improves the continuity of thin structures. CurvSegFlow is evaluated on multiple synthetic and real microtubule datasets, as well as on public benchmarks of retinal vessels, corneal nerves and coronary arteries. Across datasets, the method achieves competitive or superior performance compared to established segmentation models, with consistent improvements in precision and structural continuity, particularly under low signal-to-noise conditions. These results show that flow-based iterative refinement provides a robust and general framework for curvilinear structure segmentation. Overall, the proposed approach improves segmentation quality in challenging imaging conditions and generalizes effectively across modalities without architectural changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对生物医学图像中曲线结构（如细胞骨架、视网膜血管）分割难题，提出基于时间条件流匹配（time-conditioned flow matching）的CurvSegFlow框架。该方法将分割建模为动态过程，通过学习的速度场逐步细化噪声初始化，结合U-Net骨架、三重损失函数和时间嵌入。在多个合成和真实数据集上（包括微管、视网膜血管、角膜神经、冠状动脉）取得竞争性或更优性能，尤其在低信噪比下提升了连续性和精度。
Motivation: 曲线结构分割因薄几何、复杂拓扑和噪声敏感而困难，现有方法在低信噪比和密集交叉处容易产生碎片化或不准确分割。
Method: 采用时间条件流匹配，将分割视为逐步细化过程；使用U-Net骨干网络，结合三重损失函数和时间嵌入来指导重建阶段的细化。
Result: 在多个数据集上（合成/真实微管、视网膜血管、角膜神经、冠状动脉）达到竞争性或更优性能，尤其在低信噪比下精度和结构连续性持续改善。
Conclusion: 基于流的迭代细化提供了鲁棒且通用的曲线结构分割框架，无需架构变化即可跨模态泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: T-MOR: Learning Motion-Aware Skeleton Representations for Human Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models such as CLIP have recently achieved strong performance on a wide range of visual understanding tasks. However, most existing models rely primarily on appearance-level supervision from images or videos, and do not explicitly model human motion, which is essential for fine-grained and human-centric action recognition task as actions are defined by temporally structured and physically grounded body movements. To address this problem, we propose Transferable skeleton MOtion Representation (T-MOR), a motion-aware framework that learns transferable action representations from skeleton sequences with the aid of video and language supervision during training. T-MOR adopts a multi-modal contrastive learning scheme that aligns skeleton motion with visual and textual representations, while performing inference using only lightweight skeleton inputs. To support large-scale pre-training, we construct PoseCap-1M, a new dataset that contains over one million synchronized video, skeleton, and text triplets covering diverse human activities. We evaluate T-MOR on a range of human-centric action recognition benchmarks, including action classification and frame-wise temporal detection. Experimental results show that T-MOR consistently improves performance across multiple datasets, such as Toyota Smarthome, Penn Action, UAV-Human, TSU, and Charades. In addition, T-MOR demonstrates strong generalization ability in few-shot and zero-shot settings, highlighting the effectiveness of motion-centric and embodied representations for transferable action understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出T-MOR（可迁移骨骼运动表示），一种基于运动感知的框架，利用视频和语言监督从骨骼序列学习可迁移的动作表示，用于细粒度人体动作识别。T-MOR采用多模态对比学习对齐骨骼运动与视觉、文本表示，推理时仅需轻量骨骼输入。构建了包含超过100万视频-骨骼-文本三元组的数据集PoseCap-1M用于大规模预训练。在Toyota Smarthome、Penn Action、UAV-Human、TSU、Charades等数据集上，动作分类和帧级时序检测任务均取得一致性能提升，并在小样本和零样本设置下展现强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型主要依赖图像或视频的外观级监督，缺乏对人体运动的显式建模，而动作识别需要理解时间结构和物理基础的身体运动。
Method: 提出T-MOR框架，采用多模态对比学习将骨骼运动表示与视觉、文本表示对齐，训练时使用视频和语言监督，推理时仅使用轻量骨骼输入。同时构建了大规模PoseCap-1M数据集。
Result: 在Toyota Smarthome、Penn Action、UAV-Human、TSU、Charades等基准上，动作分类和帧级时序检测任务均取得一致性能提升，并在小样本和零样本设置下展现强泛化能力。
Conclusion: T-MOR证明了以运动为中心和具身化表示对于可迁移动作理解的有效性，且仅需轻量骨骼输入即可实现高效推理。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在Toyota Smarthome、Penn Action、UAV-Human、TSU、Charades等基准上，动作分类和帧级时序检测任务均取得一致性能提升，并在小样本和零样本设置下展现强泛化能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: T-MOR证明了以运动为中心和具身化表示对于可迁移动作理解的有效性，且仅需轻量骨骼输入即可实现高效推理。

papers.title: $μ$Match: Foundation Models for Semi-supervised Learning and Domain Adaptation in EM
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models have substantially advanced computer vision, enabling state-of-the-art performance in zero- and few-shot settings. They have been successfully applied to biomedical imaging tasks ranging from organ segmentation in computed tomography to cell segmentation in light microscopy. Electron microscopy (EM) is a central modality for analyzing cellular ultrastructure due to its nanometer-scale resolution. However, the application of foundation models in EM has so far been limited to specific organelles, such as mitochondria, largely due to the diversity of segmentation tasks and the scarcity of comprehensively annotated data. As a result, EM segmentation still predominantly relies on supervised learning, requiring extensive manual annotation and limiting ultrastructural analysis. To address this gap, we propose $μ$Match, a framework for semi-supervised learning and domain adaptation that leverages foundation models. We implement state-of-the-art student-teacher-based methods and evaluate multiple foundation models (SAM, SAM2, $μ$SAM, DINOv2/v3) on challenging EM tasks, including mitochondrion, nucleus, and neurite segmentation. Our results demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines and highlight a path toward substantially reducing the annotation effort in EM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出μMatch框架，用于电子显微镜（EM）图像分割中的半监督学习和领域适应，利用基础模型（SAM、SAM2、μSAM、DINOv2/v3）结合学生-教师方法，在线粒体、细胞核和神经突分割上取得优于强基线的结果，展示了减少EM标注工作的潜力。
Motivation: 电子显微镜（EM）中基础模型的应用局限于特定细胞器（如线粒体），因为分割任务多样且注释数据稀缺；现有方法仍依赖大量人工标注，限制了超微结构分析。
Method: 提出μMatch框架，实现多种学生-教师半监督学习方法，并评估多个基础模型（SAM, SAM2, μSAM, DINOv2/v3）在EM分割任务上的效果。
Result: 在线粒体、细胞核和神经突分割任务上，该方法一致地优于强基线，表明能显著减少标注工作。
Conclusion: 本文证明基础模型结合半监督学习可有效降低EM中的注释需求，为广泛超微结构分析提供路径。

papers.title: Learning to Place Guards by Reinforcement: A Geo-Free Neural Policy for the Vertex-Guard Art Gallery Problem
papers.abstract_en: Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) has shown that policies trained by reinforcement can construct strong solutions to NP-hard problems directly from raw instances. What such a policy actually learns, as opposed to what its decoder expresses, remains much less clear. We study this distinction on the vertex-guard Art Gallery Problem, the NP-hard task of choosing polygon vertices from which to observe an entire region. A pointer-network policy is trained from a coverage-aware reward over its own rollouts under the constraint we call geo-free inference: at test time it sees only vertex coordinates, with no visibility computation and no geometric oracle. The policy places guards economically but leaves a tail of under-covered polygons that widens far beyond the training range. To locate the cause, we freeze the trained encoder and read its embeddings with a small single-shot classifier, still geo-free at inference. The classifier closes most of the feasibility gap, in and out of distribution and at up to roughly five times the training range, cutting under-covered polygons by about an order of magnitude at an explicitly reported cost in guard count. We read this as evidence that the reinforcement-trained representation already encodes the geometry required for feasibility, and that residual failures reflect decoder calibration rather than missing knowledge. Probing a frozen encoder thus offers a practical way to ask what a neural combinatorial solver has internalized.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过强化学习训练指针网络策略，直接根据原始顶点坐标解决NP难的顶点守护艺术画廊问题，无需测试时的几何计算。研究发现，冻结的编码器嵌入已经包含了足够的几何信息来保证可行性，而解码阶段的校准不足是失败主因。
Motivation: 现有神经组合优化研究关注策略表达，但较少探究策略实际学到了什么。本文针对顶点守护艺术画廊问题，研究强化学习训练的策略内部表征。
Method: 训练一个基于覆盖率奖励的指针网络策略，使用geo-free推理（测试时仅见顶点坐标，无可见性计算）。通过冻结编码器并用小型单次分类器读取嵌入来评估内部几何知识。
Result: 该分类器大幅缩小了可行性差距，在分布内外及训练规模约五倍范围内将覆盖不足的多边形数量减少约一个数量级，但以增加守卫数为代价。
Conclusion: 实验表明，强化学习训练的表征已编码了可行性所需的几何信息，残余失败主要源于解码器校准而非缺失知识。本文提供了一种探究神经组合求解器内部化知识的实用方法。

papers.title: Deep Unrolled Networks in Representation Space Applied to MRI Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Deep unrolled networks (DUNs) integrate physical forward models with learned regularization in cascaded network architectures, achieving exceptional performance in inverse problems while maintaining interpretability. While most DUNs operate in the object domain (e.g., image space), recent variants explored representation spaces for improved information flow. However, these methods rely on heuristic methods for data consistency (DC), sacrificing fidelity with measurements. In this work, we introduce DUNE (Deep Unrolled Networks in rEpresentation space), a framework that maintains exact adherence to physical measurements while operating in learned representation spaces. By deriving the DC gradient via the chain rule and implementing it through the Vector-Jacobian Product (VJP), we enable exact backpropagation of measurement residuals into the representation space. This formulation supports diverse architectural backbones, including pre-trained encoders to guide the iterative process. We assess DUNE against state-of-the-art baselines on accelerated MRI reconstruction tasks, demonstrating that exact VJP-based gradients yield superior reconstruction quality and structural fidelity across both single-channel portable low-field and multi-channel clinical high-field MRI acquisitions. The code will be available upon publication at https://github.com/EfeIlicak/DUNE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DUNE（Deep Unrolled Networks in rEpresentation space），一种在表示空间中保持与物理测量精确一致性的深度展开网络框架，用于MRI重建。通过链式法则推导数据一致性梯度并利用向量-雅可比积（VJP）实现精确反向传播，支持预训练编码器等骨干网络。在加速MRI重建任务上，DUNE优于现有方法，在单通道低场和多通道临床高场MRI采集中均提升了重建质量和结构保真度。
Motivation: 现有深度展开网络通常在对象域（图像空间）操作，而探索表示空间的方法依赖启发式数据一致性，牺牲了与测量的保真度。
Method: 通过链式法则导出数据一致性梯度，并使用向量-雅可比积（VJP）在表示空间中实现精确的测量残差反向传播，框架支持多种骨干网络如预训练编码器。
Result: 在加速MRI重建任务上，DUNE相比现有基线方法，在单通道便携低场和多通道临床高场MRI采集中均实现了更优的重建质量和结构保真度。
Conclusion: DUNE在保持物理测量一致性的同时利用表示空间优势，为MRI重建提供了高性能且可解释的框架。代码将在发表后公开。

papers.title: $ϕ$-Scene: Physically Grounded Image-to-3D Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing compositional 3D scenes from a single image is a fundamental challenge in 3D world modeling. Recent methods can recover high-fidelity, complete 3D objects and predict plausible scene arrangements, but most still treat scene reconstruction primarily as a visual and geometric prediction problem. Their outputs may therefore contain floating objects, interpenetrations, or unstable-contact artifacts, limiting their physical validity and downstream usability in simulation, robotics, and interactive environments. We present $φ$-Scene, a physically grounded approach to open-vocabulary and compositional image-to-3D scene reconstruction. The key premise is that a reconstructed scene should not be treated merely as a set of objects with predicted poses, but as a stable physical system. Accordingly, $φ$-Scene formulates reconstruction as topology-driven physical assembly: it infers how objects support one another, orders them accordingly, and progressively settles each object against its already stabilized support context. For each object in topological order, SDF-based optimization first resolves penetrations against the pre-settled support context, and rigid-body simulation then settles the object into a stable contact configuration under real-world physical constraints. Experiments on 3D-Front show that $φ$-Scene achieves the strongest overall performance among out-of-domain methods and remains highly competitive with in-domain baselines. Human and VLM evaluations further show strong preference for $φ$-Scene in visual quality, reference alignment, and physical plausibility. Finally, dedicated physical plausibility metrics covering static contact quality and dynamic stability demonstrate that $φ$-Scene substantially reduces penetration artifacts while producing much lower post-simulation drift, indicating more stable and physically grounded 3D scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 φ-Scene，一种物理驱动的单图像到3D场景重建方法。与传统方法不同，它将场景重建视为拓扑驱动的物理组装过程：先推断物体间的支撑关系并进行拓扑排序，然后依次对每个物体进行SDF穿透优化和刚体仿真，使其在真实物理约束下达到稳定接触。在3D-Front数据集上，φ-Scene在域外方法中表现最佳，与域内方法竞争力强，且人类和VLM评估显示其在视觉质量、参考对齐和物理合理性上具有明显优势。
Motivation: 现有单图像3D场景重建方法主要关注视觉和几何预测，忽略了物理有效性，导致生成场景中存在漂浮、穿透或接触不稳定等伪影，限制了其在仿真、机器人等领域的实用性。
Method: φ-Scene 将重建问题建模为物理系统的稳定组装。首先通过推理物体间的支撑关系进行拓扑排序，然后按顺序对每个物体依次执行两个步骤：1) 基于有符号距离函数(SDF)的优化消除与已稳定环境的穿透；2) 刚体仿真在重力、摩擦等物理约束下将物体放置到稳定接触配置。
Result: 在3D-Front数据集上，φ-Scene在域外方法中达到最强整体性能，与域内方法高度接近。人类和VLM评估显示其在视觉质量、参考对齐和物理合理性上获得强烈偏好。专门的物理合理性指标（静态接触质量和动态稳定性）表明，该方法大幅减少穿透伪影，并显著降低后仿真漂移，产生更稳定、物理合理的3D场景。
Conclusion: 将场景重建视为物理系统的稳定组装（而非仅几何预测）能有效克服现有方法的物理不真实伪影，提升重建场景的物理合理性，使其更适合仿真、机器人等下游应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Boundary-by-Mask: Few-Shot Instance Segmentation with Mask-Conditioned Boundary Learning for Texture-Poor Industrial Parts
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large pre-trained models have led to remarkable progress in instance segmentation on general images. However, industrial scenarios remain challenging. Instance definitions are often application-specific and inconsistent, and the domain gap from general imagery is substantial due to weak textures and limited contextual cues. Consequently, a direct application of existing models is unreliable. We propose Boundary-by-Mask, a few-shot instance segmentation framework that supervises boundaries instead of interior appearance. Given a few RGB images and corresponding instance masks, the method extracts rich visual features using a foundation-model encoder and trains a lightweight Signed Distance Function (SDF) head to predict boundary-aware distance maps. Segmentation masks are obtained through an SDF-to-mask reconstruction process. By explicitly estimating contours, the framework achieves reliable instance separation even on low-texture and color-uniform surfaces. The instance definition is conditioned by the instance mask. Replacing the mask specifies the segmentation target, such as the whole object or a sub-part. A pixel-wise shallow MLP head enables rapid training. Experiments on industrial parts and food items with ambiguous boundaries show strong few-shot generalization, robustness in feature-poor conditions, and precise control over mask-level targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Boundary-by-Mask，一种用于纹理贫乏工业零件的少样本实例分割框架。该方法利用基础模型编码器提取视觉特征，通过轻量级符号距离函数头预测边界感知距离图，再重构为分割掩码。在工业零件和边界模糊食品上的实验表明，该方法在少样本、弱纹理条件下具有强泛化性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有实例分割模型在工业场景中表现不佳，因为实例定义通常与应用相关且不一致，且工业零件纹理弱、上下文线索少，导致域差距大。
Method: 提出 Boundary-by-Mask 框架：给定少数 RGB 图像和对应实例掩码，使用基础模型编码器提取特征，训练轻量级符号距离函数（SDF）头预测边界感知距离图，并通过 SDF-to-mask 重构过程得到分割掩码。实例定义由掩码条件化，替换掩码可指定不同分割目标。
Result: 在工业零件和边界模糊的食品数据集上，该方法在少样本条件下表现出强泛化性，在特征贫乏条件下具有鲁棒性，并能精确控制掩码级目标。
Conclusion: 框架通过显式估计轮廓实现了在低纹理和颜色均匀表面上的可靠实例分离，且像素级浅层 MLP 头支持快速训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometric and Information Compression of Representations in Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks transform input data into latent representations that support a wide range of downstream tasks. These representations can be characterized along information-theoretic and geometric dimensions, but their relationship remains poorly understood. A central open question is whether low mutual information (MI) between inputs and representations necessarily implies geometrically compressed latent spaces and vice versa. We investigate this question using class-wise clustering as a measure of geometric compression and theoretically sound MI estimation in conditional entropy bottleneck (CEB) networks and continuous dropout networks. We evaluate the interplay between MI, geometric compression, and generalization on classification tasks under controlled noise injection schemes. Our findings show that low MI does not reliably correspond to geometric compression, and that the connection between the two is more nuanced than often assumed. Indeed, our experiments reveal a negative and nonlinear relationship that can reverse when varying training setup. Our results put forward a hypothesis that generalization acts as a potential confounder in this connection rather than being their direct consequence.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨深度神经网络中潜在表示的信息论压缩（互信息降低）与几何压缩（类内聚类）之间的关系，发现两者并非简单正相关，而是存在非线性的、甚至可逆转的负相关关系。通过条件熵瓶颈网络和连续 dropout 网络上的实验，作者提出泛化能力可能是两者的混杂因素。
Motivation: 现有研究对深度表征的信息论和几何特性之间的关系认识不足，尤其是低互信息是否必然导致几何压缩（反之亦然）这一问题尚未解决。
Method: 使用类内聚类作为几何压缩的度量，在条件熵瓶颈网络和连续 dropout 网络中采用理论严谨的互信息估计，并通过受控噪声注入实验分析互信息、几何压缩与泛化之间的相互作用。
Result: 实验发现低互信息并不稳定地对应几何压缩，两者之间呈现负的非线性关系，且该关系在改变训练设置时可能发生逆转。
Conclusion: 作者提出泛化能力可能是互信息与几何压缩之间关联的混杂因素，而非两者的直接后果。

papers.title: Radial Basis Function Networks as Projection Heads in Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) typically relies on a backbone encoder followed by a small multilayer perceptron (MLP) projection head, which is conventionally discarded after training, while backbone quality is assessed via costly linear probing on labeled data. We argue that this approach including discarding the projector is rather computationally wasteful. Instead, we propose replacing the MLP head with a radial basis function network (RBFN), whose interpretable center and shape parameters can be exploited to judge representation quality without labels or a separate classifier. To this end, we introduce Scale-Normalized Separation (SNS), a novel label-free quality metric derived solely from the kernel centers and shapes learned during training. Across five canonical SSL architectures (MoCo, SimCLR, BYOL, SwAV and SimSiam) and four image classification datasets, we show that RBFN projection heads are competitive drop-in replacements for standard MLP projectors. We recommend constructing them with three RBF layers activated by the Gaussian radial basis function. Moreover, SNS exhibits strong to very strong positive correlation with established logistic regression metrics, demonstrating that a trained RBFN projector can act as a reliable proxy for backbone representation quality. We additionally publish a novel PyTorch compatible image classification dataset based on Google's Open Images V7 to facilitate reproducible research into representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用径向基函数网络 (RBFN) 替代自监督学习 (SSL) 中标准的多层感知机 (MLP) 投影头，并利用 RBFN 的可解释中心与形状参数设计无标签质量度量 SNS。在 MoCo、SimCLR、BYOL、SwAV 和 SimSiam 五种架构及四个图像分类数据集上，RBFN 投影头与 MLP 性能相当，SNS 与逻辑回归指标强正相关。
Motivation: SSL 中 MLP 投影头通常在训练后被丢弃，需依赖带标签数据线性探测来评估骨干网络质量，计算成本高；且投影头本身不提供表示质量的直接信息。
Method: 用高斯径向基函数激活的三层 RBFN 替换 MLP 投影头，并基于训练中学到的核中心与形状参数提出尺度归一化分离度 (SNS)，作为无标签的表示质量度量。
Result: 在五个常见 SSL 框架和四个数据集上，RBFN 投影头达到与 MLP 相当的迁移性能；SNS 与线性探测准确率的斯皮尔曼相关系数呈强至极强正相关。
Conclusion: 作者推荐使用三层高斯 RBF 投影头，并认为训练后的 RBFN 可作为骨干表示质量的可靠代理，无需额外分类器或标签。

papers.title: Unsupervised Susceptibility Distortion Correction of EPI without Calibration Scans via Image Translation-Based Registration
papers.abstract_en: Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) utilizes echo-planar imaging (EPI) to capture blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) signals with high temporal resolution. However, EPI is inherently sensitive to magnetic field inhomogeneities, resulting in susceptibility-induced geometric distortions along the phase-encoding (PE) direction. To correct these distortions, conventional approaches rely on additional calibration scans, such as field maps or reverse PE acquisitions, which are not always available in practice. To overcome this limitation, we propose SACRED, a calibration scan-free susceptibility distortion correction framework that corrects geometric distortions via image translation-based registration using only a routinely acquired anatomical T1-weighted (T1w) image and a unidirectional PE BOLD image. SACRED employs an invertible neural network as the image translation backbone to bridge the contrast gap between BOLD and T1w images while enforcing structural consistency through a modality independent neighborhood descriptor. This design enables the use of a mono-contrast similarity objective to train the registration network in an unsupervised manner without requiring distortion-corrected BOLD images. In addition, we incorporate test-time adaptation (TTA) to further enhance performance on out-of-distribution (OOD) data at inference time. SACRED was evaluated on one in-distribution (ID) dataset and two OOD datasets, and was compared with representative fMRI distortion correction methods. The results demonstrate that SACRED significantly outperforms competing methods on both ID and OOD datasets, exhibiting robustness to scanner and population shifts, partly enabled by TTA. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SACRED，一种无需校准扫描的 EPI 磁敏感畸变校正框架，通过基于图像翻译的配准，仅利用 T1w 图像和单方向 EPI 图像实现无监督畸变校正。方法采用可逆神经网络桥接对比度差异，并通过模态无关邻域描述符保持结构一致性，在分布内和分布外数据集上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 功能磁共振成像 (fMRI) 中常用的 EPI 序列因磁场不均匀性产生几何畸变，传统校正需要额外校准扫描（如场图或反向 PE 采集），但实际中这些数据常缺失。
Method: 提出 SACRED 框架，使用可逆神经网络作为图像翻译骨干，将 BOLD 图像转换为类似 T1w 的对比度，通过模态无关邻域描述符 (MIND) 保持结构一致性，并利用单对比度相似性目标无监督训练配准网络；同时引入测试时自适应 (TTA) 提升对分布外数据的鲁棒性。
Result: 在 1 个分布内数据集和 2 个分布外数据集上，SACRED 显著优于代表性 fMRI 畸变校正方法，对扫描仪和人群变化具有鲁棒性，TTA 进一步提升了性能。
Conclusion: SACRED 实现了无需校准扫描的 EPI 畸变校正，适用于实际中缺乏额外扫描数据的场景，但方法依赖 T1w 图像与 BOLD 图像的配准，且未探索其他模态的可用性。

papers.title: FAST: A Framework for Aligned Sampling and Training in Parallel Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning is pivotal for closed-loop autonomous driving yet remains constrained by severe bottlenecks in sampling efficiency. Standard parallel sampling mitigates this but suffers from the straggler effect, where the premature termination of a single environment necessitates a synchronized batch re-initialization, leading to suboptimal sample utilization and prohibitive re-initialization latency. To address this, we propose FAST, a synchronous parallel framework tailored for closed-loop simulation. Specifically, FAST employs Dynamic Parallel Sampling Alignment (DPSA) to maintain vectorization synchronization by extending terminated episodes via virtual continuation, thereby decoupling the sampling loop from individual terminations. By dynamically triggering global truncation based on the termination rate of parallel clips, FAST effectively eliminates the bottleneck of premature resets without sacrificing data diversity. Furthermore, to strictly preserve theoretical consistency, we incorporate a Scaled Mask-Padding Optimization (SMPO) that leverages validity masking and adaptive loss normalization to nullify the bias from auxiliary padding data. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that FAST achieves at least a 1.78 times wall-clock speedup over the single-clip baseline while preserving statistical unbiasedness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FAST，一个针对闭环自动驾驶模拟的同步并行强化学习框架。其核心创新包括动态并行采样对齐（DPSA）通过虚拟延续避免提前终止导致的同步重置开销，以及缩放掩码填充优化（SMPO）通过有效性掩码和自适应损失归一化消除填充数据的偏差。实验表明，与单片段基线相比，FAST 实现了至少 1.78 倍的时钟时间加速，同时保持统计无偏性。
Motivation: 标准并行采样在自动驾驶闭环模拟中遭受滞后效应（单个环境提前终止导致整批同步重置），造成样本利用率低和重置延迟高。
Method: 提出 FAST 框架，包含两个组件：动态并行采样对齐（DPSA）将终止片段通过虚拟延续扩展以维持向量化同步，并根据终止率动态触发全局截断；缩放掩码填充优化（SMPO）利用有效性掩码和自适应损失归一化消除填充数据的偏差。
Result: 摘要报告 FAST 在闭环模拟中实现了至少 1.78 倍于单片段基线的加速，且保持统计无偏性。
Conclusion: FAST 解决了并行强化学习中的同步重置瓶颈，适用于自动驾驶闭环模拟场景。

papers.title: The Cost Geometry of Belief: finite-resource inference under noisy observation
papers.abstract_en: We equip the space of beliefs with a cost geometry (what it costs to pass from one belief to another): optimal transport in Wasserstein space, reweighted conformally by Fisher information (the price of the precision at stake), distinct from the Fisher-Rao metric. In the setting we consider, a finite machine maintains a digital twin of a system; observing the territory through finite, noisy sensors, we model its coherent output as a belief: a probability density over states, the Bayes posterior. Certainty (the perfect twin) is denied twice, by observation and by physics, both read off the Fisher information. On the conformal class, essentially location-scale, three results emerge, all invariants of one change of cost unit. A wall: a well-posed inference rejects certainty to infinite distance as soon as the cost dominates the Fisher information (necessity conjectured beyond power laws). An honesty: an honest (eikonal) cost, each nat the same length everywhere, selects the geometries proportional to the Fisher information. A rigidity: these geometries are hyperbolic, and the Stam bound crowns the Gaussian, the most hyperbolic location-scale belief. Changing the unit dilates the geometry yet preserves the wall, the curvature ordering, and the extremality of the Gaussian: an absolute cost says nothing, only relative cost carries meaning, the value -1/4 being one of its images. The cost of reaching a given precision then has a geometric floor diverging at certainty. Thermodynamics fixes the cost unit and motivates this framework; the results are geometric, in nats.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在信念空间上引入成本几何，通过Fisher信息共形加权的Wasserstein最优传输来建模有限资源下的带噪声观测推理。摘要报告了三个几何不变量：推理将确定性推向无限距离的墙、与Fisher信息成正比的诚实几何、以及高斯分布为极值点的双曲刚性。
Motivation: 现有推理框架未充分考虑有限计算资源和观测噪声带来的成本约束，需要一种几何语言来量化信念更新中的信息成本。
Method: 将信念空间装备成本几何，定义为由Fisher信息密度共形加权的Wasserstein距离，形成一种区别于Fisher-Rao度量的共形结构。
Result: 得到三个主要结果：墙（任何良好定义的推理在成本主导Fisher信息时将确定性推至无穷远）、诚实（等距成本几何与Fisher信息成正比）、刚性（该几何是双曲的，且Stam界表明高斯分布是最双曲的位置-尺度信念）。
Conclusion: 框架揭示了信念更新的几何本质，热力学固定成本单位后，绝对成本无意义，相对成本决定几何结构，并给出精度成本的几何下界。

papers.title: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of VLMs for Zero-shot Procedural Mistake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Procedural mistake detection is important for quality control and user assistance across many disciplines. Recent work in this field has achieved significant gains by using the reasoning capabilities of Video-Language Models (VLMs) as components within multi-stage pipelines, which consist of separate modules for supervised temporal action segmentation, error detection, and explainability. Consequently, they remain dependent on tailored training datasets and require task-specific training, limiting their wider applicability. To remedy this, we introduce zero-shot procedural mistake detection and propose a unified Zero-shot Procedural Mistake detection (ZeProM) framework that jointly solves procedural mistake detection and temporal action segmentation with a single pre-trained VLM. By evaluating our framework on two canonical mistake detection benchmarks, EgoPER and CaptainCook4D, we find that ZeProM can perform these tasks successfully, while approaching, or even outperforming, the performance of fully supervised methods. For instance, we achieve a 4.4 point improvement in EDA and a 2.0 point improvement in F1@.5 on average over all five EgoPER tasks compared to the strongest supervised methods. Overall, our results show the potential of unified methods for procedural mistake detection, and we hope this will steer the field away from highly complex pipelines and toward more generally applicable solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ZeProM框架，利用单一预训练视频语言模型（VLM）同时进行零样本程序性错误检测和时间动作分割，避免多阶段流水线对监督数据的依赖。在EgoPER和CaptainCook4D基准上，ZeProM接近甚至超越全监督方法，例如在EgoPER的五个任务上平均比最强监督方法提升4.4个EDA点和2.0个F1@.5。
Motivation: 现有程序性错误检测方法依赖多阶段流水线（时间分割、错误检测、可解释性）和监督训练数据，限制了通用性。本文旨在实现零样本检测，无需任务特定训练。
Method: 提出ZeProM框架，将程序性错误检测与时间动作分割统一到单一预训练VLM中，通过特定提示设计实现零样本推理。
Result: 在EgoPER和CaptainCook4D上，ZeProM接近或超越全监督方法，例如在EgoPER上平均提升4.4个EDA点和2.0个F1@.5。
Conclusion: 结果表明统一方法在程序性错误检测中的潜力，有望推动该领域脱离复杂流水线，转向更通用的解决方案。

papers.title: A Smart Classroom Behavior Analysis Framework with a New Highly Congested Classroom Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Student behavior detection is important for intelligent classroom analysis but remains challenging in large-class scenarios due to dense instance co-occurrence, asymmetric occlusion, depth-wise scale variation, and fine-grained semantic degradation in distant targets. Existing classroom behavior datasets and general-purpose detectors are insufficient to characterize and address these challenges. This paper constructs the Highly Congested Classroom Behavior (HCCB) dataset, containing 50,229 student behavior instances across seven categories: reading, writing, heads up, sleeping, looking around, bowing head, and using phone. HCCB provides a challenging benchmark that integrates dense distributions, severe occlusion, scale variation, and fine-grained behavioral semantics. To address these issues, we propose ODER-HSFNet, a YOLO-based detection framework tailored to highly crowded classrooms. At its core, ODER-HSFNet introduces three task-specific innovations: the Occlusion-aware Deformable Edge Rectifier (ODER), which strengthens boundary evidence under occlusion; the Hypergraph-State Spatial Fusion (HSSF) module, which integrates local structure enhancement, state-space contextual modeling, and high-order relation aggregation; and the Occlusion-Calibrated Detection Head (OCDetect), which suppresses low-quality Pre-NMS candidates and reduces false positives from occlusion boundaries and neighboring instances. Experiments on two classroom behavior detection datasets show that ODER-HSFNet outperforms mainstream YOLO-series methods, achieving 60.60%/80.12% mAP50:95/mAP50 on HCCB and 57.36%/74.65% on SCB-D3-S. Ablation studies further verify the effectiveness of the proposed design for highly crowded classroom behavior detection.

TL;DR: 本文针对大班课堂场景中密集学生行为检测的挑战，构建了包含50,229个实例的HCCB数据集（7类行为），并提出ODER-HSFNet检测框架。该框架包含遮挡感知形变边缘校正器（ODER）、超图状态空间融合（HSSF）和遮挡校准检测头（OCDetect），在HCCB和SCB-D3-S数据集上超越主流YOLO系列方法。
Motivation: 现有课堂行为数据集和通用检测器难以应对密集实例共存、非对称遮挡、深度尺度变化和远距离目标语义退化等问题。
Method: 提出基于YOLO的ODER-HSFNet框架，包含三个创新：ODER增强遮挡下的边界证据；HSSF融合局部结构、状态空间上下文和高阶关系；OCDetect抑制低质量预NMS候选并减少由遮挡和邻近实例产生的假阳性。
Result: 在HCCB数据集上达到60.60% mAP50:95和80.12% mAP50，在SCB-D3-S数据集上达到57.36% mAP50:95和74.65% mAP50。
Conclusion: ODER-HSFNet在高度拥挤的课堂行为检测中有效，消融实验验证了各组件的贡献。

papers.title: Composing Verifiable Conceptual Models via Building Blocks: Towards Design-Time Verification of Agentic AI Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems orchestrate multiple LLM-based agents through workflow architectures that coordinate decisions, tools, and external actions. While current platforms emphasize runtime safeguards, little support exists for verifying workflows during system design. From a Modeling \& Simulation perspective, this gap is analogous to composing conceptual models without verifying whether their building blocks interact coherently. We propose a design-time verification approach that models agentic workflows as compositions of reusable building blocks and checks their compatibility through twelve structural rules. We implemented these rules in a software prototype and evaluated them using two openly released datasets: 48 workflows with known design flaws and 168 variants that preserve workflow logic but alter graph structure. Results show that our verifier reliably detects violations even when flawed designs are obscured through structural transformations such as splitting tasks between agents. Future works could combine our verification with community repositories of building blocks to compose safe agentic workflows.
papers.comment: To appear at the 2026 Winter Simulation Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Agentic AI系统在设计阶段缺乏工作流验证的问题，提出一种基于可重用构建块的设计时验证方法，通过12条结构规则检查构建块之间的兼容性。在包含已知设计缺陷的48个工作流和168个结构变体数据集上，验证器能可靠检测违规行为，即使缺陷被任务拆分等变换掩盖。
Motivation: 当前Agentic AI平台侧重运行时安全，但缺乏设计时验证工作流的能力；从建模与仿真视角看，相当于组合概念模型时未验证构建块是否协调一致。
Method: 将Agentic工作流建模为可重用构建块的组合，定义12条结构规则进行兼容性检查，并在软件原型中实现这些规则。
Result: 在两个公开数据集（48个有缺陷工作流和168个结构变体）上，验证器能可靠检测设计违规，即使缺陷被结构变换（如任务拆分）隐藏。
Conclusion: 未来可将该验证方法与构建块社区仓库结合，用于组合安全的Agentic工作流。

papers.title: LIG: Layer-wise Integrated Gradients for Within-Layer Flow Analysis in Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Transformers achieve strong performance, but their internal computations remain opaque. We view each Transformer layer as a dynamic graph whose nodes are token representations and per-head attention outputs, with Multi-Head Attention (ATT) and MLP as module boundaries. On this graph we use LIG (Layer-wise Integrated Gradients), which applies set-to-set Integrated Gradients (IG) at nonlinear module boundaries. Set-to-set IG applies IG to a map from a set of input token representations to a set of output representations, evaluating token-to-token contributions, which is not standard in prior IG applications. This extends IG from the usual scalar-objective setting to set-to-set maps via an L2 scalarization, and composes within-layer contributions in the spirit of Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP), with IG completeness playing the role of LRP-style conservation at each boundary. We use LIG to analyze (i) the agreement between module-wise composition and layer-whole attribution under an L2 criterion, and (ii) within-layer information flow by tracing separated ATT and MLP contributions. On BERT-base and PTB, configurations that best preserved within-layer consistency used the target token's embedding as the ATT baseline and either the ATT output at a=0 or Zero as the MLP baseline. We therefore present LIG as a diagnostic XAI tool at module-boundary granularity, without model-specific retraining or per-operation interpreter design. Code is available at https://github.com/eightsuzuki/layer-wise-integrated-gradients.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. cs.LG. Experiments on BERT-base and PTB. Code: https://github.com/eightsuzuki/layer-wise-integrated-gradients
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LIG（逐层积分梯度），一种用于 Transformer 解释性的方法，通过对每个 Transformer 层内的动态图应用集合到集合的积分梯度，分析模块边界处的贡献和层内信息流。在 BERT-base 和 PTB 上的实验验证了其有效性，可作为无需模型重训练或逐操作解释器设计的诊断工具。
Motivation: Transformers 的内部计算仍不透明，现有解释性方法如积分梯度通常应用于标量目标，缺乏在层内模块边界处进行集合到集合属性分析的框架。
Method: LIG 将每个 Transformer 层视为动态图，节点为 token 表示和注意力头输出，模块边界为多头注意力和 MLP。通过 L2 标量化将积分梯度扩展到集合到集合映射，并类似逐层相关性传播组合各模块贡献。
Result: 在 BERT-base 和 PTB 上，最佳配置是使用目标 token 的嵌入作为注意力基线，并使用注意力输出 at α=0 或零作为 MLP 基线，以最大化层内一致性。LIG 能追踪分离的注意力与 MLP 贡献。
Conclusion: LIG 提供了一种模块边界粒度的诊断 XAI 工具，无需模型特定重训练或逐操作解释器设计，有助于理解 Transformer 内信息流动。

papers.title: Compressing Observation History into Agent Memory: Distilling Transformers into Recurrent Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Transformers are AI's workhorse with strong performance in modeling sequential data, but their computational cost becomes prohibitive when processing long sequences. We target long-horizon streaming vision and robotics applications like map-free pose estimation, where it is particularly impractical to store and maintain a history of observations. Recurrent Transformers address this limitation by maintaining fixed-size memory but their performance lags behind that of transformers operating over the full observation history. We argue that this gap does not stem from architectural limitations, but from differences in how these models learn to compress past information. Without access to an observation history, recurrent models must explicitly decide what to retain in memory at each step, a significantly harder learning problem. In this work, we propose a distillation approach that transfers the compression strategy of a classical full-history transformer to a recurrent variant. We enable this by designing a teacher model that explicitly compresses its observation history into a fixed-size bottleneck representation. By directly supervising the student's memory with this bottleneck representation, we align the two compression mechanisms. We show that this approach allows to train a recurrent latent robotic memory with linear-time complexity while substantially narrowing the performance gap to full-history transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种蒸馏方法，将全历史Transformer的压缩策略迁移到递归Transformer上，用于流式视觉和机器人任务（如无地图姿态估计）。通过设计教师模型将观测历史压缩为固定大小的瓶颈表示，并直接监督学生模型的记忆，显著缩小了递归Transformer与全历史Transformer之间的性能差距，同时保持了线性时间复杂度。
Motivation: 全历史Transformer在处理长序列时计算成本高，而递归Transformer虽可维护固定大小记忆但性能落后。作者认为差距源于学习压缩历史信息的方式不同，而非架构限制。
Method: 设计一个教师模型，显式将观测历史压缩为固定大小的瓶颈表示；然后通过蒸馏使递归Transformer（学生）的记忆对齐该瓶颈表示，从而转移压缩策略。
Result: 在无地图姿态估计等任务上，该方法训练的递归Transformer性能接近全历史Transformer，同时具有线性时间复杂度。
Conclusion: 蒸馏对齐压缩机制能有效弥补递归Transformer与全历史Transformer之间的性能差距，适用于需长程流式处理的视觉和机器人应用。

papers.title: AI Alignment From Social Choice Perspectives
papers.abstract_en: Alignment from human feedback uses human judgments about model outputs to steer the behavior of language models after pretraining. When those judgments reflect conflicting views of desirable behavior, the learned objective becomes an aggregate determination of what the model should prefer. We survey recent work that has studied this aggregation problem through the lens of social choice theory. We illustrate how the social choice perspective helps identify failure modes in the feedback aggregation layer and reveals a broader design space for handling disagreement in explicit and principled ways.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in ACM SIGecom Exchanges
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从社会选择理论视角综述AI对齐中的人类反馈聚合问题，指出该视角有助于识别反馈聚合层的失败模式，并揭示处理分歧的显式且原则性的设计空间。
Motivation: AI对齐依赖人类反馈来引导模型行为，但反馈常反映冲突偏好，现有聚合方法缺乏系统分析，易引入偏差或不公。社会选择理论提供了形式化框架来研究这一聚合问题。
Method: 本文是一篇综述，系统梳理将社会选择理论（如投票规则、偏好聚合）应用于AI对齐中反馈聚合的相关工作，分析不同方法的假设、权衡与局限性。
Result: 文章并未给出新的实验结果，而是通过社会选择视角识别出反馈聚合层的若干失败模式（如操纵性、不敏感性），并指出更广泛的设计空间（如加权投票、随机化机制）。
Conclusion: 社会选择理论为AI对齐中的人类反馈聚合提供了理论工具，有助于设计更鲁棒、更符合伦理的对齐方法，但需注意不同社会选择公理在AI场景下的适用性。

papers.title: Memory Is No Longer a Bottleneck: Memory-Efficient Graph Filtering for Scalable Collaborative Filtering
papers.abstract_en: Graph convolutional networks (GCNs) have demonstrated significant success in capturing complex user-item relationships for collaborative filtering (CF). However, due to their reliance on extensive model training, training-free graph filtering (GF)-based CF methods have emerged as a promising alternative, offering computational efficiency by smoothing graph signals via matrix operations. In particular, polynomial GF-based approaches demonstrate improved accuracy through their ability to design more expressive and flexible filtering functions. Despite these advantages, existing GF methods suffer from a critical memory bottleneck: they necessitate storing the full item similarity graph, incurring prohibitive memory costs for large-scale datasets, which limits their practical applicability. To tackle this challenge, we propose Mem-GF (Memory-efficient GF), a new GF-based CF method that departs from conventional designs by principally leveraging the structure of Krylov subspaces as a core mechanism for approximating polynomial graph filters without explicitly storing the item similarity graph. We theoretically analyze the minimum Krylov subspace size that guarantees lossless approximation. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that Mem-GF achieves up to 5.74$\times$ lower memory usage and 4.38$\times$ speedup in runtime, while consistently exceeding the recommendation accuracy of state-of-the-art GF and GCN-based methods. Mem-GF robustly scales to datasets with tens of millions of interactions, establishing itself as a practically viable and theoretically grounded solution for efficient CF.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables; IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering (to appear) (Please cite our journal version.)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mem-GF，一种内存高效的图滤波协同过滤方法，利用 Krylov 子空间结构近似多项式图滤波器，无需显式存储项目相似度图。实验表明，该方法在保持甚至提升推荐精度的同时，内存使用减少高达 5.74 倍，运行时间加速 4.38 倍，可扩展至数千万交互的数据集。
Motivation: 现有图滤波协同过滤方法需存储完整的项目相似度图，导致大尺度数据集上内存瓶颈严重，限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出 Mem-GF，利用 Krylov 子空间的原理近似多项式图滤波器，避免显式构建和存储项目相似度图；理论分析了保证无损近似的最小 Krylov 子空间大小。
Result: 在多个数据集上，Mem-GF 相比现有图滤波和 GCN 方法，内存使用降低最高 5.74 倍，运行时间加速最高 4.38 倍，且推荐精度一致超越或持平。

papers.title: Accelerated and Stable Convergence with Anchored Optimistic Method
papers.abstract_en: We study first-order methods for solving monotone variational inequalities arising in min-max optimization. Classical approaches such as the extragradient method rely on two gradient queries per iteration, which limits their analysis and applicability in the online and stochastic settings. We propose a family of Generalized Optimistic Methods with Anchoring (GOMA), which combine two-time-scale optimistic updates with an anchoring term inspired by Halpern iteration. In the deterministic setting, GOMA achieves the optimal accelerated last-iterate rate $O(1/k^2)$ on the squared gradient norm for monotone Lipschitz operators. In the stochastic setting with unbounded variance, a simplified single-call variant of GOMA achieves a last-iterate convergence rate of $O(1/\sqrt{k})$ on the squared gradient norm. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first such guarantee for stochastic monotone Lipschitz variational inequalities in the unconstrained setting without variance reduction or growing batches.

papers.title: LOGOS: LiDAR-Only Gaussian Elevation Splatting for Unified Tiny Obstacle Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Robust obstacle segmentation is essential for the safety of intelligent robots, where LiDAR-based perception systems play a fundamental role in the robot-environment interaction. While extensive LiDAR-based approaches have demonstrated high performance on common obstacles in urban scenarios, their results on tiny obstacles such as curbs, gravel, and potholes remain unsatisfactory due to the significant similarity between tiny obstacles and inherent road undulations. Moreover, their segmentation accuracy even deteriorates sharply when the LiDAR scans suffer from degradation in challenging off-road scenes. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose LOGOS, a LiDAR-only unified tiny obstacle segmentation system, which models the road surface as a continuous mixture of 2D Gaussian primitives and distinguishes tiny obstacles via high-presicion elevation estimation. Unlike existing Gaussian splatting methods that rely on iterative RGB training, LOGOS is a backpropagation-free LiDAR-only approach. It directly estimates Gaussian parameters via a freespace-aware initialization by incrementally pruning non-road primitives using smoothness constraints. Subsequently, pointwise signed distances are computed via a novel normal-aware elevation splatting function, ensuring robustness to both flat and sloped terrains. We evaluate LOGOS on a highly heterogeneous benchmark of point cloud frames collected from urban mobility scenarios and mining haulage off-road environments. These data are practically acquired using different LiDAR sensors and exhibit large variations in point density, terrain roughness, and obstacle types. Experiments on the road and off-road scenes demonstrate that LOGOS significantly outperforms other state-of-the-art methods, particularly in degraded point cloud regions and challenging off-road scenarios, while maintaining real-time efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LOGOS，一种仅依赖LiDAR的统一微小障碍物分割系统。将道路表面建模为连续混合的2D高斯基元，通过高精度高程估计区分微小障碍物。LOGOS是无需反向传播的LiDAR-only方法，通过自由空间感知初始化和平滑约束增量剪枝非道路基元来估计高斯参数，然后通过新的法线感知高程喷洒函数计算逐点符号距离。在城市移动场景和矿区非道路场景的异构点云基准上，LOGOS显著优于现有方法，尤其在退化点云区域和挑战性非道路场景中，同时保持实时效率。
Motivation: 现有LiDAR方法在城区常见障碍物上表现良好，但对路缘、碎石、坑洼等微小障碍物分割效果不佳，因为微小障碍物与道路起伏非常相似；而且在非道路场景中LiDAR扫描退化时分割精度急剧下降。
Method: 将道路表面建模为连续混合的2D高斯基元，通过无反向传播的直接估计：使用自由空间感知初始化，通过平滑约束增量剪枝非道路基元；然后通过法线感知高程喷洒函数计算逐点符号距离，以区分微小障碍物。
Result: 在城市移动和矿区非道路场景的异构点云基准上（使用不同LiDAR传感器，点密度、地形粗糙度和障碍物类型变化大），LOGOS在退化点云区域和挑战性非道路场景中显著优于现有方法，且保持实时效率。
Conclusion: 该方法在微小障碍物分割上有效，尤其适用于退化点云和复杂地形场景。
