papers.title: Reward-free Pretraining for Reinforcement Learning via Occupancy Coverage Maximization
papers.abstract_en: Sparse rewards pose a central challenge in reinforcement learning, since agents receive no informative signal until they reach their goal. Intrinsic-reward methods address this issue by optimizing non-stationary objectives such as novelty, prediction error, or skill diversity, thereby injecting a supervision signal into the problem. While effective, these methods often require that the extrinsic (sparse) reward can be evaluated -- either online or during offline relabeling of the stored transitions. This limitation is particularly vexing for multi-task, meta-, and continual reinforcement learning, where agents' interactions with the environment are usually reward-free. In this work, we present a method to pre-train transferable exploration policies that rapidly adapt to sparse rewards at downstream task time. Our objective maximizes state-space covering for the occupancy measure, and can be framed in terms of entropy maximization. Its algorithmic implementation, ROVER, leverages recent advances on the operatorial formulation of RL to estimate occupancy with a learned resolvent world model, bypassing common hurdles associated with density and entropy estimation. ROVER further introduces a virtual "sink" state for unexplored regions, balancing coverage of known states with expansion into unseen ones and preventing cyclic expansion-collapse behavior during learning. In tabular and pixel-based sparse navigation tasks, ROVER produces more uniform aggregate coverage and stronger initializations for downstream tasks than standard reward-free baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习中稀疏奖励的问题，提出了一种无奖励预训练方法，通过最大化占用覆盖率来训练可迁移的探索策略。该方法基于算子形式的强化学习，使用学习的可解世界模型估计占用，并引入虚拟“下沉”状态以平衡已知与未知区域的探索。在表格和基于像素的稀疏导航任务中，ROVER比标准无奖励基线产生了更均匀的聚合覆盖和更强的下游任务初始化。
Motivation: 稀疏奖励是强化学习的关键挑战，而现有内在奖励方法通常需要评估外在奖励，这在多任务、元学习和持续学习中难以满足。本文旨在预训练可迁移的探索策略，使其在后续任务中快速适应稀疏奖励。
Method: 提出ROVER算法，通过最大化占用度量的状态空间覆盖进行无奖励预训练，目标可转化为熵最大化。利用算子形式RL，用学习的可解世界模型估计占用，避免密度和熵估计的困难；引入虚拟“下沉”状态以平衡已知状态覆盖与未知区域探索，防止循环的扩张-崩溃行为。
Result: 在表格和基于像素的稀疏导航任务中，ROVER比标准无奖励基线产生更均匀的聚合覆盖，并为下游任务提供更强的初始化。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法能有效学习迁移性探索策略，无需奖励信号，且通过占用覆盖率最大化避免了传统内在奖励方法的局限。

papers.title: Non-line-of-sight imaging with arbitrary relay surface geometries via 3D Gaussian Transient Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Imaging objects hidden outside the direct line of sight expands the effective field of view and is critical for applications such as autonomous driving and robotic perception. Despite impressive progress in time-of-flight (ToF)-based non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging, real-world deployment remains challenging because practical measurements are often collected over spatially limited, arbitrarily shaped relay regions-conditions that violate the planar-wall and dense-sampling assumptions made by most existing methods. To address these limitations, we propose a LOS-guided NLOS imaging pipeline that imposes no geometric assumptions on the relay surface and naturally supports both confocal and non-confocal configurations. Our method represents the hidden scene using 3D Gaussian primitives and couples them with an efficient, differentiable transient rendering model, enabling end-to-end optimization directly from measured transients. We validate our approach on real-world measurements from both a public dataset and a custom-built capture system. Across settings, our method achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction fidelity under spatially limited, sparsely sampled conditions, and significantly outperforms existing methods on complex, arbitrary relay surface geometries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于3D高斯瞬态渲染的非视距（NLOS）成像方法，无需对中继表面几何形状做假设，支持共焦和非共焦配置。该方法使用3D高斯原语表示隐藏场景，并耦合高效可微分瞬态渲染模型，直接从测量瞬态进行端到端优化。在真实数据集上，该方法在空间受限、稀疏采样条件下实现了当前最优的重建保真度，在复杂任意形状中继表面上显著超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有基于飞行时间的NLOS成像方法大多假设平面中继表面和密集采样，难以应用于实际中常见的空间受限、任意形状中继区域，限制了其实用部署。
Method: 提出LOS引导的NLOS成像流程：用3D高斯原语表示隐藏场景，构建高效可微分瞬态渲染模型，从测量瞬态直接端到端优化高斯参数，无需对中继表面几何做假设。
Result: 在公开数据集和自建采集系统上，该方法在空间有限、稀疏采样条件下重建保真度达到当前最优，在复杂任意中继表面几何上显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 该方法通过消除中继表面几何假设，扩展了NLOS成像的实际适用性，验证了在非平面、稀疏采样场景下的有效性。

papers.title: Few-Shot Hyperspectral Aphid Detection via FastGAN Synthetic Data Generation, Transformer-Based Classification and Explainable AI
papers.abstract_en: Early detection of aphid infestation in crops is essential for preventing yield loss and reducing unnecessary pesticide use. Hyperspectral imaging combined with Spectral Information Divergence (SID) analysis offers a non-destructive approach for monitoring plant health; however, deep learning methods applied to hyperspectral data are often limited by small dataset sizes. In this study, a data-efficient generative adversarial network (FastGAN) was employed to augment a hyperspectral SID dataset of faba bean leaves containing healthy and aphid-infested samples. The trained generator produced 10,000 synthetic images preserving structural and spectral characteristics of real samples. Image quality was evaluated using Frechet Inception Distance (FID), demonstrating stable convergence and realistic reconstruction of leaf morphology and infestation patterns. The augmented dataset was used to train four classification architectures: VGG16, ResNet-50, EfficientNet, and Vision Transformer (ViT). Results showed that dataset augmentation significantly improved classification robustness, with performance progressively increasing from classical convolutional networks to transformer-based models. The ViT model achieved the highest accuracy and F1-scores, while EfficientNet provided strong balanced performance and ResNet-50 showed moderate improvements over VGG16. Confusion matrix analysis confirmed reduced false negatives and improved disease detection when using advanced architectures. The findings demonstrate that FastGAN-based augmentation effectively enhances hyperspectral plant disease classification and that transformer-based models provide the most reliable discrimination between healthy and infested leaves.

papers.title: ARCO: Adaptive Rubric with Co-Evolution for Multi-Step LLM-Based Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for multi-step LLM agents often relies on scalar rewards that indicate success but cannot explain why a trajectory is good or bad. Rubric-based rewards improve interpretability through natural-language criteria, but existing methods score at the trajectory level and freeze the scorer behind a closed-source judge, leaving step-level credit assignment unresolved and the judge itself static. We propose ARCO (Adaptive Rubric CO-evolution), a rubric framework in which a same-scale model $μ$ shares a backbone with two heads: a generation head that produces per-step criteria, and a score head that predicts rubric-conditioned step-level rewards. A trajectory decomposition constraint ties the sum of step rewards to the terminal outcome, enabling credit assignment without step-level labels, while $μ$ and the policy $π$ are jointly updated on on-policy data so that the rubric content and the scoring function co-evolve at the parameter level. Across HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue with two open-source backbones, ARCO improves the best EM in every setting over strong outcome-, rubric-, and process-reward baselines, and analyses show that its rubrics are step-specific, robust to design choices, and useful for diagnosing agent behavior. Codes and data are available at https://github.com/zihangtian/ARCO.

TL;DR: ARCO提出了一种自适应准则共进化框架，用于多步骤基于LLM的智能体。它使用一个共享骨干网络的两个头：一个生成每步准则，另一个预测基于准则的步骤级奖励。通过轨迹分解约束将步骤奖励之和与最终结果绑定，实现无需步骤标签的信用分配。在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue上，ARCO在所有设置中均优于强基线，并提供了步骤特定的可解释准则。
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习的LLM智能体通常使用标量奖励，无法解释轨迹好坏的原因。基于准则的奖励虽可提高可解释性，但现有方法在轨迹级别评分且使用静态闭源裁判，无法解决步骤级信用分配问题。
Method: 提出ARCO框架，使用同尺度模型μ，共享骨干网络但有两个输出头：生成头产生每步准则，评分头预测基于准则的步骤级奖励。通过轨迹分解约束使步骤奖励之和等于最终结果，无需步骤标签；μ和策略π在策略数据上联合更新，实现准则内容和评分函数的参数级共进化。
Result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue上，使用两个开源骨干网络，ARCO在所有设置下均优于结果级、准则级和过程奖励基线，取得最佳EM分数。分析表明其准则是步骤特定的，对设计选择鲁棒，并可用于诊断智能体行为。
Conclusion: ARCO通过自适应共进化的准则框架有效解决了多步骤LLM智能体中步骤级信用分配和可解释性问题，且开源了代码和数据。

papers.title: Subsampling for supervised learning in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces
papers.abstract_en: In the era of big data, subsampling became a common practice in statistical learning. By selecting a subgroup of individuals based on which the learner is trained, subsampling aims at reducing the computational cost and time of the estimation step, and ideally leads to a decrease of its energy consumption and carbon footprint. This work focuses on a nonparametric setting, in which the hypotheses set lies in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space, and the estimator is a minimizer of an empirical risk reweighted à la Horvitz-Thompson. By studying the asymptotic properties of this estimator, we reveal an optimal subsampling scheme (regarding the trace of the covariance operator) and show that it can be used via plug-in. A numerical study on synthetic and real-world datasets shows the practicability and the benefit of the proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中监督学习的子采样问题。通过分析Horvitz-Thompson重加权经验风险最小化器的渐近性质，揭示了关于协方差算子迹的最优子采样方案，并可通过插件法实现。数值实验在合成和真实数据集上展示了该方法的实用性和优势。
Motivation: 大数据时代子采样成为常见做法，旨在降低计算成本和能耗，但需要理论指导下的最优采样方案以提高效率。
Method: 在非参数RKHS设定下，采用Horvitz-Thompson重加权的经验风险最小化器，通过研究其渐近性质来推导最优子采样概率（关于协方差算子迹），并利用插件法实施。
Result: 理论分析揭示了最优子采样方案，数值实验表明该方法具有实用性和计算收益。
Conclusion: 提出的最优子采样方案可有效降低监督学习中的计算开销，同时保持估计性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Spectral GS-SLAM: Observability-Aware, Degeneracy-Robust Tracking for Real-Time 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM
papers.abstract_en: Recent 3DGS-SLAM systems enable real-time operation by leveraging conventional feature matching or ICP-based tracking, thereby avoiding the heavy dense photometric optimization used in earlier approaches. However, feature matching remains prone to failure in textureless environments, while ICP-based tracking struggles in structureless or geometrically degenerate scenes due to ill-conditioned optimization. To address this issue, we propose Spectral GS-SLAM, an efficient yet robust tracking framework that integrates ICP with complementary feature-based constraints. Our method mitigates numerical instability by adaptively compensating under-constrained directions in degenerate scenarios, without interfering with the shared Gaussian representation used for mapping. We further introduce a Gaussian-aware planarity weighting mechanism that exploits the intrinsic covariance structure of 3D Gaussians to characterize scene geometry and guide information fusion. Extensive evaluations on challenging TUM RGB-D sequences demonstrate that Spectral GS-SLAM achieves real-time performance (40.14 FPS) while maintaining consistent tracking in both structureless and featureless environments. The proposed method preserves trajectory integrity in degenerate scenes while maintaining competitive performance in non-adverse conditions.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted to IROS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Spectral GS-SLAM，一种结合 ICP 与特征约束的实时 3D 高斯溅射 SLAM 框架，通过自适应补偿退化场景中的欠约束方向，并引入高斯感知平面性加权机制，在 TUM RGB-D 序列上实现 40.14 FPS，同时保持无结构/无纹理环境下的稳定跟踪。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS-SLAM 系统在纹理缺失或几何退化场景中，特征匹配或 ICP 跟踪容易失败，导致数值不稳定。
Method: 将 ICP 与互补的特征约束集成，通过自适应补偿退化场景中的欠约束方向，并利用 3D 高斯协方差结构设计平面性加权机制以引导信息融合。
Result: 在 TUM RGB-D 序列上达到 40.14 FPS，在无结构和无纹理环境中保持一致的跟踪，退化场景下轨迹完整性得到保留。
Conclusion: 该方法在保持实时性能的同时，提升了 SLAM 在退化场景中的鲁棒性，且不干扰共享的高斯地图表示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Empirical Study of OpenPangu Quantization on Ascend NPUs
papers.abstract_en: OpenPangu models are attractive targets for private and domestic large-language-model deployment, yet their robustness under aggressive post-training quantization on Ascend NPUs has not been systematically characterized. This paper conducts a controlled empirical study of OpenPangu 1B and 7B models on Huawei Ascend 910B1 NPUs. We evaluate representative weight-only and weight-activation post-training quantization methods, including RTN, GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant, GPTAQ, BiLLM, and SliM-LLM, under a unified calibration and evaluation protocol. Across 18 evaluation tasks, we find that 8-bit weight-only quantization is effectively lossless for both models, while 4-bit quantization remains practical for the 7B model but is visibly more harmful for the 1B model on reasoning, math, and code tasks. Ultra-low precision remains challenging: most 2-bit and binary settings collapse to near-random behavior, and W4A4 SmoothQuant produces non-finite perplexity in our evaluation. These results provide an NPU-oriented accuracy map for selecting OpenPangu quantization settings and highlight the persistent difficulty of extreme low-bit compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在华为Ascend 910B1 NPU上系统评估了OpenPangu 1B和7B模型在多种后训练量化方法（RTN、GPTQ、AWQ、SmoothQuant、GPTAQ、BiLLM、SliM-LLM）下的表现。在18个任务上的实验表明，8-bit权重量化无损，4-bit量化对7B模型可行但对1B模型在推理、数学和代码任务上损失明显，而2-bit和二进制量化几乎失效。研究为NPU上的OpenPangu量化配置提供了精度参考。
Motivation: OpenPangu模型在私有和国产大模型部署中具有吸引力，但其在Ascend NPU上后训练量化后的鲁棒性缺乏系统性表征，亟需实验研究。
Method: 采用统一校准与评估协议，在Ascend 910B1 NPU上对1B和7B模型进行多种权重量化与权重-激活量化方法的对比实验，涵盖8-bit、4-bit、2-bit及二进制精度。
Result: 8-bit权重量化对两个模型均无损；4-bit量化在7B模型上实用，但在1B模型的推理、数学和代码任务上性能下降显著；2-bit及二进制量化导致近乎随机行为，W4A4 SmoothQuant出现非有限困惑度。
Conclusion: 为NPU场景下的OpenPangu量化选择提供了精度映射，并指出极端低比特压缩仍面临严重困难。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Intrinsic Flow Matching on Quantum Pure-State Manifolds with Phase-Aligned Transport
papers.abstract_en: Quantum pure-state ensembles live on complex projective space, making flat Euclidean generative modeling geometrically mismatched. We introduce Intrinsic Flow Matching (IFM), a deterministic transport framework on $\mathbb{CP}^{d-1}$ that learns tangent velocity fields using Pancharatnam phase-aligned conditional paths. IFM replaces local score teachers and reverse-time stochastic sampling with manifold probability flow, while horizontal parameterization removes redundant ambient directions. We show that the IFM objective recovers the induced marginal transport field, represents deterministic projective ensemble flows, and yields endpoint and stability guarantees. Empirically, IFM often improves over ambient Euclidean flow matching across higher-qubit, multimodal, spin-coherent, physics-inspired, and amplitude-encoded MNIST image-vector benchmarks, with strongest gains on high-dimensional and coherence-sensitive tasks but not uniformly across every metric.

papers.title: Gradient-Free Warm-Start Library Recovery: an Amortized-Regret Separation
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning that is gradient-free, local, online, and append-only is attractive for edge and streaming deployment, but its value is usually argued informally. We give a provable account on recurring-regime streams. Given segmentation, a warm-start library learner attains amortized recovery cost $O\!\big(KD/\varepsilon^2+(R-K)\logK/Δ^2\big)$ versus a memoryless re-estimator's $Θ(RD/\varepsilon^2)$, an advantage $(R-K)\,Θ(D/\varepsilon^2)$ growing with dimension $D$ and recurrence density. The mechanism is a decoupling: recognizing which of $K$ seen regimes is active costs $O(\log K/Δ^2)$, independent of $D$, whereas estimating a regime costs $Θ(D/\varepsilon^2)$. We prove this is tight: matching lower bounds give recognition $Θ(\log K/Δ^2)$ and a memoryless-class bound $Ω(RD/\varepsilon^2)$, so each term is individually minimax-tight (the joint statement is conditional). The separation is born-immune (a memoryless learner's advantage is identically zero) and paradigm-level: it matches, and does not beat, a fair spawn-capable Bayesian baseline; the contribution is attaining this cost structure without end-to-end backprop and with zero forgetting by construction. A count-calibrated variant ties the baseline's leading constant up to a bounded, never-negative per-recurrence overshoot, hyperparameter-free and with no per-step transcendentals. We bound the scope: recognizable regimes are capped by simplex packing (walls $e^{Θ(D)}$); autonomous segmentation is impossible at the packing wall (no detector escapes the false-alarm/delay frontier as regimes overlap); the advantage vanishes under overlap. The dimension-dependent separation is corroborated on synthetic streams and real $k$-mer genome distributions (memoryless cost $\propto D^{1.04}$, recognition $D$-independent); the one real sequential stream sits in the $D{=}1$ near-null corner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无梯度、局部、在线、仅追加的持续学习场景，提出一种基于库恢复的暖启动方法，并给出理论保证。证明在可分割的重复流中，暖启动学习器可以实现摊销恢复代价$O(KD/\varepsilon^2+(R-K)\log K/\Delta^2)$，而记忆无关重新估计器的代价为$\Theta(RD/\varepsilon^2)$，差距随维度$D$和重复密度增长。机制是将识别$K$个已见阶段和估计阶段解耦，识别代价与维度无关。还证明下界紧致，并讨论范式界限。
Motivation: 持续学习中无梯度、局部、在线、仅追加的方法对于边缘和流式部署有吸引力，但其价值通常是非正式的论证。本文旨在提供可证明的理论分析，展示在重复流中暖启动库恢复相对于记忆无关估计器的优势。
Method: 提出一个暖启动库学习器，通过解耦阶段识别和阶段估计实现摊销恢复。识别已见阶段的代价为$O(\log K/\Delta^2)$，与维度无关；估计阶段的代价为$\Theta(D/\varepsilon^2)$。还提出一个计数校准变体，无需超参数和每步超越函数。
Result: 暖启动学习器的摊销恢复代价为$O(KD/\varepsilon^2+(R-K)\log K/\Delta^2)$，而记忆无关重新估计器的代价为$\Theta(RD/\varepsilon^2)$。下界证明识别代价$\Theta(\log K/\Delta^2)$和记忆无关类界$\Omega(RD/\varepsilon^2)$是各自minimax紧致的。在合成流和真实$k$-mer基因组分布上，记忆无关代价与维度成正比（$D^{1.04}$），而识别代价与维度无关。
Conclusion: 本文展示了暖启动库恢复在重复流中的理论优势，但指出该优势依赖于可识别的非重叠阶段，且自主分割在阶段密度高时不可行。优势在阶段重叠时消失。

summary_sections.conclusion: 本文展示了暖启动库恢复在重复流中的理论优势，但指出该优势依赖于可识别的非重叠阶段，且自主分割在阶段密度高时不可行。优势在阶段重叠时消失。

papers.title: A Neurosymbolic Framework for Interpretable Skeleton-Based Seizure Detection via Concept-Driven Logical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Video-based seizure detection is essential for the management of epilepsy patients, offering a non-invasive complement to electroencephalography. While several deep learning approaches have been developed for video-based seizure detection, none are inherently interpretable, limiting their adoption and translation into clinical practice. We present, to our knowledge, the first exploration of a neurosymbolic framework for video-based seizure detection that directly addresses this gap. Our approach (1) extracts patient-centric skeleton sequences from epilepsy monitoring units via a prompt-guided foundation model, (2) predicts binary spatio-temporal concept activations grounded in clinical motor semiology guidelines, and (3) composes them via differentiable logic into interpretable Boolean rules with auditable contributions. Furthermore, to mitigate false positives arising from the traditional binary formulation (seizure vs.\ non-seizure), we sub-classify non-seizure segments into clinically relevant normal activities, providing the model with fine-grained discriminative supervision. Evaluated on two public seizure video benchmarks, our framework achieves 89.78% sensitivity with 0.06 false detections per hour on SAHZU and 85.27%,0.09 on IEEE, while producing complete three-level interpretability: every prediction decomposes into which motor primitives were detected, how they were logically composed, and how much each rule contributed to the clinical decision. We publicly release all annotations, extracted pose sequences, our data pipeline and code, https://github.com/Mr-TalhaIlyas/CDSD/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个用于视频癫痫检测的神经符号框架，通过骨架序列提取、临床概念激活和可微逻辑推理实现可解释的癫痫发作检测。在SAHZU和IEEE两个公开基准上分别达到89.78%和85.27%的灵敏度，以及极低的误检率，并提供三级可解释性。
Motivation: 现有视频癫痫检测方法缺乏内在可解释性，限制了临床转化。同时传统二分类（发作/非发作）导致假阳性高，需要更细粒度的判别监督。
Method: 框架包括三阶段：(1) 用提示引导的基础模型从监控视频提取骨架序列；(2) 预测基于临床运动半学指南的时空概念激活；(3) 通过可微逻辑组合成可解释的布尔规则。此外，将非发作段细分为临床相关正常活动以减少假阳性。
Result: 在SAHZU数据集上达到89.78%灵敏度、0.06次/小时误检；在IEEE数据集上达到85.27%灵敏度、0.09次/小时误检。预测可分解为检测到的运动基元、逻辑组合方式及各规则贡献度。
Conclusion: 该神经符号框架是首个为视频癫痫检测提供完整可解释性的方法，代码、标注和骨架数据已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Does RoPE Prevent or Degrade Retrieval Heads? A Mechanistic Analysis Across Model Families
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval heads, attention heads that copy information from earlier context to the current position, have been proposed as the mechanistic substrate for long-context recall. Rotary position embeddings (RoPE) rotate queries and keys by frequencies decaying with a base hyperparameter theta, and a natural hypothesis is that this rotation either prevents retrieval heads from forming or degrades their function. We test both across four open-weight 7-8B models spanning multi-head and grouped-query attention and a 100x range of theta, using paired-seed needle-in-a-haystack tests, layer-clustered permutation, and causal head-masking. (i) Retrieval heads are causally necessary: masking the 87 detected heads in OLMo-2 collapses recall from 1.00 to 0.00, while masking matched random heads has no effect; this replicates in Qwen. (ii) Higher theta does not reduce retrieval-head count (LLaMA-3.1 at theta=500K has 47 heads vs LLaMA-2 at theta=10K with 42), refuting the prevention hypothesis. (iii) The norm-utility relation is family-specific and significant in opposite directions (Qwen d=-0.49, OLMo d=+0.50, both significant; LLaMA null); since OLMo and LLaMA-3.1 share theta=500K yet differ, the effect is not theta-driven. (iv) Building on Chiang and Yogatama (2025), a controlled patch shows that zeroing the lowest-frequency RoPE dimensions of retrieval heads degrades recall dose-dependently (1.00 to 0.18 when 32 of 128 dimensions are zeroed, vs 0.98 for random dimensions); the effect is head-specific and task-specific. The causal variable is RoPE frequency, not norm-utility. The direction holds in all five models patched (OLMo-2, Qwen2.5-7B/14B, Gemma-2, Mistral) across four lineages and two scales. We do not claim cross-model magnitude. Code and a paired-seed harness are released.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 3 figures, 18 tables. Code, data, and a paired-seed reproducibility harness: https://github.com/CengizhanBayram/Does-RoPE-Prevent-or-Degrade-Retrieval-Heads-A-Mechanistic-Analysis-Across-Model-Families
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文通过机制分析研究旋转位置编码 (RoPE) 对检索头 (retrieval heads) 的影响。实验表明，检索头是长上下文回忆的必要组件，增加 RoPE 的 base theta 不会减少检索头数量，而将低频 RoPE 维度置零会剂量依赖地降低回忆性能。
Motivation: 自然假设认为 RoPE 的旋转会阻止检索头的形成或削弱其功能，该论文旨在检验这一假设。
Method: 使用配对种子的 needle-in-a-haystack 测试、层聚类置换和因果头掩码，在四种 7-8B 模型（不同注意力架构和 theta 范围）中进行实验。
Result: 主要发现包括：检索头是因果必要的；更高 theta 不减少检索头数量；低频 RoPE 维度对检索头功能有因果作用，且该效应在五个模型中一致。
Conclusion: 检索头功能的因果变量是 RoPE 频率而非范数-效用关系，该方向在多个模型家族和规模中成立，但未声称跨模型幅度一致。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ACE-GS: Acing the Trade-off with Accurate, Compact and Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting achieves exceptional real-time rendering, but its substantial computational and storage demands hinder widespread deployment. Existing accelerated paradigms often aggressively prune primitives for rapid convergence, causing severe loss of high-frequency details. To address this, we tackle the fundamental problem of achieving both exceptional rendering quality and ultra-fast reconstruction speed. In this paper, we propose ACE-GS, a progressive optimization framework tailored for accurate, compressed, and efficient scene representation. We realize that precise primitive management is the key to breaking this trade-off. Therefore, we first design a momentum consistency-guided densification strategy, strictly constraining primitive growth onto authentic geometric manifolds to avoid computational waste while significantly accelerating convergence. Building upon this efficient initialization, we deploy a statistical sensitivity-driven sparsification mechanism to precisely prune redundant primitives, yielding a further compressed footprint. Finally, to thoroughly compensate for the risk of micro-structure loss caused by the aforementioned strict primitive control, we introduce a cross-dimensional residual frequency compensation scheme that explicitly back-injects high-frequency error energy into primitive attributes, perfectly restoring sharp geometric details. Extensive experiments validate our superiority. While maintaining a highly compact scene representation, our system achieves up to 3.7 times training acceleration against the rapid framework Speedy-Splat. Requiring only 3 to 5 minutes to converge, ACE-GS secures the highest structural similarity and achieves a peak PSNR improvement of up to 0.89 dB over the original 3DGS, establishing a new benchmark for ultra-fast and high-fidelity novel view synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ACE-GS，一种针对3D高斯溅射的渐进优化框架，旨在平衡渲染质量、模型紧凑度和训练效率。通过动量一致性引导的稠密化策略将生长约束在真实几何流形上，结合统计灵敏度驱动的稀疏化剪枝冗余基元，并引入跨维度残差频率补偿恢复高频细节。实验表明，在保持紧凑表示的同时，训练速度比Speedy-Splat快3.7倍，3-5分钟收敛，PSNR最高提升0.89 dB。
Motivation: 现有3D高斯溅射加速方法通过激进剪枝导致高频细节丢失，难以同时实现高质量渲染与超快重建速度。核心问题在于如何精准管理基元以打破这一权衡。
Method: 提出动量一致性引导的稠密化策略，将生长限制在真实几何流形上；随后用统计灵敏度驱动的稀疏化机制精确剪枝冗余基元；最后通过跨维度残差频率补偿显式注入高频误差能量到基元属性中，恢复锐利几何细节。
Result: 在保持紧凑场景表示的同时，训练加速达3.7倍（对比Speedy-Splat），仅需3-5分钟收敛；获得最高结构相似性，PSNR相比原始3DGS提升0.89 dB。
Conclusion: ACE-GS建立了超快高保真新视角合成的基准，验证了精准基元管理对于权衡的重要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DIPBox: A Multi-scale Testing Framework for Tracking Dataset Regeneration
papers.abstract_en: Training datasets have tremendous proprietary value and are vulnerable to unauthorized copying. Existing defenses mainly focus on tracking individual data points, but pay little attention to the threat of dataset regeneration. Through a measurement study of public tumor datasets, we identify substantial real-world partial-dataset replication, raising concerns about potential license noncompliance. To counter the challenge of tracking previously unknown adversarial regeneration, our key insight is that regeneration that preserves model utility inevitably preserves measurable signals across multiple feature scales. We categorize these dataset features into sample-, set-, and distribution-level features and design four similarity metrics to accurately identify regeneration. Based on these metrics, we develop DIPBox, which to our knowledge is the first testing framework that tracks regeneration suspects via multi-scale similarity testing across a spectrum of defender access settings, from limited to full information. We further provide a learning-theoretic analysis that justifies these multi-scale metrics and formalizes an inherent utility--divergence trade-off, implying fundamental limits on evasive regeneration. Extensive experiments on 16 vision and text base datasets, 320 regenerated datasets, and 590 derived models validate that DIPBox outperforms previous solutions while characterizing its robustness and limits under three adaptive attacks.
papers.comment: Accepted by ACM CCS 2026. Please cite this paper as "Tian Dong, Yan Meng, Shaofeng Li, Guoxing Chen, Yuling Chen, Zhen Liu, Haojin Zhu, Hao Chen. DIPBox: A Multi-scale Testing Framework for Tracking Dataset Regeneration. In the Proceedings of ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS 2026)."
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对数据集再生（dataset regeneration）这一威胁，提出多尺度测试框架DIPBox。通过测量研究发现真实世界部分数据集存在复制，设计了样本级、集合级和分布级三个层面的特征相似度指标，并在不同防御者信息设置下追踪再生数据集。实验验证了DIPBox在16个视觉和文本基础数据集、320个再生数据集及590个衍生模型上的有效性。
Motivation: 现有防御主要关注单个数据点追踪，但忽视了数据集再生的威胁。实际中部分数据集复制行为普遍，可能导致许可证违规。
Method: 提出DIPBox，利用再生过程必然保留多尺度特征信号的洞察，定义样本级、集合级和分布级特征，并设计四种相似度指标进行多尺度相似性测试，支持从有限到完全信息的多种防御者访问设置。
Result: 在16个基础数据集、320个再生数据集和590个衍生模型上，DIPBox优于先前解决方案，并在三种自适应攻击下表征了其鲁棒性和局限性。
Conclusion: 论文提供了学习理论分析，论证了多尺度度量的合理性，并形式化了效用与散度之间的权衡，暗示逃避再生存在基本限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Recency/Frequency Adaptive KV Caching for Large Language Model Serving
papers.abstract_en: Key-value (KV) caching is a powerful technique for accelerating large language model inference and generation. Inference workloads are large and diverse, which makes them difficult to cache effectively. Existing cache management strategies adopt the least-recently-used policy for evicting cache blocks. However, LRU leads to multiple unrelated workloads flushing each other's caches. To address this, we integrate adaptive caching that dynamically allocates cache space between recently and frequently occurring KV blocks. Evaluations show that it improves the KV cache hit rate by up to 10.8% and reduces time to first token by up to 12.6% over naive vLLM on synthetic document question answering workloads, and 2.1% and 2.0% respectively on real-world conversation workloads. The method generalizes well to batch inference and demonstrates clear interpretability while effectively accommodating diverse workloads.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Resource-Adaptive Foundation Model Inference (AdaptFM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型推理中KV缓存效率问题，提出一种自适应缓存策略，动态分配最近出现（recency）和频繁出现（frequency）的KV块空间，替代传统的LRU策略。在合成文档问答任务上，KV缓存命中率提升高达10.8%，首令牌时间降低12.6%；在真实对话任务上分别提升2.1%和2.0%。该方法在批处理推理中泛化良好，且具有可解释性。
Motivation: 现有KV缓存管理采用LRU策略，但不同工作负载之间频繁相互冲刷缓存，导致缓存效率低下。需要一种自适应策略来平衡最近和频繁使用的缓存块。
Method: 提出Recency/Frequency自适应KV缓存策略，动态在最近使用（recency）和频繁使用（frequency）的KV块之间分配缓存空间，而非固定LRU。
Result: 在合成文档问答任务上，KV缓存命中率提升10.8%，首令牌时间降低12.6%；在真实对话任务上分别提升2.1%和2.0%。方法在批处理推理中泛化良好。
Conclusion: 自适应KV缓存能有效提升LLM推理效率，尤其在多样工作负载下优于LRU，且具有可解释性和通用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Context-Aware Autoregressive Diffusion for Gloss-Wise Sign Language Production
papers.abstract_en: To generate natural and accurate sentence-level sign language, synthesizing the "gloss", the fundamental semantic unit, is essential. However, most current sign-language production (SLP) methods generate entire sequences at once. While this end-to-end approach is often efficient, it is prone to temporal drift and hand motion blur as sentences get longer, and fails to accurately control individual glosses. In this paper, we propose the Context-aware Gloss-wise AutoRegressive Diffusion model (GARD), a gloss-wise diffusion framework that models coarticulation by conditioning on both semantic (linguistic) and kinematic (motion) contexts. To ensure natural continuity between gloss motions, GARD introduces two additional strategies: i) Inter-Gloss Transition Guidance, which applies gradient-based guidance to kinematically align inter-gloss boundaries and ensure seamless pose consistency. ii) Global Motion Harmonizer, refining the entire gloss motion sequence based on the boundary poses adjusted by Inter-Gloss Transition Guidance. Extensive experiments on Phoenix-T and CSL-Daily datasets demonstrate that GARD achieves superior performance over existing SLP methods in terms of both linguistic accuracy and motion similarity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出上下文感知的逐词汇自回归扩散模型（GARD），用于手语生成。GARD通过语义和运动上下文条件建模协同发音，并引入跨词汇过渡引导和全局运动协调器，以生成自然连续的手语序列。在Phoenix-T和CSL-Daily数据集上，GARD在语言准确性和运动相似性方面优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有手语生成方法通常端到端生成整个句子，导致长句子中的时间漂移和手部运动模糊，且难以精确控制单个词汇（gloss）。
Method: 提出逐词汇扩散框架GARD，通过语义和运动上下文条件化来建模协同发音；引入跨词汇过渡引导（梯度引导对齐边界姿态）和全局运动协调器（基于边界姿态优化整个序列）。
Result: 在Phoenix-T和CSL-Daily数据集上，GARD在语言准确性和运动相似性方面优于现有手语生成方法。
Conclusion: GARD通过逐词汇扩散和上下文条件化有效改善了手语生成的自然性和准确性，但论文未讨论其泛化性到其他领域或计算开销。

papers.title: Comparative Evaluation of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models for Wound-Rotor Synchronous Motor Performance Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Wound rotor synchronous motors have emerged as a strong alternative that eliminates dependence on REEs. However, WRSM design requires the simultaneous optimization of numerous geometric and electromagnetic parameters, and the high computational cost of conventional finite element analysis severely limits the rapid exploration of the large parameter space. Although there are machine-learning-based surrogate modeling studies in the literature, they generally compare only a limited number of models, exclude deep learning architectures, and do not provide a comprehensive benchmark specific to WRSM. In this study, the performance of a total of eight machine learning and deep learning models from four different algorithmic families was systematically compared for the prediction of WRSM torque and motor efficiency. On a dataset of 3351 samples generated using Latin Hypercube Sampling in the Motor-CAD simulation environment, each model was trained with 10 different random seed values and tuned via Optuna hyperparameter optimization. Different from the existing literature, this study jointly offers a broad model spectrum including recent deep learning architectures such as FT Transformer, a multi-seed reproducibility protocol, and a Pareto analysis of the computational cost-accuracy trade-off. The results revealed that neural-network-based models systematically outperform tree-based models. The FT-Transformer model achieved the highest single-model accuracy with R^2 = 0.9928, producing predictions in 0.33 milliseconds and thus obtaining several orders of magnitude speedup compared to FEA. Model performances were evaluated in a multidimensional manner using R^2, MAE, RMSE, and MAPE metrics.
papers.comment: This paper was presented on April 19, 2026, at the 10th ISPEC International Congress on Modern Scientific Research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了八种机器学习和深度学习模型用于预测绕线转子同步电机的转矩和效率。在3351个样本的数据集上，FT-Transformer模型达到了最高的R²=0.9928，预测时间0.33毫秒，比有限元分析快几个数量级。研究还提供了多种子可重复性协议和计算成本-准确度权衡的帕累托分析。
Motivation: 现有文献对WRSM的代理模型只比较有限数量的模型，缺乏深度学习架构和全面的基准。本研究旨在填补这一空白，提供广泛模型谱系和系统比较。
Method: 使用Motor-CAD仿真环境通过拉丁超立方采样生成3351个样本，对八种模型（包括FT-Transformer等深度学习架构）进行Optuna超参数优化，每种模型使用10个不同随机种子训练，并通过R²、MAE、RMSE、MAPE等多维度评估。
Result: 神经网络模型系统优于树模型。FT-Transformer获得最佳单模型R²=0.9928，预测时间0.33毫秒，相比FEA获得几个数量级加速。
Conclusion: 本研究提供了WRSM性能预测的广泛基准，强调了深度学习架构的优越性，并提出了多种子可重复性协议和计算成本-准确度权衡的帕累托分析。

papers.title: Sakana Fugu Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: The capabilities of frontier Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to advance, with different providers increasingly specializing in distinct domains. This raises a natural next objective: how to combine the individual specializations of various LLMs into a collectively intelligent system. To this end, we report the development of Sakana Fugu, a family of orchestrator models that harness and amplify the capabilities of an LLM agent team. Fugu models are themselves language models trained to understand user queries and dynamically devise agentic scaffolds to solve them. Through these adaptive scaffolds, Fugu accesses performance beyond any individual LLM agent, achieving state-of-the-art results compared to other publicly accessible models across a range of challenging tasks, including SWE-Bench Pro, Terminal Bench, LiveCodeBench, GPQA-Diamond, Humanity's Last Exam, and CharXiv Reasoning. We release two models: Fugu, which balances performance with latency for everyday use, and Fugu-Ultra, which prioritizes answer quality on the hardest problems. We describe our training paradigm, which encompasses large-scale fine-tuning, evolutionary algorithms, and reinforcement learning approaches, along with the infrastructure and core design principles that turn these methods into a production system. We hope this report encourages further research into multi-agent systems and dynamic, query-adaptive agentic scaffolds as a path toward the next frontier of AI capabilities, accessed through collective intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了Sakana Fugu系列协调器模型的开发，该模型通过动态设计智能体脚手架（agentic scaffolds）来组合多个LLM的专长，在多个基准上取得SOTA结果。
Motivation: 如何将不同LLM的个体专长结合成一个集体智能系统，是当前LLM发展面临的自然下一步目标。
Method: 训练语言模型作为协调器，理解用户查询并动态设计智能体脚手架；采用大规模微调、进化算法和强化学习。
Result: 在SWE-Bench Pro、Terminal Bench、LiveCodeBench、GPQA-Diamond、Humanity's Last Exam、CharXiv Reasoning上取得SOTA结果。
Conclusion: 希望鼓励多智能体系统和动态查询自适应智能体脚手架的研究，作为通向下一代AI能力的路径。

papers.title: FleetAgent: Teleoperation Assistant for Autonomous Fleets via Vectorized V2N Messages
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale autonomous fleets rely on teleoperation to resolve rare failures, yet streaming raw sensor data from many vehicles is costly, and remote operators can only monitor a limited number of vehicles at a time. We introduce FleetAgent, a cloud-hosted multimodal large language model (MLLM) assistant that consumes compact vectorized vehicle-to-network (V2N) messages, such as map elements, detected objects, and the ego planned path. It provides a structured natural-language response (including narration, explanation, and evaluation of the plan and scene), along with an intervention urgency score for operator prioritization. To make structured messages compatible with token-based MLLMs, we propose VecFormer, a vector-to-embedding interface with differentiable top-K context selection that bounds context length and GPU KV-cache growth, enabling more efficient batch processing, which is important under the context of cloud-hosted large-scale fleet management. We also construct VecEval, a nuScenes-derived dataset with paired human and synthetic imperfect plans and human-verified language labels, to facilitate the training and evaluation of our proposed system. Our proposed system can reduce uplink payload by up to 625 times compared with raw images and reduce KV-cache memory by 16.54 times compared with original text descriptions. On VecEval, FleetAgent improves Lingo-Judge score by 16.8% and reduces intervention failure rate by 19.9%, compared with Qwen2.5-VL-7B using language descriptions. These results demonstrate that FleetAgent can utilize compact structured V2N messaging to enable efficient, explainable teleoperation monitoring for autonomous fleets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FleetAgent 是一个云托管的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）助手，用于自动驾驶车队的远程监控。它通过向量化 V2N 消息（如地图元素、检测对象和自车规划路径）提供结构化自然语言响应（包括叙述、解释和评估）以及干预紧迫性评分，帮助操作员优先处理异常车辆。提出了 VecFormer 接口，将向量数据转换为嵌入，并通过可微分的 top-K 上下文选择限制长度，提高批量处理效率。基于 nuScenes 构建了 VecEval 数据集，用于训练和评估。实验表明，与原始图像相比，上行链路负载减少最多 625 倍，KV-cache 内存减少 16.54 倍；在 VecEval 上，Lingo-Judge 分数提升 16.8%，干预失败率降低 19.9%。
Motivation: 大规模自动驾驶车队依赖远程监控处理罕见故障，但流式传输原始传感器数据成本高，且操作员同时监控的车辆数量有限。需要更高效、可扩展的监控方式。
Method: FleetAgent：云托管 MLLM，输入为向量化 V2N 消息（地图、检测对象、规划路径）；输出结构化自然语言响应和干预紧迫性评分。VecFormer：向量到嵌入的接口，包含可微分 top-K 上下文选择，限制上下文长度和 KV-cache 增长。VecEval：基于 nuScenes 的数据集，包含人工和合成的不完美规划及验证标签。
Result: 上行链路负载比原始图像降低最多 625 倍，KV-cache 内存比原始文本描述降低 16.54 倍。在 VecEval 上，FleetAgent 相比 Qwen2.5-VL-7B（使用语言描述）Lingo-Judge 分数提升 16.8%，干预失败率降低 19.9%。
Conclusion: FleetAgent 利用紧凑的向量化 V2N 消息实现了高效、可解释的自动驾驶车队远程监控，显著降低传输负载和内存消耗，并提升了监控性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Speaker Identity in Non-Verbal Vocalizations: Conditional Distillation and Mixture of Experts Approach
papers.abstract_en: As expressive text-to-speech (TTS) and voice conversion (VC) systems increasingly generate non-verbal vocalizations (NVVs) to enhance naturalness, reliable speaker verification (SV) becomes essential to objectively assess identity consistency across both verbal and non-verbal segments. Yet current SV systems generalize poorly to NVVs, and fine-tuning on NVV data causes catastrophic forgetting of speech performance. We present the first systematic study across 10 NVV types and propose a framework combining frozen Data2Vec self-supervised features with ECAPA-TDNN, enhanced by a Mixture of Experts (MoE) module with learned domain-aware routing. A conditional distillation loss on speech inputs via a pretrained teacher retains speech-to-speech accuracy, while a contrastive loss bridges the speech-NVV domain gap. Our method reduces speech-NVV EER from 38.93% to 22.66% over a pretrained baseline, and improves speech EER from 13.17% to 9.24% via distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究10种非语言发声（NVVs）中的说话人身份验证问题，提出将冻结的Data2Vec自监督特征与ECAPA-TDNN结合，并引入混合专家（MoE）模块和领域感知路由，通过条件蒸馏损失和对比损失来保持语音-语音准确率并缩小语音-NVV域差距。该方法在说话人验证任务上将语音-NVV的等错误率（EER）从38.93%降至22.66%，同时语音EER从13.17%改善至9.24%。
Motivation: 现有说话人验证系统在非语言发声上泛化能力差，且直接微调会导致语音性能灾难性遗忘，而目前缺乏对多种NVV类型的系统研究。
Method: 提出一个框架，结合冻结的Data2Vec自监督特征与ECAPA-TDNN，增加混合专家（MoE）模块和领域感知路由；使用条件蒸馏损失（利用预训练教师模型保持语音-语音准确率）和对比损失（缩小语音与NVV域差距）。
Result: 在说话人验证任务上，语音-NVV的等错误率（EER）从38.93%降至22.66%，语音EER从13.17%降至9.24%。
Conclusion: 该方法是首个系统性跨10种NVV类型的说话人验证研究，有效缓解了语音-NVV域差异且不牺牲语音性能。

papers.title: QBioFusion-QSAR: Morgan-Anchored Quantum Multiple Kernel Learning for Small-Data Ligand Classification
papers.abstract_en: Small quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) studies are difficult when close molecular analogues have different activity labels. This paper asks whether a quantum kernel can add similarity information to a Morgan/Tanimoto fingerprint model, and which molecules account for the change. QBioFusion-QSAR uses quantum multiple kernel learning (QMKL): a support vector machine combines a Morgan/Tanimoto kernel with a quantum fidelity kernel constructed from fold-local components derived from RDKit and Mordred descriptors and Deep-PK features. Linear and radial basis function descriptor kernels are included as classical controls. On the 54-molecule PsychLight-A benchmark, Morgan/Tanimoto was the strongest single representation. In the primary stratified five-fold evaluation, QMKL increased accuracy from 0.815 to 0.833 and Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) from 0.613 to 0.645. Matched-regularization auditing attributed the change to N-Me-5-HT and N-Me-tryptamine changing from false-negative to true-positive predictions; activity-cliff subset MCC increased from 0.07 to 0.22. Repeating the five-fold protocol over ten random partitionings showed that learned QMKL did not exceed Morgan/Tanimoto on mean MCC; paired held-out bootstrap intervals for the matched comparison also span zero. These results support QBioFusion-QSAR as an auditable QMKL framework for identifying localized residual quantum-kernel contributions in small-data, activity-cliff-aware ligand classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QBioFusion-QSAR，一种量子多核学习（QMKL）框架，将Morgan/Tanimoto指纹核与量子保真度核结合用于小样本配体分类。在54分子PsychLight-A基准上，QMKL将准确率从0.815提升至0.833，MCC从0.613提升至0.645，但通过多次划分的统计检验发现改进不显著。方法支持可审计的残差贡献分析。
Motivation: 小样本QSAR研究中，分子相似但活性标签不同的情况难以处理，传统Morgan/Tanimoto指纹模型缺乏额外的相似性信息。
Method: 采用量子多核学习，SVM结合Morgan/Tanimoto核和基于RDKit、Mordred描述符及Deep-PK特征的量子保真度核，并包含线性与RBF描述符核作为对照。
Result: 在54分子PsychLight-A基准上，分层五折交叉验证中QMKL准确率从0.815增至0.833，MCC从0.613增至0.645；但经过十次随机划分的重复实验，平均MCC未超过Morgan/Tanimoto，配对bootstrap区间包含零，表明改进不显著。活性悬崖子集MCC从0.07提升至0.22。
Conclusion: QBioFusion-QSAR提供了一个可审计的QMKL框架，能够识别小样本活性悬崖配体分类中的局部残差量子核贡献，但统计检验显示整体性能提升不显著。

papers.title: DCD-PFN: A Decoupling-Aware Foundation Model for Causal Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery is critical for understanding complex data-generating mechanisms, yet traditional algorithms often struggle with highly non-linear and noisy systems, or suffer from severe computational bottlenecks. Recent tabular foundation models based on Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) have demonstrated remarkable zero-shot inference capabilities, but their potential for explicit structural causal discovery remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose DCD-PFN, a decoupling-aware foundation model for causal discovery. Instead of directly amortizing global graph reconstruction, DCD-PFN focuses on local causal discovery through a decoupling-based paradigm. Through pre-training on diverse synthetic Structural Causal Models (SCMs), the model learns sample-wise decoupling weights that enable Markov boundary (MB) identification. Furthermore, by leveraging parallelized local discovery, DCD-PFN efficiently reconstructs global causal graphs while remaining grounded in the theoretical foundations of decoupling-based causal discovery. Experiments demonstrate that our foundation model achieves robust zero-shot generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DCD-PFN，一种基于解耦感知的因果发现基础模型。该模型通过预训练于多样化的合成结构因果模型（SCM），学习样本级解耦权重以实现马尔可夫边界识别，并利用并行化局部发现高效重建全局因果图。实验表明该模型在零样本泛化上表现稳健。
Motivation: 传统因果发现算法在处理高度非线性和噪声系统时面临计算瓶颈，而现有基于先验数据拟合网络（PFN）的表格基础模型在显式结构因果发现方面的潜力尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出DCD-PFN，采用解耦感知范式，专注于局部因果发现。通过预训练从合成SCM中学习样本级解耦权重进行马尔可夫边界识别，并利用并行化局部发现高效重建全局因果图。
Result: 实验表明该基础模型在零样本泛化场景下取得了稳健的性能。
Conclusion: 论文展示了基于解耦感知的预训练方法在因果发现中的有效性，为后续研究提供了新范式。

papers.title: Arc-Length Parameterized Interpolating Splines
papers.abstract_en: We present an iterative algorithm to compute an arc-length parameterized spline interpolating a set of points. This differs from other methods where the computed spline either does not interpolate the original points or the parameterization is not the arc-length of the returned curves. Our method is applicable in any dimension $D \ge 2$, and we illustrate it with numerical results for plane curves.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种迭代算法，用于计算弧长参数化的样条曲线，该曲线插值给定点集。与其他方法不同，该算法保证插值原始点且参数化为曲线的弧长。算法适用于任意维度≥2，并在平面曲线上给出数值结果。
Motivation: 现有弧长参数化样条方法要么不插值原始点，要么参数化不是弧长，本文旨在解决这一不足。

Result: 在平面曲线上展示了数值结果，证明了算法的有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种新的途径，在保证插值的同时实现弧长参数化，具有通用性。

papers.title: When Context Misleads: Surprisal, Energy and Attention Entropy as Metrics of Coherence Illusions in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Psycholinguistics studies show that human readers fall for coherence illusions: an incoherent discourse can seem coherent simply because a distractor matches what comes next. We investigate whether Dutch language models (6 monolingual and 4 multilingual) show the same behavior on texts that link back to earlier context with words such as 'again' and 'too'. First, we find that surprisal at the critical word tracks human acceptability judgments and eye-tracking data. Models are more surprised by incoherent continuations, but a matching distractor in the prior context reduces this surprisal. Second, attention entropy at the critical position identifies heads that behave differently under coherence vs. incoherence. We find that ablating these heads shows transfer effects across experiments, suggesting a shared mechanism. Third, we introduce energy from the associative-memory literature as a metric to quantify discourse coherence. Taken together, our results show that coherence illusions arise in Dutch LLMs, with entropy and energy exposing mechanisms that operate across settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了荷兰语语言模型（6个单语和4个多语）在连贯性幻觉（coherence illusions）中的表现，即当不连贯语篇中有一个干扰项与后续内容匹配时，模型会误认为语篇连贯。实验发现，关键位置的surprisal与人类可接受度判断和眼动数据一致，匹配的干扰项会降低模型的surprisal；注意力熵可以识别在连贯与不连贯条件下行为不同的注意力头，消融这些头显示了跨实验的迁移效应；引入联想记忆中的能量（energy）作为量化语篇连贯性的新指标。
Motivation: 心理语言学研究表明人类读者会受连贯性幻觉影响，但语言模型是否表现出类似行为尚不清楚，尤其是荷兰语模型。
Method: 使用surprisal、注意力熵和能量（来自联想记忆文献）作为度量，在包含'again'和'too'等词的语境中分析模型对连贯与不连贯文本的反应。
Result: 模型对不连贯延续表现出更高的surprisal，但匹配的干扰项会降低surprisal；注意力熵识别出特定注意力头，消融后显示跨实验迁移效应；能量指标有效量化了语篇连贯性。
Conclusion: 荷兰语大语言模型中存在连贯性幻觉，熵和能量揭示了跨设置运行的机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Communication Heterogeneity and Collective Consensus in Neural Cellular Automata
papers.abstract_en: Reaching global agreement from purely local interactions is a defining problem of collective intelligence, and most models of it assume that all agents share a single communication protocol. We ask what happens when they do not. Using a Neural Cellular Automaton in which a population of cells must solve the density classification task, agreeing on a global majority that no individual can observe, we introduce ``languages'' as sub-populations that read one another's messages through a translation with a tunable ``linguistic distance''. We find that linguistic distance slows consensus, that it produces mild divergence between groups rather than full fragmentation, and that a collective whose shared rule was trained under diverse protocols is robust to mismatch; a homogeneously trained one is not. The findings hold on both a ring and a two-dimensional grid, and admit a natural reading as Ising relaxation, in which a foreign-language region acts as a boundary defect that leaves the system in a higher-energy, partially ordered state. These patterns are qualitatively consistent with effects reported in human group studies, suggesting that distance between communication protocols is a minimal mechanism sufficient to produce them, without anything language-specific.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用神经细胞自动机（Neural Cellular Automata）研究通信异质性对集体共识的影响。在密度分类任务中，引入不同“语言”子群体，通过可调“语言距离”的翻译进行互动。发现语言距离减缓共识形成，导致群体间轻度分歧而非完全分裂；在多样化通信协议下训练的集体对失配具有鲁棒性，而同质训练的则不然。这些模式在一维环和二维网格上均成立，并可类比为Ising松弛中的边界缺陷。
Motivation: 大多数集体智能模型假设所有智能体共享单一通信协议，本文探讨当协议不一致时，集体共识如何受影响。
Method: 采用神经细胞自动机，让细胞群体执行密度分类任务。将细胞分为不同“语言”子群体，子群体间通过可调“语言距离”的翻译读取消息。训练规则在多样化或同质协议下进行。
Result: 语言距离延长了共识达成时间；群体间出现轻微分歧而非完全碎片化；在多样化协议下训练的集体对语言失配鲁棒，而同质训练的集体则脆弱。结果在环状和二维网格结构中一致。
Conclusion: 通信协议之间的距离本身足以产生人类群体研究中观察到的分歧模式，无需依赖语言特异性机制。该结果可类比为Ising模型中的边界缺陷。

papers.title: Whistleblowing and the machine -- towards a considered position
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligent agents and autonomous systems are embedded in our environments. They are both a commercial product and a personal tool that generates a lot of data and can draw conclusions from it: machines generate and keep secrets. But should machines protect all secrets? It has been shown that artificial agents are able to whistleblow and it has been argued that digital multi-agent environments should allow for agents in them to whistleblow. We argue that machine whistleblowing must be normative and principled and routed in the existing understanding of whistleblowing as an important rule-breaking mechanism in society. We also argue that there is a need for government regulators to formulate an informed stance on both what machines should be allowed to whistleblow on and how to legally protect those who develop whistleblowing machines
papers.comment: Presented at AAMAS-26 Workshop on Rebellion and Disobedience in AI, see https://sites.google.com/view/rad-ai/rad-ai/cfp?authuser=0
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨人工智能体与自主系统在环境中生成并保守秘密的问题，论证机器揭发（whistleblowing）必须基于规范性和原则性，根植于社会中对揭发作为重要规则打破机制的理解。作者主张政府监管者需就机器应被允许揭发什么以及如何法律保护揭发机器的开发者形成知情立场。
Motivation: 现有AI体能够揭发，数字多智能体环境应允许揭发，但缺乏对机器揭发的规范性理解和法律框架。
Conclusion: 机器揭发应基于现有社会对揭发的理解，并需要政府监管者制定关于允许机器揭发内容和法律保护开发者立场的规则。

papers.title: Real-time pedestrian attribute recognition with YOLOv8 and ResNet18
papers.abstract_en: Pedestrian attribute recognition (PAR) assigns semantic labels to detected pedestrians and is useful in surveillance, video retrieval, and human-centered graphics applications. This paper presents a two-stage framework in which YOLOv8n detects pedestrians and ResNet18-based models classify gender, estimate apparent age, and predict 61 binary attributes from each pedestrian crop. PETA and PA-100K are combined through semantic attribute mapping, producing a unified training corpus of more than 100,000 pedestrian images while retaining the PETA attribute space. On the reported test splits, the system obtains 99.89% gender classification accuracy, a 4.23-year apparent-age mean absolute error, and 89.96% multi-attribute accuracy with a 36.32% macro F1-score and 58.80% micro F1-score. Runtime measurements indicate 25-30 FPS on an NVIDIA RTX 5060 GPU. The results show that a lightweight detector-classifier pipeline can support real-time PAR, while low macro F1 indicates that rare attributes remain challenging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段行人属性识别框架，先由YOLOv8n检测行人，再由ResNet18模型进行性别分类、年龄估计和61个二元属性预测。通过合并PETA和PA-100K数据集形成统一训练集，在测试集上获得了99.89%的性别分类准确率、4.23岁的年龄平均绝对误差和89.96%的多属性准确率，但宏F1仅36.32%，表明稀有属性识别仍有挑战。
Motivation: 行人属性识别在监控、视频检索等领域有重要应用，现有方法通常在准确率和速度之间难以平衡，尤其是实时场景。
Method: 使用YOLOv8n检测行人，基于ResNet18的模型分别进行性别分类、年龄估计和61个二元属性预测，并通过语义属性映射合并PETA和PA-100K数据集。
Result: 性别分类准确率99.89%，年龄MAE 4.23年，多属性准确率89.96%，宏F1 36.32%，微F1 58.80%，在RTX 5060 GPU上达到25-30 FPS。
Conclusion: 轻量级检测-分类流水线可支持实时行人属性识别，但稀有属性的宏F1较低，表明该类属性仍是挑战。

papers.title: Orthogonal Discrepancy Kernels for Learning with Partial Physics
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a semi-parametric framework for nonlinear system identification, which decouples discrepancy functions from physics-based components. Orthogonal Gaussian process regression balances sparse parameter selection (the white box) with discrepancy learning (the black box) to produce interpretable models from incomplete physics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个半参数框架，用于非线性系统识别，通过正交高斯过程回归将差异函数与物理组件解耦。该方法平衡白盒稀疏参数选择与黑盒差异学习，从不完整的物理模型生成可解释的模型。
Motivation: 现有物理模型往往不完整，需要学习差异函数来弥补缺失的物理过程，同时保持模型的可解释性。
Method: 引入正交高斯过程回归（Orthogonal Gaussian Process Regression）框架，将系统分解为物理驱动的白盒部分和差异学习的黑盒部分，并通过正交性约束保持两者分离。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，但强调该方法能从不完整物理模型生成可解释的模型。
Conclusion: 该框架有效解耦了物理模型与差异函数，在保持可解释性的同时利用数据驱动学习弥补模型缺失。

papers.title: Extraction and Analysis of Multimodal Concepts in Vision Language Models through Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in tasks requiring joint understanding of images and text, such as image captioning and Visual Question Answering (VQA), but our understanding of their internal processes remains limited. Recently, Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a promising tool to support the interpretation of concepts encoded in VLMs. However, most SAE-based approaches focus only on textual or visual concepts separately, ignoring multimodal concepts. This limitation hinders a comprehensive understanding of VLMs, since concepts that integrate both modalities can be misclassified. Moreover, previous visual approaches often produce low-quality visual concept descriptions that are vague or incomplete, limiting their usefulness for understanding model reasoning. We propose a framework based on SAEs to extract and analyze visual, textual, and multimodal concepts from VLMs. For each neuron, we propose a candidate human-interpretable concept and compute the alignment between the concept and the dataset samples using cosine similarity scores. Experiments on a VQA dataset (LLaVA-NeXT) demonstrate that our framework improves visual concept quality by up to 45\% compared to existing SAE-based methods, while maintaining high textual concept quality and enabling systematic identification of multimodal concepts. This work contributes new insights into the conceptual space of VLMs, providing a structured approach to distinguish between visual, textual, and multimodal concepts. The code is available at https://github.com/PHDLanza/Multidata_SAE
papers.comment: International Conference on Artificial Neural Networks (ICANN), 2026, Padua
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的框架，用于从视觉语言模型（VLM）中提取和分析视觉、文本以及多模态概念。在LLaVA-NeXT的VQA数据集上，该方法将视觉概念质量提升最高45%，同时保持高文本概念质量，并能系统识别多模态概念。代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有SAE方法主要单独分析视觉或文本概念，忽略多模态概念，导致对VLM的理解不完整；且视觉概念描述质量低、模糊或不完整。
Method: 对每个神经元提出候选可解释概念，利用余弦相似度计算概念与数据集样本之间的对齐程度，从而提取视觉、文本和多模态概念。
Result: 在LLaVA-NeXT VQA数据集上，视觉概念质量相比现有SAE方法提升最高45%，同时文本概念质量保持高水平，并能有效识别多模态概念。
Conclusion: 该方法为区分VLM中的视觉、文本和多模态概念提供了结构化途径，增进了对VLM概念空间的理解。

papers.title: Beyond Hooking Onto the World: Referential Profiles and the Numerical Structure of LLM Grounding
papers.abstract_en: This paper revisits the grounding problem for large language models in light of recent vector-grounding accounts. I accept the shift from classical symbol grounding to vector grounding, but argue that the current debate remains incomplete in two respects. First, reference is often treated too thinly, as if it were a fixed link between an isolated expression and an object. I argue instead that reference is profile-based, context-sensitive, discourse-level, affectively shaped, and norm-governed. Even in the human case, reference is publicly stabilized through patterns of use, correction, distinction, inference, and continuation rather than through identical private representations. Second, vector grounding requires an account of numerical realization. LLMs do not acquire reference through human perception, memory, intention, embodiment, or understanding. Rather, through optimization, they parameterize linguistic traces of human world-directed practice. In a finite vector system, referential profiles must be distributed, may be superposed, and are recovered through context-sensitive computation. Weights, activations, attention-mediated hidden states, softmax-trained contrasts, and inner-product alignments are the mathematical sites at which inherited linguistic relations become stable and causally active. Mechanistic interpretability findings, including entity-like features, knowledge neurons, and emotion-related activation directions, provide indirect support for this view. They do not show that LLMs possess human reference. They support a more limited thesis: LLMs may possess derivative, language-mediated, profile-based, and numerically structured forms of reference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视大语言模型（LLM）的接地问题，在向量接地框架下指出当前讨论的两个不完整之处：参考被过于简化，且向量接地缺乏数值实现的具体说明。论文提出参考是基于轮廓（profile）的、上下文敏感、话语层面、情感塑造且受规范约束的，并讨论了权重、激活、注意力隐藏状态等数值结构如何使语言关系稳定。机械可解释性发现（如实体特征、知识神经元、情感相关激活方向）间接支持这一观点，但仅表明LLM可能拥有衍生的、语言介导的、基于轮廓的数值化参考形式。
Motivation: 现有向量接地讨论将参考视为固定链接，忽视了其轮廓性、语境敏感性和规范性；此外，向量接地缺乏对数值实现如何支撑参考的理论说明。
Method: 通过概念分析，提出参考的轮廓模型（profile-based model），即参考是通过使用模式、纠正、区分、推理和延续在公共层面稳定下来的，而非私有表征；并指出在有限向量系统中，轮廓必须分布式存储、可能叠加，并通过上下文敏感计算恢复。
Result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果，但引用机械可解释性研究（如实体特征、知识神经元、情感方向）作为间接证据，认为这些发现支持LLM拥有衍生的、语言介导的轮廓性参考，而非人类式参考。
Conclusion: 论文强调LLM的参考是派生性的，数值结构（权重、激活、注意力等）是语言关系稳定化的数学基础，但不足以证明LLM具备人类式参考能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MEDLAYXPLAIN: Benchmarking the Expert-Lay Gap in Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Medical Vision-Language Models (Med-VLMs) achieve strong expert-level performance, yet their ability to generate patient-accessible descriptions remains underexplored. With the 21st Century Cures Act now mandating immediate patient access to diagnostic imaging results, evaluating whether Med-VLMs can bridge this Expert-Lay Gap is both urgent and clinically consequential for patient education and shared decision-making. To this end, we introduce MedLayXPlain, the first large-scale multimodal benchmark and evaluation framework for Medical Lay Language Generation (MLLG). MedLayXPlain-122K provides 122,789 region-grounded samples across 8 imaging modalities from 12 publicly available source datasets, each comprising a medical image with paired expert and lay captions anchored in a three-level Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) ontology hierarchy spanning 7 semantic groups, 43 semantic types, and 2,411 medical concepts. Lay captions are constructed via Hierarchical Ontology-Verified Refinement (HOVER), a three-step pipeline combining patient-centric vocabulary mapping, LLM-based constrained rewriting, and cross-model visual verification to enforce semantic equivalence while preventing hallucination. We further introduce MedLayEval, a lightweight 3B evaluator distilled from a 27B verifier that scores expert-lay alignment across five clinically grounded attributes, addressing the poor correlation between standard NLG metrics and clinical judgment. Benchmarking 33 VLMs on MedLayXPlain-122K reveals a systematic Expert-Lay Gap: medical VLMs achieve strong expert captioning but suffer significant lay-register degradation, while general-purpose VLMs produce more accessible language yet lack clinical precision, confirming that neither current paradigm adequately serves patient-facing communication.
papers.comment: 40 pages (10 pages main text, 30 pages appendix), 4 main figures, 33 vision-language models benchmarked
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MedLayXPlain，首个大规模多模态基准测试和评估框架，用于医疗通俗语言生成（MLLG）。该基准包含122,789个区域标注样本，覆盖8种成像模态，并引入MedLayEval评估器。对33个视觉语言模型的基准测试揭示了专家与普通人之间的系统性差距：医疗VLM在专家描述上表现优异但通俗描述退化严重，通用VLM可访问性强但缺乏临床精确性，表明当前两种范式均不足以满足面向患者的交流需求。
Motivation: 随着21世纪治愈法案要求立即向患者提供诊断影像结果，评估Med-VLM能否弥合专家与普通人之间的鸿沟（Expert-Lay Gap）对于患者教育和共同决策至关重要。
Method: 构建MedLayXPlain-122K数据集，包含122,789个区域标注样本，覆盖8种成像模态，每个样本有专家和通俗描述，基于UMLS本体层次。通俗描述通过HOVER管道生成：患者中心词汇映射、LLM约束重写、跨模型视觉验证。还引入MedLayEval，一个从27B验证器蒸馏的3B轻量评估器，评分五个临床属性。
Result: 基准测试33个VLM，发现医疗VLM在专家描述上强但通俗描述退化严重，通用VLM可访问性强但缺乏临床精确性，表明当前两种范式都不能很好地满足面向患者的交流。
Conclusion: 现有VLM在医疗通俗语言生成方面存在系统缺陷，需要专门设计来桥接专家与普通人之间的差距。

papers.title: TF-SNO: Time-Frequency Gated Spectral Neural Operators for Learning Non-Stationary Partial Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: Non-stationary partial differential equations (PDEs) arise throughout scientific computing, where the dominant frequency content and energy distribution can drift over time. While efficient in PDE solving, many spectral neural operators apply a shared spectral response across rollout stages, leading to mismatch with time-varying spectra in non-stationary systems. To address this issue, we propose Time-Frequency Gated Spectral Neural Operator (TF-SNO), a state-adaptive framework with learnable time-frequency gating inside spectral blocks. TF-SNO extracts compact frequency-domain and physical-space statistics from the current state to generate modulation coefficients, enabling the spectral response to evolve with the dynamics. TF-SNO learns temporal variation implicitly from the evolving state without introducing an explicit time dimension or time embedding, keeping the modeling complexity low. We further embed the adaptive operator blocks to accurately capture the multi-scale features, thereby improving long-horizon stability. Experiments on six non-stationary PDE benchmarks in 1D and 2D demonstrate that TF-SNO significantly reduces prediction errors and improves robustness compared to strong baselines, with particularly clear gains in long rollout, suggesting the effectiveness of state-dependent spectral adaptation in modeling non-stationary physical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非平稳偏微分方程（PDE）中频谱随时间漂移的问题，提出时间频率门控谱神经算子（TF-SNO）。该方法通过从当前状态提取紧凑的频域和物理空间统计量来生成调制系数，使谱响应随动力学演化，无需显式时间嵌入。实验在六个1D和2D非平稳PDE基准上显著降低预测误差并提升鲁棒性，尤其在长轨迹预测中优势明显。
Motivation: 现有谱神经算子对非平稳PDE使用固定的谱响应，无法匹配随时间变化的频谱特性，导致长期预测误差累积。
Method: 在谱块内部引入可学习的时间频率门控机制，从当前状态提取频域和物理空间统计量生成调制系数，使谱响应自适应演化；同时嵌入自适应算子块以捕捉多尺度特征。
Result: 在六个非平稳PDE基准（1D和2D）上，TF-SNO相比强基线显著降低预测误差，并在长轨迹预测中展现更清晰的增益。
Conclusion: 状态依赖的谱自适应建模能有效提升非平稳物理系统的预测精度和鲁棒性，且不增加时间维度的建模复杂度。
Relevance: 55

papers.title: Two Layers of Instability in Causal Estimation
papers.abstract_en: There is a precise sense in which drawing causal inferences from observational data is hard, even when identifiability is assumed. In particular, Robins and Ritov (1997) and Robins et al. (2003) showed that causal effects can be discontinuous as a function of the data distribution: two arbitrarily close data distributions might correspond to different causal effects. This is a fact independent of the choice of estimator; however, not all estimators are equally unstable. Our contribution is to surface a second layer of instability that depends on the choice of estimator. We show that many standard point estimates can be read as point summaries of multimodal distributions over the space of structural causal models. As such, estimators can jump discontinuously in the data distribution. This defines a taxonomy of estimators that admits a decision-theoretic reading: stability depends on whether the implicit loss function an estimator optimizes is aligned with the causal effect itself. Specifically, inverse propensity weighted estimators and regression estimators are examples of discontinuous summaries, while explicit posterior means and medians are shown to be continuous.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了因果估计中的两层不稳定性：第一层是因果效应本身作为数据分布的函数可能不连续（已有结果），第二层是依赖于估计量的选择导致的不连续。作者展示许多标准点估计可以视为结构因果模型空间上多模态分布的点摘要，从而在数据分布上跳跃不连续。具体而言，逆倾向得分加权估计和回归估计是不连续摘要，而显式后验均值和位数是连续的。
Motivation: 因果推断从观测数据中估计因果效应即使可识别性成立也很困难，因为因果效应可能随数据分布不连续变化，且不同估计量的稳定性不同。
Method: 将标准点估计重新解释为结构因果模型空间上多模态分布的点摘要，通过分析隐式损失函数是否与因果效应本身对齐来划分估计量的稳定性。
Result: 逆倾向得分加权估计和回归估计是不连续的摘要，而显式后验均值和位数被证明是连续的。
Conclusion: 估计量的稳定性取决于其优化的隐式损失函数是否与因果效应本身对齐，这给出了一个决策理论视角的估计量分类。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Rejections Based on Predictive Uncertainty Enable Reliable Routine Soil Spectroscopy
papers.abstract_en: Soil properties relevant to agricultural and environmental applications are conventionally measured using elaborate laboratory methods involving physical and chemical processing. While highly accurate, these conventional methods are costly and time-consuming. In contrast, optical spectroscopy paired with machine learning enables rapid and cost-effective predictions of multiple soil properties. However, spectroscopic modelling is often considered unreliable, as the predictive accuracy varies between soil properties and individual samples. To balance this trade-off between cost and reliability, we introduce reject-to-remeasure: an AI-based measurement framework that combines probabilistic modelling with uncertainty-guided rejection. In this framework, soil samples are first analysed using spectroscopy, after which predictions are rejected if their predictive uncertainty exceeds predefined quality constraints. Rejected samples are subsequently remeasured using conventional laboratory procedures. On a regional visible-near-infrared spectral soil library from Québec, we demonstrate that reject-to-remeasure with modern foundation models (TabPFNv2.5 and TabICLv2) can facilitate the integration of optical spectroscopy into routine laboratory workflows while meeting user-defined accuracy requirements and reducing measurement costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对传统土壤测量成本高、耗时，而光谱学预测不可靠的问题，提出“拒绝-重测”（reject-to-remeasure）框架：先用光谱学预测，当预测不确定性超过阈值时拒绝预测并改用传统实验室方法。在魁北克区域可见-近红外光谱土壤库上，使用 TabPFNv2.5 和 TabICLv2 等基础模型，证明该方法可在满足用户定义精度要求的同时降低测量成本。
Motivation: 传统土壤测量准确但昂贵耗时，光学光谱学快速但预测准确性因土壤性质和样本而异，缺乏可靠性。
Method: 提出基于预测不确定性的拒绝-重测框架，结合概率建模与不确定性指导的拒绝策略，只有不确定性低的预测被接受，否则进行传统测量。
Result: 在魁北克区域可见-近红外光谱土壤库上，该方法能够集成光谱学到常规实验室流程，满足用户定义的精度要求并降低测量成本。
Conclusion: 该方法平衡了成本与可靠性，使光谱学可用于常规土壤测量。

papers.title: Anatomically Consistent TMJ Disc Segmentation via Semantic Anchoring and Clinical Priors
papers.abstract_en: Segmenting the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) disc from MRI is essential for accurate diagnosis of internal derangement, yet it remains unreliable in practice due to its small size, low contrast, and morphological variability. Existing methods, primarily adapted from general segmentation architectures, often produce fragmented or anatomically inconsistent masks, leading to unstable measurements of disc position and shape for downstream diagnosis. To address these challenges, we propose TISC, a TMJ disc segmentation framework that integrates semantic anchoring with clinical metadata-guided boundary refinement. The framework first establishes robust disc localization in the foundation model feature space via a Prototypical Semantic Anchoring (PSA) module that aggregates adjacent-slice MedDINOv3 features and derives a prototype-driven similarity map. It then performs targeted boundary refinement through a Clinical-Metadata Point Refinement (C-MPR) module, with point-wise predictions modulated by Mouth Open Limitation (MOL), a clinical indicator associated with disc displacement without reduction. On a large-scale cohort of 2,488 PD MRI volumes from 1,300 patients, our method achieves up to a 4.96 Dice improvement over strong baselines across diverse architectures, delivering more anatomically coherent and clinically reliable TMJ disc segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TISC 框架，通过语义锚定（PSA）和临床元数据边界细化（C-MPR）实现 MRI 中颞下颌关节盘的分割。在 2,488 例 PD MRI 数据集上，Dice 比强基线提升 4.96。
Motivation: 现有方法分割小尺寸、低对比度的 TMJ 盘常产生碎片化或不一致的掩膜，影响下游诊断。
Method: 使用原型语义锚定模块聚合相邻切片 MedDINOv3 特征并导出相似图，再通过临床元数据点细化模块（结合口开放受限指标）进行边界细化。
Result: 在 1,300 名患者的 2,488 例 MRI 上，Dice 最多提升 4.96，分割结果解剖一致性和临床可靠性更好。
Conclusion: 方法提供了解剖一致且临床可靠的 TMJ 盘分割，可用于内部紊乱诊断。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HERO: Hypothesis-Driven Evidence Retrieval from Omics for Multi-Task Breast Cancer Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Matched multi-omics can improve WSI-based biomarker and prognosis prediction, but most existing pipelines use omics as a paral lel feature stream or textual context rather than as an explicit retrieval constraint. HERO asks whether observed omics can be a testable mor phology hypothesis: a sparse pathway-to-morphology prior maps DNA methylation and miRNA into a K-dimensional intent vector m (K=16), TF-IDF retrieval over structured 10 captions selects endpoint-relevant regions, and a cosine gate c=cos(m,v) triggers deterministic deficit driven repair when c<τc. This closed-loop design bounds VLM calls, reduces reliance on embedding-based semantic matching, and makes every retrieval and verification step lexically auditable. On TCGA-BRCA (930WSIs, patient-level 5-fold CV), HERO sets new state-of-the-art across ER, PR, HER2, subtype, and risk prediction, outperforming both multimodal fusion and VLM-based baselines.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, Early accepted at MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HERO提出了一种假设驱动的证据检索方法，用于多任务乳腺癌分析。它利用多组学数据作为形态学假设，通过稀疏通路到形态学先验、TF-IDF检索和余弦门控机制，在TCGA-BRCA数据集上实现了ER、PR、HER2、亚型和风险预测的最新结果。
Motivation: 现有方法将多组学作为并行的特征流或文本上下文，而不是显式的检索约束，导致WSI分析不充分。HERO旨在利用组学作为可检验的形态学假设，提高预测性能。
Method: HERO方法包括：从DNA甲基化和miRNA生成K维意图向量m（K=16），通过TF-IDF检索结构化标注来选择与端点相关的区域，并使用余弦门c=cos(m,v)在c<τc时触发确定性修复。这减少了VLM调用并确保了可审计性。
Result: 在TCGA-BRCA（930张WSI，患者级5折交叉验证）上，HERO在ER、PR、HER2、亚型和风险预测上达到了新的最优，优于多模态融合和VLM基线。
Conclusion: HERO展示了将组学数据作为可测试假设的有效性，其闭环设计提供了可审计性和效率。

papers.title: Inverting the Bellman Equation: From $Q$-Values to World Models
papers.abstract_en: Model-based and model-free reinforcement learning are traditionally viewed as separate paradigms: instead of learning a model of the transition kernel $P$, model-free agents typically estimate value functions tied to a specific policy and reward. In this paper, we challenge this dichotomy by proving that value-based agents trained on a sufficiently rich set of reward functions, e.g. using goal-conditioned RL, implicitly encode a unique and accurate world model. To extract this model in practice, we introduce \textit{$P$-learning}, an inverse analogue to $Q$-learning that samples from an agent's $Q$-values, policies and rewards to decode its internal model of the environment. We then provide sufficient conditions on the type and number of goals for which agents encode the true kernel $P$, covering both stochastic and deterministic MDPs over finite or continuous state spaces. Even when our assumptions are violated, we empirically demonstrate that agents trained on a handful of reward functions encode accurate dynamics in $\texttt{Reacher}$, $\texttt{MountainCar}$ and stochastic variants of $\texttt{FourRooms}$. Surprisingly, we find that policies trained exclusively on a \texttt{Reacher} agent's implicit world model are quasi-optimal on out-of-distribution, velocity-based goals despite position-only training -- suggesting that agents contain hidden generalisation capabilities and providing a new lens into the connection between model-based, model-free, and goal-conditioned RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明基于价值的强化学习智能体在足够丰富的奖励函数上训练时（如目标条件RL）会隐式编码唯一且准确的世界模型。提出P-learning方法，通过从Q值、策略和奖励中采样来解码内部环境模型，并给出充足条件保证智能体编码真实转移核P。实验表明即使在假设违反情况下，模型在Reacher、MountainCar等环境中仍能准确学习动力学，且利用隐含模型训练的策略在分布外目标上表现准最优。
Motivation: 传统上基于模型和无模型RL被视为不同范式；本文试图挑战这一二分法，证明价值函数可以隐式包含世界模型，从而建立两者联系。
Method: 提出P-learning（逆Q-learning），从智能体的Q值、策略和奖励中采样以解码其内部环境模型；同时给出关于目标类型和数量的充分条件，确保智能体编码真实转移核P。
Result: 在Reacher、MountainCar和随机变体FourRooms中，智能体编码准确动力学；仅用位置训练隐含模型后，在速度目标的OOD上也能取得准最优策略，揭示隐藏泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调智能体隐含的泛化能力，为基于模型、无模型和目标条件RL之间的联系提供新视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BadDreamer: Transferable Backdoor Attacks against Video World Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Video world models are increasingly used in autonomous driving to forecast future scene evolution and provide future-aware spatio-temporal representations for downstream action prediction. In perception-to-action pipelines, these representations can directly influence ego-vehicle waypoint planning, making the learned future dynamics a critical security-sensitive component. Despite their promise, the training-time security risks of autonomous-driving video world models remain largely unexplored. We present BadDreamer, a transferable spatio-temporal backdoor attack that targets the perception side of this pipeline. Unlike conventional backdoors that manipulate image labels, prompt outputs, or action supervision, BadDreamer poisons the learned transition dynamics of a video world model. It constructs trigger-erasure sequences in which an oncoming yellow delivery rider is visible in the observed context frames but erased from the future frames. After fine-tuning on a small fraction of such sequences, the compromised world model learns a hidden conditional association: when the physical trigger appears, it hallucinates a future where the rider disappears and the road appears clear. We further show that this corrupted future-aware representation can transfer to the downstream action module without directly modifying ego-trajectory labels, inducing unsafe non-evasive waypoint predictions. Our experiments instantiate this attack on a representative open-source perception-to-action pipeline, revealing a representation-level safety risk in autonomous-driving video world models and highlighting the need for backdoor-aware validation beyond clean generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BadDreamer，一种针对自动驾驶视频世界模型（video world model）的可迁移时空后门攻击。与传统后门攻击不同，BadDreamer通过投毒模型的过渡动力学（transition dynamics），构造触发-擦除序列（trigger-erasure sequences），使模型在物理触发（黄色外卖骑手）出现时，幻觉出未来道路清空，该攻击可迁移至下游动作模块，导致不安全的路点规划。实验在代表性开源感知-动作流水线上验证了该表示层安全风险。
Motivation: 自动驾驶视频世界模型在感知到动作流水线中提供未来感知的时空表示，但其训练时的安全性风险尚未被探索。现有后门攻击多针对图像标签、提示输出或动作监督，未考虑对世界模型动力学本身的投毒。
Method: 提出BadDreamer，通过构造少量触发-擦除序列（可见黄色外卖骑手但未来帧中擦除）微调世界模型，使模型习得隐藏条件关联：当触发出现时，幻觉出道路清空的未来。攻击不需要修改下游轨迹标签，即可将腐败的表示传递至动作模块。
Result: 在代表性开源感知-动作流水线上成功实例化该攻击，揭示了视频世界模型在表示层面的安全漏洞，表明需要超越生成质量的基于后门的验证。
Conclusion: 该工作揭示了自动驾驶视频世界模型训练时的安全风险，强调了对此类模型进行后门感知验证的必要性。

papers.title: An Exploratory Case Study of LLM-Assisted Refactoring and Gameplay Feature Generation in an Endless Runner Game
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support software development, but their practical usefulness in applied game-development settings remains underexplored, especially when generated code must be integrated into an existing game software system. This paper presents an exploratory empirical case study of GPT-4o in a custom Python/Pygame endless runner. The study examines six selected development tasks: three localized refactoring tasks and three tasks involving gameplay feature generation. The resulting implementations were evaluated using software metrics, unit tests, and manual gameplay assessments. In this case study, all three selected refactoring tasks were completed successfully in functional terms, whereas only one of the three selected gameplay feature generation tasks resulted in a correctly integrated feature. The findings suggest that, in this setting, GPT-4o handled localized transformations more reliably than tasks requiring new gameplay interactions across multiple existing systems. Given the exploratory single-case design, these results are best interpreted as indicative observations rather than as generalizable evidence of category-level model performance. Overall, the paper contributes a transparent case-based account of the opportunities and limitations of LLM-assisted refactoring and gameplay feature generation in an existing game software system.

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM在游戏开发中的实用性进行探索性案例研究，在自定义Python/Pygame无尽跑酷游戏中测试GPT-4o的六项开发任务（三项局部重构、三项玩法功能生成）。实验发现所有重构任务功能成功，但仅一项功能生成任务正确集成。结果表明GPT-4o在处理局部变换时比处理需要跨多个现有系统的新游戏交互更可靠。
Motivation: LLM在软件开发中的应用日益广泛，但在实际游戏开发场景中的实用性，特别是将生成代码集成到现有游戏系统时的挑战，尚未得到充分探索。
Method: 在自定义Python/Pygame无尽跑酷游戏中，使用GPT-4o执行三项局部重构任务和三项玩法功能生成任务，通过软件度量、单元测试和人工游戏评估对实现进行评价。
Result: 三项重构任务均功能成功完成，而三项玩法功能生成任务中只有一项实现了正确集成。

papers.title: Trip+: Benchmarking Agents in Personalized Interactive Travel Planning
papers.abstract_en: Interactive travel planning has become a popular use case for language models. Agents are deployed to manage evolving preferences and unexpected disruptions over multiple turns. Such settings require models to make complex, profile-conditioned planning decisions. However, existing benchmarks often evaluate feasibility, personalization, or interaction in relatively isolated settings. We therefore introduce Trip+ to measure the ability of agents to plan travel holistically. In Trip+, given traveler profiles and dynamic interactions, agents must generate and revise minute-level itineraries. End-to-end traveler experiences are evaluated via an LLM-based simulator, enabling the assessment of subjective metrics like fatigue. Our scenarios range from simple request resolutions to complex environment-driven replanning. We evaluate 18 LMs and find a consistent gap in experiential quality. Models favor technically feasible but exhausting itineraries that diverge sharply from profiled traveler preferences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Trip+，一个用于评估语言模型智能体在个性化交互式旅行规划中的能力的基准。该基准要求智能体根据用户画像和动态交互生成并修改分钟级别的行程，并通过基于 LLM 的模拟器评估体验质量。评估了18个语言模型，发现模型倾向于生成技术上可行但令人疲惫的行程，与用户画像偏好差异较大。
Motivation: 现有的旅行规划基准往往孤立地评估可行性、个性化或交互性，缺乏对整体体验的综合评估。
Method: Trip+ 基准包括旅行者画像和动态交互场景，要求智能体生成并修订分钟级行程，并使用 LLM 模拟器评估主观指标（如疲劳度）。
Result: 在18个语言模型上的评估发现，模型在体验质量上存在一致差距，倾向于生成技术上可行但令人疲惫的行程。
Conclusion: 当前语言模型在个性化交互式旅行规划中仍存在不足，需要改进以更好地匹配用户偏好。

papers.title: OmniV2X: A Generative Foundation Planner for Efficient End-to-End Cooperative Driving
papers.abstract_en: We present OmniV2X, a generative foundation model for vehicle-to-everything (V2X) cooperative driving. The model directly interprets independent context sequences comprising multi-modal and multi-agent observations. The new design mitigates the computational cost of dense 3D perception, the vulnerability to data scarcity in cooperative scenarios, and the poor compliance with standardized messaging in existing methods that fuse multi-modal inputs into a shared representation. For training, we present an end-to-end supervised pipeline using a downstream trajectory generation loss, in which a high-capacity generative sequence planner implicitly learns to steer the model and leverage multi-modal inputs via cross-attention injection. As a foundation model, we demonstrate that OmniV2X pre-trained on large-scale single-agent planning datasets can efficiently adapt to cooperative environments by integrating the conditioning context with lightweight, standard-compliant V2X tokens. Evaluated on the DAIR-V2X-Seq dataset, OmniV2X outperforms existing end-to-end cooperative driving baselines, achieving state-of-the-art performance with less than 10% of the fine-tune V2X dataset and less than 1% of the communication bandwidth. We conduct comprehensive evaluations to demonstrate its computational efficiency and robustness under real-world constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniV2X，一个用于V2X协同驾驶的生成式基础模型，直接处理多模态多智能体上下文序列，通过端到端监督训练和下游轨迹生成损失。该模型预训练于大规模单智能体规划数据集，可高效适应协同环境，在DAIR-V2X-Seq数据集上以不到10%的微调数据和不到1%的通信带宽取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有方法融合多模态输入到共享表示时面临密集3D感知计算成本高、协同场景数据稀缺、以及难以遵循标准化消息等挑战。
Method: 提出生成式基础规划器OmniV2X，采用端到端监督学习，使用下游轨迹生成损失训练；通过交叉注意力注入隐式利用多模态输入；预训练后通过轻量级标准兼容V2X token适应协同环境。
Result: 在DAIR-V2X-Seq数据集上，OmniV2X以少于10%的微调数据和少于1%的通信带宽，优于现有端到端协同驾驶基线，达到最先进性能，并展示了计算效率和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调其作为基础模型在数据效率和带宽效率方面的优势，以及在实际约束下的计算效率和鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0
