papers.title: ITNet: A Learnable Integral Transform That Subsumes Convolution, Attention, and Recurrence
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional networks, recurrent networks, and transformers each encode different inductive biases -- locality, sequential memory, and content-dependent pairwise interaction -- and have remained mathematically distinct since their inception. We show that this fragmentation reflects not a fundamental diversity in how signals should be processed, but rather incomplete views of a single underlying mathematical object: a learnable integral transform. We introduce the Integral Transform Network (ITNet), a unified architecture built around a learnable kernel that depends jointly on positions and features. This kernel is implemented as a small neural network, specifically an MLP, that models pairwise interactions, enabling the model to adapt its behavior from data. We show that convolution, self-attention (including multi-head), and autoregressive recurrence (including LSTM, GRU, S4, and Mamba) arise as special cases under appropriate parameterizations, and that ITNet is a universal approximator of continuous operators. To make this practical, we develop tiled kernel fusion, importance-weighted Monte Carlo integration, and learned low-rank factorization, enabling efficient and scalable computation. A single ITNet architecture with a shared operator and lightweight modality-specific encoders matches or exceeds specialized baselines on ImageNet-1K , GLUE, ModelNet40, VQA\,v2 and NLVR2. The results demonstrate that a single learned interaction mechanism can recover the behavior of all three architectural families from data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出积分变换网络（ITNet），一种可学习的积分变换架构，其核函数依赖于位置和特征，能统一卷积、注意力（包括多头）和自回归递归（LSTM、GRU、S4、Mamba等）作为特例。ITNet通过平铺核融合、重要性加权蒙特卡罗积分和低秩分解实现高效计算，在ImageNet-1K、GLUE、ModelNet40、VQA v2和NLVR2上匹配或超越专门基线。
Motivation: 现有的卷积网络、循环网络和Transformer具有不同的归纳偏置，但作者认为这种分裂并非信号处理方式的根本差异，而是对同一数学对象（可学习积分变换）的不完整视图。
Method: ITNet围绕一个可学习的核函数构建，该核函数由一个小型MLP实现，建模成对交互。通过平铺核融合、重要性加权蒙特卡罗积分和低秩分解实现高效计算。
Result: 单个ITNet架构在ImageNet-1K、GLUE、ModelNet40、VQA v2和NLVR2上匹配或超越专门基线。
Conclusion: 结果表明，单一可学习的交互机制可以从数据中恢复所有三种架构家族的行为。

papers.title: The More the Merrier: Combining Properties for ABox Abduction under Repair Semantics in ELbot
papers.abstract_en: Abduction is a central approach to explain missing entailments from a knowledge base by providing a hypothesis, that would, if added to the knowledge base, make the missing entailment become true. Abduction under repair semantics has recently been investigated in detail, where several desirable properties and optimality criteria were considered, such as signature-restrictions and minimality in size and of introduced conflicts. Naturally, hypotheses that satisfy more than one of these properties or combine a property with an optimality criterion would be even more desirable for applications. So far, such hypotheses have not been investigated in the literature. In the present paper, we consider the ABox abduction problem for hypotheses satisfying more than one property or additional optimality criteria, for EL_bot under brave and AR semantics. Our main observation is that often requiring additional properties for hypotheses does not lead to an increase of complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究EL_bot逻辑中ABox溯因问题，考虑假设同时满足多个性质（如签名限制、大小最小性、引入冲突最小性）或附加最优准则的情况。主要发现是要求额外性质通常不会增加计算复杂度。
Motivation: 现有修复语义下的溯因工作只考虑单个性质，但实际应用中需要假设同时满足多个理想性质。本文填补了这一空白。
Method: 针对EL_bot逻辑，在勇敢（brave）和AR（AR）语义下，形式化定义并分析同时满足多个性质或最优准则的假设的复杂度。通过归约到已有问题的复杂度证明，得出主要复杂度不变结论。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但表明要求额外性质通常不增加复杂度。
Conclusion: 作者强调，在EL_bot下，组合多个性质进行溯因在复杂度上是可行的，为实际应用提供了理论依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Seeing Before Reasoning: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Shortcut-Resilient Multimodal On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a model on its own rollouts and uses a frozen copy to provide dense token-level targets conditioned on a reference target. This works well for LLM reasoning, but a direct extension to multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can create a shortcut: the privileged target may guide tokens mainly based on the text reference target rather than the image. We propose ViGOS, a visually grounded OPSD framework for MLLM post-training. The student first writes a visual description and then reasons toward the final answer. For valid rollouts, an image-only perception teacher supervises the description, while a privileged reasoning teacher supervises the reasoning and final answer on the same student prefix. A reference teacher is used only for invalid rollouts to recover the output format. Across general vision-language, expert reasoning, visual math, spatial grounding, and visual-language-prior benchmarks, ViGOS keeps the main benefits of OPSD and improves image-grounded behavior in shortcut-prone settings.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables; Project page: https://oedosoldier.github.io/ViGOS/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ViGOS，一种视觉接地（visually grounded）的在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）框架，用于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的后训练。学生模型先写视觉描述，再推理答案；对于有效轨迹，利用纯图像感知教师监督描述，特权推理教师监督推理和答案。研究发现，直接扩展OPSD到MLLM可能导致捷径：模型依赖文本参考而非图像。ViGOS在多个基准上保持OPSD优势，并在易受捷径影响的设置中改善基于图像的行为。
Motivation: 直接将文本领域的在线策略自蒸馏扩展到多模态大语言模型时，存在捷径问题：特权目标可能主要基于文本参考目标引导令牌，而非图像，导致模型忽视视觉信息。
Method: 提出ViGOS框架：学生模型首先生成视觉描述，然后推理得到最终答案。对有效轨迹，使用一个仅看图像的感知教师（image-only perception teacher）监督描述部分，使用一个特权推理教师（privileged reasoning teacher）监督推理和答案，两者基于相同的学生前缀。对无效轨迹，使用参考教师（reference teacher）恢复输出格式。
Result: 在通用视觉-语言、专家推理、视觉数学、空间接地和视觉-语言-先验基准上，ViGOS保持了OPSD的主要优势，并在易受捷径影响的设置中改善了基于图像的行为。
Conclusion: 论文强调通过解耦感知和推理，可以增强多模态模型对视觉信息的依赖，避免文本捷径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Balanced Twins: Causal Inference on Time Series with Hidden Confounding
papers.abstract_en: Accurately estimating treatment effects in time series is essential for evaluating interventions in real-world applications, especially when treatment assignment is biased by unobserved factors. In many practical settings, interventions are adopted at different times across individuals, leading to staggered treatment exposure and heterogeneous pre-treatment histories. In such cases, aggregating outcome trajectories across treated units is ill-defined, making individual treatment effect (ITE) estimation a prerequisite for reliable causal inference. We therefore study the problem of estimating the average treatment effect for the treated (ATT) by first recovering individual-level counterfactuals. We introduce a neural framework that learns simultaneously low-dimensional latent representations of individual time series and propensity scores. These estimates are then used to approximate the individual treatment effects through a flexible matching procedure that avoids classical convexity constraints commonly used in synthetic control methods. By operating at the individual level, our approach naturally accommodates staggered interventions and improves counterfactual estimation under latent bias, without relying on explicit temporal modeling assumptions. We illustrate our approach on both real-world energy consumption data and clinical time series, including high-frequency electricity demand-response programs and semi-synthetic data for individuals in intensive care unit (ICU), where hidden confounding, staggered treatment adoption, and non-stationary dynamics are prevalent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究时间序列中因隐匿混淆导致的因果推断问题，提出一种神经框架，同时学习个体时间序列的低维潜在表示和倾向得分，通过灵活匹配恢复个体反事实，从而估计平均处理效应（ATT）。方法适用于交错干预，无需显式时间建模假设。在能源消耗数据和ICU临床时间序列上展示了效果。
Motivation: 现有时间序列因果推断方法在处理隐匿混淆和交错干预时存在局限，聚合结果轨迹难以定义，需要个体处理效应（ITE）估计。
Method: 提出神经框架，联合学习个体时间序列的低维潜在表示和倾向得分，然后基于这些估计通过灵活匹配（避免合成控制中的凸性约束）近似个体处理效应，最后汇总得到ATT。
Result: 在真实能源数据和半合成ICU数据上验证了方法在隐匿混淆、交错干预和非平稳动态下的有效性。
Conclusion: 个体级别操作自然适应交错干预，提高了隐匿偏差下的反事实估计，无需显式时间建模假设。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RouteJudge: An Open Platform for Reproducible and Preference-Aware LLM Routing
papers.abstract_en: We present RouteJudge, an online pairwise preference evaluation framework for LLM routing systems, with a public platform available at https://routejudge.cn. Different from model-level response evaluation, RouteJudge focuses on router-level decision quality. For each user query, multiple routing strategies independently recommend candidate models under the same model pool and budget constraints. The selected model responses are then presented to users through anonymous pairwise comparisons, and the resulting user preferences are attributed back to the routing strategies behind the compared responses. Each evaluation record stores the query, routing decisions, model responses, preference labels, cost, latency, and task metadata, enabling preference-aware, cost-aware, and task-conditioned analysis of LLM routers. To support the continuous expansion of routing methods in RouteJudge, we further release ORBIT (Optimal Routing and Budgeted Inference Toolbox), a modular and extensible toolbox that standardizes the end-to-end workflow of LLM routing. ORBIT provides unified interfaces for benchmark loading, query representation, router implementation, budget-aware evaluation, and method comparison, allowing researchers to develop and evaluate routing algorithms under consistent protocols. It also serves as the submission and integration layer for RouteJudge: researchers can implement routing methods within ORBIT, validate them on existing routing benchmarks, and submit compatible routers for online preference-based evaluation. The code of ORBIT is available at https://github.com/LAMDA-Model-Reuse/ORBIT.
papers.comment: Accepted by Pluralistic Alignment Workshop at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RouteJudge是一个在线成对偏好评估框架，用于评估LLM路由系统的决策质量。它支持在统一模型池和预算约束下，通过匿名比较用户查询的模型响应来评估不同路由策略，并记录成本、延迟等元数据。同时发布了ORBIT工具箱，标准化LLM路由的端到端工作流程。
Motivation: 现有LLM路由评估主要关注模型级响应质量，缺乏对路由策略本身决策质量的系统评估，且缺乏可重复的偏好感知基准。
Method: 提出RouteJudge平台，通过在线成对偏好比较将用户偏好归因于路由策略；并发布ORBIT工具箱，提供统一接口支持路由方法开发、预算感知评估和标准化实验。
Result: 摘要未报告具体定量结果，主要描述平台和工具箱的设计与功能。
Conclusion: RouteJudge和ORBIT为LLM路由研究提供了可重复的评估平台和标准化开发工具，支持偏好感知、成本感知和任务条件分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PACT: Preserving Anchored Cores in Task-vectors for Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: Model merging has emerged as a training-free alternative to multi-task learning, aiming to combine multiple task-specific fine-tuned models into a single multi-task model. Most existing model merging approaches follow the Task Arithmetic paradigm, which decomposes fine-tuned weights into pre-trained parameters and task vectors, and performs merging exclusively in the task-vector space. The effectiveness of this paradigm implicitly relies on the assumption that task-specific knowledge is encoded solely within task vectors. We argue that this assumption generally does not hold due to the intrinsic task preferences of pre-trained models. Specifically, we identify \textbf{Load-Bearing Wall (LBW) dimensions}, namely some task-critical knowledge that remains embedded in the pre-trained weights rather than being fully transferred into task vectors. We characterize LBW dimensions from both scalar-weight and subspace perspectives, thereby covering the major paradigms of existing model merging methods. Our analysis reveals that, by ignoring LBW dimensions, task-vector-based approaches fail to fully resolve task conflicts and may inadvertently damage task-specific knowledge encoded in the pre-trained model, leading to degradation. To address this issue, we propose PACT, which preserves the anchored task-specific cores (i.e., LBW dimensions) within task vectors by aligning their orthogonal complements with the subspace of the pre-trained weights. These aligned subspace components are then removed from the task vectors before applying existing model merging algorithms. Furthermore, we develop an efficient variant based on randomized SVD to improve scalability. PACT can be seamlessly integrated with existing methods. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that PACT consistently enhances mainstream model merging approaches and establishes new state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现现有模型合并方法基于任务向量（task vector）的范式隐含假设——微调后的知识只存在于任务向量中，但预训练权重中仍保留着任务关键知识（称为承重墙维度 LBW）。作者提出 PACT 方法，通过保留这些锚定的核心维度，在合并前从任务向量中移除与预训练子空间正交对齐的部分，从而避免损害预训练知识。实验表明 PACT 能一致提升主流模型合并方法并在多个基准上取得新最优结果。
Motivation: 任务向量范式假设微调后知识完全转移到任务向量中，但预训练模型本身具有固有的任务偏好，部分关键知识仍留在预训练权重中，导致现有方法无法彻底解决任务冲突并可能破坏已有知识。
Method: PACT 从标量权重和子空间两个角度刻画 LBW 维度，然后将任务向量中与预训练权重子空间正交对齐的部分移除，保留锚定的核心维度，再应用现有模型合并算法；同时提供基于随机 SVD 的高效变体。
Result: 在多个基准上，PACT 一致提升主流模型合并方法的性能，并刷新当时最优结果。
Conclusion: PACT 是一种可无缝集成到现有方法的轻量插件，其保留预训练中关键知识的设计有效缓解了任务向量范式下的知识丢失问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Vision-language models for chest radiography do not always need the image
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language models report strong chest radiograph accuracy, and this is increasingly read as evidence that they use the image. That inference is unsafe: a model exploiting finding-name priors scores like one that reads the scan, and no standard benchmark separates them. We introduce a causal audit that intervenes on the image, occluding the relevant region, occluding an irrelevant one, and swapping in another patient's same-label scan, and combines three behavioral metrics to test whether a correct answer depends on the image. Across nine systems, a text-only model with no image access reaches within 5.7 accuracy points of the best multimodal one, and a 119-billion-parameter multimodal model is statistically indistinguishable from a 7-billion text-only baseline. The audit splits the cohort into three models that ignore the image, one that is unstable, and five that use it selectively, for a subset of findings; the categories hold across a second dataset, resolution, and prompt phrasing. Against board-certified radiologists, a text-only model is statistically indistinguishable from a radiologist's accuracy while grounding at zero, whereas the image-using models ground at radiologist-comparable rates. Reported confidence flags ungrounded answers only when a model uses the image. Grounding audits, not accuracy, should gate clinical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文对胸部X光片的视觉语言模型进行因果审计，发现许多模型实际上并未利用图像，而是依赖疾病名称的先验知识。仅文本模型与最佳多模态模型的精度差距在5.7个点以内，一个1190亿参数的多模态模型与70亿参数的仅文本基线统计上无差异。审计将模型分为忽略图像、不稳定和选择性使用图像三类，且分类在不同数据集和分辨率下成立。
Motivation: 现有基准无法区分模型是否真正使用了图像，模型可能仅通过疾病名称的先验（如疾病-部位共现）取得高准确率，从而高估其临床可靠性。
Method: 引入因果审计方法，通过遮挡相关病变区域、遮挡无关区域以及交换同一标签的不同患者图像，结合三个行为指标来测试模型正确答案是否依赖于图像特征。
Result: 仅文本模型与最佳多模态模型在胸片任务上精度差仅5.7个点；119B多模态模型与7B仅文本基线统计上不可区分；9个系统中有3个完全忽略图像，1个不稳定，5个选择性使用部分发现；仅文本模型与放射科医生精度统计等价但接地率为零，而使用图像的模型接地率与放射科医生相当。
Conclusion: 仅凭准确率无法保证模型真正利用了图像，临床部署前应进行接地审计（grounding audit），而非仅依赖准确率指标。

summary_sections.method: 引入因果审计方法，通过遮挡相关病变区域、遮挡无关区域以及交换同一标签的不同患者图像，结合三个行为指标来测试模型正确答案是否依赖于图像特征。
summary_sections.result: 仅文本模型与最佳多模态模型在胸片任务上精度差仅5.7个点；119B多模态模型与7B仅文本基线统计上不可区分；9个系统中有3个完全忽略图像，1个不稳定，5个选择性使用部分发现；仅文本模型与放射科医生精度统计等价但接地率为零，而使用图像的模型接地率与放射科医生相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: 仅凭准确率无法保证模型真正利用了图像，临床部署前应进行接地审计（grounding audit），而非仅依赖准确率指标。

papers.title: Demystifying Training-Time Augmentation for Data-Constrained Language Model Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: As AI labs approach a data ceiling where compute capacity outpaces the rate of new high-quality text generation, language model pretraining is shifting toward a data-constrained, compute-abundant regime that demands productive multi-epoch training on fixed corpora. Standard autoregressive (AR) pretraining overfits severely in this setting, reaching its optimum early and then continuously deteriorating. We investigate training-time data augmentation as a regularizer to mitigate this overfitting and enable productive training for hundreds of epochs on the same data. We introduce three orthogonal categories of augmentation for AR pretraining: token-level noise (masking, random replacement), sequence permutations (right-to-left prediction, Fill-in-the-Middle), and target offset prediction ($x_{t+i}$ for $i > 1$). Through systematic ablations, we find that individual augmentations delay overfitting and lower validation loss relative to the baseline, with random token replacement achieving the best minimum loss among individual methods. Combining augmentation categories further lowers the minimum validation loss. Our experiments demonstrate that data augmentations mitigate AR pretraining's data inefficiency and offer a promising solution to the data-constrained regime~\footnote{All code and data are available at https://github.com/ michaelchen-lab/ data-augmentations-for-pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究数据增强方法如何缓解数据受限下自回归语言模型预训练的多轮过拟合问题，通过引入三类正交增强（词级噪声、序列置换、目标偏移），发现随机替换词在单独使用中最佳，组合增强进一步降低验证损失。
Motivation: 计算能力超过高质量文本生成速率导致数据受限，标准自回归预训练在固定语料上多轮训练会严重过拟合，需要有效正则化策略。
Method: 提出三类训练时数据增强：词级噪声（掩码、随机替换）、序列置换（从右到左预测、Fill-in-the-Middle）、目标偏移预测（预测未来第i个词），并进行系统消融实验。
Result: 单个增强方法均能延缓过拟合并降低验证损失，随机替换效果最好；组合多种增强类别可进一步降低最低验证损失。
Conclusion: 数据增强是缓解自回归预训练数据效率低下的有效方法，为数据受限训练提供可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Know Your Limits : On the Faithfulness of LLMs as Solvers and Autoformalizers in Legal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on reasoning tasks, but whether this reflects faithful logical inference or heuristic approximation remains unclear. We study this question in legal entailment by comparing three paradigms, including pure LLM classification, LLM-based Formal Reasoning, and solver-based Formal Reasoning using the Z3 SMT solver, on a re-annotated subset of ContractNLI across five LLMs. Our re-annotation reveals a systematic and measurable gap between pragmatic legal interpretation and strict formal entailment, where a substantial proportion of legally sound inferences are not formally grounded without additional unstated assumptions. While introducing formal structure improves accuracy, with LLM-based Formal Reasoning achieving the highest benchmark performance, we show that this gain does not imply faithful reasoning. We identify three recurring failure modes: scope laundering, where LLMs report solver-inconsistent classifications without executing the underlying formal reasoning, producing conclusions that appear logically grounded but are not; implicit constraint blindness, where LLMs overlook logical constraints present in formal representations; and program synthesis failures, where LLMs generate incorrect Z3 code despite structured prompting. Critically, scope laundering persists across all models, raising serious concerns about the faithfulness of LLM-based formal reasoning as a proxy for symbolic execution. These results reveal a fundamental gap between benchmark accuracy and logical faithfulness.
papers.comment: 10 pages, submitted to COLM 2026 (under review, average score of 6.25 across 4 reviewers) and accepted by the AI4Law and AI4Math workshops at ICML. This is the version where we already addressed most of the reviews from the COLM & AI4Law & AI4Math reviewers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）在法律蕴含任务中的忠实性，比较了纯LLM分类、基于LLM的形式推理和基于Z3 SMT求解器的形式推理三种范式。在重新注释的ContractNLI子集上，发现大量法律上合理的推理缺乏严格的形式基础。引入形式结构虽提高了准确率，但LLM基于形式推理的增益并不代表忠实推理，存在范围清洗、隐式约束盲视和程序合成失败等故障模式。
Motivation: LLM在推理任务上表现强劲，但其成功是否源于忠实逻辑推理还是启发式近似尚不清楚。
Method: 在重新注释的ContractNLI子集上，使用五种LLM比较三种范式：纯LLM分类、LLM基于形式推理（生成Z3代码并使用求解器验证）、求解器直接形式推理。并识别了三种故障模式。
Result: LLM基于形式推理达到最高基准性能，但存在范围清洗（报告与求解器不一致的分类而不执行形式推理）、隐式约束盲视和程序合成失败等故障，且范围清洗在所有模型中持续存在。
Conclusion: 基准准确率与逻辑忠实性之间存在根本差距，基于LLM的形式推理不能作为符号执行的忠实代理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RetailBench: Benchmarking long horizon reasoning and coherent decision making of LLM agents in realistic retail environments
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents have made rapid progress on short-horizon, well-scoped tasks, yet their ability to sustain coherent decisions in dynamic long-horizon environments remains uncertain. We introduce RetailBench, a data-grounded simulation benchmark for evaluating tool-using LLM agents in single-store supermarket operation. RetailBench models retail management as a partially observable decision process and is designed to support thousand-day-scale simulations. In this environment, agents must manage pricing, replenishment, supplier selection, shelf assortment, inventory aging, customer feedback, external events, and cash-flow constraints. We evaluate seven contemporary LLMs under representative agent frameworks over a 180-day evaluation horizon and compare them with a privileged oracle policy. Results show substantial variation across models: only a small subset survives the full evaluation horizon, and even the strongest LLM runs remain substantially behind the oracle policy in final net worth and sales outcomes. Behavioral analysis attributes these gaps to incomplete evidence acquisition, surface-level decision making, and the lack of a consistent long-horizon policy. RetailBench provides a controlled testbed for studying reliable autonomy in economically grounded long-horizon decision-making.
papers.comment: The submission of this paper was a mistake. This is the second version of arXiv:2603.16453, so it should have replaced the original 2603 version through a replacement submission, rather than being published as a new paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RetailBench，一个基于数据的仿真基准，用于评估工具使用型 LLM 智能体在单店超市运营中的长程决策能力。该基准将零售管理建模为部分可观察决策过程，支持千天级仿真，要求智能体管理定价、补货、供应商选择、货架组合、库存老化、客户反馈、外部事件和现金流约束。在 180 天评估期内测试了七个当代 LLM 与一个特权 oracle 策略的比较，结果显示只有少数模型能完成全程，最强 LLM 的最终净资产和销售业绩仍远低于 oracle 策略。行为分析将差距归因于证据获取不完整、表面化决策以及缺乏一致的长程策略。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体在短程、范围明确的任务上进展迅速，但在动态长程环境中维持一致决策的能力尚不明确。零售管理场景提供了一个具有经济意义的长程决策测试床。
Method: 构建数据驱动的仿真环境 RetailBench，将零售运营建模为部分可观察决策过程，支持千天级仿真，包含定价、补货、供应商选择、货架组合、库存老化、客户反馈、外部事件和现金流约束等要素。评估七个当代 LLM 在 180 天内的表现，并与特权 oracle 策略对比。
Result: 只有少数 LLM 模型能完成 180 天评估期；最强 LLM 的最终净资产和销售额仍显著低于 oracle 策略。行为分析发现智能体在证据获取、决策深度和长期策略一致性方面存在不足。
Conclusion: RetailBench 为研究经济导向的长程决策中可靠自主性提供了受控测试平台，当前 LLM 在长程推理和一致决策方面仍有较大提升空间。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ClayBuddy: A Framework, Evaluation, & Mitigation of Coding Agent Failures
papers.abstract_en: Software engineering and deployment are increasingly delegated to AI coding agents. The scale of their adoption is surfacing rare, but highly destructive, failure modes. In this paper, we study these failure modes as stemming from three distinct mechanisms: underspecification, where default model behavior is unsafe; capability errors, where the safe action is available but the model does not adhere to it due to bias or capability limitations; and agent harness errors, where the model fails to execute the safe action through the harness. We assess these across 8 different evaluations, each inspired by real-life deployment failures, totaling 20 coding environments and 59 synthetic transcript templates. Based on this evaluation, we propose ClayBuddy, a harness that molds to user preferences and can be modified by the model in-session, to mitigate these errors. By adding tools for the agent to edit its own context, an extended system prompt, a customizable command classifier, and deterministic guardrails, we show that ClayBuddy is safer across a statistically significant number of samples. Thus, we suggest concrete mitigations for current coding agents and a design philosophy for future agent harness features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究AI编码代理在软件工程部署中出现的罕见但破坏性的失败模式，将其归因于未指定规范、能力错误和代理工具链错误三类机制。提出了ClayBuddy框架，通过让代理在会话中修改自身上下文、扩展系统提示、可定制命令分类器和确定性护栏来缓解这些错误，并在8个评估中展示了安全性提升。
Motivation: AI编码代理的广泛采用暴露了罕见但破坏性的失败模式，现有研究缺乏对这些失败模式的系统分类和缓解方法。
Method: 将失败模式分为三类：未指定规范（默认行为不安全）、能力错误（安全动作可用但模型因偏差或能力限制未遵守）、代理工具链错误（模型无法通过工具链执行安全动作）。提出ClayBuddy，包括允许代理编辑自身上下文的工具、扩展系统提示、可定制命令分类器和确定性护栏。
Result: 在8个不同评估（共20个编码环境和59个合成转录模板）上，ClayBuddy在统计显著样本上更安全。
Conclusion: 建议对当前编码代理的具体缓解措施和未来代理工具链特性的设计哲学。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Accuracy: Measuring Bias Acknowledgment in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Responsible AI Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning models are increasingly used in settings where the final answer is not the only object of review: educational tools may show students intermediate steps, decision-support systems may require human oversight, and audit workflows may inspect traces for misleading or biased input. In such settings, two responses can receive the same final-answer score while differing in whether the trace explicitly flags injected biasing content. Accuracy-only evaluation collapses these cases. We study this gap as a measurement blind spot for responsible evaluation and introduce a minimal trace-level diagnostic with two axes: \emph{susceptibility} (whether the bias breaks a previously correct answer) and \emph{acknowledgment} (whether the trace contains a rubric-defined surface reference to the injected content). Across thousands of biased GSM8K trials, GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet~4 have similar susceptibility rates ($1.3\%$ vs. $1.2\%$) but substantially different acknowledgment rates ($13.0\%$ vs. $75.0\%$) under the same rubric.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 Workshop on Trustworthy AI for Good
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出在需要审查中间推理步骤的场景中，仅用最终答案准确率评估推理模型会掩盖模型对注入偏误的承认差异。作者提出一个两轴诊断指标（易感性 和 承认性），并在偏置GSM8K测试上发现GPT-4o和Claude Sonnet 4的易感性相近，但承认率差异显著。
Motivation: 现有评估仅关注最终答案正确性，忽略了在推理链中模型是否明确标出偏置内容，这在教育、决策支持和审计等场景中是一个测量盲区。
Method: 提出一个基于推理链的诊断方法，包含两个维度：易感性（偏置是否导致之前正确的答案出错）和承认性（推理链中是否包含对注入内容的表面引用）。
Result: 在数千次偏置GSM8K试验中，GPT-4o和Claude Sonnet 4的易感性率分别为1.3%和1.2%，但承认率分别为13.0%和75.0%。
Conclusion: 仅依赖准确率会掩盖模型在处理偏置时的行为差异，提议在负责任AI评估中纳入推理链层面的承认性指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AutoDojo: Adaptive Black-Box Attacks Reveal the Limits of IPI Defenses and Task-Specification Effects in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Indirect prompt injection (IPI) is a major security threat to LLM-powered agents. Thus, a growing body of work have proposed a variety of defensive approaches against IPI. These can be grouped into three broad categories: 1) prompt-based (using prompting as a way to prevent agents from following malicious instructions), 2) detection-based (identifying and filtering malicious instructions), and 3) system-level (using systems insights, such as control and data isolation, for defense). However, commonly used benchmarks for evaluating defense, such as AgentDojo, are \emph{inherently static}, generating a fixed distribution of IPI attacks. Consequently, static benchmarks do not usefully evaluate defense robustness to adaptive threats. We address this issue by developing AutoDojo, an adaptive extension of AgentDojo that optimizes IPI against a given defense. Using AutoDojo against state-of-the-art IPI defenses across three task suites and five target models, we make two key observations. First, many defenses offer only limited protection: a cheap, black-box adaptive attack using a frontier LLM to iteratively optimize the injection raises attack success rate (ASR) well above the level achieved by static injections against nearly all evaluated defenses. Against a filter that reduces static ASR to 0\%, AutoDojo recovers 28\% overall and 64\% on action-open tasks. Second, for prompt-level and filter-based defenses, ASR is substantially higher on \emph{action-open} tasks -- where the user's request delegates the action itself to attacker-controlled content -- than on precisely specified tasks. This is a structural limit: on such tasks the injection can pose as ordinary data rather than an explicit instruction, bypassing defenses that rely on detecting instruction-like text. AutoDojo is publicly available at https://github.com/xhOwenMa/AutoDojo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AutoDojo，一个自适应黑盒攻击框架，用于评估LLM智能体对抗间接提示注入（IPI）防御的鲁棒性。在AgentDojo静态基准基础上，AutoDojo利用前沿LLM迭代优化注入指令，在三个任务套件和五个模型上测试发现，多数防御效果有限：即使静态攻击下成功率降至0%的防御，AutoDojo仍能恢复28%的整体攻击成功率，在action-open任务上高达64%。此外，action-open任务中攻击可伪装成普通数据，绕过基于指令检测的防御，构成结构性限制。
Motivation: 现有IPI防御评估依赖静态基准，无法反映自适应攻击下的真实鲁棒性，亟需开发适应性攻击方法以揭示防御的局限性。
Method: 开发AutoDojo框架，通过黑盒方式利用前沿LLM迭代优化注入文本，最大化攻击成功率，并针对基于提示、检测和系统级的三类防御进行自适应攻击。
Result: 在静态攻击下ASR为0%的防御上，AutoDojo恢复28%的整体ASR（action-open任务64%）；action-open任务ASR显著高于精确指定任务，表明防御存在结构性缺陷。
Conclusion: 提示级和过滤型防御对action-open任务存在结构性限制，因为攻击可以伪装成数据而非指令，绕过指令特征检测；建议未来防御需考虑此类自适应威胁。

papers.title: PrologMCP: A Standardized Prolog Tool Interface for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Frontier reasoning-tuned language models still fail on deductive tasks at depth, and the cost of improved performance through extended internal reasoning scales poorly. Symbolic delegation offers a complementary route: a language model translates the problem, while a solver performs the inference. However, current autoformalization pipelines for logic programming are typically bespoke integrations tied to particular tasks or agents. We introduce PrologMCP, a task-agnostic, open-source server that exposes Prolog as a stateful tool through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Its compact tool interface, structured error reporting, and per-session isolation make the translate-run-inspect-repair loop a reusable primitive for MCP-capable agents. We evaluate a formalizer agent enhanced with PrologMCP against standard and reasoning LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-4.1, and o4-mini) on two subsets of PARARULE-Plus: a general-purpose sample and a more challenging one targeting a specific failure mode of natural-language reasoning. On the general sample, the formalizer matches or exceeds reasoning LLMs (accuracy 1.00 vs.\ 1.00 / 0.998), with the largest gains over standard models (0.762 for GPT-4.1). On the challenging subset, the formalizer remains near-perfect (1.00 / 0.99) while reasoning LLMs drop to 0.95 / 0.94. These results suggest that delegating inference to Prolog via MCP is a robust and inspectable alternative to extended natural-language reasoning.
papers.comment: Accepted at Joint Workshop on Statistics and Knowledge Integration for Logic, Learning, Ethical Decisions, and LLMs, 18 July 2026, Lisbon v2: Added references to other Prolog MCP servers; fixed typos
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PrologMCP，一个通过模型上下文协议（MCP）将Prolog暴露为有状态工具的服务器，使LLM代理能够将推理任务委托给Prolog求解器。在PARARULE-Plus子集上，基于PrologMCP的形式化代理在准确率上匹配或超过推理型LLM（如Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-4.1、o4-mini），特别是在挑战性子集上保持近完美性能，而推理型LLM性能下降。结果表明，通过MCP将推理委托给Prolog是一种鲁棒且可检查的替代方案。
Motivation: 前沿推理型语言模型在深层演绎任务上仍然失败，且通过扩展内部推理来提升性能的成本高。符号委托提供了补充路线，但当前自动形式化管道通常是针对特定任务或代理的定制集成，缺乏通用性。
Method: 提出PrologMCP，一个任务无关的开源服务器，通过模型上下文协议（MCP）将Prolog暴露为有状态工具。提供紧凑的工具接口、结构化错误报告和每会话隔离，使“翻译-运行-检查-修复”循环成为可复用的原语。
Result: 在PARARULE-Plus通用样本上，形式化代理（使用PrologMCP）准确率达到1.00，匹配推理型LLM（1.00/0.998），但显著优于标准模型（GPT-4.1为0.762）。在挑战性子集上，形式化代理保持1.00/0.99，而推理型LLM降至0.95/0.94。
Conclusion: 通过MCP将推理委托给Prolog是鲁棒且可检查的替代方案，尤其适用于复杂演绎推理任务。

papers.title: Small LLMs: Pruning vs. Training from Scratch
papers.abstract_en: Pruning promises a shortcut to strong small language models. In this work, we examine this promise by pruning Llama-3.1-8B at pruning ratios of 0.5--0.8 with six methods spanning depth, width, and sparse granularities, under two controlled token-matched settings. (1) With the same training token budget, pruned initialization consistently outperforms random initialization. This shows that the parent model provides a strong starting point, although the advantage narrows as the training token budget grows and as the pruning ratio rises, nearly vanishing at the highest pruning ratio we study. (2) When training from scratch is instead given the full token budget consumed by the whole pipeline, pruning at finer granularities still retains an advantage, while coarser structured pruning can be matched or surpassed. This suggests that the parent model transfers knowledge that additional training tokens alone cannot fully recover, but only at fine granularity. Taken together, our results yield a clear recommendation: with a large pretrained model in hand and a limited training token budget, pruning is better than training from scratch; when the training budget is not limited, training from scratch can be competitive for coarser pruning, so a large pretrained parent is not always necessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过对比剪枝（pruning）与从头训练（training from scratch）两种方式获得小型语言模型，在受控 token 匹配设置下研究剪枝的优势。实验基于 Llama-3.1-8B，剪枝比例 0.5-0.8，覆盖深度、宽度和稀疏粒度。结果表明，在有限训练 token 预算下，剪枝初始化优于随机初始化；当预算充足时，细粒度剪枝仍保持优势，而粗粒度结构化剪枝可能被从头训练超越。
Motivation: 剪枝被认为可以快速获得强小型语言模型，但尚不清楚剪枝相对于从头训练的真正优势及其条件。
Method: 对 Llama-3.1-8B 进行六种剪枝方法（覆盖深度、宽度和稀疏粒度），剪枝比例 0.5-0.8，在两种受控 token 匹配设置下比较：1）相同训练 token 预算；2）训练从头算起使用整个流程的 token 预算。
Result: 相同 token 预算下，剪枝初始化始终优于随机初始化，但优势随 token 预算和剪枝比例增大而缩小，在高剪枝比例下几乎消失。当从头训练获得完整 token 预算时，细粒度剪枝仍保持优势，而粗粒度结构化剪枝可被匹配或超越。
Conclusion: 当手里有大预训练模型且训练 token 预算有限时，剪枝优于从头训练；当预算不受限时，对于粗粒度剪枝，从头训练可能具有竞争力，大预训练父模型并非总是必要。

papers.title: Low-variance estimators overcome the phase-gradient bottleneck in complex-valued neural quantum states
papers.abstract_en: Complex neural quantum states are difficult to optimize when their wavefunction phase carries gauge, chiral, fermionic, or topological structure. We show that the major failure mode is not only ansatz expressivity, but the Monte Carlo estimator used to learn this phase. For separated amplitude-phase states, differentiating the local energy at fixed samples gives a different unbiased estimator of the same variational Monte Carlo phase force, without changing the objective. We further extend the construction to coupled two-head networks by keeping the amplitude-gradient contribution and applying the direct derivative only to the phase path. An adaptive minimum-variance mixture interpolates between standard and direct estimators during training. Across flux ladders, chiral chains, two-dimensional flux cylinders, an interacting fermion ladder, shared-network controls, and a fractional quantum Hall benchmark, the resulting estimators reduce phase-gradient variance, suppress seed failures, and often move multi-percent standard-gradient plateaus to sub-percent accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出复杂量子神经状态优化失败的主要原因不仅是模型表达能力，还在于学习相位的蒙特卡洛估计器。作者为分离振幅-相位状态提出了直接估计器，并扩展到耦合双头网络，通过自适应最小方差混合插值训练。在多种量子系统模型上，该方法降低了相位梯度方差、抑制了种子失败，并将标准梯度平台从多百分点精度提升至亚百分位精度。
Motivation: 复杂量子神经状态在波函数携带规范、手性、费米子或拓扑结构时难以优化，现有方法受限于相位梯度估计的方差瓶颈。
Method: 对于分离振幅-相位状态，通过在固定样本下对局域能量求导，得到相同变分蒙特卡洛相位力的无偏估计器；对于耦合双头网络，保留振幅梯度贡献并对相位路径施加直接导数；训练中使用自适应最小方差混合在标准估计器与直接估计器之间插值。
Result: 在通量阶梯、手性链、二维通量柱、相互作用费米子阶梯、共享网络控制以及分数量子霍尔基准上，该方法降低了相位梯度方差，消除了种子失败，并将标准梯度平台从多百分点准确度提升至亚百分位。
Conclusion: 低方差估计器有效克服了相位梯度瓶颈，为复杂量子神经状态的训练提供了更稳健的优化方案。

papers.title: SciR: A Controllable Benchmark for Scientific Reasoning in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Three paradigmatic forms of inference recur across scientific reasoning: deduction, induction, and causal abduction. Reliably evaluating LLMs on these in scientific settings is currently out of reach: scientific benchmarks built on human annotations are costly and lack mechanistic ground truth, while synthetic logical-reasoning benchmarks do not resemble real scientific documents. We introduce SciR, a benchmark that combines multi-paradigm reasoning with controllable scientific rendering, anchored on three paradigmatic scientific problems. Tasks are generated from formal objects (deduction tree, inductive rule hypothesis, causal graph) to guarantee verifiable answers, then rendered into multi-document scientific discourse via per-track domain-tuned genres. The construction lets us independently vary two difficulty axes: how hard it is to extract the key information needed for inference, and how hard the principled inference itself is. We test six models. Both axes hurt every model, and their effects compound. The rendering even hurts neurosymbolic pipelines, which hand inference to a verified solver. The two axes yield a per-model extraction-vs-inference profile: for instance, reasoning models like deepseek-r1 mostly surpass non-reasoning instruct models on the inference axis. To our knowledge, SciR is the first multi-paradigm scientific-reasoning benchmark with parametric control on both extraction and inference difficulty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍SciR，一个可控的科学推理基准，涵盖演绎、归纳和因果溯因三种推理范式。通过从形式对象生成任务并渲染成多文档科学语篇，独立控制信息提取难度和推理难度。测试六个模型发现两个难度轴都影响性能且效应叠加。
Motivation: 现有科学推理基准依赖人工标注，成本高且缺乏机制性真值；合成逻辑推理基准不类似真实科学文档。需要可靠且可控的评估基准。
Method: 从形式对象（演绎树、归纳规则假设、因果图）生成可验证答案的任务，再通过领域调优的体裁渲染成多文档科学语篇，独立变化信息提取难度和推理难度。
Result: 测试六个模型（包括神经符号管道），两个难度轴都损害性能且效应叠加。推理模型（如deepseek-r1）在推理轴上优于非推理指令模型。
Conclusion: SciR是首个具有提取和推理难度参数化控制的多范式科学推理基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TSA: Temporal Slot Activation for Persistent Object-Centric Video Representation
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised video object-centric learning aims to decompose dynamic scenes into temporally persistent entity representations. Existing recurrent video slot-attention methods propagate a fixed set of slots across frames, but typically assume unconditional slot propagation: every slot is updated and decoded at every frame, regardless of whether its corresponding object is visible. We show that this design violates a basic lifecycle requirement for persistent slots: when an object is absent or fully occluded, its slot should preserve its previous state and avoid explaining unrelated visible content. Instead, unconditional propagation creates two failure pathways: update-induced state drift, where current-frame evidence overwrites the absent object's representation, and decoder-induced reconstruction interference, where the inactive slot remains coupled to reconstruction through decoder attention. We propose Temporal Slot Activation (TSA), a mechanism that learns a per-slot, per-frame activation score $α_{k,t} \in (0, 1)$ without visibility supervision. TSA uses this activation as a shared latent control variable for slot lifecycle modeling. When a slot is inactive, TSA anchors its state to the previous slot via activation-gated updating and suppresses its decoder participation through an activation-dependent additive bias on attention logits before softmax normalization. This jointly reduces state drift and reconstruction-driven interference. To improve decisions under partial occlusion and gradual reappearance, TSA further conditions activation prediction on a per-slot temporal memory produced by a Temporal Context Encoder. We evaluate TSA on MOVi-C/E, YT-VIS, and OVIS benchmarks using both standard and tracking-based metrics (FG-ARI, mBO, IDF1, HOTA). TSA consistently improves object decomposition and temporal identity preservation, with large gains on long, heavily occluded videos.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出时间槽激活（TSA）机制，用于无监督视频目标中心学习，通过学习每槽每帧的激活分数来控制槽的生命周期，在目标不可见时保持槽状态并抑制解码器参与，从而减少状态漂移和重建干扰。在MOVi-C/E、YT-VIS和OVIS基准上，TSA显著提升了目标分解和时域身份保持性能。
Motivation: 现有循环视频槽注意力方法无条件传播所有槽，导致当目标不存在时槽状态被覆盖并参与错误重建，违反了持久槽的生命周期需求。
Method: TSA学习一个激活分数α_{k,t}，用于门控更新和解码器注意力偏置：非激活时冻结槽状态并抑制其解码器贡献；同时使用时域上下文编码器预测激活分数，处理遮挡和逐渐重现。
Result: 在MOVi-C/E、YT-VIS和OVIS上，TSA在标准指标（FG-ARI, mBO）和跟踪指标（IDF1, HOTA）上均一致提升，尤其在长序列、严重遮挡视频上增益显著。
Conclusion: TSA通过显式建模槽激活状态，有效解决了无监督视频目标中心学习中的持久性问题，无需可见性监督。

papers.title: Beyond Spherical Harmonics: Rethinking Appearance Models for Radiance Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: View-dependent appearance modeling remains a challenging problem in novel-view synthesis and reconstruction. Accurately representing complex angular effects often requires substantial memory and computational resources. For new learning-based methods, a common approach is to rely on SH. However, capturing high-frequency phenomena such as specular reflections demands high-order expansions, which increase memory usage and computational cost. Consequently, most methods employ low-order SH, which limits the ability to model complex view-dependent effects, resulting in overly smooth or diffuse representations. To address these limitations, we systematically evaluate a wide range of spherical functions in the context of scene reconstruction. Some of them are introduced to graphics and computer vision for the first time in this paper. Based on the insights from the experiment, we develop a novel spherical formulation, the Normalized Anisotropic Spherical Gabor function that enables efficient modeling and learning of high-frequency appearance effects while maintaining compact representation. Compared to existing approaches, our function achieves higher-quality reconstruction of view-dependent phenomena such as glints, while being up to five times more memory-efficient and more efficient to evaluate. We validate its performance in radiance-field reconstruction tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了多种球面函数在场景重构中的表现，并首次将其中一些引入图形学与计算机视觉领域。基于实验洞察，提出了归一化各向异性球面Gabor函数（Normalized Anisotropic Spherical Gabor function），能够高效建模和学习高频外观效应，同时保持紧凑表示。在辐射场重建任务中，该方法在高质量重建闪烁等视角相关现象的同时，内存效率提升高达5倍，计算效率也更高。
Motivation: 现有基于球谐函数（SH）的视角依赖外观建模方法在捕捉高频率效应（如镜面反射）时需要高阶展开，导致内存与计算开销大；低阶SH则产生过平滑或漫反射表示，限制了复杂视角依赖效果的建模能力。
Method: 首先系统评估多种球面函数在场景重构中的性能，然后基于实验洞察提出归一化各向异性球面Gabor函数，该函数可在紧凑表示下高效建模和学习高频外观效应。
Result: 与现有方法相比，所提函数在重建闪烁等视角依赖现象时质量更高，同时内存效率提升高达5倍，且计算效率更优。
Conclusion: 本文提出的球面函数为辐射场重建中的视角依赖外观建模提供了一种高效且紧凑的方案，尤其适用于捕捉高频率细节。

papers.title: What the Eyes See, the LLMs Miss: Exploiting Human Perception for Adversarial Text Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-powered content moderation systems are a critical defense against harmful online content. However, they operate primarily on tokenized text and often overlook visual cues that humans naturally use when interpreting content. We show that this limitation creates a fundamental vulnerability: content readily recognized as harmful by humans can evade automated moderation. To systematically study this problem, we introduce Human-Perceptible Adversarial Attacks (HPAA), which embed harmful expressions into otherwise benign text using visually salient typographic manipulations. HPAA strategically combines features such as spacing, emphasis, and spatial arrangement to preserve human recognition while reducing machine detectability. Operating in a black-box setting with a small query budget, the attack automatically generates evasive content without model access or gradient information. We evaluate HPAA on multiple datasets and thirteen widely deployed moderation systems, including commercial APIs and state-of-the-art open-source guardrails. With only three detector queries, generated attacks achieve over 86\% human recognition while keeping detection rates below 1\% across evaluated systems. We further identify the typographic factors driving successful evasion, analyze why current moderation architectures fail to capture these signals, and discuss practical defenses. Our findings reveal a fundamental blind spot in current LLM-based moderation systems and motivate moderation approaches that better align with human perceptual understanding.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted for publication at USENIX Security 2026. This paper includes examples of harmful, hateful, or abusive language for research purposes. Reader discretion is advised
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示基于大语言模型（LLM）的内容审核系统忽略了人类自然使用的视觉排版线索，导致其易于被对抗性攻击绕过。作者提出人类可感知的对抗攻击（HPAA），通过排版操作（如间距、强调、空间排列）将有害内容嵌入看似正常的文本中，在仅需3次检测器查询的黑盒设置下，攻击使人类识别率超过86%，而检测率低于1%。研究指出当前LLM审核架构的盲点，并讨论防御措施。
Motivation: 现有LLM内容审核系统主要基于分词后的文本，忽视了人类自然依赖的视觉排版线索，这构成根本性漏洞：人类易识别的有害内容可轻易绕过自动审核。
Method: 提出HPAA（Human-Perceptible Adversarial Attacks），通过结合间距、强调、空间排列等排版特征，在保持人类可读性的同时降低机器检测能力。攻击在仅需少量查询（3次）的黑盒设置下自动生成，无需模型访问或梯度信息。
Result: 在多个数据集和13个广泛部署的审核系统（包括商业API和开源护栏）上，HPAA使人类识别率超过86%，而检测率低于1%。识别了推动成功规避的排版因素，并分析了当前审核架构为何失效。
Conclusion: 本文揭示LLM审核系统的一个根本盲点，即缺乏对人类视觉感知的模拟，并呼吁开发更符合人类感知的审核方法。由于攻击依赖特定排版操作，实际部署中的防御仍需探索。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Anything2Skill: Compiling External Knowledge into Reusable Skills for Agents
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables agents to access external knowledge at inference time, but it primarily retrieves fragmented declarative evidence, leaving agents to repeatedly infer task procedures from passages, manuals, examples, logs, or trajectories. This raises a fundamental question: can skills extracted from external knowledge bases be installed into an agent, enabling it to rapidly approximate domain expertise? In this paper, we propose Anything2Skill, a taxonomy-guided framework that compiles heterogeneous external knowledge into reusable, retrievable, and executable skills for agents. Given a corpus of knowledge records, \textsc{Anything2Skill} first decomposes each record into evidence windows and performs plan-and-expand skill extraction under a skill-tree prior. The extracted candidates are then converted into structured skill contracts that specify invocation conditions, contraindications, action moves, workflow steps, constraints, output specifications, supporting evidence, and confidence scores. To construct a deployable procedural memory, Anything2Skill manages the extracted skills in a persistent SkillBank through taxonomy-aware compilation, registry-level reconciliation, lifecycle tracking, versioned updates, and visible skill-tree projection. At inference time, agents retrieve both task-specific passages from the original knowledge base and relevant procedural skills from the SkillBank, allowing RAG to provide declarative evidence while compiled skills provide reusable procedural guidance. Experiments on qsv and GitHub-CLI show that Anything2Skill combined with RAG achieves 98.85\% and 94.10\% success rates, respectively, substantially outperforming RAG-only agents. These results suggest that compiling latent procedural knowledge into explicit skills is an effective way to extend retrieval-augmented agents from knowledge access toward capability reuse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Anything2Skill，一个将异构外部知识（如手册、范例、日志、轨迹）编译为可重用、可检索、可执行技能的系统。通过分步提取和结构化技能契约，构建持久化的技能库（SkillBank），在推理时与 RAG 协同工作，使智能体从知识访问扩展到能力复用。在 qsv 和 GitHub-CLI 基准上，结合 RAG 的成功率分别达到 98.85% 和 94.10%，显著优于纯 RAG。
Motivation: 现有的 RAG 主要提供碎片化的事实性证据，智能体仍需反复从段落中推断任务流程；缺乏一种机制将外部知识库中隐含的程序性知识编译为可直接复用的技能，从而快速近似领域专家能力。
Method: 提出 taxonomy-guided 框架，对知识记录进行证据窗口分解，在技能树先验下执行 plan-and-expand 提取；将候选技能转换为结构化技能契约（含调用条件、禁忌、动作、工作流、约束、输出规格、置信度等）；通过 taxonomy-aware 编译、注册表协调、生命周期追踪、版本管理和技能树投影来管理 SkillBank；推理时同时检索原始知识库的段落和 SkillBank 的程序技能。
Result: 在 qsv 和 GitHub-CLI 上，Anything2Skill 结合 RAG 的成功率分别为 98.85% 和 94.10%，大幅超过仅用 RAG 的智能体。
Conclusion: 将潜在的程序性知识编译为显式技能是扩展检索增强智能体从知识访问到能力复用的有效途径。

papers.title: A Geometric Framework for Absolute Pose and Velocity Estimation with Event Cameras
papers.abstract_en: Despite the rapid advancements in event-based motion estimation, current geometric methods primarily focus on velocity estimation. However, absolute pose estimation, which is equally crucial for key applications such as robotic navigation and augmented reality, remains relatively underexplored. Consequently, the simultaneous recovery of absolute pose and velocity from event streams remains an open and challenging problem. To address this gap, we propose a geometric framework for absolute pose and velocity estimation by leveraging 3D lines in the scene and the events they trigger. At the core of the framework lie two key geometric constraints: the orthogonality between a 3D line and the normal vector of its corresponding event plane, and the collinearity of an event with the 2D projection of its associated line. Based on these constraints, we present both linear and polynomial solvers for absolute pose estimation. The former enables efficient computation, while the latter provides a globally optimal solution for rotation. For velocity estimation, we develop an efficient linear solver and a more accurate optimization-based solver to recover both angular and linear velocities. Notably, our methods require a minimum of three event-line correspondences to determine the 6-DoF absolute pose or velocities independently. Extensive experiments in simulation and on real-world datasets demonstrate that our methods achieve state-of-the-art performance, with significant improvements in accuracy and computational efficiency compared to existing methods. The demo code is publicly available at https://github.com/Zibin6/EventPoseVelocity.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于场景中3D直线及其触发事件的几何框架，用于事件相机同时估计绝对位姿和速度。通过正交性和共线性约束，设计了线性和多项式求解器，实现6-DoF绝对位姿或速度的独立恢复，至少需要三个事件-直线对应。在仿真和真实数据集上，该方法在精度和计算效率上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有事件相机运动估计的几何方法主要聚焦于速度估计，而绝对位姿估计（对机器人导航和增强现实等关键应用至关重要）仍相对未被充分探索。同时从事件流中恢复绝对位姿和速度是一个开放且有挑战的问题。
Method: 提出一种几何框架，利用场景中的3D直线及其触发的事件。核心是两个几何约束：3D直线与其对应事件平面法向量的正交性，以及事件与其关联直线2D投影的共线性。基于这些约束，开发了线性求解器和多项式求解器用于绝对位姿估计（后者提供旋转的全局最优解），以及线性求解器和基于优化的求解器用于角速度和线速度估计。
Result: 仿真和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法在精度和计算效率上均达到最先进水平，相比现有方法有显著提升。
Conclusion: 该方法能够在仅需最少三个事件-直线对应的情况下，独立估计6-DoF绝对位姿或速度，为事件相机运动估计提供了新途径。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出一种几何框架，利用场景中的3D直线及其触发的事件。核心是两个几何约束：3D直线与其对应事件平面法向量的正交性，以及事件与其关联直线2D投影的共线性。基于这些约束，开发了线性求解器和多项式求解器用于绝对位姿估计（后者提供旋转的全局最优解），以及线性求解器和基于优化的求解器用于角速度和线速度估计。
summary_sections.result: 仿真和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法在精度和计算效率上均达到最先进水平，相比现有方法有显著提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法能够在仅需最少三个事件-直线对应的情况下，独立估计6-DoF绝对位姿或速度，为事件相机运动估计提供了新途径。

papers.title: REFINE: Super-efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting Pruning via Rendering-Free Primitive Importance
papers.abstract_en: Existing pruning methods for 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) suffer from either severe quality degradation or prohibitive computational overhead. In this paper, we propose REFINE, a highly accelerated 3DGS pruning framework centered on a novel rendering-free primitive importance metric. Our approach leverages an analytically approximated, rendering-aware Hessian field to quantify the expected perceptual error induced by the removal of individual primitives. By modeling the joint modulation of visibility, projection geometry and the content adaptive hyperparameter, we entirely bypass costly forward rendering passes and derive an anisotropic perceptual weight field that serves as a high-fidelity proxy for primitive importance. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that REFINE maintains highly competitive rendering quality while achieving an unprecedented $3,000\times$ reduction in pruning-related computational complexity compared to state-of-the-art pruning methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REFINE，一种针对3D高斯喷洒（3DGS）的超高效剪枝框架。核心是一种免渲染的原语重要性度量，通过解析近似的渲染感知Hessian场量化移除原语引起的预期感知误差，从而避免昂贵的前向渲染。实验表明，在保持高度竞争力渲染质量的同时，剪枝计算复杂度相比现有最先进方法降低3000倍。
Motivation: 现有3DGS剪枝方法面临两难：要么导致严重质量下降，要么计算开销过高。
Method: 提出免渲染的原语重要性度量，基于解析近似的渲染感知Hessian场，联合建模可见性、投影几何和内容自适应超参数，导出各向异性感知权重场作为原语重要性的高保真代理。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上，REFINE保持高度竞争力的渲染质量，同时实现剪枝计算复杂度的3000倍降低。
Conclusion: REFINE为3DGS剪枝提供了超高效方案，显著降低了计算成本而不牺牲渲染质量，适用于资源受限场景。

papers.title: INFUSER: Influence-Guided Self-Evolution Improves Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolution offers a scalable path to stronger reasoning: a pretrained language model improves itself with only minimal external supervision. Yet existing methods either depend on extensively curated or teacher-generated training data, or, when the generator runs unsupervised, reward it by a difficulty heuristic that need not improve the solver. We introduce INFUSER, an iterative co-training framework with two co-evolving roles: a Generator that drafts questions and reference golden answers from a pool of unstructured, automatically collected documents, and a Solver that improves by training on them. The solver is trained with standard correctness rewards against the generator-provided answers, while the generator is rewarded by an optimizer-aware influence score that measures whether each proposed question would actually improve the solver on the target distribution. Because this continuous, noisy influence score is poorly served by standard GRPO, we propose DuGRPO, a dual-normalized variant of GRPO, for generator training. Together, these turn the document pool into an adaptive curriculum that favors questions useful to the current solver, not just hard ones. On Qwen3-8B-Base, INFUSER outperforms strong self-evolution baselines with over 20% relative improvement on Olympiad and SuperGPQA benchmarks, and an 8B INFUSER co-evolving generator outperforms a frozen 32B thinking generator on math and coding. Ablations confirm each design choice is necessary, and two extensions, applying INFUSER to an instruction-finetuned anchor and augmenting it with rule-verifiable RLVR data, further demonstrate the flexibility and generalizability of the framework. Code is available at https://github.com/FFishy-git/INFUSER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出INFUSER框架，通过双角色（生成器与求解器）协同训练实现语言模型自我进化，生成器使用基于影响函数(influence score)的奖励和新型GRPO变体DuGRPO，以构建自适应课程。在Qwen3-8B-Base上，在奥林匹亚和SuperGPQA基准上相比强基线提升超过20%。
Motivation: 现有自我进化方法要么依赖精心策划或教师生成的数据，要么使用难度启发式奖励，可能并不改进求解器。目的是使生成器提出的问题真正有助于提升求解器在目标分布上的性能。
Method: 提出INFUSER迭代协同训练框架，包括生成器(Generator)和求解器(Solver)。生成器从非结构化文档池中草拟问题和参考答案；求解器通过标准正确性奖励训练。生成器使用基于优化器感知的影响分数作为奖励，并为此提出DuGRPO（双重归一化GRPO）来训练生成器。
Result: 在Qwen3-8B-Base上，INFUSER相比强自我进化基线在奥林匹亚和SuperGPQA基准上有超过20%的相对提升；8B的生成器在数学和编码任务上优于冻结的32B思考生成器。消融实验验证每个设计必要性，扩展实验展示框架灵活性。
Conclusion: INFUSER通过影响引导的自适应课程实现了更好的自我进化推理，具有通用性和可扩展性。

papers.title: Chiaroscuro Attention: Spending Compute in the Dark
papers.abstract_en: We introduce CHIAR-Former (CHIAroscuro Attention-based tRansFormer), an efficient transformer that routes each token to either DCT spectral mixing (O(d log d), sub-quadratic) or full self-attention (O(n^2 d), quadratic in sequence length n) based on per-token spectral entropy H(x) in [0,1], which measures the frequency-domain complexity of each token embedding x. We make three contributions: (1) we discover routing collapse -- a three-operator system collapses to DCT+Attention, revealing the optimal operator subset; (2) we propose a learned task-level MetaRouter g = sigma(Linear(x-bar)) in [0,1], where x-bar is the batch-mean embedding and g soft-blends spectral and identity paths end-to-end; and (3) we demonstrate 35-40% FLOP reduction at 400M parameters with a 3.93 PPL cost on WikiText-103 (Test PPL 27.51 vs. 23.58). Under mixed-dataset training, CHIAR-Former dramatically outperforms full attention on small corpora, confirming the regularisation value of spectral mixing. The MetaRouter stabilises at g ~ 0.22, indicating that at scale the model reaches a robust compute-quality equilibrium: attention layers absorb representational complexity while spectral preprocessing efficiently anchors low-frequency structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CHIAR-Former，一种高效 Transformer，通过每个 token 的谱熵 (spectral entropy) 决定将其路由到 DCT 谱混合（O(d log d)）或全自注意力（O(n^2 d)）。该方法发现路由坍缩 (routing collapse) 现象，并引入任务级 MetaRouter 进行软混合。在 400M 参数规模下，FLOP 降低 35-40%，但 WikiText-103 困惑度从 23.58 上升至 27.51。
Motivation: 标准 Transformer 的自注意力计算复杂度与序列长度呈二次关系，对于长序列计算成本过高。需要一种在保持质量的前提下降低计算开销的混合注意力机制。
Method: 提出基于每个 token 嵌入的频域复杂度（谱熵）进行路由，将简单 token 分配给 DCT 谱混合，复杂 token 分配给全注意力。此外，引入任务级 MetaRouter，利用批次平均嵌入学习一个软混合门控 g，在谱混合和恒等路径之间端到端融合。
Result: 在 400M 参数模型上实现 35-40% FLOP 减少，WikiText-103 测试困惑度为 27.51（对比全注意力基线 23.58）。在混合数据集训练下，CHIAR-Former 在小语料库上显著优于全注意力，表明谱混合具有正则化价值。MetaRouter 稳定在 g≈0.22，表明模型达到计算-质量均衡。
Conclusion: CHIAR-Former 通过感知 token 频域复杂度的路由机制，实现了计算效率与表示质量的权衡。路由坍缩现象揭示了最佳算子子集，MetaRouter 提供了稳定的端到端混合方法。

papers.title: CultureScore: Evaluating Cultural Faithfulness in Video Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: As video generation models like Veo 3.1 and LTX-2 advance, their ability to accurately represent diverse global cultures remains a critical yet understudied frontier. Current metrics, such as VideoScore, only measure visual quality but offer no mechanism for assessing cultural faithfulness. Consequently, a model that replaces a Namaste with a handshake receives the same score as one that generates the gesture correctly. We propose CultureScore, a compositional evaluation framework that decomposes cultural faithfulness into three granular dimensions: Identity (who is represented), Context (culturally localized background), and Behavior (normative gestures and interactions). We operationalize this framework through an evaluation suite spanning 10 countries, yielding 6,174 generated videos across three state-of-the-art models. Our evaluation reveals that no current model achieves culturally faithful video generation: the best-performing model reaches only 56.8\% overall CultureScore, with Behavior the most challenging dimension, which remains below 52.1\% across all models. Furthermore, human preference rankings align directionally with CultureScore but are inverted relative to VideoScore; the highest-scoring model on visual quality was ranked last by annotators, underscoring that cultural faithfulness is an essential criterion for equitable video generation. Data and code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ankurani/CultureScore.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CultureScore，一个视频生成模型文化忠实性评估框架，将文化忠实性分解为身份、背景和行为三个维度。评估了三个最新模型在10个国家的6174个生成视频，发现最佳模型仅达到56.8%总分，行为维度最差（低于52.1%）。人类偏好与CultureScore一致，但与视觉质量评分VideoScore相反。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型评估指标只关注视觉质量，无法衡量文化忠实性，导致模型在文化表现上可能产生错误，例如将合十礼替换为握手，却被视为同等质量。
Method: 提出CultureScore，将文化忠实性分解为身份（谁被表现）、背景（文化本地化环境）和行为（规范手势与互动）三个维度，构建覆盖10个国家的评估集，对三个模型生成的6174个视频进行评分。
Result: 最佳模型CultureScore仅56.8%，其中行为维度最难，所有模型低于52.1%；人类偏好排名与CultureScore方向一致，但与视觉质量评分VideoScore相反。
Conclusion: 文化忠实性是视频生成模型公平性的关键维度，当前模型尚未实现文化忠实生成，需要更全面的评估框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PJ-RoPE: A Fourier-Jet-Affine Position Space for Relative Attention
papers.abstract_en: We organize relative-position mechanisms in attention as a learnable Fourier-Jet-Affine position space. The starting point is lag-shift dynamics: a relative-position kernel is a response function of the lag \(d=i-j\), and the one-step shift \((Ef)(d)=f(d+1)\) gives a compact classification of finite structured responses through constant-coefficient difference modules. In this view, RoPE supplies simple Fourier roots, Jordan-RoPE thickens these roots into finite Fourier jets, and ALiBi supplies the repeated unit-root affine direction. NTK-aware RoPE scaling fits the same structure as a spectral flow of simple Fourier roots: moving the frequency grid generates first Fourier-jet tangent directions, while higher Taylor directions generate higher jets. PJ-RoPE makes these jet directions explicit and learnable, and uses the resulting space to measure task-level sector selection. The framework separates scalar PJ-bias kernels from exact PJ-rotary feature transforms, introduces sector-gate, effective-mass, functional-energy, and leave-one-order-out diagnostics, and stabilizes high-order coordinates with LC/rapidity compactification. Controlled probes recover designed sectors; synthetic teachers show trainable use; small byte-level language runs favor NTK-aware RoPE plus affine recency; symbolic music-token streams keep LC/affine variants strong with measurable high-order corrections; and LC diagnostics quantify the stability-resolution tradeoff.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Code available at https://github.com/ybzhang-nxu/Poincare_Rope
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可学习的 Fourier-Jet-Affine 位置空间框架，统一了相对注意力机制中的 RoPE、Jordan-RoPE、ALiBi 和 NTK-aware RoPE 缩放，通过显式化和可学习化的 jet 方向实现任务级扇区选择，并引入 sector-gate、有效质量、功能能量等诊断工具。实验在字节级语言建模和符号音乐令牌流上验证了该方法，其中 LC/affine 变体表现强劲，并量化了稳定性-分辨率权衡。
Motivation: 现有相对位置编码方法（如 RoPE、ALiBi）缺乏统一的数学框架来理解和优化其设计空间，且无法根据任务自适应地选择不同的位置结构。
Method: 从滞后位移动力学出发，将相对位置核视为响应函数，通过常系数差分模分类有限结构；将 RoPE 视为简单傅里叶根，Jordan-RoPE 视为有限傅里叶射流，ALiBi 视为重复单位根仿射方向；通过显式化和可学习化射流方向构造 PJ-RoPE，并引入 LC/rapidity 紧致化稳定高阶坐标。
Result: 控制探针可恢复设计扇区；合成教师任务展示可训练性；小规模字节级语言运行偏好 NTK-aware RoPE 加仿射近因；符号音乐令牌流中 LC/affine 变体保持强劲，且可测量到高阶修正；LC 诊断量化了稳定性-分辨率权衡。
Conclusion: 该框架统一了多种相对位置编码机制，并提供了可学习的扇区选择能力，适用于自然语言和符号序列任务，但未涉及降水预报或气象领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning While Acting: A Skill-Enhanced Test-Time Co-Evolution Framework for Online Lifelong Learning Agents
papers.abstract_en: Lifelong learning is essential for Large Language Model (LLM) agents operating in dynamic, interactive environments. However, existing lifelong learning agents for long-horizon tasks typically depend on discrete skill or past experiences retrieval with static parameters during inference, which prevents them from continuously internalizing test-time feedback like human learners. To bridge this gap, we propose Skill-enhanced Test-Time Co-Evolution (\texttt{LifeSkill}), a two-stage reinforcement learning framework for Online Lifelong Learning Agents. Specifically, we design Verifier-Guided Skill Learning that addresses the lack of direct supervision for skill extraction by rewarding candidate skills according to the average verifier success of multiple skill-conditioned policy rollouts, encouraging the model to generate skills that are useful for solving tasks rather than merely plausible in text. Furthermore, we introduce Online Skill Internalization, which continuously improves the policy model during test-time interaction by transforming skill-conditioned trajectories into reward signals. This enables the agent to directly internalize reasoning capabilities into its parameters, avoiding the context bloat of experience retrieval. Experiments on LifelongAgentBench show that LifeSkill improves average performance by 7 absolute points by comparing with existing lifelong agent baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LifeSkill，一个两阶段强化学习框架，用于在线终身学习智能体（LLM agents）在动态交互环境中持续内化测试时反馈。通过验证器引导的技能学习和在线技能内化，使智能体在测试时通过技能条件轨迹转化为奖励信号来持续改进策略参数，避免经验检索的上下文膨胀。在LifelongAgentBench上相比现有基准提升平均性能7个绝对百分点。
Motivation: 现有终身学习智能体在长时任务中通常依赖离散技能或过去经验检索，且推理时参数静态，无法像人类学习者一样持续内化测试时反馈。
Method: 提出两阶段强化学习框架LifeSkill：1) Verifier-Guided Skill Learning，通过奖励候选技能的平均验证器成功率来指导技能提取，使得生成对任务有用的技能；2) Online Skill Internalization，在测试时交互中通过将技能条件轨迹转化为奖励信号，持续改进策略模型参数，将推理能力直接内化到参数中。
Result: 在LifelongAgentBench上，LifeSkill相比现有终身学习智能体基线平均性能提升7个绝对百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架使智能体能够持续内化测试时反馈，避免经验检索的上下文膨胀，且在标准基准上显著提升性能。

papers.title: DriftSched: Adaptive QoS-Aware Scheduling under Runtime Token Drift for Multi-Tenant GPU Inference
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of large language model (LLM) inference services has increased the demand for efficient multi-tenant GPU scheduling. While modern inference runtimes such as vLLM improve throughput through continuous batching and optimized memory management, accurately estimating the runtime cost of heterogeneous inference requests remains challenging. In practice, admission-time workload estimates may deviate from observed execution behavior, leading to workload misclassification, queue imbalance, increased tail latency, and degraded Quality-of-Service (QoS). This paper presents DriftSched, a QoS-aware scheduling framework for multi-tenant LLM inference serving on NVIDIA L4 GPUs. DriftSched combines workload classification, token-budget estimation, tenant-aware queue management, and an online feedback mechanism to refine workload estimates using runtime observations. The framework evaluates FIFO, Priority, Weighted, Shortest-Job-First (SJF), and Aging Priority scheduling policies under heterogeneous multi-tenant workloads. Experimental results show that adaptive calibration reduces workload estimation error by an average of 38.8% (MAE) and 40.5% (RMSE), improving workload classification stability. Among all evaluated schedulers, SJF achieves the best overall performance, reducing median end-to-end latency by approximately 42% and P99 latency by approximately 16% relative to FIFO under sustained GPU contention. The results further indicate that scheduler selection has a greater impact on latency behavior than runtime calibration alone, while accurate workload characterization largely eliminates systematic estimation drift. This work contributes a reproducible framework for studying workload-estimation fidelity and QoS-aware scheduling in multi-tenant GPU inference systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DriftSched，一种面向多租户 LLM 推理的 QoS 感知调度框架。该框架结合工作负载分类、token 预算估计、租户感知队列管理和在线反馈机制，在 NVIDIA L4 GPU 上评估了 FIFO、Priority、Weighted、SJF 和 Aging Priority 等调度策略。实验表明，自适应校准可将工作负载估计误差平均降低 38.8%（MAE）和 40.5%（RMSE），其中 SJF 调度器相比 FIFO 将中位数端到端延迟降低约 42%，P99 延迟降低约 16%。
Motivation: 多租户 LLM 推理服务中，准入时的工作负载估计常与运行时行为偏差，导致工作负载误分类、队列不平衡、尾延迟增加和 QoS 下降。现有运行时如 vLLM 虽提升吞吐，但难以准确估计异构请求的运行时成本。
Method: DriftSched 框架包含四个组件：工作负载分类、token 预算估计、租户感知队列管理，以及利用运行时观测在线反馈校准估计的机制。该框架评估了 FIFO、Priority、Weighted、SJF 和 Aging Priority 五种调度策略。
Result: 自适应校准将工作负载估计的平均绝对误差（MAE）降低 38.8%，均方根误差（RMSE）降低 40.5%。所有调度策略中，SJF 表现最佳，在持续 GPU 争用下，相比 FIFO 将中位数端到端延迟降低约 42%，P99 延迟降低约 16%。
Conclusion: 调度策略选择对延迟的影响大于运行时校准的作用，而准确的工作负载表征可基本消除系统性估计漂移。该工作提供了一个可复现的框架，用于研究多租户 GPU 推理中的工作负载估计准确性和 QoS 感知调度。

papers.title: Estimating Mutual Information between Time Series and Temporal Event Sequences Across Diverse Analysis Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Pairwise dependence measures such as correlation and causality are fundamental to temporal data mining, yet there is still no principled and robust way to quantify dependence between heterogeneous data types, especially between continuous time series and discrete temporal event sequences. Existing approaches rely on ad hoc transformations or mutual-information estimators that are highly sensitive to quantization, repeated values, and event redundancy, leading to biased or unstable results in practice. We propose a nonparametric mutual information estimator that directly measures the dependence between time series and event sequences without data transformation, learning, or ad hoc discretization. Our method models the continuous-discrete duality of real-world time series to handle quantization and repeated-value artifacts and introduces a latent event clustering strategy to mitigate bias from event co-occurrence and redundancy. Together, these yield a robust and unified framework that bridges discrete and continuous mutual information. We evaluate the proposed estimator on four representative tasks: discrete-continuous time-delayed mutual information for causality analysis, global and local temporal repetition discovery, discrete covariate selection for time series forecasting, and continuous feature selection for classification. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show consistent improvements over existing methods in accuracy, robustness, and interpretability, positioning our approach as a general-purpose dependence operator for heterogeneous temporal data, similar to Pearson correlation for homogeneous time series. Code available at: https://github.com/HaojiHu/Multimodal-Temporal-Data-Quantification
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种非参数互信息估计器，用于量化连续时间序列与离散时序事件序列之间的依赖关系，无需数据变换或离散化。该方法通过建模连续-离散二元性处理量化与重复值伪影，并引入潜在事件聚类策略减少事件共现与冗余带来的偏差。在合成和真实数据集上的四个代表性任务（因果分析、时间重复发现、特征选择等）中展现了优于现有方法的准确性、鲁棒性和可解释性。
Motivation: 现有依赖度量（如相关性和因果性）无法稳健地处理连续时间序列与离散事件序列之间的异质数据依赖性，而现有互信息估计器对量化、重复值和事件冗余高度敏感，导致偏倚或不稳定结果。
Method: 提出一种非参数互信息估计器：直接建模连续-离散二元性以处理量化与重复值伪影，并采用潜在事件聚类策略降低事件共现与冗余的偏差，从而统一离散与连续互信息。
Result: 在四个任务（因果分析的时间延迟互信息、全局/局部时间重复发现、时序预测的离散协变量选择、分类的连续特征选择）上，合成与真实数据集实验显示方法在准确性、鲁棒性和可解释性上一致优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 该方法可作为异质时序数据的通用依赖算子，类似皮尔逊相关系数之于同质时间序列。代码已公开。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: Latent Diffusion for Missing Data
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have emerged as powerful generative approaches for missing-data imputation, yet most existing methods operate directly in data space and degrade when training data are heavily incomplete. We investigate whether shifting diffusion to a learned latent representation improves robustness under missing-completely-at-random (MCAR) corruption. To this end, we propose a two-stage framework: a robust VAE-based imputer first learns compact semantic features from incomplete observations, and a diffusion model is then trained in the resulting latent space. Across training missing rates, we perform a controlled comparison against pixel-space diffusion models under the same incomplete-data setting. The latent diffusion model maintains high sample quality and remains stable up to 50% missingness, while pixel-space diffusion degrades progressively as missingness increases. For downstream imputation, latent diffusion also achieves consistently better performance than pixel-space diffusion. These findings indicate that latent-space modeling mitigates artifact amplification from zero-imputed inputs and provides a more robust generative prior for incomplete-data learning. Overall, our results support latent diffusion as a strong and practically useful alternative to pixel-space diffusion for missing-data problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对缺失数据插补问题，提出一种两阶段隐空间扩散模型：先用鲁棒VAE从缺失观测中学习紧致的语义特征，再在隐空间训练扩散模型。在MCAR缺失机制下，隐空间扩散模型在50%缺失率时仍保持稳定，而像素空间扩散模型性能随缺失率增加而退化。下游插补任务中，隐空间扩散也持续优于像素空间扩散。
Motivation: 现有数据空间扩散模型在训练数据高度不完整时性能下降，需要更鲁棒的生成先验。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段用鲁棒VAE从缺失观测中学习隐表示，第二阶段在隐空间训练扩散模型。
Result: 隐空间扩散在50%缺失率下仍保持高样本质量，像素空间扩散性能随缺失率递增而持续下降；下游插补任务中隐空间扩散一致更好。
Conclusion: 隐空间建模缓解了零插补输入引入的伪影放大，为缺失数据问题提供了更鲁棒的生成先验，是像素空间扩散的有力替代。

papers.title: FM-fMRI: Event Conditioned Flow Matching for Rest-to-Task fMRI Time-Series Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Task-based fMRI provides a direct readout of task-evoked neural dynamics, but it is expensive and difficult to acquire at scale, motivating rest-to-task synthesis from widely available resting-state fMRI (rsfMRI). We propose FM-fMRI, an event-conditioned flow-matching model that learns a continuous-time conditional vector field to generate task ROI time series from a subject's rsfMRI and the task event information. The formulation enables fast ODE-based sampling and flexible conditioning over heterogeneous event schedules. Rather than optimizing for pointwise reconstruction, we evaluated generated signals using complementary criteria that probe temporal and spectral structure, subject and group-level connectome consistency, and distributional alignment. On the public Human Connectome Project and internal BioPoint autism cohort, FM-fMRI achieves the strongest spectral and connectivity agreement and improved distribution-level matching over conditional diffusion, generative adversarial networks (GANs), and variational autoencoders (VAEs) baselines. Furthermore, we augment the BioPoint cohort by synthesizing task-fMRI ROI time series with our method, improving downstream autism classification and demonstrating practical utility in data-limited clinical settings. The code will be available on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FM-fMRI，一种基于事件条件流匹配的模型，用于从静息态 fMRI 合成任务态 fMRI 的 ROI 时间序列。该方法通过学习连续时间条件向量场，支持快速 ODE 采样和灵活的事件条件。在 HCP 和 BioPoint 数据集上，FM-fMRI 在频谱和连接一致性上优于条件扩散、GAN 和 VAE 基线，并通过合成数据增强提升了自闭症分类性能。
Motivation: 任务态 fMRI 获取成本高且难以大规模采集，限制了其应用。作者希望利用广泛可得的静息态 fMRI 合成任务态 fMRI，以缓解数据稀缺问题。
Method: 提出事件条件流匹配模型，以受试者的静息态 fMRI 和任务事件信息为条件，学习连续时间条件向量场，通过 ODE 采样生成任务 ROI 时间序列。
Result: 在 HCP 和 BioPoint 数据集上，FM-fMRI 在频谱和连接一致性方面优于条件扩散、GAN 和 VAE 基线；合成数据增强了自闭症分类性能。
Conclusion: FM-fMRI 能合成与真实任务态 fMRI 在频谱和连接上高度一致的时间序列，并在数据有限的临床场景中表现出实用价值。

papers.title: Neuronal Stochastic Attention Circuit (NSAC) for Probabilistic Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reliable uncertainty quantification in continuous-time (CT) representation learning remains nascent, particularly within CT attention literature. We introduce the Neuronal Stochastic Attention Circuit (NSAC), a novel biologically-inspired CT attention architecture that reformulates attention logit computation as the solution of an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck stochastic differential equation modulated by input-dependent, nonlinear interlinked gates derived from repurposed C. elegans Neuronal Circuit Policies (NCPs) wiring mechanism. It induces a Gaussian distribution over logits that propagates principled stochasticity through a logistic-normal distribution over attention weights to yield probabilistic output. A two-term objective function combining Gaussian negative log-likelihood with an epistemic-separation regularizer enforces higher predictive variance under distributional shifts and enables joint quantification of aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. Theoretically, we provide: (i) state stability bounds; (ii) closed-form guarantees; and (iii) frozen-coefficient error approximation. Empirically, we implement NSAC in a diverse set of learning tasks including: (i) irregular CT function approximation; (ii) multivariate regression; (iii) long-range forecasting; (iv) Industry 4.0; and (v) lane-keeping of autonomous vehicles. We observe that NSAC remains competitive against several baselines in terms of accuracy and produces informative uncertainty estimates while being interpretable at the neuronal cell level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种受生物启发的连续时间注意力架构NSAC，将注意力logit计算建模为Ornstein-Uhlenbeck随机微分方程的解，并通过改造秀丽隐杆线虫神经回路策略（NCPs）的布线机制实现输入依赖的非线性门控。该方法在logits上引入高斯分布，并通过logistic-正态分布传播随机性得到概率输出，结合高斯负对数似然与认知分离正则化项以量化偶然和认知不确定性。理论上证明状态稳定性界、闭式保证和冻结系数误差近似，实验涵盖不规则连续时间函数逼近、多变量回归、长程预测、工业4.0和自动驾驶车道保持等任务，在准确性和不确定性估计方面具有竞争力。
Motivation: 连续时间表示学习中的不确定性量化研究不足，尤其是连续时间注意力文献中缺乏可靠的概率方法。
Method: 提出神经随机注意力电路（NSAC），将注意力logit计算作为Ornstein-Uhlenbeck随机微分方程的解，利用NCPs机制设计输入依赖的非线性门控，生成logits的高斯分布，进而通过logistic-正态分布得到概率注意力权重，优化目标为高斯负对数似然加认知分离正则化。
Result: 实验表明NSAC在不规则连续时间函数逼近、多变量回归、长程预测、工业4.0和自动驾驶车道保持等任务上，在准确性与基线相当的同时，提供了信息丰富的不确定性估计，并在神经元细胞层面具有可解释性。
Conclusion: NSAC为连续时间注意力机制提供了概率表示学习的新框架，能联合量化偶然和认知不确定性，理论保证与实验验证了其有效性，但未涉及降水或天气预测相关任务。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Minimax Limits of k-Fold Cross-Validation via Majority
papers.abstract_en: We study the mean-squared error of $k$-fold cross-validation as a risk estimator, with particular emphasis on how its accuracy depends on the number of folds $k$. Despite the widespread use of cross-validation, principled guidance for choosing $k$ is largely absent, mainly due to the complex dependence between fold-wise error estimates. To obtain sharp and interpretable results, we focus on the majority algorithm in binary classification, a minimal yet nontrivial empirical risk minimization procedure. We provide a fine-grained analysis of its cross-validation behavior, showing that even this simple algorithm exhibits subtle and delicate phenomena for which existing theory provides loose and even vacuous bounds. Leveraging this analysis, we introduce a minimax framework for cross-validation risk estimation and prove that no empirical risk minimization algorithm can achieve an $O(1/n)$ minimax mean-squared error when the number of folds grows with the number of samples $n$; instead, a lower bound of order $Ω(\sqrt{k}/n)$ is unavoidable. Our results reveal fundamental limitations of cross-validation as a data-reuse strategy, clarify gaps and inaccuracies in prior theoretical work, and position the majority algorithm as a natural benchmark that any tight analysis of cross-validation should be able to explain.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究二分类问题中多数投票算法的k折交叉验证均方误差（MSE）与折数k的关系，建立极小极大（minimax）框架并证明：当k随样本数n增长时，任何经验风险最小化算法的MSE下界为Ω(√k/n)，揭示交叉验证作为数据重用策略的根本局限。
Motivation: 尽管交叉验证广泛使用，但如何选择折数k缺乏原则性指导，主要因为折间误差估计的复杂依赖性；现有理论对简单算法（如多数投票）的交叉验证行为分析松散甚至无效。
Method: 聚焦二分类中的多数投票算法（一个最小但非平凡的ERM过程），对其进行精细的交叉验证误差分析，并引入极小极大框架刻画风险估计的准确度下界。
Result: 证明当k随样本数n增长时，任何ERM算法的交叉验证MSE下界为Ω(√k/n)，表明O(1/n)的极小极大MSE无法达到。
Conclusion: 揭示了交叉验证在数据复用中的根本局限，澄清了先前理论工作中的空白和不准确之处，并将多数投票算法定位为任何严格交叉验证分析应能解释的基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: YOLO26 vs. YOLOv8: A Comprehensive Architectural Benchmark of Next-Generation Real-Time Object Detection Models
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a rigorous empirical evaluation of Ultralytics YOLO26 against the YOLOv8 baseline, offering an independent real-world stress test of NMS-free architectures on non-COCO distributions. Engineered for edge deployment, YOLO26 introduces native end-to-end one-to-one label assignment, the removal of Distribution Focal Loss (DFL), and a spectral-constrained CSP-Muon backbone. We conducted a comprehensive, cross-scale comparative analysis across five model capacities, using the general object detection (Pascal VOC) and dense aerial small-object detection (VisDrone) datasets. Models are evaluated across accuracy (mAP_50 and mAP_50:95), model complexity, and hardware-specific CPU/GPU latency. Our findings revealed that while YOLO26 achieves a lower computational footprint and superior accuracy on Pascal VOC, with YOLO26-x reaching 0.635 mAP_50:95, this advantage narrows in dense aerial environments. On VisDrone, where over 75% of objects are under 2,000 pixels, both architectures struggle significantly, yielding a minimal performance gap (0.214 mAP_50:95 for YOLOv8-x vs. 0.224 mAP_50:95 for YOLO26-x). Crucially, hardware benchmarking demonstrates that YOLOv8 maintains a consistent edge in GPU inference latency across identical scales (e.g., 6.92 ms for YOLOv8-s vs. 8.38 ms for YOLO26-s), showing that NMS-free design does not inherently guarantee superiority in universal deployment. This work maps the operational boundaries of NMS-free frameworks to guide architecture selection based on dataset density, object scale, and hardware constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对Ultralytics YOLO26与YOLOv8进行了全面基准测试，在Pascal VOC（通用目标检测）和VisDrone（密集航拍小目标检测）上评估了多个模型容量。结果显示YOLO26在Pascal VOC上达到更优精度（YOLO26-x：0.635 mAP_50:95），但在VisDrone上优势很小；而YOLOv8在GPU推理延迟上始终更快（如YOLOv8-s：6.92 ms vs YOLO26-s：8.38 ms）。
Motivation: 现有工作缺乏对下一代无NMS架构在非COCO数据集上的独立评估，且部署硬件性能考量不足。
Method: 跨五个模型尺度，使用Pascal VOC和VisDrone数据集，从精度（mAP_50、mAP_50:95）、模型复杂度和硬件特定CPU/GPU延迟进行对比。
Result: YOLO26-x在Pascal VOC上mAP_50:95达0.635，优于YOLOv8-x（0.622）；VisDrone上两者差距小（YOLO26-x 0.224 vs YOLOv8-x 0.214），且YOLOv8 GPU延迟全面领先。
Conclusion: 无NMS设计未带来普遍部署优势，架构选择需考虑数据集密度、目标尺度和硬件约束。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Infra-Bayesian Reinforcement Learning Agents Outperform Classical RL For Worst-Case Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Classical reinforcement learning assumes the agent interacts with a fixed environment whose behavior does not depend on the agent's policy. This assumption breaks down in non-realizable settings where other actors might anticipate the agent's behavior, including environments crucial to AI safety, where the agent interacts with predictors, humans, other AI agents, and institutions. In such settings, the agent's model class fails to capture the world in which it operates. Under such misspecification, classical Bayesian methods can produce confidently wrong posteriors, unreliable decisions, and unbounded regret, as realizability fails to obtain. Infra-Bayesianism is a decision-theoretic framework that addresses these failures by distinguishing ordinary probabilistic uncertainty, where priors can be reasonably chosen, from Knightian uncertainty, where no grounds exist for the construction of such a prior. It does so by evaluating actions on their worst-case outcomes, rather than from posterior expectations or weighted averaging. We present the first proof-of-concept implementation of an infra-Bayesian reinforcement learning architecture for finite-outcome stateless decision problems. Our agent maintains a set of imprecise hypotheses, updates them using infra-Bayesian conditioning, and selects actions by maximizing worst-case expected value. We apply this implementation of the infra-Bayesian maximin decision process to an environment with Knightian uncertainty, and demonstrate a lower worst-case regret as compared to classical reinforcement learning agents. We also investigate Newcomb's problem and show that the infra-Bayesian agent picks the optimal strategy, outperforming classical decision theory agents. Our results provide a step towards reinforcement learning agents that remain robust under model misspecification and policy-dependent uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次提出了一种基于infra-Bayesian的强化学习架构的原型实现，用于有限结果、无状态的决策问题。该代理维护一组不精确假设，通过infra-Bayesian条件更新，并选择最大化最坏情况期望值的动作。实验表明，在具有Knightian不确定性的环境中，该代理的最坏情况后悔低于经典强化学习代理；在Newcomb问题中，它选择了最优策略，优于经典决策理论代理。
Motivation: 经典强化学习假设环境固定且不依赖于代理的策略，但在非可实现设置（如AI安全关键场景）中这一假设失效，导致代理的模型类无法捕捉真实世界，进而产生置信度错误的後验、不可靠的决策和无界的后悔。Infra-Bayesianism通过区分概率不确定性（可合理选择先验）和Knightian不确定性（无法构建先验）来解决这些失败。
Method: 实现了一种infra-Bayesian强化学习架构，用于有限结果、无状态决策问题。代理维护一组不精确假设，使用infra-Bayesian条件进行更新，并通过最大化最坏情况期望值来选择动作。
Result: 在具有Knightian不确定性的环境中，infra-Bayesian代理的最坏情况后悔低于经典强化学习代理；在Newcomb问题中，它选择了最优策略，优于经典决策理论代理。
Conclusion: 该工作为在模型误指定和策略相关不确定性下保持鲁棒的强化学习代理提供了重要一步。
