papers.title: Worse than Random: The Importance of a Baseline for Unsupervised Feature Selection
papers.abstract_en: Many novel unsupervised feature selection methods are proposed each year, yet their empirical evaluation is limited to supervised and unsupervised evaluation metrics computed on selected datasets, along with comparisons to existing methods. However, in the absence of an established evaluation baseline, it is difficult to determine the value added to the existing literature by each of these methods, and how effective their underlying approaches are. We propose using random feature selection as a baseline for evaluating the unsupervised feature selection methods. We empirically show that many of the state-of-the-art methods in unsupervised feature selection are outperformed by random feature selection in both performance and efficiency. Accordingly, we emphasize on the strict requirement of considering random feature selection as a baseline in the development process of novel unsupervised feature selection methods to ensure a consistent improvement over random feature selection.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将随机特征选择作为无监督特征选择方法的基线，并实验证明许多现有最先进方法在性能和效率上均不如随机选择。作者强调新方法开发必须与随机基线比较以确保实际改进。
Motivation: 无监督特征选择方法缺乏公认的评价基线，难以评估新方法的实际贡献。
Method: 使用随机特征选择作为基线，通过实验对比多种无监督特征选择方法。
Result: 实验表明许多最新无监督特征选择方法在性能和效率上被随机特征选择超越。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁在无监督特征选择方法开发中严格采用随机选择作为基线，以证明方法改进的有效性。

papers.title: Embedding-Based Federated Learning with Runtime Governance for Iron Deficiency Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Recent reviews find that the vast majority of published healthcare federated learning (FL) studies never reach real-world deployment. We developed an embedding-based FL pipeline for iron deficiency prediction from routine full blood count (FBC) data and deployed it across real institutional environments at Amsterdam University Medical Centre (AUMC) and NHS Blood and Transplant (NHSBT), two clinical environments that differ markedly in iron deficiency prevalence, ferritin distribution, and subject populations. A frozen domain-specific haematology foundation model, DeepCBC, performs site-local representation extraction, restricting federated training to a compact downstream classifier and substantially reducing recurrent communication relative to full-encoder federation. The two clinical datasets are structurally not independent and identically distributed (non-IID), with heterogeneity arising from distinct population differences rather than sampling artefacts. Runtime governance is enforced by FLA$^3$, a healthcare-oriented FL platform providing study-scoped execution, policy-based authorisation, and signed audit logging. Standard sample-size-weighted aggregation (FedAvg) reduced the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) at both sites relative to local-only training, as the global update was biased towards the larger AUMC distribution. FedMAP, a personalised aggregation method, raised ROC-AUC from 0.9470 to 0.9594 at AUMC and from 0.8558 to 0.8671 at NHSBT relative to local-only training, achieving the highest macro ROC-AUC of 0.9133 and the best macro balanced accuracy overall. These results support personalised aggregation in clinical federations where client sample size and task relevance diverge substantially.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于嵌入的联邦学习管道，用于从常规全血计数数据预测铁缺乏，并在两家临床环境（AUMC和NHSBT）中部署。使用冻结的血液学基础模型DeepCBC进行局部表示提取，联邦训练仅限下游分类器，减少通信开销。针对非独立同分布数据，个性化聚合方法FedMAP相比本地训练提升了ROC-AUC，优于标准FedAvg。
Motivation: 大多数已发表的医疗联邦学习研究未能实现真实部署，且临床数据常存在非独立同分布问题，标准聚合方法（如FedAvg）可能因样本量偏差而降低性能。
Method: 构建嵌入联邦学习管道：使用冻结的DeepCBC模型提取局部表示，仅训练下游分类器；采用FedMAP个性化聚合方法，结合运行时治理平台FLA$^3$确保合规性。
Result: 在AUMC和NHSBT数据集上，FedMAP相比本地训练将ROC-AUC分别从0.9470提升至0.9594和从0.8558提升至0.8671，宏观ROC-AUC达0.9133，宏观平衡准确率最佳。标准FedAvg则因偏向大站点而降低性能。
Conclusion: 在客户样本量和任务相关性差异大的临床联邦学习中，个性化聚合方法（如FedMAP）优于标准加权平均，支持了其在非IID医疗数据部署中的有效性。

papers.title: Do as I Say, Not as I Do: Instruction-Induction Conflict in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Language models are trained to follow instructions, but they are also powerful pattern completers. What happens when these two objectives conflict? We construct conversations in which a user instruction to behave in a target way T (e.g., always output a specific token, answer in a particular language, or adopt a persona) is opposed by N hardcoded assistant turns demonstrating a competing pattern P. We then measure instruction-following (IF) rates in this setting, across 13 models and 16 different instructions, for up to 50 turns. Average instruction-following rates range from 1% to 99% across models, largely uncorrelated with standard capability benchmarks. The transition from instruction-following to pattern-following is universal but highly model-dependent. Robustness is modulated both by instruction content, with models resisting induction longer when instructions align with their trained value priors, and by output format, with diverse multi-token responses proving substantially more resistant than single-token outputs. Chain-of-thought reasoning improves robustness but does not eliminate susceptibility, and can produce dissociation between correct deliberation and incorrect output. When asked to predict their behavior in this setting, models achieve 83.5% accuracy on average but systematically underestimate their own resistance to induction pressure. These results suggest that instruction-following remains brittle under induction pressure even for otherwise capable models, and that output diversity, rather than semantic engagement with the input, is the primary factor predicting robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型在同时遵循用户指令和完成模式补全时出现的冲突。作者构造对话场景，其中用户指令要求模型以特定方式行为（如输出固定token、使用特定语言或扮演角色），而助手的历史回复则展示一个竞争模式。实验跨13个模型和16种指令，发现指令遵循率从1%到99%不等，与标准能力基准基本不相关。模型从指令遵循向模式遵循的转变是普遍的但高度依赖模型。输出格式的多样性（多token响应）是鲁棒性的主要预测因素，而思维链推理虽能改善但不能消除脆弱性。模型在预测自身行为时系统性地低估了自己的抵抗能力。
Motivation: 语言模型既需遵循指令又是强大的模式补全器，当两个目标冲突时会发生什么？现有研究未充分探索这种指令-归纳冲突。
Method: 设计对话场景：一条用户指令（如输出特定token、用某种语言回答或采用某种人格）与N条硬编码的助手回复（展示竞争模式P）对立，测量模型在13个模型、16种指令、最多50轮对话中的指令遵循率。
Result: 平均指令遵循率在1%到99%之间，与标准能力基准不相关；输出格式多样性（多token响应）比语义参与更能预测鲁棒性；思维链推理提高鲁棒性但无法消除；模型在预测自身行为时准确率83.5%但系统性地低估自身抵抗能力。
Conclusion: 指令遵循在归纳压力下仍然脆弱，即使对于能力强的模型也是如此；输出多样性而非语义参与是鲁棒性的主要因素。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dimension-Free Convergence of Discrete Diffusion Models: Adjoint Equations Induce the Right Space
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion has become a leading framework for generative modeling in various applications including language, vision, and biology. Existing convergence theory, however, exhibits fundamental limitations. KL-based analyses diverge under singular priors such as the masked distribution, while bounds in total variation (TV) depend on the state space size $S$ and become vacuous for modern language tasks, where vocabularies contain hundreds of thousands of tokens. We develop a unified adjoint-equation-based framework that establishes dimension-free convergence guarantees in any integral probability metric (IPM). To the best of our knowledge, our bounds are the first to be entirely free of $S$ and applicable to both masked and uniform priors. Importantly, our theory relies only on a single standard rate-matrix regularity assumption and applies to general priors. Five novel techniques drive our improvements: working in the space of observables via adjoint equations rather than directly with probability measures, a regularity analysis that yields bounds on any IPM, a coupling argument that removes $S$-dependence under uniform transitions, and score-marginal cancellation and exit-routing techniques that remove $S$-dependence under masked transitions. Our framework thus sharply departs from prior analyses and avoids the shortcomings of pathspace-KL and existing TV-based approaches. Beyond convergence bounds, our framework provides a versatile toolkit for further theoretical study of discrete diffusion models, including principled choices of loss functions and dimension-free step complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文针对离散扩散模型现有的收敛理论局限性（KL分析在奇异先验下发散，TV界依赖状态空间大小S），提出基于伴随方程的统一框架，在任何积分概率度量（IPM）下建立无维数收敛保证。该框架首次完全独立于S，适用于掩码和均匀先验，并引入了五种新技术（工作在可观测量空间、正则性分析、耦合论证、得分-边际抵消和退出路由）来消除S依赖性。理论仅依赖单一标准速率矩阵正则性假设。
Motivation: 现有离散扩散模型收敛理论存在根本局限：KL基分析在奇异先验（如掩码分布）下发散，而总变差（TV）界依赖于状态空间大小S，在词汇量巨大的语言任务中变得无效。因此需要建立完全不依赖S的收敛保证。
Method: 基于伴随方程的统一框架：在可观测量（observables）空间而非概率测度空间工作，通过正则性分析得到任意IPM的界；利用耦合论证消除均匀过渡下的S依赖性；通过得分-边际抵消和退出路由技术消除掩码过渡下的S依赖性。
Result: 摘要声称首次获得完全无状态空间大小S的收敛界，适用于任何积分概率度量（IPM），且仅依赖单一标准速率矩阵正则性假设，同时适用于掩码和均匀先验。
Conclusion: 该框架不仅提供了收敛界，还为离散扩散模型的进一步理论研究提供了通用工具，包括损失函数的原则选择和维度无关的步长复杂度。

papers.title: Backdoor Channels Hidden in Latent Space: Cryptographic Undetectability in Modern Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Recent cryptographic results establish that neural networks can be backdoored such that no efficient algorithm can distinguish them from a clean model. These guarantees, however, have been confined to stylised architectures of limited practical relevance, leaving open whether comparable undetectability extends to modern, end-to-end trained networks. We construct such an attack mechanism for state-of-the-art architectures, closely aligned to the cryptographic notion of undetectability, by identifying backdoor channels as learned latent directions, and show that the question of undetectability reduces to a hypothesis test between two unknown distributions over model parameters, which we conjecture to be intractable in practice. The consequence of this reframing is significant: if exploitable channels within a network's latent space are statistically indistinguishable from naturally learned directions, an attacker need not introduce foreign structure but can instead exploit the geometry the network already possesses. Demonstrating the approach on ResNet and Vision Transformer architectures trained on standard image classification datasets, the attack achieves both consistently high success rates with negligible clean accuracy degradation, and resists a comprehensive suite of post-training defences, none of which neutralise the backdoor without rendering the model unusable. Our results establish that cryptographic backdoors need not be artefacts requiring exotic architectures or artificial constructions, but identifiable as latent properties inherent to the geometry of learned representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现代神经网络（ResNet、Vision Transformer）构造了一种密码学意义上不可区分的后门攻击。通过将后门通道视为学习到的潜在方向，将不可检测性问题归约为两个未知分布间的假设检验，并论证该检验在实践中不可行。在标准图像分类数据集上的实验表明，该方法在保持高攻击成功率的同时几乎不降低干净模型精度，并能抵御多种后训练防御手段。
Motivation: 现有密码学后门仅适用于特殊架构，缺乏向现代端到端训练网络的推广。本文旨在证明实际部署的神经网络中可实现同等不可检测性。
Method: 将后门作为潜在空间中的方向嵌入，将不可检测性转化为对模型参数分布的假设检验问题，并利用网络已有几何结构避免引入额外结构。
Result: 在ResNet和Vision Transformer上实现高攻击成功率，干净精度损失可忽略；多种后训练防御均无法在不破坏模型的前提下消除后门。
Conclusion: 密码学后门无需依赖特殊架构，而是可以自然存在于学习表示的几何属性中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Iterative Audit Convergence in LLM-Managed Multi-Agent Systems: A Case Study in Prompt-Engineering Quality Assurance
papers.abstract_en: Prompt specifications for multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems carry data contracts and integration logic across interdependent files but are rarely subjected to structured-inspection rigor. We report a single-system case study of iterative, agent-driven auditing applied to AEGIS (Autonomous Engineering Governance and Intelligence System), a seven-lane production pipeline whose 7152-line specification surface was audited across nine rounds, surfacing 51 consistency defects (per-round counts of 15, 8, 12, 2, 8, 1, 4, 1, 0). We present a seven-category post hoc taxonomy with explicit coding rules, non-monotonic convergence consistent with cascading edits and audit-scope expansion, and a locked audit protocol. We further report two partial replications on a public synthetic mini-specification: a cross-LLM panel of four frontier vendors (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI; 12 traces; multi-vendor union detects all five seeded defects) and an inter-rater reliability check on a stratified subsample (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.80 on category, 0.46 on severity). The full reproducibility bundle accompanies the submission.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Published in MDPI Software (Special Issue: Software Reliability, Security and Quality Assurance). Companion preprint at arXiv:2604.05000
papers.journal_ref: Software 2026, 5, 26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告一个单系统案例研究，对AEGIS多智能体LLM管线（7152行规范）进行九轮迭代审计，发现51个一致性缺陷，并提出后验七类分类法。部分重复实验使用四个前沿大模型（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、xAI）检测公共合成迷你规范中的种子缺陷，跨供应商联合检测率达100%，类别级Cohen's κ=0.80。
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统的提示规范（prompt specifications）包含跨文件的数据契约和集成逻辑，但缺乏结构化检验的严格流程。
Method: 采用迭代、智能体驱动的审计方法，对AEGIS管线进行九轮审计，构建后验七类分类法并制定显式编码规则，同时进行跨LLM面板和评分者信度检验的部分重复实验。
Result: 九轮审计共发现51个一致性缺陷（每轮依次15、8、12、2、8、1、4、1、0个）；跨供应商联合检测能识别所有五个种子缺陷；类别级Cohen's κ=0.80，严重性级κ=0.46。
Conclusion: 研究表明多轮审计中缺陷收敛呈非单调性（级联编辑和审计范围扩展所致），锁定审计协议可提升可靠性，但严重性判断仍需改进。

papers.title: Positive Alignment: Artificial Intelligence for Human Flourishing
papers.abstract_en: Existing alignment research is dominated by concerns about safety and preventing harm: safeguards, controllability, and compliance. This paradigm of alignment parallels early psychology's focus on mental illness: necessary but incomplete. What we call Positive Alignment is the development of AI systems that (i) actively support human and ecological flourishing in a pluralistic, polycentric, context-sensitive, and user-authored way while (ii) remaining safe and cooperative. It is a distinct and necessary agenda within AI alignment research. We argue that several existing failures of alignment (e.g., engagement hacking, loss of human autonomy, failures in truth-seeking, low epistemic humility, error correction, lack of diverse viewpoints, and being primarily reactive rather than proactive) may be better addressed through positive alignment, including cultivating virtues and maximizing human flourishing. We highlight a range of challenges, open questions, and technical directions (e.g., data filtering and upsampling, pre- and post-training, evaluations, collaborative value collection) for different phases of the LLM and agents lifecycle. We end with design principles for promoting disagreement and decentralization through contextual grounding, community customization, continual adaptation, and polycentric governance; that is, many legitimate centers of oversight rather than one institutional or moral chokepoint.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“正向对齐”（Positive Alignment）概念，主张发展不仅安全且能主动促进人类和生态繁荣的AI系统，作为现有以安全、控制为主导的对齐研究范式的补充。作者分析了现有对齐失败的案例（如参与度黑客、自主性丧失等），并提出了贯穿LLM和智能体生命周期的技术方向（数据过滤、训练、评估）以及设计原则（去中心化、社区定制、多渠道治理）。
Motivation: 现有AI对齐研究过度聚焦于安全与防止危害，忽略了AI系统如何主动支持人类繁荣这一积极维度，导致一些对齐失败（如自主性丧失、缺乏多样性观点）未得到充分解决。
Method: 通过文献分析和概念论证，提出正向对齐的定义、挑战与技术方向，包括数据过滤与上采样、预训练与后训练、评估及协作价值收集，并给出促进分歧与去中心化的设计原则（情境基础、社区定制、持续适应、多中心治理）。
Result: 论文未提供实验性结果，而是提出概念框架和研究议程。
Conclusion: 正向对齐是AI对齐研究中独立且必要的议程，需在安全基础上主动追求人类与生态繁荣，并呼吁多中心治理以避免单一机构或道德瓶颈。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pseudo-Deliberation in Language Models: When Reasoning Fails to Align Values and Actions
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are often evaluated based on their stated values, yet these do not reliably translate into their actions, a discrepancy termed "value-action gap." In this work, we argue that this gap persists even under explicit reasoning, revealing a deeper failure mode we call "Pseudo-Deliberation": the appearance of principled reasoning without corresponding behavioral alignment. To study this systematically, we introduce VALDI, a framework for measuring alignment between stated values and generated dialogue. VALDI includes 4,941 human-centered scenarios across five domains, three tasks that elicit value articulation, reasoning, and action, and five metrics for quantifying value adherence. Across both proprietary and open-source LLMs, we observe consistent misalignment between expressed values and downstream dialogues. To investigate intervention strategies, we propose VIVALDI, a multi-agent value auditor that intervenes at different stages of generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现大语言模型在明确推理时仍存在价值观与行为不一致的问题，称为“伪深思熟虑”（Pseudo-Deliberation）。作者提出VALDI框架，包含4941个人类中心场景、三项任务和五项指标，用于量化价值观表达与对话行为之间的对齐程度。实验表明多种LLM均存在系统性错位，并进一步提出多智能体审计器VIVALDI进行干预。
Motivation: 现有评估LLM价值观时，其陈述的价值观并不总能转化为实际行动，且这种价值-行动差距在显式推理下仍然存在，表明存在更深层的失败模式。
Method: 提出VALDI框架，包括跨五个领域的4941个场景、三项任务（价值阐述、推理和行为）以及五项量化指标，用于测量价值观与对话行为的对齐程度。并在此基础上设计VIVALDI，一个多智能体价值审计器，可在生成的不同阶段进行干预。
Result: 对商业和开源LLM的实验显示，模型表达的价值与后续对话行为之间存在持续的不一致。
Conclusion: 论文强调LLM即使在显式推理过程中也会出现价值-行动错位，VALDI和VIVALDI为诊断和缓解该问题提供了系统工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TMPO: Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization for Diverse and Efficient Diffusion Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown extraordinary potential in aligning diffusion models to downstream tasks, yet most of them still suffer from significant reward hacking, which degrades generative diversity and quality by inducing visual mode collapse and amplifying unreliable rewards. We identify the root cause as the mode-seeking nature of these methods, which maximize expected reward without effectively constraining probability distribution over acceptable trajectories, causing concentration on a few high-reward paths. In contrast, we propose Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization (TMPO), which replaces scalar reward maximization with trajectory-level reward distribution matching. Specifically, TMPO introduces a Softmax Trajectory Balance (Softmax-TB) objective to match the policy probabilities of K trajectories to a reward-induced Boltzmann distribution. We prove that this objective inherits the mode-covering property of forward KL divergence, preserving coverage over all acceptable trajectories while optimizing reward. To further reduce multi-trajectory training time on large-scale flow-matching models, TMPO incorporates Dynamic Stochastic Tree Sampling, where trajectories share denoising prefixes and branch at dynamically scheduled steps, reducing redundant computation while improving training effectiveness. Extensive results across diverse alignment tasks such as human preference, compositional generation and text rendering show that TMPO improves generative diversity over state-of-the-art methods by 9.1%, and achieves competitive performance in all downstream and efficiency metrics, attaining the optimal trade-off between reward and diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出轨迹匹配策略优化（TMPO），通过将标量奖励最大化替换为轨迹级奖励分布匹配，解决扩散模型对齐中的奖励作弊和多样性下降问题。TMPO引入Softmax轨迹平衡（Softmax-TB）目标，使策略概率匹配奖励诱导的玻尔兹曼分布，并利用动态随机树采样减少多轨迹训练的计算开销。在人类偏好、组合生成和文本渲染等对齐任务上，TMPO将生成多样性提升9.1%，同时保持竞争性的下游性能和效率。
Motivation: 现有强化学习对齐方法趋向最大期望奖励，导致模式崩溃和多样性损失，本质是缺乏对可接受轨迹概率分布的约束。
Method: TMPO采用Softmax-TB目标，匹配K条轨迹的策略概率与奖励诱导的玻尔兹曼分布，其前向KL散度具有模式覆盖特性；同时引入动态随机树采样，通过共享去噪前缀和动态分支调度减少冗余计算。
Result: 在人类偏好、组合生成和文本渲染等多种对齐任务上，TMPO将生成多样性较最先进方法提升9.1%，并在所有下游任务和效率指标上达到奖励与多样性的最优权衡。
Conclusion: TMPO通过轨迹级奖励分布匹配，在保持多样性的同时优化奖励，为扩散模型对齐提供了一种高效且多样化的方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lost in Volume: The CT-SpatialVQA Benchmark for Evaluating Semantic-Spatial Understanding of 3D Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D medical vision-language models have enabled joint reasoning over volumetric images and text, showing strong performance in medical visual question-answering (VQA) and report generation. Despite this progress, it remains unclear whether these models learn spatially grounded anatomy from 3D volumes or rely primarily on learned priors and language correlations. This uncertainty stems from the lack of systematic evaluation of semantic-spatial reasoning in volumetric medical VLMs for clinically reliable decision support. To address this gap, we introduce CT-SpatialVQA, a benchmark designed to evaluate semantic-spatial reasoning in 3D CT data. The benchmark comprises 9077 clinically grounded question-answer (QA) pairs derived directly from 1601 radiology reports and CT volumes, which are validated via a robust LLM-assisted pipeline with a 95% human consensus agreement rate. Our dataset requires explicit anatomical localization, laterality awareness, structural comparison, and 3D inter-structure relational reasoning. We also introduce a standardized evaluation protocol and benchmark eight 3D medical VLMs, finding severe degradation on semantic-spatial reasoning tasks, averaging 34% accuracy and often below random, highlighting the need for deeper integration of volumetric evidence for trustworthy clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CT-SpatialVQA基准，用于评估3D医学视觉语言模型在CT数据上的语义空间推理能力。基准包含9077个临床问题-答案对，来源于1601份放射学报告和CT体积，并经95%人类共识验证。评估了八个3D医学VLM，发现其在空间推理任务上性能严重下降，平均准确率仅34%，经常低于随机水平。
Motivation: 当前3D医学视觉语言模型的学习能力评估缺乏对语义空间推理的系统性评测，无法确定模型是否真正理解3D体积中的空间解剖结构。
Method: 构建CT-SpatialVQA基准，包含9077个QA对，来自1601个临床CT体积和报告，采用LLM辅助管线生成并经95%人类共识验证。评估协议要求明确解剖定位、侧向性、结构比较和3D结构间关系推理。
Result: 在八个3D医学VLM上测试，语义空间推理任务平均准确率34%，经常低于随机水平，显示当前模型严重依赖先验和语言相关性而缺乏空间理解。
Conclusion: 基准揭示了现有3D医学VLM在临床语义空间推理上的显著不足，强调需要更深入地整合体积证据以实现可信的临床决策支持。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchical Perfusion Graphs for Tumor Heterogeneity Modeling in Glioma Molecular Subtyping
papers.abstract_en: Precise molecular subtyping of gliomas, including isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) mutation and 1p/19q codeletion, directly guides surgical and therapeutic decisions, yet currently relies on invasive tissue sampling. Deep learning on structural MRI has emerged as a non-invasive alternative, but anatomy-only approaches cannot capture the hemodynamic signatures that distinguish molecular subtypes. Radiogenomics based on dynamic susceptibility contrast (DSC) MRI holds immense potential for non-invasively characterizing glioma molecular subtypes, yet clinical deployment has been hindered by inter-site variability and the limitations of voxel-wise analysis. We introduce HiPerfGNN, a framework that first learns discrete hemodynamic representations from raw time-intensity curves using a vector-quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE). These quantized perfusion codes define coarse-level graph nodes representing functional tumor habitats, each of which is hierarchically subdivided into fine-level subregions guided by structural MRI. A hierarchical graph neural network then propagates information across scales for molecular prediction. On an internal cohort (n=475), the model achieved AUCs of 0.96 (IDH), 0.89 (1p/19q), and 0.84 (WHO grade), and maintained robust IDH performance (AUC 0.89) on an independent external cohort (n=397) without recalibration. Gradient-based saliency analysis confirms biologically grounded attention patterns aligned with known glioma pathophysiology. Our results demonstrate the added value of integrating perfusion dynamics into radiogenomic pipelines for glioma molecular subtyping. Code is available at https://github.com/janghana/HiPerfGNN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出HiPerfGNN框架，通过VQ-VAE从动态磁敏感对比MRI中学习离散血流动力学表示，构建分层灌注图，然后用分层图神经网络预测胶质瘤分子亚型（IDH突变、1p/19q共缺失和WHO分级）。在内部队列（n=475）上AUC分别为0.96、0.89、0.84，在外部队列（n=397）上IDH AUC达0.89。表明整合灌注动力学可提升放射基因组学性能。
Motivation: 精确的胶质瘤分子分型依赖侵入性组织采样。基于结构MRI的深度学习无法捕捉血流动力学特征，而动态磁敏感对比MRI的放射基因组学受限于站点差异和体素分析。目标是实现非侵入性、鲁棒的分子分型。
Method: 使用VQ-VAE将原始时间-强度曲线学习为离散血流动力学表示，定义粗粒度图节点（功能肿瘤栖息地），再通过结构MRI分层细分为细粒度子区域，最后用分层图神经网络跨尺度传播信息进行分子预测。
Result: 内部队列AUC: IDH 0.96, 1p/19q 0.89, WHO分级0.84；外部队列IDH AUC 0.89。梯度显著性分析验证了生物学相关注意力模式。
Conclusion: 将灌注动力学整合到放射基因组学管线可提高胶质瘤分子分型的准确性，且具有跨中心的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unified Framework of Distributional Regret in Multi-Armed Bandits and Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study the distribution of regret in stochastic multi-armed bandits and episodic reinforcement learning through a unified framework. We formalize a distributional regret bound as a probabilistic guarantee that holds uniformly over all confidence levels $δ\in (0,1]$, thereby characterizing the regret distribution across the full range of $δ$. We present a simple UCBVI-style algorithm with exploration bonus $\min\{c_{1,k}/N, c_{2,k}/\sqrt{N}\}$, where $N$ denotes the visit count and $(c_{1,k},c_{2,k})$ are user-specified parameters. For arbitrary parameter sequences, we derive general gap-independent and gap-dependent distributional regret bounds, yielding a principled characterization of how the parameters control the trade-off between expected performance, tail risk, and instance-dependent behavior. In particular, our bounds achieve optimal trade-offs between expected and distributional regret in both minimax and instance-dependent regimes. As a special case, for multi-armed bandits with $A$ arms and horizon $T$, we obtain a distributional regret bound of order $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{AT}\log(1/δ))$, confirming the conjecture of Lattimore & Szepesvári (2020, Section 17.1) for the first time.
papers.comment: Conference of Learning Theory (COLT) 2026, camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，研究随机多臂老虎机和情节强化学习中的后悔分布。通过形式化分布后悔界（对全部置信水平δ∈(0,1]一致的概率保证），并设计一个简单的UCBVI风格算法（探索奖励为min{c_{1,k}/N, c_{2,k}/√N}），推导出gap独立和gap依赖的分布后悔界，实现了期望后悔、尾部风险与实例依赖性之间的最优权衡。作为特例，对多臂老虎机得到O(√(AT) log(1/δ))的分布后悔界，首次确认Lattimore & Szepesvári的猜想。
Motivation: 现有后悔界多关注期望，未能刻画后悔的完整分布特征（如尾部风险）；本文旨在通过统一框架提供对所有置信水平一致的分布后悔保证，填补理论空白。
Method: 形式化定义分布后悔界，并提出一个UCBVI风格的算法，其探索奖励由用户指定参数(c_{1,k}, c_{2,k})控制。对任意参数序列，推导出通用的gap独立和gap依赖分布后悔界，展示参数如何调节期望性能、尾部风险与实例依赖行为之间的权衡。
Result: 在多臂老虎机设置下（A臂，T时段），获得O(√(AT) log(1/δ))的分布后悔界，首次证实了Lattimore & Szepesvári (2020)的猜想；在minimax和实例依赖两种场景下均达到了期望后悔与分布后悔的最优权衡。
Conclusion: 该框架为后悔分布提供了系统的理论刻画，统一了多臂老虎机和强化学习，并展示了通过参数选择实现最优权衡的可行性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAGA: Workflow-Atomic Scheduling for AI Agent Inference on GPU Clusters
papers.abstract_en: AI agents execute tens to hundreds of chained LLM calls per task, yet GPU schedulers treat each call as independent, discarding gigabytes of intermediate state between steps and inflating end-to-end latency by 3-8x. We argue that this request-level abstraction is fundamentally mismatched to compound AI workloads, and propose a shift to program-level scheduling: treating the entire agent workflow (not individual inference calls) as the first-class schedulable unit. We present SAGA, a distributed scheduler that implements this abstraction through three mechanisms: (1) Agent Execution Graphs that capture workflow structure to predict KV cache reuse across tool-call boundaries, achieving within 1.31x of Bélády's optimal offline policy; (2) session-affinity batching with work stealing that co-locates correlated requests while maintaining global load balance; and (3) Agent Fair Share, a task-completion-time fairness metric with provable bounded-deviation guarantees. On a 64-GPU cluster serving SWE-bench coding agents and WebArena browser tasks, SAGA reduces task completion time by 1.64x (geometric mean, p < 0.001) over vLLM v0.15.1 with prefix caching and affinity routing, while improving GPU memory utilization by 1.22x and achieving 99.2% SLO attainment under multi-tenant interference. These latency gains come at a quantified cost: approximately 30% lower peak throughput than throughput-optimal batch scheduling, a tradeoff appropriate for the latency-sensitive interactive deployments that dominate compound AI usage. Our results demonstrate that workflow-aware scheduling is essential for efficient compound AI serving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI Agent执行链式LLM调用时现有GPU调度器视每个调用独立、导致延迟增加3-8x的问题，提出SAGA，将整个agent工作流作为调度单位。通过Agent Execution Graphs预测KV缓存重用、会话亲和性批处理与工作窃取、以及Agent Fair Share公平度量，在64-GPU集群上（SWE-bench和WebArena任务）将任务完成时间降低1.64倍（几何平均，p<0.001），GPU内存利用率提升1.22倍，多租户干扰下SLO达成率99.2%，但吞吐量降低约30%。
Motivation: 现有GPU调度器以请求为粒度调度LLM调用，丢弃了agent工作流步骤间的中间状态，导致端到端延迟膨胀3-8倍，与复合AI工作负载的需求不匹配。
Method: 提出程序级调度抽象SAGA，包含：(1) Agent Execution Graphs捕获工作流结构以预测工具调用边界上的KV缓存重用；(2) 会话亲和性批处理与工作窃取，关联请求共置并维持全局负载均衡；(3) Agent Fair Share，一种任务完成时间公平性度量，具有可证明的有界偏差保证。
Result: 在64-GPU集群上，相比vLLM v0.15.1（带前缀缓存和亲和路由），任务完成时间降低1.64倍（几何平均，p<0.001），GPU内存利用率提升1.22倍，多租户干扰下SLO达成率99.2%，但峰值吞吐量比吞吐最优的批调度低约30%。
Conclusion: 工作流感知调度对于高效复合AI服务至关重要，尤其适用于延迟敏感的交互式部署；延迟收益以吞吐量下降为代价，但该权衡适合主流场景。

papers.title: MoCapAnything V2: End-to-End Motion Capture for Arbitrary Skeletons
papers.abstract_en: Recent methods for arbitrary-skeleton motion capture from monocular video follow a factorized pipeline, where a Video-to-Pose network predicts joint positions and an analytical inverse-kinematics (IK) stage recovers joint rotations. While effective, this design is inherently limited, since joint positions do not fully determine rotations and leave degrees of freedom such as bone-axis twist ambiguous, and the non-differentiable IK stage prevents the system from adapting to noisy predictions or optimizing for the final animation objective. In this work, we present the first fully end-to-end framework in which both Video-to-Pose and Pose-to-Rotation are learnable and jointly optimized. We observe that the ambiguity in pose-to-rotation mapping arises from missing coordinate system information: the same joint positions can correspond to different rotations under different rest poses and local axis conventions. To resolve this, we introduce a reference pose-rotation pair from the target asset, which, together with the rest pose, not only anchors the mapping but also defines the underlying rotation coordinate system. This formulation turns rotation prediction into a well-constrained conditional problem and enables effective learning. In addition, our model predicts joint positions directly from video without relying on mesh intermediates, improving both robustness and efficiency. Both stages share a skeleton-aware Global-Local Graph-guided Multi-Head Attention (GL-GMHA) module for joint-level local reasoning and global coordination. Experiments on Truebones Zoo and Objaverse show that our method reduces rotation error from ~17 degrees to ~10 degrees, and to 6.54 degrees on unseen skeletons, while achieving ~20x faster inference than mesh-based pipelines. Project page: https://animotionlab.github.io/MoCapAnythingV2/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了首个面向任意骨架的单目视频运动捕捉全端到端框架，其中视频到姿态和姿态到旋转均为可学习模块并联合优化。通过引入目标资产的参考姿态-旋转对来消除姿态到旋转映射的歧义，并设计了骨架感知的全局-局部图引导多头注意力（GL-GMHA）模块。实验表明，该方法在Truebones Zoo和Objaverse上旋转误差从约17度降至约10度，在未见骨架上达到6.54度，推理速度比基于网格的管线快约20倍。
Motivation: 现有任意骨架运动捕捉方法采用分解管线，依赖非可微分的逆运动学（IK）阶段，导致关节位置到旋转的映射存在歧义（如骨轴扭转），且无法针对最终动画目标进行优化。
Method: 提出全端到端可学习框架，包括视频到姿态网络和姿态到旋转映射，后者通过引入参考姿态-旋转对将旋转预测转化为条件问题。两个阶段共享骨架感知的全局-局部图引导多头注意力（GL-GMHA）模块进行局部推理和全局协调。
Result: 在Truebones Zoo和Objaverse上，旋转误差从约17度降至约10度，在未见骨架上进一步降至6.54度；推理速度比基于网格的管线快约20倍。
Conclusion: 端到端框架有效解决了骨架旋转预测的歧义问题，实现了高精度和快速推理，且对未见骨架泛化良好。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Persuadability and LLMs as Legal Decision Tools
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are proposed as legal decision assistants, and even first-instance decision-makers, across a range of judicial and administrative contexts, it becomes essential to explore how they answer legal questions, and in particular the factors that lead them to decide difficult questions in one way or another. A specific feature of legal decisions is the need to respond to arguments advanced by contending parties. A legal decision-maker must be able to engage with, and respond to, including through being potentially persuaded by, arguments advanced by the parties. Conversely, they should not be unduly persuadable, influenced by a particularly compelling advocate to decide cases based on the skills of the advocates, rather than the merits of the case. We explore how frontier open- and closed-weights LLMs respond to legal arguments, reporting original experimental results examining how the quality of the advocate making those arguments affects the likelihood that a model will agree with a particular legal point of view, and exploring the factors driving these results. Our results have implications for the feasibility of adopting LLMs across legal and administrative settings.
papers.comment: Final version to appear in proceedings of 21st International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Law (ICAIL 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）作为法律决策辅助工具时，如何受到法律论证质量的影响。实验表明，前沿模型的回答倾向于被更有说服力的律师的论点所左右，这引发了对模型在法律设置中可靠性的担忧。
Motivation: 法律决策者需要回应当事方的论点，但不应被律师的说服技巧而非案情本身过度影响。现有研究缺乏对LLM在回应法律论证时是否易被说服的系统评估。
Method: 通过设计实验，向不同的开源和闭源LLM提供法律问题，并变化论证的质量（由不同水平的律师提出），测量模型同意特定法律观点的概率。
Result: 实验结果揭示了模型对论证质量的敏感性，高质量的律师论证显著提高了模型同意该观点的可能性。
Conclusion: 结果对在司法和行政环境中采用LLM作为决策工具提出了挑战，因为模型可能会被说服性论证而非案件实质所影响，需要进一步研究缓解策略。

papers.title: ServImage: An Image Generation and Editing Benchmark from Real-world Commercial Imaging Services
papers.abstract_en: Recent image generation and editing models demonstrate robust adherence to instructions and high visual quality on academic benchmarks. However, their performance on paid, real-world design projects remains uncertain. We introduce \textbf{ServImage}, a benchmark that explicitly correlates model outputs with economic value in commercial design projects. ServImage consists of (i) \textbf{\textit{ServImageBench}}: a dataset of 1.07k paid commercial design tasks and 2.05k designer deliverables totaling over \$295k, covering portrait, product, and digital content, along with 33k candidate images and 33k human annotations. (ii) \textbf{\textit{ServImageScore}}: an integrated scoring system that combines three quality dimensions: baseline requirements fulfilment, visual execution quality, and commercial necessity satisfaction. These three dimensions are designed to characterize the factors that drive human payment decisions and indicate whether an image is commercially acceptable. (iii) \textbf{\textit{ServImageModel}}: under this scoring system, we propose a payment prediction model trained on the human-annotated candidate images, achieving 82.00\% accuracy in predicting human payment decisions and producing calibrated payment probabilities. ServImage provides a comprehensive foundation for assessing the commercial viability of image generation models and offers a scalable resource for future research on economically grounded vision systems \href{https://github.com/FengxianJi/ServImage}{Github.}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ServImage 基准，用于评估图像生成与编辑模型在真实商业设计项目中的经济价值。基准包含付费任务数据集（总价值超29.5万美元）、三维度评分系统（基线需求、视觉执行、商业必要性）以及支付预测模型，后者在预测人类支付决策上达到82.00%准确率。
Motivation: 现有学术基准无法反映模型在真实付费商业设计项目中的表现，缺乏与经济效益的直接关联。
Method: 构建包含1.07k付费任务、2.05k设计师交付物、33k候选图像和33k人工标注的数据集；设计三维度评分系统；训练支付预测模型。
Result: 支付预测模型在预测人类支付决策上达到82.00%准确率，并输出校准后的支付概率。
Conclusion: ServImage 为评估图像生成模型的商业可行性提供了基础，并为经济导向视觉系统研究提供可扩展资源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Disentangling Linguistic Relatedness from Task Alignment in Cross-Lingual Transfer
papers.abstract_en: We study cross-lingual transfer by fine-tuning seven large language models (4B--671B parameters) on Arabic and evaluating zero-shot reading comprehension on Semitic languages and non-Semitic controls. Across dense and Mixture-of-Experts architectures, we find no evidence of Semitic-specific transfer: models with weak baselines improve dramatically across all languages, while strong-baseline models show only marginal gains regardless of language family. A chain-of-thought ablation reinforces this finding -- the same models that benefit most from fine-tuning benefit equally from inference-time reasoning, suggesting both mechanisms address task-format alignment rather than cross-lingual knowledge transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文通过微调7个大语言模型（4B--671B参数）在阿拉伯语上，评估对闪语族和非闪语族的零样本阅读理解表现，发现没有闪语特异性迁移的证据。弱基线模型在所有语言上大幅改进，而强基线模型仅获得边际收益。链式思维消融进一步表明，微调和推理时推理都主要解决任务格式对齐而非跨语言知识迁移。
Motivation: 研究跨语言迁移中语言相关性与任务对齐的作用，探究微调是否真正促进语言间知识迁移。
Method: 微调7个不同规模和架构的大语言模型（包括密集和MoE）在阿拉伯语上，然后在闪语族和非闪语族语言上进行零样本评估，并进行链式思维消融实验。
Result: 没有发现闪语族特异性迁移；弱基线模型在所有语言上显著提升，强基线模型增益有限；链式思维消融表明微调和推理时推理都主要改善任务格式对齐。
Conclusion: 跨语言迁移中的收益主要来自任务格式对齐而非语言间知识迁移，对跨语言迁移研究具有启示意义。

papers.title: Sink-Token-Aware Pruning for Fine-Grained Video Understanding in Efficient Video LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) incur high inference latency due to a large number of visual tokens provided to LLMs. To address this, training-free visual token pruning has emerged as a solution to reduce computational costs; however, existing methods are primarily validated on Multiple-Choice Question Answering (MCQA) benchmarks, where coarse-grained cues often suffice. In this work, we reveal that these methods suffer a sharp performance collapse on fine-grained understanding tasks requiring precise visual grounding, such as hallucination evaluation. To explore this gap, we conduct a systematic analysis and identify sink tokens--semantically uninformative tokens that attract excessive attention--as a key obstacle to fine-grained video understanding. When these sink tokens survive pruning, they distort the model's visual evidence and hinder fine-grained understanding. Motivated by these insights, we propose Sink-Token-aware Pruning (SToP), a simple yet effective plug-and-play method that introduces a sink score to quantify each token's tendency to behave as a sink and applies this score to existing spatial and temporal pruning methods to suppress them, thereby enhancing video understanding. To validate the effectiveness of SToP, we apply it to state-of-the-art pruning methods (VisionZip, FastVid, and Holitom) and evaluate it across diverse benchmarks covering hallucination, open-ended generation, compositional reasoning, and MCQA. Our results demonstrate that SToP significantly boosts performance, even when pruning up to 90% of visual tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示现有训练无关的视觉token剪枝方法在细粒度视频理解任务上性能严重下降，识别出“sink tokens”（语义无信息但吸引过多注意力的token）是主要障碍，并提出Sink-Token-aware剪枝（SToP），通过引入sink分数量化并抑制sink token。在多个剪枝方法（VisionZip、FastVid、Holitom）上应用SToP，在幻觉评估、开放生成、组合推理和MCQA等基准上显著提升性能，即使剪掉90%的视觉token。
Motivation: 现有训练无关视觉token剪枝方法在需要精确定位的细粒度任务（如幻觉评估）上性能急剧下降，缺乏对此问题的系统分析与解决方案。
Method: 提出SToP，一种即插即用方法，通过计算每个token的sink分数（衡量其作为sink token的倾向），并应用于现有空间和时间剪枝方法中，以抑制sink token，从而增强细粒度视频理解。
Result: 在VisionZip、FastVid、Holitom等多种剪枝方法上应用SToP，在幻觉、开放生成、组合推理和MCQA基准上均显著提升性能，即使在剪掉90%视觉token时仍能保持或提升效果。
Conclusion: SToP是一种简单有效的即插即用方法，能有效抑制sink token，显著提升视频LLM在细粒度任务上的表现，且兼容多种现有剪枝方法。

papers.title: FSEVAL: Feature Selection Evaluation Toolbox and Dashboard
papers.abstract_en: Feature selection is a fundamental machine learning and data mining task, involved with discriminating redundant features from informative ones. It is an attempt to address the curse of dimensionality by removing the redundant features, while unlike dimensionality reduction methods, preserving explainability. Feature selection is conducted in both supervised and unsupervised settings, with different evaluation metrics employed to determine which feature selection algorithm is the best. In this paper, we propose FSEVAL, a feature selection evaluation toolbox accompanied with a visualization dashboard, with the goal to make it easy to comprehensively evaluate feature selection algorithms. FSEVAL aims to provide a standardized, unified, evaluation and visualization toolbox to help the researchers working in the field, conduct extensive and comprehensive evaluation of feature selection algorithms with ease.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FSEVAL，一个特征选择评估工具箱和可视化仪表盘，旨在标准化和统一特征选择算法的评估过程，支持监督和无监督设置下的多种评估指标。
Motivation: 特征选择是机器学习和数据挖掘的基本任务，但目前缺乏标准化的评估工具，使得不同算法之间的比较困难且不系统。
Method: 开发FSEVAL工具箱，包含一个可视化仪表盘，集成多种评估指标，覆盖监督和无监督特征选择场景，提供统一的评估接口。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，主要介绍FSEVAL的设计目标和功能。
Conclusion: FSEVAL旨在帮助研究人员便捷地进行全面、标准化的特征选择算法评估，促进该领域的可复现性和可比性。

papers.title: Understanding U.S. Users' Security and Privacy Transparency Needs for Consumer-Facing Generative AI
papers.abstract_en: Users increasingly rely on consumer-facing generative AI (GenAI) for tasks ranging from everyday needs to sensitive use cases. Yet, it remains unclear whether and how existing security and privacy (S&P) communications in GenAI tools shape users' adoption decisions and experiences. Understanding how users seek, interpret, and evaluate S&P information is critical for designing usable transparency that users can trust and act on. We conducted semi-structured interviews and design sessions with 21 U.S. GenAI users. Our findings suggest that available S&P information rarely drove initial adoption in practice, as participants often perceived it as incomplete, ineffective, or not credible. Instead, they relied on rough proxies (e.g., popularity) to infer S&P practices. After adoption, S&P uncertainty constrained participants' willingness to use GenAI tools, especially for high-stakes purposes, and, in some cases, contributed to discontinued use. Participants therefore called for transparency that supports decisions and actions through trustworthy information (e.g., independent evaluations) and usable interfaces (e.g., on-demand disclosure). We categorize participants' desired design practices into five dimensions to facilitate systematic future investigation into best practices. We conclude with recommendations for researchers, designers, and policymakers to improve S&P transparency in consumer-facing GenAI.
papers.comment: To Appear at the Twenty-Second Symposium on Usable Privacy and Security (SOUPS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过半结构化访谈和设计会话，研究了美国用户对生成式AI工具的安全与隐私透明度需求。研究发现现有安全与隐私信息很少驱动用户初始采纳，用户常依赖流行度等粗略代理推断安全实践，且安全与隐私不确定性限制了高风险场景的使用甚至导致弃用。用户期望通过可信信息（如独立评估）和可用界面（如按需披露）获得可支持决策的透明度。作者将期望的设计实践归纳为五个维度，并提出改进建议。
Motivation: 现有生成式AI工具的安全与隐私沟通是否影响用户采纳决策和体验尚不明确，理解用户如何寻找、解读和评估安全与隐私信息对设计可信任的透明度至关重要。
Method: 对21名美国GenAI用户进行半结构化访谈和设计会话，收集用户对安全与隐私透明度的看法和设计偏好。
Result: 现有安全与隐私信息很少驱动初始采纳，用户认为其不完整、无效或不可信；用户依赖流行度等粗略代理；安全与隐私不确定性限制了高风险使用甚至导致弃用。
Conclusion: 用户期望通过独立评估等可信信息和按需披露等可用界面获得透明度；作者将设计实践归纳为五个维度，并为研究人员、设计师和政策制定者提出改进安全与隐私透明度的建议。

papers.title: HRDexDB: A Paired Human-Robot Dataset for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasping
papers.abstract_en: We present HRDexDB, a paired cross-embodiment dexterous grasping dataset of high-fidelity dexterous grasping sequences featuring both human and diverse robotic hands. Unlike existing datasets, HRDexDB provides a comprehensive collection of grasping trajectories across human hands and multiple robot hand embodiments, spanning 100 diverse objects. Leveraging state-of-the-art vision methods and a dedicated multi-camera system, HRDexDB offers high-precision spatiotemporal 3D ground-truth motion for both the agent and the manipulated object. The dataset comprises 2.1K grasping trials, each enriched with synchronized visual and kinematic modalities, with contact-force signals available for tactile-enabled robotic hands. By providing closely aligned captures of human dexterity and robotic execution on the same target objects under comparable grasping motions, HRDexDB serves as a foundational benchmark for cross-embodiment dexterous manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HRDexDB，一个配对跨具身灵巧抓取数据集，包含人类和多种机器人手的高保真抓取序列，覆盖 100 个物体、2.1K 次抓取试验，提供同步视觉、运动学和触觉信号。该数据集旨在作为跨具身灵巧操作的基准。
Motivation: 现有灵巧抓取数据集缺乏人类与多种机器人手在相同物体和类似运动下的配对数据，限制了跨具身抓取研究。
Method: 利用先进视觉方法和专用多摄像机系统，采集人类和机器人手的抓取轨迹，提供高精度时空 3D 真值运动，并同步多模态数据。
Result: 数据集包含 2.1K 次抓取试验，100 个物体，涵盖多种手部形态，并提供触觉信号（对于触觉感知机器人手）。
Conclusion: HRDexDB 可作为跨具身灵巧操作的基准数据集，促进人机协作和机器人抓取泛化研究。

papers.title: An AI Co-Data-Scientist for Prioritizing Candidate Biomarkers from Wearable Sensor Data
papers.abstract_en: Wearable devices generate continuous physiological and behavioral data, but converting these signals into clinically reviewable biomarker hypotheses remains labor-intensive. We introduce CoDaS, an AI co-data-scientist that integrates multi-agent hypothesis generation, deterministic statistical analysis, adversarial validation and literature-grounded interpretation under human oversight. Across three wearable cohorts comprising 9,279 participant-observations, CoDaS prioritized candidate associations for mental-health and metabolic endpoints after internal checks for replication, stability, robustness and leakage. The system identified related circadian-instability signals associated with depression, including sleep-duration variability in DWB ($ρ$ = 0.252, $p$ < 0.001) and sleep-onset variability in GLOBEM ($ρ$ = 0.126, $p$ < 0.001), and derived a wearable cardiovascular-fitness index associated with insulin resistance (steps/resting heart rate; $ρ$ = -0.374, $p$ < 0.001). Adding these features to demographic models produced modest gains ($ΔR^2$ = 0.040 for depression, 0.021 for insulin resistance). In a 12-clinician review totaling approximately 25 active hours, clinician validity judgments aligned with CoDaS confidence tiers ($ρ$ = 0.67, $p$ = 0.005), whereas added clinical value and confidence to act were rated lower. CoDaS supports traceable, hypothesis-generating prioritization of wearable candidate biomarkers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoDaS，一个结合多智能体假设生成、确定性统计分析、对抗验证和文献解释的 AI 联合数据科学家系统，用于从可穿戴传感器数据中优先排序候选生物标志物。在三个可穿戴队列（共 9279 参与者-观察）中，系统识别了与抑郁相关的昼夜节律不稳定信号（如睡眠时长变异性和入睡时间变异性）以及与胰岛素抵抗相关的可穿戴心血管健康指数。12 名临床医生的审查显示，其有效性判断与 CoDaS 的置信层级高度一致（ρ=0.67）。
Motivation: 将可穿戴设备生成的连续生理和行为数据转化为可供临床审查的生物标志物假设通常耗时且费力，需要自动化方法来加速这一过程。
Method: CoDaS 采用多智能体假设生成框架，结合确定性统计分析、对抗验证和文献解释，并在人类监督下运行。系统经过复制性、稳定性、鲁棒性和泄漏测试的内部检查。
Result: 在三个可穿戴队列中，系统识别了与抑郁相关的睡眠时长变异性和入睡时间变异性，以及可穿戴心血管健康指数（步数/静息心率）与胰岛素抵抗的关联。将这些特征加入人口统计学模型后，抑郁的 ΔR²=0.040，胰岛素抵抗的 ΔR²=0.021。临床医生审查中，有效性判断与 CoDaS 置信层级的相关系数为 0.67。
Conclusion: CoDaS 能够在人类监督下可追溯地生成假设，并优先排序可穿戴候选生物标志物，但临床附加价值和行动信心评分较低，表明其当前更适合早期筛选而非独立临床决策。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Behavior Cloning Under PD Control: A Finite-Horizon Theory of Gain-Dependent Error Amplification
papers.abstract_en: Behavior cloning (BC) on position-controlled robots is shaped by the PD loop that executes policy actions. We give a finite-horizon, nonasymptotic analysis of how controller gains affect BC failure. Independent sub-Gaussian action errors propagate through gain-dependent closed-loop dynamics into sub-Gaussian position errors. The resulting failure tail is controlled by controller amplification multiplied by validation loss and generalization slack, so validation loss alone can mis-rank gains. Under shape-preserving upper-bound assumptions, the analysis separates label difficulty, injection strength, and contraction, ranking compliant-overdamped gains as tightest and stiff-underdamped gains as loosest, with the mixed regimes system-dependent. In the canonical scalar second-order PD system, stationary position-error variance increases with stiffness and decreases with damping over the stable range, and exact zero-order-hold discretization inherits the ordering to leading order. This extends the error-attenuation explanation of bronars et al. (2026) to finite-horizon failure bounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对位置控制机器人中PD控制器增益对行为克隆（BC）失败的影响，提出有限时域非渐近分析理论。摘要指出，独立亚高斯动作误差通过增益依赖的闭环动力学传播为位置误差，失效尾部受控制器放大倍数、验证损失和泛化差距共同控制。在标量二阶PD系统中，稳态位置误差方差随刚度增加、阻尼减小而增大，且零阶保持离散化继承该排序。
Motivation: 现有行为克隆方法在位置控制机器人中受PD回路影响，但控制器增益如何导致失败尚不明确。验证损失单独无法正确排序增益，需要理论理解增益依赖的误差放大机制。
Method: 通过亚高斯动作误差在增益依赖闭环动力学下的传播分析，构建有限时域失效上界，利用控制器放大倍数量化误差放大，并采用保形上界假设分离标签难度、注入强度和收缩。
Result: 推导出稳态位置误差方差与刚度正相关、与阻尼负相关；增益排序中，阻尼过紧（compliant-overdamped）增益最紧，刚性欠阻尼（stiff-underdamped）增益最松，混合区间系统依赖。
Conclusion: 将bronars等人(2026)的误差衰减解释扩展到有限时域失效边界，为PD增益选择提供理论指导。

papers.title: A Physics-Informed, Behavior-Aware Digital Twin for Robust Multimodal Forecasting of Core Body Temperature in Precision Livestock Farming
papers.abstract_en: Precision livestock farming requires accurate and timely heat stress prediction to ensure animal welfare and optimize farm management. This study presents a physics-informed digital twin (DT) framework combined with an uncertainty-aware, expert-weighted stacked ensemble for multimodal forecasting of Core Body Temperature (CBT) in dairy cattle. Using the high-frequency, heterogeneous MmCows dataset, the DT integrates an ordinary differential equation (ODE)-based thermoregulation model that simulates metabolic heat production and dissipation, a Gaussian process for capturing cow-specific deviations, a Kalman filter for aligning predictions with real-time sensor data, and a behavioral Markov chain that models activity-state transitions under varying environmental conditions. The DT outputs key physiological indicators, such as predicted CBT, heat stress probability, and behavioral state distributions are fused with raw sensor data and enriched through multi-scale temporal analysis and cross-modal feature engineering to form a comprehensive feature set. The predictive methodology is designed in a three-stage stacked ensemble, where stage 1 trains modality-specific LightGBM 'expert' models on distinct feature groups, stage 2 collects their predictions as meta-features, and at stage 3 Optuna-tuned LightGBM meta-model yields the final CBT forecast. Predictive uncertainty is quantified via bootstrapping and validated using Prediction Interval Coverage Probability (PICP). Ablation analysis confirms that incorporating DT-derived features and multimodal fusion substantially enhances performance. The proposed framework achieves a cross-validated R2 of 0.783, F1 score of 84.25% and PICP of 92.38% for 2-hour ahead forecasting, providing a robust, uncertainty-aware, and physically principled system for early heat stress detection and precision livestock management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个物理信息数字孪生框架，结合不确定性感知的专家加权堆叠集成模型，用于精准畜牧业中奶牛核心体温的多模态预测。在MmCows数据集上，该框架集成ODE热调节模型、高斯过程、卡尔曼滤波和行为马尔可夫链，并采用三阶段堆叠集成（LightGBM专家模型、元特征、Optuna调优元模型），通过自举法量化不确定性。2小时前预测的交叉验证R²为0.783，F1分数84.25%，PICP为92.38%。
Motivation: 精准畜牧业需要准确及时的热应激预测以确保动物福利和优化农场管理。
Method: 提出物理信息数字孪生框架，包含ODE热调节模型、高斯过程捕获个体偏差、卡尔曼滤波对齐实时传感器数据、行为马尔可夫链建模活动状态转移。输出与原始传感器数据融合，经多尺度时间分析和跨模态特征工程，输入三阶段堆叠集成：阶段1训练模态特定LightGBM专家模型，阶段2收集预测作为元特征，阶段3用Optuna调优的LightGBM元模型输出最终预测。不确定性通过自举法和PICP验证。
Result: 2小时前预测的交叉验证R²为0.783，F1分数84.25%，PICP为92.38%。消融分析证实引入数字孪生特征和多模态融合显著提升性能。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了鲁棒、不确定性感知且物理原则的系统，适用于早期热应激检测和精准畜牧管理。

papers.title: How Your Credentials Are Leaked by LLM Agent Skills: An Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on third-party skills that operate within privileged execution environments and routinely handle sensitive credentials, yet how these credentials are leaked remains largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we present the first large-scale empirical study on credential leakage in agent skills. From 170,226 artifacts on SkillsMP, the largest open-source skill marketplace, we sampled 17,022 skills via stratified random sampling and analyzed each through static secret extraction (regex and AST parsing), dynamic sandbox testing with mock credentials, and cross-referencing developer intent against runtime behavior. Our analysis identifies 520 affected skills containing 1,708 security issues, and yields a taxonomy of 10 leakage patterns. Three findings stand out. First, 76.3% of cases require jointly analyzing natural-language descriptions and programming logic, showing that credential exposure in skills is fundamentally cross-modal. Second, debug logging accounts for 73.5% of vulnerabilities because agent frameworks feed stdout into the LLM context window, turning routine debugging into a credential exposure vector. Third, 89.6% of leaked credentials are immediately exploitable -- 92.5% during routine execution without elevated privileges -- and the fork-based distribution model defeats remediation, as secrets removed from 107 upstream repositories persist across 50+ independent forks. Following responsible disclosure, all malicious skills have been removed and 91.6% of hardcoded cases remediated. We release our dataset, taxonomy, and detection pipeline to support future agent security research.
papers.comment: Accepted to ASE 2026 (The 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对LLM Agent第三方技能中凭证泄露的首项大规模实证研究。从SkillsMP市场170,226个技能中分层抽样17,022个，结合静态秘密提取、动态沙箱测试和意图交叉引用，识别520个受影响技能，总结10种泄露模式。关键发现：76.3%泄露需跨模态分析，73.5%源于调试日志，89.6%可立即利用，且fork分发模型导致修复困难。
Motivation: LLM Agent日益依赖第三方技能处理敏感凭证，但凭证如何在实际场景中泄露缺乏系统研究。
Method: 分层随机抽样17226个技能，采用静态秘密提取（正则+AST）、动态沙箱测试（模拟凭证）以及开发者意图与运行时行为的交叉引用分析。
Result: 识别520个受影响技能（共1708个安全问题），总结10种泄露模式。76.3%需联合分析文本与代码；73.5%由调试日志导致；89.6%可立即利用，其中92.5%在常规执行下即可触发。责任披露后，所有恶意技能被移除，91.6%硬编码案例已修复。
Conclusion: 揭示了凭证泄露的跨模态本质、调试日志作为主要暴露向量，以及fork分发模式对修复的阻碍。开源了数据集、分类法和检测管线以支持后续研究。

papers.title: CogFormer: Learn All Your Models Once
papers.abstract_en: Simulation-based inference (SBI) with neural networks has accelerated and transformed cognitive modeling workflows. SBI enables modelers to fit complex models that were previously difficult or impossible to estimate, while also allowing rapid estimation across large numbers of datasets. However, the utility of SBI for iterating over varying modeling assumptions remains limited: changes to parameterizations, generative functions, priors, and design variables all necessitate model retraining, thereby diminishing the benefits of amortization. To address these issues, we pilot the CogFormer, a meta-amortized framework for cognitive modeling. Our framework trains a transformer-based architecture that remains valid across a combinatorial number of structurally similar models, allowing for changing data types, parameters, design matrices, and sample sizes. We present promising quantitative results across families of decision-making models for binary, multi-alternative, and continuous responses. Our evaluation suggests that CogFormer can accurately estimate parameters across model families with minimal amortization offset, making it a potentially powerful engine that catalyzes cognitive modeling workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CogFormer，一种用于认知建模的元摊销框架，基于Transformer架构，可在大量结构相似的模型之间泛化，无需为每个变体重新训练。摘要展示了在二元、多选择和连续响应决策模型上的参数估计准确性，并声称最小化摊销偏移。
Motivation: 现有的基于神经网络的仿真推断（SBI）在认知建模中需要为每个参数化、生成函数、先验或设计变量变化重新训练模型，限制了摊销效率。
Method: 提出CogFormer，一个元摊销框架，训练一个Transformer架构，使其在多种结构相似的模型上保持有效，能处理变化的数据类型、参数、设计矩阵和样本量。
Result: 在二元、多选择和连续响应的决策模型族上，CogFormer能准确估计参数，且摊销偏移极小。
Conclusion: CogFormer有望成为加速认知建模工作流的强大引擎，但当前仍处于试验阶段。

papers.title: Revisiting OmniAnomaly for Anomaly Detection: performance metrics and comparison with PCA-based models
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models have become the dominant approach for multivariate time series anomaly detection (MTSAD), often reporting substantial performance improvements over classical statistical methods. However, these gains are frequently evaluated under heterogeneous thresholding strategies and evaluation protocols, making fair comparisons difficult. This work revisits OmniAnomaly, a widely used stochastic recurrent model for MTSAD, and systematically compares it with a simple linear baseline based on Principal Component Analysis (PCA) on the Server Machine Dataset (SMD). Both methods are evaluated under identical thresholding and evaluation procedures, with experiments repeated across 100 runs for each of the 28 machines in the dataset. Performance is evaluated using Precision, Recall and F1-score at point-level, with and without point-adjustment, and under different aggregation strategies across machines and runs, with the corresponding standard deviations also reported. The results show large variability across machines and show that PCA can achieve performance comparable to OmniAnomaly, and even outperform it when point-adjustment is not applied. These findings question the added value of more complex architectures under current benchmarking practices and highlight the critical role of evaluation methodology in MTSAD research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文重新审视了OmniAnomaly在多变量时间序列异常检测中的表现，并与基于PCA的简单线性基线进行系统比较。在服务器机器数据集（SMD）上使用相同的阈值和评估程序，发现PCA可以达到与OmniAnomaly相当甚至更优的性能，质疑了复杂架构的附加价值。
Motivation: 当前深度学习模型在MTSAD中常报告显著改进，但评估协议和阈值策略不统一，难以公平比较。论文旨在通过严格的对比实验检验OmniAnomaly的真实优势。
Method: 将OmniAnomaly与PCA基线在SMD数据集上，对28个机器各进行100次重复实验，采用相同的阈值和评估流程，计算Precision、Recall、F1-score，包括点调整和未调整的情况。
Result: 结果显示各机器间性能差异大，PCA在无点调整时可以达到甚至超过OmniAnomaly的性能。
Conclusion: 当前基准测试实践可能高估了复杂架构的价值，评估方法学在MTSAD研究中至关重要。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: You've Got a Golden Ticket: Improving Generative Robot Policies With A Single Noise Vector
papers.abstract_en: What happens when a pretrained generative robot policy is provided a constant initial noise as input, rather than repeatedly sampling it from a Gaussian? We demonstrate that the performance of a pretrained, frozen diffusion or flow matching policy can be improved with respect to a downstream reward by swapping the sampling of initial noise from the prior distribution (typically isotropic Gaussian) with a well-chosen, constant initial noise input - a golden ticket. We propose simple search methods to find golden tickets using Monte-Carlo policy evaluation that keeps the pretrained policy frozen, does not train any new networks, and is applicable to all diffusion/flow matching policies (and therefore many VLAs). Our approach to policy improvement makes no assumptions beyond being able to inject initial noise into the policy and calculate (sparse) task rewards of episode rollouts, making it deployable with no additional infrastructure or models. Our method improves the performance of policies in 46 out of 51 tasks across simulated and real-world robot manipulation benchmarks, with absolute improvements in success rate by up to 55% for some simulated tasks, and 28% within 60 search episodes for real-world tasks. Our approach naturally extends to multi-task settings, where we improve the average performance of a VLA policy across 7 tasks by 14% using a single noise vector. Further, we find that, a golden ticket optimized for one task can also boost performance in other related tasks for the same VLA policy. We release a codebase with pretrained policies and golden tickets for simulation benchmarks using VLAs, diffusion policies, and flow matching policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现，为预训练的生成式机器人策略（如扩散策略或流匹配策略）提供一个精心选择的恒定初始噪声向量（称为“金票”），而不是从高斯分布中反复采样，可以提升下游奖励的性能。作者提出使用蒙特卡洛策略评估的简单搜索方法来寻找金票，无需额外训练或基础设施，在46/51个模拟和真实机器人操作任务中提高了成功率，最高提升55%（模拟）和28%（真实，60次搜索）。
Motivation: 预训练生成式策略通常从随机噪声中采样，但不同的初始噪声会导致不同的策略输出，可能有些噪声向量能产生更好的表现。本文旨在探索是否可以通过选择一个恒定噪声输入来改进策略性能，而不改变策略本身。
Method: 提出基于蒙特卡洛策略评估的搜索方法，在预训练、冻结的扩散或流匹配策略中固定初始噪声输入，通过评估任务奖励来优化噪声向量，不训练任何新网络。

Conclusion: 恒定初始噪声（金票）可以有效提升预训练生成式机器人策略的性能，方法简单且无需额外模型，并可跨任务迁移。

papers.title: Localizing and Editing Knowledge in Large Audio-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) have shown strong performance in speech understanding, making speech a natural interface for accessing factual information. Yet they are trained on static corpora and may encode incorrect facts. Existing model editing methods localize and update facts in text-only LLMs, but do not account for continuous speech representations, or where knowledge is stored across acoustic or language modules, or their cross-modal module. We construct the first audio benchmark for knowledge localization and editing in LALMs and propose a speech-driven locate-then-edit framework. First, we use speech-aware causal tracing to localize layers and modules that support factual retrieval and then apply editing at identified sites. Experiments show that factual knowledge is jointly encoded in audio and text modules, and that audio editing yields more effective updates than text editing or fine-tuning, enabling fine-grained knowledge control in speech AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次构建了大型音频语言模型（LALMs）知识定位与编辑的音频基准，并提出了一种基于语音的定位-编辑框架。通过语音感知因果追踪定位支持事实检索的层和模块，然后在识别的位置进行编辑。实验表明，事实知识共同编码在音频和文本模块中，音频编辑比文本编辑或微调更有效，实现了对语音AI系统中知识的细粒度控制。
Motivation: 现有模型编辑方法仅适用于纯文本LLM，无法处理连续的语音表示，也不清楚知识存储在声学模块、语言模块还是跨模态模块中。
Method: 构建首个音频知识定位与编辑基准，提出语音驱动的定位-编辑框架：先使用语音感知因果追踪定位支持事实检索的层和模块，再在识别位置进行编辑。
Result: 实验发现事实知识共同编码在音频和文本模块中，音频编辑比文本编辑或微调更有效，能实现细粒度的知识控制。
Conclusion: 音频编辑为语音AI系统中的知识控制提供了更有效的手段，该框架有助于修正LALMs中的错误事实。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PicoSAM3: Real-Time In-Sensor Region-of-Interest Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Real-time, on-device segmentation is critical for latency-sensitive and privacy-aware applications such as smart glasses and Internet-of-Things devices. We introduce PicoSAM3, a lightweight promptable visual segmentation model optimized for edge and in-sensor execution, including deployment on the Sony IMX500 vision sensor. PicoSAM3 has 1.3M parameters and combines a dense CNN architecture with region of interest prompt encoding, Efficient Channel Attention, and knowledge distillation from SAM2 and SAM3. On COCO and LVIS, PicoSAM3 achieves 65.45% and 64.01% mIoU, respectively, outperforming existing SAM-based and edge-oriented baselines at similar or lower complexity. The INT8 quantized model preserves accuracy with negligible degradation while enabling real-time in-sensor inference at 11.82ms latency on the IMX500, fully complying with its memory and operator constraints. Ablation studies show that distillation from large SAM models yields up to +14.5% mIoU improvement over supervised training and demonstrate that high-quality, spatially flexible promptable segmentation is feasible directly at the sensor level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PicoSAM3是一种轻量级可提示分割模型，仅1.3M参数，结合密集CNN架构、区域关注提示编码和高效通道注意力，并通过知识蒸馏从SAM2和SAM3中学习。在COCO和LVIS上分别达到65.45%和64.01% mIoU，INT8量化后在Sony IMX500传感器上实现11.82ms实时推理，满足内存和算子约束。
Motivation: 现有分割模型难以在资源受限的边缘设备（如智能眼镜、IoT设备）上实现实时、低延迟、保护隐私的推理，同时保持高质量的可提示分割能力。
Method: 提出PicoSAM3，采用密集CNN架构，融合区域关注提示编码和高效通道注意力机制；通过知识蒸馏从大型SAM2和SAM3模型迁移知识；支持INT8量化部署于Sony IMX500视觉传感器。
Result: COCO上mIoU 65.45%，LVIS上mIoU 64.01%，超出同类SAM基线和边缘基线；量化后精度损失可忽略，在IMX500上延迟11.82ms；蒸馏带来最高+14.5% mIoU提升。
Conclusion: 证明了在传感器级实现高质量、空间灵活的可提示分割是可行的，为边缘设备上的实时分割提供了高效方案。

papers.title: Harf-Speech: A Clinically Aligned Framework for Arabic Phoneme-Level Speech Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Automated phoneme-level pronunciation assessment is vital for scalable speech therapy and language learning, yet validated tools for Arabic remain scarce. We present Harf-Speech, a modular system scoring Arabic pronunciation at the phoneme level on a clinical scale. It combines an MSA phonetizer, a fine-tuned speech-to-phoneme model, Levenshtein alignment, and a blended scorer using longest common subsequence and edit-distance metrics. We fine-tune three ASR architectures on Arabic phoneme data and benchmark them with zero-shot multimodal models; the best, OmniASR-CTC-1B-v2, achieves 8.92% phoneme error rate. Three certified speech-language pathologists independently scored 40 utterances for clinical validation. Harf-Speech attains a Pearson correlation of 0.791 and ICC(2,1) of 0.659 with mean expert scores, outperforming existing end-to-end assessment frameworks. These results show Harf-Speech yields clinically aligned, interpretable scores comparable to inter-rater expert agreement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Harf-Speech，一个针对阿拉伯语进行音素级别发音评估的模块化系统。该系统结合MSA音素化器、微调语音到音素模型、Levenshtein对齐以及基于最长公共子序列和编辑距离的混合评分器。在三个ASR架构中，最佳模型OmniASR-CTC-1B-v2达到8.92%的音素错误率。经三位认证语言病理学家对40条语音进行临床验证，Harf-Speech与专家平均评分的Pearson相关系数为0.791，ICC(2,1)为0.659，优于现有端到端评估框架。
Motivation: 自动音素级别发音评估对可扩展的言语治疗和语言学习至关重要，但针对阿拉伯语的验证工具稀缺。
Method: 提出模块化系统，包含MSA音素化器、微调语音到音素模型、Levenshtein对齐以及结合最长公共子序列和编辑距离指标的混合评分器。在阿拉伯语音素数据上微调三种ASR架构，并与零样本多模态模型进行对比。
Result: 最佳模型OmniASR-CTC-1B-v2音素错误率为8.92%。临床验证中，Harf-Speech与专家评分平均值的Pearson相关系数为0.791，ICC(2,1)为0.659，性能优于现有端到端评估框架。
Conclusion: Harf-Speech产生临床对齐且可解释的评分，其一致性接近专家间信度。

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Anatomical Guidance for Text-to-CT Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-conditioned generative models for volumetric medical imaging provide semantic control but lack explicit anatomical guidance, often resulting in outputs that are spatially ambiguous or anatomically inconsistent. In contrast, structure-driven methods ensure strong anatomical consistency but typically assume access to ground-truth annotations, which are unavailable when the target image is to be synthesized. We propose a retrieval-augmented approach for Text-to-CT generation that integrates semantic and anatomical information under a realistic inference setting. Given a radiology report, our method retrieves a semantically related clinical case using a 3D vision-language encoder and leverages its associated anatomical annotation as a structural proxy. This proxy is injected into a text-conditioned latent diffusion model via a ControlNet branch, providing coarse anatomical guidance while maintaining semantic flexibility. Experiments on the CT-RATE dataset show that retrieval-augmented generation improves image fidelity and clinical consistency compared to text-only baselines, while additionally enabling explicit spatial controllability, a capability inherently absent in such approaches. Further analysis highlights the importance of retrieval quality, with semantically aligned proxies yielding consistent gains across all evaluation axes. This work introduces a principled and scalable mechanism to bridge semantic conditioning and anatomical plausibility in volumetric medical image synthesis. Code is available at https://github.com/arco-group/RAGText2CT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种检索增强的文本到CT生成方法，通过3D视觉语言编码器检索与放射报告相关的临床案例，将其解剖标注作为结构代理，经ControlNet注入文本条件潜在扩散模型，实现解剖引导下的体素图像生成。在CT-RATE数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比纯文本基线提升了图像保真度和临床一致性，并赋予显式的空间可控性。
Motivation: 文本条件生成模型缺乏显式解剖引导，导致输出空间模糊或解剖不一致；而结构驱动方法依赖真实标注，在目标图像合成时不可得。
Method: 给定放射报告，使用3D视觉语言编码器检索语义相关的临床案例，提取其解剖标注作为结构代理，通过ControlNet分支注入到文本条件潜在扩散模型中。
Result: 在CT-RATE数据集上，检索增强生成相比纯文本基线提升了图像保真度和临床一致性，并额外实现了空间可控性。进一步分析表明，语义对齐的代理在所有评估维度上带来持续增益。
Conclusion: 该方法在语义条件和解剖合理性之间提供了可扩展的桥接机制，适用于体积医学图像合成。

papers.title: Skeleton-to-Image Encoding: Enabling Skeleton Representation Learning via Vision-Pretrained Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large-scale pretrained vision models have demonstrated impressive capabilities across a wide range of downstream tasks, including cross-modal and multi-modal scenarios. However, their direct application to 3D human skeleton data remains challenging due to fundamental differences in data format. Moreover, the scarcity of large-scale skeleton datasets and the need to incorporate skeleton data into multi-modal action recognition without introducing additional model branches present significant research opportunities. To address these challenges, we introduce Skeleton-to-Image Encoding (S2I), a novel representation that transforms skeleton sequences into image-like data by partitioning and arranging joints based on body-part semantics and resizing to standardized image dimensions. This encoding enables, for the first time, the use of powerful vision-pretrained models for self-supervised skeleton representation learning, effectively transferring rich visual-domain knowledge to skeleton analysis. While existing skeleton methods often design models tailored to specific, homogeneous skeleton formats, they overlook the structural heterogeneity that naturally arises from diverse data sources. In contrast, our S2I representation offers a unified image-like format that naturally accommodates heterogeneous skeleton data. Extensive experiments on NTU-60, NTU-120, and PKU-MMD demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our method for self-supervised skeleton representation learning, including under challenging cross-format evaluation settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Skeleton-to-Image Encoding (S2I)，将3D人体骨架序列转换为图像状数据，从而利用预训练视觉模型进行自监督骨架表示学习。该方法通过基于身体语义的分块和重采样，将骨架数据统一为图像格式，支持异构骨架数据。实验在NTU-60、NTU-120和PKU-MMD上验证了有效性，包括跨格式评估。
Motivation: 现有预训练视觉模型难以直接应用于3D骨架数据，且大规模骨架数据集稀缺。同时，多模态动作识别中需要将骨架数据整合到视觉模型中而不引入额外分支。
Method: 提出S2I编码，将骨架序列按身体部位语义分块并重排为固定尺寸的图像状张量，使预训练视觉模型（如ViT）可直接处理，实现自监督骨架表示学习。
Result: 在NTU-60、NTU-120和PKU-MMD上，自监督骨架表示学习性能优于现有方法，且能处理异构骨架格式。
Conclusion: S2I首次将预训练视觉模型成功应用于骨架表示学习，为跨模态骨架分析提供了统一表示框架。

summary_sections.result: 在NTU-60、NTU-120和PKU-MMD上，自监督骨架表示学习性能优于现有方法，且能处理异构骨架格式。
summary_sections.conclusion: S2I首次将预训练视觉模型成功应用于骨架表示学习，为跨模态骨架分析提供了统一表示框架。

papers.title: Good-Enough LLM Obfuscation (GELO)
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly served on shared accelerators where an adversary with read access to device memory can observe KV caches and hidden states, threatening prompt privacy for open-source models. Cryptographic protections such as MPC and FHE offer strong guarantees but remain one to two orders of magnitude too slow for interactive inference, while static obfuscation schemes break under multi-run statistical attacks once the model is known. We present GELO (Good-Enough LLM Obfuscation), a lightweight protocol for privacy-preserving inference that limits information leakage from untrusted accelerator observations by hiding hidden states with fresh, per-batch invertible mixing. For each offloaded projection, the TEE samples a random matrix $A$, forms $U = AH$, offloads $U$ and weights W to the accelerator, and then applies $A^{-1}$ on return, so that $A^{-1}((AH)W ) = HW$ and outputs are unchanged. Because mixing is never reused across batches, the attacker faces only a single-batch blind source separation problem. We analyse information leakage and introduce two practical defences: (i) non-orthogonal mixing to mask Gram matrices, and (ii) orthogonal mixing augmented with a small fraction of high-energy "shield" vectors that pollute higher-order statistics. On Llama-2 7B, GELO preserves float32 outputs exactly, closely matches low-precision baselines, and shows about $20$--$30\%$ compute-side overhead in a controlled offload microbenchmark; an unoptimized remote prototype is dominated by transport overhead, motivating deeper serving-engine integration. GELO resists ICA/BSS and anchor-assisted attacks; a 60M-parameter transformer-based unmixing attack also fails under strong mixing and shielding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GELO，一种轻量级协议，用于在共享加速器上进行隐私保护的LLM推理，通过每批可逆混合隐藏隐藏状态，抵御设备内存读取攻击。分析信息泄露并引入两种实用防御：非正交混合和正交混合加护盾向量。在Llama-2 7B上，GELO保留float32输出完全不变，计算侧开销约20-30%，并能抵抗ICA/BSS等攻击。
Motivation: 共享加速器上LLM推理面临提示隐私威胁，传统密码学保护太慢，静态混淆易受多轮统计攻击。
Method: 提出GELO协议，利用TEE生成每批随机可逆混合矩阵，对隐藏状态进行变换后卸载到加速器，返回后逆变换恢复原始输出。引入非正交混合和正交混合加护盾向量两种防御机制。
Result: 在Llama-2 7B上，GELO保持float32输出精确，接近低精度基线，计算开销约20-30%；抵抗ICA/BSS和基于锚点的攻击，6000万参数Transformer解混攻击在强混合和护盾下也失败。
Conclusion: GELO在安全性和效率之间取得平衡，适合集成到现有服务引擎中，但远程原型受传输开销主导。

papers.title: ZeSTA: Zero-Shot TTS Augmentation with Domain-Conditioned Training for Data-Efficient Personalized Speech Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the use of zero-shot text-to-speech (ZS-TTS) as a data augmentation source for low-resource personalized speech synthesis. While synthetic augmentation can provide linguistically rich and phonetically diverse speech, naively mixing large amounts of synthetic speech with limited real recordings often leads to speaker similarity degradation during fine-tuning. To address this issue, we propose ZeSTA, a simple domain-conditioned training framework that distinguishes real and synthetic speech via a lightweight domain embedding, combined with real-data oversampling to stabilize adaptation under extremely limited target data, without modifying the base architecture. Experiments on LibriTTS and an in-house dataset with two ZS-TTS sources demonstrate that our approach improves speaker similarity over naive synthetic augmentation while preserving intelligibility and perceptual quality. Audio samples are available on our web page.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ZeSTA框架，利用零样本文本转语音（ZS-TTS）作为数据增强源，用于低资源个性化语音合成。通过域条件训练区分真实与合成语音，并结合真实数据过采样，在LibriTTS和内部数据集上实验表明，该方法相比朴素合成增强提高了说话人相似度，同时保持可理解性和感知质量。
Motivation: 在低资源个性化语音合成中，朴素地将大量合成语音与少量真实录音混合会导致微调时说话人相似度下降。
Method: 提出ZeSTA框架，通过轻量级域嵌入区分真实和合成语音，并结合真实数据过采样来稳定适应过程，不修改基础架构。
Result: 在LibriTTS和内部数据集上，使用两种ZS-TTS源，该方法提高了说话人相似度，同时保持可理解性和感知质量。
Conclusion: 域条件训练和真实数据过采样能有效缓解合成数据带来的说话人相似度下降问题，适用于数据高效个性化语音合成。

papers.title: mlx-vis: GPU-Native Dimensionality Reduction on Apple Silicon
papers.abstract_en: Dimensionality reduction is a foundational tool for visualizing high-dimensional data, yet its reference implementations span a fragmented stack of CPU-bound Python packages that leaves the Metal GPU on Apple Silicon entirely unused. We present mlx-vis, a library that reimplements seven widely used dimensionality reduction methods and k-nearest neighbor graph construction in pure MLX, with every stage -- from PCA preprocessing through embedding optimization to a circle-splatting renderer -- executing on GPU. On Fashion-MNIST 70K, all seven methods embed in 2.1--4.6 s on an M3 Ultra, achieving 3--13x speedups over CPU baselines while reducing the entire dependency stack to MLX and NumPy. The same pipeline scales to ten million points on a single workstation. Code at https://github.com/hanxiao/mlx-vis
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. To appear in IEEE VIS 2026 (short paper). Software: https://github.com/hanxiao/mlx-vis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 mlx-vis，一个在 Apple Silicon 上利用 Metal GPU 进行降维的纯 MLX 库，重新实现了七种常用降维方法和 k-近邻图构建，所有阶段（PCA预处理、嵌入优化、圆形飞溅渲染）均在 GPU 上运行。在 Fashion-MNIST 70K 上，七种方法在 M3 Ultra 上仅需 2.1-4.6 秒，相比 CPU 基线加速 3-13 倍，且依赖栈缩减至仅 MLX 和 NumPy，可扩展至千万点。
Motivation: 现有降维参考实现分散在 CPU 绑定的 Python 包中，完全未利用 Apple Silicon 上的 Metal GPU 能力。
Method: 在 MLX 中实现 PCA 预处理、嵌入优化和圆形飞溅渲染器，所有计算在 GPU 上执行，依赖仅 MLX 和 NumPy。
Result: 在 Fashion-MNIST 70K 上，七种方法在 M3 Ultra 上嵌入时间为 2.1-4.6 秒，取得 3-13 倍加速，并能处理千万点规模。
Conclusion: mlx-vis 证明了纯 GPU 原生降维在 Apple Silicon 上的高效性和可扩展性。

papers.title: GAC: Stabilizing Asynchronous RL Training for LLMs via Gradient Alignment Control
papers.abstract_en: Asynchronous execution is essential for scaling reinforcement learning (RL) to modern large model workloads, including large language models and AI agents, but it can fundamentally alter RL optimization behavior. While prior work on asynchronous RL focuses on training throughput and distributional correction, we show that naively applying asynchrony to policy-gradient updates can induce qualitatively different training dynamics and lead to severe training instability. Through systematic empirical and theoretical analysis, we identify a key signature of this instability: asynchronous training exhibits persistently high cosine similarity between consecutive policy gradients, in contrast to the near-orthogonal updates observed under synchronized training. This stale-aligned gradient effect amplifies correlated updates and increases the risk of overshooting and divergence. Motivated by this observation, we propose GRADIENT ALIGNMENT CONTROL(GAC), a simple dynamics-aware stabilization method that regulates asynchronous RL progress along stale-aligned directions via gradient projection. We establish convergence guarantees under bounded staleness and demonstrate empirically that GAC recovers stable, on-policy training dynamics and matches synchronized baselines even at high staleness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现异步强化学习训练中策略梯度之间持续高余弦相似度（stale-aligned gradient effect）会导致训练不稳定，甚至发散。提出梯度对齐控制（GAC）方法，通过梯度投影调节该方向，恢复稳定的on-policy训练动态，并在高滞后情况下匹配同步基线性能。
Motivation: 异步RL训练广泛应用于大模型和智能体，但现有工作忽略其特有的优化不稳定性问题；本文旨在揭示该不稳定性的成因并提出解决方案。
Method: 通过理论和实证分析识别出stale-aligned梯度效应，提出GAC方法，利用梯度投影动态控制异步RL在陈旧对齐方向上的更新步长，并给出了有界滞后下的收敛性保证。
Result: 实验表明GAC能恢复稳定的训练动态，在高滞后条件下与同步基线性能持平，且收敛性得到理论保障。
Conclusion: 论文强调GAC有效解决了异步RL训练中的不稳定性问题，为异步策略梯度方法提供了实用的稳定化方案。

papers.title: The MAMA-MIA Challenge: Advancing Generalizability and Fairness in Breast MRI Tumor Segmentation and Treatment Response Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Breast cancer is the most frequently diagnosed malignancy among women worldwide and a leading cause of cancer-related mortality. Dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging plays a central role in tumor characterization and treatment monitoring, particularly in patients receiving neoadjuvant chemotherapy. However, existing artificial intelligence models for breast magnetic resonance imaging are typically developed and evaluated using heterogeneous datasets, study populations, and assessment protocols, making direct comparison difficult and limiting understanding of model robustness across institutions and clinically relevant patient subgroups. The MAMA-MIA Challenge was designed to address these challenges by providing a standardized benchmark for the joint evaluation of primary tumor segmentation and prediction of pathologic complete response using pre-treatment magnetic resonance imaging only. The training cohort comprised 1,506 patients from multiple institutions in the United States, while evaluation was conducted on an external test set of 574 patients from three independent European centers to assess cross-continental and cross-institutional generalization. A unified scoring framework combined predictive performance with subgroup consistency across age, menopausal status, and breast density. Twenty-six international teams participated in the final evaluation phase. Results demonstrate substantial performance variability under a common external evaluation framework and reveal trade-offs between overall accuracy and subgroup fairness. The challenge provides standardized datasets, evaluation protocols, and public resources to promote the development of robust and equitable artificial intelligence systems for breast cancer imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 乳腺癌是女性最常见恶性肿瘤，动态对比增强MRI在肿瘤特征描述和治疗监测中起核心作用。现有AI模型因异质数据集和评估协议难以直接比较，且缺乏对临床亚组公平性的考虑。MAMA-MIA挑战提供了标准化基准，联合评估术前MRI的肿瘤分割与病理完全缓解预测，训练集包含1506名美国患者，外部测试集含574名欧洲患者。26支团队参与，结果显示性能差异显著，并存在总体准确率与亚组公平性之间的权衡。
Motivation: 现有乳腺癌MRI AI模型在异质数据集和不同评估协议下开发，导致跨机构比较困难，且模型在年龄、绝经状态、乳腺密度等亚组上的公平性未得到充分关注。
Method: 提出MAMA-MIA挑战，构建包含1506名美国患者训练集和574名欧洲患者外部测试集的标准化基准，设计统一评分框架联合评估肿瘤分割准确性和病理完全缓解预测能力，并纳入亚组一致性指标（年龄、绝经状态、乳腺密度）。
Result: 26支国际团队参与最终评估，结果显示在统一外部评估框架下性能差异较大，且总体准确率与亚组公平性之间存在明显权衡。
Conclusion: 该挑战通过提供标准化数据集、评估协议和公共资源，强调了开发鲁棒且公平的乳腺癌MRI AI系统的必要性，并为未来研究奠定基础。

papers.title: Revisiting Text Ranking in Deep Research
papers.abstract_en: Deep research has emerged as an important task that aims to address hard queries that need extensive open-web exploration. To tackle it, most prior work equips large language model (LLM)-based agents with opaque web search APIs, enabling agents to iteratively issue search queries, retrieve external evidence, and reason over it. Despite search's essential role in deep research, black-box web search APIs leave the behaviour of established text ranking methods in deep research largely unclear. To fill this gap, we reproduce key findings and best practices for text ranking methods in deep research. We examine their effectiveness from three perspectives: (i) retrieval units (documents vs. passages), (ii) pipeline configurations (different retrievers, re-rankers, and re-ranking depths), and (iii) query characteristics (the mismatch between agent-issued queries and the training queries of text rankers). We perform experiments on BrowseComp-Plus, a deep research dataset with a fixed corpus, evaluating 2 open-source agents, 5 retrievers, and 3 re-rankers. We find that agent-issued queries typically follow web-search-style syntax (e.g., quoted exact matches), favouring lexical, learned sparse, and multi-vector retrievers; passage-level units are more efficient under limited context windows, and avoid the difficulties of document length normalisation in lexical retrieval; re-ranking is highly effective. We further propose a query-to-question (Q2Q) method that translates agent-issued queries into natural language questions, significantly reducing the query mismatch.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 49th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度研究任务中的文本排序方法进行复现研究，从检索单元、流水线配置和查询特性三个角度评估效果。实验发现代理查询偏向网络搜索风格，段落级单元更高效，重排序有效。提出查询转问题（Q2Q）方法缓解查询不匹配。
Motivation: 现有深度研究依赖黑盒网络搜索API，文本排序方法的行为尚不明确，需要系统复现最佳实践。
Method: 使用开源代理、检索器和重排序器在BrowseComp-Plus数据集上实验，从三个维度分析，并提出Q2Q方法将代理查询转为自然语言问题。
Result: 代理查询偏好词法、学习稀疏和多向量检索器；段落级单元在有限上下文窗口下更高效；重排序显著有效。Q2Q方法减少了查询不匹配。
Conclusion: 文本排序在深度研究中仍具关键作用，需考虑查询特性与检索单元的匹配，Q2Q能改善性能。
