papers.title: Conditional neural control variates for variance reduction in Bayesian inverse problems
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian inference for inverse problems involves computing expectations under posterior distributions--e.g., posterior means, variances, or predictive quantities--typically via Monte Carlo (MC) estimation. When the quantity of interest varies significantly under the posterior, accurate estimates demand many samples--a cost often prohibitive for partial differential equation-constrained problems. To address this challenge, we introduce conditional neural control variates, a modular method that learns amortized control variates from joint model-data samples to reduce the variance of MC estimators. To scale to high-dimensional problems, we leverage Stein's identity to design an architecture based on an ensemble of hierarchical coupling layers with tractable Jacobian trace computation. Training requires: (i) samples from the joint distribution of unknown parameters and observed data; and (ii) the posterior score function, which can be computed from physics-based likelihood evaluations, neural operator surrogates, or learned generative models such as conditional normalizing flows. Once trained, the control variates generalize across observations without retraining. We validate our approach on stylized and partial differential equation-constrained Darcy flow inverse problems, outperforming classical Stein control variates and achieving substantial variance reduction, even when the analytical score is replaced by a learned surrogate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出条件神经控制变量（conditional neural control variates），一种从联合模型-数据样本中学习摊销控制变量以降低贝叶斯逆问题中蒙特卡洛估计方差的方法。方法利用Stein恒等式设计基于层次耦合层（hierarchical coupling layers）的架构，支持高维问题，训练后无需重新训练即可推广到不同观测数据。在风格化问题和偏微分方程约束的Darcy流逆问题上验证，优于经典Stein控制变量。
Motivation: 贝叶斯逆问题中，后验期望的蒙特卡洛估计需要大量样本才能达到足够精度，而偏微分方程约束问题的采样成本高昂。现有控制变量方法依赖于代理模型或稀疏网格，难以扩展到高维参数空间。
Method: 从联合模型-数据样本中学习参数化的控制变量，利用Stein恒等式设计基于层次耦合层（hierarchical coupling layers）的神经网络架构，其雅可比迹（Jacobian trace）可解析计算，支持高维问题。训练需要联合分布的样本和后验得分函数（可由物理似然、神经算子代理或条件归一化流得到）。
Result: 在风格化问题和偏微分方程约束的Darcy流逆问题上，该方法优于经典Stein控制变量，实现了显著的方差缩减，即使将解析得分替换为学习的代理模型仍能保持性能。
Conclusion: 条件神经控制变量为贝叶斯逆问题提供了一种模块化、可泛化的方差缩减手段，且不限于特定正向模型。局限性在于训练需要后验得分函数，但对代理得分函数同样鲁棒。

papers.title: DistributedEstimator: Distributed Training of Quantum Neural Networks via Circuit Cutting
papers.abstract_en: Circuit cutting decomposes a large quantum circuit into smaller subcircuits executed independently; expectation values are recovered by classically combining subcircuit outcomes. Prior work characterises cutting overhead via subcircuit counts and sampling complexity, but its end-to-end impact on iterative, estimator-driven training pipelines remains under-measured from a systems perspective. We propose DistributedEstimator, a cut-aware estimator execution pipeline that treats circuit cutting as a staged distributed workload, instrumenting each query across four phases: partitioning, subexperiment generation, parallel execution, and classical reconstruction. Using logged runtime traces and learning outcomes on two binary classification workloads (Iris and MNIST), we quantify cutting overheads, scaling limits, and sensitivity to injected stragglers, and assess whether accuracy and robustness are preserved under matched training budgets. Reconstruction dominates per-query time -- a median of 53% and 95th percentile of 58% at three cuts -- bounding achievable speed-up under parallelism. Despite this, test accuracy is fully preserved on Iris and maintained without systematic degradation on MNIST across all cut configurations. Robustness under Gaussian noise and FGSM perturbations is similarly preserved, with several configurations matching or improving on the uncut baseline. Exponential growth of subexperiment counts (${O}(9^c)$ for CNOT-based decomposition) is a fundamental barrier limiting practical experimentation to small qubit counts. These results establish that practical scaling for learning workloads requires reducing and overlapping reconstruction, scheduling policies for barrier-dominated critical paths, and computationally efficient reconstruction strategies for larger qubit counts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DistributedEstimator，一种针对量子神经网络分布式训练的电路切割感知执行流水线。电路切割将大规模量子电路分解为独立子电路，并通过经典组合恢复期望值。实验表明，在Iris和MNIST二分类任务上，虽然重构耗时主导（中位数53%，95分位数58%），但测试精度在切割配置下完全保留，鲁棒性也未下降。指数增长的子实验数量（CNOT分解下O(9^c)）限制了实际可扩展性。
Motivation: 电路切割在迭代的、估计器驱动的训练流水线中的端到端影响尚未从系统角度被充分评估，尤其缺乏对切割开销、扩展限制和鲁棒性的量化分析。
Method: 提出DistributedEstimator，将电路切割视为分阶段分布式工作负载，每次查询包含四阶段：分区、子实验生成、并行执行和经典重构。
Result: 在Iris和MNIST上，测试精度在切割配置下完全保留（Iris）或未系统性退化（MNIST）；高斯噪声和FGSM扰动下的鲁棒性也得以保持，部分配置甚至优于未切割基线。重构耗时占主导（中位数53%，95分位数58%），限制了并行加速。子实验数量指数增长（O(9^c)）成为实际障碍。
Conclusion: 实际扩展需要减少重叠重构、调度策略优化以及更高效的重构方法。

papers.title: MAVRL: Learning Reward Functions from Multiple Feedback Types with Amortized Variational Inference
papers.abstract_en: Reward learning typically relies on a single feedback type or combines multiple feedback types using manually weighted loss terms. Currently, it remains unclear how to jointly learn reward functions from heterogeneous feedback types such as demonstrations, comparisons, ratings, and stops that provide qualitatively different signals. We address this challenge by formulating reward learning from multiple feedback types as Bayesian inference over a shared latent reward function, where each feedback type contributes information through an explicit likelihood. We introduce a scalable amortized variational inference approach that learns a shared reward encoder and feedback-specific likelihood decoders and is trained by optimizing a single evidence lower bound. Our approach avoids reducing feedback to a common intermediate representation and eliminates the need for manual loss balancing. Across discrete and continuous-control benchmarks, we show that jointly inferred reward posteriors outperform single-type baselines, exploit complementary information across feedback types, and yield policies that are more robust to environment perturbations. The inferred reward uncertainty further provides interpretable signals for analyzing model confidence and consistency across feedback types.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于贝叶斯推理的方法，从多种反馈类型（演示、比较、评分、停止信号）中联合学习奖励函数，使用可扩展的摊销变分推理（amortized variational inference）优化一个证据下界（ELBO），避免手动平衡损失项。在离散和连续控制基准上，联合推理的奖励后验优于单类型基线，并能利用反馈之间的互补信息，生成对环境扰动更鲁棒的策略。
Motivation: 现有奖励学习通常依赖单一反馈类型或通过手动加权结合多种反馈，但如何从异质反馈类型（如演示、比较、评分、停止）中联合学习奖励函数仍然不清楚。
Method: 将多类型反馈奖励学习形式化为对共享潜在奖励函数的贝叶斯推理，每种反馈类型通过显式似然贡献信息。提出可扩展的摊销变分推理方法，学习共享奖励编码器和反馈特定似然解码器，通过优化单一ELBO进行训练，无需将反馈减少到共同中间表示或手动平衡损失。
Result: 在离散和连续控制基准上，联合推理的奖励后验优于单类型基线，利用互补信息，生成对环境扰动更鲁棒的策略。奖励不确定性为分析跨反馈类型的模型置信度和一致性提供了可解释信号。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法避免了手动损失平衡，并且联合推理能够利用多种反馈的互补信息，提高策略鲁棒性。

papers.title: A Hybrid TGN-SEAL Model for Dynamic Graph Link Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting links in sparse, continuously evolving networks is a central challenge in network science. Conventional heuristic methods and deep learning models, including Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), are typically designed for static graphs and thus struggle to capture temporal dependencies. Snapshot-based techniques partially address this issue but often encounter data sparsity and class imbalance, particularly in networks with transient interactions such as telecommunication call detail records (CDRs). Temporal Graph Networks (TGNs) model dynamic graphs by updating node embeddings over time; however, their predictive accuracy under sparse conditions remains limited. In this study, we improve the TGN framework by extracting enclosing subgraphs around candidate links, enabling the model to jointly learn structural and temporal information. Experiments on a sparse CDR, email, message dataset show that our approach increases average precision by at least 2% over standard TGNs, demonstrating the advantages of integrating local topology for robust link prediction in dynamic networks.
papers.journal_ref: EPJ Data Science (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合TGN-SEAL模型，用于稀疏动态网络中的链接预测。通过提取候选链接周围的封闭子图，使模型能够联合学习结构和时间信息。在稀疏的CDR、邮件和消息数据集上，该方法的平均精度比标准TGN至少提高2%。
Motivation: 现有方法如启发式方法和图神经网络主要用于静态图，难以捕获时间依赖；基于快照的方法面临数据稀疏和类别不平衡问题。TGN在稀疏条件下预测精度有限。
Method: 在TGN框架基础上，提取候选链接周围的封闭子图，利用SEAL（Subgraph-based Encoding and Learning）方法同时学习结构和时间信息，从而增强链接预测。
Result: 在稀疏的CDR、邮件和消息数据集上，平均精度比标准TGN至少提高2%。
Conclusion: 集成局部拓扑信息有助于在动态网络中进行鲁棒的链接预测，尤其适用于稀疏网络。

papers.title: Empty Shelves or Lost Keys? Recall Is the Bottleneck for Parametric Factuality
papers.abstract_en: Standard factuality evaluations of LLMs treat all errors alike, obscuring whether failures arise from missing knowledge (empty shelves) or from limited access to encoded facts (lost keys). We propose a behavioral framework that profiles factual knowledge at the level of facts rather than questions, characterizing each fact by whether it is encoded, and then by how accessible it is: cannot be recalled, can be directly recalled, or can only be recalled with inference-time computation (thinking). To support such profiling, we introduce WikiProfile, a new benchmark constructed via an automated pipeline with a prompted LLM grounded in web search. Across 4 million responses from 13 LLMs, we find that encoding is nearly saturated in frontier models on our benchmark, with GPT-5 and Gemini-3 encoding 95--98% of facts. However, recall remains a major bottleneck: many errors previously attributed to missing knowledge instead stem from failures to access it. These failures are systematic and disproportionately affect long-tail facts and reverse questions. Finally, we show that thinking improves recall and can recover a substantial fraction of failures, indicating that future gains may rely less on scaling and more on methods that improve how models utilize what they already encode.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个行为框架，将LLM的事实性错误分为知识缺失（空架子）和记忆访问失败（丢失钥匙）两类。基于新基准WikiProfile对13个LLM的400万响应分析发现，前沿模型（GPT-5、Gemini-3）的知识编码近乎饱和（95-98%），但召回仍是主要瓶颈，错误多源于访问失败而非缺失。推理时计算（thinking）可改善召回并恢复大量错误，提示未来提升可能更依赖利用已有知识的方法而非规模扩展。
Motivation: 标准LLM事实性评估将所有错误混为一谈，掩盖了错误源于知识缺失还是编码事实访问受限的问题，无法指导针对性改进。
Method: 提出基于事实而非问题的行为框架，通过编码（encoded）和可访问性（accessible）两个维度刻画事实，并构建自动化流水线WikiProfile（基于提示LLM和网络搜索）来支持该框架。
Result: 对13个LLM的400万响应分析发现：GPT-5和Gemini-3编码95-98%的事实，但召回仍是主要瓶颈；召回失败系统性地影响长尾事实和逆向提问；推理时计算（thinking）可显著改善召回并恢复大量失败。
Conclusion: 摘要强调LLM的事实性瓶颈在于从编码知识中召回信息的能力，而非知识本身缺失；未来提升应聚焦于增强模型利用已编码知识的方法，而非单纯扩展规模。

papers.title: Temper-Then-Tilt: Principled Unlearning for Generative Models through Tempering and Classifier Guidance
papers.abstract_en: We study machine unlearning in large generative models by framing the task as density ratio estimation to a target distribution rather than supervised fine-tuning. While classifier guidance is a standard approach for approximating this ratio and can succeed in general, we show it can fail to faithfully unlearn with finite samples when the forget set represents a sharp, concentrated data distribution. To address this, we introduce Temper-Then-Tilt Unlearning (T3-Unlearning), which freezes the base model and applies a two-step inference procedure: (i) tempering the base distribution to flatten high-confidence spikes, and (ii) tilting the tempered distribution using a lightweight classifier trained to distinguish retain from forget samples. Our theoretical analysis provides finite-sample guarantees linking the surrogate classifier's risk to unlearning error, proving that tempering is necessary to successfully unlearn for concentrated distributions. Empirical evaluations on the TOFU benchmark show that T3-Unlearning improves forget quality and generative utility over existing baselines, while training only a fraction of the parameters with a minimal runtime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 Temper-Then-Tilt Unlearning (T3-Unlearning) 的生成模型遗忘方法，通过将遗忘任务视为密度比估计并采用两步推理：先对基础分布进行退火（tempering）以平滑高置信度尖峰，再使用轻量级分类器进行倾斜（tilting）。理论分析提供了有限样本保证，证明退火对于集中分布的成功遗忘是必要的。在 TOFU 基准上的实验表明，该方法在遗忘质量和生成效用上优于现有基线，且仅训练少量参数。
Motivation: 现有基于分类器引导的遗忘方法在遗忘集分布尖锐集中时，由于有限样本可能无法忠实执行遗忘。本文旨在解决这一局限性。
Method: 冻结基础生成模型，在推理时执行两步过程：(i) 对基础分布进行退火，降低高置信度区域的尖峰；(ii) 使用区分保留样本和遗忘样本的轻量级分类器对退火后的分布进行倾斜，从而逼近目标分布。
Result: 在 TOFU 基准上，T3-Unlearning 在遗忘质量和生成效用方面优于现有基线，仅训练少量参数且运行时开销极小。理论分析给出了有限样本下分类器风险与遗忘误差之间的界。
Conclusion: 本文证明了退火对于成功遗忘集中分布的必要性，并提出了一种原则性的两步遗忘框架，具有理论保证和实用效率。

papers.title: Learning with Multiple Correct Answers -- Regret Bounds under Different Feedback Models
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning with multiple correct answers, where each instance admits a set of valid labels. We primarily focus on the online setup, where in each round the learner must output a valid label for the queried example. This setting is motivated by language generation, in which a prompt may admit many acceptable completions, but not every completion is acceptable. We study this problem under three feedback models. For each model, we characterize the optimal mistake bound in the realizable setting using an appropriate combinatorial dimension. We then show that the rate of regret can be constant, linear, or sublinear across the three models in the agnostic setting. Our results also imply sample complexity bounds for the batch setup that depend on the respective combinatorial dimensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多正确答案的在线学习问题，每个实例允许一组有效标签。在三种反馈模型下，表征了可实现设置中的最优错误界，并分析了不可知设置中的遗憾率，揭示出常数、线性或次线性趋势。结果也隐含了依赖于组合维数的批处理样本复杂度界。
Motivation: 许多实际任务（如语言生成）中，一个输入可能对应多个正确输出，但并非所有输出都正确。现有学习框架通常假设单一正确标签，无法处理这种多正确答案的场景。
Method: 从在线学习角度出发，针对三种反馈模型，定义相应的组合维度，并据此推导可实现情况下的最优错误界；在不可知情况下分析遗憾率的行为。
Result: 在可实现设置下，三种反馈模型的错误界由不同的组合维度刻画；在不可知设置下，遗憾率分别呈现常数、线性或次线性增长。
Conclusion: 本文建立了多正确答案学习在不同反馈模型下的理论基础，揭示了组合维度与学习难度的关系，并为批处理设置提供了样本复杂度上界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reciprocal Latent Fields for Precomputed Sound Propagation
papers.abstract_en: Realistic sound propagation is essential for immersion in a virtual scene, yet physically accurate wave-based simulations remain computationally prohibitive for real-time applications. Wave coding methods address this limitation by precomputing and compressing impulse responses of a given scene into a set of scalar acoustic parameters, which can reach unmanageable sizes in large environments with many source-receiver pairs. We introduce Reciprocal Latent Fields (RLF), a memory-efficient framework for encoding and predicting these acoustic parameters. The RLF framework employs a volumetric grid of trainable latent embeddings decoded with a symmetric function, ensuring acoustic reciprocity. We study a variety of decoders and show that leveraging Riemannian metric learning leads to a better reproduction of acoustic phenomena in complex scenes. Experimental validation demonstrates that RLF maintains replication quality while reducing the memory footprint by several orders of magnitude. Furthermore, a MUSHRA-like subjective listening test indicates that sound rendered via RLF is perceptually indistinguishable from ground-truth simulations.
papers.journal_ref: SIGGRAPH Conference Papers 2026, Los Angeles, CA, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Reciprocal Latent Fields (RLF)，一种内存高效的声学参数编码与预测框架，通过可训练潜嵌入的体素网格与对称解码器保证声学互易性。结合黎曼度量学习，在复杂场景中更好地再现声学现象。实验表明，RLF 在保持复制质量的同时将内存占用降低数个数量级，主观听感测试显示与真实模拟不可区分。
Motivation: 物理准确的波场模拟计算开销极大；波编码方法预计算并压缩场景脉冲响应，但在大场景中声学参数规模庞大，难以管理。
Method: RLF 使用体素网格存储可训练潜嵌入，通过对称函数解码以确保声学互易性；研究多种解码器，并利用黎曼度量学习提升复杂场景的声学现象再现质量。
Result: 内存占用降低数个数量级；MUSHRA 主观听感测试表明，RLF 渲染的声音与真实模拟在感知上无法区分。
Conclusion: RLF 为预计算声传播提供了内存高效的解决方案，同时保持复制质量，适用于实时虚拟场景。

papers.title: Fair Transit Stop Placement: A Clustering Perspective and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: We study the transit stop placement (TrSP) problem in general metric spaces, where agents travel between source-destination pairs and may either walk directly or utilize a shuttle service via selected transit stops. We investigate fairness in TrSP through the lens of justified representation (JR) and the core, and uncover a structural correspondence with fair clustering. Specifically, we show that a constant-factor approximation to proportional fairness in clustering can be used to guarantee a constant-factor biparameterized approximation to core. We establish a lower bound of 1.366 on the approximability of JR, and moreover show that no clustering algorithm can approximate JR within a factor better than 3. Going beyond clustering, we propose the Expanding Cost Algorithm, which achieves a tight 2.414-approximation for JR, but does not give any bounded core guarantee. In light of this, we introduce a parameterized algorithm that interpolates between these approaches, and enables a tunable trade-off between JR and core. Finally, we complement our results with an experimental analysis using small-market public carpooling data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一般度量空间中的公平交通站点布置（TrSP）问题，通过正当表示（JR）和核心（core）的视角探讨公平性，并揭示其与公平聚类的结构对应关系。文章证明了聚类中比例公平的常数因子近似可保证核心的常数因子双参数近似，并给出了JR可近似性的下界。进一步提出了扩展成本算法（Expanding Cost Algorithm）实现JR的紧2.414近似，以及一种参数化算法在JR与核心之间可调权衡。实验基于小市场公共拼车数据。
Motivation: 现有交通站点布置研究缺乏对公平性的系统分析，特别是从群组公平（如JR和核心）的角度。本文旨在建立TrSP与公平聚类之间的理论联系，并设计具有严格保证的算法。
Method: 首先建立TrSP与公平聚类的对应关系，利用聚类中比例公平的常数因子近似推导核心的常数因子双参数近似。提出扩展成本算法，通过动态调整站点成本实现JR的2.414近似。再引入参数化算法，插值扩展成本算法与基于聚类的方法，实现JR与核心之间可调权衡。
Result: 建立了JR可近似性的下界1.366，并证明无聚类算法能在因子3内近似JR。扩展成本算法达到JR的紧2.414近似，但无有界核心保证。参数化算法提供可调权衡。实验验证了理论结果。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了交通站点布置公平性与公平聚类的深刻联系，提供了具有理论保证的算法，并展示了在拼车数据上的实用性。未来可探索更通用的公平概念或动态设置。

papers.title: Robust Representation Learning in Masked Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Masked Autoencoders (MAEs) achieve impressive performance in image classification tasks, yet the internal representations they learn remain less understood. This work started as an attempt to understand the strong downstream classification performance of MAE. In this process we discover that representations learned with the pretraining and fine-tuning, are quite robust -- demonstrating a good classification performance in the presence of degradations, such as blur and occlusions. Through layer-wise analysis of token embeddings, we show that pretrained MAE progressively constructs its latent space in a class-aware manner across network depth: embeddings from different classes lie in subspaces that become increasingly separable. We further observe that MAE exhibits early and persistent global attention across encoder layers, in contrast to standard Vision Transformers (ViTs). To quantify feature robustness, we introduce two sensitivity indicators: directional alignment between clean and perturbed embeddings, and head-wise retention of active features under degradations. These studies help establish the robust classification performance of MAEs.
papers.comment: To appear in ICPR 2026. 10 pages, 5 figures, and 2 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Masked Autoencoders (MAE) 的内部表示鲁棒性，发现其预训练和微调后的特征对图像退化（模糊、遮挡）具有良好分类性能。通过逐层分析，MAE 以类别感知方式逐步构建潜在空间，且编码器层表现出早期持续的全局注意力。作者提出了两个敏感性指标来量化特征鲁棒性。
Motivation: 理解 MAE 在下游分类任务中强大性能的原因，并探索其表示对退化的鲁棒性。
Method: 对 MAE 进行层级的 token 嵌入分析，观察类别分离性；通过注意力分析揭示全局注意力模式；提出对齐度和头部保留度两个敏感性指标。
Result: MAE 特征对模糊和遮挡等退化具有鲁棒性，潜在空间类别可分性随网络深度增加，全局注意力在早期层出现并持续。
Conclusion: 这些分析有助于建立 MAE 鲁棒分类性能的理解，但方法仅针对图像分类，未涉及其他模态或任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ultrafast On-Chip Online Learning via Spline Locality in Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.abstract_en: Ultrafast online learning is essential for high-frequency systems, such as controls for quantum computing and nuclear fusion, where adaptation must occur on sub-microsecond timescales. Meeting these requirements demands low-latency, fixed-precision computation under strict memory constraints, a regime in which conventional Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) are both inefficient and numerically unstable. We identify key properties of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) that align with these constraints. Specifically, we show that: (i) KAN updates exploiting B-spline locality are sparse, enabling superior on-chip resource scaling, and (ii) KANs are inherently robust to fixed-point quantization. By implementing fixed-point online training on Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs), a representative platform for on-chip computation, we demonstrate that KAN-based online learners are significantly more efficient and expressive than MLPs across a range of low-latency and resource-constrained tasks. To our knowledge, this work is the first to demonstrate model-free online learning at sub-microsecond latencies.
papers.comment: Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML'26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用Kolmogorov-Arnold网络(KAN)的B样条局部性和对定点量化的鲁棒性，在FPGA上实现了亚微秒延迟的在线学习。与多层感知机相比，KAN在低延迟和资源受限任务中更高效、更具表现力。这是首个在亚微秒延迟下实现无模型在线学习的工作。
Motivation: 高频系统（如量子计算和核聚变控制）需要亚微秒时间尺度的在线学习，但传统MLP在低延迟、固定精度和严格内存约束下效率低且数值不稳定。
Method: 识别KAN的关键特性：利用B样条局部性实现稀疏更新，以提升片上资源缩放；KAN对定点量化固有鲁棒。在FPGA上实现定点在线训练，验证其效率。
Result: 摘要报告KAN在低延迟和资源受限任务中显著优于MLP，并首次实现亚微秒延迟的无模型在线学习。
Conclusion: 该工作表明KAN在超快在线学习场景中具有显著潜力，尤其适合硬件实现。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 识别KAN的关键特性：利用B样条局部性实现稀疏更新，以提升片上资源缩放；KAN对定点量化固有鲁棒。在FPGA上实现定点在线训练，验证其效率。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告KAN在低延迟和资源受限任务中显著优于MLP，并首次实现亚微秒延迟的无模型在线学习。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作表明KAN在超快在线学习场景中具有显著潜力，尤其适合硬件实现。

papers.title: NewPINNs: Physics-Informing Neural Networks Using Conventional Solvers for Partial Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: We introduce NewPINNs, a physics-informing learning framework that couples neural networks with conventional numerical solvers for solving differential equations. Rather than enforcing governing equations and boundary conditions through residual-based loss terms, NewPINNs integrates the solver directly into the training loop and defines learning objectives through solver-consistency. The neural network produces candidate solution states that are advanced by the numerical solver, and training minimizes the discrepancy between the network prediction and the solver-evolved state. This pull-push interaction enables the network to learn physically admissible solutions through repeated exposure to the solver's action, without requiring problem-specific loss engineering or explicit evaluation of differential equation residuals. By delegating the enforcement of physics, boundary conditions, and numerical stability to established numerical solvers, NewPINNs mitigates several well-known failure modes of standard physics-informed neural networks, including optimization pathologies, sensitivity to loss weighting, and poor performance in stiff or nonlinear regimes. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach across multiple forward and inverse problems involving finite volume, finite element, and spectral solvers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NewPINNs 是一种将神经网络与传统数值求解器（如有限体积、有限元、谱方法）耦合的物理信息学习框架。它通过求解器一致性定义学习目标，让神经网络产生候选解状态并由数值求解器推进，从而最小化网络预测与求解器演化状态之间的差异，避免了标准 PINNs 中的损失加权、优化病态等问题。
Motivation: 标准物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在刚性或非线性区域存在优化病态、对损失权重敏感等失败模式，需要问题特定的损失工程。
Method: 将传统数值求解器直接集成到训练循环中：神经网络输出候选解状态，求解器将其推进一个时间步，训练目标为最小化网络预测与求解器演化状态之间的差异（solver-consistency）。
Result: 在多个正向和逆向问题中（涉及有限体积、有限元、谱求解器）验证了有效性，缓解了标准 PINNs 的常见失效模式。
Conclusion: 通过将物理约束、边界条件和数值稳定性委托给成熟求解器，NewPINNs 无需显式微分方程残差项，实现了对复杂问题的鲁棒学习。

papers.title: From RAG to Agentic RAG for Faithful Islamic Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for Islamic question answering, where ungrounded responses may carry serious religious consequences. Yet standard MCQ/MRC-style evaluations (MCQ: Multiple choice questions, MRC: Machine Reading Comprehension) do not capture key real-world failure modes, notably free-form hallucinations and the ability to abstain when evidence is insufficient. To address this gap, we introduce IslamicFaithQA, a 3,810-item bilingual (Arabic/English) generative benchmark with atomic single-gold answers, which enables direct measurement of hallucination and abstention. We additionally developed an end-to-end grounded Islamic modeling suite consisting of (i) 25K Arabic text-grounded SFT reasoning pairs, (ii) 5K bilingual preference samples for reward-guided alignment, and (iii) a verse-level Qur'an retrieval corpus of ~6k atomic verses (ayat). Building on these resources, we develop an agentic Quran-grounding framework (agentic RAG) that uses structured tool calls for iterative evidence seeking and answer revision. Experiments across Arabic-centric and multilingual LLMs show that retrieval improves correctness and that agentic RAG yields the largest gains beyond standard RAG, achieving state-of-the-art performance and stronger Arabic-English robustness even with a small model (i.e., Qwen3 4B). We made the datasets are publicly available. https://huggingface.co/datasets/QCRI/IslamicFaithQA
papers.comment: Islamic Question Answering; Faithful Question Answering; Retrieval-Augmented Generation; Agentic RAG; Large Language Models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对伊斯兰教问答中LLM可能产生无根据回答的宗教风险，构建了IslamicFaithQA双语生成基准（3810项，原子参考答案），并开发了一套端到端的有根基伊斯兰模型套件，包括25K阿拉伯文SFT推理对、5K双语偏好样本以及约6K节Qur'an检索语料。在此基础上提出基于智能体RAG（agentic RAG）的框架，通过结构化工具调用进行迭代证据检索和答案修正。实验表明，检索能提升正确率，且智能体RAG相比标准RAG带来最大增益，小模型Qwen3 4B即达到最先进性能。数据集已公开。
Motivation: 现有LLM用于伊斯兰教问答时，标准选择题/机器阅读理解评估无法捕捉自由文本幻觉和证据不足时弃权等关键实际失败模式，需要更真实的基准和框架。
Method: 构建IslamicFaithQA基准（3810项双语生成任务，原子参考答案）和25K阿拉伯文SFT推理对、5K双语偏好样本、约6K节Qur'an检索语料；提出智能体RAG框架，通过结构化工具调用迭代搜索证据并修正答案。
Result: 智能体RAG在阿拉伯文和跨语言LLM上均超越标准RAG，小模型Qwen3 4B即取得最先进性能，且阿拉伯文-英文鲁棒性更强。
Conclusion: 论文强调智能体RAG能有效提升伊斯兰教问答的忠实性，并将数据集公开以促进该方向研究。

papers.title: ORB: An Open Radio Buoy for Coastal Water Measurements
papers.abstract_en: Oceanographic instrumentation technology is currently under rapid transition towards increasingly open-source technology. Open-source buoys compete with commercial and closed-source buoys both in price, functionality and availability. Long-range radio (LoRa) is a communication technology which is inexpensive both in terms of data transfer cost and power without the need for pre-existing infrastructure. In this paper, we present ORB, an open-source drifter buoy using LoRa for coastal water measurements. ORB is designed to be reliable, low-cost, modifiable and power efficient. We present validation experiments demonstrating that ORB can achieve a radio telemetry range of five kilometers, and has an expected battery lifetime of up to seven months, owing largely to a the radio telemetry which operates at the low power consumption of 7 mA. Finally, we discuss the role and contribution of ORB in the space of open-source instrumentation and ocean modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了ORB（Open Radio Buoy），一种基于LoRa（Long-Range radio）通信的开源漂流浮标，用于近岸海水测量。ORB设计强调可靠性、低成本、可修改性和低功耗。验证实验表明其无线电遥测范围可达5公里，在7mA低功耗下预期电池寿命长达7个月。文章还讨论了ORB在开源仪器和海洋建模中的角色。
Motivation: 当前海洋学仪器正快速向开源技术转型，但现有开源浮标在价格、功能和可用性上仍需改进。需要一种可靠、低成本且无需现有基础设施的通信方案。
Method: 提出ORB，采用LoRa通信技术，实现远距离低功耗数据传输。通过现场实验验证其性能，包括遥测范围和电池寿命测试。
Result: 实验显示ORB可实现5公里无线电遥测范围，在7mA功耗下电池寿命达7个月。
Conclusion: ORB作为开源浮标，在近岸海水测量领域提供了一种低成本、可修改的解决方案，并有望推动开源海洋建模的发展。

papers.title: Tracking Summer Greenland Blocking: the Upstream Pathway Shapes Historical Extremes and Future Change
papers.abstract_en: The representation and future evolution of summer Greenland atmospheric blocking in climate models is here investigated from a Lagrangian perspective using a novel Python package blocktrack. By applying the blocktrack algorithm to ERA5 reanalysis and a CMIP6 model ensemble, we identify and track blocking events over Greenland, and obtain their trajectories, intensities, duration and wave-breaking patterns. Greenland blocking (GB) events in ERA5 are then classified into two types based on their wave-breaking characteristics. These correspond to the previously identified upstream (anticyclonic wave breaking) and retrograding (cyclonic wave breaking) GBs. Upstream blocks, which originate in Northern Canada, exhibit stronger moisture transport before and during blocking onset and higher temperature anomalies than retrograding blocks, which follow an east-to-west trajectory and originate in the North Atlantic. Our analyses show how the recent observed increase in GB frequency, particularly in 2012, is primarily driven by upstream blocks. CMIP6 models generally fail to capture the observed increase and underestimate GB variability, especially for the upstream component. Projections under the SSP3-7.0 scenario show a decline in retrograding blocks but a possible increase in upstream blocks, depending on the detection index used. We discuss possible drivers of these changes, which include jet stream shifts, increased frequency of high-moisture transport events from low to high latitudes, surface temperature increases due to Atlantic Multidecadal Variability and Arctic Amplification. By analyzing block trajectories, this study demonstrates how Lagrangian diagnostics can provide novel insights into the dynamics of blocking events over Greenland.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用Lagrangian方法（blocktrack算法）追踪夏季格陵兰阻塞事件，基于ERA5再分析和CMIP6模式集合，将阻塞分为上游型（反气旋波破碎）和逆行型（气旋波破碎），并分析其历史极端事件与未来变化。上游阻塞源自加拿大北部，伴随更强的水汽输送和温度异常，是近期频率增加的主因；CMIP6模式低估了上游阻塞的变率，未来SSP3-7.0下逆行阻塞减少而上游阻塞可能增加。
Motivation: 现有研究对格陵兰阻塞的动力学机制和模式模拟能力认识不足，尤其是从轨迹追踪角度区分不同类型阻塞的贡献与未来演变。
Method: 开发Python包blocktrack，对ERA5和CMIP6模式中的阻塞事件进行识别、追踪，获取轨迹、强度、持续时间和波破碎特征，并基于波破碎特性分类。
Result: ERA5中上游阻塞（源自加拿大北部）在阻塞 onset 前后水汽输送更强、温度异常更高；2012年格陵兰阻塞频率增加主要由上游阻塞驱动；CMIP6模式无法捕捉观测到的增加趋势，且低估阻塞变率；SSP3-7.0情景下逆行阻塞减少，上游阻塞可能增加。
Conclusion: Lagrangian诊断方法能揭示阻塞事件的新动力学特征，CMIP6对上游阻塞的模拟缺陷可能影响未来高纬度水汽输送和极端事件的预估。

papers.title: VDAWorld: World Modelling via VLM-Directed Abstraction and Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Generative video models, a leading approach to world modelling, face fundamental limitations. They often violate physical and logical rules, lack interactivity, and operate as opaque black boxes ill-suited for building structured, queryable worlds. To overcome these challenges, we propose a new paradigm focused on distilling an image caption pair into a tractable, abstract representation optimized for simulation. We introduce VDAWorld, a framework where a Vision-Language Model (VLM) acts as an intelligent agent to orchestrate this process. The VLM autonomously constructs a grounded (2D or 3D) scene representation by selecting from a suite of vision tools, and accordingly chooses a compatible physics simulator (e.g., rigid body, fluid) to act upon it. VDAWorld can then infer latent dynamics from the static scene to predict plausible future states. Our experiments show that this combination of intelligent abstraction and adaptive simulation results in a versatile world model capable of producing high quality simulations across a wide range of scenarios. We demonstrate several applications of VDAWorld across interactive control and counterfactual generation, and physical and logical reasoning, achieving state-of-the-art results on several benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新范式，通过将图像-标题对提炼为适合仿真的抽象表示，从而构建可交互、可查询的世界模型。VDAWorld 框架利用视觉语言模型（VLM）作为智能代理，自动选择视觉工具构建场景表示，并选择合适的物理模拟器进行仿真。实验表明该方法在多个基准上达到最优性能。
Motivation: 生成式视频模型作为世界建模的主流方法存在违反物理逻辑、缺乏交互性、黑箱等问题。
Method: 提出 VDAWorld 框架，其中 VLM 自主选择视觉工具构建 2D 或 3D 场景表示，并选择兼容的物理模拟器（如刚体、流体），然后从静态场景推断潜在动力学以预测未来状态。
Result: 实验表明该方法在多个场景中产生高质量仿真，并在交互控制、反事实生成、物理和逻辑推理等多个基准上取得最优结果。
Conclusion: 该组合的智能抽象和自适应仿真生成了一个通用世界模型，适用于广泛场景。

papers.title: Training Diffusion Policies via Prior-Mapping Co-Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) faces a persistent tension: policies that are stable to optimize (e.g., Gaussians) are often too simple to represent the multimodal action distributions required for complex control. Conversely, expressive generative policies -- such as diffusion and flow matching -- can be difficult to optimize in online RL due to intractable likelihoods and gradients propagating through long sampling chains. We address this tension with a key structural principle: decoupling optimization from generation. Building on this, we introduce GoRL (Generative Online Reinforcement Learning), an algorithm-agnostic framework that trains expressive policies from scratch by confining policy optimization to a tractable latent space while delegating action synthesis to a conditional generative decoder. Viewed as prior-mapping co-evolution, each stage first improves a tractable latent prior through RL and then consolidates the resulting behavior into a more expressive prior-to-action mapping. This two-timescale schedule, anchored by fixed-prior decoder refinement, enables stable optimization while continuously expanding expressiveness. Empirically, \textsc{GoRL} consistently outperforms unimodal and generative baselines across diverse continuous-control tasks. Notably, GoRL achieves returns exceeding 870 on HopperStand, more than 3* the strongest baseline; on high-dimensional humanoid tasks, it further outperforms the strongest non-GoRL baseline by over an order of magnitude.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GoRL，一种用于在线强化学习的算法无关框架，通过将策略优化限制在可处理的潜空间并利用条件生成解码器合成动作，解耦优化与生成过程。该方法基于先验映射协同演化，交替改进潜先验和先验到动作的映射，在多种连续控制任务上超越单峰和生成式基线。
Motivation: 强化学习面临优化稳定性与表达能力之间的张力：易于优化的策略（如高斯）过于简单，而表达力强的生成式策略（如扩散模型）在在线RL中因似然不可解和梯度通过长采样链传播而难以优化。
Method: 提出GoRL框架，核心是将策略优化限制在可处理的潜空间，而动作合成由条件生成解码器负责。该过程视为先验映射协同演化：每阶段先用RL改进可处理的潜先验，再通过固定先验的解码器精炼将行为固化为更表达力的先验到动作映射，采用两时间尺度调度。
Result: 在多种连续控制任务上，GoRL一致优于单峰和生成式基线。在HopperStand上回报超过870，是强基线的3倍以上；在高维人形任务上，非GoRL强基线提升一个数量级以上。
Conclusion: 解耦优化与生成是训练表达力策略的有效原则，GoRL通过两时间尺度先验映射协同演化实现了稳定优化与表达能力扩展。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Robust 3DGS-based SLAM via Adaptive Kernel Smoothing
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we challenge the conventional notion in 3DGS-SLAM that rendering quality is the primary determinant of tracking accuracy. We argue that, compared to solely pursuing a perfect scene representation, it is more critical to enhance the robustness of the rasterization process against parameter errors to ensure stable camera pose tracking. To address this challenge, we propose a novel approach that leverages a smooth kernel strategy to enhance the robustness of 3DGS-based SLAM. Unlike conventional methods that focus solely on minimizing rendering error, our core insight is to make the rasterization process more resilient to imperfections in the 3DGS parameters. We hypothesize that by allowing each Gaussian to influence a smoother, wider distribution of pixels during rendering, we can mitigate the detrimental effects of parameter noise from outlier Gaussians. This approach intentionally introduces a controlled blur to the rendered image, which acts as a regularization term, stabilizing the subsequent pose optimization. While a complete redesign of the rasterization pipeline is an ideal solution, we propose a practical and effective alternative that is readily integrated into existing 3DGS frameworks. Our method, termed Corrective Blurry KNN (CB-KNN), adaptively modifies the RGB values and locations of the K-nearest neighboring Gaussians within a local region. This dynamic adjustment generates a smoother local rendering, reducing the impact of erroneous GS parameters on the overall image. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach, while maintaining the overall quality of the scene reconstruction (mapping), significantly improves the robustness and accuracy of camera pose tracking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑3DGS-SLAM中渲染质量决定跟踪精度的传统观点，提出通过自适应核平滑增强光栅化过程对参数误差的鲁棒性。作者提出CB-KNN方法，动态修改局部K近邻高斯体的RGB值和位置，生成更平滑的局部渲染，从而稳定相机位姿跟踪。实验表明该方法在保持重建质量的同时显著提升跟踪鲁棒性和精度。
Motivation: 现有3DGS-SLAM方法过度追求场景表示精度，但光栅化过程对参数误差敏感，导致相机跟踪不稳定。本文旨在增强光栅化对参数噪声的鲁棒性。
Method: 提出Corrective Blurry KNN (CB-KNN)策略，在渲染过程中自适应修改局部K近邻高斯体的RGB值和位置，引入可控模糊作为正则化项，使光栅化对异常高斯体的参数误差更不敏感。
Result: 实验证明该方法在保持场景重建质量的同时，显著提升了相机位姿跟踪的鲁棒性和准确性。
Conclusion: 本文挑战了传统观念，表明通过平滑光栅化而非单纯追求渲染质量可以更有效地提升跟踪性能，提出的CB-KNN可轻松集成到现有3DGS框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Null-Space Diffusion Distillation Unlocks Speed, Fidelity and Realism in Lensless Imaging
authors: Jose Reinaldo Cunha Santos A V Silva Neto
papers.abstract_en: Lensless imaging reconstructs scenes from highly multiplexed measurements, resulting in a severely ill-posed inverse problem. In this work, we identify a fundamental trade-off between measurement consistency, perceptual quality, and inference speed across lensless reconstruction paradigms. Traditional methods favor consistency but produce perceptually degraded results, supervised approaches achieve high-quality reconstructions with fast inference but may violate physical constraints, and diffusion-prior methods achieve high perceptual quality and consistency--particularly when structured constraints such as range-null decomposition are used--but remain slow due to iterative sampling. Motivated by this observation, we propose Null-Space Diffusion Distillation (NSDD), a single-pass reconstruction model that distills structured diffusion-prior inference into an efficient feed-forward network. NSDD learns to produce high-quality reconstructions that preserve measurement consistency while avoiding costly iterative sampling. Experimental results demonstrate that NSDD achieves perceptual quality and consistency competitive with diffusion-prior methods, while providing significantly faster inference and offering a favorable balance across all three objectives. Furthermore, ablation experiments show that distilling the range--null decomposition improves reconstruction quality and robustness over unstructured full-reconstruction distillation, including on unseen real scenes. These results highlight the potential of structure-aware distillation for efficient lensless imaging. Code is available at github.com/JRCSAVSN/NullSpaceDiffusionDistillation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无透镜成像中测量一致性、感知质量和推理速度之间的权衡，提出零空间扩散蒸馏（NSDD），将结构化扩散先验推理蒸馏为单次前馈网络，实现高质量重建并保持测量一致性，同时避免迭代采样。实验表明NSDD在感知质量和一致性上可与扩散先验方法竞争，且推理更快。
Motivation: 无透镜成像重建是严重病态逆问题，现有方法在测量一致性、感知质量和推理速度三者间难以兼得：传统方法一致性好但感知质量差，监督方法速度快但可能违反物理约束，扩散先验方法质量高但推理慢。
Method: 提出Null-Space Diffusion Distillation (NSDD)，将基于范围-零分解（range-null decomposition）的结构化扩散先验推理蒸馏为高效的单次前馈网络，学习生成高质量重建并保持测量一致性。
Result: NSDD在感知质量和一致性上与扩散先验方法相当，同时显著加快推理速度；消融实验表明蒸馏范围-零分解比非结构化全重建蒸馏能改善重建质量和鲁棒性，包括在未见真实场景上。
Conclusion: 结构感知蒸馏（structure-aware distillation）有望实现高效的无透镜成像，NSDD为平衡三个目标提供了有利方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Decision-Focused Continual Learning for Seaport Power-Logistics Scheduling: Generalization across Varying Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Power-logistics scheduling in modern seaports typically follows a predict-then-optimize pipeline. To enhance the decision quality of predictions, decision-focused learning has been proposed, which aligns the training of forecasting models with downstream decision outcomes. However, this end-to-end design inherently restricts the value of forecasting models to a specific task structure and therefore generalizes poorly to evolving tasks induced by varying vessel arrivals. We address this gap with a decision-focused continual learning framework that adapts online to a stream of scheduling tasks. Specifically, we introduce Fisher-information-based regularization to enhance cross-task generalization by preserving parameters critical to prior tasks. A differentiable convex surrogate is also developed to stabilize gradient backpropagation. The proposed approach enables learning a decision-aligned forecasting model across a varying task stream with sustainable long-term computational and memory requirements. Experiments calibrated to Jurong Port show improved decision performance and cross-task generalization over existing methods, together with reduced computational cost and a bounded memory footprint.
papers.comment: Preprint to IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种决策聚焦持续学习框架，用于海港电力物流调度中的预测-优化问题。该框架通过Fisher信息正则化保留对先前任务关键的参数，并开发可微凸代理稳定梯度传播，从而在线适应不断变化的调度任务流。基于裕廊港的实验表明，该方法相比现有方法提升了决策性能和跨任务泛化能力，同时降低了计算成本并限制了内存增长。
Motivation: 现有决策聚焦学习将预测模型与特定任务结构绑定，导致对船舶到达变化引起的演变任务泛化能力差。
Method: 提出持续学习框架，在线适应任务流；引入Fisher信息正则化增强跨任务泛化，并开发可微凸代理以稳定梯度反向传播。
Result: 在裕廊港校准实验中，相比现有方法，决策性能提升，跨任务泛化更好，计算成本降低，内存占用有界。
Conclusion: 该框架能够在变化的任务流中学习决策对齐的预测模型，且计算和内存需求可持续。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Revisiting the Neural Tangent Kernel: the role of large width and depth
papers.abstract_en: Overparameterized fully-connected neural networks have been shown to behave like kernel models when trained with gradient descent, assuming standard scaling conditions on the width, the learning rate, and the parameter initialization. In the limit of infinitely large widths and infinitesimal learning rate, the obtained kernel provides a description of the learned model's output via a closed-form solution dependent on the architecture and the activation function. The Neural Tangent Kernel, central to this description, remains constant throughout training, a phenomenon that is referred to as ``lazy training'' or within the ``lazy regime''. Prior works show that the ``lazy regime'' leads to non-varying hidden neuron activations in infinitely-wide networks. Moreover, as infinitely-wide networks increase in depth, the Neural Tangent Kernel induces a closed-form solution that is data-independent, hence trivial. The Neural Tangent Kernel seemingly fails to describe the complexity of overparameterized neural networks on two distinct axes: large widths and large depths. In this work, we challenge these two conclusions and open the door to re-evaluating the Neural Tangent Kernel's role in describing the output of overparameterized neural networks. Specifically, we show experimentally that while deviations in the activations of individual hidden neurons vanish, the aggregate norm of these deviations does not. We support this finding with a theoretical result showing that the activations of the last hidden layer do not remain constant. Furthermore, we demonstrate that properly scaling the depth and stopping time in infinitely-wide ReLU networks yields a well-behaved, non-trivial output at large dataset sizes. We empirically evaluate the stability of this behavior on large datasets, and we describe the essential properties that enable the generalization of our results to other kernels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视神经正切核（NTK）在大宽度和深度下的表现，通过实验和理论证明，虽然单个隐藏神经元激活的偏差消失，但聚合范数并不消失，且最后一层激活并非恒定。在无限宽ReLU网络中，适当缩放深度和停止时间可在大数据集上得到非平凡输出，为NTK的描述能力提供了新视角。
Motivation: 现有理论认为无限宽网络中NTK导致隐藏层激活不变，且深度增加时输出变得平凡，无法描述实际超参数化网络的复杂性；本文试图挑战这两点结论。
Method: 通过实验观察隐藏层激活的聚合范数变化，并结合理论分析证明最后一层激活的不恒定性；通过缩放深度和停止时间在大数据集上验证输出行为。
Result: 实验表明隐藏层激活的聚合范数不消失，且适当缩放深度和停止时间后，无限宽ReLU网络在大数据集上产生非平凡输出。
Conclusion: 本文认为NTK并非无法描述大宽度和大深度下的网络行为，并描述了使结果泛化到其他核所需的关键性质。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MedFedPure: A Medical Federated Framework with MAE-based Detection and Diffusion Purification for Inference-Time Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) has shown great potential in medical imaging, particularly for brain tumor detection using Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI). However, the models remain vulnerable at inference time when they are trained collaboratively through Federated Learning (FL), an approach adopted to protect patient privacy. Adversarial attacks can subtly alter medical scans in ways invisible to the human eye yet powerful enough to mislead AI models, potentially causing serious misdiagnoses. Existing defenses often assume centralized data and struggle to cope with the decentralized and diverse nature of federated medical settings. In this work, we present MedFedPure, a personalized federated learning defense framework designed to protect diagnostic AI models at inference time without compromising privacy or accuracy. MedFedPure combines three key elements: (1) a personalized FL model that adapts to the unique data distribution of each institution; (2) a Masked Autoencoder (MAE) that detects suspicious inputs by exposing hidden perturbations; and (3) an adaptive diffusion-based purification module that selectively cleans only the flagged scans before classification. Together, these steps offer robust protection while preserving the integrity of normal, benign images. We evaluated MedFedPure on the Br35H brain MRI dataset. The results show a significant gain in adversarial robustness, improving performance from 49.50% to 87.33% under strong attacks, while maintaining a high clean accuracy of 97.67%. By operating locally and in real time during diagnosis, our framework provides a practical path to deploying secure, trustworthy, and privacy-preserving AI tools in clinical workflows. Index Terms: cancer, tumor detection, federated learning, masked autoencoder, diffusion, privacy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedFedPure，一个针对联邦学习中推理时攻击的个性化防御框架，结合 Masked Autoencoder (MAE) 检测异常输入和扩散模型净化受攻击样本，在脑 MRI 数据集 Br35H 上，将强攻击下的准确率从 49.50% 提升至 87.33%，同时保持干净数据准确率 97.67%。
Motivation: 联邦学习下的医学影像模型在推理时易受对抗攻击，现有防御大多假设集中数据，难以适应联邦场景的分散性和数据异构性。
Method: 构建三组件框架：个性化联邦学习模型适配各机构数据分布；MAE 检测隐藏扰动；自适应扩散净化模块仅对标记的异常样本进行选择性去噪。
Result: 在 Br35H 脑 MRI 数据集上，强攻击下准确率从 49.50% 提升至 87.33%，干净样本准确率 97.67%。
Conclusion: MedFedPure 通过本地实时运行，在推理时保护模型安全且不牺牲隐私或精度，为临床部署提供可行方案。

summary_sections.method: 构建三组件框架：个性化联邦学习模型适配各机构数据分布；MAE 检测隐藏扰动；自适应扩散净化模块仅对标记的异常样本进行选择性去噪。
summary_sections.result: 在 Br35H 脑 MRI 数据集上，强攻击下准确率从 49.50% 提升至 87.33%，干净样本准确率 97.67%。
summary_sections.conclusion: MedFedPure 通过本地实时运行，在推理时保护模型安全且不牺牲隐私或精度，为临床部署提供可行方案。

papers.title: Model Inversion meets Cryptographic Fuzzy Extractors
papers.abstract_en: Model inversion attacks pose an open challenge to privacy-sensitive applications that use machine learning (ML) models. For example, face authentication systems use modern ML models to compute embedding vectors from face images of the enrolled users and store them. If leaked, inversion attacks can accurately reconstruct user faces from the leaked vectors. A fuzzy extractor (FE) is a cryptographic primitive with properties that can help defend against model inversion, offering attack-agnostic security without requiring any re-training of the ML model it protects. To date, no systematic cryptanalysis of existing FE schemes that tolerate $\ell_2$ noise, as needed in modern ML-based face recognition systems, has been conducted. We perform the first in-depth security analysis of existing $\ell_2$-FE schemes showing that they offer weak security. We also show end-to-end inversion attacks that achieve high success rates in recovering original faces that are meant to be protected by FE schemes. We then offer a simple but new candidate scheme and prove its security formally. Our construction offers the first design point that offers practical runtime, stronger security, and usable accuracy for use in commodity ML-based face authentication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统分析了现有容忍ℓ2噪声的模糊提取器（ℓ2-FE）方案的安全性，发现其安全性较弱，并展示了端到端反转攻击成功恢复受保护的人脸图像。作者提出一种新的候选方案，并在形式上证明了其安全性，兼顾了实用运行时间、更强的安全性和可用精度，适用于基于ML的人脸认证。
Motivation: 模型反转攻击对使用机器学习模型的隐私敏感应用（如人脸认证系统）构成威胁；现有模糊提取器方案虽可防御反转攻击，但未经过系统的密码分析，尤其是针对现代人脸识别所需的ℓ2噪声容忍方案。
Method: 对现有ℓ2-FE方案进行深度安全分析，指出其安全缺陷；提出一种新的构造方案，并给出形式化的安全证明。
Result: 现有ℓ2-FE方案安全性弱，反转攻击能高成功率恢复原始人脸；新方案在实用运行时间下提供更强安全性并保持可用精度。
Conclusion: 当前ℓ2-FE方案不足以抵抗模型反转攻击，作者的新方案首次在实用性和安全性上取得良好折中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GenTrack: A New Generation of Multi-Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel multi-object tracking (MOT) method, dubbed GenTrack, whose main contributions include: first-a hybrid tracking approach employing both stochastic and deterministic manners to robustly handle unknown and time-varying numbers of targets, particularly in maintaining target identity (ID) consistency and managing nonlinear dynamics, second-leveraging particle swarm optimization (PSO) with some proposed fitness measures to guide stochastic particles toward their target distribution modes, enabling effective tracking even with weak and noisy object detectors, third-integration of social interactions among targets to enhance PSO-guided particles as well as improve continuous updates of both strong (matched) and weak (unmatched) tracks, thereby reducing ID switches and track loss, especially during occlusions, fourth-a GenTrack-based redefined visual MOT baseline incorporating a comprehensive state and observation model based on space consistency, appearance, detection confidence, track penalties, and social scores for systematic and efficient target updates, and five-the first ever publicly available source-code reference implementation with minimal dependencies, featuring three variants, including GenTrack Simple, Strengthen, and Super, facilitating flexible reimplementation. Experimental results have shown that GenTrack provides superior performance on standard benchmarks and real-world scenarios compared to state-of-the-art trackers, with integrated implementations of baselines for fair comparison. Potential directions for future work are also discussed. The source-code reference implementations of both the proposed method and compared-trackers are provided on GitHub: https://github.com/SDU-VelKoTek/GenTrack
papers.comment: The content of this paper was included in the full manuscript of GenTrack family which has been submitted to the journal for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的多目标跟踪方法 GenTrack，融合随机与确定性跟踪策略，利用粒子群优化（PSO）引导粒子分布，并结合目标间社交交互来增强跟踪鲁棒性。在标准基准和真实场景中，GenTrack 优于现有方法，并提供了三种变体及开源实现。
Motivation: 现有 MOT 方法在处理未知时变目标数量、身份一致性维护以及弱检测器下非线性动态时存在不足。
Method: GenTrack 混合随机与确定性跟踪：采用 PSO 算法，设计适应度函数引导粒子朝向目标分布模式；集成社交交互模型以改进强弱航迹的连续更新；并构建包含空间一致性、外观、检测置信度、航迹惩罚和社交分数的综合状态观测模型。
Result: 在标准 MOT 基准和真实场景中，GenTrack 优于现有最先进跟踪器，并提供了公平对比的基线实现。
Conclusion: GenTrack 在鲁棒性和身份一致性上取得显著提升，未来工作方向包括进一步优化社交模型及应对复杂遮挡。

papers.title: When Compression Becomes an Attack Surface: Black-Box Attacks on Prompt-Compressed LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Prompt compression is increasingly deployed in LLM agents to reduce latency and cost, but it also determines what the backend LLM ultimately sees. We show that, when trusted and untrusted inputs are compressed under a shared budget, this lossy transformation creates a new attack surface: by perturbing only untrusted inputs before compression, an adversary can cause the compressor to discard task-critical evidence or safety guardrails before inference. Unlike prompt injection, jailbreaks, or RAG poisoning, the attack target is the compressor rather than the backend LLM; the perturbation need not encode a meaningful instruction or survive compression. We formalize this vulnerability as adversarial information loss (AIL), the excess downstream distortion caused by adversarially steering a lossy compressor beyond benign compression alone. To exploit AIL, we present COMA, a transfer-based black-box attack that optimizes pre-compression perturbations using attacker-side surrogate compressors and backend LLMs. Across three tasks and six compressors, COMA achieves 0.71 average ASR, versus 0.21 for the strongest baseline, and transfers to two real-world agent case studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示提示压缩（prompt compression）在LLM代理中引入新的攻击面：当可信与不可信输入在同一预算下被压缩时，攻击者可通过扰动不可信输入使压缩器丢弃任务关键证据或安全护栏，导致下游推理失真。作者将这种漏洞形式化为对抗性信息损失（AIL），并提出基于迁移的黑盒攻击COMA，在三个任务和六个压缩器上实现平均0.71的攻击成功率。
Motivation: 现有研究关注提示注入、越狱或RAG投毒，但忽略了压缩环节本身可能成为攻击目标。当压缩器同时处理可信和不可信输入时，有意的扰动可能导致压缩器丢失关键信息。
Method: 形式化对抗性信息损失（AIL）概念，提出COMA攻击：利用攻击者侧的替代压缩器和后端LLM，通过迁移优化预压缩扰动，实现黑盒攻击。
Result: 在三个任务和六个压缩器上，COMA平均攻击成功率为0.71，而最强基线仅为0.21，并成功迁移到两个真实代理案例。
Conclusion: 提示压缩成为LLM代理的安全薄弱环节，需要开发对压缩稳健的防护机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interpretable Machine Learning for Predicting Startup Funding, Patenting, and Exits
papers.abstract_en: This study develops an interpretable machine learning framework to forecast startup outcomes, including funding, patenting, and exit. A firm-quarter panel for 2010-2023 is constructed from Crunchbase and matched to U.S. Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) data. Three horizons are evaluated: next funding within 12 months, patent-stock growth within 24 months, and exit through an initial public offering (IPO) or acquisition within 36 months. Preprocessing is fit on a development window (2010-2019) and applied without change to later cohorts to avoid leakage. Class imbalance is addressed using inverse-prevalence weights and the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique for Nominal and Continuous features (SMOTE-NC). Logistic regression and tree ensembles, including Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost, are compared using the area under the precision-recall curve (PR-AUC) and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). Patent, funding, and exit predictions achieve AUROC values of 0.921, 0.817, and 0.872, providing transparent and reproducible rankings for innovation finance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文开发了一个可解释的机器学习框架，用于预测初创公司的融资、专利和退出结果。基于Crunchbase和美国专利商标局（USPTO）数据构建了2010-2023年的公司季度面板数据，分别在12个月、24个月和36个月内预测下一次融资、专利存量增长和退出（IPO或收购）。预处理在2010-2019年的开发窗口上拟合，并原封不动地应用于后续队列以避免数据泄露。使用逆患病率权重和SMOTE-NC处理类别不平衡。比较了逻辑回归和树集成模型（随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost），专利、融资和退出预测的AUROC分别达到0.921、0.817和0.872。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对初创公司融资、专利和退出结果的可解释预测框架。
Method: 构建公司季度面板数据，预处理在开发窗口上拟合后不变地应用于后续队列。使用逆患病率权重和SMOTE-NC处理类别不平衡。比较逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost，评估指标为PR-AUC和AUROC。
Result: 专利、融资和退出预测的AUROC分别为0.921、0.817和0.872。
Conclusion: 框架提供了透明且可重复的排名，可用于创新金融。

papers.title: GyroSwin: 5D Surrogates for Gyrokinetic Plasma Turbulence Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Nuclear fusion plays a pivotal role in the quest for reliable and sustainable energy production. A major roadblock to viable fusion power is understanding plasma turbulence, which significantly impairs plasma confinement, and is vital for next-generation reactor design. Plasma turbulence is governed by the nonlinear gyrokinetic equation, which evolves a 5D distribution function over time. Due to its high computational cost, reduced-order models are often employed in practice to approximate turbulent transport of energy. However, they omit nonlinear effects unique to the full 5D dynamics. To tackle this, we introduce GyroSwin, the first scalable 5D neural surrogate that can model 5D nonlinear gyrokinetic simulations, thereby capturing the physical phenomena neglected by reduced models, while providing accurate estimates of turbulent heat transport. GyroSwin (i) extends hierarchical Vision Transformers to 5D, (ii) introduces cross-attention and integration modules for latent 3D$\leftrightarrow$5D interactions between electrostatic potential fields and the distribution function, and (iii) performs channelwise mode separation inspired by nonlinear physics. We demonstrate that GyroSwin outperforms widely used reduced numerics on heat flux prediction, captures the turbulent energy cascade, and reduces the cost of fully resolved nonlinear gyrokinetics by three orders of magnitude while remaining physically verifiable. GyroSwin shows promising scaling laws, tested up to one billion parameters, paving the way for scalable neural surrogates for gyrokinetic simulations of plasma turbulence.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2025, First authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GyroSwin，首个可扩展的5D神经代理模型，用于模拟旋动等离子体湍流的非线性动力学。GyroSwin将层次化Vision Transformer扩展到5D，通过交叉注意力机制实现3D电位场与5D分布函数之间的交互，并采用基于物理的通道模式分离。实验表明，GyroSwin在热通量预测上优于传统简化模型，能捕捉湍流能量级联，同时将完全非线性旋动模拟的计算成本降低三个数量级，并展示了高达10亿参数的可扩展性。
Motivation: 核聚变中，等离子体湍流严重阻碍约束性能，但其全5D非线性旋动模拟计算成本极高，现有降阶模型忽略了关键的5D非线性效应。
Method: GyroSwin通过三个关键设计实现5D神经代理：(i) 将层次化Vision Transformer扩展到5D维度；(ii) 引入交叉注意力与集成模块建模静电势场与分布函数之间的3D↔5D相互作用；(iii) 受非线性物理启发，执行通道级模式分离。
Result: GyroSwin在热通量预测上优于广泛使用的简化数值模型，能够捕捉湍流能量级联，并将完全非线性旋动模拟的计算成本降低三个数量级，同时保持物理可验证性。
Conclusion: GyroSwin为可扩展的旋动等离子体湍流神经代理铺平了道路，其良好的缩放定律表明可进一步扩展至更大规模。

papers.title: Spatially Grounded Concept-Based Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks can achieve high accuracy while relying on evidence that is hard to inspect or misaligned with the intended task. Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) expose human-interpretable concepts, but most treat concepts as global attributes and do not show how localized evidence is aggregated into a decision. We propose \textbf{SEG-MIL-CBM}, a spatially grounded CBM that decomposes each image into concept-guided regions and classifies it by attention-based aggregation of segment-level concept evidence. The same segment evidence terms form the prediction and the explanation, exposing which regions and concepts support the predicted logit without a separate post-hoc attribution module. Among evaluated CBM-family baselines, SEG-MIL-CBM improves Waterbirds worst-group accuracy from $65.1\%$ to $72.0\%$, reaches $87.4\%$ worst-group accuracy on Pawrious, remains competitive on standard recognition, and attains the best CBM accuracy on CIFAR-100 ($85.3\%$). Segment-level faithfulness experiments on CUB further show that its learned segment ranking matches or improves over evaluated segment-ranking controls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SEG-MIL-CBM，一种空间接地概念瓶颈模型，将图像分解为概念引导区域，通过基于注意力的段级概念证据聚合进行分类，无需单独的后验归因模块即可提供解释。在Waterbirds上最差组准确率从65.1%提升至72.0%，在Pawrious上达到87.4%，在CIFAR-100上达到最佳CBM准确率85.3%。
Motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型（CBM）将概念视为全局属性，缺乏局部证据如何聚合的可见性，且依赖事后的归因解释，难以检查模型的证据是否与任务对齐。
Method: 提出SEG-MIL-CBM，将每个图像分解为概念引导区域，通过基于注意力的聚合段级概念证据进行分类，并使用相同的段证据同时提供预测和解释。
Result: 在Waterbirds上最差组准确率从65.1%提升至72.0%，在Pawrious上达到87.4%最差组准确率，在CIFAR-100上达到85.3%的CBM最佳准确率，并在CUB的段级忠实性实验中表现优于或等于基线。
Conclusion: 该方法无需单独的后验归因模块即可提供局部解释，在多个数据集上提升了最差组准确率并保持标准识别竞争力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Frequency Response Identification of Low-Order Systems: Finite-Sample Analysis
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a frequency-domain estimator for low-order systems from repeated noisy measurements. The estimator minimizes a quadratic data-fitting term regularized by the nuclear norm of a Loewner matrix, subject to a convex stability constraint enforced via a semidefinite program. We prove a finite-sample error bound at the sampled frequencies and extend it to all frequencies through rational interpolation. The bound characterizes the dependence on the number of repeated experiments, number of frequency points, system order, and noise level. Numerical experiments on SISO and MIMO systems demonstrate the low-order-promoting effect of the method and validate the predicted scaling laws.
papers.comment: 16 pages, Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低阶系统提出了一种基于频域的估计器，通过最小化由Loewner矩阵核范数正则化的二次数据拟合项，并施加凸稳定性约束（半定规划）。证明了在采样频率处的有限样本误差界，并通过有理插值推广到所有频率。数值实验验证了方法的低阶促进效应和预测的缩放规律。
Motivation: 现有频域辨识方法缺乏有限样本保证，尤其对于重复实验场景下的低阶系统。
Method: 提出频率域估计器，最小化二次数据拟合项加上Loewner矩阵的核范数正则化，稳定性约束通过半定规划实现。
Result: 证明了在采样频率处的有限样本误差界，并推广到全频域；数值实验表明方法能有效促进低阶并符合理论缩放规律。
Conclusion: 该估计器提供了理论保证，适用于SISO和MIMO系统的低阶辨识。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mitigating Cross-Image Information Leakage in Multi-Image Understanding with Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) exhibit strong performance on single-image tasks. However, their performance degrades significantly when handling multi-image inputs. While this degradation has been observed in prior work, its nature remains poorly understood. We empirically observe visual elements from different images become entangled in the model's representations and responses. We refer to this phenomenon as cross-image information leakage. To address this issue, we propose FOCUS, a training-free and architecture-agnostic method. FOCUS masks all but one image with random noise, guiding the model to focus on the single clean image. This process is applied across the target images to obtain logits under partially masked contexts. These logits are aggregated and then refined using a noise-only reference input, which suppresses the leakage and yields more accurate outputs. FOCUS consistently improves performance on diverse multi-image benchmarks. We further show that FOCUS generalizes to video understanding, extending its applicability beyond static multi-image inputs. This demonstrates that FOCUS offers a general solution for enhancing multi-image reasoning without additional training or architectural modifications.
papers.comment: Source code is available at https://github.com/yejipark-m/FOCUS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在多图像输入时出现跨图像信息泄漏，即不同图像的视觉元素在表示和响应中相互纠缠。提出无需训练且架构无关的方法FOCUS，通过随机噪声掩码其余图像，让模型专注于单个干净图像，聚合logits并用纯噪声参考抑制泄漏。在多个多图像基准上一致提升性能，并推广到视频理解。
Motivation: 现有LVLMs在单图像任务表现好，但在多图像输入时性能显著下降，且其本质原因尚不明确。本文实证观察到跨图像信息泄漏现象。
Method: 提出FOCUS，一种无需训练、架构无关的方法。对目标图像，将其他图像替换为随机噪声，获得部分掩码上下文下的logits；聚合这些logits，再使用纯噪声参考输入进行精炼，抑制泄漏。
Result: 在多个多图像基准上一致提升性能，并推广到视频理解任务，无需额外训练或架构修改。
Conclusion: FOCUS提供了一种通用的多图像推理增强方案，无需训练或架构修改，适用于静态多图像和视频理解。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Quantum Visual Fields with Neural Amplitude Encoding
papers.abstract_en: Quantum Implicit Neural Representations (QINRs) have emerged as a promising paradigm that leverages parametrised quantum circuits to encode and process classical information. However, significant challenges remain in areas such as ansatz architecture design, the effective utility of quantum-mechanical properties, training efficiency, and the integration with classical modules. This paper advances the field by introducing a novel QINR architecture for 2D image and 3D geometric field learning, which we collectively refer to as Quantum Visual Field (QVF). QVF encodes classical data into quantum statevectors using neural amplitude encoding grounded in a learnable energy manifold, ensuring meaningful Hilbert-space embeddings. Our ansatz follows a fully entangled design of learnable parametrised quantum circuits, with quantum (unitary) operations performed in the real Hilbert space, resulting in numerically stable training with fast convergence. QVF does not rely on classical post-processing -- in contrast to the previous QINR learning approach -- and directly employs measurements to extract learned signals encoded in the ansatz. Experiments on a quantum hardware simulator demonstrate that QVF outperforms an existing quantum approach and competes with widely used classical foundational baselines in terms of visual representation accuracy across various metrics and model characteristics. We also show applications of QVF in 2D and 3D field completion and 3D shape interpolation, highlighting its practical potential. Project page: https://4dqv.mpi-inf.mpg.de/QVF/.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2025; 19 pages, 13 figures and four tables; project page: https://4dqv.mpi-inf.mpg.de/QVF/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量子视觉场（QVF），一种新颖的量子隐式神经表示架构，用于2D图像和3D几何场学习。QVF利用可学习的能量流形进行神经幅度编码，将经典数据编码到量子态向量，并采用全纠缠参数化量子电路，直接使用测量输出信号，无需经典后处理。实验表明QVF在视觉表示精度上优于现有量子方法，并与经典基线竞争，同时展示了2D/3D场补全和3D形状插值的应用。
Motivation: 现有量子隐式神经表示（QINR）在ansatz架构设计、量子力学特性的有效利用、训练效率以及与经典模块的集成方面存在显著挑战。
Method: 提出QVF架构，使用基于可学习能量流形的神经幅度编码将经典数据嵌入希尔伯特空间；采用实希尔伯特空间中的全纠缠参数化量子电路进行酉操作；直接使用测量结果提取学习信号，无需经典后处理。
Result: 在量子硬件模拟器上，QVF在视觉表示精度上优于现有量子方法，并与广泛使用的经典基线相竞争，在多个指标上表现良好。
Conclusion: QVF展示了量子隐式神经表示在2D和3D视觉任务中的潜力，包括场补全和形状插值，但未提及与气象相关的应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: UniFFBench: Evaluating Universal Machine Learning Force Fields Against Experimental Measurements
papers.abstract_en: Universal machine learning force fields (UMLFFs) promise to revolutionize materials science by enabling rapid atomistic simulations across the periodic table. However, their evaluation has been limited to computational benchmarks that may not reflect real-world performance. We introduce UniFFBench, a comprehensive evaluation framework featuring the MinX dataset -- a diverse collection of 1,500+ mineral systems spanning 85 elements, extreme thermodynamic conditions (0--5000 K, 0--1000 GPa), and structural complexity, including partial occupancy and disorder. This diversity, combined with experimental reference values for validation, enables assessment of UMLFF generalization across chemical space and conditions substantially beyond typical training scenarios. Our systematic evaluation of six state-of-the-art UMLFFs reveals a substantial ``reality gap'': models achieving impressive performance on computational benchmarks often fail when confronted with experimental complexity. Even the best-performing models exhibit higher density prediction error than the threshold required for practical applications. We observe disconnects between simulation stability and mechanical property accuracy, with prediction errors correlating with training data representation rather than the modeling method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniFFBench 基准框架和 MinX 数据集（1500+ 矿物体系，涵盖85种元素、极端热力学条件和结构无序），用于评估通用机器学习力场（UMLFF）在实验测量上的表现。对六种现有 UMLFF 的系统评估揭示了“现实差距”：模型在计算基准上表现优异，但在实验复杂度下失效，密度预测误差甚至超过实际应用阈值。
Motivation: 现有 UMLFF 评估局限于计算基准，可能无法反映真实实验性能，缺乏涵盖多样化学空间和极端条件的实验验证基准。
Method: 构建 UniFFBench 框架，包含 MinX 数据集（1500+ 矿物，85元素，0–5000 K，0–1000 GPa，部分占位和无序），以实验参考值为验证标准，评估 UMLFF 的泛化能力。
Result: 六种 UMLFF 在计算基准上表现良好，但面对实验复杂度时性能显著下降；最佳模型的密度预测误差仍高于实际应用阈值；模拟稳定性与力学性质精度脱钩，预测误差与训练数据代表性相关而非建模方法。
Conclusion: UMLFF 存在明显的现实差距，当前模型缺乏实验可迁移性，未来需要关注训练数据覆盖和实验验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robust and Differentially Private Principal Component Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances have sparked significant interest in the development of privacy-preserving Principal Component Analysis (PCA). However, many existing approaches rely on restrictive assumptions, such as assuming sub-Gaussian data or being vulnerable to data contamination. Additionally, some methods are computationally expensive or depend on unknown model parameters that must be estimated, limiting their accessibility for data analysts seeking privacy-preserving PCA. In this paper, we propose a differentially private PCA method applicable to heavy-tailed and potentially contaminated data. Our approach leverages the property that the covariance matrix of properly rescaled data preserves eigenvectors and their order under elliptical distributions, which include Gaussian and heavy-tailed distributions. By applying a bounded transformation, we enable straightforward computation of principal components in a differentially private manner. Additionally, boundedness guarantees robustness against data contamination. We conduct both theoretical analysis and empirical evaluations of the proposed method, focusing on its ability to recover the subspace spanned by the leading principal components. Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing approaches in terms of statistical utility, particularly in non-Gaussian or contaminated data settings.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 6 figures before Appendix. Now published at Statistical Analysis and Data Mining
papers.journal_ref: Statistical Analysis and Data Mining, 18(6), e70053 (2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种适用于重尾和可能污染数据的差分隐私主成分分析方法。通过利用椭圆分布下重缩放数据的协方差矩阵保留特征向量及其顺序的性质，结合有界变换，实现了差分隐私主成分的简单计算，同时保证对数据污染的鲁棒性。理论和实验表明该方法在非高斯或污染数据场景下统计效用优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有差分隐私PCA方法常依赖次高斯假设或易受数据污染影响，且部分方法计算昂贵或依赖需估计的未知参数，限制了实用性。
Method: 利用椭圆分布下重缩放数据的协方差矩阵保持特征向量及其顺序的特性，对有界变换后的数据进行差分隐私主成分计算，同时实现鲁棒性。
Result: 大量数值实验表明，所提方法在统计效用上持续优于现有方法，尤其在非高斯或污染数据场景下。
Conclusion: 摘要强调方法适用于重尾和可能污染数据，提供鲁棒差分隐私PCA，且计算简单。

papers.title: CLAR: Learning 3D Representations for Robotic Manipulation by Fusing Masked Reconstruction with Multi-Level Contrastive Alignment
papers.abstract_en: The spatial information inherent in 3D point clouds is crucial for robotic manipulation. However, existing 3D pre-training methods face a fundamental trade-off: Masked Autoencoding (MAE) excels at capturing spatial-geometric features but lacks semantics, whereas contrastive learning, while able to distill semantics from 2D foundation models, is ill-suited for the fine-grained details required for manipulation tasks. To address these challenges, we propose CLAR, a novel 3D pre-training framework that synergizes global understanding with fine-grained local alignment. Our framework unifies MAE with global cross-modal contrastive learning to integrate robust spatial awareness with rich semantic understanding. To enhance its focus on fine-grained details, at the local level, we introduce an adaptive alignment mechanism that leverages deformable attention to force precise correspondences between local 3D geometry and 2D visual features, thereby overcoming the limitations of conventional global alignment in manipulation tasks. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate that CLAR achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming existing methods in visuomotor policy learning.

papers.title: Neural Concept Verifier: Scaling Prover-Verifier Games via Concept Encodings
papers.abstract_en: While Prover-Verifier Games (PVGs) offer a promising path toward verifiability in nonlinear classification models, they have not yet been applied to complex inputs such as high-dimensional images. Conversely, expressive concept encodings effectively allow to translate such data into interpretable concepts but are often utilised in the context of low-capacity linear predictors. In this work, we push towards real-world verifiability by combining the strengths of both approaches. We introduce Neural Concept Verifier (NCV), a unified framework combining PVGs for formal verifiability with concept encodings to handle complex, high-dimensional inputs in an interpretable way. NCV achieves this by utilizing recent minimally supervised concept discovery models to extract structured concept encodings from raw inputs. A prover then selects a subset of these encodings, which a verifier, implemented as a nonlinear predictor, uses exclusively for decision-making. Our evaluations show that NCV outperforms classic concept-based models and pixel-based PVG classifier baselines on high-dimensional, logically complex datasets and helps mitigate shortcut behavior. Overall, we demonstrate NCV as a promising step toward concept-level, verifiable AI.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables, revised references. An earlier version of this work was presented at the ICML 2025 Workshop on Actionable Interpretability
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经概念验证器（NCV），将证明者-验证者游戏（PVG）与概念编码相结合，以处理高维图像输入并实现形式化可验证性。NCV使用弱监督概念发现模型提取结构化概念编码，证明者选择子集，验证者作为非线性预测器仅基于这些编码进行决策。实验表明NCV在高维逻辑复杂数据集上优于经典概念模型和基于像素的PVG分类器，并有助于缓解捷径行为。
Motivation: PVG尚未应用于高维图像等复杂输入，而概念编码虽能翻译复杂数据为可解释概念但常用于低容量线性模型。本文旨在结合两者优势，推动现实世界的可验证性。
Method: 提出NCV框架，利用最小监督概念发现模型从原始输入提取结构化概念编码，证明者选择概念子集，验证者作为非线性预测器仅使用这些编码进行决策。
Result: NCV在高维逻辑复杂数据集上优于经典概念模型和基于像素的PVG分类器基线，并缓解了捷径行为。
Conclusion: NCV是迈向概念级可验证AI的有前景的一步。

papers.title: Thalia: A Global, Multi-Modal Dataset for Volcanic Activity Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Monitoring volcanic activity is of paramount importance to safeguarding lives, infrastructure, and ecosystems. However, only a small fraction of known volcanoes are continuously monitored. Satellite-based Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) enables systematic, global-scale deformation monitoring. However, its complex data challenge traditional remote sensing methods. Deep learning offers a powerful means to automate and enhance InSAR interpretation, advancing volcanology and geohazard assessment. Despite its promise, progress has been limited by the scarcity of well-curated datasets. In this work, we build on the existing Hephaestus dataset and introduce Thalia, addressing crucial limitations and enriching its scope with higher-resolution, multi-source, and multi-temporal data. Thalia is a global collection of 38 spatiotemporal datacubes covering 7 years and integrating InSAR products, topographic data, as well as atmospheric variables, known to introduce signal delays that can mimic ground deformation in InSAR imagery. Each sample includes expert annotations detailing the type, intensity, and extent of deformation, accompanied by descriptive text. To enable fair and consistent evaluation, we provide a comprehensive benchmark using state-of-the-art models for classification and segmentation. This work fosters collaboration between machine learning and Earth science, advancing volcanic monitoring and promoting data-driven approaches in geoscience. See https://github.com/Orion-AI-Lab/Thalia
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文介绍了一个名为Thalia的全球多模态数据集，用于火山活动监测。数据集包含38个时空数据立方，覆盖7年，整合了InSAR产品、地形数据和大气变量，并带有专家注释的变形类型、强度和范围。论文还提供了基于最新模型的分类和分割基准测试。
Motivation: 目前只有少数火山得到持续监测，卫星InSAR数据复杂，深度学习应用受限于缺乏高质量的标注数据集。
Method: 在现有Hephaestus数据集基础上扩展，引入更高分辨率、多源和多时相数据，构建包含InSAR、地形和大气变量的时空数据集，并提供专家注释。
Result: 论文提供了38个时空数据立方和全面的基准测试结果，但摘要中未给出具体性能数字。
Conclusion: 该数据集有望促进机器学习与地球科学在火山监测领域的合作，推动数据驱动的火山学方法。

papers.title: Towards Adaptive Categories: Dimensional Governance for Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: As AI systems evolve from static tools to dynamic agents, traditional categorical governance frameworks -- based on fixed risk tiers, levels of autonomy, or human oversight models -- are increasingly insufficient on their own. Systems built on foundation models, self-supervised learning, and multi-agent architectures increasingly blur the boundaries that categories were designed to police. In this article, we make the case for dimensional governance: a framework that tracks how decision authority, process autonomy, and accountability (the 3As) distribute dynamically across human-AI relationships. A critical advantage of this approach is its ability to explicitly monitor system movement toward and across key governance thresholds, enabling pre-emptive adjustments before risks materialise. This dimensional approach provides the necessary foundation for more adaptive categorisation, enabling thresholds and classifications that can evolve with emerging capabilities. While categories remain essential for decision-making, building them upon dimensional foundations allows for context-specific adaptability and stakeholder-responsive governance that static approaches cannot achieve. We outline key dimensions, critical trust thresholds, and practical examples illustrating where rigid categorical frameworks fail -- and where a dimensional mindset could offer a more resilient and future-proof path forward for both governance and innovation at the frontier of artificial intelligence.
papers.comment: 12 pages core text, 15 pages including references, 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证了传统基于固定风险等级、自主水平或人类监督模型的分类治理框架已不足以应对从静态工具向动态代理演进的AI系统，提出了维度治理（dimensional governance）框架，通过追踪决策权、过程自主性和问责制（3A）在人类-AI关系中的动态分布，监控系统向关键治理阈值的移动，从而实现自适应分类和更具韧性的治理。文章以案例说明刚性分类的失败点和维度思维的优势。
Motivation: 随着AI系统从静态工具发展为动态代理，基于固定类别的传统治理框架（如风险等级、自主水平或人类监督模式）越来越难以适用，因为基于基础模型、自监督学习和多智能体架构的系统不断模糊类别间的边界。
Method: 提出维度治理框架，核心是追踪决策权威（decision authority）、过程自主性（process autonomy）和问责制（accountability）这三个维度（3A）在人类-AI关系中的动态分配，并监控系统向关键治理阈值的移动，从而在风险显现前进行预调整。
Result: 该框架能够显式监控系统向治理阈值移动的情况，支持根据新兴能力演进的阈值和分类，提供上下文特定的适应性和利益相关者响应式治理。
Conclusion: 维度治理为更自适应的分类提供了基础，使阈值和分类能随能力演进，而静态方法无法实现。文章强调在AI前沿，维度思维能提供更具韧性且面向未来的治理与创新路径。

papers.title: Brain-Inspired Stochastic Joint Embedding Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Representation learning is one of the key research topics in machine learning, and the framework of self-supervised learning (SSL) has revolutionized computer vision. However, these approaches have not yet fully leveraged insights from biological visual processing systems. In this paper, we introduce PhiNet v2, a novel architecture that processes temporal visual input (i.e., sequences of images) without relying on strong data augmentation, enabling it to learn robust visual representations in a manner similar to human visual processing. Our learning objective is derived from variational inference. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that PhiNet v2 achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art vision representation models, including RSP and CropMAE, while retaining the ability to learn effectively from sequential input without strong data augmentation. This work represents a step toward more biologically plausible computer vision systems that process visual information in a manner more aligned with human cognitive processes.

papers.title: DataMIL: Selecting Data for Robot Imitation Learning with Datamodels
papers.abstract_en: Recently, the robotics community has amassed ever larger and more diverse datasets to train generalist policies. However, while these policies achieve strong mean performance across a variety of tasks, they often underperform on individual, specialized tasks and require further tuning on newly acquired task-specific data. Combining task-specific data with carefully curated subsets of large prior datasets via co-training can produce better specialized policies, but selecting data naively may actually harm downstream performance. To address this, we introduce DataMIL, a data selection framework built on the datamodels paradigm that reasons about data selection in an end-to-end manner, using the policy itself to identify which data points will most improve performance. Unlike standard practices that filter data using human notions of quality (e.g., based on semantic or visual similarity), DataMIL directly optimizes data selection for task success, allowing us to select data that improves the policy while dropping data that degrade it. To avoid performing expensive rollouts in the environment during selection, we introduce a surrogate loss function on task-specific data, allowing us to use DataMIL in the real world without degrading performance. We validate our approach on 60+ simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, notably showing successful data selection from the largest open collections of robot datasets (OXE); demonstrating consistent gains in success rates over prior works. Our results underscore the importance of end-to-end, performance-aware data selection for unlocking the potential of large prior datasets in robotics. More information at https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/datamodels4imitation/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器人模仿学习中，大型通用数据集训练的策略在特定任务上表现不佳的问题，提出DataMIL数据选择框架。该框架基于datamodels范式，以端到端的方式，利用策略本身识别哪些数据点最有帮助。引入代理损失函数避免环境回滚，在60多个仿真和真实操作任务上验证，从OXE数据集中选择数据，持续提高成功率。
Motivation: 大型通用机器人数据集训练的策略在特定任务上表现不佳，需要针对性调整。简单地合并数据可能损害性能，而人工筛选基于语义或视觉相似性并非最优。
Method: 提出DataMIL，基于datamodels的数据选择框架，端到端地优化数据选择以最大化任务成功。使用代理损失函数替代实际环境回滚，从而在现实世界中可行。
Result: 在60多个仿真和真实操作任务上，DataMIL从大型开放机器人数据集OXE中选择数据，持续提高成功率，优于先前方法。
Conclusion: 强调端到端的、性能感知的数据选择对于发挥大型机器人数据集潜力至关重要。

papers.title: Autonomous and Self-Adapting System for Synthetic Media Detection and Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Rapid advances in generative AI have enabled the creation of highly realistic synthetic images, which, while beneficial in many domains, also pose serious risks in terms of disinformation, fraud, and other malicious applications. Current synthetic image identification systems are typically static, relying on feature representations learned from known generators; as new generative models emerge, these systems suffer from severe performance degradation. In this paper, we introduce the concept of an autonomous self-adaptive synthetic media identification system -- one that not only detects synthetic images and attributes them to known sources but also autonomously identifies and incorporates novel generators without human intervention. Our approach leverages an open-set identification strategy with an evolvable embedding space that distinguishes between known and unknown sources. By employing an unsupervised clustering method to aggregate unknown samples into high-confidence clusters and continuously refining its decision boundaries, our system maintains robust detection and attribution performance even as the generative landscape evolves. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing approaches, marking a crucial step toward universal, adaptable forensic systems in the era of rapidly advancing generative models.
