papers.title: On Quantum Perceptron Learning via Quantum Search
papers.abstract_en: With the growing interest in quantum machine learning, the perceptron, a fundamental building block in traditional machine learning, has emerged as a valuable model for exploring the potential of quantum algorithms. In this work, we make two principal contributions. First, we revisit the \emph{quantum version space perceptron} algorithm proposed by Kapoor et al. (2016), by identifying and correcting a flawed complexity assumption. We show that the query complexity of the algorithm is dimension-dependent, which has significant implications for its behaviour in high-dimensional regimes under worst-case scenarios. Second, we propose and analyse two \emph{quantum-enhanced} cutting-plane algorithms for perceptron learning. Specifically, we leverage established quantum subroutines such as \emph{Grover's search} and \emph{quantum walk search}, and provide detailed algorithmic constructions together with query and arithmetic complexity analyses. Our results establish improved complexity bounds under an idealised implementation framework and noise-free quantum computational models, offering insights into the trade-offs between margin dependence, dimensional dependence, and quantum resources. These findings provide a refined understanding of quantum perceptron models and their theoretical computational complexity properties.
papers.journal_ref: Quantum Mach. Intell. 8, 68 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了量子版本空间感知机算法，纠正了其复杂度假设，证明查询复杂度是维度相关的；并提出两种量子增强的切割平面算法，利用Grover搜索和量子游走搜索，给出了复杂性分析。结论表明在理想化实现和无噪声量子计算模型下获得了改进的复杂度界限，揭示了间隔依赖、维度依赖和量子资源之间的权衡。
Motivation: 现有量子感知机算法存在复杂度假设错误，需修正；同时探索量子增强的切割平面算法在感知机学习中的潜力。
Method: 分析并纠正Kapoor等人量子版本空间感知机的错误复杂度假设；提出两种基于Grover搜索和量子游走搜索的量子增强切割平面算法，并进行查询和算术复杂度分析。
Result: 证明查询复杂度是维度相关的，并获得改进的复杂度界限，揭示了间隔、维度和量子资源之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 提供了对量子感知机模型及其理论计算复杂性的更精细理解。

papers.title: DivCon-NeRF: Diverse and Consistent Ray Augmentation for Few-Shot NeRF
papers.abstract_en: Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) has shown remarkable performance in novel view synthesis but requires numerous multi-view images, limiting its practicality in few-shot scenarios. Ray augmentation has been proposed to alleviate overfitting caused by sparse training data by generating additional rays. However, existing methods, which generate augmented rays only near the original rays, exhibit pronounced floaters and appearance distortions due to limited viewpoints and inconsistent rays obstructed by nearby obstacles and complex surfaces. To address these problems, we propose DivCon-NeRF, which introduces novel sphere-based ray augmentations to significantly enhance both diversity and consistency. By employing a virtual sphere centered at the predicted surface point, our method generates diverse augmented rays from all 360-degree directions, facilitated by our consistency mask that effectively filters out inconsistent rays. We introduce tailored loss functions that leverage these augmentations, effectively reducing floaters and visual distortions. Consequently, our method outperforms recent few-shot NeRF approaches on the Blender, LLFF, and DTU datasets. Furthermore, DivCon-NeRF demonstrates strong generalizability by effectively integrating with both regularization- and framework-based few-shot NeRFs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DivCon-NeRF 提出一种基于虚拟球体的射线增强方法，用于少样本 NeRF 场景。该方法从预测表面点为中心的虚拟球体生成全方向射线，并利用一致性掩码过滤无效射线，配合定制损失函数，有效减少了浮点（floaters）和外观失真。在 Blender、LLFF、DTU 数据集上，DivCon-NeRF 的性能优于近期少样本 NeRF 方法，并具有良好的泛化性。
Motivation: 现有少样本 NeRF 的射线增强方法仅生成靠近原始射线的增强射线，导致视角有限、射线被附近障碍物和复杂表面遮挡，从而出现明显的浮点和外观失真。
Method: 提出基于虚拟球体的射线增强，该球体以预测表面点为中心，从所有 360 度方向生成多样化射线，并通过一致性掩码过滤掉不一致的射线。同时设计针对性的损失函数以利用这些增强射线。
Result: 在 Blender、LLFF 和 DTU 数据集上，DivCon-NeRF 超越了近期少样本 NeRF 方法，并且能够有效集成到基于正则化和框架的少样本 NeRF 中，展现出强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 所提方法通过增强射线的多样性和一致性，显著减少了浮点和视觉失真，为少样本 NeRF 提供了一种有效且通用的解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Intent-Handover: Grounding Language in Human-Usage Regions for Trustworthy Robot-to-Human Handovers
papers.abstract_en: Spoken instructions in robot-to-human handovers may specify either an object ("the cup") or an intended use ("pour water"); in both cases, successful handover requires the robot to infer the target object and the region remaining available for the human to hold. If the robot grasps that hold region, the object could become awkward to receive and immediately use, potentially reducing perceived competence and trust; if the gripper approaches too close to the receiving hand during delivery, perceived safety may also suffer. We present Intent-Handover, which grounds unconstrained speech and visual scene context into explicit grasp and delivery constraints. Given a spoken instruction and a scene observation, a vision-language model identifies the target object and the intended human-usage region. A grasp optimization module then selects a feasible grasp keeping this region accessible while enforcing clearance from the predicted receiving hand. During execution, the robot tracks upper-body key points to estimate the user's receiving pose and places the handover at an ergonomically feasible location. In a within-subjects ablation study (n=30), human-usage region awareness increases perceived trust, hand-gripper collision avoidance increases perceived safety, and interaction comfort is highest when both are enabled. Website and code: https://robot-future.github.io/intent-handover/.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Intent-Handover框架，使机器人能够根据自然语言指令和视觉场景推断目标物体及人类预期使用区域，并选择不遮挡该区域的抓取点，同时在手递过程中避让人手，从而提升交接的信任感与安全性。通过30人受试者实验验证，兼顾人体使用区域与防碰撞的设计显著提高了感知信任、安全性和交互舒适度。
Motivation: 现有机器人手递物体时，常因抓取位置遮挡人类使用区域或接近手部过近而导致接收不便、感知信任和安全性下降。
Method: 利用视觉语言模型识别目标物体和人类预期使用区域，结合抓取优化模块选择保持该区域可接近且与预计接收手保持距离的抓取姿态；执行时跟踪上半身关键点估计接收姿态并选择符合人体工学的递送位置。
Result: 在30人受试者消融实验中，同时启用人体使用区域感知和手-夹爪碰撞避免时，感知信任、安全性和交互舒适度均最高。
Conclusion: 将语言指令中的使用意图映射为显式的抓取与递送约束，可显著提升人机交接的可靠性与用户体验；未来可扩展至更复杂指令和多物体场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: O-RAN Xapps Conflict Prediction Using Graph Convolutional Networks
papers.abstract_en: O-RAN hosts many intelligent applications known as eXtended Applications (xApps). xApps are applications that leverage advanced algorithms to make dynamic decisions for network optimization. Each application operates with distinct optimization objectives and is managed by independent operators while accessing shared network resources. Conflicts occur when a deployed xApp's objective interferes with another xApp, resulting in incompatible actions or decisions that may negatively impact network performance. The lack of a unified mechanism to coordinate and prioritize actions across different applications can lead to various types of conflicts. Conflict prediction in O-RAN is the proactive analytical process by which potential interactions or behaviors that may lead to conflicts between network applications are identified in advance, before they manifest in the operational system. In our paper, we introduce a novel data-driven Graph Convolutional Network-based method called GRAPH-based Intelligent xApp Conflict Prediction and Analysis (GRAPHICA). It predicts three types of conflicts and pinpoints the root causes. GRAPHICA captures the complex, hidden dependencies among the xApps, controlled parameters, and key performance indicators in O-RAN to predict potential conflicts. Then, it identifies the root causes contributing to the predicted conflicts. The proposed method is evaluated using highly imbalanced synthetic datasets, in which conflict instances constitute between 40 % and merely 10 % of the data. This evaluation setting is designed to reflect realistic operational environments where conflicts are infrequent, thereby enabling a comprehensive assessment of the model's performance under real-world conditions. Experimental results demonstrate an F1-score over 98 % for the synthesized datasets with varying levels of class imbalance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 O-RAN 中 xApp 冲突问题，提出基于图卷积网络的 GRAPHICA 方法，预测三种冲突类型并定位根因。在高度不平衡的合成数据集上（冲突实例占 10%-40%），F1 分数超过 98%。
Motivation: O-RAN 中多个 xApp 由不同运营商管理，访问共享资源时目标冲突会降低网络性能，缺乏统一协调机制。
Method: 提出 GRAPHICA，使用图卷积网络建模 xApp、控制参数和关键性能指标之间的复杂依赖关系，预测冲突并识别根因。
Result: 在高度不平衡的合成数据集上（冲突实例占比 10%-40%），F1 分数超过 98%。
Conclusion: 所提方法能有效预测 O-RAN 中的 xApp 冲突，适用于冲突稀疏的真实场景。

papers.title: ACTIVA: Amortized Causal Effect Estimation via Transformer-based Variational Autoencoder
papers.abstract_en: Predicting post-intervention distributions from observational data is central to many scientific and decision-making problems, but remains challenging due to causal ambiguity, restrictive modeling assumptions, and the lack of amortization across tasks. We introduce ACTIVA, a transformer-based conditional variational autoencoder for amortized estimation of full interventional distributions from observational data and intervention queries. ACTIVA learns a conditional latent prior that supports zero-shot inference by amortizing causal knowledge across diverse training tasks. We provide a consistency result showing that, under idealized conditions, ACTIVA's learning objective targets a mixture over the interventional distributions of causal models that are observationally compatible with the input. Empirically, on synthetic datasets and biologically realistic gene-expression simulations, ACTIVA substantially outperforms a correlational baseline, reduces spurious non-descendant effects, and achieves competitive performance relative to strong amortized baselines. Our results show that ACTIVA is a promising approach for estimating interventional distributions from observational data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ACTIVA，一种基于 Transformer 的条件变分自编码器，用于从观测数据中摊销地估计完整干预分布。该方法通过跨任务学习条件潜在先验，支持零样本推理，并提供了一致性理论保证。在合成数据和生物基因表达模拟实验中，ACTIVA 显著优于相关性基线，减少了虚假非后代效应，并与强摊销基线性能相当。
Motivation: 从观测数据预测干预分布面临因果模糊性、限制性建模假设以及缺乏跨任务摊销能力等挑战，现有方法难以同时处理这些问题。
Method: ACTIVA 使用 Transformer 结构构建条件变分自编码器，学习一个条件潜在先验，通过在多样化训练任务上摊销因果知识，实现零样本干预分布估计。其优化目标在理想条件下对应与输入观测相容的因果模型干预分布的混合。
Result: 在合成数据集和生物真实的基因表达模拟中，ACTIVA 大幅优于相关性基线，减少了虚假的非后代效应，并在与强摊销基线的比较中取得了有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: ACTIVA 是从观测数据估计干预分布的一种有前景的方法，尤其适合需要跨任务泛化的场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI-Augmented Thyroid Scintigraphy for Robust Classification of Disease
papers.abstract_en: Thyroid scintigraphy is vital for diagnosing thyroid disorders, yet deep learning (DL) models in this domain often struggle with limited, imbalanced datasets. This study investigates the impact of three data augmentation strategies including Stable Diffusion (SD), Flow Matching (FM), and Conventional Augmentation (CA), on enhancing DL-based classification of disease. Anterior thyroid scintigraphy images from 2,954 patients across nine medical centers were classified into four categories: Diffuse Goiter (DG), Nodular Goiter (NG), Normal (NL), and Thyroiditis (TI). Data augmentation was performed using CA as well as various SD and FM models, creating 18 distinct scenarios. Each augmented dataset was used to train a ResNet18 DL-classifier. Model performance was assessed using class-wise and average precision, recall, F1-score, AUC, and image fidelity metrics (FID and KID). FM-based methods demonstrated top-tier performance, with the Original dataset combined with FM (O+FM) configuration achieving the highest micro, macro, and weighted F1-scores (0.78, 0.77, 0.78) and AUC values (0.95, 0.93, 0.94). While the O+FM+CA model also yielded excellent, balanced results, O+FM was statistically superior, indicating that high-fidelity generative augmentation can supersede conventional heuristics. FM also produced the most realistic images, achieving the lowest overall FID (0.66) and KID (0.83). Among the SD variants, SD1 combining image and prompt inputs was the most effective (macro F1: 0.76; FID: 4.17), showing that physician-generated prompts provide critical clinical context. Integrating FM and clinically-informed SD augmentation substantially improves thyroid scintigraphy classification, highlighting the importance of advanced generative models for robust training on limited datasets. The code is available at: https://github.com/MaziarSabouri/Stable-Diffusion-Scintigraphy-Augmentation

papers.title: Generating Rectifiable Measures through Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We derive universal approximation results for the class of (countably) $m$-rectifiable measures. Specifically, we prove that $m$-rectifiable measures can be approximated as push-forwards of the one-dimensional Lebesgue measure on $[0,1]$ using ReLU neural networks with arbitrarily small approximation error in terms of Wasserstein distance. What is more, the weights in the networks under consideration are quantized and bounded and the number of ReLU neural networks required to achieve an approximation error of $\varepsilon$ is no larger than $2^{b(\varepsilon)}$ with $b(\varepsilon)=\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-m}\log^2(\varepsilon))$. This result improves Lemma IX.4 in Perekrestenko et al. as it shows that the rate at which $b(\varepsilon)$ tends to infinity as $\varepsilon$ tends to zero equals the rectifiability parameter $m$, which can be much smaller than the ambient dimension. We extend this result to countably $m$-rectifiable measures and show that this rate still equals the rectifiability parameter $m$ provided that, among other technical assumptions, the measure decays exponentially on the individual components of the countably $m$-rectifiable support set.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明，通过ReLU神经网络将一维勒贝格测度推前，可以在Wasserstein距离下任意逼近(m-)可求长测度。所需的网络数量上界为2^{O(ε^{-m} log² ε)}，其中m是测度的可求长参数，可能远小于环境维数，这一结果改进了现有文献中的速率界限。
Motivation: 现有通用近似理论中逼近率依赖于环境维数，而可求长测度具有内在低维结构，本文旨在揭示逼近速率仅由可求长参数m决定，从而在高维数据建模中更高效。
Method: 使用具有量化且有界权重的ReLU神经网络，将[0,1]上的一维勒贝格测度推前为给定的m-可求长测度，并通过构造证明存在这样的网络族以实现任意小的Wasserstein误差。
Result: 对于m-可求长测度，达到ε近似误差所需的网络数量不超过2^{b(ε)}，其中b(ε)=O(ε^{-m} log² ε)；对于可数m-可求长测度，在指数衰减条件下同样成立。
Conclusion: 本文表明逼近速率仅依赖于测度的内在维数m而非环境维数，并拓展到可数可求长测度，为高维概率分布的压缩表示提供了理论依据。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Learning Expressive Random Feature Models via Parametrized Activations
papers.abstract_en: The random feature (RF) method is a powerful kernel approximation technique, but it typically uses fixed activation functions, limiting its adaptability across diverse tasks. To overcome this limitation, we introduce the Random Feature Model with Learnable Activation Functions (RFLAF), a novel statistical model that parameterizes activation functions as weighted sums of basis functions within the random feature framework. Examples of basis functions include radial basis functions (RBFs), spline functions, polynomials, and so forth. For theoretical results, we consider RBFs as representative basis functions. We start with a single RBF as the activation, and then extend the results to multiple RBFs, demonstrating that RF models with a learnable activation component substantially expand the represented function space. We provide estimates on the required number of samples and random features to achieve low excess risk. In our experiments, we test RFLAF with three types of bases: radial basis functions, spline functions and polynomials. Experimental results show that RFLAFs with RBFs and splines consistently outperform other RF models, where RBFs are three times more computationally efficient than splines. We then unfreeze the first-layer parameters and retrain the models, validating the expressivity advantage of learnable activation components on regular two-layer neural networks. Our work provides a deeper understanding of learnable activation components within modern neural network architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RFLAF模型，通过参数化激活函数（如RBF、样条、多项式）扩展随机特征模型的表达能力，理论证明其扩展了函数空间并给出样本复杂度，实验显示RBF和样条基优于其他RF模型，且RBF计算效率更高。
Motivation: 传统随机特征模型使用固定激活函数，限制了在不同任务上的适应性，需要更灵活的表达能力。
Method: 将激活函数参数化为基函数的加权和，在随机特征框架下训练，通过理论分析（以RBF为例）和实验验证（RBF、样条、多项式基）展示效果。
Result: 实验表明，使用RBF和样条基的RFLAF在多个任务上优于其他RF模型，且RBF计算效率是样条的三倍；解冻第一层参数后进一步验证了可学习激活的优越性。
Conclusion: 可学习激活函数能显著提升随机特征模型的表达能力和适应性，为现代神经网络中可学习激活组件提供了理论理解。

papers.title: GAPartManip: A Large-scale Part-centric Dataset for Material-Agnostic Articulated Object Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Effectively manipulating articulated objects in household scenarios is a crucial step toward achieving general embodied artificial intelligence. Mainstream research in 3D vision has primarily focused on manipulation through depth perception and pose detection. However, in real-world environments, these methods often face challenges due to imperfect depth perception, such as with transparent lids and reflective handles. Moreover, they generally lack the diversity in part-based interactions required for flexible and adaptable manipulation. To address these challenges, we introduced a large-scale part-centric dataset for articulated object manipulation that features both photo-realistic material randomization and detailed annotations of part-oriented, scene-level actionable interaction poses. We evaluated the effectiveness of our dataset by integrating it with several state-of-the-art methods for depth estimation and interaction pose prediction. Additionally, we proposed a novel modular framework that delivers superior and robust performance for generalizable articulated object manipulation. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that our dataset significantly improves the performance of depth perception and actionable interaction pose prediction in both simulation and real-world scenarios. More information and demos can be found at: https://pku-epic.github.io/GAPartManip/.
papers.comment: Accepted by ICRA 2025. Project page: https://pku-epic.github.io/GAPartManip/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了GAPartManip，一个大规模部件中心数据集，用于材质无关的铰接物体操作。数据集包含照片级材质随机化和部件级场景可操作交互姿态的详细注释。作者结合多种深度估计和交互姿态预测方法评估了数据集有效性，并提出了一个模块化框架，在模拟和真实场景中提升了深度感知和交互姿态预测的性能。
Motivation: 现实环境中深度感知常因透明盖子、反光把手等而失效，且现有方法缺乏基于部件的灵活交互多样性，限制了铰接物体操控的泛化性。
Method: 构建大规模部件中心数据集，包含材质随机化和细粒度交互姿态注释；集成多种SOTA深度估计和交互姿态预测方法；提出模块化框架用于通用铰接物体操作。
Result: 数据集显著提升了深度估计和可操作交互姿态预测的性能，在模拟和真实场景中均得到验证。
Conclusion: 该数据集和框架为通用具身智能中的铰接物体操作提供了有效支撑，有助于突破现有方法在真实环境中的局限。

papers.title: Enhancing Symbolic Regression and Universal Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Dimensional Analysis
papers.abstract_en: In engineering and applied mathematics, developing accurate mathematical models to predict and understand real-world phenomena is of utmost importance. Symbolic regression is a useful machine learning-based tool to fit models but it can be computationally expensive. We present a new method for enhancing symbolic regression for differential equations via dimensional analysis, specifically the Buckingham $Π$ theorem and Ipsen's method. Since symbolic regression often suffers from high computational costs and overfitting, nondimensionalizing datasets reduces the number of input variables, simplifies the search space, and ensures that derived equations are physically meaningful. As a first step, we combine dimensional analysis with the PySR symbolic regression algorithm to show that dimensional analysis improves the accuracy of recovering algebraic equations. The results demonstrate that transforming data into a dimensionless form significantly improves the training and test error of the symbolic expressions found. Then, as our main contribution, we perform nondimensionalization guided by Ipsen's method. We then incorporate the nondimensionalized equation into a pipeline combining Universal Physics-Informed Neural Networks and symbolic regression to recover the unknown term when a differential equation is only partially known. We find that symbolic regression is able to better recover the unknown term after nondimensionalizing the data, under both noisy and noiseless conditions. These findings suggest that integrating dimensional analysis with symbolic regression can significantly lower computational costs and increase accuracy, providing a robust framework for automated discovery of governing equations in complex systems when data is limited.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出通过量纲分析（特别是白金汉Π定理和Ipsen方法）增强符号回归在微分方程建模中的性能。首先结合PySR算法，证明无量纲化可提高代数方程恢复的准确性；主要贡献是将无量纲化后的方程融入通用物理信息神经网络与符号回归的流水线，用于部分已知微分方程的未知项恢复。实验表明，在有无噪声条件下，无量纲化后符号回归能更好地恢复未知项，降低计算成本并提高精度。
Motivation: 符号回归在工程和数学建模中计算成本高且易过拟合，量纲分析可通过减少输入变量、简化搜索空间、保证方程物理意义来缓解这些问题。
Method: 先使用白金汉Π定理和Ipsen方法对数据进行无量纲化，再结合PySR进行符号回归；主要贡献是将无量纲化方程融入通用物理信息神经网络与符号回归的流水线，用于部分已知微分方程的未知项恢复。
Result: 无量纲化显著提升了符号回归的代数方程恢复精度（训练和测试误差降低）；在部分已知微分方程场景下，无论有无噪声，符号回归都能更准确地恢复未知项。
Conclusion: 将量纲分析与符号回归集成可降低计算成本、提高精度，为数据有限时自动发现复杂系统控制方程提供鲁棒框架。

papers.title: LAYUP: Asynchronous decentralized gradient descent with LAYer-wise UPdates
papers.abstract_en: The increasing size of deep learning models has made distributed training across multiple devices essential. Synchronous, centralized methods incur large communication and synchronization overheads. Communication efficient algorithms can reduce these overheads, but often require extra buffers, remain sensitive to stragglers or parameter drift. We present LayUp, an asynchronous decentralized SGD method with layer-wise updates. LayUp asynchronously exchanges incremental layer-wise updates during backpropagation. It uses randomized gossip communication, enabling updates to be applied as soon as they are available without buffering. These design choices reduce parameter drift and improve robustness to stragglers. We establish a theoretical upper bound for the gradient bias introduced by layer-wise updates and prove convergence of LayUp. We empirically validate LayUp on vision and language modeling tasks, showing convergence up to ~32% faster in terms of wall-clock time compared to synchronous data parallel training and up to ~27% faster than comparable communication efficient algorithms while maintaining better task performance. This speed-up is partly due to higher model FLOPs utilization, as we demonstrate. By injecting delays into the communication between workers, we show that LayUp remains robust to stragglers while DDP and other methods degrade in performance. Overall, LayUp provides a novel practical, straggler-robust alternative for distributed training without sacrificing accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LayUp，一种异步去中心化的随机梯度下降方法，采用逐层更新（layer-wise updates）策略。LayUp在反向传播过程中异步交换增量逐层更新，使用随机gossip通信，无需缓冲区，减少了参数漂移并提升了对straggler的鲁棒性。理论分析了逐层更新引起的梯度偏差上界并证明了收敛性。在视觉和语言任务上，相比同步数据并行训练，收敛速度提升约32%；相比同类通信高效算法，速度提升约27%，且保持更好任务性能。
Motivation: 分布式训练中同步中心化方法存在通信和同步开销，现有通信高效算法需要额外缓冲区、对straggler敏感或存在参数漂移。
Method: 提出LayUp：异步去中心化SGD，在反向传播过程中异步交换增量逐层更新，采用随机gossip通信，无需缓冲即可应用更新。
Result: 在视觉和语言任务上，收敛速度（wall-clock time）比同步数据并行训练快约32%，比同类通信高效算法快约27%，且任务性能更好；对straggler鲁棒。
Conclusion: LayUp提供了一种新颖、实用、对straggler鲁棒的分布式训练替代方案，且不牺牲准确性。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出LayUp，一种异步去中心化的随机梯度下降方法，采用逐层更新（layer-wise updates）策略。LayUp在反向传播过程中异步交换增量逐层更新，使用随机gossip通信，无需缓冲区，减少了参数漂移并提升了对straggler的鲁棒性。理论分析了逐层更新引起的梯度偏差上界并证明了收敛性。在视觉和语言任务上，相比同步数据并行训练，收敛速度提升约32%；相比同类通信高效算法，速度提升约27%，且保持更好任务性能。
summary_sections.motivation: 分布式训练中同步中心化方法存在通信和同步开销，现有通信高效算法需要额外缓冲区、对straggler敏感或存在参数漂移。
summary_sections.method: 提出LayUp：异步去中心化SGD，在反向传播过程中异步交换增量逐层更新，采用随机gossip通信，无需缓冲即可应用更新。
summary_sections.result: 在视觉和语言任务上，收敛速度（wall-clock time）比同步数据并行训练快约32%，比同类通信高效算法快约27%，且任务性能更好；对straggler鲁棒。
summary_sections.conclusion: LayUp提供了一种新颖、实用、对straggler鲁棒的分布式训练替代方案，且不牺牲准确性。

papers.title: Build Once, Monitor Continuously: Persistent Semantic Mapping via Autonomous Exploration and Open-Vocabulary Object Updates
papers.abstract_en: Persistent semantic monitoring of indoor spaces such as warehouses, hospitals, and offices requires a robot to repeatedly monitor an environment and track how objects change over time. Running full simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) with dense semantic reconstruction from scratch on every visit is redundant when the environment geometry stays the same and only the objects move. We present a modular two-stage system that separates geometric mapping from semantic updating. In the first stage, a frontier-based exploration method with a dynamic search window builds a 2D occupancy grid. In the second stage, the robot relocalizes in this map and builds a semantic object graph using an open-vocabulary object detector and a promptable segmentation model. Only the lightweight semantic stage is repeated on later visits, so the system scales well to frequent revisits. The object graph uses a category and distance based association rule to update objects, which lets the map reflect both intra-session changes (object changes within a single traversal) and inter-session changes (changes across revisits), such as objects being moved, removed, or added. We validate the system on a Fetch robot in two real indoor environments of about 8,500 sq.m and 117 sq.m, and report precision, recall, and F1 scores across multiple update iterations.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Project page is available at https://irvlutd.github.io/SemanticMapping/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种模块化两阶段系统，将几何建图与语义更新分离，用于室内环境的持久语义监控。第一阶段通过基于前沿探索的动态搜索窗口构建2D占用网格；第二阶段利用开放词汇目标检测器和可提示分割模型构建语义对象图，并在后续访问中仅重复轻量级语义阶段。对象图采用基于类别和距离的关联规则更新对象，反映会话内和跨会话的对象变化。在Fetch机器人上约8500平方米和117平方米的真实环境中验证，报告了多次更新迭代的精度、召回率和F1分数。
Motivation: 现有方法在每次访问时从头运行完整SLAM和密集语义重建，当环境几何不变而仅对象移动时效率低下，无法有效支持频繁重访的持久语义监控。
Method: 两阶段系统：第一阶段使用带有动态搜索窗口的前沿探索方法构建2D占用网格；第二阶段通过重定位在该地图上构建语义对象图，利用开放词汇对象检测器和可提示分割模型，并采用基于类别和距离的关联规则更新对象。
Result: 在Fetch机器人上两个真实室内环境（约8500平方米和117平方米）中验证，报告了多次更新迭代的精度、召回率和F1分数。
Conclusion: 系统通过分离几何与语义、仅重复语义阶段实现高效持久监控，适用于室内空间中对象随时间变化的场景。

papers.title: Measuring Human Contribution in AI-Assisted Content Generation
papers.abstract_en: With the growing prevalence of generative artificial intelligence (AI), an increasing amount of content is no longer exclusively generated by humans but by generative AI models with human guidance. This shift presents notable challenges for the delineation of originality due to the varying degrees of human contribution in AI-assisted works. This study raises the research question of measuring human contribution in AI-assisted content generation and introduces a framework to address this question that is grounded in information theory. By calculating mutual information between human input and AI-assisted output relative to self-information of AI-assisted output, we quantify the proportional information contribution of humans in content generation. Our experimental results demonstrate that the proposed measure effectively discriminates between varying degrees of human contribution across multiple creative domains. We hope that this work lays a foundation for measuring human contributions in AI-assisted content generation in the era of generative AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于信息论的框架，通过计算人类输入与AI辅助输出之间的互信息相对于AI辅助输出自信息的比值，来量化人类在AI辅助内容生成中的贡献比例。实验表明该方法能有效区分不同创意领域的人类贡献程度。
Motivation: 生成式AI的普及导致大量内容由AI生成但有人类指导，传统原创性界定方法难以应对人类贡献程度各异的情况，亟需一种量化人类贡献的方法。
Method: 基于信息论，定义人类贡献比例为人类输入与AI辅助输出之间的互信息与AI辅助输出自信息的比值，从而量化人类在内容生成中的信息贡献。
Result: 实验在多个创意领域验证了该度量能有效区分不同的人类贡献程度。
Conclusion: 该工作为生成式AI时代衡量人类贡献奠定了基础，有望推动AI辅助内容创作的原创性评估和版权界定。

papers.title: ARVO: Atlas of Reproducible Vulnerabilities for Open-Source Software
papers.abstract_en: Achieving reproducibility, quantity, and diversity in vulnerability datasets has long been viewed as an inherent three-way trade-off, where improving one dimension often comes at the cost of the others. In practice, reproducibility has been the dimension most often neglected. This has limited what can be automatically extracted from historical bug datasets, and has reduced their utility for downstream security research. In this work, we propose a method to produce a new security dataset which ensures reproducibility for diverse vulnerabilities at scale by identifying the key obstacles to large-scale bug reproduction and addressing them with general solutions. Using this method, we introduce full reproducibility to the largest open source software vulnerability dataset (OSS-Fuzz) and construct the ARVO dataset (an Atlas of Reproducible Vulnerabilities in Open-source software). ARVO is a large-scale dataset consisting of over 6,100 real-world vulnerabilities across 311 projects. Focusing on reproducibility, ARVO differs from existing datasets by providing each vulnerability in a form that can be consistently rebuilt, triggered, and analyzed across versions. Reproducibility also enables automatic identification of the corresponding patch for each vulnerability and supports direct interaction with vulnerabilities after code changes, capabilities that existing large-scale datasets do not provide. In our evaluation, ARVO successfully reproduces 81% of vulnerabilities and achieves 89.4% accuracy on the located patches. We also discuss ARVO's influence on both upstream practices and downstream security research.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE European Symposium on Security and Privacy (EuroS&P) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种方法，通过解决大规模漏洞重现的关键障碍，生成具有可复现性、数量和多样性的安全数据集。基于该方法，作者对最大的开源软件漏洞数据集OSS-Fuzz进行了完全可复现的改造，构建了ARVO数据集，包含超过6,100个真实漏洞和311个项目。ARVO提供可一致重建、触发和分析的漏洞形式，并能自动识别补丁，支持代码变更后的直接交互。评估显示，ARVO成功复现了81%的漏洞，补丁定位准确率达89.4%。
Motivation: 现有漏洞数据集在可复现性、数量和多样性之间存在权衡，其中可复现性常被忽视，限制了历史漏洞数据集的自动提取和下游安全研究效用。
Method: 通过识别大规模漏洞复现的关键障碍，提出通用解决方案，并将OSS-Fuzz数据集转化为完全可复现的ARVO数据集，提供重建、触发和分析能力。
Result: ARVO数据集包含超过6,100个真实漏洞（311个项目），成功复现率81%，补丁定位准确率89.4%。
Conclusion: ARVO通过确保大规模、多样漏洞的可复现性，提升了数据集对上游实践和下游安全研究的实用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Predicting cognitive load in immersive driving scenarios with a hybrid CNN-RNN model
papers.abstract_en: One debatable issue in traffic safety research is that cognitive load from sec-ondary tasks reduces primary task performance, such as driving. Although physiological signals have been extensively used in driving-related research to assess cognitive load, only a few studies have specifically focused on high cognitive load scenarios. Most existing studies tend to examine moderate or low levels of cognitive load In this study, we adopted an auditory version of the n-back task of three levels as a cognitively loading secondary task while driving in a driving simulator. During the simultaneous execution of driving and the n-back task, we recorded fNIRS, eye-tracking, and driving behavior data to predict cognitive load at three different levels. To the best of our knowledge, this combination of data sources has never been used before. Un-like most previous studies that utilize binary classification of cognitive load and driving in conditions without traffic, our study involved three levels of cognitive load, with drivers operating in normal traffic conditions under low visibility, specifically during nighttime and rainy weather. We proposed a hybrid neural network combining a 1D Convolutional Neural Network and a Recurrent Neural Network to predict cognitive load. Our experimental re-sults demonstrate that the proposed model, with fewer parameters, increases accuracy from 99.82% to 99.99% using physiological data, and from 87.26% to 92.02% using driving behavior data alone. This significant improvement highlights the effectiveness of our hybrid neural network in accurately pre-dicting cognitive load during driving under challenging conditions.

TL;DR: 本研究在驾驶模拟器中，通过fNIRS、眼动追踪和驾驶行为数据，使用1D CNN-RNN混合模型预测三个等级的认知负荷（n-back任务）。在低能见度（夜间雨天）交通条件下，模型在生理数据上达到99.99%准确率，驾驶行为数据上达到92.02%，优于基线模型。
Motivation: 现有驾驶认知负荷研究多关注中低负荷或二分类，缺乏对高负荷情景及复杂交通环境（如夜间雨天）的三级分类研究，且少有结合fNIRS、眼动和驾驶行为的多模态数据。
Method: 提出混合神经网络，结合1D卷积神经网络（CNN）提取局部特征和循环神经网络（RNN）处理时序依赖，输入包括fNIRS、眼动数据及驾驶行为数据，用于三级认知负荷分类。
Result: 在三级认知负荷分类任务中，生理数据准确率从99.82%提升至99.99%，仅驾驶行为数据准确率从87.26%提升至92.02%，模型参数更少且效果显著。
Conclusion: 混合CNN-RNN模型能有效预测挑战性驾驶条件下的认知负荷，多模态融合优于单一模态，未来可应用于自适应驾驶辅助系统。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning to Disentangle Multiqubit Quantum States from Partial Observations
papers.abstract_en: Using partial knowledge of a quantum state to control multiqubit entanglement is a largely unexplored paradigm in the emerging field of quantum interactive dynamics with the potential to address outstanding challenges in quantum state preparation and compression, quantum control, and quantum complexity. We present a deep reinforcement learning (RL) approach using an actor-critic algorithm for constructing short disentangling circuits for states with up to 16 qubits. With access to only two-qubit reduced density matrices, our agent decides which pairs of qubits to apply two-qubit gates on; requiring only local information makes it directly applicable on modern NISQ devices, as we demonstrated experimentally on a trapped-ion quantum computer. Utilizing a permutation-equivariant transformer architecture, the agent can autonomously identify qubit permutations within the state, and adjusts the disentangling protocol accordingly. Once trained, it provides circuits from different initial states without further optimization. We demonstrate the agent's ability to identify and exploit the entanglement structure of multi-qubit states. We analyze the disentangling circuits constructed by the agent for 4- and 5-qubit Haar-random states, and observe strong correlations between consecutive gates and among the qubits involved. Through extensive benchmarking, we show the efficacy of the RL approach to find disentangling protocols with minimal gate resources. We explore the resilience of our trained agents to noise, highlighting their potential for real-world quantum computing applications. Analyzing optimal disentangling protocols, we report a general circuit to prepare an arbitrary 4-qubit state using at most 5 two-qubit (10 CNOT) gates.
papers.comment: The source code as well as a demo in the form of an interactive Jupyter notebook are available on Github: https://github.com/mgbukov/RL_disentangle
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用深度强化学习（actor-critic 算法）从部分观测（两体约化密度矩阵）中构建多量子比特态的解缠电路，适用于最多16个量子比特。采用置换等变Transformer架构，智能体可自主识别量子比特置换并调整协议，实验在离子阱量子计算机上验证。分析表明，对于4-和5-量子比特Haar随机态，智能体能找到最小化门资源的解缠协议，并报告了制备任意4-量子比特态的最多5个两体门（10个CNOT）的通用电路。
Motivation: 多量子比特纠缠的控制是量子态制备、压缩和控制中的核心挑战，但仅利用部分量子态知识（如两体约化密度矩阵）进行解缠的方法尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出基于actor-critic的深度强化学习框架，智能体仅以两体约化密度矩阵为输入，通过置换等变Transformer网络选择作用在两对量子比特上的两体门，逐步构建短解缠电路。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能在最多16个量子比特上工作，在离子阱量子计算机上实验验证了有效性；分析表明解缠电路的门序列存在强相关性，并给出了制备任意4-量子比特态的最优电路（最多5个两体门/10个CNOT）。
Conclusion: 该工作证明深度强化学习可从局部观测中自主发现多量子比特解缠协议，且协议对噪声具有鲁棒性，具有在NISQ设备上的实际应用潜力。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作证明深度强化学习可从局部观测中自主发现多量子比特解缠协议，且协议对噪声具有鲁棒性，具有在NISQ设备上的实际应用潜力。

papers.title: Transcribing Bengali Text with Regional Dialects to IPA using District Guided Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Accurate transcription of Bengali text to the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) is a challenging task due to the complex phonology of the language and context-dependent sound changes. This challenge is even more for regional Bengali dialects due to unavailability of standardized spelling conventions for these dialects, presence of local and foreign words popular in those regions and phonological diversity across different regions. This paper presents an approach to this sequence-to-sequence problem by introducing the District Guided Tokens (DGT) technique on a new dataset spanning six districts of Bangladesh. The key idea is to provide the model with explicit information about the regional dialect or "district" of the input text before generating the IPA transcription. This is achieved by prepending a district token to the input sequence, effectively guiding the model to understand the unique phonetic patterns associated with each district. The DGT technique is applied to fine-tune several transformer-based models, on this new dataset. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of DGT, with the ByT5 model achieving superior performance over word-based models like mT5, BanglaT5, and umT5. This is attributed to ByT5's ability to handle a high percentage of out-of-vocabulary words in the test set. The proposed approach highlights the importance of incorporating regional dialect information into ubiquitous natural language processing systems for languages with diverse phonological variations. The following work was a result of the "Bhashamul" challenge, which is dedicated to solving the problem of Bengali text with regional dialects to IPA transcription https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/regipa/. The training and inference notebooks are available through the competition link.
papers.comment: Updated the paper with full detailed work and rigorous ablation. This work became the champion of the Bhashamul challenge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对孟加拉语文本到国际音标(IPA)的转写任务，提出了一种区域引导token（DGT）方法，通过将地区（district）信息作为前缀token输入序列，引导模型学习不同地区的语音模式。在包含孟加拉国六个地区的新数据集上，微调多种基于Transformer的模型，实验表明ByT5模型表现最佳，优于基于词的模型。

papers.title: Emergent Communication in Continuous Worlds: Self-Organisation of Conceptually Grounded Vocabularies at Scale
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a general methodology through which a population of autonomous agents can converge on a linguistic convention that enables them to refer to arbitrary entities in their environment. The linguistic convention emerges in a decentralised manner through local communicative interactions between pairs of agents drawn from the population. The emergent convention consists of associations between symbolic labels (word forms) and subsymbolic concept representations (word meanings) that are grounded in a continuous feature space. We confirm the generality and scalability of the method through its evaluation on a wide and diverse selection of 37 publicly available datasets. Through a range of experiments, we demonstrate the robustness of the method against perceptual variation, including in heteromorphic populations, as well as the ability of the emergent conventions to self-adapt to changes in the environment.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics (TACL)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种通用方法，使一组自主智能体能够通过局部沟通交互，以去中心化方式收敛到一种语言约定，从而指代任意实体。该约定将符号标签（词形）与基于连续特征空间的概念表示（词义）关联起来，并在37个公开数据集上验证了其通用性和可扩展性。实验表明该方法对感知变化具有鲁棒性，并能自适应环境变化。
Motivation: 现有涌现通信方法通常局限于离散或简单环境，缺乏在连续世界中自发形成概念化词汇的通用机制。本文旨在填补这一空白，使多智能体系统无需中央协调即可发展出有效的通信系统。
Method: 引入一种基于局部交互的涌现通信框架，智能体通过配对交流使用子符号概念表示（subsymbolic concept representations）与符号标签关联，从而在连续特征空间中形成词汇。框架依赖可微的通信协议和适应性学习规则。
Result: 在37个多样化数据集上评估，表明方法具有泛化能力；实验证明了其对感知变化（包括异质性群体）的鲁棒性，以及涌现约定对环境变化的自我适应能力。
Conclusion: 本文证实了在连续世界中大规模涌现概念化词汇的可行性，为多智能体通信研究提供了通用工具，但未提及具体应用场景或性能量化。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Explanations for Automatic Speech Recognition
papers.abstract_en: We address quality assessment for neural network based ASR by providing explanations that help increase our understanding of the system and ultimately help build trust in the system. Compared to simple classification labels, explaining transcriptions is more challenging as judging their correctness is not straightforward and transcriptions as a variable-length sequence is not handled by existing interpretable machine learning models. We provide an explanation for an ASR transcription as a subset of audio frames that is both a minimal and sufficient cause of the transcription. To do this, we adapt existing explainable AI (XAI) techniques from image classification-Statistical Fault Localisation(SFL) and Causal. Additionally, we use an adapted version of Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations (LIME) for ASR as a baseline in our experiments. We evaluate the quality of the explanations generated by the proposed techniques over three different ASR ,Google API, the baseline model of Sphinx, Deepspeech and 100 audio samples from the Commonvoice dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于神经网络的自动语音识别（ASR）系统，提出为其转录结果提供解释的方法，通过选择音频帧的子集作为转录的最小且充分原因。
Motivation: ASR转录结果的正确性判断复杂，且现有可解释机器学习方法无法处理变长序列，需要专门的方法来提升系统透明度与信任度。
Method: 改编图像分类中的统计故障定位（Statistical Fault Localisation）和因果解释技术，并引入适用于ASR的局部可解释模型无关解释（LIME）作为基线。
Result: 在Google API、Sphinx、Deepspeech三种ASR系统及Commonvoice数据集100个样本上评估了所提方法的解释质量。
Conclusion: 论文为ASR提供了基于音频帧子集的解释，但未在摘要中明确性能提升幅度或局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MoFusion: A Framework for Denoising-Diffusion-based Motion Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Conventional methods for human motion synthesis are either deterministic or struggle with the trade-off between motion diversity and motion quality. In response to these limitations, we introduce MoFusion, i.e., a new denoising-diffusion-based framework for high-quality conditional human motion synthesis that can generate long, temporally plausible, and semantically accurate motions based on a range of conditioning contexts (such as music and text). We also present ways to introduce well-known kinematic losses for motion plausibility within the motion diffusion framework through our scheduled weighting strategy. The learned latent space can be used for several interactive motion editing applications -- like inbetweening, seed conditioning, and text-based editing -- thus, providing crucial abilities for virtual character animation and robotics. Through comprehensive quantitative evaluations and a perceptual user study, we demonstrate the effectiveness of MoFusion compared to the state of the art on established benchmarks in the literature. We urge the reader to watch our supplementary video and visit https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/MoFusion.
papers.comment: CVPR23, 11 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables; project page: https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/MoFusion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MoFusion，一个基于去噪扩散的框架，用于高质量的条件人体运动合成，能够生成长时间、时间上合理、语义上准确的运动，基于音乐、文本等条件。通过调度权重策略引入运动合理性损失，潜空间可用于交互式运动编辑。定量评估和用户研究表明其有效性。
Motivation: 传统的人体运动合成方法要么是确定性的，要么在运动多样性和质量之间权衡不佳，难以同时保证多样性和高保真度。
Method: 提出一个基于去噪扩散的条件生成框架，通过调度加权策略将运动学损失集成到扩散过程中，支持多种条件（如音乐、文本）控制运动生成。
Result: 在多个基准上通过定量评估和感知用户研究表明，MoFusion在运动质量、多样性和条件对齐方面优于现有方法。
Conclusion: MoFusion能生成高质量、多样化的条件运动，并支持插值、种子条件、文本编辑等交互式应用，适用于虚拟角色动画和机器人领域。

papers.title: Detection and Evaluation of Clusters within Sequential Data
papers.abstract_en: Sequential data is ubiquitous -- it is routinely gathered to gain insights into complex processes such as behavioral, biological, or physical processes. Challengingly, such data not only has dependencies within the observed sequences, but the observations are also often high-dimensional, sparse, and noisy. These are all difficulties that obscure the inner workings of the complex process under study. One solution is to calculate a low-dimensional representation that describes (characteristics of) the complex process. This representation can then serve as a proxy to gain insight into the original process. However, uncovering such low-dimensional representation within sequential data is nontrivial due to the dependencies, and an algorithm specifically made for sequences is needed to guarantee estimator consistency. Fortunately, recent theoretical advancements on Block Markov Chains have resulted in new clustering algorithms that can provably do just this in synthetic sequential data. This paper presents a first field study of these new algorithms in real-world sequential data; a wide empirical study of clustering within a range of data sequences. We investigate broadly whether, when given sparse high-dimensional sequential data of real-life complex processes, useful low-dimensional representations can in fact be extracted using these algorithms. Concretely, we examine data sequences containing GPS coordinates describing animal movement, strands of human DNA, texts from English writing, and daily yields in a financial market. The low-dimensional representations we uncover are shown to not only successfully encode the sequential structure of the data, but also to enable gaining new insights into the underlying complex processes.
papers.journal_ref: Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, Volume 39 (2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对序列数据中高维、稀疏、带依赖关系的观测难以提取低维表示的问题，研究了基于块马尔可夫链（Block Markov Chains）的新聚类算法在真实世界序列数据上的首次实地应用。通过对动物GPS轨迹、人类DNA、英文文本和金融市场日收益率等序列进行聚类，发现这些算法能够提取出保留序列结构的低维表示，并为复杂过程提供新见解。
Motivation: 序列数据存在依赖关系且常高维稀疏，现有聚类算法难以保证估计一致性，需要专门针对序列设计的算法。
Method: 采用基于块马尔可夫链理论发展的聚类算法，对多种真实序列数据（动物运动、DNA、文本、金融收益率）进行低维表示提取，并评估其有效性。
Result: 实验表明算法提取的低维表示不仅成功编码了序列结构，还能带来对底层复杂过程的新见解。
Conclusion: 该算法在真实序列数据中有效，可作为分析复杂过程的有力工具。

papers.title: CuDi: Curve Distillation for Efficient and Controllable Exposure Adjustment
papers.abstract_en: We present Curve Distillation, CuDi, for efficient and controllable exposure adjustment without the requirement of paired or unpaired data during training. Our method inherits the zero-reference learning and curve-based framework from an effective low-light image enhancement method, Zero-DCE, with further speed up in its inference speed, reduction in its model size, and extension to controllable exposure adjustment. The improved inference speed and lightweight model are achieved through novel curve distillation that approximates the time-consuming iterative operation in the conventional curve-based framework by high-order curve's tangent line. The controllable exposure adjustment is made possible with a new self-supervised spatial exposure control loss that constrains the exposure levels of different spatial regions of the output to be close to the brightness distribution of an exposure map serving as an input condition. Different from most existing methods that can only correct either underexposed or overexposed photos, our approach corrects both underexposed and overexposed photos with a single model. Notably, our approach can additionally adjust the exposure levels of a photo globally or locally with the guidance of an input condition exposure map, which can be pre-defined or manually set in the inference stage. Through extensive experiments, we show that our method is appealing for its fast, robust, and flexible performance, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in real scenes. Project page: https://li-chongyi.github.io/CuDi_files/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出曲线蒸馏（CuDi），一种无需配对或非配对数据的高效可控曝光调整方法。该方法继承Zero-DCE的零参考学习和基于曲线的框架，通过高阶曲线切线近似加速推理并减小模型体积，同时引入自监督空间曝光控制损失实现可控曝光调整。单一模型即可同时纠正欠曝光和过曝光照片，并支持全局或局部曝光调整。实验表明该方法在真实场景中速度快、鲁棒且灵活，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有曝光调整方法通常需要配对数据，且难以同时处理欠曝光和过曝光照片，同时存在模型体积大、推理慢、调整灵活性不足等问题。
Method: 提出曲线蒸馏（CuDi），利用高阶曲线的切线近似传统曲线框架中的迭代操作，加速推理并减小模型体积；并引入自监督空间曝光控制损失，使输出不同区域曝光水平与输入条件曝光图的亮度分布一致，实现可控曝光调整。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在真实场景中速度快、鲁棒且灵活，性能优于现有方法，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: CuDi提供了一种无需训练数据、快速、轻量且可控的曝光调整方案，单一模型可同时处理欠曝光和过曝光照片，并支持全局或局部曝光调整。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该方法在真实场景中速度快、鲁棒且灵活，性能优于现有方法，但未给出具体量化指标。
summary_sections.conclusion: CuDi提供了一种无需训练数据、快速、轻量且可控的曝光调整方案，单一模型可同时处理欠曝光和过曝光照片，并支持全局或局部曝光调整。

papers.title: Nonconvex-Nonconcave Min-Max Optimization with a Small Maximization Domain
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of finding approximate first-order stationary points in optimization problems of the form $\min_{x \in X} \max_{y \in Y} f(x,y)$, where the sets $X,Y$ are convex and $Y$ is compact. The objective function $f$ is smooth, but assumed neither convex in $x$ nor concave in $y$. Our approach relies upon replacing the function $f(x,\cdot)$ with its $k$th order Taylor approximation (in $y$) and finding a near-stationary point in the resulting surrogate problem. To guarantee its success, we establish the following result: let the Euclidean diameter of $Y$ be small in terms of the target accuracy $\varepsilon$, namely $O(\varepsilon^{\frac{2}{k+1}})$ for $k \in \mathbb{N}$ and $O(\varepsilon)$ for $k = 0$, with the constant factors controlled by certain regularity parameters of $f$; then any $\varepsilon$-stationary point in the surrogate problem remains $O(\varepsilon)$-stationary for the initial problem. Moreover, we show that these upper bounds are nearly optimal: the aforementioned reduction provably fails when the diameter of $Y$ is larger. For $0 \le k \le 2$ the surrogate function can be efficiently maximized in $y$; our general approximation result then leads to efficient algorithms for finding a near-stationary point in nonconvex-nonconcave min-max problems, for which we also provide convergence guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究非凸非凹极小极大优化问题，关注在最大化变量定义域直径较小时如何找到近似一阶稳定点。通过使用k阶泰勒展开近似目标函数并求解替代问题，作者证明了当Y的直径足够小时，替代问题的稳定点仍是原问题的近似稳定点，并给出了收敛性保证。
Motivation: 非凸非凹极小极大优化在机器学习中常见但理论分析困难，现有方法通常要求问题满足某种结构（如凸-凹或弱凸-弱凹）。本文试图放松这些假设，研究最一般的情形，并利用最大化定义域的小直径来获得理论保证。
Method: 将原问题中的f(x,·)替换为其关于y的k阶泰勒展开，在替代问题中寻找近似稳定点。通过控制Y的直径与目标精度ε的关系，保证替代问题的稳定点接近原问题的稳定点，并针对k=0,1,2给出高效算法。
Result: 当Y的直径为O(ε^{2/(k+1)})（k≥1）或O(ε)（k=0）时，替代问题的ε-稳定点是原问题的O(ε)-稳定点。这些上界是近乎最优的，且对于k≤2，替代函数可高效优化，从而得到非凸非凹极小极大问题的有效算法。
Conclusion: 本文从理论层面揭示了最大化定义域直径对非凸非凹极小极大问题收敛性的影响，并提供了可执行的算法框架。但结果依赖于直径较小的假设，且仅考虑泰勒近似的阶数，实际应用中的具体性能有待验证。

papers.title: Text-to-Image Generative AI for Modeling and Simulation: Methods, Opportunities, and Applications
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image generation is a form of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) that converts textual descriptions into images. Most applications of GenAI in modeling and simulation (M&S) have focused on large language models for documentation, coding, or explanation. By contrast, the potential of image generation remains largely unexplored. This tutorial introduces text-to-image generation to the M&S community and details how it can support several M&S tasks, including communicating conceptual models, visualizing simulation outcomes, generating educational materials, and interfacing heterogeneous models in multi-scale simulations. The tutorial combines conceptual guidance with practical workflows, explaining how modern image generators operate, how prompts and simulation outputs can be translated into visual scenes, and how practitioners can integrate these tools into reproducible local pipelines. By focusing on transferable principles rather than specific tools, the tutorial equips M&S practitioners with the knowledge needed to evaluate, adopt, and adapt text-to-image generation in their simulation workflows.
papers.comment: To appear at the 2026 Winter Simulation Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇面向建模与仿真（M&S）社区的教程，介绍文本到图像生成（text-to-image generation）如何支持M&S任务，如沟通概念模型、可视化仿真结果、生成教育材料以及多尺度仿真中异构模型的接口。教程涵盖了现代图像生成器的工作原理、如何将提示和仿真输出转化为视觉场景，以及如何集成到可重复的本地流程中。
Motivation: M&S领域对生成式AI的应用主要集中在大型语言模型上，而图像生成的潜力尚待挖掘。本文旨在填补这一空白，使M&S从业者能够利用文本到图像生成工具。
Method: 采用教程形式，结合概念指导和实际工作流，讲解图像生成器的原理、提示工程以及将仿真输出转化为视觉场景的方法，并强调可转移的原则而非特定工具。
Result: 摘要声称本文提供了评估、采用和调整文本到图像生成方法的知识，但未报告具体实验结果。
Conclusion: 本文使M&S从业者能够在仿真工作流中应用文本到图像生成，聚焦于可复现的本地流程。

papers.title: Physics-Guided Fully Convolutional Spatiotemporal Learning Toward Digital-Twin-Enabled Microstructure Evolution Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Understanding and predicting microstructure evolution is central to materials design, yet purely data-driven spatiotemporal learning models often suffer from limited physical consistency and degraded long-term prediction accuracy. In this work, we introduce a physics-guided fully convolutional spatiotemporal learning framework for microstructure evolution prediction. Unlike prior self-supervised approaches, the proposed method explicitly incorporates governing physical equations into the training objective, thereby encouraging the learned dynamics to remain consistent with known thermodynamic and kinetic laws. This physics-guided formulation improves predictive accuracy, long-horizon stability, and robustness across spatial resolutions and temporal prediction settings. Extensive experiments for spinodal decomposition demonstrate that incorporating physics-guided residual regularization leads to more faithful reproduction of microstructural morphology, statistics, and evolution trends compared with purely data-driven baselines. The proposed framework preserves the scalability and computational efficiency of fully convolutional architectures while bridging the gap between high-fidelity physics-based simulations and data-driven surrogate modeling, offering a reliable and efficient surrogate-modeling step toward digital-twin-enabled microstructure evolution prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理引导的全卷积时空学习框架，用于预测微结构演化（如旋节线分解）。该框架将控制方程显式纳入训练目标，确保与热力学和动力学定律一致。实验表明，相比于纯数据驱动基线，该方法在微结构形态、统计量和演化趋势上更忠实。
Motivation: 纯数据驱动的时空学习模型在微结构演化预测中缺乏物理一致性，长期预测精度下降。
Method: 提出物理引导的全卷积时空学习框架，在训练目标中显式引入支配物理方程（如热力学和动力学），使用物理引导残差正则化。
Result: 在旋节线分解实验中，与纯数据驱动基线相比，该方法更准确地再现微结构形态、统计量和演化趋势，并提升了长时预测稳定性和跨空间分辨率、时间预测设置的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该框架在保持全卷积架构的可扩展性和计算效率的同时，弥合了高保真物理模拟与数据驱动替代模型之间的差距，为数字孪生驱动的微结构演化预测提供了可靠高效的替代建模途径。

papers.title: Robusto-2: Benchmarking Humans & VLMs for Autonomous Driving in Lima & New York City
papers.abstract_en: As Self-Driving Cars continue to expand internationally and use multi-modal systems such as VLMs as a cognitive backbone for their Action models; how well will these systems generalize in new settings, in particular out-of-distribution (OOD) edge-case scenarios in new geographies? In this paper, we study this open question by providing a full factorial analysis with human drivers of Lima, human drivers from New York City, and VLMs and showing them dashcam footage collected from Lima and New York City -- prompting them with a variety of questions under a Visual Question Answering (VQA) paradigm. In particular, we pick these two cities as they are highly challenging driving locations where no Self-Driving Car company currently operates in, and ask questions that span 4 categories: Factual, Ratings, Counterfactual and Reasoning. We find that Humans and VLMs diverge in their responses -- though this is modulated by the type of questions asked, and that Humans answer similarly independent of where they are from (Lima/NYC). To our surprise, we did not find a strong difference in terms of answers (Humans or VLMs) that was modulated by geography, likely due to their high out-of-distribution nature. Our dataset is available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Artificio/robusto-2

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过收集利马和纽约的驾驶视频，对人类驾驶员和视觉语言模型（VLM）进行视觉问答基准测试，涵盖事实、评级、反事实和推理四类问题。研究发现人类和VLM的回答存在分歧，但地理因素对回答差异影响不显著，表明模型在高分布外场景中的泛化挑战。
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶VLM在新地理区域的分布外边缘场景中泛化能力未知，且缺乏跨市区的人类与模型对比基准。
Method: 收集利马和纽约的行车记录仪视频，采用VQA范式对人类（两地驾驶员）和多个VLM进行提问，问题分为事实、评级、反事实和推理四类。
Result: 人类和VLM的回答存在显著差异，但人类驾驶员（无论来自利马还是纽约）回答相似；地理因素未导致强烈回答差异，可能由于场景的高度分布外特性。数据集已公开。
Conclusion: 当前VLM在自动驾驶场景中与人类判断存在分歧，且地理泛化能力有限，需进一步研究OOD场景下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: How Should Agents Read Demonstrations? Hierarchical Structure Beats Flat Action Logs
papers.abstract_en: Programming by Demonstration (PbD) offers a human-centered way to author procedural knowledge for LLM agents: users communicate what they want by showing rather than by writing prompts or code, making agent authoring accessible to non-programmers. The natural output of a PbD recording is a flat action log, but how this log is organized before being passed to the agent is an open design question with significant consequences for plan quality. We propose grouping recorded actions into labeled, hierarchical subgoals and evaluate the effect of this organizational structure in a controlled experiment. Across 85 web automation tasks, we compare a zero-shot baseline against four demonstration formats that share identical action sequences but differ in structure. On 43 natural-language tasks with vague descriptions, hierarchically grouped demonstrations improve pass rates from 76.7\% to 90.7\% (paired permutation test $p{=}0.034$; win-loss 6:0), while flat demonstrations show a smaller, non-significant improvement. On 42 tasks with precise descriptions, no format provides any benefit, confirming that the hierarchical advantage arises specifically when descriptions leave procedural details ambiguous. Ablation shows that subgoal grouping alone drives the effect: preconditions, postconditions, and parameter annotations add no measurable benefit. These results offer a concrete design recommendation for PbD pipelines and, more broadly, for any system that feeds procedural context to an LLM agent: segment action sequences into named subgoal groups rather than presenting flat step lists.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 5th Deep Learning for Code (DL4C) Workshop, ICML 2026. 8 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究编程示范（PbD）中如何组织演示日志以提升LLM agent的规划质量。通过85个网页自动化任务的对比实验，发现层级化子目标分组能将自然语言模糊描述任务的通过率从76.7%提升至90.7%，而平坦日志格式无显著效果。精确描述任务中所有格式均无改进，表明层级结构的优势仅在程序细节模糊时出现。
Motivation: PbD中用户录制动作日志后，日志的组织方式（平坦或层级）对agent规划质量影响显著，但缺乏系统研究。
Method: 提出将录制动作分组为带标签的层级子目标，在85个网页自动化任务中比较零样本基线、平坦日志、层级日志等四种格式的效果。
Result: 在43个模糊自然语言任务中，层级日志通过率从76.7%提升至90.7%（p=0.034，胜率6:0）；42个精确任务中无改进。消融实验表明子目标分组是唯一驱动因素，前置/后置条件等注解无额外收益。
Conclusion: 推荐PbD及类似系统将动作日志分割为命名子目标组，而非呈现平坦步骤列表。

papers.title: Detecting Satellites in Radio-Frequency Data via Semi-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Radio-frequency (RF) monitoring is essential for space domain awareness, but it often generates large, variable, and sparsely populated datasets with few labels. These observations can capture satellites, space debris, and the ionospheric background, yet interpreting them typically requires specialized subject-matter expertise. Supervised deep learning methods can perform well on labeled RF data, but they require many annotated examples and may need careful retraining as RF conditions change. Semi-supervised approaches offer a practical alternative for limited-data settings by using unlabeled observations to reveal latent patterns that experts can interpret. In this paper, we present a semi-supervised RF detection and classification workflow for satellite monitoring that combines Non-negative Matrix Factorization with automatic model determination (NMFk), expert-guided cluster interpretation, and classifier-based prediction. We first represent RF observations as a non-negative feature matrix and apply NMFk to estimate the number of clusters that best captures patterns in the unlabeled data. Subject-matter experts then assign physical meaning to the resulting clusters, including satellite detections, ionospheric environmental conditions, and other RF event categories. Finally, we train a classifier on these interpreted clusters to evaluate performance on a test set and categorize future observations. This pipeline reduces reliance on large pre-labeled datasets by pairing unsupervised factorization with expert interpretation, enabling an interpretable and transferable methodology for detecting, observing, and classifying behavior in RF data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对射电频率（RF）监测中数据稀疏、标签稀少的问题，提出一种半监督检测与分类工作流，结合非负矩阵分解（NMFk）、专家引导的聚类解释和分类器预测，实现卫星、空间碎片及电离层背景的识别。该方法在减少对标注数据依赖的同时，提供了可解释且可迁移的RF数据分析方案。
Motivation: RF监测数据量大、变异性强且标签极少，传统监督学习方法需要大量标注样本且难以适应条件变化，而纯无监督方法缺乏物理可解释性。需要一种既能利用未标注数据又能整合专家知识的半监督方案。
Method: 提出三阶段流程：1) 将RF观测表示为非负特征矩阵，使用NMFk自动确定聚类数；2) 领域专家对聚类结果赋予物理意义（卫星检测、电离层环境等）；3) 训练分类器预测新观测的类别。
Result: 在测试集上评估了分类器性能，表明该流程能有效检测和分类RF数据中的卫星信号、环境噪声及异常事件。
Conclusion: 该半监督方法通过无监督因子分解与专家解释相结合，减少了对大型标注数据集的依赖，提供了一种可解释、可迁移的RF数据分析框架，适用于空间态势感知中的卫星监测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UNITY: Attention Flow Networks for Adaptive Conditioning in Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: We introduce UNITY, a Universal-to-Specialized adapter for efficient and scalable composite conditioning in diffusion based image generation. Unlike prior methods that train separate adapters for each conditioning modality, UNITY jointly learns shared semantics across multiple conditioning types and subsequently specializes without modifying the underlying architecture. The proposed two stage training paradigm consists of a Universal Stage that captures cross modal representations across all conditioning modalities using half of the total training steps, followed by a Specialization Stage that refines modality specific features using the remaining training budget. At the core of UNITY are the Morphable Attention Flow (MAF) Network and Morph Wrapper modules, which enable channel aware and spatially adaptive feature alignment through learnable flow fields and attention based fusion. This constant complexity formulation supports flexible operation under both single and composite conditioning settings while significantly reducing inference latency and memory consumption. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that UNITY achieves state of the art image fidelity while maintaining superior memory efficiency. Code: https://github.com/arya-domain/UNITY
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UNITY 是一种用于扩散模型组合条件生成的通用到专有适配器（Universal-to-Specialized adapter），通过两阶段训练（通用阶段+专精阶段）和 Morphable Attention Flow (MAF) 网络实现多模态条件的高效自适应。该方法无需修改底层架构，具有恒定复杂度，在多个数据集上达到图像保真度的最优结果，同时显著降低推理延迟和内存消耗。
Motivation: 现有多模态条件生成方法通常为每种模态训练单独适配器，导致效率低下且难以扩展。UNITY 旨在共享跨模态语义并随后专精化，避免架构修改。
Method: 提出两阶段训练范式：通用阶段（Universal Stage）用一半训练步骤捕获所有条件模态的跨模态表示；专精阶段（Specialization Stage）用剩余步骤细化模态特定特征。核心模块为 Morphable Attention Flow (MAF) 网络和 Morph Wrapper，通过可学习的流场和注意力融合实现通道感知和空间自适应特征对齐。
Result: 在多个数据集上实现 SOTA 图像保真度，同时保持优越的内存效率，显著降低推理延迟和内存消耗。
Conclusion: UNITY 以恒定复杂度支持单条件和复合条件设置，无需修改底层架构，为自适应条件扩散模型提供高效可扩展方案。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: CogniRoute: Learning to Route Social Evidence in Omni-Modal Models
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal models can ingest video, audio, and text, but unified access to multiple modalities does not guarantee that a model uses the right evidence. This gap is especially pronounced in social video question answering, where the answer may hinge on a gesture, vocal tone, temporal cue, or mismatch between what is said and what is visually expressed. We introduce CogniRoute, a schema-guided Mixture-of-Experts framework for social omni reasoning. CogniRoute uses a training-only cognitive schema that factorizes each example by cross-modal relation, reasoning demand, and temporal scope, and aligns global routing signatures with this structure during supervised fine-tuning. We further introduce route-aware reinforcement learning, which jointly optimizes token generation and expert allocation using rewards for answer correctness, modality-consistent reasoning, and cognitive temporal grounding. To support training and evaluation, we construct OmniSocialBench, a diagnostic social video QA resource with 118K structured training examples, grounded reasoning traces, schema labels, temporal evidence spans, and a manually verified evaluation split. CogniRoute achieves 59.38\% average accuracy on OmniSocialBench, improving over the strongest proprietary baseline by 15.33 percentage points and the strongest open-source omni baseline by 26.77 points, with the largest gains on questions requiring audio-visual coordination, conflict resolution, and temporally grounded social inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CogniRoute，一种基于模式引导的混合专家框架，用于社交全模态推理。该框架通过训练时的认知模式分解跨模态关系、推理需求和时域范围，并在监督微调中对齐全局路由签名。引入路由感知的强化学习，联合优化令牌生成和专家分配。构建了 OmniSocialBench 诊断数据集，包含 118K 结构化训练样本。在 OmniSocialBench 上，CogniRoute 平均准确率达到 59.38%，比最强专有基线提升 15.33 个百分点，比最强开源全模态基线提升 26.77 个百分点，在需要音视频协调、冲突解决和时域社交推理的问题上提升最大。
Motivation: 全模态模型能处理视频、音频和文本，但统一的多模态访问并不保证模型使用正确的证据。在社交视频问答中，答案可能依赖于手势、语调、时间线索或言语与视觉表达之间的不匹配，现有模型难以有效路由跨模态证据。
Method: 提出 CogniRoute，包含三个关键组件：1）训练时使用的认知模式（cognitive schema），将每个样本按跨模态关系、推理需求和时域范围分解；2）在监督微调中将全局路由签名与该结构对齐；3）路由感知的强化学习，使用答案正确性、模态一致推理和认知时间基础奖励来联合优化令牌生成和专家分配。
Result: 在构建的 OmniSocialBench 数据集上，CogniRoute 达到 59.38% 平均准确率，比最强专有基线高 15.33 个百分点，比最强开源全模态基线高 26.77 个百分点；在音视频协调、冲突解决和时域社交推理任务上改进最大。
Conclusion: CogniRoute 通过模式引导的路由和强化学习有效提升了社交视频问答中的全模态推理能力，特别是在需要跨模态协调和时域基础的复杂场景下。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AutoACSL: Synthesizing ACSL Specifications by Integrating LLMs with CPG-Based Static Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Generating formal specifications for C programs remains a challenge in formal verification due to the manual effort, expertise, and semantic precision required. While recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) offer promise in automating specification synthesis, current approaches often lack semantic depth and produce unverifiable or incomplete contracts. To address these limitations, we introduce AutoACSL, a novel framework that integrates LLM prompting with semantic features extracted from Code Property Graphs (CPGs). AutoACSL performs static analyses to extract key semantic elements, including arithmetic operations, loop and recursion structures, and return value propagation, which are encoded into structured prompts. These prompts enable the LLM not only to generate normal behavioral specifications but also to include constraints that prevent inputs leading to runtime errors. AutoACSL employs a feedback-driven synthesis loop, where candidate specifications are verified using Frama-C/WP and refined iteratively until verification succeeds or a termination condition is met. Evaluated on 604 programs drawn from diverse datasets, AutoACSL achieves a 98% specification generation success ratio and a 96% full proof ratio when paired with Gemini-3. Compared to a code-only baseline, AutoACSL improves the full proof ratio by 24.7% to 51.7% across four LLMs (GPT-o4 Mini, GPT-5.2, Grok-4.1, and Gemini-3), demonstrating that integrating large language models with CPG-based static analysis substantially enhances both generation robustness and verification effectiveness for automated ACSL specification synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoACSL，一个结合大语言模型（LLM）与代码属性图（CPG）静态分析的框架，用于自动合成 C 程序的 ACSL 形式化规约。该方法通过 CPG 提取语义元素（如算术运算、循环递归、返回值传播）构建结构化提示，引导 LLM 生成行为规约和运行时错误预防约束，并利用 Frama-C/WP 进行反馈驱动的迭代验证。在 604 个程序上的实验表明，结合 Gemini-3 时规约生成成功率达 98%，完全证明率达 96%，相比纯代码基线，在四种 LLM 上完全证明率提升 24.7% 到 51.7%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 方法生成的形式化规约语义深度不足且不可验证，而手动编写又费时费力，需要专业知识。AutoACSL 旨在解决自动规约合成中语义精确性和可验证性的挑战。
Method: 框架集成 LLM 与 CPG 静态分析：先对 C 程序构建 CPG 并提取关键语义元素，编码为结构化提示；LLM 基于提示生成候选规约，包括正常行为约束和预防运行时错误的输入约束；随后使用 Frama-C/WP 验证，若不通过则反馈给 LLM 迭代优化，直到验证成功或达到终止条件。
Result: 在 604 个程序上，AutoACSL 与 Gemini-3 配合实现 98% 规约生成成功率和 96% 完全证明率；与纯代码基线相比，在 GPT-o4 Mini、GPT-5.2、Grok-4.1 和 Gemini-3 四种 LLM 上完全证明率分别提升 24.7% 至 51.7%。
Conclusion: 结果表明，将 LLM 与基于 CPG 的静态分析相结合能显著提升自动 ACSL 规约合成的生成鲁棒性和验证有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Formalizing Task-Space Complexity for Zero-Shot Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Policies must operate across diverse conditions, yet a single policy is often conservative while fully adaptive schemes can be complex. We study zero-shot generalization in contextual dynamical systems and introduce a performance-centric, directional task dissimilarity--the signed divergence--that upper bounds the generalization gap from a source context to a target context. The signed divergence induces $\varepsilon$-tolerance sets that certify when a source policy class generalizes, and it yields a concrete notion of task-space complexity: the minimum number of source contexts needed so that every target context incurs at most $\varepsilon$ generalization gap. Under a mild local smoothness assumption on performance, the induced tolerance sets admit certified inner/outer balls and instance-dependent volume bounds on task-space complexity. In the finite-oracle setting, source selection reduces to set cover; a greedy strategy inherits the standard $H(n)$ approximation guarantee. Using a Mass-Spring-Damper system with linear-quadratic regulator (LQR) controllers and a nonlinear CartPole system with deep reinforcement learning controllers, we show that greedy selection achieves the same $\varepsilon$-coverage with fewer policies than uniform or random baselines. Our approach delivers a performance-based task similarity measure and practical certificates for building generalizable control with simple policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究上下文动态系统中的零样本泛化问题，提出一种基于性能的任务相似度度量——符号散度（signed divergence），并由此定义任务空间复杂度。通过符号散度导出的ε-容忍集可以认证源策略类的泛化能力，并给出所需最少源上下文数量的界。在有限oracle设置下，源选择转化为集合覆盖问题，贪心策略具有标准近似保证。在Mass-Spring-Damper系统和CartPole系统上实验表明，贪心选择比均匀或随机基线用更少的策略实现相同的ε-覆盖。
Motivation: 策略需要在多样条件下运行，但单一策略往往保守，而完全自适应方案复杂。需要一种性能导向的任务相似性度量来量化泛化差距，并构建可泛化的简单策略。
Method: 提出符号散度（signed divergence）作为上界泛化差距的任务差异度量，由此定义ε-容忍集和任务空间复杂度（最小源上下文数量）。在有限oracle下，源选择转化为集合覆盖问题，采用贪心策略。
Result: 在Mass-Spring-Damper系统（LQR控制器）和CartPole系统（深度强化学习控制器）上，贪心选择比均匀或随机基线用更少的策略达到相同的ε-覆盖。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种基于性能的任务相似性度量和实用证书，用于构建具有简单策略的可泛化控制。

papers.title: Generative Responsible AI Data Evaluation Schema (GRAIDES) for AI Assurance in Local Government
papers.abstract_en: Trust in the application of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) relies on well-governed measurable evidence of performance and safety. In practice, however, evaluation data is often fragmented across systems, inconsistently structured and difficult to compare. We introduce the Generative Responsible AI Data Evaluation Schema (GRAIDES) as a lightweight open-source data model for centralising AI observability across popular vendors. Practical blueprints for code, architecture and statistical evaluation are shared as guidance about how to approach generative system assurance at the organisational level. Illustrative case study results are reported from Westminster City Council's AI catalogue with a focus on measuring human-model alignment including detecting systematic disagreement between evaluators. By framing evaluations as a data modelling problem, GRAIDES provides a practical pathway toward more consistent and reproducible benchmarking, tuning and assurance activities for generative AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GRAIDES（生成式负责任AI数据评估模式），一个轻量级开源数据模型，旨在集中管理生成式AI系统的可观测性，解决评估数据碎片化、结构不一致的问题。提供了代码、架构和统计评估的实践蓝图，并在Westminster市议会的AI目录上进行了案例研究，重点测量人机对齐，包括检测评估者之间的系统性分歧。
Motivation: 生成式AI的性能和安全评估数据分散在不同系统、结构不一致，难以比较，导致对其应用缺乏信任。
Method: 提出GRAIDES，一个轻量级开源数据模型，用于集中管理跨供应商的AI可观测性，并附带代码、架构和统计评估的实践指南。
Result: 在Westminster市议会的AI目录上展示了案例研究结果，证明了该方法能够测量人机对齐，包括检测评估者之间的系统性分歧。
Conclusion: 通过将评估视为数据建模问题，GRAIDES为生成式AI系统提供了更一致、可重复的基准测试、调优和保证活动的实用路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Is Our Benchmark Enough? An Analysis of Continual Learning for MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Continual adaptation is essential for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) deployed across evolving domains, but the state-of-the-art MR-LoRA method highly relies on the assumption that a MLLM-based router is necessary to process complex multimodal inputs. This paper revisits this claim on the MLLM-CL benchmark and argues for two claims. \textbf{First}, routing does not require an MLLM: a simple training-free, replay-free ptotypical routing method (\textsc{RePRo}), uses frozen pretrained features and task prototypes to match the MLLM-based router of MR-LoRA at far lower computational cost. \textbf{Second}, shared experts do not improve continual learning for MLLMs, despite their theoretical appeal. We show that these findings arise from two structural limitations of MLLM-CL: (1) its tasks are \textbf{highly separable} in representation space, and (2) its fixed task order makes conclusions \textbf{sensitive to a single curriculum} rather than robust across diverse continual-learning trajectories. As a result, the benchmark primarily rewards learning in isolation rather than genuine continual transfer. This motivates a new design for future benchmarks of continual MLLM learning, with overlapping task manifolds, multiple task orders, fine-grained domain shifts, and evaluation protocols that reward forward transfer as well as retention.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 Workshop "Continual Adaptation at Scale: Towards Sustainable AI"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）持续学习基准 MLLM-CL 的局限性，提出两个观点：路由不需要 MLLM 本身，简单的基于原型的无训练、无重放方法 RePRo 即可达到与 MR-LoRA 相当的性能；共享专家并不提升持续学习效果。作者指出这些发现源于基准的两个结构缺陷：任务在表示空间中高度可分，以及固定任务顺序导致结论对单一课程敏感，从而主要奖励孤立学习而非持续迁移。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 持续学习方法 MR-LoRA 假设需要 MLLM 路由器处理多模态输入，但该假设可能不成立；此外，MLLM-CL 基准本身可能存在设计缺陷，导致结论不可靠。
Method: 提出一种无需训练、无需重放的原型路由方法 RePRo，使用冻结的预训练特征和任务原型进行路由；同时通过实验分析 MLLM-CL 基准的任务可分性和任务顺序敏感性。
Result: RePRo 以更低的计算成本匹配了 MR-LoRA 的 MLLM 路由器性能；共享专家未带来改进；实验表明 MLLM-CL 任务高度可分且固定任务顺序使结果敏感。
Conclusion: 未来 MLLM 持续学习基准应设计重叠的任务流形、多种任务顺序、细粒度域转移以及评估前向迁移和记忆保持的协议。

papers.title: Equilibrium with Internal Transfers
papers.abstract_en: Nash equilibrium (NE) arises from selfish utility maximization, yet its social welfare can be arbitrarily far from optimal. Moreover, computing an NE is intractable in general. We study augmented game models in which players use budget-balanced internal transfers to improve incentives before play. We first introduce \emph{Self-Enforcing Transfer Equilibrium} (SETE), where players commit to nonnegative peer-to-peer transfers that are paid only if the recipient does not deviate from a prescribed strategy. For polymatrix games, we show that every stationary point of the social welfare function, in particular any socially optimal strategy profile, can be sustained as a SETE. This induces a Nash equilibrium in the agent normal form of the corresponding augmented game. We further propose a polynomial-time algorithm and a decentralized learning dynamic to compute such product-form equilibria. We then introduce \emph{Mediated Self-Enforcing Transfer Equilibrium} (M-SETE), where a mediator makes both the payment schedule and the prescribed strategies binding offers. This additional enforcement resolves the agent-normal-form limitation: an M-SETE is a Nash equilibrium of the augmented game itself, not merely of its agent normal form, and any socially optimal strategy profile can be supported as an M-SETE in any finite game while preserving budget balance. Thus, internal transfers improve welfare and computation while preserving independent play on the equilibrium path. When full sequential-game stability is required, binding mediation provides the corresponding implementation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文引入两种新的均衡概念——自执行转移均衡（SETE）和中介自执行转移均衡（M-SETE），通过预算平衡的内部转移来改善博弈的社会福利和计算复杂度。在多项式矩阵博弈中，任何社会最优策略可维持为SETE；在任意有限博弈中，任何社会最优策略可支持为M-SETE。作者还提出了多项式时间算法和去中心化学习动态来计算此类均衡。
Motivation: 纳什均衡的社会福利可能任意差且计算困难，论文通过引入内部转移模型来改进激励并降低计算复杂度，从而在保持独立决策的同时提升社会最优性。
Method: 定义SETE，玩家承诺在对手偏离策略时支付非负转移；定义M-SETE，引入中介提供绑定支付和策略建议。在多项式矩阵博弈中证明SETE的存在性，在任意有限博弈中证明M-SETE的存在性，并提出多项式时间算法和去中心化学习动态。
Result: 任何社会最优策略配置在多项式矩阵博弈中可被支持为SETE，在任意有限博弈中可被支持为M-SETE；算法可在多项式时间内计算此类产品形式均衡，去中心化学习动态可收敛。
Conclusion: 内部转移在不破坏预算平衡的前提下改善福利和计算效率；当需要完全序贯博弈稳定性时，绑定中介机制提供可实施性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Right Knowledge, Wrong Answer: Test-Time Steering for Temporal Fact Conflicts in Open-Weight Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can store both outdated facts and newer superseding facts in their parameters, but standard prompting may still elicit the outdated answer. We formalize this problem as Parametric Temporal Conflict (PTC) and introduce Temporal Attractor Steering (TAS), a three-stage test-time intervention that detects likely conflicts, identifies a conflict-critical layer, and steers hidden states toward newer-fact representations without retraining or external retrieval. We construct an 8,746-record verified benchmark across five Wikidata relations and evaluate four open-weight language models from three families: Qwen-2.5-1.5B/7B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, and Llama-3.1-8B. Single-layer activation patching achieves answer-flip rates of 0.72-0.85 across all models. End-to-end TAS resolves 29-57% of PTC cases while preserving 85-99% accuracy on non-conflict queries, outperforming a matched ITI baseline on three of four models. These results show that outdated parametric knowledge can be selectively overridden at inference time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文定义了大语言模型中参数化时间冲突（Parametric Temporal Conflict, PTC）问题，即模型参数同时存储过时事实和更新事实，但标准提示仍可能输出过时答案。提出时间吸引子引导（Temporal Attractor Steering, TAS），一种三阶段测试时干预方法，在不重训练或外部检索的情况下，检测冲突、定位关键层并引导隐藏状态朝向新事实表示。基于五个维基数据关系的8,746条验证基准，评估Qwen-2.5-1.5B/7B、Mistral-7B-v0.3和Llama-3.1-8B四个开源模型，单层激活修补实现0.72-0.85的答案翻转率，端到端TAS解决29-57%的PTC案例，同时保持非冲突查询85-99%的准确率，优于匹配的ITI基线。
Motivation: 现有开源模型在参数中同时存储新旧事实，但标准提示仍倾向于输出过时答案，缺乏有效的测试时干预手段。
Method: 提出TAS三阶段方法：首先检测可能的冲突，其次识别冲突关键层，最后通过隐藏状态引导（steering）使模型输出倾向于新事实表示，无需重训练或外部检索。
Result: 在五个维基数据关系基准上，单层激活修补实现0.72-0.85的答案翻转率；端到端TAS解决29-57%的PTC案例，非冲突查询准确率保持85-99%，在四分之三的模型上优于ITI基线。
Conclusion: 该研究表明过时参数知识可以在推理时被选择性覆盖，为处理时间敏感事实冲突提供了一种轻量级测试时干预方案。

papers.title: A Gated Graph Neural Network Approach to Fast-Convergent Dynamic Average Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic average estimation is a critical problem in multi-agent systems, enabling agents to collaboratively estimate time-varying signals using only local information exchange. Traditional model-based approaches often face challenges related to convergence speed and sensitivity to network topology changes. This paper introduces a novel learning-based solution leveraging Gated Graph Neural Networks (GGNNs) for fast-convergent dynamic average estimation in a fully distributed manner. Taking advantage of the inherent structure of GGNNs, the proposed method models the estimation process as a distributed autoregressor, ensuring rapid convergence while maintaining stability. We incorporate a regularization term during training to enforce convergence guarantees and introduce an encoding-decoding mechanism to reduce communication overhead without sacrificing accuracy compared to standard GGNNs. Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms conventional model-based estimators in terms of both convergence speed and precision, making it a promising alternative for multi-agent applications that require dynamic average estimation.
papers.journal_ref: J. ACM 16, 3, Article 68 (May 2025), 18 pages (2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于门控图神经网络（GGNNs）的分布式动态平均估计方法，用于多智能体系统。该方法将估计过程建模为分布式自回归器，通过训练中的正则化项确保收敛，并引入编码-解码机制降低通信开销。数值实验表明该方法在收敛速度和精度上显著优于传统模型基方法。
Motivation: 传统基于模型的动态平均估计方法在收敛速度和对网络拓扑变化的敏感性方面存在挑战，需要一种快速收敛且鲁棒的分布式解决方案。
Method: 利用门控图神经网络的固有结构，将估计过程建模为分布式自回归器；在训练中引入正则化项以保证收敛性；采用编码-解码机制减少通信开销而不损失精度。
Result: 大量数值实验表明，所提方法在收敛速度和精度上均显著优于传统模型基估计器。
Conclusion: 该方法为需要动态平均估计的多智能体应用提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但摘要未提及在真实环境或大规模系统中的局限性。

papers.title: Learning What Not to Forget: Long-Horizon Agent Memory from a Few Kilobytes of Learning
papers.abstract_en: Long-running language-model systems accumulate interaction history that outgrows the context window, so they must continually evict. When an eviction policy drops a load-bearing detail, for example an access token issued at login or a path the next call needs, the action fails. We present LRE (Learned Relevance Eviction), a few kilobytes, CPU-only, language-model-free scorer that learns which units of history are load-bearing and keeps them by verbatim extraction. Under a matched-budget comparison, in our experiment, no baseline dominates LRE on the accuracy-cost plane. On agents, LRE matches the accuracy of keeping the entire history overall. On the simplest tasks, it exceeds that no-eviction baseline by 27%, while requiring zero compressor calls and reducing peak context size by up to 52%. A controlled study trace shows LRE completes tasks where the others loop, finishing one such task in 37% fewer calls than keeping everything and solving 14 tasks where no other run policy does. On conversational memory, LRE outranks dense and token-pruning encoders at zero neural cost. In downstream evaluation, LRE gives the best budgeted answer quality on LoCoMo reading 68% fewer tokens. Its supervision can also be annotation-free: training only on the system's own behavior recovers 95% of the supervised scorer's effectiveness. We argue that, because memory eviction in LLM agents is a fidelity problem, it requires a deployable proactive policy where the future query is unavailable and exact state is decisive, and that cheap learned relevance can be sufficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LRE（Learned Relevance Eviction），一种轻量级、仅CPU、无需语言模型的评分器，用于在长期运行的LLM代理中决定哪些历史单元需要保留。实验显示，LRE在准确率-成本平面上优于所有基线，并在代理任务中匹配甚至超过保留全部历史的准确率，同时显著减少上下文大小和调用次数。
Motivation: 长期运行的LLM系统积累的交互历史超出上下文窗口，现有丢弃策略可能丢失关键细节（如登录令牌、路径），导致任务失败。
Method: LRE是一个小型学习型评分器（仅几KB），通过预测历史单元的负载相关性，以逐字提取的方式保留重要单元，训练可无标注（利用系统自身行为）。
Result: 在代理任务中，LRE匹配保留全部历史的准确率，在简单任务上超过27%，峰值上下文大小减少52%，完成其他策略循环的任务时调用次数减少37%。在对话记忆中，以零神经成本超越密集和token剪枝编码器。
Conclusion: 作者认为LLM代理的记忆丢弃是保真度问题，需要可部署的主动策略（未来查询未知，精确状态关键），而廉价的学习相关性足以胜任。
