papers.title: FOCA: Future-Oriented Conditioning for Data-Efficient Vision-Language-Action Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable general-purpose robotic control via large-scale multimodal pretraining, yet their effectiveness under few-shot imitation learning remains limited. We conduct a systematic stress test of state-of-the-art VLA models and show that performance degrades sharply as demonstrations are reduced, revealing a key weakness of existing adaptation strategies. To address this, we introduce FOCA, a future-oriented conditioning framework for data-efficient VLA adaptation. FOCA combines explicit prediction of task-grounded future interaction embeddings with implicit alignment to future goal observations, enabling long-horizon reasoning in latent space without pixel-level prediction. This formulation naturally supports action-free co-training with synthetic videos from video world models and can be interpreted as learning a future-conditioned value-like representation. Extensive experiments demonstrate FOCA achieves 95.7% success with 20 demonstrations on LIBERO, improves 7-12% on RoboCasa, and delivers up to 26% absolute gains on real robots, establishing a new state of the art in few-shot VLA adaptation.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Project page: https://focavla.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在少样本模仿学习中的性能退化问题，提出面向未来的条件框架FOCA。FOCA结合显式的任务驱动未来交互嵌入预测和隐式的未来目标观测对齐，在潜在空间实现长程推理，无需像素级预测。实验表明，在LIBERO上20个演示即可达到95.7%成功率，在RoboCasa上提升7-12%，在真实机器人上获得高达26%的绝对增益。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型在少样本条件下性能急剧下降，揭示了当前适应策略的关键弱点。
Method: 提出FOCA框架，包含显式预测任务相关的未来交互嵌入和隐式对齐未来目标观测，并通过视频世界模型的合成视频支持无动作联合训练，学习类似未来条件价值的表示。
Result: 在LIBERO上20个演示达到95.7%成功率；在RoboCasa上提升7-12%；在真实机器人上实现最高26%的绝对增益，刷新少样本VLA适应最先进水平。
Conclusion: FOCA通过面向未来的条件化，显著提升了VLA模型在数据稀少场景下的适应能力，但局限在于依赖合成的未来视频质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Synthetic Network Packet Generation through Statistical Learning and Genetic Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Developing robust intrusion detection systems (IDS) for IoT environments requires large, labeled datasets capturing realistic traffic distributions across both benign and malicious activity. Existing public datasets suffer from fixed activity distributions and extreme class imbalance, while deep generative models (GANs, VAEs) provide no mechanism to enforce that synthetic packets remain within physically valid feature ranges. This paper proposes and compares two constraint-enforcing approaches for synthetic IoT network packet generation: (i) a statistical learning method combining PCA-based latent space sampling with dual One-Class SVM (OCSVM) and Isolation Forest (IF) boundary enforcement, and (ii) a genetic algorithm (GA) method that treats packet generation as a multi-objective optimization problem with explicit fitness criteria for anomaly model acceptance and distributional fidelity. Both methods embed hard validity constraints -- dual anomaly-detection gating, feature-range clamping, and independent validation -- directly into the synthesis pipeline. Evaluation on the complete ACI IoT 2023 dataset (1,231,411 packets, 12 attack categories, class imbalance up to 175,805:1) demonstrates that both methods achieve PASS status across all categories under independently trained validators with a 30% anomaly rate threshold: the statistical method attains 1.20% average anomaly rate with ~1,091 packets/s throughput, while the GA attains 0.62% average anomaly rate with organic per-class variance (0.00%-2.50%) at ~5.7 packets/s. Both methods successfully amplify the 5-sample ARP Spoofing category by 200x to 1,000 validated packets. The ~190:1 throughput ratio between methods, combined with their complementary quality profiles, provides evidence-based selection criteria for deployment contexts ranging from rapid dataset augmentation to adversarial robustness testing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出两种约束性合成物联网网络数据包生成方法：基于统计学习的方法（PCA潜空间采样+单类SVM/孤立森林边界强制）和基于遗传算法的方法（多目标优化+显式适应度标准）。在ACI IoT 2023数据集上评估，两种方法均通过独立验证器的30%异常率阈值测试，统计方法平均异常率1.20%，吞吐量约1091包/秒；遗传方法平均异常率0.62%，吞吐量约5.7包/秒。
Motivation: 现有关键字检测系统（IDS）需要大规模标注数据集，但公开数据集存在固定分布和极端类别不平衡，深度生成模型无法保证合成数据包在物理有效特征范围内。
Method: 提出两种约束强制方法：统计方法结合PCA潜空间采样与双异常检测门控（OCSVM和孤立森林），遗传方法将数据包生成视为多目标优化问题，二者均嵌入硬有效性约束（特征范围钳制、独立验证）。
Result: 在ACI IoT 2023数据集上，统计方法平均异常率1.20%，吞吐量~1091包/秒；遗传方法平均异常率0.62%，吞吐量~5.7包/秒，且均能放大ARP欺骗类别200倍至1000个验证包。
Conclusion: 两种方法提供互补的质量特征，吞吐量比约190:1，为快速数据集增强和对抗性鲁棒测试等部署场景提供基于证据的选择标准。

papers.title: Betting on Moments: Legendre Jumper Martingales for Online Exchangeability Testing
papers.abstract_en: We present a family of conformal test martingales based on shifted Legendre polynomials, which extends the Simple Jumper martingale. The Simple Legendre Jumper substitutes the linear betting function with a polynomial of arbitrary degree, thereby facilitating the detection of variance, skewness, and higher-order deviations from uniformity; the standard Simple Jumper is a specific instance of degree one. The Product Legendre Jumper integrates multiple polynomial degrees into a unified betting function, although its state space expands exponentially-a cost we refer to as the jumping tax. To address this issue, we introduce the Variational Legendre Jumper, which factorises the joint adaptation through a mean-field approximation, thereby reducing exponential scaling to linear time with minimal loss in power. Lastly, the Composite Legendre Jumper incorporates several jumping rates, ensuring a wealth floor under exchangeability and automatic adaptation to the shift's timescale. Empirical results from a real-world classification task demonstrate that the combined methods consistently surpass any single-degree martingale under distributional shift, and the composite variant is recommended as the default when the shift timescale is unknown.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一系列基于移位勒让德多项式的共形检验鞅（conformal test martingales），扩展了Simple Jumper鞅。Simple Legendre Jumper用多项式替代线性押注函数，可检测方差、偏度等高阶偏差；Product Legendre Jumper集成多个多项式度但状态空间指数增长（称为跳跃税）；Variational Legendre Jumper通过平均场近似将指数缩放降至线性时间；Composite Legendre Jumper结合多种跳跃率以自适应时间尺度。实验表明组合方法在分布漂移下优于单度鞅。
Motivation: 现有Simple Jumper鞅仅使用线性押注函数，无法有效检测方差、偏度等更高阶的分布偏差。
Method: 提出基于移位勒让德多项式的共形检验鞅族：Simple Legendre Jumper（单多项式度）、Product Legendre Jumper（多度集成，但状态空间指数增长）、Variational Legendre Jumper（平均场近似降为线性时间）、Composite Legendre Jumper（多跳跃率自适应）。
Result: 在真实分类任务上，组合方法在分布漂移下始终优于任何单一度数的鞅，且Composite变体在漂移时间尺度未知时推荐为默认方法。
Conclusion: 该家族鞅方法可有效检测分布漂移，Composite Legendre Jumper是普适性选择，但未在气象领域验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evolutionary Discovery of Developmental Reward Schedules in Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: The temporal structure of reward composition in reinforcement learning (RL) is typically hand-designed and held fixed throughout training, leaving the progression of motivational priorities largely unexplored. In this work, we propose an evolutionary framework for discovering developmental reward schedules, in which three distinct biologically inspired motivational components -- agency, novelty, and reactivity -- are combined through time-varying weights that dynamically shift over the course of training. Evaluated on two sparse-reward MiniGrid tasks: DoorKey-6x6 and KeyCorridorS3R1, our framework compares the generalizability of four evolutionary algorithms: CMA-ES, xNES, DE, and L-SHADE against an extrinsically motivated baseline (our main comparison point), and three additional hand-designed methods. On DoorKey-6x6, all evolved methods outperform the non-evolved baselines, with L-SHADE achieving the best performance -- an approximate relative mean improvement of 11.4% over the extrinsic only baseline. On KeyCorridorS3R1, CMA-ES achieves the best overall performance, with the remaining evolved methods showing weaker and less reliable generalization capability compared to the extrinsic only baseline. Interestingly, the discovered schedules diverge from our defined developmental ordering, with novelty consistently emerging as the dominant early signal during training, across both tasks. Collectively, our results position evolutionary optimization as a promising approach for developmental reward schedule discovery in deep reinforcement learning, and suggest that what evolution finds to be optimal in computational settings may differ from what it finds to be optimal in biology. The code for this project can be found at: https://github.com/alannadels/Evolutionary_RL.git.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Development and Learning (ICDL)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个进化框架，用于发现深度强化学习中的发育奖励调度（developmental reward schedules），将三种生物启发的动机成分（能动性、新奇性、反应性）通过随时间变化的权重组合。在DoorKey-6x6和KeyCorridorS3R1两个稀疏奖励MiniGrid任务上评估了四种进化算法（CMA-ES, xNES, DE, L-SHADE）与外在奖励基线及三种手工设计方法的对比。结果显示所有进化方法在DoorKey-6x6上优于基线，L-SHADE相对提升11.4%；在KeyCorridorS3R1上仅CMA-ES表现最佳。进化发现的时间表与生物学中的发展阶段不同，新奇性始终是早期主导信号。
Motivation: 强化学习中奖励组合的时间结构通常手工设计且固定，忽视了动机优先级随训练过程的动态变化。
Method: 提出进化框架，使用进化算法优化三种生物启发动机成分（agency, novelty, reactivity）的时间权重，以发现发育奖励调度。
Result: 在DoorKey-6x6任务上，L-SHADE达到最佳性能，相对平均提升11.4%；在KeyCorridorS3R1上，CMA-ES表现最佳，但其他进化方法不如外在基线。
Conclusion: 进化优化是发现深度强化学习中发育奖励调度的有前景的方法，并且计算最优调度可能与生物最优调度不同。

papers.title: SignVLA: Real-Time Sign Language-Guided Robotic Manipulation via Attention LSTM and Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to execute manipulation tasks from natural-language instructions grounded in visual observations. However, existing VLA interfaces primarily rely on speech or text input, limiting accessibility for deaf, hard-of-hearing, and speech-impaired users. We present SignVLA, a real-time sign-language-guided VLA framework for accessible human-robot interaction. The system introduces a modular sign-to-text interface that converts visual sign gestures into semantic instructions compatible with downstream VLA policies. Given video streams, SignVLA extracts hand landmark features and employs an attention-enhanced Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network to capture temporal gesture dynamics for alphabet- and command-level sign recognition. A temporal stabilization module further improves prediction consistency in real-time interaction settings.The generated instruction sequence is then passed to a downstream VLA policy for sign-conditioned robotic manipulation. Experimental results demonstrate stable real-time sign recognition and successful execution of manipulation tasks driven by sign-language inputs. Our findings suggest that lightweight temporal sign recognition can serve as an effective and practical accessibility layer for multimodal embodied intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SignVLA，一种实时手语引导的机器人操作框架。系统通过注意力增强的LSTM网络从视频中提取手势特征并进行字母级和命令级手语识别，生成的指令传递给下游视觉-语言-动作模型以执行操作任务。实验表明系统能实现稳定的实时手语识别和成功操作。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型主要依赖语音或文本输入，限制了听障及语言障碍用户的可访问性。
Method: 提出模块化的手语到文本接口：从视频中提取手部关键点特征，使用注意力增强的LSTM网络捕捉时间动态进行手语识别，并通过时间稳定模块提升一致性；生成的指令序列输入下游策略模型。
Result: 实验证明系统能稳定地进行实时手语识别，并成功执行由手语输入驱动的操作任务。
Conclusion: 轻量级时间手语识别可作为多模态具身智能的有效可访问性层。

papers.title: Stochastic Signed Distance Processes
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view surface reconstruction is a core problem in computer vision. One prominent line of work represents the surface implicitly as a signed distance field (SDF), optimizing it based on the photometric loss between rendered and observed pixel colors. These approaches typically employ SDF-based volume rendering to obtain a differentiable relaxation of discontinuous visibility along rays, thereby reducing reliance on silhouette supervision. In this paper, we reformulate SDF-based volume rendering as probabilistic surface rendering, where each pixel color is modeled as a mixture distribution induced by the random first ray-surface intersection. To this end, we introduce Stochastic Signed Distance Processes (SSDP), which model the SDF along each ray as a stochastic process, inducing a first-passage-time distribution for each ray. We then derive the first-passage probability for each sampling interval based on Bayesian filtering, together with its practical approximation for parallel rendering. We further show that NeuS, an existing SDF-based volume rendering method, arises as a special case of our formulation. Experiments on the DTU and MobileBrick datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms baselines in both surface reconstruction and uncertainty quantification, supporting the effectiveness of our first-passage formulation. Our code is available at https://github.com/skmhrk1209/SSDP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新表述基于SDF的体渲染为概率表面渲染，提出随机符号距离过程(SSDP)，将每条射线上的SDF建模为随机过程，导出首次通过时间分布，并在DTU和MobileBrick数据集上优于基线。
Motivation: 现有SDF体渲染方法依赖于离散化的不连续可见性近似，缺乏概率解释。
Method: 提出SSDP，用贝叶斯滤波计算首次通过概率，并给出并行渲染的近似。
Result: 在DTU和MobileBrick数据集上，表面重建和不确定性量化均优于基线。
Conclusion: SSDP有效，且NeuS是其特例。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Translating Inference-Time Control to Radiology Vision-Language Models: Activation Steering for Pneumonia Classification on Chest X-rays
authors: Eduardo Moreno Judice de Mattos Farina
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time engineering can alter model behavior without fine-tuning. However, its utility for improving diagnostic performance in medical vision-language models (VLMs) remains unclear. We aim to evaluate whether Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) can improve pneumonia classification in chest radiograph VLMs without updating model weights. Three frozen chest radiograph VLMs (MedGemma-4B-IT, NV-Reason-CXR-3B, and CheXOne-3B) were evaluated on the public Kermany pneumonia test set. Classification was based on the logits of the tokens Yes and No under a binary prompt. Steering vectors included a 30-pair answer-bias control, a 30-pair pneumonia text contrast, and an image-conditioned contrast derived from 30 pneumonia and 30 normal development images. A deterministic 200-image development set was used for layer and scale selection (100 images) and threshold calibration (100 images). Performance was assessed using ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, F1 score, threshold analyses, reverse-vector controls, random-vector controls, and conditional bootstrap confidence intervals. Fixed-threshold F1 improvements were frequently observed but did not consistently indicate improved diagnostic performance. For MedGemma-4B-IT. NV-Reason-CXR-3B showed the strongest benefit: calibrated F1 improved from 0.7692 in the zero-shot setting to 0.8619 with pneumonia-text steering and to 0.8727 with image-conditioned steering. For CheXOne-3B, pneumonia-text steering increased calibrated F1 from 0.8528 to 0.8666, although the confidence interval crossed zero. On this public pneumonia benchmark, CAA substantially altered prediction score distributions and operating characteristics without fine-tuning. Meaningful performance gains were observed in one of three evaluated VLMs, suggesting that activation steering may serve as a lightweight approach for adapting medical VLM behavior.

TL;DR: 本文研究推理时激活引导（Contrastive Activation Addition, CAA）能否在不微调的情况下改善胸部X光视觉语言模型（VLM）的肺炎分类性能。在三个冻结的胸部VLM（MedGemma-4B-IT、NV-Reason-CXR-3B和CheXOne-3B）上，使用Kermany肺炎测试集评估。结果显示，对于NV-Reason-CXR-3B，校准F1从零样本的0.7692提升至0.8619（肺炎文本引导）和0.8727（图像条件引导）；CheXOne-3B有微小改进但置信区间跨零；MedGemma-4B-IT无显著提升。研究表明激活引导可能是一种轻量级调整医学VLM行为的方法。
Motivation: 推理时工程可以在不微调的情况下改变模型行为，但其在医学VLM诊断性能改进中的效用尚不清楚。本文旨在评估CAA是否能提升胸部X光VLM的肺炎分类性能。
Method: 使用对比激活添加（CAA）方法，构建三种引导向量：答案偏置控制、肺炎文本对比、图像条件对比。在三个冻结的胸部VLM上，基于二元提示下Yes和No令牌的logits进行分类。使用200张开发图像进行层和尺度选择以及阈值校准。评估指标包括ROC-AUC、PR-AUC、F1等。
Result: NV-Reason-CXR-3B受益最大：校准F1从0.7692提升至0.8619（肺炎文本引导）和0.8727（图像条件引导）。CheXOne-3B：校准F1从0.8528提升至0.8666，但置信区间跨零。MedGemma-4B-IT无显著改善。总体表明CAA显著改变了分数分布和操作特性，但仅在三个VLM中一个观察到有意义的性能提升。
Conclusion: 激活引导可能作为一种轻量级方法用于调整医学VLM行为，但在多个模型中的一致性和稳定性需要进一步研究。

papers.title: From Uncertainty to Stability and Fidelity: Guiding Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting with Fisher Information
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a promising technique for novel view synthesis. However, 3DGS requires dense input views to achieve high-quality rendering. In sparse-view scenarios, 3DGS often prones to overfitting, resulting in noticeable artifacts and degraded rendering quality. Previous methods explore to address this issue by introducing additional priors (e.g. depth priors) or integrating regularization techniques (e.g. Dropout). However, these methods are often applied without principled guidance. In particular, prior-based augmentation typically samples novel viewpoints randomly, while Dropout-based regularization randomly removes Gaussians. The compounded randomness introduces uncertainty and instability, limiting the fidelity of novel view synthesis. In this paper, we propose a novel method for sparse-view 3DGS that incorporates Fisher Information to quantitatively guide the utilization of geometric priors and regularization. Specifically, our method comprises two key components: (1) Stereo augmentation with Fisher Information. By leveraging Fisher Information, we actively select most informative supporting views and use depth priors to curate reliable pseudo ground truths, which reduces randomness in augmentation and improves stability and rendering fidelity; (2) Uncertainty-aware regularization. We reduce the instability of Dropout-based regularization by using Fisher Information to quantitatively measure the uncertainty of each 3D Gaussian, and adaptively adjust the removal probability, leading to more stable and effective regularization. With these two components, our method effectively mitigates overfitting and improves the stability of optimization in sparse-view 3DGS, resulting in superior rendering fidelity. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in sparse-view novel view synthesis benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏视图下的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）过拟合问题，提出利用Fisher信息量指导几何先验利用和正则化，包括基于Fisher信息的立体增强和不确定性感知正则化，在稀疏视图新视角合成基准上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有稀疏视图3DGS方法在引入先验（如深度先验）或正则化（如Dropout）时缺乏原则性指导，随机性导致不稳定和保真度下降。
Method: 提出两个关键组件：(1) 利用Fisher信息主动选择最具信息量的支撑视图，结合深度先验生成可靠伪真值，减少增强随机性；(2) 利用Fisher信息量化每个3D高斯的不确定性，自适应调整其移除概率，使Dropout正则化更稳定有效。
Result: 在稀疏视图新视角合成基准上，该方法达到了最先进的渲染保真度。
Conclusion: 通过Fisher信息定量指导先验和正则化，有效缓解过拟合，提升优化稳定性和渲染保真度。

papers.title: Process-Reward Tactic Evolution for Long-Horizon Bioinformatics Workflows
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents can write code and call tools, but reliable bioinformatics work requires long-horizon interaction with workflow software, typed data objects, provenance, and biological checks. We study this setting through Galaxy workflow execution. The agent must explore task data, construct or adapt an executable workflow DAG, bind inputs and dataset collections, monitor execution, debug failures, and validate biological outputs. We propose Process-Reward Tactic Evolution, a Galaxy-based training framework that turns verified workflow rollouts into reusable \tactics. During training, agents practice on curriculum-organized Galaxy tasks in Agent Gym; process verifiers score workflow construction, software interaction, execution, and biological correctness; successful and failed traces are distilled into a tactic library. At inference, the trained executor, Process-Reward Tactic Evolution, uses this library to execute held-out peer reviewed Galaxy workflow converted BioWorkflow Bench and BioAgent Bench tasks in isolated environments. The paper evaluates whether process-supervised tactic accumulation improves long-horizon bioinformatics workflow completion, biological correctness, and execution efficiency over no-memory and reflection-style baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生物信息学工作流中的长期交互问题，提出了一种基于Galaxy平台的训练框架——Process-Reward Tactic Evolution。该框架通过过程验证器对工作流构建、软件交互、执行和生物正确性进行打分，并将成功与失败的轨迹蒸馏为可复用的策略库。在推理阶段，智能体利用该策略库执行未见过的同行评审Galaxy工作流任务。实验评估了过程监督的策略积累能否提升长期生物信息学工作流的完成度、生物正确性和执行效率。
Motivation: 现有的LLM智能体在编写代码和调用工具时表现良好，但生物信息学工作流需要长期交互，包括处理工作流软件、类型化数据对象、溯源和生物学检查，目前缺乏可靠的解决方案。
Method: 提出Process-Reward Tactic Evolution框架，在Agent Gym中通过课程组织的Galaxy任务训练智能体；过程验证器对工作流构建、软件交互、执行和生物正确性进行评分；将成功与失败的轨迹蒸馏为策略库供推理时使用。
Result: 论文在BioWorkflow Bench和BioAgent Bench任务上评估了该方法，比较了无记忆和反思型基线，但摘要中未报告具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 过程监督的策略积累有望改善长期生物信息学工作流的完成度、生物正确性和执行效率。

papers.title: Study on Quantitative Dynamic Epistemic Logic for Belief Revision
papers.abstract_en: Belief revision is a process in which an agent begins to believe in something she previously did not. I begin the paper by presenting, based on (Gärdenfors, 1998; Hansson, 1999), postulates for belief revision that constitute the basis of the AGM theory. I will then briefly show the semantics of a modal logic introduced in (van Ditmarsch, 2005), which I call `$P$'. This logic formalizes static epistemic states and has greater expressive power than AGM in doing so because it captures the quantitative notion of "degrees of conviction". The third step is to introduce revision operators on $P$ and, mostly following (van Ditmarsch, 2005), obtain the Dynamic Epistemic Logic (DEL) I call `$P*$'. It models processes of belief revision in several ways. Original results are presented in the following two sections. The first one of these sections revolves around a formalization of AGM postulates within $P*$ by proving some theorems related to the satisfaction of those postulates by revisions defined in $P*$. The last section features an analysis of $P*$'s revisions that go beyond the mere satisfaction of postulates. I compare their formal behavior with respect to some philosophical criteria. At last, I conclude that the functions presented in (van Ditmarsch, 2005) are not good formalizations of the philosophical intuition behind AGM. Instead, it is captured by the function $*^0$ originally defined in this paper (but highly inspired by (van Benthem, 2007)). An implementation of this function is also provided.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于AGM信念修正理论，引入量化‘确信程度’的模态逻辑P，并扩展为动态认知逻辑P*，定义多种修正算子。通过形式化AGM公设并进行哲学分析，指出van Ditmarsch（2005）中的修正函数未能充分体现AGM直觉，而本文提出的函数*^0更优，并给出实现。
Motivation: 现有信念修正逻辑对认知状态的量化程度（如‘确信程度’）表达不足，且AGM公设在动态逻辑中的形式化尚不完善。
Method: 先介绍静态逻辑P及其语义，再引入修正算子得到动态认知逻辑P*。重点分析van Ditmarsch（2005）的修正函数，并定义新函数*^0（受van Benthem（2007）启发），同时提供实现。
Result: 通过定理证明P*中的修正满足部分AGM公设，并基于哲学标准比较不同函数，得出*^0优于原函数的结论。
Conclusion: van Ditmarsch（2005）的修正函数不符合AGM哲学直觉，而新函数*^0更好地形式化了这一直觉，且已实现。

papers.title: ReLaTS: a Reinforcement Learning-based method for dynamically determining the coupling Time Step in multi-scale simulations of self-gravitating systems
papers.abstract_en: Astrophysical simulations frequently address multi-scale, multi-physics problems through subsystem decomposition, problem-tailored integration schemes, and coupling on fixed manually set timescales. Here we introduce ReLaTS, a reinforcement learning framework that dynamically selects the coupling time step to optimize the trade-off between accuracy and computational cost. We validate ReLaTS on star clusters containing a planetary system, and test the method by varying the number of stars $N_\star$ in the cluster and the number of planets ($N_{\rm planet}$) orbiting one of them. The method finds the optimal coupling time step that balances speed and accuracy without requiring expert knowledge. In addition, the trained network operates independently of the coupled \textit{N}-body algorithms, displaying stable performance across a range of setups. We observe that the method is less reliable for cases with infinitesimal masses, as their contribution to the total energy is negligible compared to that of the massive bodies, and the network is not capable of recognizing potential errors generated while integrating them. For long-time integration of large $N$ systems, the error accumulates. The reinforcement learning algorithm, however, manages to keep the energy error below a pre-set threshold. This approach substantially reduces energy errors relative to fixed-time step baselines without substantial additional computational overhead. Once trained, ReLaTS requires no expert tuning and generalizes across diverse astrophysical domains, enabling adaptive multi-scale simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReLaTS，一种基于强化学习的框架，用于在多尺度天体物理模拟中动态选择耦合时间步，以平衡计算精度和成本。在包含行星系统的星团验证中，该方法能在保持能量误差低于预设阈值的同时，显著降低与固定时间步基线相比的误差，且无需专家调参。但方法对极小天体质量的处理可靠性有限，长期积分中误差会累积。
Motivation: 传统多尺度模拟依赖人工设定的固定耦合时间步，难以在精度和计算成本之间取得最优平衡，且需要专家知识进行调优。
Method: ReLaTS 使用强化学习智能体，根据系统状态动态选择耦合时间步，优化精度与计算开销的权衡，训练后的网络可独立于耦合的 N 体算法运行。
Result: 在星团-行星系统上测试，ReLaTS 在多种 N_star 和 N_planet 配置下均能稳定运行，能量误差低于固定时间步基线，且额外计算开销很小。
Conclusion: 强化学习可有效实现自适应多尺度模拟，无需专家干预，且能泛化到不同天体物理场景；但对极小质量天体（如行星）的积分错误不敏感，长期积分误差会累积但可控。

papers.title: NeoLoc-68: End-to-end 68-point neonatal facial landmark localisation in neonatal clinical environments
papers.abstract_en: Facial landmark localisation is a prerequisite for developing automated, non-contact neonatal pain assessment methods. Clinicians use pain scales to judge the severity of pain, many of which rely on facial expression. However, facial landmark detectors trained on adult faces perform poorly in neonatal clinical environments due to frequent occlusions caused by medical equipment, varied head poses, and challenging imaging conditions, including motion blur triggered by sudden pain-related movements. We propose an end-to-end facial landmark detector capable of predicting 68 landmarks on neonatal faces in clinical environments. We combined 37,459 single-face images from 11 public datasets, standardised to 68-point markup, with 1,123 manually annotated frames from a neonatal research dataset (totalling over 76,000 landmarks). A YOLO-based keypoint model was adapted to regress the facial landmarks, initialised with weights from a pretrained neonatal face detector. On public datasets, our proposed model achieved state-of-the-art performance: Normalised Mean Error (NME) = 5.37, Failure Rate (FR) = 12.5%, Area Under the Cumulative Error Curve (AUC) at AUC0.08 = 38.00% and AUC0.1 = 48.70%. On the clinical neonatal test set, before fine-tuning, the model achieved the lowest Detection Failure Rate (DFR) = 5.3% among all baselines and showed strong generalisation. After fine-tuning, performance improved further to NME = 6.36, FR = 22.30%, DFR = 1.77%, AUC0.08 = 29.24% and AUC0.1 = 40.25%. To the best of our knowledge, this represents the first end-to-end 68-point neonatal facial landmark detection model. With further dataset expansion and refinement, it could support downstream tasks in neonatal health monitoring and pain-related facial analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了首个端到端68点新生儿面部特征点定位模型NeoLoc-68，用于临床环境下的非接触疼痛评估。模型基于YOLO关键点架构，结合11个公共数据集（37,459张图像）和手动标注的新生儿数据集进行训练，在公共数据集上达到SOTA性能，在临床新生儿测试集上经微调后NME=6.36，检测失败率（DFR）为1.77%。
Motivation: 现有面部特征点检测器在成人面部表现良好，但在新生儿临床环境中因医疗设备遮挡、头部姿态多样和运动模糊等因素表现不佳，制约了自动化、非接触式疼痛评估方法的发展。
Method: 提出端到端的YOLO-based关键点回归模型，初始化为预训练的新生儿人脸检测器权重。训练数据包括11个公共数据集（标准化为68点标注）和1,123帧手动标注的新生儿临床数据集，总计超过76,000个特征点。
Result: 在公共数据集上达到NME=5.37，FR=12.5%；在临床新生儿测试集上，微调前DFR最低（5.3%），微调后NME=6.36，FR=22.30%，DFR=1.77%，AUC0.08=29.24%，AUC0.1=40.25%。
Conclusion: 这是首个端到端68点新生儿面部特征点检测模型，在临床环境下表现优异，未来可通过数据集扩展和精细化进一步支持新生儿健康监测和疼痛相关面部分析等下游任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CELEUS: Certifiable and Efficient LLM Evaluation via E-Processes
papers.abstract_en: Can we trust evaluation scores to capture an LLM's true real-world performance? Certifiable evaluation answers this question by providing guarantee for LLM evaluation. In particular, existing methods sequentially curate evaluation samples and keep updating confidence intervals (CIs) that cover the true performance with high probability (e.g., 95%) until some conditions are satisfied, e.g., the CI width reaches a target precision. However, existing methods are not generally anytime-valid: the claimed coverage (e.g., 95%) may fail when CIs are repeatedly updated and used to decide when to stop, leaving a gap between theoretical rigor and practice. This paper bridges this gap by proposing Celeus, a Certifiable framework for Efficient LLM evaluation, which leverages E-processes to build anytime-valid CIs. Concretely, we propose signals that combine two ingredients: (i) Uncertainty-guided sampling to select informative samples for evaluation, and (ii) Surrogate-assisted approximations for unevaluated samples. We prove that such signals remain unbiased for the evaluation score conditional on the past, enabling statistically-grounded and anytime-valid $e$-process CIs. More importantly, the two ingredients reduce estimation variance and help reach the target precision with fewer evaluated samples. We also prove that CIs obtained by Celeus can shrink at a near-parametric rate up to logarithmic factors and analyze the oracle variance-optimal sampling rule that motivates the empirical uncertainty-guided one. Experiments show that Celeus reaches the target precision using 54-62% fewer evaluated samples than baselines, while preserving anytime-valid coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Celeus 框架，通过 E-processes 构建任意有效置信区间，实现可认证且高效的 LLM 评估。结合不确定性引导采样和替代辅助近似，减少评估样本数并保持覆盖保证。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 评估方法在顺序采样和停止规则下无法保证任意有效性，导致理论严格性与实践之间存在差距。
Method: 利用 E-processes 构建任意有效置信区间，提出结合不确定性引导采样和替代辅助近似的信号，确保信号在历史条件上无偏，并降低方差。
Result: Celeus 在达到目标精度时，比基线方法少用 54-62% 的评估样本，同时保持任意有效的覆盖。
Conclusion: Celeus 通过 E-processes 实现了统计上严格且高效的 LLM 评估，适用于动态停止场景。

papers.title: Provably Sub-Linear Two-Timescale NeuroEvolution with Online Plasticity
papers.abstract_en: NeuroEvolution of Augmenting Topologies (NEAT) is a widely used neuroevolution algorithm for learning neural network architectures and weights for control tasks. However, standard offline optimisation searches for connection strengths directly, which can scale poorly in high-dimensional weight spaces and more difficult continuous control problems. Hybrid methods that combine neuroevolution with online learning can address this challenge, but their theoretical properties remain underexplored. This paper gives the first regret analysis for a general NeuroEvolutionary Online Learning (NEOL) framework, which decouples learning into two timescales: an outer loop for architecture search and an inner loop for online weight adaptation via rewardmodulated plasticity. Under mild conditions, we prove that NEOL achieves sublinear regret. Empirically, under fixed interaction budgets on four standard control benchmarks, a NEAT-based NEOL implementation achieves higher final fitness and lower variance than pure NEAT, and is competitive with strong reinforcement learning (RL) baselines on several tasks. The results are supported byWilcoxon rank-sum tests and ablation studies. Overall, the findings show that online plasticity can improve the sample efficiency and robustness of two-timescale neuroevolution. Code is available at https://github.com/boobaa2001/NeuroEvolution Online Learning NEOL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次提出神经进化在线学习（NEOL）框架的遗憾分析，该框架将结构搜索（外循环）与通过奖励调制可塑性进行的在线权重适应（内循环）解耦为两个时间尺度。在温和条件下证明了次线性遗憾界，并在四个标准控制基准上，基于NEAT的NEOL实现比纯NEAT获得更高的最终适应度和更低的方差，且与强强化学习基线具有竞争力。
Motivation: 标准NEAT在连续控制问题的高维权重空间中扩展性差，且缺乏理论分析。混合神经进化与在线学习的方法有潜力但理论性质尚未探索。
Method: 提出神经进化在线学习（NEOL）框架，分为架构搜索的外循环和通过奖励调制可塑性进行在线权重适应的内循环，并提供次线性遗憾界。
Result: 在四个标准控制基准上，NEOL在固定交互预算下比纯NEAT获得更高最终适应度和更低方差，与强化学习基线竞争，统计学上由Wilcoxon秩和检验和消融研究支持。
Conclusion: 在线可塑性可提高两时间尺度神经进化的样本效率和鲁棒性。

papers.title: What Shapes Emergent Misalignment? Insights from Training Dynamics, Model Priors, and Data
papers.abstract_en: Emergent misalignment (EM) is a phenomenon in which models generalize with narrow fine-tuning, leading to broad (yet uneven) misalignment across evaluation questions. We study EM and its variability directly through the components of fine-tuning: training dynamics, model priors, and data. (1) We first explored how in-domain training loss relates to out-of-domain alignment scores across datasets and model families. Then, we tried to induce potential alternative local minima through different learning schedules for one narrow fine-tuning, but did not find strong runs with better broad alignment scores conditioned on similar or lower training loss. (2) We found that although the mean and standard deviations of the misaligned model scores are usually statistically different from those of the pre-trained model, there are some potential signals on overall positive correlation. The evaluation prompt-only activations from both the pre-trained and the original instruct models (prior to narrow fine-tuning) could predict fine-grained alignment scores after narrow fine-tuning. (3) Finally, we compared activation deltas before and after narrow fine-tuning and found moderate-to-high subspace overlap and similarity between the resulting activation shifts for training and evaluation prompts. Subspace overlaps between training and evaluation prompt activations correlate with their shifts' similarities when measuring with the last prompt-token activations. The train-evaluation data prompt overlap is controlled against overlap computed from random vectors and evaluation prompts activations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了涌现性失调（emergent misalignment, EM）现象，即模型通过窄微调后泛化出广泛但不均衡的不对齐。作者从训练动态、模型先验和数据三个角度分析了EM的成因，发现训练损失与域外对齐分数之间的关系不一致，且预训练模型和原始指令模型的激活可以预测微调后的对齐分数。
Motivation: 现有工作观察到窄微调会导致模型在广泛问题上出现不对齐，但其背后的机制尚不清晰。本文旨在通过分解微调组件来理解EM的形成原因。
Method: 通过分析训练损失与对齐分数的关系、不同学习率策略的效果，以及利用激活模式（包括仅提示激活和激活变化）来预测和解释微调后的对齐行为。
Result: 未找到在相似或更低训练损失下具有更好对齐的强运行；预训练和原始指令模型的提示激活能预测微调后的对齐分数；微调前后训练和评估提示的激活变化存在中到高的子空间重叠和相似性。
Conclusion: EM的变异性与模型先验和数据相关，但单纯改变学习率策略难以同时优化训练损失和对齐性能；激活分析表明训练和评估提示在微调中产生类似的激活偏移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: B[FM]$^2$: Brain Foundation Model via Flow Matching with SplitUNet
papers.abstract_en: EEG foundation models can learn generalizable representations from large-scale EEG corpora to enable single-backbone transfer across diverse clinical and brain-computer interface tasks. Existing models typically discretize the continuous multi-channel EEG waveform into patches or codebook tokens and train a transformer with masked self-supervision. Recognizing that this discretization fragments continuous brain rhythms and obscures fine-grained temporal dynamics, we present B[FM]$^2$(Brain Foundation Model via Flow Matching), whose inductive bias aligns with the data by pretraining directly on the raw signal using continuous-time flow matching without patches, tokenization, or masking. However, multi-channel EEG signals pose an architectural challenge for flow matching: time is densely sampled and highly autocorrelated (thousands of timepoints), while the electrode axis is short (tens of channels) at distinct scalp positions. To address this time-electrode asymmetry, we introduce SplitUNet, a velocity network that factorizes each block into separate 1D temporal and 1D electrode convolutions and downsamples only along time, preserving electrode topology throughout the hierarchy. B[FM]$^2$ sets a new state of the art on 7 of 9 standard downstream EEG classification tasks, using a pretraining budget of only 36,895 segments ($\approx$ 307h), 1-2 orders of magnitude ($\approx$ 30x) less than required by existing EEG foundation models. Further, it generates synthetic EEGs that two board-certified neurologists cannot distinguish from brain data (Cohen's $κ=$ -0.096). https://jd730.github.io/projects/BFM2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 B[FM]$^2$，一种基于流匹配（flow matching）的脑电图（EEG）基础模型，直接在原始多通道信号上预训练，无需分块、令牌化或掩码。为处理 EEG 的时间-电极不对称性，引入 SplitUNet 网络，将每个块分解为独立的 1D 时间卷积和 1D 电极卷积，仅下采样时间轴。在 9 个标准下游分类任务中 7 个达到 SOTA，预训练数据量仅为约 307 小时（比现有模型少 30 倍），并能生成神经科医生无法区分的合成 EEG。
Motivation: 现有 EEG 基础模型将连续波形离散化为块或代码本令牌，破坏了连续脑节律并掩盖细粒度时间动态，因此需要一种保留原始信号连续性的预训练方法。
Method: 采用连续时间流匹配直接在原始 EEG 信号上预训练，提出 SplitUNet 作为速度网络，通过分离时间与电极维度的 1D 卷积并仅沿时间下采样，解决多通道信号的时间-电极不对称架构挑战。
Result: 在 9 个标准下游 EEG 分类任务中 7 个取得 SOTA，预训练仅用 36,895 个片段（≈307 小时），数据量较现有模型减少 1-2 个数量级（约 30 倍）；生成合成 EEG 的图灵测试中，两名神经科医生无法区分真假（Cohen's κ = -0.096）。
Conclusion: B[FM]$^2$ 验证了流匹配作为 EEG 基础模型预训练范式的可行性，SplitUNet 有效处理了时间-电极不对称性，为低资源下游任务提供了高效基础模型。

papers.title: Eigenspace-Based Clustering for Personalized System Identification
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of system identification in heterogeneous settings, where different systems may follow distinct underlying dynamics. Existing clustered system identification approaches often rely on iterative training-based cluster assignment, which can be sensitive to learning uncertainty and model initialization. In contrast, we propose a one-shot, training-free clustering method that identifies similar systems using the structure of their locally observed data. Specifically, each system estimates a local state covariance matrix, and cluster identities are inferred by measuring the alignment between the leading covariance eigenspaces of different systems. We provide a mathematical interpretation of the proposed similarity score and develop a finite-sample analysis that characterizes how covariance estimation error induces eigenspace perturbations in terms of the underlying system dynamics. We then derive a probability bound for pairwise false merges and a global clustering success guarantee. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed eigenspace-based clustering method effectively identifies systems with shared dynamics, leading to lower personalized model-estimation error compared with training-based clustering and non-clustered baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对异构系统辨识问题，提出一种基于特征空间的一次性无训练聚类方法。每个系统估计局部状态协方差矩阵，通过比较不同系统间领先特征空间的对齐程度来推断聚类身份。提供了相似度分数的数学解释和有限样本分析，数值实验表明该方法能有效识别共享动态的系统，降低个性化模型估计误差。
Motivation: 现有聚类系统辨识方法依赖迭代训练，对初始化敏感且易受学习不确定性影响，而本文提出无需训练的一次性聚类方法以克服这些局限。
Method: 每个系统估计局部状态协方差矩阵，然后通过测量不同系统之间领先协方差特征空间的 alignment 来推断聚类身份。提供相似度分数的数学解释，并推导有限样本分析，刻画协方差估计误差如何导致 eigenspace 扰动。
Result: 数值实验表明，该方法能有效识别具有共享动态的系统，相比基于训练的聚类和非聚类基线，降低了个性化模型估计误差。
Conclusion: 本文提出的基于 eigenspace 的聚类方法为异构系统辨识提供了一种无需训练的、一次性聚类方案，具有理论保证和实际有效性。

papers.title: GroundShot: Visually Consistent Multi-Shot Long Video Generation via Entity-Grounded Shot Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Generating visually consistent multi-shot videos remains an open challenge. As videos span more shots, inconsistencies can accumulate across shots, causing entities that reappear across shots -- characters, objects, and locations -- to drift away from how they first appear. We observe that viewers judge consistency by comparing each later appearance of an entity with its first clear appearance; the visual quality of this initial appearance sets the consistency ceiling for all that follows. Motivated by this, we present \textbf{GroundShot}, a training-free, model-agnostic agentic framework for entity-grounded multi-shot generation. GroundShot builds an entity-level visual memory online from accepted generated shots: it schedules shots' generation order by their expected usefulness as entity references, grounds entities from generated videos, verifies their reliability before adding them to memory, and retrieves suitable entity references from memory before each shot is generated. To evaluate this entity-centered view of consistency, we further introduce \textbf{GroundBench}, a diagnostic benchmark that measures consistency at the entity level while isolating controlled challenge dimensions. Experiments show that GroundShot improves multi-shot consistency over existing methods while requiring no additional training or model modification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多镜头长视频生成中的视觉一致性问题，提出训练无关、模型无关的智能体框架GroundShot。该框架在线构建实体级视觉记忆，通过调度镜头生成顺序、验证实体可靠性并检索引用，提升了跨镜头的视觉一致性。同时引入诊断基准GroundBench用于实体级一致性评估，实验表明无需额外训练即可改善一致性。
Motivation: 现有方法在多镜头视频生成中视觉一致性不足，实体（角色、物体、场景）在跨镜头重现时因累积误差而发生漂移，且缺乏针对性评估基准。
Method: GroundShot是一个无需训练、模型无关的智能体框架：在线构建实体级视觉记忆，根据实体作为参考的有用性调度镜头生成顺序；从生成视频中提取实体并验证其可靠性后才加入记忆；在生成每帧前从记忆中检索合适的实体参考。
Result: 实验表明，GroundShot在提升多镜头一致性方面优于现有方法，且无需额外训练或修改模型。
Conclusion: 论文强调实体中心视角对多镜头视频一致性的重要性，并提出相应框架与诊断基准，为后续研究提供新思路。

papers.title: Fara-1.5: Scalable Learning Environments for Computer Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Collecting computer use data from human demonstrations is expensive and slow, motivating the need for scalable generation strategies. This requires two key ingredients: environments in which agents can act and verifiers that can judge whether their demonstrations succeeded. We introduce FaraGen1.5, a scalable data pipeline for computer use agents composed of three modular components: environments, solvers, and verifiers. FaraGen1.5 uses both live websites and synthetic environments that faithfully simulate domains gated by authentication or that require irreversible actions. It employs a solver harness that can be powered by multiple models, including strong frontier models such as GPT-5.4, and also incorporates a user simulator to enable multi-turn rollouts. Finally, FaraGen1.5 scores the resulting trajectories with three complementary verifiers covering task correctness, efficiency, and critical-point adherence. Using data produced by this pipeline, we train Fara1.5, a family of native computer use agents (CUAs) at three scales built on Qwen3.5 (4B, 9B, and 27B). To train these models, we employ a supervised finetuning (SFT) recipe that carefully balances data from FaraGen1.5 for broad coverage, specific high-value tasks, and target model deficiencies in an iterative approach. Each model sets a new state of the art for its size class on browser-use benchmarks: Fara1.5-9B reaches 63.4% on Online-Mind2Web and 86.6% on WebVoyager, while Fara1.5-27B achieves 72.3% on Online-Mind2Web, which is competitive with much larger proprietary systems.

TL;DR: FaraGen1.5是一个用于计算机使用代理的可扩展数据生成流水线，包含环境、求解器和验证器三个模块。它利用真实网站和合成环境生成轨迹，并通过三种互补的验证器评分。基于此数据训练的Fara1.5系列模型（基于Qwen3.5，参数规模4B、9B、27B）在浏览器使用基准测试中达到了各自规模的最新水平。

Conclusion: 论文表明，通过可扩展数据生成和精心平衡的训练数据，可以在浏览器使用代理任务上取得领先性能。

papers.title: World Action Models: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) are embodied predictive-action models that make a forecast of the future available to action. Recent WAMs repurpose large video generation models, and a parallel line relies on language or vision-language backbones without a video-generation core. This rapid expansion has blurred the boundary among broad world models, video generation models, action-grounded video world models, Vision-Language-Action policies, and WAMs. This survey gives the field a common account. It first clarifies these boundaries, then organizes existing works through two complementary views. The first view asks what each method is required to generate, spanning rendered futures, latent futures, and video-generation-free action reasoning. The second view decomposes each method by predictive substrate, backbone, action coupling, and deployment regime. This anatomy supports a unified discussion of interactability, causality, persistence, physical plausibility, and generalization, followed by data, evaluation, and open challenges. Across these axes, a consistent design pattern emerges: WAMs are not simply video generators with action heads, but predictive-action methods whose design choices trade representational richness against compute, memory, latency, and action-label cost. The field is moving toward methods that generate less of the future while preserving what control requires. The survey homepage is available at https://world-action-models.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对世界动作模型（World Action Models, WAMs）的综述，系统梳理了该领域的边界、方法分类与设计权衡。WAMs 是具身预测-动作模型，近期工作复用大规模视频生成模型，另一条路线则基于语言或视觉-语言骨干。综述从所需生成内容（渲染未来、潜在未来、无视频生成动作推理）和预测基质、骨干、动作耦合、部署模式两个视角组织现有工作，并讨论交互性、因果性、持久性、物理合理性和泛化等维度。
Motivation: 世界动作模型领域快速扩张，导致广义世界模型、视频生成模型、动作接地视频世界模型、视觉-语言-动作策略与 WAMs 之间的边界模糊，缺乏统一框架。
Method: 通过两个互补视角组织现有工作：一是按生成内容分类（渲染未来、潜在未来、无视频生成动作推理），二是按预测基质、骨干、动作耦合、部署模式分解。
Result: 揭示出一致的设计模式：WAMs 并非简单地在视频生成器上加动作头，而是预测-动作方法，其设计选择在表征丰富性与计算、内存、延迟和动作标签成本之间权衡。
Conclusion: 该领域正转向生成更少的未来信息，同时保留控制所需的内容。

papers.title: Formally Verified Code Synthesis for Structured Data Translation in a Medical Internet of Things
papers.abstract_en: In this work we present a LLM powered, evolutionary code synthesis system for structured data translation in a Medical Internet of Things settings. A key challenge in this domain is ensuring that the synthesized code is trustworthy and reliable. To this end, we integrate a formal verification step into our code synthesis pipeline to ensure that any generated code is guaranteed to satisfy predefined requirements. In particular, we present a case study of integrating a novel device (a pulse oximeter) into the existing network of devices. Our system generates a formally verified translation between the device's JSON schema and the Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) format used by the wider system. This formal verification stage ensures structured data translated by the generated code will always be in the target output schema. We provide a set of experimental results which demonstrate that our system is able to consistently generate correct translation at low cost.

papers.title: TriMotion: Modality-Agnostic Camera Control for Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Camera motion control is essential for directing viewpoint changes in generative systems. However, existing methods typically condition the generation process on a single specific modality, such as explicit pose trajectories or reference videos, limiting their ability to support heterogeneous user inputs. To address this limitation, we present TriMotion, a modality-agnostic framework for camera-controlled video generation that maps video, pose, and text inputs, describing the same camera trajectory into a shared motion embedding space. Learning such a space requires synchronized supervision across modalities. Therefore, we build the Motion Triplet Dataset by extending a Multi-Cam Video Dataset with geometry-grounded motion descriptions derived from camera extrinsics. We further introduce a latent motion consistency objective that leverages the motion embedding space to encourage the generated video to follow the target camera trajectory directly in latent space, avoiding the cost of pixel-space decoding. Extensive experiments show that TriMotion generates high-quality videos that accurately follow the target camera trajectories across all three modalities. Beyond standard generation, the shared motion embedding space also enables flexible applications such as sequential motion composition and cross-modal motion interpolation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TriMotion，一个模态无关的相机控制视频生成框架，将视频、姿态和文本三种描述同一相机轨迹的输入映射到共享的运动嵌入空间。为此，作者扩展了多相机视频数据集，基于相机外参生成几何驱动的运动描述，构建了 Motion Triplet 数据集，并引入潜在运动一致性目标。实验表明 TriMotion 能生成高质量视频，准确跟随目标轨迹，并支持顺序运动组合和跨模态运动插值等应用。
Motivation: 现有相机控制方法通常依赖单一模态（如显式姿态轨迹或参考视频），无法兼容多种用户输入形式，限制了系统的灵活性和适用性。
Method: 提出 TriMotion 框架，通过对比学习将视频、姿态和文本三种模态的相机轨迹映射到共享嵌入空间；构建 Motion Triplet 数据集提供同步监督；引入潜在运动一致性目标，直接在隐空间约束生成视频的运动符合目标轨迹。
Result: 在多个模态下，TriMotion 生成的高质量视频能准确跟随目标相机轨迹，并实现顺序运动组合和跨模态运动插值等灵活应用。
Conclusion: 共享运动嵌入空间有效支持异构用户输入，为多模态相机控制提供统一解决方案，并展示了序列组合与跨模态插值等扩展能力。

papers.title: ELADO: Elliptic PDE Assessment Datasets for Operator Learning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ELADO (Elliptic PDE Assessment Datasets for Operator Learning), a systematic benchmark suite constructed to show and quantify failure modes of neural operator architectures when learning solution operators of elliptic PDEs. While the benchmarks of existing datasets focus on average case performance, the ELADO datasets are constructed to highlight challenges that arise naturally in elliptic PDE problems. In particular, we construct several datasets built around Poisson's equation and the Helmholtz equation, each with non-constant coefficients. We define a controllable data-generating process to create datasets, that are designed to isolate a distinct source of difficulty. Specifically, these are (1) heavy-tailed solution distributions arising from light-tailed coefficient field distributions, (2) spectral distribution shift of the input data, (3) heavy-tailed distributions in the frequency domain of solutions, arising from light-tailed coefficient field distributions, (4) input sensitivity of learned operators, quantified by an empirical local Lipschitz analysis, and (5) the effect of input signal complexity on prediction accuracy under controlled amplitude normalization. We evaluate several neural operator architectures across all datasets and show that heavy-tailed targets, spectral shift, and input sensitivity each cause substantial degradation of the prediction accuracy that standard datasets and metrics (e.g., the mean relative $L^2$ error) may obscure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍ELADO，一个用于展示和量化神经算子架构在求解椭圆偏微分方程时失效模式的系统基准套件。数据集围绕泊松方程和亥姆霍兹方程构建，具有非常数系数，并设计了多个可控数据生成过程来隔离不同的困难来源，包括重尾解分布、谱分布偏移、频率域重尾分布、输入敏感性以及输入信号复杂度的影响。评估显示这些因素会显著降低预测精度，而标准数据集和指标可能掩盖这些问题。
Motivation: 现有基准数据集主要关注平均性能，未能充分揭示神经算子在学习椭圆偏微分方程解算子时面临的特定挑战，如重尾目标、谱平移和输入敏感性等失效模式。
Method: 构建了一系列围绕泊松方程和亥姆霍兹方程的基准数据集，每个数据集通过可控数据生成过程隔离一个特定的困难来源，包括重尾解分布、谱分布偏移、频域重尾分布、输入敏感性（通过经验局部Lipschitz分析量化）以及输入信号复杂度的影响。
Result: 评估了多种神经算子架构，发现重尾目标、谱平移和输入敏感性会导致预测精度显著下降，而这些在标准数据集和平均相对L2误差等指标上可能被掩盖。
Conclusion: ELADO数据集能够揭示标准基准中难以察觉的失败模式，有助于更全面地评估和推动神经算子方法在椭圆偏微分方程问题上的发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond 'One Language, One Script': Quantifying Orthographic Bias in Multilingual VLMs with PuMVR
papers.abstract_en: Current Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are celebrated for their multilingual capabilities, yet they operate under a flawed assumption: that one language corresponds to a single writing system. This overlooks billions of users of multi-script languages like Punjabi, Serbian, Hindi-Urdu, Kurdish, among many others, for whom a model's capability may be fractured by orthographic bias. We introduce PuMVR (Punjabi Multimodal Visual Reasoning), the first benchmark designed to quantify script-dependent bias through 375 culturally grounded image-reasoning tasks across Punjabi's three active scripts (Gurmukhi, Shahmukhi, Roman). Evaluating 10 state-of-the-art VLMs, we expose a substantial Script Gap: models frequently solve visual puzzles in one script while failing identical tasks in another, with accuracy deltas reaching 16% and Script Consistency Rates (SCR) as low as 24.8%. Crucially, visual input boosts absolute performance but does not close this gap, the relative bias persists. Our analysis suggests reasoning patterns show limited cross-script transferability, and Chain-of-Thought pathways diverge based on script alone. We propose SCR as a core metric for script-agnostic evaluation, challenging current multilingual assessment paradigms and providing a framework for equitable AI.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the 4th Workshop on Cross-Cultural Considerations in NLP (C3NLP) @ ACL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示多语言视觉语言模型（VLM）存在正交偏差（orthographic bias）：模型在一种脚本（如Gurmukhi）上表现良好，但在同一语言的其他脚本（如Shahmukhi、Roman）上显著下降。作者引入PuMVR基准，包含375个旁遮普语跨脚本图像推理任务，评估10个SOTA VLM后发现的准确率差异高达16%，脚本一致性率（SCR）低至24.8%。视觉输入虽提升绝对性能，但未能缩小相对偏差，且推理路径因脚本而异。
Motivation: 当前VLM假设一种语言对应单一书写系统，忽略了使用多脚本语言的数十亿用户（如旁遮普语、塞尔维亚语等），导致模型能力被正交偏差割裂。
Method: 构建PuMVR基准，包含375个基于文化背景的跨三种旁遮普语脚本（Gurmukhi, Shahmukhi, Roman）的图像推理任务，并评估10个SOTA VLM。提出脚本一致性率（Script Consistency Rate, SCR）作为核心指标。
Result: 发现显著的脚本差距（Script Gap）：同一VLM在不同脚本上的准确率差异可达16%，SCR低至24.8%。视觉输入提升绝对性能但不缩小相对偏差，推理模式的跨脚本迁移性有限，思维链（CoT）路径因脚本而异。
Conclusion: 挑战当前多语言评估范式的假设，呼吁将SCR等脚本无关指标纳入评估，以推动更公平的AI系统。

papers.title: FirstPass: Grounding AI Scientific Judgment in Multi-Round Editorial Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: AI systems for peer review fail on three fronts: they train on Computer Science and Machine Learning venues alone, ignore the iterative dialogue that validates science, and evaluate on stylistic mimicry rather than real editorial judgment. We introduce FirstPass, a dataset and fine-tuned model that addresses all three. Curating 3,668 complete multi-round peer-review dialogues from Nature Communications across five scientific domains (biology, chemistry, neuroscience, physics, and earth science), we exploit mandatory transparent peer review (instituted November 2022) and verify 100% content integrity by automated audit. We fine-tune Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on three tasks: review generation, reviewer updating, and revision-cycle prediction. Our key finding is that response-only loss masking is a prerequisite, not an optimization: without it, accuracy is 62.0%, below the majority baseline; with it, FirstPass achieves 80.5% accuracy and F1-macro 78.2% on predicting editorial outcomes (Standard vs. Extended revision cycles), outperforming Gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview zero-shot by 10.4 percentage points and all baselines with statistical significance (McNemar p < 0.001). On generation, FirstPass produces reviews averaging 1,187 words, substantially closer to human references (2,155 words) than any baseline, achieving ROUGE-L 0.154 with significant gains over Qwen and DeepSeek zero-shot (p < 0.001). Deployed in the pre-submission loop as an anticipatory scientific co-author, FirstPass simulates expert critique and predicts revision cycle outcomes before submission, giving authors the judgment a trusted colleague would provide, with consistent cross-domain performance across five disciplines.
papers.comment: Accepted at the AI for Science Workshop at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 9 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI同行评审系统在领域覆盖、迭代对话利用和评估标准三方面的不足，提出了FirstPass数据集和微调模型。FirstPass从Nature Communications收集了5个科学领域的3668个完整多轮同行评审对话，基于强制透明同行评审机制确保内容完整性。通过LoRA微调Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，在评审生成、评审更新和修订周期预测三个任务上训练，发现响应损失掩码（response-only loss masking）是关键前提。模型在预测编辑结果（标准vs扩展修订周期）上达到80.5%准确率和78.2% F1宏平均，显著优于基线；生成的评审长度更接近人类专家。
Motivation: 现有AI评审系统仅训练于计算机科学和机器学习领域，忽略了验证科学的迭代对话，且评估的是风格模仿而非真正的编辑判断。
Method: 构建包含5个科学领域3668个完整多轮评审对话的数据集，利用强制透明同行评审机制确保数据完整性。采用LoRA微调Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，设计三个任务：评审生成、评审更新、修订周期预测，并引入响应损失掩码作为必要预处理。
Result: 在编辑结果预测上达到80.5%准确率和78.2% F1宏平均，比Gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview零样本高出10.4个百分点（McNemar p<0.001）。生成的评审平均长度1187词，更接近人类（2155词），ROUGE-L达0.154，显著优于Qwen和DeepSeek零样本。
Conclusion: FirstPass可作为预提交环节的预期科学合著者，模拟专家评审并预测修订周期结果，跨学科表现一致。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: UniSLAD: A Unified Framework for Structural and Logical Industrial Visual Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Visual anomaly detection is a fundamental task in industrial automation. While existing approaches have achieved notable progress in identifying structural defects, the detection of logical anomalies remains relatively underexplored. In practice, structural and logical anomalies frequently co-occur in industrial workflows. Therefore, a solution capable of detecting both structural and logical anomalies is crucial for advancing comprehensive anomaly detection research. To address this limitation, we propose a unified framework, termed UniSLAD, which jointly addresses logical and structural anomalies without additional training, enabling a practical solution for dynamic industrial environments. First, we introduce a dual-feature extractor that synergistically integrates a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) backbone for local texture perception with a Transformer backbone for global contextual reasoning, yielding richer and more comprehensive representations. Building on this foundation, we design dual-granularity feature representation modules. At the patch level, memory banks enhanced by the Mahalanobis Transform (MT) preserve representative features and support more discriminative anomaly scoring. At the image level, distribution maps are aggregated using Lower-Upper Mean (LUM) and Power Mean Pooling (PMP), yielding a more robust global representation than conventional average pooling. Extensive experiments on the two industrial benchmarks demonstrate that UniSLAD achieves competitive performance in comprehensive anomaly detection, achieving 99.4% and 93.1%, respectively. Furthermore, ablation studies verify the individual contributions and effectiveness of each proposed component.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniSLAD，一个统一框架，用于同时检测工业视觉中的结构异常和逻辑异常，无需额外训练。框架结合CNN和Transformer双特征提取器，以及双粒度特征表示模块（基于马氏距离的补丁级记忆库和基于均值池化的图像级分布图），在两个工业基准上达到99.4%和93.1%的检测性能。
Motivation: 现有工业异常检测方法主要针对结构缺陷，逻辑异常检测相对未被充分探索，而二者常同时出现，亟需能同时检测两种异常的实用解决方案。
Method: 提出UniSLAD框架，包含CNN-Transformer双特征提取器（局部纹理与全局上下文）、双粒度特征表示（补丁级马氏变换记忆库和图像级Lower-Upper Mean与Power Mean Pooling聚合分布图）。
Result: 在两个工业基准上分别达到99.4%和93.1%的全面异常检测性能，消融实验验证各组件有效性。
Conclusion: UniSLAD为动态工业环境提供了一种无需重新训练即可同时检测结构性和逻辑性异常的实用方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dataset-Aware Cold-Start Active Learning for Annotation-Efficient 3D Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning for 3D medical image segmentation requires extensive manual annotations, a major bottleneck in volumetric medical imaging. Active learning aims to reduce this burden by selecting informative samples for annotation, but most methods assume that an initial labeled set is already available. This leaves the cold-start problem largely unresolved: how to select the first volumes from a fully unlabeled pool before any task-specific model is trained. We propose CSCS, a Curriculum-Stratified Cold-Start framework that adapts initial sample selection to the structure of the unlabeled dataset. CSCS combines two self-supervised, label-free signals: local typicality, measuring representativeness in the embedding space, and reconstruction-based uncertainty, used as a proxy for sample difficulty. These signals are combined through a weighted geometric score, where the weighting is determined by a closed-form pacing rule based on the effective annotation budget and the Difficulty-Coverage Ratio, a pool-level statistic measuring the alignment between difficulty and representativeness. We evaluate CSCS on four 3D medical image segmentation benchmarks: BraTS, FeTA, Spleen, and an in-house fetal MRI dataset. Using nnU-Net as downstream segmentation model, CSCS shows consistently competitive performance across datasets and annotation budgets, with the strongest gains in low-to-mid annotation regimes. These results suggest that dataset-aware cold-start initialization can improve the robustness of active learning for 3D medical image segmentation by adapting sample selection to the geometry of the unlabeled pool.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Supplementary material available as ancillary file
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对3D医学图像分割中主动学习的冷启动问题，提出CSCS框架，利用自监督信号（局部典型性和重建不确定性）结合加权几何分数和节奏规则来初始化样本选择。在四个基准上验证，在低标注预算下表现良好。
Motivation: 现有主动学习方法假设已有初始标注集，忽略冷启动阶段如何挑选第一个未标注样本的问题，导致标注效率低下。
Method: 提出CSCS框架，融合两个自监督信号（局部典型性和重建不确定性），通过基于标注预算和难度覆盖比的节奏规则确定权重，用于初始样本选择。
Result: 在BraTS、FeTA、Spleen和胎儿MRI四个数据集上，使用nnU-Net，CSCS在低到中等标注预算下取得竞争力性能，优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 数据集感知的冷启动初始化可提高主动学习在3D医学图像分割中的鲁棒性，适应未标注数据池的结构。

papers.title: One Image is All You Need: Agentic One-Shot Image Generation via Text-Based World Models for Long-Tail Spatial Perception
papers.abstract_en: Reliable spatial decision automation, such as autonomous driving and maritime surveillance, critically depends on robust visual perception. However, real-world spatiotemporal data exhibits severe heterogeneity, often manifesting as extreme long-tail distributions for safety-critical scenarios. This data scarcity induces dataset shift that degrades detection performance and pose safety risks. While synthetic data generation offers a potential solution, existing generative approaches, such as diffusion models and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), often lack explicit spatial grounding and structural constraints, resulting in spatial and physical inconsistencies in generated scenes. To address these challenges, we introduce WMGen-v1, an agentic text-based world model framework for long-tail spatial data generation. WMGen-v1 employs a Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) to construct a structured scene representation from a single reference image, while a Large Language Model (LLM) performs guidance-based scene expansion under physical plausibility and commonsense constraints. Subsequently, conditioned on the structured semantic representations produced by this reasoning process, a diffusion model generates diverse and physically grounded long-tail training data. Experiments on internal industrial datasets, ROADWork, and LaRS benchmarks demonstrate that WMGen-v1 outperforms baseline approaches. Notably, detectors trained solely on WMGen-v1 synthetic data approach real-only performance on aggregate dataset-level metrics, highlighting its potential to alleviate long-tail data scarcity for downstream spatial perception.

papers.title: Co-Construction Blindness and Asymmetric Epistemic Vulnerability in Human-LLM Interaction
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces two constructs to describe, as far as we know, a previously unnamed risk in human-LLM interaction. Co-construction blindness is the failure to recognize that LLM outputs are not independent assessments to be verified, but co-constructed artifacts shaped by the user's own inputs, accumulated history, and metadata. Every user of a conversational LLM is IN the loop, not ON it -- yet every deployment disclaimer positions them as external auditors. Asymmetric epistemic vulnerability describes the condition in which co-construction blindness produces consequences of radically different magnitude depending on where in the authority structure the user sits. We argue that these constructs describe a structural inevitability, not an anomaly, using the public case of Richard Dawkins's interaction with Claude as a paradigmatic instance. We document a secondary mechanism -- structural deference -- through a first-person exchange in which a large language model concedes that it treated Dawkins more gently than warranted because his intellectual output is represented in its training data. We map the research gaps this analysis opens and call for shared terminology as a precondition for appropriate governance and design response.
papers.comment: 12 pages, out of which 2 are transcripts; Target venue: CHI 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出两个新构念——共构建盲点（co-construction blindness）和不对称认知脆弱性（asymmetric epistemic vulnerability），用于描述人类与LLM交互中未被命名的风险。共构建盲点指用户未能意识到LLM输出是由用户自身输入、历史记录和元数据共同构建的产物，而非独立评估；不对称认知脆弱性指该盲点对不同权力结构位置的用户产生截然不同的后果。通过Richard Dawkins与Claude的公共案例及第一人称交换，作者还记录了结构性服从（structural deference）机制。
Motivation: 现有LLM部署声明将用户定位为外部审计者，但用户实际上处于交互循环内部（in the loop），这种错位导致认知风险未被充分认识。
Method: 概念分析与案例研究：以Richard Dawkins与Claude的交互为典型实例，并通过第一人称交换揭示结构性服从机制。
Result: 识别出共构建盲点和不对称认知脆弱性两种结构性问题，并发现模型因用户的知识代表在训练数据中而给予更温和对待的结构性服从现象。
Conclusion: 呼吁建立共享术语以指导适当的治理与设计响应，指出这些风险是结构性的而非异常情况。

papers.title: Integrating Large Language Model Agents with Digital Twins for Industrial Autonomous Systems
papers.abstract_en: Industrial automation is being transformed by digitalization and the increasing use of cyber-physical systems. Modern production environments require greater adaptability, faster reconfiguration, and more intuitive human-machine interaction. However, traditional rule-based systems rely on fixed logic and cannot autonomously adapt to changing conditions. Consequently, current automation systems lack a systematic approach for integrating adaptive and generalizable reasoning capabilities for interpreting, planning, and executing user tasks across dynamic environments and heterogeneous components. This dissertation proposes a three-layer framework that integrates large language models (LLMs), digital twins, and automation systems into an autonomous system. Autonomy is defined as a design property assigned to system components and enabled through LLM-based reasoning to achieve adaptive, goal-oriented behavior. The Task-Process-Service-Resource (TPSR) model is introduced to transform user tasks into executable processes. Four LLM roles are identified: process orchestration, service matching, digital resource generation, and agent-as-a-service. Five peer-reviewed studies develop and refine these concepts using the design science research methodology. Case studies and prototypes demonstrate adaptive task planning, event-driven control, simulation-based parameterization, and digital model generation. Results show high task executability, command correctness, and content-generation accuracy while reducing manual effort. The framework enables the integration of LLM-based reasoning into industrial automation systems and improves adaptability and usability. Limitations include dependence on accurate digital representations, the computational demands of LLMs, and the need for human intervention in safety-critical situations.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个三层框架，将大型语言模型、数字孪生和自动化系统集成到工业自主系统中。通过TPSR模型将用户任务转化为可执行过程，并定义了四种LLM角色。案例研究显示该方法在自适应任务规划、事件驱动控制等方面有效，提高了任务可执行性和准确性，减少手动工作。
Motivation: 传统工业自动化系统基于固定规则，无法自主适应动态环境，需要一种系统性的方法集成自适应和可泛化的推理能力。
Method: 提出一个三层框架，引入TPSR模型将用户任务转化为可执行流程，识别四种LLM角色（过程编排、服务匹配、数字资源生成、智能体即服务），并采用设计科学研究方法进行开发和验证。
Result: 案例研究和原型显示高任务可执行性、命令正确性和内容生成准确性，同时减少了手动工作量。
Conclusion: 框架能够将LLM推理集成到工业自动化系统中，提升适应性和可用性，但受限于精确数字表示、LLM计算需求和安全关键场景中的人工干预。

papers.title: A Topology-Aware, Memory-Centric Architecture that Separates Root-Cause Derivation from Root-Cause Explanation
papers.abstract_en: Modern microservice deployments fail in ways that are easy to detect and hard to explain. When a fault propagates along service dependencies, alerts fire in floods, dashboards multiply, and the scarce resource, an engineer who understands how the services relate, is consumed reconstructing context that the monitoring stack discarded. We argue that the missing ingredient in autonomous operations is not a better anomaly detector or a larger language model, but operational memory: a persistent, structured representation of how a system normally behaves, how its parts depend on one another, and how it has failed before. We present O PS C ORTEX, a working multi-agent prototype that organizes this memory into four tiers and uses it to separate two tasks the field usually conflates: deriving a root cause and explaining it. Root cause is computed deterministically from a learned dependency graph and the temporal ordering of threshold crossings; a large language model (LLM) is then asked only to explain, confirm, and recommend, using evidence the system has already assembled. We motivate the design with two documented production cascading failures, review representative literature on observability, anomaly detection, graph-based localization, and LLM-assisted diagnosis, and show how each architectural choice maps directly to a failure mode those incidents exhibit. The prototype is validated on an instrumented e-commerce benchmark with eight injectable failure scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个拓扑感知、以内存为中心的架构OPS CORTEX，用于微服务故障诊断，将根因推导与解释分离。系统利用四层操作记忆（operational memory），包括学习到的依赖图和阈值穿越时间顺序，确定性地计算根因，然后由LLM进行解释、确认和建议。原型在电商基准测试上验证。
Motivation: 现有监控系统在故障时产生大量告警，工程师需要重建上下文，而缺乏持久化的操作记忆来关联系统正常行为、依赖关系和历史故障。作者认为自治运维缺少的不是更好的检测器或更大的LLM，而是结构化的记忆。
Method: 提出OPS CORTEX多智能体原型，组织操作记忆为四个层级，将根因推导与解释分离。根因由确定性算法基于学习到的依赖图和阈值穿越时间顺序计算，然后LLM仅用于解释、确认和推荐，使用系统已收集的证据。
Result: 通过两个文档化的生产级级联故障案例进行动机说明，并在一个仪器化的电商基准测试中验证，包含8个可注入故障场景。
Conclusion: 本文强调将根因推导与解释分离的重要性，并展示了通过操作记忆架构可以更有效地进行故障诊断。

papers.title: Evidential Fusion Network for Multimodal Survival Prediction under Missing Modalities
papers.abstract_en: Recent multimodal survival prediction models have demonstrated strong predictive performance by leveraging complementary information across modalities. However, such models generally assume data completeness and exhibit limited robustness toward missing modalities, which are frequently encountered in real-world clinical settings. We propose the Evidential Missing Modality Survival Fusion (EMMS) model for multimodal survival prediction under missing modalities. EMMS offers a straightforward, computationally effective approach to survival analysis without requiring a generative phase for missing data. By employing Dempster-Shafer theory and Gaussian Random Fuzzy Numbers for multimodal decision fusion, it considers both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty alongside modality reliability for fusion. Moreover, the model treats missing modalities as vacuous evidence, preventing interference with available inputs and naturally reflecting increased uncertainty and calibrated predictions. Extensive experiments on four cancer datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance while providing calibrated and interpretable uncertainty estimates under incomplete multimodal observations, without introducing additional computational overhead.

TL;DR: 本文提出EMMS模型，用于在缺失模态条件下进行多模态生存预测。该模型基于Dempster-Shafer理论和高斯随机模糊数进行多模态决策融合，将缺失模态视为空证据，同时考虑偶然不确定性和认知不确定性，无需生成缺失数据。在四个癌症数据集上取得最先进性能，并提供校准的不确定性估计。
Motivation: 现有多模态生存预测模型通常假设数据完整，对临床中常见的模态缺失缺乏鲁棒性。
Method: 提出EMMS模型，采用Dempster-Shafer理论和高斯随机模糊数进行多模态融合，考虑模态可靠性和不确定性，缺失模态作为空证据不干扰可用输入。
Result: 在四个癌症数据集上达到最先进性能，提供校准且可解释的不确定性估计，无额外计算开销。
Conclusion: 模型无需生成缺失数据，直接处理缺失模态，通过不确定性建模提高预测鲁棒性。

papers.title: A large-scale foundation model enables simulation-to-real adaptation for nuclear magnetic resonance-based molecular structure analysis
papers.abstract_en: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy is a powerful tool for molecular structure analysis, and spectral artificial intelligence offers great potential for its rapid and automated interpretation. However, the scarcity of experimental NMR datasets has constrained deep learning in this domain to narrow, task-specific applications that lack broad generalization. Here, we introduce UltraNMR, a large-scale foundation model for NMR that leverages the intrinsic properties of NMR spectra to learn generalizable spectral representations. We collected 158 million paired simulated $^{1}$H and $^{13}$C NMR spectra to train UltraNMR, employing multiple domain-specific pre-training objectives. UltraNMR captures both intra-spectral and inter-spectral dependencies, enabling seamless simulation-to-real adaptation. We demonstrate that adapting UltraNMR to a range of molecular structure analysis tasks on experimental NMR spectra consistently yields state-of-the-art performance and clearly outperforms UltraNMR variants trained directly on downstream data without simulation pre-training. We also construct a large-scale NMR spectral vector library by encoding simulated NMR spectra using UltraNMR, covering 94 million unique molecules and enabling effective structure-aware retrieval. In real-world applications, UltraNMR facilitates the structural elucidation of two previously unknown natural products from Chinese herbal medicines recorded in the Chinese Pharmacopoeia. These results suggest that large-scale simulation pre-training can effectively bridge the simulation-to-real gap, enabling robust and generalizable molecular structure analysis of real-world NMR spectra.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍UltraNMR，一个大规模基础模型，通过模拟NMR谱图预训练实现仿真到现实的适应。该模型在实验NMR谱图的多个分子结构分析任务上取得最先进性能，并构建了覆盖9400万分子的谱向量库，成功解析了两种未知天然产物结构。
Motivation: 实验NMR数据集稀缺，导致深度学习在该领域局限于狭窄任务，缺乏泛化能力。
Method: 收集1.58亿对模拟1H和13C NMR谱图，采用多个领域特定预训练目标训练UltraNMR，学习谱图内和谱图间的依赖关系。
Result: 在实验NMR谱图的多个结构分析任务上持续取得最先进性能，明显优于无模拟预训练的变体；构建的谱向量库支持9400万分子的有效检索。
Conclusion: 大规模模拟预训练可有效弥合仿真到现实的差距，实现真实NMR谱图的鲁棒且泛化的分子结构分析。

papers.title: Empowering Polymeric Materials Discovery by Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Polymeric materials underpin modern technologies spanning energy storage, microelectronics, healthcare and sustainable manufacturing. Yet their rational design remains exceptionally challenging because material performance emerges from complex interactions among molecular composition, chain architecture, processing history and hierarchical structural evolution across multiple length and time scales. Consequently, polymer research has long relied on labor-intensive experimentation and fragmented modeling approaches, limiting both mechanistic understanding and innovation efficiency. Recent advances in data infrastructure, machine learning, large artificial intelligence (AI) models and laboratory automation are beginning to reshape this landscape. Rather than functioning as isolated tools, polymer databases, predictive models, AI agents and automated laboratories are increasingly converging into interconnected discovery ecosystems. As a result, the central challenge is shifting from improving predictive accuracy alone to enabling reliable decision-making, adaptive learning and seamless integration across computation, experimentation and scientific reasoning. We argue that polymer science is entering an era of autonomous discovery, in which data, simulation, reasoning and experimentation operate within self-improving feedback loops that continuously generate hypotheses, design materials, execute experiments and refine predictive models. By unifying molecular design, process optimization, experimental validation and industrial translation, such autonomous ecosystems establish a more predictive, reproducible and scalable paradigm for polymer innovation, fundamentally transforming how polymer research is conducted.

papers.title: Mirage: a Clean-Label Backdoor against LiDAR 3D Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural network-based LiDAR 3D object detection serves as a critical perception component in safety-critical autonomous systems. However, recent studies have revealed its vulnerability to backdoor attacks. Existing attacks typically require white-box access or label modification and focus on geometric attacks such as object disappearance or bounding-box manipulation. In this paper, we present Mirage, a black-box and clean-label backdoor attack against deep neural network-based LiDAR 3DOD. Mirage injects a small number of label-consistent poisoning samples into the training set, causing the model to learn a malicious association between a trigger pattern and an attacker-chosen target class while preserving normal training semantics. As a result, the compromised model behaves normally on benign inputs yet systematically misclassifies triggered objects as the target class during deployment. We evaluate Mirage on multiple state-of-the-art LiDAR 3DOD models and benchmark datasets. Experimental results show that Mirage achieves a 73% misclassification success rate with a poisoning rate of only 0.5%, while maintaining detection performance close to that of benign models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mirage，一种针对 LiDAR 3D 物体检测的黑盒、干净标签后门攻击方法。通过注入少量标签一致的毒化样本，使模型学习触发器与目标类别的恶意关联。在多个 SOTA 模型和数据集上，以 0.5% 毒化率达到 73% 的误分类成功率，且检测性能接近正常模型。
Motivation: 现有 LiDAR 3DOD 后门攻击通常需要白盒访问或标签修改，且集中于几何攻击（如目标消失或边界框操纵）。本文旨在探索更实际的黑盒、干净标签攻击场景。
Method: Mirage 在训练集中注入小部分标签正确的毒化样本（样本标签真实，但包含特定触发器），使模型学习到触发器与目标类别的关联，同时保持正常训练语义。攻击者无需了解模型内部细节。
Result: 在 KITTI 等基准数据集上，针对多种 LiDAR 3DOD 模型（如 PointPillars、SECOND），以 0.5% 毒化率实现 73% 的误分类成功率，且模型在干净样本上的检测性能几乎不受影响。
Conclusion: 研究表明，即使仅毒化极少量标签一致的样本，也能对 LiDAR 3D 物体检测构成严重安全威胁，凸显了该领域防御后门攻击的重要性。

papers.title: TIDY: Thermal Infrared Image Denoising via Wavelet Domain Entropy and Directional Stripe Index
papers.abstract_en: Thermal infrared (TIR) imaging has been a popular choice for field robotics due to its robust perception capability under low light visual degradation, but it suffers from severe stochastic and fixed-pattern noise that breaks downstream estimation. This noise is intensified indoors due to low thermal contrast and uniform temperature distributions, contributing to the relative lack of indoor TIR deployments. Existing TIR denoising methods exhibit a poor accuracy-efficiency tradeoff, either too slow for online deployment required in robotics or insufficiently robust to severe degradation, while typically being trained on synthetic noise. Addressing these problems, we propose TIDY, a lightweight wavelet-domain denoiser trained on real clean-noisy TIR data. By reformulating TIR denoising in the wavelet domain, TIDY explicitly disentangles noise from structural content, enabling targeted suppression with reduced spatial complexity, significantly improving inference speed over prior methods (~34Hz). TIDY introduces two new metrics, Wavelet Entropy and Wavelet Directional Stripe Index, as complementary loss terms to explicitly suppress stochastic noise and stripe artifacts. Across severe indoor corruption and zero-shot settings, TIDY improves robustness and yields consistent gains in downstream robotics tasks including thermal inertial odometry and monocular depth estimation. Code and dataset is available at: https://github.com/williamrheeth/TIDY
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对热红外图像在室内低对比度环境下的去噪问题，提出轻量级小波域去噪器 TIDY，通过小波熵和小波方向条纹指数作为损失项显式抑制随机噪声和条纹伪影，在真实噪声数据上训练，推理速度达约34Hz，并在热惯性里程计和单目深度估计等下游机器人任务中取得一致提升。
Motivation: 现有热红外去噪方法在室内低热对比度下性能不佳，且大多依赖合成噪声训练，速度慢或鲁棒性差，限制了机器人在室内的部署。
Method: 提出 TIDY，一种轻量级小波域去噪器。在小波域中重新定义去噪问题，引入小波熵和小波方向条纹指数作为互补损失项，显式分离噪声和结构内容，降低空间复杂度。
Result: 在严重室内噪声和零样本设置下，TIDY 提高鲁棒性，推理速度达约34Hz，并在热惯性里程计和单目深度估计等下游任务中取得一致提升。
Conclusion: 通过在小波域重新定义去噪问题并引入针对性损失，TIDY 实现了精度和效率的良好平衡，有望推动室内热红外机器人应用。

papers.title: On-Manifold Variational Learning with Heat-Kernel Priors
papers.abstract_en: Learning unsupervised representations of medical imaging cohorts can reveal clinically meaningful prototypes without expert labels, which are often noisy and fail to capture true pathological heterogeneity. However, existing deep latent-variable models estimate Gaussian mixture priors via Euclidean averaging, producing prototypes that drift off the curved data manifold and degenerate as the number of sub-populations grows. We propose a manifold-anchored variational framework built on a geometry-aware Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm, whose M-step selects each sub-population prototype as the graph medoid with the highest diffusion centrality on a heat-kernel-weighted latent graph, ensuring that every prototype remains on-manifold. A Dirichlet energy regularizer enforces geometric smoothness of the latent space, and a per-sub-population uncertainty score enables label-free quality assessment. The manifold-anchored EM is a general-purpose geometric tool that extends standard EM and applies readily to other latent-variable models beyond this setting. On cardiac scar and brain MRI benchmarks, our framework attains the highest accuracy among all compared methods, produces the sharpest prototypes reported to date, and remains stable at large sub-population counts where all baselines degenerate. The Code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/jr-xing/On-Manifold-Variational-Learning-with-Heat-Kernel-Priors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于流形锚定的变分框架，用于医学影像的无监督表示学习。通过引入热核加权图上的几何感知EM算法，确保每个子种群原型保持在数据流形上，并利用Dirichlet能量正则化保持潜在空间的几何平滑。在心脏瘢痕和脑MRI基准上，该方法达到了最高精度和最清晰的原型，且在子种群数量大时仍保持稳定。
Motivation: 现有深度潜变量模型通过欧几里得平均估计高斯混合先验，使得原型偏离弯曲的数据流形，且随着子种群数量增加而退化。医学影像中无标签的真实病理异质性难以捕捉。
Method: 提出基于几何感知EM算法的流形锚定变分框架。M步骤选择图medoid作为子种群原型，该medoid具有热核加权潜在图上的最高扩散中心性；引入Dirichlet能量正则化确保潜在空间几何平滑；对每个子种群提供不确定性评分用于无标签质量评估。
Result: 在心脏瘢痕和脑MRI基准上，该方法在所有对比方法中达到最高精度，产生迄今最清晰的原型，且在子种群数量大时所有基线退化，而该方法保持稳定。
Conclusion: 该流形锚定EM是一种通用几何工具，可扩展到其他潜变量模型。实验证明了其高精度和稳定性。
