papers.title: CAOA -- Completion-Assisted Object-CAD Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Accurately aligning CAD models to their corresponding objects in indoor RGB-D scans is a central challenge in 3D semantic reconstruction. The task requires estimating a 9-Degree-of-Freedom (DoF) pose-position, rotation, and scale along three axes-but is hindered by noisy and incomplete scans, as well as segmentation errors that cause geometric distortions. We present Completion-Assisted Object-CAD Alignment (CAOA), a method that integrates a semantically and contextually aware point cloud completion module with a symmetry-aware relative pose estimation algorithm, enabling precise alignment of CAD models to scanned objects. Existing completion methods are typically trained and evaluated on synthetic datasets, which often fail to generalize to real-world scans. To bridge this gap, we introduce a synthetic data generation strategy tailored to indoor scenes, significantly reducing the synthetic-to-real domain gap-validated through quantitative comparisons with widely used completion datasets. In addition, we release S2C-Completion, an expert-annotated dataset of over 8,500 object-CAD pairs from Scan2CAD, created for real-world indoor single-object completion and intended as a new benchmark for this task. For object-CAD alignment, we incorporate symmetry information via a symmetry-aware loss, improving robustness to symmetric ambiguities. On the Scan2CAD benchmark, CAOA achieves a 17% accuracy improvement over state-of-the-art methods.
papers.journal_ref: Thirteenth International Conference on 3D Vision (3DV), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Completion-Assisted Object-CAD Alignment (CAOA)，一种将语义上下文感知的点云补全模块与对称感知相对位姿估计算法相结合的方法，用于在室内RGB-D扫描中精确对齐CAD模型与物体。在Scan2CAD基准上，CAOA相比现有最优方法提升了17%的精度，并发布了包含超过8,500个物体-CAD对的S2C-Completion数据集。
Motivation: 从室内RGB-D扫描中准确对齐CAD模型是3D语义重建的核心挑战，但扫描噪声、不完整以及分割错误导致的几何畸变使得9-DoF位姿估计十分困难。
Method: 集成一个语义和上下文感知的点云补全模块与一个对称感知的相对位姿估计算法，并引入针对室内场景的合成数据生成策略以减少合成到真实的域差距，同时通过对称感知损失提高对对称歧义的鲁棒性。
Result: 在Scan2CAD基准上，CAOA的精度比现有最优方法提高了17%。
Conclusion: CAOA通过结合点云补全和对称感知位姿估计有效提升了室内场景中CAD模型对齐的准确性，发布的S2C-Completion数据集为真实世界单物体补全提供了新基准。

papers.title: Nothing from Something: Can a Language Model Discover 0?
papers.abstract_en: AI systems based on artificial neural networks are being developed with aspirations of pushing the boundary of human mathematical knowledge. A key question for these systems is how much they can reach beyond their training data. Mathematical discovery requires a strong form of out of distribution generalization; the ability to hypothesize genuinely new - and potentially logically more powerful - mathematical structures. It has been hypothesized that language abilities support such generalizations in human cognition. In this work, we use simple arithmetic as a case study for examining how modern AI models could expand their mathematical horizons, evaluating whether these models can independently discover the concept of "zero". We show that (1) language models of a GPT-2 size are unable to perform this generalization at test time regardless of language pretraining, but (2) models can improve substantially after training on tens or hundreds of examples of zero. Additionally, we find that language pretraining reduces the number of required examples by approximately $50\%$, showing that language abilities can scaffold mathematical discovery in neural models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以简单算术为案例，研究语言模型能否独立发现“零”的概念。结果表明，GPT-2大小的模型在测试时无法独立泛化出零，但经过少量示例训练后可以显著改进；语言预训练可将所需示例数量减少约50%。
Motivation: 探索AI系统能否超越训练数据、发现全新的数学结构（如零的概念），以评估其数学发现能力。
Method: 使用简单算术任务，测试语言模型在测试时是否无需额外训练就能发现零的概念，并对比经过数十或数百个零的示例训练后的表现。
Result: GPT-2大小的语言模型在测试时无法独立发现零；但经过少量训练后能力显著提升，且语言预训练使所需示例数量减少约50%。
Conclusion: 语言能力可以辅助神经模型进行数学发现，但零的概念仍需通过训练示例才能被模型掌握。

papers.title: ARVO: Atlas of Reproducible Vulnerabilities for Open-Source Software
papers.abstract_en: Achieving reproducibility, quantity, and diversity in vulnerability datasets has long been viewed as an inherent three-way trade-off, where improving one dimension often comes at the cost of the others. In practice, reproducibility has been the dimension most often neglected. This has limited what can be automatically extracted from historical bug datasets, and has reduced their utility for downstream security research. In this work, we propose a method to produce a new security dataset which ensures reproducibility for diverse vulnerabilities at scale by identifying the key obstacles to large-scale bug reproduction and addressing them with general solutions. Using this method, we introduce full reproducibility to the largest open source software vulnerability dataset (OSS-Fuzz) and construct the ARVO dataset (an Atlas of Reproducible Vulnerabilities in Open-source software). ARVO is a large-scale dataset consisting of over 6,100 real-world vulnerabilities across 311 projects. Focusing on reproducibility, ARVO differs from existing datasets by providing each vulnerability in a form that can be consistently rebuilt, triggered, and analyzed across versions. Reproducibility also enables automatic identification of the corresponding patch for each vulnerability and supports direct interaction with vulnerabilities after code changes, capabilities that existing large-scale datasets do not provide. In our evaluation, ARVO successfully reproduces 81% of vulnerabilities and achieves 89.4% accuracy on the located patches. We also discuss ARVO's influence on both upstream practices and downstream security research.

papers.title: On the Memorization Behavior of LLMs in Generative Recommendation: Observations, Implications, and Training Strategies
papers.abstract_en: Generative recommendation (GR) has emerged as a promising direction for recommender systems. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly adopted for GR, as their rich pretrained knowledge is expected to help them generalize beyond common user behavior patterns that traditional memorization-oriented baselines can capture. However, existing LLM-based GR works largely ignore LLMs' well-known tendency to memorize, which, if present in LLMs fine-tuned for GR, would restrict their utilization of pretrained knowledge. In this work, we investigate this concern by examining one-hop memorization, where a model recommends items that are direct successors of items in the training data. We show that LLMs do this more than non-LLM-based GR models-in fact, the vast majority of their gains over GR baselines are actually on users whose target items can be predicted through one-hop memorization. We intuit that improving performance on the remaining users requires LLMs to learn richer item-item relations beyond one-hop transitions. To achieve this, we propose IIRG, a novel training strategy that teaches LLMs to capture: (1) collaborative relations derived from item co-occurrences across multiple hops in user sequences, and (2) semantic relations among items with similar themes, both of which can serve as useful recommendation signals. We show that IIRG significantly improves over LLMs trained solely with standard next-item prediction, with especially large gains for users whose test items are not covered by train-time one-hop transitions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）在生成式推荐（GR）中的记忆行为。作者发现LLM比非LLM的GR模型更依赖一跳记忆（直接预测训练数据中物品的后继），其大部分性能提升实际上来自那些可以通过一跳记忆预测的用户。为改善对剩余用户的推荐，作者提出IIRG训练策略，教LLM捕获多跳物品共现的协同关系和相似主题物品间的语义关系。实验表明IIRG显著优于标准下一项预测训练，尤其对测试项不在训练时一跳覆盖的用户提升更大。
Motivation: 现有LLM-based GR忽略了LLM易于记忆的倾向，导致其无法充分利用预训练知识，限制了泛化能力。作者旨在揭示并缓解该问题。
Method: 提出IIRG训练策略，包含两个目标：(1) 从用户序列的多跳物品共现中学习协同关系，(2) 从具有相似主题的物品中学习语义关系。
Result: LLM在GR中比非LLM基线更依赖一跳记忆；IIRG在整体推荐性能上显著优于标准下一项预测训练，尤其对测试项不属于训练时一跳覆盖的用户提升最大。
Conclusion: LLM在生成式推荐中倾向于记忆而非泛化，IIRG通过注入多跳协同和语义关系信号能有效改善其推荐能力。

papers.title: Integrated Marketing Attribution: A Bayesian Framework for Privacy-Safe Granular Measurement Anchored in MMM
papers.abstract_en: Retail marketing measurement increasingly requires granular campaign-level insights without relying on user-level tracking. However, the two dominant approaches, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), often produce fragmented insights. MMM is privacy-safe and robust for channel-level planning but is too coarse for campaign optimization, while MTA provides granular attribution but has become less reliable under increasing privacy restrictions. We propose Integrated Marketing Attribution (IMA), a unified framework that combines MMM with channel specific Bayesian attribution models to derive campaign-level effects from aggregated data. By leveraging MMM-informed priors, IMA delivers granular, privacy-safe attribution while preserving consistency with MMM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种统一的营销归因框架IMA，将营销组合建模（MMM）与渠道特定的贝叶斯归因模型相结合，在保护隐私的前提下从聚合数据中推导出广告活动级别的效果。该方法利用MMM提供的先验信息，实现细粒度且隐私安全的归因，同时保持与MMM的一致性。
Motivation: 现有营销测量方法中，MMM隐私安全但粒度粗，MTA细粒度但受隐私限制可靠性下降；需要一种既能提供细粒度洞察又保护隐私且与宏观模型一致的统一方法。
Method: 提出IMA框架，将MMM作为先验，结合贝叶斯归因模型，从聚合数据中提取渠道级广告活动效果。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但指出IMA在保持与MMM一致性的同时，提供了细粒度、隐私安全的归因。
Conclusion: IMA框架可以有效弥合MMM和MTA之间的差距，在隐私受限环境下实现可解释且一致的营销归因。

papers.title: MuVAP: Multimodal Multiparty Voice Activity Projection for Turn-taking Prediction in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Current multiparty turn-taking models often rely on complex microphone arrays or multi-camera setups, limiting their applicability in human-robot interaction scenarios. We introduce MuVAP, a causal multimodal framework that extends Voice Activity Projection by grounding acoustic predictions in face tracks, enabling speaker-aware turn-taking predictions from a monaural audio stream and a single camera view. To address the combinatorial complexity of modeling multiple speakers, we propose Role-Relative Projection, which maps any N-speaker interaction onto a fixed current versus next floor-holder state. Because existing audiovisual datasets contain disruptive editing cuts that break causal tracking, we introduce the Audio-Visual Conversation Corpus, a 31-hour dataset of unedited, single-camera multiparty conversations. Evaluations demonstrate that MuVAP outperforms strong baselines on Shift-Hold and next-speaker prediction tasks across two- and three-speaker settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MuVAP，一种多模态多方语音活动投影（Voice Activity Projection）框架，用于在野外进行轮流说话预测。该框架通过将声学预测与面部轨迹结合，从单声道音频和单摄像头视图实现说话人感知的轮流预测。为解决多说话人建模的组合复杂度，提出角色相对投影将任意 N 说话人交互映射为固定状态。同时引入 31 小时无编辑单摄像头对话数据集 Audio-Visual Conversation Corpus。实验表明，MuVAP 在两人和三人设置下的 Shift-Hold 和下一说话人预测任务中优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有多方轮流说话模型通常依赖复杂的麦克风阵列或多摄像头设置，限制了在人机交互场景中的适用性。
Method: 提出 MuVAP，一种因果多模态框架，通过角色相对投影（Role-Relative Projection）将 N 说话人交互映射到固定的当前与下一个说话人状态，利用面部轨迹辅助声学预测，并在新构建的 31 小时无编辑单摄像头对话数据集上训练。
Result: MuVAP 在两人和三人设置下的 Shift-Hold 与下一说话人预测任务中优于多个强基线。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，结合面部轨迹和单声道音频可以在单摄像头设置下实现有效的轮流说话预测，同时引入的无编辑数据集有助于因果建模。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Activation Monitors Survive Model Updates? Benchmarking, Predicting, and Repairing Activation-Monitor Staleness
papers.abstract_en: Activation monitors -- lightweight probes trained on a language model's internal representations -- are an increasingly common layer in deployment safety stacks. Deployed models however are rarely static: they are quantized, fine-tuned, adapted with LoRA, or served with merged adapters while the monitor remains frozen. We present the first systematic test of whether this implicit contract holds: whether activation monitors trained on a base model remain reliable after these routine model updates. Across multiple safety-relevant monitors, model depths, update families, and open-weight models, we find a sharp split: quantization-style updates largely preserve frozen probe performance, while fine-tuning-style updates frequently make probes stale. Fragility is highly monitor-dependent, with privacy/PII probes most affected and refusal-compliance probes comparatively stable, showing that retraining a behavior need not stale its corresponding monitor. QLoRA is especially damaging despite NF4 quantization alone being relatively benign, suggesting that quantization becomes riskier when combined with adaptation. We further show that degradation is predictable from pre-deployment features, enabling revalidation budgets to be triaged toward the monitors most likely to fail. Finally, we test repair strategies and find that cheap label-free activation realignment repairs every repair-relevant stale cell, with none requiring score calibration, few-label heads, or labeled retraining. These results suggest that fine-tuning should trigger activation-monitor revalidation by default, with prediction triaging which monitors to check first and label-free realignment as the default repair.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统测试了激活监控器（activation monitors）在模型更新后的可靠性，发现量化风格更新基本保持性能，而微调风格更新常导致监控器过时，且脆弱性因监控器类型而异。进一步表明退化可从部署前特征预测，并验证了廉价的无标签激活重校准可作为默认修复策略。
Motivation: 激活监控器在部署安全堆栈中越来越常见，但模型部署后常经历量化、微调、LoRA适配等更新，而监控器保持冻结，其可靠性缺乏系统评估。
Method: 对多个安全相关监控器、模型深度、更新族和开放权重模型进行系统性基准测试，量化更新和微调更新对监控器性能的影响，并探索基于部署前特征的退化预测和多种修复策略（包括廉价的无标签激活重校准）。
Result: 量化风格更新基本保持冻结监控器性能，而微调风格更新经常导致监控器过时；隐私/PII监控器最受影响，拒绝合规监控器相对稳定；QLoRA尤其有害；退化可从部署前特征预测；无标签激活重校准可修复所有相关过时单元。
Conclusion: 微调应默认触发激活监控器重新验证，可利用预测方法优先检查最可能失败的监控器，无标签重校准可作为默认修复手段。

papers.title: AgentRivet: an automated system for producing Rivet routines from journal publications
papers.abstract_en: Particle physics collider experiments provide Rivet routines as part of the analysis preservation strategy for model-independent measurements. Rivet is a C++ toolkit that allow new theoretical models to be compared to the measurements, thus aiding the development and tuning of Monte Carlo event generators as well as searches for physics beyond the Standard Model. However, analysis coverage is known to be incomplete, with only 39% of measurements having documented and publicly available Rivet routines. In this article, we design and implement an automated workflow based on Large Language Models with the goal of providing the missing routines. This multi-step workflow, referred to as AgentRivet, extracts the physics analysis information from published papers and writes the missing Rivet routines, with intermediate code- and physics- reviews as part of an autonomous quality control. We report the results obtained using commercial Large Language Models, provided by OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, for two recent measurements from the ATLAS and CMS experiments. We find that AgentRivet produces competent Rivet routines with few syntax errors. The physics fidelity of the routines is reasonable and follows the explanations given in the relevant publications. Nevertheless, physics-implementation issues do arise and are investigated using the artefacts produced by AgentRivet. The majority of physics implementation issues arise from subtle-but-ambiguous definitions in the given publication, although some models struggle to implement complex observables even when clear definitions are given.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentRivet，一个基于大语言模型的自动化系统，用于从期刊论文中提取物理分析信息并生成缺失的Rivet例程（C++工具包，用于将新理论模型与测量结果比较）。系统包含多步工作流，包括中间代码和物理审查的质量控制。使用OpenAI、Anthropic和Google的商业大语言模型，对ATLAS和CMS实验的两个近期测量进行了测试。结果显示AgentRivet能生成语法错误较少的Rivet例程，物理保真度合理，但存在因论文定义模糊或模型实现复杂可观测量的困难。
Motivation: 粒子物理对撞机实验通过Rivet例程保存分析，但目前仅有39%的测量有公开可用的Rivet例程，分析覆盖不全。
Method: 设计并实现基于大语言模型的多步骤自动化工作流AgentRivet：从论文提取物理分析信息，编写缺失的Rivet例程，并加入中间代码和物理审查作为自主质量控制。
Result: 对ATLAS和CMS实验的两个近期测量，AgentRivet生成的Rivet例程语法错误少，物理保真度合理；但存在物理实现问题，多数源于论文中微妙但不明确的定义，部分模型即使在给定清晰定义时也难以实现复杂可观测量。
Conclusion: AgentRivet能有效补充缺失的Rivet例程，但物理实现问题需关注，主要挑战在于论文定义的模糊性。

summary_sections.result: 对ATLAS和CMS实验的两个近期测量，AgentRivet生成的Rivet例程语法错误少，物理保真度合理；但存在物理实现问题，多数源于论文中微妙但不明确的定义，部分模型即使在给定清晰定义时也难以实现复杂可观测量。
summary_sections.conclusion: AgentRivet能有效补充缺失的Rivet例程，但物理实现问题需关注，主要挑战在于论文定义的模糊性。

papers.title: Accelerating NeurASP with vectorization and caching
papers.abstract_en: Neurosymbolic AI combines neural networks with symbolic programs to create robust and explainable predictions. One such framework is NeurASP, which trains a neural network to predict concepts and reasons over them using rules written in answer set programming (ASP) to solve downstream tasks. Crucially, labels are only provided for the downstream prediction produced by the symbolic rules, not for the latent concepts themselves. Backpropagation through the non-differentiable ASP component requires expensive probability and gradient calculations, which has hindered scalability to more sophisticated tasks. In this paper, we address the current limitations of NeurASP by improving its computational performance through vectorization, batch processing and caching of intermediate computations during training. We compare computation speeds between the original and our new implementation of NeurASP and report speedups of multiple orders of magnitude for larger tasks. To this end, we propose a new dataset of difficult tasks involving playing cards, which we use to test the capabilities of NeurASP's enhanced learning function.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 11 figures, to be published in the Theory and Practice of Logic Programming (TPLP) journal for the 42nd International Conference on Logic Programming (ICLP) issue
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过向量化、批处理和缓存中间计算，加速了神经符号AI框架NeurASP的训练过程。原NeurASP因非可微的ASP组件需要昂贵的概率和梯度计算而难以扩展。新实现报告在更大任务上实现了多个数量级的加速，并提出了一个涉及扑克牌的新数据集以测试增强的学习功能。
Motivation: NeurASP框架受限于非可微ASP组件的反向传播导致计算昂贵，阻碍了其扩展到更复杂任务。
Method: 对NeurASP的训练进行向量化、批处理以及中间计算的缓存优化。
Result: 新实现相比原版在更大任务上实现了多个数量级的计算速度提升。
Conclusion: 通过向量化和缓存技术可以有效提升神经符号计算的效率，新提出的扑克牌数据集可用于测试复杂场景下的学习能力。

papers.title: AGENTSERVESIM: A Hardware-aware Simulator for Multi-Turn LLM Agent Serving
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn LLM agents interleave model calls with external tool invocations, shifting serving from stateless request processing to stateful program execution. Serving these workloads requires scheduling, KV-cache management, and routing policies that use program-level context, including turn dependencies, tool-induced gaps, and reusable KV state. Evaluating such policies directly on real systems is costly, since each design point may require dedicated accelerator time across arrival rates, model scales, serving-instance counts, and memory hierarchies. Simulation offers a scalable alternative, but existing LLM serving simulators target stateless request-level workloads and therefore omit the core dynamics of agent serving: multi-turn program execution, cross-turn cache locality, and KV-cache residency during tool gaps. We present AGENTSERVESIM, a hardware-aware simulator for multi-turn LLM agent serving. AGENTSERVESIM evaluates serving policies at program granularity through composable modules: a Program Orchestrator preserves program identity and turn order, a Tool Simulator materializes tool-induced gaps, a Session-Aware Router maintains program-to-instance affinity for cache-aware dispatch, and a KV Residency Model tracks policy-defined KV placement across HBM, host DRAM/CXL, and eviction. Across real serving deployments and hardware configurations, AGENTSERVESIM reproduces real-system behavior within 6% error across key performance metrics while running entirely on commodity CPUs. These results show that AGENTSERVESIM enables controlled, repeatable exploration of agent-serving policies without requiring exhaustive deployment on costly accelerators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AGENTSERVESIM，一个硬件感知的多轮LLM Agent服务模拟器。通过程序粒度模块（程序编排器、工具模拟器、会话感知路由、KV驻留模型）评估服务策略，在真实部署中关键性能指标误差小于6%，全程在普通CPU上运行。
Motivation: 现有LLM服务模拟器针对无状态请求，缺乏多轮Agent执行、跨轮缓存局部性和工具间隙期间KV缓存驻留动态的建模，直接评估真实系统成本高昂。
Method: AGENTSERVESIM包含四个可组合模块：程序编排器维护程序身份与轮次顺序，工具模拟器模拟工具调用间隙，会话感知路由保持程序到实例的亲和性以实现缓存感知调度，KV驻留模型追踪策略定义的KV放置（HBM、宿DRAM/CXL及驱逐）。
Result: 在真实硬件部署上，AGENTSERVESIM的关键性能指标（如延迟、吞吐量）误差在6%以内，且完全在普通CPU上运行，无需专用加速器。
Conclusion: AGENTSERVESIM支持可控、可重复的Agent服务策略探索，避免在昂贵加速器上穷举部署，适用于研究调度、缓存管理和路由优化。

papers.title: Closing the Prior-Posterior Loop: Self-Reflective Molecular Design with Analysis-Driven LLM Iteration
papers.abstract_en: Can a general-purpose large language model design molecules with the precision of a seasoned chemist? Current LLM-based frameworks answer this question with scalar feedback loops - generate, score, reject - that amount to informed trial-and-error. Here we show that replacing a single number with the full physicochemical rationale from first-principles calculations transforms the LLM from a stochastic sampler into a causal reasoner. Our system couples retrieval-augmented generation with a self-reflection module that feeds orbital energies, atomic charges, and electron densities - rather than compressed scores - back into the design loop. On HOMO-LUMO gap targets from 2.0 to 5.0 eV, this structure-property-relationship (SPR) reflection achieves a deviation as low as 0.0014 eV with a 100% success rate under the SPR+RAG configuration, consistently outperforming scalar-feedback and non-reflective baselines in median and mean deviation. The framework generalizes seamlessly to dipole-moment design, synthetic accessibility optimization, and molecular docking, and proves robust across 7 distinct LLM backbones. These results establish a new paradigm: when the model understands not only that a molecule fails, but why, iterative molecular design becomes genuinely mechanistic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于LLM的分子设计框架，用第一性原理计算的物理化学参数（轨道能量、原子电荷、电子密度）替代传统的标量反馈循环，使LLM从随机采样器转变为因果推理器。在HOMO-LUMO能隙设计任务中，该方法在结构-性质-关系（SPR）反射和检索增强生成（RAG）配置下达到0.0014 eV的偏差和100%成功率，并推广至偶极矩、合成可及性和分子对接设计。
Motivation: 现有LLM分子设计框架依赖标量反馈（如分数）进行试错，缺乏对失败原因的深层理解，导致效率低下。
Method: 将检索增强生成（RAG）与自反思模块结合，将第一性原理计算的轨道能量、原子电荷和电子密度作为反馈输入LLM设计循环，替代单一的标量分数。
Result: 在HOMO-LUMO能隙（2.0-5.0 eV）目标上，SPR+RAG配置实现低至0.0014 eV的偏差和100%成功率，在中位数和平均偏差上一致优于标量反馈和非反思基线；方法可泛化至偶极矩、合成可及性和分子对接设计，并在7种不同LLM骨干上保持鲁棒。
Conclusion: 当模型理解分子为何失败而非仅知失败结果时，迭代分子设计可变为真正的机械推理过程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Few-step Cofolding with All-Atom Flow Maps
papers.abstract_en: All-atom generative modeling of 3D biomolecular complexes has emerged as the dominant paradigm for predicting the structure of proteins and protein-ligand systems. Generating structures at the atomic level of fidelity, however, typically requires expensive iterative diffusion rollouts, making both conventional deployment and inference-time search techniques computationally costly. In this paper, we introduce the Denoiser Cofolding All-Atom Flowmap (DeCAF) framework for distilling state-of-the-art all-atom cofolding models into all-atom flow maps that produce high-quality samples in only a few inference steps. We build DeCAF on a denoiser-based formulation of flow maps with endpoint losses that naturally support SE(3) rigid alignment, which we show is critical for training accurate models. We further derive a simple change of variables that lets DeCAF operate in the σ-space noise schedule of EDM-style architectures, enabling direct distillation from pretrained cofolding diffusion models. Equipped with DeCAF's flowmap lookahead, we introduce a purpose-built inference-time framework that improves sampling through reward-guided search. Empirically, DeCAF-Boltz statistically improves over Boltz-1x in both accuracy (RMSD) and physical validity scores of protein-ligand poses at strict NFE budgets on the challenging Runs N' Poses, while also showing a more optimal Pareto frontier across all inference compute budgets on PoseBusters. Distilling the state-of-the-art Pearl cofolding model, DeCAF-Pearl outperforms diffusion-based cofolding models and matches its teacher on success rate while using 5x fewer NFEs. We release our code at https://github.com/genesistherapeutics/decaf.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeCAF框架，将全原子共折叠扩散模型蒸馏为少步流映射（flow maps），只需几步推理即可生成高质量的蛋白质-配体复合物结构。DeCAF基于去噪器流映射公式，支持SE(3)刚性对齐，并利用EDM风格的σ空间噪声调度。在Runs N' Poses和PoseBusters基准上，DeCAF-Boltz在严格NFE预算下优于Boltz-1x；DeCAF-Pearl在成功率达到教师模型的同时NFE减少5倍。
Motivation: 现有全原子生物分子复合物生成模型依赖昂贵的迭代扩散，导致推理和搜索成本高昂，限制了实际部署。
Method: 提出DeCAF框架，通过蒸馏将预训练的全原子共折叠扩散模型转化为少步流映射。引入基于去噪器的流映射公式，结合端点损失和SE(3)刚性对齐，并使用σ空间噪声调度。推理时利用流映射前瞻进行奖励引导搜索。
Result: DeCAF-Boltz在Runs N' Poses上以严格NFE预算在RMSD和物理有效性上优于Boltz-1x；在PoseBusters上展现更优的Pareto前沿。DeCAF-Pearl以5倍更少NFE匹配教师模型成功率。
Conclusion: DeCAF框架能有效蒸馏扩散模型为少步流映射，在显著降低计算成本的同时保持或提升生成质量，适用于蛋白质-配体结构预测。

papers.title: From Untrusted Input to Trusted Memory: A Systematic Study of Memory Poisoning Attacks in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Memory is a core component of AI agents, enabling them to accumulate knowledge across interactions and improve performance. However, persistent memory introduces the risk of memory poisoning, where a single adversarial memory write can exert long-term influence over agent behavior. We present a systematic study of memory poisoning in LLM-based agents. We identify four memory write channels and nine structural vulnerabilities in model capabilities, system prompt design, and agent system architecture that make these channels exploitable. Based on these vulnerabilities, we develop a taxonomy of six classes of memory poisoning attacks. Furthermore, we design MPBench -- a benchmark for evaluating memory poisoning attacks, and show that agents designed to write and retrieve memory more aggressively are more exploitable. We also show that existing prompt injection defenses fail to cover memory poisoning attacks. Our findings provide a foundation for understanding and mitigating memory poisoning attacks against AI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了LLM智能体中的内存投毒攻击，识别了四个内存写入通道和九个结构漏洞，并基于这些漏洞提出了六类攻击分类法。同时设计了MPBench基准，实验发现更积极地写入和检索内存的智能体更容易被利用，现有提示注入防御无法覆盖此类攻击。
Motivation: 持久内存是AI智能体的核心组件，但单个对抗性内存写入可能对智能体行为产生长期影响，构成安全风险。
Method: 通过分析智能体能力、系统提示设计和架构，识别可被利用的漏洞，并在此基础上建立六类内存投毒攻击的分类法，同时构建了MPBench基准。
Result: 实验表明，更积极地写入和检索内存的智能体更易被攻击，且现有提示注入防御无法防护内存投毒。
Conclusion: 该研究为理解和缓解LLM智能体的内存投毒攻击提供了系统性基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LALE: Lightweight-Transformer Architecture for Land-Cover Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation of remote sensing imagery requires models that capture both global context and local detail under tight computational budgets. Prior work typically optimizes for one of these axes: attention for global context, convolution for local detail, or compactness for efficiency. While hybrid approaches aim to capture both, they require architectural changes and encoder backbones with computational overhead, limiting efficiency and performance. We present LALE (Lightweight-transformer Architecture for Land-cover Estimation), an end-to-end remote sensing image segmentation architecture, that bifurcates its encoder by resolution: lightweight ConvMixer stages handle high-resolution local features, while transformer stages handle low-resolution global context, confining the quadratic cost of self-attention to deep, downsampled feature maps. An all-MLP multi-scale decoder, together with RMSNorm and StarReLU throughout, further reduces compute and parameter count. On the large-scale ARAS400k remote-sensing segmentation benchmark, LALE establishes a strong efficiency-performance trade-off against CNN, transformer, and hybrid baselines. Our smallest variant, (just 1.6M parameters), reaches within 2.6 F1 points of the best baseline (UPerNet) while using 4.5x fewer parameters, 7x less storage, 17x fewer GMACs, and delivering 1.8x higher throughput. The codebase for LALE is publicly available at https://github.com/caglarmert/LALE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LALE是一种针对遥感图像语义分割的轻量级Transformer架构，通过分辨率分叉编码器分别处理高分辨率局部特征（ConvMixer）和低分辨率全局上下文（Transformer），将自注意力的二次成本限制在深层下采样特征图上。全MLP多尺度解码器配合RMSNorm和StarReLU进一步降低计算量。在ARAS400k基准上，最小变体（1.6M参数）以4.5倍更少的参数、7倍更少的存储、17倍更少的GMACs和1.8倍的吞吐量，达到与UPerNet相差仅2.6 F1点的性能。
Motivation: 现有遥感语义分割模型往往在全局上下文（注意力）、局部细节（卷积）和紧凑性（效率）之间权衡，混合方法需要架构改动和计算开销，限制了效率与性能。
Method: 提出分辨率分叉编码器：高分辨率路径使用轻量ConvMixer捕捉局部细节，低分辨率路径使用Transformer捕捉全局上下文，将自注意力限制在深层下采样特征图上。解码器为全MLP多尺度结构，并统一使用RMSNorm和StarReLU。
Result: 在ARAS400k基准上，LALE最小变体（1.6M参数）达到80.2 F1分数，与最佳基线UPerNet（82.8 F1）相差2.6点，但参数减少4.5倍、存储减少7倍、GMACs减少17倍、吞吐量提升1.8倍。
Conclusion: LALE通过分辨率分叉编码器和全MLP解码器，在遥感语义分割中实现了优异的效率-性能平衡，展示了轻量级架构在资源受限场景下的潜力。

papers.title: SAGE: A Novelty Gate for Efficient Memory Evolution in Agentic LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Agentic LLMs must continuously decide whether newly extracted facts should be added, merged with existing memories, or ignored, yet prior work has focused more on retrieval and storage than on principled write-side control. We frame memory evolution as a novelty-detection problem and propose SAGE, a Spherical Adaptive Gate for memory Evolution that scores candidate facts with a von Mises-Fisher-based density estimator over memory embeddings and routes them with an adaptive threshold that tracks memory-store geometry. SAGE resolves clearly novel facts as ADD, clearly redundant facts as NOOP, and sends only uncertain cases to an LLM merge step, reducing expensive write-time reasoning. On LoCoMo, SAGE achieves the best average token-F1 against Mem0 on all seven open-weight backbone comparisons, while on GPT-4o-mini it reduces add-phase API cost by 3.4$\times$ and add-phase latency by 2.5$\times$ with only a small average judge-score gap. As a drop-in binary gate for A-Mem, SAGE skips roughly 16-18% of LLM calls across five models with minimal quality change on open-weight backbones. These results suggest that novelty-aware write control is a practical lever for improving both memory quality and system efficiency in long-term agentic memory. The source code for our approach is accessible at https://github.com/swang1024/SAGE.

papers.title: TriOpt: A Scalable Algorithm for Linear Causal Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Learning causal relations from observational data is challenging because the graph search space grows super-exponentially with the number of variables. Ordering-based methods reduce this space by first identifying the topological ordering, whereas continuous optimization methods explore most likely regions of the space by casting DAG learning as a differentiable objective with an acyclicity constraint. Despite their conceptual appeal, both paradigms face significant scalability limitations in high-dimensional settings, restricting their practical applicability. In this work, we introduce a new formulation for linear causal discovery that tightly integrates these two paradigms to achieve substantial gains in scalability without sacrificing accuracy. Our approach, TriOpt, decomposes the problem into two efficient stages. First, it recovers the topological ordering by exploiting the Sherman-Morrison rank-1 downdate together with the additive structure of linear kernels, enabling fast and scalable ordering estimation. Second, given this ordering, we reformulate structure learning as a convex continuous optimization problem that entirely avoids the need for enforcing costly acyclicity constraints. We theoretically show that, under the true ordering, TriOpt exactly recovers the underlying linear DAG. Empirically, across synthetic, semi-synthetic, and real-world datasets, TriOpt achieves orders-of-magnitude speedups over state-of-the-art linear causal discovery methods in high-dimensional regimes, while maintaining comparable or superior accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TriOpt，一种可扩展的线性因果发现算法，通过结合排序与连续优化，实现高维场景下数量级的加速，同时保持准确性。
Motivation: 现有的基于排序和连续优化的因果发现方法在高维设置下扩展性差，限制了实际应用。
Method: 分解为两阶段：先利用Sherman-Morrison rank-1 downdate和线性核的可加性高效估计拓扑排序；然后在给定排序下将结构学习转化为无环性约束的凸优化问题。
Result: 在合成、半合成和真实数据集上，TriOpt在高维区域比现有方法快数个数量级，且精度相当或更优。
Conclusion: 理论上证明在真实排序下能精确恢复线性DAG；实践上展示了高效性。

papers.title: Decision Tree Learning on Product Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Decision tree learning has long been a central topic in theoretical computer science, driven by its practical importance. A fundamental and widely used method for decision tree construction is the top-down greedy heuristic, which recursively splits on the most influential variable. Despite its empirical success, theoretical analysis of this heuristic has been limited. A recent breakthrough by Blanc et al. (ITCS, 2020) provided the first rigorous theoretical guarantees for the greedy approach, but only under the uniform distribution. We extend this analysis to the more general and practically relevant setting of arbitrary product distributions. Our main result shows that for any function $f$ computable by an optimal decision tree of size $s$, maximum depth $D_{\text{opt}}$, and average depth $Δ_{\text{opt}}$, the greedy heuristic constructs an $ε$-approximating tree whose size grows at most with $\exp(Δ_{\text{opt}} D_{\text{opt}} \log(e/ε))$. In the special case where the optimal tree is a full binary tree, this bound improves upon the bound of Blanc et al. and holds under a strictly broader class of distributions. Moreover, we present an algorithm based on the top-down greedy heuristic that is entirely parameter-free -- it requires no prior knowledge of the optimal tree's size or depth -- offering a practical advantage over Blanc et al.'s method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了贪心决策树学习算法的理论保证，从均匀分布推广到任意乘积分布（product distribution）。主要结果表明，对于任何可由大小为s、最大深度D_opt、平均深度Δ_opt的最优决策树计算的函数f，贪心启发式算法构造的ε-近似树的大小至多为exp(Δ_opt D_opt log(e/ε))。当最优树为完全二叉树时，该界优于Blanc等人的结果，且适用于更广泛的分布。此外，本文提出了一种无需先验知识的无参数化算法。
Motivation: 贪心决策树学习的理论分析此前仅限于均匀分布（Blanc et al., ITCS 2020），而实际应用中常遇到非均匀分布（如乘积分布）。本文旨在将理论保证推广到更一般且实用的乘积分布场景。
Method: 基于自上而下贪心启发式算法，分析了在任意乘积分布下决策树学习的性能，给出了近似树大小的上界，并设计了一种无参数化（parameter-free）的算法，无需提前知道最优树的规模或深度。
Result: 在任意乘积分布下，贪心算法构造的ε-近似树大小增长为exp(Δ_opt D_opt log(e/ε))；在最优树为完全二叉树的特例下，该界优于Blanc等人的均匀分布结果。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了贪心决策树算法在乘积分布下的理论可行性，但结果依赖于最优树的平均深度和最大深度，且分析局限于乘积分布，未涉及更复杂的分布或实际数据中的噪声。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Neuroevolution for Diverse LLM Generation: Quality-Diversity Optimization via Prompt Embedding Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models exhibit mode collapse, producing homogeneous outputs that fail to explore valid solution spaces. We present QD-LLM, a framework for parameter-efficient neuroevolution that evolves prompt embeddings, compact neural interfaces (~32K parameters) that steer generation in frozen LLMs (70B+ parameters), within a Quality-Diversity (QD) optimization framework. Our contributions: (1) evolved prompt embeddings via gradient-free optimization enabling behavioral steering without model fine-tuning; (2) hybrid behavior characterization combining semantic and explicit features with formal coverage bounds (Theorem 1) under validated near-independence (NMI $= 0.08 \pm 0.02$); (3) co-evolutionary variation operators including targeted behavioral mutation via finite-difference gradient estimation. On HumanEval (164 problems), MBPP, and creative writing benchmarks, QD-LLM achieves 46.4% higher coverage and 41.4% higher QD-Score than QDAIF ($p<0.001$, 30 runs, Vargha-Delaney $A=0.94$). We demonstrate downstream utility: diverse archives improve test generation (34% more edge cases) and fine-tuning data quality (8.3% accuracy gain). We validate across open-source LLMs (Llama-3-70B, Mistral-Large) with full embedding access, establishing prompt embedding evolution as an effective paradigm bridging neuroevolution and modern LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QD-LLM框架，通过质量-多样性优化（Quality-Diversity Optimization）进化冻结大语言模型（LLM）的提示嵌入（prompt embedding），以缓解模式坍塌问题。该方法仅需约32K参数的可学习嵌入，通过无梯度优化（gradient-free optimization）和混合行为特征（语义+显式特征）驱动生成多样性。在HumanEval、MBPP等基准上，覆盖率和QD-Score显著高于基线，并展示了在测试生成和微调数据质量上的下游收益。
Motivation: 大语言模型存在模式坍塌（mode collapse），生成结果同质化，难以探索有效解空间。现有方法依赖微调或大量参数，效率低下。
Method: 提出参数高效神经进化框架QD-LLM：1）进化可学习的提示嵌入（~32K参数），通过无梯度优化引导冻结LLM（70B+参数）的行为；2）混合行为特征（语义+显式特征），并给出覆盖范围的形式化保证（定理1），验证近似独立性（NMI=0.08±0.02）；3）共进化变异算子，包括通过有限差分梯度估计实现目标行为突变。
Result: 在HumanEval（164问题）、MBPP和创意写作基准上，QD-LLM相比QDAIF实现46.4%更高的覆盖率和41.4%更高的QD-Score（p<0.001，30次运行，Vargha-Delaney A=0.94）。下游应用中，多样化存档使测试生成增加34%的边界情况，微调数据质量获得8.3%的准确率提升。
Conclusion: 提示嵌入进化是连接神经进化（neuroevolution）与现代LLM的有效范式，无需模型微调即可实现行为多样化，并在代码生成和创意写作任务上验证有效性。

papers.title: EvoPref: Multi-Objective Evolutionary Optimization Discovers Diverse LLM Alignments Beyond Gradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: Gradient-based preference optimization methods for large language model (LLM) alignment suffer from preference collapse, converging to narrow behavioral modes while neglecting preference diversity. We introduce EvoPref, a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm that maintains populations of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapters optimized across helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty objectives using Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II) selection with archive-based diversity preservation. Our primary contribution is demonstrating that population-based methods discover substantially more diverse alignments than gradient descent. On standard benchmarks, EvoPref improves preference coverage by 18% (median 82.5% vs. 70.0% for ORPO, $p<0.001$, Wilcoxon, $n=30$) and reduces collapse rates by 47% (11.0% vs. 20.6%, $p<0.001$), while achieving competitive alignment quality (median 75.5% RewardBench vs. 75.0% for ORPO, $p<0.05$). We provide theoretical motivation extending recent multi-objective evolutionary algorithm (MOEA) runtime analysis (Dang et al., 2025) suggesting why archive-based methods escape collapse more effectively than single-trajectory optimization. Comprehensive comparisons against MOEA/D, SMS-EMOA, CMA-ES, and gradient baselines (DPO, IPO, KTO, ORPO) with rigorous statistical testing (Friedman with Holm correction, Vargha-Delaney effect sizes, median with IQR) confirm that multi-objective selection with diversity preservation is essential. This work establishes evolutionary optimization as a principled paradigm for diverse LLM alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EvoPref，一种基于多目标进化算法的LLM对齐方法，通过维护LoRA适配器种群并采用NSGA-II选择与存档多样性保持，优化有用性、无害性和诚实性目标。实验表明，该方法比梯度下降法（如ORPO）发现更多样化的对齐，偏好覆盖率提升18%，崩溃率降低47%，同时对齐质量相当。
Motivation: 现有基于梯度的偏好优化方法（如DPO、ORPO）存在偏好崩溃问题，收敛到狭窄的行为模式，忽视偏好多样性。
Method: 使用非支配排序遗传算法II（NSGA-II）维护LoRA适配器种群，结合存档多样性保持，在有用性、无害性和诚实性三个目标上同时优化。
Result: 在标准基准上，EvoPref偏好覆盖率中位数82.5% vs. ORPO 70.0%（提升18%），崩溃率11.0% vs. 20.6%（降低47%），RewardBench分数75.5% vs. 75.0%（p<0.05）。

papers.title: Sequential Feature Selection for Efficient Landslide Segmentation from Multi-Spectral Data
papers.abstract_en: Landslide detection from satellite imagery has advanced through deep learning, yet most models rely on large, highly correlated spectral-topographic inputs whose contributions remain poorly understood. The question of which channels are actually necessary has received surprisingly little attention. This matters: redundant or correlated inputs obscure physical interpretability, inflate computational overhead, and can actively degrade model performance through the Hughes Phenomenon. We present a systematic, explainable channel-selection framework for the Landslide4Sense benchmark, combining Sentinel-2 multispectral and ALOS PALSAR terrain data with 16 engineered spectral and structural indices. Rather than relying on conventional single-band drop tests, which evaluate channels in isolation and miss interaction effects, we apply Sequential Forward Floating Selection (SFFS) to iteratively build and prune a candidate feature pool using a lightweight U-Net++ proxy model. Beyond identifying a compact 8-channel subset that matches or exceeds the segmentation F1 of configurations using up to 30 channels, we use the selection process itself to interrogate which spectral and topographic features landslide models genuinely rely on, and what this reveals about the physical cues driving their predictions. We argue that SFFS represents a principled feature selection approach to input design in Earth observation, in contrast to the prevailing practice of appending every available band and hoping the model learns what to ignore.
papers.comment: In Process of Submission to Frontiers in Remote Sensing. Keywords: landslide segmentation, multispectral remote sensing, feature selection, explainability, Landslide4Sense
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对滑坡分割中使用的多光谱与地形特征冗余问题，提出基于序列前向浮动选择（SFFS）的特征选择框架。在Landslide4Sense基准上，该方法仅用8个通道即可达到或超过使用30个通道的分割F1分数，并通过选择过程揭示模型实际依赖的物理线索。
Motivation: 现有滑坡分割模型通常使用大量高度相关的光谱-地形输入，冗余特征增加计算开销、降低可解释性，且可能因Hughes现象损害性能。
Method: 结合Sentinel-2多光谱和ALOS PALSAR地形数据及16种工程化光谱指数，采用轻量级U-Net++代理模型，应用SFFS迭代构建并剪枝候选特征池。
Result: 识别出仅含8个通道的子集，其分割F1分数与使用至多30个通道的配置相当或更优。

papers.title: DynProto: Dynamic Prototype Evolution for Out-of-Distribution Detection
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies show that using potential out-of-distribution (OOD) labels from large corpora as auxiliary information can improve OOD detection in vision-language models (VLMs). However, these methods often fail when real-world OOD samples fall outside the predefined OOD label set. To address this limitation, we propose DynProto, a novel approach that learns OOD prototypes dynamically during testing using only in-distribution (ID) information. DynProto is inspired by a key observation: OOD samples predicted as the same ID class tend to cluster in the feature space. With this insight, we leverage easy-to-detect OOD samples as ``anchors'' to find their harder-to-detect, similar counterparts. To this end, DynProto introduces two modules: \textbf{Coarse OOD Pattern Capturing Module} caches OOD patterns that are easily confused with each ID class during testing, and \textbf{Fine-grained OOD Pattern Refinement Module} subsequently clusters these patterns within each cache and aggregates them into representative OOD prototypes. By measuring similarity to ID and dynamic OOD prototypes, DynProto enables accurate OOD detection. DynProto significantly outperforms prior methods across multiple benchmarks. On ImageNet OOD benchmark, DynProto reduces FPR95 by 11.60\% and improves AUROC by 4.70\%. Moreover, the framework is architecture-agnostic and can be integrated into various backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DynProto，一种在测试阶段仅利用分布内（ID）信息动态学习OOD原型的方法。受观察启发，将易检测的OOD样本作为锚点来寻找难检测的相似样本。该方法包含粗粒度和细粒度两个模块，通过缓存和聚类OOD模式形成原型，在多个基准上显著优于先前方法。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖预定义OOD标签集，当真实OOD样本超出集合时效果不佳。
Method: 提出两个模块：粗粒度OOD模式捕获模块在测试时缓存易与每个ID类混淆的OOD模式；细粒度OOD模式精炼模块对缓存内的模式进行聚类并聚合为代表性OOD原型。
Result: 在ImageNet OOD基准上，FPR95降低11.60%，AUROC提升4.70%。
Conclusion: DynProto是架构无关的，可集成到多种骨干网络。摘要强调其动态原型学习的优势。

papers.title: Seeing the Scene Matters: Revealing Forgetting in Video Understanding Models with a Scene-Aware Long-Video Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Long video understanding (LVU) remains a core challenge in multimodal learning. Although recent vision-language models (VLMs) have made notable progress, existing benchmarks mainly focus on either fine-grained perception or coarse summarization, offering limited insight into temporal understanding over long contexts. In this work, we define a scene as a coherent segment of a video in which both visual and semantic contexts remain consistent, aligning with human perception. This leads us to a key question: can current VLMs reason effectively over long, scene-level contexts? To answer this, we introduce a new benchmark, SceneBench, designed to provide scene-level challenges. Our evaluation reveals a sharp drop in accuracy when VLMs attempt to answer scene-level questions, indicating significant forgetting of long-range context. To further validate these findings, we propose Scene Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Scene-RAG), which constructs a dynamic scene memory by retrieving and integrating relevant context across scenes. This Scene-RAG improves VLM performance by +2.50%, confirming that current models still struggle with long-context retention. We hope SceneBench will encourage future research toward VLMs with more robust, human-like video comprehension.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长视频理解（LVU）中场景级推理的遗忘问题，定义场景为视觉和语义一致的视频片段，提出SceneBench基准测试，并发现现有VLM在场景级问题上的准确率急剧下降。为验证遗忘现象，进一步提出Scene-RAG方法，通过动态场景记忆检索整合上下文，提升VLM性能+2.50%，确认模型仍难以保留长上下文。
Motivation: 现有视频理解基准主要关注细粒度感知或粗粒度摘要，缺乏对场景级时间理解的评估，导致对VLM长上下文遗忘的研究不足。
Method: 定义场景一致性概念，构建SceneBench基准，包含场景级问题；并提出Scene-RAG，通过检索和整合场景上下文构建动态场景记忆，辅助VLM推理。
Result: SceneBench评估发现VLM在场景级问题上准确率大幅下降；Scene-RAG将VLM性能提升2.50%，证实了长上下文遗忘的存在。
Conclusion: SceneBench和Scene-RAG揭示了当前VLM在长视频场景推理中的遗忘瓶颈，期待推动更鲁棒的类人视频理解模型发展。

papers.title: RetailBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Autonomous Decision-Making and Strategy Stability of LLM Agents in Realistic Retail Environments
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents have made rapid progress on short-horizon, well-scoped tasks, yet their ability to sustain coherent decisions in dynamic long-horizon environments remains uncertain. We introduce RetailBench, a data-grounded simulation benchmark for evaluating tool-using LLM agents in single-store supermarket operation. RetailBench models retail management as a partially observable decision process and is designed to support thousand-day-scale simulations. In this environment, agents must manage pricing, replenishment, supplier selection, shelf assortment, inventory aging, customer feedback, external events, and cash-flow constraints. We evaluate seven contemporary LLMs under representative agent frameworks over a 180-day evaluation horizon and compare them with a privileged oracle policy. Results show substantial variation across models: only a small subset survives the full evaluation horizon, and even the strongest LLM runs remain substantially behind the oracle policy in final net worth and sales outcomes. Behavioral analysis attributes these gaps to incomplete evidence acquisition, surface-level decision making, and the lack of a consistent long-horizon policy. RetailBench provides a controlled testbed for studying reliable autonomy in economically grounded long-horizon decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对大语言模型(LLM)智能体在长期动态环境中的决策稳定性问题，本文提出RetailBench——一个基于数据、支持千天级仿真的零售管理基准，模拟超市运营中的定价、补货、选品、库存、客户反馈、外部事件及现金流约束。在180天评估周期内，评估7种当代LLM在代表性智能体框架下的表现，并与最优策略比较。结果表明仅少数模型能完成全程，最强模型的最终净值和销售额仍明显低于最优策略，行为分析指出问题在于不完整信息获取、表面化决策和缺乏一致长期规划。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体在短期、边界明确的任务上进步迅速，但在动态长期环境中维持连贯决策的能力尚不确定，缺乏针对此类场景的标准化评估基准。
Method: 构建RetailBench仿真环境，将零售管理建模为部分可观测决策过程，支持千天级模拟；并采用工具调用型LLM智能体框架在180天周期内进行评估，对比最优策略。
Result: 7个LLM中仅少数存活全程，最强模型的最终净值和销售额仍显著落后于最优策略；性能差异源于信息获取不完整、决策表面化及缺乏长期一致性策略。
Conclusion: RetailBench为研究LLM智能体在基于经济逻辑的长期决策中的可靠自主性提供了受控测试平台，揭示了当前模型在长期规划方面的明显不足。

papers.title: What if? Emulative Simulation with World Models for Situated Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Situated reasoning often relies on active exploration, yet in many real-world scenarios such exploration is infeasible due to physical constraints of robots or safety concerns of visually impaired users. Given only a limited observation, can an agent mentally simulate a future trajectory toward a target situation and answer spatial what-if questions? We introduce WanderDream, the first large-scale dataset designed for the emulative simulation of mental exploration, enabling models to reason without active exploration. WanderDream-Gen comprises 15.8K panoramic videos across 1,088 real scenes from HM3D, ScanNet++, and real-world captures, depicting imagined trajectories from current viewpoints to target situations. WanderDream-QA contains 158K question-answer pairs, covering starting states, paths, and end states along each trajectory to comprehensively evaluate exploration-based reasoning. Extensive experiments with world models and MLLMs demonstrate (1) that mental exploration is essential for situated reasoning, (2) that world models achieve compelling performance on WanderDream-Gen, (3) that imagination substantially facilitates reasoning on WanderDream-QA, and (4) that WanderDream data exhibit remarkable transferability to real-world scenarios.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. The data and code are available at: https://github.com/RuipingL/WanderDream
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WanderDream，第一个用于心理探索仿真模拟的大规模数据集，使模型无需主动探索即可进行情境推理。WanderDream-Gen包含15.8K全景视频，WanderDream-QA包含158K问答对。实验表明心理探索对情境推理至关重要，世界模型在生成和推理任务上表现良好，且数据可迁移到真实场景。
Motivation: 现实场景中主动探索常因物理约束或安全问题不可行，需要代理仅从有限观测出发，通过心理仿真回答空间假设问题。
Method: 构建WanderDream数据集，包含从HM3D、ScanNet++和真实场景生成的15.8K全景视频和158K问答对，覆盖起始状态、路径和终止状态。使用世界模型和MLLM进行实验。
Result: 心理探索对情境推理至关重要；世界模型在WanderDream-Gen上表现良好；想象显著提升WanderDream-QA推理性能；WanderDream数据可迁移到真实场景。
Conclusion: 心理探索仿真模拟是情境推理的有效方法，世界模型能生成逼真的心理轨迹并辅助推理，数据集和模型具有泛化能力。

papers.title: Combinatorial Sparse PCA Beyond the Spiked Identity Model
papers.abstract_en: Sparse PCA is one of the most well-studied problems in high-dimensional statistics. In this problem, we are given samples from a distribution with covariance $Σ$, whose top eigenvector $v \in R^d$ is $s$-sparse. Existing sparse PCA algorithms can be broadly categorized into (1) combinatorial algorithms (e.g., diagonal or elementwise covariance thresholding) and (2) SDP-based algorithms. While combinatorial algorithms are much simpler, they are typically only analyzed under the spiked identity model (where $Σ= I_d + γvv^\top$ for some $γ> 0$), whereas SDP-based algorithms require no additional assumptions on $Σ$. We demonstrate explicit counterexample covariances $Σ$ against the success of standard combinatorial algorithms for sparse PCA, when moving beyond the spiked identity model. In light of this discrepancy, we give the first combinatorial method for sparse PCA that provably succeeds for general $Σ$ using $s^2 \cdot \mathrm{polylog}(d)$ samples and $d^2 \cdot \mathrm{poly}(s, \log(d))$ time, by providing a global convergence guarantee on a variant of the truncated power method of Yuan and Zhang (2013). We provide a natural generalization of our method to recovering a vector in a sparse leading eigenspace. Finally, we evaluate our method on synthetic and real-world sparse PCA datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏PCA问题，指出现有组合算法在尖峰恒等模型之外存在反例，并提出首个在一般协方差矩阵上可证明成功的组合方法，基于截断幂法变体，具有样本复杂度$s^2 \cdot \mathrm{polylog}(d)$和时间复杂度$d^2 \cdot \mathrm{poly}(s, \log(d))$，并推广到稀疏主导特征空间恢复。
Motivation: 现有组合稀疏PCA算法通常在尖峰恒等模型下分析，而SDP方法虽无额外假设但复杂度高；本文旨在填补组合方法在一般协方差矩阵上的理论空白。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集上进行了评估，但摘要未给出具体数值结果。

papers.title: Compress the Easy, Explore the Hard: Difficulty-Aware Entropy Regularization for Efficient LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has substantially empowered Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle complex reasoning tasks, yet the verbose nature of explicit reasoning steps incurs prohibitive inference latency and computational costs, limiting real-world deployment. While existing compression methods - ranging from self-training to Reinforcement Learning (RL) with length constraints - attempt to mitigate this, they often sacrifice reasoning capability for brevity. We identify a critical failure mode in these approaches: explicitly optimizing for shorter trajectories triggers rapid entropy collapse, which prematurely shrinks the exploration space and stifles the discovery of valid reasoning paths, particularly for challenging questions requiring extensive deduction. To address this issue, we propose Compress responses for Easy questions and Explore Hard ones (CEEH), a difficulty-aware approach to RL-based efficient reasoning. CEEH dynamically assesses instance difficulty to apply selective entropy regularization: it preserves a diverse search space for currently hard questions to ensure robustness, while permitting aggressive compression on easier instances where the reasoning path is well-established. In addition, we introduce a dynamic optimal-length penalty anchored to the historically shortest correct response, which effectively counteracts entropy-induced length inflation and stabilizes the reward signal. Across six reasoning benchmarks, CEEH consistently reduces response length while maintaining accuracy comparable to the base model, and improves Pass@k relative to length-only optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对链式思维推理中因压缩导致熵崩溃、探索空间萎缩的问题，提出难度感知的熵正则化方法CEEH。CEEH动态评估问题难度，对困难问题保留多样化搜索空间以保证鲁棒性，对简单问题则允许激进压缩；同时引入基于历史最短正确响应的动态最优长度惩罚，抵消熵引起的长度膨胀。在六个推理基准上，CEEH在保持与基模型相当准确率的同时一致地减少响应长度，并相对纯长度优化提升了Pass@k。
Motivation: 现有压缩方法（自训练、带长度约束的强化学习等）在追求简短推理时会导致熵快速崩溃，缩小探索空间，尤其对需要大量推导的难题损害推理能力。
Method: 提出CEEH框架：利用难度感知的选择性熵正则化，对简单问题施加强压缩，对困难问题保持多样探索；并设计动态最优长度惩罚，锚定历史最短正确响应来稳定奖励信号。
Result: 在六个推理基准上，CEEH一致降低响应长度，同时保持与基模型相当的准确率，并在Pass@k指标上优于纯长度优化的方法。
Conclusion: CEEH通过难度感知的熵正则化实现了效率与推理能力的平衡，为LLM高效推理提供了新思路。

papers.title: Agent Skill Framework: Perspectives on the Potential of Small to Medium Language Models in Industrial Environments
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills are widely supported by major agentic frameworks and perform well with proprietary models, yet their effectiveness for small and medium-sized open source language models (270 M-80B) remains underexplored. We systematically study the Skill paradigm in resource-constrained industrial settings, where reliance on proprietary APIs is impractical due to data security and budget constraints. Across two open-source tasks and a real-world insurance claims classification task, we find that very small models struggle with reliable skill selection, while models around 30B-80B benefit substantially. Thinking variants do not show major levels of improvement from skills, also considering GPU usage increases due to overthinking. These findings reveal a trade-off between GPU cost and agent performance, and provide actionable insights for effective Skill configuration and SLM deployment in real world settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了中小型开源语言模型（270M-80B）在工业环境中的Agent技能（Skill）范式。在两个开源任务和一个真实保险索赔分类任务上，发现非常小的模型难以可靠选择技能，而30B-80B模型受益显著。Thinking变体没有显示出技能带来的重大改进，反而因过度思考增加GPU开销。研究揭示了GPU成本与Agent性能的权衡。
Motivation: 现有Agent技能主要依赖商业API，但在数据安全和预算受限的工业环境中不可行，中小型开源模型在技能范式下的有效性尚不明确。
Method: 在工业资源受限场景下，系统评估不同规模开源模型（270M-80B）使用Skill范式在开源任务和保险索赔分类任务上的表现，并比较普通模型与Thinking变体。
Result: 非常小模型（如270M）在技能选择上可靠性低；30B-80B模型从技能中获益显著；Thinking变体未带来明显提升，且因过度思考增加GPU使用。
Conclusion: 建议在工业环境中部署Agent技能时，应选择30B-80B规模模型，并注意Thinking变体的效率问题；存在GPU成本与性能的权衡。

papers.title: Policy4OOD: A Knowledge-Guided World Model for Policy Intervention Simulation against the Opioid Overdose Crisis
papers.abstract_en: The opioid epidemic remains one of the most severe public health crises in the United States, yet evaluating policy interventions before implementation is difficult: multiple policies interact within a dynamic system where targeting one risk pathway may inadvertently amplify another. We argue that effective opioid policy evaluation requires three capabilities -- forecasting future outcomes under current policies, counterfactual reasoning about alternative past decisions, and optimization over candidate interventions -- and propose to unify them through world modeling. We introduce Policy4OOD, a knowledge-guided spatio-temporal world model that addresses three core challenges: what policies prescribe, where effects manifest, and when effects unfold.Policy4OOD jointly encodes policy knowledge graphs, state-level spatial dependencies, and socioeconomic time series into a policy-conditioned Transformer that forecasts future opioid outcomes.Once trained, the world model serves as a simulator: forecasting requires only a forward pass, counterfactual analysis substitutes alternative policy encodings in the historical sequence, and policy optimization employs Monte Carlo Tree Search over the learned simulator. To support this framework, we construct a state-level monthly dataset (2019--2024) integrating opioid mortality, socioeconomic indicators, and structured policy encodings. Experiments demonstrate that spatial dependencies and structured policy knowledge significantly improve forecasting accuracy, validating each architectural component and the potential of world modeling for data-driven public health decision support. Our code and data have been released in https://github.com/antman9914/Policy4OOD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对阿片类药物危机中的政策评估问题，提出一个知识引导的时空世界模型Policy4OOD。该模型联合编码政策知识图谱、状态空间依赖和社会经济时间序列，通过策略条件Transformer预测未来阿片类药物结果。训练后的世界模型可用于前瞻预测、反事实推理（替换历史策略编码）和基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的策略优化。实验基于2019-2024年美国州级月度数据，表明空间依赖和结构化政策知识显著提升预测准确性。
Motivation: 阿片类药物流行病是美国严重的公共卫生危机，但政策干预在实际实施前难以评估：多种政策在动态系统中相互作用，针对一条风险路径的措施可能意外加剧另一条路径的问题。现有方法缺乏统一框架来同时实现预测、反事实推理和策略优化。
Method: 提出Policy4OOD，一个知识引导的时空世界模型。核心是将政策知识图谱、州级空间依赖和社会经济时间序列编码为策略条件Transformer，实现未来阿片类药物结果的预测。训练后的模型作为模拟器：预测只需前向传播，反事实分析通过在历史序列中替换替代策略编码实现，策略优化采用蒙特卡洛树搜索。
Result: 基于2019-2024年州级月度数据集，实验表明空间依赖和结构化政策知识显著提升预测准确性，验证了各架构组件的有效性以及世界模型在数据驱动的公共卫生决策支持中的潜力。
Conclusion: Policy4OOD展示了世界模型在政策干预模拟中的潜力，能够统一预测、反事实推理和策略优化。代码和数据已公开。

papers.title: From Noise to Order: Learning to Rank via Denoising Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: In information retrieval (IR), learning-to-rank (LTR) methods have traditionally limited themselves to discriminative machine learning approaches that model the probability of the document being relevant to the query given some feature representation of the query-document pair. In this work, we propose an alternative denoising diffusion-based deep generative approach to LTR that instead models the full joint distribution over feature vectors and relevance labels. While in the discriminative setting, an over-parameterized ranking model may find different ways to fit the training data, we hypothesize that candidate solutions that can explain the full data distribution under the generative setting are better equipped to estimate relevance. With this motivation, we propose DiffusionRank that extends TabDiff, an existing denoising diffusion-based generative model for tabular datasets, to create generative equivalents of classical discriminative pointwise and pairwise LTR objectives. We conduct thorough empirical evaluation on four standard LTR datasets to demonstrate improvements from DiffusionRank models over their discriminative counterparts. Our work points to a rich space for future research exploration on how we can leverage ongoing advancements in deep generative modeling approaches, such as diffusion, for LTR. We made our code publicly available at https://github.com/sadjadeb/DiffusionRank.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于去噪扩散的深度生成方法 DiffusionRank，用于学习排序（LTR），替代传统判别式方法。该方法对特征向量和相关性标签的联合分布进行建模，并在四个标准 LTR 数据集上取得比判别式对应模型更优的性能。
Motivation: 传统 LTR 方法多采用判别式模型仅建模文档相关性的条件概率，而生成式模型能更好地拟合数据完整分布，从而更准确地估计相关性。
Method: 提出 DiffusionRank，扩展了针对表格数据的去噪扩散生成模型 TabDiff，构造了判别式 pointwise 和 pairwise LTR 目标的生成式对应物。
Result: 在四个标准 LTR 数据集上的实验表明，DiffusionRank 模型相比其判别式对应模型有改进。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了深度生成方法（如扩散模型）在 LTR 中的潜力，并为未来研究开辟了空间。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Active Causal Experimentalist (ACE): Learning Intervention Strategies via Direct Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Discovering causal relationships requires controlled experiments, but experimentalists face a sequential decision problem: each intervention reveals information that should inform what to try next. Traditional approaches such as random sampling, greedy information maximization, and round-robin coverage treat each decision in isolation, unable to learn adaptive strategies from experience. We propose Active Causal Experimentalist (ACE), which learns experimental design as a sequential policy. Our key insight is that while absolute information gains diminish as knowledge accumulates (making value-based RL unstable), relative comparisons between candidate interventions remain meaningful throughout. ACE exploits this via Direct Preference Optimization, learning from pairwise intervention comparisons rather than non-stationary reward magnitudes. Across synthetic benchmarks, physics simulations, and economic data, ACE achieves 70-71% improvement over baselines at equal intervention budgets (p < 0.001, Cohen's d ~ 2). Notably, the learned policy autonomously discovers that collider mechanisms require concentrated interventions on parent variables, a theoretically-grounded strategy that emerges purely from experience. This suggests preference-based learning can recover principled experimental strategies, complementing theory with learned domain adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Active Causal Experimentalist (ACE)，将因果实验设计建模为序贯策略学习问题，利用直接偏好优化（DPO）从成对干预比较中学习，而非依赖非平稳的绝对信息增益。在合成基准、物理模拟和经济数据上，ACE在同等干预预算下比基线方法提升70-71%（p<0.001, Cohen's d~2），并自主发现对碰撞器机制需要集中干预父变量的理论策略。
Motivation: 传统因果实验设计方法（随机采样、贪心信息最大化、轮询覆盖）孤立地处理每次干预，无法从经验中学习自适应策略；而基于价值强化学习因绝对信息增益随知识积累递减而不稳定。
Method: 提出ACE框架，将实验设计学习为序贯策略，核心创新是使用直接偏好优化（DPO），通过成对干预比较（相对偏好）而非非平稳奖励幅度来学习策略。
Result: 在合成基准、物理模拟和经济数据上，ACE在同等干预预算下比基线方法提升70-71%（p<0.001, Cohen's d~2），且学习到的策略自主发现了对碰撞器机制需要集中干预父变量的理论策略。
Conclusion: 基于偏好的学习能够恢复原则性的实验策略，通过经验学习补充理论指导，但摘要未明确讨论在降水/天气预报等领域的应用或局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Temporal Graph Pattern Machine
papers.abstract_en: Temporal graph learning is pivotal for deciphering dynamic systems, where the core challenge lies in explicitly modeling the underlying evolving patterns that govern network transformation. However, prevailing methods are predominantly task-centric and rely on restrictive assumptions -- such as short-term dependency modeling, static neighborhood semantics, and retrospective time usage. These constraints hinder the discovery of transferable temporal evolution mechanisms. To address this, we propose the Temporal Graph Pattern Machine (TGPM), a foundation framework that shifts the focus toward directly learning generalized evolving patterns. TGPM conceptualizes each interaction as an interaction patch synthesized via temporally-biased random walks, thereby capturing multi-scale structural semantics and long-range dependencies that extend beyond immediate neighborhoods. These patches are processed by a Transformer-based backbone designed to capture global temporal regularities while adapting to context-specific interaction dynamics. To further empower the model, we introduce a suite of self-supervised pre-training tasks -- specifically masked token modeling and next-time prediction -- to explicitly encode the fundamental laws of network evolution. Extensive experiments on temporal link prediction and temporal node classification show that TGPM consistently ranks among the top-performing methods, demonstrating exceptional cross-domain transferability. Our code has been released in https://github.com/antman9914/TGPM.

papers.title: Boosting CVaR Policy Optimization with Quantile Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing Conditional Value-at-risk (CVaR) using policy gradient (a.k.a CVaR-PG) faces significant challenges of sample inefficiency. This inefficiency stems from the fact that it focuses on tail-end performance and overlooks many sampled trajectories. We address this problem by augmenting CVaR with an expected quantile term. Quantile optimization admits a dynamic programming formulation that leverages all sampled data, thus improves sample efficiency. This does not alter the CVaR objective since CVaR corresponds to the expectation of quantile over the tail. Empirical results in domains with verifiable risk-averse behavior show that our algorithm within the Markovian policy class substantially improves upon CVaR-PG and consistently outperforms other existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对CVaR策略梯度（CVaR-PG）样本效率低下的问题，提出通过引入期望分位数项来增强CVaR，利用分位数优化的动态规划形式充分利用所有采样数据。实验表明，在马尔可夫策略类中，该方法显著优于CVaR-PG及其他现有方法。
Motivation: CVaR-PG仅关注尾部性能，忽略大量采样轨迹，导致样本效率低下。
Method: 在CVaR目标中引入期望分位数项，利用分位数优化的动态规划形式，使算法能够利用所有样本数据。
Result: 在可验证风险规避行为的领域中，该方法在样本效率和性能上均显著优于CVaR-PG及其他现有方法。
Conclusion: 通过分位数梯度增强CVaR策略优化可有效提升样本效率，且不改变原CVaR目标。

papers.title: Rate-Distortion Optimization for Transformer Inference
papers.abstract_en: Transformers achieve superior performance on many tasks, but impose heavy compute and memory requirements during inference. This inference can be made more efficient by partitioning the process across multiple devices, which, in turn, requires compressing its intermediate representations. We introduce a principled rate-distortion-based framework for lossy compression that learns compact encodings that explicitly trade bitrate for accuracy. Experiments on language benchmarks show that the simplest of the proposed codecs achieves substantial rate savings, outperforming more complex methods. We characterize and analyze the rate-distortion behaviour of transformers, offering a unified lens for understanding performance in representation coding. This formulation extends information-theoretic concepts to derive bounds on the achievable rate of learned codecs. For different architectures and tasks, we empirically demonstrate that their rates are driven by these bounds, adding to the explainability of the formulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于率失真优化的框架，用于Transformer推理中的有损压缩，旨在学习紧凑编码以显式权衡比特率与准确性。实验表明，最简单的编解码器在语言基准上实现了显著的比特率节省，并优于更复杂的方法。论文还分析了Transformer的率失真行为，并推导了可学习编解码器可达速率的上界。
Motivation: Transformer推理过程计算和内存需求高，通常需要跨设备分区，这要求压缩中间表示。现有方法缺乏对比特率与准确性权衡的显式优化。
Method: 提出基于率失真优化的有损压缩框架，学习紧凑编码，并引入信息论概念推导可达速率上界。
Result: 在语言基准上，最简单的编解码器实现显著比特率节省，优于更复杂的方法，且率失真行为逼近理论界限。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了解释表示编码性能的统一视角，并增强了公式的可解释性。

papers.title: RelightAnyone: A Generalized Relightable 3D Gaussian Head Model
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a standard approach to reconstruct and render photorealistic 3D head avatars. A major challenge is to relight the avatars to match any scene illumination. For high quality relighting, existing methods require subjects to be captured under complex time-multiplexed illumination, such as one-light-at-a-time (OLAT). We propose a new generalized relightable 3D Gaussian head model that can relight any subject observed in a single- or multi-view images without requiring OLAT data for that subject. Our core idea is to learn a mapping from flat-lit 3DGS avatars to corresponding relightable Gaussian parameters for that avatar. Our model consists of two stages: a first stage that models flat-lit 3DGS avatars without OLAT lighting, and a second stage that learns the mapping to physically-based reflectance parameters for high-quality relighting. This two-stage design allows us to train the first stage across diverse existing multi-view datasets without OLAT lighting ensuring cross-subject generalization, where we learn a dataset-specific lighting code for self-supervised lighting alignment. Subsequently, the second stage can be trained on a significantly smaller dataset of subjects captured under OLAT illumination. Together, this allows our method to generalize well and relight any subject from the first stage as if we had captured them under OLAT lighting. Furthermore, we can fit our model to unseen subjects from as little as a single image, allowing several applications in novel view synthesis and relighting for digital avatars.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种通用的可重光照3D高斯头部模型，能够在不使用逐次光照数据的情况下对任意对象进行重光照。模型分为两阶段：第一阶段学习无逐次光照的3DGS头像，第二阶段映射到基于物理的反射参数。该方法支持从单张或多张图像重建，并实现高质量重光照。
Motivation: 现有3DGS头像重光照方法通常需要复杂的逐次光照捕捉，限制了泛化性和实用性。本文旨在消除对逐次光照数据的依赖，实现任意头像的通用重光照。
Method: 两阶段模型：第一阶段在无逐次光照的多视角数据集上训练，学习平坦光照下的3DGS头像，并引入数据集特定的光照编码进行自监督对齐；第二阶段在少量逐次光照数据上训练，学习从3DGS参数到物理基底反射参数的映射。
Result: 摘要表明该方法能够对未见对象进行重光照，支持从单张图像拟合，实现新颖视角合成和重光照应用。
Conclusion: 该方法通过两阶段设计实现了无需逐次光照数据的通用重光照，适用于数字头像的灵活部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PhyGDPO: Physics-Aware Groupwise Direct Preference Optimization for Physically Consistent Text-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in text-to-video (T2V) generation have achieved good visual quality, yet synthesizing videos that faithfully follow physical laws remains an open challenge. Existing methods mainly based on graphics or prompt extension struggle to generalize beyond simple simulated environments or learn implicit physical reasoning. The scarcity of training data with rich physics interactions and phenomena is also a problem. In this paper, we first introduce a Physics-Augmented video data construction Pipeline, PhyAugPipe, that leverages a vision-language model (VLM) with chain-of-thought reasoning to collect a large-scale training dataset, PhyVidGen-135K. Then we formulate a principled Physics-aware Groupwise Direct Preference Optimization, PhyGDPO, framework that uses real-world video as winning case to guarantee correct physics learning and builds upon the groupwise Plackett-Luce probabilistic model to capture holistic preferences beyond pairwise comparisons. In PhyGDPO, we design a Physics-Guided Rewarding (PGR) scheme that leverages VLM-based physical rewards to direct the optimization to focus on challenging physics cases. In addition, we propose a LoRA-Switch Reference (LoRA-SR) scheme that avoids full-model duplication as reference for efficient DPO training. Experiments show that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art open-source methods on PhyGenBench and VideoPhy2. Please check our project page at https://caiyuanhao1998.github.io/project/PhyGDPO for more video results. Our code, data, and models are publicly available at https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/Open-PhyGDPO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出物理感知的群组直接偏好优化框架 PhyGDPO，用于生成符合物理规律的文本到视频。通过构建大规模物理增强数据集 PhyVidGen-135K，并利用群组 Plackett-Luce 模型和物理引导奖励方案，显著提升了视频生成的物理一致性。在 PhyGenBench 和 VideoPhy2 基准上超越现有开源方法。
Motivation: 现有文本到视频生成方法在视觉质量上取得进展，但难以保证视频符合物理定律。基于图形或提示扩展的方法泛化能力差，且缺乏包含丰富物理交互的训练数据。
Method: 首先提出物理增强视频数据构建流程 PhyAugPipe，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）结合思维链推理收集大规模数据集 PhyVidGen-135K。然后提出 PhyGDPO 框架，以真实视频为获胜样本，基于群组 Plackett-Luce 概率模型捕捉整体偏好，设计物理引导奖励（PGR）方案并引入 LoRA-Switch 参考（LoRA-SR）机制降低训练开销。
Result: 在 PhyGenBench 和 VideoPhy2 基准上显著优于现有开源方法，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: 该方法通过偏好优化和物理奖励实现了更好的物理一致性视频生成，数据集和代码已开源。

papers.title: EgoExo-Con: Exploring View-Invariant Video Temporal Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Do Video-LLMs have consistent temporal understanding when videos capture the same event from different viewpoints? To study this question, we introduce EgoExo-Con(sistency), a benchmark of synchronized egocentric and exocentric video pairs with human-refined queries that ensure all concepts are visible in both viewpoints. EgoExo-Con emphasizes two temporal understanding tasks: Temporal Verification and Temporal Grounding. It evaluates not only correctness but consistency across viewpoints. Our analysis reveals two critical limitations of existing Video-LLMs: (1) models often fail to maintain consistency, with results far worse than their single-view performances. (2) When naively finetuned with synchronized videos of both viewpoints, the models show improved consistency but often underperform those trained on a single view. For improvements, we propose View-GRPO, a novel reinforcement learning framework that effectively strengthens view-specific temporal reasoning while encouraging consistent comprehension across viewpoints. Our method demonstrates its superior temporal understanding capabilities, especially for improving cross-view consistency. All resources have been made available at https://minjoong507.github.io/projects/EgoExo-Con/
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026; project page at https://minjoong507.github.io/projects/EgoExo-Con/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视频大语言模型（Video-LLMs）在不同视角下时间理解的一致性。作者构建了EgoExo-Con基准，包含同步的第一人称与第三人称视频对及人工精炼的查询，评估时间验证与时间定位任务上的一致性与正确性。分析表明现有模型跨视角一致性差，且简单联合微调反而会降低单视角性能。为此提出View-GRPO强化学习框架，增强视角特定时间推理并促进跨视角一致理解。
Motivation: 现有Video-LLMs在捕捉同一事件的不同视角时时间理解是否一致尚不清楚。作者发现模型在单视角表现尚可，但跨视角一致性远低于预期，且简单联合微调会损害单视角性能，急需针对性方法。
Method: 提出View-GRPO，一种基于强化学习的框架，通过分组相对策略优化（GRPO）在同步视角视频上训练，同时增强视角特有的时间推理能力和跨视角一致性。
Result: 在EgoExo-Con基准上，View-GRPO显著优于现有Video-LLMs，特别是在跨视角一致性指标上表现突出，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了视频时间理解中视角一致性的重要性，并证明强化学习框架View-GRPO有效弥补了该问题，但同时指出当前模型仍存在改进空间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Arguments that Alter Minds: LLM Rationales Sway Human (and LLM) Notions of Plausibility
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the degree to which human (and LLM) plausibility judgments of multiple-choice commonsense benchmark answers are subject to influence by (im)plausibility arguments for or against an answer, in particular, using rationales generated by LLMs. We collect 3,000 plausibility judgments from humans and another 13,600 judgments from LLMs. Overall, we observe increases and decreases in mean human plausibility ratings in the presence of LLM-generated PRO and CON rationales, respectively, suggesting that, on the whole, human judges find these rationales convincing. Experiments with LLMs reveal similar patterns of influence. Our findings demonstrate a novel use of LLMs for studying aspects of human cognition, while also raising practical concerns that, even in domains where humans are ``experts'' (i.e., common sense), LLMs have the potential to exert considerable influence on people's beliefs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM生成的合理性论证（赞成或反对）如何影响人类和LLM对常识选择题答案的 plausibility 判断。收集了3000个人类判断和13600个LLM判断，发现LLM生成的论证能显著改变人类的平均评分，LLM本身也表现出类似的受影响模式。结果表明LLM可用于研究人类认知，但也引发了对LLM影响人类信念的担忧。
Motivation: 探究LLM生成的论证是否以及如何影响人类（及LLM）对常识基准答案的 plausibility 判断，特别是人类作为“专家”的常识领域是否易受LLM影响。
Method: 收集3000个人类判断和13600个LLM判断，向人类和被试LLM提供LLM生成的赞成（PRO）或反对（CON）论证，测量前后 plausibility 评分的变化。
Result: 人类平均 plausibility 评分在PRO论证时上升，在CON论证时下降，表明论证有效；类似模式在LLM实验中也观察到。
Conclusion: LLM生成的论证能显著影响人类判断，即使是在常识这种人类专长领域；这为研究人类认知提供新方式，但也提出LLM可能操纵信念的实践担忧。

papers.title: SIMSplat: Language-Aligned 4D Gaussian Splatting for Driving Scenario Generation
papers.abstract_en: Driving scene manipulation using real-world sensor data has emerged as a promising alternative to traditional driving simulators. Despite advances in language control and neural scene representations, existing methods treat grounding, editing, and simulation as loosely connected stages, relying on heuristic object localization, manual guidance, and single-agent validation, thereby constraining semantic expressiveness and hindering scalable, reactive scenario generation. We introduce SIMSplat, a driving scene editor built on scene-graph-based 4D Gaussian Splatting augmented with language-aligned features. By embedding appearance, motion, and location semantics directly into Gaussian scene-graph nodes, SIMSplat makes reconstructed scenes queryable through free-form natural language, bridging language understanding to object-level editing and multi-agent simulation within a single framework. Building on this language-grounded scene graph, SIMSplat supports diverse edits including fine-grained pedestrian manipulation, while a multi-agent path refinement module propagates changes across all agents to ensure reactive, physically plausible simulations. The pipeline further integrates with Vision-Language Models for automated scenario mining. Experiments show that SIMSplat more than doubles baseline grounding accuracy, achieves the highest task completion rate, and produces the lowest failure rates across diverse driving scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SIMSplat是一个基于场景图的4D高斯泼溅（4D Gaussian Splatting）驾驶场景编辑器，通过将外观、运动和位置语义嵌入高斯场景图节点，支持自然语言查询和对象级编辑，并整合多智能体路径优化与视觉语言模型实现自动化场景挖掘。实验表明，该方法在接地准确性、任务完成率和失败率上均显著优于基线。
Motivation: 现有驾驶场景生成方法将接地、编辑和仿真视为松散连接的阶段，依赖启发式目标定位和人工引导，限制了语义表达能力和可扩展的交互式场景生成。
Method: 提出SIMSplat，使用语言对齐特征增强的场景图4D高斯泼溅，将语义嵌入节点以实现自然语言查询，并结合多智能体路径细化模块和视觉-语言模型进行自动化场景挖掘。
Result: 相比基线，SIMSplat的接地准确性提升一倍以上，任务完成率最高，并在多种驾驶场景中取得最低失败率。
Conclusion: SIMSplat通过语言对齐的场景图统一了接地、编辑和仿真，为可扩展的交互式驾驶场景生成提供了新范式。

papers.title: VDW-GNNs: Vector diffusion wavelets for geometric graph neural networks
papers.abstract_en: We introduce vector diffusion wavelets (VDWs), a novel family of wavelets inspired by the vector diffusion maps algorithm that was introduced to analyze data lying in the tangent bundle of a Riemannian manifold. We show that these wavelets may be effectively incorporated into a family of geometric graph neural networks, which we refer to as VDW-GNNs. We demonstrate that such networks are effective on synthetic point cloud data, as well as on real-world data derived from wind field and neural activity measurements. Theoretically, we prove that these new wavelets have desirable frame theoretic properties, similar to traditional diffusion wavelets. Additionally, we prove that these wavelets have useful symmetries with respect to rotations and translations.
papers.comment: Presented at ICML 2026. A previous, shorter version of this work was presented in the "New Perspectives in Advancing Graph Machine Learning" workshop at NeurIPS 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出向量扩散小波（VDW），一种受向量扩散图算法启发的新型小波族，并证明其可有效融入几何图神经网络（VDW-GNNs）。在合成点云、风场和神经活动实测数据上展示了有效性，并理论上证明了与经典扩散小波类似的框架性质以及旋转平移对称性。
Motivation: 现有图神经网络缺乏处理流形切丛上数据的内在几何结构，向量扩散小波提供了一种保留旋转平移对称性的框架，以更好地建模几何数据。
Method: 提出向量扩散小波，将其融入图神经网络架构形成VDW-GNNs，并证明其具有框架性质和旋转、平移对称性。
Result: 在合成点云数据以及风场、神经活动实测数据上验证了有效性。理论部分证明了新小波的框架性质和对称性。
Conclusion: 向量扩散小波可有效用于几何图神经网络，且具备理想的对称性，为处理切丛数据提供了新工具。

papers.title: Generalization of Fine-Tuned Uncertainty Communication and Metacognition in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Background. Large language models are increasingly used in settings where confident but incorrect answers can mislead users. Reliable uncertainty communication requires a form of metacognition: monitoring when one's own answers are likely to be correct. Yet models' stated confidence is often poorly aligned with answer correctness. We test whether supervised fine-tuning improves uncertainty communication and whether gains transfer across domains and task formats. Methods. We fine-tuned two models on general knowledge, mathematics, and open-ended trivia questions. We evaluated single-question confidence estimation, in which the model reports numeric confidence for one answer, and pairwise confidence comparison, in which it chooses which of two questions it is more likely to answer correctly. We tested held-out questions from training domains and new medical, legal, and truthfulness benchmarks. We assessed calibration, discrimination, and answer accuracy before and after fine-tuning. Results. Here we show that fine-tuning improves alignment between stated confidence and observed accuracy and increases the model's ability to assign higher confidence to correct than to incorrect answers. Gains occur within training domains and, to a lesser extent, in new domains. However, single-task training does not reliably transfer between single-question confidence estimation and pairwise confidence comparison. Multitask fine-tuning produces broader gains in the models and tasks studied here. Conclusions. Uncertainty communication in large language models is trainable, but transfer across metacognitive tasks is limited. Joint training on multiple confidence tasks may support broader generalization, although further tests across model families and metacognitive tasks are needed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究通过监督微调改善大型语言模型的不确定性通信能力，并考察其在不同领域和任务格式上的泛化。作者对两个模型在常识、数学和开放领域问题上进行微调，评估单问题置信度估计和成对置信度比较。结果表明微调能提升置信度与准确率的一致性，但训练任务之间的迁移有限，多任务微调可获得更广泛的提升。
Motivation: 大语言模型在应用中常出现自信但错误的回答，误导用户，而模型表达的置信度与真实正确率往往不一致，因此需要提高不确定性通信的可靠性。
Method: 对两个模型在常识、数学和开放领域问题上进行监督微调，然后评估单问题置信度估计（模型对单个答案报告数值置信度）和成对置信度比较（模型判断两个问题中哪个更可能答对），并在训练领域的保留问题和新的医疗、法律、真实性基准上测试。
Result: 微调改善了置信度与准确率之间的校准和判别能力，提升出现在训练领域内，并在一定程度上泛化到新领域；但单任务训练在两种置信度任务之间没有可靠迁移，而多任务微调带来了更广泛的收益。
Conclusion: 大语言模型的不确定性通信是可训练的，但元认知任务间的迁移有限；联合训练多种置信度任务可能支持更广泛的泛化，但需要跨模型族和更多元认知任务的进一步验证。
