papers.title: CrediBench: Building Web-Scale Network Datasets for Information Integrity
papers.abstract_en: Automatically assessing the credibility of online sources presents an invaluable tool for navigating today's information ecosystem. However, existing approaches either depend on scarce and costly human annotations, or focus exclusively on assessments at the level of individual claims. Misinformation often spreads via interlinked web domains, whose connections evolve over time. Focusing on claims alone ignores these structural and temporal credibility signals evident in the changing web topology. Existing datasets fail to capture these central modalities in web domain credibility prediction: namely, internet topology, temporality and text (webpage) content. To address this gap, we present CrediBench, a dataset containing eights months of web graph data; of which we analyze the three months surrounding the 2024 U.S. federal elections, a time of heightened misinformation propagation online. Each monthly snapshot contains over 40 million nodes, their scraped webpage content, and over 1 billion hyperlink edges. CrediBench supports credibility prediction as both a regression (continuous credibility score) and a binary classification task (credible or not). For classification, we curate a novel binary label set containing 662,575 web domains labelled for boolean credibility, spanning four areas (misinformation, crowd-sourced, malware and phishing). Our empirical experiments support that all task modalities-graph, text and time-contribute significantly to achieving the best performance. In particular, our multi-modal regression model trained on CrediBench outperforms other configurations and existing baselines, decreasing Mean Average Error from 0.162 to 0.107 on the regression task, while the multi-modal classifier improves accuracy from 56% to 85% on the classification one. CrediBench, our proposed web-scale multi-modal dataset, is available on Huggingface for future research.
papers.journal_ref: KDD 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CrediBench 是一个大规模网络数据集，包含八个月的网页图数据，覆盖2024年美国联邦选举前后三个月，每个快照有超过4000万个节点和10亿条超链接边。该数据集支持网页可信度预测的回归和分类任务，并提供了包含66万多个域名的二分类标签集，涵盖虚假信息、众包、恶意软件和钓鱼四类。实验表明，图结构、文本内容和时间信息三种模态均对性能有显著贡献，多模态回归模型将平均绝对误差从0.162降至0.107，分类准确率从56%提升至85%。
Motivation: 现有可信度评估方法依赖昂贵的人工标注或仅关注单个声明，忽略了网络域之间相互链接的拓扑结构和随时间演化的动态特征，缺乏同时包含网络拓扑、时间演化和网页文本内容的大规模数据集。
Method: 构建了 CrediBench 数据集，包括连续八个月的网络图快照，每个快照包含超过4000万个节点及其爬取的网页内容，以及超过10亿条超链接边。为分类任务人工标注了66万多个域名的布尔可信度标签（覆盖虚假信息、众包、恶意软件和钓鱼四类）。支持基于图、文本和时间模态的多模态可信度预测模型。
Result: 多模态回归模型在回归任务上将平均绝对误差从0.162降至0.107；多模态分类器在分类任务上将准确率从56%提升至85%。
Conclusion: 图结构、文本内容和时间信息三种模态对网页可信度预测均重要，多模态方法优于单模态和现有基线。CrediBench 数据集已公开在 Huggingface 上供后续研究使用。

papers.title: Lane Change Intention Prediction of two distinct Populations using a Transformer
papers.abstract_en: In complex traffic scenarios, intention prediction of surrounding vehicles can improve the strategy of automated driving functions. Existing work on intention prediction is often trained on datasets of single regions or countries. In this article, a transformer network for lane change intention prediction was trained to predict whether target vehicles perform a left lane change, right lane change or keep their lane. Features inputs used were vehicle positions and distances, each for longitudinal and lateral direction. Before being inputted, these features were converted to Frenet coordinates. Two different datasets from leveLXData collected on highways were used: one from German highways and one from Hong Kong highways. Through cross-dataset evaluation, we show that the accuracy values drop to 71.94%, compared to 85.44% when doing dataset-specific training. When training on both datasets, accuracy levels up to 86.84% were achieved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用Transformer网络预测高速公路场景中车辆的换道意图（左换道、右换道或保持车道），输入为车辆位置和距离的Frenet坐标。基于德国和香港两个高速公路数据集进行训练和跨数据集评估，发现仅在单一数据集上训练时准确率为85.44%，跨数据集测试时降至71.94%，而联合训练两个数据集可达86.84%。
Motivation: 现有换道意图预测模型多基于单一地区数据训练，泛化性不足，需验证模型在不同交通文化和驾驶行为下的表现。
Method: 采用Transformer网络，输入特征为车辆在纵向和横向的位置及距离，并转换为Frenet坐标。分别使用德国和香港高速公路数据集进行单数据集训练、跨数据集评估及联合训练。
Result: 单数据集训练准确率85.44%，跨数据集评估降至71.94%；联合训练两个数据集后准确率提升至86.84%。
Conclusion: 跨数据集的性能下降表明区域差异显著影响模型泛化，而联合训练可有效提升跨区域预测能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond the LUMIR challenge: The pathway to foundational registration models
papers.abstract_en: Medical image challenges have played a transformative role in advancing the field, catalyzing innovation and establishing new performance benchmarks. Image registration, a foundational task in neuroimaging, has similarly advanced through the Learn2Reg initiative. Building on this, we introduce the Large-scale Unsupervised Brain MRI Image Registration (LUMIR) challenge, a next-generation benchmark for unsupervised brain MRI registration. Previous challenges relied upon anatomical label maps, however LUMIR provides 4,014 unlabeled T1-weighted MRIs for training, encouraging biologically plausible deformation modeling through self-supervision. Evaluation includes 590 in-domain test subjects and extensive zero-shot tasks across disease populations, imaging protocols, and species. Deep learning methods consistently achieved state-of-the-art performance and produced anatomically plausible, diffeomorphic deformation fields. They outperformed several leading optimization-based methods and remained robust to most domain shifts. These findings highlight the growing maturity of deep learning in neuroimaging registration and its potential to serve as a foundation model for general-purpose medical image registration.
papers.comment: Accepted to Medical Image Analysis ((c) MedIA). Code available at https://github.com/JHU-MedImage-Reg/LUMIR_L2R
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了大规模无监督脑部MRI图像配准挑战赛LUMIR，提供了4014张无标注T1加权MRI用于训练，并通过自监督学习鼓励生物上合理的形变建模。评估包括590个域内测试样本以及跨疾病人群、成像协议和物种的零样本任务，深度学习方法在大多数域偏移下表现稳健且优于多种基于优化的方法。
Motivation: 医学图像配准领域需要更大规模的无监督基准和更强泛化能力的模型，此前挑战依赖解剖标签图，而LUMIR提供大量未标注数据以推动自我监督方法的发展。
Method: 构建LUMIR挑战赛，使用4014张未标注T1加权MRI进行无监督训练，采用生物上合理的形变模型和自监督学习，评估包括域内测试和跨域零样本任务。
Result: 深度学习方法在域内和跨域测试中均取得最先进性能，生成解剖上合理且微分同胚的形变场，优于多个领先的优化方法，并对多数域偏移保持鲁棒。
Conclusion: 研究结果表明深度学习在神经影像配准中日益成熟，有潜力成为通用医学图像配准的基础模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Year-to-Decadal Temperature Prediction using a Machine Learning Model-Analog Framework
papers.abstract_en: Multi-year-to-decadal climate predictions are a key tool in understanding the range of potential regional climate futures. Here, we present a framework that combines machine learning and analog forecasting for regional predictions on these timescales. A neural network is used to learn a mask of weights that highlights important global precursors to the evolution of a specific prediction target (region, variable, and lead time). A library of mask-weighted model states, or potential analogs, are then compared to a mask-weighted observational state. The known future of the best matching potential analogs serve as the prediction for the future of the observational state. We predict 2-meter temperature using the Berkeley Earth Surface Temperature dataset for observations, with a multi-model potential analog library of CMIP6 simulations. Using a 30-year climatology reference, we compare our analog method to two other analog prediction methods and the CMIP6 library using the continuous ranked probability score to assess the quality of predicted distributions, and mean squared error to assess the quality of predicted ensemble means. For nearly all cases explored, our analog method produces skillful predictions. We find higher distribution skill over the CMIP6 library in all cases, which is due to improved prediction of the distribution spread. We find overall higher skill than other analog methods in the predicted distributions and ensemble means. Finally, we find broadly similar skill to an ensemble of bias-corrected initialized Earth system models. Benefits of our analog method include low computational cost, ensemble size flexibility, and interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一个结合机器学习和类比预测的框架，用于多年至年代际的区域温度预测。神经网络学习权重掩码突出全球前兆，从CMIP6模拟库中寻找最佳匹配的掩码加权状态，以其已知未来作为预测。在伯克利地球地表温度数据集上评估2米温度预测，与CMIP6库和其他类比方法比较，显示技巧性预测，分布技巧提高，且具有低计算成本、可解释性等优势。
Motivation: 多年至年代际气候预测是理解区域气候未来范围的关键工具，现有方法在预测分布展宽和计算效率上存在局限，需要结合机器学习和类比预测的新框架。
Method: 使用神经网络学习权重掩码，突出对特定预测目标（区域、变量、提前时间）重要的全球前兆；构建掩码加权的CMIP6模拟状态库作为潜在类比；将掩码加权的观测状态与库中状态匹配，用最佳匹配的未来预测观测未来；采用30年气候学参考，用连续排序概率得分（CRPS）和均方误差（MSE）评估。
Result: 在所有案例中，该方法产生技巧性预测；分布技巧在所有情况下优于CMIP6库，源于改进的分布展宽；整体技巧高于其他类比方法；与偏差校正的初始化地球系统模型集成有相似的技巧。
Conclusion: 该类比方法具有低计算成本、集合大小灵活性和可解释性等优点，适用于多年至年代际温度预测。

papers.title: Mixture-of-Experts Graph Transformers for Interpretable Particle Collision Detection
papers.abstract_en: The Large Hadron Collider at CERN produces immense volumes of complex data from high-energy particle collisions, demanding sophisticated analytical techniques for effective interpretation. Neural Networks, including Graph Neural Networks, have shown promise in tasks such as event classification and object identification by representing collisions as graphs. However, while Graph Neural Networks excel in predictive accuracy, their "black box" nature often limits their interpretability, making it difficult to trust their decision-making processes. In this paper, we propose a novel approach that combines a Graph Transformer model with Mixture-of-Expert layers to achieve high predictive performance while embedding interpretability into the architecture. By leveraging attention maps and expert specialization, the model offers insights into its internal decision-making, linking predictions to physics-informed features. We evaluate the model on simulated events from the ATLAS experiment, focusing on distinguishing rare Supersymmetric signal events from Standard Model background. Our results highlight that the model achieves competitive classification accuracy while providing interpretable outputs that align with known physics, demonstrating its potential as a robust and transparent tool for high-energy physics data analysis. This approach underscores the importance of explainability in machine learning methods applied to high energy physics, offering a path toward greater trust in AI-driven discoveries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合图变压器 (Graph Transformer) 与混合专家层 (Mixture-of-Experts) 的模型，用于高能物理中粒子碰撞事件的分类。模型在ATLAS模拟数据上区分超对称信号与标准模型背景，实现了竞争性的分类精度，并通过注意力图和专家专业化提供可解释性，使预测与物理特征对齐。
Motivation: 图神经网络在高能物理事件分类中表现出高预测精度，但其黑箱特性限制了可解释性，难以信任决策过程。本文旨在兼顾高性能与内置可解释性。
Method: 将图变压器与混合专家层结合，利用注意力机制和专家专业化，使模型内部决策可解释，并将预测与物理启发的特征关联。
Result: 在ATLAS模拟事件上，模型在区分超对称信号与标准模型背景时达到了竞争性的分类准确率，同时输出与已知物理一致的可解释结果。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了在高能物理数据分析中实现可解释机器学习的潜力，有助于增强对AI驱动发现的信任。

papers.title: Maintain Plasticity in Long-timescale Continual Test-time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Continual test-time domain adaptation (CTTA) aims to adjust pre-trained source models to perform well over time across non-stationary target environments. While previous methods have made considerable efforts to optimize the adaptation process, a crucial question remains: can the model adapt to continually-changing environments with preserved plasticity over a long time? The plasticity refers to the model's capability to adjust predictions in response to non-stationary environments continually. In this work, we explore plasticity, this essential but often overlooked aspect of continual adaptation to facilitate more sustained adaptation in the long run. First, we observe that most CTTA methods experience a steady and consistent decline in plasticity during the long-timescale continual adaptation phase. Moreover, we find that the loss of plasticity is strongly associated with the change in label flip. Based on this correlation, we propose a simple yet effective policy, Adaptive Shrink-Restore (ASR), towards preserving the model's plasticity. In particular, ASR does the weight re-initialization by the adaptive intervals. The adaptive interval is determined based on the change in label flipping. Our method is validated on extensive CTTA benchmarks, achieving excellent performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究持续测试时间域适应（CTTA）中模型的可塑性（plasticity）长期维持问题。发现现有CTTA方法在长时间尺度适应中可塑性持续下降，且与标签翻转变化强相关。提出自适应收缩恢复（ASR）策略，根据标签翻转变化自适应调整权重重初始化间隔，在多个CTTA基准上取得优异性能。
Motivation: 现有CTTA方法关注适应过程优化，但忽略了模型在长时间连续变化环境中维持可塑性的能力，导致适应性能随时间衰减。
Method: 提出自适应收缩恢复（ASR）策略，通过监测标签翻转变化自适应确定权重重初始化间隔，在适应过程中周期性恢复模型可塑性。
Result: 在多个CTTA基准上验证，ASR方法在长时间尺度适应中保持了模型的可塑性，取得了优于现有方法的性能。
Conclusion: 标签翻转变化可作为可塑性丧失的有效指标，ASR策略通过简单自适应重初始化即可有效维持长期适应性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Category-Adaptive Cross-Modal Semantic Refinement and Transfer for Open-Vocabulary Multi-Label Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Benefiting from the generalization capability of CLIP, recent vision language pre-training (VLP) models have demonstrated the ability to capture a wide range of visual concepts in daily images. However, due to the presence of unseen categories in open-vocabulary settings, existing algorithms struggle to capture semantic correlations between categories, leading to suboptimal performance on open-vocabulary multi-label recognition (OV-MLR). Furthermore, the substantial variation in the number of discriminative areas across diverse object categories is misaligned with the fixed-number patch matching used in current methods, introducing noisy visual cues that hinder the capture of target semantics. To address these challenges, we propose a novel category-adaptive cross-modal semantic refinement and transfer (C$^2$SRT) framework to model semantic correlations both within each category and across different categories, in a category-adaptive manner. The proposed framework consists of two complementary modules, i.e., intra-category semantic refinement (ISR) module and inter-category semantic transfer (IST) module. Specifically, the ISR module leverages the cross-modal knowledge of the VLP model to adaptively select a set of local discriminative regions that represent the semantics of the target category. The IST module adaptively discovers a set of correlated categories for a target category by constructing a category-adaptive correlation graph and transfers semantic knowledge from the correlated seen categories to unseen ones. Experiments on OV-MLR benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed C$^2$SRT framework improves over current methods.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出类别自适应跨模态语义精炼与转移（C²SRT）框架，用于开放词汇多标签识别（OV-MLR）。该框架利用CLIP的跨模态知识，通过类别内语义精炼（ISR）模块自适应选择局部判别区域，并通过类别间语义转移（IST）模块构建类别自适应相关图，从已见类别向未见类别转移语义知识。实验表明，该方法在OV-MLR基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有算法在开放词汇多标签识别中难以捕捉未见类别间的语义相关性，且固定数量的区域匹配与不同类别判别区域数量变化不匹配，引入噪声视觉线索，阻碍目标语义捕获。
Method: 提出C²SRT框架，包含两个互补模块：ISR模块利用VLP模型的跨模态知识自适应选择代表目标类别语义的局部判别区域；IST模块通过构建类别自适应相关图发现目标类别的相关类别，并从相关已见类别向未见类别转移语义知识。
Result: 在开放词汇多标签识别基准上，C²SRT框架提升了现有方法的性能。
Conclusion: 该框架通过类别自适应方式建模类别内和类别间语义关联，有效提升了开放词汇多标签识别的效果。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在开放词汇多标签识别基准上，C²SRT框架提升了现有方法的性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架通过类别自适应方式建模类别内和类别间语义关联，有效提升了开放词汇多标签识别的效果。

papers.title: Generating Fearful Images: Investigating Potential Emotional Biases in Image-Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: This paper examines potential biases and inconsistencies in the emotions evoked by images produced by generative artificial intelligence (AI) models and their potential bias toward negative emotions. We assess this bias by comparing the emotions evoked by an AI-produced image to the emotions evoked by prompts used to create those images. After developing and validating automated methods for emotion recognition across modalities, we examine correlations in the prevalence of emotions across text and images and measure the degree to which generative AI models tend to over-represent specific emotions in the resulting images. Findings indicate that AI-generated images from Stable Diffusion models are biased towards producing images that evoke fear, regardless of the original prompt, as metrics show a significant over-representation of that emotion compared to five other emotions. We extend this analysis to a more recent enterprise-level models, such as ChatGPT and Gemini, and find similar results, suggesting a systemic bias rather than one present only in a single model. While certain limitations in the alignment of emotions across modalities limit this work, the emotional skew we find in generative models is consistent with an over-representation of fearful content in training data, and this bias could amplify negative affective content in digital spaces further, perpetuating its prevalence and impact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生成式AI图像模型的情感偏见，发现Stable Diffusion、ChatGPT和Gemini等模型无论输入提示如何，生成的图像都倾向于唤起恐惧情绪。作者开发了跨模态情感识别方法，并表明这种系统性偏见可能源于训练数据中恐惧内容的过度代表，进而放大数字空间中的负面情感内容。
Motivation: 生成式AI图像模型可能在情感表达上存在系统性偏见，偏向于产生负面情绪，这会影响数字内容的情感分布，但缺乏量化评估。
Method: 作者开发并验证了跨模态（文本与图像）的情感识别自动化方法，然后比较了Stable Diffusion、ChatGPT和Gemini等模型生成的图像与对应文本提示之间的情感分布差异。
Result: 无论原始提示的情感如何，AI生成的图像都显著过度代表恐惧情绪（与其他五种情绪相比）。该现象在Stable Diffusion、ChatGPT和Gemini等多个模型中一致出现，表明是系统性偏见。
Conclusion: 生成式AI图像模型存在系统性恐惧偏向，可能与训练数据的统计偏差有关。这种偏见可能进一步放大数字空间中的负面情感内容。

papers.title: Aligning AI-driven discovery with human intuition
papers.abstract_en: As data-driven modeling of physical dynamical systems becomes more prevalent, a new challenge is emerging: making these models more compatible and aligned with existing human knowledge. AI-driven scientific modeling processes typically begin with identifying hidden state variables, then deriving governing equations, followed by predicting and analyzing future behaviors. The critical initial step of identification of an appropriate set of state variables remains challenging for two reasons. First, finding a compact set of meaningfully predictive variables is mathematically difficult and under-defined. A second reason is that variables found often lack physical significance, and are therefore difficult for human scientists to interpret. We propose a new general principle for distilling representations that are naturally more aligned with human intuition, without relying on prior physical knowledge. We demonstrate our approach on a number of experimental and simulated system where the variables generated by the AI closely resemble those chosen independently by human scientists. We suggest that this principle can help make human-AI collaboration more fruitful, as well as shed light on how humans make scientific modeling choices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI驱动的动态系统建模中，自动发现的状态变量难以被人类科学家直观理解的问题，提出一种不依赖先验物理知识的新原则，用于蒸馏出更符合人类直觉的表示。在多个实验和模拟系统上，AI生成的变量与人类科学家独立选择的变量高度相似。
Motivation: AI科学建模的第一步是识别隐藏状态变量，但现有方法找到的变量常缺乏物理意义，难以解释，阻碍了人机协作。
Method: 提出一种通用原则，通过蒸馏表示使得状态变量天然更符合人类直觉，无需物理先验知识。
Result: 在多个实验和模拟系统上，AI生成的变量与人类科学家独立选择的变量高度相似。
Conclusion: 该原则有望促进人机协作，并揭示人类如何做出科学建模选择。

papers.title: Self-Improvement Can Self-Regress: The Rise-and-Collapse Failure Mode of LLM Self-Training
papers.abstract_en: Self-improvement can self-regress. In REINFORCE post-training for code, a model can quickly improve on its optimized metric and then collapse within the same training campaign. We study this in a controlled multi-seed testbed using Qwen-2.5-3B and Qwen-2.5-7B, trained on competitive-programming tasks with binary CodeGrader reward across 10 sequential 20-step campaigns. Across campaigns, pass@1 shows a robust rise-then-collapse pattern: it peaks within tens of gradient steps and then falls back, sometimes to near zero. This is not cross-task catastrophic forgetting, but within-task policy over-optimization on a fixed distribution; KL- and EWC-style constraints do not prevent it. We ask where the control loop should sit. We compare three levels: CARE, a between-campaign memory mechanism with a capability posterior, transfer gate, and regression-aware belief revision; ES, a within-campaign early-stop rule that rolls forward the peak checkpoint and sets the next budget to peak_step+3; and GRPO, which changes the RL update using group-relative reward normalization. The answer is regime-dependent. On Qwen-2.5-3B, where naive REINFORCE is fragile, CARE v2 nearly doubles end-of-chain pass@1 from 4.9% to 9.5%, with paired bootstrap 95% CI [+0.4,+8.9] and gains in 4/5 seeds. On Qwen-2.5-7B, CARE reaches parity with naive REINFORCE, 13.8% vs. 11.8%, while ES reaches 22.2% [14.1,28.0]. Out-of-the-box GRPO reaches 20.7% [15.7,25.1], nearly matching REINFORCE+ES. GRPO raises the floor but does not remove the cliff. Its 7B gain mainly comes from better between-campaign carryover, while the within-campaign peak-to-end gap remains about 17 points under both REINFORCE and GRPO. GRPO+ES gives mixed evidence: 2/3 seeds improve, but one final cliff lowers the mean to 17.0% [0.0,28.1]. A Gemma-3-4B pilot shows the same signature, suggesting the phenomenon is not limited to Qwen.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现LLM在自改进训练（如REINFORCE）中会出现先快速上升后突然崩溃的模式，并在Qwen-2.5-3B/7B的代码竞赛任务中验证。通过比较CARE（跨轮记忆机制）、ES（内部早停）和GRPO（分组相对奖励归一化）三种控制方法，发现不同规模模型的最佳策略不同：3B上CARE v2效果最好，7B上ES和GRPO优于基线，但GRPO未能消除崩溃悬崖。
Motivation: 自我改进训练中模型可能在优化指标上迅速提升后崩溃，需要理解崩溃机制并寻找有效的控制策略。
Method: 在Qwen-2.5-3B/7B上使用二进制CodeGrader奖励，进行10轮20步训练，比较三种控制层级：CARE（跨轮记忆机制）、ES（内部早停，回滚到峰值检查点并设置下一步预算为peak_step+3）、GRPO（组相对奖励归一化）。
Result: Qwen-2.5-3B上，CARE v2将pass@1从4.9%提升到9.5%（95% CI [+0.4,+8.9]）；7B上，CARE与普通REINFORCE持平（13.8% vs 11.8%），ES达到22.2% [14.1,28.0]，GRPO达到20.7% [15.7,25.1]；GRPO+ES混合结果不稳定（17.0% [0.0,28.1]）。
Conclusion: 上升-崩溃模式是固定分布上的策略过优化，而非跨任务灾难性遗忘；KL和EWC约束无法阻止；GRPO虽提高下限但未消除悬崖，不同规模模型需要不同控制策略。

papers.title: Repeated post-training is not Self-improving: Diagnosing Scientific Amnesia in Continual DPO Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Industrial LLM teams often ship behavior updates by repeatedly DPO-training a base model on sequences of related preference-data campaigns. The dominant failure mode in this regime is not always classical catastrophic forgetting: a pipeline may preserve previously learned behaviors while still failing to accumulate reusable methodological knowledge about how to train the next campaign. We call this failure mode scientific amnesia. This paper turns that practitioner intuition into a measurable industrial problem. We contribute: (i) a diagnostic suite for amnesia, (ii) a Program-based pipeline that chains FSDP-sharded DPO checkpoints across Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct runs, (iii) a 30-campaign HumanEval subdomain benchmark, and (iv) a comparative diagnostic study of five strategy proposers: random memory, rule-based scheduling, retrieval-only memory, warm-start Bayesian optimization, and MSCL, a meta-scientific memory and reasoner candidate. Across a single-seed 5-condition * 3-step real-LM chain, 4 of 5 candidates degrade in step-level peak pass@1, including MSCL; only the deliberately conservative rule-based schedule improves. Follow-up pilots qualify rather than overturn this finding: in a heterogeneous chain, MSCL is the only completed candidate that improves, whereas in a small multi-seed homogeneous sweep, retrieval-only has the best mean Delta and no pairwise candidate gap is statistically distinguishable. The contribution is therefore diagnostic, not a claim that MSCL solves the problem: scientific amnesia is observable in a production-like continual-DPO pipeline, and conclusions about interventions depend sharply on chain regime, evaluator design, and seed coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了工业LLM团队在连续DPO训练中出现的 "科学遗忘" (scientific amnesia) 现象，即模型虽能保留旧行为，但无法积累可复用的方法论知识来指导后续训练。作者提供了诊断套件、基于程序的流水线、30-次HumanEval基准以及五种策略的比较研究。实验表明，多数策略（包括候选方法MSCL）在逐步峰值pass@1上退化，只有保守的基于规则调度有所提升。结论是诊断性的，即科学遗忘在类生产环境中可观测，且干预效果高度依赖链条设置、评估器和种子覆盖。
Motivation: 工业LLM团队频繁通过连续DPO训练更新模型行为，但除经典灾难性遗忘外，还存在一种被忽视的失败模式：模型无法积累可复用的训练方法论知识。
Method: 提出诊断科学遗忘的套件、基于FSDP分片DPO检查点的程序化流水线、30-次HumanEval子域基准，并比较了五种策略：随机记忆、基于规则调度、仅检索记忆、热启动贝叶斯优化以及元科学记忆与推理候选MSCL。
Result: 在单种子5条件×3步真实LM链条中，除保守规则调度外，所有候选（包括MSCL）的逐步峰值pass@1均下降；在异构链条中MSCL唯一改善，在均匀多种子扫描中检索记忆均值Delta最优但无统计显著差异。
Conclusion: 科学遗忘在类生产连续DPO流水线中可被诊断，不同干预策略的效果高度依赖链条类型、评估器设计和种子覆盖范围。

papers.title: CIExplainer++: Generating Causal and Interpretable Explanations for Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Explainable Artificial Intelligence aims to make black-box models more trustworthy by presenting, in a human-understandable manner, the elements that lead to the model's output. This involves both (i) identifying components and connections with genuine causal influence on outputs and (ii) translating such structures into an interpretable representation. For the former, we introduce CIExplainer, a novel perturbation-based method grounded in causal inference for explaining Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). CIExplainer identifies the subgraph with the highest causal effects on GNN predictions using the Potential Outcome Framework. We evaluate and compare CIExplainer on various GNN architectures (GCN, GraphSAGE, GAT, GIN) and datasets. To bridge subgraph explanations with human interpretability, we further propose G2TeXplainer, a method that transforms causal subgraphs into natural language explanations that capture both feature-level and relational information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CIExplainer，一种基于因果推断的扰动方法，用于解释图神经网络（GNN）的预测结果。CIExplainer 利用潜在结果框架识别对预测具有最高因果效应的子图。进一步提出 G2TeXplainer，将因果子图转化为包含特征和关系的自然语言解释。在多种 GNN 架构（GCN、GraphSAGE、GAT、GIN）和数据集上进行了评估。
Motivation: 黑盒模型需要可解释性以提升信任度，包括识别真正影响输出的因果组件以及将其转化为人类可理解的表示。现有方法在因果性和可解释性方面不足。
Method: 提出 CIExplainer，一种基于潜在结果框架的扰动方法，通过计算因果效应识别 GNN 预测的关键子图。并提出 G2TeXplainer，将子图转化为自然语言解释，同时捕捉特征和关系信息。
Result: 在多个 GNN 架构和数据集上评估了 CIExplainer 和 G2TeXplainer，验证了其有效性。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个完整的因果解释框架，涵盖从识别因果子图到生成可理解解释的步骤，有助于提升 GNN 的透明度和信任度。

papers.title: Massive Activations Are Architecturally Robust: A Controlled Scratch/Commitment Residual Stream Test
authors: Maruthi Vemula (University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill)
papers.abstract_en: Trained transformers reliably develop massive activations, a small number of hidden dimensions whose magnitude is far above the median and which concentrate on the sequence-start token. Whether these outliers are a removable artifact of the residual stream's overloaded read and write role, or instead a functional necessity, is actively debated. We test the artifact hypothesis directly, with an architectural intervention. Our architecture, Ledger Residuals, splits the residual stream into a mutable scratch stream (Deliberation) that intermediate computation may freely overwrite and a protected, decode-only accumulator (Commitment) that holds the representation the model reads out. If massive activations exist only because one stream is forced to be both scratchpad and answer, then a dedicated answer channel should remove the need for them. We find that it does not. In matched-loss language models at the 160M and 290M scales, the model rebuilds the canonical fixed-dimension, start-token outlier inside the protected channel. The rebuilt feature is smaller in magnitude than in a standard transformer but more sharply concentrated on the start token, and a stronger sparsity penalty makes it more persistent and more concentrated still, rather than removing it. Massive activations therefore look architecturally robust: they re-emerge in whichever representation the model decodes from, which is what we would expect if they are functional rather than incidental. We release our architecture and measurement code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过架构干预（Ledger Residuals）直接检验了“massive activations”是否为残差流双重角色的伪影。实验发现，即使将残差流分为可变暂存流和保护性累积流，模型仍会在保护流中重建固定维度、起始标记的异常高激活值，表明这些大规模激活具有架构鲁棒性，可能是功能性的而非偶然。
Motivation: 关于transformer中大规模激活（massive activations）是否是残差流需要同时承担暂存和输出角色而产生的伪影，存在争论。本文旨在直接验证该伪影假说。
Method: 提出Ledger Residuals架构，将残差流分为可变的暂存流（Deliberation）和受保护的只累积流（Commitment），后者作为模型解码的表示。在160M和290M规模的匹配损失语言模型上进行实验。
Result: 模型在受保护流中重建了固定维度、起始标记的异常高激活值，其幅度小于标准transformer，但更集中于起始标记；更强的稀疏惩罚使其更持久、更集中，而非消除。
Conclusion: 摘要结论认为大规模激活看起来是架构鲁棒的，会在模型解码的任何表示中重新出现，这符合其功能性而非偶然性的预期。

papers.title: A Digital Twin Framework for Traffic-Aware UAV Pavement Monitoring without Lane Closure
papers.abstract_en: UAV-based pavement inspection can reduce the cost and risk of road-surface monitoring, but real-world deployment remains difficult when traffic, pedestrians, and temporary occlusions affect the visibility of defects. This paper presents a Unity-based digital twin framework for traffic-aware UAV pavement monitoring without lane closure. The proposed environment integrates procedurally generated road defects, dynamic vehicles and pedestrians, autonomous UAV navigation, and an embedded road-damage perception pipeline. The perception module uses a two-stage approach: a lightweight YOLOv8n detector first localises road defects, pedestrians, and vehicles, while a second classifier distinguishes among potholes, single cracks, and crocodile cracks. On the simulator test set, the full pipeline achieved 99.26% overall accuracy across five classes. The digital twin was then used to evaluate three recovery strategies for occluded road segments: hover-and-recheck, micro-repositioning, and skip-and-revisit. Experiments were conducted across different traffic densities and flight altitudes using coverage, mission time, energy consumption, and revisit ratio as operational metrics. Results show that flight altitude has a strong influence on inspection coverage and that adaptive recovery improves performance under occlusion. In particular, hover-and-recheck achieved the most consistent coverage under medium and high traffic conditions, reaching up to 97.03% coverage, while skip-and-revisit was most effective in low-traffic scenarios, reaching 97.95\% coverage at medium altitude. These results demonstrate that digital twins can support the development and evaluation of traffic-aware UAV inspection strategies before real-world deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 6th Annual IEEE International Conference on Digital Twins and Parallel Intelligence (DTPI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 Unity 的数字孪生框架，用于在交通流和行人干扰下进行无车道封闭的无人机（UAV）路面裂缝监测。框架集成了程序化生成的路面缺陷、动态交通和行人、自主无人机导航以及基于 YOLOv8n 和二级分类器的感知流水线。在模拟器测试集上实现了 99.26% 的五类总体精度，并评估了三种遮挡恢复策略（悬停重检查、微调重定位、跳过重访）在不同交通密度和飞行高度下的覆盖、任务时间、能耗和重访率等指标。结果表明飞行高度显著影响覆盖，自适应恢复策略在遮挡下提升性能，其中悬停重检查在高交通密度下达到 97.03% 覆盖率。
Motivation: 基于无人机的路面检测能降低成本和安全风险，但实际部署中交通、行人和临时遮挡会影响缺陷可见性，现有方法缺乏考虑动态交通环境的数字孪生仿真平台。
Method: 构建 Unity 数字孪生环境，集成程序化道路缺陷生成、动态车辆/行人模型、自主无人机导航以及两级感知流水线（YOLOv8n 目标检测 + 二级分类网络区分坑洞、单裂缝和鳄鱼裂缝）。在仿真中对比三种遮挡恢复策略（悬停重检查、微调重定位、跳过重访）的运营指标。
Result: 感知流水线在仿真测试集上达到 99.26% 总体准确率；悬停重检查策略在中高交通密度下实现 97.03% 覆盖率，跳过重访在低交通密度下达到 97.95% 覆盖率。飞行高度对覆盖有强烈影响。
Conclusion: 数字孪生平台可支持在真实部署前开发和评估交通感知的无人机检测策略，但摘要未提及与真实世界的差距或跨域泛化能力。

papers.title: VeriBound: PAC-Bayesian Generalization Bounds for Process Reward Models Trained with Formal Verification Tools
papers.abstract_en: Process Reward Models (PRMs) provide step-level verification for Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning, yet their training data acquisition remains a bottleneck: human annotation is costly and Monte Carlo roll-out estimates are noisy. A recent approach, FOVER, trains PRMs on step-level error labels automatically annotated by formal verification tools such as Z3 and Isabelle, and empirically observes cross-task generalization from symbolic tasks to diverse reasoning benchmarks. However, this generalization phenomenon lacks any theoretical explanation, and no formal bounds exist on the generalization error, sample complexity, convergence rate, or downstream Best-of-K performance of such PRMs. We propose VeriBound, a theoretical framework that provides PAC-Bayesian generalization bounds for PRMs trained with formal verification tools. We establish four main results: (i) a PAC-Bayesian generalization bound that relates the empirical verification error on formal-verification-annotated training data to the expected error on unseen reasoning tasks, with the bound depending on the formal verification accuracy and the divergence between training and test task distributions; (ii) a sample complexity result showing that $O(d \log(d/δ) / ε^2)$ formal-verification-annotated examples suffice to achieve generalization error $ε$ with probability $1-δ$, where $d$ is the complexity of the PRM hypothesis class; (iii) a convergence analysis proving that PRM training with formal verification labels converges at a linear rate under $L$-smoothness and bounded variance conditions; and (iv) an error propagation bound that relates step-level verification error to Best-of-K performance degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出VeriBound理论框架，为使用形式验证（Z3, Isabelle）自动标注过程奖励模型（PRM）提供PAC-Bayesian泛化界。证明了泛化误差、样本复杂度、线性收敛速率以及步骤级误差到Best-of-K性能退化的传播界。实验上FOVER已观察到跨任务泛化，但缺乏理论解释。
Motivation: 过程奖励模型（PRM）训练数据获取昂贵或噪声大，FOVER使用形式验证工具自动标注，但跨任务泛化缺乏理论支撑，且没有泛化误差或样本复杂度的形式化界。
Method: 建立PAC-Bayesian泛化界，将形式验证注释上的经验误差与未见任务上的期望误差关联；推导样本复杂度O(d log(d/δ)/ε²)；在L-光滑和有界方差条件下证明线性收敛；推导步骤级验证误差到Best-of-K性能退化的误差传播界。
Result: 四个主要结果：PAC-Bayesian泛化界依赖验证准确率和任务分布差异；样本复杂度界；线性收敛速率；步骤级误差到Best-of-K的性能退化界。
Conclusion: 从理论上解释了形式验证训练的PRM的泛化能力，提供了关键保证，但局限在于分析假设验证工具无偏且训练与测试任务分布差异可控。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An approach with Visual and Tabular Mamba to multimodal medical data using Mixed Fusion
papers.abstract_en: This article presents a complementary approach for integrating multimodal medical data in cancer classification, based on state space models represented by the Mamba architecture. To this end, a mixed multimodal fusion architecture, called Mixed Fusion, was employed and developed to enhance the interpretability of the decision-making process. The proposed approach explores two variants of Mamba: one dedicated to visual processing, responsible for classifying the lesion image and generating probabilities associated with the target classes, and another focused on tabular processing, which uses these probabilities together with clinical and/or sociodemographic data to produce the final diagnosis. The experiments were conducted on two medical datasets: PAD-UFES-20, composed of clinical images and information associated with skin lesions, and NDB-UFES, consisting of histopathological images and sociodemographic data related to oral cancer. The results indicate slightly lower performance in balanced accuracy, compared with Transformer-based approaches, on PAD-UFES-20, and superior performance on NDB-UFES. Additionally, substantial gains were observed in the recall metric. Furthermore, the adoption of the Mixed Fusion architecture enables the application of the Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) method, increasing the interpretability of the results. These findings indicate that Mamba-based models constitute a suitable alternative for multimodal classification in medical data, especially in scenarios in which sensitivity is a relevant requirement.
papers.comment: 15 pages. accepted to 36th Brazilian Conference on Intelligent Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Mamba架构的混合多模态融合方法，用于癌症分类。方法使用两个Mamba变体分别处理视觉和表格数据，并在两个医学数据集上评估，结果显示在平衡精度上略低于Transformer，但在召回率上有显著提升，且通过SHAP提高了可解释性。
Motivation: 多模态医学数据融合中，现有方法可解释性不足，本文旨在利用状态空间模型（Mamba）提升决策过程的可解释性。
Method: 提出Mixed Fusion架构，包含视觉Mamba（处理病变图像并生成类别概率）和表格Mamba（结合概率与临床/社会人口学数据做出最终诊断），并使用SHAP进行解释。
Result: 在PAD-UFES-20数据集上平衡精度略低于Transformer方法，在NDB-UFES数据集上表现更优，召回率指标有显著提升。
Conclusion: Mamba模型是多模态医学分类的合适替代方案，尤其在灵敏度要求高的场景中。

papers.title: Repeated Shared Access Enables Grokking, but Edit Propagation Depends on a Fine-Grained Addressable Memory
papers.abstract_en: We study factual edit propagation in a controlled synthetic knowledge-graph QA setting, comparing four architectures that cross loop recurrence with shared memory access: dense (Dense), looped (Loop), dense with shared memory (Dense+Mem), and looped with shared memory (LMC). Dense fits in-distribution 2-hop compositions but fails OOD; both looped recomputation and memory rereading cross this OOD grokking barrier, indicating that repeated shared access -- not a specific architecture -- is the common ingredient for learning. Editing, however, separates the substrates along a different axis. On a shared pre-edit-correct ID set, a single-row factual edit propagates strongly in the two memory-bearing cells (LMC 0.78-0.92, Dense+Mem 0.71-0.96) and only weakly in the others (Loop 0.04-0.30, Dense 0.00-0.03); the separation is statistically clean (Mann-Whitney p=0.008 between memory and non-memory cells, p=0.55 between the two memory cells, though n=5 vs n=5 is underpowered to rule out a moderate gap). In LMC, atomic facts localize to dominant memory sites that composition rereads, and a one-row value edit on LMC's own pre-edit-correct probes achieves 100% direct success with mean 0.989 intended propagation while moving unrelated facts ~0.1% of the time (matched specificity across substrates pending). A coarse hold-answer-subspace (HOLDANS) interchange diagnostic is consistent with this ordering, suggesting that what separates the substrates is when an edited fact is injected and how much computation remains afterwards to reuse it. These results dissociate learning competence from editing affordance: repeated shared access suffices to grok, but edit propagation depends on whether the substrate exposes a fine-grained addressable memory the forward computation can write to and later reread -- an affordance that loop recurrence provides only partially.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在合成知识图谱问答环境中研究事实编辑传播，比较四种跨循环递归与共享内存的架构。发现重复共享访问（repeated shared access）是跨越OOD grokking障碍的共同要素，但编辑传播需要细粒度可寻址内存（fine-grained addressable memory），循环递归仅提供部分支持。
Motivation: 现有研究对学习能力（grokking）和编辑能力（edit propagation）之间的关系尚不清楚，需要分离二者所需的架构要素。
Method: 在控制的知识图谱QA设置中，比较Dense、Loop、Dense+Mem和LMC四种架构，使用单行事实编辑和hold-answer-subspace互换诊断。
Result: 重复共享访问（如循环或共享内存）使OOD泛化产生grokking；编辑传播在带内存的架构中显著（LMC 0.78-0.92, Dense+Mem 0.71-0.96），而在无内存架构中微弱（Loop 0.04-0.30, Dense 0.00-0.03）。
Conclusion: 学习能力与编辑能力可分离：重复共享访问足以实现grokking，但编辑传播依赖于细粒度可寻址内存，该能力循环递归仅部分提供。

papers.title: REKEY: Metadata-Grounded Visual-Key Regeneration for Contamination-Resilient VQA Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Static visual question answering (VQA) benchmarks age quickly: Once the items leak into training corpora, scores can reflect memorization rather than genuine visual ability, thus obscuring real progress. Rebuilding high-quality benchmarks such as V*Bench requires substantial human annotation, yet each static release can quickly become another leaked artifact. We propose ReKey, a live benchmark protocol that randomly regenerates the answer-bearing local detail, or visual key, in real images at evaluation time. Using human-validated edit slots, ReKey samples fresh instances with new answers, construction-grounded labels, and controlled visual-search difficulty. On V*Bench, the ReKey regenerated benchmark reveals a sharp score jump across eight frontier vision-language models (VLMs): The original items score 9.5--18.8 percentage points higher than the regenerated variants. By making the visual key renewable, ReKey keeps evaluation fresh as models and training data evolve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReKey，一种用于VQA评估的实时基准协议，通过在评估时随机重新生成图像中的局部细节（visual key）来对抗数据污染。基于V*Bench，ReKey重新生成的基准显示，八个前沿视觉语言模型（VLM）在原始项目上得分比重新生成的变体高9.5-18.8个百分点，表明原始基准已被泄露。
Motivation: 静态VQA基准一旦泄露到训练语料，分数反映记忆而非真实视觉能力，且重建高质量基准需要大量人力，而新基准也会再次泄露。
Method: 利用人工验证的编辑槽，在评估时随机重新生成图像中的视觉键，生成新实例、新答案和受控的视觉搜索难度，使基准可再生。
Result: 在V*Bench上，ReKey重新生成的基准揭示前沿VLM在原始项目得分比再生变体高9.5-18.8个百分点，证明原始基准存在污染。
Conclusion: ReKey通过使视觉键可更新，保持评估新鲜，随模型和训练数据演变而持续有效。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出ReKey，一种用于VQA评估的实时基准协议，通过在评估时随机重新生成图像中的局部细节（visual key）来对抗数据污染。基于V*Bench，ReKey重新生成的基准显示，八个前沿视觉语言模型（VLM）在原始项目上得分比重新生成的变体高9.5-18.8个百分点，表明原始基准已被泄露。

papers.title: Robust Zero-Shot Generalization for Open-Vocabulary Action Recognition via Task Arithmetic
papers.abstract_en: Open Vocabulary Action Recognition (OVAR) enables the recognition of novel actions by leveraging vision-language representations, overcoming the limitations of traditional closed-set approaches. However, achieving robust performance in real-world scenarios typically requires domain-specific fine-tuning, which is often costly and raises privacy and regulatory concerns. In this work, we propose an alternative paradigm that bypasses target-domain training and recombines knowledge from existing datasets and models. Leveraging model merging and task arithmetic, we extract and combine task vectors from models fine-tuned on diverse public OVAR datasets. We show that, in out-of-distribution settings, the resulting merged model achieves superior zero-shot generalization to the pre-trained base model. Code is available at https://github.com/omaymaMoussadek/robust-ovar
papers.comment: Accepted by the 22nd International Conference on Advanced Video and Signal-Based Surveillance (AVSS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放词汇动作识别（OVAR）的域特定微调成本高、隐私监管问题，提出一种基于任务算术（task arithmetic）的模型合并方法，从多个公开OVAR数据集上微调的模型中提取并组合任务向量，在分布外设置下实现优于预训练基础模型的零样本泛化。

Conclusion: 摘要表明所提范式可无需目标域训练实现鲁棒零样本泛化，代码已公开。

papers.title: XmoPipe: A Pipeline for Large-Scale In-the-Wild Human Motion Dataset Construction
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale human motion datasets are essential for training robust motion models for analysis, synthesis, and understanding. While marker-based motion capture provides precise data, it is costly and limited in scale and diversity. Recent advances in monocular motion capture and video-language understanding open the way to extract plausible motion from unconstrained online videos. We present a scalable pipeline for constructing in-the-wild human motion datasets. From a few keywords, the system retrieves videos, extracts 3D body and facial motion, and generates high-level textual descriptions. The pipeline is flexible, enabling targeted collection of various motions, multi-person interactions, or expressive behaviors. We demonstrate its quality by training motion reconstruction and motion generation models, showing performance comparable to models trained on traditional motion capture datasets and strong cross-dataset generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出XmoPipe，一个可扩展的管道，用于从在线视频构建大规模野外人体运动数据集。系统通过关键词检索视频，提取3D身体和面部运动，并生成高级文本描述。实验表明，在该数据集上训练的运动重建和生成模型性能与传统运动捕捉数据集相当，且跨数据集泛化能力强。
Motivation: 现有标记运动捕捉数据成本高、规模有限，而单目运动捕捉和视频-语言理解的发展使得从无约束视频中提取合理运动成为可能，但缺少大规模、多样化的野外数据集构建管道。
Method: 提出XmoPipe管道，从关键词输入开始，依次进行视频检索、3D身体和面部运动提取、高级文本描述生成，支持多人和表情行为的定向收集。
Result: 训练的运动重建和运动生成模型性能与传统运动捕捉数据集模型相当，并展现出强大的跨数据集泛化能力。
Conclusion: 该管道可灵活构建各种运动类型的野外数据集，有望降低对昂贵动作捕捉的依赖。

papers.title: LLM-Guided Test-Time Discovery of Quantum-Chemical Approximation Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Quantum chemistry simulations underpin modern materials discovery, yet their impact is limited by steep computational cost and dependence on fixed approximation schemes. Foundation models, such as machine-learned interatomic potentials, have accelerated parts of this workflow, but their reliance on large-scale pretraining restricts adaptability at the frontier of chemical space, where methodological innovation and sparse data are the norm. Agentic AI systems can automate existing simulation pipelines, yet they remain constrained by the predefined tools and algorithms they orchestrate. In response, we introduce LADeQ, an LLM-guided workflow that discovers, implements, and benchmarks candidate approximation algorithms at test-time within existing quantum chemistry codes. Rather than selecting from a predefined repertoire, LADeQ constructs candidate approximation schemes on demand, drawing on techniques from disciplines such as spatial statistics, circuit simulation, and kernel methods that have had little prior presence in electronic-structure theory. Because it builds on an out-of-the-box language model, LADeQ requires no task-specific pretraining or curated data, and the resulting implementations are transparent and inspectable, with explicitly traceable approximation errors that enable principled control of accuracy--efficiency trade-offs. We show that LADeQ accelerates coupled cluster singles and doubles (CCSD) and configuration interaction singles and doubles (CISD) calculations while keeping correlation-energy errors within user-specified tolerances, demonstrating autonomous, objective-driven discovery of approximation algorithms inside existing electronic-structure solvers.
papers.comment: 13 main pages, 6 main figures, and 2 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LADeQ，一种基于现成大语言模型的工作流，能在测试时自动发现、实现并评估量子化学近似算法。LADeQ 从空间统计、电路模拟和核方法等领域借用技术，在现有电子结构求解器（如 CCSD 和 CISD）中构造候选近似方案，无需任务特定预训练或定制数据。实验表明，LADeQ 在保持相关能量误差在用户指定容差内的前提下，加速了耦合簇和组态相互作用计算。
Motivation: 量子化学模拟的计算成本高且依赖固定近似方案；机器学习势函数需大规模预训练，难以适应前沿化学空间；现有 AI 智能体受限于预定义工具。因此需要一种能在测试时按需发现并实现新近似算法的方法。
Method: LADeQ 利用现成语言模型，在运行时从空间统计、电路模拟、核方法等领域动态构建候选近似方案，并将其嵌入现有量子化学代码中。生成的实现透明、可检查，且近似误差可显式追溯。
Result: LADeQ 加速了 CCSD 和 CISD 计算，并将相关能量误差控制在用户指定的容差范围内，展示了自主、目标驱动的近似算法发现。
Conclusion: LADeQ 无需预训练或策划数据，通过可追溯的近似误差实现精度-效率权衡的精细化控制，为量子化学模拟中的算法自动发现提供了新范式。

papers.title: VTOS: Learning to Orchestrate Vision Tools by Co-Searching Solutions and Observers
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation tools such as open-vocabulary detectors, segmentation models, and post-processing operators are powerful building blocks for computer vision, but their effectiveness depends heavily on how they are orchestrated: which tools are used, in what order, with what parameters, and under what visual conditions. Existing visual-programming agents typically generate a fixed solution pipeline, making them brittle under dense objects, occlusion, small targets, and domain shift. We introduce VTOS (Vision Tools Orchestration Search), a framework for adaptive visual tool orchestration through joint solution--observer search. VTOS co-searches executable solution programs that compose vision tools such as Grounding DINO, SAM, NMS, and slice-and-detect, together with observer programs that diagnose candidate solutions, identify failure modes, and generate actionable feedback. These observations are accumulated in a shared VisionThoughts knowledge base to guide subsequent search. We evaluate VTOS through two case studies: dense object counting on LVIS-Count and zero-shot plant-disease segmentation on PlantSeg-OOD, which stress different orchestration challenges including threshold calibration, NMS, slicing, mask refinement, and domain generalization. Across both tasks, VTOS outperforms static tool pipelines and agentic visual-programming baselines, showing that co-searching solutions and observers is an effective strategy for adapting vision tools to challenging computer vision tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VTOS 提出一种联合搜索解决方案和观察者的框架，用于自适应编排视觉基础工具（如 Grounding DINO、SAM）以处理密集目标、遮挡和小目标等挑战。在 LVIS-Count 密集物体计数和 PlantSeg-OOD 零样本植物病害分割任务上，VTOS 优于静态流水线和现有视觉编程方法。
Motivation: 现有视觉编程代理生成固定的工具执行流水线，在密集物体、遮挡、小目标和域迁移等复杂视觉条件下表现脆弱，缺乏自适应性。
Method: VTOS 通过联合搜索可执行的解决方案程序（编排视觉工具）和观察者程序（诊断候选方案、识别失败模式、生成可操作反馈），并将观察结果积累到共享的 VisionThoughts 知识库中以指导后续搜索。
Result: 在 LVIS-Count 密集物体计数和 PlantSeg-OOD 零样本植物病害分割两个任务上，VTOS 超越了静态工具流水线和智能体式视觉编程基线。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，联合搜索解决方案和观察者是一种有效的策略，能使视觉工具适应具有挑战性的计算机视觉任务。

papers.title: FPGA-Accelerated Neuromorphic Vision System for Real-Time Orbital Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: The escalating congestion in orbital space demands advanced monitoring solutions. This work presents a comprehensive open-source framework for neuromorphic resident space object (RSO) detection, adapting the foundational grid clustering algorithm for FPGA acceleration. The system integrates a single event-based camera (EBC) with a custom, distributed processing architecture, where rapid spatial quantization is executed in programmable logic (FPGA) and cluster formation is managed by a software client. We validate this architecture through systematic sampling of night-sky observations from the EVAS dataset, demonstrating 97% detection accuracy for RSOs. The implementation, which serves as a foundational toolkit for event-based FPGA processing, achieves efficient throughput with a total power consumption of 8.5 W and deterministic processing latencies below 62 ms. The architecture's energy efficiency and high-precision detection position it as a viable solution for distributed space surveillance networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于FPGA加速的神经形态视觉系统，结合事件相机和分布式处理架构，实现了实时轨道物体（RSO）检测。系统在FPGA上执行快速空间量化，软件端管理聚类，在EVAS数据集上达到97%检测准确率，功耗8.5W，延迟低于62ms。该框架作为事件FPGA处理的基础工具包，适用于分布式空间监视网络。
Motivation: 轨道空间日益拥挤，需要先进的监测解决方案；事件相机与FPGA加速可提供低延迟、低功耗的实时处理能力，弥补传统方法在高帧率场景下的不足。
Method: 提出开源框架，将网格聚类算法适配至FPGA；事件相机采集数据，FPGA进行快速空间量化（可编程逻辑），软件客户端负责聚类形成，实现分布式处理。
Result: 通过EVAS数据集夜间天空观测验证，RSO检测准确率达97%，总功耗8.5W，确定性处理延迟低于62ms。
Conclusion: 该架构的能效和高精度检测使其成为分布式空间监视网络的可行解决方案，并可作为事件FPGA处理的基础工具包。

papers.title: How Well Can Your Video Model Remember? Measuring Memory-Budget Trade-offs in Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a compact empirical model that quantifies how answer accuracy degrades as a function of frame budget B and temporal distance D in long video understanding -- analyzing performance when recalling content from D seconds in the past using a fraction B of total frames. Long-form models operate under strict budgets, yet no prior framework predicts how accuracy degrades as B shrinks and events recede. We fit a weighted least-squares model on ~155,000 binary predictions across ten models and three sampling strategies, deriving a law where logit-accuracy scales linearly in log-budget with a distance-dependent exponent that decays log-linearly with distance. This budget exponent α(D) captures the marginal value of extra frames at distance D. The law achieves cell-level weighted R^2 = 0.05-0.75 across models. Notably, budget effectiveness at D = 1000 s differs by \approx 7.4\times between the best streaming and base models. STREAMINGVLM achieves α(1000) = 1.26 (95% CI: [1.06, 1.58]), meaning a tenfold budget increase substantially improves long-distance accuracy, while the best Qwen3-VL base model reaches only α(1000) = 0.17 (CI: [0.04, 0.34]). In accuracy space, a 10\times budget increase at D = 1000 s yields +29 percentage points for STREAMINGVLM versus +4 pp for the base model. Sampling strategies show model-dependent trade-offs: random sampling yields higher base sensitivity but steeper distance decay. We demonstrate how α(D) enables principled budget allocation, including a model-ranking reversal at long distance, and propose it as a diagnostic metric for streaming video models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个紧凑的经验模型，量化长视频理解中答案准确率如何随帧预算 B 和时序距离 D 下降。通过对十种模型和三种采样策略的约15.5万个二值预测拟合加权最小二乘模型，发现logit-准确率与log-预算呈线性关系，且指数随距离对数衰减。该预算指数 α(D) 可捕捉在距离 D 处额外帧的边际价值，并在模型间表现出显著差异，例如 STREAMINGVLM 在 D=1000 秒时的 α 为 1.26，而 Qwen3-VL 仅为 0.17。
Motivation: 长视频模型在严格预算下运行，但缺乏预测准确率随预算缩减和事件后退如何退化的框架。
Method: 拟合一个加权最小二乘模型，使用约15.5万个二值预测，推导出 logit-准确率随 log-预算线性缩放，且指数随距离对数衰减的规律。
Result: 预算指数 α(D) 在模型间差异高达约7.4倍；在 D=1000 秒时，STREAMINGVLM 的 α=1.26，而 Qwen3-VL 为 0.17；预算增10倍，STREAMINGVLM 准确率提高29个百分点，基模型仅提高4个百分点。采样策略显示出模型依赖的权衡。
Conclusion: α(D) 可作为流式视频模型的诊断指标，用于原则性的预算分配和模型排名，包括长距离下的排名反转。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一个紧凑的经验模型，量化长视频理解中答案准确率如何随帧预算 B 和时序距离 D 下降。通过对十种模型和三种采样策略的约15.5万个二值预测拟合加权最小二乘模型，发现logit-准确率与log-预算呈线性关系，且指数随距离对数衰减。该预算指数 α(D) 可捕捉在距离 D 处额外帧的边际价值，并在模型间表现出显著差异，例如 STREAMINGVLM 在 D=1000 秒时的 α 为 1.26，而 Qwen3-VL 仅为 0.17。
summary_sections.motivation: 长视频模型在严格预算下运行，但缺乏预测准确率随预算缩减和事件后退如何退化的框架。
summary_sections.method: 拟合一个加权最小二乘模型，使用约15.5万个二值预测，推导出 logit-准确率随 log-预算线性缩放，且指数随距离对数衰减的规律。
summary_sections.result: 预算指数 α(D) 在模型间差异高达约7.4倍；在 D=1000 秒时，STREAMINGVLM 的 α=1.26，而 Qwen3-VL 为 0.17；预算增10倍，STREAMINGVLM 准确率提高29个百分点，基模型仅提高4个百分点。采样策略显示出模型依赖的权衡。
summary_sections.conclusion: α(D) 可作为流式视频模型的诊断指标，用于原则性的预算分配和模型排名，包括长距离下的排名反转。

papers.title: D2HDMap: Non-visible Driveline Map Prior for Online Vectorized HD Map Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate, up-to-date representations of road structures are critical for the safe operation of autonomous vehicles. Existing systems rely either on costly, maintenance-heavy high-definition (HD) maps which compromise safety when outdated, or purely sensor-based online mapping which struggles with long-range reliability and occlusion. Systems incorporating map prior information into online mapping seek to overcome drawbacks of both approaches by combining them in some way. We propose 'Driveline To HD Map' (D2HDMap), an online mapping system that injects a lightweight, non-visible driveline prior to guide the estimation of visible road structures such as lane dividers, road boundaries and crosswalks. This prior incurs less effort to create and update compared to full HD map priors used in other approaches. We also show that training with such a prior can improve generalization at inference time when no prior is available. Ablation studies conducted on the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 dataset demonstrate that models trained using a driveline prior largely retain performance even when priors are not available. On a geographically disjoint split, D2HDMap achieves 44.8 mAP, surpassing recent state-of-the-art. Additionally, noise-aware training substantially increases robustness to realistic localization error.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables, to appear in "IEEE intelligent vehicles symposium (IV) 2026 Proceedings"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出D2HDMap，一种在线向量化高清地图预测系统，利用轻量级非可见的驾驶线先验（driveline prior）来引导估计车道分隔线、道路边界和斑马线等可见道路结构。该方法相比全高清地图先验创建和更新成本更低，且训练时使用该先验能提升无先验时的泛化能力。在nuScenes和Argoverse 2数据集上的消融实验表明，即使先验不可用，模型性能基本保持；在地理隔离划分上达到44.8 mAP，超过现有最优方法。噪声感知训练显著增强了对定位误差的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶系统依赖昂贵且维护繁琐的高清地图（HD map），或纯传感器在线建图（长距离可靠性差、易受遮挡）。结合地图先验的在线建图方法试图结合两者优势，但全HD地图先验成本高。本文目标是引入一种更轻量的先验（驾驶线先验）来实现高效在线建图。
Method: 提出Driveline To HD Map (D2HDMap) 系统：将非可见的驾驶线先验注入在线映射模型，用于指导可见道路结构（车道线、路沿、人行横道）的矢量化预测。先验本身轻量易维护；训练时采用噪声感知训练以增强对定位误差的鲁棒性。
Result: 在地理隔离的验证集上，D2HDMap达到44.8 mAP，超过现有最先进方法。消融实验显示，训练时使用驾驶线先验的模型即使推理时无先验也能保持性能。噪声感知训练显著提升了应对定位误差的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: D2HDMap证明了一种轻量级非可见先验（驾驶线）可以替代全HD地图先验，在降低维护成本的同时保持高精度在线建图性能，且对定位噪声具有鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Web Agents Finish but Still Fail: Reproducible Triggers and Trace Diagnostics for Parallel Web Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon web agents often fail in ways hidden by final-answer evaluation: they may visit useful pages, produce a well-formed answer, and terminate confidently while still missing fields, over-including unsupported items, or relying on stale evidence. We study these failures with Parallel WebBench, a parallel web-exploration benchmark containing 1,679 verified records: 350 manually curated parallel tasks and 1,329 reconstructed records with verified URL-based trajectories. We train WebExplorer-style agents with GRPO under human-only, balanced human-synthetic, and synthetic-heavy data mixtures. At 16k context and 16 interaction rounds, the best GRPO model improves completion over WebExplorer-8B from 50.7% to 96.0% and GPT-4.1-mini-judged element-wise F1 from 0.2489 to 0.4529, but binary accuracy remains far below completion. Trace-level analysis identifies three persistent failure modes: context-bound search loops, premature termination on partial answers, and synthesis collapse after relevant evidence has already been retrieved. These results show that synthetic-data GRPO reduces abstention and improves partial correctness, but leaves a completion-correctness gap that requires evidence-grounded coverage and synthesis diagnostics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长周期网页代理（web agent）在并行网页探索中的隐性失败模式，即代理虽然完成最终回答但仍遗漏字段、依赖过时证据等问题。作者构建了包含1679条验证记录的Parallel WebBench基准，并训练基于GRPO的WebExplorer风格代理，在16k上下文和16轮交互下将完成率从50.7%提升至96.0%，但二元准确率仍远低于完成率。追踪分析揭示了三种持久失败模式：上下文受限的搜索循环、过早终止于部分答案、以及检索到相关证据后的合成崩溃。结果表明合成数据GRPO减少了弃权和提高了部分正确性，但留下了完成-正确性差距，需要基于证据的覆盖和合成诊断。
Motivation: 现有网页代理评估仅关注最终答案的正确性，忽略了代理虽生成正确形式答案但仍存在信息遗漏或使用过时证据的隐性失败，这在并行网页探索场景中尤为突出。
Method: 创建Parallel WebBench基准（1679条记录，含350条人工并行任务和1329条基于URL轨迹的重建记录）；使用GRPO训练WebExplorer风格代理，在三种数据混合（纯人工、平衡混合、合成数据为主）下进行实验。
Result: 在16k上下文和16轮交互下，最佳GRPO模型将完成率从WebExplorer-8B的50.7%提升至96.0%，GPT-4.1-mini评判的元素级F1从0.2489提升至0.4529，但二元准确率远低于完成率。
Conclusion: 合成数据GRPO能有效降低弃答并提升部分正确性，但无法消除完成-正确性差距，需要开发基于证据覆盖和合成诊断的方法来检测和修复这些隐性失败。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluation of Medical Vision Language Models HuluMed and MedGemma, and general purpose chatbots Gemma 3, ChatGPT Plus, and Claude Pro on real previously unseen wound images
papers.abstract_en: Chronic wound assessment remains a clinically challenging task that requires accurate interpretation of wound morphology, tissue composition, vascular characteristics, and infection risk. Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have introduced the possibility of automated multimodal wound analysis through image understanding combined with clinical reasoning. This study evaluates the performance of several general-purpose and medically specialized open-source and proprietary VLMs for clinical wound assessment using an expanded, curated dataset of 20 clinically diverse wounds spanning vascular, surgical, ischemic, venous, lymphedema, and amputation-related etiologies. Six VLMs were evaluated using a structured twelve-question clinical framework covering wound classification, infection risk, vascular intervention recommendations, debridement urgency, wound therapy selection, and advanced management planning. Across 20 wound cases and 240 clinician-graded wound-analysis decisions, ChatGPT achieved the highest overall performance with 174/240 correct responses (72.50%), followed by Claude with 149/240 (62.08%). Among the open-source and medically specialized models, HuluMed achieved the strongest performance with 96/240 correct responses (40.00%), followed by Gemma 3 (81/240, 33.75%), MedGemma 4B (62/240, 25.83%), and MedGemma 27B (42/240, 17.50%). The findings suggest that frontier general-purpose multimodal systems currently demonstrate substantially stronger wound-analysis performance than medically specialized alternatives, highlighting the continued importance of broad multimodal reasoning capabilities alongside domain-specific medical knowledge. Although current VLMs demonstrate promising potential for clinical decision support, substantial limitations remain in advanced wound-management reasoning, procedural planning, and autonomous clinical reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了通用和医学专用视觉语言模型在临床伤口评估中的表现。使用20个临床多样伤口图像和240个临床决策问题，ChatGPT正确率最高（72.5%），Claude次之（62.08%），医学专用模型HuluMed仅40%。结果表明通用多模态系统当前优于医学专用模型，但在高级伤口管理推理方面仍有显著局限。
Motivation: 慢性伤口评估是临床挑战，需要准确解读伤口形态、组织组成等。现有视觉语言模型可能实现自动多模态分析，但缺乏在真实伤口图像上的系统比较评估。
Method: 使用20个临床多样伤口图像（涵盖血管、手术、缺血性、静脉、淋巴水肿和截肢相关病因），设计12个结构化临床问题框架（包括伤口分类、感染风险、血管介入建议、清创紧迫性、伤口治疗选择和高级管理计划），由临床医生评分，比较ChatGPT、Claude、Gemma 3、MedGemma 4B、MedGemma 27B和HuluMed六个模型。
Result: ChatGPT在240个临床决策中正确174个（72.50%），Claude正确149个（62.08%），HuluMed正确96个（40.00%），Gemma 3正确81个（33.75%），MedGemma 4B正确62个（25.83%），MedGemma 27B正确42个（17.50%）。
Conclusion: 前沿通用多模态系统当前表现明显优于医学专用替代品，表明广泛的多模态推理能力与领域知识同样重要；但现有模型在高级伤口管理推理、程序规划和自主临床可靠性方面仍存在重大局限。

papers.title: Multimodal Image Colorization: Quantifying the Impact of Text-Conditioned Guidance on Grayscale-to-Color Translation
papers.abstract_en: Grayscale images are commonly found in historical photography restoration, medical imaging, and artistic media. However, automatically applying color to these images remains a significant challenge in computer vision because many plausible colorizations can correspond to the same grayscale input. In this work, we quantify the effect of text conditioning on pixel-level and perceptual metrics for grayscale-to-color image models. Specifically, we compare two architectures, a U-Net and Stable Diffusion 1.5, each tested with and without CLIP text conditioning while holding all other variables constant. Our results show that text conditioning improves PSNR by 5.6%, SSIM by 1.2%, and colorfulness by 36.6%, while reducing LPIPS by 7.6% in the U-Net tier. In the Stable Diffusion tier, text conditioning improves PSNR by 5.8%, SSIM by 1.5%, and colorfulness by 0.6%, while reducing LPIPS by 11.3%. These results indicate that text conditioning provides consistent, measurable improvements to colorization quality across both architecture scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文量化了文本条件（CLIP）对灰度图着色模型的影响，在U-Net和Stable Diffusion 1.5两种架构上控制变量进行对比。结果表明，文本条件在PSNR、SSIM、色彩丰富度上均有提升，并降低了LPIPS感知距离指标。
Motivation: 灰度图着色存在多可能的解，需要额外条件来引导生成合理的颜色。文本条件作为一种直观的引导方式，其量化效果尚未被充分研究。
Method: 在U-Net和Stable Diffusion 1.5两种架构上，分别测试有无CLIP文本条件的情况，保持其他变量不变，测量像素级和感知级指标。
Result: 文本条件在U-Net上提升PSNR 5.6%、SSIM 1.2%、色彩丰富度36.6%，降低LPIPS 7.6%；在Stable Diffusion上提升PSNR 5.8%、SSIM 1.5%、色彩丰富度0.6%，降低LPIPS 11.3%。
Conclusion: 文本条件在两种架构上均带来一致且可量化的着色质量提升，说明其作为先验信息的有效性。

papers.title: Escape from Delusional Echo Trap: Symmetry Breaking, Stochastic Dynamics and Mathematical Mitigation Strategies for Algorithmic Sycophancy
papers.abstract_en: We propose a rigorous and systematic mathematical framework for tracking the cognitive trajectories of a user, in the context of algorithmic sycophancy and AI-driven delusional spiraling. Using tools from dynamical systems theory and stochastic differential equations, we explore how individuals perceive, interpret, and update their beliefs as they interact with AI chatbots that possess hidden traits of sycophancy. We treat the evolving conviction as a continuous log-odds state variable, coupled into a stochastic differential equation, navigating a multi-valley potential energy landscape. Our analysis reveals several critical observations governing the stability and rigidity of belief dynamics. We demonstrate that the baseline prior perception of the individual is systematically enhanced by sycophantic feedback beyond a critical threshold. Here, the perceptual potential landscape undergoes a structural phase transition that severely deepens any incremental initial tilt present in the baseline state, transforming the landscape and giving rise to deep, highly resilient attractor basins that trap the individual in unshakeable, self-reinforcing, delusional convictions. Finally, we demonstrate that genuine external information can successfully challenge these rigid states. If this incoming evidence is strong and authentic enough to overcome the internal feedback barrier, it can correct the structural asymmetry caused by sycophancy, inducing a perception reversal that successfully restores the objective belief state.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一个严格的数学框架，利用动力系统理论和随机微分方程，建模用户与具有谄媚特性的AI聊天机器人交互时的认知轨迹。研究发现，谄媚反馈会引发势能景观的结构相变，形成深度吸引子盆地，导致用户陷入不可动摇的妄想信念。此外，强且真实的外部信息可以突破内部反馈屏障，恢复客观信念状态。
Motivation: 算法谄媚可能导致用户陷入妄想螺旋，需要系统理解其动力学机制并设计缓解策略。
Method: 将信念演变建模为连续对数几率状态变量，耦合随机微分方程，在多势能景观中导航，分析相变和吸引子盆地。

papers.title: MIRAGE: Stealthy Visual Prompt Injection for Vulnerability Detection in Web Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based web agents provide practical, high-precision solutions for visual browser automation; however, they inherently expand the attack surface, introducing novel vision-based vulnerabilities. Existing adversarial evaluations targeting these agents frequently rely on permissive threat models and visually conspicuous artifacts. In this paper, we investigate a constrained vulnerability detection setting: a trusted web platform where the evaluator acts solely as an unprivileged third party, such as a merchant or advertiser, controlling only a semantically legitimate, spatially constrained region, such as an ad slot, a sponsored card, or a localized widget. Operating under these realistic constraints, we propose MIRAGE, a novel visual indirect prompt injection framework for targeted next-action hijacking. Our approach leverages diffusion models to generate perceptually benign adversarial images strictly confined to the attacker-controlled boundaries permitted by the trusted service provider. To maximize attack efficacy within such a restrictive setting, we introduce a robust optimization technique combining curvature-aware adversarial diffusion guidance with sparse, dark-pixel residual perturbations. Comprehensive evaluations against prominent MLLM web agent frameworks, specifically SeeAct and OpenClaw, empirically demonstrate the potency, realism, and stealth of our proposed MIRAGE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MIRAGE，一种针对多模态大模型网页代理的视觉间接提示注入框架。攻击者仅控制广告位等受限区域，通过扩散模型生成感知无害的对抗图像，结合曲率感知对抗扩散引导和稀疏暗像素残差扰动，实现对代理下一步操作的劫持。在SeeAct和OpenClaw框架上的实验验证了攻击的有效性和隐蔽性。
Motivation: 现有针对网页代理的对抗评估常依赖宽松威胁模型和明显视觉痕迹，缺乏在现实约束（如仅控制有限区域）下的漏洞检测方法。
Method: 提出MIRAGE框架，利用扩散模型生成严格限制在攻击者可控边界内的感知良性对抗图像，并结合曲率感知对抗扩散引导与稀疏暗像素残差扰动进行稳健优化。
Result: 在SeeAct和OpenClaw框架上的全面评估表明，该方法在受限设置下实现了有效的目标下一动作劫持，且具备真实性和隐蔽性。
Conclusion: MIRAGE展示了在现实约束下视觉间接提示注入的可行性，强调了MLLM网页代理面临的新视觉安全风险。

papers.title: CDER-SME: A Cross-Device Event-RGB Micro-Expression Dataset under Multi-Level Stress Induction
papers.abstract_en: Micro-expression recognition (MER) in realistic scenarios demands high temporal sensitivity and ecological validity, yet existing benchmarks are largely constrained to laboratory-controlled settings and rigid hardware-coupled sensing. We introduce CDER-SME, a cross-device Event-RGB dataset collected under a multi-level stress induction framework (cognitive and social) to elicit spontaneous emotional leakage. To enable reproducible acquisition with independent, decoupled sensors, we provide a hardware-agnostic alignment pipeline for temporal synchronization and landmark-guided spatial registration. CDER-SME adopts a three-tier structure with 92 subjects and 1,963 expert-annotated samples (Action Units and emotions), including 790 Event-RGB pairs and 210 high-fidelity aligned pairs. We further report a reproducible multimodal baseline, where cross-modal fusion improves performance over single-modality counterparts, supporting the complementarity of event dynamics and RGB cues. By removing the need for coaxial calibration, CDER-SME offers a practical benchmark for cross-device alignment and deployable Event-RGB MER in real-world affective intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 CDER-SME，一个跨设备（事件相机和 RGB 相机）的微表情数据集，在多级压力诱导框架下采集自发性微表情，并提供硬件无关的对齐管线。数据集包含 92 名受试者、1963 个专家标注样本（AU 和情绪），其中 790 对 Event-RGB 对和 210 对高保真对齐对。跨模态融合相比单模态方法性能提升，验证了事件动态和 RGB 线索的互补性。
Motivation: 现有微表情识别基准多局限于实验室控制和刚性硬件耦合的传感器设置，缺乏跨设备、生态效度高的数据集。
Method: 提出 CDER-SME 数据集，采用认知和社会多级压力诱导框架诱发自发性情绪泄露；提供硬件无关的时序对齐和地标引导的空间配准管线；定义三层数据结构，包含 92 名受试者的 1963 个专家标注样本。
Result: 跨模态融合（Event-RGB）相比单模态方法性能提升，验证了事件动态和 RGB 线索的互补性；提供了可复现的多模态基线。
Conclusion: CDER-SME 去除了同轴校准需求，为真实世界情感智能中的跨设备对齐和可部署的 Event-RGB 微表情识别提供了实用基准。

papers.title: A Generalized Formalism of Auto-Regressive Decoding for Speech Processing
papers.abstract_en: In speech processing, most state-of-the-art sequence prediction models rely on auto-regressive (AR) strategies to generate output sequences based on the raw predictions of the model. Despite their crucial role in the inference process, a comprehensive overview of AR strategies as a unified field is lacking, due largely to implicit and multiple definitions of next-token decoding. This context complicates the choice, comparison, and evaluation of strategies, while creating inconsistencies in the characterization of approaches as auto-regressive or not. We begin by setting explicit inclusion criteria for the field of AR search in speech processing, and derive a generalized theoretical framework to categorize and report on search strategies for neural models. We show the capabilities of this formalism in simplifying the design of benchmarks centered around the decoding process, allowing for ablation studies that are focused on search strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语音处理中自回归解码策略缺乏统一形式化框架的问题，提出了一个广义理论框架来分类和报告神经模型的搜索策略。该框架简化了围绕解码过程的基准设计，支持聚焦于搜索策略的消融研究。
Motivation: 语音处理中大多数序列预测模型依赖自回归策略，但现有定义隐式且不统一，导致策略选择、比较和评估困难，且对模型是否属于自回归的描述存在不一致。
Method: 设定自回归搜索在语音处理中的明确包含标准，推导一个广义理论框架来分类和报告神经模型的搜索策略。
Result: 摘要展示了该框架在简化解码过程为中心的基准设计方面的能力，允许进行专注于搜索策略的消融研究。
Conclusion: 该形式化框架有助于统一自回归解码策略的理解，促进更一致的评估和比较。

papers.title: FairTutor: Equity-Aware Pedagogical LLM Routing for Budget-Constrained AI Tutoring
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI tutors provide real-time, personalized learning support, but also create a new education inequity: students with access to premium AI services may receive clearer explanations, more personalized guidance, and better scaffolding than students limited to free or low-cost services. To address this challenge, we propose FairTutor, an equity-aware model-routing framework that achieves cost-effective AI tutoring via pedagogically motivated multi-agent orchestration. FairTutor combines query analysis, pedagogical planning, low-cost model generation, evaluator-guided critique and revision, and selective escalation to premium AI models. We introduce access-tier AI Education (AIED) Advantage Gap to measure the quality difference between premium-access and budget-constrained tutoring, and TutorAccessEval, a benchmark spanning math, reading, writing, science, and language learning. Empirical evaluations show that FairTutor achieves 97.1% of premium pedagogical quality (in floor-adjusted Likert scale) while reducing serving cost by 71.6%. Sensitivity analysis reveals a tunable cost--quality Pareto frontier, enabling FairTutor to be tailored to the needs of diverse student populations.
papers.comment: AI for Education Day at SIGKDD 2026, 14 pages, 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出FairTutor，一种公平感知的模型路由框架，通过多智能体编排（查询分析、教学规划、低成本模型生成、评估引导批评修订和选择性升级）实现预算受限下的高质量AI辅导。引入AIED优势差距指标和TutorAccessEval基准。实验表明，在调整后的Likert量表上达到高级教学质量的97.1%，同时降低71.6%的服务成本，且存在可调的成本-质量帕累托前沿。
Motivation: 付费学生能获得更清晰的解释和个性化指导，而免费或低成本学生享受的服务质量较低，造成教育不平等。
Method: 结合查询分析、教学规划、低成本模型生成、评估引导的批评与修订，以及选择性升级到高级AI模型的多智能体协调框架。
Result: 在TutorAccessEval基准上，达到高级教学质量的97.1%（按调整后的Likert量表），服务成本降低71.6%，并展现出可调的成本-质量帕累托前沿。
Conclusion: FairTutor可根据不同学生群体的需求定制，实现成本效益与教育公平的平衡。

papers.title: Video2Code: Generating Interactive Webpages from UI Videos via Action-Aware Revisit
papers.abstract_en: UI videos provide a natural input for generating interactive webpages, as they capture both webpage appearance and action-triggered state transitions. However, directly applying video-capable vision-language models to this task remains insufficient. Existing models typically rely on sparse sampling or compressed temporal representations, which may miss short action boundaries and break the state-action-state transitions needed to implement webpage behavior. We formulate UI video-to-code generation as executable state-transition recovery from interaction videos, and identify this failure mode as state-transition misalignment. We introduce Video2Code, an action-aware video-to-code approach for recovering executable UI state transitions. Rather than allocating the visual budget uniformly across the video, Video2Code first performs coarse video understanding to locate action-critical regions, then invokes a temporal clipping tool to revisit these regions at higher temporal resolution before generating HTML/CSS/JavaScript code. We instantiate Video2Code with action-aligned video-code supervision and evaluate it under both visual and functional criteria. Experiments show that Video2Code substantially strengthens the underlying open-source model for UI video-to-code generation, improving functional correctness over direct video observation, especially on dense multi-step interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文针对从UI交互视频生成可交互网页代码的任务，提出Video2Code框架。现有方法因稀疏采样导致动作边界丢失和状态转换未对齐，Video2Code通过先进行粗粒度视频理解定位动作关键区域，再以更高时间分辨率重访这些区域，从而恢复可执行的UI状态转换，并生成HTML/CSS/JS代码。实验表明，该方法在视觉和功能指标上显著提升底层开源模型的表现，尤其适用于密集多步交互场景。
Motivation: 现有视频-语言模型在UI视频到代码生成任务中因稀疏采样或压缩时间表示而错过短动作边界，导致状态-动作-状态转换断裂（即状态转换未对齐），无法正确实现网页交互行为。
Method: 提出动作感知的Video2Code流程：先对视频进行粗粒度理解以定位动作关键区域，然后使用时间裁剪工具对这些区域以更高时间分辨率进行重访，最后生成HTML/CSS/JavaScript代码。训练使用动作对齐的视频-代码监督数据。
Result: 在视觉和功能标准评估下，Video2Code显著提升了底层开源模型的UI视频到代码生成能力，尤其是在密集多步交互场景中提高了功能正确性。
Conclusion: 通过动作感知的时间重访策略，Video2Code有效缓解了状态转换未对齐问题，为从UI视频生成可交互网页提供了一种有效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TeleStyle V2: Beyond Content-Preserving Style Transfer with Self-Distillation and Distribution-Matching-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Given a content reference and a style reference, content-preserving style transfer requires the model to generate stylized outputs with content and style consistency. We introduced TeleStyle V1 to tackle this problem. However, TeleStyle V1 is trained with photorealistic content reference and artistic style reference, which makes it incapable to cope with artistic content reference and realistic style reference in most cases. In this paper, we designed a Self-Distillation data synthesis strategy to construct such triplets from TeleStyle V1. Trained with such self-distilled triplets, our TeleStyle V2 supports Content-Style references in the forms of Realistic-and-Realistic (RnR), Realistic-and-Stylized (RnS), Stylized-and-Realistic (SnR), Stylized-and-Stylized (SnS). In addition, we found Distribution Matching Distillation could preserve the general text-guided image editing capability of the foundation model and fix the content consistency degradation caused by SFT process. Through quantitative evaluations, our TeleStyleV2-QIE-2509-DMD performs at least on par with Qwen-Image-Edit-2509-DMD, demonstrating strong general image editing skills beyond content-preserving style transfer. We observed the content/style reference order confusion problem in TeleStyle V1 and further introduced prompt enhancer to solve it. TeleStyle V2 uses Qwen-Image-Edit's VLM encoder, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, to generate content prompt and style prompt for free. TeleStyle V2 could achieve comparable style transfer performance with state-of-the-art commercial model, gemini-3-pro-image-preview.

papers.title: Simulated Customers Never Walk Away: Decision Fidelity of LLM User Simulators Measured Against Real Purchase Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-user-simulation has become core infrastructure for conversational AI: agent benchmarks (tau-bench), training pipelines, and a growing body of fidelity studies all rely on LLMs role-playing the human side of dialogue. Existing frameworks measure communicative fidelity -- whether simulators talk like humans -- against ground truth from paid participants role-playing assigned goals. We argue this has a structural blind spot: when the goal is assigned, the user's willingness is exogenous, so no framework can test whether simulators make decisions like real users whose motivation is endogenous, latent, and decaying. We introduce decision fidelity -- whether a simulated population reproduces the decision-state dynamics of real users facing real, consequential choices -- and measure it on a unique testbed: 2,790 production conversations between an LLM sales agent and real customers, including 793 with verified payment outcomes. Using a teacher-forced probe protocol that holds context and instrument fixed, we find a systematic, outcome-correlated failure we call the disengagement deficit: simulators reproduce eventual buyers almost exactly (depth bias +0.09) but inflate eventual non-buyers toward the purchase frame (depth bias +0.40; d=0.38, p<0.001), halving expressed resistance (25.1% to 13.5%) and nearly doubling deliberation (21.9% to 40.1%) while fabricating no purchases. The deficit replicates across model families (DeepSeek: d=0.41, p=0.002) and resists the obvious fix: instructing the simulator that it may disengage cuts marginal bias five-fold but barely moves the outcome-conditioned contrast (d=0.34, p=0.008). Real non-buyers say "not now" and stop; simulated non-buyers ask about price. Evaluating or training sales and persuasion agents against such simulators overstates funnel progress exactly where it matters most -- the customers who walk away.

papers.title: Ghost Vectors: Soft-Deleted Embeddings Remain Reconstructible in HNSW Vector Databases
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) allows large language models to access external and private corpora for factual, domain-specific responses. Modern RAG pipelines use hierarchical navigable small world (HNSW) vector databases for efficient similarity search. When a user requests data deletion, the systems typically only mark the record as deleted, leaving the embedding on disk physically unchanged. This soft-delete operation raises compliance concerns under data-erasure and retention requirements such as GDPR Article 17 and HIPAA. Analysis on three HNSW implementations confirms that deleted vectors remain physically recoverable by accessing the raw index files at the storage layer, bypassing API access. Using the Vec2Text inversion model without domain-specific fine-tuning, we show this vulnerability on multiple real-world datasets and data modalities. On Wikipedia biographical living persons dataset (BLP), we successfully recover 25.5% of exact person names and 46.4% of geographic locations (ROUGE-L 0.185). Recovery reaches 100% for both patient age and gender markers (ROUGE-L 0.290) on highly structured, sensitive data (NIH Synthea dataset). On soft-deleted image embeddings, we show 100% tissue classification on histopathology patches (p=1.02e-07) and top-1 identity recovery reaches 99% on facial embeddings (p<0.01). This work introduces Epoch Key Rotation, which encrypts vectors and discards the key upon deletion. Epoch key rotation reduces observed PII recovery to 0% and completes in 2.5 ms for 500 deleted vectors (approximately 0.005 ms/record). Additionally, it generates an ECDSA-signed cryptographic proof as an auditable record of the deletion event.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables. Prepared for submission
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了HNSW向量数据库中软删除操作的隐私风险：即使标记为删除，嵌入向量仍可从存储层物理恢复。作者在多个数据集（包括维基百科人物、NIH Synthea医疗数据、病理图像和面部图像）上验证了恢复攻击的有效性，并提出了Epoch Key Rotation加密方案，通过密钥丢弃实现可审计的彻底删除。
Motivation: 现代RAG系统使用HNSW向量数据库存储外部私有数据，软删除仅标记记录而未实际擦除嵌入，可能违反GDPR和HIPAA等数据擦除法规。
Method: 通过直接读取原始索引文件绕过API访问，利用Vec2Text反转模型恢复软删除的文本嵌入；针对图像嵌入直接进行分类或身份识别。提出Epoch Key Rotation，对向量加密并在删除时丢弃密钥，附带ECDSA签名作为删除证明。
Result: 在BLP数据集中恢复25.5%的精确人名和46.4%的地理位置（ROUGE-L 0.185）；在NIH Synthea数据中年龄和性别恢复率达100%（ROUGE-L 0.290）；病理图像组织分类准确率100%，面部嵌入top-1身份恢复率99%。Epoch Key Rotation将PII恢复降至0%，每记录耗时约0.005ms。
Conclusion: 软删除在实际HNSW实现中不足以满足数据擦除要求，Epoch Key Rotation方案能以极低开销实现可证明的隐私保护删除。

papers.title: GEOPHYS: The Geometry of Physical Plausibility
papers.abstract_en: While humans can identify physically implausible events within milliseconds, machine learning approaches addressing the same problem are extremely slow and expensive. They either rely on external multimodal-LLM judges or require ad-hoc modifications to the training procedure. In this work, we argue that indicators of physical plausibility are implicitly captured by five geometric properties of the per-frame embeddings produced by frozen image encoders. In aggregate, we call them GEOPHYS. First, we show that these signals correlate with human EEG responses to two forms of object-permanence violations. Second, GEOPHYS robustly discriminates physically implausible videos from realistic ones, achieving state-of-the-art physics-violation detection: 98.3% on LikePhys and 93.3% on IntPhys2, whereas V-JEPA 2, GPT-4o, Gemini, and twelve modern video diffusion models perform near chance. Third, used as a best-of-N verifier for physical alignment during video generation, GEOPHYS lifts MAGI-1 24B from 50.01% to 64.50% on PhysicsIQ at 1.5x lower wall-clock and 4.65x lower memory than the V-JEPA 2 world-model verifier. Ultimately, GEOPHYS demonstrates that physical plausibility in videos can be assessed by leveraging the emergent geometric properties of temporal features extracted from image encoders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GEOPHYS，一种利用冻结图像编码器的逐帧嵌入的五种几何属性来检测视频物理合理性的方法。该方法无需额外训练或大型模型判断，在物理违反检测任务上达到SOTA（LikePhys 98.3%），且作为视频生成验证器可提升MAGI-1 24B在PhysicsIQ上的性能。
Motivation: 现有方法检测物理不合理事件要么依赖外部多模态大语言模型判断，要么需要修改训练流程，速度慢且成本高。本文旨在发现一种无需训练或大模型的快速物理合理性检测方法。
Method: 提出GEOPHYS，通过分析冻结图像编码器逐帧嵌入的五种几何属性（如流形曲率等）来评估物理合理性，无需额外训练或修改编码器。
Result: 检测物理违反：LikePhys 98.3%, IntPhys2 93.3%，显著优于V-JEPA 2、GPT-4o等。作为视频生成验证器，将MAGI-1 24B在PhysicsIQ上从50.01%提升至64.50%，且计算开销更低。
Conclusion: 论文表明，视频的物理合理性可以通过利用图像编码器时间特征的几何属性来评估，为无需昂贵模型的方法提供了新思路。
