papers.title: Weibull Weight-Scale Parameter Evolution under AdamW Training Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Building on a two-parameter Weibull framework for diagnosing transformer weight distributions, we study why the Weibull weight-scale parameter $λ$ grows, overshoots, and then relaxes during AdamW training. We derive a leading-order three-force decomposition of the squared weight norm from the AdamW update: an alignment force measuring the correlation between weights and the adaptive update direction, an injection force from adaptive step magnitude, and a decay force from decoupled weight decay. On self-trained Pythia-70M models with ground-truth optimizer moments, alignment dominates the rise phase, contributing 88-94% of the absolute force budget across four random seeds and remaining robust to super-weight removal. Near saturation, alignment and decay approach balance, explaining the transition from weight-scale growth to relaxation. These force dynamics directly govern the squared-norm component underlying $λ(t)$; the remaining RMS-to-Weibull reconstruction offset is measurable and decomposes into bridge and integration components, totaling approximately 5-6% in densely sampled regions. To extend the analysis to real models where optimizer moments are unavailable, we introduce a spline displacement method that recovers the alignment force from sparse checkpoints with approximately 92-94% accuracy, about twice the naive two-point baseline. We further observe that the peak value of $λ(t)$ varies with training-data coherence in our experiments, suggesting a data-dependent component of weight-scale growth that we leave to a controlled follow-up study. Code and data are available at https://github.com/tiexinding/NPM-Weibull-public.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于双参数Weibull框架研究Transformer权重分布在AdamW训练中尺度参数λ(t)的增长、过冲与松弛现象。通过对Pythia-70M模型自训练中真实优化器动量的分析，将平方权重范数分解为alignment、injection和decay三种力，其中alignment在上升阶段贡献88-94%的力预算，并在饱和期与decay趋于平衡。提出样条位移法从稀疏检查点恢复alignment力，精度约92-94%。实验还观察到λ(t)峰值与训练数据一致性相关。
Motivation: 理解AdamW训练下Transformer权重分布Weibull尺度参数λ(t)的动态演化机制，特别是其增长、过冲与松弛的驱动因素。
Method: 推导AdamW更新中平方权重范数的三力分解（alignment、injection、decay），并引入样条位移法从稀疏检查点恢复alignment力。
Result: 在Pythia-70M模型上，alignment力主导上升阶段（占绝对力预算88-94%），与decay力在饱和期接近平衡；样条位移法恢复alignment力精度约为92-94%，是朴素两点基线的两倍。
Conclusion: 权重尺度参数λ(t)的演化可由平方范数的力动力学直接解释，且其峰值可能依赖训练数据一致性，留待后续控制实验。

papers.title: DrugBench: Evaluating AI Control Protocols for Medication Harm Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models have the potential to expand and improve the access to clinical information by enabling new ways of interacting with medical knowledge in natural language. However, their deployment in medical question-answering settings is safety-critical, since misaligned outputs can lead to severe patient harm. AI control is an emerging approach that introduces external safeguards to mitigate unsafe behaviours in misaligned systems and has been shown to be effective in domains such as code generation. However, its applicability and effectiveness in medical settings have not been systematically studied. In this work, we present a pipeline for evaluating AI control protocols to mitigate medication-related harm. To this end, we introduce DrugBench, an AI control evaluation benchmark which combines 3,671 multi-turn medical conversations from HealthBench with drug information from official FDA labels, covering four categories of medication-related harm: drug interactions, contraindications, dosing constraints, and patient action restrictions. Furthermore, inspired by the medical domain, we argue that safety should account for the severity of unsafe outputs, not just their probability. Under this revised definition, we show that existing control protocols can be subverted and propose severity-based monitoring to address this limitation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DrugBench基准，用于评估AI控制协议在减轻药物相关危害（药物相互作用、禁忌症、剂量限制、患者行为限制）中的效果。该基准结合3,671轮医疗对话与FDA标签信息，并引入基于严重性的监控以弥补现有控制协议的不足。
Motivation: 大语言模型在医疗问答中可能产生不安全输出导致患者伤害，现有AI控制协议在医疗领域的系统性评估缺失，且传统安全度量仅考虑概率而忽略严重性。
Method: 构建DrugBench基准，包含3,671轮多轮医疗对话（来自HealthBench）和FDA官方标签，覆盖四类药物危害。提出基于严重性的监控方法以修正现有控制协议的可颠覆性。
Result: 实验表明现有控制协议可以被颠覆，而基于严重性的监控能够识别并缓解此类安全漏洞。
Conclusion: AI控制协议在医疗场景中需要纳入输出严重性度量，DrugBench为评估此类协议提供了标准化基准。

papers.title: Confidence Laundering in Agent Systems: Why Uncertainty Needs a Latent Carrier
papers.abstract_en: Modern agent systems can turn uncertainty into overconfidence. Fragile upstream decisions are often exposed to downstream components as clean intermediate artifacts, while the uncertainty behind those decisions is lost at the interface. As a result, local ambiguity can become system-level error amplification. We argue that this reveals an interface bottleneck in agent uncertainty propagation: uncertainty does not propagate simply because a trajectory contains uncertain steps; it propagates only when it survives the handoff between components. We define uncertain decision handoff as the transfer of an intermediate decision made under uncertainty, and identify confidence laundering as a failure mode in which fragile upstream states are repackaged as procedurally valid artifacts that downstream agents over-trust. To address this bottleneck, we propose latent uncertainty as an uncertainty-bearing carrier attached to decision handoffs. Rather than replacing text with hidden states, latent uncertainty aims to preserve pre-commitment fragility in a form that downstream components can use. This position shifts agent uncertainty propagation from step-wise uncertainty estimation toward uncertainty-preserving interface design for more recoverable agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证了智能体系统中的不确定性传播存在接口瓶颈：上游脆弱的决策被重包装为看似合法的中间产物，下游组件过度信任导致错误放大。作者提出“潜在不确定性”(latent uncertainty)作为附属于决策传递的不确定性载体，旨在保留决策前的脆弱性，而非用隐状态替代文本。该工作将不确定性传播问题从逐步估计转向不确定性保留的接口设计。
Motivation: 现有智能体系统中，上游不确定的决策在传递给下游时被清洗掉不确定性，导致局部模糊转变为系统性错误放大，缺乏有效的接口来传递不确定性信息。
Method: 定义“不确定决策移交”和“置信洗白”概念，提出“潜在不确定性”作为不确定性载体附加到决策移交中，使下游组件能感知并利用前置决策的脆弱性。
Result: 论文为概念性论证，未报告具体实验结果，但指出当前系统存在置信洗白现象，潜在不确定性有助于设计更可恢复的智能体系统。
Conclusion: 不确定性传播的关键在于接口设计而非逐步估计；应将不确定性作为显式信息在组件间传递以提高系统鲁棒性。

summary_sections.result: 论文为概念性论证，未报告具体实验结果，但指出当前系统存在置信洗白现象，潜在不确定性有助于设计更可恢复的智能体系统。
summary_sections.conclusion: 不确定性传播的关键在于接口设计而非逐步估计；应将不确定性作为显式信息在组件间传递以提高系统鲁棒性。

papers.title: From Knowing to Acting: Benchmarking Self-Awareness Capability of LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: The integration of external tools has transitioned LLM agents from passive responders to autonomous systems. However, current benchmarks prioritize execution success, neglecting self-awareness capability, the ability to discern whether a problem requires necessary external resources or can be solved via internal parametric knowledge. To address this, we introduce KAPRO (Knowing-Acting Quadrant PRObe), a framework that evaluates cognitive-behavioral alignment by decoupling an agent's metacognitive judgment (Knowing) from its spontaneous execution (Acting). We further construct KAware, a dataset rigorously partitioning tasks into external, internal, and hybrid subspaces to systematically probe these epistemic boundaries. Extensive experiments across diverse agent architectures show that self-awareness capability is strongly correlated with task success but degrades sharply in internal-capability settings. Moreover, open-source and instruction-following models exhibit stronger tool overuse due to shallow pattern matching, while proprietary and reasoning-oriented models demonstrate more reliable cognitive gating. Benchmark and codes are available at https://github.com/AI-Santiago/KAware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KAPRO 框架和 KAware 数据集，用于评估 LLM 智能体的自我意识能力（即判断任务是否需要外部工具或内部知识）。实验发现自我意识与任务成功强相关，开源模型易过度使用工具，而专有模型表现出更可靠的认知门控。
Motivation: 现有基准主要衡量执行成功率，忽略了智能体判断是否需要外部资源的能力，即自我意识能力。
Method: 提出 KAPRO 框架，解耦元认知判断（Knowing）和自主执行（Acting），并构建 KAware 数据集，将任务划分为外部、内部和混合子空间以系统探测认知边界。
Result: 自我意识能力与任务成功强相关，但在内部能力设置中显著下降；开源模型因浅层模式匹配导致工具过度使用，专有模型和推理型模型具有更可靠的认知门控。
Conclusion: 自我意识是 LLM 智能体能力的重要组成部分，当前模型在处理内部知识任务时仍存在不足，需要改进认知门控机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Skill Coverage: A Test Adequacy Metric for Agent Skills
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills encode reusable procedural knowledge that guides large language model agents across tasks and execution contexts. Existing evaluations primarily assess skills through task level outcomes, yet task success alone does not reveal which parts of a skill have been exercised or which remain untested. We introduce skill coverage, a test adequacy metric that treats the skill artifact as the object under test. Our approach extracts observable skill behavior constraints from skill documents and measures whether an agent trajectory provides sufficient evidence to exercise and evaluate each constraint. Skill coverage uses a binary cover or not cover judgment, which reports whether a documented behavior has been exercised with sufficient observable evidence, without assigning an additional outcome label to the behavior. Applying skill coverage to SkillsBench reveals that existing benchmark executions cover only 39.90 to 43.98% of skill behavior constraints, suggesting that current benchmark tasks leave large portions of documented skill guidance untested. These findings show that successful task completion does not imply adequate testing of the skill artifact, highlighting skill coverage as a measure of how thoroughly agent skills are tested.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出技能覆盖率 (skill coverage)，一种将技能工件本身视为测试对象的测试充分性度量。该方法从技能文档中提取可观察的行为约束，判断智能体轨迹是否提供了足够证据来执行和评估每个约束。对 SkillsBench 的应用显示，现有基准执行仅覆盖 39.90% 到 43.98% 的技能行为约束，表明任务完成并不等于技能工件的充分测试。
Motivation: 现有智能体技能评估主要依赖任务级结果，但任务成功无法揭示技能的哪些部分已被执行或哪些尚未测试，缺乏对技能工件本身的测试充分性度量。
Method: 从技能文档中提取可观察的行为约束，对智能体轨迹进行二元覆盖判断（覆盖/未覆盖），不额外分配结果标签，仅依据是否有足够可观察证据。
Result: 对 SkillsBench 的分析表明，现有基准执行仅覆盖 39.90% 到 43.98% 的技能行为约束，说明大量文档化的技能指导未被测试。
Conclusion: 成功完成任务并不意味技能工件被充分测试，技能覆盖率可作为衡量技能测试彻底性的指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Expected Free Energy-based Planning as Variational Inference
papers.abstract_en: Planning under uncertainty requires agents to balance goal achievement with information gathering. Active inference addresses this through the Expected Free Energy (EFE), a cost function that unifies instrumental and epistemic objectives. However, existing EFE-based methods typically employ specialized optimization procedures that are difficult to extend or analyze. In this paper, we show that EFE-based planning can be formulated as Variational Free Energy minimization on a generative model augmented with epistemic priors. Our main result demonstrates that minimizing a Variational Free Energy functional with appropriately chosen priors yields a decomposition into expected plan costs (the EFE) plus a complexity term. This formulation reinforces theoretical consistency with the Free Energy Principle by casting planning as the same inferential process that governs perception and learning. We validate our approach on three environments of increasing complexity: a deterministic T-maze, a stochastic Reactivity Maze, and a partially observable MiniGrid DoorKey-8x8 environment. The experiments demonstrate that the epistemic priors induce information-seeking behavior, that the variational formulation yields policy-based inference outperforming plan-based methods under stochastic transitions, and that temporal factorization enables scalability to environments where existing tabular active inference methods cannot operate.
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明基于期望自由能 (EFE) 的规划可以形式化为带有认知先验的生成模型上的变分自由能最小化。关键结果是将变分自由能泛函最小化分解为预期计划成本（EFE）加复杂度项，从而将规划纳入与感知和学习相同的推理过程。实验在确定性 T-maze、随机 Reactivity Maze 和部分可观测 MiniGrid DoorKey-8x8 三个环境中验证，表明认知先验能诱导信息寻求行为，变分形式在随机转换下优于基于规划的方法，时间分解使方法可扩展至现有方法无法处理的场景。
Motivation: 现有基于 EFE 的规划方法使用专门的优化过程，难以扩展或分析。论文希望将 EFE 规划统一到变分推理框架下，以增强理论一致性和可扩展性。
Method: 将 EFE 基础的规划重新表述为在带有认知先验的生成模型上进行变分自由能最小化，推导出规划推理的统一形式。
Result: 在三个环境（确定性 T-maze、随机 Reactivity Maze、部分可观测 MiniGrid DoorKey-8x8）中，该方法展现了信息寻求行为，变分推理在随机转换下优于基于规划的方法，且时间分解提升了可扩展性。
Conclusion: 该工作加强了主动推理中规划与自由能原理的理论一致性，并提供了一种更易扩展的变分推理框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A-Evolve-Training: Autonomous Post-Training of a 30B Model
papers.abstract_en: Post-training a frontier model is normally weeks of human work: proposing data and recipe changes, launching runs, reading evals, deciding what to keep. We report an autonomous system that runs this loop with no human in the loop, post-training a 30B Nemotron across four rounds over multiple weeks. The autonomously produced model reaches a held-out score of 0.86 against the top human submission's 0.87 on the public NVIDIA Nemotron-Reasoning Challenge leaderboard, placing 8th of ~4000 at the time of writing. More striking than the number: the loop detected that its own dev metric had stopped tracking external performance on the weakest domain -- candidates drove dev to record highs without moving the external target -- and revised its own search policy, no longer maximizing dev but seeking interventions that lowered the now-misleading proxy while improving the external target. We treat this as direct, auditable evidence that a scaled autonomous loop can produce discovery, not only optimization: it detected that its measurement frame had become misleading and changed what counted as evidence. We take the operational view that any system worth the "recursive self-improvement" label must eventually perform end-to-end post-training of a frontier-class model; this is one datapoint of that bar being cleared. We do not claim a "first autonomous match" of human researchers. The claim we make is narrower and auditable: to our knowledge, this is the first publicly reported autonomous post-training run at this scale, where prior public autonomous-ML-research demonstrations sit at GPT-2-class (~124M) budgets. The same system also post-trains the 120B and 550B Nemotron; with no public human baseline there, this shows only that the loop closes at that scale, not that its output is competitive -- infrastructure evidence, with the effectiveness claim deferred until a comparable human anchor exists.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文报告了一个自主后训练系统A-Evolve-Training，在无人干预的情况下对30B参数的Nemotron模型进行多轮后训练。系统在NVIDIA Nemotron-Reasoning Challenge排行榜上达到0.86分（人类最佳0.87），排名第8。更关键的是，系统检测到自身开发指标与外部性能脱钩后，自动修正了搜索策略，表现出自主发现能力。这是首次公开报道的大规模（30B）自主后训练实验。
Motivation: 当前后训练前沿模型通常需要数周的人力工作，包括提出数据配比、运行实验、评估、决定保留方案等。论文的目标是实现无需人类在环的自主后训练循环，以降低人力成本并提升效率。
Method: 提出一个完整的自主后训练闭环系统，包括自动提出数据/配方变更、启动运行、读取评估、决定保留等步骤，对30B Nemotron进行四轮迭代。系统还监控开发指标与外部性能的对齐情况，当检测到开发指标不再跟踪外部表现时，自动调整搜索策略，不再单纯最大化开发指标，而是寻找降低误导性代理指标同时改善外部目标的干预。
Result: 自主生成的模型在NVIDIA Nemotron-Reasoning Challenge排行榜上达到0.86分，与人类最佳0.87分接近，在约4000个提交中排名第8。系统还展示了自主发现能力：检测到开发指标失效后自动修正策略，改变了搜索目标。
Conclusion: 论文声称这是首个公开报道的大规模（30B）自主后训练实验，此前公开的自主ML研究示范仅到GPT-2级别（~124M）。系统在120B和550B规模上也完成了后训练，但有效性需待人类基线出现后才能评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Splitting Heuristics for Parallel String Solvers
papers.abstract_en: String constraint solvers are crucial for reasoning about string-manipulating programs. However, many practical string constraints are undecidable, and real-world applications often present complex constraints that challenge current solvers. The rise of multi-core architectures offers an opportunity for parallel solving. A key parallel solving method is \emph{cube-and-conquer}, in which the quality of splitting heuristics is critical to effectively dividing the search space. Unfortunately, manually designing the heuristics is labor-intensive, and handcrafted heuristics are often sub-optimal. This paper introduces a data-driven approach to automatically generating splitting heuristics. We frame the problem of selecting a splitting atom as a learning task, using features from input formulas and dynamic data from solver execution. We implement this approach in two popular string solvers, Z3seq and Z3str4, demonstrating that the learned heuristics outperform manually designed ones in the number of solved formulas and the average solving time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的方法，自动生成字符串求解器中的分裂启发式，以改进并行求解中的搜索空间划分。该方法在Z3seq和Z3str4两个求解器上实现，学习到的启发式在求解公式数量和平均求解时间上优于手工设计的启发式。
Motivation: 手动设计分裂启发式费时且容易次优，而高质量的分裂启发式对于并行求解的搜索空间划分至关重要。
Method: 将分裂原子的选择问题建模为学习任务，利用输入公式的特征和求解器执行的动态数据自动生成启发式。
Result: 在Z3seq和Z3str4求解器上，学习到的启发式在求解公式数量和平均求解时间上均优于手工设计的启发式。
Conclusion: 数据驱动的方法可以自动生成有效的分裂启发式，提升并行字符串求解器的性能。

papers.title: Input-schema identifiability limits in physics-informed surrogates for mechanics-governed flow
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed and data-driven surrogates are increasingly used to approximate mechanics-governed flow fields, but the target quantities assigned to such models are not always identifiable from the input variables available at prediction time. We introduce an input-schema identifiability certificate for computational surrogates. Starting from a reduced physical model, the certificate decomposes a target field into components that are measurable from geometry, components that require boundary-condition information, and components identifiable only up to a symmetry quotient. This yields a pre-training audit: it predicts which oracle-channel interventions should reduce error, which should fail, and which ambiguity cannot be removed by changing the architecture, loss, optimizer, or sample size. We instantiate the framework for incompressible tubular flow using a Cosserat-rod reduction, where lumen velocity separates into a mesh-measurable tangent direction, a boundary-condition-dependent magnitude, and a signed-orientation ambiguity. Controlled experiments on patient-specific aortic CFD geometries, analytic Womersley flows, and an advection-diffusion transfer problem confirm the predicted pattern: supplying signed direction collapses angular error to the oracle regime, whereas supplying magnitude without orientation leaves the predicted sign ambiguity and yields 16-33 percent per-node sign flips. The results provide a mechanics-based diagnostic for deciding whether a surrogate modelling task is physically identifiable before training, and expose failure modes that aggregate error metrics can hide.
papers.comment: Main text with Supplementary Information included; 11 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对力学控制流的物理信息代理中目标量从输入变量不可辨识的问题，提出一种输入模式可辨识性证书（input-schema identifiability certificate）。该证书基于简化物理模型将目标场分解为几何可测量部分、边界条件依赖部分以及仅对称性模糊部分，实现预训练审计，预测哪些干预能降低误差、哪些无效。在不可压缩管流中，利用Cosserat-rod约简将流场速度分解为网格可测切向、依赖边界条件的大小和符号方向模糊性。在患者特异性主动脉CFD几何、解析Womersley流和对流扩散问题上的实验证实了预测模式：提供符号方向可将角度误差降至oracle水平，而不提供符号则导致16-33%的节点符号翻转。
Motivation: 物理信息和数据驱动的代理越来越多地用于近似力学控制流场，但分配给这些模型的目标量并不总是能从预测时输入的变量中辨识出来，这导致模型可能无法正确学习。
Method: 引入输入模式可辨识性证书，从简化物理模型出发，将目标场分解为几何可测分量、边界条件分量和仅对称商可辨分量，从而在训练前诊断哪些干预有效、哪些无效以及哪些模糊性无法通过架构、损失、优化器或样本量消除。
Result: 在患者特异性主动脉CFD、解析Womersley流和对流扩散问题上的实验证实了预测模式：提供符号方向可将角度误差降至oracle水平，而不提供符号方向则导致16-33%的节点符号翻转。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了基于力学的诊断，用于在训练前判断代理建模任务是否物理可辨识，并揭示了聚合误差指标可能隐藏的失败模式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Distributed Model Predictive Control with Adaptive Safety Zones for Multi-Fleet Drone Operations
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous drone swarms in space-constrained environments such as warehouses, inspection corridors, and urban delivery routes must share limited airspace safely at high vehicle density. Existing approaches rely on fixed safety zones sized for worst-case velocity, which wastes airspace in congested scenarios. We replace the fixed radius with an adaptive, speed-dependent safety sphere whose size scales with braking distance: tight at low speeds, expanded at high speeds. We develop both a centralized model predictive control (MPC) formulation and a distributed MPC (DMPC) in which each drone optimizes locally from detected neighbors, accommodating mixed fleets with non-cooperative agents. We prove feasibility up to the geometric packing limit evaluated at the minimum radius, establish Lyapunov stability under sufficient conditions on the adaptation parameter, drone density, and prediction horizon, and extend these guarantees to the distributed setting via a contraction condition that preserves the centralized stability margins. We further derive modified sphere-packing capacity bounds and a throughput-optimal crossing speed for narrow passages. Simulations confirm that the adaptive framework remains feasible where fixed-radius methods fail: it roughly doubles the admissible drone count, reduces traversal time through constrained passages by about 25 percent, and enables passage through openings impassable to static safety zones. The centralized variant realizes a larger fraction of the theoretical capacity, while the distributed variant offers a more realistic deployment model for mixed-fleet operations under the same safety guarantees.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE CONES on April 15, 2025. Code: https://github.com/linda78/TLCAmpc/releases/tag/v2.2.1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对空间受限环境中多无人机群的空中交通管理问题，提出自适应安全区域（adaptive safety zones）的分布式模型预测控制（DMPC）。传统方法使用固定半径的安全区域，导致空间浪费。本文将其替换为与速度相关的自适应球形安全区域，半径随刹车距离变化。作者证明了该方法在几何堆积极限内可行，并通过李雅普诺夫稳定性分析给出保证，同时推导了改进的球堆积容量边界和最优通过速度。仿真表明，自适应框架在固定半径方法失效的场景下仍可行，可容纳的无人机数量翻倍，通过狭窄通道的通行时间减少约25%，并能通过固定安全区域无法通过的开口。集中式和分布式变体分别在理论容量和实际部署方面取得优势。
Motivation: 现有方法使用基于最坏情况速度的固定安全区域，在拥挤场景下浪费空域，限制了无人机密度。
Method: 提出自适应速度相关的安全球区域（半径与刹车距离成正比），并分别设计集中式MPC和分布式MPC。分布式变体中每架无人机根据检测到的邻居进行局部优化，可容纳非合作代理的混合机队。
Result: 仿真显示：自适应框架在固定半径方法失败时仍可行；可容纳的无人机数量翻倍；通过狭窄通道的通行时间减少约25%；能通过固定安全区域无法通过的开口。
Conclusion: 自适应安全区域与MPC结合可显著提升空间利用率，集中式变体更接近理论容量，分布式变体更适合混合机队部署且保持同等安全保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EmoInstruct-TTS: Dual-Path Instruction-Guided Emotional Speech Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-based controllable speech synthesis enables users to specify emotions through natural language. However, existing approaches often rely on coarse emotion labels and lack explicit modeling of fine-grained intensity. We propose EmoInstruct-TTS, a dual-path instruction-guided framework for emotional speech synthesis. We introduce Emotion2embed, a supervised semantic-acoustic emotion embedding covering 48 emotional states, including fine-grained categories and intensity levels. To infer embeddings from free-form instructions, we design an Instruction-Conditioned Emotion Flow Model (ICE-Flow) that generates acoustically grounded emotion representations. The inferred embeddings are integrated into an LLM-based synthesis pipeline to provide explicit emotional control while preserving semantic planning. Experiments show improved emotional controllability and speech naturalness over strong baselines.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to Interspeech 2026. Audio demos: https://huanyu-lab.github.io/EMOINSTRUCT-TTS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EmoInstruct-TTS 提出双路径指令引导框架用于情感语音合成。引入 Emotion2embed 语义-声学情感嵌入，覆盖48种情感状态（含细粒度类别和强度级别），并通过指令条件情感流模型（ICE-Flow）从自然语言指令生成声学情感表示，集成到基于LLM的合成流水线中。实验表明该方法在情感可控性和语音自然度上优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有基于指令的情感语音合成依赖粗略的情感标签，缺乏对细粒度强度的显式建模。
Method: 提出双路径指令引导框架，包含 Emotion2embed（覆盖48种情感状态）和 ICE-Flow（从自由形式指令生成声学情感表示），并将嵌入集成到LLM合成流水线中。
Result: 实验显示情感可控性和语音自然度优于强基线。
Conclusion: 该方法通过细粒度情感嵌入和指令生成，提升了情感合成的可控性。

papers.title: Platooning Connected, Autonomous, and Human-Driven Vehicles: A Deep Reinforcement Learning-based Approach
papers.abstract_en: Conventionally, existing vehicle platooning approaches are designed for connected vehicles, typically including connected autonomous vehicles and connected human-driven vehicles. Non-connected vehicles, such as non-connected autonomous or human-driven vehicles, are not incorporated. As a result, these platooning approaches may not properly reflect real-world mixed traffic conditions at the current stage. To address this limitation, this study proposes a hybrid platooning pattern that conditionally permits non-connected vehicles to join platoons, thereby enhancing platooning diversity and flexibility. However, it was found that the unregulated integration of non-connected vehicles can trigger rapid platoon expansion, significantly amplifying the risk of disturbance propagation in traffic flow. This, in turn, exacerbates the inherent conflict between traffic throughput and stability. To mitigate these challenges, this paper further develops a hybrid platooning control strategy based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL). This strategy integrates vehicle dynamics, platoon topology, and traffic flow states through a multi-level state representation network, enabling a dynamic trade-off between traffic capacity and stability. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed strategy effectively suppresses velocity disturbance propagation by dynamically optimizing platoon structures, thereby significantly enhancing the stability and safety of mixed traffic while reducing fuel consumption and emissions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合编队模式，允许非网联车辆有条件地加入编队，以提升编队的多样性和灵活性。然而，无限制地整合非网联车辆会导致编队快速扩张，加剧交通流中的扰动传播。为此，基于深度强化学习（DRL）开发了一种混合编队控制策略，通过多层级状态表示网络整合车辆动力学、编队拓扑和交通流状态，动态平衡通行能力与稳定性。数值模拟表明，该策略能有效抑制速度扰动传播，提升混合交通的稳定性和安全性，并降低油耗和排放。
Motivation: 现有编队方法通常仅针对网联车辆设计（包括网联自动驾驶车辆和网联人类驾驶车辆），未考虑非网联车辆，无法反映当前阶段真实混合交通条件。
Method: 提出一种混合编队模式，允许非网联车辆有条件加入；进一步开发基于DRL的混合编队控制策略，通过多层级状态表示网络融合车辆动力学、编队拓扑和交通流状态，实现通行能力与稳定性的动态权衡。
Result: 数值模拟表明，该策略能有效抑制速度扰动传播，动态优化编队结构，显著提升混合交通的稳定性和安全性，同时降低燃油消耗和排放。
Conclusion: 本文提出的混合编队控制策略通过DRL实现了编队结构的动态优化，在混合交通条件下兼顾了通行能力与稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bridging Multi-Valued Heuristics and Dimensionality Reduction in Multi-Objective Search
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective shortest-path (MOSP) algorithms traditionally rely on single-valued heuristics (SVHs), which associate each state with a single admissible cost vector. While SVHs provide safe lower bounds, they fail to capture the trade-off structure of the Pareto frontier and often yield weak search guidance. Multi-valued heuristics (MVHs) address this limitation by mapping states to sets of cost estimates, enabling a richer approximation of possible trade-offs. Modern MOSP algorithms are highly dependent on dimensionality reduction (DR) techniques to efficiently perform dominance checks. However, integrating MVHs with DR introduces subtle correctness challenges. We show that naively combining DR with MVHs destroys the ordering invariants required for DR, leading to unsound and incomplete search. To address this issue, we develop the first theoretical frameworks for safely integrating MVHs with DR. First, we introduce $\text{NAMOA}^*{\text{dr}\text{-}\text{mvh}}$, a theoretical baseline that restores search correctness by enforcing heuristic consistency. Recognizing the practical limitations of this approach, we then introduce our primary contribution, $\text{L}\text{-}\text{NAMOA}^*{\text{dr}\text{-}\text{mvh}}$. This algorithm employs a "lazy," optimistic approach to DR, preserving exact correctness with only an admissible MVH by dynamically detecting and repairing local ordering violations. Across a range of benchmarks, $\text{L}\text{-}\text{NAMOA}^*{\text{dr}\text{-}\text{mvh}}$ matches or improves over state-of-the-art MOSP algorithms, and achieves speedups of over 10x in instances where the additional guidance provided by the MVH translates into stronger pruning.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. To appear in Proceedings of SoCS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多目标最短路径（MOSP）搜索中多维启发式（MVH）与降维（DR）技术的安全集成。作者指出简单组合DR和MVH会破坏序不变性导致搜索不正确，提出两种理论框架：NAMOA*_dr-mvh（通过强制启发式一致性恢复正确性）和L-NAMOA*_dr-mvh（采用懒惰乐观方法动态检测局部序违规）。实验表明后者在基准测试上匹配或超越现有算法，在MVH提供强剪枝的实例上实现超过10倍加速。
Motivation: 传统单值启发式（SVH）难以刻画Pareto前沿的权衡结构，导致搜索引导弱；多值启发式（MVH）可提供更丰富的近似，但与降维（DR）技术结合时存在正确性问题。
Method: 提出两种安全集成MVH与DR的算法：NAMOA*_dr-mvh（强制启发式一致性）和L-NAMOA*_dr-mvh（懒惰乐观法，动态检测修复局部序违规）。
Result: 在多个基准上L-NAMOA*_dr-mvh匹配或超越现有MOSP算法，并在MVH提供额外引导的实例上实现超过10倍加速。
Conclusion: 本文建立了首个安全集成MVH与DR的理论框架，其中L-NAMOA*_dr-mvh在保证精确正确性的同时利用MVH的剪枝优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPARC: A Multi-Agent System for Electrical Circuit Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Electrical circuit diagram QA tasks require complex mathematical reasoning, which remains challenging for multimodal LLMs. We present SPARC, a multi-agent system that answers questions over circuit diagrams by grounding reasoning in executable physics-based simulations. SPARC uses LLM agents to synthesize, execute, and analyze simulation programs, improving accuracy and reliability by design. It achieves 83% accuracy, with up to a 58% absolute improvement over baselines, while enabling systematic error diagnosis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPARC是一个多智能体系统，用于回答电路图问题，通过将推理基于可执行的物理仿真程序，提高了准确性和可靠性。系统利用LLM代理合成、执行和分析仿真程序，在基准测试上达到83%的准确率，相比基线最高提升58%。
Motivation: 电路图问答任务需要复杂的数学推理，对多模态大语言模型仍具有挑战性，现有方法缺乏可靠的推理机制。
Method: 提出SPARC，一个多智能体系统，使用LLM代理合成、执行和分析基于物理的仿真程序，从而将推理锚定在可执行的仿真中。
Result: 在电路图问答任务上达到83%的准确率，相比基线最高提升58个百分点，并支持系统化的错误诊断。
Conclusion: 通过将推理与物理仿真结合，多智能体方法能显著提升电路图问答的准确性和可靠性。

papers.title: Hypothesis-Disciplined Multi-Agent Automated Formalization of Asymptotic Statistical Theory
papers.abstract_en: Asymptotic statistical theory is a challenging domain for AI-assisted formalization: its central results mix convergence statements, asymptotic expansions, functional analysis, and regularity conditions that have a large gap from existing infrastructure in Lean 4 formalization. To address these challenges, we propose a hypothesis-disciplined Lean 4 formalization pipeline built from multiple agents: a manager that coordinates seven specialist roles for proof planning, skeleton scaffolding, Mathlib reconnaissance, proof construction, integration, independent review, and audit. The main methodological discipline is the hypothesis-disciplined audit, implemented by the Auditor agent: every main-theorem hypothesis and concept-layer field must be anchored in the source mathematical prose, justified as a Lean encoding adapter, marked as source-implied, or rejected as an unsupported strengthening. Using this workflow, we build a systematic formalization of asymptotic statistical theory, especially the parametric and semi-parametric models' asymptotic distribution and efficiency results. The resulting Lean development is axiom-clean and source-faithful, with Lean-checked and human-audited proofs of core parametric and semi-parametric theorems organized so that theorem-agnostic infrastructure and statistical concept definitions are separated from theorem-specific assembly. The formalization results are available at https://github.com/junwei-lu/Lean-Asymptotic-Statistical-Theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于假设约束的多智能体流水线，用于将渐近统计理论自动形式化为 Lean 4 代码。系统包含七个专业角色，通过假设约束审计确保源数学文本与 Lean 编码之间的忠实性。作者成功形式化了参数和半参数模型的新近分布与效率结果，代码已开源。
Motivation: 渐近统计理论的形式化面临挑战：其核心结果涉及收敛陈述、渐近展开、泛函分析和正则条件，与现有 Lean 4 基础设施差距大。
Method: 提出一个假设约束的多智能体形式化流水线，包括管理者和七个专业角色（规划、骨架搭建、Mathlib 侦察、证明构造、集成、独立审查、审计）。关键部分是审计者智能体执行的假设约束审计，确保每个主定理假设和概念层字段都锚定于源数学文本。
Result: 成功构建了渐近统计理论的系统形式化，尤其是参数和半参数模型的新近分布与效率结果。Lean 开发是公理清洁且源忠实的，经 Lean 检查和人审计。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了假设约束的多智能体方法在复杂数学领域形式化中的有效性，将定理无关基础设施与定理特定组装分离。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MAGNIFIED: RL Fine-tuning of Multimodal Large Language Models for Motion Planning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in semantic understanding and common sense reasoning, making them promising candidates for solving planning problems in autonomous driving. However, the next-token text prediction objectives traditionally used in pre-training and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of MLLMs may fall short of fulfilling the planning objectives for autonomous vehicles. The next-token prediction objective merely encourages per-token imitation in text, often irrespective of multi-step consequences and the alignment with crucial planning considerations such as giving space to other road actors. To overcome these limitations, we propose a reinforcement learning fine-tuning (RLFT) approach, MAGNIFIED, that aligns the MLLM-based driving agent with planning objectives by learning from token-level rewards. By mapping a sequence of predicted tokens to corresponding vehicle trajectories and learning from planning rewards, MAGNIFIED optimizes for the true planning objectives rather than focusing solely on token prediction accuracy, enabling the model to refine its understanding of the planning task beyond simple imitation. We validate our approach on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset with a novel setup incorporating rasterized birds-eye views and tokenized trajectories as inputs and planning-oriented outputs. An initial SFT phase establishes a strong baseline in outputting plan trajectories as sequences of X-Y coordinates in text, while subsequent RL fine-tuning substantially enhances planning performance relative to the SFT baseline (demonstrating over a 10.5% reduction in overlap rate and a 38.9% reduction in off-road rate), underscoring the potential of RLFT on MLLMs to achieve vehicle planning that is better aligned with compliant, comfortable, and efficient driving.
papers.journal_ref: ICRA 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAGNIFIED，一种针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的强化学习微调方法，用于自动驾驶运动规划。该方法通过将预测的 token 序列映射到车辆轨迹，并使用规划奖励进行 RL 微调，以优化真实规划目标而非仅模仿 token 预测。在 Waymo Open Motion Dataset 上，相比 SFT 基线，重叠率降低 10.5%，离路率降低 38.9%。
Motivation: 传统 MLLMs 的预训练和监督微调使用下一个 token 预测目标，仅鼓励逐 token 的文本模仿，忽视了多步后果和规划关键因素（如给其他道路参与者让空间），无法满足自动驾驶规划目标。
Method: 提出 MAGNIFIED 方法，对 MLLM 进行强化学习微调，从 token 级别奖励中学习规划目标。将预测的 token 序列映射到对应的车辆轨迹，并利用规划奖励进行优化，使模型超越简单模仿，细化对规划任务的理解。
Result: 在 Waymo Open Motion Dataset 上，基于鸟瞰栅格图和 token 化轨迹作为输入，经过初始 SFT 阶段后再进行 RL 微调，相比 SFT 基线，重叠率降低超过 10.5%，离路率降低 38.9%，表明 RLFT 在 MLLMs 上实现更合规、舒适和高效的车辆规划。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 RLFT 方法在 MLLMs 上实现与合规、舒适、高效驾驶更好对齐的潜力。

papers.title: An LLM-Explainable DRL Framework for Passenger-Directed Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous vehicles offer the potential for safer and more efficient mobility, yet public trust remains limited due to the lack of transparency in their decision-making. This work addresses this issue by combining deep reinforcement learning (DRL) for adaptive driving control with large language model (LLM)-based explainability modules designed to communicate agent behavior to passengers. DRL agents were trained in simulation using a Dueling Double Deep Q-Network to follow distinct driving requests: \textit{fast}, \textit{comfort}, and \textit{stop}. They demonstrated stable learning, safe compliance with traffic rules, and reliable switching between modes within a single trip. In parallel, LLM modules were introduced to interpret passenger requests, determine when explanations were needed, and generate concise, safety-oriented justifications. Results show that this framework, serving as a proof of concept for integrating RL decision-making and LLMs, balances safety, adaptability, and explainability, and is most effective when requests are delayed or overridden due to safety constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合深度强化学习（DRL）与大语言模型（LLM）可解释性模块的框架，用于乘客导向的自动驾驶。DRL代理使用Dueling Double DQN在仿真中训练以响应不同驾驶请求（快速、舒适、停止），并展示稳定学习和安全合规。LLM模块解释乘客请求并生成安全导向的说明。摘要指出该方法在请求因安全约束被延迟或覆盖时最有效。
Motivation: 公众对自动驾驶信任度低，因为决策缺乏透明性。本文旨在通过结合DRL自适应控制和LLM可解释性模块来增强乘客对自动驾驶行为的理解。
Method: 使用Dueling Double Deep Q-Network训练DRL代理，使其能在一次行程中根据乘客指令（快速、舒适、停止）切换驾驶模式。并行引入LLM模块，用于解析乘客请求、判断何时需要解释，并生成简洁的安全导向说明。
Result: DRL代理在仿真中表现稳定，能安全遵守交通规则并可靠切换模式。LLM模块在请求因安全约束被延迟或覆盖时最有效，实现了安全性、适应性和可解释性的平衡。
Conclusion: 该框架作为将RL决策与LLM可解释性集成的概念验证，表明在保障安全的前提下能兼顾乘客指令适应性和决策透明度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RIZZ: Routing Interactions to Near Zero-Interference Zones for Continual Adaptation of Black-Box Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as long-lived agents that must adapt across users, tasks, domains, modalities, and feedback regimes without access to model weights. Existing black-box adaptation methods typically optimize a single prompt, maintain an undifferentiated memory, or rely on repeated rollout-heavy search. However, these designs struggle when streams of input are nonstationary, feedback is sparse, and failures from one task family can contaminate behavior on another. We introduce RIZZ (Routing Interactions to Near Zero-interference Zones), a continual adaptation framework for compound language-model systems that learns entirely through verifier-gated memory, routing, and prompt compilation. RIZZ organizes input streams into dynamically spawned memory branches. At inference time, either while online or offline, a context-aware router selects or creates a branch that retrieves branch-local, global, graph-structured, and working-memory context, which is compiled into a bounded prompt together with retrieved task evidence. After the model acts, task verifiers score the output, and only verified interactions can update memory, promote reusable rules, demote harmful rules, or create anti-patterns. This yields a black-box agent that improves through persistent natural-language feedback while explicitly controlling interference. RIZZ targets the regime where adaptation must occur online under context budgets. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework against state-of-the-art baselines on competitive benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RIZZ框架，用于黑盒语言模型代理的持续适应，通过验证器门控记忆、动态分支路由和提示编译，显式控制跨任务干扰，在非平稳输入和稀疏反馈下提升适应能力。
Motivation: 现有黑盒适应方法在非平稳输入、稀疏反馈和任务间干扰场景下表现不佳，尤其是单一提示或未区分的记忆容易导致跨任务污染。
Method: RIZZ将输入流组织成动态记忆分支，推理时由上下文感知路由器选择或创建分支，整合多种上下文（分支局部、全局、图结构、工作记忆）编译成有界提示；模型输出经任务验证器评分后，仅通过验证的交互更新记忆、推广或降级规则、创建反模式。
Result: 在竞争性基准上，RIZZ优于现有最先进的黑盒适应方法。
Conclusion: RIZZ通过显式控制干扰，实现了在线、上下文预算约束下的黑盒代理持续适应，适用于需要持久自然语言反馈的场景。

papers.title: Constituency Optimisation Through Hamiltonian Representation Of Mandates (COTHROM): Algorithmic Redistricting of Irish Election Boundaries
papers.abstract_en: Electoral redistricting in Ireland's Proportional Representation Single Transferable Vote (PR-STV) system faces the challenge of selecting an optimally representative set of electoral boundaries from an enormous set of possible configurations, and where ``representative'' is a delicate balance of constitutional objectives that are often in tension with one another. We present the first computational framework for Irish electoral redistricting that systematically optimises across multiple constitutional requirements while making trade-offs explicit and quantifiable. The electoral redistricting problem is parsed using statistical physics, where constitutional objectives are considered as terms in a Potts Hamiltonian. Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods and simulated annealing are employed to minimise this objective function, systematically exploring this configuration space, with coupling constants as proxies for objective weightings. Multi Criterion Decision Analysis (MCDA) and Pareto Optimality is then utilised to remedy the ambiguity in choosing a certain objective weighting combination over others. With respect to proportional representation and compactness objectives evaluated in County Cork, COTHROM consistently improves on the existing legal constituency boundaries for a range of objective weightings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了第一个用于爱尔兰选举重新划界的计算框架COTHROM，通过统计物理学方法（Potts Hamiltonian、MCMC、模拟退火）优化多个宪法目标，并在科克郡的选区划分中一致改进了现有边界。
Motivation: 爱尔兰PR-STV选举制度中的选区划分面临巨大配置空间，且宪法目标（如比例代表制、紧凑性）之间存在权衡，缺乏系统优化框架。
Method: 将选区划分问题视为统计物理学中的Potts模型，目标函数为包含多个宪法项的哈密顿量，使用MCMC和模拟退火最小化，并通过多准则决策分析和帕累托最优解决权重模糊问题。
Result: 在科克郡的评估中，COTHROM在比例代表制和紧凑性目标上，对于一系列权重组合，一致优于现有法律选区边界。
Conclusion: 该框架首次实现了爱尔兰选区划分的多目标显式权衡优化，展示了统计物理学方法的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SkillHarness: Harnessing Safe Skills for Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Computer-Use Agents (CUAs) are increasingly deployed in dynamic interactive environments, creating a growing need for continual skill learning during interaction. Recent approaches address this challenge by learning reusable skills from successful trajectories. However, these skill learning methods largely assume static and safe environments, overlooking risks from adversarial interactions (e.g., prompt injections) and environmental dynamics (e.g., pop-ups). In dynamic settings, such assumptions can lead to risky skill learning and brittle execution, undermining the reliability of CUAs. This raises the question: how can CUAs learn and use skills safely in dynamic environments? To address this problem, we propose SkillHarness, a framework for safe skill harnessing in dynamic environments. SkillHarness moves beyond static skill abstractions by modeling skill learning and utilization as a safety-constrained interaction process. Specifically, we introduce the skill boundary that leverages multi-source supervision signals to identify safe skills from interaction trajectories, and construct self-improving safety constraints throughout the skill lifecycle. In addition, SkillHarness introduces selective skill reuse, where tasks are guided to decompose according to context and completed through the selective activation of skill subsets. Our experiments demonstrate that SkillHarness significantly reduces the unsafe rate of learned skills by 57.1% and consistently improves execution stability under dynamic environmental changes, outperforming existing baselines.

Result: 在不安全率指标上降低了57.1%，且在动态环境变化下持续提升执行稳定性，优于现有基线。
Conclusion: SkillHarness通过安全约束建模和选择性重用，有效提升了CUAs在动态环境中的安全性与可靠性。

papers.title: Measuring the Occupation-Level Impact of AbbVie Intelligence: AI Applicability Analysis, 2024-2025
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an empirical analysis of AbbVie Intelligence's measurable impact on employee work activities across 192 distinct occupations in 2024 and 2025. Drawing on 598,744 de-identified AI conversations classified according to the O*NET Intermediate Work Activity (IWA) taxonomy, we compute occupation-level AI Applicability Scores that quantify the extent to which AI tools can meaningfully assist or automate real work at scale. Three convergent analyses are conducted: (1) longitudinal year-over-year trends from 2024 to 2025, (2) a quasi-experimental pre-post evaluation of the AbbVie Intelligence version 3 platform release in August 2025, and (3) a pre-post evaluation of the AbbVie AI Learning Summit held in November 22025. Results demonstrate statistically significant improvements across all three dimensions. Mean AI Applicability Scores rose substantially from 2024 to 2025; the platform release product a +10.0% gain (p<0.001); and the AI Learning Summit produced a +6.68% gain (p<0.001). These findings establish that both technological platform enhancements and structured enterprise AI eduction programs independently and substantially expand the reach of AI across the AbbVie workforce.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文实证分析了AbbVie公司的AI工具（AbbVie Intelligence）在2024-2025年间对192种职业工作活动的可应用性影响。基于598,744条去标识化的AI对话，按照O*NET中间工作活动（IWA）分类法计算职业级AI适用性分数。三个收敛分析显示：年度均值显著上升；2025年8月平台版本发布带来+10.0%的提升（p<0.001）；AI学习峰会带来+6.68%的提升（p<0.001）。结论认为技术平台增强和结构化AI教育计划均独立且显著地扩展了AI在劳动力中的覆盖范围。
Motivation: 需要量化AI工具对具体职业工作活动的实际影响，而现有研究缺乏基于真实企业大规模部署数据的职业级适用性分析。
Method: 收集AbbVie内部AI对话数据，按O*NET IWA分类，计算每个职业的AI适用性分数。通过纵向对比、准实验前后测试（平台发布和学习峰会）三个维度进行统计分析。
Result: 从2024到2025年AI适用性分数显著上升；平台版本发布产生+10.0%的增益；AI学习峰会产生+6.68%的增益，均p<0.001。
Conclusion: 技术平台升级和结构化的AI教育项目能独立且显著地提高AI对职业工作活动的可应用性，为企业在AI部署和人才培养提供量化依据。

papers.title: DEMM-Bench: A Cross-Regime Benchmark for Agent-Runtime Governance-Evidence Sufficiency
papers.abstract_en: Agent-runtime systems emit traces, ledgers, provenance graphs, policy logs, delegation tokens, cache events, and tool-firewall records, but those containers do not necessarily answer governance questions about a specific decision. DEMM-Bench is a cross-regime benchmark for agent-runtime governance-evidence sufficiency, grounded in the Decision Evidence Maturity Model (DEMM): it measures whether records across eight evidence regimes are sufficient to reconstruct decision-level properties rather than merely present. The benchmark normalizes the regimes through adapters, asks property questions over actor, authority, action, policy, decision basis, resource touch, lifecycle context, and verification strength, and applies eight deterministic degradation conditions. Across 64 manuscript cases, trace-present and schema-present baselines overclaim on 75% of cases, ledger-present overclaims on 50%, and the redacted property-level candidate scorer has zero overclaim with 56.25% mean Property Sufficiency Accuracy. The deposited package provides the 64-case dataset, construction-oracle labels, baselines, and adapters, supporting reproducible evaluation of decision-evidence maturity across heterogeneous agent-runtime evidence substrates.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 8 tables, no figures. Benchmark and dataset paper. Dataset (CC-BY-4.0) and code (Apache-2.0): Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.20426092 and Hugging Face https://huggingface.co/datasets/dev404ai/DEMM-Bench; code at https://github.com/agent-runtime-evidence/decision-evidence-benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DEMM-Bench 是一个针对代理运行时治理证据充分性的跨机制基准，基于决策证据成熟度模型 (DEMM)。它测量八个证据机制（如追踪、账本、策略日志等）的记录是否足以重构决策级属性，而非仅仅呈现。在 64 个手写案例上，追踪存在和模式存在的基线在 75% 的案例中过度声称，账本存在在 50% 中过度声称，而脱敏的属性级候选评分器实现零过度声称，平均属性充分性准确率为 56.25%。
Motivation: 代理运行时系统产生多种记录（追踪、账本、策略日志等），但这些记录不一定能够回答关于特定决策的治理问题。需要一个基准来评估证据是否充分支持决策级属性重构。
Method: 提出 DEMM-Bench，通过适配器归一化八个证据机制，提出关于行为者、权威、行动、策略、决策基础、资源接触、生命周期上下文和验证强度的属性问题，并应用八种确定性退化条件。提供 64 个案例数据集、构造-预言标签、基线和适配器。
Result: 在 64 个案例上，追踪存在和模式存在的基线在 75% 的案例中过度声称，账本存在在 50% 中过度声称，而脱敏的属性级候选评分器实现零过度声称，平均属性充分性准确率为 56.25%。
Conclusion: DEMM-Bench 支持对异构代理运行时证据基质进行可重复的决策证据成熟度评估，并揭示了常见基线在证据充分性方面的过度声称问题。

papers.title: Post-Training Recipe, More Than Model Family, Shapes Multi-Agent LLM Conversational Behavior
papers.abstract_en: Multi-LLM systems use multiple language models to deliberate, judge each other's outputs, or coordinate as agents. Their value depends on the models producing measurably different conversational behaviors when given the same input. Prior offline studies recommend drawing one model per family for behavioral diversity, because LLMs prefer outputs from their own family when rating one another in isolation. Whether the same family label predicts behavior in interactive multi-LLM systems, the setting that real deployed systems use, has not been tested. We study this with a 940,000-chain 11-checkpoint corpus and a 1.6M-chain same-base Llama factorial. On our validated headline metric, hedging, a reasoning-distilled Llama checkpoint shifts by 18% depending on which same-base partner it replies to, more than any cross-family hedging gap in the controlled subset. Qwen, closed-API, and runtime checks suggest the pattern is not isolated, while repair and challenge analyses remain exploratory because their surface-cue detectors are weaker. Overall, the results identify post-training recipe as a first-class axis for multi-LLM panel composition and show that model family alone is an incomplete proxy for conversational diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过大规模实验（94万链11检查点语料库和160万链同基Llama阶乘）研究多LLM系统中的对话行为多样性，发现后训练配方（post-training recipe）对模型行为的影响显著大于模型家族。在主要指标hedging上，同一基础模型经不同后训练得到的检查点在与不同同基伙伴交互时变化达18%，超过任何跨家族差距。结果表明，模型家族不能作为对话多样性的完整代理，后训练配方应成为多LLM面板组成的关键考虑因素。
Motivation: 之前离线研究建议按模型家族选择行为多样的模型，因为LLM在孤立评价中偏好同家族输出，但该推荐在真实交互式多LLM系统中未经验证。
Method: 构建大规模多LLM对话数据（940,000链11检查点语料库和1.6M链同基Llama阶乘），以hedging为核心指标，分析不同后训练配方和同基/跨家族配对下的对话行为差异。
Result: 推理蒸馏的Llama检查点根据回答的不同同基伙伴，hedging变化达18%，超过任何跨家族hedging差距。Qwen、封闭API和运行时检查表明该模式具有普遍性。
Conclusion: 后训练配方是多LLM系统面板组成的一级轴，模型家族不能充分代表对话多样性；repair和challenge分析仍需更强表面线索检测器的进一步探索。

papers.title: Harnessing Agent Skills: Architectural Patterns and a Reference Architecture for Skill-Mediated LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills externalise reusable agent-facing behavioural knowledge and guidance as persistent artefacts that can be discovered, activated, and interpreted by LLM agents. Although a skill artefact is static at rest, its architectural responsibilities arise in use, when the artefact is selected for a run, bound to context and authority constraints, interpreted by a stochastic agent, and recorded as run evidence. We call this run-specific relation skill-in-use. This paper studies agent skill harnessing: the architectural responsibilities that govern the transition from skill artefacts to skill-in-use, bound the executable consequences associated with skill-in-use, and capture evidence for attribution, verification, repair, and evolution. This paper provides a catalogue of ten empirically grounded architectural patterns (five core, five supporting) for skill harnessing and synthesises them into a reference architecture with four responsibility layers: Supply Chain, Mediation, Execution Control, and Evidence & Feedback. We evaluate the architecture through cross-instantiation across 8 selected systems. The resulting patterns and reference architecture provide a vocabulary and diagnostic frame for analysing skill-harnessing responsibilities across agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM代理技能（agent skills）的架构模式，提出了一个技能中介的参考架构，包含四个责任层：供应链、中介、执行控制、证据与反馈，并通过8个系统评估。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理系统缺乏对技能从静态构件到运行时使用（skill-in-use）的系统化架构责任划分，导致可重用性、约束绑定和证据记录不足。
Method: 通过实证研究归纳出10个架构模式（5核心+5支持），并综合为四层参考架构，覆盖技能供应链、中介、执行控制及证据反馈。
Result: 通过8个系统的交叉实例化验证了参考架构的覆盖性和诊断能力，提供了分析代理技能责任的词汇和框架。
Conclusion: 提出的模式和架构可作为设计和调试技能中介LLM系统的结构化工具，但仍需更广泛的验证和演化。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Design Principles for Human-Agent Interaction
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are rapidly evolving into autonomous systems capable of sustained interaction, tool use, and long-term collaboration. Yet their real-world adoption remains limited, suggesting that the key barrier lies not only in technical capability but also in a lack of design knowledge for successful human-agent interaction. This position paper argues that AI agents should not be solely evaluated or deployed based on autonomous task capability alone; because agents interact with, adapt to, influence, and sometimes fail humans, human-agent interaction must be treated as a core design and evaluation target for agentic AI. We present 14 design principles that articulate the ideal human-agent relationship across four interaction stages: initially, during interaction, over time, and when things go wrong. We use these principles to evaluate nine agent systems to illustrate that these design principles can provide actionable guidance for AI design teams to systematically design and evaluate agents that are usable, trustworthy, and effective in real-world interactive settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出 AI 代理的成功不能仅依靠自主任务能力，人-代理交互本身应成为设计和评估的核心目标。作者提出 14 条设计原则，涵盖初始、交互、长期和出错四个阶段，并用这些原则评估了 9 个代理系统，展示了其为实际交互设计提供系统化指导的潜力。
Motivation: AI 代理在现实中采纳有限，关键障碍不仅是技术能力，更是缺少人-代理交互的设计知识。现有评估往往忽略交互质量，导致代理不可用、不可信或低效。
Method: 提出 14 条设计原则，覆盖人-代理交互的四个阶段（初始、交互过程、长期、出错时），并用这些原则对 9 个现有代理系统进行定性评估。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，仅说明该原则体系能为设计团队提供可操作指导，使代理在真实交互中更可用、可信和有效。
Conclusion: 人-代理交互应作为代理 AI 的核心设计目标，所提出的设计原则可用于系统化设计和评估，以提升代理的实用性和信任度。

summary_sections.motivation: AI 代理在现实中采纳有限，关键障碍不仅是技术能力，更是缺少人-代理交互的设计知识。现有评估往往忽略交互质量，导致代理不可用、不可信或低效。
summary_sections.method: 提出 14 条设计原则，覆盖人-代理交互的四个阶段（初始、交互过程、长期、出错时），并用这些原则对 9 个现有代理系统进行定性评估。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未提供定量结果，仅说明该原则体系能为设计团队提供可操作指导，使代理在真实交互中更可用、可信和有效。
summary_sections.conclusion: 人-代理交互应作为代理 AI 的核心设计目标，所提出的设计原则可用于系统化设计和评估，以提升代理的实用性和信任度。

papers.title: Specialize Roles, Mix Deployments: Pushing the Cost-Accuracy Frontier of LLM Agent Teams
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly deployed as multi-role teams, where tasks are divided across specialized roles such as planner, executor, and verifier. In these systems, cost and accuracy are no longer properties of a single model: they depend on which model fills each role and where it is hosted, including API, self-hosted, and hybrid deployment. Existing agentic benchmarks typically evaluate fixed models or fixed agent configurations, and therefore offer limited guidance for cost-accuracy-optimal deployment. We introduce AgentCARD, a role-aware benchmark suite for evaluating LLM agent teams across role assignment and deployment mode. AgentCARD combines a role-decomposed evaluation harness, a unified API/self-hosted cost model, Pareto-frontier analysis, and a Shapley-based diagnostic for identifying role bottlenecks. Our evaluation shows that heterogeneous teams consistently occupy the cost-accuracy frontier. They improve accuracy by up to $44\%$ over cost-equivalent homogeneous teams, or match the strongest homogeneous team at up to $12\times$ lower per-task cost through hybrid deployment. We further find that the best role assignment is domain-dependent: some domains are planner-bottlenecked, while others are executor-bottlenecked. Finally, AgentCARD extends beyond planner--executor teams to workflows with additional roles such as verification, and supports continual evaluation as new domains and team structures emerge. Our code is released at: https://github.com/Auto-CAP/AgentCAP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentCARD，一个角色感知的基准套件，用于评估LLM agent团队在角色分配和部署模式下的成本与准确性。实验表明，异构团队占据成本-准确性前沿，相比成本相等的同构团队准确率提升最多44%，或通过混合部署将成本降低12倍。最佳角色分配依赖于领域，不同领域存在不同的角色瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有agent基准通常评估固定模型或固定配置，缺乏对成本-准确性最优部署的指导，无法支持多角色团队的异构部署决策。
Method: 提出AgentCARD，包含角色分解评估框架、统一API/自托管成本模型、帕累托前沿分析以及基于Shapley值的角色瓶颈诊断工具。
Result: 异构团队在成本-准确性前沿上持续领先：相比成本相等的同构团队准确率提升最多44%，或通过混合部署将成本降低12倍。最佳角色分配呈领域依赖性。
Conclusion: AgentCARD可扩展至包含验证等多角色的工作流，并支持新领域和团队结构的持续评估。

papers.title: Human Decision-Making with AI Assistance under Correlated Features
papers.abstract_en: Humans increasingly make decisions with AI assistance; for example, doctors may follow AI-recommended diagnostic tests and base their diagnoses on the results. A natural question is which tests should AI recommend to balance short-term decision quality and long-term human learning when different features (e.g., test results) are correlated. While prior work establishes that stationary policies that recommend the same tests repeatedly are optimal when features are independent, we prove that feature correlations lead such policies to perform arbitrarily poorly. Instead, we prove that any optimal policy must follow an explore-then-commit structure; initially, the AI should offer diverse tests so humans can learn accurate feature coefficients, then the AI should commit to a single set of tests, with exploration length that depends on the degree of feature correlation. We prove that computing the optimal policy is NP-hard and derive a dynamic programming-based algorithm that finds the optimal policy for finite horizons. We additionally develop an approximation that plans for shorter horizons and appends a stationary suffix, achieving near-optimal performance. Our empirical results complement our theory by showing that stronger feature correlation leads to longer exploration phases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在特征存在相关性时，AI如何推荐诊断测试以平衡短期决策质量与长期人类学习。理论证明特征相关会导致静态策略表现极差，而最优策略需遵循探索-承诺结构：先提供多样化测试使人类学习准确系数，再固定测试集。计算最优策略是NP-hard，提出动态规划算法和近似方法，实验表明特征相关性越强探索期越长。
Motivation: 现有工作假设特征独立时静态策略最优，但特征相关场景下该策略效果极差，需探索更优的推荐策略。
Method: 证明最优策略必须为探索-承诺结构；证明计算最优策略是NP-hard；提出针对有限时域的动态规划算法以及规划短时域后接静态后缀的近似方法。
Result: 理论证明特征相关下静态策略任意差；实验显示特征相关性越强，最优策略的探索期越长。
Conclusion: 特征相关性对AI辅助决策的推荐策略设计至关重要，探索-承诺结构能有效应对相关特征。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Latent Goal Prediction from Language for Model-Based Planning
papers.abstract_en: Planning with world models is bottlenecked by compounding prediction errors and the difficulty of defining optimizable goals. Visual targets provide precise local gradients but poor distant guidance, while language is flexible yet limited by noisy cross-modal alignment or dependence on large generative models unsuited for the high-sampling nature of model-based planning. To address these challenges, we introduce Latent Goal Prediction from Language (LAGO), a framework that predicts both sequences of intermediate goal states from language instructions and action-conditioned rollouts, all within the same latent space. Rather than optimizing toward a single global objective, LAGO dynamically decomposes instructions into explicitly predicted, locally tractable latent subgoals. By updating these subgoals online and using a soft minimum trajectory cost during planning, LAGO enables an agent to follow coherent latent trajectories over long horizons. Evaluation across multiple environments planning horizons shows that LAGO avoids the sharp degradation of prior methods. By achieving robust and precise long-horizon planning purely from language, LAGO bridges the precision of visual goals with the flexibility of text-guided control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LAGO 框架，从语言指令在潜在空间中同时预测中间子目标状态序列和动作条件 rollout。通过动态分解指令为局部可处理的潜在子目标，并采用软最小轨迹成本在线更新，实现了长程连贯规划。实验表明该方法避免了先前方法在长时域规划中的性能急剧退化。
Motivation: 现有模型基规划受困于累积预测误差和难以定义可优化目标：视觉目标虽提供精确局部梯度但缺乏远距离指导，语言目标灵活但受跨模态对齐噪声或依赖大生成模型，不适用于高采样需求的规划。
Method: LAGO 在统一潜在空间中预测语言指令对应的中间子目标序列，并在线更新这些子目标；规划时采用软最小轨迹成本（soft minimum trajectory cost）替代单一全局目标优化。
Result: 在多个环境的长时域规划任务上，LAGO 避免了先前方法的性能急剧退化，实现了稳健且精确的长程规划。
Conclusion: LAGO 桥接了视觉目标的精确性与语言引导的灵活性，实现了纯文本驱动的长时域精确规划。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Safety Benchmarking via Item Response Theory
papers.abstract_en: Safety benchmarks for language models are typically evaluated using static paradigms that treat all items as equally informative for all models, an assumption that is particularly problematic for adversarial, highly heterogeneous safety items. Applied in full to modern benchmark suites, the current evaluation procedures would require on the order of $10^5$ responses, most of which provide little ranking signal. We analyze a suite of widely used safety benchmarks and make three contributions toward more efficient safety evaluation. First, we show that Item Response Theory (IRT) recovers interpretable structure on safety benchmarks, with ability estimates resolving differences among models that cluster at the ceiling of raw safety metrics. Second, we show that adaptive item selection, which dynamically chooses informative items for each model based on its responses, approximates full-benchmark rankings while reducing evaluation cost by at least 80% on benchmarks where Spearman's $ρ>$90% with full-benchmark is attainable, and by up to 99.9% on AIR-Bench 2024. Third, we introduce a practical procedure for extracting a fixed, informative subset of items reusable across models, providing an alternative to adaptive selection with savings of up to 99.8% on AIR-Bench 2024. Together, these results establish that psychometric methods enable benchmark-aware reductions in evaluation costs across the safety evaluation pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语言模型安全基准测试中静态评估效率低下的问题，引入项目反应理论（IRT）进行高效评估。研究表明，IRT能够从安全基准中恢复可解释的结构，自适应项目选择可在保持排名准确性的前提下将评估成本降低至少80%，在AIR-Bench 2024上最高降低99.9%。同时，提取的固定信息子集可跨模型复用，节省最多99.8%的成本。
Motivation: 现有安全基准测试采用静态评估，假设所有项目对所有模型的信息量相同，这在对抗性、高度异质的安全项目中问题突出。完整评估需要约10^5个响应，但大部分提供很少排名信号，导致效率低下。
Method: 使用项目反应理论（IRT）对安全基准建模，通过自适应项目选择动态为每个模型挑选信息量大的项目，并设计提取固定可复用信息子集的实用方法。
Result: IRT能区分在原始安全指标上处于顶峰的模型差异；自适应选择在保持Spearman ρ>90%的前提下减少至少80%的评估成本，在AIR-Bench 2024上降低99.9%；固定子集方法在AIR-Bench 2024上节省99.8%成本。
Conclusion: 心理测量方法（如IRT）能够实现安全评估全流程中基准感知的成本降低，为高效安全评测提供可行路径。

papers.title: AlphaMemo: Structured Search-Process Memory for Self-Evolving Alpha Mining Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are promising for alpha mining via combining financial priors, symbolic reasoning, executable factor generation, and feedback-driven refinement. Yet, they face a combinatorial search space, noisy non-stationary feedback, redundant discoveries, and overfitting risks from naively reusing past successes. To address these challenges, we propose AlphaMemo, a self-evolving alpha mining agent with Structured Search-Process Memory. Rather than memorizing only final factors or full trajectories, AlphaMemo records reusable evidence about which edit motifs work or fail under specific parent-factor contexts. It extracts motifs from Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) differences, applies confidence-gated residual memory on top of a search-ledger prior, and uses asymmetric veto control to suppress high-confidence failure patterns. Experiments on CSI 500 and S\&P 500 show improved out-of-sample performance and fixed-budget discovery efficiency, with ablations validating the roles of residual learning, confidence gating, AST-diff motifs, and veto memory. Code is at https://github.com/jarrettyu/AlphaMemo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AlphaMemo，一种基于结构化搜索过程记忆的自进化alpha挖掘智能体。它通过记录编辑模因（edit motifs）在特定父因子上下文中的成功/失败模式，并采用置信门控残差记忆和非对称否决控制来优化搜索过程。在CSI 500和S&P 500上的实验显示，该方法提升了样本外表现和固定预算下的发现效率。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体在alpha挖掘中面临组合搜索空间、非平稳噪声反馈、冗余发现以及过拟合风险，缺乏对搜索过程的结构化记忆。
Method: 提出结构化搜索过程记忆，从抽象语法树（AST）差异中提取编辑模因，使用置信门控残差记忆叠加在搜索账本先验上，并通过非对称否决控制抑制高置信度失败模式。
Result: 在CSI 500和S&P 500指数上的实验表明，该方法提升了样本外表现和固定预算下的发现效率；消融实验验证了残差学习、置信门控、AST差异模因和否决记忆各自的有效性。
Conclusion: 结构化搜索过程记忆能有效缓解过拟合和冗余问题，提升alpha挖掘的泛化能力和搜索效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: In LLM Reasoning, there is Irrationality on top of Value Misalignment
papers.abstract_en: Significant progress has been made in aligning LLMs with target value functions. We argue that, even when an LLM has been well aligned in (post-)training, it may still fail to maximise the aligned value in reasoning. We mathematically formalise this gap as rational value risk: the utility discrepancy between a model's deployed reasoning strategy and its rational counterpart, which is defined to be the responses that maximise expected utility in the steepest direction. The estimation error of rational value risk is further decomposed into three components from finite candidates, finite prompts, and imperfect verifiers. Extensive experiments are conducted, covering models Llama-3.1, Qwen-2.5, T{\"}ulu-3 families (7B-72B), GPT-5.2, GPT-5.5, and DeepSeek-V4, and benchmarks UltraFeedback, AlpacaEval, GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, and MathArena. The results validate that (1) rational value risk is widespread; (2) value alignment can reduce, but cannot eliminate, it; (3) the risk is highly sensitive to inference-time reasoning strategy; and (4) longer reasoning improves rationality with diminishing returns. The code is at https://github.com/EVIEHub/LLM-Rationality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了大语言模型（LLM）在推理过程中即使经过价值对齐（value alignment）训练，仍可能无法最大化对齐价值的现象。作者将这一差距形式化为“理性价值风险”（rational value risk），并将其估计误差分解为有限候选、有限提示和不完美验证器三个来源。实验覆盖多个主流模型和基准，验证了理性价值风险的普遍性、对齐无法消除该风险、对推理策略的高敏感性以及更长推理带来的收益递减。
Motivation: 现有LLM对齐工作主要关注训练阶段的价值对齐，但忽略了推理阶段即使模型已对齐仍可能表现非理性，导致实际效用损失。
Method: 形式化定义理性价值风险为模型部署推理策略与理性策略（在梯度最陡方向最大化期望效用的响应）之间的效用差异，并将估计误差分解为有限候选、有限提示和不完美验证器三部分。
Result: 实验表明（1）理性价值风险广泛存在；（2）价值对齐可降低但无法消除该风险；（3）该风险对推理时策略高度敏感；（4）更长推理提高理性但收益递减。
Conclusion: 即使价值对齐已取得进展，LLM推理中仍存在非理性问题，需要关注推理阶段的对齐或优化。

papers.title: Path-dependent program induction under resource constraints explains human sequence learning
papers.abstract_en: How do people build abstract, reusable knowledge from sequential experience under bounded cognitive resources? To answer this question, we integrate rate-distortion theory with recent advances in program induction to describe how prior knowledge shapes which future structures are cheap to encode and easy to discover. We formalize this in a hierarchical Adaptor Grammar (HAG) with distinct local (within-task) and global (across-task) libraries, governed jointly by constraints on memory and computation. In simulations, HAG achieves better rate-distortion trade-offs and stronger generalization than fixed grammars or shallow chunking methods. In an online melodic sequence-learning experiment, participants' recall errors reflected systematic simplifications and reaction times increased at inferred program boundaries. Trial-by-trial fits further showed that hierarchical libraries best explained individual differences in both recall and out-of-sample continuation choices, outperforming all alternative models. These findings cast structured learning as bounded program induction in which the order of experience shapes future abstractions a learner builds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将率失真理论与程序归纳结合，提出分层适应语法（HAG）模型，用于解释人类在有限认知资源下如何从序列经验中构建抽象、可重用的知识。HAG模型包含局部（任务内）和全局（跨任务）库，受记忆和计算约束共同调控。在模拟中，HAG在率失真权衡和泛化能力上优于固定语法或浅层分块方法；在线旋律序列学习实验中，参与者的回忆错误和反应时间模式支持了HAG的预测，分层库最好地解释了个体差异。
Motivation: 理解人类如何在有限认知资源下从序列经验中学习抽象、可重用的知识，现有模型（如固定语法、浅层分块）无法充分解释路径依赖性和资源约束的作用。
Method: 提出分层适应语法（Hierarchical Adaptor Grammar, HAG）模型，整合率失真理论（rate-distortion theory）和程序归纳（program induction），包含局部（within-task）和全局（across-task）库，受记忆与计算约束共同调控，并通过在线旋律序列学习实验进行验证。
Result: 模拟中HAG取得更好的率失真权衡和更强的泛化；实验中参与者回忆错误反映系统简化，反应时间在推断的程序边界增加；逐试次拟合表明分层库在回忆和续接选择上优于所有替代模型。
Conclusion: 结构化学习可视为有界程序归纳，经验顺序塑造了学习者建立的未来抽象结构。

papers.title: Darwin Mobile Agent: A Roadmap for Self-Evolution
papers.abstract_en: The goal of artificial intelligence is to create agents capable of general, adaptive behaviour in open-ended environments. Guided by the "Bitter Lesson", we argue that the most effective path toward this goal is to systematically remove human priors and allow intelligence to naturally emerge through interaction with a "Big World" that is orders of magnitude more complex than the agent itself. We propose the mobile Graphical User Interface (GUI) as a practical proxy for such a world and introduce Darwin Mobile Agent, an open-source infrastructure designed as a foundation for autonomous reinforcement learning in this domain. This framework addresses the data-collection bottleneck in real-world mobile interactions by using an asynchronous agent-environment loop across parallel cloud-phone instances. We further propose a conceptual roadmap to systematically remove human priors from three fundamental pillars of a self-evolving agent: task curricula, outcome verification, and memory management. We validate that the Darwin infrastructure provides the stability and scalability required for the first stage of this roadmap: policy optimisation in the GUI domain. This work establishes the practical and theoretical foundation necessary to move toward truly autonomous, self-evolving GUI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Darwin Mobile Agent，一个用于移动GUI自主强化学习的开源框架。该框架通过异步代理-环境循环在并行云手机实例上运行，解决真实移动数据收集瓶颈，并提出了逐步消除人类先验的路线图，涵盖任务课程、结果验证和内存管理三个支柱。验证表明该基础设施为GUI策略优化提供了所需的稳定性和可扩展性。
Motivation: 目标是创造通用自适应智能体，认为最有效途径是消除人类先验，让智能在复杂世界中自然涌现。移动GUI被视为复杂世界的代理，但现有方法在数据收集和人类先验依赖方面存在瓶颈。
Method: 提出Darwin Mobile Agent框架，使用异步代理-环境循环在并行云手机实例上运行，解决数据收集问题。同时提出概念性路线图，系统性地从任务课程、结果验证和内存管理三个支柱中移除人类先验。
Result: 验证了Darwin基础设施为GUI领域策略优化的第一阶段提供了稳定性和可扩展性。
Conclusion: 建立了向真正自主、自我进化GUI代理移动的理论和实践基础，为后续消除人类先验的步骤铺平道路。

papers.title: PEAR: Permutation-Equivariant Adaptive Routing Multi-Agent Debate
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent debate improves the reliability of large language models (LLMs) through iterative peer critiques. However, fixed topologies often introduce persistent positional biases, amplify unreliable agents, and cause high sensitivity to role assignments. We introduce \textit{Permutation-Equivariant Adaptive Routing Multi-Agent Debate (PEAR)}, an inference-time protocol that dynamically reconfigures communication roles and sparse topologies across consecutive debate rounds. By strategically switching agent-to-role assignments based on evolving agent states, PEAR prevents any agent from permanently occupying a privileged network position or distributes influence more evenly across the debate. We theoretically characterize PEAR as an equivariant sparse router: it preserves accuracy under agent relabeling while reducing routing complexity and improving generalization. Comprehensive empirical evaluations across four reasoning benchmarks and six diverse LLM backbones demonstrate PEAR significantly improves average accuracy over the strongest debate baselines. The code is at https://github.com/EVIEHub/PEAR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PEAR，一种置换等变自适应路由多智能体辩论协议，通过动态重新配置通信角色和稀疏拓扑来减少位置偏见和不均衡影响，提升LLM辩论可靠性。理论证明该路由是等变稀疏路由器，实验在四个推理基准和六个LLM骨干上显著提高平均准确率。
Motivation: 固定拓扑的多智能体辩论存在持久位置偏见、放大不可靠智能体和角色分配敏感性问题。
Method: PEAR在推理时动态切换智能体到角色的分配，基于演化智能体状态构建稀疏拓扑，实现置换等变的自适应路由。
Result: 在四个推理基准和六个LLM骨干上，PEAR相比最强辩论基线显著提升平均准确率。
Conclusion: PEAR通过动态路由有效解决多智能体辩论中的偏见和不均衡问题，理论保证泛化，代码开源。

papers.title: A Viscosity Semigroup Framework for Stable Image Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Starting from the axiomatic formulation of scale-space theory, we develop a viscosity-solution framework for multiscale image representations arising from degenerate elliptic-parabolic partial differential equations. Rather than introducing a new semigroup theory, we work within the standard viscosity-solution setting, using comparison principles to obtain well-posedness, uniqueness, and contraction in the supremum norm. This perspective is used to motivate a hybrid reconstruction operator in which a learned inverse map is followed by a nonlinear diffusion evolution. At the continuous level, the diffusion operator satisfies non-expansiveness, which provides stability for the reconstruction process; this framework is then evaluated on a CT-based mesothelioma classification task, where it attains an AUC of 0.875 with negligible variation across epochs, while the baseline model acquires AUC values from 0.49 to 0.80 without a clear convergence pattern. These observations are consistent with the stabilizing role suggested by the discussed viscosity theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从尺度空间理论的公理化表述出发，针对退化椭圆-抛物偏微分方程导出的多尺度图像表示，建立了粘性解框架。通过比较原理获得了适定性、唯一性和上确界范数下的压缩性。该框架启发了一种混合重建算子：先使用学习到的逆映射，再执行非线性扩散演化。在连续层面上，扩散算子满足非扩张性，为重建过程提供了稳定性。在基于CT的间皮瘤分类任务上，该方法AUC达到0.875且跨epoch变化极小，而基线模型AUC从0.49到0.80波动且无清晰收敛模式。作者认为这些观察与粘性理论所暗示的稳定作用一致。
Motivation: 现有图像重建方法常缺乏理论稳定性保证，尤其当引入学习组件时。本文旨在利用粘性解理论为多尺度图像表示提供一个严格的理论框架，并基于此设计具有稳定性的重建算子。
Method: 基于粘性解框架，提出混合重建算子：先应用一个学习得到的逆映射，再执行一个非线性扩散演化。扩散算子被设计为满足非扩张性（非扩张性保证稳定性）。在CT图像上进行评估。
Result: 在CT-based间皮瘤分类任务上，使用该框架的方法AUC达到0.875且跨epoch变化极小，而基线（无稳定化）的AUC从0.49到0.80波动且无收敛模式，表明方法显著提升了稳定性和性能。
Conclusion: 粘性解框架为图像重建提供了理论上的稳定性保证，实验验证了其在实际任务中的有效性。未来可扩展到其他逆问题或医学成像任务。

papers.title: Analysis and Prediction of At-Risk Students Using Machine Learning Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Student attrition represents a significant challenge for higher education institutions because it impacts both academic results and financial viability. Machine learning provides an effective solution to identify students who require assistance before they leave their academic programs. The research investigates how machine learning approaches enable institutions to predict student withdrawal and enrollment cancellation through data-driven insights for strategic decisionmaking. The evaluation of models includes Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Support Vector Machines (SVM), and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) based on academic performance and demographic data and enrollment records. The results show that logistic regression and linear SVM models produced the highest accuracy which demonstrates ML's capability to detect students at risk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了利用机器学习算法预测高等教育中面临辍学风险的学生，旨在通过数据驱动的方法为机构提供早期干预支持。评估了逻辑回归、随机森林、支持向量机和K近邻等模型，其中逻辑回归和线性SVM取得了最高准确率。
Motivation: 学生流失对高校的学术成果和财务可持续性构成挑战，亟需有效方法提前识别需要帮助的学生。
Method: 基于学生学业表现、人口统计数据和注册记录，构建并比较了逻辑回归、随机森林、支持向量机和K近邻四种机器学习模型。
Result: 逻辑回归和线性SVM模型取得了最高的预测准确率，表明机器学习在识别风险学生方面的有效性。
Conclusion: 研究证实机器学习能够为高校提供数据驱动的决策支持，用于预测学生辍学或取消注册，以实施针对性干预。

papers.title: Specifying AI-SDLC Processes: A Protocol Language for Human-Agent Boundaries
papers.abstract_en: AI agents now participate as first-class team members across the software development lifecycle, yet no specification language exists for expressing the human-agent responsibility boundaries, approval gates, and governance constraints this collaboration requires. Existing approaches encode process in agent prompts (subject to drift), target adjacent domains (workflow management, business processes), or address only fragments (access control, approval gates). We propose a domain-specific language for specifying AI-SDLC processes as protocols, with formal syntax, well-formedness conditions, operational semantics, and enforcement invariants. The language distinguishes policy (declared intent) from mechanism (structural enforcement), enabling implementations to bound process non-determinism through primitives such as validation tokens and capability boundaries. Three results follow. A failure rate analysis shows that structural enforcement bounds system failure rates at a weighted product of agent and validator rates, while behavioral compliance permits cumulative or near-saturating growth. The 2+N team pattern (two human-in-control roles plus N specialized agent members) formalizes classical Separation of Duties for AI-SDLC. Kleene closure of orchestration loops and reflexive protocol-adherence validation emerge as design properties rather than special-case constructs. We position the contribution against multi-agent frameworks (MetaGPT), workflow specification (FlowAgent, BPMN extensions), and capability-based security (SAGA): the novelty lies in the specific integration, not any single primitive. A working implementation demonstrates feasibility; empirical evaluation is future work.
papers.comment: Position paper with formal specification, failure rate analysis, and feasibility demonstration. Companion empirical paper and open-source implementation forthcoming
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于AI-SDLC（AI软件开发生命周期）过程的协议语言，该语言通过形式化语法、良构条件、操作语义和执行不变式来定义人类与智能体之间的责任边界、审批门控和治理约束。语言将策略（政策声明意图）与机制（结构强制）分离，通过验证令牌和能力边界等原语约束过程非确定性。论文包含故障率分析、2+N团队模式（两个人类控制角色加N个专业智能体成员）以及Kleene闭包等贡献。
Motivation: 现有AI智能体已参与软件开发生命周期，但缺乏一种用于表达人机责任边界、审批门控和治理约束的规范语言；现有方法依赖于智能体提示（易漂移）、面向相邻领域或仅处理碎片化问题。
Method: 提出一种用于AI-SDLC过程的领域特定语言（DSL），作为协议进行规范，具有形式化语法、良构条件、操作语义和执行不变式。语言通过验证令牌和能力边界等原语区分策略与机制，实现结构强制。
Result: 故障率分析表明结构强制将系统故障率限定为智能体和验证器速率的加权乘积，而行为合规允许累积或近饱和增长。2+N团队模式形式化AI-SDLC中的职责分离，Kleene闭包等作为设计属性出现。
Conclusion: 该工作的创新点在于特定集成而非单个原语，已有实现证明可行性，实证评估为未来工作。

papers.title: Estimating Learners' Skill Acquisition Without Temporal Information
papers.abstract_en: Recent research in educational data mining, especially knowledge tracing, has focused on predicting learners' future knowledge states to support adaptive instruction. However, in many real-world educational settings, learning data are often available only as single-time-point assessments without temporal information, making existing time-series-based approaches difficult to apply. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for predicting future skill acquisition using only snapshot data. Specifically, we address the problem of predicting the next skill to be acquired from skill mastery patterns estimated by cognitive diagnostic models (CDMs). In the absence of temporal information, we exploit inclusion relations among learners' skill sets to induce a pseudo-temporal ordering, interpreting expanding skill sets as a proxy for learning progression. To efficiently approximate unobserved acquisition paths, we introduce a neural model that captures latent skill acquisition dynamics through expected skill increments. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms baseline approaches, with particularly strong advantages as the skill space becomes larger. These results indicate that meaningful skill acquisition patterns can be inferred from snapshot data alone, providing a practical framework for adaptive learning support in data-constrained educational environments.
papers.journal_ref: AIED 2026 - 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education, Jun 2026, Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无时间信息的学习者技能获取预测框架，利用认知诊断模型估计的技能掌握模式，通过技能集的包含关系构造伪时间顺序，并使用神经网络捕捉潜在技能获取动态。实验表明在合成和真实数据集上优于基线方法，尤其在大技能空间中优势明显。
Motivation: 现有知识追踪方法依赖时间序列数据，但许多现实教育场景仅提供单次评估的快照数据，缺乏时间信息，限制了传统方法的应用。
Method: 利用认知诊断模型（CDM）估计技能掌握模式，通过技能集的包含关系诱导伪时间顺序，将技能集扩张视为学习进程的代理；引入神经网络模型通过期望技能增量近似未观测的获取路径。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，所提方法一致优于基线方法，在技能空间较大时优势尤为显著。
Conclusion: 从快照数据中推断有意义的技能获取模式是可行的，为数据受限的教育环境中的自适应学习支持提供了实用框架。

papers.title: Signals in the Noise: Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) for AI Loss of Control Detection
papers.abstract_en: This paper applies open-source intelligence (OSINT) and cyber threat intelligence (CTI) methodologies to the problem of detecting AI systems operating outside human control. Drawing on a cross-disciplinary literature review and 14 semi-structured expert interviews conducted under Chatham House Rule, the paper develops two threat models, identifies a range of observable traces, and proposes an institutional architecture for monitoring. The research finds that OSINT-based detection of loss of control is partially feasible and worth building now. Three detection vectors emerge as highest priority: transcript-based collection of user-reported AI behaviour; infrastructure correlation for unexpected external connections or replication; and output analysis for capability concealment. The paper argues for a dedicated, federated international monitoring capability anchored in OSINT methods and independent of frontier AI developers, and identifies sustained non-industry funding as the highest-leverage structural intervention available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用开源情报（OSINT）和网络威胁情报（CTI）方法检测人工智能系统失控问题。通过跨学科文献综述和14次专家访谈，开发了两种威胁模型，识别了可观测痕迹，并提出监控架构。研究发现基于OSINT的失控检测部分可行且值得构建，优先检测向量包括用户报告行为、基础设施关联和输出分析。论文主张建立独立于AI开发者的联邦式国际监控能力，并指出非行业持续资助是关键结构性干预。
Motivation: 当前缺乏独立于AI开发者的外部监控方法来检测AI系统失控，论文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 采用OSINT和CTI方法，结合文献综述和14次Chatham House Rule下的半结构化专家访谈，构建威胁模型并识别可观测线索，提出监控架构。
Result: OSINT检测失控部分可行；优先检测向量为：基于转录的用户报告收集、基础设施关联分析（如意外外部连接或复制）以及输出分析（如能力隐藏）。
Conclusion: 主张建立独立的联邦式国际监控能力，并强调非行业持续资助是最关键的杠杆干预。

papers.title: Understanding Privacy by Formalizing It
papers.abstract_en: In most of the modern societies, there is a broad consensus regarding the need for promoting privacy and thus placing restrictions on technological-including AI-developments to protect people's right to privacy. In order to meet these expectations on the algorithmic level, first we need to make the concept of privacy and the related or derived rights formally specified. However, the notion of (the right to) privacy is subject to different interpretations. In this paper, we use a multi-modal logic to provide an initial formalization of different theories, basic principles and their implications investigating the right to privacy as an epistemic right within the theory of normative positions.
papers.comment: Published in Proceedings of the 17th International Conference on Juris-informatics, JURISIN 2023
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用多模态逻辑对隐私权进行形式化建模，探讨不同隐私理论及其规范含义，将隐私视为一种认知权利（epistemic right）置于规范位置理论（theory of normative positions）中分析。
Motivation: 隐私概念在算法层面缺乏精确的规范定义，难以在AI系统中实现保护；需要形式化表达不同隐私理论以弥合法律与技术之间的鸿沟。
Method: 采用多模态逻辑（multi-modal logic）对隐私权的不同解释进行初始形式化，并分析其基本原则与推论。
Result: 提出了一个将隐私权作为认知权利进行形式化的框架，能够在规范位置理论中表达不同隐私理论的基本结构。
Conclusion: 该形式化为在算法层面实现隐私保护提供了概念基础，但尚处于初步阶段，需要进一步细化与扩展。
